1.1: Elohimin Semtilin van le leiset asem tai.
1.2: Leiset chu agong bei le ahomkeu ahin, muthim chun twipi thuhtah chu akhukhum ahin, Hiche twipi chung'a chu Elohim lhagao chu ana lhale ahi.
1.3: Elohimin; “Vah hung umhen,” atin, Vah chu aum tai.
1.4: Elohimin vah chu aven pha asah e. Chule Elohimin vah chu muthim akon in asep khen tai.
1.5: Elohim'in vah chu sun asah in muthim chu jan asah tai. Hiche apat chun nilhah le jingkah ahung umdohtan hichu nikho masa pen ahung hitai.
1.6: Hichun Elohimin aseiyin, “Twipi sukhen dingin, vanthamjol hung kidal hen lang Van, twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah sukhen hen,” atin.
1.7: Hiti chun asei bang in aum in, van twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah asukhen tai.”
1.8: Elohimin onghom chu vanthamjol asah in, hichun nilhah le jingkah achedoh kitin ahileh nikho nina ahi tai.
1.9: Chule Elohimin aseiye, “Vantham jol'a twi umjouse chu mun khat'a kikhol khom hen lang chule tolgo lai um doh hen,” ati. Asei bang chun aum jeng tai.
1.10: Elohimin tolgo lai chu leiset asah in chule twi jouse kikhol na mun chu twikhanglen asah e. Elohimin aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
1.11: Chuin Elohim'in aseiye, “Leiset in hamphung ho, amu nei hamphung, agathei hamhing chi chom chom leh thingphung aga amunei ho, hiche ho chun ama ama chi dungjui cheh ahin sepdoh kit diu ahi,” ati. Hiti chun ahung kehdoh tauve.
1.12: Leiset'in hamphung thingphung ama ama chi dung juiyin ahung kehdoh in, agathei amu nei thingphung ama ama chi dungjuiyin ahung kehdoh tauvin ahi. Elohim'in aven pha asalheh jeng in ahi.
1.13: Nilhah khat le jingkah khat achekit in nithum alhing tai.
1.14: Chuin Elohim'in aseiye, “Sun le jan sepkhen dingin vanthomjol avah thei vahho hung kigol uhenlang, hiche ho chu kum kihei chin melchihnan jong, nikho simtoh nan jong chule kum simtoh nan jong pang'u hen.
1.15: Chujong le hiche ho chu vana vanthamjol'a kon in leiset salvah-in pang uhen,’’ atin ahileh, hiti chun aum tai.
1.16: Hiche achun Elohimin vah alen cheh ni asem in, vah alenjo chu sunlaiya thunei ding in apansah-in, chule vah aneojo chu janlaiya thunei ding in apansah tai; hiti chun ahsi ho jong ahin sem tai.
1.17: Elohimin vahho chu vanthamjol'a pat in leiset salvah din apansah tai.
1.18: Sunlaiya thunei ding, janlaiya thunei ding, chule khovah le muthim sepkhen ding in apansah tan ahi. Elohimin aven ahileh pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
1.19: Hichu nikho li alhin ni ahi.
1.20: Elohimin aseiye, “Twija kon in nga ho leh ganhing ahingthei dangho umhen, chuleh vanthamjol'a jong vachate ajat kimsoh in hung leng leu hen,’’ati.
1.21: Hiti chun Elohimin twikhanglen'a ganhing ahing thei jouse ahona kijot le ding in asem in, hiche ho chun twi a kidil sah sah-uvin, ama ama jat cheh in alha uvin ahi, chujong le ajat jat in alhanei vachate jong asem in ahi. Hichu Elohimin aven pha asalheh jeng in ahi.
1.22: Elohimin abonchauvin phatthei aboh in, “Hinpha uvin lang chule pung uvin, twikhanglen'a twi lah dimset uvin, chule leiset chunga vachate jong pung u-hen,’’ ati.
1.23: Chuin nilhah khat le jingkah khat achen ni nga lhinna ahi tai.
1.24: Chuin Elohimin aseiye, “Leiset in ama akon in sa jat chom chom hin hingdoh hen! Ama ama jat dungjui cheh in, vah ngoi thei gancha, tol'a kithol ganhing, leh gamsa ho jong hihen” ati. Hiti chun aum jeng tai.
1.25: Chuin leiset chunga gamsa ho ama ama jat cheh in chule gancha ho jong ama ama jat cheh in a-opma kithol ajat jat in asem e. Elohimin hiche ho chu aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
1.26: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Eihon mihem ho, eiho lim pu'in sem u-hitin. Amaho chun twikhanglen sunga nga ho jouse chunga thunei diu, vanlai jol'a leng le vacha ho chule vah ngoi thei gancha ho, le gam sa ho, chule a opa a kithol chengse chung'a thunei vaihom in pang uhen,” ati.
1.27: Hiti chun Elohimin ama lim mong mong in mihem chu asem in, Elohim lim tobang bang in ama lim chu asem tai, pasal le numei asem doh tan ahi.
1.28: Elohimin amani chu phatthei aboh in amani jah'a aseiye, “Chiphalhon in chule pung jing lhon in simsen louvin leiset chung hinlo dimset un, chule nangni noiya vaihom na umhen, vanlaijol a leng vachate chunga jong chule twikhanglen'a ahingthei jouse chunga hijong le aboncha ganhing namkim hihen chule leiset chunga lhale ganhing jouse hile achung uva thunei vaihom in pang lhon tan,’’ ati.
1.29: Elohimin hitin jong seiye, “Ve lhonnin keiman leiset chunga muchi gathei phung jouse le thingphung gathei jouse aboncha hi nangni kihinso theina dinga kapeh lhon nahitai.
1.30: Chule leiset chunga um gamsa jouse hihen chunga leng vachate ho hijongle tol'a aop'a kithol ganhing jouse hijongle ah ahaithei hinna nei jouse aneh dinguva hamhing jouse kapeh doh ahi tai,’’ atile, hitobang chun aum tai.
1.31: Chuin Elohimin asemsa chengse chu abonchan aven, “Apha lheh jeng in ahi,” hichea chun nilhah le jingkah khat ahung um doh in nigup lhinni ahung hitai.

2.1: Hiti chun van le leiset chule asunga thil umjouse chu loupi tah a sem chai ahi tai.
2.2: Hichun ni sagi lhin nin Elohimin athilsem chu abonchan achaiyin, hiti chun a thilsem ho jouse akon in ama akicholdo tai.
2.3: Hiche ni sagi lhinni chu Elohimin phatthei aboh in chule atheng ahi tin aphongdoh tai, ajeh chu athilsem le anatoh jousea kon'a akicholdo ni ahi.
2.4: Hiche hi van le leiset ahung kisemdoh a akhanggui hung kipatdoh dan ho chu hiti hi ana hi. Yaweh Elohimin leiset le van ahinsem patni chun,
2.5: Leiset chunga tollhang a jong hamphung keh doh loulai ahi. Ajeh chu Yaweh Elohimin gotwi leiset chunga ajuhsah loulai ahin chule hia chu koima natong ding umlou lai ana hi.
2.6: Ahin leiset'a konin twimei ahung kaiyin chule leichung jouse chu twiyin achapnou vin ahi.
2.7: Chuin Yaweh Elohimin leichunga konin vutvai achun mihem asemin, chule a nahhom'a hinna hu alhakhum a ahile mihem chu hinna nei ahung hitai.
2.8: Chuphat in Elohiminjong niso lama Eden hon aphut dohin hiche achun asem sa mihem chu akoi tai.
2.9: Chuin Yaweh Elohimin leichung'a kon in vetnom nom umle neh ding thingga namkim akedoh sah in ahi, chule honlai lung'a chun hinna thingphung jong chule ase le apha hetna thing-phung jong akesah in ahi.
2.10: Hiche Eden hon'a kon chun honlei chapnou jing ding in vadung along in, vadung chu vadung li in ahung long khen'in vadung li asohdoh e.
2.11: Vadung khatna chu ahile Pishon ahin, hiche chu sana kimuna vadung ahin Havilah gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
2.12: Hiche gam'a sana kimu ho chu ahoi thei lheh in a namtui jah nom umtah chule song namtui jong akimui.
2.13: Vadung ni lhinna chu amin Gihon ahin, hiche vadung chu Cush gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
2.14: Vadung thum lhinna chu ahile Haddekel ahin, hiche vadung hin sah solam gam'a Asshur gam pumpia long ahin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi.
2.15: Chuin Yaweh Elohimin amisem dohpa chu Eden hon sunga apuilut in hiche hon'a natong ding le avetup ding in apansah tai.
2.16: Ahin Elohimin mipa koma athupeh chu, “Nang man hiche honsunga theiga ho khu nadei dei naneh thei cheh ahi.
2.17: Hinlah nangman hon lailung'a ase le apha hetna theiga vang naneh lou beh ding, hichu naneh nini, na thitei tei ding,’’ ahi.
2.18: Chujong le Yaweh Elohimin aseiye, “Mihempa achanga a-umhi apha poi hijeh chun keiman a umkhom pi ding khat sempeh ing kate,’’ ati.
2.19: Chuin Yaweh Elohimin leivui chu leingan a sosah in leichunga ganhing namkim asem in chule vacha ho chung lam'a alensah in chuin hiche ho jouse hi amin ipi pi asah em tin mihempa kom'a ahinpui khom in hiche a mihem pan amin vo najouse chu tuni geia amin a pangden ahi tai.
2.20: Hiti chun mihempa in ganhing namkim chu aminvo cheh in, chunga lengthei vachateho leh gamsa jouse jong aminvo soh keiyin ahi. Ahinlah mihempa kithopi ding akimu doh hih laiye.
2.21: Hijeh chun Yaweh Elohimin mihempa chu a imut-mil sah in a imut-mil kah chun Elohimin anahgu khat aladoh in anung chu aphe in atom jol peh in ahi.
2.22: Chuin Yaweh Elohimin Adam nahgu a lah doh'a kon chun numei khat asemdoh in amanu chu Adam kom'a ahin puilut in ahi.
2.23: Hichun mihempan aseiye, “Amanu hi keima gu akon'a kisemdoh ahin, chule aphevou jeng jong keima phevou ahin, amanu hi tu apat'a numei kiti ding ahi, ajeh chu amanu hi pasal'a konna kiladoh ahi,” ati.
2.24: Hijeh a chu pasal in anu le apa a dalhah a aji numei'a beh ding chule amani chu tipum khat kiti lhon ding ahiye.
2.25: Ahin hichepet chun pasalpa ahin numeinu ahin ani gel lhon a sagoh keuva um lhon ahin, ahi vang'in jachat na anei lhon pon ahi.

3.1: Elohim thilsem jouse laha gul hi a lungthim thempen ahi. Nikhat chu aman numeinu adong in, “Elohimin honsunga theiga jouse naneh thei lhon lou beh ding ahi tia asei mong em?” ati.
3.2: Numei nu chun gul jaha keini'n “Eden hon sunga theiga jouse kaneh thei lhon ding ahi nai.”
3.3: Ahin Elohimin hitin aseiye, “Hon lailung a theiga vangkhu naneh lhon lou hel ding, lo jong nalo lhon lou hel ding ahi. Ahin iti ham khat'a nalo lhon a naneh lhon le nathi jeng lhon ding ahi,” tin aseiye.
3.4: Hinlah Satan in numeinu jah a aseiyin, “Nathi lhon loubeh ding ahi.
3.5: Ajeh chu Elohimin ahet ahi hichu naneh nini lhonle namit lhon hung hahdoh intin Elohim toh nabah lhon ding thilpha le thilse hetheiya naum lhon ding ahi ti Elohimin ahet jeh'a asei ahi bouve,” atitai.
3.6: Hiche a chun numeinun theiga chu aven ahile neh dinga tui chule mitvet dinga jong vetnom nom um, chule mi achihsah jeng ding jeh chun ahaduchat cheh tai. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilo in anetan chule a pasalpa jong them khat apen amapan jong ala in ane tai.
3.7: Hiche apat chun amit lhon chu ahung hahdoh in tahsa sagoh keo ahilhon chu aki hechen lhon tai. Hichun thingna akilo lhon in atahsa lhon chu akisel na lhon tan ahi.
3.8: Chuin nisa dai lhah lamin honsunga Yaweh Elohim awgin chu ajalhon in hijeh chun hon lailung'a thinglah a chun amani tah Yaweh Elohim masanga akisel mang lhon tai.
3.9: Ahivang in Yaweh Elohimin mihempa chu akouvin, “Adam hoiya umna hi tam?” atile,
3.10: Adam in jong adonbut in “Keiman nangma honsung'a na hung chu ka hen ahile ka sagoh keo ka hijeh a ka kichat'a kisela kahi,” ati.
3.11: Hichun Elohimin jong aseiye, koi ham nangma sa gohkeova na um'e tia na seipeh a chu? Honsung'a theiga nehih in kati chu naneh hitam? atile,
3.12: Adam in adonbut in, “Keiman ka um khompi dinga nangman neipeh numeinu hin theiga chu themkhat eipen keiman kana netai,” ati.
3.13: Chuphat in Yaweh Elohimin numeinu jah'a aseiye, “Nang in ipi dinga hitobang pihi nabol hitam!” atile numei nun adonbut'in, “Hiche gul hin eijol jol phat'a kaneh ahi bouve,” ati.
3.14: Hichun Yaweh Elohimin gul jah'a, “Nangman hiche nana boldoh jeh in, ganhing jouse lah a nanghi sapset nachan ding na hinkho lhung keiya na oipoh'a na kithol tho ding, chule na hinkho sunga leivui naneh ding ahi.
3.15: Keiman nangle numeinu chilhah kah a kidouna kakoi ding, amapa chun nangma hi na luchang avohchip a; nangman amapa kengphang na chuh peh ding ahi,”ati.
3.16: Elohimin numeinu jah'a chun hitin a seiye, “Keiman na naovop hahsatna kabe peh ding, nao-sonat gentheiya cha nahin doh ding ahi. Najipa chung'a vai nahom nom jing ding, ahi vang'a najipan nang chunga vai ahop ding ahi,”ati.
3.17: Chuin Yaweh Elohimin Adam jah'a hitin ati, “Nangman naji thu nangaiya naneh louhel ding ahi tia ka thupehsa theiga naneh tah jeh in nangma jeh a leiset hi sapset chang ahitai. Chule na hinkho damlai sungse a gimna le genthei thohpum pum'a neh na kihol a naneh ding ahi.
3.18: Chule nang doudin ling le mi-at thei jong hung kehdoh intin, chule nangma anche louhing a naki vahding ahi.
3.19: Na ti-ul na mai ja long pum'a anneh na kihol'a na neh ding, chule nangma leiset a kisemdoh nahin leiset naleso kit ding ahiye,” ati.
3.20: Hichun Adam in ajinu chu amin Eve asah tai. Ajeh chu amanu mijouse hung pen dohna minu ahi tan ahi.
3.21: Hichun Yaweh Elohimin savun akon in Adam le Eve ding von akhui peh in amani chu asilpeh in ahi.
3.22: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Tuapat'a hi Adam hi eiho lah'a khat tobang ahung hi tan, thilpha le thilse hethei jin a um tai, chule tunjong aman hinna thingphung ga khu kilo intin hin ne lhon leh tonsot'a hing den ding ahi tai ati.”
3.23: Hiche'a pat chun Yaweh Elohimin Amani chu Eden hon a kon'in anodoh in, Chuleh Adam chu ahung kisemdohna leiset loulhou dingin soldoh tan ahi.
3.24: Hiti chun Elohimin Adam anodoh jouvin, Eden hon nisolam'a hinna thingphung ngah ding in vantil Cherubim chu achen sah in, chule chemjam kou jeju chu akipei kimvel le sahtan ahi.

4.1: Chujouvin Adam le Eve akitimat lhon in ahile Eve'in nao ahin vopin Cain chu ahung peng tai, hiche'a chun amanu'n hitin aseiye, Elohim phatthei bohna jal in cha pasal khat kanei tai ati.
4.2: Phat chomkhat jou chun Eve chun chapa Abel ahing kit tai, hichun khonung in chapang teni chu ahung khanglen lhon tan, Abel chu kelngoi ching in ahung pang in, Cain vang chu loubol mi ahung hi tan ahi.
4.3: Phat phabep jouvin Cain in alousohga alhun phat in alousohga phabep ahin pon Elohim a dingin kilhaina ahung sem tai.
4.4: Hitobang ma chun Abel in jong akelngoi lah'a apeng masa athao pen tah khat chu Elohim ading in ahin pedoh tai, Hichun Elohimin Abel lam joh aven athilto jong kipahtah in asanpeh tai.
4.5: Hinlah Elohimin Cain thilto maicham chu asanpeh tapoi, hijeh chun Cain chu hatah in alunghang in akaiku jeng in ahi.
4.6: Hiche phat chun Elohimin Cain jah a, “Ibola nangle nang kilunghan nahi ham? chule ibola namai thim jeng a ham?
4.7: Thilpha bol dinga kilomho chu nabol le na kisan pehda ding ham? Ahin thilpha boldinga kilomho chu na bolnom loule kichih theiyin chonsetnan naval lhum ding ahitai. Hiche hohi na chinpha ding joh ahi,” ati.
4.8: Nikhat chu Cain in asopipa Abel jah'a “Eini thinglhang lam'a che hite atin, gamlang agei lhon phat in Cain chu asopipa Abel chunga achun athat tai.”
4.9: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yaweh Elohimin Cain jah a, “Nasopipa Abel hoiya um hitam?” atile Cain'in jong adonbut in, “Kahe poi, Keima hi ka sopi pa Abel ching tup ka him?” ati.
4.10: Hichun Elohimin jong Cain jah'a “Ipi nabol hitam? Na sopi pa Abel thisan chu tol'a kon'in keima angsung gei in ahung peng in ahi.
4.11: Hijeh chun tua patna nangma hi leiset chunga sapset na noija uma nahitai, na sopi pa Abel thisan in na chup ahitai.
4.12: Leiset a konna nangma dinga ga imacha pung ding ahi tapoi, itobang in natong jong leh chun nangman leiseta in mun neilou gamvah mangpa na kiti ding ahi.”
4.13: Chuphat in Cain chun Elohim henga aseiye, “Keima gotna kachan hi kei thoh jou hoi ahi poi.
4.14: Vetan tunin nangma akon in neidel mangtai, nang in leichunga umna neilou neihi sahtai, tua pat'a hi koihijongle eitoh khapen pen chun eitha ding ahi tai.”
4.15: Elohimin adonbut in, “Ahipoi koi tobang nangma hinkho sumang dinga kigo a aumle keiman ama chunga sagi vei ka phulah ding ahi.” Hichea chun Elohimin Cain chu koiman atha louna ding in Cain chunga melchihna khat akoipeh in ahi.
4.16: Hichea kon chun Cain in Elohim kom adalhan Eden niso lam a Nod muna chun acheng tai.
4.17: Cain chun ajinu aki timatpin ahile nao ahin vop kit tan hiche nao chu Enoch ahi. Chuin Cain in phat phabep jouvin khopi khat ahinsem dohin, achapa min aput sah in hiche khopi min chu Enoch asah tai.
4.18: Enoch in chapa Irad ahing in, Irad chun Mehujael ahing in, Mehujael chun Methushael ahing in, Methushael chun Lamech ahing'e.
4.19: Lamech chun ji numei ni anei jin amasa nu chu ahile Adah ahin chule anina nu chu Zillah ahiye.
4.20: Adah in Jabal ahing in, amahi ahiye, khoilupon in a chenga gancha chingho ding'a apau chu.
4.21: Chule asopi pa min chu Jubal ahin, ama chu lathem gosem mut them masa pen ahiye.
4.22: Zillah jong chun Tubal-cain ahing in, ama chun manchah ding abonchan sum-eng jong thih jong ahin kheng'e. Chule Tubal-cain chun sopi numei khat anei jin amin Naamah ahi.
4.23: Chujou vin nikhat chu Lamech chun ajite ni jaha hitin a seiye, “Vo Adah le Zillah ka aw kasei ngai lhon in, ‘Ajeh chu pasal khat in eimavo jeh in ka that'in golhang khat'in eiden jeh-in ka that tai.
4.24: Koi tabang mikhat in Cain chu atha le sagi vei gotna chang ding ahile keima hinkho lading koi tobang aumle som sagi vei gotna chang ding joh ahiye.”
4.25: Chuin Adam chun ajinu akitimat pikit in ahile amanun chapa khat ahing kit in, amin Seth asah tai; ijeh inem itile amanun hitin aseiye, “Elohimin chapa eipeh kit hi Abel khel a ei kipe ah ahi, ajeh chu Cain thapa khel ding in eipe tai,” ati.
4.26: Seth chu mipi lhing ahung hiphat in chapa khat aneiyin amin Enosh asah-e. Hiche apat chun mipi hon Elohim chu amin pan in ahou pan tauvin ahi.

5.1: Hiche hohi Adam te insung khanggui umdan kijihna lekhabu ahi. Elohimin mihem asem chu ama lim tobang din asem in ahi.
5.2: Elohimin numei le pasal ana semdoh in aman amisem doh teni chu phatthei aboh in chuin amani chu mihem asah tai.
5.3: Adam chu kum jakhat le kum somthum alhinin ama limle ama mel to kilou cha khat ahing in hichepa chu amin Seth asah tai.
5.4: Seth apen jou chun Adam chu kum jaget tabang ahin be kit in, chu achun Adam in cha numei le pasal anei be na laiye.
5.5: Adam chu kum jako le kum somthum ahing nomsel in hiche jou chun ama athi tai.
5.6: Seth chu kum jakhat le kum nga ahi chun ama chu Enosh pa ahung hi tai.
5.7: Enosh pen jou chun Seth chu kum jaget le kum sagi ahin be nalai in chu achun aman cha numei le pasal adang ahin be nalaiye.
5.8: Hichun Seth chu kum jako le kumsom le kumni ahing in hiche jou chun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
5.9: Enosh chu kum somko ahi chun ama chu Kenan pa ahung hi tai.
5.10: Kenan pen jou chun, Enosh chu kum jaget le kum som le kum nga ahing na laiyin chujou chun cha numei le cha pasal ahing na laiye.
5.11: Enosh chu kum jako le kum nga ahing in ama athi tai.
5.12: Kenan chu kum som sagi alhing in ama chu Mahalalel pa ahung hitai.
5.13: Mahalalel pen jou chun, Kenan chu kum jaget le kum somli ahing na laiyin, chule aman chapa dang le chanu dang jong anei be nalaiye.
5.14: Kenan chu kum jako le kum som gei ahing in chuin ama hinkho abeitai.
5.15: Hichun Mahalalel chu kum somgup le kum nga alhing in ama chu Jared pa ahung hi tai.
5.16: Jared pen jou chun, Mahalalel chu kum jaget le kum som thum jen ahing nalaiyin chule cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
5.17: Hichun Mahalalel kum jaget le kum somko le kum nga gei ahing in hichun ama leiset hinkho abeitai.
5.18: Jared chu kum jakhat le kum somgup le kum ni alhin in ama chu Enoch pa ahung hitai.
5.19: Enoch pen jou chun, Jared chu kum jaget gei ahingin, chuban in chapa le chanu dang jong ahing na laiye.
5.20: Jared chu kum jako le kum som gup le kumni ahing in, hichun ama aleiset hinkho abeitai.
5.21: Enoch chu kum som gup le kum nga alhin in ama chu Methuselah pa ahung hitai.
5.22: Methuselah pen jou kum jathum sungin Enoch chu Elohim toh kinai tah in aum jing jeng in chule chapa dangle chanu dang tampi jong ahinbe nalaiye.
5.23: Hiti chun Enoch chu kum jathum le kum somgup le kum nga ahing in ahi.
5.24: Elohim toh kingaitah a umjing ahin nikhat chu ama akimu tapon Elohimin akou doh ahi tai.
5.25: Methuselah chu kum jakhat le kum somget le kum sagi alhin in, ama chu Lamech pa ahung hitai.
5.26: Lamech pen jou chun, Methuselah chu kum jasagi le kum somget le kumni ahing in, hichun aman chapa le chanu dang tamtah anei be nalaiyin ahi.
5.27: Methuselah chu kum jako le kumsom gup le kum ko ahing in hichun ama ahinkho abeitai.
5.28: Hichun Lamech chu kum jakhat le kum som get le kumni alhinin chapa khat ahing in,
5.29: Ama min chu Noah asah in hitin aseiye, “Elohimin agaosapsa gim genthei thoh'a ikhut uva i-tohgim nau hiche leiset'a konna ama hin eitha-ol sah ding'u ahi,”ati.
5.30: Noah pen jou chun, Lamech chu kum ja nga le kum somko le kum nga ahing in hijou chun cha pasal le numei tamtah ahing na laiyin ahi.
5.31: Lamech chu kum jasagi le kum som sagi le kum sagi ahing in, hichun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
5.32: Noah chu kum ja nga alhin'in, ama chun Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahing in ahi.

6.1: Hiche achun leiset chunga mihem ahung pung pan tan ahile alah uva chanu jong tampi ahing tauve.
6.2: Chuin Elohim chapate chun numei hoitah ho chu amu uvin ama hon adei thei lheh jeng uvin, hijeh chun adei dei akilhen uvin ajinu ding in akipui tauvin ahi.
6.3: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Ka lhagao mihem sunga atonsot kumkho in chengden thei deh ponte, ajeh chu ama tahsaphe bou ahin, ahin nikho jong kum jakhat le kum somni bou hiding ahiye,” ati.
6.4: Hiche lai chun leiset chunga Nephilim miho ana um uvin, chujong le Elohim chapate mihem Chanute henga ahunglut nung'u chun amahon jong cha ahin peh tauve; hiche ho chu khanglui laiya mihat te ana hiuvin, chule mi minthang ho chu ana hiuvin ahi.
6.5: Elohimin leiset chunga mihem ho setna chu akhol chen jing in, chule Elohimin mihem ho thil phalou agel'u ahi loule lungthima ase abolnom ho'u chu aboncha aphalou jeng ahi chu amu doh tai.
6.6: Hichun Yaweh Elohimin mihem asem'a leiset chung'a aumsah hatah in akisih tai.
6.7: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Keiman kasem doh mihem hohi leiset chunga kon'a kasuh mang ding ahitai, mihem jouse alen aneo, gancha alen aneo tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse chule chunglam a leng vachate ahi uvin, ajeh chu hicheng pi kana semdoh hi ka kisih lheh tai,” ati.
6.8: Hinlah Noah chu Elohim lungdei lam in aum jing in ahi.
6.9: Hiche hi Noah le a insung mite umchan thusim ahiye, Noah chu mi chonpha, hiche khanglai'a chu leichung'a mona neilou va um chu Noah bou anahi, chule Noah chu Elohim toh ki lhakang louhel le Elohim toh kihou mat jing mi ahi.
6.10: Noah chun chate thum aneiyin amaho chu ahi le Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uve.
6.11: Hichun Elohimin leiset chung ahinven ahile mihem ho phatlou na le kitahlou jeng amudoh tan ahi.
6.12: Elohimin jong thilpha lou jouse le thudih louva vannoi pumpia mihemte khat cheh a jong asetnao chu amudoh sohhel tai.
6.13: Hichun Elohimin Noah jah'a aseiyin, “Keiman tua hi hinna neiya avahle thei jouse ka suhmang ding ahi tai. Ajeh chu amaho jeh hin leiset chunga pumhat'a kino na jeng adim tan ahi, vetan kei man abonchauva leiset toh ka suhmang tha ding ahi tauve.
6.14: Nangman Gopher thingin kong innei lentah khat kisem in lang, kong innei sunga chun indan adan adan in khah tanin, chuteng asung le apo twilut na thei lai jouse na huhbing sohkei ding ahi.
6.15: Hiche kong chu tong jali le somnga sao hiding, chule asan dan chu tong somsagi le nga a sang hiding, chule avai lam chu tong somli le nga a len hiding ahi.
6.16: Kong innei chu bangkot hong inlang achunglam chu khap somle get in sem inlang kong abanga kotpi hong in lang, indan noi nung danni lhinna, chule dan thum lhinna geiya nasem ding ahi.
6.17: Tun ven kei man leichung jouse hi twisanglen a ka chupsah ding, hichu ganhing ahai thei jouse ahinkho kalah mang ding ahitai. Chule leichung'a umjouse ka suhmang ding ahi.
6.18: Hinlah keiman nangma toh kitep na khat nei ing kating, chujou teng le kongsunga nang nahin, na chapate ahi uvin, najinu chule namou tetoh nabon chauva kong sunga lut tauvin,
6.19: Chule tahsa neiya hing gamsa namkim anu khat le achal khat cheh in kongsunga hin puilut un, ajeh chu twisang hatah ahung let teng na hinso jou thei nadiu ahi.
6.20: Vacha ho akop toni, gancha ho lah a jong ama ama jat dung juiya, tol'a aop'a kithol tho lah a jong ama ama jat dung jui cheh a anu khat le achal khat cheh navah hing dinga nahenga hung kitol lut ding ahi uve.
6.21: Chule nasuhmil theilou ding chu kong sunga naneh dingu an naneh diu ninglhingset a nakipohlut diu nakikhol khom diu ahi, Ajeh chu hiche anneh dingho chu nangho le gancha ho jouse ding ahi,” ati.
6.22: Hichun Noah in jong Elohimin asei peh bang bang in abolpan tan ahi.

7.1: Chuin ima jouse ahina ding bang ahijou phat in Elohimin Noah chu ahoulim pitai. “Nangma le na insung mite kongsunga lut tauvin ajeh chu leiset chunga mihem holah'a mi chonpha thudih achon nang bou nahi”ati.
7.2: Nangman gancha theng lah a konin kop sagi, kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh, chule gancha thenglou lah a kon a jong kop sagi ma kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh ki kailut inlang,
7.3: Chule chunga leng vachate lah a jong kop sagi cheh na puilut ding amaho lah a chu achal khat le anu khat akopto cheh ana puilut ding hichengse chu twisang let a konna nahinso theina dinga navah a chikhai dinga nahing hoi ding ahi.
7.4: Ni sagi jouva pat go hatah a leiset chunga ka juhsah pan ding ahitai, chule go chu ni somli le jan somli sunga ka juhsah ding leiset chunga umjouse le ahing thei jouse ka suh mang hel ding ahi tai,”ati.
7.5: Hiti chun Noah injong Elohimnin athupeh bang bang chun abonchan abolsoh kei tan ahi.
7.6: Leiset chunga twisang ahunglet chun Noah chu kum jagup ana lhingtan ahi.
7.7: Hichun Noah chu achapate toh, ajinu toh, chule amoute toh twisanglen na kon'a ahoidoh theina diuvin kong sunga alut tauve.
7.8: Satheng ho lah a ahin, sa thenglou ho lah a konin jong tol'a kithol thoho lah akonin jong,
7.9: Akop kop a anu khat le achal khat cheh, Elohimin Noah ahoulim pi nabang chun kong sunga chun Noah koma avahlut cheh tauvin ahi.
7.10: Chuin ni sagi lhin jou chun twisanglen go ahung ju pantan, leiset chung chu gotwi in achup tai.
7.11: Noah chu kum jagup alhin kum lhani lhin na ah, leinoi ja twi umjouse ahung put tan, chule vanthamjol apat in hatah in go alon tho tai.
7.12: Ni somli le jan somli sung in go chu tang lou hel'in hatah in ajujom jing tan ahi.
7.13: Hiche nitah chun Noah ahin, Noah chapate Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uvin, Noah jinu ahin, amoute thum ahi uvin abonchauvin kong sunga alut tauve.
7.14: Amaho ahi uvin, kong sunga um gamsa hang ahin insa gancha alen aneo chule tol'a aop'a kitholtho ho jong ama ama jat dungjui cheh in, vachate jong ama ama chilhah dungjui a vacha namkim a kon ahiuve.
7.15: Akop akop in amaho chu kongsung ahin jon cheh un, hichun avetsah chu ahile hinna neiya tahsa hing ahiuve ti photchet na ahi.
7.16: Hichu gancha ho lah a anu khat le achal khat ahung lut soh phat un Elohimin Noah atep peh bang chun, Yaweh Elohimin kot akhah tai.
7.17: Chujouvin ni somli le jan somli sungin hatah in twisanglen chu akhang in leiset chung jouse achup tan, hichun kong chu twi in ahin potou cheh cheh tan leiset sanga sang jon alet dohtai.
7.18: Twi chu nasa tah in akhang tul tul jeng tan ahile kong chu twi chunga akitol le len ahi.
7.19: Achaina geiyin twi chun mol jouse lah a asangpen geiyin abonchan achup soh heltai.
7.20: Twi chu akhanbe jingin mol jouse lah a asangpen jong chu tong som ni jen thuh-in achup mang hel tai.
7.21: Hijeh chun leiset chunga um ahing thei ahaithei jouse, chunga leng vachate ahin, in na kivah gancha ho ahin, gam'a gamsa ho ahiuvin, ahon hon a kiloiya leiset chung'a kitol le ganhing namkim ahiuvin chule mihemte geiyin agam soh heltai.
7.22: Ima jouse leiset chunga um kiti pou anahhom a hinna hu neiya haithei jouse abonchan athi gam soh tan ahi.
7.23: Elohimnin leiset chunga thil ahing thei jouse asumang sohhel tai. Mihem ho jouse, gancha ho, ganhing gamsa ho, tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse, chunga leng vachate jouse abon'in athi soh hel tai. Ahin hichea sohcha a hing doh Noah le a insung mite chule kong sunga um ganhing anu khat le achal khat um ho bou ahiuve.
7.24: Hiche twisanglen chu leiset chung ni jakhat le nisom nga sung achup me.

8.1: Hinlah Elohimnin Noah le gamsa hole gancha ho kong sunga umjouse ageldoh jingin, Leiset chunga huipi hattah ahin nun sahin ahile twisanglen chu ahung kem lheh tai.
8.2: Leinoi lam a twi ho jong along kang tan, chule chunglam'a van'a konna go nasa tah a ju jong athip tan ahi.
8.3: Hichun twisanglen chu leiset chunga konnin ni jakhat le ni som nga jouvin akang hei hoitan ahi.
8.4: Hiti chun ni somle ni sagi lhinni lha sagi chan na chun kong chu Ararat molchunga ahung kinga tai.
8.5: Lhani le akeh jouvin twi chu ahung kemtul tul'in mol dang dang ho jong molvum ahung kimu pantan ahi.
8.6: Chujouvin ni somli jou chun Noah in huikot kong sunga asem chu ahin hong doh tan,
8.7: Hichun vavom khat alha doh in ahile, leiset chung adung avaiyin aleng len, leiset chunga twi akan loulai jeh'in ahung kinungle kit tai.
8.8: Chuin Noah in jong leiset chunga twi kang soh tam ti vetna dingin vakhu khat alendoh sah kit'in ahi.
8.9: Hinlah vakhu chu kingah na ding mun amu hihlaiye, Ajeh chu twijin leiset achup nahlai jeh in ahung ki nungle kitin, hichun Noah in vakhu chu akhut a adomlhan asung langa akoi lha kit tai.
8.10: Chuin ni sagi akho ngaiyin, chujouvin kong'a kon chun vakhu chu alha doh kit'a ahile,
8.11: Vakhu chu nilhah lang in ama henglam'a ahung kile kit'in, vetau amuh achun athah beh a kiloulha Olive thingna khat ahin pon, hijeh chun Noah in jong leiset chunga twipi akangsoh tai, ti ahedoh pai jin ahi.
8.12: Chujouvin Noah jong ni sagi ma akho ngai kit'in vakhu chu alha doh kit'in ahile vakhu chu ahung kinung le kit tapoi.
8.13: Noah hinkho chu kum jagup le kum khatna lha masapen, chu che lha ni masapen ni chun leiset chunga twipi abonchan akang soh heltan, hijeh chun Noah'in jong kong husin chu ahoh lhan agahven ahile leiset chung chu ana go heltan ahi.
8.14: Hiti chun lhani jou don chun leiset chung hoitah in ago hel tai.
8.15: Hichun Elohimin ahoulimpin hitin ati,
8.16: “Nabon chauvin kong sunga kon chun pot doh tauvin, nangma nahin, na jinu ahin, na chapate ahiuvin, chule na moute ahi uvin kilhon doh pin.
8.17: Tahsa a hing ganhing jouse, naum khompi ho vachate ahiuvin, gancha ho ahi uvin, leiset chunga a op'a kitholtho ho ahiuvin, hiche ho chu leiset letthe thua ahung chikhai uva, ahung hinphat uva chule ahung punjalna ding uvin hinpui doh tan,” ati.
8.18: Hichun Noah ahin, ajinu ahin, achapate ho ahin amoute toh konga kon chun ahung potdoh tai.
8.19: Chuin gancha jouse alen aneo abonchauvin vacha ho ahiuvin ni ni in akop kop in anu khat le achal khat konga konin ahung potdoh'un ahi.
8.20: Hichun Noah in maicham Elohim henga asemin, hi achun aman kipeh dohna maicham pumgo thilto saho chule vacha ho amaho akipeh doh na dung jui cheh in pumgo thilto ding in agou vam in ahi.
8.21: Chuin anam tui maicham ahung kisem jeh chun Elohim alung lhai lheh jengin hitin ama aki houlim in aseiye, “Mihem jeh in keiman leiset hi gaosap kit tapong'e, ajeh chu mihem lung ngaito him him hi aneocha kipat'a hung gilou pan ahi tai; chule ganhing ka semsa ho jong hi sumang kit tapong'e.
8.22: Iti nama jongle leiset aum laisen muchi tuphat, chang aat phat, gam dap phat, gamsat phat, nipi lai le phalbi lai, sun laile jan beilou ding ahi,” ati.

9.1: Hichun Elohimin Noah le achapate phatthei aboh in hitin ahou limpi in hitin aseiye, “Chale nao hing uvin, pung uvin lang leiset lochan sohkei uvin ati.
9.2: Leiset chunga um sa jouse ahin chunga leng vachate jouse ahin chule gamsa a op'a kithol tho ho ahiuvin chule twikhanglen'a nga ho ahiuvin abonchauva nangho naki chat cheh dingu ahi, abon chaouva nangho khut na kapeh doh ahi tai.
9.3: Ahing theiya avahle thei jouse nangho dinga anneh a pang thei cheh ahiuve, anche louhing kapeh ma banga chu aboncha kapeh doh nahitauve.
9.4: Hinlah nangman naneh thei lou ding chu sahing athisan pum pum a naneh lou beh ding ahi.
9.5: Hinlah keiman kakhol childing chu koi tabang khat touvin mihem hinkho asuhbeiya thisan asole, itiham khat a gamsan mihem athale hiche gamsa chu thadoh pai ding chule koitabang in mihem hinkho asuh bei leh ama hinkho hi tabang ma achu suhbei ding ahiye.
9.6: Koitobang in mihem hinkho asuhbei le hiche mihem hinkho sumang pachu ama hinkho jong hi tobang'a chu kisumang ding ahiye, ajeh chu Elohimin mihem hi ama lim bang banga asem doh ahiye.
9.7: Tuhin nangho hatah in punguvin lang leiset le asung dimset in cha le nao hing uvin lang, pung uvin chule hinlo chan soh kei uvin,” ati.
9.8: Hichun Elohimin Noah le achate ahoulim pin hitin aseiye.
9.9: “Keiman kaki tepna avel'in ka sudet nom lheh tai, nangtoh na chilhah te chengse ding injong,
9.10: Chule gancha nam kim nangma toh kong sunga um chengse toh vacha ho ahin, insa ho ahin, chule gamsa hang ho jouse ahin chule leiset chunga atoi thei avahthei jouseding ahi.
9.11: Keiman nangho toh ka kitepna ka phudoh na ajehpen tah chu hiche hi ahi, tahsa a hingho twisanglen a kisumang kit louhel ding ahin, chule leiset suh mang na dinga jong twisang letna um kit louhel ding ahi tai,” ati.
9.12: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ka phudoh hi nangho le nalhat khom piu ganhing nam kim ho ahi uvin chule tonsot'a khangguija mite ding ahin, i-kah uva amel chihna hiche hiding ahi.
9.13: Keiman ka semdohsa nisa vah emsel chu vantham jol'a ka koiye, hichu leiset le kei kikah a kitepna khat'a um melchihna hiding ahi.
9.14: Keiman meibol lhang leichunga kahin sol teng nisa vah emsel ho chu meilhang lah a hung kilang ding ahiye.
9.15: Hiche phat le chun keiman nangho le ikah uva ka kitepna chu hingel doh kit ingting, chuteng le gotwi chu tahsa hingte sumang dinga twi sanga hunglen kit lou hel ding ahiye.
9.16: Keiman nisa vah emsel meilhang lah a kamuji tengle Elohim le leiset chunga tahsa a ahing thei jouse kah a tonsot kumkho a dinga kitepna chu kagel doh ding ahi,”ati.
9.17: Hichun Elohimin Noah ahoulim pin hitin aseiye, “Hiche hi leiset chunga tahsa ahingthei jouse toh kei kikah a kitepna ka phudoh chu amelchihna hi ding ahi,” ati.
9.18: Noah chate ho kong sunga kon'a hung potdoh ho chu ahi leh Shem, Ham chule Japhath ahiuve, Ham kiti pa hi Canaan pa ahiye.
9.19: Amaho chenghi Noah chate a konna vannoi mihem hung dim ahi.
9.20: Chuin twisanglet kichai jou chun Noah in tolgo lah achun lou abol pan tan hia chun lengpi phung aphut doh tai.
9.21: Chujouvin nikhat chu Noah chun lengpitwi adonnin ahile akham tan khoilupon buh sung ah chun asagoh keovin alum tai.
9.22: Ham Canaan pa chun apa Noah sagoh keova aum chu amun apot doh paiyin asopi teni aga het sah in ahile,
9.23: Hichun Shem le Japheth in ponsil achoi lhon in alengkouva adom gel lhon a nunglam ngan anung toi lhon in apa akeova um chu agakhu khum lhonin, amai lhon vang ahei manggel lhon in apa akeova um amulhon poi.
9.24: Noah hichun alupna a kon in ahung khah doh phat in achapa neopen in ana limbol chu ahedoh tai.
9.25: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiyin: “Canaan vang gaosap chang hen, Asopi teni henga soh jouse soh in hung pang hen,” atin,
9.26: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiye, “Elohimin Shem phattheiboh mai hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi soh himai hen,
9.27: Elohimin Japheth gam chu hatah in keh let peh hen, chule Japheth in Shem pon buh sung dunga jong chen sah hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi pa soh hijing mai hen,” ati.
9.28: Twisanglen kichai jouvin Noah chu kum jathum le kum som nga ahing nalaiye.
9.29: Hitichun Noah hin nikho abon bonin kum jako le kum somnga alhing in, chujouvin ama athi tai.

10.1: Hiche thusim hohi Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah thusim chu ahiye; Twisang let jou chun amaho akonin cha tamtah ahung punbe in ahi.
10.2: Japheth chilhah ho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
10.3: Gomer chilhah ho chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmath ahiuve.
10.4: Javan chilhah ho chu Elishah, Kittim, chule Rodanim ahiuve.
10.5: Hiche apat chun amaho chilhah chengse chu leiset ahin toupha pan tauvin ama ama hithei na leh aphung achang akaidol chehin ama nam hina dol chehin acheng tauvin ahi.
10.6: Ham chilhah ho chu Cush, Mizraim, Put, chule Canaan ahiuve.
10.7: Cush chilhah ho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve.
10.8: Cush kitipa hin leiset chunga mihat ahung pang masapen Nimrod chu ahing'in ahi.
10.9: Hiche phat laiya chu vannoiya gamlen hat sakap them pen ahung hin, chule Elohim ging tah mi jong ana hi'e, hijeh chun mihon Nimrod banga gamlen hat sakapthem pen ahi tin aseiuve.
10.10: Hichun Cush chun alenggam chu Babylon khopi sunga Babylonia tin ahin semdoh'in, hiche khopi ho chu Erech, Akkad, chule Calneh ahiuve.
10.11: Aman hiche akon chun Assyria ajonin hikom achun Nineveh khopi aphut doh in aban'a Rehobothir khopi ahin Calah khopi jong ahin phut doh kit e.
10.12: Chuban chun Nineveh le Calah khopi teni kikah achun Resen khopi aphut doh in khopi lentah ahi.
10.13: Mizraim chu Ludite, Anamite, Naphuhite chule Lehabite ho cheng pa ahi.
10.14: Pathrusiho, Casluhiho, chule Caphtoriho a konna chu Philistine te hung kon dohna chu ahi.
10.15: Canaan chapa tahpen chu Sidon, Sidon chilhah te hung kon dohna ho chu ahiuvin chule Hit chilhah ho jong Canaan akon ahiuve.
10.16: Jebus ho, Amor ho, Girgash ho ahin,
10.17: Hivi teho, Arki ho, Sin ho ahin,
10.18: Arvad ho, Zemar ho, chule Hamath ho jouse hi ama hinsa cheh ahiuve, ahin khonung in Canaan insung kon mite chu gamtina akithe cheh soh kei uvin ahi.
10.19: Hiche apat chun Canaan gamgi chu Sidonna pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin aki lhung lut peh in, Sodom lang jonin aki lhung in, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahin phan, chule Zeboiim ahop in Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e.
10.20: Amaho cheng hi Ham chilhah ho ahi uvin, ama ama insung dungjuile, apao dung juile, agam dung jui chuleh ajat dung jui uva ahiye.
10.21: Shem chate pasal ho jouse apunbe in ama chu Japheth upa ahin, Ebel chilhah ho jouse hi Shem'a konna hung kondoh cheh ahiuve.
10.22: Shem chilhah ho chu ahile Elam, Asshur, Arphaxed, Lud chule Ram ahiuve.
10.23: Ram chilhah ho chu ahile Uz, Hul, Gether, chule Mash ahiuve.
10.24: Arphaxad chu Shelah pa ahin, chule Shelah chu Ebel pa ahiye.
10.25: Ebel chun cha ni aneiyin amasa pachu Peleg (Hichu kisuh khenna tina ahi) ahi, Ijeh inem itile ama phatlai a chu vannoi chu ama ama paotho doh dungjuiya ahung umdoh laitah chu ahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
10.26: Joktan chapa chu Almodad ahin, Sheleph ahin, Hazarmaveth ahin, Jerah ahin,
10.27: Hadoram ahin, Uzal ahin, Diklah ahin,
10.28: Obal ahin, Abimael ahin, Sheba ahin,
10.29: Ophir ahin, Havilah ahin chule Jobab ahiuve. Amaho chengse hin Joktan chilhah cheh ahi uve.
10.30: Ama hon gam ki-vaipohna atoupha u-chu Mesha apat'in Sephar lang jonin ahung kilhung in, nisolam'a thinglhang gamsung geiyin ahung kilhunglut peh-in ahi.
10.31: Amaho jouse hi Shem chilhah ahi uvin, a phungle achang, a pao tho'u dung jui le, agam dung jui le, ajat dungjui uva Shem chilhah te ahi uve.
10.32: Hiche phungle chang hung kimin phah se hi Noah chate a kon'a chi le nam hung kisem doh ama gui penna dung juiya vannoiya nam jouse hi hiche phungpi a kon'a twisanglet jouva patna hung um doh ahi.

11.1: Phatkhat lai tah chun vannoiya mihem jousen pao khat bou ana tho uvin, apao cheng manu jong thakhat cheh ana hi.
11.2: Hiche lai chun miho chu nisolama konin ahung kichon uvin ahile Shinar gamsunga chun phaicham mun ong lentah ahin mudoh uvin, hikoma chun acheng tauve.
11.3: Hichun ama ho khat le khat aki hou un, “Eihon cheh gadengu hitin goutah lheng'u hite,” akiti uvin; hiti chun song panna pang dingin cheh amang uvin, songlou dingin leingan amang uve.
11.4: Hichun amahon hitin aseiuve, “Hung un eihon khopi khat kisah uhitin, chule in sangtah khat a tingvum vantoh kibang khat sadoh uhitin, vannoiya imin'u ki thansah uhite, achuti loule leiset chunga iki moh thethang gam ding'u ahi,” atiuve.
11.5: Hinlah Yaweh Elohim chu mihemten khopi asah'u le insang asah doh'u veding in Yaweh ahung kumlha tai.
11.6: Hichun Yaweh Elohimin aseiye, “Vetan mipiho hi aki pumkhat thei lheh jeng uvin chule pao khatseh bou atho uvin, hijeh chun phat chomkhat jou teng le amaho hin ipi hijongle abolgot ho u-chu ajo lel lou beh dingu ahi.
11.7: Hijeh chun hung un eiho ga kumsuh'u hitin apao'u ga suhkhen peh uhite, chutile khat le khat athusei kihet mon um tauvinte,” ati.
11.8: Hiti chun Yaweh Elohimin leiset chung ah abon uvin, athe cheh soh hel'in hiche apat'a chu khopi insah chu hung bouiya ahiuve.
11.9: Hijeh a chu hiche kopi insang kisah chu Babel kiti ahi, ajeh chu Elohimin mipi ho lung asuhboui a paochom paochom athosah ahi tia hi Elohimin vannoiya ana thecheh'u ahi.
11.10: Hiche hi Shem insung mite thusim ahi e. Twisang let kum ni jouvin Shem chu atahsa kum jakhat alhing in achapa Arpachshad chu ahing'e;
11.11: Arpachshad apen jou chun Shem chu kum ja nga ahingin, hichun aman cha numei le pasal tamtah ahinbei.
11.12: Hichun Arpachshad chu kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Shelah pa ahung hitan ahi.
11.13: Shelah ahung pen jouchun Arpachshad chu kum jali le kum thum ahingin, chuin aman cha pasal le numei tamtah ahinbei.
11.14: Shelah kum som thum alhin in ama chu Eber pen na pa ahung hitai.
11.15: Eber pen jou chun, Shelah chu kum jali le kum thum ahinbe in chuin cha pasal le cha numei jong ahin be nalaiye.
11.16: Eber kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Peleg pa ahung hi tan ahi.
11.17: Peleg pen jou chun Eber chu kum jali le kum somthum ahing nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahinbe nalaiye.
11.18: Peleg chu kum som thum alhinin, ama chu Reu pa ahung hitan ahi.
11.19: Reu pen jou nung in Peleg chu kum jani le kum ko ahin be nalaiyin, cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
11.20: Reu chu kum som thumle kum ni bou alhinin Serug pen na pa ahung hitai.
11.21: Serug pen jou chun, Reu chu kum jani le kum sagi ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jouchun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah anei be nalaiye.
11.22: Serug kiti pachu kum som thum bou alhinin Nahor pa ahung hitai.
11.23: Nahor pen jou chun Serug chu kum jani ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei phachompi ahinbe nalaiye.
11.24: Nahor chu kum som ni le kum ko bou alhin in Terah apeng tai.
11.25: Terah pen jou chun Nahor chu kum jakhat le kum som le kum ko ahing nalaiyin, hichun aman cha pasal le cha numei simsen lou ahinbe nalaiye.
11.26: Terah vang chu kum som sagi jen ahung lhinin Abram, Nahor, chule Haran ahin hingin ahi.
11.27: Hiche hi Terahte thusim kisei ahi. Terah chun Abram, Nahor, chule Haran pa ahin, chule Haran chu Lot pa ahiye.
11.28: Ahin Haran chu apa Terah thi masang in, apenna Chaldeans gam'a Ur khopi achun athitai.
11.29: Ahin chutobang lai chun Abram le Nahor chun ji anei gel lhon in, Abram jinu min chu Sarai ahin, Nahor jinu min chu ahile Milcah ahin, Haran chanu ahiye; (Milcah le a sopi nu Iscah chu Nahor sopi pa Haran Chanute ahi lhon e).
11.30: Ahin Sarai chu aching in naovop thei louvin cha hing lou vin aum tai.
11.31: Nikhat Terah chun achapa Abram le amounu Sarai chule Haran chapa atupa Lot akipuiyin abonchauvin Chaldea gam khopi Ur a kon chun Canaan gam jon ding in ache tauve; Ahin Haran khopi ahin phah phat uvin hiche muna chun acheng den tauve.
11.32: Hichun Terah hinkho chu kum jani le kum nga alhing in, chujou vin Haran khoa chun Terah athi den tai.

12.1: Elohimin Abram chu ana houlimpi in “Nagam, na insung mite, na sopiho chule napa sopi ho dalhan keiman gamthah ka musah ding khu jon tan,” ati.
12.2: Keiman nang hi nam lentah kasoding nahiye; chule keiman nangma phatthei kaboh ding chule namin kaki than sah ding chule midangho phatthei chan na nahi ding ahi.
12.3: Chule nangman phathei naboh ho chu phathei chang diu, chule nangman na sapset techu ka sapset ding; chule nangma jeh a leiset chunga phung nam kim phatthei chang ding ahiuve.
12.4: Hichun Elohimin athu mop dung jui chun Abram chu akichon in, chule Lot in ama aki lhonpi in. Abram chu Haran dalha a akichon doh chun akum kum somsagi le kum nga ana lhing tan ahi.
12.5: Aji ngaitah Sarai, asopi pa Lot, anei agou, agam jouse toh, agancha jouse, chule Haran a ana um laiya a insungmi ana kisemdoh chengse chu aki puiyin Canaan lam ajon tauve.
12.6: Abram in alamjot'na a Shechem chu ahopa in saotah ajot un, hiche achun ngah mun Moreh thingphung kom ah akingauvin hiche mun chu Canaan mihon ana lodimun ahi.
12.7: Hichun Elohimin Abram chu akimupi'n “Keiman hiche gamhi na chilhahte kapeh ding ahiye,” hichun Abram injong ahenga hung kilah Yawehya dingin hiche muna chun maicham khat asem in ahi.
12.8: Phat chomkhat jou chun, Abram in noilam gam ahin jon'in kingah na mun ding thinglhang lam'ah asem doh in hichu nilhum lama Bethel khopi, niso lam'a Ai khopi, akah achun ponbuh akison in akinga in, hiche mun'a chun aman Yawehya dingin maicham khat asemmin chule Yaweh min in atao tai.
12.9: Hichun Abram chu noilam'a ahung chalbe ben Negev lam jonin ache paiye.
12.10: Hiche lai phat dontah chun Canaan gam sunga nasatah in kel alhan, Abram chu Egypt ma chelou thei ahi tapon, hikom achun Abram chu gampam mi vaitah in ana um'in ahi.
12.11: Abram chu ahung suh deu vin Egypt gamgi ahung lhun phat chun, Abram'in ajinu Sarai jah achun aseiyin, Sarai “Ven nangma hi numei melhoi tah nahin.”
12.12: Egypt miten namu teng u-leh, amahon hitia asei diu, “Ama hi ajinu ahi, amapa hi that doh'u hitin hiche teng chule ajinu hi eiho ichan thei ding'u ahi ati ding'u ahi.”
12.13: Hijeh chun nang chu kei sopinu hi kahi tin kisei in lang hile chun kei dingin phapen intin chule nangma jal'a chu kei jong ei hinghoi ding'u ahi,” ati.
12.14: Thudihtah khat chu ahile Abram chu Egypt ahung lhun chun mipiho chun Sarai chu amelhoi chu amudoh sohtauvin ahi.
12.15: Chule Pharaoh lengpa chapaten amudoh phat uvin Pharaoh koma amanu chu aphat sei lheh jeng tauve. Hichun Sarai chu Pharaoh insunga apuilut tauvin ahi.
12.16: Hichun Sarai jeh chun Pharaoh in Abram chu thil mantam tah apen, kelngoi hon ahin, bong chalte ahin, sangan chal ho ahiuvin; soh pasal hihen soh numei ho hileh, sangongsao ho ahin sangongsao api ho ahiuvin anei doh sah lotai.
12.17: Hinlah Elohimin Pharaoh le ainsung mite chu Abram jinu Sarai jeh chun het phahlou thoh hah tah chun abolgim lheh jeng tan ahi.
12.18: Hichun Pharaoh'in Abram chu nasatah in ahousal in, “Ipi bol'a kingaito nahim,” atin, “I bol la naloinu na jinu ahi chu nei seipeh lou ham?”
12.19: Ibola ka sopi nu ahi natia kaji dinga neiki pui sah ham? Hijeh chun ven tunjong hikom a na jinu aum e ki puiyin lang gangtah in chedoh tan,” ati.
12.20: Hichun Pharaoh'in asemang pachong ho thu apetan, “Abram ahin ajinu ahin chule anei agou abonchan hiche gam'a konin gathah doh un,” ati.

13.1: Hichun Abram'in ajinu Sarai, asopipa Lot toh, Egypt gam chu adalha uvin chunglam Negev mun lang jonin achetou tai.
13.2: Abram chun gancha anei lheh jeng tan, hiche keo hilouvin sana le dangka jong ahao lheh jengtan ahi.
13.3: Hitichun Negev apat Bethel geiyin ahung cheng un, chuleh Bethel le Ai kikah mun a khoilupon in asong un phat masa a ana um bang in,
13.4: Hiche mun chu ahile Abram in maicham anasem dohna mun ahin hikom achun Elohimin avel in ana hou kit tai.
13.5: Lot, Abram toh kilhon jing pa jong chu ahung hao lheh tan kelngoi hon ahin kelcha hon ahin tamtah ahin nei tan chule khoilupon in jong ahin nei doh tan ahi.
13.6: Hinlah gam achen nau chu Abram le Lot dingin ahung neo lheh jeng tai, ajeh chu akelngoi hon ho le kelcha hon ho ahin gancha dang ho aum khom thei tapouve.
13.7: Hijeh chun Abram le Lot gancha chingho kahlah a kihet khelna ahung um doh tan hiche phatlai chun Canaaan mite le Perizzite mite jong ana cheng khom uve.
13.8: Achainakeiyin Abram in Lot jah'a hitin aseiye, “Eini kiheto themsel hite nang ma le kei gancha ching ho kahlah'a, ajeh chu eiho hi ucha kinai tah ihi bouve.
13.9: Ven na masanga gam-ong lenpitah hi nanga ahiye, nangman kilhen in hoilam hi nadei ham kilhen in ikihop ding ahi. Leiset gam ong veilam nadei le keiman gam ong jetlam kaki lah ding, nangman jetlam aphajoi nati le keiman na dei lou lang chu kaki lhen mai ding ahi tai,” ati.
13.10: Lot chun phat sottah gam chu aven gam pha leithao potna mun Jordan phaicham lang chu Zoar lang toh kinai lang deu, hilang chu ahile aphat seh a twiyin achapnou na mun gam Elohim honlei tobang twi chap nou jing ahi louleh Egypt te honlei banga hoitah ahi. Hiche phatlai chu Yawehyin Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang masang ana hi.
13.11: Hijeh chun Lot in jong Jordan vadung phaicham pumpi chu akilhen in, hiti chun Lot chu niso lam jonin akitol tai; hitobang hin amani aki inkhen lhontan ahi.
13.12: Hichun Abram Canaan gam'a cheng din aum tai. Chua chun Lot'in ama khoilupon buh chu Sodom gam toh kinai phaicham geiyin aga songdoh pehin ahi.
13.13: Hinlah hiche Sodom mite chu apha mothei lheh un, chule agilou thei lheh un Elohim douna in akisa chavai lheh un ahi.
13.14: Lot apotdoh jou phat in Elohimin Abram chu ahoulim pi in, “Vetem in namit a namu phah chan gam ninggei achunglam anoilam, solam le lhumlam.
13.15: Keiman nangma hiche gam jouse namit'a namu phah jouse nangma le na chilhahte jouse tonsot'a nei le gou va kapeh na hitai.
13.16: Keiman na son na chilhahte chu leiset'a leivui jat ka phahsah ding, leiset leivui jat sim jou lou banga nang son le chilhahte jong simjou lou ahi bouve.
13.17: Hijeh chun kipatdoh in lang agamsung hi adung avai asuh atung in ga kholtoh in, Ajeh chu ken nangma kapeh ding ahi.”
13.18: Hichun Abram'in aumna chu Hebron mun a achon in gangpi thing kena kom Mamre kiti mun chu ahi. Chule Abram in hiche mun'a chun Yawehya dingin maicham khat asem in ahi.

14.1: Hiche phat laitah chun gal kinah kiboi na ana um'in, hiche a ana ki boi ho chu ahile Amraphel Babylon lengpa Ellasar Arioch lengpa, Elam Kedorlaomer lengpa, chule Tidal Goiim lengpa ahiuve.
14.2: Chule akidou pi houchu Sodom gam lengpa Bera, Birsha Gomorrah lengpa, Shinab Admah lengpa, Shemeber Zeboiim lengpa, chule Bela lengpa (Zoar) kitipa ahiuve.
14.3: Hichea anunung'a leng ho hi Siddim phaicham twithi kol phaicham a apang un ahi.
14.4: Kumsom le kumni sung'a ama ho hi Kedorlaomer lengpa noiya ana kun jing'u ahin, amavang kum som le kum thum lhin kum'in adouvin ahung pang tauve.
14.5: Kum khat jou chun Kedorlaomer lengpa le ama pankhompi lengho chu ahung kon uvin, Rephaim mite chu Ashteroth-Karnaim achun ajou un, Zuzites mite chu Ham achun ajou un, Emim mite chu Shaveh-Kiriathaim achun anajou un,
14.6: Chule Horite mite chu amolsangu Seir apat gamthip lang gamgi Ei-Paran chan geiyin aga joupeh uvin ahi.
14.7: Hichun amaho hikoma kon chun akinungle kit uvin Kadesh kiti, tuhin En-misphat achun Hazazontamar a cheng Amorites mite leh Amalekites mite chu agam sung pum pin ajou tauve.
14.8: Hichun leng phalou akiphin ho sese chu Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, chule Bela (Zoar kitipa) galkon din akigong un twipi-thi phaicham achun gal asat uvin,
14.9: Elam gam lengpa Chedorlaomer le Goiim lengpa Tidal toh, Shinar lengpa Amraphel toh chule Ellasar lengpa Arioch chutoh akisat uvin, hicheng leng li ho chun leng nga ho chu anadou un ahi.
14.10: Amaho se gal akisat jou uchun Twipi-thi kol phaicham achun thih e meichang adim jengin ahi. Hichun Sodom lengpa le Gomorrah lengpa sepoi ho chu ajamdoh un, ama ho loi khat chu kotong sunga alut un, amaho lah a loikhat chu thing lhang lama ajam cheh tauve.
14.11: Gal hangsan mihat ho chun Sodom le Gomorrah alokhum un galman chah ho jouse chule neh le chah ho jouse akichom khomun ache tauve.
14.12: Amaho chun Lot, Abram sopipa jong chu amanu vin Sodom a chengpa chu anei thil le agou jouse jong alah peh tauve.
14.13: Hinlah Lot insung mite khat ana sohcha in, amapa chun Abram Hebrew mipa aga seipeh tai, hiche lai chun Abram chu Eshcol le Aner sopipa, Amorites mi Mamre gangpi thing phung vel dunga chun ana cheng nalaiye, amaho jong chu Abram toh ana pangkhom ahiuve.
14.14: Hichun Abram in asopipa Lot kimat ajahdoh phat chun aman natoh tohgon ahin neitan, mihem ja thumle som le get phatah a galbol kithem chuhsa ama insunga peng cheh ahin lhengdoh in ama tah in alamkai yin amaho chu Kedarlaomer sepai ho chu Dan geiyin aga nungdel peh'in ahi.
14.15: Hichun Abram in amaho chu ahom khenin jankim laitah in abulu'un Kedarlaomer sepai ho chu ajam cheh tauve, Abram in amaho sepai ho chu gamla tah anojam'in Damascus khopi sah lang Hobah chan geiyin agadel peh-uvin ahi.
14.16: Hiti chun Abram injong asopipa Lot jong, athilkeo chengse toh, numeiho ahiuvin mipi ahiuvin abonchan ahin nungpui soh tai.
14.17: Abram chun Kedarlaomer chuleh apankhom pi leng ho aga jo a ahung kinungle lam chun Sodom lengpan Shaveh phaicham (Shaveh tichu lengpa phaicham tina ahi), achun alamto ding in ahunge.
14.18: Hichun Melchizedek Salem lengpa chule Elohim thempu chung-nung pen a pang pan Abram chu lengpitwi chuleh chang-lhah ahin poh peh e.
14.19: Melchizedek in Abram chu hiti hin phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Van le leiset hin phutdoh a Elohim chungnung pen kom'a, Abram phattheiboh chang hen,
14.20: Chule na galte nangma khut lum'a lousah a, chungnung pen Elohim chu loupi hen,” ati. Chuin Abram in Melchizedek chu thil jousea kon in hopsom a hopkhat khat apesoh keiye.
14.21: Sodom lengpan Abram jah'a hitin aseiye, “Kanam mite na hentup ho chu nei nungpeh tan, amavang thilkeo ho chengse nang in na mat dohho vang chu nangma adin na kikoi theiye,” atile,
14.22: Abram in Sodom lengpa hitin adonbut in, “Van le leiset hin phutdoh Yaweh Elohim chungnung pen koma kaki hahsel ahi tai,
14.23: Keiman patse jang khat cha hihen lang, kengchot khao jeng cha hijong leh nang thil kiti poupou khatcha kalah louhel ding ahi, nangman Abram ka hao doh sah tai,” tia nasei thei louna ding in;
14.24: Ahin keiman ka lah ding chu gollhang hon aneh doh ule mihon ana nehchai hobou chu ahi, chule keiman ka dei lhen pentah chu ahile achan ding uva kilom thil le gouho chu kaloi ka mite Aner, Eshcol chule Mamre amaho petan.

15.1: Phat chomkhat jou nung hin; Elohimin gaovin Abram aki houlim pin hitin asei peh'e. “Abram imacha kicha hih in, ajeh chu keiman ka huhding; kipa man jong atam a tam na chan ding ahi,” ati.
15.2: Abram in adonbut in, “O Yaweh Elohim loupi pen nangma phatna na phatthei hohi keiman chapa kanei poi, ajeh chu nangman chate ding nei peh lou jeh in, ka insung a soh a pang Eliezer Damascus amapa bou hin ka gou alo ding joh in aum tai.
15.3: Elohim nang man keima chilhah ding a chikhai ding, neipe ta pon, hijeh a chu ka sohte lah a khat hin ka gou alo ding ahi tai.
15.4: Elohimin ama chu ahoulim pin, “Ahipoi nangma soh hon na gou alo thei lou ding ahi, nangma a konna chapa um ding ama chun na gou alo ding ahi.”
15.5: Hichun Elohimin Abram chu polama akou doh in aki hou pin, “Vanchung lam ven Ahsi ho khu simtem in nasim jou nah em? Hitobang chu ahi na chilhah atam ding dan chu,” ati.
15.6: Chuin Abram in jong Yawehya tahsan na dihtah in aneitan ahile hichu ama ding in dihchan nan akisimpeh tai.
15.7: Chujou vin Elohimin Abram ahoulimpi kit in, “Hiche gamhi nalo ding'in na pe-ing'e tia Chaldea gam Ur khopia konna nangma na hin puidoh a Yaweh chu keima kahi,” ati.
15.8: Hichun Abram in adonbut in, “O Yaweh ka Elohim hiche hi kalo ding ahi ti ipia iti kahet doh thei ding ham?” ati.
15.9: Hichun Elohimin Abram ahou lim pin ajah a, “Bongnou kum thum lhingsa khat toh, kelngoi chal kumthum lhingsa khat toh, chule vahui nou khat le vapal nou khat ka henga hin choi tan,” ati peh e.
15.10: Hichun Abram in hichengse chu ape doh in athat in, hichun ahapsat cheh in, ahap lang ton alupsah in hinlah vacha ho vang chu asemkeh poi.
15.11: Chuin muthongho ahung lenglhao vin hiche sa kikoi ho chu ane kigo uvin ahile Abram in muthongho chu anodoh jin ahi.
15.12: Chuin nisa alhum dingkon in Abram ahung imut soh tan, chu jongle tijat umtah muthim lhangkhal ahung jing in amapa chu ahin jinkhum tai.
15.13: Hichun Elohimin Abram ahoulimpi in, “Nangman thonlou dinga nahet ding chu na chilhah hohi gam danga hung mah thah diu ahiye, amaho se chu kum jali sunga mi bol genthei thoh'a ga um ding ahiuve.
15.14: Ahin keiman hiche nam sugenthei ho chu ka phulah ding ahi, chule phat ahung sot a achaina teng amaho chu hatah a nei le gou ahin nei diu ahi.
15.15: Nangman vang lungmong sel'a na pute heng na jot ding, chule na kum lhing set'a na hinkho kichai a na kivui ding ahiye.
15.16: Chule amaho hi khangli ahung lhin phat le hiche gam'a hi hung ki nungle kit diu ahi, ajeh chu tuchan gei hin Amor mite khan gitlouna hi pilhing lou lai ahiye,” ati.
15.17: Chuin nisa alhum phat in mu athim tan ahile, meikhu belsung khat ah mei al-lenglung khat le meivah tobang khat ahung kitol in, hiche pi chu sa kihapsat a kikoi teni kah achun ahung kitol lelen ahi.
15.18: Hichun Elohimin Abram chu hitin a kihoulimpi in, kinoptona aneilhon in hiche nichun, “Keiman nason na chilhahte kapeh gam chu hiche hi ahi, Egypt gamgi apat luipi dung gei Euphrate vadung gei,
15.19: Gamsung tutua Kenites, Kenizzites chule Kadmonites ten atoupha se,
15.20: Hittites mite Perizzites mite chule Rephaites miten atoupha se,
15.21: Amorites mite ahi-uvin, Canaan mite ahiuvin, Girgash miho ahiuvin, chule Jebus miho gam ahiuve,” ati.

16.1: Tun Abram jinu Sarai chun cha anei thei tapon ahin lah Sarai chun Egypt mi soh numei khat ana neiyin amanu chu Hagar ahi.
16.2: Chuin Sarai'in jong Abram jah a aseiye, “Ven Yawehyin keila cha eihin sah tapon, lungset tah in ka sohnu koma ga lut tan; ijem itile amanua konna khu ka inchen dohsah thei nahi,” atile, Abram in jong Sarai thu angai tai.
16.3: Hichun Sarai Abram in-neipin Hagar chu apuiyin Abram ji din apetai, hiche phat laitah chu ahile Abram kum som Canaan na achen jou don ahi tai.
16.4: Hichun Abram toh Hagar chu akitimat lhon tan, chuin Hagar chun nao ahin vop tan hichun apinu Sarai chu noise tah in ahin vepan tan ahi.
16.5: Hijeh chun Sarai in Abram jaha aseitai, “Hiche ho jouse hi nang suhkhel ahi, ka sohnu hi nangma dannoiya ka koi ahin, Hinlah tuhin amanun nao avop tan keima noise tahin eive tan hijeh chun keile nang kah a Yaweh thutan in hung pang jeng hen!” atitai.
16.6: Abram'in adonbut in “Ven amanu khu nasoh hilou ham, nangman pha nasah dungjuiyin bol tang em?” ati. Hichun Sarai in Hagar hatah in ahin sugenthei pantan hichun amanun (Hagar) ajamsan tai.
16.7: Yaweh Vantil in gamthip Gam'a twikhuh phungkhat'a Hagar chu aga mudoh in ahi, hiche twi khuh chu Shur jotna lampia um ah ahiye.
16.8: Yaweh Vantil chun aseiye, “Hagar, Sarai sohnu hoilanga konna hungsoh doh na him? Hoilam jon ding na him?” atile Hagar in adonbut in, “Kapi nu Sarai kom'a kon ahung jam doh kahi,” ati.
16.9: Hichun Yaweh Vantil chun amanu ahoulimpi in, “Nangma na pinu kom'a kinungle in chule amanu dan noiya nakun angaiye.”
16.10: Hichun Yaweh Vantil chun ahoulimpi na laiyin, “Keiman na chilhahte tamtah ka pehbe ding nahi, sim jong na sim joulou ding ahiye,” ati.
16.11: Yaweh Vantil chun ahoulimpi nalaiyin, “Tua hi nangma naovop na hitan chapa khat nahin ding, hiche naosen chu amin Ishmael nasah ding ahi. (Elohimin angailhi jing'e tina ahi), ijeh inem itile Yawehyin na gimna chu na khongai peh tai.
16.12: Chule nachapa hi mihem laha gam'a sangan lungthim bei bang ding, mitin douna akhut hinlap a chule mitin khut ama chunga hung chu ding, chuleh aphunggol jouse toh kidou toa hung khosa ding ahi.”
16.13: Hiche jou chun Hagar in ajah a thu hinsei Yaweh chu aminvovin, “Nangma hi keima eimudoh a 'El-roi' nahi,” ati. Ajehchu amanu'n “Tahbeh monga keiman Elohim kamu a chule ama ka mu nunga ka hing'a ka um nah lai ham?” atin ahi.
16.14: Hichun Twisam putna chu amin Beer-lahai-roi asah tai, hichu Twikhuh hi Kadesh le Bered kikah aum ah ahiye.
16.15: Hichun Hagar in Abram chu chapa khat ahin peh tai. Hichun Abram in achapa min chu Ishmael asah tai.
16.16: Hagar in Abram ding'a Ishmael ahin peh chun Abram chu kum som get le kum gup alhing tan ahi.

17.1: Abram chu kum somko le kumko alhin in Elohimin ahoulimpi in hitin aseipeh e, “Keima (Elshaddai) Elohim chungnung kahi. Hijeh chun lunglhaisel in nei hou jing in lang, chule thenna hinkho mang jing in,” ati.
17.2: Keiman nangma to ikikah a kitepna nape ing ka-ting hichu thonlou hela nangma chilhah simsen lou kapeh ding nahi.
17.3: Hichun Abram in amai tol lang aven hichun Elohimin ahin hou vin hitin aseiye,
17.4: Hiche hi keima le nangma kinop tona ahi, keiman nangma hi nam jouse mipa kaso ding nahi ati.
17.5: Abanna jong na min jong kakhel peh ding, Abram nahi tahlou ding, Hinlah nangma hi Abraham na kiti ding ahi tai, ajeh chu nangma hi nam jouse mipa nahi ding ahi tai.
17.6: Keiman nangma hatah a kaga sah ding, na lolhin ding na chilhah ten nam tamtah ahin sondoh diu, chule leng thupitah tah jong amaho lah a hung umdoh ding ahiye.
17.7: Keiman athah a nangma to iki noptona chu na chilhahte to kaki tepna avela ka phudoh kit ding nangma nunga na chilhahte a dinga jong, khang le khang kikah ajong, hiche hi atonsot'a hiding, keima na Elohim nu kahi jing ding chule nanam, na chilhahte Elohim jong kahi jing ding ahi.
17.8: Keiman Canaan gam pumpi ahin, tua nachen na gam kholjin banga nachen nau hi nason na chilhahte atonsot a goulo dinga kapeh ding, chule amaho dinga jong a Elohim'u kahi jing ding ahi,” ati.
17.9: Hichun Elohimnin Abraham ahoulimpin, “Nangma tah in jong kinoptona hi najui ding, chule na nunga nason na chilhahte dinga jong akhang lhum keiuva ajui ding'u ahi.
17.10: Hiche hi ahi kinopto na nangma le na chilhahte jousen ajui cheh ding, nangho lah a pasal jousen chep akitan soh kei ding'u ahi.
17.11: Nangman na bollou a hitheilou chu natahsa vunval abohlai chu nachelhah sohkei ding, hichun avetsah chu ahile keima le nangma kikah a kinoptona hijing ding ahi.
17.12: Hiche hi nangma insung mite seh hilou vin, koi tobang nasoh nakol nangma insunga dinga nachoh doh ho jouse jong ahop tha cheh ding,
17.13: Abonchauva chep nakitan cheh diu, na tahsauva maha napoh u-chu keima toh atonsotna iki nopto na'uva umjing ding ahiye.
17.14: Koi tobang pasal khat tou hiche kinoptona cheptan hi bol lou aumle ama chu kinopto na insunga kon'a paimanga umding ahi, ajeh chu kinoptona ajuilou jeh ahi.
17.15: Hichun Elohimin Abraham ahoulimpi'n “Sarai na Inneipi Sarai na ti tahlou ding ahi, ijeh inem itile amanu min jong hi tua patna Sarah hiding ahi tai.
17.16: Keiman amanu hi phatthei kaboh a chu jongle ama nu akon a hi chapa khat kapeh ding nahi, hitia chu keiman amanu hi phatthei kaboh a ama jong “Sarah” chitin namtin nu hung hi ding mitin vaipi leng ding ho jeng jong amanu akonna hung peng doh ding ahiuve,” ati.
17.17: Hichun Abraham jong akun in tol lang aven anui tai, chuin alungthim in amale ama akihou vin, Keima hi kum jakhat kahi nunga mipa kahi thei ding ham? Chule ka inneipi Sarah jong kum som ko le kum ko ahi jouva naosen iti anei thei ding ham? ati.
17.18: Abraham'in Elohim heng'a asei in, “Ahi thei ding le Ishmael hi nangma phattheibohna noiya um jing tahen.”
17.19: Hinlah Elohimin adonbut in, “ahipoi Sarah na inneipi in nangma adinga chapa khat nahin peh ding, nangman hiche chapang chu amin Isaac nasah ding ahi. Chule keiman amale ama nunga ason achilhahte dinga kinopto na chu atonsot geiya kinopto na a umjing dinga kaphu doh ding ahi.
17.20: Ishmael jong chu phatthei kaboh ding nangman nathum ma bang'a, ama jeng jong hatah a kapun sah ding, chule ama chilhahte ho jong hatah a pung dingu ahi.
17.21: Hinlah keima kitepna vang chu Sarah in khovei tulai phat'a hi nahin ding Isaac chuto bou ka phudoh ding ahi,” ati.
17.22: Elohimin thu aseijou phat chun Abraham chu adalhatai.
17.23: Hichun Abraham'in jong achapa Ishmael ahin, asoh pasal ama insunga peng den hihen, sum a achoh tho hi jongle, Abraham mite lah a pasal jouse chu apuikhom in, Elohim'in aseipeh bang bang chun hiche nikho mama chun chep atan peh soh keiyin ahi.
17.24: Abraham'in chep akitan chun akum kum som ko le kum ko ana lhing tai.
17.25: Chule achapa Ishmael in chep akitan chun kum som le kum thum ana lhing tan ahi.
17.26: Ani lhon in Abraham le achapa Ishmael chu nikhat na chep atan lhon gel ahi.
17.27: Chule a insunga pasal jouse, insunga pengden hihen lang gam dang mi soh dinga akichoh tho hi jongle aboncha amatoh tha khat'a chep kitan tha cheh ahiuve.

18.1: Mamre munna gangpi phung komma chun Yaweh chu Abraham henga ahung kilah in ahi. Nikhat hi nichangsat pettah hin Abraham chu aponbuh maiya ana touvin ahi.
18.2: Ama ahung dahdoh in ahile akomma mithum ana din amun ahi. Amaho chu amu phat in ama alhai jel in amaho lemnan tol ah abohkhup in ahi.
18.3: Chuin Abraham'in “Ka Yaweh,” tin adonbut in, “Nanghon pha nasah uleh phat chomkhat naki ngah thei diu ham.
18.4: Nakeng sil na ding'u kahin choi kah in hiche thing limnoiya hin ana kicholdo ta diu vin.
18.5: Chule nang hon na lhacha pa hi khoto na neitah a nei hungvil ngal'u ahi leh na kholyin na mano masang in na tha kido na ding un naneh ding'u them khat nahin gon peh ing nge, ama hon aphai, nasei bang chun hin bol tan ati uve.
18.6: Hichun Abraham chu apon buh kom langa alhai jel'in Sarah kom ah asei tan ahi, “Kinloi tah in changbong ate na dimthum tedoh in lang twi to mehnang in, chule changlhah hin kang loi tem in,” aga tin ahi.
18.7: Hichun Abraham'in gancha ho kivah na lang ajon in bongnou athao pen asohte ho apen, gangtah in ahin hon sah in ahi.
18.8: An neh ding ho amin phat in Abraham'in bongnoi ha le bongnoi toh chule bongnou sa ahon u-chu amaho angsung ah aneh diuvin aga lui peh in amaho anneh laisen ama jong thinglim a chun ading jinge.
18.9: Chuin ama hon Abraham jah'a “Na loinu Sarah hoilam a um aham?” atiu leh Abraham'in ponbuh sunga aum nai ati.
18.10: Chuin amaho lah a khat chun aseiyin, “Keima hi khovei tulai phat mama le kahung ki nungle kit ding ahi, vetan hiche phatteng chule na inneipi Sarah khun chapa khat ana hin ding ahi,” ati chu anunga ponbuh sunglam a um Sarah chun angai lhin ahi.
18.11: Abraham le Sarah chu atahsa kum lhon chu atam gel lhon tan, chule Sarah jong nao nei phat kum akhel ahi tai.
18.12: Hichun Sarah guhthim in ama le ama aki nuisat in hitin aseiye, “Iti hithei ding ham, kei tobang aching sa numeiyin kipana thilpha kamu ding ham, ka jipa jeng jong akum atam lheh tai,” ati.
18.13: Elohimin Abraham jah achun aseiye, “Ipi dinga Sarah khu nuiya ka teh nunga keiman cha kanei tahbeh mong ding hi nam,” ati ham?
18.14: Yaweh Elohim ading'a ipi ahahsa umham? keima khovei tulai phat na kahung kit ding chule Sarah in cha pasal khat anei ding ahi.”
18.15: Chuphat in Sarah chu atija tan hichun Sarah in aseilep tan, “Keima ka nuipoi” atin ahin la, “Elohimin adonbut in nangma na nui nai,” ati.
18.16: Hichun pasal thum hochu an aneh jou un ading doh un Sodom lang chu galdot un, ama hon adalha uvin, Abraham chu amaho thah doh ding tin lampi gei aga kilhonpin ahi.
18.17: Elohim chun aseiye, “Keiman katoh gon hohi Abraham kom a kasei lou ding ham?” ati.
18.18: Ajeh chu Abraham chu len tah le nam hattah chule vannoi ja nam jouse Abraham jeh a phatthei chang ding ahi ngal'in,
18.19: Chule achapate le ama ban a ainsung mi aman thu apeh a, chutia chu adih abol theiyu va, thu adih a atan thei na dinguva Yaweh lampi ajui thei uva, chuteng le Yawehyin Abraham chung chang'a akitep nasa chu ahin molso theina dinga ama hi kilheng doh ahiti la ka henan,” ati.
18.20: Hichun Elohimin Abraham ahoulimpi in “Sodom le Gomorrah douna thu kisei asangval tan chule achonset nau jong ase val tai,” ati.
18.21: Keima che suh ing kating ka henga thu hung kisei dungjuiya hi abol cheh'u ham, ahilou ham gapho chen inge,” ati.
18.22: Hichun miho chu chukom akon in aki heiyun Sodom lang chu ajon un ache tauve, ahin lah Abraham chu Yaweh masanga chun ading chah den jing'in ahi.
18.23: Abraham'in Elohim chu anailut in hitin aseiye, “Nangman michonpha atheng chule mi phalou agilouho aboncha nasuh mang tha ding ham,” ati.
18.24: Ijem tin khopi sunga chun michonpha som nga bang um ta le, asunga michonpha som nga ho jal'a jong chu akhomun chu khen dehlou hela nasuh mang jeng ding ham?
18.25: Nang dinga hitobang thil nabol a, michonpha le migilou agoma natha cheh a, michonpha le migilou akibah ding chu bolda hel jengle chun kati! Leiset thutan pan adih a atan lou ding ham?” atile.
18.26: Hichun Elohim'in adonbut in, “keiman mi somnga thudih thilpha bol Sodom khopi a kamu doh theile, amaho jal'a chu khopi kahuhdoh ding ahi.”
18.27: Hichun Abraham'in asei kit in, “Ka Yaweh nangman neiphal peh thei dingle kasei ban ho kajom nom in keima vang bohse vutvai tobang kahin,
18.28: Ijem tin mi somli le nga tobang chonpha mitheng mi som nga sanga lhomjo namu le amaho jeh'a chu khopi hi nasuh mang ding ham, mi nga lhahsam jeh chun, Elohimin adonbut in, Keiman hiche khopi a hi mi som li le nga kamu doh jouva ahile sumang ponge,” ati.
18.29: Hichun Abraham'in adeichat angaichat avel in aseiyin, “Ijem tin mi som li bou umta le,” atin chuin Yawehyin ahoulimpi kit in, “Keiman amaho mi somli jeh a chu kasuh manglou hel ding ahi,” ati.
18.30: Ka Yaweh lungset tah in lung hanglou jenin, Abraham atao kit leovin, neiphal peh theile chun kasei nom na laiye, Ijemtin mi som thum muta le chun,” atile Yaweh Elohimin ahoulimpi in “Keiman mi somthum hijong le ka suhmang lou ding ahi,” ati.
18.31: Hichun Abraham'in aseikit in, “Nangman neiphal peh theile ka thusei hi ka jom nome, Ijem tin mi som ni hi jongle atile,” Yawehyin adonbut in, “Mi somni kamu jongle ka suhmang lou ding ahi,” ati.
18.32: Abraham'in achaina in asei peh tan, “Ka Yaweh Elohim nei lung han hih beh in lang, khatvei neisei sah kit le tia katao ahi, mi som muta le chun” hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Mi som kamu doh jongle kasuh manglou ding ahi,” ati.
18.33: Hichun Abraham henga athusei ding aboncha aseisoh phat'in Yaweh chu ache tai; Abraham vang chu a in mun lam'a ahung kile kit tai.

19.1: Hiche ni nilhah lam in vantil ni ahung lhon in ahile Lot chu Sodom khopi kelkot a anatou pet ahin Lot in vantil teni amu phat chun alamto dingin akipat don in amani masanga tol ah abohkhup'in ahi.
19.2: Chuin Lot in hitin aseiye, “Ka Yaweh hung lhonnin ka insunga nakeng hung kisop lhonnin, chule tujan kain a geh lhon inlang, jingpi matah in thou lhon in lang na kholche na lhon aban najom thei lhon ahi,” atile, amanin ahi poi hithei ponte ati lhon in “Keini tujan hiche mun a ong dunga geh mai lhon tange,” ati.
19.3: Hinlah Lot in aha sei behset jeh chun amani jong Lot in lang a geh din ache tauve, hichun Lot in amani neh ding chol kisolou changlhah akanpeh in amani in jong ane lhon tai.
19.4: Hinlah anehjou don khojin masang chun Sodom khopi sunga khangthah, tehse, kiti jouse ahung kikhom un amaho gena in chu aum kimvel tauvin ahi.
19.5: Amaho chun Lot henga asam tauvin “Nangma koma ageh dinga hungho chu hoilam a nakoi hitam? amani chu hinpui doh in amani chutoh ka lupkhom diu ahi tin athum tauve.”
19.6: Hichun Lot chu ahung pot doh in amaho toh kihoulim din, anung lam a kot chu akhah in ahi.
19.7: “Lungset tah in sopite ho” tin ama atao tan, “Hitobang thilphalou hi bolda uvin.”
19.8: Veuvin Keiman chanu nungah thengsel ni kaneiye. Keiman ka chanu teni hin puidoh ing ting nangho koma, amani chu nadei dei a nabol theiyu ahi.
19.9: Hinlah amahon Lot chu “Kinung chen,” ati uvin, chu jongle amahon aseiyun “Hiche pa hi ahung khopem len chule eiho thutanna pang ding akigo vehta! tua amaho (Vantil teni), ki gim bol na ding sanga nangma agilou cheh a kabol ding'u nahi,” atiuve. Hitichun Lot chu hatah in avouvin kotpi jong chu phutjal ding in ahin go tauve.
19.10: Hichun vantil teni chun Lot chu akhut na aman lhon in akailut lhonin insunga kot chu akhah tauve.
19.11: Hichun vantil teni chun kotpi phunga miho chu ateh jong akhangthah jong abonchauvin amit'u achosah lhon in ahile abonchauvin kotphung holmon akisu lungdong gam tauve.
19.12: Phat chomkhat jou vin vantil teni chun Lot jah a hitin asei lhon e, “Hiche khopi a hi sopi ule nao adang nanei nahlai em? na chanu jipa ho hihen, na chapate hihen, na chanu ho hihen lang koi dang dang hi jong le hiche khopi sunga nangma mi poupou chu abonchauvin hiche mun akon hin pui dohtan.”
19.13: Ajehchu hiche khopi hi pumsuh mang ding kati lhon ahitai. Awgin hung kithong hi aphatmo na alen lheh tan Elohim kom ahin phatai, chujeh a chu keini hi asumang dia eihin sol lhon ahi.
19.14: Hijeh chun Lot chu apot doh in achanute ni jipa ding teni jah a chun, “Kinloi tah in hiche khopi akon hin potdoh loi lhon in, ajeh chu Yawehyin hiche khopi asuhmang ding ahi tai,” aga ti leh, achanu teni jipa ding teni chun a tot dan in ana gel lhon e.
19.15: Kho ahung vahlhah a jingkah chun vantil teni chu ahung kino lheh lhon tan, “Gang in Lot,” tin asei peh lhon e, “na jinu chule na chanute pui doh in hikom'a kon in pot doh'in tutu hin achuti louleh nangma hiche khopi toh'in suhmang tha a naum ding ahiye,” ati lhon e.
19.16: Lot chu akhongai na laiyin, vantil teni chun ama khut, ajinu khut, chule achanute ni khut na aman lhon in khopi pam lam ah ajamdohpi lhon in ahi, ajeh chu Elohimin amaho angailut lheh jeng ahi.
19.17: Amaho khopi pam langa ahin puidoh lhon phat in Vantil teni in thu amop in “Naki hinso thei na dingu vin jam dohloi jin hung jong hung kinung hei hih uvin phaicham dunga jong bangpa hihhel uvin, thinglhang lam'a jam doh loiyun achuti louleh nangma jong suhmanga naum tha khah ding ahi,” ati peh lhon e.
19.18: Hichun Lot chun amani jah'a “Ahipoi ka Yaweh,” atin!
19.19: Nangman neina ngailu lheh in chule ka hinkho jong neina huhdoh in chukeo hilouvin ngailutna sangtah jong nei musah in, Hinlah molsang langa kache jou lou ding ahiye, thinan eiphah lo ding ahi, ka hinkho kichai ding ahi.
19.20: Vetem in khoneo phai-cham khat muthei in aum'e, jamlut nading in abailam in chule naicha bou ahi; ka kihinso na ding'in lungsettah in hikom a khun nei jamlut sah tan,” ati.
19.21: Vantil in adonbut in “aphai tua nasei jong hi nanop peh ingting, chule keiman hiche phaicham gam'a um khopi nasei jong khu sumangda tange.
19.22: Ahin kino gang un, jamdoh loijun, Ajeh chu keiman ima ka bolthei lou ding nangma ho khulam nalhun kahseu vin,” (Hiche in avetsah ahil chet chu khopi min chu Zoar kiti ahin hiche chu ahile khomun neocha tina ahi).
19.23: Lot Zoar mun agah lhun chun jingkah nisa hungso doh jou tah ahi.
19.24: Hichun Elohimin vanthamjolla konin meikong chule hui thanei thina thei akongthei hui Sodom le Gomorrah chunga ajuh sah tai.
19.25: Chule Elohim'in khopi teni jong, phaicham geiya akhopi teni sunga cheng jouse ahin, tolla kehdoh thingna louna abonchan asugam hel tai.
19.26: Hinlah Lot Inneipi chu aki nunghei jin anunglam agah vet leh chiphung asoh in khom bang in akitung den tai.
19.27: Chule Abraham chu ajing jingkah matah in ache loijin Yaweh angsunga adinna mun a chun ading in,
19.28: Sodom le Gomorrah lam gam chu agah vesuh in ahile, vetan agam meikhu pi chu meihol kilhut bang in akhu akitung doh jen jun jeng chu amu tan ahi.
19.29: Hinlah Elohimin Abraham taona ageldoh in hijeh chun asopipa Lot chu phaicham khopi asuhmang masang in apuidoh in, chujou vin Lot chenna khopi teni chu a sumang tai.
19.30: Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin Lot le achanu te nin Zoar mun chu adalha uvin, thinglhang lam ajon in, songko sung khat a achanute ni chu toh acheng khom tauve.
19.31: Nikhat chu Lot chanu teni alenjo nu chun anaonu kom'a hitin aseiye “Hikom gamsunga pasal gollhang aum tapoi midangho banga ji inei lhon lou ding ahi tai. Chuleh eihing hon ipa jong hungvoija ateh lang ahi tan, cha aneilou ding ahi tai.
19.32: Hung in ipa hi khamna thei donsah hitin, akham teng iki timatpi lhon ding ahiye, hiche akonna chu eiho insung hi ipa akon a chilhah inei doh lhon ding ahibou e,” ati.
19.33: Hichun amanin hiche jan chun apa lengpi twi akham sah lhonin, chuin alenjo nu chu asunglhan apa to aga kiti mat lhon tan ahin apa chun achanu aluppet jong atho doh pet jong ahepoi.
19.34: Ajing ni chun alenjo nun anaonu kom ah hitin aseiye, “Keima janlhah chun ipa to kaki timat ka lum lhon tai, tujan jong lengpi twija khamsah hitin, tujan teng nangma gache in lang ga ki timatpi in hiche akonna eiho chilhah hi ipa a konna bou ikisem doh thei ding bou ahi,” ati.
19.35: Hiche jan chun amanin apa lhon lengpi twi adonkham sah lhon in chuin aneojo nu aga sunglha kit in apa to aga kitimat lhon kit tan, amasa abang chun achanu aneonu ahung lup pet akitho dohpet jong ahepoi.
19.36: Hiche jeh chun Lot chanute ni'n apa akon in nao ahin vop gel lhon tan ahi.
19.37: Achanu alenjo nu chun nao pasal khat ahing tan amin chu Moab asah tai, amapa chu nam khat ahung hitan tua Moab mite kiti hohi ahiuve.
19.38: Aneojo nun nao pasal khat ahing kit in, amanun achapa min chu Ben-ammi asah tai. Amahi nam khat mipa lamka ahung hin tua Ammon mite hohi ahiuve.

20.1: Hiche akon chun Abraham chu Negev gam langa akichon'in Kadesh le Shur kikah a phat chomkhat ana cheng in, chuin Gerar lang gei in aga cheng in ahi.
20.2: Abraham'in a inneipi Sarah chu “Ka sopinu ahi,” tin ana phong don in ahile Gerar lengpa Abimelech chun mi asol'in Sarah chu aga pui sah tai.
20.3: Hinlah hiche jan chun Elohimin Abimelech amang in aki musah in hitin aseipeh'e, “Nangma hi athisa nahi ahi tai, ajeh chu numei na kipui hi aji nei numei ahi bouve!”
20.4: Ahin Abimelech chun amanu (Sarah), chu akitimatpi loulai ahi, hijeh chun Abimelech in “Yaweh nangin hiche imacha hechenlou nam hi na suhmang mong ding hitam?
20.5: Hitia chu Abraham tah in jong ka sopinu ahi tia eina houlimpi hilou ham? Chule amanun jong ka sopipa ahi atia,” hijeh achu keiman ka lungthim'a jong themmo na beihel a chule ka khut teni jong atheng ahi bouve ati.
20.6: Hijeh chun Elohim'in amang in adonbut in, “Ahinai, keiman nangma hetthem louna ho chu ka henai. Hiche ho jeh achu nangma keima douna a chonset a konna kasuh khen'a chule hiche ho jeh a chu numeinu to kaki timat sah lou ahi.
20.7: Tun numeinu chu a inneipu komma soltan, amapa a inneipun taona naman peh ding ahi, ajeh chu ama themgao ahi, chuteng nangma nadam kit ding ahi tai. Ahin nahet ding khat chu a inneipi nanung peh doh louleh nangma chule na mite nathi gam diu ahi.
20.8: Hijeh chun Abimelech jong jingkah matah in a kithou doh in chuin asoh ho jouse gang tah in akou khom tan, chuin Abimelech in thusoh jouse chu asohte ho lah achun aseiyin tijatnan adim tauve.
20.9: Hichun Abimelech in Abraham chu akouvin ajah'a “Ipibol a hiti pia hi nei hung bol'u hitam? Itobang'a nang douna a kana chonset hitam, hitia keile ka leng gam chunga chonset nasatah hi nahin pohlut ham? bol louhel ding thil nangman neibol khum ahi tai,” ati.
20.10: Chuin Abimelech in Abraham komma aseiye, “Nang in ipi nabol na ham?”
20.11: Abraham'in adonbut in, “Hiche munhi Elohim ginglou mihem tamna mun ahi tin kagel in, ka loinu chu ka sopinu ahi kiti leh ama nu jeh a chu eitha lou diu ham kati ahi.”
20.12: Adihtah asei dinga ka sopinu jong ahi nai, kapa eihing lhonpa khat ahin kanu lhon vang achom chom ahi. Keiman kaji din kaki pui tai.
20.13: Elohimin eina kou doh chun kapa insung kanada lhah chun mun khat a patna mun chom a kana vale lhon lai chun kana seiye, thil ngaichat kaneiye katin, hoilang hi jongle iche le naho gamsunga kasopipa tin miho lah a neiphon doh ding ahi tin kana seipeh e.”
20.14: Hichun Abimelech in akelcha ho le kelngoi hon ho chule abong hon chule numei pasal asoh ho chu Abraham apetai. Abimelech in a inneipi Sarah jong chu anungsol peh kit tai.
20.15: Hichun Abimelech in adonbut in, “Dah'in lang vetem in kagam sung nang in nadei pen na mun'a na chen thei ahiye.”
20.16: Abimelech in Sarah jah'a aseiye, “Ven keiman na sopipa dangka sang khat kapen, hiche sum hi na koma um chengse mitmu a suhkhel kihet them to na dinga kapeh ahi, chule japi angsunga nangma boina nanei tapoi,” ati.
20.17: Hichun Abraham'in Elohim kom a taona amang in Elohimin Abimelech asu dam tan, chule a inneipi le asoh numei ho jouse naobu jouse jong cha aneithei na diuvin aki hong gam tai.
20.18: Ajeh chu Abraham jinu Sarah jeh a Yawehyin Abimelech insunga numei naobu jouse ana kha tan peh ahiye.

21.1: Yawehyin ana seisa bang chun Sarah ahung villin Sarah chunga asuh bulhit peh tai.
21.2: Hichun Sarah in nao ahin vop'in, Abraham chu atehset nung in Elohimin atep peh phat don tah in chapa khat ahin pe tan ahi.
21.3: Abraham'in achapa chu amin Isaac asah tan ahi.
21.4: Chule Isaac pen jou niget alhin nin Abraham'in Elohim thupeh bangin achapa chu chep atan pehtai.
21.5: Isaac ahung pen chun, Apa Abraham chu kum jakhat ana lhing tai.
21.6: Chuin Sarah in aphong doh in, “Elohimin nuina eipei,” ati.
21.7: Chule aman, “Sarah hin chale nao noi hin chep sah inte tin koipen in Abraham komma ana sei ngam dem? ahin lah keiman atehset nung in chapa khat kahin peh tai,” ati.
21.8: Isaac chu ahung khanglen diu in an neh masa pen Abraham'in kipanan kikhop na asem e.
21.9: Hichun Sarah in jong achapa chu Egypt mi Hagar'in Abraham ahinpeh Ishmael to aki chep lhon chu amudoh tai.
21.10: Hichun amanun Abraham kom ah hitin aseiye, “Hiche sohnu le achapa chu solmang in ajeh chu hiche chapang hin keima chapa toh chanvou anei khom lhon ding aum poi; Isaac toh ki komto thei lou ding ahi.”
21.11: Hichun Abraham'in nopmo asa lheh jeng in ajeh chu Ishmael jong chu achapa ahiye.
21.12: Hinlah Elohimin Abraham chu ahoulimpi in, “Nangman chapang chung chang chule na sohnu jeh in ima lungphat mo na nei hih in, Sarah in bol in atiho chu bol in ajeh chu Isaac akonna bou na chilhah te hung kisim ding bou ahi.”
21.13: Hinlah keiman Hagar chapa jong chu nam lentah khat kaso thou thou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa jong chu nangma chapa jong ahi thouve.”
