21.14: Hichun Abraham ajing in matah in akithou vin, neh ding bu asutup'in chule twipoh na ding twibom Hagar chu apen aleng kouva aledoh peh tan ahi, hichun amanu le achapa chu asolmang in, chuin Hagar chu suhna ding helouvin Beersheba gamthip noiya avah lelei.
21.15: Hichun twi ahung bei chun amanu (Hagar) chun naosen chu hampa nang boh lim noi ah akoi tai.
21.16: Hichun amanu (Hagar) apot doh in atou lha tan achang seh in lamsom tobang kikah in “Keiman hiche chapang thi hi kamu nompoi,” atin amanu chu alhi along in akap tai.
21.17: Hinlah Elohimin chapang ka awgin chu ajan chuin Yaweh Vantil in vanna kon in Hagar chu ahin kouvin, “Hagar ipi boina nanei ham? Imacha kichatna nei hih in, Elohimin chapang ka awgin chu ajatai aumna muna kon in ati.
21.18: Kipat doh inlang nao khu gaki dop loiyin na khut in kipom chah jon, ijeh inem itile keiman ama khu nam lentah ka hisah ding ahi.”
21.19: Hichun Elohimin Hagar mit chu kho amusah in chua twi tamtah amusah tan, hichun amanun gangtah in twipai chu asu dim in chapang chu adon sah tai.
21.20: Chule chapang chu Elohimin ahin umpi jing in neocha ahi apat gamthip gamnoi jenga ahung cheng in, thalpi kap ahung them lheh jeng in ahi.
21.21: Chule Ishmael chu Paran gamthip noi a ana cheng in, chule anun Egypt gam'a ama ji ding in numei khat aga pui peh in ahi.
21.22: Hiche phat laitah chun Abimelech le asepai jalamkai Phicol chu Abraham vil din ahung'e. “Elohimin nangma hi na umpi jing in, na thilbol na jouse ah na kithopi jinge,” tin ahung seiye.
21.23: Elohim min'in kitem in, chule nei joulhep louhel ding, ka chate jong ahilou leh ka chilhah ho jong, kei vang nangma adia thilpha bolnom jing, chule tuhin naki hahsel ding, thilpha na bol jing ding hiche gam-sunga maljin gampam nahi laisen,” ati.
21.24: Abraham'in adonbut in “Heng'e kaki tem e,” ati.
21.25: Hichun Abraham'in Abimelech komma lunglhai louna aphong doh in Abimelech sohten twikul namphu a Abraham sohte ana lah peh'u thu chu ahi.
21.26: “Tuchung hi hiche thu kajah masah pen ahi,” tin Abimelech in a donbut'e. “Keiman hiche chungchang hi koi oimo a, koi ngoh ding ham kahepoi. Ajeh chu phat masan ima thu nana sei kha poi,” ati.
21.27: Abraham'in hichun akelngoi ho, kelcha ho, chule bonghon ho Abimelech apen kinop tona anei lhon'e.
21.28: Hichun Abraham'in kelngoi nou sagi ho chu achom a alheng doh'in ahi.
21.29: Abimelech in Abraham chu adongin “Adangho a kon a hiche sagi ho hi ipi dia nachom khen ham?” ati.
21.30: Abraham'in adonbut in, “Hiche twikhuh keiman kalaisa ahi, tia ahetoh a neipan pehna dinga hiche kelngoi sagi hi neisanpeh tei in” ati.
21.31: Hijeh chun ama in hiche mun chun Beersheba asah tai. Ajeh chu mihem teni akihet tona mun lhon ahiye.
21.32: Beersheba munna kihet tona muna aki muto jouvin, Abimelech le Phicol sepai lamkai pachu Philistine mun lama akinung le lhon tan ahi.
21.33: Abraham'in Beersheba mun achun chahthing phung aphutdoh in, hiche achun aman Elohim chu tonsot Elohim ahi tin aphong doh e.
21.34: Hichun Abraham chu Phillistine muna chun phat sottah achengin ahi.

22.1: Thil hijatpi kichai jouvin Elohimin Abraham chu apatep in aman hitin aseiye, “Vo Abraham,” atile, hikoma kaum e Yaweh ati.
22.2: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Nangailut tah na chapa changkhat seh Isaac chu pui jin lang Moriah gam'a chen kei man kahin seipeh ding molsang khat pen pen chunga chu pumgo thilto maicham adin pedoh tan,” ati.
22.3: Chuti chun Abraham chu jingkah matah in athoudoh in asanngan teni akigon tup in chule asoh pasal ni akipuiyin achapa Isaac apuiyin, pumgo thilto govamna ding in thing akipoh in akipat doh in Elohimin aseipeh na mun chu ajon tai.
22.4: Ani thum chanan Abraham chu adah in aven ahile amun chu gal'a kon in amu tai.
22.5: Abraham'in asoh teni jah a aseiyin, “Nangni hikoma hin sangan toh ana um tauvin, keile ka chapa khulam akhun gache lhon tadinge, Elohim kaga hou lhon ding kahung kinung le vah lhon ding ahi.”
22.6: Abraham'in thinglom maicham a pumgo thilto halna ding chu Isaac apohsah in chule achempai achoi jin amani hiti chun akijot lhon in achelhon tai.
22.7: Chuin Isaac in apa Abraham jah'a “Hepa” atile Abraham'in jong “Hoijo kacha” ati, hichun Isaac in “Veteh mei le thinglom la aumtan, pumgo thilto kelngoi hoiba ham?” ati le.
22.8: Abraham'in adonbut in “Elohim ama tah in hin gong nante, kelngoi pumgo maicham adin, kachapa deitah,” hichun amani achebe lhon in ahi.
22.9: Elohimin Abraham aseipeh na mun ahung lhun lhon phat in Abraham chun maicham khat asem in, thinglom chu agol chan ajam'in chuin achapa Isaac chu aheltum in maicham chunga alup sah tai.
22.10: Hichun aman achem chu apaiya kon in aladon in, achapa chu sut agon akilam tai,
22.11: Hinlah vana konin Yaweh vantil in “Abraham, Abraham” tin ahin kouvin ahile, Abraham'in “Yaweh keima hikoma ka um'e,” ati.
22.12: Ama chun “chapang pa chunga na khut nalha lou hel ding, imacha jong nalo lou ding ahi, Ajeh chu Elohim na gin jeh-in nangman na chapa chang khat seh jeng jong keima adin na khut kih poi, tihi tun kichen tah in kahe doh tai,” ati.
22.13: Chuin Abraham adah doh in avet leh, “Vetan anung langa nanglom lah a kelngoi chal khat akia kihen amun ahi,” hichun Abraham jong achen kelngoi chal chu aga kaiyin achapa khel chun maicham thilto chun atoh'in ahi.
22.14: Hijeh chun Abraham'in hiche mun chu Elohimin hin ngaito nante tin asahtai (Yahweh-Yireh), tuni geihin hiche “Elohim'in amolsang chung ah hin kingaito nante,” ti thuchih hi akisei jing nalaiye.
22.15: Yaweh vantil chun vanna konin Abraham tin a nivei na a ahin koukit in ahi.
22.16: Hitin aseiye, “Keima ka tahsa tah a ka kihahsel ahitai, hitobang a thilhi nabol ngam jenga na chapa chang khat seh chunga khut kih louva napan jeng phat-in tin Yawehyin aseiye.
22.17: Keiman kitah tah a phatthei ka boh ding nahi, chule na chilhahte chunga ahsi jat ka phahsah ding chule vadung panga neldi jat ka sosah ding nahi, na chilhah ten amelma teu kelkot ahin toupha diu ahiye.
22.18: Chule nangman ka thusei nangai jeh a leiset chunga namtin vaipi na son na chilhah te vanga phatthei hung kiboh ding ahiuve,” ati.
22.19: Hichun Abraham asohteni kom langa ahung kinungle in, chuin amaho Beersheba lam ajon un, hichea chun Abraham chu Beersheba a aum tai.
22.20: Phat chomkhat jou chun Abraham chu thu aseipeh un Milcah jong hin nasopi pa Nahor to cha pasal phachompi ahing lhone.
22.21: Uz chu atahpen ahin, Buz hi anichan na ahin, Ram hingpa Kemuel ahin,
22.22: Chesed ahin, Hazo ahin, Pildash ahin, Jidlaph ahin chule Bethuel ahi uve,” ati.
22.23: Bethuel chun Rebekah ahing'e. Abraham sopipa Nahor chu Milcah cha hicheng get hi ana hin peh e.
22.24: Hicheng val in jong athai-kemnu amin Reumah kiti nu jong chun Tebah toh, Gaham toh, Tahash toh chule Maacah ana hing'e.

23.1: Sarah chu kum jakhat le kum som ni le kum sagi jen ahing in,
23.2: Sarah chu Kiriath-arba kiti muna athi tan, hichu Hebron kiti Canaan gam sunga um ahi, hichun Abraham chu Sarah umlou jeh a lunghel le mitlhi long in achup in ahi.
23.3: Hichun ajinu long adalhah ding jeh in Hit mite ho kom a aseiyin,
23.4: “Keima gam chom mi kahin nangho lah a maljin bou kahi. Gambeh neo khat nei choh sah un, chuti le keiman ka jinu hi phaten kivui thei ing'e,” ati.
23.5: Hit mite ho chun Abraham adonbut un,
23.6: Ja umtah kapu thuseiyu ngaiyin, nangma Elohim a leng chapa banga kei ho lah a uma keiho lhan khuh aphapen khat'a khun na thilong chu vui jeng in, ka lah uva mihem khat cha jong hi alhan khuh na itpeh a na thilong na vuisah lou ding aum poi,” atiuve.
23.7: Hichun Abraham ading doh in agamsung mipite Hite miho chu salam bol din abohkhup tai.
23.8: Abraham'in aseiyin, “Nangman nei kithopi nom kahen ahithei dingle Ephron Zohar chapa koma neisei peh uvin.”
23.9: “Ajeh chu agamgi chin a um ama Machpelah songlhan keo khu eipeh theiya ahile ken jong lhan muna kaman jing dingin nangho umpet tah hin aman alhingset in peng kate,” ati.
23.10: Ephron chu mipi lah a atou pet ahin, Abraham chu adonbut in midang hon jong athusei chu aja cheh un, Hite mite ho khopi sunga umjouse jah ah hitin aseiye.
23.11: “Hithei ponte ka Yaweh,” tin Abraham chu adonbut'e, “Lungset tah in ka thusei hi ngaiyin, keiman ka gam sunga adam lai, atong lai, kapeh ding nahi. Tuhin mipi ho masanga nangma kapeh ding nahi, chule nangman naji nu alongdamsa navui thei ahi.”
23.12: Abraham chu agam mipiho masang'a abohkhup kit in,
23.13: Hichun Abraham'in Ephron le mipi atou cheng ho jah'a aseikit in, “Hithei ponte, lungset tah in ngaiyun, nangho koma ka choh nom lheh e, keiman gam man chu ka peh lhing nom e, ka loinu longdamsa kavui thei na ding in,” ati.
23.14: Hichun Ephron in Abraham adonbut in,
23.15: Ka Yaweh lungset tah in ngaiyin hiche gam man hi dangka jali ahiye, amavang eini golcha kingailut nahi mantam ahi? che inlang na loinu long damsa chu gavui tan ati.
23.16: Hichun Abraham chun Ephron in aseijat dangka jali chu apetan, hiche lai phat na kailhang thil man dung jui jin, thil kichoh dan ho chu Hit mite lah a tehse hon amu cheh uve.
23.17: Abraham'in Ephron koma gam Machpelah kiti Mamre koma um chu acho doh tai. Hiche mun in ahop chu ahile atong, adam sung, chule akoma thingphung um jouse jong ahi.
23.18: Abraham dinga chu anei agou ahitan, hichea chun Hit mite kelkot kom a chenghon jong ahe soh un ahi.
23.19: Phat chomkhat jouvin Abraham'in ajinu Sarah long Machpelah a Mamre koma Hebron kiti Canaan gamsunga avuitan ahi.
23.20: Aleimun le aleilaiya songlhan keo chu Hite miten alhan mun dingin Abraham achansah tauve.

24.1: Abraham chu akum ahung tam lheh tan Elohimin hatah in anatoh na jouse ah phatthei aboh sohkeiye.
24.2: Chuin Abraham'in nikhat chu asohte lah a atahpen insung vaihom pa heng ah hitin aseiye, “Nakhut chu kataigui noiya koiyin lang naki hahsel ding ahi.”
24.3: Chuteng le Yaweh van le leiset sempa min in ki hahsel in hichu nangman kamou ding hi Canaan gamsung tu a ichen nao muna konna hi nahin puilou ding ahi.
24.4: Hinlah nangma che inlang keima um nalui gam ka sopi holah a Isaac ji ding naga pui peh ding ahi ati.
24.5: Sohpan Abraham adonbut'in “Ijemtin numeinu chu keiho toh hiche gam'a kanung hinjui ding da tale ikalo ding hitam? Ahiloule keiman nachapa Isaac hi nangma hung kondoh na gam a chu kanung puikit thei ding ham?” ati.
24.6: Abraham'in adonbut'in “hoitah in gelchen in lang ka chapa vang kholam a na nung pui lou beh ding ahi.”
24.7: Yaweh van Elohim kanam mite le kapa insunga konna eipui dohpa, ka penna gam'a patna eihin puidoh pan kitepna aneiyin hitin eina seipeh e, nangma chilhah te hiche gamhi kapeh ding na hiuve.
24.8: Hinlah numeinu chun na hinyui nomlou le nangma keima dan kitepna a konna ongthol na hitai, thil khat chu ahile ka chapa vang khulam a nanungpui louhel ding ahi.”
24.9: Hichu Abraham sohpan apu Abraham taigui noiya akhut akoiyin apun ahilna thudol'a hin aki hahsel tai.
24.10: Hichun asohpa chun sangongsao som apupa Abraham kom ah alan thil mantam ajat jat apon Mesopotamia lama Nahor khopi jon din ache tai.
24.11: Aman sangongsao ho chu twi veina kotong koma khopi pam a akichol sah in nilhah langkai ahiphat in numei ho chu twi khai dingin ahung potdoh'un ahi.
24.12: Chuin Abraham sohpa chun, “O Yaweh kapu Abraham Elohim, tunia neipi lhin sah na dingin na-angsunga kataove, kapu Abraham dingin khoto na hinneiyin.”
24.13: Vetan keima hiche twikhuh phunga hin kadinge, chule hiche khopi sunga miho chanute twi khaiya hung ding ahiuve.
24.14: Hichehi kangai chat ahi. Alah uva khatpen pen chu kadoh ding, lungset tah in nakhon a twi chu neidon sahin. Amanun hitia hi ahin donbut leh, heng'e, donin, chule na sangongsao ho jong keiman hin donsah ing'e! Hiche nu chu nangman Isaac inneipi a dinga nalhen doh hiding ahi. Hiche akon a chu keiman ichan geiya kapu chunga guitan lou ngailutna nachan ham ti kahet ding ahi.
24.15: Asohpa taona achai masang in Rebekah numei khangthah nu chun aleng kouva twibel ahin pun ahung pot doh tan ahi, Amanu chu Bethuel chanu, Abraham sopipa Nahor le ajinu Milcah toh ahin lhon ahi.
24.16: Rebekah chu nungah melhoi vetnom nom a melhoi khat ahin, chule pasal tojong kitimat na neikha lou hel lai ahiye. Amanu chun Twikhuh sunga achelut in a twibel dimset in twi aga kithal in chu jouvin ahung kaldoh tai.
24.17: Abraham sohpa chu Rebekah kom lama alhai in hitin aseiye, “Lungset tah in nabel a twi chu themkhat neidon sah thei ding ham,” atile,
24.18: Rebekah in jong “Henge kapu nadon thei ma ma ahi,” chuin amanun a twi poh chu a lengkouva pat in ahin dom lhan Abraham sohpa chu adonsah tai.
24.19: Chuin Rebekah in twi adonsah jou chun, ana khongai tadin “Keiman na sangongsao ho ding jong twi gadom tading'e ati, chule na sangongsao hon adon chim tokah sen keiman gathal peh ing'e,” ati.
24.20: Hichun Rebekah chu gangtah in atwi poh chu gancha ho twikong sunga alheilhan, twikhuh langa chun twithal dingin a lhaijel kit'in amapa sangongsao ho abonchauvin twi adon chim sah soh keiyin ahi.
24.21: Chuphat'in sohpan thipbeh in Rebekah umchan chu aven ama akingaiton Yawehyin ka hung kholyin lona penhi a lolhin sah ding khat hitam, hilou ham tin phot chen ding gon Rebekah um chan chu thip behchan ave ave jeng in ahi.
24.22: Phat chomkhat jouvin sangongsao ho jousen twi ahin donva cheh tauvin, hichun sohpan sana bilba anah a budin ahin ladoh in chule sana chao jang ni lentah akhut cheng teni a bupeh din ahin ladoh tai.
24.23: Amapan adong tan, “Nangma hi koi chanu nahim? lungset tahin eihin donbut in, napa in mun a chu tujan kaki ngah thei diu ham?” ati.
24.24: Amanu'n adonbut in, “Keima hi Bethuel chanu kahi atin, kapu le kapi chu Nahor le Milcah ahi.
24.25: Henge, adih e, keihon chang pol tamtah kanei jun sangongsao ho neh thei ding, chule jin lhun in jong kanei uve,” ati.
24.26: Hichun sohpa abohkhup in Yaweh Elohim athangvah tai.
24.27: Elohim vahchoiyin umhen, kapu pa Abraham Elohim atitai. “Yawehyin a lungsetna longlou chule phatkim na kapu pa amusah tai, ajeh chu ahile imacha boina umlouva kapu sopite koma eipui lhungjel tai.”
24.28: Hichun khangthah nungahnu chu gangtah in a inlama alhai jel in ama chunga thilsoh um cheng a insung mite aga hetsah in ahi.
24.29: Rebekah chun sopi Laban aneiyin, amapa chun twikhuh kam'a chun ahung gamkon ho kimu pi din ahung tai.
24.30: Laban chun anah'a sana akiba a akhuta sana chaojang akibu chu amu tan, chuleh Rebekah in amaho chung chang thu asei chengse chu ajan, hichun ama alhaidoh pai jin twikhuh umna lama sangongsao ho nunga adin chu amun ahi.
24.31: Laban chun amakom a, “Nangho ding leh na sangongsao te ding uva mun gottup ahinung a khopam a iti nadin jeng uham? Elohim phattheiboh changho, hung in keiho kom a hung um in” ati.
24.32: Hichun amapa chun Laban toh insung alut tauvin, Laban chun sangongsao ho chu alham lhan changpol ho apen aki choldo na diu, chuleh aneh diu jong twi jong sohpa ding, chule sangongsao hoiya pang ho dinga akeng kisop ngim na ding un apen ahi.
24.33: Hichun aneh diu an ahung kilui doh tan ahin Abraham sohpan aseiye, “Imacha kaneh nompoi kahung na ajeh kasei masang in,” aphai tin Laban in adon but in, “Neisei peh un” ati.
24.34: “Keima hi Abraham sohpa kahi,” tin aman asei tai.
24.35: Chule Elohimin kapu pa hi hatah in phatthei aboh in ama nei le gou jong ahao thei lheh tan ahi. Chule Elohimin kelngoi hon, le sa namkim jong anei sah tan, chule sana dangka le soh numei le pasal, sangongsao tamtah jong chule sangan tamtah apetan ahi.
24.36: Chuin kapu pa loinu Sarah chu akum ahung teh jou nung in, kapupa chapa pasal khat ahing in, kapu pan achapa chu anei agou jouse ama ape doh tai.
24.37: Hia chun kapu Abraham'in eikitep sah in, Aman hitin aseiye, “Nangman hiche ka chapa hi Canaan numei ho toh na kichen sah lou hel ding ahi.”
24.38: “Amavang ka pate kom langa, ka insung mite kom lang joh a nache a ka chapa Isaac ji ding nei gapui peh tan,” ati.
24.39: Hinlah keiman kapu ka donbut in “Keiman ipi kalo ding ham? numei khangthah keima toh hung kinung le ding ka mu thei lou leh kati'e.
24.40: Aman ei donbut'in, “Yaweh ama umna limnoiya eiumpi pan avantil te nahin solpeh ding na kin jong thupitah a na lolhin sah ding ahi. Adih e! Hijeh a chu ka chapa aloinu ding keima insung miho lah a nahin pui tei ding ahi.
24.41: Hiche teng chule, keima a konna na onthol ding ahitai. Kasopi ho lah a naga che a amahon a chanu u chu nangtoh hung ding anoplou ule hiche achu nangma na themmo tapoi.
24.42: Hijeh chun tunnin, keima hilai twikhuh mun a hin kataove, O Yaweh, kapu pa Abraham Elohim tuchung hi ka hung ki gonna kin hi lungset tahin neilo lhin sah in kati'e.
24.43: Ven, keima hilaiya twikhuh koma kadin pet ahin, numei khangthah hon hiche twikhuh a twi thal a ahung teng ule hitia hi kasei ding, lungset tahin na khon na chun twi themkhat nei donsah thei ding ham?
24.44: Ama nun henge ati a chule keiman na sangongsao ho jouse jong twi ka donsah soh ding ahin tileh amanu chu kapupa chapa Isaac ji ding in nei petai tia ka lah ding ahi tai.
24.45: Keiman ka lungthima katao chai masang in Rebekah in alengkou va twibel ahin pun twikhuh lam ahin jon in, hichun keiman amanu jah'a hitin kaseiye, lungset tah in don ding twi neipen kati'e.
24.46: Hichun Rebekah in jong gangtah in a lengkouva twibel a twi aput chu ahin domlhan hitin asei tai. Henge aphai, twi nadon thei ahiye chule keiman nagancha Sangongsao ho jouse jong twi donva sah cheh nange ati, hichun ken jong ka don in, a sangongsao ho jong abonchauvin twi avahva cheh in ahi.
24.47: Hichun keiman ka dong in nangma hi koi chanu nahim katile aman eidonbut'in, “Bethuel chanu kahin Nahor le Milcah chu kapu le kapi ahi, hichea chu keiman anah a sana bilba kaba peh a akhut teni a sana chaojang kabu peh ahi,” ati.
24.48: Hichun keima ka kun in ka boh khup in Yaweh kavah choiye, kapu pa Abraham Elohim chu, Ajeh chu Elohimin lolhing tah in eipui jin ama sopi atute kom lama achapa ji puithei ding muna kaum tah jeh in ati.
24.49: Neisei peh in, nangman kilungset na longlou chule kingailut phot chetna hi kapu pa nasuh bulhit sah ding ham? ahilou leh ipi neilo ding ham? hiche teng chule keiman aban bolbe ding chu kigel tang kate.
24.50: Hichun Bethual le Laban in adonbut lhon in, “Elohimin hikoma hi na hin pui uchu ka nom e keima ho emacha seibe ding kahe pouve.”
24.51: Rebekah hi kipui jun che tauvin nadei ma bang in na pupa chapa inneipi din kipui tauvin, Elohimin nahin puiji mabang in atilhone.
24.52: Abraham sohpan hiche thu kisei ho jouse chu ajah phat chun tol'a abohkhup in Elohim a thangvah tai.
24.53: Hichun Abraham sohpan dangka sum eng chule sana khivui, pon mantam ho chu Rebekah apen, hiche tilou chun thil thupi mantam tah Laban le anu jong apen ahi.
24.54: Hichun amahon an ane khomun Abraham sohpa le ahin lhonpi ho jouse hiche jan chun ageh un, Hinlah jingkah matah in, Abraham sohpan hitin aseiye, “Ka pupa koma kinungle din neisol tauvin,” ati.
24.55: Amavang Laban le anun, “Rebekah chu nisom tobang aum be ding in adei lhon nalaiye. Hiche jouteng amanu chethei tante,” atiuve.
24.56: Ahin sohpan nei ni chon sah sah hih un, ajeh chu ka Yaweh ka hung na kin lenpen tah hi eilo lhin sah peh ahi tai. Lungset tah in kapu pa koma din eiki nungle sah tauvin.
24.57: Amahon aseiyun, “Aphai, Keihon Rebekah kouvung ting, aman ipi agel dong uving e” atiuvin ahi.
24.58: Hichun amahon Rebekah akouvun, “Amapa toh'in nache ding hitam,” tin adong uve. Chuin ama nun adonbut in “Henge kache ding ahi,” ati.
24.59: Hichun amahon damsel tauvin tin Rebekah chu alhau vin, Abraham sohpa toh ahin kilhonpi hotoh asol tauvin ahi. Rebekah chu aneova patna ahin sasah nu jong asol peh thauvin amanu toh kilhon ding ahi.
24.60: Amaho Rebekah in adalhah kon un hitin phatthei aboh un “Ka sahtah u sopinu nangman mi asang sang hin hing inlang, na chilhah te jong hat jing'u hen. Amahon amelma teu kelkot hinkal lhah jing'u hen,” atiuve.
24.61: Hichun Rebekah le asoh numei ho chu sangonsao chunga kaldoh un, Abraham sohpa nung chu ajui tauve, Hiti chun Abraham soh pan Rebekah chu apuiyun ahung tauve.
24.62: Hiche petna chu Isaac chu Beerlahai-roi japat achenna mun Negev lama ahung kinungle pettah ahi.
24.63: Nilhah khat Isaac chu avah len atao dinga ache le pet in phailei lam agahven ahile sangong-sang ho ahung chu amun ahi.
24.64: Chuin Rebekah agah khodah in ahile Isaac amuphat in sangongsao chunga kon in ahung kum lha tai.
24.65: “Koiham khulanga phailei lama vahle a eiho eigal dot'u khu,” tin Rebekah'in sohpa chu adongtan ahi. Chuin Abraham sohpan adonbut'in “Ama khu kapupa ahi,” hichun Rebekah'in adel alan akikhu khume.
24.66: Hichun sohpan Isaac chu ima jouse thusoh ho chu asei peh tan ahi.
24.67: Chuin Isaac in Rebekah chu anu Sarah ponbuh in na ahin puilut in, aman Rebekah chu aji din asang tan hatah in alungset in, amanu chu Isaac anun adalhah jou alung hem na jouse jong amil tai.

25.1: Abraham'in ji numei khat aneibe kit in, amanu min chu Keturah ahi.
25.2: Amanu chun cha hicheng hi ahing in, amaho se chu Zimran ahin, Jokshan ahin, Medan ahin, Ishbak ahin, chule Shuak ahiuvin;
25.3: Jokshan chun Sheba le Dedan ahingin, Dedan chilhah ho chu ahile Assurite ho ahin, Leteshite ho ahin, chule Leumimite jouse jong ahiuve.
25.4: Midian chate ho chu Ephah ahin, Epher ahin, Hannoch ahin, Abida ahin chule Eldaah amaho jouse hi Abraham cha Keturah a konna peng ahiuve.
25.5: Chule Abraham'in anei jouse achapa Isaac chu apetan ahi.
25.6: Amavang Abraham'in athi masang in aji kopte cha ho jouse jong thilpeh anei soh keiyin chule nisolam gamma abon'un aki in chonsah tai.
25.7: Abraham chu kum jakhat le kum som sagi le kum nga alhing in;
25.8: Hichun Abraham kum sottah ahing in lolhing tah in ahinkho amang in aleiset hinkho abeitai, chuin ama apu apa amite to akivui thatai.
25.9: Chule achate ni Isaac le Ishmael in apa lhon Abraham chu songlhan keova Machpelah achun avui lhon tai. Hichu Mamre kom ahin hiche mun chu Ephron chapa Zohar Hittites ho komma kicho doh anahi.
25.10: Hiche gam hi Abraham'in Hite mite ho koma a inneipi Sarah kivuina dinga ana choh doh mun chu ahi.
25.11: Abraham thijou chun, Elohimin hatah in Isaac chu Beerlahoi-roi Negev mun a phatthei abohtan ahi.
25.12: Hiche hohi Ishmael chilhah Abraham chapa Hagar a konna hung peng Egypt mite numei Sarah sohnu akon ahi.
25.13: Anoija hohi Ishmael chilhah amin, anam, aphung dungyui ja kipe, apeng masa penpa Nebaioth ahin, Kedar ahin, Adbeel ahin, Mibsam ahin,
25.14: Mishma ahin, Damah ahin, Masah ahin,
25.15: Hadard ahin, Tema ahin, Jetur ahin Naphish ahin chule Kedarmah hicheng hi ahiuve.
25.16: Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate ahiuvin, aminu jong akhotin a kisem a chuleh a ngahmun dung-juiya akilah le aphung khaijin haosa chapa cheh som le ni alhing uve.
25.17: Chule Ishmael chu kum jakhat le kum somthum le kum sagi ahing in, chuin ama aleiset hinkho abeitan hichun apu apate along lup naova ama jong akichol dotai.
25.18: Chule Ishmael chilhahte chun gam leiset Havilah apat Shur chan gei alodim un, hiche hi Assyria gam jotna Egypt gamto kinai Asshur a hung kipan ahi. Amaho chu asopi ule nao hotoh kivet dagunset in ana umjing uve.
25.19: Hiche hi Isaac Abraham chapa insung chilhah thusim ahi.
25.20: Chuin Isaac kum som li alhin in aji ding in Rebekah Paddan- Ram gam'a Bethuel chanu Aramean mi Laban sopinu chu a kipuiyin ahi.
25.21: Isaac ajinu ding in Elohim heng'a ataovin ahi, ajeh chu aching in cha neilouva aum phat in, hichun Elohim'in Isaac taona chu asan pehtan ahile Rebekah chu ahung kikopmo tan naosen ni ahung kijil tan ahi.
25.22: Hinlah naosen teni chu anu naobu sunga ahung kiboi jing lhonin hichun amanu Elohim dong dingin achen hiche hi itidan ham? ati.
25.23: Elohimin amanu ahoulim pi in “naobu sunga naocha teni chu nampi ni hung hiding hiche nam teni hi abulla patna hung kitoh mo peh lhon ding ahi, nam teni lah a khat hung hat intin, nacha teni lah a aupan anaopa chu ahin jenle ding ahi”.
25.24: Chuin naonei na ding phat ahung lhin chun Rebekah in naoni avop chu ahin kihet chen bep'in ahi.
25.25: Chuin ahung peng masa pachu asanin atahsa pumpi chu amul in atom in hichun ama chu Esau asah tauvin ahi.
25.26: Phat chomkhat jou chun asopipa ahung peng lhatan akhut teni a chun a upa keng atuh chah kheh in, Hichea chu amapa min chu Jacob asah un, ajinun amani ahin peh pet hin Isaac chu kum som gup ana lhingtai.
25.27: Chapang teni chu ahung khanglen lhonin, Esau chu gamleng sakap them gam vahmi ahung hikhan, Jacob vang chu mi mong khat ahin pondal buh a umjing mi ahi.
25.28: Isaac in Esau chu hatah in angailun ahi, Ajeh chu asa delsa ahin poh lut aneh jing jeh in, Hinlah Rebekah in Jacob chu alungset lheh in ahi.
25.29: Nikhat chu Jacob in changchim ahon pet in Esau chu agamlen na a konin ahung lhung in, nasa tahin agil akeltan atha alhasam lheh tan ahi.
25.30: Hijeh chun Esau in Jacob jah a hitin aseitai, “Kagil akel valtai na changchim hon salenglung chu them khat neipe tan” ati. Hijeh a chu amapa min Edom kisah ahi.
25.31: Aphai, tin Jacob in adonbut in, “Amasa pen in na upat nahina chu neipe doh tan,” ati.
25.32: Esau in hitin aseiye, “Keima gilkella thi dinga um ka hitan hiche mi upa chu ipi kaphat chom pi ding ham?”
25.33: Jacob in asei kit in, “Amasa pen a naki hahsel angaiye,” hichun Esau chu aki hahsel tan mi upa ahina chu Jacob komma akijoh doh tai.
25.34: Hichun Jacob in Esau chu changlhah toh chang-noi apetan hichun aman anevan adon chim set'in akithou doh in achetai, Hichun Esau in mi upa ahina chu akijoh dohtai.

26.1: Chuin gamsunga chun nasatah in kel ahung lhatan, hiche kel lhah chu Abraham damlaiya ahah tabang in, Isaac chu Gerar langa Philistine lengpa Abimelech heng a ache tai.
26.2: Chuin Elohimin Isaac chu ahou limpin hitin aseiye, “Keima thusei ngaiyin, Egypt langa nache thei lou ding ahi.
26.3: Chule nangma hiche gam a hin gampam kholjin mi bangin um'in keiman hatah a phatthei kaboh ding nahi. Chule gam jouse hi nangma le na chilhahte jouse kapeh ding nahi, Ajeh chu keiman napa Abraham komma kaki hahselna kamolso tei ding ahi.
26.4: Keiman na chilhahte van chunga ahsite jat banga kapun sah ding, hiche gam ho jouse hi kapeh ding, chule nangma chilhahte a konna vannoi mi jouse phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
26.5: Hiche ho jouse hi kabol ding ahi. Ajeh chu Abraham'in kathu angaiyin, kathu lhahna ahin, ka thupeh ahin, ka chondan thu ahin, chule ka danthu anitsoh keiyin ahi.
26.6: Hichun Isaac Gerar gamma acheng tan ahi.
26.7: Hiche gamma cheng miho chun Isaac jinu Rebekah chu koi ham tia adoh ule aman adonbut in, “Kasopinu ahi ati peh e,” ajeh chu hiche miho hin Rebekah jeh hin, “Keima eitha lo get uvinte tia anagel jeh a ka sopinu ahi anati ahiye. Ajeh chu amanu amelhoi jeh ahi.”
26.8: Hinlah ni phabep jou chun Abimelech Phalistines lengpan bangkot a kon agahven ahile vetan Isaac in Rebekah aji bol'a akinoupi pet amudoh tai.
26.9: Hichun gang tah in Abimelech in Isaac chu akouvin, “Amanu chu na jinu hilou ham? ibola amanu chu ka sopinu ahe tia nasei ham?” Isaac in adonbut in, “Ka seina ajeh chu ahile ka innneipi jeh a koi tabang khat in eitha lo ding ham kati ahi.”
26.10: Abimelech in aseiye, “Ipi dinga hiti pia chu neibol'u hitam? ilou themkhat in ka mite lah a khat touvin na jinu chu ana kipui hen ana luppi kha ta hen lang hileh nangma jeh a kei hon chonset lentah a neilhah sah ding'u hita chula em.”
26.11: Hichun Abimelech in danpi khat asem in mipi jouse henga aphong doh in ahi, “Koihi jong leh hiche mipa hihen ajinu hijong le ahin tongkha asuse aum leh thina chan a gotna kipe ding ahi.”
26.12: Hiche kum chun Isaac in muchi akitun ahile kum dang sang in ajat jakhat val jena tamjon aki-aat e, hiti chun Yawehyin ama phatthei ana boh'e.
26.13: Chua kon chun Isaac chu neile gou in ahung hao doh tan, anei le agou hatah in apun be cheh, apun be cheh jeng in ahi.
26.14: Hitobang chun neile gou keu hilouvin kelngoi jong, keltah jong, bonghon jong chule soh le kol jong tamtah ahin neitan, hiche ho jeh hin Phalistine miten nasatah in ahung engse tauvin ahi.
26.15: Hichun Phalistine miho chu athangthip jeh'un Isaac twikhuh jouse chu abonchan asuhbing peh tauvin ahi. Hiche twikhuh ho sese hi apa Abraham adamlaiya asohten ana laihou chu ahi.
26.16: Chuin Abimelech in achaina in Isaac komma aseiye, “Nangma keiho komma kon in chedoh tan ajeh chu nangma keiho sang in natha lhing jotai,” ati.
26.17: Hichun Isaac chu amaho komma kon in achen Gerar phaicham ah amaho ponbuh akison uvin hiche mun achun acheng tauve.
26.18: Chuin Isaac in Apa Abraham thi jouva Palestine mipiten ana huhbing peh'u twikhuh ho sese chu alai hong kit'in apa Abraham'in ana minsah twikhuh min ho chu avel sah kit in asem hoisah kit tai.
26.19: Isaac sohten Gerar phaicham chu twikhuh alai uva ahile twisam phungkhat alai doh tauve.
26.20: Ahin Gerar gamma kelngoi chinghon Isaac kelngoi chingho komma chun “hiche twikhuh hi keiho twikhuh ahi,” atiuvin a kinelpi tauvin ahi; hichun Isaac in hiche twikhuh chu “Esek” asah'in hichun avetsah chu “Kiboina mun,” tina ahi.
26.21: Hichun Isaac sohten twikhuh chom dang khat alai kit'un ahile hiche mun jong chu boina ahung um kittan hichun Isaac in “Sitnah” (Tichu kitomona mun tina ahi) asah tan ahi.
26.22: Chuin Isaac in hiche mun chu adalhan akichon in twikhuh chom beh khat alai kit in ahile hiche mun a vang chun akinahpi tapouvin ahi, hijeh chun Isaac in hiche mun chu “Rehoboth” asah tai. “Ajeh chu tun vang Elohimin eiho ding in gam eihon peh tauve, agamsung ahin eiho cha le nao vin pungjal tauhite,” ati.
26.23: Hiche mun a pat chun Isaac in Beersheba ah akichon kittai.
26.24: Hiche jan lele chun Isaac henga Elohim ahung kilah in “Keima napa Abraham Elohim chu kahi, Imacha gichat na nei hih behin ajeh chu keiman nangma ka umpi jing nai, chule phatthei ka boh ding nahi, nason nachilhah te jong hatah a ka punsah ding amaho nam lentah ka soding ahi. Hiche hohi kasuh bulhing ding ahi. Ajeh chu ka sohpa Abraham koma kana kitep nasa ahi.”
26.25: Hichun Isaac in hiche mun achun maicham asem in Elohim ahou tai, chule aman aponbuh jong asongdoh kit in asohten twikhuh khat alaikit un ahi.
26.26: Ni khat chu Abimelech jong Gerar gamma pat na semangpa Ahuzzath chule asepai lamkai Phicol akipuiyin Isaac to kimuto dingin ahungtai.
26.27: Isaac in amaho chu adong in, “Ipi dinga ka henga hung nahiuvem?, nei vetda uva nagam uva patna neino doh u hitalou ham?” anatin ahi.
26.28: Ama hon adon but'un, “Keihon Elohimin nangma na umpi hi phatechan kamu chen tauve. Hijeh chun nangho le keiho kikah a kihou cham ding kanom ui, chule ikah uva kitepna khat sem kanom uve.
26.29: Ahi theile kihou chamna inei thei ding'u dei aum lheh e, keima hon jong nangho chunga imacha bolse pou ving'e, kei hon nang ho ka ngailu jing uve. Chule lung damsel a kasol doh joh nahiuve. Ven! tun nangho Elohimin nasatah in phatthei naboh tauve.
26.30: Hichun Isaac in kinopto na ankong nehkhom na asem in amahon abonchauvin anekhom un adonkhom un ahi.
26.31: Ajing in jingpi matah in akithou’ un amaho khat khat in kitepna anei uvin, hichun Isaac in amaho chu a in lam uva asolkit tan, amaho jong lunglhai sel in akinung le tauve.
26.32: Hiche ni ma ma chun Isaac sohten twisam thah khat alai doh'u chu thu ahung peuvin amahon aseiyun, “Keihon twisam thah khat kamu uve,” ahung tiuve.
26.33: Hichun Isaac in twisam thah chu Shebath asah tai. (Shebath tichu kinoptona tina ahi) Hiche nia patna chu tuni gei a hi Beershiba khopi kiti ahiye.
26.34: Esau chu kum som li alhin chun Hit mite numei Beeri Judith le Hit mi mama Elon chanu Basemath chu ji ding in akipui jin ahi.
26.35: Amavang Esau ji teni chu Isaac le Rebekah din thoh lel aum lheh jeng lhon in ahi.

27.1: Ateh a kho amu chen lou nung hin nikhat hi Isaac in achapa alenjo pachu akouve.
27.2: “Ka chapa! Keima hi ateh kahi tai, Itih thiding kahim kasei thei tapoi,
27.3: Hijeh chun tun nangma kigong in lang na man chah nathalpi kigot inlang gamlah a kei ding sa gakap'in,
27.4: Chuteng le keiman kadu lamtah in hin lhonin lang hinchoi jin keiman kaneh ding chuteng le nangma hi kahinkho abei masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi ati.
27.5: Ahin Isaac le Esau kihou na chu Rebekah'in guhthim chan ana ngai jin hichun Esau chu gamleng ding a akon doh phat in;
27.6: Rebekah in Jacob jah'a hitin aseiye, “Ngaijin napa Isaac in na upa Esau hitin ahoulimpi kaja'e,” ati.
27.7: “Sa neiga delpeh inlang kadu lamtah in hinhon in lang hinchoi in keiman ne ingting chule Elohim masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi, kahinkho abei masang in,” ati.
27.8: Hijeh chun tun kachapa ka thusei hi phatechan ngaiyin kathu sei hohi najui ding ahi.
27.9: “Nangma kelngoi hon lah a gachen lang ahoitah cheh anouni hinkai jin chuteng le keiman napa dulam tah a kahon peh ding,
27.10: Hiche teng chule nangman napa komma nachoi ding aman aneh a aneh jou teng phatthei na boh ding ahi, ama ahinkho adampet ahi,” ati.
27.11: Ahin Jacob in anu Rebekah adonbut in ajah'a, “Vetem in ka upa Esau a tichung amul in ahin keima vou nem a timul lou ka hi.
27.12: I kati ding ham? kapa in eihin jut le ta le jou a kabol ahin hetdoh leh koi phatthei chan sanga sapset na joh kachan joh ding ahi,” ati.
27.13: Hinlah anu Rebekah in adonbut in, “Sapsetna ho aumle abon'in keiman kipoh tang kate ati, chapa bol in ka ti hohi na bol angaiye, che inlang kelngoi chu ka henga hin kailut loiyin ati!”
27.14: Hichun Jacob jong achen kelngoi chu anu kom'a ahin kailut tai. Chuin anun jong apa dulam tah in ahon peh tai.
27.15: Hichun Esau von holah a aphapen chu insunga kon in agala doh in achapa aneojo pa Jacob chu avonpeh tan ahi.
27.16: Chule kelngoi nou teni mulchu akhut teni le angong amul bei lai achun atom peh in ahi.
27.17: Hichun Rebekah in sa twitah a ahon chule changlhah ama semsa chu achapa Jacob khut a apetan ahi.
27.18: Hichun Jacob in changlhah le kelsa chu apa aga pen “Hepa” atileh aman jong “Hoiyo koipen nahim ka chapa?”
27.19: Jacob'in a donbut in, “Keima Esau na chapa apeng masa chu kahi,” ati. “Keiman kahin subulhit tai nei nganse na chu lungset tah in kithou inlang ka hin choi sa twitah a kihon hi ne inlang phatthei neiboh tan,” ati.
27.20: Chuin Isaac in achapa chu adonbut in, “Iti dan ham? man gangtah in nahin vaidoh loijen in ka chapa atile aman jong adonbut in Yaweh na Elohimin gangtah a eihin lolhin sah ahi bouve,” ati.
27.21: Hichun Isaac in Jacob henga, “Hung ki khin nai jin katham phah thei nadin, nangma hi ka chapa Esau nahi mong nam nahi lou ham na jutle tem inge.
27.22: Hijeh chun Jacob in apa Isaac anailut in ahile ahin jutle tan ahi, a awso hila Jacob awso ahin, akhut teni vang hi Esau khut ahi ngal in atin ahi.
27.23: Amavang Jacob ahi chu ahetchen thei lou ahitai, ajeh chu Jacob khut chu a upa Esau khut tobanga mul ahijeh'in hichun Isaac chun Jacob chu phatthei abohtan ahi.
27.24: Isaac in adong pha kit leuvin, “Nangma hi kachapa Esau nahi mong hinam? atile, Jacob in adonbut in “Ka hinai,” ati.
27.25: Chuphat in Isaac in aseiye, “Ka henga hindom naitan nangma phatthei kaboh thei na dingin kachapan gangtah a naga mat sa na hon chu ne ing kate,” ati, chuin Jacob in ahin doppeh phat in anen chule lengpitwi jong ahin dop peh in ahile Isaac chun adon tai.
27.26: Hichun apa Isaac chun ajah a “eihin nailut in lang neihin bengchop tem in ka chapa,” atile,
27.27: Jacob'in anai phei jin apa chu abengchop tai, chuin Isaac kivonna ho gimnam chu anah le len chuin achapa chu phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Vetan kachapa gimnam hi Yaweh phatthei bohsa gamlah gimnam abang'e.
27.28: Tun Yaweh Elohimin vana kon in daitwi na chap jing hen, leiset'a leipha lai lai nachan sah jing hen; chule chang le mim chule juning ninglhin sah jing hen.
27.29: Nam simsen lou vin naja hen chule mihem tamtah nangma noija kun cheh hen lang, nasopi ho chunga vai hin hom jing in lang; nanu sunga peng doh pasal jouse jong na henga kun cheh uhen. Nangma na gaosapte chu gaosap chang hen, chule nangma phatthei na bohte chu phattheiboh chang hen!” ati.
27.30: Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh chai chai jin; Jacob in apa angsung agah dalhah ding kon chet in a upa Esau chu agam lena a kon in ahung lhung pai jeng tai.
27.31: Chuin Esau in jong nehding a althet in ahon peh in apa henga ahin dop peh in apa jah a aseitai. “Hepa hung kithou in lang na hai hai pet'a phatthei neiboh na ding in na chapa thasa hi hung ne o!” ati.
27.32: Ahin Isaac in adonbut in, “Nang koi nahim? Esau in adonbut in, “Na chapa apeng masa Esau kahi,” ati.
27.33: Isaac hatah in ati akithing tan aseiye, “Koiham Ijo langa hin dom a hunga chu, keiman ama hin dop chu kana ne tai. Nangma hung lhun masang jep chun phatthei jong ka boh jou tai; phatthei na jouse jong ama achang jou tai.”
27.34: Chuin Esau in apa thusei jouse chu angai chai sohhel phat'in Esau jong ha kan akap'in hatah in alunghang in apa komma atao kit'in, “Hepa keima jong phatthei nei boh teitei in ong,” ati.
27.35: Hinlah Isaac in aseiye, “Na sopipa ahung in eihung lhem lha tai, nang phatthei na chan ding jouse nalah peh gam tai.”
27.36: Esau in adonbut in, “Hiche jeh a chu amin Jacob kisah hitei jinte ong? Ajeh chu aman nivei jen eilhep lhah ahitai, phat masa in ka upat hina eina lah peh in, tun ka phatthei chan ding ana kilah doh kit e, atin hichun keiya dinga phatthei khat beh jong neina khen pehlou hitam?” atile.
27.37: Isaac in Esau adonbut in, “keiman Jacob chu nangma chunga vaihom ding in ka koi tai, chule asopite jouse ama noija kun cheh diu, chule chang le mim ahin, juning ahin, haothei na jong kapeh ahitai, tua hijat nunga nangma ipi kabolpeh thei nahlai ding ham kachapa?” atitai.
27.38: Ahi vang'in Esau in apa jah a “O hepa phatthei na khat chabeh jong umlou hitam? phatthei neiboh teitei yin ong Hepa!” atin apeng in akap tai.
27.39: Chuin apa Isaac in ahoupin ajah a “Nangma leichung phalou lah lah a cheng ding na hitan, chule van daitwi in jong hin chap khata ponte.
27.40: Nangma na chemjam a naki vahding chule na sopipa noija na um ding ahin nangma na hung ki- ondoh teng vangleh nangong chang'a konna ama namkol chu na pai lhah ding ahi tai,” ati.
27.41: Hiche phat a pat a chu Esau in Jacob chu hatah a ahin vetda pan ahi tai; ajehchu apa Isaac in phatthei na jouse Jacob aboh jeh ahi. Chule Esau in alung thim sunga hitin agel tan, “Kapa hin nikho jong hi sotta pon tin a kichai teng le keiman ka naopa Jacob hi ka tha ding ahi,” ati.
27.42: Ahin achapa alenjo Esau lungthim tohgon jouse chu Rebekah jah a aki seidoh khatan ahin Rebekah in mi asol'in achapa neojopa Jacob chu aga kousah in ajah a asei pehtai, “Ngaiyin na upa Esau khun nang thana ding in lungthim tohgon anei tai,
27.43: Chapa chingthei tah in ngai jin, tun kigong inlang kasopipa Laban kom Haran langa jam tan.
27.44: Hiche mun achun ni ejat hijong leh ga umtan na upa Esau lungdam kahsen.
27.45: Ama ahung lungdam a nabolset naho asuhmil hel'a ahung lungdam mong mong teng leh keiman mi hinsol ing ting nahung holdoh sah nang'e. Nang ni ucha nikhat a na manthah lhon ding ka nompoi.
27.46: Hichun Rebekah in Isaac komma aseiye, “Keiman hiche Hit mite numei ho kathei chim behset jeng tai, Ijem tin Jacob in hiche numei ho jin ahin kipui kit ding ka gel thei poi kathi lo tei ding ahi,” ati.

28.1: Hichun Isaac in Jacob akouvin, phatthei aboh-in chule athu lhah in ajah a hitin aseiye, “Nangman hiche Canaan numei hohi jia nakipui thei louhel ding ahi;
28.2: Hijeh chun gangtah in kipatdoh in lang Padan-Ram a nanu upa Bethuel in a chen chukom akon chun nanu sopipa Laban Chanute joh ga kipuitan.
28.3: Pa Elohimin phatthei naboh hen lang nacha nanao tha lhinsah hen, na punsah hen, chule amaho chu nam lentah hung himaiyu hen.
28.4: Elohimin nangma le nachilhahte chunga phatthei naboh uhen, napu Abraham kom a anaki tepna ho chu tua nangma na khopem nagam jong hi nahin losoh ding ahi, Ajeh chu Elohimin Abraham ana pehsa ahitai.
28.5: Chule Isaac in Jacob chu asol mang tai, ama jong Padan-aram langa Jacob le Esau hingnu Rebekah sopipa Laban, Aramea mi Bethuel chapa henga achetai.
28.6: Esau in ahechen tai apa Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh a Padan-Ram langa numei ji a gakipui dinga a phatsah a, chule phatthei aboh pet'a agihsal a “nangman hiche Canaan numei ho ji a naki pui thei lou ding ahi,” tia asei peh jong aja tai.
28.7: Chule Jacob in apa le anu thu angaiyin Padan-aram lam ah achetai.
28.8: Chule Esau chun Canaan numei ho chunga apa Isaac alunglhai poi ti ahe chen tai.
28.9: Hichun Esau jong apu Ishmael henga achen Abraham chapa Ishmael chanu Nebaioth sopinu Mahalath chu aji masa teni belap ding in aga kipui ben ahi.
28.10: Chule Jacob in Beersheba chu adalhan Haran lang ajon tai.
28.11: Hiti chun gamkim lai khat ahung geidon hin nisan alhum den tai, hichun ama jong jan chun chukom muna ageh dentai, age na muna songho khat chu alan lukhap in aneiyin alumden tai.
28.12: Ama hiti chun alup lhah chun amanga kalbi saotah kido amun leiset apat vantham jol geiya kidolut amun, hichun Jacob in Yaweh vantilte akaltou akumsuh jing u chu amun ahi.
28.13: Chule kalbi achung langa chun Yaweh ading in hitin aseiye, “Keima Yaweh Elohim napu Abraham Elohim napa Isaac Elohim kahi. Tua naki choldo na mun hohi nangma leh nachilhahte kapeh doh ahitai.
28.14: Na chilhahte chu tol'a leivui ja kaphahsah ding amaho chun solam, lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglam aboncha ahin lodim soh dingu ahi, chule leiset chunga nangma le na insung mite jeh a vannoi phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
28.15: Itihchan hi jongle nangma ka umpi jing ding nache nachan a nikhat teng hiche gam'a hi kahin nung pui lut kit ding nahi, ajeh chu kaki tepna jouse ka suhbulhit masangse a donlouva ka koi louhel ding nahi.
28.16: Hichun Jacob a imutna konna ahung khang doh in hitin aseiye, “Hikom ahin Elohim a um mong'e tihi kana hetphah lou ahi.”
28.17: Hinlah ama chu tijatnan adim in hitin aseiye, “Hiche lai mun hi Elohimin ahiloule thildang imacha ahi tapoi; chujong le hiche lai hi van gam kelkot phung ahi bouve,” ati.
28.18: Hichun Jacob jingkah matah in athouvin alukhap song chu alan khom phun aphut'in achunga chun thao twi asun khum in ahi.
28.19: Hiche mun chu Beth-el asah tai, hichun avetsah chu Elohim Hou-In tina ahi; phat masalai chun Luz tin ana kihei.
28.20: Hichun Jacob in kigahna khat aneiyin, “Keima Elohimin ei umpi jing le kakhol jinna hi kaneh ding bu chuleh sil le chen eipeh ding ahi,” ati.
28.21: Chule keima kapa in damsel a ei nungpui lhung kitleh ama chu ka Yaweh Elohim dihtah mong ahi tia ding det kahitai.
28.22: Chule hiche song khomphu a ka phudoh hi Elohim hou na in kiti ding ahi. Chuleh Elohimin eipeh jouse hi hopsom a hopkhat nangma kapeh ding ahi ati.

29.1: Hichun Jacob akhol che chu abanjom in solam mite gam chu ahung lhung tai.
29.2: Chuin aman agah ven ahile loulaiya Twisam amun akomma chun kelngoi hon loi thum'a akol jong amun hiche gancha ho chu twikulla don ding twi ngah ahiuve, chule twisam chu songpi lentah in adal khum ahi.
29.3: Hitia chu kelngoi hon ho abonna ahung kisuh kimteng uleh kelngoi ching hon twikhuh kamsin songpi chu akhin doh jiuva kelngoi te twi achip sah jiuva achipva teng ule song chu akikoi na ngai ngai twikhuh kam a chu ale khin lut kit jiu ahi.
29.4: Chuin Jacob in amaho jah a “Sopite ho hoiya hung kon na hiu ham?” atile amahon adon but un “Keiho Haran gam'a hung kon ka hiuve,” ati.
29.5: Amapan adong kit in amaho chu “Nahor chapa Laban chu nahet khah hih uvem?” atile “Amahon jong kahe nauve,” atiuve.
29.6: Chuin Jacob in ajah uva “Ama chu dam dam a hinam? tia adohle amahon “henge adam jingnai ven tua hung kelngoi hontoh hung kilhon khu achanu Rachel hija khu,” atiuve.
29.7: Jacob in ama ho jah a “Tuhin nisa sangtah hinalai ja gancha hoi khom phat bon hilou lai, kelngoi hon chu twi chipsah uvin lang gavah pha uvin,” ati.
29.8: Ama hon a donbut un, “Gancha ho jouse ahung kikim tokah in twi kipethei ponte atiuve, hichun kelngoi chingho chun songpi chu twisam kot apat chun atangdoh un kelngoi hon jouse twija ka vah va ding ahi,” atiuve.
29.9: Amahon hitia akihou lim pet tah uchun Rachel chu apa kelngoi hon hotoh ahung ki jot luttai, Ajeh chu amanu jong kelngoi ching a pang ahiye.
29.10: Hichun Jacob in anu sopipa Laban chanu Rachel le anu sopipa Laban kelngoite amu phat in anai lut in twikhuh kamsin songpi chu alih doh in apupa kelngoi hon chu twi achip sah in ahi.
29.11: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel chu abeng chop in awging tah in akap'e.
29.12: Jacob in Rachel jah a apa sopinu Rebekah chapa ahi thusim aseipeh tan ahile Rachel chu achen apa aga hetsah tan ahi.
29.13: Laban in Jacob asopinu chapa ahung lhun ahet chun akimu pin akoi jin achop jeng in chuin a in lama ahin puilut tai. Hichun Jacob in ima jouse thusimho chu aseipeh tai.
29.14: Chuin Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi kagu ka chang chule ka phevou mong nahi,” ati. Hichun Jacob chu apu Laban kom'a lhakhat sung aum tai.
29.15: Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi ka insung mi nahi vang'in mohseh a tohman beiya na um ding chu adih thei poi, natoh man ipi hiding ham neisei peh tem in? tin adong tai.”
29.16: Laban in chanu ni aneiyin, alenjo nu min chu Leah ahin, chule aneojo nu min chu Rachel ahi.
29.17: Ahin Leah mit chu aleng thim in ama vang Rachel chu amelhoi jin, amaiso jong lungset aum lheh jenge.
29.18: Jacob'in Rachel chu hatah in adeichat jeh in hitin aseiye, “Keiman nang ding in kum sagi na nei tohsah in lang, na chanu aneojo nu Rachel hi keima ji din kipui tang kate,” ati.
29.19: Laban in adonbut'in, “Hithei nante,” ati. “Ajeh chu keiman midang ho kapeh sanga nangma kapeh ding chu thilphajo ahibouve, Hijeh chun keima koma um jingtan,” ati.
29.20: Hichun Jacob in kum sagi sung in Rachel man toh kitoh ding in na atong tan, Hinlah Jacob in Rachel angailut behset jeh chun ni chomcha toh abahsah in ahi.
29.21: Chujouvin Jacob in Laban jah a hitin aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ho jouse ka subulhit tai, kajinu tun neipe tan ka luppi nom tai,” tin ahung thum tai.
29.22: Hichun Laban in jetle veija cheng ule nao jouse akou khom soh keiyin kichen na golvah chu aboltai.
29.23: Hinlah hiche jan ahung thim phat chun Laban in Leah chu Jacob koma aga that lut pehtan, Jacob in hichenu chu alup khom petai.
29.24: Laban in asohnu Zilpah jong chu Leah kithopi a pang ding in apeh tha tai.
29.25: Ahin jingkah matah in Jacob ahung kitho leh Leah joh anahin, Jacob in Laban jah a aseiyin, “Ipi iti a hiti a hi neibol hitam? kum sagi nangma noiya na kana toh chu Rachel manding a katoh hilou ham? “Ibol a nei jou lhep ham? tin aseiye.
29.26: Laban in adonbut in “Kei ho chondana a unu umpet a hi anaonu jinei doh thei lou ahi.”
29.27: Hiche hapta khat sunghi ji nei dan hi subu lhit tadin, hiche teng chule Rachel jong kapeh ding na hi, ahin nangman kum sagi ma kana, natoh kit ding ahi ati peh e.
29.28: Chuin Jacob in Leah chu hapta khat lhing in akichen pin hiche jou chun Laban in Rachel jong ajinu ding in ape tai.
29.29: Laban'in asohnu Bilhah jong chu achanu Rachel jenle a pang dingin apehtha tai.
29.30: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel jong alup khom pitan, aman Rachel chu Leah sang in hatah in adei jon, hichun Jacob in kum sagi ma Laban na atong kit'in ahi.
29.31: Ahin Elohimin Leah kihot bol chu amudoh tan, hijeh chun anaobu ahondoh peh in, amavang Rachel chu aching in cha neilou in aum tai.
29.32: Leah vang chu achung agih tan; chapa khat ahing in amin Reuben asah tai, Ijeh in em itile, “Elohimin ka gimna ho eihet pehtai, hiche jeh a hi ka jipan eilungset ding ahi tai,” ati.
29.33: Chuin aman nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing kit tai, ajeh chu “Keima eikihot bolhi Yawehyin ajah doh phat'a chapa hiche jong hi eipeh kit ahiye” atin hijeh chun amin Simeon asah tai.
29.34: Hichun Leah achung gih in, nao avop kittan ama nun hitin aseiye, “Tua pat'a hi ka jipa toh thakhat tipum khat kahi lhon ding ahi tai, ajeh chu keiman cha pasal thum ka hin pehtai hichun naosen chu amin chu Levi asah tai.”
29.35: Chujouvin Leah in nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing in, “Tuchunga vang Yaweh ka thangvah na ding ahi,” atin hijeh chun amin Judah asah tai, chujou a pat in vang cha abang tan ahi.

30.1: Hichun Rachel'in Jacob cha ahinpeh lou akihet chet phat in asopinu athangset pin, hijeh chun Jacob komma atao tan, “Keijong cha le nao nei hinpeh in achuti loule keima thi ding ka nom jotai atin ahi.”
30.2: Jacob chu Rachel chunga alung hang jah jeng in, “Keima Elohim ka hipoi ama ahi cha nei louva na koi, na naobu khah tan achu,” ati.
30.3: Hichun Rachel in adonbut in, “Kasohnu Bilhah hi galup khompi tan, chutile amanun nao eihin peh intin chua konna chu keiman jong ka chilhah insung kaki semdoh thei ding ahi,” ati.
30.4: Rachel in Bilhah asohnu chu Jacob ji din apetai chuin Jacob'in Bilhah chu akitimat pitai.
30.5: Bilhah in nao ahinvop'in Jacob ding in chapa khat ahin peh tai.
30.6: Hichun Rachel in aseiye, “Elohimin ka lunggel eisu bulhit pehtai, chule katao na jong eisan peh in chapa eipe tai atin hijeh chun naosen min chu Dan asahtai.”
30.7: Chuin Rachel sohnu Bilhah chun nao avop kit in Jacob chapa anina ahin peh kittai.
30.8: Hichun Rachel'in, “Keiman ka sopinu toh hatah a kaki set delna lhon a keiman kajou tai,” atin hichun naosen min chu Napthali asah tai.
30.9: Leah in nao aneikit tah lou ding ahin kihet doh phat in asohnu Zilpah chu ji din ape tai.
30.10: Hijeh chun Leah sohnu Zilpah chun Jacob ding in chapa khat ahin pehtai.
30.11: Hichun Leah in hitin aseiye, “Hamphat aum bouve,” atin naosen min chu “Gad” asah tai. Hichun avetsah chu, keima iti vangphat kahi hitam tina ahi.
30.12: Hichun Leah sohnu Zilpah chun Jacob chapa anina chu ahin peh kitin ahi.
30.13: Leah chun aseiye, “Keiya din iti thanop um hitam, tua hi numei dang jousen hatah a eiki papi diu ahitai,” atin hiche naosen min chu Asher asah tai.
30.14: Nikhat Reuben chu suhlou chang vohlai in akon in ahile loulai achun Joldei-Ai (Mandrake) amun anu Leah ahin poh peh in ahile, hichun Rachel in Leah koma “lungset tah in na chapa Joldei-Ai hinpoh chu kei jong nei hom thei ding ham tin athum tai.”
30.15: Hinlah Leah in Rachel jah a “Ka inneipu neilah peh jong thil neocha na bola, tua jong kachapa Joldei-Ai hinpoh jong lahpeh ding neiti ham?” atile Rachel in adonbut in, “Chuti ahile nachapa Joldei-Ai poh man ding in tujan Jacob'in nangma na lupkhompi thei nante,” ati.
30.16: Hiche nilhah chun Jacob phailei lama konna ahung ki nungle phat in Leah achen aga kimu pin, “Tujan hi keima toh ilupkhom ding ahi, Ajeh chu tujan adinga ka chapan nao neitheina hinpoh a tujana dinga ka choh na hitai,” hichun Jacob chu hiche jan chun Leah to ageh lhontai.
30.17: Elohimin Leah taona chu asan pehtan, nao ahin voptan Jacob chapa nga lhinna ahin neipeh tai.
30.18: Hichun Leah in asei tan, “ka sohnu chu kajipa ka pehdoh jeh in Elohimin ka choh doh man eipe tai,” atin hichun naosen min chu Issachar asah tan ahi.
30.19: Chujouvin jong Leah chun nao avop kit'in Jacob ding in chapa gup lhinna ahin peh kit tai.
30.20: Hichun Leah in asei tan, “Elohimin keima numei thilken phatah tah eiken peh tai, tuapat'in kaji pan ngailutna sangtah einei ding ahi tai, ajeh chu chapa gup kaneipeh tai,” hichun amanun naosen min chu Zebulun asah tai.
30.21: Ahin phat chomkhat jouvin nao numei khat ahingin amin chu Dinah asah in ahi.
30.22: Hichun Elohimin Rachel chu asumil pon Elohimin ataona asanpeh in anaobu chu ahon pehtai.
30.23: Hijeh chun Rachel in jong nao ahin vop'in chapa khat ahin neitai; hichun Rachel in hitin aseiye, “Elohimin kaja chatna jouse asubeitai,” ati.
30.24: Rachel'in anao min chu Joseph asah in hitin aseiye, “Yawehyin chapa dang khat jong eihin sah kit teitei hen o!” ati.
30.25: Rachel in Joseph ahin neijou phat chun, Jacob in Laban koma asei tai, “Nei nungsol tan kagam lang uva,” ati.
30.26: Kajite kachate neipe dohtan phat sottah nangma in alhachan ka pangtan, tua hi keima ki nungle phat ahung hitai, chule ito banga nangma na katoh peh nahim nangman nakihet nai ati.
30.27: Ahin Laban in Jacob jah a aseiye, “Ahithei dingle lungset tah in neida lha hih in ajeh chu nangma ka insunga na hung lutna pat in Elohimin phatthei eiboh lheh jeng in ahi.
30.28: Chule Jacob in asei in, natoh man ding ijat ham neisei peh tan keiman kapeh ding nahi ati.
30.29: Chuin Jacob in adonbut in, “Nangman na henai itobanga nangma na katoh a na gancha ho hung pung thei ham?” ati.
30.30: “Ajeh chu keima ka hung masang chun themcha bou na neijin tun apung jal tan, Elohimin hatah in phatthei na boh tan ahi. Ahile itih phat hi ding ham? keima insunga ding katoh na ding,” ati.
30.31: Chule Laban in adong kitin, “Ipiba ka peh ding ham? Jacob'in aseiye, Imacha neipe hih in, ahin thil khat neibol peh le chun keiman nagancha na vettup peh nang'e ati.
30.32: Tun keiman na gancha kelngoi ho ga khol sohkei jing ting, amaho lah achun apol jouse hin lheng doh inting, chule keltah ho laha jong apol thim hihen hapol apol jouse hin lheng doh ingting, hichengse chu keima natoh man in neibol pehtan ati.
30.33: Khonung teng kana toh man sutoh dinga nahung teng ka kitah na nahin muchen thei na dingin, kelchate lah a apol lou hihen, ha pol a pol lou akimu doh khah a, kelngoi lah a jong apol lou khattou aum khah a ahile hiche ho se chu nangma akonna kaguh a kisim jeng thei ding ahi,” ati.
30.34: Hichun Laban in adonbut in, “Apha lheh jeng'e nangman nasei bang chu himai tahen,” ati.
30.35: Hinlah Laban in hiche nikho ma ma chun kelcha achal asandup apol, chule abeh beh a kang kelcha anu apol ho, chule kelngoi avom ho jouse chu achapa koma abon'in agathah doh sah sohkei in ahi.
30.36: Hichun aman Jacob to nithum jen lampi a kigam lat'in asol mangtai, chule Jacob in Laban gancha aki thah lou jouse chu aching jom jing tan ahi.
30.37: Chuin Jacob in Almond le Shiga phung bah ho chu amal ngim in hiche thingbah avel akang lai ho chu kelcha ho amusah in ahi.
30.38: Hichun Jacob in thingbah amal ngim hon chu kelngoi ho twi donna konga akoiyin, kelngoite twichip dinga ahung ji teng ule kijang matji ahi jeh uva akoi ahi.
30.39: Kelngoi ho chu thingbah akang lai masanga chu ki jang mat ji, chuteng chule kelngoite chun akang pol jong, hapol a pol jong ahin hing doh doh tauve.
30.40: Jacob in kelngoi ho chu ahoikhen in Laban kelngoi hon lah a akangpol ho leh avom ho chu ahoikhen in ama chan ding chengse chu atum in akhen doh in, Laban a lah achun ahoi lut tapoi.
30.41: Hiti chun kelngoi lah a asapha ho chu aki jang mat teng ule thingbah ho amu uva, aki jang mat theina ding uvin Jacob in jong thingbah ho amasang uva twi lonna kom laiya aga jam peh jin ahi.
30.42: Hinlah Jacob'in kelngoi atahsa phalou ho ahi tengle aga jamle jipoi, ajeh chu Laban a chu asapha lou jeng ahin, Jacob a vang chu asapha jeng ahiuve.
30.43: Hijeh chun Jacob chu ahung hao thei lheh tan, kelngoi tamtah ahin neitan, soh numei ahin soh pasal ahin tamtah aneiyin, chule sangan le sangangsao jong tamtah anei doh tai.

31.1: Jacob in Laban chapate ama chung'a alung damlou'u thu aja tan ama hon aseiyun, “Jacob in ipau thil jouse akilah tan, chule anei agou athil keu jouse khu ipauva konna akilam doh ahi,” ati tauve.
31.2: Chujong le Jacob in Laban maiso aven ahile alung lhailou lungthim chom agel jong ahe chen tan ahi.
31.3: Hichun Elohimin Jacob chu ahoulimpin, “Nangma ki nungle kit tan, napu napa chule na sopite chenna gam'a kei man ka umpi jing ding nahi,” ati.
31.4: Hichun Jacob in mi asol in loulam a akelngoi chin nauva Rachel le Leah aga kou sah tan ahi.
31.5: Chuin Jacob in hitin aseiye, “Keiman ka hechen tai, napa lhon maiso kavet le lungthim chom chom aneitai, masang tobang ahi tapoi, hijong le kapu ka pate Elohimin ei umpi jingnai.
31.6: Nangnin jong nahe lhon nai, katha nei sun kajo chan a napa lhon ding na toh ka tonge.
31.7: Hinlah aman eijou lhep tan, kanatoh man jong somvei tobang eikhel pehtai, amavang Elohimin keima chunga vang thil phalou imacha alhunsah pon ahi.
31.8: Aman hitin aseiye, gancha apol ho jouse chu nangma nikho tha man hitante atile gancha ho chu apol jeng ahe hatah in ahung pung tul tul kit tan, hichun aman alunggel akhel kit in gancha availang jenga pol ho atikit leh gancha anou jouse chu adung le avai langa pol bou apeng kit tai.
31.9: Hitia hi Pa Elohimin napa gancha ho jouse alah a keima eipehsoh ahitai.
31.10: Chuin phat chomkhat jou kelngoite kijang mat lai in jan mang khat ka neiyin, ka khodah in ahile kelpi chunga kal doh kelchal ho chu apol hole adup ho aki timat piu ka mui.
31.11: Chuin hitia mang kanei petin Yaweh vantil khat in eihin houpin Jacob eihin tin kenjong “Hoijo hikoma kaum e,” kati.
31.12: Chuin Yaweh vantil chun dah inlang gahve temin, kelpi ho chunga kal doh kelchal ho khu apol, adup, akangpol, availanga pol jeng in amat e, Ijeh inem itile Laban in na bolsetna jouse keiman abonchan ka musoh keitai.
31.13: Keima na Elohim Bethel, muna song khom thao nanu a na kigah na Elohim chu kahi, tun kipat doh in hiche gam hi dalhan lang na penna gam langa kile kit tan.
31.14: Chuphat in Rachel le Leah in adonbut in, “Keinin imacha boina kanei lhonpoi; kapa lhon neile gou chanvou ka chan lhon ding um beh ham?”
31.15: Aman dalpam mi a eigel lhon hilou ham? Ajeh chu aman eijoh doh lhon a keini kichoh na sum jouse jong eisuh mang peh tauve.
31.16: Chule nei le gou jouse Elohimin kapa lhona kon a alah mang peh ho jouse chu eiho le ichate ho a ahi bouve. Hijeh chun tun Elohimin najah a asei jouse chu ipi hi jongle bol jeng in,” ati lhon tai.
31.17: Hichun Jacob akipat doh in ajite le achate jouse chu Sangan chunga atoudoh sah soh kei tan;
31.18: chule aganchaho jouse amasang lamuva ahoiyin Padan-aram gam'a anei agou jouse aki suhtup in Canaan gam'a apa Isaac henga che dingin aumtai.
31.19: Chuin Laban chu kelngoi mulvou dinga akon doh phat'in Rachel in apa insung semthu pathen chu ana kiguh mang tai.
31.20: Jacob'in jong Laban Syria mipa chu alhem lhan, ajamdoh dingu jong aseipeh pon ahi.
31.21: Hichun Jacob in anei agou jouse akipoh in Eupharate vadung apal galkai in Gilead thing lhang lam ahin jontai.
31.22: Ahin ni thum jouvin Jacob ajam mang tai tithu chu Laban ahin seipeh un;
31.23: Chuin Laban in asopi ho cheng akou khom in, Jacob chu ahin nung del tauvin ahile, nisagi lhin ni chun Gilead lhang gamsunga ahin juilut tan ahi.
31.24: Hinlah Elohimin Laban Syrea mipa chu jan in ana kimu pin hitin aseiye, “Kichih thei jin Jacob chu imacha nalo theilou ding ahi,” ati.
31.25: Hichun Laban'in Jacob chu ahin phatan, chule Jacob in thing-lhang lah a chun apon buh akison tauvin, chuin Laban le a-u anaoten jong Gelead thinglhang a Jacob to kigam lhat louvin aponbuh'u akison tauve.
31.26: Chuin Laban in Jacob jah'a aseiye, “Ibola hi tobanga hi neijou lhep hitam ati, chule iti dana ka chanu teni jong gal a sohchang ho banga na bol jeng ham?
31.27: Ibola guhthim cha a najam mang uham? Ibol'a neijou lhep ham ati, chule nache ding iti dan a neihet sah loubeh ham? Neina hetsah le chun thupitah a kilhahna ankong le la ngeitah tah kisan tin, tumging to kithoa kivai lhah ta dinga ati.
31.28: Nathil bol hohi ngolna in na dimset'e, ka chanu teni cha katute jong kabeng chop man tapon, kilhahna jong kana bol thei tapoi! ati.
31.29: Tua hi nangma ka suhbei thei nahi, Hinlah napu napate Elohimin jan hi nilhah in eina kimuto pin gihna jong eineiyin Jacob chu na suhboi theilou ding ahi eiti!
31.30: Nangma lunggel na in lam a nache ding na thanop na chu ka hethem lheh'e, kham thei jong nahipoi, napa insung miho toh kimu to kal nanga lel jong kahe nai, hinlah ibola ka Elohim houna doiphung chu naguh ham? ati.
31.31: Jacob in adonbut in, “Keiman nangma kana ging lheh in ahi, ajeh chu nang ma in, nachanu teho chu namphu a nei lah peh ding ham tia kana gel ahi.
31.32: Amavang nadoi bom vang chu ahile nang man hol in lang namu doh thei leh namu na michu koi hile ahinkho subei jeng tan ati, chule nangma thil ho jong keima sopiho analakha aumle kanung peh ding nahi; Jacob in vang Rachel in analah chu anahet lou ahi.
31.33: Laban chu Jacob ponbuh a ache masa pen in doibom hol in, aban'in Leah kom ah, hiche jou chun Leah soh teni komah achen, hinlah imacha amudoh pon, achaina in Rachel pon buh a alut in ahi.
31.34: Rachel in apa insung doibom chu ana ladoh in Sangan pho kah a chu ana sel'a chule achunga chu ama ana tou ahi, hichun Laban in ponbuh sung aning akah aphet vang'in imacha amudoh tapon ahi.
31.35: Ama nun apa komma asei tai, “Lungsettah in nei ngaidam in ka Yaweh keima numei hina lhinna kanei jin kadin theilou ding ahi,” Laban vang ahol chu atang dehpon amavang insung doibom chu amudoh pon ahi.
31.36: Hichun Jacob hatah in ahung lunghang tan Laban apupa jah'a asei tan ahi, “Keima ipi ka guchat na ka jonna umham atitan, chule ipi mong kabol khel a hichan geiya hi ka nung neihin del a keima migucha banga nei bol hitam?
31.37: Nangman kanei kathil koina jouse aning akah geiyin naphet in, tun nangthil nakimudoh ho chu neivet sah un, sopi ule nao ho masang laitah ahin hinpodoh in, amahon eini kah lah a thutanna neimaiyu hen ati.
31.38: Nangma koma kum som ni na gancha ho kana vettup peh in, na gancha ho kelngoi ahin na kelcha ho ahin imacha boina ana umpon hiche kum hijat kana vettup sunga chun kelngoi khat jong kana kilah khapoi.
31.39: Keiman gamsa in, gancha ho athasa jong kahin polut khapon, athi amang ho jong keima nikho tha to suhto din kana boljin, gancha ho sun hileh jan hileh amang ho jouse chu keima lhalo toh suhto din neikah pehjin ahi.
31.40: Hiche hi keima dinmun ana hi, Hitipi chun sun teng nisan eihal vampai gon, jan tengle dap kathoh jin, kamit tenin la kei eimut na him him amupha pon ahi.
31.41: Hitobang achu kum somni nangma insunga kana kiman chah ahi. Keiman kum som le kum li nangma insunga lhacha in kana pangin, na chanu teni lona in kum gup ka na tohbe in gancha ho lona in chule kana toh man somvei tobang neikhel peh in ahi.
31.42: Kapate Elohim, Abraham Elohim, kapa Isaac ginpa chun eipanpi lou hile tua hi nangman khut keohel tah bah a neina solmang ding ahitai. Elohimin ka gentheina le kakhut tah a katoh gimna hi amua jan nilhah a chu na gihsal ahiye,” ati.
31.43: Hichun Laban in hitin Jacob adonbut in, “Hiche numei hohi ka chanu ahin, hiche chapang hojong kachate katute ahi, chule gancha ho jouse jong abonna keima gancha ahi. Chule ipi hitale namu phah chan hi aboncha keiya jeng ahi cheh nai. Amavang keiman tua hi ka chanute chule achate ho chunga ipi kabol ding hitam ati.
31.44: Hijeh chun hung in eini kikah a kitepna nei hite hichun eini eikan khom cheh lhon ding ahi.”
31.45: Hichun Jacob'in hetjing nading in song khom khat aphut dohtai.
31.46: Hichun Jacob'in asopi ho lah a aseiyin, “Songho hin chom khom un,” ati, amahon song chu khat chunga khat asethop un, hichun Jacob le Laban song kise thop komma atou lhon in kitepna ankong chu anekhom lhon tan ahi.
31.47: Songlhuh kise chu Laban in Jegar-sahadutha asah-in, hiche ma ma chu Jacob'in Galeed asah-e.
31.48: Hichun Laban in, “Tuni nikhoa hiche song lhuh hi kei le nang kah a sakhia panga ahi tai,” tia, hiche jeh chun amin jong Galeed asah in ahi.
31.49: Hiche mun jong hi Mizpah akiti tai, aman aseiyin, “Ajeh chu nangma le keima jong khonung teng jong leh gamla tah a umjongle hen Elohimin ei umpi jing lhon hen.”
31.50: Ka chanute ho nahin suh genthei ja numei dang ho jia nahin kipuiya ahile, koima chan muhih jongle abonchan Elohimin amusoh keiye, Elohim hi nangle kei kikah a kitepna a hiche thua hi pang jing ding ahi.
31.51: Hiche song athopma kise ho hi Jacob in Laban jah ah, “Vejing in kei le nang kah a kihet themna hijing ding ahi tai.
31.52: Hiche song kise thop hile songphu hi sakhi a pang ahin, ken jong nangma suse dinga hiche hi kahin khokhel lou hel ding, nang in jong keima suse dinga hiche hi nahin khokhel louhel ding ahi.
31.53: Abraham Elohim, Nahor Elohim chule amani pa-Elohim chu eini kah a thutan ding ahi tai,” ati. Hijeh chun Jacob jong apa Isaac ginpa min akihahsel tai.
31.54: Hichun Jacob in hiche molchunga chun Elohim henga maicham asem in kitepna ki hetthem na ankong jong asem in, an neh anei jou u-chun hiche jan machun molchunga chun ageh tauve.
31.55: Laban ajing chun matah in athoudoh in achanute ho le atute ho jouse abonchan achop soh keiyin, chule abonchauvin phatthei aboh soh keiyin, hichun ama a inlam ma aki nungle kit tai.

32.1: Jacob chu akhol jinna amachal jing in, chule Yaweh vantilten analam touvin ahi.
32.2: Jacob in amaho amu chun hitin aseyin, “Hilai mun hi Elohim ki choldo na mun ahi,” ati. hiche mun chu Mahanaim asah tai.
32.3: Hichun Jacob in Seir gamsunga Edom gamkaiya a upa Esau henga ding in thupo dingin mi asol masan.
32.4: Aman hitin athumop in, “Kapu Esau koma hitia hi nasei ding ahi. Na sohpa Jacob in hitin aseiye, tuni gei hin Laban komma kaum jing nalaiye.
32.5: Keiman gancha bong hon ahin, sangan hon ahin, kelngoi hon ahin, kelcha hon ahin, sohle kol jong tamtah ka neitai. Tua ka Yaweh pa masanga ka hung tao ahi hichu nangma mitmun ngailut kachan thei nading tia nangma seipeh dinga mi ka hinsol ahiye ati, tin ga seitauvin,” ati.
32.6: Thu hettoh sah ho ahung ki nungle chun, Jacob komma hitin asei un, “Nasopi pa kaki muto piuvin, tua hi ama nangtoh kimuto ding in mi sang li toh ahung kon doh in ahi.”
32.7: Ahin Jacob chu hiche thu ajah chun akicha lheh tan, hichun aman a insung mite ahin, gancha kelngoi ho jouse ahin, keltah ho se chule sangongsao hose ahin hop nin ahom khen in ahiye.
32.8: Jacob in hitin agel lin, “Esau vin honkhat chu ahung bulu tah jongle honkhat pa beh asohcha theiye,” ati.
32.9: Hichun Jacob ataovin, “Vo kapu Abraham Elohim, kapa Isaac Elohim, O ka Yaweh, Nang in 'na sopite lah nagam languva ki nungle kit tan' tin neiseipeh in chuleh 'keiman nang ding in aphat phat nan bol peh nange' tin kitepna naneiye.
32.10: Nasohpa neimusah longlou ngailutnaho le nakitahna ho chu chang din lhinna imacha kaneipoi. Ajehchu ka tenggol keoseh puma hiche Jordan hi hung galkaiya kahin, tun mihem loini lhingset ka lamdoh tai.
32.11: O ka Yaweh lungset tah in ka sopipa Esau khut a konnin nei huhhing teiyin, keima kati aja lheh jeng'e; Ajeh chu aman kajite ho chule ka chate ho jong eihung no khum ding ahitai.
32.12: Hinlah nangman, nang dingin aphat phat nan bolpeh nange, na chilhah te jeng jong twikhanglen panga neldi jat hin phantin, tam behseh jeng a kisim jou lou ding ahi,’ tin nana kitep e,” ati.
32.13: Jacob chu hiche muna chun ajan geh in athil poh ho lah achun alhengdoh in Esau asopipa peh ding in,
32.14: Kelpi jani, kelchal somni, kelngoipi jani chule kelngoi chal som ni toh,
32.15: Sangongsao pi som thum toh, anoute se toh, bongpi somli toh, bongchal som toh, sanganpi somni toh, chule sangan chal som toh alheng doh e.
32.16: Hichun Jacob in hiche gancha ho chu hopni in ahom in amaho vekol ding chun soh khat cheh anganse in, hichun asoh ho jah a hitin aseiye, “Nanghon hiche gancha hotoh hin keima masanglam a che tauvin Hinlah gancha hon teni kikah a chun mun ong umsah un,” ati.
32.17: Hichun ama hon lamkaipa jah achun hitin aseiye, “ka sopipa Esau to na kimuto lhon teng aman thu na hin doh teng, nangho hi hoilam jon ding na hiuvem? chule nangho koi gam mi na hiuham? tua gancha ho ahung masa ho chu koiya ham? ahin ti teng leh,
32.18: Hiche teng chule hitia hi amaho na donbut dingu ahi, “Hiche gancha ho se hi na sohpa Jacob ma ahi, amaho hi kipa thilpeh adia kapu Esau a dinga kahin poh ahiye. Chule ama jong kanung lam uvah ahung e,” tiuvin ati.
32.19: Hiti chun Jacob in soh masa pa athuhil bang chun anina pa ahin, athum napa geiyin gancha ho vetup lamkai jouse chu asei peh cheh tan, “Esau toh nakimu to tengu le na thusei hou chu ki bang cheh ding ahi.”
32.20: Chujong le vetan na sohpa Jacob jong kei ho nunga ahung'e,’ tia na seipeh ding'u ahi,” atin ahi. Ijeh inem itile Jacob gel a chu, “Ka masanga kitol thilpeh chengse hin ama jol lung dam thei khat ingting, ajou teng amai kamu thei ding ahi; ijem atile bon eina sang jeng khat inte,” tia angaito ahi.
32.21: Jacob in ngailut thilpeh ho chu ache masang in asol tan ahi, amavang hiche mun achun ajan geh in akhovah den tai.
32.22: Hiche jan chun Jacob in ajite ni chule asoh teni chule achate pasal som le khat chu athoudoh tan Jabbok vadung chu agal kai pitan ahi.
32.23: Hichun Jacob in amaho chutoh vadung agalkai phat chun anei agou jouse toh asol tan ahi.
32.24: Hichun Jacob chu achanga adalha tauvin, pasal khat in ama chu khovah geiyin akibot pin ahi.
32.25: Pasal akibot pipa chun ajolou ding phat chun Jacob akonggu ahomlai tah chu asuhboh pehtan ahi.
32.26: Hichun pasal mihem pa chun aseiye, “Nei lhatan kho hungvah ding ahitai.” Amavang Jacob in adonbut in, “Phatthei neiboh tokah a nangma kalha lou ding nahi,” ati.
32.27: Mihem pasal pa chun adong in, “na min ipi ham? ati, hichun aman adonbut in, “Jacob ahi,” ati.
32.28: Mihem pa chun adonbut in, “Na min hi Jacob hitalou ding, tua patna Israel kiti ding nahitai. Ajeh chu nangma Elohim to na kibot in jong na hat in, mihemte jong na hinjo ding ahi,” atipeh e.
32.29: Jacob in adong in, “Lungset tah in na min neisei peh in,” ati, mipa chun adonbut in, “Ibola kamin chu nahet nom ham,” ati. Hichun aman Jacob chu hilai mun a chun phatthei abohtan ahi.
32.30: Hichun Jacob in hiche mun chu Peniel asahtai. “Ajeh chu keiman Elohim kaki maito pitan chule kahin kho jong ei huhdoh peh in ahi.”
32.31: Jacob in Peniel adalhah chun nisa ahung soh dohtan ahi, ajeh chu akonggu anat jeh ahi.
32.32: Hiche jeh chun tuni geihin Israel chaten akonggu to kijop matna khelgu hom sunga thapigui hi anepouve; ipijeh inem itile aman Jacob konggu hom sunga thapigui ana hebal peh in ahi.

33.1: Hichun Jacob akhodah in avet a ahile “Ven Esau chu mihem jali jen to ahung amu tan,” chuin Jacob in jong achate chu Leah le Rachel chule asoh numei teni ahop peh soh keiyin,
33.2: Hichun asoh numei le achate ho jouse amasat sah in, abanin Leah le achate achesah in, chule achaina in Rachel le Joseph apansah e.
33.3: Chuin Jacob ama mong mong amaho jouse masanga chun achen, aupa heng ahin phah tokahsen sagi vei jen tol'a abohkhup in ahi.
33.4: Hichun Esau alhai phei jin apum koijeng in, chule angong koiya achop a ahile ani lhon in aki ka lhon tai.
33.5: Hichun Esau in numei ho chule achate ho chu aven adong in, “Amaho hi koi hiuva ham,” ati. Jacob in adonbut in, “Hiche chapang hohi Elohimin na sohpa phatthei eibohna ahi,” ati.
33.6: Hichun soh numei teni le achate hon ahin nailut un Esau masanga chun abohkhup tauvin ahi.
33.7: Leah le achate jong ahung nai lut uvin abohkhup'in asalam uve; chule anu khah pen in Joseph le Rachel ahung nailut lhon in abohkhup lhon in salam abol lhon tai.
33.8: Esau in adong tan, “Ahile hiche kahin kitopi gancha honpi chu ipi na bolna ham,” ati. Jacob'in adonbut in, “Nangma masang'a lunglhai na kamuna tei ding kati ahi,” ati.
33.9: Esau in adonbut in, “Kanao keiman jong tamtah kanei nai ati, nangma thil chu nang ding in ki koi tan,” ati.
33.10: Ahin Jacob in asei teiyin, “Nangman hiche kipa thilpeh hohi nalah louva hithei lou ahi, keiman nangma mai kamu hi Elohim mai mu tobang kahi, nangma mai kamu theiya nanui awgin kajah hi thina akonna galkai kahitai,” ati.
33.11: Lungset tah in hiche thilpeh hohi neisan peh teiyin, Elohimin ka ngaichat jouse eipe tai, hichun Jacob'in ahasei behset jeh chun Esau chun thilpeh ho chu asang tai.
33.12: Esau in aseiye, “Aphai atitai, keiman na lamkai jing ting eini che ta hite.”
33.13: Jacob'in adonbut in, “Ka Yaweh neihet them peh mai jin, chate ho hi alhasam thei lheh na laiyun, gancha bongnou hole kelnou ho jong api hontoh ki khen thei lou lai ahiuvin, nikhat sunga hatah in kihoi pai taleh gancha honte aboncha thigam jeng thei ahiuve.
33.14: Hijeh chun lungset tah in na sohpa masanga kapu ana masa jeng in lang keiman olcha chan ka masanga gancha ho ki kalvan bang ule chapang te kikalvan bang bangu hin, Seir gam'a kapu heng kahin phah kah sen hung nange ati.
33.15: Apha lheh jenge tin Esau in adonbut in, “Hinlah ka miteho them khat tou dalhang kating nangho lam hil ding chule boina le hahsat na a pan lathei ding ati, Jacob in adonbut in, “Hiche hochu ngai ponte, lungset umtah'a kapu neina lamdot hi alhingset in ka sange,” ati.
33.16: Hichun Esau chu aki nunghei jin Seir gam jon ding chun hiche ni mama chun achekit tai.
33.17: Jacob vang chu ahile Succoth lama achen hiche muna chun inlim gancha ho din asong in, chule ama chenna ding in jong in aki sahtai. Hiche jeh a chu hiche mun chu Succoth kiti ahi. (Succoth tichu chenna mun tina ahi).
33.18: Phat chomkhat jouvin Jacob chu Padan-aram lammah kon in Shechem Canaan gam ahung lhung tan, hiche khopi phah masanga chun ngah mun khat asem kit tai.
33.19: Jacob in Shechem pa Hamor chate khut a kon chun gam leiset phabep sum (Qesitah) jakhat in aki choh in hikom a chun ponbuh akison tai.
33.20: Hichun aman maicham atungdoh in amin chu El-Elohe Israel asah tai.

34.1: Jacob le Leah chanu Dinah chu nikhat apot doh in hiche gam'a cheng numei khangthah hotoh kimuto din achen ahi.
34.2: Ahin hiche gam'a lengpa chapa Shechem Homar Hivite kitipa chun Dinah chu aman in aluppi tan ahi.
34.3: Ahin amapa chun ahin ngailu lheh tan, hichun aman thudihtah a kihou limpi a nopsah ding chu adei lheh tai.
34.4: Shechem in apa Homar jah a asei tan, hiche numei nuhi neipui peh un kaji din ka deiye ati.
34.5: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in thusoh aja tan Shechem in Dinah aluppia asuhset chu ahe tan, ahin Jacob in achate gamlah a gancha ho ching ahi jeh u chun amaho ahung lhun angah in kam cheng khat jeng cha jong akeh poi.
34.6: Hamor Shechem pachu Jacob henga kihoulim dingin ache dohtai.
34.7: Chuin Jacob chate loulam akon in ahung lhung tauvin amahon hiche thuho ajah uchun alung nommo lheh un kidang jong asa lheh uvin hatah in alunghang uvin, asopinu Dinah Shechem in asuhset na Jacob insung asuhboi chu bollou ding khat ahiye atiuve.
34.8: Hamor in Jacob le achate aki houlim pin, aman aseiye, “Kachapa Shechem in na chanu alungset lheh jeng in ahi, lungset tah in amani chu ki chensah uhite.
34.9: Ahithei dingle eiho chate kila tou hite, kei hon nangho chanu ho kipui uving kating, keima ho chanute ho jong nangho chapate ho din kipui un ati.
34.10: Hiche gamsunga hi ichen khom theiyu ahi, chule khosa uvin bolthei toh thei tong un, na nop chanu neile gou jong na kilam theiyu ahi.”
34.11: Shechem chu Dinah sopiho le apa jah a ataotan, “Lungset tah in nei khotou vin, ahithei ding le kaji din kaki pui nom e chule nangma hon na thum channu chu keiman ka peh ding na hiuve.”
34.12: Numei nu chu kaji dinga nei peh pou ule keiman ipi thilpeh hijongle suhto thei ding alen aneo hileh kapeh ding ahi ati.
34.13: Hinlah Shechem in Dinah ana luppi a asuhset tah jeh chun Jacob chate chun Hamor le achapa Shechem chu lungpha lou tah in ahoulimpi tauve.
34.14: Amahon adonbut un, “Hiche hi keima ho moh nop lhah thei ka hi pouve, Ajeh chu nangho hi chep tanlou na hiuvin, ka sopinu'u nanghon nakipui dingu chu keiho dinga jachat umtah khat hung hi ding ahi.
34.15: Hinlah kihou cham theina khat vang aum'e, hichu ahileh na pasal ho jouse achep na tan thei diu le atiuve.
34.16: Hiche teng chule ka chanu teho'u kapeh theiyu, chule nang ho chanu ho jong keima hon jong kaki pui thei dingu ahi atiuve.
34.17: Ahin nangho pasal hon acheptan ding anop lou ule ka sopinu'u ka peh theilou dingu ahi atiuve.
34.18: Hamor le achapa Shechem chun amaho thilgon chu pha asa lhon in ahi.
34.19: Shechem chu alunglhai lheh in bol ding ho chu agei sang tapon, ajeh chu Dinah Jacob chanu adei behset jeh chun Shechem chu amaho insung milah a jathei umdol tah khat ahi.
34.20: Chuin Hamor le achapa Shechem khopi kelkot a ahung lhon in mipi ho laha aki hou na'u kinop tona ho chu ahung phong doh lhon in hitin asei lhon in ahi.
34.21: Ama nin aphong doh lhon in hiche miho hi mipha eiho mi ahi ati lhon e, veuvin gam jong lentah enei uvin amaho chenna thei ding, amaho toh chengkhom uhitin, bolthei thei bol uhitin, eihon jong amaho chanute ijon thei ding'u chule amahon jong eiho chanute aki chenpi thei dingu ahi,” ati.
34.22: Amaho toh eiho ichen khom thei na diuvin thil khat aum e, hichu ahileh eiho pasal jouse amaho banga chep ekitan tengu le ichen khom thei ding'u ahi.
34.23: Hinlah thilpha khat ihet dingu chu ichen khom tengule, agancha hou, anei agou hou jouse aboncha a eiho a hung hithei ahi. Hijeh chun amahon adei atup ho chu bolpeh leuhen amaho jong eiho lah a chen ding tha nom tah a hung cheng diu ahi tai.
34.24: Hichun khopi sunga cheng aching athem jouse Hamor le achapa Shechem thupeh chu anom cheh tauvin, chule pasal jousen achep akitan soh hel tauvin ahi.
34.25: Ahin nithum jou don chun amaho cheptan na maha jong damtheng loulai in Jacob chateni Simon le Levi a sopinu Dinah toh peng khom teni chu ahung kon lhon in hiche khopi sunga pasal jouse chemjam in asat lih lhontan ahi.
34.26: Hiche athi ho lah achun Hamor le achapa Shechem jong ajao lhon tai, Hichun Dinah chu Shechem in muna kon in amaho inlam a ahin pui lhon tan ahi.
34.27: Phat chomkhat jou in Jacob chate ho ahung lhung cheh tauvin, amahon khopi sunga mipi athi amang akithat ho chu asopinu u ki suhthang na khopi chu achom theng hel uve.
34.28: Amahon akelngoi hou ahin, abongchal hou chule sangan ho jouse phaicham khopi sungle tollhang a thil keo jouse akilah tauve.
34.29: Anei agou jouse jong alah peh soh keijun, amaho jite chate jong alah peh un, amaho hetkhah nalouva apui mang tauve.
34.30: Jacob in phat chomkhat jouvin Simon le Levi koma hitin aseiye, “Keima hi neisuh mang lhon ahi tai, hiche gam mite le Canaan mite le Perizzites mite koma hin ka namse in ka ui lheh tai. chule eiho lhomcha ihiuvin amaho ahung kihou toh tengule eiho eisuh mang dingu ahi. keima kahin ka insung pumpi kaki chai helding ahitai,” ati.
34.31: Ama hon lung hang tah in asei jun, “Ipi bol'a chu isopinu u chu numei kijoh banga abolset ham?” atiuve.

35.1: Hichun Elohimin Jacob ahoulimpin, “Kithouvin lang Bethel lama kinungle kit inlang hikom a chun gacheng tan, chule na upa Esau koma nahung jampet'a nahenga hung kilah Elohim ding chun hikoma chun maicham khat gasem in,” ati.
35.2: Chuin Jacob in a insung mite ahin midang akoma cheng ho jah a hitin aseiye, “Doiphung jouse pai mang un, natahsa kisuhthengun, vonthah kivon un,
35.3: Tua eiho Bethel lama iche diu Elohim henga maicham ka semding ahi. Ajeh chu Yawehyin ka hahsat laitah a kataona eisan pehin, Ama in kache na kalam jotna jouse a eiumpi jinge ati.
35.4: Hichun amahon gamdang mite indoi akoi jouseu chule abil uva abilba u abonchan Jacob apeuvin ahile Jacob'in abonchan Shechem nai vel'a gangpi phungnoi khat ah agavui mang tai.
35.5: Amaho ahung kon doh uchun Elohim a konna tijat na mipi adimun, hijeh chun Jacob insung mite bulu din koimacha ahung kondoh ngam tapoi.
35.6: Jacob le a insung mite Luz kiti mun hichu Bethel Cannan gam sunga um ahi. (Bethel ti chu Elohimin tina ahi).
35.7: Chule hikom'a chun Jacob in maicham khat asem in, hiche lai mun chu EL-Bethel asah in ahi. Ajehchu aupa henga konna ahung jam doh a chu hikoma chu Elohim ama mong mong ahenga hung kiphong ahi.
35.8: Rebekah jenle nu Deborah athi a chu Bethel noiya gangpi phungnoi khat ah ana kivui ahin, hiche jeh a chu hiche min chu lhilon na gangpi phung kisah ahiye.
35.9: Hichun Elohimin Jacob Padan-Arama konna ahung chun ana kimuto pi kitin, chuin Bethel muna Elohimin phatthei aboh kit in ahi.
35.10: Elohimin ahoulimpin ajah'a, “Namin hi Jacob ahin tunia patna hi nangma Jacob na kiti talou ding ahi. Amavang ISRAEL kiti ding na hitai,” hichun Elohimin ama pa min chu Israel asah tai.
35.11: Hichun Elohimin aseiye, “Keima El-Shaddai kahi. Elohim hattah ka hi, hatah in ga un, hatah in pung tul tul un, nam lentah ka so ding nahi, chule chilhah jong tamtah kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
35.12: Chule khatvei Abraham, Isaac kapeh gamchu nangma le na insung mite kapeh kitding nahi, khonung teng jongle nangma kapeh ding nahi.
35.13: Hichun Yaweh vantil chu Jacob akihoulimpi na akon in achemang tai.
35.14: Jacob in Yaweh to a kimutona melchihna ding in hiche muna chun song khom khat aphut doh kitin, hiche khom chunga chun kilhaina ju asun khum in, chule hiche chunga chun Olive thao twi asun khume.
35.15: Chule Jacob'in hilai mun chu Bethel asah tan ahi.
35.16: Jacob le a insung miten Bethel chu adalhau vin, Ephratha lam ajot laitah un Rachel chu anaovop nat ahung kipantan, akhol che nao jong lhung joujep lou lai ahin, amanu soh dingin ha nat nat'in ahung natai.
35.17: Rachel chu soh dinga hanat'a anat pet chun anaodom a pang a sohnu numei ho chun hitin ahoulimpi uve, “Nangma kicha hih in, lungneo hih beh in, chapa khat na neibe ding ahi,” atiuve.
35.18: Hinlah Rachel chu alhagao apotdoh tai, ajeh chu amanu athia ahitan ahi; hijeh chun aman jong nao min chu Ben-oni asah in (Ben-oni tichu, ka thoh gimpeta kacha tina ahi), apan vang Benjamin asah tai. (Benjamin tichu, kajet lama pang chapa tina ahi).
