35.19: Rachel chu athitan Ephratha lampia avui tau vin ahi.
35.20: Jacob'in angailut hetjing nan Rachel lhan song asem peh in, tuni gei hin hiche Rachel lhan hi aum jing nalaiye.
35.21: Hichun Israel (Jacob) chu achen pondal buh chu Eder inting vum geiyin atung doh e.
35.22: Israel chuche gamsunga ana cheng nalaiyin, ahin Reuben in apa jithahnu Bilhah chu ana chonsetpin ana luppi tan, hiche thu chu Israel in jong aja tai. Chule Jacob chapate chu som le ni alhinguve.
35.23: Leah chapate chu Reuben, Jacob chapa apeng masa pen, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar chule Zebulun ahiuve.
35.24: Rachel chapate ni chu Joseph le Benjamin ahi lhon'e.
35.25: Rachel sohnu Bilhah chapate nichu Dan le Naphtali ahilhon in,
35.26: Leah sohnu Zilpah chapate ni chu Gad le Asher ahi lhone. Hi chengse hi Jacob'in Padan-aram gamsunga ahindoh achapate chu ahiuve.
35.27: Hichun Jacob apa Isaac koma ahung kinungle kit tan Mamre a Kiriath-arba gam (Hebron tiajong kisei) phatkhat laia Abraham le Isaac maljin na ana umna'u mun chu ahi.
35.28: Isaac chu akum kum jakhat le kum som get ana lhing tan ahi.
35.29: Hichun Isaac ahaitan in ahinkho abeitai, anam mite ho jouse ateh akhang abonchauvin a nilhum gei in op cheh un, chuin achate ni Esau le Jacob in avui lhon tai.

36.1: Hiche hose hi Esau phunggui Edom tiajong kisei ahi.
36.2: Esau in Canaan nungah ni aji din ana ki pui'in khat nu chu Hite mi Adah Elton ahi, anina nu chu ahile Oholibamah Anah chanu ahin Zibeon Hivi tedinga atunu u ahi.
36.3: Chule Esau in asopinu Basemath Ishmael chanu Nebaioth naonu jong ajidin aki puiye.
36.4: Adah chun chapa amin Eliphaz Esau ahin peh in Basemath chun chapa Reul ahing in ahi.
36.5: Oholibamath chun Canaan gam'a achen laiyin chapa thum Esau din ana hinpeh in, amaho min chu ahile Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
36.6: Esau in ajite le achate cheng abonchauvin, agancha ho jouse, abongchal ho jouse, chule anei agou thil jouse Canaan gam'a achen laiya alam doh jouse toh mun chom ajon tan, asopipa Jacob chu adalhatan ahi.
36.7: Ijeh inem itile anei agoulhon, aganchalhon chuleh adinmun lhon jeh chun aumkhom lhon theina dia gam chu ninglhingjou lou ahitai.
36.8: Hijeh chun Esau (Edom) chu thinglhang lam a Seir kiti muna acheng tai.
36.9: Hiche hohi Esau thusim Edomite pa Seir thinglhanga ahung chen namun chu ahi.
36.10: Ama hohi Esau chilhahte ho min ahi, Eliphaz kitipa hi Adah in ahin chule Reul kitipa hi Esau loinu Basemath in ahin ahiye.
36.11: Eliphaz chilhah ho Teman, Omar, Canaan chule Kanaz ahiuve.
36.12: Timna, Eliphaz jithahnu chapa khat ahing in amin chu Amalek ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Adah in ahin ama hung kikhailha chilhah ho ahiuve.
36.13: Reul chapate ho chu Nahath, Zerath, Shammah chule Mizzah ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Basemath chilhah ho ahiuve.
36.14: Esau chate ho Aholibamath in ahin ho chu, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahi uvin, Aholibamah hi Anah chanu Zibeon dinga atute ahung hitai.
36.15: Hiche hohi Esau chate chilhahte phung choma hung lamkai ho ahi uve, Esau chapa tahpen chilhah ho Eliphaz a hung kikhai lha ho, Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz ahin,
36.16: Korah chule Gatam chule Amalek amaho se hi Eliphaz phung lamkai Edom gamsunga cheng ahiuvin, amaho jouse hi Esau jinu Adah chilhah a konna hung peng doh ahiuve.
36.17: Esau chapa Reul a konna hung pengdoh ho phung lamkai ho chu, Nahath, Zertah, Shammath chule Mizzah ahiuve. Amaho chenghi phung lamkai Edom gam sunga Reul chate ahin, Esau jinu Basemath chilhah a konna hung peng doh ahiuve.
36.18: Esau chate ho Oholibamah toh ahin ho Jeush, Jalam chule Korah ahiuve. Amaho se hi phung lamkai cheh jong ahung hitauvin, hiche phung lamkai ho sese hi Esau loinu Oholibamah kitinu Anah chanu chilhah a hung kon doh ahiuve.
36.19: Hiche phung hohi Esau a konna hung kon doh cheh ahiuvin, amaho hi Edom mi jong akitiuve.
36.20: Seir Horite kitipa chate chengse hiche gam'a ana cheng ho chu amaho hi ahiuve, Lotan, Shobal, Anah chule Zeboan ahiuve.
36.21: Edom gam'a cheng Seir chate langa pangho chu Horite chilhah ho chu Dishan, Ezer, chule Dishon ahiuve.
36.22: Chule Lotan chate ho chu Hori le Heman ahin, Lotan sopinu min chu ahile Timna ahi.
36.23: Shobal chapate chu Alvan ahin, Manahath ahin, Ebal ahin, Shepho ahin, chule Onam ahi.
36.24: Zibeon chateni min chu Aiah le Anah ahilhone. Zibeon chapa Anah kitipa hin apa gancha sangante achin pet a nel gamgo lah a twisam putna ana mudoh ahi.
36.25: Anah chate ni chu Dishon le Anah chanu Oholibamah ahi lhone.
36.26: Dishon chapate chu Hemdan le Eshban toh, Ithran toh, chule Cheran toh ahiuve.
36.27: Ezer chate ho chu Bilhan ahin, Zaavan ahin, chule Akan ahiuve.
36.28: Dishan chate ni chu Uz le Arana ahi lhone.
36.29: Horite mi upa lamkai ho chu Lotan ahin, Shobal ahin, Zibeon ahin, Anah ahin,
36.30: Dishon, Ezer chule Dishan amaho cheng hi Horite mi upa ho amaho phung dungjuia Seir gamsunga cheng ahiuve.
36.31: Hiche lengho hi Edom gamsunga vai ana hom un amaho masanga Israel mite lah a leng vaipo ana um khalou lai ahi.
36.32: Beor chapa Bela chun Edom gamsunga lengvai anapon, ama khopi chu amin Dinhabah ahiye.
36.33: Bila athi jou chun Zerah chapa Johab chapa chu Bozrah gamsunga vaipon ahung pang in ahi.
36.34: Johab athi jou chun Husham Temanite gam mipa chun lengvai ahin hom kit tai.
36.35: Hosham athi jou chun Bedal chapa Hadah chun lengvai ahinpon, ama chenna khopi Avith a pat'in Moab gamsunga Midianite ho jouse gal'a ahin joutan ahi.
36.36: Hadah athi jou chun Masrekah khopi a cheng Somlah in lengvai ahinpo kit tai.
36.37: Samlah athi jou chun Rehoboth vadung toh kinai khopi a cheng Saul chu ahung vaihom in ahi.
36.38: Saul thi jou chun Achor chapa Baal-Hannan kitipa chun lengvai ahipo kit in ahi.
36.39: Achor chapa Baal-Hannan athi jouchun, Hadar in Pau khopi apat in lengvai ahipo pantan, Hadar jinu min chu Mehetabel ahin Matred chanu Mazehab dinga atunu ahitai.
36.40: Amaho phung lamkai jouse hi Esau chilhah a konna hung kondoh cheh ahiuvin, Timna gam'a cheng ahiuvin, mi upa Alvah ahin, mi upa Jetheth ahin,
36.41: Mi upa Oholibamah ahin, mi upa Elah ahin, mi upa Pinon ahin,
36.42: Mi upa Kenaz ahin, mi upa Teman ahin, mi upa Mibzar ahin,
36.43: Mi upa Magdiel ahin, chule mi upa Iram ahi; hicheng hi leiset atoupha na gamsung uva akho mun dung jui uva Edom chilhah a kon a mi upa ho chu ahiuve.

37.1: Hichun Jacob Canaan chu apa khopem na Canaan gamsunga anung chen kit tai.
37.2: Hiche thusim hohi Jacob insung mite a ahi, Joseph kum som le sagi alhinin apa kelngoi ho asopi ho toh aching tup jingin avahva jingun, asopi ho apa jithah chate ho Bilhah le Zilpah chate ho toh natong khom jing ahiuve. Ahin nikhat chu Joseph in asopiho umchan phatlou dan apa kom ahin lhut tan ahi.
37.4: Amavang asopite hon Joseph chu avetda cheh un ahi, Ajeh chu apan midang ho sanga Joseph angailut najeh in amahon Joseph henga ngailut thucheng thupha seiding hahsa asa lheh un ahi.
37.5: Joseph in nikhat mang anei in amang chu asopiho asei pehle amahon avetda cheh un ahi.
37.6: Aman aseiye, “Ngaijun ka mang ho kasei ding ahi ati.
37.7: Ehon phailei lama chang phel ikan khom un, hiche tah chun hetman louvin keima changphal ho chu ading doh in, nangho changphal ho chu keima changphal masanga abohkhup uve,” ati.
37.8: Hichun asopi hon adonbut un, “Amapa chun keiho chunga vaihom ding kigong nahim? Ahiloule keiho chunga thanei ding kigo mong nahim,” atiuve. Hichun amahon amang neitoh athusei doh ho jeh in hatah in avetdau vin ahi.
37.9: Joseph in mang khat aneibe kit in chuin asopi ho chu asei peh kit in aman aseiye, “Ngaijun mang khat ka neibe kitne ati, tun nisa, lha, chule ahsi som le khat ho jong keima masanga abohkhup cheh uve,” ati.
37.10: Tua mang aneipa hi Joseph in apa chule asopite ho jouse jong abonchan aseipeh soh keiyin ahi. Ahin apa in aphoh thip'in,” hiche mang chu ipi tina ham tin adonbut e, “nanu toh kei chule nasopi teho jouse atahbeh a kahung uva nang masanga ka hung boh khup dingu ham?”
37.11: Ama vang Joseph sopiho chu alung ahang lheh un athangthip thei lheh un, apa vang chun hiche mang chu ipi tina ham ahet thei lou jeh in alung adong lheh in ahi.
37.12: Phat chomkhat jou chun Joseph sopiho chu Schechem lama apa kelngoi ching ding in achekit tauvin ahi.
37.13: Amaho chedoh jou phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in Joseph koma aseiye, “Nasopite ho Schechem lam a kelngoi hon ho aga vah un ahin, nangma naga che lou khoh ahi atin, Joseph in adonbut in, “keima kaga che ding ahi,” ati.
37.14: Jacob in adon but in, “Nangma gache inlang na sopite ho chule kelngoi ho iti hinauvem gaven ati. Amaho thusoh kajah nom kitne, Hebron phaicham apat in asol tan, hichun Joseph hiche Schechem chu ahung lhung tan ahi.
37.15: Ahin vetan gamlah a lampi akimansah a ava koile na a mi khat in atoh khan mipa chun adongin “Ipi ham nahol le?” atile.
37.16: Joseph in adonbut in, “Ka sopite ho kahol ahi atin, hoi langa gancha ho achin uham neisei peh thei ding ham,” ati.
37.17: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Amaho kihou limna kajan eiho Dothan lama chetau hite,” aki tiuve.
37.18: Joseph ahung chun asopihon gam la thimtah ahivang in ahe pai tauvin, ama ahung lhun masang in asopite hon Joseph thadoh nading tohgon anei tauvin ahi.
37.19: “Tuhin mang neipa ahung tai,” amahon atiuve.
37.20: Hung un amahi that doh taute, chule hiche kotong ho sung khat a pai mang taute. Ipa'u koma hitin seiyu hite, “Gancha khat in Joseph chu a nedoh tai, chule eihon veu hite ama amang ho chu hunggui lhung nam,” atiuve.
37.21: Ahin Reuben in amaho tohgon lung thim ho chu ahet phat in Joseph kitho pi ding in ahungin, “Aman asei tai Joseph hi tha datau hite,” ati.
37.22: Ibola thisan imoh lonsah ding'u ham? hilai kotong gamgo lah a seplut leuhen ama cham in eihon that hih jong leu hen ama thi ta lou ding ham. Reuben chu a lungthima Joseph chu huhdoh tei ding tichu ama dei ahi.
37.23: Hichun Joseph ahung lhun chun asopite hon a sangkhol chol hoitah chu asut lhah peh pai tauvin ahi.
37.24: Hichun amahon Joseph chu adah a aman uvin kotong sunga aseplut tauvin, hiche kotong chu imacha umlou twi jong veilou ahi.
37.25: Chule amaho sun an ne dinga aumlai tah'un, aga dadoh uva ahile vetan Gilead a konna hung sumkol veile Ishmael miho a sangan ho toh hung kilhona bego le thingthao namtui toh chule lou namtui hinpoa Egypt gam lang jonsuh ding amu uvin ahi.
37.26: Hichun Judah in a sopiho jah a aseiyin, “I sopipau itha doh uva ipi apha chom ding umham,” ati, chule athi san isel mang uva chu ipi phachom ding ham?
37.27: Hung uvin Joseph hi Ishmael te koma joh doh tauhite, isopi nah nah iphe ivou nah nah chu a chunga jong ikhut lhapou hite,” atile asopiten jong asei angai cheh tauve.
37.28: Hiti chun Egypt gam'a kivei miho chun apui tauvin Joseph chu asopihon kotong a kon in a kaidoh un, Ishmael miho Midianite miho koma dangka somni in akijoh doh tauve.
37.29: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Reuben chu kokhuh langa chun achekit'in ahile Joseph chu kokhuh sunga ana umtapoi, hichun Reuben chu alung akham lheh jengtan asang khol ho chu abottel in ahi.
37.30: Hichun Reuben asopiho lah'a akinungle kit in lungkham tah in, “Joseph chu aum tapoi! tua hi keiman ipi kabol ding hitam,” ati.
37.31: Hichun Joseph sopihon kelnou khat athat uvin, athisan chu Joseph sangkhol a chun anu tauve.
37.32: Amahon hichu sangkhol thisan anu u-chu apau Jacob athot un, mihon jong apau henga achoi uvin, “Hiche pihi ka mudoh uve, vetem in na chapa sangkhol chol hiya ham hilou ham,” atiuve.
37.33: Jacob'in gangtah in ahedoh pai in, hitin asei tai, “Hiche hi kachapa sangkhol ahi monge gamsa khat in vang anehdoh ahitai ati, Joseph vang hi aphe avou lahthei hita ponte,” ati.
37.34: Hichun Jacob'in apon ho chu abot tel in khaodip pon akikhu khum tan, Ama ni sottah lung hemin genthei tah in achapa pul adoutan ahi.
37.35: Jacob chate jouse le achanute jousen lhepbi ding agong un, ahin amavang lhepbi jou ahitapoi, hitin amapan aseiye, “Keima lunghem pum in kachapa lhankhuh jon tang kate, tin Jacob chu akap e.”
37.36: Phat chomkhat jouchun Midian miho chun Joseph chu Potiphar kitipa Pharaoh Egypt lengpa Semang Pachong pa koma ajoh doh tauve. Potiphar natoh chu ahile sepai lah a semang pachong ahi.

38.1: Hiche phat laitah chun Judah chun asopite adalhan Adullan kiti muna Hirah kitipa toh ana cheng khom lhon in ahi.
38.2: Chule Judah in Canan numei amin Shua kitinu chu aki chenpin chule ana kiti matpi tan ahi.
38.3: Amanu chu ahung kivopmon nao ahin neitan chule nao min chu Er asahtan ahi.
38.4: Chuin amanu akivopmo kit in nao pasal khat ahin hinbekit in nao min chu Onam asah tai.
38.5: Abanin amanun nao pasal athum lhinna pachu amin Sheila asah in, Sheila apen lai tah a chu amaho Kezib kiti muna achen laitah'u ahiye.
38.6: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Judah in achapa atah pen Er ding in numei khang thah amin Tamar chu ajidin apui peh e.
38.7: Hinlah Er chu migilou miphamo tah ahijeh chun Yawehyin ahinkho ala dohtai.
38.8: Hichun Judah Onam kitipa, Er sopipa koma hitin aseiye, “Nangma che inlang Tamar khu gaki chenpi tan ati, ajeh chu pasal khat insunga ahinkho abeitah le dan in aphal ahi, asopipan avet thei ding, na sopipa dinga chilhah nasem doh peh tei ding ahi.”
38.9: Amavang Onan kitipa chu anompon ama chilhah ahilou ding chu, hijeh chun a sopi pa ji toh alup khom lhona a kitimat teng abotwi ho chu tollhanga abolha jin, hijeh chun Tamar chun nao avop thei tapon asopipa adin jong chilhah gou aum doh jou tapon ahi.
38.10: Amavang Yawehyin Onan umchan chu gilou engse asa lheh in asopi pa athisa adin chapa ahin peh nom lou athang thip jeh ahi, hijeh chun Yawehyin Onan hinkho jong asuh chom pehtai.
38.11: Hichun Judah in Tamar amounu jah a hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Sheila kikhan lhit kah in napa in'a meithai jin ga umdohtan,” ati. Ijeh-inem itile asopite ni bang in ama jong thiget in te tia anagel ahi. Hijeh chun Tamar jong achen apa in nah aga chengtai.
38.12: Phat chomkhat jou in Shua chanu Judah jinu jong athi tai; ahin Judah chu aki lhep lung mong dom phat in agolpa Adullam mi Hirah chutoh Timnah a akelngoi mul vouho henga aga che tauve.
38.13: Koiham khat in Tamar chu aseipeh in, “Ven natehpu khu Timnah a kelngoi mul vou ding in ache touve,” a tipeh e.
38.14: Chuphat in amanun jong ameithai von chu akhel loijin, ponlu akikhun, akitomjol in Timnah lampia Enaim lamkot'a chun atou tai; ijeh-inem itile Sheila kikhan lhit ahitan, aji dinga amanu akipeh lou akimu ahitai.
38.15: Judah in amanu (Tamar), chu amun ahin amanun amai asel jeh chu numei kijoh ho ahisah in ahi.
38.16: Hichun ama akingapa in amounu ahilam chu helouvin amanu chu ajollin, “Keiman nangma kitimat pi inge” ati. Hichun Tamar in “Kei nei kitimatpi ding leh ipi ijat neipeh ding ham?” atileh,
38.17: “Keima kelchanou lah a khat nahin thah peh nang'e,” tin kitepna aneiyin ahi. Hichun ama nun adong in, “Kelchanou nahin pehtei ding kihet na a ipi kitepna neipeh ding ham,” ati.
38.18: Judah in adong in, “Itobang kitepna na dei ham ati,” amanun adonbut in, “Na Mohor le nakhao toh chule nakhut a nachoi na tenggol chu toh,” ati. Hijeh chun amapan hichengse chu apen amanu chu aluppin ahile aman jong nao avop tai.
38.19: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Tamar a in lama a kinungle kit in a sangkhol chol akoi lhan masanga akivonna lui meithai sangkhol chu akivon in til a bang chun hinkho amang kit tai.
38.20: Judah chun kelchanou chu aloipa Adullam mipa khut'a numeinu henga khamgah na thil lhat doh dinga aga thahsah a ahile, Adullam mipan amanu chu agahol motan ahi.
38.21: Hichun Adullam mipa Hira in hi koma cheng ho chu adong in, “Ena-im jotna a tou numeinu aki johnu chu hoilam a che hitam, ama hon adonbut un, “Keima hon hikoma hin numei phalou atahsa joh kamu kha pouve,” atiuve.
38.22: Hichun Adullam mipa Hirah ahung ki nunglen thu umchan ho chu Judah asei peh tan ahi, “Keiman amanu umna chu kahol doh jou tapoi, chule chua cheng mihon jong hi tobang numei phalou atahsa joh aum poi,” atiuve.
38.23: Judah in aseiye, “Thil kana pehho chu amanun eina koipeh maita hen, kaki nopto nalhon dungjui a kelchanou khat ka pen ahin nangman na holmo tan, amanu chu inung hol kit le khosunga mijousen ei nuisat ding'u ahi tai.”
38.24: Lhathum jou don chun Judah chu mihon asei peh tauvin, “Tamar na mounu chu numei kijoh banga ana bol thu ahije, chule tuhin amanun nao avoptai atiuve.” Hichun Judah in aseiye, “Amanu chu hinpui doh unlang halvam tauvin,” ati.
38.25: Amavang amahon Tamar chu tha dingin ahin puidoh tauvin, Tamar in atehpu thu athot in hitin aseiye, “Hiche thil neipa tenggol ahin, khaodip ahin, Mahor ahin, koi thil pen ham? Ipi dinga thip beh cha uma ham hiche neipa akonna hi nao kavop ahi,” ati.
38.26: Judah in gangtah in ama nei le gou chu amu mun agel doh paitan ahi, “Tamar hi keima sanga chonpha jo ahiye ati. Ajeh chu keiman kachapa Sheila toh akichen lhon na ding imacha kana gonlou jeh ahi,” ati, chupet tah chun Judah chu Tamar toh apum kitimat tapoi.
38.27: Tamar dinga nao neina phat ahung naitan, amanun nao pasal ni pengkop ding ahi chu ahe tauvin ahi.
38.28: Naoso nat akipan tan hiche pet tah chun naocha teni lah a khatpa akhut ahung doh in hichun numei lhacha a pangho chun patsan akhut'a akan peh un, “Hichepa hi hung peng masa ahi,” atiuve.
38.29: Hinlah hiche naocha chun akhut akailut kit tan, asopipa joh ahung peng masa tai. Hichun numei lhacha ho chun “Hiche hi ipi ham atiuve.” Nang in iti dan'a amasa a peng dingpa nahin chop khup ham atiuve.” Hichun amapa min chu Perez asah tauve.
38.30: Chujouvin, naosen patsan a akhut kikanpa chu ahung peng tan hichun amapa min chun Zerah asah tauve.

39.1: Joseph chu Egypt gam'a ana puijun hiche apat a chu Ishmaelite sum-kolvei mihon Potiphar kiti pa koma ana joh un ahi. Potiphar natoh chu Egypt lengpa Pharaoh sepai lamkai a pang ahi.
39.2: Elohimin Joseph chu aumpi jing in, hijeh chun Egypt gamsunga abol lam jouse a alolhing jingin ahi.
39.3: Joseph chu Elohimin aumpi chu athil bolna jousea konnin apupan ahin muchen tan ahi.
39.4: Hichun Potiphar chu Joseph chunga alunglhai lheh jeng in, Joseph chu ama ban tah in akoi tan ahi. chule Potiphar in Joseph chu a insung jouse chule anei agou jouse vetup dingin atungdoh tan ahi.
39.5: Hiche nia pat'a chun Joseph chu apupa Potiphar in insunga ima jouse vetup in anganse tai, chule Joseph chonphat jeh chun Yaweh phatthei bohna chu Potiphar insung a achutan ahi. Hitichun ainsung a thil ijakai akituptan, chule alousohga ho ahin chuleh agancha ho jong apungthei taovin ahi.
39.6: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu ama insung vetup ding le anei agou ho jouse vetup ding in thanei na jouse ape dohtai, chule Joseph umjeh chun aman imacha ah akisaboi tapon, lungkham na jong aum tapon, chule aneh ding anneh tilou thil dang thil dang imacha ahepha tapoi. Joseph chu mi melhoitah vetnom nom umkhat ahi.
39.7: Chule phat chomkhat jouvin, apupa loinun Joseph chu ahin velel tan, “Hung in eini lumkhom hitin kitimat hite tin Joseph chu ajol tai.”
39.8: Amavang Joseph anom pon, Joseph in Potiphar inneipi chu hitin adonbut e, “Ka pupan hiche insunga thil ho jouse vetup dinga ei nganse ahi,” ati.
39.9: Hiche insunga hi keima tilou thanei dang aum poi, kapu pan nangma chung a thaneina eipe poi, ajeh chu nangma aloinu nahi jeh in hi tobang thilpha lou chu iti keiman katoh a Elohim douna a chonset kabol ding ham ati.
39.10: Hiti chun ama nun aniseh in Joseph chu ano ano jeng in, amavang Joseph chu amanu toh lupkhom a ki timat ding chu pum noplou ahin, ahithei chan a jammang ding joh chu agot ahiye.
39.11: Nikhat vang chu koima cha umlouna achun Joseph chu ama ngaiya natong ding in achen.
39.12: Amanu chu ahung lut in a sangkhol ah akai jin, “Hung loiyin eini ilup khom lhon ding ahi,” ati. Hichun Joseph in a sangkhol asut lhan aki tom doh tai. Ahin a sangkhol chu Potiphar loinu khutna adalha den tan ahi.
39.13: Hichun Joseph la ajamdoh tan ahin amanun akhut a um asangkhol chu achoiyin,
39.14: Amanun insunga asohte jouse akou khom soh keiyin, hiche phat chun pasal jousen ahin dellut cheh un, amanun hitin aseiye, “Veuvin! Eingolbol diuvin hiche Hebrew sohpa hi kajipan ahinpuilut e! Amapa hi kei suse din ka insung denna a ahunglut in, ahin keima o sangtah in kapeng in ahi.
39.15: Keima hatah a o sangtah a kapen phat in polam a ajamdoh in alheimang tai, ahin aman asangkholchol chu kakoma ada lha dentai” ati.
39.16: Hiti chun amanun sangkhol chu aloipa in ahung lhun masang in phatechan a koitup sellin ahi.
39.17: Hichun amanun aloipa koma thusoh ho chu asei tai; “Hebrew sohpa nahin puilut pa khun insunga ahung lut in suhset ding eigoi,” ati tai.
39.18: Amavang keima o sangtah a kapen phat in polam ah ajam doh in a sangkhol ada lhah ahi.
39.19: Hichun Potiphar chun ajinu thusim Joseph in amanu chung a athilbol chu ajahdoh phat chun hatah in alung hang lheh tan.
39.20: Hijeh chun Potiphar in Joseph chu songkul'a akoitan chule lengpa songkul'a umho to akihen khom un, ama jong hiti chun aum den tai.
39.21: Ahin Elohimin Joseph chu songkul'a jong aumpi jing in, angailut na ho jong avetsah jing in chule Elohimin Joseph chu songkul ngahpa to jong kingailut na ape kit tai.
39.22: Phat chomkhat jouvin songkul ngahpan Joseph chu songkul'a umho lah a alenpen in akoitan, hiche songkul sunga thil soh bouina jouse chu Joseph thaneina noiya akoi tai.
39.23: Elohimin Joseph chu aumpi jeh in imacha boina aumtapoi, athil bolna anatoh na jouse alolhingsel in hijeh chun songkul ngah pa jong imacha aboita poi, ajeh chu thil jouse Joseph in anga jeh chun imacha aphamo ding aumpoi.

40.1: Hicheng thilsoh kichai nung chun Pharaoh lengpa natong ju vaihompa le an vai hompan apupa Egypt lengpa doumah abol lhon in achonse lhontai.
40.2: Hiche lamkai teni chunga hi Pharaoh nasatah in alunghang tan ahi.
40.3: Chuin Pharaoh in amani chu Joseph umna lengpa songkul natong ho umna ah akoiyin ahi.
40.4: Songkul ngahpan amani chu Joseph thanei na noiya a umsah in Joseph in jong amani chu vetkolna anei jing in ahi.
40.5: Jan khat chun songkul insunga kihen teni Egypt lengpa juvaihompa le an vaihompa chun mang khat cheh, amang ledohna toh kilhon cheh-in anei lhon in ahi.
40.6: Hichun Joseph in amani chu jingkah lama amailhon lunglhai lou chu ahedohtan Joseph in amani chu adongin, ibola nang teni namai lhon kipah lou ham ati.
40.7: Joseph in adong in, “Sopi teni ibola namai lhon lhailou ham,” ati.
40.8: Amanin adon but lhon in, “Janlhah in keinin mang kanei gel lhon in amavang koi machan kamang ipi kisei na ahi aledoh thei aumpoi ati lhon e, ahin Joseph in adonbut in,” mang in ipi ahetsah dichu Elohim kin ahi. Chule namang lhon chu neisei peh lhon in ati.
40.9: Hichun khon dom le a pang lamkai pa chun Joseph chu amang ho chu asei peh tai. Ka manga lengpi bah ka masanga ka mun.
40.10: Hiche lengpi phunga chun abah thum ajam kamun, gang tah in ahung mum in chu in apah lha tai, hiche aga hochu lengpithei ga ahung hitai.
40.11: Pharaoh chakhon chu ka khut chunga ana um'in, hichun keiman lengpi ga phabep chu atwi khon a chun kahehlhan ahi” ati.
40.12: Joseph in hitin aseiye, “Lengpi bah thum hochu nithum tina ahi.
40.13: Nithum sunga hi Pharaoh in nadomtou intin, chule masanga nana toh na a nanung koi kit ding ahi.
40.14: Chule nangma koma katao ahi, chanvou pha nahung chan teng neihin sumil hih beh in Pharaoh koma hitobang kathil bol hohi eina seipeh in, ajeh chu songkul'a konna eilha doh thei na ding in,” ati.
40.15: Ajeh chu Hebrew gam a ka in apat a eikiman doh tua hiche songkul'a kaum hi mona neilou bolkhel ka neipoi.
40.16: Hichun changlhah hom'a lamkai pachun mang aphalam a hoitah a Joseph in ale chu amu le ama jong atha anom lheh in; Joseph jah ah hitin aseiye, “Keiman jong jan mang kaneiye, ka manga chun paipeh thum changlhah dimset kalu chunga kapun ahi.
40.17: Pharaoh a ding in Paipeh achunga pa sunga chun changlhah ajat lhingsel in aum in, ahin vacha ho ahung leng un ka luchunga changlhah ho chu ane doh tauve.”
40.18: Joseph in amang chu ale pehtan, “Paipeh thum chun nithum ma avetsah ahin,
40.19: Nithum sunga hi Pharaoh in nalu adopsang ding thing phunga nakhai sang a, vachaten naphe anehchai ding'u ahi.”
40.20: Pharaoh in nithum jou in ama penni kipapina in anoiya a semang pachonga pang jouse akou khom in hiche a pang dinga chu juvai hom lamkai pa le an vaihom lamkaipa chu alhadoh gel in,
40.21: Ju vaihom pachu aju vaihom na ma man apansah kit'in, aman jong jukhon chu Pharaoh khut a agapetai.
40.22: Ahin an vaihom lamkaipa vang chu Joseph in amani henga mang alepeh bang chun akhai lih tan ahi.
40.23: Hichun ju vaihom lamkaipan Joseph chu ageldoh tapon asumil deltai.

41.1: Kum ni nungin Pharaoh in mang anei in ahile, vetan ama Nile vadung panga ana ding in ahi.
41.2: Amanga chun bongchal sagi athao a thao cheh ahung kal doh un hamhing lah a chun alhaovin ahi.
41.3: Chujou in ama ho nunga chun bongchal sagi ma agon a gong cheh Nile vadunga kon chun ahung doh un, vadung panga bongchal sagi dangho koma chun ading uvin ahi.
41.4: Hichun bongchal agong ho chun bongchal athao sagi ho chu aval lhum tauvin ahi. Hiche mang anei pet tah chun Pharaoh chu ahung khang doh tai.
41.5: Ahin Pharaoh a imulhu kit in mang anivei na aneiyin, hiche amanga hin changphal sagi hoitah vetnom nom um phungkhat a konna hung kikhai lha amun ahi.
41.6: Hichun changphal sagi amanga amu kit'in ahin hiche changphal ho chu ageo cheh chuh jeng in, solam huijin amut geo lheh jeng ahi.
41.7: Chuin hiche geochih banga changphal ho chun changphal lom sagi ahoi phungkhat a kikhai lha ho chu aval lhum kittai. Hichun Pharaoh ahung khangin ahile ajanmang ahichu ageldoh in ahi.
41.8: Hiche ni ajingkah apat'in Pharaoh chu amang ho jeh chun a suboi lheh in aum thei tapoi. Hichun Pharaoh Egypt gamsung a mitphel doi themho le miching jouse akou khomin amng chu aseitan, ahin amaho lah a khatbeh in jong ipi kiseina ham ti chu adonbut thei aumpouve.
41.9: Phat achaina langtah chun lengpa jukhon doma lamkai pachu ahung ding doh in, “Tunia keiman geldoh khat kaneiye phat masa a kana chatvai na atin Pharaoh koma aseitan ahi.
41.10: Nangman nasoh teni chunga nana lunglhai pon changlhah hom lamkaipa le keima chunga, hijeh chun keini hi lengpa songkul'a neina koiyin ahi.
41.11: Nikhat chu changlhah hompa le keiman mang chom cheh kanei lhon in ka mang lhon jong chu thusim chom cheh kanei lhon in,
41.12: Hiche laiphat chun Hebrew khangthah khat lengpa songkul'a chun keiho toh ana um'in, ama chu lengpa semang pachong pa soh a jong ana pang ahi, kamang nei lhon chu kasei lhon in ahile chu'in aman kamang lhon chu eile doh peh lhon e ati.
41.13: Chule aman eiledoh peh lhon bang bang chun ahung guilhung cheh in ahi, keiman kana toh ngai ngai eikitohsah in an vaihompa akikhai lihtan ahi.”
41.14: Pharaoh in Joseph chu ahol in mi asol paijeng tan ama chu agan a gang in songkul'a kon in ahin puidoh jeng uvin, chuin avon ho akikhel in chule akhamul ho a kisuhtheng in, hichun ama Pharaoh toh kimuto din alut tai.
41.15: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma aseitai, “Keiman janlhah in mang ka neijin koima chan ale doh theipon ahin keiman ka jah chu ahile mang kiti hohi nang man hetthei na nanei chu kana jai.”
41.16: Joseph in adonbut in, “Hiche ho chu keima adinga thil hahsa ahi ati. Amavang Elohimin hiche ipi tina ham chu nahetsah theiye,” ati.
41.17: Chuin Pharaoh in amang chu Joseph koma aseitai, aman hitin aseiye, “Ka mang in Nile vadung panga kana ding in.
41.18: Hiche a chun bongchal sagi hoitah kivah thao cheh vadunga kon chun ahung doh in chule hilaiya hampa dong ho chu ane pantauvin ahi.
41.19: Hinlah keiman chom khat jouvin bongchal adang sagi agonga gong ahoimo cheh ahung potdoh kit ka mun, keiman hitabang gancha gong aphe umlou Egypt gamsunga ka hinkhon kana mukha hih laiye.
41.20: Hiche bong agong melse tah hochun bongchal sagi athao ho chu aval lhum tan ahi.
41.21: Achuti jeng vang chun akikhel muthei aumpoi, ajehchu amaho chu masang a bangin agong nalai un ahi. Chujouvin keima kahung khangdoh tan ahi.
41.22: Hichun keima ka imu lhu kit'in, chule keiman mang khat kaneibe kit'in, hichea kamang achun changvui sagi vetnom umtah phungkhat a ga ka mun ahi.
41.23: Chule chang vui sagi machu akiveigeosa akeoseh cheh, nisolam khohui mut geosa cheh chu ahung kilahdoh in ahi.
41.24: Chuin changvui ageosa ho chun changvui hoitah hochu avallhum kittan, hiche kamang hohi doithem ho koma kaseiyin, hinlah ka mangho chu ipi kisei na ham koima chan eihil chen theipoi ati.
41.25: Joseph in adonbut in, “Pharaoh mang teni hi thakhat ahi, Elohimin Pharaoh hi ipi abol ding ahin hetsah masah ahi bouve.
41.26: Bongchal sagi athao ahoi ho chule changvui sagi vetnom nom uma, aga hon avet sah nom chu ahile kum sagi sunga hi neh le chah neng ding avetsah ahi,” ati.
41.27: Chule bongchal sagi agong hole Changvui sagi ageosa aphunga goden solam huiyin asemgot den hon avetsah chu ahile kum sagi nasa tah a kel hunglha ding chu avetsah ahi.
41.28: Hiche hohi keiman ka phondoh banga hung guilhung ding ahi, Ajeh chu Elohimin Pharaoh hi aphat ahung lhun masanga ipi abol dingho chu ahin hetsah ahiye ati.
41.29: Tuapat a Egypt gamsung'a hi kum sagi hatah a neh le chah hung neng ding ahi.
41.30: Amavang hiche joule chun kum sagi ma kel nasatah in hung lhan tin, chuteng chule chun Egypt gamsung ima ma ana tha lhing chu kisumil gam'a, kel lhah chun agamsung abah gam jeng ding ahi tai.
41.31: Hiche kel hung khoh hi gimnei lheh jeng ding kum tamtah neh le chah ana ninglhin na ho jouse chu koiman agel doh lou ding ahitai.
41.32: Pharaoh mang teni ahung ki hetsah na thupi pen tah chu ahile, Elohimin na ahin toh vahding ahi ti gontup sa ahi tai, hung lhung vah tei ding ahi ati.
41.33: Hijeh a chu Pharaoh in achingthei tah pasal chule thil hethem tah koitobang aholdoh a Egypt gamsung pumpia mopothei ahol angai tai.
41.34: Hichun Pharaoh in agam agam a lamkai avetup ding mi lhengdoh henlang hiche teng chule louga sohho kum sagi neh anen sung chun hop nga lah a hop khat koidoh uhenlang,
41.35: Pharaoh thanei na noiya tua patna neh le chah hiche kum sunga hatah a anen pet ahin changpang ahin koi dimset un, phatechan koitup uhenlang chule angah jong umjing hen, kho nung chan geiya khopi sunga neh le chah umjing thei nadin ati.
41.36: Tua chang le mim ho jouse hi phatechan mun khat a gamsung pumpin koikhom uhen, chutile kum sagi sunga nasatah a kel ahung khoh teng Egypt gam sunga mipi jouse kihinso thei ding ahi.
41.37: Hiche lungthim tohgon hi Pharaoh ahin ama semang pachong hon jong pha asa cheh tauvin ahi.
41.38: Hichun Pharaoh in amaho chu adongin, “Eihon hitobang pasal Elohim lhagao chenna hi imujou dingu hi nam,” ati.
41.39: Hiche pet chun Pharaoh in Joseph ahoulimpi in, “Ajeh chu Elohimin ema jouse nangma nahetsah tah jeh in nang tobang koimacha ahethem le aching aumta poi.
41.40: Nangma keima leng touna anatou ding ahitai, kamiten nangma thupeh jouse ajui cheh dingu ahitai. chule thil khat bou ikikhet nading chu keima kalengvai pohna bou lenjo ding kahi ati.
41.41: Pharaoh in Joseph jah ah aseitan, “Keiman nangma hi Egypt gam sunga thanei na le mopoh na kapeh doh nahi tai ati.”
41.42: Hichun Pharaoh in akhut a sana khutjem chu ala doh in Joseph khut a abupeh tai, Aman vonkang hoitah aki vonsah in chule sana khi jong angong a aki osah tai.
41.43: Hichun lengpan Joseph chu asakol chunga atousah in amasanga chun “Mihon dilsu vo tin asamuvin ahi.” Hiti hin aman Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpi semang in ana pansah tai.
41.44: Chule Pharaoh in Joseph kom a hitin aseiye, “Nangma phatsah louva Egypt gamsunga koima chan akhut alapthei lou ding, keima amina bou Pharaoh kahi ding ahi,” ati.
41.45: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egyptte min Zaphenath-paneah asah in, chuleh Potiphera chanu Asenath chu Joseph ji din Pharaoh in agontup peh in ahi. Hiche apatna chu Joseph in Egypt gamsung a mopoh na alah ahitai.
41.46: Egypt lengpa Pharaoh koma anatong dinga alut chun Joseph kum somthum alhing tai. Chuin Joseph chu Pharaoh angsunga konin apotdoh in Egypt gam leiset pumpi aga kholsoh keiyin ahi.
41.47: Ana kisei bang chun kum sagi sung chun neh le chah lousoh hatah in apungin ahi.
41.48: Hiche kum sagi sunga chun Joseph in chang le mim Egypt gamsunga kimu jouse chu mun khat a akoikhom soh kei in, chule khopi jousea akoina mun asem soh keiyin ahi.
41.49: Hichun Joseph in chang le mim chu tamtah avum leo in akhol khom in, vadung panga neldi bang in atam valtah jeh chun hetlut jou jong ahita pon, achaina langa chun simsen lou ahitan sim jong asim tapouve.
41.50: Kellhah kum hung lhun masang chun On thempu pa Potiphera chanu Asenath chun Joseph dingin chapa ni ana hinpeh-in
41.51: Joseph in achapa atahjo pa min chu Manasseh asah in, aman aseiyin, “Hiche hin ka Elohimin kagenthei na jouse eisuh milsahtai, chule kapa insung jong abonchaovin kasumil sohtai tina ahi.”
41.52: Joseph in achapa aneojo pa min chu Ephraim asah tai, “Aman hitin aseiye, “Ka Elohim ka hahsat na le kagenthei na jeh in lolhin na eipe tai,” ati.
41.53: Egypt gamsunga kum sagi sunga chang le mim mang ketkut a ga jouse chu ahung kichai gamtan ahi.
41.54: Hichun kum sagi kel lhah ahung kipantan, Joseph in anasei dohma bangin hiche a nasatah a kel hah chun anaivel a gam ho jouse jong asuboi soh heltai, ama vang Egypt gamsunga chun neh le chah ahahsat na imacha aumpoi.
41.55: Egypt gamsunga kel ahung khoh lheh jeng tan, hichun mipi ho chu neh le chah ngaichat jeh in Pharaoh koma ahung un, hichun Pharaoh in Egypt mipi teho chu “Joseph koma asol in aman bol un atiho chu bol uvin,” ati.
41.56: Hiti chun kel lhah chu hatah in ahung khohse cheh tan gamsung jouse aboilou aumta pon, Joseph in chang pang ho jouse chu ahong doh tan, Egypt mipite chu aki choh sah tai. Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga kelkhoh chu asang lheh in hitobang kel hah chu ana umkha hihlaiye.
41.57: Chule gam dang dang Egypt gam kimvel a jousen neh le chah akichoh thei nadiuvin Joseph heng ahinnai lut tauvin, Ajeh chu hitobang kel hah chu vannoi leiset chung jouse asuh boi cheh ahi.

42.1: Hichun Egypt ma anneh anendan chu Jacob in ahe tan, achate jah a asei tai, “Ibola na din chet chut uva kiveto nahiu ham?
42.2: Keiman thusoh kajan Egypt gam lama chang aum e, hijeh chun nangho cheuvin lang neh ding gacho tauvin, eima ho ikihinso thei nadingu vin,” ati.
42.3: Hichun Joseph sopite mi som hochu neh choding in Egypt lama asuh chetauvin ahi.
42.4: Hinlah Jacob in vang Joseph sopipa Benjamin chu amaho lah a asol tapoi, aman aseiyin, “Keima katiya lheh tai ajole kisuh khah na le boina toh khante,” ati.
42.5: Canaan gam kel hah aum tah jeh chun Israel (Jacob) chate chu Egypt lama anneh hol din mijouse toh ahung lhung khom tauve.
42.6: Tua hi Joseph chu Egypt gam'a chu gam vaihom ahitan, chule chang johna dinga thanei na jouse Joseph kipe ahi tan, hiche pettah chun asopite ahung lhung tauvin, amaho ahung lhun lhun un, hikoma chun tol'a ama ho abohkhup un akunsoh tauve.
42.7: Joseph'in asopite chu amuphat in abonchauvin ahe soh keiyin, ahi vang in amaho chu hetphah lou bol in, hutot tah-in ahouvin, chule ajah uva, “Hoiya konna hung na hiuvem ong?” atile amahon jong “Canaan gam'a kon kahiuvin, puhsui dinga hung kahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
42.8: Joseph in asopiho chu ahet vang'in amahon ahe doh jou pouve.
42.9: Hichun Joseph in kum tamtah masang a asopi ho mang ana mat ho chu ahin geldoh in asopi ho koma hitin aseiye, “Nangho hi mipha lou le migucha nahiuve, keima ho gam hi lah mangthei ham ahiloule akihongbit joupouve, tia neihung khol leu ahi,” ati.
42.10: Ahipoi ka pakai! tin ama hon asam un ahi. “Nasoh teho hi anneh cho ding bou kahi jouve.
42.11: Keiho jouse hi pa khat a hung peng cheh kahi bouvui, milung theng ka hiuve, nasoh hohi miphalou kahi pouve!”
42.12: Ahin Joseph in a sei kit leuvin, “Ahipoi nangho hi ka gam'u hi gam ong kivaipoh achavaiye tia nei hung khol leu ahi,” ati.
42.13: Hinlah ama hon a donbut uvin, “nasoh teho hi ucha pasal som le ni kahiuvin, pa khatna hung peng ka hiuvin, Canaan gam'a incheng tuchung hin aneopen pa hi ka paotoh ka hin dalha uvin, chule mi khatpa vang aum tapoi.”
42.14: Joseph in adonbut in, “Keiman kasei banga nang ho hi michom miphalou na hiuve,” ati.
42.15: Hichea hi nangma ho kapatep ding na hiuve, Pharaoh hinlai sea hiche mun hi nada lhah lou ding'u, chule nasopi pau a lhumpen pa na hinpui kah seuva ati.
42.16: Nangho lah a mikhat kisol uvin lang amapa chun na sopi pau chu hinpui henlang, chule adangho se hilaiya na um ding'u, na thusei'u hi dihnam tia ka khol chil ding ahi; amavang hichu ahi loule Pharaoh ahin laisea nang ho hi michom, miphalou kiti chu na hiuve.
42.17: Hichun Joseph in amaho chu abonchauvin songkul'a nithum jen ahen in ahi.
42.18: Nithum lhin nin Joseph in aseiyin, “Hiche hi bol uvin nahin thei nading uvin, ajeh chu keiman Elohim ka ging lheh jeng'e ati.
42.19: Nangho hi milung theng na hiu leh nangho lah a mikhat hi songkul'a umden uvin lang, ahin adangse se vang ki nungle cheh uvin, na insung mite din chang le mim kipoh un che tauvin ati.
42.20: Chule na sopi pau alhumpen pachu keima koma nahin pui dingu, na thusei houchu dihnam tia kakhol chil ding ahi. Chule nangho nathi lou dingu,” hiti chun amahon jong akisei chu abol'un ahiye.
42.21: Hichun amaho khat le khat akihou lim un, “Adih tah a sei dinga eiho hi isopi pau Joseph ibolset jeh uva gotna ichan'u ahi tai atiuve. Ajeh chu eihon imusoh kei jun aman ahinkho huhdoh na ding in a taovin, hinlah eihon inahsah pouve, hiche ho jeh a chu tua hi gotna ho hi eiho chunga hung chu ahitai atiuve.
42.22: Hichun Reuben in amaho chu hitin adonbut in, “Keiman kasei hilou ham, chapang chu imachan bolse hih un, ahin ka thusei nangai pouvin, tua eihon ama thisan man chu isah diu ahitai.”
42.23: Amaho kikah a Paole aum jeh chun Joseph in amaho ahetchet u ahilam chu amahon ahedoh pouvin ahi.
42.24: Hinlah Joseph a kihei doh in achom lang angan akap tai, ahin ama ahung kinung hei kitin avel in amaho jah thei dingin ahoulim in, hichun amaho lah a Simeon chu alheng doh in amaho mitmu tah in akan tup tai.
42.25: Hichun Joseph in thu apen, amaho dipsunga chun chang khum peh uvin, chule sum ho jong chu ama ama dipsunga nung hetpeh un, chule lampia aneh dingu jong gonpeh uvin hiti chun amaho din thil gontup in aumtai.
42.26: Hichun asopi hon sangan chunga chun nehding chang chu ahengdoh un a inlamu ahin jon tauve.
42.27: Ahin jan na akingah naova amaho lah a mikhat pa chun sangan an neh peh ding agotan adipsung chu agah hon doh le adip sunga sum dangka chu ahin mudoh tan ahi.
42.28: Veuvin tin asopiho jah a aseiyin, “Kasum hohi ka dipsunga eiki nungkoi peh kit tai,” hichun amaho chu alungu alhadeh tauvin kithing pum pum in khat le khat akihou khom un, “Elohimin ipi eito sah u hi tante atiuve.”
42.29: Hichun amahon apao Jacob heng Canaan gamsung ahung lhung kit tauvin, hichun ama hon Jacob koma thil ahinto hou chu aseipeh un, hitin aseiyui.
42.30: “Gamneipa chun hiti hin aw sangtah in keiho jah din asam in, chule keiho hi miphalou gamsunga thilse bol ding in eigingmo un ahi.
42.31: Hinlah keihon amapa chu ka donbut un, keiho hi milung theng miki tah ka hi bouvui katiuvin, chule keiho miphaloute kahi pouve.
42.32: Chule keima hohi ucha sopi som le ni solam a hung kon ka hiuvin, Pakhat in eihin'u ahin, mikhat vang ahing tapon chule aneo pen pa vang tuhin ka pao toh Canaan gamsunga ka hin dalha uve.
42.33: Hichun gamsung a lamkai pipu pa chun hitin eisei peh uve, nangma ho hi hitia ka bol ding mipha milung theng nahiu kahet doh nadin, nangho lah a khat ki dalhau vin, chule adanghon an neh ding chang le mim pouvin lang na inkote kom lang nung che tauvin.
42.34: Hinlah na sopipau alhumpen pachu ka henga na hin puilut tei ding'u ahi ati, chule keiman hiche jou teng chule nang hohi mipha midih tah nahiu, michom le mikhol na hi pouve tichu kahet chet ding ahitai. Hiche teng chule nasopi pau chu kanung peh kit diu chule nanghon boina umlouva navah sel a an jong nakihol theiyu ahi,” ati.
42.35: Adip'u chu alhei lha uvin ahile vetan amitakip in asum chun cheh chu ama ama dip sung cheh a ana umsoh keiyin; ama hon jong apaovin jong a sumchun chengseu chu amudoh phat uvin akihot lhul gam tauve.
42.36: Jacob chu tijatah'in ahoulim in, “Nangho hin ka chate ho neiguh mang peh cheh dingu ahi tai, Joseph jong aum ta pon, Simeon jong aum ta pon, chule tua nang hon Benjamin jong nei puimang peh kigo kit'un, na thil bol jouseu hi keima douna jeng ahi tai!”
42.37: Hichun Reuben in apa Jacob chu a donbut in, “Benjamin chu ka hin nungpui louleh ka chate ni hi na deidei nalo thei ahitai, chule keiman Benjamin na ding in mopo nang kate ati, chule thonlouva kahin nungpui kit teitei ding ahi,” ati.
42.38: Ahin Jacob in a donbut in, “Ka chapa chu nangma toh chelou ding ahi, ajeh chu aupa Joseph jong athi tan, tua kanei ka lungmonpi ama bou ahi tai; ijem tin lamkim lang nagei tengu le lamkah lah a toset tohkha ta hen lang hile kasam kan nung jenga jong lunghema thikhol khul a neilhoh lut pai tah bah dingu ahibouve,” ati.

43.1: Tuhin Canaan gamsunga kel lhah chu akhoh cheh cheh jeng in ahi.
43.2: Egypt gam'a konna ahinpoh'u anchang aneh chai phat un hichun apao Jacob in achate jah a aseitai, “Nung che kit unlang neh ding gacho kit tauvin,” ati.
43.3: Ahin Judah in apa Jacob adonbut in, “Gamsung lamkai pa chun hatah in eigah un, na sopi pao chu nahin puilou ule kamai namu lou dingu ahi,” ati.
43.4: Benjamin keiho toh na sol khom le kache dingu anchang kaga choh dingu ahi ati.
43.5: Amavang Benjamin che ding naphal loule keiho jong kache lou hel ding'u ahitai ti geldoh in, ajehchu gamsung lamkai pa chun aseiye, “Na sopi pao alhum pen pachu nahin pui lou ule kamai namu lou dingu ahi atisa ahi.”
43.6: Hichun Jacob in adonbut in, “Ibol a nang hon nei suh genthei ju hitam, hiche gamvai popa koma chu sopi khat ka nei nalai uve tia nahin seidoh uham,” ati.
43.7: Amahon a donbut un, “Hiche gamsung lamkai pa chun eiho insung chan chin thu hoitah in aman thudoh eineijun, napao dam nalai em tin eidong un, hiche a chun keihon amapa thudoh ho chu ka donbut cheh un, chule keihon iti ka het thei diu ham? na sopi pao hinpui yun ati ding chu,” atiuve.
43.8: Judah in apa Israel koma asei tan, “Chapang pachu hin sol in hiche teng chule keiho kaga che diu ahi, chule eiho jouse le echateu jouse iki hinso thei ding'u ahi ati.
43.9: Chule keima ka tahsa tah in mopo nang kate ijem tia boina aum khah le, ahin Benjamin chu kahin nung pui loule boina jouse keiman mo kapoh ding ahi ati; chule nangma angsunga mopoh na thepmo na jouse keima chunga chu jeng hen ati.
43.10: Amavang eiho ana geisang hih leu hen tuphat a hi nivei tobang kilhung thei ding ahitai.”
43.11: Chuphat in apao Israel chun ajah uva, ‘chuti ding mong ahiya ahile hiti hin ki gong uvin, gamsunga thingga phalai cheh lheng khom uvin lang, thingnai, lou them khat le khoiju them khat toh, thil namtui toh, thei chang toh, chule jonmot chang toh nadip sunguva mipa peh ding chun posuh uvin ati.’
43.12: Chule dangka jong athop in pohbe un, ajeh chu na dip sung uva anaki koi chu koitobang khat in jong anabol khel jong himai thei ahi.
43.13: Hijeh chun nasopi pao hi pui jun lang gamsung lamkai heng'a nung che tauvin.
43.14: Chule hatchung nung Elohimin phatthei naboh maiju hen, hiche gamsung vaipo mit mua jong ngailut na mel na chan thei na diuvin ati, chule nanghon na sopi pao Simeon chule Benjamin na hin hen ohna lou dingu vin, chule keima vang ka chate jal'a thilo pai ding ka hitai,” ati.
43.15: Hichun amahon Jacob thilpeh ho chu agongtup un, chule adipsung uva sum jong athop in apoh be uvin, Benjamin toh akilhon tauve; hichun amaho Egypt gam alhung taovin Joseph masanga ading tauvin ahi.
43.16: Chuin Joseph in Benjamin amaho lah a ahung chu amutan, hichun aman a insunga lhacha a pangho jah a hitin aseiye, “Amaho toh'in tunia an nekhom ding ka hiuvin hijeh chun insung lama ana puilut un, chule gancha ana that un, kin thupitah kimang ding ahi.”
43.17: Hichun lhacha hon Joseph'in asei bang chun abol'un, amaho sese chu Joseph inlam a apuitau vin ahi.
43.18: Joseph insung'a akipui lut jengu ahetdoh phat un asopiho chu akichauvin, “Iche masah uva hilai mun a koihamkhat in idip sunguva sum ana hetlut u ahi. Aman eihon iguh u bang a agon a, eimat uva, asoh uva eisem uva, chuleh isangan hou jong eilahpeh u ahitai” akiti uve.
43.19: Asopihon chun Joseph insung lhachapa koma ache un akelkot koma,
43.20: “Ja umtah pu, keiho hi phat masa chun Egypt gam'a anneh ding chon kahung uve.
43.21: Ahin keiho kaki nungle uchun jan ahia kakicholpet uva ka dip sungu kahon doh ule keihon ka dipsung cheh uva mumasah pen cheh in kathil chohna man cheh uchu ana umsoh keiye! tuhin hiche dangka ho chu kahin nungpoh cheh nauve.
43.22: Chule keihon anneh chohbe nading dangka jong ka hin pohbe uvin, koi tobang ham khat in dangka ho ka dipsung uva ana koi jong chu ka pum het pouve.” atiuvin ahi.
43.23: “Imacha lungboina nei hih un,” tin insung lhacha pa chun aseiye, na Yaweh na pate Elohim chun na dipsung uva nahin koipeh'u ahi, na dangka hou jong keima koma aum nai; hichun aman Simeon chu alha kang in amaho laha ahinpui dohtan ahi.
43.24: Insung lhacha pa chun miho chu Joseph leng insung lama apuilut tauvin ahi, insung lhacha pan twi akengu kisil ngim na ding apen chule sangan ho ding anneh jong ape uvin ahi.
43.25: Hilai mun a chu an aneh ding thu u ahetdoh phat un, sun a Joseph ahung lhun masang in amahon thilpeh ho chu akigon tup tauvin ahi.
43.26: Hichun Joseph in ahung lhun chun amahon athil poh'u chu ahin la doh un Joseph masanga tol'a abohkhup tauvin ahi.
43.27: Amahon alemjou chun adong tan napao akum atam tai nati pao chu “Dam jinga hinam, ama chu dam dam a hinam tin adong'in ahi.”
43.28: Amahon adon but un, “Henge adam dam nai atiuve,” chule nasohte keiho dinga ka pao chu adam in ahing na laiye,” chuin amaho Joseph masanga abohkhup kit uvin ahi.
43.29: Hichun Joseph in asopipa Benjamin chu aven “Amahi ham na sopiu alhum pen pa na tiu chu tin Joseph in adong tai,” Elohimin na umpi jingta hen O ka chapa!” ati.
43.30: Hichun Joseph ama umna insung dana kon in apot doh in, ajeh chu asopipa amu chun ama akitim joutapon, hichun ama indan sungnunga alutin agakaptan ahi.
43.31: Chuin amai akiphet jouvin ama ahung potdoh kit in nasatah in akitim ham ham in, “An neh ding hin thuh taovin,” ati.
43.32: Hijeh chun amahon Joseph ding atum in, amaho ding atumin, chule ama toh nekhom ding Egypt mite ding atumin ankong asem tauve, ijeh inem itile Egypt miten Hebrew mite toh an aneh khom ngailouvu, neh khom ding chu Egypt mite dinga bohna khat hiya ahiye.
43.33: Joseph in asopiho chu atouna diu akoi peh cheh in, ama hon jong ajalheh jeng un, amaho tahsa kum alen penna pat aneopen pa geiyin atou nao agontup peh in atou sah tan ahi.
43.34: Amaho chan ding chu Joseph chan lah a konnin asoh doh uvin ahi; chujong le Benjamin chan chu amaho khat chan jat sangin chan ajat ngan atam joi. Hitobang chun ama hon Joseph chutoh an ane khom uvin adon khom tauvin ahi.

44.1: Hichun asopiho chu cheding in aki gong tauvin, Joseph in insung lhacha ho lah a aseitan, “Amaho dipsunga chun apoh thei jat u dimset in anchang kipoh sah un, chule dangka ahin kipoh hou chu nunghet peh cheh kitun,” ati.
44.2: Chuteng le keima sum eng cha khon chu alhumpen pa dipsunga achung tho pena koi jun chule chang choh na dinga sum ahin kipoh toh chun koi than, hiti chun insung lhacha pan jong Joseph in asei bang chun aboltan ahi.
44.3: Jingkah matah in akipat doh un ache tauve, a sangan ho jong vumlet set in neh ding apon alampiu majon ding in asol tauve.
44.4: Amaho chu khopia kon chun achedoh tauvin gamla pi agei masang uvin Joseph in jong ainsung thil chingpa jah a chun, “kipat doh in lang miho nung chu del loiyin, amaho chu naphah teng le ajah uva, “Ipi ding pen tah a ka phat nau thilpha chu git louva na lethuh u-hitam ong? Ipi dinga keima dangka khon chu nana guh mangu ham?
44.5: Nangho hin ibola kapupa sum eng cha khon na guh'u hitam? Aman hiche chu aman chah a thil ahung lhung ding ho hetna a aneiji ahi; nanghon thilpha loutah na boldoh'u hitalou ham ati.
44.6: Insung lhacha pan amaho chu amat tup jouvin hitin aseitai.
44.7: Amahon amapa koma hi tin aseiuve, “Keiho hi nasoh kahiuvin, chule keihon hitobang chu ka bol lou beh ding'u ahi,” atiuve.
44.8: Ven keiho Canaan gam'a patna sum dangka chu kahin ki choi cheh nauve, chule kadip sung uva ana umho chu ka Yaweh pa in na konna kei hon iti dana sum eng chakhon chu ka guh doh thei diu ham atiuve.
44.9: Nasohte lah a koi hijongle ala ana umtah le ama jong chu thidoh maita hen, chule keiho jong ka pakai pa koma soh chang ding kahi tauve.
44.10: Hiche chu apha lheh jenge tin ama pan adonbut e, “Hinlah ka chakhon gupa bou chu ka soh a pang ding ahi ati tai, adangho vang imacha kalo louding adangho che tauvin,” ati.
44.11: Amahon gangtah in adip hou chu sangan chunga konnin adom lhauvin ahong doh un ahi.
44.12: Hiphat chun insung lhacha pan alenpen apat in aneo pen pa gei in adip sung ahin kholtan ahile sum eng chakhon chu Benjamin dipsunga ahin mudoh tan ahi.
44.13: Hichun ama hon a sangkhol'u abot tel tel tauvin, apot hou chu a sangan chunga aheng doh kit un, khopi lam ahin nung jot kit tauve.
44.14: Judah le asopi ho ahung lhun u chun Joseph chu a in na ana umna laiye, chule amaho Joseph masanga tol ah abohkhup tauvin ahi.
44.15: Chuin Joseph in amaho jah a aseiyin, “Ipi ham nanghon na bol'u hi? Nang hon na het lou'u ham hitobang mihem ho hi keiman amaho khonung ding kasei thei ahi,” ati.
44.16: Hichun Judah in asei tai, “Ipi ka sei dingu hitam? keima ho iti them ka kichan diu hitam Elohimin nasohte chonsetna hohi ahin het dohsah ahi tai. Hijeh chun keiho ka boncha uva sum eng chakhon kimat doh na pa toh ka pakai pa soh a pang ding ka hitauve.
44.17: Hinlah Joseph in adonbut in, “Hiche ho chu keiya kon in kigam lhat maihen, keiman bolda jeng inge, hiche pasal pa ka khon kimu doh na pa bou chu kasoh a pang ding, adang se sevang damsel in napa koma nung che tauvin,” ati.
44.18: Hichun Judah aphei chen aseitai, “Lungset tah in ka pakai koma nasoh pan thu cheng khat tou kasei thei ding ham? lungset tah in nei lunghan khum hih in, nangma Pharaoh toh nalal na lhon jong ki bang ahitan;
44.19: Ka pakai pan phat masa chun nasohte ho nei dong uvin, nangma hon sopi nanei juvem ahiloule na pa'u umnalai em natin,
44.20: Chuin keihon ka donbut un, henge ka pakai pa ka tiuvin kapa'u jong adam nalaiye ahin amavang ateh lheh tai ka tiuve, chule achapa aneopen pachu ateh jou nungsanga ahin ahi. Asopipa jong athi tan, amabou chu anu sunga hing doh ahin, hijeh a chu apan jong hatah a angailut ahi,” ati.
44.21: Nangman thu neina peh jal a amapa chu hinpui un keiman kamit taha kamu nom e natin;
44.22: Ahin keihon kana donbut un, ka pakai pa'u chu hiche chapang chun apa adalha thei poi ajeh chu apa thilo thei ahi.
44.23: Ahin nangman thu neina mop kit un, nasopi pa'u alhum pen pa ahung tokah a nanghon kamai namu kitlou dingu ahitai nati.
44.24: Hichun keiho kaki nungle un, na sohpa kapa'u kom lang a ka pakai pa uvin thugah na neisei peh hou chu ama koma ka na lhut tauve.
44.25: Hichun ka paovin eidonbut un, ‘Keima ho kache thei lou dingu ahi na chapa alhum pen pa ache lou dingle kasopiu alhumpen Benjamin ajao lou le ei kimu pi lou dingu ahi.
44.27: Hichun nalhacha pa kapa uvin hitin aseiye, nanghon naheuvin ka loinu Rachel in cha ni eihin peh in ahi.
44.28: Chule amani lah a khat pan eidalhatan ahung ki nungle tapon; gamsa hon ahal hal a abotel ding in ginmo aum lheh tan, hiche apatna chun tugei hin kamu kha tapoi ati.
44.29: Tua ama, asopipa hi na puidoh uva boina hahsat na hintoh le tua kasam kan jouva thina lunghem na nei tosah kit diu ahi,’ ati.
44.30: Tun, ka pakai, keima kapa henga hiche chapang jao louvin ki nungle thei pong kate. Kapa'u hinkho hi hiche chapang pa hinkho hi kingam ahiye.
44.31: Kapan hiche chapang hi amulou le thilo tei ding ahi, nasoh teho hin kapa'u samkan jouva thina kato sah kit dingu ahitai atiuve.
44.32: Amonga jong na sohpa hi kapa henga hiche chapang khel'a hung kipe doh jenga hitia hi, keiman ama hi naheng kahin nunglhut kit louva ahile nahenga hinkho lhumkei jin themmo chang jeng ing kate, kati ahi.
44.33: Hijeh chu kapu lungset tah in ahithei dingle hiche chapang khel in keima hi nangma soh din um tang kate, chule ahithei dingle hiche chapang hi a u-teho toh ki nungle tau hen.
44.34: Keima iti kapa koma kaki nungle kit ding ham hiche chapang pa beiya hi ati, kapa in gim genthei athoh ding chu iti kavet jou ding ham ati.

45.1: Hichun Joseph ana tohkhompi ho masanga ama le ama akitim jou tapon hichun awthong jejun akaptan, mijouse hikoma konin asoldoh in ama asopi ho lah a akiphong doh tan ahi.
45.2: Chuin ama hatah in akaptan ahile Egypt miten jong aja uvin, chule hiche thu kisei chu apet petin Pharaoh in ajatan ahi.
45.3: Joseph asopi ho kom a aseiyin “keima Joseph chu kahi! kapa chu dam nalai hinam?” ati, Hinlah asopiho imacha seithei louvin aum taovin ahi! Amasang uva ding Joseph ahi ahin hetdoh u chun alung kidang lheh jengun ahi.
45.4: Hung kikhin naijun ati, amapan hichun ama hon anai lut un, chuin ama aki phongdoh kit in “Keima hi Joseph kahi,” ati, na sopiu soh chang dinga Egypt gam'a najoh pa'u chu kahi ati.
45.5: Ahin nang hon nopmo sahih un, chule keima hilaimun a neijohdoh jeh uva nangho le nangho kilunghan jong bolhih un, ajehchu nangho hinkho huhdohna dinga Elohimin hilai mun a hi eina sol masahjoh ahibouve ati.
45.6: Hiche gamsung a hi kum ni bou kel hah hung kipan bep ahin, ahung lhung ding kum nga sunga chang um talou ding ahiye.
45.7: Elohimin nangho huh doh dinga eina sol masat joh ahi, nangho le na insung mite thilouva leichunga achi aman na lou ding ahi.
45.8: Hiche chu nanghon na bol ahipon, Elohimin eina masol joh ahi, chule Elohimin Pharaoh hithei ding ama lenggam ma Egypt gamsung a semang a pang ka hitai.
45.9: “Tun gangtah in kino uvin lang kapa gaseipeh loiyun lang nachapa Joseph aseiye: 'Elohimin Egypt gamsunga vaipo alen pennin eipansah tai. Hijeh chun kakom a hungsuh loiyin!
45.10: Keima toh kinai cha a nachate le natute jouse, na gancha ho le nanei nagou jouseu pumma Goshem gamsunga na chen theiyu ahi.
45.11: Hikoma chu keiman kavetsui diu ahi, ijeh inem itile kel lhah na ding hi kum nga jen aum nalaiye, achuti louva ahile na insung pumpiu leh na gancha ho jouseuvin an angol diu ahi.
45.12: Hichun Joseph in athusei ajom in “Veuvin nangho che un, ka sopipa Benjamin neiven keima Joseph ka hi ati.
45.13: Cheuvin lang kapa Jacob chu gasei peh loi un, mun phatah hiche Egypt gamsunga kanei uve, chule amachu thil namu jouse seipeh un, chule aganna thei chan in hilanga hinpui jun ati.
45.14: Hichun Joseph in Benjamin chu angong koiyin akap tai, chuti ma chun Benjamin in jong akoiyin akap tai.
45.15: Joseph in asopi ho chengse chu akoiyin akap tai, chule asopite hon lungthoi na um louvin aki houlimpi tauve.
45.16: Joseph sopi ho ahung lhung tauve tithu chu Pharaoh le a insung miten jong aja tauve, chule amahno jong akipa pi lheh un ahi.
45.17: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma aseiyin, “Na sopi ho chu seipeh in gangtah in na sangan chung uva napot hou chu hengdoh unlang gangtah in Canaan gama ki nungle loiyun,” ati.
45.18: Chule napa ahin adang insung mite jouse keima koma hinle pui loiyun Egypt gamsunga aphapen kapeh diu nahi; chule agam ga soh ahoipen na neh diu ahi ati.
45.19: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma asei in, “Na sopiho chu seipeh tan amahon kangtalai chu kipuiyu hen lang chapang ho le a jiteho'u chule napa'u chu ka henga hinpui jun.
45.20: Nanghon nathil neihou chu lunggim pi da taovin, ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga ahoipen aphapen jouse nang ho a ahitai.”
45.21: Hichun Israel chaten amaho thu kisei peh bang chun abol'un, Joseph in jong kangtalai ho chu agontup peh in Pharaoh in aphatsah le athupeh dungjui in, chule lampi kah a neh le chah ding jong agontup peh in ahi.
45.22: Chule aman asopiho chu vonthah apecheh in, Benjamin vang chu golvah von nga chule dangka sum eng jathum toh apen ahi.
45.23: Joseph in apa din sangan chal ho poh thei Egypt gamsunga atwi aphapen ho jouse athot in chule sangan anu som dimset changlhah apohsah in lampi kah a akihinso thei na dingu ahi.
45.24: Hichun Joseph in asopiho chu alha doh in, amaho akipatdoh ding kon un, Joseph in amaho chu availhah in “Lampi najot lai un nangho kina pa hih un,” ati.
45.25: Chuin amahon Egypt chu adalha uvin Canaan gam lang apa Jacob kom anung lhun kit tauve.
45.26: Amahon apao chu aseipeh un hitin atiuve, “Joseph chu ana hing nalaiyin, chule Egypt gam pumpia vaipoa khu ama hijah ahiye,” atiuve. Ahinah vang chun Jacob in la amaho a tahsan loujeh in alungthim akiloh dehpoi.
45.27: Ahin amahon Joseph thusei chu avel vel in apao chu a seipeh un, chule Joseph in apa poh na dinga kangtalai chu agah ven amuphat in apao Jacob lhagao chu akidodoh kit tai.
45.28: Hichun Israel in aphong doh tai, “Keima kanomtai adih ahitai, Joseph hi ahing mong nai ka hinkho abei masang in kaga kimupi ding ahi,” ati.

46.1: Hichun Jacob chu Egypt gam jon din akipat dohtan anei agou jouse jong apon Bersheba ahung lhungin hiche jan chun apa Isaac Elohim min in maicham asem in ahi.
46.2: Hiche jan chun Elohimin gaova akihoulim pin, “Jacob Jacob tin akouvin,” hichun aman jong, “Hoijo Yaweh keima hikoma ka ume,” ati.
46.3: Keima napu napate Elohim kahi tin ahoulim pin, nangma Egypt gam langa suh cheding kicha hih beh in ajeh chu keiman nangma hiche muna chu nam lentah kaso ding nahi ati.
46.4: Keiman Egypt lama nasuh cheteng ka kilhonpi ding nahi, chule keiman nangma ka hin nungpui kit ding nahi ati; Egypt a nathi ding ahi, ahin namit nasin na mun a chu Joseph in naumpi ding ahi.
46.5: Hichun Jacob in Beersheba adalhan chule achate sen Egypt lama apui tauvin, kangtalai chunga ama ahin chapang naosen ho jong chule ajite ho chengse jong Pharaoh in ima ma agontup peh bang in apuisuh tauvin ahi.
46.6: Amahon anei agou jouse chule agancha hou jouse Canaan gamsunga ana kilamdoh ho jouse jong apo tauvin ahi.
46.7: Achate hou sese chule atute ho jouse jong chule achanute ho jong chule achanute chate jouse jong ama chilhah namkim jouse toh Egypt ahin jon tauve.
46.8: Tua min hung kipe ho chengse hi Israel chilhah Jacob chate Egypt gam'a anache ho chu ahiuve, Reuben chu Jacob chate lah a atahpen ahi.
46.9: Reuben chate ho Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi ahiuve.
46.10: Simeon chate amaho hi ahiuve, Jenuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Johan.
46.11: Levi chate ho, Gershon, Kohath, chule Merari, ahiuve.
46.12: Judah chate ho chu, Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, chule Zezah ahiuve. Er le Onan chu Canaan gam'a ana thi lhon tai; Perez chate ho Hezron le Hamul ahiuve.
46.13: Issachar chate ho chu, Tolah, Puvah, Jashub, chule Simron ahiuve.
46.14: Zebulun chate ho chu Sered, Elon, chule Zahleel ahiuve.
46.15: Hiche pasal min hung kijih hohi Jacob le Leah Padan-Ram gam'a achen lai uva peng ho se ahiuve, chule amaho tilouva apenbe chu ahile achanu Dinah jong ahi; Jacob chate jouse numei le pasal abon'a Leah a konna hung peng doh jouse chu agoma som-thumle thum ahiuve.
46.16: Gad chate ho chu, Zephon ahin, Haggi ahin, Shumi ahin, Ezbon ahin, Eri ahin, Arodi chule Areli ahiuve.
46.17: Asher chilhah ho chu, Imnah ahin, Isvah ahin, Ishvi chule Beriah ahiuve; chule Serah chu asopinu ahin Beriah chate ho Heber chule Malkaiel ahiuve.
46.18: Hiche pasal ho sese hi Zilpah chate ho Leah sohnun akon a Jacob chilhah ho ahiuvin agom a som le gup ahiuve.
46.19: Jacob chilhah Rachel in ahinpeh Joseph le Benjamin ahi.
46.20: Joseph chate ni Egypt gam'a peng Mannaseh le Ephhraim ahi lhone, amani nu min chu Asenath Potiphera chanu On gam'a thempu pa chanu ahiye.
46.21: Benjamin chate ho chu, Bela ahin, Bekar ahin, Ashbel ahin, Gera ahin, Namaan ahin, Ehi ahin, Rosh ahin, Muppim ahin, Huppim ahin, chule Ard ahiuve.
46.22: Hiche a pasal hung kijih hohi Rachel le Jacob ma konna hung peng doh abonchauva som le li ahiuve.
46.24: Napthali chate ho chu, Jahzeel ahin, Guni ahin, Jezer ahin chule Shillem ahiuve.
46.25: Hiche pasal ho hi Jacob chate Bilhah in ahin peh Laban in Rachel soh dinga apeh nu akon a chu ahi, abon'un cha pasal sagi ahing lhone.
46.26: Jacob chilhah te Egypt ma amatoh che ho chu achate jiho sim louvin mihem somgup le gup ahiuve.
46.27: Hiche tilou chun Jacob in Egypt ma cha pasal ni aneiben hijeh chun abonchauvin Jacob insung mite chu Egypt gam'a anachen laiyu chun mihem som sagi alhingset un ahi.
46.28: Amaho alamjot naova alhun nadiu ahung naithim tan, Jacob in Judah chu Goshem jotna lamhil hedin asol in, chuin phat chomkhat jouvin amaho alhung tauve.
46.29: Joseph a sakol kangtalai chunga atou doh in apa Jacob chu Goshem lama aga kimuto pitai, Hichun Joseph in apa Jacob amu phat chun phat sottah a ngongkoi in akap tai.
46.30: Hichun Jacob in ahin hou in, Joseph koma aseitai, “Keima tua hi thithei ka hitai, Ajeh chu nangma nana hing nalai in tuhin namai ka mutai,” ati.
46.31: Hichun Joseph in asopite le apa insung mite jah a “Keima chetou ing ting Pharaoh jah a thu galhut ing ka ting ajah a, ‘Canaan gam'a cheng ka sopite le kapa insung mite ka heng ahung lhung tauve!
46.32: Amaho hi kelngoi ching mi ahiuvin, chule amahon anei thil jouse le agancha hou jong ahin kipui uve gati ing'e.
46.33: Ahin Pharaoh in nahin hou teng ule nahin doh dingu ahin, “Nangma hohi ipi na natoh ji uham ahin ti ding ahi.
46.34: Nangma hon hitia hi na donbut dingu ahi, keiho nasoh teho hi ka neo uva patna kapate kapute banga kelngoi ching ka hung hitauve nati diu ahi, chuteng chule Pharaoh in Goshem lhanglam a nahin chen sah diu ahi; ajeh chu Egypt miten kelngoi chingho athei nom pouve.”

47.1: Hiti chun Joseph ache lut in Pharaoh henga thu agalhut in, ‘‘Kapa le ka sopite akelngoi ho jouse le aganchau toh chule aneijouseu toh kilhon in Canaan gam'a kon in ahung lhung tauve; tuhin Goshem gamsunga aum uve,” aga ti.
47.2: Chuin Joseph in asopi ho lah a mi nga alhengdoh in Pharaoh henga phondohna aneiyin ahi.
47.3: Chuin Pharaoh in amaho chu thu adong tan, “Nangma ho ipi natong nahiu ham?” amahon adonbut un, “Keima ho nasohte ho hi kapu kapate khanga patna kelngoi ching ka hiuve atiuvin ahi.”
47.4: Amahon Pharaoh henga ahoulim un, hiche gam'a cheng dinga hi keiho ka hung taovu ahe, ajeh chu nasoh teho hi kelngoi vah ka hiuvin, hamdong jong Canaan lhang lama aum tapoi; Hijeh chun lungset tah in Goshem lhang langa nei chen sahun kel hah sungin atiuvin ahi.
47.5: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph jah a aseiye, “Napa ahin, na sopi ho nangma koma din ahung tauve.
47.6: Nangman lhen peh tan Egypt gamsung pumpia amaho achen theina diuvin, chule Egypt gamsung a apha pen chu pen ati; Hichun Goshem lhang lam chu pen amaho din ati. Chule amaho lah a miching thepna nei aumle keima gancha ho vetup din nei koi peh in,” ati.
47.7: Hichun Joseph in apa Jacob chu Pharaoh koma ahin puijin akihet tohsah in chujouvin Jacob in Pharaoh chu phatthei aboh in ahi.
47.8: Chuin Pharaoh in “Kum ijat na hitam tin Jacob chu adong in ahi.”
47.9: Jacob in adonbut in, “Keima hi leiset chunga lam ka hin jotna patna hi kum ja khat le som thum tobang ka hitai; Amavang ka hinkho hi kapate ho kapute ho sang in achom jo na laiye,” ati.
47.10: Hichun Jacob in Pharaoh adalhah masang in avel in phatthei aboh kit in ahi.
47.11: Joseph in apa Jacob ahin asopiho abonchauvin Egypt gamsunga achensah tan, chule nei le gou jong apen gam jong apha pen Ramases lhangjol lam chu Pharaoh thupeh dungjui in ape tan ahi.
47.12: Chuin Joseph in apa ahin, asopite ahin abonchauvin amahon angaichat dungjui in ape sohkei jin, chule chapang neocha cha ho gei ding in jong ape jeng tan ahi.
47.13: Phat chomkhat jouvin neh-leh-chah ahah lheh jeng tan, anchang kikoi jouse jong ane chai gam tauve, Egypt gamsung le Canaan gamsunga mipite jouse neh le chah hahsat jeh in mipi thi ding in aum gam tan ahi.
47.14: Joseph in sum le pai akhol doh jouse chu Egypt gamsung ahin Canaan gamsunga anchang achoh nau sum jouse chu Pharaoh gou kholna muna ahin polut tai.
47.15: Mipite jouse Egypt akon ahin, Canaan a kon ahin, sum le pai jouse alhahsam phat in Joseph koma ahung taovun ahi, Amaho akap'un “Sum le pai Sana le dangka ho jouse akichai tai; an neh ding neipeh lou ule nangma mitmua thiding ka hitauve atiuvin ahi.”
47.16: Hichun Joseph in adonbut in, “Na dangka hou abei tah le nagancha hou keima henga hinkai jun, keiman nangho gancha hotoh kitoh ding an neh ding kalhet peh ding na hiuve ati.
47.17: Hichun amahon an nehtoh lheh ding in agancha hou jouse Joseph koma ahin kaiyun, chule sakol hon ho ahin, kelngoi hon hole keltah hon ho ahin chule abong hon ho le sangan ho jouse jong Joseph koma alheh cheh un hichun aman kum khat an neh ding apeh be kit tan ahi.
47.18: Amavang hiche kum chu akichai kit tan, kumthat ahung lhung kittan hichun amahon a seikit tauve, “Nangma akon in imacha ka im thei tapouve, Ajeh chu ka dangka hou se la aki chaitan, ka gancha hou ka bong hou la abei tan, tua hi keima hon imacha peh ding ka neita pouve, tua hi ka tahsao le ka leiset bou'u aum tai.
47.19: Nangma mitmua iti ka moh thi thei diu ham keima ho tahsa ahin ka leiset'u hi an neh ding toh lheh jeng tau vinge atiuve; ka leiset u ahin ka tahsau ahin Pharaoh soh in umtau ving kate, hijeh chun anchang neh ding neipe uvin, kathi lou na diuvin, chule leiset gam chu mohseh a umlou a asetna lou ding in atiuve.
47.20: Hichun Joseph in Egypt gamsunga leiset jouse Pharaoh din Egypt mite koma konin achodoh soh tan ahi.
47.21: Mipi ho vang chu ahile khopi akon in gam ong thinglhang lama asol in Egypt gamsunga mun khat a patin mun chom a asol in ahi.
47.22: Gam leiset Joseph in ana choh lou chu thempu ho gambou chu ahi. amaho chun Pharaoh a konna anneh akisan'u ahi jeh in agam leiset'u jong ajoh u ngai lou ahi.
47.23: Hichun Joseph in mipite lah a ahoulim in, “Veuvin tunia keiman nangho chule nagam leiset'u Pharaoh adia ka chohdoh ahitai keiman nangho muchi kapeh ding nanghon na phailei uva chang na tu theiyu ahitai.
47.24: Chule nangman chang na at teng hop nga lah a hop khat Pharaoh adia napeh ding hopli chu nangma muchi adia na kikoi diu, chule nangma ho insung mite an neh a pang ding aneocha cha ho geija kapeh na hiuve.
47.25: Amahon aphong doh un, “Keima ho hinkho hi nangman neihuh doh peh'u ahi atiuve, chule nangma phatsah bang hi jeng hen; chule lungset tah in ka pakai pa Pharaoh soh in pangmai jeng tau vinge atiuvin ahi.”
47.26: Chule Joseph in dan asem in Egypt gam'a tuni geihin aki mang na laiye, hichu ahile Pharaoh in hop nga lah a hopkhat ane jing na laiyin, thempu ho a tilou chu gam leiset abona Pharaoh a ahi tai.
47.27: Hichun phat chomkhat jouvin, Israel mipite chun Egypt gamsunga Goshem lhanglam chu alodim tauvin, hichea pat chun amahon nei le gou akilamdoh un, abol jouse'u jong nasatah in apung tul tul jengun ahi.
47.28: Hichun Jacob chu Egypt ahung lhun jouvin kum som le kum sagi ahinbe in Jacob hin nikho abon bon'a kum jakhat le kum som li le kum sagi alhing in ahi.
47.29: Israel chu athi tei ding nikho ahung nai tul tul phat in aman jong achapa Joseph akouvin ajah a “Na mit mua nangma ka lung lhaisah jouva ahile gunchu tah le kitah tah a nei bolna dingin kataipi gui noi tuhin lang Egypt gam'a neihin vuilou hel na dingin kitep in;
47.30: Keima ka hinkho ahung beiteng lungset tah in ka tahsa hi Egypt akon in eipo doh inlang kapu kapate kivui na muna neivui in, hichun Joseph jong aki hahsel in, “Keiman nangma seibang bang in hinbol peh nang kate,” ati.
47.31: Hichun Jacob in avel in aseikit in, “Nangma kitep in ati, hichun Joseph akihahsel tan, chuin Jacob chu alupna a abohkhup tan ahi.”

48.1: Thusoh hichengse kichai nung phat chomkhat jouvin, “Napa chu alha suh lheh jeng tai” tia Joseph ahung seipeh uleh; Joseph chu apa kimu pi din achen achate ni Ephraim le Manasseh jong akipuiyin ahi.
48.2: Chuin Jacob chu aseipeh un, “Ven nachapa Joseph chu nangma kom ahin jone,” hichun Jacob atha ahung kido in alupna apat in athou doh in atoutai.
48.3: Hichun Jacob in Joseph chu ahoulimpin, “Elohim hatchungnung in Luz muna Canaan gam'a eiki mupi chun phatthei eiboh e ati.
48.4: Aman kakom a anaseiyin, “Ven nangma ka Chiphat sah ding chule kapun sah ding chu jong le nangma chilhah tamtah'a kasem doh ding nahi; nachi lhah techu Canaan gam hi amaho nei le goudia atonsot a kapeh ding ahitai” tin eihou limpi'e.
48.5: Keima hung lhun masanga Egypt gamsunga nacha teni Manasseh le Ephraim hi keima a hiding ahi; Reuben le Simeon keija ahitobang hi amani jong hi keiya ahi lhon'e.
48.6: Hinlah chapang naosen tu khonunga peng ho vang nangma a hiding ahitai; chule amaho se chu asopi ho goulo min lah aki simtha ding ahi lhon e.
48.7: Phatkhat lai chun keima Padan- aram lama kahung kinunglen Rachel chu Canaan gam'a athipa tan keima ho Ephrathah toh kikah gamla thim lheh nalaiyin lung kham tah in Rachel chu Ephratha Jerusalem lampi noiya kahin vuitai.”
48.8: Hichun Jacob in chapang teni chu aven adong kit in “hiche chapang teni hi nangma chate ham ati.”
48.9: Joseph in adonbut in adih e ati, “hiche chate ni hi Elohimin hiche Egypt gamsunga eipeh ahi.” Jacob in adonbut in “Amani chu keima koma hinpui nai uvin phatthei kaboh ding ahi.”
48.10: Jacob chu akum atam phat in amittha jong alhasam lheh jeng tai, Ajeh chu aha muchen joutapoi; hichun Joseph in achateni chu apa kom Jacob naideu in ahin pui in chuin apan amani chu achop in akoiyin ahi.
48.11: Israel in Joseph koma aseiyin, “Keiman nangma maichang mu kitdinga hi kana kigin chat lou ahitai, ahin tuhin Elohimin na chate ni jong eimusah tai,” ati.
48.12: Hichun Joseph in achateni chu apa Israel khup akon in akhin doh in amai tolang angan abohkhup tai.
48.13: Joseph chun achate ni chu ani tah lhon in akaiyin, Ephraim chu akhut jet lam in Israel khut veilama chun akai lutpeh-in, chule Manasseh chu Israel khut jetlam a, akhut veilam in akai lut in anilhon chun amapa henga apuiluttai.
48.14: Ahin Israel in Ephraim chu aneojo ahivangin akhut jetlam chu achunga angamtan, chule Manasseh chu apeng masa ahivang in Israel in akhut veilam chu Manasseh chunga angam tan ahi.
48.15: Hichun Jacob in Joseph phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Ka Elohim kapu Abraham kapa Isaac masanga lamkai jingpa ka Yaweh kelngoi chinga hung pang jing ka hinkho pumpi tuni geiya eipui hoipa;
48.16: Thil gilou tin chenga konna eina lhatdoh jing vantil chun chapang teni hi phatthei hin boh hen; chule amani chunga hin keima min le kapu Abraham min, kapa Isaac min hung kihedoh jing jeng hen; chujong le amani hi leiset vaipi jalah a mipi atama tam in hung pung lhon hen,” ati.
48.17: Ahin Joseph chu alunglhai molheh jeng in apa Isaac in akhut jetlam Ephraim chunga angap jeh chun, ahin Joseph in apa khut chu atuh in ajetlam chu Manasseh chunga angap sah in akhut veilam chu Ephraim chunga angap sah tai.
48.18: “Hepa ahipoi ati amapa joh hi apeng masa ahi bouve, nangma khut jetlam chu Manasseh chung joh ahin ngamtan,” ati.
48.19: Amavang apa Israel anom poi, ka hethem nai chapa keiman Manasseh jong ama chilhah te jong hunglen diu mitamtah hiding ahin anaopa amasanga hung nasa joding ahi, chule ama chilhah ho chu nam tamtah hung hiding ahibouve.
48.20: Hichun Israel in chapang teni chu phatthei aboh in hiche ni chun ama a konna phatthei jouse aboltai; nangma min a Israel in hiche phatthei hi naboh ding ahi, Pa Elohimin nangma hi Ephraim le Manasseh bang in pung jing tahen.
48.21: Hichun Jacob in Joseph koma aseitai, “Ven keima kathi na ding anaitai, ahin Elohimin phatthei naboh ding, chule Canaan a napu na pate gam'a nanung puikit ding ahi.
48.22: Na sopite ho kapeh sanga nang ma lentah gam kapeh be ding nahi; chule leiset gam Amorite mite khut a konna kachoh dohsa Shechem molbih khat kapei atin ahi.

49.1: Hichun Jacob in achate jouse akou khom in hitin aseiye, “Keima naivel a hung kikhom un, chule keiman nangho thuguh kasei peh ding nahiuve, khonunga ipi hung lhung ding ham naseipeh uvinge,” ati.
49.2: Hungun chule ngaijun, nangho Jacob chate ho napao Israel thusei ngai jun,
49.3: Reuben kachapa atahpen katha hat pen laiya kanei, ka khanghoi lai tah a kahin chule nangma amasa penna jana chang chule nangma amasa pena thahat chang nahi.
49.4: Nangma twi kimang banga phatna najou tapoi, ajeh chu napa lupna jalkhun nasuboh tai.
49.5: Simeon le Levi sopi khat ahilhone, chule aman chah lhon ho chu galsat na ding bou ahi.
49.6: Keima lhagao vang amaho lah a jaoda mai hen, chule amaho natoh gon jong jahda ding kanome; ahin amaho alunghan teng ule mihem hinkho ahin suhbei dingu ahi, chule amaho deilah a bongchal ho ahin hellhuh diu ahi.
49.7: Jacob chate ho lah a kahop khen ding keiman Israel sunga amaho chu kathe cheh ding ahitai, alunghan nau sapset ahitai, ajeh chu tijat umtah, alunghan nao jong phalou tah ahi.
49.8: Judah nangma nasopi houvin nathang at ui, nangma namel mate angonga na matchah ding, nasopi ho jouse nangma masanga kun cheh diu ahi.
49.9: Judah ka chapa hi keipi nou tobang ama chu aneh jou tobang pet ahi, keipi bangin akitaulei, chule keipi nou konba anodoh jou ding gam.
49.10: Hiche tenggol chu Judah a konna potdoh lou ding ahi, chule dan thempu a konna akeng teni kikah ajong pot doh lou ding Shiloh ahung lhun to kahsea anam miten athu angai jing dingu ahi.
49.11: Aman a sangan chu lengpi thei phunga ahen in chule sangan nou chu abah hoipen lengpi bah a ahenin, chule apon ho chu lengpi twiya asop in chule ama von ho chu lengpi twiya asop ngime.
49.12: Amit teni chu lengpi twi sangin asangjon chule ahatu jouse chu bongnoi twi bang phet phut ding ahi.
49.13: Zebulun chu twi-khanglen panga cheng ding ahi, chule ama koma chu kongho kinga ding chule agamgi chu Sidon geiya cheng diu ahi.
49.14: Issachar vang chu ahile sangan hattah ahi, ama chu hahsat na molni kikah aum ahi.
49.15: Aman ngahmun khat amudoh in, chule agam nop dan jong chu dei chat um ahi; hijeh chun aman thilpo ding in alengkou adon, namphu in soh dingin akipelut tai.
49.16: Israel phungdang ho bang a Dan in amite chung a vai ahin hop ding ahi.
49.17: Dan chu lampi lhanglang a gul tobang ahi, chule lampi a gulse kijam tobang ahin, ama chun sakol keng achuh le achunga toupa akinung le lhah tai.
49.18: Keiman nangma katahsane huhhingna kachan thei na din o ka Yaweh.
49.19: Mipihon Gad chunga lam ajot diu ahin achaina aman amaho chunga lam ahin jot ding ahi.
49.20: Asher chu an neh neng ding ahiye, chule aman lengho neh thei ding hoitah le twitah a ahon thei ding ahi.
49.21: Napthali chu sajuh pi kihen lou tobang ahin, aman thu ngei tah a pao doh ding ahi.
49.22: Joseph hi lengpi thingga phatah tobang ahi, chule twinah phung thingbah ga phatah ahi, abah hon jong bang akhokhel gamtai.
49.23: Thalpi kapthem hon avetda lheh un, amapa akap un chule abol genthei lheh jeng uve.
49.24: Ahin amapa thalpi alhou lheh in suhset bun aum poi. Chule Kelngoi chingpa, Israelte songpi, Jacob Elohim thahatna chun abanthahat na jong akipeh ben ahi.
49.25: Chule na panpi Elohimin na kithopi jeh in hatchung nung pen phatthei naboh mai hen, chujong leh van chunga phattheina tin changmai jin, chule leithol noilanga twi dim bangin phatthei na chang jing in, chule noitwi akon, naobu akon phatthei na jouse chang tan.
49.26: Napan phatthei na bohna ho chu masanga napute phatthei na ho sangin phatthei joh hi maihen, chule molsang pen ho sangin sangpen main. Hiche phatthei na ho jouse hi Joseph chunga umjing tahen, ajeh chu amahi asopite lah a dinga leng cha ahi.
49.27: Benjamin chu Sial tobang ahi, ajeh chu jingkah lam le amelmate chu aval lhum jin nilhah lam teng alotup ho chu ahomkhen jenge.
49.28: Amaho se hi Israel phungsom le phungni ahiuve, hiche thucheng ho hi apan asei peh'u ahi; amaho jouse chu phatthei aboh in chule ki lhahna thu cheng aneiyin, chule amaho jouse khat khat in ama hina cheh in phatthei aboh cheh in ahi.
49.29: Hichun Jacob in hitin ahil e, amaho se chu keima hi thivah ding kahitai, chule kapute kapate ho lah a jaovah ding kahitai, Ephron Hite gam'a kapute kapate kivui na muna chu kei jong neivui un ati.
49.30: Abraham'in hiche songlhan chu Machpelah loumun Mamre nisolam Canaan gamsunga um ahin, ama lhan mun dinga Hite mipa Ephron henga loumun ana choh doh ahi.
49.31: Hiche muna chun Abraham le Sarah akivui lhon in, chule hiche mun chu Isaac le aloinu Rabekah jong aki vuijin chule keiman jong hilai mun a chu Leah kana vui ahi.
49.32: Hiche gam chu phaicham kotong lam chu kapu Abraham'in Hite mipa koma ana choh doh ahi.
49.33: Hichun Jacob chu achapate athu lhah chai in jalkhun chunga akeng teni asep doh in ama ahaitan tai, chuin ama amite to akivui tha tai.

50.1: Hichun Joseph apa mai senan akineiyin apa chunga kap pum in akoi jin achop in ahi.
50.2: Chuin Joseph in asohte louthem ho chu apa longdamsa tom din thu apen, hichun louthem ho chun atom tauvin ahi.
50.3: Hitobanga longdamsa kitom chu nisom li tobang lut jia ahi; chule Egypt miho ama chu nisom sagi alunghem piuvin ahi.
50.4: Hichun lunghem na nikho ho chu ahung kichai tan, Joseph in lengpa Pharaoh insung mite chu ahoulimpin, “Lungset tah in kadei khat neibol peh thei diu ham Pharaoh koma keima khel in neiga sei peh dingu kanom e,” ati.
50.5: Kapa in adamlai in eina kihahsel sah in hitin aseiye, “Keima ka hinkho beivah ding ahitai, hijeh chun keima tahsa hi Canaan gam'a nei nung lhut teiyin ati, chule keima kivui na dia lhan ka kisem na muna nei vui tei ding ahi ati. Hijeh chun lungset tah in neisol inlang kapa ga kivui ingting kin kivuina akichai teng tep son louva kahung kinungle ding ahi tai.
50.6: Chuin Pharaoh in adonbut in, “Napan nangma na kitep sah na bang in gachen lang napa chu gaki vuitan,” ati.
50.7: Hichun Joseph chu apa Israel vui din achetan ahile Pharaoh in alhon piding in Egypt gamsunga alen alal ho ahin asohte ahin, asemang pachong ho jouse toh asol than ahi.
50.8: Joseph in a insung mite ahin asopite ahinpui in chule chapang neocha hole gancha hole kelcha ho ahin, sangan hole bongho le adang hose vang Goshem a ahin dalhau vin ahi.
50.9: Chuin amaho jouse toh sakol kangtalai toh sakol chunga atou un Joseph chu alhon piuvin ahi.
50.10: Hichun amaho Jordan vadunga Atad chang vohna mun ahung lhun un amaho gimna tah in a lunghem na aneiyun lhase tah in aum un Joseph in jong nisa gi jen lunghem tah in aum in ahi.
50.11: Chuin hiche a cheng Canaan gam miten Atad chang voh na muna amaho lunghem tah a aumu chu amu uvin, hichun amahon hitin asei uve, “Tuhi Egypt mite dinga nasa taha lunghem lhaset phat ahin hijeh chun hiche mun chu Abel Mizraim asah tauvin ahi.”
50.12: Hichun Jacob chaten ama in athupeh bang bang in abolpeh'un ahi.
50.13: Ama hon apa longdamsa chu Canaan gam'a apolut tauvin Macphelah kotong phailei a Mamre koma Abraham'in hiche mun chu Ephron Hititte pa koma atonsot a kivui thei na dinga ana choh doh ahitai.
50.14: Aman apa Jacob chu avui jou chun Joseph ahin asopite ho jouse chule midang akilhon pi jouse Egypt gam'a ahung ki nungle tauvin ahi.
50.15: Ahin tua hi amaho apao umtah luo jeh chun Joseph sopi ho chu hatah in ahung tija tauvin, amahon aseiyun, “Joseph chun alunghan na ho eihon ina bolset nau jouse chu ahin phulah ding ahi,” atiuve.
50.16: Hijeh chun amahon hiche thucheng ho hi Joseph hetdin athot tauve, napa athi masang chun hiche thuguh ho eina seipeh uve.
50.17: Joseph henga hiti hin sei peh uvin lang, “Na heng'a ka tao ahi, na sopiten na chunga thil gilou abol uva suhkhel anei nau chu ngaidam in,” ‘tin aseiye tiuvin,’ ati. Hijeh chun keiho na henga katao vui, na hingpa napa Elohim sohte suhkhel na chu ngaidam tan atiuve; ajah a athusei jeh-u chun Joseph akap tai.
50.18: Hichun asopi ho ahung un ama masanga akun un hitin aseiyun, “keima ho hi nangma soh kahiuve.”
50.19: Ahin Joseph in amaho chu a houlimpi in, “Nangho tija hih un, keima Elohim khel a ka hipoi?”
50.20: Nanghon thil phalou nana gong un ahin Elohimin aphalam tah in ahin gong in tu tua mutheiya um mihem tamtah hinkho huhhing'a um thei ahi.
50.21: Hijeh chun nangho kicha hih un, nangho ahin nachate hou ahin, ka ngailut na kajom jing ding ahi, chule Joseph in avel in angailut avetsah in thu ngeitah in ama ho chu ahoulim pin ahi.
50.22: Joseph ahin asopite ho jouse Egypt ma acheng soh keiyin, Joseph chu atahsa kum ja khat le kum som alhing tan ahi.
50.23: Chuin Joseph in khang thum chan na geiya Ephraim chilhah ho jong amun chu jong leh Joseph thagui a peng Manasseh chapa Machir chate jong ana mupeh in ahi.
50.24: Chuin Joseph in asopite jah a, “Keivang kathina ding anai lam tan, ahivang in Elohimin nangho nahungvil tei yun tin, hiche gam a kon hin Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga anaki hahsel nagama dingin nahin puitou vunte,” ati.
