50.25: Hichun Joseph in Israel chate chu aki tepsah in chuin aman hitin aseiye, “Elohimin nahin kithopiuva hiche muna konna nahung pui teng ule hiche muna konna kagu kachang ho hi na nungpoh teitei diu ahi,” ati.
50.26: Hichun Joseph kum jakhat le kum som ahin ahinkho abeitai. Hichun Egypt miten Joseph long damsa chu atom un athi kong chu Egypt gam sunga thingkong sunga akoi tauve.

1.1: Israel mite (hichu, Jacob chapate), ama insung mi cheh hin kipuija Egypt gam-sung'a apau toh kitollut ho min chu hicheng hi ahiuve:
1.2: Reuben, simeon, Levi, Judah.
1.3: Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin
1.4: Dan, Naphtali, Gad chule Asher amaho cheng hi ahiuve.
1.5: Abonchauvin, Egypt gamsung'a Jacob chilhah chengse chu som sagi alhing'un chule Joseph vang agamsung'a ana um jingsa ahitai.
1.6: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Joseph le asopi chengse athigam tauvin, hiche khang mite se chu akichai tan ahi.
1.7: Ahinlah ason achilhah teu, Israel chate chun tu le cha tampi anei tauvin apung lheh jeng un, ahung hatdoh cheh cheh un gamsung pumpi ahin lodim tauve.
1.8: Egypt gamsunga chun Joseph chung chang thule ana toh ho hephalou leng thah khat thaneina ahung chang tan ahi.
1.9: Amapa chun amite henga thu aseijin, “Vetem'un! Israel mite hi eiho sang'in apung'un chule eiho sang'in ahat lheh jeng tauve.
1.10: Amaho hi apunbe lou na diuvin, tohgon khat nei tauhite. Achuti louva ahile hung hatdoh untin, chule gal hung um taleh, imelma teu ahin panpi diu eihin dou'uva gamsunga kon'a jamdoh ding ahiuve,” ati.
1.11: Hijeh chun Egypt miten Isarel chate jouse soh in amangcha tauvin, achung'uva toh vaipo mikhanse tah tah ho apan sah un, chutobang bolgim na soh natoh akon'a chu suhnem ding akinem'un, namphu chang'in lengpa thilkhol na ding Pithom leh Rameses khopi chu asah sah uvin ahi.
1.12: Ahinlah Egypt mite'n amaho asuhgim chan'un apungbe uvin akithejal cheh jo tauvin ahi, Egypt mite chu kichat nan aum jo tauvin ahi.
1.13: Chutah chun Egypt miten Israel mite chu ngailut na beihel'in thohgim hahsa athohsah uvin na atohsah un ahi.
1.14: Aki manchah na jouse uva gimna alhun sah un, bon ngan achilsah un, leilhang asemsah un, loujaova natoh jouse atohsah un, atoh nalam jouseuva gimbolna achansah tauvin ahi.
1.15: Chuin Pharaoh, Egypt lengpan Hebrew mi nao dom teni Shiphrah leh Puah henga hiche thupeh hi aneiyin:
1.16: “Hebrew numei hon nao anei uva nao dom'a napan teng lhon le, hichu phatah in vechil lhon in lang, naosen chu pasal ahileh natha lhon ding; numei ahile vang na hinghoi lhon ding ahi,” ati.
1.17: Ama vang nao dom teni chun Pathen agin lhon jeh chun, lengpa thupeh chu anahsah lhon tapon, naosen pasal'a hungpeng lha ho jong chu ahinghoi lhon tan ahi.
1.18: Chu in lengpan nao dom teni chu aheng'a akouvin, “Ipi jeh a hiche hi nabol lhon hitam?” tin adong'in, chule “Ipi jeh a naosen pasal ho chu, nahinghoi lhon ham?” tin ajah lhon'a aseiyin ahi.
1.19: Naodom tenin adonbut in “Hebrew numei ho hi Egypt numei hotoh abang pouve, amaho hi athoh hat un aheng'u akilhun masang'in amaho le ama ho beilam tah in ana ki doplhah jitauvin aphatchan kalap ji lhonpoi,” tin asei lhon'e.
1.20: Pathen chu naodom teni din aphalheh jeng'in, Israelte chu apungbe cheh cheh tauvin ahile, athanei nau jong ahung hatdoh cheh cheh jeng tan ahi.
1.21: Naodom teni in Pathen agin lhon jeh chun, Pathenin amani chu ama a ama a ding cheh insung asem dohpeh lhon'in ahi.
1.22: Chuin Pharaoh in amite jouse hiche thupeh hi aneiyin: “Hebrew naosen'a penglha pasal kiti phot chu Nile Vadung lam'a na pailhah jeng diu, ahin lah numeiya hung peng chengse vang chu hing hoiyun,” ati.

2.1: Hiche phatlai hin, Levi insung'a kon pasal khat leh Levi insungmi numei khat ma aki cheng lhon tan ahi.
2.2: Numeinu chu ahung gaijin chapa khat ahing tai. Amanun achapa chu aven ahile lunglhai umtah naosen ahin, lhathum sung'in asel tan ahi.
2.3: Ahivang'in amanun achapa chu asel joulou phat in, sinkhup Pyparus naang'a kisa khat agalan twilut na lou ding'in avonglai jouse ahubit sohkeiye. Chuin sinkhup sung'a naocha chu akhum'in Nile Vadung pang phaipheng lah achun alha lut tai.
2.4: Chuin naosen a unu jong gamlha thim'a kon'in ading'in naosen chu i-atidem tin agalvet in ahi.
2.5: Chu jouvin Pharaoh chanu vadung'a kisil ding'in ahung suh tan, asot tolle hojong vadung pang achun avah le uvin ahi. Chuin amanun phaipheng phung lah a sinkhup chu ahin mudoh tan, aga la din asoh nu chu asol tan ahi.
2.6: Lengpa chanun jong sinkhup chu ahongdoh in ahile, naocha chu amu in ahi. Chu-in naocha chu akap'in, amanun jong naocha chu avoujang natpi lheh in, “Hiche hi Hebrew mite cha khat hitei ding ahi,” ati.
2.7: Hichun naosen sopinun jong Lengpa chanu heng ahin naijin. “Keima kache a Hebrew numei khat naosen don ding kagahol peh ding ham?” tin adong'e.
2.8: Lengpa chanu in jong, “Henge, gapui jin!” tin adonbut in, numeinu jong ache-in naosen hingnu mama chu aga puiye.
2.9: Chuin lengpa chanu'n jong naosen hingnu jah'a aseijin. “Naosen hi lanlang neidon peh'in, Keiman na don man ka peh ding nahi,” ati. Chuin numeinu in jong naosen chu a-inlam'a adom'in amapa chu adon tan ahi.
2.10: Khonung'in, chapang pa jong akhang len tan ahile, anu in amapa chu Pharaoh chanu henga ahung thahkit tan, achapa mong mong ding a Lengpa chanu in amapa chu amin Mose asah tai, ajeh chu amanun aseijin, “keiman amapa hi twi lah a kon kaloidoh ahi,” ati.
2.11: Kum phabep ache nung in, Mose jong ahung khang lentan, amapa jong asopiho vil din ache toutan, aman jong asopi Hebrew mite hunam'a na atohsah nau aga mudoh tai. Agavil pet chun, Egypt mikhat in asopi Hebrew mikhat chung'a akhut alha chu amu paijin ahi.
2.12: Akimvel avet a koima eive poi ti aphot chen phat in, Mose'n Egypt mipa chu athat in neldi lah a asel tan ahi.
2.13: Ajing nikho in, asopi ho vildin Mose apot doh kit tan ahile, Hebrew mini akinah lhon aga amun ahi. “Ipi jeh a na golpa navoh ham?” tin kinah hin panpa heng'a chun Mose'n aseiye.
2.14: Amapan adonbut in, “Koiham nangma keiho chunga leng'a na pansah le thutan ding'a thaneina nape? Janhi a Egypt mipa natha banga chu keima jong tha ding neigot ham?” tin aseiyin ahileh, Mose jong akichan “Ka thil bol mijousen ahetai.” tin angai ton ahi.”
2.15: Mose thilbol chu Pharaoh in ahin jadoh tahbeh tan, chuin amapan Mose chu tha ding ago tan ahi. Ahivang'in Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon'in ajam'in Median gamsung'a chengdin ache tai. Median alhun chun Mose jong twikul pang'a atou tan ahi.
2.16: Tun Median thempupa chun chanu sagi aneiyin amaho chengse chu apau ganchahon ho ding'in twi kongho chu athal ngai bang'un ahung thal dim'un ahi.
2.17: Ahinlah kelngoi ching midang phabep ahung'uvin amaho chu anodoh un ahi. Hichun Mose jong achomdoh jeng'in kelngoi ching hoa kon chun numei chapang ho chu ahuhdoh tan ahi. Chuin amapan amaho ganchate a ding twi chu athal peh tan ahi.
2.18: Numei chapang ho chu apau Reuel heng ale lhun uchun, amapan adong un, “Ipi jeh-a tuni nahung kimale uham?” ati'in ahile,
2.19: amahon jong adonbut uvin, “Egypt mi khat in kelngoi ching hoa kon'a eihuhdoh uva, chule amapa chun keiho ding le igancha hon houva ding twi eithal peh jeh'u ahi,” atiuve.
2.20: “Ahile amapa hoiba ham?” tin apauvin adong'in, “ipi ding'a amapa chu chukom'a chu nahin dalhah uham? Ahung'a ankong isokhom diuvin gakouvun,” ati.
2.21: Mose'n jong akounau chu asanpeh in, lengpa toh chun hiva chun acheng khom tan ahi. Hiche phatlai chun, Reuel in achanu Zipporah chu Mose ji ding in ape tan ahi.
2.22: Phat chomkhat jouvin, amanun chapa khat ahing'in, Mose'n Gershom asah tai “Ajeh chu keima hi gamchom beh'a khopem kahi,” tina ahi.
2.23: Kum phabep ache nung in, Egypt lengpa athitan ahi. Hinlah Israelte chu soh kihen ohna noiya pohgih poa khoisa jing nalai ahiuve. Panpi ngaiyin akap un, aka awgin'u chu Pathen angsung alhung tan ahi.
2.24: Akhoisat nau Pathenin aja tan, chuin Abraham, Isaac leh Jacob heng'a akitepna ahin geldoh tan ahi.
2.25: Aman Israel mite chu avesuh in, chuin tunvang toh phat ahitai ti chu ahe tan ahi.

3.1: Mosen nikhat anupa pa Midian thempu pa Jethro kelngoi achin laijin. Kelngoi hon chu gamlha tah gamthip lam'a apuiyin, Pathen molsang, Sinai mol lam'a chun ahung tan ahi.
3.2: Hiche laimun'a chun Pathen vantil meikong in hamboh lah'a ahung kilah in, Mose in lungdong tah in aven ahi. Hamboh chu akong jeng in hinlah akavam deh pon ahi.
3.3: Chuin Mose ama leh ama aki houlim in, “Hiche hi datmah umtah thil ahiye, ipijeh pentah a hiche hamboh khu kavam lou ahidem? kache a kavet tei angaiye” ati.
3.4: Hichu ve dinga Mose in hilam chu anailut jep jep e ti Pakaiyin amuphat'in, Pathenin hamboh lailung akon in, “Mose! Mose!” tin akouvin ahile, Mose in jong a donbut in “Keima hiva ka um'e,” ati.
3.5: “Hin nailut hihbeh in” tin Pakaiyin agih tan ahi. “Nakeng chot kisut in, ajeh chu nang ma muntheng'a ding nahi.
3.6: Keima napa dinga a-Pathen kahi - Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, leh Jacob Pathen kahi”, ati. Hichu Mose in ajah phat in amai akhutai, ajeh chu Pathen avet ngamlou ahi.
3.7: Chuphat in Pakaiyin ahenga aseijin, “Egypt a kamite kibol gimna ka muchen tai. Achung'uva tohvai hom hon asuh gimnau aka awgin'u kaja tan ahi. Heng'e, a thohgim nau abonchan ka hechen tai, ati.
3.8: Hijeh a chu Egypt mite thannei nanoiya kon'a amaho huhdoh ding le Egypt gam'a kon'a gampha tah, khoiju le bongnoi lon na gam hichu - Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite Chule Jebus mite tua achenna'u gam'a puilut dinga Keima hikoma hung kumlha kahi, ati.
3.9: Vetan! Israel chate ka awgin ka angsung ahung lhung tai, chule Egypt miten asuh gimnau kichen tah in kamutai.
3.10: Tun che jengin, ajeh chu Keiman nanghi Pharaoh henga kasol nahiye. Kami Israelte Egypt gam'a konna nahin puidoh ding ahi,” ati.
3.11: Hinlah Mose Pathen heng'ah akiphin in, “Kei koi kahia Pharaoh henga kaga kilah ding ham? Kei koi ka hia Israelte Egypt gam'a kon'a ka hin puidoh ding ham?” ati.
3.12: Pathenin adonbut in, “Keiman ka umpi jing ding nahiye. Keiman kasol nahina nangma dinga melchihna hiche hi ahi: Nangman miho chu Egypt gam'a kon'a nahin puidoh teng leh, hiche mol tah a hi Pathen na hou ding'u ahi,” ati.
3.13: Ahivang'in Mose akiphin'in, “Keima Israel chate henga kachea ajah uva, ‘Napu napateu Pathenin na heng uva eihinsol ahi,’ tin sei leng ‘Amin ipi ham?’ tia eidoh diu ahi, chuteng amaho chu iti ka donbut ding ham?,” ati.
3.14: Pathenin Mose a donbut in, “Keima hi Keima ka hi jeng'e. Hiche hi Israelte heng'a seipeh in: Keima chun na heng'uva eihinsol ahi,” tin ati.
3.15: Pathenin jong Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Hiche hi Israelte heng'a seipeh in: Yahweh, napu napateu Pathen - Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathenin - naheng uva eihin sol ahi. Hiche hi ka tonsot min ahi, akhang akhang'a nageldoh jing diu kamin ahi.
3.16: “Tun chenlang Israel sung'a upa ho gakou khom tan. Aheng'uva seipeh in 'Yahweh, napu napauteu Pathen - Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob Pathen - kahenga akilah in ahi. Aman kajah-a aseiyin, “Keiman naichan kanave jing'un, chule Egypt miten na-engbol nau keiman kamui.
3.17: Keiman nangho Egypt a nagenthei thoh nauva kon'a huh doh ding'a kakitep ahi. Keiman khoiju leh bongnoi lon na gam'a chu kapuilut ding nahiuve - hichu Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite Chule Jebus mite tua achen nau gam khu ahi,” ati.
3.18: “Israel upa hon nathusei angai diu ahi. Chuteng nang leh Israel upa chengse Egypt lengpa heng'a nache tei uva, ‘Yaweh, Hebrew mite Pathen chun, eikimupi uve. Hijeh chun lungset tah in nithum sung'a gamthip lam'a kakhol jin uva Yaweh ka Pathen'u henga kilhaina kasem dingu ahi” tia aheng'a nagasei diu ahi.
3.19: “Amavang Egypt lengpa chu khut thahat in ano kahse a nahin soldoh lou diu keiman kahei,” ati.
3.20: “Hijeh a chu Keiman kakhut ka lhan a, chule Egypt mite kajep ding, alah uva thil kidang jouse kabol ding ahi. Ajona le Aman nahin soldoh ding'u ahi.
3.21: Chule keiman Egypt mite mitvet a khotona ka hin chan sah ding na hiuve. Ama hon thilpeh na hin peh dingu chuteng khut goh keova na dalhah lou diu ahiye.
3.22: Israel numei jousen akinaipiu Egypt mite leh a in'uva um gamchom numei ho hokom'a sana leh dangka chule ponsil akithum cheh ding'u ahi. Na chanu teu leh na chapa teu hiche ho chu navon peh dingu, Egypt mite haosatna jouse na holhah peh dingu ahi,” ati.

4.1: Hinlah Mose avel'in akiphin kit in, “Eitahsan lel-u henlang kathusei ngai hih uleh iti tantem? 'Nangma heng'a Yaweh akilah kha him him poi' tiu leh iti tantem?”
4.2: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah a, “Nakhut a nachoi chu ipi ham?” tia adoh le, Mosen a donbut in “Tenggol ahi,” ati.
4.3: Pakaiyin ajah a, “Tol'ah seplhan,” ati. Hichun Mosen tenggol chu tol'ah asep lhan, chuin gul ahung kisoh tan! Mose anung chop jeng'in ahi.
4.4: Chuin Pakaiyin aheng'a, “nakhut lhangdoh in lang ameiyin man tem'in” ati. Hichun Mosen akhut alhangdoh in aman in ahile, akhut ah kelngoi chinna tenggol ahung kinung soh doh kit tan ahi.
4.5: Pakaiyin ajah-a, “Hiche melchih nahi nabol ding ahi. Chuteng apu apateu Pathen - Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chuleh Jacob Pathen chu nangma heng'ah akilah mong'e ti ahin tahsan dingu ahi,” ati.
4.6: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'ah, “Tunna khut chu na pon ah sung nadip a koiyin,” atile, Mose'n jong akhut chu apon ah sung adip a akoiyin, akhut chu alah doh kit a ahile, akhut chu avun aphah in buhbang bangin abang jeng'in ahi.
4.7: Pakaiyin, “Tun nakhut chu napon ah sung nadip'a avel'in koikit tem in,” atin ahi. Hijeh chun Mose in jong akhut chu anung koilut kit in, chuin ala doh kit in ahile atidang bang'in atahsa adamsel tan ahi.
4.8: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “ijem tia nangma natahsan lou uva chule melchih na masapen jeng'a jong atahsan theilou uva ahile, melchina anichanna a atahsan diu ahi tai.
4.9: Chule hiche melchih na teni jeng'a jong atahsan thei lou'uva ahile, Nile Vadunga kon in twi themkhat la in lang tolgo laiya sung lhan. Hichu nabol teng, Nile Vadung twi chu tolgo laiya thisan kisoh ding ahi,” ati.
4.10: Ahin Mose Yaweh heng'a ataovin, “O Yaweh, keima thusei them kahipoi. Achesa phat hihen, chule tujeng in jong, kahenga thu nasei nung hijong leh, ka lei a-oh jin, chule kathusei a-ngongkai jie,” ati.
4.11: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose adong paijin, “Koiham mihem kam sem? Koi ham mihem apaothei ahilou leh apaomo, kho jathei ahilou leh ana ngong, kho muthei ahilou leh micho umsah nadia gellhuh na sem ji? Hichu Keima, na Yaweh kahi hilou ham?
4.12: Tun chen! napao doh na chan'a Ka umpi ding, chule na thusei na chan'a Keiman kalamhil ding nahi,” ati.
4.13: Ahinlah Mose avel in Yaweh heng'a ataovin, “Yaweh, lungset tah in! midang khattou sol tan,” ati.
4.14: Chuin Yaweh Mose chung'a alung hang tan, “Aphai,” ati. “Na sopipa Levi mi Aaron um'a hilou ham? Aman lei kileh pel'in thu aseitheiye ti keiman kahei. Chule vetan! Tun nang toh kimuto ding in ahung tai. Nang toh kimu ding lung thanop na'a dim ahi,” ati.
4.15: Ama chu houlim pin lang, thuho hi akamsung'a mop in. Keiman napao doh na chan lhon'a ka umpi ding, na ni lhon'a nathilbol nachan lhon'a nalamhil lhon nang'e, ati.
4.16: “Aaron hi nangma ding'a miho lah a thuseija pang ding ahi. Nangma ding'a nakam sung'a pang ding chule ama ding'a nangma hi Pathen khel'a na din ding, aman ipi asei ding nahil ding ahi,” ati.
4.17: Na kelngoi tenggol hi kichoiyin lang, melchih na bol ding'a ka thumop chengse bol nading'in mang chan,” ati.
4.18: Hijeh chun Mose in lam anu-pa-pa Jethro heng lam'a akile tan ahi. “Lungset tah in kasopi ho heng lam Egypt gam'a kile tange,” tin Mosen aseiyin, “Hing nalaiyu hinauvam tijong hepha lou kahi,” ati in ahile, Jethro in “lungmong in chen,” tin adonbut in ahi.
4.19: Mose in Median adalhah masang'in Pakaiyin aheng'a aseiyin, “Egypt a kile tan, ijeh-inem itileh nangma nathat nom ho abonchauvin athi gam tauve,” ati.
4.20: Hijeh chun Mose in ajinu leh achate akipuiyin, sangan chunga atousah in, chuin Egypt gam'a akile tauvin ahi. Akhut a Pathen tenggol chu achoiyin ahi.
4.21: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Egypt gamsung nalelhun teng, Pharaoh henga chen lang keiman bol ding'a thuneina kapeh bang'in thil kidang ho jouse abonchan gabol'in, ati. Ahinlah Keiman alungthim kasuh tah ding chuteng miho chedoh ding aphal lou ding ahi.”
4.22: “Chuteng nangman aheng'a nasei ding, “Hiche hi Yaweh thusei ahiye: Israel hi keima chapa peng masapen ahi.”
4.23: Keiman thu kapeh nahi, “Ka chapa soldoh tan, chuti leh aman keima eihou thei ding ahi.”'Ahivanga nangman nah sah louva na koi jeh in, tua hi keiman nang chapa amasapen katha ding ahi tai!”' ati.
4.24: Egypt gam ajot laiyun Mose leh a insung mite jan geh din ngahmun khat'a akinga tauvin, Pakaiyin amapa chu akimaitopin, amapa chu atha pai ding ahitai.
4.25: Amavang Mose jinu Zipporah, in songiel chem alan achapa chep atan peh in ahi. Amanun chep chu amapa keng atohkhah sah in hiti hin aseiye, “Tua hi nangma hiche thisan jal'a kei dia moulang nahitai,” ati.
4.26: (Amanun “thisan jal'a moulang” tia asei chu chep tan chu aseina ahi.) Chujou chun Pakaiyin amapa chu adalhatai.
4.27: Tun Pakaiyin Aaron henga, “Mose kimupi din Gamthip lam'a khun chedoh in,” ati. Hijeh chun Aaron Pathen molsang lam'a achen Mose aga kimupi in, a angkoiyin ahi.
4.28: Hichun Mose in jong Aaron jah a Pakaiyin sei dinga athupeh jouse ajah a asei peh tan ahi. Chule bol dinga athupeh thil kidang melchih naho chung chang ho chu aseipeh tan ahi.
4.29: Chuin Mose le Aaron Egypt gam ahung kile lhon'in Israel upa jouse abonchan akoukhom lhon tan ahi.
4.30: Aaron in Pakaiyin Mose athumop chengse chu abonchan amaho jah a aseipeh soh keiyin, Chule Mose in melchihna thil kidang hochu aheng uvah abol in avetsah soh kei uve.
4.31: Hichun Israel miten Mose leh Aaron chu Pathenin ahin sol mong ahi ti atahsan tauve. Pakaiyin amaho chung chang agelkhoh in agim hesoh nau amu taiti ajahdoh phat un, abohkhup uvin ahou tauvin ahi.

5.1: Hicheng jouse chu Israel upa hole lamkai chengse heng'a asei peh chai lhon phat'in, Pharaoh heng'a Mose le Aaron achelhon in aga sei lhon tai. “Hiche hi ahi Israelte Yaweh, Pathenin asei chu: gamthip noiya kami Israelten keima jabol naa kut abolna diuvin soltauvin,” tin amapa henga asei lhon tai.
5.2: Pharaoh in ale donbut in, “Hichu hi mong ham? Yaweh kitipa chu koiham? Keiman ipi jeh a ama thu kangaiya Israelte chu kasol doh ding ham? Yaweh kitipa chu keiman kahekha poi, chule keiman Israelte kasol doh lou ding ahi,” ati.
5.3: Ahinlah Aaron leh Mose apang tinten lhon in, “Hebrew mite Pathen chun eikimupi lhon ahi,” tin aphongdoh lhon'e. “Hijeh chun ni thum sung'a gamthip a kache uva Yaweh ka Pathen'u henga kilhaina ka ga sem na diuvin neisol tauvin. Achuti louva ahile, Pakaiyin gamna hise ahinlan sah ding ahilou leh chemjam'a eitha gam diu ahi,” ati lhon'e.
5.4: Pharaoh in a donbut in, “Mose leh Aaron, ipi ding'a mipite ana toh nauva konna alungu nalahmang lhon'a nasuboi lhon ham? Na kitoh kit tauvin!
5.5: Ven, “Gamsung'a namite hi tampi ahiuvin, ahin nangnin amaho hi anatoh nau natansah lhon tai,” ati.
5.6: Hiche nikho mama chun Pharaoh in Egypt mite ding'a soh natong vaipo ho leh Israel lamkai ho chu hiche thupeh hi ape tan ahi:
5.7: “Chehlhang semna ding'in changpol pe tahih un. Ama ama cheh kihol sah tauvin!
5.8: Ahivang'a masang'a na bolsah ngai bang'uva chehlhang nasem sah jat u kibanga nasem sah dingu ahi. Achanvou u lhom jong lhom sah hih un. Athase gam tauve. Hijeh chun amahon, 'cheu hitin I-Pathen'u henga kilhaina gasem tauhite,' tia asap jengu ahi, ati.
5.9: Achung'uva natoh hahsa cheh koibe peh un! A-ulsau lonsah un! Hichun jou thu angaisah lou na diuva ahil dingu ahi!” ati.
5.10: Hichun soh natong vaipo ho leh natong lamkai ho chu acheuvin mipi ho heng'a asei peh tauvin: “Pharaoh in asei hiche hi ahi: Tuapat changpol kapeh talou ding'u nahi.
5.11: Cheuvin lang nangma nangman ga kipoh uvin. Hoilaimun hijongle namu thei chan'un ga kihol tauvin. Ahinlah masanga banga chehlhang atam nathei chan'a na sem doh dingu ahi,” ati.
5.12: Hijeh chun mipi jong Egypt gamtin ah changpol hol nan aki the cheh tauvin ahi.
5.13: Chomkhat jouvin, Egypt natong vaipo hon gah tah in aboljom nalaiyun, “Changpol kapeh laiyuva nasem bang'uva, niseh leh chehlhang nasem doh ding jat u nasuh bulhit tei ding'u ahi” tin ngeh na aneiyuve.
5.14: Chuin Israel natong lamkaiya anganse hou chu ajep uvin, “Ipi ding'a janhia chule tunia jong natoh doh diu jat na toh doh louvu ham? tin ngehna aneiyuvin ahi.
5.15: Chuphat in Israel natong lamkai cheng Pharoah heng'a ache un chule atao uvin, “lungset tah in nasohte hi hitin neibol hih un,” tin athum un ahi.
5.16: “Changpol la eipe pouvin, ahinlah soh vaipo hon angeh nalaiyun “chehlhang sem'un!” tin eivo jing'un, ahinlah hiche hi keiho themmo ahi poi! Nangma mite ho mama ngoh ding ahijoi!” tin asei uve.
5.17: Ahivang'in Pharoah apeng jah jeng'in, “Nangho na thaset u ahi! a thase na hiuve! Hijeh a chu hitia hi naseiyu ahi, 'Cheu hitin chule I-Yawehyu heng'a kilhaina ga toh doh ute natiu ahi.'
5.18: “Tun natong din kileuvin! Nangho changpol na kipe lou diu, ahivang'a chehlhang nasem doh diu jat lhingset a nasem doh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
5.19: “Niseh a chehlhang nasem jat u nakemsuh sah theilou ding'u ahi,” ati jeh u chun Israel natong lamkai hon nasa tah abol gim'a aum'u chu amu tauvin ahi.”
5.20: Pharoah thutanna insung ahin dalhah phat un, pam lang'a amaho ana ngah Mose leh Aaron chu aki mupi uvin ahi.
5.21: Chuin natong lamkai ho chun ajah lhon'ah, “Pakaiyin nachung chang thu lhon tan hen lang gotna nape lhon hen, ijeh inem itileh Pharaoh leh alhacha ho angsung'a nei suh namset u ahi. Nangnin amaho khut a chemjam na koipeh lhon in, neitha gamsah kigot un ahi,” atiuve.
5.22: Chuin Mose Yaweh heng'a akile in akiphin tai, “Ipi ding'a namite chung'a hitobang gimna hi nalhun sah hitam, Yaweh? Ipi ding'a keima nei sol ham?”
5.23: Nangma thalheng'a thusei dinga Pharoah heng kahunga kipat namite chunga akhanse cheh cheh jon ahi. Hinlah nangman amaho huhdoh nadin ima nabol poi!”

6.1: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, “Tua hi keiman Pharoah chung'a ipi ka bol'am namu ding ahi. Aman ka ban thahatna ahin hetdoh teng, aman mipi ho chu ahinsol doh ding ahi. Dih tah a, aman namphu a agamsung dalha dinga ahin soldoh ding'u ahi!”
6.2: Chule Pathenin Mose henga aseiyin, “Keima Yahweh - 'Yaweh' kahi.
6.3: Abraham henga, Isaac henga, chule Jacob henga El-Shaddai - 'Hatchungnung Pathen' - aheng uva ka kilah in ahi, hinlah kamin, Yaweh, ahi ti amaho heng'a kaphong doh poi.
6.4: Chule kholjin miho banga achen nau gam, Canaan gam peh dinga kakitep na keiman amaho toh avel'in namdet na kanei kit in ahi.
6.5: Israel mite, tua Egypt mite soh a pang ho thohgim na kaja nai ti hi naginchat mong thei ahi. Chule amaho toh ka kitepna jong phatah in kahe jing nai.
6.6: “Hijeh chun, Israel mite henga seiyin: 'Keima Yaweh kahi. Egypt gam'a nasoh tan nauva kon'a kahuhdoh ding chule nathoh gimnauva kon'a kalha ong ding nahiuve. Keiman nangho ban thahat tah le thutan'a gimnei tah a kalhatdam ding nahiuve.
6.7: Keima mite nahi mong'uve tia kachu dingu, chule na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi. Chuteng keima hi nangho Yaweh na Pathen'u Egypt gamma nathoh gim nauva kon'a nahin lha ong pau chu kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
6.8: Keiman Abraham, Isaac, chuleh Jacob heng'a kakihahsel na gam'a chu ka puilut ding na hiuve. Nangho goulo ding mong monga kapeh ding nahiuve. Keima Yaweh kahi!'”
6.9: Pakaiyin asei bang'in Mose in jong Israel mite heng'a asei peh in, ahinlah amahon avel'in angainom tapouvin ahi. Ajeh chu amaho asoh channauva aki sugim'u chun alungphatmo sah val tauvin ahi.
6.10: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin,
6.11: “Egypt lengpa Pharaoh heng'a leche in lang, Israel miten nagamsung dalha tauhen tin aheng'a gaseiyin.”
6.12: “Ahinlah Yaweh!” Mose anompon, “Ka miten kathusei eingaipeh tapouvintin. Iti Pharaoh in ka thu ngai mong nante tia kakinep ding ham? Keima mipaomo kahi.”
6.13: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a thu aseiyin Israelte ding leh Egypt lengpa Pharaoh ding'a abol lhonding ho ape lhon'in, Pakaiyin Israelte Egypt akon puidoh ding'in Mose leh Aaron thupeh anei tan ahi.
6.14: Hichengse hi apu apate'u khang chedol'a Israel insung upa ho ahi: Israel insung'a apeng masapen Reuben chapate se chu: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi. Amaho chilhahse hi Reuben insung kon ahitauve.
6.15: Simeon chapate se chu: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Shaul ahiuve. (Shaul hingnu vangchu Canaan numei ahi.) Amaho chilhahse hi Simeon insung kon ahitauve.
6.16: Levi chilhahte se amaho insung minbu dungjuiya achapate chu: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. (Levi chu kum ja le somthum le sagi ana hing'e).
6.17: Gershon chihahte chu Libni leh Shimei ahi lhonne. Anigel lhonin insung khangguiyin akisim lhon tan ahi.
6.18: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi. (Kohath chu kum ja le somthum le thum ana hing'e.)
6.19: Merari chilhahte chu: Mahli leh Mushi ahi lhon'e. Ama ho chengse hi Levi insung chedol minbua amin cheh uchu ahi.
6.20: Amram chun apa sopinu Jochebed chu jin aneiyin, amanun chapa ahin peh in, Aaron leh Mose ahi lhon'e. (Amram chu kum jale somthum le sagi ana hing'e.)
6.21: Izhar chapate chu Korah, Nepheg leh Zicri ahiuve.
6.22: Uzziel chapate chu, Mishael, Elzaphan leh Sithri ahiuve.
6.23: Aaron in Elisheba aki chenpin, amachu Amminadab chanu chule Nahson ding'a asopinu ahi. Amanun chapa ahindoh ho chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahiuve.
6.24: Korah chapate hochu Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph ahiuvin, amaho chilhah hi Korah insung mi ahitauve.
6.25: Aaron chapa Eleazar chun Putiel chanute lah a khat ji in aneiyin, chuin amanun chapa khat ahing'in Phinehas ahi. Amaho chenghi Levi insung'a pu le pate ho insung bahkai dungjuiya chengse chu ahiuve.
6.26: Aaron leh Mose hichelaiya kimin phah teni mama hi ahilhon'e Pakaiyin ajah lhon'a, “Israel mite chu Egypt gamma kon in sepoyte bang'in hin lamkai lhon in,” tia asei chu.
6.27: Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh koma Israel mite Egypt gam'a konna puidoh ding'a thu sei chu, Mose leh Aaron ahi lhon'e.
6.28: Egypt gam'a Pakaiyin Mose ahoulimpi achun,
6.29: Aheng'a aseiyin, “Keima Yaweh kahi! Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh henga seiyin, keiman naheng'a kasei jouse chu.”
6.30: Ahinlah Mose in Yaweh akinel pin, aseiyin, “Hichu ka bolthei lou ding ahi! ajeh chu keima mipaomo kahi! Ipi jeh a Pharaoh in ka thusei angai ding ham?” ati.

7.1: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Hiche hi phatechan ngaiyin. Pharaoh lengpa koma Pathen tobang'a kasem ding nahiye, chule na sopipa, Aaron, hi nang dia themgaova pang ding ahi.
7.2: Kathupeh jouse hi Aaron jah'a sei in lang, Aaron in Pharaoh heng'a Israel mite agamsung'a kon'a asol doh nading'a thu apeh tei ding ahi.
7.3: Ahinlah Keiman Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, chuteng melchihna le thil kidang tampi Egypt gamsung'a kapunsah ding ahi.
7.4: Hiche a jong chu Pharaoh in na thu angai lou lai ding ahi. Keiman Egypt gamsung'a ka khut kahin lhanjah ding. Keiman ka thaneina kon - kamite, Israelte - Egypt gam'a kon thutanna gimnei tah pum'a ka huh doh ding ahiuve.
7.5: Keiman ka khut ban thahat ka hinlhan'a Israelte kahin puidoh teng, Egypt miten Keima hi Yaweh kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai.”
7.6: Chuin Yaweh thupeh bang'in Mose leh Aaron injong abol lhon tan, ahi.
7.7: Pharaoh heng'a ngehna aganei lai lhon chun, Mose kum somget ahitan, chule Aaron chu kum som get leh kum thum ahitai.
7.8: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'ah thu aseiyin,
7.9: “Pharaoh in ngehna ahin nei ding, ‘thil kidang neivetsah lhonin.' hitobang ahin seiteng, Aaron henga seiyin ‘nateng gol chu la in lang Pharaoh masang laiya chun sep lhan, chuteng gul hung kisoh ding ahi.”
7.10: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achelhon in Yaweh thupeh bang'in abol lhon tai. Aaron in tenggol chu Pharaoh le avaipipo teho angsung'a chun asep lhan ahile, gul ahung kisoh tai!
7.11: Hichun Pharaoh in ama miching ho le doithem ho a koukhom in, Egypt gamma mitphel doithem hon jong chuche tobang chu athemguh un abol'un ahi.
7.12: Atenggol'u tol'a a seplha cheh uvin ahile, amahoa jong gul aki sohtai! Ahinlah Aaron tenggol chun amaho tenggolho chu aval lhum soh tai.
7.13: Hicheng nung jeng hin jong Pakaiyin asei masat bang chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiyin, thu ima ngaisah in anei hih laiye.
7.14: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Pharaoh lungchang atah in, chule aman mipiho soldoh ding anom naipoi.
7.15: Hijeh chun jingkah teng Pharaoh vadung lam'a hung suh teng nangma na che ding. Nile vadung pam'a nadin ding, hikoma chu nakimupi ding ahi. Na tenggol gul kisoh chu kichoi teiyin.
7.16: Chuteng akoma hiti hin seiyin, 'Yaweh, Hebrew mite Pathenin nakoma thuseiya eihin sol ahi: “Kamite soldoh tan, chuteng amahon gamthip noiya keima eihou na ding uvin.” Tugeiyin, nangman ama thusei iman na ngaisah poi.
7.17: Hijeh a chu hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi: “Keima Yaweh kahina ka kilah sah ding ahi.” Vetan! Ka khut'a um tenngol hi mang cha'a Nile twi kajep ding, chu teng vadung hi thisan kisoh ding ahi.
7.18: Asung'a Nga jouse thi ding, chule vadung uilhahel ding, Egypt miten Nile vadung'a kon twi adon thei lou hel diu ahitai,” ati.
7.19: Chu jongle Pakaiyin Mose heng ah aseiyin: “Aaron jah a seiyin, 'Na tenggol kimat in lang Egypt gam'a twi jouse chunga na khut jah in lang - vadung jouse, twinah jouse, luikhuh jouse chunga. Twi jouse thisan so sah tan. Egypt gam muntin'a twi jouse, thingtwikong le songkong jouse sunga twi jouse geiya thisan soh ding ahi.'”
7.20: Chuin Mose leh Aaron in jong Yaweh thupeh bang'in abol lhon tan ahi. Pharaoh le athunei vaihomte hon avet laiyun, Aaron in jong a tenggol ajahdoh'in Nile luidung chu ajep jeng tan ahi. Phulou helouvin, Vadung twi apumpin thisan akisoh hel tan ahi.
7.21: Luidunga nga jouse athisoh heltan, chule twi anen behseh phat chun Egypt miten adon thei tapouvin ahi. Egypt gamsung pumpi mun jouse thisan dim ahitai.
7.22: Ahivang'in Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong adoiyu mangchan amahon jong twi thisan asosah uvin ahi. Hijeh chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiye. Pakaiyin asei bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu nahsah in anei hih laiye.
7.23: Pharaoh jong a leng inpi lam'ah akilen, hicheng thilsoh jouse ho chu alungthim'a gel lut kham asa hih laiye.
7.24: Ahin Egypt mite jousen luipang dung alai thuh'un twi akihol le tauvin ahi, ajeh chu amahon Nile luidunga twi chu a donthei tah louvu ahi.
7.25: Pakaiyin Nile luidung ajep kal nisagi alhing tan ahi.

8.1: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Pharaoh heng ah chen lang hiti hin gasei kit tem in, “Hiche hi Yaweh thusei ahi: Kamite soldoh jeng tan, chutileh amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahiye.”
8.2: “Nahsah moa amaho nasol doh louva ahileh, nagam sung pumpia ukeng kahin lansah ding ahi.”
8.3: “Nile luidung jong ukeng dimlha jeng ding ahi. Na insung leh na lupna channa hungkal doh diu! Na mite leh na nung jui ho jouse kom channa lhung ding, na chang lhah meh nau jouse'a jong hung lut dimset ding ahiuve.”
8.4: “Ukengte chung leh nanung juiho jouse chung'a chom le ding'u ahi.”
8.5: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron jah'a sei jin lang, ‘Egypt gamsung pumpi ukeng ten ahinlo dim nading in, natenggol jah in, twinah jouse, twilam jouse leh luidung jouse chu jeptan! Ukengten Egypt gam pumpi hinluo dim tante, tin seipeh in,” ati.
8.6: Aaron'in jong Egypt gamsung twi chung'a akhut ajah'in ajep tan ahile, ukengte ahung potdoh'un Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim jeng tan!
8.7: Ahinlah Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong hitabang chun abolthei uve. Ukengte chu gamsung'a alhalut thei un ahile gam pumpi chu ukengte adim lhatai.
8.8: Chu phat'in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron akouvin hiti hin aseije, “Yaweh heng'a tao lhon tan, ajeh chu keima le ka mite jouse'a konna ukengte alah doh na ding in, chu teng keiman namite'u ka soldoh ding, amaho che uva Yaweh kin aga bol diu ahi,” ati.
8.9: Mose'n adonbut in, “Nang le na sohte, chule namite ding'a itih phat'a katao ding nei seipeh in ati. Chuteng na in dung jouse'a ukengte Nile vadung lam'a kitol ding ahitai,” ati.
8.10: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah a, “Jing teng bol in,” ati. Mose'n henge, “Nasei bang bang hita hen. Chuti leh nangman keiho Yaweh, Pathen tailou dang aum poi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
8.11: “Ukengten nangma leh na nungjui ho jouse le namite naboncha uva na dalhah diu, Nile luidung a bou umden diu ahi,” ati.
8.12: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in achedoh lhon in, Mose chu Yaweh lam sang in kap pum in ataovin, Pharaoh le amite akon in ukengte ladoh tan ati.
8.13: Pakaiyin Mose taona chu asanpeh tan, indung jouse, lou jao leh gamsung'a ukeng jouse a sumang hel tan ahi.
8.14: Egypt miten ukeng thisa hochu aloh khom'un ahile gamsung pumpi a uilha jeng tan ahi
8.15: Ahinlah Pharaoh'in dinmun ahung oldom taiti ahin hetdoh phat in, angaija bang in a lungthim atah kit tai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu anahsah kit tapoi.
8.16: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron heng'a sei inlang, ‘Na tenggol jandoh in tol lhang jep tem in. Chuteng Egypt gam pumpi'a thousi vaishi chule nen'in ahin lodim jeng ding ahi,” ati.
8.17: Yaweh thupeh bang in Mose leh Aaron'in jong abol lhontan. Aaron'in jong akhut ajah'in atenggol'a tol lham chu ajep'a ahile, thousi vaibong tamtah'in Egypt gam pumpi le gamsa jouse a lodim jeng tan chule boh nen in gamsung alodimjeng in ahi.
8.18: Pharaoh doithem choihon atabang bang abolthei jing vang uvin, tunvang alosam tauvin abolthei tapouvin ahi. Thousi vaibong'in mipi hole gamsung'a gancha jouse atomlha tauvin ahi.
8.19: Hiti chun doithem choihon jong Pharaoh heng'a asei un, “Hiche hi Pathen khutnung mong ahi,” atitauve. Ahinlah Pharaoh lungthim chu angaija bang'in atah jing na laiye. Pakaiyin a seidoh sa bang in, Pharaoh'injong amaho thusei chu anahsah deh pon ahi.
8.20: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hitihin a seikit tai, “Jingkah teng Nile vadung lam'a Pharaoh hung ding chuteng nangman na kimu piding.” Ajah'a Pakaiyin hiti hin asei je: “Kamite soldoh tan, ajeh chu amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahi,” tia nasei ding ahi, ati.
8.21: Na soldoh louva ahile, “Keiman namite, nanung juiho chule na insung jousea thousi vaisi kahin lansah ding ahi. Egypt mite in jouse thousi vaisin atomlhah jeng ding, Gam leiset pumpi jong dimlha jeng ding ahi, ati.
8.22: Ahinlah kamite chenna Goshen achom beh'a kahoidoh ding ahi. Thousi khatcha lenglut louhel ding ahi. Chuteng leiset pumpin keima hi Yaweh kitipa chu kahi ti nahin hetdoh diu ahi,” ati.
8.23: Keiman kamite leh na mite kah'a kikhenna ka sem doh ding, “Hiche thil kidang meilchihna hi jing nikho teng soh ding ahi,” ati.
8.24: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang'in aboltan. “Thousi vaibong techun Pharaoh insung, anungjui ho ingsung leh gamsung in jousea a lenglut tauvin adimlha jeng tai.” Thousi vaibong ahon hon in Egypt gamsung'a ahung kitol lut tan ahile gamsung pumpi chu athim lha jeng tan ahi.
8.25: Chuphat in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron aga kouvin, hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai! che uvin lang Yaweh maicham gasem taovin, ati.” Aman asei jin “Hichu Egypt gamsung'a na bol ding'u ahi,” ati.
8.26: Mose'n a donbut in hitin aseije, “Hichu adih thei poi. Keihon Ka-Yawehju le Ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina maicham kasem diu chu, hiche lai Egypt mite adia thil kitoh thei louding ahiye. Ven! Hitabang thilho pi chu bol taleng'u Egypt miten song'a eise lih gam ding'u ahi,” ati.
8.27: “Ka-Yawehju leh ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina hi nithum sung hitei ding ahi, hichu Pakaiyin keima hodia a seidohsa ahi, ati.”
8.28: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah'a hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai, che tauvin,” keiman nangho gamthip noija na-Yaweh ju kinbol ding'in kaphal tai, amavang na che gamlhat louhel ding'u ahi. “Tun che uvin lang keima ding in neitao peh'un,” ati.
8.29: Mose'n a donbut'in, “Na angsung'a konna ka potdoh ding, jing nikho teng leh nangma akon leh namite chule na insung jouse uva akonna thousi vaisi apot doh na ding'a ka tao tei ding ahi, ka gihna ahiye nangma Pharaoh in jong nei joulhep da uvin lang Israel miten jong Yaweh dia kilhaina hi boldao hen na tilou beh ding ahi,” ati.
8.30: Pharaoh angsung'a kon in Mose apotdoh tan, thousi vaibong jouse aki tolmang hel na ding'in aga tao tan ahi.
8.31: Pakaiyin Mose taona'a sanpeh tan, Pharaoh akon, anungjui holeh amite hojousea konin, thousi vaibong abonchan akitolmang tan, khatcha jeng jong akimudoh tapon ahi.
8.32: Ahinlah angaiya bang in Pharaoh lungthim atah kit tan ahileh, Israel mipi asol doh deh tapoi.

9.1: Pakaiyin Mose thupeh anei jin, “Pharaoh heng'a che kit in lang ajah'a hiti hin sei jin. Hiche hi ahi Hebrew mite Yaweh, Pathen'in asei chu: Kamite che'u hen lang, Keima kin gabol uhen.
9.2: Na soldoh louva Israel mite hi na umsah jeng ding'a ahile,
9.3: Na loujaova na gancha jouse na sa kolte, sangante, sangongsao te, gancha hon, kelngoite leh na kelchate chung'a gamna hise kahin lansah ding thigam kei ding ahiuve, ati.
9.4: Ahin lah Pakaiyin Isrrael te gancha ho leh Egypt mite gancha ho chung'a chom khenna ahin sem ding, Israel mite ganchaho vang chu khatcha jong thilou ding ahi!
9.5: “Pakaiyin hiche gamna hise ahin lan sah ding ahitai. Aman aseije jing nikho teng gamsung pumpia ahinlan sah ding ahi.”
9.6: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang in aboltai. A jing jingkah in Egypt mite gancha athigam hel tan, ahinlah Israel mite gancha vang chu khatcha jong athi hih beh jeng'e.
9.7: Thilsoh umchan dol khol chil ding'in Pharaoh'vin asohte hochu asoltan ahile, Israel mite gancha hochu khat cha jeng jong athi pon ahi! Ama vang Pharaoh lung thim chu angaiya bang'in atah jing nalaiyin aman mipiho chu asol doh dehpon ahi.
9.8: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a asei jin, “lhum sung'a kon in vutdi tampi kiham lhon'in, hichu Pharaoh mitmu chang tah'a Mose'n vanlam'a athe touding ahi,” ati.
9.9: “Egypt gamsung pumpi chu vulvai nelsel chun alodim jeng ding, chuteng mihem chung hile gancha chung hile uilut natna huoisen alhundan jeng diu ahi,” ati.
9.10: “Chuin amanin jong lhumsung'a konin vutdi aki ham lhonin, Mose angsung'a ading lhon tai,” Pharaoh'vin avet jing laiyin, Mose'n vutdi chengse chu vanlam angan athetou le, vutdi niel chun gampumpi aluodim jing tan mihem le gancha hochung'a uilut natna huoisi alang’ tai.
9.11: Egypt gam'a doithem choiya thilbol ho chung'a jong achutan Mose angsung'a ading ngam ta pouvin, ajeh chu uilut natna huoisi chun amahole Egypt mite jouse alhun den jeng ahitai.
9.12: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah nalaijin, “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseidohsa bang'in, Pharaoh in ngainahsa in anei hih laiye.”
9.13: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei yin, “Jingkah matah'in thouvin Pharaoh angsung'a ga ding'in lang, ajah'a seijin. Hebrew mite Yaweh Pathenin hiti hin aseije: “Kamite soldoh tan, keima kin agabol na ding uvin.”
9.14: “Na soldoh louva ahile, keiman natna huoisi ka hin lansah benah lai ding nangma le nanung juiho chule namite chung'a ka hin lansah cheh ding, chuteng nangman keima Yaweh tailou leiset'a Pathen dang aum poi ti na hin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
9.15: “Tu jeng ajong keiman ka khut ka lhan jah'a nangma le namite chung'a gamna huise ka lansah'a leiset chung'a hi kasuh mang hel jeng thei na hiye.”
9.16: “Ahinlah keiman leiset pumpia ka thaneina ka musah bou na hin hichu leiset pumpia kithe jal ding ahi.”
9.17: “Ahinlah hicheng jouse nung injong nangma leh nangma na kichoisang gunset in, kamite na soldoh hih laiye.”
9.18: “Jing nikho tuphat dontah le keiman gilchang nasatah Egypt gamsung'a ima tichanna analha khaloulai chu kahin lhahsah ding ahiye.”
9.19: “Kino tan! Na loujaova gancha ho jouse hoitup ding in namite sol loijin, achuti louva ahile hi tabang gilchang ahung kheh teng lou jaova mihem hihen gancha hijong le aki dalha chan chu gilchang'in ase'a thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
9.20: Pharaoh nungjuiho mi phabep chu Pakaiyin hitia asei jeh chun aki cha tauve. Amaho acheloi jun loujaova gancha hole asohte ho'u chu aga puilut taovin ahi.
9.21: Ahinlah Yaweh thusei ija sep louse vang chun a loujao dung uva kihong tah'in gancha alha thang nalai uve.
9.22: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt gamsung loujao tin cheng'a gelchang ahung kheh'a mihem ahin gancha ahin chule loujaova thingphung jouse hihen lang, Egypt gamsung pumpia thil umjouse ase khah na ding in vanlam nganlang na khut lhang jah tan,” tin asei tai.
9.23: Chuin Mose'n jong vanlam asang in a tenggol chu agah jah doh jeng le, Pakaiyin van thamjol aki thinsah'in gelchang ahung khe tan, leiset chung geijin meikong ahung leng lha tan, Egypt gam pumpia Pakaiyin gilchang goju toh ki bang chat in a khehsah tan ahi.
9.24: Imatih chan a jong hitobang gilchang chu Egypt gamsunga anakhe khalou lai ahin, tanglou hel'in gelchan chu akhe tan meikou apah lha jeng in ahi.
9.25: Hitabang gelchang chun Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim lhajeng tan chule lou jaova umphot gancha hihen mihem hijong le aum jouse chu asep lhu jeng tan, gamsunga thingphung jouse jong asep thang deh tan ahi.
9.26: Goshen mun Israel mite chenna mun bou chu ahoidoh tan ahi.
9.27: Hitia thil asophat chun, Pharaoh in jong mi asol loijin Mose leh Aaron agakousah tan hiti hin aseiye, “Tun vang keima chonse ka hitai,” tin kilhaina aneiyin “Yaweh hi thudih tanpa ahin, keima le kamite ka dih tapouve,” ati.
9.28: Yaweh henga nei tao peh lhon tan, ajeh chu vanthamjol aging jeng jung'e! gilchang na satah in akhe jing nalaijin ahi. Ka gim val taove. Keiman na soldoh tau ving'e; umjong umsot ta hih'un, ati.
9.29: Mose'n a donbut in, “ahi le aphai”, Khopi sung hi ka dalhah lhah leh keiman jong Yaweh heng'a ka taoding ahi. Vanthamjol gin hung thip ding, gilchang khejong hung tang jeng ding, nangman jong leiset pumpi hi Yawehya ahi ti na het doh ding ahi,” ati.
9.30: “Ahinlah keiman kahe jing nalaije, nangma leh nasoh ten tuchan'in Yaweh na ging hih lai uve,” ati.
9.31: Hiti chun gamsung'a Phaipheng jouse leh sakol chang abonchan amangthah hel jeng tai, sakol chang chu avui ado laitah ahin chule phaipheng chu ahung don doh laita ahiye.
9.32: Hiche lah achun suhlou chang leh butun chang vang ahoidoh nai, ajeh chu suhlou chang leh butuchang chu aduo aum lou laiphat ana hiye.
9.33: Chu in Mose jong Pharaoh angsung khopi dalhan ache tai. Yaweh lam asang in ataovin ahile, vanthamjol kithin le gelchang khe chu atang jeng tan, leiset pumpia gojuh jeng jong atang hel tan ahi.
9.34: Pharaoh’ in jong gojuh, van ki thin, leh gelchang kheh akitang taiti ahin hetdoh phat'in amale anung jui ho achonse kittao vin, angaiya bang'in Pharaoh lungthim atah kit tai.
9.35: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a ana seidoh sa bang in Pharaoh lung-thim angaiya bang'in atah kittan, Pharaoh'in jong Israel mite asoldoh deh poi.

10.1: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Pharaoh heng'a che kit inlang, ga seikit tan. Keiman ama leh a sohte ho lungthim ka suhtah ahin, melchihna hicheng jouse hi ka kilah sah ding ahi,” ati.
10.2: “Chule nangman jong na chapate leh natupa te jah'a ichan geija ka gimsah uva chule melchihna tampi ka musah uve ti na jahsah thei na diuva kasei ahiye. Nangho jeng in jong keima hi Yaweh kitipa chu kahi ti na hetdoh jeng diu ahi,” ati.
10.3: Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achie lhonin asei lhon tai, “Hebrew mite Yaweh, Pathen'in hitihin aseiye: Itih chan ka-angsung'a kunding da nahitam? Keima kin agabol na ding uvin, kamite soldoh tan.
10.4: Nanop louva ahile, vetan! Jing nikho teng le na gamsung'a khaokho te kahin lansah ding ahi.
10.5: Gam pumpi a lodim soh uva tol lham jong na muthei louding ahi. Gilchang'in akheh lih lou amoh chengse khaokho ten aneh gam hel diu, loujaova keh thingphung hojouse jong anehchai kei ding'u ahiye.
10.6: Nangma insung hinhen nasohte insung hi jong leh Egypt gam insung jouse ahin lodim soh hel jeng diu, hiche tabang thilsoh gimnei hi napu napateo khang'a pat na gamsung uva anaum khalou lai ahi, tin ahenga agasei lhon tai, chuin Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a potdoh tan ahi.
10.7: Pharaoh sohte hojong ahung uvin Pharaoh heng'a asei tauve. “amapa hi itih chan lom lom eiho ding'a hahsatna a lhunsah ding hitam? Mipi hohi chie uva a Pathen kin abolna diuvin soltan! Egypt mite pihi jou le nal'a mangthah gamding ahitauve ti na hetdoh hih laiyem?”
10.8: Chuin Mose leh Aaron chu Pharaoh heng'a ding in ahin puilut kit tauvin. Pharaoh in jong amani jah'a aseiyin,”che uvin lang na-Yawehju leh Na-Pathen kin gabol taovin. Ahile koipen mong hi nahiuvem ache ding? tin amani chu adong tan, ahi.
10.9: Mose'n a donbut'in, “ateh-akhang, kacha pate hou ahin ka chanu teho'u jaona khatcha kidalha lou ding ka hiuve. Ka kelngoi jouseo leh gancha jouse aboncha ka puisoh kei diu, chule keihon kut chu alouthei louva ka gabol teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
10.10: Pharaoh'in jong asei jin, “kei man nangho nacha sen gei uva kasol doh tha ngei ngeija ahile Yaweh umpi nachu chang un! Na lungthim sung lhonna lungthim phalou na keng lhon'e.
10.11: “Hiche vang chu hithei louhel ding ahi! Nangho lah'a Pasal chengse che uvin lang na Yaweh ju kin gabol tauvin, hichu natup tenten uva hilou ham? Hiche phat chun Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a soldoh tauvin ahi.”
10.12: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhopite alan na ding in na khut jah doh jeng tan. Egypt gamsung'a hamphung gilchang in a khehlih moh chengse aboncha aneh gamset diu ahi,” ati.
10.13: Mose’ atenggol chu Egypt gamsung pumpi chungvum a ajahdoh jeng tan ahile, hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung pumpi nilhum keileh khovah hel'in huiphalou solama kon'in tanglou vin anun sah tai. Jingkah in solam akon hui jin khaokhote ahon hon'in ahinpolut taovin ahi.
10.14: Chule Egypt gam pumpi chu khaokhoten alosoh hel jeng tan, hi tabang'a gamsunga khaokhote chu imatih channa ana um kha loulai ahiye.
10.15: Khaokhoten gamsung pumpi alodim lhatau vin ahile mu athim lha jeng tai. Gelchang in akheh moh chengse gam leiset'a thing phung jouse jong anemang hel taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpi thingphung chule hamphung abonchan ana do khat jeng cha jong jong umlou vin khaokho ten anechai hel jeng taove.
10.16: Chuphat in Pharaoh in jong asohte ho asol loiyin, Mose leh Aaron agakousah un, hiti hin aseiye. “Keiman na Yaweh leh nangni chung'a chonset phat louna kabol kha tai,” ati.
10.17: “Ka chonset na nei ngaidam lhon'in, Yaweh heng'a neitao peh teitei lhon tan, hiche thi gamna huise hi keima angsung'a kon in tolmang jeng lhon tan,” ati.
10.18: Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a kondoh in Yaweh heng'a aga tao tai,
10.19: Pakaiyin nisolam a kon in hui hattah ahin nunsah'in ahile, hiche huipi chun khaokhote jouse twikhanglen dung laiya alhoh lut soh hel jeng tai. Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhote chu khat jeng cha jong aum ta hih hel jeng'in ahi.
10.20: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah jeng na laijin, Pharaoh in jong mipi ho chu asol doh hih laiye.
10.21: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Nakhut ban jah'in lang vanlam sang tem in, Egypt gamsung pumpi muthim'in alo soh hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
10.22: Mose'n jong Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in vanlam asan jeng'a ahile, “Egypt gamsung pumpi nithum sung mu athim lha jeng tan, ahi.”
10.23: Hiche phatsung chun khat le khat akimu thei tapouvin, koimacha jeng jong pot le thei lou ahi tai. Ahinlah Israel chate chenna mun vang chu khovah'in aumpi jing uve.
10.24: Ajonan Pharaoh in jong Mose a koukit tan, a heng'a aseije, “Cheuvin lang Yaweh kin gabol tauvin,” nachate'u kipui jun lang, ahinlah na kelngoi hon teu vang na dalhah ding'u ahi,” ati.
10.25: Mose'n adon but in, “hichu hithei him him ponte.” Ka gancha te'u chu nei puisah tei teiju angaije, ajeh chu ka Yaweh u-leh ka Pathen angsung'a kilhaina a kaman chah ding'u ahi, ati.”
10.26: “Ka gancha teu aboncha, ka pui teitei diu ahiye; khat jeng cha jong ka dalhah thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu ka ganchate'u lah a konna hi keihon Yaweh angsung'a kilhaina'a kat doh ding'a ka lhen doh cheh cheh diu ahi. Chule amun ka lhun kahse uva itilam dol'a Yaweh kin ka bol diu ham ti ka hechen nai pouve,” ati.
10.27: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu khatvei a sutah kit nalai jin, Pharaoh'in jong mipiho chu asol doh hih laiye.
10.28: Chuin Pharaoh jong apeng jah jeng tan, “Mose henga aseiyin, ka- angsunga kon in potdoh jeng'in!” ati. “Keiman nangma ka gih nahiye. Avel'a nei hung kinung mupi kitthei lou hel ding ahi! Nei kimupi kit ngai ngaiya ahile hiche nikhoa chu nathi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
10.29: Mose'n a donbut in, “Apha jenge,” “Avella ka kimaito pi tah lou ding nahiye,” ati.

11.1: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Keiman Egypt gamsung leh Pharaoh chung'a ka hin lhunsah ding hoise khat aki vat nalaije. Hiche hi aso chai chai teng le, Pharaoh vin agam sung dalha ding'a nahin no jeng ding'u ahitai,” ati.
11.2: “Israel mite heng'a seipeh in lang, ama ama cheh'in aheng akom Egypt mite sana dangka akijep na ding uvin kithum cheh taohen,” ati.
11.3: Tun Pakaiyin Israel chate chu Egypt mite mitmun lunglhai na achansah tai. Chule Mose chu Egypt gamsung pumpia amin akithang in, Pharaoh mitmu chang leh mipite mitmun amin che lheh jeng tan ahi.
11.4: Chuin Mose'n Pharaoh heng'a asei jin Hiche hi Pakaiyin aseiye: “Keiman jankim tah le Egypt mite lungthim kahin suhthou ding ahi.”
11.5: Egypt gamsung'a chapang peng masa jouse, Pharaoh chapa peng masapen ahin, a laltouna'a peng masa penpa ahin, a sum buh laiya chang bong goija pang a sohnu chapa changei ja abonchauva thigam kei ding, gancha peng masa jouse jong aboncha thisoh hel ding ahiye,” ati.
11.6: “Chu teng Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao kithong lhading, ajeh chu hitabang thilsoh gimnei hi imatih channa anaum kha loulaiya ahin, Avella hung kilah kit talou ding chu ahi.”
11.7: “Ahinlah Israel mite vang chu lungmon nan aumpi jing diu, uicha jeng jong hampoh lou ding ahi. Chu teng Pakaiyin Egypt mite leh Israel mite kikah'a ijakai datkhenna asemdoh tai, hichu nanghon na hetdoh cheh ding'u ahi,” ati.
11.8: “Chu teng Egypt gam'a nanung juiho leh nasohte abonchauva keima lam'a hung kipelut ding'u hitia hi asei diu ahi, khaiye! “Nangma leh nanung juiho abonchauvin hikoma kon hin potdoh tauvin,” tin aseije atipeh tai. Chuin Mose jong lungphamo tah'in Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a che doh tan ahi.
11.9: Tun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Pharaoh vin nangma thusei ahin moh ngai thei lou ding, ahinlah keiman Egypt gamsung'a thil kidang melchihna ka bolbe nahlai ding ahi,” ati.
11.10: Mose leh Aaron'in jong Egypt gam Pharaoh angsung'a thil kidang melchihna tampi aki lahsah lhon'in, ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu ki dang tah in asutah jing nalaijin ahile, Pharaoh'vin Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung a kon in ana soldoh hih laiye.

12.1: Israel mite Egypt gamma aum jing laijun, Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a hicheng hi thupeh aneiye:
12.2: “Tuapat hiche lha hi nang ho ding'a lha kipatna ahin, kumkhat adia lha kipatna'a kisim ding ahi tai,” ati.
12.3: “Israelte kikhop khomna munpi jouse ah ga seipeh lhon tan. Hiche lhasung nisom alhin niteng leh ama ama cheh in apu apateu insung kai lhah apat, insung khat cheh akon kelngoi khat cheh kat doh ding'a ahin kai diu ahiye.”
12.4: Kelngoinou khat kitha ding'a insung khat'a mijat chu alhom khah'a ahile, inneipu le aheng akoma pa kinop to ding kelngoi nou adol ding cha bep khat chu aga kimat lhon ding, amichan cheh'in aneh khopset ding kelngoinou khat ding mijat chu phatecha nasim toh lhon ding ahi.
12.5: “Kelngoinou chu nolna beihel hiding, kumkhat lhingsa hitei ding, hiche kelngoinou chu kelngoi honlah'a konna hihen kelcha honnlah konna hijong leh athah beh mong mong'a na kimat ding'u ahi.”
12.6: “Hichea manchah ding kelngoinou chu hiche lha nisom leh nili lhinni geija nahen cheh diug'u hichu nilhum lam teng leh Israel kikhom pumpi chun ama amacheh adia akitha ding'u ahiye.”
12.7: Gancha kithat thisan chu phabep a sodoh diu, hichu kelngoinou thisan a chu in kotpi phung le inkam'a aloinat cheh cheh diu ahi.”
12.8: “Hicheni jan teng chule kelngoinou sa chu meiya akihul min uva aneh cheh diu, hichu cholso lou changlhah leh anchekha toh ametha cheh cheh diu ahiye.”
12.9: “Hiche sa chu asel puma hihen twija kihonminsa hijong leh koimachan naneh thei lou hel diu ahi. Sa pumpi aluchang le akeng chule asung jouse jaona meiya na kihulmin tho uva naneh cheh diu ahi,” ati.
12.10: “Sahel moh neocha jong jingkah chan'na na khovah sah louhel diu ahi. Jingkah geija ana um taphot chu meiya na govam jeng ding'u ahiye.”
12.11: “Hicheng hi sa naneh teng ule najui cheh ding'u ahiye: nangma cheh na kivon lhingsel uva, nakeng chot ho'u na kisi cheh diu, chule nakhut uva tenggol na kiphu soh kei ding'u ahi. Chu teng naneh khom soh kei uva hichu Yawehya dia kalchuh kut ahiye,” ati.
12.12: “Hiche jan teng chule keiman Egypt gamsung kahin jotpa'a mihem leh gancha aboncha apeng lha masa jouse kasuh gam hel ding ahi. Chule Egypt gamsung'a milim doi kisemthu jouse chung'a jong thu katan ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima Yaweh kahi!” ati.
12.13: “Ahinlah nangho jouse ding'a hiche thisan kiso chu melchihna hung kilah tading, keiman Egypt gampumpi ka hinsuh mang ding, hiche thisan chu kahin mudoh jiteng keiman nangho jouse chung'a natna hoise hung lang theijouse akonna kaven doh ding na hiuve,” ati.
12.14: “Hiche nikho hi nangho ding'a het jing na nikho'a pang jeng ding ahitai. Hichu kumsih chule akhang akhang'a Yawehya dia kut nikho ahi ti na gel doh jeng ding'u ahiye. Na khang lhumkei uva chonna dan hiti'a nanit jing diu ahitai,” ati.
12.15: “Ni sagi sung'a cholso lou chang lhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi. Ni sagi alhinni teng leh nangma insung cheh'a chol umjouse pamlamma na paidoh soh kei ding'u ahi. Nalah uva koitabang khat chun hiche cholso lou changlhah, ni sagi lhinnia pat naneh khah ngeingei uva ahile, amachu Israel mite lah'a konna kisumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
12.16: “Kut kipat nikho masa pen'ni teng khompi len khat nanei uva, ni sagi alhinni teng jong leh khompilen theng khatma nanei diu ahi. Hiche nikho teni hi atumbeh a nanit cheh diu, amichan'in aneh khop ding nabol peh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
12.17: “Hiche hi Cholsolou chang lhah kut'a naman diu ahiye, ajechu hiche nikhoa hi keiman nang ho Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hin puidoh nau na geldoh jing diu, nakhang lhumkei uva nangho jousen hiche nikho chu chonna dan ahi tia nanit jom jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
12.18: “Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho nilhah lam teng leh na boncha uva hiche chol solou chang lhah chu naneh pan diu ahi”
12.19: “Ni sagi sungse'a vang chu nangma nangma insung cheh'a, chol sosa changlhah khat jeng cha jong kilah lou ding ahiye. Kholjin mi ahin agamsung cheng den miho hijong leochun cholsosa changlhah nekha tapou chu, Israel khompi akonna ki sumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
12.20: ‘Hiche phatsung hin amitakip'in cholsosa changlhah kiti phot na neh lou hel ding'u ahiye. Ajeh chu chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.”
12.21: “Chu in Mose'n jong Israel sung'a upa ho jouse akou khom in aheng uvah asei peh tai, “Che uvin, nangma cheh insung ding kelngoinou gakikai jun lang, chule kal chuh kut'a ding'in kithauvin.”
12.22: “Khutsilna kong'a gan thisan chu koi jun. Chule hichu hyssop nado phabep lauvin lang dekot'uvin. Hissop chu lauvin lang thisan achun kotpi khom teni ahin kotpi chunglah inkam a chun loinat soh kei uvin. Jing khovah kahse'a koima chan hichu a kallhah theilou ding ahi,” ati.
12.23: Ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Egypt mite jouse sugamma hung ding kahi, chuteng Pakaiyin kotpi chung lah'a thisan kiloinat hochu amu ding, hitia chu a suh gam ding hojal achu hiche insung chu apeldoh ding ahiye, ati.”
12.24: “Geldoh jing'un, thupeh hichengse hi nangho jouse ding leh nachateo khang geija chonna dan ahi tia na jui jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
12.25: “Pakaiyin nangho peh ding'a aki tepna sa gamsung na lhun teng ujongleh hiche chonna dan hi najui jing diu ahi,” ati.
12.26: “Chule hiche chonna hi na chate u vin ipi ding'a kibol ham, ti na hin doh ding'u ahi.”
12.27: “Nang hon jong na donbut uva, “hiche chonna dan hi Yaweh ja dia gantha kilhaina ahin chule Pakaiyin Egypt mite anatha gamlai chun Aman Israel mite in hochu ana kalchuh ji'e tia nasei peh ding'u ahi. Chuin Mose'n thupeh hichengse chu achaiphat'in mipi jouse Yaweh angsung'a akunlha sohkei uvin chibai aboh tauve.
12.28: Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi.
12.29: Chule hiche Jan khangkim chun Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung'a nao cha pengmasa jouse, Pharaoh chapa apeng masapen alatouna toupa akipat, akimvella cheng asohpa chapa peng masapen ahin, chule gancha peng masa jouse athat gam hel tan ahi.
12.30: Jankim laijin Pharaoh, asohteho chule Egypt mite abonchauvin athou doh taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao awgin akithong helsoh tai. Ajeh chu intin chang'a mi thina lou umlouva ahi tai.
12.31: Jankim lai jin Pharaoh'vin Mose le Aaron aga kousah tauvin, “Ka mite dalhan che tauvin chule Israel mite kipui jin che tauvin! Nei tepna bang un che uvin lang Yaweh kin chu gabol jeng tauvin,” ati.
12.32: “Na seima bang in na kelngoi jouseo leh nagan cha jouse'u abonchan ki pui unlang, che tauvin, nei dalhah ding tah jeh'un keima jong phatthei neichan lhon ding ahiye,” ati.
12.33: Egypt miten abonchauvin Israelte ding in a kisaboi lheh jeng tauvin, Egypt gamsung'a konna Israel mite soldoh loiding lunggel akeng tauvin, ama hon hiti hin ase uve; “Keiho ka boncha uva thigam ding kahi tauve! tin asei uve.”
12.34: Israel mite'n jong chang bong neldi anei jouse'u aki hamkhom tauvin. Chang bong ameh nau lhengkam jouse jao nan poh ding'in aki got cheh tauvin ahi.
12.35: Mose'n athu peh bang bang uvin, Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi; Egypt mite akon'in sana le dangka kijep na ding jouse akithum doh gam tauvin ahi.
12.36: Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite mitmun alunglhaisah soh keijun ahile, Egypt miten jong anei chasun uchu itcha louhel lin ana pesoh kei uvin. Egypt mite haona jouse toh akon tauvin ahi!
12.37: Hiche jan chun Israel mite Rameses khopia kon in Succoth lam'a ding'in akipat doh tauvin ahi. Numei chapang simtha louvin keng lamma che pasal jat mong chu sang jagup alhing uve.
12.38: Amaho ahiuvin chule miphum miphah, gancha ho, kelngoi hon tampi le gancha hon tampi jaonan aki tol tauve.
12.39: Egypt gamsung'a aum lai uva kisem chang bong chu alhon lhon'in aki ken jiuvin ahi. Egypt gam'a kino tah'a ki soldoh ahiyeh uvin amahon chang lhah chu chol aso man tah louvu, chule ama cheh nehding jeng jong ana kigon man tapo uve.
12.40: Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung'a kum jali le kum som thum ana cheng uve.
12.41: Chuin, Kum jali le kum somthum lhin'nin Yaweh thanei jin Israel mite chu Egypt gam'a kon'in ahin puidoh tauvin ahi.
12.42: Hiche jan chun Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'a kon'na ahinpui doh ding kitepna aneiyin ahi. Hiche jan hi Yaweh ding'a mong ahin, hijeh achu Israel mite'n akhang akhang'uva anit jing diu ahiye.
12.43: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Hichengse hi kalchuh kut kibol ding dan ahi. Kalchuh kut ankong hi kholjin min anehthei lou hel ding ahi.”
12.44: Amavang hiche mihem chu sum'a kichodohsa le cheptan sa ahile aneh jeng thei ahinai,” ati.
12.45: “Kholjin maimai le tha'a kila akigoimi hon jong aneh thei lou ding ahi.”
12.46: “Insung cheh'a kalchuh kut an chu kine ding ahi. Inpolam'a naneh thei lou diu chule sagu hel neocha jong kipodoh thei lou ding ahiye.”
12.47: “Hiche hi Isreal khompi jousen phatecha anit cheh diuva ahi.”
12.48: “Gamdang mikhat tou ahung kholjin khah'a Yaweh kalchuh kut'a ajaonom'a ahile pasal kiti phot chun achep kitan cheh uhen, chuteng kalchuh kut chu anailut'uva aneh thei ding chuteng amaho chu Israel mite bang'a lhathei ding ahiye.”
12.49: “Hiche thupeh hi amitakip ading ahin, agammi Israelte hihen gamdang mi hijong le dan khat'a um cheh ding ahi,” ati.
12.50: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abolsoh kei uve.
12.51: Hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gamsung a kon in galsat sepaite bang in ahin puidoh tauvin ahi.

13.1: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin.
13.2: “Israel mite lah'a apeng lhamasa phot kaheng'a na todoh ding ahi. Mihem hihen gancha hijong leh aboncha keija ahi,” ati.
13.3: “Mose'n mipiho heng'a asei jin, “Hiche nikho hi imatih chan'na gedoh jing uvin Egypt gamma nasoh chan nauva konna nahung kitoldoh nikhou chu ahiye. Tunin Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'nan nahin puidoh tauve.” (geldoh jing un, cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi),” ati.
13.4: “Hiche nikho hi phalbi matah hichu Abid nikhoa hi na boncha uva chamlhat tah'a na potdoh sohkei ding'u ahiye.”
13.5: “Pakaiyin nangho chan dia napu napateu heng'a akitepna Canaan gam mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hivi mite chule Jebus mite chenna (khoiju le bongnoi lonna gamsung'a nahin puilut teng uleh hiche lhasung'a chu nangman jong hiche chonna dan chu nabol ding ahi),” ati.
13.6: “Ni sagi sung'a chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi. Ni sagi lhin ni teng le vang Yaweh heng'a kut khat nabol diu ahi.”
13.7: “Ni sagi sung'a cholsolou changlhah jeng bou naneh thei diu ahi. Tahbeh'in hiche nikho sagi sungse'a hi na gamsung kimvel'u aboncha koiman cholsosa changlhah kiti toh naum khom louhel diu ahi.”
13.8: “Ni sagi lhinni teng leh na chate hou heng'a na sei uva, ‘Egypt gamsung'a keima ka um laiya Pakaiyin hiche melchihna hi eibol peh ahiye,’ nati ding ahi.
13.9: “Hiche golvah nahi melchihna khat'a pang jing ding, chule namit jeng ajong hetjing na a pang ding, hiche kihilna hi na kamsung'a navop jing ding ahi: Pakaiyin nangma abanthahat pan'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
13.10: “Hijeh chun hiche golvahna hi kumseh'a ngai ngai ja bang'a na bol jing ding ahi.”
13.11: “Hiche chonna dan hi Pakaiyin khanglui ja pat'a kitepna anei bang'a hichu aguilhun kahse'a nabol jom jing ding, nangman Canaan mite chenna nalhun teng leh nabol ding ahiye,” ati.
13.12: “Hijeh achu Israel sung'a konna pasal pengdoh masapen mihem hihen gancha hijong le Yawehya dia napeh doh jing ding ahi, hichu Yawehya ahi.”
13.13: “Hiti achu sangan nou penglha masa chan chu kelngoi nouva nalhat ding, nalhat tah lou jong le sangan nou hochu angong chang na hekelep ding ahi. Chule na chapate lah'a apeng masa chan nale lhat doh cheh cheh ding ahi.”
13.14: “Chule khonung teng, nachapan thil umchan dol'a nahin doh ding, hiche ho jouse hi ipijeh pentah'a kibol ham?” Nangman hitia hi na donbut ding, “Egypt gam'a soh ichan lai uva Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'na mipi jouse leh gancha aboncha ehin puidoh uva ahiye,” na ti ding ahi, ati.
13.15: “Pharaoh ana lungtah lheh jing in ahile, Egypt gam'a konna ipotdoh diu chu ana phal tapon, ajonan Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung'a pasal peng masa jouse leh gancha jouse abonchan athat chaikeiye. Hijeh achu tuahi keiman Yawehya dia kilhaina kasem ahin hibang'a chu keiman ka chapate lah'a peng masa pen chan chu lhatdohna kaneiji ahi.” tia na seipeh ding ahi,” ati.
13.16: “Hiche chondan hi nakhut teni ahin, namit teni chule na nah lhong geija melchina thil'a navop jing ding ahiye. Hichu Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'na Egypt gam'a kon'na nahin puidoh het jing na ahi.”
13.17: Ajonan Pharaoh vin Israel mite ahin soldoh tan ahile, gamtepna lamlhun'na naicha ahi vang chun, Pathen'in Philistine galbol hojih chun lampia ahinpui pouvin ahi. Pathen'in aseiye, “Kamite hon galtoh khata le alung heikhao vintin Egypt lam'a kile ding ahiuve,” ati.
13.18: Pathen'in amaho chu gamthip lah'a ahinpui leuvin, vadung san lammun chu ahin jon tauvin ahi. Israel mite chu galsat mibang in ahung kitol taovin ahi.
13.19: Mose'n jong Joseph gu-le chang ahin choijin, ajeh chu Joseph in hiche thulhah nahi ana neijin, hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen nangho kithopia hung jing ding ahi. Aman nangho nahin panpi teng ule, hiche kagu kachang hi nahin poh jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
13.20: Israel miten Succoth mun ahida lha uvin gamthip lah Etham kiti mun ahung lhung tauvin hiche mun'na chun ngahmun akisem tauve.”
13.21: Pakaiyin amite chu malam'a alhon pijing in, “Sunteng meibol khompi bang in alhon pe uvin, jan teng meivah khompi bang in alhon pi jiuve.”
13.22: Pakaiyin amite dalha louvin mei-lhang meivah'in aum pi jing uve.

14.1: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a thupeh hicheng hi anei jin:
14.2: “Israel mite heng'a seiyin nung lam'a a kihei uva Pi-hahiroth le Migdol kikah san-dung chule Baalzephon gal lamma ngahmun asem naiduvin aheng uvah seipeh'un,” ati.
14.3: Chutileh Pharaoh in hitia hi angaito ding, “Israel mite alungdong tauvin, suhna ding helouvin gamthip noija akitol le tauve, ati ding ahi.”
14.4: “Hitia chu keima avel'a Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, aman nangho nung ahin delding ahi. Ajeh chu keiman ka gontupsa ahitai, Pharaoh le agalsat mite chung'a ka loupina kakilah sah ding ahi. Chuteng Egypt mite'n keima Yaweh kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai! Aheng uva kisei peh bang'in Israel mite'n hiche munna chun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
14.5: “Pharaoh lengpa le asohte ho heng'a Israel mite ajam tauve tithu alhun phat in, Pharaoh leh asohte lungthim akikhel kit tan, “Ipi khat ibol uva Israel mite asoh chan nauva kon'na jam gam'u hitam?” tin asei uve.
14.6: Pharaoh in jong agalsat miho le sakol kangtalai hochu agon tupsah loijin ahi.
14.7: “Pharaoh vin sakol-kangtalai hatcheh jagup le Egypt gamsung'a sakol kangtalai dangho jouse abonchan vaihom mitam pichu atou tauvin ahi.”
14.8: “Pakaiyin Pharaoh kiti Egypt lengpa lungthim asutah nalai jin ahile, aman jong Egypt gamsung dalha'a jam Israel mite nungchu adel tan ahi.”
14.9: “Egypt mite'n jong Israelte chu Pharaoh'in galsat miho thaneina lhingset apen anung adel tauvin a sakol jouseo leh sakol-kangtalai jouse, sakol touthem jouse le agalsat mijouse abonchauvin adimlha tauvin ahi.”
14.10: Pharaoh jong Israel mite umnalam anailut jep phat'in amahon Pharaoh lam chu avetou uvin, hichun amahon anung lam uva Egypt mite ahung kitol chu amu tauve. Abonchauvin Yaweh heng'a atao uvin,
14.11: Mose heng'a asei un, “Ipi ding'a gamthip noija hi thigam ding'a neihin puidoh'u hitam? Hitia ka thi gam sang uva Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'mu phajo lou ham? Ka chung uva ipi nabol jing hitam? Ipi dinga Egypt gamsung'a konna nei puidoh'u ham?
14.12: Egypt gamsung kaum lai uva chu, hi tabanghi soh tei ding ahi tia ka seiju hilou ham? Tunjong na henga ka seiju ahi, “Nei dalha jeng tauvin! Egypt mite khut noija soh in umkit tau vinge. Hiche laimunna ka thigam sang uvin Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'u apha joi!” tin asei tauve.
14.13: Ahinlah Mose'n mipi heng'a asei jin, “Kicha hihhel un, dingdet jing un veuvin, tunia hi Pakaiyin na huhdoh diu ahiye. Chule tunia kipat avella Egypt mite namukit tah lou diu ahi,” ati.
14.14: “Yaweh amatah'in nangho galsat'a pang ding ahi.”
14.15: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Ipi ding'a keima heng'a tao na hiuvem? Mipiho ma lamma akitol na diuvin seijin!
14.16: “Na-tenggol jan doh tem in twikhanglen-dung vum chu jep tan. Twipi chu sukhen'in chutileh Israel mite twikhanglen lai lung tolgo lah achu ki jot ding'u ahi.”
14.17: “Chule keiman Egypt mite lungthim kasuh tah ding, amahon Israel mite thagam na ding angai todiu ahi, chuteng asakol kangtalai jouseo, asakol tounau nangho that gam ding'a hungkon ahiuvin, abonchauva keiman kathaneina aheng uva ka kilah sah ding ahi.”
14.18: “Egypt mite ma-sang'a kaloupina kakimusah ding ahijoi, chuteng keima Yaweh kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahi!” ati.
14.19: Chuin Yaweh vantil'in Israel mite ahin lhonpi'n. Mipi masang lam'a meilom chu nunglam joh'a ahung tan ahi.
14.20: Chuin meilom chu Israel mite le Egypt mite kah'a ahung umtai. Mu-athim lha jeng tan, meilom jong meikong a kisoh'in kho ahung thim tan ahile, jan khovah keijin Israel mite chu Egypt miten ahin del pha tapo uvin ahi.
14.21: Chuin Mose'n a tenggol chu twikhanglen san-dung vumma ajah doh jing'a ahile, chuin Pakaiyin twikhanglen dung chu solamma kon hui ahung nung in ahinsem hoh tan ahi. Jan khovah keijin huijin twikhanglen chu asem in, twikhanglen jong aki khen'in tol lham golai ahung umdohtan ahi.
14.22: Chuphat'in Israel mite abonchauvin tolgo laiya chun akitol'un alang alang'abang-bang'in twi chu kiting tan ahi!
14.23: Chuin Egypt mite Pharaoh galsat sakol jouse, sakol kangtalai jouse chule sakol touthem jouse jaona'n Twikhanglen lailung'a kitol Israel mite chu adel tauvin ahi.
14.24: “Jingpi ahi phat in Pakaiyin Egypt mite chu meikong leh meilom mangchan ahin vesuh tauvin ahile, chuin Egypt galsat miho chu abonchauvin suh na ding beijin a nohgam tauvin ahi.
14.25: Pakaiyin a kangtalai jouse'u abonchan a tuhtang gam tan ahile, kangtalai hochu abonchan a kitang den gam tai. Egypt miten jong aseita'u vin! “Israel mite angsung'a kon'in jamdoh loiju hite,” ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Israel mite apan pin Egypt mite chung'a gal asat tai,” atiuve.
14.26: Israel mite agalkai phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt mite twijin ale lonkhum na ding'in na tenggol jahdoh inlang twipilen chungvum hi jep tem in, ati.”
14.27: Nisa ahung sodoh toh ki lhon'in, Pakaiyin a thupeh bang in Mose'n Twipilen chung vumma akhut ajah tan ahile, Twipilen jong angai ja bang bang in ahung um doh kit tai.
14.28: Chuin Twi akitol mat kit tan, Israel mite nung hindel a Egypt galsat miho le sakol touthem jouse, kangtalai jouse abonchauvin Twi jin achup gam hel taovin khat jeng cha jong asohcha tapouvin ahi.
14.29: Ahinlah Israel mite chu Twipilen lailung'a tolgo achun akitol jing uvin, twipi jing jong ajet aveija akisong den jeng in ahi.
14.30: Hiche nikho'a hi Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite khut akon'in ahu doh'in Israel mite'n amit tah uvin twi-khanglen galla Egypt mite thilong kijam hochu amutaovin ahi.
14.31: Egypt miten Isreal mite douna anei uva Yaweh thahat le natoh ki dang amuchen ta uvin ahile, Israel mite'n Yaweh chu aging tauve. Yaweh le alhachapa Mose jong aging uvin, tahsan ki phudetna anei tauvin ahi.

15.1: Chuin Mose le Israel mite'n Yaweh avahchoijun la asa uve: “Keiman Yaweh vahchoila ka sah ding, ajeh chu aman loupitah in gal ajou tai; sakol ahin achung toupa Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga aseplut tan ahi.”
15.2: “Yaweh hi kei dinga, ka thahat nale ka vahchoi ding'a lomtah ahi; ajeh chu aman galjona eipetai.” Amahi ka Pathen, ka vahchoi ding ahi, chule kapau Pathen ahin, choiat ding'a lom Ama bou ahi!
15.3: “Yaweh hi galhattah ahin, ajeh chu amin jong Yaweh ahiye!”.
15.4: “Pharaoh kangtalai jouse le agalsat jouse, Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga asep lut tauvin; Pharaoh deitum le alhen tumho abonchauvin Twikhanglen san dunga aseplut gamtauvin ahi”.
15.5: “Twikhanglen kinong in achup gamsoh heljing uvin; abonchaovin songtum bangin Twinoi lamma a lhalhum gam tauve.”
15.6: “O Yaweh nakhut jetlam hi loupe le thahat chungnung ahi. Melmate jeng jong a sugam hel tan ahi.”
15.7: “Na lalna leh na loupina jal in na melmate naleh khup jing e, Nalunghan na nasatah in nahin tahlang jitan ahile; abonchauvin meiyin changpol akah vamkei bang'in a kavam soh hel tauve.”
15.8: “Nangma husan akonin twipi kinong jeng jong alhuh den in ahile atang jeng tai! Chule twikhanglen lailung'a twi kitangjong chu ale chupsoh heljeng in ahi.”
15.9: “Chuin Melmapa chun hitin aseiye, keiman anung ka del ding ka phah tei ding ahi. Thil kiladoh kale lah ding chule ka deichat bangtah'a kakile lah ding ahiye; kachem jam ka sadoh ding, abonchauva kasat chap jeng ding ahiuve.”
15.10: “Ahinlah nangman na haikhum in ahile, abonchauvin twikhanglen in a chup tauve. Twipi hattah lailung'a alhum gam tauvin ahi.
15.11: “O Yaweh, Pathen dangho jouse lah jeng'a jong koi macha nang kal lhah aumpon, amaho chu imacha toh'a kite thei deh pouvin, nangma kala koima cha thenna chang ding aum hih e. Loupi na leh tijat umtah'a thilbola koiham?”
15.12: “Nangman nakhut jetlam najahdoh in ahile, hichun leiset'a melmate avallhum gam tauve.”
15.13: Na lungsetna long louvin, na lhatdohsa mite aumpi jing in ahi. Na chena mun geijin namite nahin puilhung tai.”
15.14: “Mitin vaipin hichu ahin jasoh tauvin ahile; Philistine gamsung'a cheng jouse din nat hesoh achang tauve.”
15.15: “Edom gamsung'a lamkai kitiphot alung thomlhao gamtan; Moab gamma lamkai jouse jong aki thing soh hel tauve. Canaaan gam'a cheng jouse jong alung thoi gamta uve.”
15.17: “Nangman namite nahin puilut ding nangma molsang chungvum a chu na tundoh ding ahiye; ajeh chu nangman hiche laimun chu na chenna dinga na tundoh sa ahi tai, O Yaweh nangman mun theng laijeng jong chu na khut te nia na tundoh ahi tai, ati.”
15.18: “Yaweh hi tonsot tonsot'a chung nung chang ahi tai!”
15.19: Ajeh chu Pharaoh sakol kangtalai jouse twikhanglen lailung'a atol lut in, Yaweh thahat chun achungvum uvah twikhangklen chu alechup sah gam ahitai. Ahinlah Israel chate abonchauvin twi-khanglen lailung tolgo lah achun akijot galkai sah tauvin ahi.
15.20: Chuin Aaron a sopinu, themgao Miriam akhut'a khutbeh khat chu akilah in, numeija kaijousen amanu nung chu ajui tauvin, khutbeh jaonan apotdoh uvin alam uve.
15.21: Chule Miriam chun hiche jaila hi a-oijin ahi: “Yaweh vahchoila sa'u hite, Aman loupitah'in gal asat'in ajou tai; sakol chung'a toupa jeng jong twikhang len lailung'a aleh khup jeng tai.”
15.22: Mose'n jong twikhanglen San akon'in Israelte chu ahin pui nalaijun, chuin Shur kiti neldi gam'a akitol lut tauvin ahi. twidon ding thei louvin nithum sung'in akitol tauve.
15.23: Marah mun ahung geitauvin ahile hiche mun'na twi chu akha'n don thei ahi tapoi. Hijeh chun hichelai munchu Marah asah tauvin ahi (hichu akha tina ahi).
15.24: Chuin mipi Mose chung'a aphunchel gamtaovin hiti hin aseyuve, “Ipi kadon diuva hitam?”
15.25: Mose jong Yaweh lamsang in kap pum in atao tai. Pakaiyin thing lhon neokhat avetsah in hichu asat doh'in twi lah chu akho lut'a ahile twi chu donthei ahung sohdoh tan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin hiche Marah munna chun Israelte ding in chonna dan khat a sempeh'in Ama'a akitah jing na diuvin jong hilchetna aneiyin ahi.
15.26: “Aman hiti hin aseije, “Nangman ching thei tah'in na Yaweh na Pathen thusei ngaijin, Ama mitmu'a thudih jeng'a na chon ding, a thupeh jouse na nit ding, hi tia chu Egypt mite chung'a gamna hoise ka lan sah chu nangho chung'a ka lansah louhel ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima nadamsah na Yaweh chu kahi,” ati.
15.27: Marah mun adalhah phat'uvin Israel mite jong Elim kiti twiko somleni putdoh namun tom-thing somsagi kenna munna twipang achun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.

16.1: Elim akon'in Israel mipi akitol uvin Sin kiti gammang lam hichu Elim le Sinai molsang kahlah ahiye. Hiche mun chu Egypt gamsung'a konna ahungpotdoh kal'u lhani alhing tan, hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinin ahunglhung taovin ahi.
16.2: Hiche mun jeng ajong chun Isreal mite Mose le Aaron heng'a aphunchil taovin ahi.
16.3: Ama hon aseiyun, “Kada tangei uve! Egypt gamsunga kana um laiyun saneh ding hihen changlhah hijong le adimlha jeng jin, tun nangman hiche gamthip noiya hi kelthohsah'a thi gam sah ding nei got u hitam,” atiuve.
16.4: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Vetan! Vanna konna keiman nangma ann kahinpeh ding nahiye. Nisih niseh'a aneh diu adeichannu agakilo ding'u ahi. Keiman amaho kapatep ding ahiuve, ajeh chu kathu angai nah uvem.”
16.5: “Nigup lhinni teng keiman aneh khopset diuva an'neh kahin pehding ahiuve, hichu anehkhopset diu ajatnia tam hiding ahi.”
16.6: Chuin Mose le Aaron'injong Israel mite heng'a aseipeh lhon tan, “Nilhah lam teng na hetdoh ding'u ahiye, ajeh chu koiham Egypt gamsung'a konna nahin puidoh paochu,” atipeh lhon tai.
16.7: “Chule jingkah lamteng Yaweh loupina namudiu ahi, ajeh chu nangho nakiphin nau awgin Aman ajasoh tai, hichu Amadia doumah um ahin, hichu keini chung'a doumah naneijin phun hihhel un, ati lhon'e.”
16.8: Mose'n asei aseikit in, “Pakaiyin nilhah lamma naneh diu sa nahin peh diu, jingkah lama naneh diu changlhah nahin peh diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nangho na phunchel uva ama douna thu na seinau aja soh tai. Keini a kon ipijeh'a na kiphin'nu ham? Henge, na phunchel nau chu keini douna hilouvin, Pathen douna ahijoi,” ati lhonne.
16.9: Chuin Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Israel mite jouse heng'a seipeh tem in: Nangma cheh Yaweh angsung'a kipe lut uvin, ajeh chu Aman nang ho phunchel na ajahsoh ahi tai, tin seiyin,” ati.
16.10: Aaron'injong Isreal mite jouse heng'a aseiyin ahile, amahon gammang lah chu avel le jeng tauvin ahi. Amahon Pathen loupina thil chu vanlam'a amu tauvin ahi.
16.11: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin,
16.12: “Keiman Israel mite phunchelna ka jahsoh tan ahi. Tun nangman aheng uvah seijin, nilhah lamteng naneh diuva sa ka hin peh ding na hiuvin chule jingkah lamteng naneh diuva changlhah kahin peh ding na hiuve. Chuteng nanghon keima hi na-Yaweh u-leh Na-Pathen'u kahi na hetdoh ding'u ahi,” ati.
16.13: Hiche nilhah lam chun vamimte ahung kitol tauvin ahile ngahmun chu alo dimlha jeng tauve. Jingkah khovah machun ngahmun kim vel lah jouse chu daitwi jin ana chup in ahi.
16.14: Chuin daitwi hochu ahung kihoh dohtan ahile, gammang lah akon chun thilpha tah khat alomlom chan ahung umtan, hichu abeh beh'a kigol'in anaum in ahi.
16.15: Israel miten jong hichu ahinmudoh taovin ahile, amaho akidong tochheh un, “hiche khu ipi ahidem?” amahon ipi ahichu ahedoh jou pouvin ahile. Chu in Mose'n ahil chen un, “Hiche hi nehding'a Pakaiyin napeh uvah ahi,” ati.
16.16: “Hicheng hi Pakaiyin aseije: Nangma insung cheh'in naneh khopset diu kilah unlang, chule mikhat'in vamim jatnia tamjo napon buh sung uvah kichoi lut un,” ati.
16.17: Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi, kimkhat in tampi a kichoi jun, akim khatma chun achoi khambep cheh aki choi uve.
16.18: Ahinlah Omer dimkhat cheh atetoh uvin ahileh, tamtah hinkilah ho ahin chule ama ding khambep hin kilah ho jong hiti chun, kitam lah chom leh kilhom lah chom um louvin; abonchauvin kitoh chat chat'in akihom uvin aki choiyuve.
16.19: Chuin Mose'n aheng uvah aseiyin, “Jingkah khovah lhah channa ahelsi cha jeng jong na koi loudiu ahi,” ati.
16.20: Kimkhat chun a ngaisah pouvin changlhah aneh moh uchu jingkah lam chan in akoi jun ahile, chang lhah akoi den hou chu thaan achu tan a uilha gam tai, Mose jong ama ho chung'a chun a lungpha mo tan ahi.
16.21: Jingkah sih'in Mipiho chun aneh khop cheh diu changlhah chu aga kilo jiuvin, nisa ahungsat doh teng levang changlhah hochu ajunmang jitan ahi.
16.22: Nigup lhinni teng le changlhah chu achan jatbep cheh diuvin akilo jiuvin, hitia abol'u toh kilhon chun khompi lamkai ho ahung uvin Mose heng'a asei jiuvin ahi.
16.23: Aman aheng uvah aseiyin, “Pakaiyin hiti hin aseije: Jing nikho teng nangho nakicholdo diu ahi, ajeh chu Yawehya dia Sabbath nikho theng ahi. Changlhah na kisem theijat channu tunin kisem unlang, hiche hochu jinglam'a ding jong kikoi doh taovin,” ati.
16.24: Mose'n athupeh bang'un, changlhah phabep chu achom in jingkah khovah chan in akoi jun ahi. Jingkah'in changlhah hochu ima ati tapon than jong chu louvin hoitah'in ana um'e.
16.25: Mose'n aseijin, “Hiche changlhah hi tunin neuvin, ajeh chu tunikho hi Yawehya dia Sabbath ahi. Ajeh chu tol lhamma chang lhah umlou ding ahiye,” ati.
16.26: Nigup sung'a changlhah na kilo cheh diu, ni sagi niteng nalo thei lou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
16.27: Kim khat chu Sabbath nikhon changlhah kilo din acheuvin, hinlah changlhah khat jeng cha jong amu tapouve.
16.28: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “hiche mite hin itih chan kathu peh apalkeh diu hitam?
16.29: “Amahon ageldoh diu chu Sabbath nikho hi Yawehya akon ahin Aman eipeh'u ahiye. Hijeh achu Pakajin nigup sung'in changlhah neh ding na peuvin, nigup lhinni man nini sung'a neh ding changlhah na peuve. Nalah uva koi hijong leu chun naum na cheh uva umthim beh jeng uvin lang,’ nisagi lhinni teng koima cha achenna munna konin pamlama potda jeng tahen,” ati.
16.30: Nisagi lhin ni leh na boncha uvin ima ne louvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
16.31: Israel miten chang lhah chu Manna asah tauvin ahi. Hichu muchi mu tabang bang ahin, atwi dan jong khoiju ta bang ahiye.
16.32: Mose'n asei in, “Yaweh thupeh chu hiche hi ahiye: “Nakhang lhumkei uva umjing ding in Manna ki hamdoh cheh uvin, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva mite hon Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hinpui uva gammang thip lah'a Manna'a kahin vah nao ahidan ahetdoh thei ding'u ahi,” ati.
16.33: Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Belneo khat latem'in asung'a chun Manna phabep khat khum'in. Hichu akhang akhang'a umjing dia Yaweh ansung'a nagakoi ding ahi,” ati.
16.34: Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Aaron in jong aboltan ahi. Yaweh angsunga akhang akhang'a het tohsah'a pang ding'in kitepna thingkong maiya chun akoi tan ahi.
16.35: Israel mite'n jong achenna diu mun ahin phah kahseo vin, kum somli sung sen Manna jeng ahin neuvin, Canaan gam ahung lhun kahse uva ding'in Manna jeng chu ahin ne tauvin ahi.
16.36: Manna Omer dimkhat chu Ephah khatseh hopsomma hop khat toh aki bang in ahi.
