17.1: Yaweh thupeh bang in Israel chate abonchauvin Sin gammang akon in akitol uvin mun khat akon munchom khat'a akitol leuvin ahi. Rephidem kiti mun'na ngahmun akisem'uvin hinlah hiche lai mun'na chun twidon ding aumta pon ahi.
17.2: Mipi jong Mose heng'a avel lin a phunchel kit tauvin, “Don ding twi neipe uvin,” ati tauve. Mose'n a donbut in ajah uva, “Ipi ding'a kei koma ki phin'a na hiuvem? Chule ipi ding'a nang hon Yaweh na patep u ham?”
17.3: Mipihon twi angaicha jing uvin Mose dounan thu aseijun akiphin gam tauvin, “Ipi ding'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nei hin puidoh mong mong'u hitam? Nangman keiho le, ka chate'u chule ka gan chate'u ka boncha uva dangchah'a thigam sah ding nei got uva hitam?” tin asei uve.
17.4: Chuin Mose jong Pathen heng'a kap pum'in ataovin, “Hiche miteho ding'a ipi kabol ding hitam? Song'a selih ding eigo tauve,” ati.
17.5: “Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Mipiho ma'sang a konchun ki khen doh tem'in chule Nile vadung San najepna tenggol chu kichoiyin lang Israel upa ho phabep kipuijin.”
17.6: “Keiman Sinai molsang songpi chungvum'ma ka dinpi ding nahiye, chuteng songpi chu jep lechun twi hung kikho doh jeng ding, Israel miten adon thei diu ahitai,” ati.
17.7: Mose'n jong hiche mun chu Massah asah tan ahi (hichu ‘patepna’ tia kihe ahi) Chule Maribah (hichu ‘ki khoh doh’ tina ahi) ajeh chu Isreal mite Mose heng'a aphunchil uva, Yaweh doumah jing asei doh uvin, “Na Pakaiyin keiho hikoma hi ei umpi mong uva hinam?” atiuvin ahi.
17.8: Israel mite Rephidim mun aum jinglai yun, Amalek mite ahung kon uvin akisat petauve.
17.9: Chuin Mose'n jong Joshua heng'a thupeh aneiyin, “Amalek mite toh kisat ding pasal galsat ding phabep khat lheng doh tem'in. Jing nikho le keima gamlah molsang'a ka din ding hichea chu Pathen bantha hat ka dopsang'a ka pan ding ahi,” ati.
17.10: Mose thupeh bang'in, Joshua'n jong Galsat ding pasal phabep alheng doh tan Amalek mite chu gal akisat pi tauvin ahi. Chuin Mose, Aaron leh Hur amaho cheng chu gam lah molsang lam'a akal tou tauvin ahi.
17.11: Mose'n akhut teni a dopsang chan in Israel mite ahat be cheh jiuvin, chule akhutteni akham teng le vang Amelek mite ahat jita uvin ahi.
17.12: Mose khut teni chu ahung khaam tan ahile aman jong adomsang joutapon chuin Aaron le Hur'in jong akhut ngap nading'in song ahol le hontan, a khut teni chu song chung'a angam lhan toumun in nilhum keijin akhut chu chol lou helin a domsang thei tan ahiye.
17.13: Ajonan Joshua le agalsat mihon Amelek mite chu ajoutaovin ahi.
17.14: Gal ajo phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Het jing na ding'in lekhajol khat lanlang hiche gal kisat chung chang thuhi sunlut'in lang Joshua nabeng'a avella nasim peh tan: vannoiya Amalek kihetna kiti keiman kasuh mang hel ahitai,” ati.
17.15: Mose'n jong hiche lai munna chun maicham asem in, “YAWEH-NISSI” (Yaweh chu kaponlop ahi) tin asah tai.
17.16: Aman aseijin, “Amalek mite'n Yaweh doumah'a chon masao ahin, tunvang! Pakaiyin imatih channa Amalek mite akidou peding ahitai,” ati.

18.1: Mose ding'a anupa pa, Jethro Midian thempupa'n Mose le asopi Israel mite chung'a Yaweh natoh thil kidang abolho ajadoh tai. Amapan jong Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'ma kon'na ahin lhatdoh chu ki dang asaval jeng'in ahi.
18.2: Mose'n jong anupa pa, Jethro heng'a ajinu Zipporah le achapateni chu asol'in, chuin amahon insung'a apuilut uvin ahi.
18.3: Mose chapa pengmasa min chu Gershom ahin, achapa apen lhah chun Mose'n hiti hin aseiye. “Mi gamsung'a khosa kahi,” tia ana minsah chu ahi.
18.4: Ani channa achapa min chu Eliezer asah in, Mose'n hiti hin aseije, “Keima khangluiya pat ka Pathen chun Pharaoh chemjam akon eihuh hing ahi,” tia asah ahi.
18.5: Mose nupa pa, Jethro chu Mose vil lin gammang lam'a ahung tan ahile. Aman ajinu le achapa teni chu ahin puijin, Mose le amiten gamthip lah Pathen molsang kom'a ngahmun akisem nau mun'na ahinpha taovin ahi.
18.6: Jethro'in jong Mose chu thu athot tan, “Keima Jethro nanupa pa kahin, keima nangma vil'a najinu le na chapa teni jaona hung kahi,” ati.
18.7: Mose jong pamlam'a agache doh'in anupa pachu agakimu pitai. Amajong akum lhan abeng achop peh tan ahi. Hiti chun khat le khat akilem touvin Mose chen'na ponbuh sung'a alut taovin ahi.
18.8: Mose'n jong anupa pa heng'a Pakaiyin ichangeiya Egypt gam'a konna Israel mite chung'a na-ahintoh ham ti thudol'a aseipeh'in ahi. Chule lamkah jouse'a thohgim hahsa athoh nau le agenthei najouseo abonchan anupa pa heng'a asei peh in ahi.
18.9: Pakaiyin Israelte ichangeiya Egypt mite khut'a kon ahin panpi hitam tithu le ahin huhdohna thudol phatah'a ahet chet phat'in alungthim akipah lheh jeng in ahi.
18.10: Jethro'n hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen thangvah in umhen.” “Ajeh chu Aman Pharaoh le Egypt mite akonna nahin huhdoh jal in. Henge, Yaweh bou chu ahiye Egypt mite thanei na konna na huh doh uva! ati.”
18.11: “Tun keiman ka hechen sel taije, Yaweh hi pakai jouse lah a thanei chung nungpen Yaweh ahiye. Ajeh chu Aman aban thahat apan'in Egypt mite akiletsah nauva kon'na ahin huhdoh ahi,” ati.
18.12: Chuin Jethro amachu Mose ding'a anupa pan jong Pathen angsung'a pumgo thilto kilhaina asem in ahi. Aaron le Israel sung'a upa ho ahung uvin Pathen angsung'a kilhaina ankong chu asoh khom uve.
18.13: Ajing nikhon Mose'n jong atouna a kon'nin mipiho thutan ding'in ahung doh tan ahile, mipiho jong chu nilhum keijin ading tauve.
18.14: Mose nupa pan, hitia mipiho chung'a athilbol amudoh phat'in aman Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche laimunna hi ipi mong mong tongdoh inge nati ham? Ipi bol mong inge natia jingkah'a kipat nilhah lamchangeiya mipiho hi nahiti din sah hitam?” ati.
18.15: Mose'n adonbut'in ajah'a, “Ajeh chu mipiho hi kaheng'a hung uva Pathen akon kavai hopna hi akilah mang kigot uva ahi.”
18.16: “Amaho hi ahung kinah komu le kaheng ahin jonlut jiuvin, chuteng keiman thu katan peh jiuvin, Pathen akon nun leh khan dan toh kitoh'a Pathen phatsah bang'a ka hilchen jiuva ahiye,” ati.
18.17: Chuin Mose nupa pan ajah aseiyin, “na thilbol hi adih poije!” ati.
18.18: “Mipi ahin nangma nahin na bon'uva na gimna diuva ahi bouve ajeh chu nathilbol hi abeipon ahi. Nangma changseh adin thi lhah satah khat ahiye,” ati.
18.19: “Tun keiman kahil nahiye, ajeh chu keiman kultah'a kahil nahi ngaijin lang Pathen'in naum pijing hen. Mipiho jouse khella hi Pathen ansung'a ding jing nahin, akibaotam nao jouse Pathen angsung'a na selhah ding ahijoi,” ati.
18.20: “Mipiho hi Pathen akon chonna Danho le phatsahna ho hilchen in lang, hichu aboltei na diuva na thumop'a chule ajui cheh na diuva jong nasei ngaija ahi.”
18.21: “Ahinlah mipiho lah akonna thilbol thei miman tam, Pathen ging, nehguh chah guh beija natong thei ding nalhen doh ding ahi. Amaho chun mijakhat lah hihen sangkhat lah hihen jakhat lah hijong le aloi loija vaihomma na pansah ding ahiye.”
18.22: “Phat tinna mipi thutanna napan sah diu, thupi diuva thutanna ding aumvang le nangma heng'a hinpuiyun tin, thuneo hojouse vang chu amahon ama chamma atan lhah jeng theiju ahi. Nangma dia jong agom lam hijo ding chule amahon jong nangma nahin kithopi nau jong ahi,” ati.
18.23: “Hichengse hi na jui'a ahile, nangma chunga Pathenin tohding nahin peh teng doujou'na tha naneijoh ding chule mipihon jong lungmoung sella ama ama in cheh akile jut thei diu ahi.”
18.24: Mose'n jong anupa pa Jethro thusei chu angaijin, aman aseibang bang'in aboltan ahile apha lheh jeng tai.
18.25: Israel mite lah akonin thilbol thei miman tam cheh alheng doh tan. Amaho chengse chu Israel mite lah'a lamkaija pang ding hichu mi sangkhat, jakhat chung'a vaihomin apan sah soh kei uve.
18.26: Amaho chun kiphunna le baotam na nei ho chu Mose heng'a ahin lhut lut jiuvin ahi. Thuneo boina hovang chu amahon acham'un a sulham jiuvin ahi,
18.27: Hicheho jouse nung hin, Mose'n anupa pa asol in, anupa pa Jethro in jong alam pi ahung'na mama chu ahoh in akile tan ahi.

19.1: Israel miten Egypt gamsung ahin dalhah kalseo lhani lhin'in Sinai mun gamthip ahung lhung atovin ahi.
19.2: Rephidim ngahmun ahin sukeh un ahin dalha tauvin, chuin Sinai mun'na ngahmun a kisem uvin hichu Sinai ngahmun tin aminsah uve.
19.3: Mose molchung lam akaltou tan Yaweh toh agakimu ton ahile, Pakaiyin molchung'a kon'in ahin kouvin aseije, “Thupeh hicheng hi; Jacob insung le Israel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin:
19.4: “Egypt mite chung'a ipiti lamdolla na katoh, nang hon na musoh kei uve. Keiman nangho muvan lai lhaving'a ka hin pui uve ti namu chenset tauvin ahi.”
19.5: Chule tua hi kathu nangai uva kakitepna nakoi jing uva ahileh, nangho hi vannoi mite jouse lah'a keima dia atumbeh'a naum diu; ajeh chu vannoi leiset pumpi hi keima'a ahi.”
19.6: “Chule keima lenggam machu nangho naleng chan diu, kagam theng nalo ding'u ahi. Hiche thuhi nangman Israel mite heng'a naseipeh teiding ahi,” ati.
19.7: Chuin Mose molchung akon'in akumsuh'in Israel sung'a upa ho akou khom'in Pakaiyin a thupeh chengse abonchan a seipeh soh kei uve.
19.8: Chuin amahon adonbut cheh uvin, “Ijakai Yaweh thupeh bang'a keihon kabol diu ahi,” atiuve.
19.9: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Keima naheng'a meilhang kiheh bang'a kahung ding, Nangma Mose kahin houpi teng Israel miten ajah cheh diu, chuteng amahon jong nangma nahin tahsan jing diu ahitai,” ati. Mose'n jong Israel miten adonbut'na chu Yaweh heng'a aseijin ahi.
19.10: Chuin Pakajin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang keima kahung nading'in Israel mite gongtup tan, tuni le jing nikhoa din seipeh uvin chule avon jeng u-jong kisop theng cheh u-hen,” ati.
19.11: “Nithum lhin'nia ding'in kigontup sah soh kei uvin, nithum lhin niteng a mitmu tah uva Yaweh chu Sinai Mol chung'a pat hung kumlha ding ahi tipeh'un,” ati.
19.12: “Mipiho abonchauvin akimvel'uva melchih'na sempeh'in lang, seijin, kichih thei un! Koima molchung lam'a kaldoh hih hel'un chule akim vellah jeng jong koiman natham khah theilou diunahi. Koi hile molchung tham khachan chu thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
19.13: “Melchihna pal kallhah khut kiti phot'in atohkhah'a ahile, hichejeh'a chu; song'a selih jeng ding, ahilou jong le, thalpi'a kap lih ding gancha hihen mihem hile hitabang'a chonchu ahing'a kiumsah ngailou ding ahi, tin seipeh un. Sumkon ahung kimut gin apat mipi jong molchung lam'a hung kitol diu ahiye.”
19.14: Mose'n jong mipi lam chu ahin jonsuh tan. Aman mipi thenso'na anei jin, mipihon jong ama ama von cheh akisop theng uvin ahi.
19.15: Aman mipi heng'a asei jin, Nithum lhin nia ding in ki gotup cheh uvin chule numei angsung ki tiajong na lut louhel ding'u ahi,” ati.
19.16: Nithum lhin'ni jingkah khovah lam'in vahthamjol aki thing'in kolphe avah in, molchung vum chu meilhang'in atom lha jeng tan ahi. Sumkon hatah'in ahung ging tan ahile, ngahmun sung lam'a um mipi abonchauvin akicha lheh jeng tauve.
19.17: Mose'n jong mipi abonchan Pathen toh kimaito ding'in ahin pui uvin, chuin mipi abonchauvin molchung kipatna lam'a chun adding den gam tauve.
19.18: Sinai molchung akon in Yaweh chu meikong'in ahung kum lhan ahile, lhum sung'a kon'na meikhu bang'in ahung khudoh'in ahintomlha jeng tan, ling jong akihot lha jeng'in ahi.
19.19: Sumkon gin chu ahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahile, Mose jong akipat'in hiti hin aseije, van gin kithong lah akon'in Pathen'in ahin houpin ahi.
19.20: Yaweh chu Sinai molchung vum'a kon'in ahung kumsuh tan chuin, Molchung vum'a kon'in Pakaiyin Mose ahin kouvin ahi. Mose jong akipatdoh'in molchung lam'a chun akal touvin ahi.
19.21: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang mipi heng'a seipeh loijin, ajeh chu Yaweh ahinmu nomuva pal kigen khu ahin tumlhah ngai uva ahile thigam bep ding'u ahiye,” ati.
19.22: Chule thempu ho jeng jong atahsao amacheh kithenso uva eihin nailut thei diu bou ahi. Chutile Pakaiyin amaho lam pal chu atumkeh lou ding ahi, ati.
19.23: Mose'n jong Yaweh heng'a aseijin, ahinlah Pakaiyin, mipi abonchauva Sinai molchung'a hung kal theilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangma thupeh bang'a molchung kimvella pal gen uvin, tia nei thupeh sa'u ahiye, ati.
19.24: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin. “Chesuh inlang Aaron gakipuiyin lang hinki lhon pitan. Amavang mipi abonchauvin thupeh neijin lang khat cha jeng jong paltum keh'a Yaweh lam'a hung theilou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
19.25: Pakajin athupeh bang in Mose achesuh in mipi ho heng'a aga seipeh soh kei uve.

20.1: Chuin Pakaiyin mipi heng'a thupeh hichengse hi anei in.
20.2: Keima na-Yaweh u-leh na-Pathen chu kahi, Egypt gamsung'a nasoh chan nauva konna nalhatdoh pau chu keima kahi,” ati.
20.3: “Keima tailou Pathen dang nanei louhel diu ahi.”
20.4: “Nang hon vannoi leiset hihen twikhanglen'a um thil hijong leh alim na semthu uva pathen lim'a naman theilou ding'u ahi.”
20.5: “Hicheng ho ang sung'a chu naboh khup louhel diu, ajeh chu keima, na-Yawehyu-leh na-Pathen-u kahin pathen dang na kisem uva ahileh, keiman nangho heng'a ka lethuh diu napu na pate'u le nangma insung cheh chule a khang thumle li na channa lethuh ding kahi,” ati.
20.6: “Keima thupeh nit jinga, eingailu mi chu asang aja chung'a kalungset nalong lou chu ka umsah jing ding ahiye,” ati.
20.7: “Nangman Na-Yaweh le Na-Pathen min jeng jong ajehbeija namin phah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Ama min ajehbeija minphah chung'a themmo achansah ding ahi.”
20.8: “Cholngah nikho hi atheng'a nanit jing ding ahiti, sumil hih hel'in.”
20.9: “Natoh ding cheng nigup sungse'a natoh chai ding,
20.10: Ni sagi lhinni hi na-Yawehya dia cholngah nikho, hiche nikhoa hi nangman natoh ima nabol louhel ding chule nangma nahin, nachapa, nachanu, na sohpa, na sohnu, na gancha jouse le na kelkot phung hungsung lha'a na kholjin mi naboncha uva ima natoh thei lou hel diuva ahiye.”
20.11: “Ajeh chu Pakaiyin nigup sungsen van le leiset, twikhanglen le asung'a umjouse ana sem in; hiche nikhoa chu Pakaiyin cholngah nikho hi phatthei aboh'a ana lhandohsa ahi tai,” ati.
20.12: “Chule Yaweh na-Pathenin napehsa hiche leiset chunga na hinkho asot thei na ding in nanu napa ging jing in.”
20.13: “Toltha nabol lou ding ahi.”
20.14: “Mitoh jon nabol lou ding.”
20.15: “Guchat nabol lou ding.”
20.16: “Na sopi muda man'na thuse pole a napan lou ding.”
20.17: “Na kinaipi khat inchen chu na thangsetpi lou ding ahi. Na sopi ji khat chu na deichat lou ding, chule asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin abong chal ahin, asangan hijong le na sopi chule na kinaipi koma thil ima navet lal lou hel ding ahi,” ati.
20.18: Mipihon van gin nasa tah chu aja tauvin, kolphe jeng jong amu tauvin, sumkon gin jing jong athong jeju jeng tan, molchung lam'a kon meikhu amukit tauvin ahile amaho chung'a kichatna alhung ta, chuin amahon anailut ngam tapouvin ahile gamlha tah'in aum den tauve.
20.19: “Chu in mipihon jong Mose heng'a asei tauvin, ‘Sei ding a na deisah chan keima ho heng'a seijeng tan, na sei kangai diu ahiye, ajeh chu Pathenin keiho heng'a thu seikha taleh mohseh'a ka thi gam lhah jeng ding'u ahi!”
20.20: “Mose'n a donbut uvin hiti hin aseiye, “Kicha hih un,” Pathen na gin diu chule na chonset thei lou na diuva, nangho sudet ding'a Pathen hung'a ahi joi!” ati.
20.21: “Meilhang kiheh muthim'in atom nalah Pathen angsung'a chun Mose ache lut tan ahile, mipi jong chu akicha uvin gamlha thimma chun ading densoh kei tauve.”
20.22: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche hi Isarel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin: vanna kon in nang ho toh kihouna kaneije, tihi na mit tah uvin namu tauve,” ati.
20.23: “Geldoh jing un, ka masang'a dangka'a kijem patthen dang na sem louhel diu, dangka'a ki sem pathen dang kiti phot khat jeng cha jong nasem lou beh diu ahiye,” ati.
20.24: “Keima ding'in vannoi leiset na maicham khat nasem ding, hiche maicham chung'a chu pumgo thilto, chule chamna thilto jouse jaona kelngoi nou ahin, bongchal thilto a ding chengse jong na todoh ding, hoichan'na hijong le Keima geldoh jing'na ding'a naheng'a kahung jing ding phatthei ka chansah ding nahiye,” ati.
20.25: “Chule nangman song maicham kiti khat nasem ding'a ahile, hicha song naman chah ding chu kijem pol ding chule songchung'a chu khut themma thiljem najihlut ding kitup tah'a na koi ding ahiye.
20.26: “Maicham chungvum lam'a kalbi nado son ding chule nangma na sagohkeo jeng jong kimusah louva, ding-chang khenna na um ding ahiye,” ati.

21.1: “Hicheng se hi Israel mite chon'na ding dan ahiye.
21.2: “Hebrew mi soh ding'a na choh teng le, amachun kumgup sungse'a sohna chu atoh jing ding, kumsagi ahung lhin teng vang le soh'a kivul michu chamlhat chang ding che ding ahitai,” ati.
21.3: “Soh'a pangpa chu amachang seh seh bou ahileh, amabou kile ding Chule, jineisa ahi khah tah le, ajinu jaona anilhon'na kilhon doh lhon ding ahi.”
21.4: “Hiche sohpa chu apupan ji aholpeh'a ahile, achate sese leh sohpa jinu chu apupa chang ding, ajona teng le sohpa chu achang seh'a che ding ahi.”
21.5: Ahinlah sohpa chu hitia asei ding, ka pupa ahin ka jinu chule ka chate abonchauvin kalha ngaijin,’ chamlhat chang din che da jeng ing'e tia aseija,
21.6: Hichepa chu apupan Pathen heng'a ahin puiding, hiche asohpa chu kotphung gei hihen kotphung khom chang hijongh leh ahin puija, chuteng apupan thihtul khat'a asohpa bilkol a vuhom peh ding, hiche teng chule sohpa chun nilhum keija apupa kin'a kisa lal ding ahiye.
21.7: Pasal khat bang chun achanu soh ding'a akijoh doh ding'a ahile, amanu chu soh pasal ho bang'a kisol doh lou ding ahi.
21.8: Hiche sohnu chun apupa lunglhaina mong mong aboldoh jou lou ding'a ahile, apupan jong mi dang akilhat doh sah thei jeng ding, apupan hiche sohnu chu kitahna nei louvin anabol tan ahile amanu chu apupan jong gamchom ma joh doh son nading ima agel lou ding ahi.
21.9: “Ahinlah hiche sohnu chu apupan achapa sohnu a pang ding a agella ahile amanu chu achanu ngai ngai banga bol ding ahiye.”
21.10: “Ibang khat a achapa chun amading'a ji achom akipui khah tah a ahile, sohnu chu aji hina'a an-neh ding, sil-le-chen ding leh athaneina ima asuhnem peh chom lou ding ahi.”
21.11: “Asohnu dinga chu hicheng thum hochu abolpeh louva ahile, asohnu chun bat ima neilouva sum jong pelouva adalhah jeng thei ding ahi.”
21.12: “Khat touvin midang chun'a akhut alha khah'a ahile, akhut lhapa chu tha teitei ding ahi.”
21.13: “Ahinlah kihetkhelna maimaija konna ahile, hichu Pathenin amosah lou ding, keiman nangma munding kasem pehsa nahiye atia ahile hiche laimuna chu mivolihpa jamlut'a kihuh hing thei ding ahi.”
21.14: “Amavang, khat touvin aloipa hamkhat chu atha jeng'a ahile, hiche mithat pachu keima maicham phung'a konna tha ding'a napuidoh ding ahi, ati.”
21.15: “Koi hile, anuham apa ham vo'a achung'a khut lha aumma ahile ama chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
21.16: “Mihem gumang aum'a, amiguhpa bang chu ana johdoh tah'a chule akomma ana um nah laiya, akomma aum pet hichu amatoh kimudoh khom hijong leh, akimu doh pachu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
21.17: “Koiman anu apa a engbol thei lou ding amavang anu engbol mihem chu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
21.18: “Tun, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah a, khatpan jong khat pachu song tum'a asuh ham akhut tumma akhet hamma ahile hiche amisuh pachu thipei dehlouva ahile jalkhun anga ding ahi.”
21.19: “Ahinlah alhupa chu ahung kitho doh'a tenggol mangcha a ava le theiya ahile, ama anasukhapa chu achungchang kisutheng thei ding, anat nasung'a aki jenna phat mansah chengse alepeh ding chule ajen dam sel ding ahiye.”
21.20: “Mihem khat touvin asohpa ham asohnu ham chung'a khut alha'a athikhah a ahile, soh neipa chu thina chang ding ahiye.”
21.21: “Ahinlah hiche soh kijep penchu nikhat ahilou le nini sung'a adam theng tah'a ahile, sohchung'a khut lha mihem chu thina chang lou ding ahiye. Ajeh chu soh kivul michu ama nei gou khat ahi.”
21.22: “Tun tekah nan, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah tan, numei naovop lai chu asuh khah tah lhonna anaovop chu kisuhmo'a aphat louva ahungpot doh khah tah le, numeinu suhkha penpen chu ajipan jong anop channa aman adel khum jeng thei ahi. Ahinlah apeh ding chengse chu thutan vaihom hon aphatsah peh'u angaiye.”
21.23: “Amavang numeinu kisuklhahna khonung'a ahung nat khat tah ahile: hiche hinkho khel ding'a chu hin kho khat ma lepeh ding ahi.”
21.24: Mitchang khella michang hiding, haa khella haa hiding, khut khel la khut hiding, keng khel la kengg na peh ding ahi,
21.25: Meiyin akah'a ahile meikah jeh'a meiya nale peh ding, kimavo jeh'a namavoa chule kijep jeh'a chu nale jep jeng ding ahi, ati.
21.26: “Mihem koitobang khat chun asohpa ahilou leh asohnu ham mit asuh khah peh'a ahile, hiche soh chu amit adam loutah jeh'a chamlhat ding'a asol doh jeng ding ahiye.”
21.27: “Soh goiya pang pan jong asohnu ham, asohpa ham khat achu ahaa asuhlhoi peh a hile, ahaa asuh lhopipeh tah jeh'a hiche sohpa ham sohnu ham chu chmalhat chansah ding'a asol doh ding ahitai.”
21.28: “Bongchal khattou vin numei ham pasal ham khat chu aki'a ahin pihlih khah'a ahile, hiche bongchal chu song'a selih jeng ding ahiye. Amavang bongsa chu koiman aneh theilou ding chuteng bong neipa ding'a achungchang thu kisutheng ahitai,” ati.
21.29: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang kisanna mihem dang ana pihlih sa ahileh, aneipa jeng'in jong anahsah lou ahitah leh, hiche bongchal in jong numei ham pasal ham chu aki a apihlih khah'a ahileh, bongchal chu thadoh jeng ding chule aneipa jeng jong anigel la tha teitei lhon ding ahiye.”
21.30: Amavang athipa chu longlhat na ding'a aki peh doh'a ahile, aki pehdoh sah jatchu aman jong long lhatna ding'a apeh ding ahi.”
21.31: “Hiche bongchal chun numei ham pasal ham khat ahin peh lih khah bang le, hiche gancha neipa chu dan kisem dungjuiya kitham gah ding ahi.”
21.32: “Bongchal chun soh numeija pang ham pasal ham khat chu ahin pihlih bang leh, bongchal neipan jong sohneipa chu dangka shekel somthum apeh teitei ding chule hiche bongchal chu song'a aselih pai jeng ding ahi.”
21.33: “Tekah nan mikhat chun kokhuh khah bit louva adalhah jeng'a chule hiche kokhuh sin kikhah bit louva adalhah'a sangan ham bongchal ham kokhuh'a alhah lut'a athi den tah'a ahileh,
21.34: “Kokhuh neipan jong aphat toh kitoh chatna asem phat ding, gancha neipa jong sum apeh ding, a gancha pohlih vang chu ama chang ding ahi.”
21.35: “Mihem khat bongchal chun mi dang khat bongchal a suhkhah a asuh khah bongchal chu athi jeng'a ahile, bong nei ten jong hiche bong chal athinai louchu akijoh doh diu aki johdohna man vang chu kihom lhon ding, hiche bongchal thisa jeng jong chu aman kihom lhon ding ahi.”
21.36: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang jeng'ajong gancha dang ana pihlih jeng'a ahile, aneipa jeng in jong ahilchahsa ahi a chule ngaisah'a akoi louva ahile, anei pan jong bongchal thi chu bongchal khat mama'a alesah ding, bongchal thisa vang chu ama chang teitei ding ahiye.”

22.1: Mikhat touvin bongchal ham kelngoi ham aguhdoh'a hichu akitha ham ahilouleh akijoh doh'a ahile bongchal khat jat chu bongchal nga'a ale ding, chule kelngoi khat man dia kelngoi li alepeh ding ahi.
22.2: Gucha chun jankah a inbang aphetvang jeh'a ama chu akimatna aki vohlih khah tah'a ahileh, hiche guchapa hinkho that pachu tolthat a kisim lou ding ahi.
22.3: Ahinlah hiche thisoh hi sun khovah pet ahi leh vang mithat pachu tolthat a kisim ding ahi. “Ajeh chu gucha kiman chun, athil guhdoh jouse aboncha alesah kit ding ahin, a le sah joulouva ahi leh ama chu kijoh doh a athil guh ho sahna a kinei ding ahi.”
22.4: Khat touvin bongchal hihen lang, Sangan hihen, Kelcha hi jong leh aguh doh sa khat ama insung neilegou lah'a aga kimatdoh khah a ahileh ajat leni'a asah kit ding ahi.
22.5: Mihem koihile loulaija gancha alut sah'a lengpi lei ham khat gasoh aneh khah'a ahileh gancha chingtup louva loulaija alha thang jeh'a hichepa chun aloulaija gasoh phapen achu a lepeh teitei ding ahiye.
22.6: Chule Loulai meiyin ahinkah khah'a ling le khao leilah ahin kah jeng'a, chang aki at-lai leh a ki-at loulai mun lah chule loulai chu akah vam lhah jeng tah'a ahile, meihal kong pen pen chun akahvam cheng se aboncha ale sah cheh cheh ding ahiye.
22.7: Tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akoma sum ham thil khat koiding'a angensea ahile, hiche thil chu akoipa insung'a konna aki guhmang khah tah'a ahile hiche gucha pachu akimat matna'a athil guh chengse aboncha ajat nia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
22.8: Amavang hiche guchapa chu akimat doh kha tah louva ahile athil koipa chu alah ham alou ham ti hetchetna ding'a Pathen ang sung'a kipui lut ding ahiye.”
22.9: Ajeh chu kitahsan lelna chung chang kiti phot'a chu bongchal chung chang hihen, sangan chung chang hihen, kelngoi chule ponsil thua hijong le thil kiman sah chung chang thua khat touvin, “Hiche hi keima thil ahi”, hiche hi keima thil ahi titeni chung'a achu athem joh pen hetchetna ding'a Pathen ama-angsung'puilut’a umlhon ding ahi. Amani chu koipen themmo nachang'a Pathen angsung'a konna hetchet ahiteng ajatnia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
22.10: Tun tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akom khat ngansena aneija sangan ahilou le bongchal ham kelngoi ham gancha khat pen pen apeh a ahile, hichu koima muphah nalou munkhat'a akidel mang tai.”
22.11: Hitia chu aumkhah tah le ani gellhon na Yaweh angsung'a kihahselna anei lhon ding ahi. Chu teng gancha neipan jong kihahselna chu anganse jeng ding hiche gancha chu asah lou ding ahi tai.”
22.12: Ahinlah akoipa akonna kigumang anahi khah tah le, gancha koipan aneipa chu phatecha alepeh cheh cheh ding ahi.
22.13: Gamsa hang in atha khah ahitah le hiche hetchetna chu gancha koipan jong avetsah ding, chu teng gancha koipan asah tah lou ding ahi.
22.14: Mi khat touvin asopi khat koma gancha vaiding'a alah ham ahilou leh manchah ding hamma alah'a hiche gancha chu akisuh khah, ahilou leh athi khah tah'a ahile, hiche vang chu bat'a lapan aman phatah'a lepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
22.15: Ahinlah aneipa umpet toh aki tokhah'a ahile alapa chun asah tah lou ding, manpeh ding'a avai ahi jong le avaiman toh akito sah cheh cheh ding ahitai.”
22.16: Pasal toh ki hepha loulai nungah khat chu pasal khat in ajol lhah'a alupi khah'a ahile, Pasal pan jong hiche nungahnu man chu apeh ding chuteng jia anei pai ding ahi.
22.17: Ahinlah nungahnu pan achanu chu hiche pasalpa chu apeh nom hih beh jeng'a ahileh, a lupkhom pipa chun nungah thengho man ki khum peh jat jat bang'a apeh ding ahiye.”
22.18: Nangman numei doithem kiti jong na tha jeng ding ahiye.
22.19: Chule koi hijong le gancha toh lumkhom kitiphot chu tha jeng ding ahiye.
22.20: Koi hijong leu chun Yaweh kom tailouva kilhaina dang nei mihem chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
22.21: Maljin kiti chu adih louva na bol louhel ding, na suhgenthei lou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsung'a maljin ana hisa na hiuve.
22.22: Meithai le chaga jeng jong nangailut ding ahi.
22.23: Amaho na suhgim uva ahile amaho ka heng lama hung diu chuteng keiman amaho taona ka san ding ahi, ati.
22.24: Chuteng ka lungsatna na chung uva hung lhung ding najiteo kasat lhuh gamdiu, nacha teo chaga kisoh gam ding ahiuve, ati.
22.25: Chule na heng na kom'a um ka mite khat tou sum le pai na bat sah ahile, vaichapa chung'a chun sumkol vei tabang'in umdan lang, sum tong jeng jong ama chung'a chu nadel khum lou hel ding ahiye.
22.26: Naheng nakom ponsil khat tou tundoh ding'a nalah'a ahile, nisa leplhah masang'a hiche ponsil chu aneipa na ga lepeh ding ahi.
22.27: Ajeh chu aman hiche bou chu tahsa ponsilla anei ahin, pondang silla imutpi ding anei louva ahin ipi pon akisil ding ham? Keima heng'a hungtao khata henlang hile keiman amachu kangaipeh teitei ding ahi ajeh chu keima hi milainat pi jing kahi,” ati.
22.28: Pathen dou mah nasei thei lou ding chule namite lah'a vaihompa jeng jong gaosapna nabol lou ding ahi.
22.29: Na lhosoh ga le na lengpi gasoh chengse chu lungopkaina neilou hel'a nakat doh jing ding, nachapate lah'a apeng masapen chu keima ding'a na todoh ding ahi, ati.
22.30: Na bongchal le na kelngoi jeng jong hitia chu nabol ding, hiche gancha nou chu nisagi sung'a ahonsung umden jeng ding, ahinlah niget lhin niteng le keima neipeh doh ding ahiye.
22.31: Nangho hi na boncha uva keima dia thensosa mitheng nahi diu chule gamlah'a sahang'in atha sa kiti jong naneh lou hel diuva ahi. Hiche tabang ho chu uicha te neh ding'a napeh diu ahiye.

23.1: Nangman jouthu na sei thei lou ding, muda jeh'a thet umtah hettohsah'a napan thei lou ding ahiye.
23.2: Chule thilse bolding'a mihem chele hojong najui a najop lou hel ding, mipi nung najui louva amaho khat le khat kikah'a them achan theina diuva jong hettohsah'a napan lou ding ahiye.”
23.3: Vaichaho thukitanna jeng ajong pan nalah lou hel ding, sih neina lang neina jeng jong nabol lou ding ahi.
23.4: Chule na melma khat sangan ahi loule bongchal vah mang jong nadon peh lou ding, hiche gancha chu ama heng'a nahin le kailut peh joh ding ahi.
23.5: Nangma doumah bolpa sangan in apot apoh lal tah'a aopkhum ma ahile hichu, na dalhah jeng lou ding, sangan akitho doh theina ding'a na panhu teitei ding ahi joi.
23.6: Vaicha thutanna'a adinmunanna konna achanding dolla thudih chu napam paipeh lou hel ding ahi.
23.7: Jouthu phot'a kinilna le kihehtona chu najam san jeng ding, themmona beija mihem chu natha lou ding, ajeh chu keiman kahenai agiloupa chu them kachan sah him him lou ding ahiye.
23.8: Nehguh chahguh jong nakilah thei lou ding, ajeh chu nehguh kitihi vaihomma pangpan amit asel mang jin chule adih'a pangte chu akhup athal'a alekhup jeng ahi.
23.9: Kholjin mijong na suhgim lou ding, ajeh chu kholjin mihon ichanna lunggel nei uvem ti na hetauve, amaho bang chu nanngho jong Egypt gamma khol jin mi'a nanaum'u ahiye.
23.10: Kum gup sung'a phatah'a na gam sung'a ann-ga natu ding, muchi gasoh na kilokhom ding ahi.
23.11: Kum sagi alhin teng hiche kum sung'a chu nagamsung nakicholdo sahding hiche nangma miten avaicha ho chun aneh diu, louna tong lou beh'a naki chol damsah thei ding, amahon aneh joulou aneh moh chengseo vang chu gamsa hon aneh diuva ahitai. Hiche bang bang'a chu lengpi leilai le Olive chu nabol cheh cheh diu ahi.
23.12: Nigup sung'a hi natoh ding chan natoh ding, chule ni sagi lhinni vang le nasangan jeng jong na choldam sah ding, na bongchal ahin sangan jeng jong choldo thei ding, na sohnu chapa ahin na jin ho jong ki chol do thei diu ahi.
23.13: Naheng uva kasei doh hi nanit jeng jing diu, chule hichengse hi nakam sung uva jong napotdoh sah lou hel diu ahi.
23.14: Kumkhat sung'a keima dinga kut thumvei chan nabol ding ahi.
23.15: Chol solou chang-lhah kut, keiman phat katepeh dung juiya hi ding, Abib lhasung hichu cholsolou changlhah ni sagi sung sea naneh ding hiche lhasung'a hi Egypt gamsung'a kon'a na hung doh na lha ahiye. Hijeh achu khat cha jong keima angsung'a khut goh keuva hung sung lha thei lou ding ahi.
23.16: Loulaija na lhosoh ga amasapen penchu nangman lholhun kut'a ding'a na kat doh jeng ding, hi tabang ma chu lou lai pumpia na lhosoh ga nahin chop khom teng jong le kut nabol ding ahi.”
23.17: Kum khat sung'a namite holah'a pasal'a kai lhah kiti phot chu Yaweh Pathen keima ansung'a thumvei hung ki lah cheh diu ahi.”
23.18: Keima angsung'a kilhaina gancha kithat chu cholsosa changlhah jaona nahin totha thei lou ding, kaheng'a kilhaina sathao jeng jong khovah geija nakoi den lou ding ahi.
23.19: Na leiset ga soh lah'a gamasa pen pen chu na Yaweh na Pathen heng'a na hin poh lut masat pen ding, kelngoi sakithat jeng jong chu api noitwi mangcha'a nahon lou ding ahi.
23.20: Ven! Na chena channa nangma na ventup ding le na lhon pijing ding'in namasang lama vantil khat ka sol peh in ahi.”
23.21: Vantil khu jabol'in lang, athu napal keh thei louding, ama doumah thei himhim nabol lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu aman nasuhkhel channu ngaidam intin, ajeh chu amasung'a khu keima min um jeng'a ahi.
23.22: Aman aseichan lunglut tah'a nangai jing ding, keiman kasei chan nabol'a ahile, namel mate dia melma'a kapan ding, nadoute ding'a adouva pang ding kahi, ati.
23.23: Ka Vantil chu namasang lama lamkai jing ding, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Canaan mite, Hivi mite, chule Jebus mite jouse abonchaova nahin pui teng leh keima tah in abonchauva ka suhmang hel jeng ding ahi, ati.
23.24: Chule mihem in asem thu milim doi pathen ho masang kitia naboh khup lou ding, hicheho ding'a jong chu na kisahlal louhel ding, anatoh bang bang uva jong ima natoh thei lou ding aboncha na phuhlhuh ding, a songkhom tincheng jong na lekhup jeng ding ahiye.
23.25: Na boncha uva na Yaweh Na Pathen nahou uva ama kin jeng na bol diu ahi.” Na boncha uva na Yaweh na Pathen kin jeng a na kisah lel diu, amatah in na changlhah neh diu le na twidon ding jing ujong phatthei aboh ding, chu teng keiman na jalah uva konna phatthei nasa tah ka hin boh ding ahi, ati.”
23.26: Nangma gamsung achu koima aching kal val jong um thei lou ding, ama vang nangma hinkho chu ka suh bukim sel joh ding ahi.
23.27: Na masang tinna mihem ten aki chat thei chan ka ma sol peh ding, kidoupi ding'a nahin tupchan lungsung kasuh mol peh jing ding, chuteng nangma nahin doute jamcheh diu nangma nung lam jeng'a bou khodah diu ahi.
23.28: Na masang'a khoi-ngel te kalha masat peh ding, Hivi mite, Canaan mite, Hit mie abonchauva khoingel ten a delmang hel diu ahi.
23.29: Na masang'a vang amahochu kumkhat sung'a kadel cheh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu gamsung ahomkeu va aum khah le gamsa hungpung lha jeng ding gamsa ten nagma nahin dou khah diuva ahi.
23.30: Nangma na hung pun be jing ding, chuteng amaho khu aloiloija ka del cheh ding ahiuve, ati.
23.31: Na gam gi chu twisan dung len aki pat Palistinete twikhanglen chan hop'a ka kaipeh ding, gamang lah akipat Euphrates vadung channa kakai peh ding nahiye, ajeh chu hiche gamsung ana lo jouse keiman nangho khut a kapeh doh ding, amaho chu nangman jong nadelcheh jeng diu ahiye, ati.
23.32: Amite jouse lah hihen a semthu uva pathen hijong le kitepna neocha jong nanei theilou ding ahi.
23.33: Amaho jouse khu khat jeng cha jong na gamsung'a cheng thei loudiu ahi, ahinlah amaho pathen lim sem thuho kin nabol khah ngai ngaiya ahile vang, hichea chu nasatah'a nangma na kipel lhuh ding ahi, ati.

24.1: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, Yaweh heng lama hung kal touvin nagma chule Aaron chule Nadab ahin, Abihu chule Isarel upate mi som sagi jong jaonan na boncha uva na hung diu ahiye. Gamlha thimma kon in chibai nahin boh diu ahi, ati.
24.2: Mose bouseh Yaweh heng'a hung lut thei ding, adangse vang khat'a khat cha jong Yaweh heng na hin nailut thei lou diu ahiye, hitia chu Mose le mipi aboncha hung kilhon lut thei lou ding ahi, ati.
24.3: Chuin Mose jong akum suh tan Pakaiyin apeh chonna dan thu abonchan mipi ho heng'a aseipeh soh keiyun ahi. Mipin jong ki thutoh tah'in awkhat in adonbut uvin asei uve, “Pakaiyin asei chan chu aboncha kabol diu ahi,” tin asei uve.
24.4: Mose in jong Yaweh thupeh chengse abonchan a sundoh soh keiyin, jingkah matah in athou doh in, molsang chung lama chu Israel phungsom leni bang bang chun, Maicham a keng somleni neikhat asem doh tan ahi.
24.5: Mose'n jong Israel te lah'a gollhang sese a sol tan, ama hon abonchauvin Yawehya din pumgo thil to ahin choi cheh tauvin ahi.
24.6: Mose'n jong thisan phabep pi chu athal in, twibel sung ho achun asung lut in ahi. Chule thisan kehlang khatse chu maicham maija a chap khum in ahi.”
24.7: Chuin Mose'n jong kitepna lekhabu chu ahin choiyin mipi angsung'a chun ahin phongdoh tan ahile, mipi'n jong abonchauvin asei uvin, “Pakaiyin a sei chan aboncha ka bol kimsoh kei uva, chule keiho hin asei chan kangai uva pha tah a ka umdiu ahi” tin asei uve.
24.8: Chuin Mose'n jong thisan phasah khat alan mipiho chu achap khum uvin, aseipeh taove, “vetaovin, Thu kisei doh chengse toh ki saiya Pakaiyin nangho dia hiche thisan hi kitepna asem ahi” ati.
24.9: Hi chengse a kichai jin, Mose, Aaron, Nadab chule abihu jaonan, Israel mite lah'a upa som sagi chu akal tou taovin ahi.
24.10: Abonchauvin Israel mite Pathen chu aga mu tauvin, Pathen keng phang noiya chun Sapphire song jeng keng lampi khat ana um in, athen dan jong van chung vum kihohsel la theng bep bep'in ana um in ahi.
24.11: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel mite chung'a chun doumah abol tapon, Pathen loupina chu nasa tah'in amu tauvin ahile, anneh jong phatah in aki sem un ane uve.
24.12: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei peh in, Molsang chung lama khun keima heng'a hung kal in lang, hiche laimunna chun neina ngah tem in, keiman mipiho heng'a chonna dan ka sei peh chan chu hiche song puma khu ka peh tha ding na hitai, ati.
24.13: Mose jong achetan, alhacha Joshua chu akipuije, chuin Pathen molsang chung lama chun akal tou tan ahi.
24.14: Mose'n jong upa ho heng'a seipeh uvin, “Kei ni naheng uva ka hung kile kit kahse lhona hiche laimun na hi nana umjing diu ahi, Aaron le Hur vang nangho toh na umkhom jing diu, nalah uva koi hile seinom nei chan Amani heng'a che a aga sei ding ahiye, ati.
24.15: Mose jong molsang lama akaltoutan ahile mei lhang in mol chu ahin tomlha jeng tan ahi.
24.16: Hichun Yaweh loupina chu Sinai molsang chung'a ahung kingam jeng tan ahile, nigup sungse hiche molsang chu meilhang in atom in athim lha jeng tai, nisagi lhin nin meibol abonchan ahung kihoh doh tan ahile Pakaiyin Mose ahin kou vin ahi.
24.17: Molsang chung vumma Yaweh loupina ahung kilah jeng chu Israel mite jouse mitmun jong meikong in thil akah vam tabang in amu tauvin ahiye.
24.18: Mose chu Meibang kiheh lah a chun ache lut tan ahile, Mose jong molsang chung vum lama chun nisom li le jan som li a hung umden tan ahi.

25.2: Israel chate jouse heng'a seipeh inlang, keima henglam'a thilto ding adon khom diu, amichang cheh keima ding'a thiltoh doh nom chan in thil hin dong khom cheh uhen, ati.
25.3: Israel chate jouse'a konna na don diu thil ho chu hicheng hi hiding ahite: “Sana, dangka, chule sum eng hiding ahi.
25.4: A eng-dup, asan dup, asan thim, ho leh kelcha vun hose hiding,
25.5: Chule aki jut jolsa kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun jao nan thinggi thing hi ding ahiye.
25.6: Thaomei hoa manchah ding thaotwi jong, kinujol nading thao twi tah jaona hi ding ahi.
25.7: Thempu in aki-O ding leh alengkou chung a a kikhai ding song mantam chu hi ding ahi.
25.8: Chujou teng Israel mite lailung a ka chenna ding muntheng tah khat na sem doh ding ahi.
25.9: Houbuh le asunga thilkeo ding ho aboncha ka vet sah ding hiche dung jui'a chu na bol diu ahiye, ati.
25.10: Israel miten thinggi thing mangcha'a thingkong khat asem diu hichu, adung tongni, tong keh khatna sao hi ding, avai tongkhat le tongkeh'a sao chu asem ding u ahiye.
25.11: Thingkong chu asung ahin apo sana a natom jol ding, agei gol jong sana a natom jol ding ahi.
25.12: Hiche thingkong'a manchah ding achu sana chao kol li nalhah jun ding, chaokol ni chu thingkong pang lang khat'a akeng teni chung'a na khai ding, khat teni machu alang khat teni chung'a na khai lhah ding ahiye.
25.13: Nangman thinggi chu mol lhon ni tah nasui ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu anigella sana twiya natom jolsel ding ahi.
25.14: Hiche mol lhon teni chu kong putna kimang thing ahin hichu apang lang khat'a chaokol teni sung'a chu nathol lut cheh cheh ding ahiye.
25.15: Mol lhon teni chu thingkong pang a chaokol ki khai lha teni sung'a chu aputna dia kikhai den jing ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu koi macha gache a aga sut lhah lou hel ding ahiye.
25.16: Hiche thingkong sung keiman ka peh ding hettoh sahna chu na khum lut ding ahi, ati.
25.17: Sana touna chu na lah ding hiche a chu ngailut hepi touna khat na sem doh ding, hichu avai tongkhat le tong keh'a hi ding ahi.
25.18: Nangman jong sana cherub ni nasem ding hichu ngailut hepi touna among lang tenia nakhet beh ding ahiye.
25.19: Amang lang khat'a ding chu cherub khat nasem teitei ding, ngailut hepi touna among lama ding'a na boncha uva Cherub nasem cheh cheh diu ahi.
25.20: Cherub lha teni chung ani gel'a a chunglam angat lhon ding, alhate nichun ani gel'a ngailut hepi touna chu alekhu teitei lhon ding ahi.
25.22: Hiche mun na chu keiman nang ka hin kimu peding, Ngailut hepi touna le hettoh sahna thingkong chung'a um Cherub teni kikah achu keiman Israel chate ding'a thil man lutah ka sei ding hichu keiman thu peh'a kapeh ding nahiye, ati.
25.23: Thinggi thing na manchah ding hichu dokhang khat na sem ding, adung tong nia sao hi ding, avai lang tong khat hi ding, atun tong khat le akeh sao hi ding ahi.
25.24: Hiche dokhang chu sana thengsella phatah'a natom khum ding, apam jouse aboncha sana keu seh'a natom peh ding ahi.
25.25: Dokhang kim vel'a chu a kol'a kiveithei ding ban jang toh ki bang'a lenkhat na kaikol ding, hiche akim vel'a kivei kol jong chu sana'a kijem lhah ding ahiye.
25.26: Dokhang'a manchah ding sana chaokol li nasem ding, hiche chaokol li chu dokhang keng ningli hosea chu naba peh ding ahi.
25.27: Dokhang kol kimvel chule chaokol hose chu kimatsoh kei ding, dokhang chu akijon teng le hiche chaokol ho achu thing jol thil lut ding chu teng kipuding ahi.
25.28: Thinggi thing phatah'a moljol phasah pikhat nasui nam ding hichengse chu sana'a natom jol ding, moljol hosese chu dokhang jon na le a kimang ding ahi.
25.29: Lheng kong phasah pikhat na koi ding, lengpi twi sunlut nathei lheng le hai khat jong nakoi tha ding ahiye; hichu aboncha sana a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
25.30: Hiche bang bang'a chu nangman jong keima ka umjing nai ti photchetna ding'a dokhang chung'a keima changlhah na koi jing ding ahi, ati.
25.31: Sana keu seh'a kisem thaomei khom khat nasem ding, thaomei tunna ding'a akhom chu sehcha'a na khet beh ding, akhon hose le alu langse chule pahcha a kijem chengse aboncha thakhat chat'a kigom khom ding ahi.
25.32: Thaomei phung ajet le avei apat abah gup hung um doh ding, thaomei pang lang khat a abah thum hung um doh ding chule khat lang'a ma chu abah thum hung kisep doh ding ahi.
25.33: Hiche abah khat cheh apat chu thingga jom'a kisem doh bang'a khon thum chule aluchang umdoh ding, hichea pahcha jouse jong jaonan, hiti chun thaomei phung'a kon chun abah ahung jam doh'in ahi.
25.34: Thaomei khomjong chu thingga ajom bang bang'a kisem khon li ahin alulam jaonan apahcha jouse chutoh ajao vin ahi.
25.35: Thaomei phung'a kon hung jamdoh abah gup chengse chu aluchang lamtoh thakhat chat'a hung soh doh tha ding ahiye.
25.36: A lulam se ho chu toh thaomei chu thakhat chat'a hung um ding, thaomei pumpi chu sehcha a kideng toh chet chet hiding, hichu sana theng sel'a kimang cha hiding ahi.
25.37: Hichea det kong ding'a thaomei sagi na sem ding, amalam salvah dia hiche thaomei sagi ho chu tun doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
25.38: Amei kong at tan na ding choi che ahin adop na kong tong aboncha sana twiya kisem jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
25.39: Hichea kimangcha thilkeo jouse chu aboncha sana thengset a kisem cheh cheh ding ahi.
25.40: Ven! hiche ho jouse hi aboncha molsang chunga alim nakimusah bang bang a nasem doh ding ahi, ati.

26.1: Nangman nasah ding houbuh chu tupet pon'a kikhong hiding, pondal som khat'a nasah ding, pondum chule pon pol them naman khom ding, pondal chengse chu Cherub ho lim hoitah'a kisem bang'a nakhai cheh cheh ding'u ahiye. Hichengsea chu houbuh nasah ding ahi.
26.2: Pondal tinchang chu adung tong som ni le tong get'a len le sao hiding, pondal khat cheh vang chu tong li cheh hiding, pondal kiti phot aboncha adung avai alet le aneo dan kibang cheh cheh ding ahiye.
26.3: Pondal nga chengse vang chu kigom soh keiding chule alang khat'a pondal nga jong chu kigom soh kei ding ahi.
26.4: Pondal masa chengse chu aninggol hoa akol kol'a tampi patdum'a nasem ding, hichebang bang'a chu pondal gol niloilah'a apam nung pen pondal gol lah'a chu abil nasut hom ding akol kola tampi nasem doh ding ahi.
26.5: Pondal kimkhat chu abil navu hom pehding akol kol somnga nasem peh ding, chule pondal kolni lhinna gollah ajong abil navu ding akoljong somnga jen nasem peh ding ahi. Akol navu hom chengse chu amacheh lhing'a toding ahi.
26.6: Sana kol somnga nasem ding, hiche sana sumkol ho achu pondal chengse chu na kaimat cheh cheh ding, chuteng houbuh thil hojouse kigom khomma houbuh khat'a nasah doh ding ahi.
26.7: Houbuh chung khuna ding nangman kelcha mul'a kikhong pon phabep naman chah ding, agoma ding'a pondal somle khat nasem ding ahiye.
26.8: Pondal khat'a tongsom'a sao hi ding chule avai tong li cheh hiding, hiche pondal som le khat se chu aboncha alet le aneo dan kibang chet ding ahi.
26.9: Pondal ngaho vang chu nakil mat soh kei ding, adang pondal gup jong na kilmat soh keiya, agup channa pondal vang chu ponbuh maiya chu na khu ding ahi.
26.10: “Chule pondal golmasa pen chu apam chin lah'a akol somnga jen nasem ding, pondal golni channa jong chu aning gol hoa akol somnga mama navu hom ding ahi.”
26.11: Nangman sum eng somnga jen na sem ding, sumkol hose chu aboncha pondal kol navu hom hoa chu nathil lut ding, ajeh chu ponbuh chu khatseh'a akitun doh na ding'a na kaimat soh kei ding ahiye.
26.12: Chule ponbuh'a pondal amoh chengse chu, houbuh ponbuh nunglama chu nakailhah sah cheh cheh ding ahi.
26.13: Ponbuh kisahna'a amoh chengse ho chu alang khat'a hihen khat lang a hijong le, houbuh lang to gella ding'a tongkhat cheh kikhai lhasuh ding ahi.
26.14: “Hiche ponbuh khu nading'a chu nangman jong kelgnoi chal vun le kelcha vun nemlai jeng naman chah ding ahiye.
26.15: Houbuh'a manchah thil ho chu nanagman thinggi thing jol namsella nasem cheh cheh ding ahi.
26.16: Kol khat'a naman chah ding chu tongsom hiding, akol khat ding chu avai tongkhat'a sao le tong keh hiding ahi. Akol khatna tongsom hiding, chule akol khat ding chu avai tong khat le tong keh hiding ahi.
26.17: Hiche thing kol khat cheh chu among lang'a abil navu hom peh cheh ding, houbuh thing kol jouse chu aboncha abil nahoi peh cheh cheh ding ahi.
26.18: Houbuh ding'a thing kol nasem peh ding chule lhang lamma dingse chu aboncha thing kol som cheh hiding ahi.
26.19: Thing kol khat cheh le among lang suhmat nading'a chu, thingkol som in chung'a pansa ding'a abil hom somin nadinga'a dangka'a kisem abiltom somli nasem ding, thingkol khat among lang'a chu asuh mat nathei ding abil tom ni cheh nasem peh ding ahi.
26.20: A golni channa houbuh chung lamkaiya pang ding chu thingkol som nia nasem ding ahi.”
26.21: Dangka'a kitomjol abil somli hiding, thing kol khat mong lang'a pang ding chu abil tomni hiding chule thingkol lang khat'a pansa ding jong chu abil tomni mama hi ding ahi.
26.22: Lhumlam nga'a houbuh nunglama pang ding chu thing kol gup nasem peh ding ahi.
26.23: Chule houbuh nunglama'a pang dia abiltomma ding'a ni mama na sem peh ding ahiye.
26.24: Hiche thing kol teni chu anoi lam douva pang lhon ding, chule a lulam'a vang chu chaokol masapen chutoh adangho kaimat na a pang ding ahi. Hiche teni chu aning koltenia pang ding mong mong ahiye.
26.25: Dangka a kisem abil tom hojouse chu a gomma thingkol get hi ding, abil tom aboncha somle get lhing ding ahi; thingkol khat a pang ding chu abikol tom hi ding, anoija pang ding ma chu abiltom ni mama hi ding ahiye.
26.26: Houbuh lang khatna thingkol chengsea vang chu thinggi'a kisui nam kotgol nga nasem ding ahi.
26.27: Hichu houbuh lang khat'a thingkol hose avaiya pang ding'a nga nasem ding, chule houbuh nunglama lhum lama pansa dinga agol'a jam ding'a ngama nasui ding ahi.
26.28: Chule thing kol chengse chu akimlaija pang ding'a alailha pen chu among langto gella ding'a pang ding ahi.”
26.29: Hiche thingkol chengse chu aboncha sana'a natomjol selding chaokol hojouse jong chu aboncha sana ‘a natom jol ding, agola kijam jouse jong chu sana mama'a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
26.30: Molsang chung'a houbuh na kimu sah bang bang'a na tundoh teitei ding ahi.
26.31: Chu teng houbuh chu pondum, ponsandup chule ponsan pol thim naman chah ding ponbuh chu nakhu ding, tupat ponnem ma ki khong naman chah tei teija; hiche pon ho chu aboncha khut a kikhong cheh cheh hiding, cherub lim bang'a kikhong ding ahi.
26.32: Chule aponchu sana akitom jol hiding thinggi thing'a kisui khom li chung'a hiding, abilkol a kol li ho achu na khai lhah cheh ding ahi.
26.33: Alukhuh asumkol hochu na khai lhah cheh cheh ding, hettohsahna thingkong jong chu pon lukhuh noija chu nahin koi ding ahiye; hichu pon lukhuna akonna chu mungtheng chung nung nga konna chu muntheng laichu na sem khen diu ahi.”
26.34: Chu teng het-tohsah na thing kong muntheng laiya chu hepi touna khat na do ding ahi.
26.35: Pon lukhuna polama achu dokhang khat nasem ding houbuh lhang lama dokhang toh kinga to lhon ding akimlai tah achu thao Meivah natun ding ahi; hiche dokhang chu sahlam sang a nadoh doh ding ahi.”
26.36: Ponbuh kot maiya ding chu pon dum leh pon sendup chule ponsan pol thim. Tupat pon nemma heojang pahcha jem kijepna hoa bou nasem peh ding ahi.
26.37: Pondah na ding'a thinggi khom nga nasui ding, hichengse chu aboncha sana a natom jolsel ding, akikhai lhah nading thihkol chengse jong sana twiya kisem jeng hiding, abil tom nga jong chu sum eng jenga nasem cheh cheh ding ahiye, ati.

27.1: Chule maicham ding'a thinggi thing naman chah ding, maicham chu bempel'a kisem hi ding, hichu tong nga'a sao hiding, maicham chu abem pilla kisem hiding, asan lam vang chu tong thumma kisem ding ahi.”
27.2: Maicham gol'a pang ding'a aki li na sem ding, aki sese chu maicham toh kigom khom cheh ding, hiche aki chengse chu sana'a natom jolsel ding ahi.
27.3: Vutvam ho lo doh nading'a bel phabep khat na sem ding, khe keh jong phabep khat nasui ding, twibel jong chule sumkhe jong nasem ding khangbel phabep khat jong nasem ding, manchah thilkeu jouse chu aboncha sum eng jeng a kisem hicheh cheh ding ahi.
27.4: Maicham'a pansa ding chu kipheh chah kheh khat nasem ding, hichu len pheh'a kipheh chah kheh bang a na sem ma achunga chu sum eng koli jen na koi ding ahiye.
27.5: Hichu maicham thinggi jol noija chu na koi ding, hitia chu lenpheh'a kipeh chah kheh chu akimlai tah'a hung kijung lhah ding ahiye.
27.6: Maicham putna ding'a moljol ni nasem ding hichu thinggi jeng na sem ding aboncha sana'a na tom jolsel ding ahi.
27.8: Hichu thingpel tabang'a nasem ding, alai nahom sah ding, molsang lama na kimusah bang a aboncha na bol sohkei ding ahi.
27.9: Houbuh munlaise chu pal naget khum cheh cheh ding, lhang lama pang ding pondal kikhai lha chengse chu tupat pon nemma kikhong hiding hichu pondal tong jakhat a sao naman chah ding ahi.
27.10: Akikhai lhah na ding khom jong agomma somni hiding, aboncha keija sum eng jeng'a kisem hiding ahiye. Akhompi'a pang ding le aning lah'a chengse vang chu aboncha dangka a kisem cheh cheh hi ding ahi.
27.11: Pal kigen sah lamse'a chu pondal na khai lhung kei ding, aboncha sum eng jeng jakhat'a kikhai lha'a nasem ding, akhom ning dung'a pang thih koi chengse le alutom ho jouse aboncha dangka'a na sem peh ding ahi.
27.12: Nilhum lama pang pal kigen avaiya um chengse chu somnga jeng na khailhah ding, khompi som khat se chu atunlut nadinga somkhat cheh kisem ding ahi.
27.13: Nisom lama pal kigen maiya chu avai lang pang tong somnga nasem ding ahi.
27.14: Kelkot'a pat alang khat sese a pondal vangchu tong som le tong nga'a sao ding, atun nading khom phung thum toh khomko thum hitha teitei ding ahi.
27.15: Alang khat'a pang ding pondal jonchu tong som le tong nga hiding, akhom pi phung thum jaona atunna ding thum toh hitha ding ahi.
27.16: Kelkot'a pang ding pondal chu tong somni jen hiding, pon sen-ao thim leh pondup chule ponsandup thim hichu tupet pon nemma ki khong hi ding, hichu phatah'a na jep pol cheh cheh diu ahiye.
27.17: Pal kiget'na a pang khom jouse chu aboncha dangka jeng'a na jep ding, khom phung chengse vang chu sum eng'a kijem hiding ahi.
27.18: Pal kigen chu tong jakhat lhing ding, a vailam chu tong somnga jen hi ding, asan lam vang chu tong nga hi ding ahiye; hichengse chu aboncha tupat pon nemma ki khong jeng kikhai lha ding ahi.
27.19: Hiche thil manchah jouse chu aboncha keiya, thil khaina jouse hihen lang, pal geiya ki khailha ding jouse hi jong le abon chakeija sum-eng jeng'a kisem naman chah diu ahiye.
27.20: Nangman Israel chate ho thu na peh ding, amahon Olive'a ki ladoh thaomei thengsel chu ahin choi uva; a Ima tih channa kivah vah jeng ding a thaomei chu ahin tundoh diuva ahi.
27.21: Kikhopna ponbuh sung ahin, chule het-tohsahna ponbuh mailam ma Aaron le achapaten hiche thaomei chu nilhah lama pat jingkah khovah chan geiya, Yaweh angsung a akisah lal peh diu ahi.” Hichengse hi aboncha Israel chate ding a akhang akhang lhung keiyuva anit jing diu le chonna dan a aneijing diu ahiye.

28.1: Israel chate lah'a kon in chien lang nasopipa Aaron le a chapate chengse khu ka heng a hinpui in; amaho chengse khu keima thempu a pang ding ahiuve, Aaron le Aaron chapate, Nadab le Abihu chule Eleazar le Ethamar, hi chengse chu hi diu ahi.
28.2: Na sopipa Aaron ding'a khu nangman aloupi na ding le amel hoi nading'a akivon nading nagon peh ding ahiye.
28.3: Keiman nangma lungthim ahin chule tha ka peh chengse aboncha thilbol theina jousea chu thu nasei doh ding, chu teng amahon Aaron kivon na ding'a von tamtah akhon diu, amachu keima themo pua pang ding a thensona um ding ahiye.
28.4: Akivon na ding'a akhon peh diuva pon chu hicheng hi ahiye: Ompho a ding khat, kongah na ding khat, sangkhol chol khat, thempu natoh na ding a sangkhol achol khat le aponung a ding khatma, delkop'a ding khat, taigah na ding khat jaona hichu keima ding mong mong'a thempua pang ding na sopipa Aaron le a chapate din von theng chu kimsel la agon peh diu ahi.
28.5: Sana jong, pondum chule ponsandup jaona pon san pol thim hichu tupat ponnem ma kikhong chu amanchah diu ahi.”
28.6: Konggah'a pang dia sana, patdum, ponsandup, patsan polthim khut tem na nei tah'a kikhong hichu tupet ponemma asem peh cheh cheh ding'u ahi.
28.7: Hichu aki jotmat na ding'a among lam teni alengkouva hung kikhai lhathei jong asem peh ding'u ahi.
28.8: Khut themna neitah'a kikhon pet chu ahin, kong'a kigah ding jong, konggah'a kigah ding'a kisem ki mang cha jat chengse chu akisem bang bang'a khut soh tah mong'a kisem hi ding, sana jaona, pat dum, patsan dup chule pansan pol thim, hichengse chu aboncha tupat ponnem ma kikhong cheh cheh ding ahi.
28.9: Nangman song mantam ni na lah ding, Hiche songman tam ni chung a chu Israel chate ama ama min cheh nakhet lut ding ahi.
28.10: Song mantam khat penna chu amin'u gup nakhet beh ding chule, amoh chengse hoding achu gupma ma khat joh'a chu nakhet peh diu ahi, hichea chu amin jouse ama ama cheh pen dungjuiya nakhet peh cheh cheh diu ahi.
28.11: Sana kheng them pan khut jem hoa thil hoitah a akhet them bang'a nangman jong songman tam chung'a chu Isarel chate min jouse na khet pol peh soh kei uva, na khet polna chan chu aboncha sana twiya nasun jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
28.12: Hichu song mantam teni chu Israel chate ding'a het jingna ding'a kong gah teni among geiya agen tenia chu na suh beh den ding; Aaron injong Israel chate het jing na ding'a amin jouse'u alengkou chung vumma apoh'a Yaweh heng'a apoh lut peh diu ahi.
28.13: Sana khut thempa akonna jong nasem ding sana thengsel'a kisem sana jang ni jong khaokol veija kivei bang'a na sem ding ahi.
28.14: Hiche khao veija kivei sana chu na jopmat cheh cheh ding ahiye.
28.15: Nangman thutanna munna akivonna ding ompho jong chu khut them tah'a nasem peh teitei ding, konggah kisem na bang bang'a nasem ding ahi; sana jong, patdum, patsan dup, patsan polthim chule hiche jong chu tupat pon nemma ki sem'a na sem peh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
28.16: Nangman ompho khat nasem ding hichu, aning li chule hichu thoni hiding adung khapkhat chule avai jong khap khat ma hi ding ahiye.
28.17: A kimlaija gol lia song na gol ding chule amasa'a na gol ding chengse chu Sardis song hiding; Topaz song aiha song jong hiding ahi.
28.18: Gol nina a pang ding hochu ahile, Emerald Song, sapphire song chule diamond song hiding ahi.
28.19: Gol thum lhinna pang ding hochu ahile; Jacinth song, Agate song chule Amethyst songhi ding ahi.
28.20: Golli channa ding chu ahi leh, Beryl song, Onyx song, Jesper songhi cheng chu ahiye; aboncha sana twija chap nou ding ahi.”
28.21: Song som leni chu ama ama mincheh dungjuiya Israel te khat khat cheh toh umtha ding; hiche bang bang achu Israel phung somleni ho chu songkhat cheh chu toh Mohor kinam den tha ding ahiuve.
28.22: Nangman jong omphoa man chah ding in sana thengsel khao jang bang'a kiheh'a na sem ding ahi.
28.23: Ompho'a manchah ding'a sana kaokol nijong nasem ding, hiche chaojong teni chu ompho ning'a bupeh ding ahi.
28.24: Hiche chaojang kol teni sung'a chu sana khaojang chu nathillut ding ahiye.
28.25: Hiche chaokol teni among lam akolsung'a patjang nathil lut ding; konggah teni masang lama chu um ding ahi.”
28.26: Sana chaokol ni nasem ding; hiche chaokol ompho agei tenia chule hiche teni chu ompho sung lama kon ageichanna konggah bantah a nathil lut ding ahi.
28.27: Hitia chu sana chaokol nijong nasem tha ding, hiche chaokol teni konggah lengkouva ki khailhahna noilang chule amasang lama na suhmat peh ding; kong gah ding a kisem hoitah chunga chu kikhai mat ding ahiye.
28.28: Ama hon patdum a manchah diu hichu omphoa chaokol sung tenia chu athil doh paijel ding u ahiye; hiche konggah a chaokol teni toh chun athil mat ding u, khut them na tah a kisem konngah chu toh asuh mat chat diu, ompho le konggah chu kikhen louva umjing ding ahi.
28.29: Hichu Aaron injong Yaweh angsunga alut teng, Israel chate asuh mil louva, thutanna'a kivonna ompho achu Israel chate mincheng apoh jing ding ahi.
28.30: Hiche thutanna ompho chung achu Urim le Thummin chu adal na naman chah ding, Yaweh ang sunga na lut teng hiche teni chu Aaron chunga kikhai den ding, Aaron in jong hichu Israel chate thutanna Yaweh angsunga alut teng apoh ji ding ahi.
28.31: Thempu hon konggah a manchah cheng chu pondum jeng a nakhon peh ding ahi.
28.32: Hiche sangkhol chol a chu luchang hetlut nading ahomkhat na sem ding ahi. Hiche sangkhol chol achu luchang hetlut na ding ahom khat anei ding; Sangkhol dang bang'a angaija a ngong kol kimvelse chu pha tah'a ki pheh chah ding ahi.
28.33: Sangkhol gei jouse aboncha ajem asan le adup a hi ding, asan-ao thim hichu kolbu theiga bang bang a nasem ding; kolbu thei lim a kisem chengse chu aboncha sana jeng a nasem a agei mong se a naum sah ding ahi.”
28.34: Sana chao khat naba na munna chu kolbuthei lima kisem khat cheh um ding, sangkhol chol gei lhung keija sana chao chu na ba peh ding hichu kolbu thei ga limma kisem khat cheh hi ding ahi.
28.35: Aaron in Hou-In sunga kin anei teng hiche sangkhol chol chu akiah ding, Yaweh ansunga alut pat hihen ahung potdoh hijong leh hiche chao jang chu agin kija jeng ding, hichu akijah khah louva ahile athi a hi ding ahi.
28.36: Sana theng set'a apheng khat na sem ding, Achung'a chu Mohor kijem bang'a Pakaiyin athenso ahitai tia ajem khat nakhet ding'a ahi.
28.37: Sana pheng chu pat jang adum khat a delkop'a na kan chah peh ding, adelkop chu amai lam ama sang lang'a aki tah ding ahi.
28.38: Sana pheng chu Aaron chal pang'a kitah jing ding, Aaron in jong Israel chaten thil theng ato ding chengse'u a thensoa chule themmona hung lut kha photphot chu hichu ama cheh in mona atahsa chung a akipoh ding, Yaweh angsung'a santhei dol ahi na ding'a Aaron in jong achalpanga kitah jing ding ahi.
28.39: Hiche sangkhol chol chu tupet pom nemma na khon peh ding, delkop jing jong tupet ponnem ma na khon peh ding konggah jeng jong heu jang khatna khut themmna neitah mikhat in apheh peh ding ahi.
28.40: Chuteng nang man Aaron chapate jouse chu aloupi na diu le a vethoina diuva sangkhol ahin, konggah ahin, lukhuh ho jong na gonpeh cheh cheh diu ahi.
28.41: Hiche von hose chu na sopipa Aaron ahin chule a chapate chengse na von peh ding, thempua pang diu keima kin'a akisah lal na diuva thao na nu soh kei ding ahi.
28.42: Nangman jong amaho se chu atahsa gohkeovu a kidal na diuva sangkhol chol na choh peh cheh cheh ding u ahiye; hiche sangkhol chol sese chun akong uva pat akhu jal channu akhu khum cheh cheh ding ahi.
28.43: Aaron le achapate hochu kikhop khomna ponsunga ahunglut'u hihen, muntheng munna kinbol maicham phung ahin nailut pet'u hijong leh hiche delchol chengse chu a ki-ah soh kei diu ahi; achuti louva ahile amaho le amaho themmo akipoh lut uva hicheng toh chun thina ato tha khah diu ahi. Hiche dan chengse hi Aaron le ama nung a ason a chilhhahte ding geija chonna dan hi jing ding ahi tai, ati.

29.1: Nangman keima thempua pang dia hiteho hi na thenso teng le hicheng hi nabol peh cheh cheh ding ahi. Bongchal khat le kelngoi chal khat nahin mat ding ahi.
29.2: Chu teng cholso lou chang lhah lhon phabep jao na hi ding, hicheng chu thao toh kihelsa jeng hi ding ahi. Chule chol solou changlhah neldisel thao thoh kihel tha hi ding hiche ho chu aboncha suhlou chang bong akon na lah doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
29.3: Hiche hojouse chu aboncha pucha khat a nakhum lut cheh cheh ding, apucha puma chu nahin todoh ding chuteng bongchal golpai le kelngoi chal na hin kai lut tha pai pai ding ahiye, ati.
29.4: Chule nangman Aaron le achapa te chengse abonchauva kotpi phung maiya na hin puilut soh kei uva, abonchauva twiya nasil ngim soh kei ding ahi.
29.5: Chu teng nagman ponsil hochu na gah lah ding, Aaron chu sangkhol chol a kisem chule konggah chu navon peh ding; hitia chu konggah chu nagah peh ding, ompho jong navon peh ding, konggah ding a khut themna tah a kipheh chu nagah peh ding ahiye.
29.6: Aluchang'a delkop na kop peh ding, hiche delkop chunga chu lukhuh theng na khuh peh ding ahi.
29.7: Chuteng tahsa chunga nuding thao chu na lah'a Aaron chu nanu khum ding ahi.
29.8: Chule hichu na bol chai teng le a chapate ho chu na hin puilut pai dng abonchauva sangkhol chol chu na ah peh soh kei diuva ahi.
29.9: Amaho chengse jong chu konggah nagah peh cheh cheh ding, hichu thempu hina beitih nei louva ama hon achonna dan a ahin cheh pe jing ding ahiuvin. Nangman Aaron le a chapate chu thempua pang ding na suh det ding ahi.
29.10: Chu teng nangman kikhop na in maiya chu bong chal nahin kailut pai ding, hiche bongchal luchung nga chu Aaron le achapate cheng in akhut angap lhah cheh diu ah.
29.11: Hiche bongchal chu Yaweh angusng a natha ding ahiye.
29.12: Chule bongchal thisan chu na khut jung na dekot ding hichu selki hoa chu naloi nat cheh ding ahiye, gan thisan amoh chengse vang chu maicham maiya chu nasun lhah ding ahi.
29.13: Bongchal sathao jouse ahin, chule athin, akel tenia athao jouse jong nalha doh ding hichengse chu aboncha maicham chung a na go vam hel ding ahi.
29.14: Hiche bongchalsa chu avun ahin chule a eh chengse chu pam lam ma meiya na go vam mang ding ahi; ajeh chu chonset kithoina ahiye.
29.15: Chujou teng nangman kelngoi achal sang nei khat na hin kailut paipai ding, Chu teng Aaron le achapate ho jousen hiche kelngoi achal luchung'a chu akhut angap lhah cheh ding u ahi.
29.16: Chuteng nangman kelngoi chal chu natha ding, athisan phabep khat na lah ding maicham maiya akimvel lah achu nathe khum soh kei ding ahi.
29.17: Kelngoi chal sa chu na sem ding, asung jouse jaona akeng jeng jong nasop ngim soh ding chule hitia chu asa na sem sa chengse leh a luchang jaona hichengse chu ki tupchet a na koi ding ahi.
29.18: Hiche kelngoi chal sa chu aboncha maicham ma na go vam hel ding ahiye. Hichu Yawehya dia pumgo thilto ahin, chule agimnamtui sel hichu lung lhaisah nading ahin, Yawehya dia meiya govam hel ding ahi.
29.19: Hichu aki chai chai le kelngoi chal khat ma na kai lut kit ding Aaron le achapa ten jong kelngoi chal chunga chu akhut angap lhah cheh diu ahi.
29.20: Chu teng kelngoi chal chu na tha ding, Athisan phabep na lah doh ding, Aaron bilkol jet lama nanu nat peh ding, chule akhut jetlamma akhutpi chense jaona akeng jetlamma khutpi chung jousea jong nanu nat peh cheh cheh ding ahi; chuteng athisan moh chengse chu maicham maiya nathe khum ding ahi.
29.21: Maicham chung a thisan phabep le thao kinu thei chu na lah ding Aaron ponsil cheng chung a chu na sun khum ding ahi; hitia chu Aaron le aponsil chengse kithenso a atheng a um ding, ama ahin chule a chapate jeng jong ki thenso na chang ding atheng a umjing ding ahitauve.
29.22: Nangman jong kelngoi chal sa thao chengse ahin, chule amei thao ahin asung thao le amei thao ho ahin amel jetlam toh nalah tha ding ahiye; hichu ki suhdet na ding'a kelngoi chal ahi.
29.23: Changlhah phengkhat ahin thao toh kihelsa chang lhah khat na lah ding, chang lhah pheng khatma toh nalah tha ding, hichu Yaweh angsunga chol solou changlhah pucha sung a umho a konna chu na lah doh ding ahi.
29.24: Hichengse chu Aaron le achapate khutna na peh doh ding, aboncha chu Yaweh angsunga thilpeh ding a na koi jing ding ahi.
29.25: Chuteng Aaron ahin chule achapate ho a konna na lelah doh kit ding, Yaweh angsung maicham chunga chu nale halvam cheh cheh ding ajeh chu Yaweh adia govam thilpeh khat a ki sim ahi.
29.26: Chule Aaron ki suhdet na kelngoi chal op-phang chu na lah ding, hichu Yaweh angsunga thilto dinga na todoh ding, hichu nangma na chan vou a paimang ding ahi.
29.27: Hiche thilto chu thempu ho chan ding chule amal toh chule ki suhdet na ding a kitoh doh ding chengse jaona Aaron le achapate chan ding ahi jeh a then sona na sem peh ding ahi.
29.28: Hichengse chu Aaron le a chapate jouse ding a akhang akhanga Israel chaten apeh cheh ding uva bat a anei cheh diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel cha ten chamna thil ahin to doh ding u hichu Aaron le achapate chan ding ahi. hichu Amaho jouse dia Yawehya thil to ding ahiye.
29.29: Aaron kivonna ponsil chengse chu ama khang akichai teng achapate chan vou ding ahin, thao akinu uva hichu ki suhdetna a anei jing ding u ahi.
29.30: Aaron umna munna achapa thempua pang ding pen pen chun kikhopna ponbuh sunga ahung sung lhah ding teng; ni sagi sungsea hiche vontheng chu aki von jing ding ahi.
29.31: Nangman jong kelngoichal ki suhdeh na chu na hin puiya, asa chu muntheng lai khat a naga hon min ding ahi.
29.32: Chuteng Aaron le achapaten kelngoi chalsa le pucha sung a kikoi chang lhah chengse chu aneh khom diu ahi.
29.33: Hichengse chu kisem hoina ding le kisem toh na pang ding, ajeh chu hiche thil jouse chu aboncha atheng sa ahi tai.
29.34: Chu jong leh ki suhdet na sa moh ham changlhah moh ham khat jingkah khovah geiya aum khah a ahile; nangman hiche ho chu meiya na govam cheh ding ahiye, hichu koiman aneh thei lou ding ahi.
29.35: Keiman nangma ka thupeh bang bang a hi Aaron le achapa ten abolna diuva na hil chah soh kei diu ahi, nisagi sungse amaho chu na suhdet ding ahi.
29.36: Aniseh le ki suhdihna dinga chonset thilto a pang dia bongchal khat na kat doh jing ding, hichu na bol teng nangman maicham sunga konna chonset suhmang thei na dinga, maicham chu thao nanu cheh cheh ding, thensona na nei ding ahiye.
29.37: Ni sagi sungsea nangman ki suhdetna maicham nasem jing ding, hichu maicham lah a atheng chung nung penna kisim ding ahin; ipi hi jong le hiche maicham sukha phot phot chu atheng aum jing ding ahi.
29.38: Maicham chunga na thilto ding chu hicheng hi jing ding ahiye: Anisih a tanglou hel ding a kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal ni na kat doh jing ding ahi.”
29.39: Kelngoinou chu jingkah simma na kat doh jing ding chule kelngoinou dang khat chu nilhah lang a na kat doh ji ji ding ahi.
29.40: Kelngoinou kikat doh masa pachu ahin chang bong nel hopkhat a kitena hopsom jaona akiheh lhasa thaotwi khon dimkhat hopli a kihom hopkhat jaona, kilhaina ding a khon dimkhat hoplia kihom khat jaona hi ding ahi.
29.41: Jingkah lama natoh bang bang chu nilhah lamma jong kelngoi chal khat na todoh ding ahin; kelgnoi chal aki toh doh jaona chule chang thil ki todoh chu ahin, don ding a thilto jong na jaosah ding; Hichu Yawehya dia gim namtui tah pumgo thilto a ki mang cha ding ahi.
29.42: Hi chengse hi na khang khang uva pumgo thilto a naman jing ding u ahi. hichu kikhop khomna ponbuh maiya na bol jing diu ahin, chu teng keiman nangma hiche kotpi phung maiya chu najah a thu ka sei peh ding nahiye.
29.43: Hiche mun laitah achu keiman jong Israel chate ka kimu pi ding, keima loupi nan amun chu asuh theng jing ding ahi.
29.44: Keiman jong ki khopkhomna ponbuh leh maicham ka suhtheng ding, Aaron leh a chapate ahin thempu a pang dia ka suhtheng ding ahiye.
29.45: Hichu teng leh Israel chate lah a kachen ding, amaho dinga keima hi a Pathen u ka hi jing ding ahiye, ati.
29.46: Chu teng keima hi amaho jouse Yaweh le Pathen ka hi jing ding, alah uva ka chen jing na ding a amaho hi keiman Egypt gam'a konna ka hin pui galkai uva ahi; ti ahin hetdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi Yaweh dih tah amaho hin puidoh pachu ka hi, ati.

30.1: Nang man gim-namtui kihalnam jing a maicham na sem ding ahiye, hiche maicham chu thinggi thing a na sem ding ahi.
30.2: Maicham chu adung tongkhat asao ding chule avai jong tongkhat a sao hi ding, a ning li um ding; a tunjong tongni a sao ding, hiche a kimang saki ho jong chu maicham toh thakhat'a um tha cheh cheh ding ahi.
30.3: Maicham chung lang chule ajet le avei a kimvel sese ahin saki ho jaonan, aboncha sana thengsel'a na tom jol ding, a kimvel jouse chu sana a na jep pahthet ding ahi.
30.4: Hiche maicham a manchah dia chu sana chaokol nijen nalhah ding, hiche chaokol teni chu maicham alang alang a sana ki jeppah na noiya abil na sem ma na ba peh chehcheh ding ahiye. Hiche chaokol teni sung a chu moljol ki thillut ding chu teng maicham chu kiputna ding ahi.
30.5: Hiche maicham putna ding'a moljol teni jeng jong chu thinggi thing na suipeh ding, ania chu sana a na jep pah ding ahi.
30.6: Chule hiche hettoh-sahna thing-kong maicham ki khaina pondal maija chu, hettoh-sahna hepi laltouna mai lai tah hichu keiman nangma toh ka kimu to na ding a ka lhen dohna munna chu maicham na sem ding ahiye, ati.
30.7: Aaron in jong jingkah sim le hiche maicham kilhutna ho chu asuh theng jing ding chule hiche munna chu gimnatwi ahal nam jing ding ahi.
30.8: Hiche bang achu nilhah lam jong le Aaron in gim namtui chu ahal nam jing ding, na khang lhum kei uva Yawehya dia hiche gimnam tui chu na halnam jing diu ahi.
30.9: Hiche maicham chunga chu atheng lou ahin, chule gimnamtui hihen pumgo thil to hijong le na tothei lou diu ahi; don thei thilto jeng jong na sun khum lou hel diu ahi, ati.
30.10: Kum khat sungse'a Aaron in jong sakiho chunga chu suhdetna abol ding, chule hiche na dinga chu suhdet na chonset thilpeh gan thisan amanchah ding ahiye; na khang lhum kei uva kumseh le khat vei cheh nabol diu, hichu Yawehya dia thil theng chung nung penna pang ding ahi.
30.11: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin ahi.
30.12: Nangman Israel cha te na simma amin bu u na sem peh teng le, ama mimal cheh in along lhen diu akipoh cheh cheh diu ahi. Hitia chu nabol a amin u nasim teng achung'uva natna hoisi hung lang lou ding ahitai,” ati.
30.13: Amin hungkisim ding jousen muntheng chunga chu longlhen man chah dinga shekel keh khat cheh ahin kipoh uva akoi diu ahi. hiche shekel khat chu Gerah dim khat toh'a kibang in, sekel keh khatma chu Yawehya dia kikat doha ahi.
30.14: Hiche min sim na pang kum somni'a lhah chunglam sen, Yaweh heng'a thilpeh ding chengse chu apeh doh cheh diu ahiye.
30.15: Na boncha uvin Yaweh ya dia thilpeh na peh teng uleh ahao avai khentum na beihel la shekel keh khat cheh na peh ding u ahi.
30.16: Israel chaten ki suhdetna ding'a athilpeh chengse'u chu aboncha na lah khom ding, hiche a sum ho chengse chu kikhomna ponbuh thil le loa na man chah ding ahi. Hichea konna chu Israel chaten a natoh na uva konna Pathenin ahet jing ding u, hichu amaho Jouse longlhenna ding'a kibol jing ding ahi, ati.
30.18: Kisilna dinga sum eng kong khat na sem ding, atunna ding jong sum eng a na sem peh ding ahi. Hiche sum eng kong chu kikhop-khomna ponbuh le maicham kikah a na tun ding asung'a chu twi na sun dim ding ahi, ati.
30.19: Hiche twiya chu Aaron le achapate jousen a khut ule akeng chengse'u a kisil ngim diu ahi.
30.20: Aaron leh achapate houbuh sunga aluh ding teng ule, maicham a kin bolna dinga ahung nailut teng'u hi jong le, Yawehya ding a thilto ding a hung u ham halnam ding thil a ahung u hijong le, abonchauva twiya chu kisil ngim soh kei ding u ahiye. Achuti louva ahile thina chang jeng ding ahiuve, ati.
30.21: Ama hon akeng phang jouse'u le akhut jouseo akisil ngim chehcheh diu ahi, Ajeh chu hitia chu abollou uva ahile thina chang ding ahiuvin; a chate jouse'u ding hihen Aaron a ding hijong le ason achilhah jouseu va ding hi jong le hiche hi a khang a khang lhumkei uva chonna dan a ache pe jing diu ahi.
30.22: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei jin.
30.23: Nangman gimnamtui lah a anam tuipen na kilah ding, gimnam tui atwi lah Myrrh chu shekel ja-nga man nalah ding agim nam tui lah a ahoipen thingnam tuichu kehkhat nalah ding, hichu shekel jani le somnga alhing in, thingnam tui lah a jong anamtuipen shekel jani le somnga mama nalah ding ahiye.
30.24: Lingnamtui ga jing jong chu shekel kisim dungjuiya janga ma hi ding, chule Olive thao jong khon dimkhat ma na lah ding ahiye.
30.25: “Hi chengse'a konna chu thao namtui sem them hon abolngai bang bang a, kinu thei dinga thao namtui nasem ding, hiche thao chu aboncha thao theng a kimang jing ding ahi.”
30.26: Hiche thao chu kikhopna ponbuh a na nunam ding hettohsahna thingkong a jong chu na nunam ding ahiye.
30.27: Dokhang ahin, thilman chah ahin, thaomei khom ahin chule aman chah ho jouse jaonan, gim- namtui halna maicham jong aboncha nanu soh kei ding ahiye.
30.28: Hichu pumgo thilto le maicham thilto ahin, chule twikong ahin a kitunna jeng jong chu nanu soh kei ding ahi.
30.29: Thil hicheng se chu aboncha atheng ahi jing na dinga na thenso ding, ipi hi jong le hiche thil tongkha chan chu atheng a umjing ding ahi.
30.30: Keima thempua pang ding'a Aaron le achapate jouse chu na thenso ding ahi.
30.31: Chu teng Nangman Israel chate henga na seipeh ding, hiche thao hi keima kinu ding a kasem ahin chule hichu akhang akhang a nakoi jing diu ahiye.
30.32: Hiche thao theng chu moh mi chunga kinu khum theilou hel ding, hiche thao theng kihal khom bang chu thao dang toh na hel tha lou hel ding, hiche hi thao theng mong mong ahin, nang ho jouse dia athenga umjing ding ahiye.
30.33: Koi hile hiche thao theng chu adangho bang'a kihel chop ma aum ngai ngaija chule khol jin mi ham hetlou mikhat chung'a nanu nat ngai ngai uva ahile ama chu amite lah akon a ki delmang jeng ding ahi.”
30.34: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, Thilnamtuiho chu kilah inlang, Stacte, le Onycha, Chule Galbunum, thilnam tui ho jaonan Bego thengsel'a kihel hochu kilah tan ati.
30.35: Thao namtui sem pa sem bang bang a na sem ding, chi naso khum ding thengsel'a na koi ding ahi.
30.36: Ahalneo khat pha bep khat alum lumma na sem ding hicheng akonna chu akeh khat na khen doh a keiman nangma ka kimu pi na ding munna chu, hettosahna maicham maiya na koi ding, hichu nangho jouse dia thil theng chung nungpen ahi.
30.37: Nangman hiche na sem ding thao namtui chu nang ho manchah ding maimaija na kisem jeng lou diu ahiye; Ajeh chu nangma dinga Yawehya dia atheng ahi.
30.38: Koi hijong le nalah uva hiche gim namtui ja ki sem thil theng kihal mangcha aum khah a ahile ama chu amite lah a kon a delmang aum jeng ding ahi.

31.2: Vetan Judah phung akon Hur chapa ahin, Uri chapa Bezalel chu amin ka pan in ka kou e.
31.3: Keiman jong Bezalel chu Pathen lhangao ka dimsah in, chule thil boltheina le chihna khut themna jong ka petai.
31.4: Thil lim jat chom chom a semna ding sana, chule sana dangka ahin sum eng khen themna tah ahi.
31.5: Chule song tampi jong ahin, thingthem bol theina agomma Bezalel ka peh ahi tai, ati.
31.6: Tun vetan, Bezalel kitipa hi Dan phunga kon Ahisamach chapa Oholiab toh ka kitho khomsah ahiye, hiche chung chonna keiman nangma ka thupeh chengse hi asuh bukimsel na ding un, Keima mi ahi jal a bolthei chan abolna ding ka peh a ahi, ati.
31.7: Kikhop khomna ponbuh ahin, hettoh sahna thingkong chule achunga hepi touna le asunglama thil jouse aboncha hi ding ahi.
31.8: Dokhang chule manchah jouse jao nan, thaomei khom le amanchah chengse le gimnamtui kihalna jong hi ding ahi.
31.9: Pumgo thilto maicham semna manchah ahin, kisil thengna kong le aman chah jong hi ding ahi.
31.10: Phatah a kikhong ponsil chule hichu thempu-kin abolna diuva kikhong hi ding Aaron thempu chule achapate ding a akivon na diu atheng jong hi ding ahi.
31.11: Tahsa a kinu ding thao namtui a kibol soh kei uva. Hitia chu ka thupeh chengse bang a aboltei tei diuva ahi.
31.12: Hicheng jouse nung hin Pakaiyin Mose henga asei kit tan.
31.13: Israel chate henga seipeh tem in, nang hon keima cholngah nikho nanit teitei diu ahi, hiche cholngah nikho hi na khang lhum kei uva keima le nangho kikah a melchih na pang jing ding ahin; ajeh chu keima na Yaweh uvin nangho jouse kathenso nao nahin hetjing diu ahi, ati.
31.14: Na boncha uva cholngah nikho nanit teitei diu ahi, ajeh chu cholngah nikho hi nangho dinga atheng ahin; koi hile hiche cholngah nikho'a atheng lou a kikum kha chan chu thina chang ding ahiye. Chule cholngah nikhoa na tong a aumjong le hiche mipa chu amite lah akonna paidoh a um jeng ding ahi.
31.15: Nigup sungse'a toh thei channa toh ding, nisagi lhinni teng hichu nikho theng cholngah nikhoa naman chah diu ahin, ajeh chu Yaweh nikho theng ahi. Koi hijong leh cholngah nikhoa na tong pen pen chu thina kichan sah ding ahi, ati.
31.16: Hijeh a chu Israel chate jousen cholngah nikho theng hi beitih neilouva nanit jing diu, cholngah nikho chu aman jing diu, bei tih nei louva anit jing jing diuva ahiye.
31.17: Ajeh chu ni gup sung chun Pakaiyin van le leiset anasem in; ni sagi lhin nin a kicholdo in ahi. hiche laitah jeh ahi nangman Israel chate jouse henga keima leh amaho kikah a melchih na apang jing ding ahi tin aheng uvah seiyin, ati.
31.18: Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chung a Mose henga hichengse asei chaisoh phat in, hettohsahna song pheng teni Pathen akon khutjih chu, Mose apetai.

32.1: Mose chu Sinai Molsang akon in ahung kumlha vah tapon ahile, Israel mipi abonchauvin Aaron henga ahung uvin ajah a asei tauvin ahi; Nagman keiho eilam kai diuvin milim Pathenin neisem peh uvin, Mose Egypt gam'a kon'a eihin puidoh pa'u ageina lam ka hepha tapouvin, ama chungchang thua ima ka hepouve tin aseiyuve.
32.2: Aaron in jong aheng uva aseiyin, Na ji na chate'u bilba jouse sutlha uvin lang ka heng a na hin lhut soh kei diu ahi, ati.
32.3: Chuin mipin jong abilba chengse'u a sutlha uvin Aaron henga ahin choi soh kei uve.
32.4: Aaron in jong sana hochu alan, sana khen na manchah khat a kheng in, hichu bongnou khat limin akheng doh tai. Chuin mipin jong “Vo! Israel, Egypt gam'a konna na hin puidoh uva Pathen chu hiche hi ahi, atiuve”.
32.5: Aaron in jong bongnou kilhajol chu aven, hiche lim kisemna maiya chun maicham asem in, Aaron in hitin aseiye; Jing nikho teng le Yawehya di kut khat um ding ahi, ati.
32.6: Mipi jong chu jingkah matah in atou taovin Yawehya din pumgo thilto maicham ahin choiyun, mipin jong neh le don ding twi jong atoh doh un, hiti chun ama ama malam cheh a nopsanan aumpai kit tauve.
32.7: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu a seikit in, ajah a, Chen lang na mite lam jon suh tan, ajeh chu nangman Egypt gamsunga konna nahin puidoh namite khu ama ama lam cheh a chon nun mangthah ding ahitaove, ati.
32.8: Keiman jui ding a ka peh jousea konin amaho achemang gam taovin, ama cham un bongnou lim asemun, chibai aboh un kithoi nan amang uvin hiti hin asei uve, “Vo israel mipite Egypt gam'a konna nahin puiod uva pathen chu hiche ho ahi, tin asam uve, ati.”
32.9: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Amaho chung chang thua keima kaki kum ding ahiye, ahi na'u abonchan kahesoh keijin milouchal te ahiuve, ati.
32.10: Keima kaki kum ding, achung'uva kalung souna ka buhlhah ding abonchauva kabah gam hel ding ahiuve, amavang keiman in nangma hi nam lentah a katun ding nahi, ati.
32.11: Mose jong Yaweh henga atao jing tan hitin aseije, “Ka Yaweh na lungsatna Egypt gamma konna na hin puidoh namite chunga nalhun sah kigot jeng hi tam, ati.
32.12: Egypt miten hiti hin sei unte, Pakaiyin amaho hi thagam dinga ahin puidoh a, Pakaiyin amaho hi molsang chunga pat a ahin pui doh uva tha gam hel ding ati ahi tin gel unte, tia a seina thei diuva nabol ki got hi tam? Na lunghan na akon in lungset tah in na lung heijin lang hiche mite chunga hin suhgamna lhun sah hih beh jeng in tin a tauve.
32.13: Nalhacha masa Abraham, Isaac chule Israel chu avel in geldoh kit temin, aheng uvah kihahselna nana neiyin hitin naseiye, “Na son na chilhah teo kapunsah ding van'a ahsi jat kaphah sah diu chule keiman katepsa hiche gampumpi hi nanghon naluo soh hel ding u ahi, hichu nanghon atonsot tonsot geija ding ahi tia nasei chu avel in geldoh kit temin, ati.
32.14: Chuin Pakaiyin amite chung a abol ding thil chu bol talouvin alung ahai tan ahi.
