32.15: Mose jong molsang apat chun ahung kumsuh tan ahile, hettoh sahna songpheng teni a mailamma Pathen khut jih ki jih teni chu ahin choiyin ahi. Hiche song pehng teni chu anung lam ahin chu le amalam a jong anigel a lekha jem kisun ahi.
32.16: Hiche songpheng teni chu Pathenin asem ahin, Lekha jem kisung jeng jong chu Pathen lekha sut ma ahi. Hichu asong peng teni chunga chu a kijih sa ahiye.
32.17: Chuin mipi awgin chu akithong jeng tan ahile Joshua injong Mose henga asei tai, “Ngahmun sunglama khu galkisat a hitam awgin khu ngaitiem in atin ahi”,
32.18: Mose'n jong a don but in aseije, “galjona awgin jong ahideh poi chule gal lal na jeh a awgin jong ahipoi, keiman ka jah dan in lakisa awgin joh ahiye, ati.
32.19: Mose jong ngahmun lailung ahung lhun tan ahile, bongnou lim ki sem thu chu amutan chule mipi abonchauva alam ujong chu amun ahile ama alungsa lheh jeng tan ahi. Chuin akhut tenia ahin choi songpheng teni chu tolla asep lhajeng tan ahile anigellin akeh jeng tan ahi.
32.20: Mose'n jong bongnou lim kisem chu alan meiyin ahal vam lha jeng tan chuin tol lham ma jong agoidi jel in chu jouvin avutvai chengse chu twija asunglut in hiche twi chu Israel te abonchauvin adonsah in ahi.
32.21: Mose'n jong Aaron henga aseiyin, hiche mite hon nachunga ipi lomlom a se abol uva nangman amaho chungchang thu jeh a hichan loma hi chonset nabol jeng hitam tin aseijin ahi.
32.22: Aaron jeng jong chun aseijin ipilom ma nalung sat na na lhunsah jeng hitam kapu atin, amaho hi thilse bol ding a kipedoh ahitauve tin aseijin ahi.
32.23: Amahon ka heng a asei un, ei lamkai thei diuvin pathen lim semthu tampi eisem peh un ajeh chu Mose kitipan Egypt gam'a kon in eihin puidoh uvin tun ama hoiya uma iti ham keihon ama chungchang imacha kahe tapouve tin asei uve.
32.24: Keiman jong aheng uva ka seijin, sana bilba neichan in sutlha uvin katin ahile hichu kaheng a ahin choi jun, chuin keiman jong sana bilba jouse chu meilhum sung a kalhah a ahile bongnou lim in ahung soh doh tan ahi, ati.
32.25: Aaron in hitia mipi anabol tah jeh chun Mose'n jong hiche mite hi akijumso ding mong mong a kilha thang ahitauve ti ahe chen tai.
32.26: Mose jong achen ngahmun kelkot achun ading in, Yawehya dia pang jing koikoi nalah uva um'em, kaheng lama hung un tin aseitan ahile, Levi chapate jouse chu Mose henglama ahung taovin ahi.
32.27: Mose'n jong amaho henga aseijin, Yaweh Israel Pathenin aseije, Pasal ki tiphot in chem cha akong a ki poh cheh uhen, ngahmun kelkot alangto gel'in phetlha uvin lang, pasal a kai kiti phot in asopipa chu that jeng hen, chule pasal a kai phot chun a sopipa that jeng hen, pasal jousen aheng akom a in heng chan chu that jeng hen tin aseiye, ati.
32.28: Chuin Levi chapaten jong Mose thupeh bang ban in mi a that tauvin ahile, hiche nikho chun mihem sang thum jen athi tauvin ahi.
32.29: Mose'n jong hiti hin aseyin, tunia kipat nanghon na macham cheh uva Yaweh kin nabol theina diuva, mi abangin achapa atha a, chule asopipa ham atha a, ajeh chu tuni nikhoa hi nang ho jouse chunga Pakaiyin nachung cheh uva thensona anei ahi, ati.
32.30: Mose'n jong ajing nikho in japi henga chun aseijin, nang hon chonsetna thanghoi tah nabol doh tauvin, keima tua hi Yaweh henglama che touding ka hin, hiche chonset na bol uchu thoidamna na kisem peh diuva ahiye, ati.
32.31: Mose jong Yaweh henglama akilen asei tai, Hiche mipite jouse hi abonchauvin thanghoi tah in chonset abol tauvin ahi. ama amacham in pathen limsem thu tamtah ana kisem doh tauvin ahi, ati.
32.32: Hijong le Pakaiyin na lung ahile a chonset na'u jouse ngaidam teiyin, ngaidam thei lou dinmun ahitah le vang, na heng a ka hung tauve, nang man na jihdohsa hiche songpheng a kon chun keima hi nei sugam hel jeng tan tin atao tan ahi.
32.33: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Koi hijong le keima doumah bol'a chonse pa bou chu hiche ka lekhasut akonna chu keiman jong ka suh gam hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
32.34: Tun nangma ki patdoh in keiman ka sei peh na mun, hiche mun channa chu mipi na ga lam kai ding ahiye. Ka vantil chu na masang lama masa ding, keiman nangma ka hung vil teng le koi hile hiche mite lah a achonse pen pen chu keiman lethuhna ka peh cheh cheh ding ahi,” ati.
32.35: “Aaron in mi jouse bong lim ana sem peh tah jeh in Pakaiyin jong gamsunga natna hoise alansah tan ahi.”

33.1: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, “kipat doh inlang che touvin, nangma chule Egypt gam'a konna nahin puidoh mite jouse jao nan, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kana kihah silna, na son na chilhha te ka peh ding ahi tia ka seina gam khu jon tauvin, ati.”
33.2: “Keiman na masang lama vantil khat ka sol ding, chuteng keiman Canaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite, Hit mite chule Jebus mite abonchauva ka deldoh gam hel ding ahiuve, ati.”
33.3: “Bongnoi le khoiju lonna gam khu jon taovin lang, ahin ka tahsa taha ka lhonpi lou ding nahi. Ajeh chu na louchal jeh'a lampi a ka moh suhgam jeng thei nahi, ati.
33.4: Mipin jong thu kisei awgin chu ajah doh phat uvin akap lha gam tauvin ahi. Mikhat jouse khat jeng cha jong a kivon na ngai yin a kivon ta pouvin ahi.”
33.5: “Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, Israel chate jouse henga seiyin, mi louchal te na hiuvin, bangkah khat na lhon tou pi jong leu, na louchal jal uva ka suhgam hel thei na hiuve, tun nangma chung cheh a na kivon na chengse'u sutlha uvin lang, chu teng keiman nangho lamhil ding dan na hin het them diu ahi, ati.”
33.6: Chuin Horeb molsang akon in Israel chaten achung'uva kai akivon na jouse'u asut lha'u vin ahi.
33.7: Mose'n jong ponbuh chu ana lang jing chule hichu ngah mun apat ki gamlha thim khat a ana son ji ahiye. Ponbuh chu kikhop khomna ponbuh ahin, miholah a koi hijong le Yaweh holnom chan chu ngahmun pamlama ponbuh ki song lama chu ga che teitei ding ahi, ati.
33.8: Mose jong chu ponbuh akonna ahung potdoh teng mipi abonchauvin ading doh jiuvin, mjouse jong chu ama ama kotpi phungbula ding den soh keijuva, Mose jong ponbuh asung lha kahsea mipin jong avet mang kei u ahi.
33.9: Chuin Mose jong ponbuh sung alut jiteng meibol chu ahung kitollut jin, kotpi phunga chun akitang den jin, chuteng Pakaiyin Mose chu akihoulim pijin ahi.
33.10: Mipiho jousen hiche meilhang kotpi phunga ahung kitan den amujiteng ule, Mipi jong abon chaovin ading doh uvin, amimal cheh in ama kotpi phung bul cheh a chibai aboh jiuvin ahi.
33.11: Mikhat in aloipa ahoulimpi bang bang in Pathenin Mose chu ahoulim pijin ahi. Mose jong ponbuh sunga ahung sunglhah kit teng, ama lhacha a pang leji Nun chapa Joshua jong hiti chun aum den jitai.
33.12: Mose'n Yaweh henga aseijin, ven! Nangmatah in kajah a nasei ahi. Hiche mite hohi hinpui touvin tin naseiyin, ahinlah amahola a hi koipen toh neisol ding ham ti neiseipeh pon ahi. Ahinlah nangman naseiyin, keiman nangma hi hetsahna kapeh nahin chule nangman nasei jin keima lunglhaina vang nachang e nei tinai, ati.
33.13: Tun nangma mitmua lunglhaina kachan tah a ahile, nahenga kahung taove, nangma kahetthem jinga chule namitmua jong lunglhaina kachan jing theina ding in, lamdih a kipugina ding jouse abonchan neihil inlang, amaho jong hi nagma mite ahiuve tijong hin sumil hih hel in, ati.
33.14: Pakaiyin aseijin, kami umpi nachun nalhon pi jing ding ahi. Hiche akonna chu nangma choldamna kachansah teiding nahiye, ati.
33.15: Mose'n jong Yaweh henga aseijin, ahinaije, nangma umpi na chun neilhonpi jing louva ahile hiche munna pat hin neipuidoh dajeng taovin ati.
33.16: Keima kahin chule namite jouse ahin nangma mitmua lunglaina kachang uve tihi iti kihetdoh thei ding ham? Neilhon piteng ule keima ho hi atumbeh a neigel na'u ahin, keima ka hin chule namite abonchauva leiset chunga midang jouse akonna a tumbeh mong mong ka hitauve tihi ka het doh thei lou diu ham, ati.
33.17: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Na seidohsa hi keiman ka bol ding ahi. Ajeh chu kamit mua lunglhaina nachan ahin, hiche jeh chun keiman nangma ka het chenset na hitai,” ati.
33.18: Mose'n jong asei jin, ka hung tauve,” na loupina ka heng'a kilah sah tei teijin ati tan ahile.”
33.19: Pakaiyin adonbut in ajah a, “Ka loupi na aboncha na masang lama ka kitolsah ding, na masang lama pakai min ka sam phong peh ding, chule ka lungsetna chu na chan jing ding, hepi na jong nangma kachansah ding naiye,” ati.
33.20: Chuin aman aseijin, “Ahinlah kamai vang namu thei lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu mihem koihile kamai muchan chu thijeng ding ahi,” ati.
33.21: Pakaiyin aseijin, Ven! “Ka komma a onglaija hin hung ding inlang, hiche songpi chunga hi nadin ding ahiye.”
33.22: “Ka loupina ahung kitol teng le keiman songpi kikah a kasel ding, hiche laimunna chu kasel jing ding keiman kadalhah teng le bou kahoh doh kit ding ahi,” ati.
33.23: “Ka dalhah teng le keiman ka hin hoh doh ding, chuteng kanung lam bou namu ding, itinama jong le kamai vang namu thei lou ding ahi,” ati.

34.1: Pakayin Mose henga thu aseijin, “Masang ngaiya bang'in songpheng'ni suiyin lang, hiche song pheng teni achu masang'a nangman nasekeh songpheng teni chung'a kijih thuchang chu keiman ka hin sut kit ding ahi.”
34.2: “Kigo'in lang jingkah teng'le Sinai molsang lam'a nahung kal touding, molsang vum'a kaheng'a nahung din ding ahi,” ati.
34.3: “Koima dang na hin kilhon pithei lou ding, hiche molsang jousea khu koi macha dang kilah thei lou ding ahi. Kelngoi hon ahin gancha kitiphot khat jeng cha jong molsang lah a khu nalhat sah lou ding ahi.”
34.4: Mose'n jong masang'abang bang chun songpheng ni asuiyin, ajing jingkah matah'in athoudoh'in Yaweh thupeh bang chun Sinai molsang chung vum'a ache tou tan, song pheng teni achoijin a kaltou tai.
34.5: “Molvum lama kon'in Yaweh chu mei bol in ahung tan chuin Mose toh'a ding khom lhonne. Chuin Yaweh min chu sangtah in akouvin ahi.”
34.6: “Yaweh jong Mose masa lang lama chen, a sei peh in, Yaweh, Yaweh hepi them le lunghang vah lou iti channa mi lungset them le dihna dimset jeng tin asei in ahi.”
34.7: “Mihem asang asang chung'a lungset na nei jing, themmona le suhkhel na jouse jong ngaidam jia, amavang themmona alembaseh'a umsah lou mipa le chate kikah atute channa natong jing ding, chule khang thumle-li channa natong theiya ahi,” ati.
34.8: “Mose jong tol lhamma akun'in chibai aboh paijin ahi.”
34.9: “Mose'n aseijin, “O Yaweh nangma mitmua lunglhaina kachanna ahile, nahenga kataove, Yaweh hi kalah uvah hung um henlang, kathemmo nao le kachonset najouse ngaidamin, nagoulo thei din neisem taovin,” ati.
34.10: “Chuin Pakaiyin aseijin, Tua hi keiman nangma toh ikah'a kitepna ka sem ding ahi. Namite lah a keiman thil nasatah tah ka kilah sah ding, hi tabang thil ki dang hohi leiset'a ana umkha lou lai ahin, chule nam dang telah jeng ajong anasoh khalou lai ahi. Na chenna chan uva mihem hon Yaweh thil bol ki dang ahin mudoh diu, ajeh chu keiman ka hinbol ding thil hi thil ki dang tah ahi,” ati.
34.11: “Tunin ka thupeh hi na suhmil lou ding ahi. Nei hin ven, kei matah in namasang lama Amor mite, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite le Jebus mite abonchauva kajam sah gam diu ahi.”
34.12: “Tun nangma ki cheh theiyin, na chenna gammite toh kitepna hinsem khan nate, achuti louva ahile hitabang kitepna chu kipal lhuh'na hung pang ding ahi,” ati.
34.13: “Hijeh chun nangman hiche gammite maicham jouse chu nasuh set gamhel ding, akhompi jouseo jong nasuh lhuh soh kei ding ahi, chule Asher doi jong chu na phuh lhuh ding ahi.”
34.14: “Ajeh chu nangma pathen dang angsung'a naboh khup'a natao theilou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amin jong Yaweh chule Pathen chu hung thang tom jing thei ahi,” ati.
34.15: “Hijeh chun agamsung chengte toh kitepna na sem thei lou ding, hiche mite chun a pathen'nu umchan atho diu amaho le amho kah a jonthan hoi in apat diu, hiche pathen semthu ho heng'a kilhaina asem teng ule nangma jong nahin tep diu ahin, hiche a na hinkou pen pen-sa ki lhaina chu naneh thei lou ding ahi,” ati.
34.16: “Na chapate ji ding'a agam cheng numei napuipeh theilou ding, a channute jouse'u a pathen'u umchan atho uva a ki joh bang uva khu, na chapate jeng jong hung ki joh lo ding'u ahi.”
34.17: “Chule nangma macham'ma pathen limsem thu kiti mong mong nahou lou ding ahi.”
34.18: “Chol solou changlhah kut jong imatih channa na man jing ding ahi. Ka thupeh bang bang'a aphat ahung lhun teng, Abib lha sungse'a chu nangman cholsolou changlhah na neh ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche lha sunga hi nangma Egypt gam sung'a kon'a na hung doh ahi,” ati.
34.19: “Chule ahung peng doh masa jouse chu keiya ding ahi. Achal'a kai lhah ki tiphot chu, gancha lah'a bong ahin, kelngoi hi jong le keija ding ahi.”
34.20: “Sangan hung peng doh masa jong chu nangman kelngoi khat'a nalhat doh ding, ita bang khatna na lhat doh jou louva ahile hiche sangan nou chu angong chang na he boh peh ding ahi. Na chapate lah'a ahung peng doh masa pen jong lhat dohna na sem peh tei ding, ajeh chu na lah uva koima ka heng lam'a khut goh keuva hung kilah thei lou ding ahi.”
34.21: “Ni gup sung se'a nangman tohthei chan natoh ding, ni sagi lhinni teng le na kichol do ding ahi. Lou na toh lai hihen lholhun lai hijong le nangma nakichol teitei ding ahi,” ati.
34.22: “Ni sagi lhin nia kut jong na bol jing ding na nit teitei ding ahi. Chule suhlou chang kut jong na bol jing ding, kum lhun teng le muchi ga soh khop tup kut jong na bol cheh cheh ding ahi.”
34.23: “Kum khat sung'a namite lah'a pasal'a kai lhah jouse Israel Yaweh, Pathen heng'a hung kilah cheh ding'u ahi.”
34.24: “Ajeh chu keiman nam tin vaipi jouse masang'a ka huh doh'a hitia chu na gamgi ka suh len ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangma kumkhat sung'a Yaweh heng'a kilah ding na che teng le hiche gamma kon'na chu khat jeng chan jong na umlou kah'a na gam sung lah ding lung aken lou hel ding'u ahi.”
34.25: “Ka heng'a ki lhaina sa kiti phot chol sosa toh na neh tha lou ding, kalchuh kut'a ding'a sa kithat chan jong jing khovah geiya na koi den theilou diu ahi.”
34.26: “Na gamsung'a ga soh jouse jong na Yaweh leh na Pathen heng'a nahin poh lut cheh cheh ding ahi. Chule kelngoi nou jeng jong api noitwija na hon min thei lou ding ahi.”
34.27: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a thu asei in, Ka thupeh chengse abonchan sun doh cheh cheh in, Ka thupeh chengse dung juiya hi Israel toh na kikah'a kitepna ka sem doh ding ahi,” ati.
34.28: Hiche laimun na chun Yaweh le Mose chu ni som le jan som li jen aum khom in ahi. Hiche phatsung'a ahin Mose'n twi jong donlou an jong ne louvin aum in ahi. Hichea kitepna jouse chu Mose'n jong song pheng teni chung achun ajih lut tan ahi.”
34.29: “Sinai molsang lam'a kon'in Mose jong ahung kum suh'in ahile hettoh sahna song pheng teni chu ahin choiyin ahi. Mose mai chu vahlha jeng'e ajeh chu Pathen toh aga kihou lim jeh ahin hinlah aman ahedoh pon ahi.”
34.30: “Chuin Aaron le Israel chate jousen amudoh taovin ahile, Mose chu amai avah lha jeng tan, chuin amaho abonchaovin akicha lheh jeng tauvin ave ngam ta pouvin nai jong ahin nai lut ngam tapouve.”
34.31: Mose'n ahin kouvun, Chun in Aaron le khopi sung'a lamkai jouse Mose henglama ahung un, Mose'n jong ama ho chengse chu aki hou pin ahi.”
34.32: “Israel chate ho jousen jong ahin nailut cheh uvin, Sinai molsang chung vumma Pakaiyin Mose ahoupi na bang bang in Mose'n jong Israel mite Jouse chu a houlim pi'n thu jouse chu ajah uva a sei peh tan ahi.”
34.33: “Mose'n jong thupeh Jouse aheng uva asei chai soh phat in amai dal ding in pon khat aki lekhu sah tai.”
34.34: “Mose jong Yaweh to kihoulim ding'a ache lut ji teng, ahung potdoh kit kahsen amai dalna ding'a ponkhu chu ahin ki lah doh kit ji tan ahi. Mose jong ahung poh doh'a Pakaiyin ipi ahin seipeh ahi dem ti Isreal mite heng'a a seipeh jin ahi.”
34.35: Israel cha ten jong Mose maichu ave uvin ahile, avah lha jeng in ahi. Mose jong Yaweh toh kimu to ding'a ache lut kit kah sen amai dalna pon chu akikhu jin ahi.

35.1: Mose'n jong Israel insung abonchauvin a kou khom soh keiyin ajah'uva a seipeh in ahi. Hi chengse hi Pakaiyin nangho jouse jui ding in aseiyin ahi.
35.2: “Nanghon hapta sung'a tohthei chan na toh pan ding un ni gup na nei uvin, ni sagi lhinni hi nang ho dia nikho theng ahin, hiche nikhoa hi na kichol soh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu Yawehya dia thenso ahi tai, koi hile hiche nikhoa na tong chan chu thina chang jeng ding ahiye.”
35.3: “Cholngah nikhoa hi nangma insung cheh'a mei jong nati kong louhel ding'u ahi.”
35.4: Chuin Mose'n Israel chate jouse heng'a a seipeh in, hiche hi Pakaiyin athupeh ahi:
35.5: “Yaweh henga na thilpeh diu chu nangma nei cheh chu dong khommu vin lang, ami chancheh in Yaweh ding'a thilpeh na kat doh diu chu ki choi cheh'uvin. Yaweh ding'a hongphal tah in hicheng hi pehen: sana le dangka chule sum eng,”
35.6: “A engdum ahin, asan dup hichu hoitah'a kikhong hi ding; kelcha mul jaona hi ding ahiye.
35.7: “A ki nam-sel kelngoi chal vun chule kelcha vun ahin thinggi thing jaona hi ding ahi.
35.8: “Thaomei ding'a Olive thao hi ding; chule kinu ding thao namtui jong halnam thei thao twi jao cheh cheh ding ahi;
35.9: “Songman tam, chule tun ding song jong konggah omphoa manchah ding jong ahi.
35.10: “Koi hile na lah uva khutthem na tong thei jouse hung'un. Tundoh ding'a Yaweh thupeh chengse sauvin:
35.11: “A ponbuh ding, a chung vum'a khu ding, athil manchah jouse jao nan, ajol le akhompi jouse jaona hiding ahi;
35.12: “Thingkong chule aputna ding moljol teni jong; hepi touna, chule pon akhu khumna'a kimang jong hi ding ahiye;
35.13: “Chule dokhang ahin amol jol ho jaona; manchah chengse le changlhah ki kat dohsa ho jaona hi ding ahi;
35.14: “Meivah thaomei khom le aman chah chengse; chule Olive thao vahding jaona hi ding ahi.
35.15: Gimnam tui lhut na ding; chule amol jol chengse kinu ding; thaotwi le halnam thei thao twi chengse jong; chule houbuh a manchah ding pondal chengse jong hiding ahi.
35.16: Pumgo thilto maicham; chule athil keo Jouse kisilna kong le atunna jong ahi;
35.17: Amunna khai ding ho jong; akhailhah nading khom ho jaonan; chule kotbulla khai ding pon dal jong jaona hiding ahiye.
35.18: Houbuh kilmat na ding ahom ho ahin, akhao jouse jong jao cheh ding ahi.
35.19: Muntheng'a manchah ding'a kikhong von jouse leh thempu kin bol'a apan teng ule aman chah diuva kikhong Aaron vontheng chengse ahin chule a chapate von chengse jong hi ding ahi.
35.20: Chuin Israel insung pumpi'n Mose akon chun apotdoh tauvin ahi.
35.21: Chule alungthim'ma ki tilkhou na nei chan le lhagaova hel doh chan chu ahung khom uvin, ki khopkhomna ponbuh sung'a manchah ding ahin, kin bolna'a manchah ding chule ki von'na athenga manchah ding abonchan Yaweh heng'a ahin lhut taovin ahi.
35.22: Numei le pasal ani gel'in ahung khom taovin ahi. Chuin heo jang ahin, khutjem, bilba, chaokol le sana'a ki sem thil jouse jong ahin choikhom soh kei uvin ahi. Ama ama michan cheh in sana thil peh jouse ahin choisoh kei uvin ahi.
35.23: Ama cham'a kipedoh chan chun hi chengse hi ahin choiyun ahi: pon dum, sandup, a sanpol, tupat pon, kelcha mul, kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun chengse jong anei channu ahin choi khom soh kei uvin ahi.
35.24: Ami takip in Yawehya thilpeh ding ama ama cheh'in ahin choiyuvin ahi. Chule ipi thil'a ki mang hi jong le Yawehya din ahin choi khom soh kei un ahi.
35.25: Ajou chan in ama cheh khut themna tah'in pat akhong un, chu teng hiche pat kikhong jouse chu asan hihen asan dup hijong le asanpol jaonan tupat ponnem'ma hijong le ahin choi khomsoh keiyuvin ahi.
35.26: Numei ho jouse lah'a alung sung'a konna kipiehdohna nei channa chun kelcha mul'a kon'in abol cheh uvin ahi.
35.27: Japi lamkaija pang chengse'n jong konggah ding le omphoa beh ding'in songman tam jatchom cheh ahin choi khom uvin ahi.
35.28: Chule ama hon gim namtui ahin, meivah'a pang ding thaotwi ahin, kinu ding thaotwi chule gimnam tuiya halnam thei jong ahin choi khom uve.
35.29: “Isreal chate lah'a numei ahin chule pasal ahin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a a thupeh bang in bol inge tia a lungthim ma kon na ki tilkhouna nei channa chu Yaweh heng'a ki pah le thanom tah in ipi hijong le apeh nom chan'u chu ahin choi khom uvin ahi.”
35.30: Chuin Mose'n Israel mite heng'a aseijin. “Juda phung'a kon Hur chapa Bezalel chu Pakaiyin alheng dohtan ahi.
35.31: Pakaiyin Bezalel chu Pathen lhagao adimset sah jeng tan, amapa jong Chihna, le lung thim hat tah thil bol thei tah ahung hidoh tan ahi.”
35.32: “Amapa chu thil jep dan jong them tah, sana le dangka jaonan thil ijakai sem dan jong amacham'in ahin he doh theiyin ahi.”
35.33: “A mapa chun tun ding song tam tah a sem in, thing jong ajat jat in ajem theiyin, khutthem na jouse achang theiyin ahi.”
35.34: “Pakaiyin Bezalel chule Dan phungkai akon'in Ahismach chapa Oholiab ahin, ani tah lhon'in mijouse kihil nathei ding'in asem doh lhon tan ahi.”
35.35: “Pakaiyin Amani chu natoh ijakai thepna ape lhon tan ahile, thilsem themna neijin, thembol in apang lhon in, thil lim gon dan jong, pon jep pol dan jong, a dum, asan pol, chule tupat pon bang khui themna jong apeh lhonna ahi. Bezalel le Oholiab in jong thil ijakai boltheina chu achang lhon tan ahi.”

36.1: “Pakaiyin Bezale le Oholiab chu thilbol theina ape'n chule muntheng tun dohna mun chu chihna le ijakai bol ding jouse het them theina apie'n ahi. Pasal'a kailhah kitiphot in Yaweh thupeh bang bang'a abol diu'vin a seiyin ahi.”
36.2: Mose'n jong Bezalel le Oholiab Pakaiyin thilbol theina apieh lhon bang chun adang hojouse'n jong natong ding'in ama cheh'in thanopna aneiyun ahi.
36.3: Mose in jong muntheng sah doh na ding le amun theng tun doh na ding chun Israel mite'n thil man chah ding a dondoh chengse'u chu natong ho ape tauvin ahi. Ahinlah ama hon jingkah sim in Mose heng'a thil lelo ahin choijun atohdoh jing uvin ahi.
36.4: Ajo nan thilbol them ho chun mun theng munna ana toh banjom dalhan ache tauvin ahi.
36.5: Ama hon Mose heng acheuvin hiti hin asei uve, Mipihon ka heng'uva Pakaiyin toh ding eipeh chengse'u sang'a tamjo eipe tauvin ahi, tin aga sei uve.
36.6: Chuin Mose'n jong aum nau ngahmun achun thu athot tauvin ahi: “Muntheng na toh na ding'in pasal hile numei hile thil ima hin peh be dajeng taovin, tia thu ahil'uvin, ajeh chu thil ijakai aning lhing'e tin aseiyin ahi!” Chuin mipi'n jong thil ijakai ahin choiyu chu angataovin ahi.
36.7: Thil le lo ahin choijeh uchun ijakai adimlha jeng tan, tohgon ding kalval'in manchah aum tan ahi.
36.8: Natong them hochun pondal somkhat cheh amang uvin ponbuh akison taovin ahi. Bezalel in jong ponbuh'a kimang chu tupet ponnem kikhong ahin, adum le asadup le asanpol hochu ahin, thilbol theina tah'a cherub limbang bang kisem hose chu amangchan ahi.
36.9: Pondal khat cheh chu a dung tongsom li-le-tongni asaovin, a vailam'a pang pondal ho chengse vang chu tong gup alhing in ahi.
36.10: Pondal lah'a nga chu khat le khat akilmat cheh cheh'in adang pondal nga chengse jong chu khat le khat akilmat in ahi.
36.11: Chule amasang lam'a pondal kigol chengse chu abil homkol tampi dum thim in asem peh'in chule pondal kikhai ageigol'a chengse jong chu abilhom tampi asem'in ahi.
36.12: Pondal masa joa abilhom somnga asem peh in, ani chana pondal chengse jong somnga ma asem in ahi. Aki kilmat na ho chu khat le khat kimai ngat tocheh in ahiuve.
36.13: Aman sana kol somnga asem in, sana kol hochun pondal khat le khat akilmat in, chuin houbuh chu pondal buh khat ahung sodoh tan ahi.
36.14: Chuin aman houbuh chungvuma khu ding in kelcha'vun ho chu amang chan, pondal jong som le khat asem doh'in ahi.
36.15: Pondal khat chu adung somli-le-nga cheh alhing in, chule adang pondal availama chu tong-gup alhing in ahi.
36.16: Bezalel'in jong pondal ngaho chengse chu akilmat soh keiyin, chule amoh pondal gup chengse chu anichanna achun apansah'in ahi.
36.17: Aman pondal hoa chun abi lhom somnga asem peh in, hichun pondal saotah'a a kilmatsah cheh cheh ahi.
36.18: Chuin aman ponbuh khatseh'a akison doh theina ding le akilmat na ding in sum eng kol somnga asem in ahi. Hiti lamdol chun, ponbuh chu a khu khum na a sempeh in ahi.
36.20: Chule houbuh sem doh na ding in Bezalel chun thinggi thing pha bep asem doh'in ahi.
36.21: Thingtun khat chu adung tongsom le tonnga alhing in, atun khat cheh chu inchi somni le sagi alhing in ahi.
36.22: Thingtun khat cheh chun atun na ni aneiyin ahi. Chule atunna jouse chu abonchan asem hoisoh keiyin ahi.
36.23: Aman thingtun somni a semdoh in hichu lhanglam houbuh'a amang cha'n ahi.
36.24: Aman jong atunna dangka in somli asem'in chule atunna khat abil'a pang ding achu abilhom jong asempeh cheh in ahi.
36.25: Houbuh solam'a pang ding chun atun somni ma asem peh'in ahi.
36.26: Atunna dangka somli'a kisem khomkhat na atunna chu ni asempeh cheh'in ahi.
36.27: Aman houbuh nunglama pansa ding'in ajol gup asem'in
36.28: Houbuh nunglama pang ding chun atun ni ma asem peh'in ahi.
36.29: Hichea kimang atunna ho jouse chu abul lang achom cheh ahin, alu lamse vang chu anung lama chu kikai mat cheh'a ahiuvin, aning gol'a pang ding in atunna teni jong chu asem in ahi.
36.30: Aki tunna dangka chu toh'a semtha in ahile som le gup alhing in ahi. Ajol'a pang ding chun atunna ni cheh alhing in ahi.
36.31: Chuin aman thinggi thing amang chan avaiya pang ding asuiyin, houbuh solam'a pang ding chun agolvai nga asem in,
36.32: Chule lhanglam'a pansa ding'in agolvai nga ma asem'in ahi. Hichengse chun lhumlam angan ahi.
36.33: Aman alaigol lah'a pansa din among lang khat'a konna alang khat mong golla pang ding chun, ajol khat asem kit in ahi.
36.34: A tunna chengse chu abonchan sana in atom jol nam soh keiyin, sanakol jouse jong chu agolvai ho manchah din asempeh in, agolvaiya ho jouse jong chu sana mama'in atom jol soh keiye.
36.35: Houbuh chung lam'a pansa ding chun Bezalel in pondum, ponsandup le asan-ao tupat pon mang chan asem in, hiche pon chu khut themna nei tampi'n asem cherub lim tampi akhuijin ahi.
36.36: Hichea pansa ding chun thingggi thing-li a sem doh in chule akhom jong sana-li in ajol nam sel in, akol asempeh'in akhom li ding machun sana jong lijen asem'in ahi.
36.37: Chule aman ponbuh kot phung lam'a pansa ding chun adum, asan dup, asa-ao chule tupat pon jeng'a ajem in ahi.
36.38: A kikhaina chengse chu sana jeng'a kisem atunna nga asempeh in ahi. Akhom chengse ahin chule atomna chengse chu sana jeng'in atom jol soh keiyin akhom nunglam'a pansa ding vang chun sumeng jeng mangchan asem'in ahi.

37.1: Chu ban'in Bezalel chun thinggi thing mangchan thingkong asem tan; adung tongni le akeh ahin, avai tongkhat le akeh chule atun tongkhat le akeh ma alhing in ahi.
37.2: Aman jong asung lam le apolam ani gellin sana'in atomjol sellin, akimvel jouse jong sana mama in atom'in ahi.
37.3: Aman jong aning gol'a pansa ding chun sana kol-li asem in pang lang khat'a chun kol-ni asem'in ahi.
37.4: Chun aman moljol ni thinggi thing mangchan asuiyin, sana mama'in atom na'in ahi.
37.5: Thingkong putna ding in moljol teni chu thingkong geiya chaokol teni achun athil lut'in ahi.
37.6: Chuin aman sana thengsellin thingkong khuna asem in, chule hepi touna jong asem in adung lam chu tong ni le akeh ahin, availam chu tongkhat le akeh alhing in ahi.
37.7: Chuin aman sana sehcha'a kikheng cherub lim bang'a um ni asem doh'in hepi touna among lam'a chun hiche teni chu apansah'in ahi.
37.8: Chule aman cherub khat aning lam khat achun apansah'in among langkhat ma achun Cherub khat ma apan sah in hichengse chu khat'in asem doh'in ahi.
37.9: Cherubim teni chun chunglang anga lhon'in chule alha ajap lhon'in hepi touna chu alhaving tenin a veng bit lhon in ahi.
37.10: Chuin Bezalel in jong thinggi thing mangchan dokhang asem in ahi. Adunglam chu tongni in asem in, avai chu tong khat ahin chule atun lam chu tong khat le akeh alhing'in ahi.
37.11: Aman akhom ho jouse chu sana in atom jol soh keiyin ahi.
37.12: Akimvel sechu khutphang tebep a saovin akhuna asem in chule ageikol jouse jong sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
37.13: Chuin aman dokhang'a manchah ding in sana chaokol-li asem in, dokhang keng-li lama chung apansah'in ahi.
37.14: Chaokol chengse chu abonchan kinai chan aumsah sohkeiyin, chaokol hose chu dokhang akijon teng kimang cha ding ahi.
37.15: Aman hichengse chu thinggi thing jeng mangchan asuiyin, abonchan sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
37.16: Chule dokhang'a machah ding chun sana kong thengsel phabep asem'in lhengkong ahin, gimnamtui halna ding chule lengpi twi chapna ding jong abonchan sana in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
37.17: Chuin Bezalel'in thaomei khom asem'in hichu sana theng sela asem ahi. Thaomei khom tuna ding ahin aputna ding, anigellin phatah'in sehcha'n akheng in ahi. Hichea pahcha kijem'a pang le alutom ijakai jouse chutoh thaomei khom jong jaonan khat'in asem doh tan ahi.
37.18: Thaomei khom chu gup ahin, aning ho a kon in abah thum cheh ahin jamdoh'in ahi.
37.19: Alang alanga abah gup jamdoh hoakon chun thaomei vah khon bang in ajamdoh'in alu ajum in apah jeng jong ahung um doh in ahi.
37.20: Hiche thaomei khom chu almond pahbang'in aning li aum'in ahi.
37.21: Thaomei khom akonna hung jam doh abah gup chengse chu toh'a noilam'a chengse jao nan khat in asem doh tan ahi.
37.22: Almond bah hung jam doh chengse chu toh abonchauva khat ahung soh doh theiyin, hichengse chu sana thengsella kikheng jeng seh ahi.
37.23: Aman jong thaomei sagi asem in amei khao che tanna chengse jaonan sana thengsel in asem doh in ahi.
37.24: Thaomei khom chu ahin, aman chah jouse jaonan sana thengsel dangka somsagi le nga mangchan asem doh in ahi.
37.25: Bezalel chun gimnam tuiya ding'in maicham khat thinggi thing'in asem'in ahi. Hichu adung tong khat chule atun tong khat ahi. Chule hichea kimang cha saki chengse chu toh khat in ahung um doh in ahi.
37.26: Aman maicham chu sana theng sel in atom namsel in, achung vumlam ahin chule ajet le avei jeng ajong, chu le a saki jouse jong abonchan sana in atom namsel in ahi. Hiti chun aboncha'n a kimvel jouse'a chun sana ajem in ahi.
37.27: Sana ki jem pah noiya akol a pang ding in aman sana chaokol ni asem doh in, khat cheh chu akingat tohsah in akhaiyin, maicham put le na manchah ding in asem doh in ahi.
37.28: Aman amoljol jouse jong chu thinggi thing jeng'in asemin sana'in atomnam soh keiyin ahi.
37.29: Chuin aman kinu thei ding'in thaotwi asem doh'in gimnamtui jeng jong chu halnam thei ding'in asem'in ahi. Hichengse chu abonchan thaosem them hon asemdoh bang bang'in asem tan ahi.

38.1: Chuban in Bezalel in jong thinggi thing amangchan, pumgo thilto maicham asem in ahi. Hichu atun feet sagi le akeh ahin asaodan jong feet sagi le akehma alhing'in chule asan dan tong li-le-akeh alhing'in ahi.
38.2: Aman aningli chengse a chun saki-li asem'in hiti chun saki chengse le maicham chu khat'in aum doh theiye. Aman maicham chu sum-eng in atom in ahi.
38.3: Chule aman maicham'a manchah ding in sum-eng a mangchan bel ahin, khe keh, khangbel, kong le sum khe asem in ahi.
38.4: Chu jouvin aman sum-eng jeng in lhuhkhuh asem in ahi.
38.5: Aman hiche dopna ding chun ningli asem'in ajol toh tho a pansahna ahin, hichengse chu sum-eng jeng mangcha'a alhah ahi.
38.6: Aman thinggi mangcha'n thingjol jouse chu sum-eng jeng'in atom'in ahi.
38.7: Aman maicham putna ding'a akol-li asem ho chun, moljol chengse athillut'in ahi. Chuin maicham chu aumna ding asemtuoh'in ahi.
38.8: Bezalal chun ponbuh kotphung'a lhacha'a pang numei ho kisil'na kong ahin chule atunna ding jong chu sum-eng jeng'a asem'in ahi.
38.9: Chuin Bezalel'in pal agen kimsoh keiyin, pal'a khaiding poun jouse chu tupat pomnem ma kisem jeng ahi. Chule lhanglam'a khai ding poundal se chu feet jakhat to somnga alhing'in ahi. hiche pal lhanglama khaiding pondal chengse jong chutupat ponnem jing a kikhong ahin agom chun tong jakhat jen ahilhng e.
38.10: Apal khom somni ahin, aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Palkhom'a akol kisem chengse jong dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
38.11: Aman pal sah lam'a pansa ding'in feet jakhat thoh somnga chule akhom somni jaona hichengse chu sum-eng jeng'a asem ahi. Pal khom ahin, akhaina kol aboncha sana le dangka jeng ahi.
38.12: Chule lhumlam'a pondal pal chengse chu feet somsagi le nga alhing'in akhom ahin, akol kisem jouse chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
38.13: Mailam'a pansa pondal chengse jong chu tong somsagi le nga sao ahi.
38.14: Kelkot polam'a pondal khat chu Tong somnileni akeh alhing in, chule atunna khom jong thum ahi.
38.15: Chule kelkot langkhat'a pansa jong chu kibang'in asem'in Tong somni le ni ahin, chule atunna khom jong thum’ ahi.
38.16: Pal kigetna'a pansa pondal jouse chu tupat ponnem jeng'a kisem ahi.
38.17: Palkhom ahin atunna khom aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Akhom'a kimang ho jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
38.18: Aman palmai kot phung'a ding chun pondal asem'in ahi. Hichu Tong somthum in asaovin, asandan tong sagi le akeh ahi. Aboncha pal'a kigen chengse toh chun kibang ahi.
38.19: Akhom chengse chu li ahin, atunna jouse jong chu sum-eng jeng ahi. Chule atunna, akhaina kol jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
38.20: Houbuh ahin chule akimvella pondal jouse jong sum-eng jeng ahi.
38.21: Hichengse houbuh ahin, chule hettohsana houbuh hichu Mose thupeh dungjuiya kisem, thempu Aaron chapa Ithamar ngaisahna dungjuiya Levi teho natoh nading'a kisem ahi.
38.22: Chule Juda phung khaiya kon Hur chapa, Uri chapa Bezalel'in jong Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang chu bolkim soh keiyin ahi.
38.23: Amapa chu Dan phung akon Ahismach chapa Oholiab chule khut themna neitah le ijakai thilbol them patdum ahin, ponsandup chule tupat ponnem bol them'a jong pang ahi.
38.24: Houbuh le muntheng sahdohna ding'in sana Shekhel somni le ko leh ja sagi leh somthum ahin choi khom uve.
38.25: Israel pumpi'n dangka talent jakhat toh Shekhel sangkhat toh jasagi leh som sagi leh nga jaonan apedoh'uvin muntheng sahna'a kimangcha shekel dungjuiya kisim ahi.
38.26: Hiche dangka kidongkhom chengse hi min kisim dungjuiya hung kipielut chu ahi. (Hichu beka khat shekel kehkhat toh kibang ahin, muntheng laiya manchah ding ahi) Pasal Kum somni'a pat chunglamsea konna ki dong sangjagup le sangthum le janga le somnga alhing'in ahi.
38.27: Muntheng chung khunading, chule atunna ho aboncha'n sana le dangka sangsagi le janga alhing in atunna khat cheh chu dangka somsagi a ki sem ahi.
38.28: Amoh cheng sang le dangka somli le nga chengse chu akhom ahin, akhaina nading'a kisem akol chengse tomnan amang in ahi.
38.29: Chule mipi chun sum-eng a kisem dangka sangnga le jathum le somkhat ahin choijun ahi.
38.30: Hichengse chu akhomho chule houbuh semnan amang'in maicham achun sum-eng apansah'in chule sum-eng chu thil ijakai semnan jong amang'in ahi.
38.31: Sum-eng mangchan palkikai jouse, kelkot chule houbuh sung'a thil ijakai jouse semnan aneiyin ahi.

39.1: Muntheng'a natong ding hon aman chah diu'vin asan-dup chule asanpol bang'a kikhong pon akikhuiyu'vin—Aaron'in muntheng'a na-atoh teng akivonna ding hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
39.2: Bezalel chun sana mangcha'n konggah asem'in hichu asandup le asan-ao patnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
39.3: Aman sana khat lim'in hoisel in khut them tah'in asem'in ahi. Hichu asandup, asan-ao patdum mangcha'n sehcha'n akheng tuoh'in asemdoh in ahi.
39.4: Chule konggah akon chun akhaina ding anung le ama lam'a aumtuo'n lengkou changei jin akhailhah'na aum'in among lam chu akijopmat'in ahi.
39.5: Hiche jong hi a ngaija bang'in hoisel'in asem'in: phatah'a ki pheh, adum, asan-dup, asan-ao sana jeng'a ki tom ponnem mangcha'a kisem, hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh dungjuiya kisem ahi.
39.6: Chule Onyx song chu-ni amang chau'vin chuin sana alhon'in agol tuoh sohkeiyun ahi. Song-ho chu Israel mite ama ama insung dungjui cheh'in amin'u mohor kinam khum bang'in agol tuoh soh kei u've.
39.7: Aman hiche song-agol chule kong-gah lengkou vumma ki khailha akon chun, Israel mite geldoh jing na ding'in asem tuoh sohkeijin. Hichengse jong hi Pakaiyin Mose a thupeh bang in abol sohkei u've.
39.8: Bezalel chun khutthem tah'in Ompho asem'in ahi. Aman konggah bang bang chun asemdoh'in hichu sana ahin, adum chule asan-dup ponnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
39.9: Aman ompho chu lheptup theiyin asemdoh'in akilhep teng adung avai khutchang ko ahiye.
39.10: Amahon song-mantam chu golli'n akoi jun. Amasan Carnelian song-san apansah'uvin, pale-green, chule emerald song ahi.
39.11: Golni channa ding'in blue lapis lazuli, chule songgil ahi.
39.12: Gol-thum channa ding'in aiha song, khipi chule umbel song ahi.
39.13: Gol-li channa ding'in song-eng, Onyx song chule song-mantam-eng apansah'uve. Hi chengse hi abonchan sana twiyin akaimatsoh keiyun ahi.
39.14: Song-gol khat cheh chun Israel mite ama-ama kailhah dungjuiyin amin jouse toh akijih tha'n songkhat cheh achu Mohor kisem ahiye.
39.15: Ompho le konggah kijopmatna ding chun sana thengsel la kisem khao bang'in akhuiyun ahi.
39.16: Chule sana pat-jaang'a kisem le sana akol-ni jong asem uvin sana-kol teni chu ompho ning lama chun akaimat'uvin ahi.
39.17: Ompho tenia kikhai sana kol teni chu akhaimat'uvin ahi.
39.18: Chule sana-pat-jaang teni le sana golteni chu a jopmat uvin ahi. Konggah khaina leng-kou tenia kon chun agen kikhailha tenichu ompho maiya chun abehpeh peh'uvin ahi.
39.19: Chuin ama hon sana kol-ni asemkit'vin, ompho geilam hichu konggah toh chun akaimat uvin ahi.
39.20: Chule sana-pat-jang kolni a semdoh kit uvin ani tah chun lengkou vumma konggah ki khaina achun akaimat uvin ahi.
39.21: Chuin ompho chu pat-jaang khat mangcha'n akolsung'a chun athilmat'uvin konggah'a beh akol chengse toh athilmat uvin ahile phatah'a kipheh bang'in aumdoh tan ahi. Hitia abol phat uchun konggah le ompho chu achah kheh jeng tan ahi. Hichengse chu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in abol sohkei uvin ahi.
39.22: Bezalel chun adum'a kikhong kivonna ding'in sang-khol asem'in
39.23: Hichu Aaron'in aki-ah ding chule hiche songkhol chol chu agei gol akhui-eh cheh cheh'in ahi.
39.24: Ama hon sangkhol-chol chu kolbu thei jem'in asem uvin patdum, asan-ao chule ponnem mangcha'n asemdoh'uvin ahi.
39.25: Chuin amahon sana thengsel'in chaojang asem'uvin hichengse chu abonchan kolbuthei jem le sangkhol golla chun akoiyun ahi.
39.26: Chao jang khat khaina achun kolbu theijem khat in akiba cheh-cheh in ahi. Hiche sangkhol-chol thempu khat chun na-atoh teng hoilai mun hijong le Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kivon ding ahiye.
39.27: Ama hon Aaron le achapate ho jouse ding'in sangkhol chol len tupat jeng'in asem peh'uvin ahi.
39.28: Delkop chule lukhuh ding jong jaonan toka-chol jong poun phatah'in asem'uvin ahi.
39.29: Kigah-ding jouse chu pon-nem asan-dup, san-ao phatah'a heo jang'a kisem jeng, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kibol ahi.
39.30: Achaina'n lal lukhuh sana thengsel in a sem uvin ahi. Mohor kinam den bang in aum khum uvin: Yaweh atheng e ti thucheng akoi un ahi.
39.31: Ama hon lukhuh chu adum khat Aaron delkop ding'in asem'uvin, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
39.32: Hiti chun ajona lam in kikhop khomna hou buh chu sahchaiyin aum tai. Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong atong chai sohkeiyun ahi.
39.33: Chuin ama hon Mose heng'a houbuh chule thil-le-lo ijakai abonchan ahin choijun: akhaina-kolho, agolho, akhomho, akhom noi nung'a ho hiti chun abonchan ahin choi sohkeiyun ahi.
39.34: Ponbuh khuna ding chun kelngoi chule kel chal-vun; hichengsea chu khuding ahi;
39.35: Hettoh sahna thingkong; thingkong putna dinga moljol teni; chule hepi touna jaona,
39.36: Dokhang le thilkeo ho; chule changlhah thilto chengse jaona ahi;
39.37: Sana thengsel'a ki semdoh thaomei-khom chule thaomei-khon chengse jaona, amanchah chengse le athaotwi jong jaona ahi;
39.38: Sana'a kisem maicham, chule kinu ding thaotwi; gimnamtui jaona le pondal jouse jong ahi.
39.39: sum-eng'a kisem maicham; chule aputna ding'a sum-eng jolho jaonan; kisilna kong le atunna jouse jong ahi.
39.40: Bangpheija kigol pondal ho; pal khom chengse ahin; chule houbuh lutna lam; houbuh'a kimang thil-le-lo jouse jaona ahi;
39.41: Thempu hoding'a hoitah'a kikhui hichu muntheng laiya na-atoh teng ule akivon nadiu Aaron thempu, chule achapate hon thempu kin abol teng ule akivon nadiu ahi.
39.42: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh bang chun Israel mite'n jong abonchan ajuikimsoh keiyun ahi.
39.43: Chuin Mose'n anatoh jouseao abonchan avelhan ahi. Amahon tohding ijakai Yaweh thupeh bang'in atong kimsoh keiyuve ti amuchet phat chun, phatthei aboh taovin ahi.

40.2: “Kum-thah nikho masa pennia houbuh natundoh ding ahi.”
40.3: “Chule houbuh sung'a chu hettoh sahna thingkong na koi ding, hiche thing-kong chu muntheng chungnung mun ahin, hichu pondal na khu ding ahi”
40.4: “Dokhang hinpu'n lang, manchah thil-le-lo hojong jaonan, chule thaomei khom ahin thaomei vah chengse jong na hinchoi ding ahi.”
40.5: “Hettohsahna thingkong maija chu gimnamtui lhut'na maicham nakoi ding ahi. Chuteng houbuh kotphung'a chu nakhai ding ahi.”
40.6: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh lutna maiya chu hiche pumgo thilto maicham chu nasem ding ahi.”
40.7: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh le pumgo thilto maicham kimlai donna chu kisil-na kong nakoi ding, adimset'a twi nadip ding ahi.”
40.8: “Chule ponbuh kimvel jousea pal kaiyin lang, kelkot lut'na chu pondal nakhai cheh cheh ding ahi.”
40.9: “Kinu thei thao chu choiyin lang houbuh sung'a thil-le-lo ijakai nanu sohkei ding, aboncha atheng ding'a nathenso ding ahi.”
40.10: “Chule pumgo thilto maicham ahin athilkeo jouse jaona thao nanu ding, atheng ding'a thensona nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hiche maicham chu atheng chungnung'a pang ding ahi.”
40.11: “Chu jou teng, kisilna-kong le atunna ho aboncha thao nanu ding, thensona naneipeh ding ahi.”
40.12: “Aaron le achapate chengse kikhop-khomna ponbuh sung lam'a hinpuijin lang, kong'a kilui twiya chu nasil diu ahi.”
40.13: “Aaron chu thao nanu ding chule ponsil theng pen'na navon ding, ajeh chu keima kinbol thempu a pang diu ahi.”
40.14: “Chule achapate chengse jong hinpuijin lang abonchaova sangkhol-chol na-ah peh ding ahi.”
40.15: “Apau Aaron thao nanu bang chun, amaho chengse jong thao nanu sohkei ding ahi. Ajeh chu abonchauva keima kinbol thempua pang diu ahi.”
40.16: Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun Mose'n jong atong kimsoh kei tan ahi.
40.17: Kumkit-kum thah lha masa nikho ma sapen'in houbuh chu atung doh tan ahi.
40.18: Mose'n hichengse jaonan houbuh chu ana-tung doh tan ahi; akhom ho, amoljol ho, pal khom ho abonchan atong kimsoh keiyin ahi.
40.19: Chuin aman houbuh chung lam'a pon akhu'n Yaweh thupeh bang'in abol'in ahi.
40.20: Aman hettohsahna song-pheng chengse chu alan tingkong sung lam'a chu akoiyin ahi. Chuin aman thingkong chungvum'a chun moljol chu akoilut'in thingkong chungvum'a chun hepi touna akoiyin ahi.
40.21: Aman thingkong chu houbuh lailung'a ahin pu'n pondal kikhu chu ahohdoh paijin, Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun abol in ahi.
40.22: Chuban in Mose'n houbuh sung lam'a chun dokhang akoiyin, polam pondal kilan'na achun akoiyin ahi.
40.23: Chule aman dokhang chung'a chun Yaweh angsung'a ding in changlhah akoiyin ahi. Hichu Yaweh thupeh bang'a abol ahiye.
40.24: Aman houbuh lhang lam dokhang chule muntheng laiya chu thaomei atung doh tan ahi.
40.25: Chuin aman thaomei chu atung doh tan, Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
40.26: Aman ponbuh sung lam'a chun sana gimnamtui chu aluoi doh'in hichu pondal maiya muntheng chungnung chu ahi. Achung'a chun sana gimnamtui chu ahal'in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
40.29: Chule aman houbuh lut-na kotbul'a chun pumgo thilto maichan chu akoiyin ahi. Achung'a chun pumgo thilto atodoh'in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
40.30: Chu ban in Mose'n houbuh le maicham kimlaija chun kisilna-kong chu akoiyin ahi. Aman kong dimset chun twi adip tan, ajeh chu thempu kinbol'a pang hon kisilna'a amanchah ding ahi.
40.31: Mose chule Aaron le achapate'n kong- sung'a twi chu kisilna'a aman chah diu ahi.
40.32: Houbuh maicham lam ahinjut lut teng ule, kisil ngimna'a aman jing ding'u ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
40.33: Chuin aman houbuh le maicham kimvel chengsea chun pondal akhaiyin ahi. Chule kelkot lam'a jong pondal akhaijin ahi. Ajonan Mose'n natoh ijakai atong kimsoh keijin ahi.
40.34: Meibol'in ponbuh chu akhu jeng tan ahile, Yaweh loupina chu kikhop khom'na ponbuh adim lha jeng tai.
40.35: Mose chu houbuh sung lam'a chun alut thei tapon akiting den tai, ajeh chu meibol lom chu kiheh jeng ahitan, chule Yaweh loupi na chun houbuh chu atomlhah jeng ahitai.
40.36: Tun meibol jong chu houbuh akon'in ahung kitol tan ahile, Israel mite jeng jong meibol chie dungjuijin akitol tha jitauvin ahi.
40.37: Amavang meibol aum den laisen, amaho jong aumden jitauve.
40.38: Yawehya konna meibol chun nilhum kei jin houbuh chu atomlha jeng tan, janteng mei-kong in akilah'jin ahile Israel mite'n amittah'uvin amuthei jun ahi. Hiche hin a kholjin na chan uva ahin jui peh ahi.

1.1: Pakaiyin Mose chu houbuh akon in akouvin, ajah’a hiti hin asei peh tai.
1.2: Hiche thupeh chengse hi Israelte hengah seipeh in, “Nang hon Pathen henga pumgo thilto nabol teng uleh, gamkol sung akon bong hon hihen kelcha hijong leh nato jing thei diu ahi.”
1.3: Nangman gancha nato ding chu pumgo thilto ding gancha akul sunga pat hiding, nolna bei thilto hi ding hichu Pathenin asan thei na dinga houbuh kotphunga todoh ding ahi.
1.4: Hiche gancha pumgo thilto chu aluchunga nakhut ngamlhan, chuteng kithoidam nadia hiche thilto chu Pakai adia santhei dol hiding ahi.
1.5: “Chuteng leh Pakai Pathen ma sanga bongchal nou natha ding chule Aaron chapate leh thempu hon gancha thisan chu houbuh maiya maicham akimvel jousea athe khum diu ahi.”
1.6: Chutengleh gancha chu avun nalip ding abong bonga nasat chen ding ahi.
1.7: Hitia chu Aaron chapate thempu hon maicham chunga mei atikong diu, meikong chunga chu thing alom loma akoi diu ahi.
1.8: Amahon maicham kitonaa sa kisem ho chu, aluchang leh athao hochu maicham chung meikou lah achu aban bana akoi diu ahi.
1.9: Ama vang sasung jouse leh akeng ho jouse amasa pena twiya sop lhah ngimsel ding, hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo thilto maicham chung meiya ahal vam ding, hichu Pakai, Pathen adia namtui tah thilto hi ding ahi.
1.10: Nangman pumgo thilto dinga gancha hon lah akon napeh teng, kelngoi ahilouleh kelcha hithei ahi; amavang hichu achal hitei ding chule nolna beihel hiding ahi.
1.11: Chuteng gancha chu maicham chunglama natha ding, Pakai angsunga Aaron thempu leh achapate hon, gancha thisan chu maicham phung anigli chunga achap kimvel soh diu ahi.
1.12: Hiche teng chule thempu pan gancha maicham chu atum tum, alhang lhang nga asat khen ding, aluchang, alap leh athao jouse pumgo thilto maicham mei kong nga ahalvam ding ahi.
1.13: Ahinla sasung jouse chule akeng jouse chu amasa tah’a twiya asop theng ding ahi. Hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo maicham pumpia maicham phung meiya ahal vam soh ding, hichu thilman lutah kipe, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui kihal vam ahi.
1.14: Nangman Pakaiya pumgo maicham’a vacha napeh le, nalhen kah ding vakhu ahilou le vapal napeh ding ahi.
1.15: Hiche teng chule thempu pan vapal leh vakhu ham chu maicham phunga akoi ding, chuteng aluchang chu maicham phung chunga atan lhah ding, thempupan amasa pena hiche thisan jouse chu maicham aning gol jousea achap khum ding ahi.
1.16: Chule thempu pan achang-oi le amul jouse apaimang ding, niso lam maicham phung meivam lah’a ase lhah ding ahi.
1.17: Chuteng thempu pan vapal lha ving tenia amat a abojal ding; asat tel lou hel ding chule maicham chunga meiya ahal vam ding, hichu pumgo maicham, gimnamtui Pakai adia kikat doh ahi.

2.1: Nangman lhosohga Pathen maichama napeh tengleh, hiche lhosohga changbong neldisel chu nalhen doh ding, hiche changbong chunga chu Olive thao nasunkhuma, Bego toh nachap khum ding ahi.
2.2: Hichu Aaron chapate, Thempu ho koma nahin choi ding, Thempu ho chun changbong thaotwi toh kihalsa chu, khut a sip-kham khat ahamdoh ding, Bego namthei toh kihalsa changbong ho chengse chu maicham phunga ahal diu ahi. Hichu Pakaiya dia thilpeh pha leh gimnamtui tah hiding ahi.
2.3: Gasoh maicham amoh chengse chu Aaron leh achapate jouse na hoppeh ding, hiche maicham thilpeh hi Pakai adia thilpeh athengpen leh aman lupen hiding ahi.
2.4: Na lhosohga thilto changlhah chu lhummeiya kisang minsa ahileh changlhah chu thao thengsel'a kikeng hi ding, chol kiso lou hi ding ahi.
2.5: Na lhosohga maicham chu khangbela naken min ahijong leh changbong lah’a anel pen hiding, chule Olive thao naloi ding, hijong chu chol jao lou hiding ahi.
2.6: Hiche chang bong hose chu, atum tum in homkhen inlang chuteng Olive thao toh nuhel in, hichu lhosohga maicham ahi.
2.7: Nangman lhosohga maicham anbela nahon teng, hiche changbong chu anelpen leh Olive thao ahoi pen toh kihel hi ding ahi.
2.8: Ipi lhosohga maicham hijong leh, iti kisem hijong leh thempupa koma hinpuiyun amapa chun maichama atodoh ding ahi.
2.9: Thempupa chun lhosohga maicham atodoh chu, maicham chunga agovam ding ahi.
2.10: Hiche lhosohga maicham amoh chengse chu Aaron le achapate kipe ding amahon anneh chohnaa anei diu, hiche maicham chu atheng pen, ahoipen leh lunglhaina dimset Pakaiya dia kikat doh hiding ahi.
2.11: Nanghon lhosohga maicham nabol teng uleh chol kisolou changlhah jeng hiding, Pathen henga na pehdoh jouseu chu khoiju leh chol jaona ho chu maicham phunga na halvam theilou hel diu ahi.
2.12: Theichang gathah ho jouse jong, Pakai angsunga thilto dia nahin choi thei ahinai, hinlah hiche ho vang chu maicham phunga ki gouvam theilou hel ding ahi.
2.13: Na lousohga maicham todoh ding jouse chu chi-al toh na haltha cheh ding ahi. Hichu Pathen tonsot'a dia na kiteppi nau na geldoh jing nau hiding ahi.
2.14: Na lousohga amasa pen maicham nasem tengleh, changvui lah a ahinhoi apumchep ho chu meiya na hulgot a, Pakaiya dia nahin todoh thei ahi.
2.15: Na anchang ho chu Olive thao sunkhum inlang Bego namthei toh hal in.
2.16: Thempu pan lousohga phasah khat chu alah a Olive thao asunkhuma, Bego toh ahal ding, chu teng Pathen adia thilto loupi hi ding meiya ahal vam ding ahi.

3.1: Nangman gancha akul apat maicham nasem teng, achal hihen anu hijong leh nato thei ding, amavang nolna bei hi ding ahi.
3.2: Gancha luchunga chun nakhut ngam inlang, chule Houbuh lutna a chun that in. Chutengle Aaron chapate, thempu ho chun, thisan chu maicham ning jousea chu athe khum diu ahi.
3.3: Thempu pa chun chamna thilto phabep chu Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah a apeh dingu ahi. Hichea hi athao jouse le asung ho jouse ahin,
3.4: Akongbuh toh kinaiya um akal teni le akimvela beh athao chengse, chule athin chunga beh athao jouse jong jaoding ahi. Hichengse hi akal toh kiladoh khoma,
3.5: Chule Aaron chapaten hichengse chu pumgo thilto dinga maicham chunga meikonga chu ahal vam diu ahi. Hichu Pakaiya dinga lunglhai um gimnam tuitah, thilpeh lupen hiding ahi
3.6: Nangman gancha kul sunga konna gancha chu Pakaiya chamna thilto a naton ding tengle, hichu achal ahiloule anu hiding, amavang nolnabei hiding ahi.
3.7: Nangman nato ding thilto chu kelngoi ahile, Pakai henga nahin kailut na,
3.8: aluchunga nakhut nangapma, chule Houbuh maiya chu natha ding ahi. Chutengle Aaron chapaten kelngoi thisan chu maicham ning jousea chu athekhum soh kei dingu ahi.
3.9: Thempupa chun hiche chamna thilto a athao jouse chu Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah a apeh ding ahi. Hiche lah a chu atingpigu amei kitanlhah na geiya beh athao ho, agila beh athao jouse,
3.10: akongbuh toh kinaiya um akal teni le akimvela beh athao chengse, chule athin chunga beh athao jouse jong jaoding ahi. Hichengse hi akal toh kiladoh khoma,
3.11: Chule Thempu pan hichengse hi maicham chunga ahal vam ding ahi. Hichu Pakai anneh dinga kipe thilpeh lutah hiding ahi.
3.12: Nangman nato ding thilto chu kelcha ahile, Pakai henga nahin kailut na,
3.13: aluchunga nakhut nangapma, chule Houbuh maiya chu natha ding ahi. Chutengle Aaron chapaten kelcha thisan chu maicham ning jousea chu athekhum soh kei dingu ahi.
3.14: Thempu pan hiche thilto lah a konna phabeh khat chu Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah a apeh ding ahi. Hiche ho lah a chu sunga um athao jouse,
3.15: akongbuh toh kinaiya um akal teni le akimvela beh athao chengse, chule athin chunga beh athao jouse jaoding ahi. Hichengse hi akal teni toh kiladoh khoma,
3.16: chule thempu pan maicham chunga ahalvam ding ahi. Hichu Pakai anneh dinga kipe thilpeh lutah, lunglhai um gimnamtui tah ahi. Athao jouse chu Pakaiya ahi.
3.17: Nangman athao hihen athisan hileh naneh louhel ding ahi. Hiche hi nanga dinga aumjing ding dathupeh ahin, chule hoilai muna cheng jong leuchun, akhang khanga nanit jing jeng dingu ahi.

4.1: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hitin aseiye,
4.2: “Israelte henga anoiya hilchahna chengse hi seipeh tan. Koitobang hetlouva chonset bola Pakai danthuho lah a khat pen pen palkeh aum khah a ahileh hitia hi nabol dingu ahi
4.3: Thempu chungnung chun chonset abola ahile, mipi jouse chunga chonset ahin pohlut ahin, hijeh a chu aman hitobang chonset jeh a chu chonset thilto atoding ahi. Hichea chu aman Pakaiya dinga nolnabei bongchalgol khat atoding ahi.
4.4: Aman Houbuh maiya Pakai koma chu bonchalgol chu ahin kailutna, aluchunga akhut angapma, chule Pakai angsunga chu atha ding ahi.
4.5: Chutengle thempu chungnung chun bongchalgol thisan chu themkhat alah a, Houbuh sunga chu lutding,
4.6: Akhutjung chu thisan lah a adelutna, chule muntheng chungnung kidaltan na pondal mai Pakai angsunga chu sagi vei athinkhum ding ahi.
4.7: Chutengle thempupa chun Houbuh sunga Pakai angsunga kitung gimnamtui halna maicham chunga saki hoa chu thisan phabep cheh asunlut ding ahi. Bongchalgol thisan adangse vang chu Houbuh maiya pumgo thilto kitona maicham bula chu asunlhah ding ahi.
4.8: Chujongle thempupa chun bongchalgol chu athao jouse chonset thilto a todinga alahdoh soh keiding ahi. Hiche sathao lah a chu agila beh athao jouse,
4.9: akongbuh toh kinaiya um akal teni le akimvela beh athao chengse, chule athina beh athao jouse jaoding ahi. Hiche ho jouse hi akal teni toh alahdoh tha ding,
4.10: chamna thilto a kitoh kelngoi chunga abol banga abola, chule pumgo thilto maicham chunga ahalvam soh keiding ahi.
4.11: Ahin bongchalgol vun, asa, alu, akengho, asung, chule a-eh amoh jouse chu alah a
4.12: chule ngahmun polama vutvam ho kisunlhah na a kimang ngai jing muntheng lai khat na apohdoh ding ahi. Hiche vutbou chunga chu thing ati-a agovam ding ahi.
4.13: Israel nampi chun Pakai dan thupeh holah a khat apelkeh a achonset uva, ahivanga amahon achonsetlam akihetdoh hih'u jong le, amaho chu chose hithou thou dingu ahi.
4.14: Itih hijongle achonset nau ahin kihetdoh tengule, amahon bongchalgol khat chonset thilto dinga ahin to uva chule Houbuh maiya chu ahin kailut dingu ahi.
4.15: A-upa houchun bongchalgol luchunga chu akhut angap uva Pakai angsunga chu atha dingu ahi.
4.16: Chutengle Thempu Chungnung chun bongchalgol thisan chu phabep khat alah a Houbuh sunga chu achoilut ding,
4.17: akhut jung chu thisan lah a chu aphum lut a, chule muntheng chungnung kidaltan na pondal mai Pakai angsunga chu sagi vei athinkhum ding ahi.
4.18: Chutengle thempupa chun Houbuh sunga Pakai angsunga kitung gimnamtui halna maicham chunga saki ho a chu thisan phabep cheh asunlut ding ahi. Bongchalgol thisan adangse vang chu Houbuh maiya pumgo thilto kitona maicham bula chu asunlhah ding ahi.
4.19: Chutengle Thempupa chun sathao jouse chu alahdoh soh kei ding, chule maicham chunga chu ahal vam ding,
4.20: Thempu chung nunga dinga kitoh chonset thilto bongchal kibolna bang banga abol ding ahi. Hitobanga hi, thempupa chun mipi chu asuh thenga, Pakai toh asuhcham ding, chutengle achonset nau ngaidama umding ahi.
4.21: Chutengle thempu pan bongchal amoh chengse chu ngahmun polama achoidoh a ahalvam ding, thempu chungnunga dinga chonset thilto tobanga chu abol ding ahi. Hiche hi Israel mipi jousea dinga chonset thilto ahi.
4.22: Koi hijongle Isarel mite lah’a alamkai khat pen chun Pakai a Pathen thupeh apelkeh a achonset khah a ahivanga achonsetna kigeldoh lou aumkhah ahile, amapa chu chonse hithou thou ding ahi.
4.23: Amapa chun achonsetna ahin kigel doh ni nileh, chonset thilto a dinga nolnabei kelchal khat ahin kailut ding ahi.
4.24: Chutengle akhut chu kelchal luchanga angap a chule pumgo thilto a kitoh gancha ho kithana Pakai angsunga chu atha ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto ahi.
4.25: Chutengle thempu pan chonset thilto ganthisan lah achu akhut jung aphumlut ding, chule pumgo thlto dinga maicham chunga saki ho a chu asunlut ding ahi. Adangse vang chu maicham bula chu asunlhah ding ahi.
4.26: Chutengle kelchal thao jouse chu maicham chunga ahal vam ding, chamna thilto tobanga abol ding ahi. Hitobanga hi, thempupan lamkaipa chu achonset na a konna asuh thenga, Pakai toh asuhdih ding, chutengle achonsetna kingaidam ding ahi.
4.27: Koitobang milhamho lah a Pakai thupeh pelkeh a chonset bola, ahivanga abollam helou ho jong chu chonse hithou thou dingu ahi.
4.28: Achonsetnau ahin geldoh ni niuleh, achonsetnau thilto dinga nolnabei kelpi khat ahin kai dingu ahi.
4.29: Chonset thilto luchunga chu khut angap uva, pumgo thilto a kitoh gancha ho kithana muna chu atha dingu ahi.
4.30: Chutengle thempu pan akhutjung gan thisen lah achu aphumlut a pumgo thilto dinga maicham chunga saki ho a chu asunlut ding ahi. Thisan amoh chengse vang chu maicham bula asun lhah ding ahi.
4.31: Chutengle kelpi thao jouse chu alah doh ding, chamna thilto a kitoh sathao kibolna banga abol ding ahi. Sathao chu maicham chunga ahal vam ding, chule hichu Pakaiya dinga lunglhai um namtui tah hiding ahi. Hitobanga hi, thempupa chun mipi chu asuh thenga Pakai toh asuhdih ding, Chutengle achonsetnau ngaidama um dingu ahi.
4.32: Mipi chun chonset thilto dinga kelngoi ahin kai uva ahile, hichu nolnabei anu hiding ahi.
4.33: Chonset thilto chunga chu akhut angap uva chule pumgo thilto a kitoh gancha ho kithana muna chu atha dingu ahi.
4.34: Chutengle thempupan akhutjung chu chonset thilto gan thisan lah a chu aphumlut a pumgo thilto dinga maicham chunga saki ho a chu asunlut ding ahi. Thisan amoh chengse vang chu maicham bula asun lhah ding ahi.
4.35: Chutengle kelngoi thao jouse chu alah doh ding, chamna thilto a kitoh kelngoi thao kibolna bang banga abol ding ahi. Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah kipehna chunga sathao chu maicham chunga ahal vam ding ahi. Hitobanga hi, thempupan mipi chonsetna a konna asuh thenga, Pakai toh asuhdih ding, chutengle amaho chu ngaidama um dingu ahi.

5.1: Nanghon thil khat namu'u leh nahet'u chungchanga hettoh sah dinga nakikou tengule, hitobang hettoh sah louva um chu chu chonset ahin, chule nachonset jeh a chu gotna nachan ding ahi.
5.2: “ahilouleh nangman sathenglou sathisa hamkhat chu hetlouva natoh khah a ahileh hichu chona dola thenglou ahi. Hitobanga nathilbol chu nahet doh tengle nangman nakisuhboh nale nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi. Hitobang sathisa chu gamsa hihen, insa hihen, ahiloule tolla vah ho hijong le aboncha chunga nabol soh kei dingu ahi.
5.3: “Ahilou jongle nangman hetlouvin mihem suhboh thei thilkhat natongkha tai. Hiche nathil tohkhah chu nahet doh ni nileh, nangman nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi.
5.4: “Ahiloule nangman aphatna ding hihen asetna ding hijongle ngolhoitah in nakihahsel tan ahi. Hichu ngolhoitah ahi ti nageldoh tengle, nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi.
5.5: Hitobang chonsetna ho hi khat pen pen hijongle nahin geldoh ni nileh, na chonsetna naphondoh ding ahi.
5.6: Chutengle chonset themona jeh a nangman gancha kul sunga konna kelngoi hihen kelcha hijongle anu khat Pakai henga nahin kai ding ahi. Hiche hi chonset thilto hiding thempupan nangma chonsetna a konna nasuhtheng nale Pakai toh nasuh dih na hiding ahi.
5.7: Ahinlah nangman kelngoi nahin kaijou hih jongle, chonset themmona jeh a thilto dinga vakhu ni ahilouleh vapal ni nahin choi ding ahi. Vahcha khat chu chonset thilto ding ahin chule khat chu pumgo thilto hiding ahi.
5.8: Hichengse chu thempupa henga nahin choi ding, aman vacha khat pen chu chonset themmona thilto a ato ding ahi. Vacha ngong chang chu ahechip a, ahivanga aluchang chu atahsa toh akikhen sah lou ding ahi.
5.9: Chuteng chonset thilto gan thisan phabep chu maicham ning ho a chu athekhum ding, chule thisan amoh chengse chu maicham bula chu alonlhah sah ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto hiding ahi.
5.10: Hitia chu thempu pan vacha ani chana pachu pumgo thilto adia asem ding, akibolding dan kisei tobang chetna abol ding ahi. Hitobanga hi thempupa chun nachonsetna a konna nasuhthenga, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chtengle ngaidama naum ding ahi.
5.11: Vakhu ni le vapal ni nahin choi jou louva ahileh, nachonset thilto dinga chu changbong ephah dimni nahin choi thei ahi. Hiche hi chonset thilto ahijeh chun, olive thao toh nahelkhom lou ding, thil namtui jong nalhah lut lou ding ahi.
5.12: Changbong chu thempupa koma nahin choiding, chutengle aman changbong lah a konna chu khut dimkhat asodoh hing ahi. Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah napeh na bana hiche changbong chu Maicham chunga ahalvam ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto ahi.
5.13: Hitobanga hi chonset jeh a themona neiho chu thempu pan asuhtheng a, Pakai anga asuhdih ding, chule achonset nau ngaidama umding ahi. Changbong amoh chengse chu lhosohga thilto kibolna banga, thempupa chang ding ahi.
5.14: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
5.15: “nalah uva khat touvin hettohlou jeh a Pakai thilthengho asuhboh a chonsetna naneikhah uva ahile, Pakai henga chonset thilto nahin choi ding ahi. Chonset thilto ding chu nangma a mong mong kelngoichal nolna bei hiding, ahiloule aman kibahpi khat dangka a nachoh ding, hichu muntheng phunga thiltena a kitetoh dungjuiya hiding ahi.
5.16: Thiltheng nasuhset ho chu aman napeh a nasem phat kitding kit ding, chule adang soma ni jong napehtha ding ahi. Thempupa koma napeh tengle, aman kilhaina kelngoichal toh chun chonset thilto a ato a nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.
5.17: “vetsahnan Pakai thupeh ho lah a khat napelkeh in nachonsetai. Nangman nabolkhel chu nahetlouva nabol hijong le chonse nahithou thou ding chule nachonset jeh a chu bolgima naum ding ahi.
5.18: Hitobang chonset thilto dinga chu, thempupa henga nangma kelngoichal nolnabei khat nahin kailut ding, ahiloule aman kibahpi khat nachoh a nahin kailut ding ahi. Hitobanga hi thempupan hetlouva nabolkhah chonsetnaho a konna nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.
5.19: Hiche hi chonset thilto hiding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai douna a chonse nahi.

6.1: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiye,
6.2: “Vetsahnan mikhat touvin akivoppi khat dounan chonset abolin, chule Pakai henga kitah louvin aumin ahi. Ahilouleh vetsahna dangkhat mikhat in sum nakoisah chu najoubolin, nagumang in, nachompeh tai,
6.3: ahilouleh thilkeu mangkhat namun chule najou naseiyin, thutah seina a nakihahsel in jou naseiyin, ahilouleh hitobang chonsetna dangkhat naboldoh tan ahi.
6.4: Hitobang chonsetnaho hi khatpen pen nabolkhah a ahileh, nangma chonse nahitai. Naguhmang jouse chu nalepeh ding, achamlouva nalahpeh sum hihen lang, min nakoisah naguhmangho hijongleh, ahilouleh thilmang namuho hihen lang,
6.5: jouthu a nakihahsel a nalamdoh jouse hijongleh aboncha a nalepeh ding ahi. Nalahpeh ho jouse koma lhingsetna nalepeh ding lhingsetna nalepeh ding akelvala jong soma ni napeh tha ding ahi. Napehdoh nikho lechun chonset thilto jong napeh tha ding ahi.
6.6: Chonset thilto dinga chu, nangma a mong mong kelngoichal nolnabei khat nahin kaiding, nangma a aumlouleh aman kibahpi khat nachoh ding ahi.
6.7: Hitobanga hi thempupan Pakai angsunga nasuhtheng ding, amatoh nasuhdih, chule hitobang chonsetna jousea konna ngaidama naum ding ahi.
6.8: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiye,
6.9: “Aaron le achapate henga pumgo thilto chungchanga hilchahna hi seipeh tan. pumgo thilto chu ajing jingkah chan'a maicham chunga nadalhah den ding, chule maicham mei jong chu jankhovah keiya nakousah ding ahi.
6.10: jingkah tengle, thempupan atupatpon von chu ahin kivona chule tupat pon vonsungnung chu ahin kivon jouteng chuleh, pumgo thilto kihal vamna vut ho chu ahin suhtheng ding, chule maicham ning langa akoi ding ahi.
6.11: Chujoutengle avonho chu asutlhah ding, avon ngaiya kivon kit ding, chule vutvam ho chu ngahmun polama munthenglai khatna apohdoh ding ahi.
6.12: Hiche phat sunga chu maichama mei chu kou jing ding; mitsah louhel ding ahi. Jingkah sehle thempupa'n meilah a chu thing ahetbe jing ding chuleh pumgo thilto a dinga agontup jing ding ahi.
6.13: Maicham chunga mei chu phat jousea kou jing jeng ding, ding, mit louhel ding ahi.
6.14: Hichu lhosohga thilto maicham ahin, chule Aaron chapate jousen thilto ding chu Maicham Pakai angsunga ahin tocheh diu;
6.15: Amaho jouse lah a mikhat pen chun athilto lah’a konna lhosoh changbong neldi khut dim khat aham doh ding, lhosoh thilto toh kihel thaotwi leh gimnamtui puma alah a, hichu mangtheilou maicham chunga chu agovam soh hel ding, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui soh ding ahi.
6.16: Chule amoh chengse chu Aaron le achapate sesen aneh diu ahi. Aneh teng uleh cholso lou hiding, hichu muntheng lai khat a aganeh diu ahi; aneh nadiu mun chu kikhop khomna ponbuh sunga chu aneh diu ahi.
6.17: Chule changlhah neh dia akiken teng uleh, cholso lou hi ding; hichu keiman pumgo maicham ka chan ka hoppeh ahin, chonset maicham le themmona chungnung ahi.
6.18: Pathen akonna pumgo thilto thudola nakhang lhung uva dia thu katep peh na hiuvin, hichu Aaron chate lah a pasal jousen aneh diu ahi, hiche maicham thilto hi koi hile atongkha chan theng jing ding ahi.
6.19: Mose henga Pakaiyin hiti hin aseijin,
6.20: Aaron le achapate hon thempu pan mun dia thao akinu nikho teng uleh, Pakai henga athilto diu chu hiche hiding ahi; lhosohga thilto dia changbong nelsel ephah dimkhat hopsom lah a hop khat hiding, akeh khat chu jingkah maichama atoding chule akeh langkhat ma chu nilhah lang maichama ato ding ahi.
6.21: Changbong nel chu khangbel sunga thaotwi toh kichoh hel ding, chuteng nangman dip a kihelsa chu maicham thilto dang ho banga apheng phenga nakoi tup ding; hichu Pakaiya dia gimnamtui dinga nahin choi ding ahi.
6.22: Chule Aaron chapate ho lah a, ama khela thempu dia thaonu chang pachun, hiche maicham thilto chu a-itih chana dia Pakai heng lama ato ding, hiche ho jouse chu govam hiding ahi.
6.23: Thempu koi hileh lhosohga maicham thilto ato doh jouse, aboncha agovam hel ding, hichu koima chan aneh thei lou ding ahi.
6.24: Chuin Mose henga Pakaiyin hitin asei pehin ahi.
6.25: Aaron le achapate henga hiti hin sepeh in, hiche hi chonset jeh’a maicham thilto dinga dan ahin; hichu pumgo thilto gancha kitthana mun Pakai angsunga chonset maicham thilto ding gancha jong tha ding, ajeh chu hiche hi maicham thilto lah a atheng chungnung ahi.
6.26: Chonset jal'a maicham thilto toh doh a thempu pan asa chu aneh ding, hichu kikhop khomna ponbuh muntheng lailung khat a aneh ding ahi.
6.27: Chule itobang thil hijongleh hiche maicham thilto sa gatong kha chan athenga umjing ding, athisan hijongleh apon chunga anat khah a ahileh, hiche thisan natna ponsil chu nangman muntheng lailunga nasop ngim ding ahi.
6.28: Chule sa honna bel jeng jong kivo keh ding, sum eng bela mangchaa kihon ahileh, suhtheng sela twiya phumlut ding ahi.
6.29: Hiche maicham thilto sa chu, thempu ho jouse lah a pasal kiti phot in aneh diu, hichu atheng chungnung ahi.
6.30: Ahinlah muntheng muna kithoidamna dinga thisan puma kipolut sa, kikhopkhomna ponbuh sunga kilhut chonset themmo thiltoa kithat sa chu koiman aneh thei lou hel ding, asa chu apumpia meiya govam hel ding ahi.

7.1: Themmo jeh a maicham thilto ding chu hiche hi ahi, hichu atheng chung nung hiding ahi.
7.2: “Pumgo thilto maicham phunga gancha kithana muna chu, hiche themmona thilto chu kithat ding chule gan thisan chu maicham ning gol jousea chapkhum ding ahi.”
7.3: Hitia chu thempu pan athao jouse aboncha maichama atodoh ding, amei tobuh thao, asung thao alap jouse toh,
7.4: Ataijung lah a akal teni leh akala athao um chengse, athin leh akal teni jaonaa aphe le athao jouse aboncha alah doh cheh cheh ding,
7.5: Chuteng leh thempu pan pumgo thilto ding a Pakai heng lam, maichan chunga agovam hel ding ahi, ajeh chu themmo maicham thilto ahi.
7.6: Hitobang maicham thilto chu thempu ho lah a pasal kiti phot in aneh thei ding, ahin muntheng sung lai khat a aneh ding dol ahi, hichu atheng lah a atheng chung nung khat ahiye.
7.7: Themmona maicham thilto le chonset thilto hi akikhehna umbeh lou ahin, anitah a dan khat a um chu ahi, chutia chu athoiya pang thempupa chun ki thoi damna maicham thilto chu akilah ding ahi.
7.8: Pumgo maicham thilto a pang jouse sanpeh a toh doh a pang thempu pan hitabang maicham thil to savun cheng se chu akilah ding ahi.
7.9: Chule lhosohga maicham thilto, meilhum sunga kigousa, khang bela kihon sa le ki kang sa jouse chu aboncha hiche thempupa chun akilah ding ahi.
7.10: Hitia chu lhosohga maicham thilto thaotwi kichap kotsa hihen, akichap kot lou hi jongleh, aboncha Aaron chapate chang diu ahi.
7.11: Ajeh chu hiche maicham thilto hi, koi hileh Pathen henga chamna maicham kilhaina ganthaa hitia hi chepi ding ahi.
7.12: Maicham thiltoh pan thangvahna dia ato doh ding ahileh, hitobang thangvah maicham thilto ding chu changlhah thaotwi kichap khumsa changlhah pheng phabep chu toh, hiche thaotwi toh kihalsa changlhah le changbong neldil a kisem chutoh ato thading ahi.
7.13: Amapa chun hiche thangvahna maicham thilto kilhaina gantha chu chol jaolou changlhah chutoh ahin totha ding ahi.
7.14: Chule hiche thilto ho jouse lah’a konna chu khat cheh alah doh ding, hichu Pakai maicham thiltoa apeh ding ahi. Hiche ho jouse chu chamna maicham thilto gancha thisan jouse chap jal'a pang thempupa chang ding ahi.
7.15: Hiche thangvahna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha kithat chu, anikhoa neh ding ahin, asa neo khat jeng jong khovah chan umsah lou ding ahi.
7.16: Chule hiche gancha kilhaina maicham toh doh pa chun, thu lolhin sah a kitoh doh ham ahilouleh deisah jal'a kitoh doh ahileh, hiche kilhaina gancha kitha nikho mama achu aneh ding amoh chengse chu ajing lam le aneh thei kit ahi.
7.17: Chule ani thum chana sa umho vang chu meiya govam hel ding ahi.
7.18: Ito bangkhat a hiche mipan gancha kilhaina maicham thilto aneh nah laiya ahileh, hiche kilhaina maicham tohpa chu santhei dol ahipoi; hiche maicham thilto chu amapa dinga ngensea umthei lou ding ahi, ajeh chu hot umtah sohdoh ahitan hitobang thilto nekha sun chu chonset themmona chu chang jing ding ahi.
7.19: Thil theng lou sa chu neh tah lou ding, hichu meiya govam hel ding ahi, hinlah mi koihileh atahsa chung theng chan chun sa aneh thei jing ahi.
7.20: Ahinlah koibang khat chu ama tichung boh puma, Pakaiya dia kitoh doh kilhaina maicham nekha sun chu koi hileh amite lah a konna pampeiya umjing ding ahi.
7.21: Koi hileh atheng lou tongkha achu, hiche atheng lou atoh khah pen pen chu, mihem ahin gancha theng lou hi jong le hiche ho jouse toh chun kilhaina maicham thilto ho chu nekha jing ta leh, amapa chu amite lah a konna pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
7.22: Pathenin Mose henga hiti hin asei tan,
7.23: Israel chate jouse henga hiti hin thu sepeh in, sathao kiti phot bongchal thao hihen, kelngoi thao, kelcha thao hitaleh athao kiti phot chu neh da jeng un,
7.24: Gancha thikam thao hihen, gam mang lah a gamsa tha athao hijongleh hiche sa thao hochu lam choma kimang thei ding, hinlah neh vang naneh louhel diu ahi.
7.25: Hitobang achu koi hijong leu chun, Pathen henga govam dia kitoh doh gancha sa thao nekha chan chu namite lah uva konna pampeiya um ding ahi.
7.26: Nanghon thisan kiti phot, vacha thisan le gancha thisa kiti phot, nache lenauva thisan um phot chu naneh thei lou diu ahi.
7.27: Hiche bang achu nalah uva koi hileh, thisan tep kha phot chu pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
7.28: Pathenin Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
7.29: Israel chate jouse henga hiti hin seipeh tan, nalah uva koitobang in Pathen adia chamna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha apeh nom chan in peh jeng thei ahi.
7.30: Amachun atahsa tah a hiche kilhaina gancha chu Pathen heng lama ahin kaiya, hichea chu athilto ding chu athao le a oppheng ahin choi ding, chuteng Pathen ansunga aoppheng lai chu maicham thennso naa pang ding ahi.
7.31: Chujou tengleh thempu pan sa thao chengse maicham phunga agovam hel ding, a oppheng jouse vang chu Aaron chapate chang ding ahi.
7.32: Chamna thilto nabol bang un, Sa amal khat pen chu thempupa henga napeh lut diu ahi.
7.33: Hitia chu Aaron chapate ho lah a gancha thisan le athao toh'a pangpa chun, ama chan ding samal jet lam chu aki koi ding ahi.
7.34: Ajeh chu kithenso sa oppheng le sa mal chu Israel chate jouse lah a kon kiladoh a, chamna maicham thilto apeh jouse lah uva konna kachom khen doh ahi.
7.35: Hichu Aaron le achapate jouse chang diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho Pathen thempu adia akithen souva ahung kipeh doh nikhouva pat, Pathen henga pumgo maicham thilto jouse akilah diuva gotsa chu ana hitai.
7.36: Chule thempu dia thao akinu nikhouva pat, hichu amaho chang diu ahitia Pathenin Israelte lah a ana phondohsa ahitai, hitia chu akhang lhung keiyuva tang louhela bat a anei jing diu ahi.
7.37: Hichu pumgo maicham thilto ding dan, lhosohga, themmona, kisuhthengna chule chamna maicham thilto dan hi ding ahi.
7.38: Gamthip lailunga Pathenin Mose henga athusei chun, Israel chaten Pathen henga maicham thilto ahinchoi diu ahitia, ana phondohsa ahitai.

8.1: Hichun Pathenin, Mose henga hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
8.2: Aaron leh achapate kou khom inlang, akivonna ding un, kiloi ding thaotwi choiyin chonset maicham thilto ding in bongchal le kelngoi achal nitoh puiyin chule cholso lou changlhah pucha khat jong nachoi peh ding u,
8.3: Chuteng leh khopi sunga ami takip ki khopkhomna ponbuh kot phunga chun koukhom soh keiyin, ati.
8.4: Chuin Mose’n jong Pathen thupeh bang bang chun na atong in, khopi sunga konin amitakip chu kikhopkhomna ponbuh kot achun ahung kikhom soh tauve.
8.5: Hichun Mose’n jong Mipi hojouse jah a thu aseiyin, hiche hi Pathenin bol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
8.6: Aaron le achapate ho Mose’n ahin puitan, abonchauvin twiyin asiltheng soh tauve.
8.7: Chuin Aaron chu sang khol lah a alenpen chu avonpeh tan, sangkhol chol jong avon peh in, konggah jong agah peh tan ahi, hichu khut them tah a kisem chalchep konggah chu agahpeh in ahi.
8.8: Hiti chun ompho achung a atom peh in, chuin ompho chunga chun vahna le chamkimna akoi lhing sel’in ahi.
8.9: Chuin Mose’n Aaron luchunga del akop peh in, adelkop mailama chun sana pheng lallukhuh akhaipeh tan, Pathenin Mose athupeh bang chun aboltai.
8.10: Chuin Mose’n tahsaa anu ding thao chu alan, Pathen houbuh le asunga umjouse anu sohkeiyin, thensona aneiyin ahi.
8.11: Hichea chu vel sagi jen achap khum ding, maicham leh ama manchah thil jouse jong chu thao achap soh in, kisilna konglen chule atunna jong thaotwi achap in abonchan athenso tan ahi.
8.12: Thempu Aaron luchunga nu ding in thaotwi helkhat achap khum in, atahsa ajong anun, athenso paitan ahi.
8.13: Chuin Aaron chapte ho chu Mose’n ahin puiyin, khat cheh in sangkhol len a ahpeh tauvin; konggah jeng jong gahpeh in aluchang cheh uva lukhuh akhuh peh cheh un, Pathen thupeh bang bang in Mose’n amaho chu khat cheh in abolpeh tauvin ahi.
8.14: Hiti chun Chonset maicham thilto ding in, bongchal chu ahin kai luttan, chuin Aaron le achapate hon gancha luchanga chun akhut angam lhasoh keiyun ahi.
8.15: Chuin bongchal chu Mose’n athat paiyin, athisan achun akhut jung aphum lut in, maicham phunga saki ho achun achap natsoh keiyin, maicham jong athenso in, ganthisan chu maicham khombul hoa achapnat soh helin, thensona sem in, hiachun kithoina jong aboltan ahi.
8.16: Asunga athao jouse achom khen in, athin lah a aphe le athao le akal teni ahin, athao beh jouse jong achom khen in, hiti chun Mose’n maicham achun agouvam tai.
8.17: Hiche bongchal avun atahsa ho chule aeh jaonan, Pathen thupeh bang bang in Mose’n polam ngah mun achun agouvam heltan ahi.
8.18: Chuphat in pumgo maicham thilto ding in kelngoi chal ahin pelut in, hiti chun Aaron le achapaten kelngoi chal chunga chun akhut-u angam soh kei tauvin ahi.
8.19: Mose’n kelngoi chal chu athat in, gan thisan chu maicham aning gola achap khum in ahi.
8.20: Kelngoi chal sa chu asem toh selin, aluchang ahin asa kisem toh sel leh athao abonchan Mose’n meiya agouvam tan ahi.
8.21: Gancha sa sung jouse ahin, akeng ahin; abonchan twiya asoptheng soh phat in, Pumgo maicham thiltoa ding in Mose’n kelngoi chal chu agoutan, Pathen thupeh dungjuiyin Mose’n Pathen heng lam adin pumgo thilto namtuisel chu atodoh in ahi.
8.22: Chuin kelngoi chal khatma thensona ding in ahin kailut paiyin, Aaron le achapate hon gancha luchang achun akhut-u angam soh keiyun ahi.
8.23: Hiti chun Mose’n jong Kelngoi chal thenso na chu athat tan, athisan phabep aladoh in, Aaron bilkol jetlam achun aloipeh in, akhut jetlang khupi achun thisan anupeh in, akeng phang khupia jong chun anupeh in ahi.
8.24: Hiti chun Aaron chapate abonchauvin ahin puiyin, gan thisan hel khat khat abilkol jet lamu aninggol leh akhut jet lamu khutpi cheh-u ahin, akengphang jetlamu khupi achun anunat peh soh keiyin ahi. Gan thisan chu Mose’n jong maicham kimvela chun athe chap soh hel in ahi.
8.25: Athao ho jouse ahin, asunga athao ho jouse jaonan, athina aphe um cheng leh athao toh kihal akal teni jaonan, athao chengse chutoh amal jet lam achom khen in,
8.26: Pathen angsunga kitung pucha sunga chol jaolou changlhah phengkhat, thao toh kihal chu mang chan, changlhah atum tuma umkhat jong alan, hiche ho jouse chu abonchan sathao holeh samal chunga chun akoiyin,
8.27: Chuphat in Aaron le achapate khut a apedoh tan, hichengse chu abonchan Pathen angsunga thensona maicham din thennsona aneiyin ahi.
8.28: Hiche ho chu abonchan Mose’n anung lah in, abonchan pumgo maicham thilto toh chun maicham phunga meiyin agouvam tai. Ajeh chu ki thensona maicham ahin, hichu Pathen heng lam adia gimnamtui tah pumgo thilto ahi.
8.29: Aoplhang se chu Mose’n aladoh in, Pathen heng lama thensona thilto din alhan in, hichu Pathen thupeh bang banga Mose’n chanvou anei ding ahi.
8.30: Thao phabep khat le gan thisan phabep maicham chunga um chu nu ding in, Mose’n alan Aaron tahsa chung le aposil chung hoa chun achap khum in, Aaron le achapate jouse jaonan, achapate jouse ponsil ahin ama ponsil abonchan thensona aneiyin ahi.
8.31: Hiti chun Mose’n Aaron chule achapate jouse henga hiti hin aseipeh in, kikhop khomna ponbuh achun sa hi kihon tauvin, ajeh chu Aaron le achapa ten aneh diu ahi, tia ana kiphong doh bang bang achun; khopi phung lam achun sa thensona changlhah pucha sunga um chu naneh diu ahi.
8.32: Hichea naneh moh chengseu chu, aboncha sa hihen changlhah hileh meiya nago vam diu ahi.
8.33: Chule ni sagi sung sesea koi machan kotpi phung apaltan lou ding, hichu thensona nikho ahung lhun kahsea koi macha pampot louhel ding na hiuve, ajeh chu na kithenso na dinga, na ki suhtheng ngaijah ahi.
8.34: Hichu ahin tunia na kitong banga hi, Pathenin nang ho kithoina sem nadinga thupeh ana nei ahitai.
8.35: Hijeh chun nangho koihi jongleu chun nisagi sunga hi, ki khopkhomna ponbuh kotpi bula najan ge jeng diu; Pathen thupeh banga ima jouse najui diu, hiche bang bang achu keima jong ngensena eina kipe a ahi.
8.36: Chuin Aaron le achapate jousen, Pathen akon Mose’n athupeh bang uchun ijakai abol tauvin ahi.

9.1: Chuin niget lhin nin, Mose’n Aaron chapate chengse le Israelte lah a upa ho akou khom in,
9.2: Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in, chonset maicham thilto ding in bongchal khat gakaiyin, chule pumgo maicham thiltoa toding in kelngoi chal khat ma gakaiyin lang, anitah achu Pathen henga na todoh a,
9.3: Hitia hi Israel chate henga na seipeh ding, chonset maicham thilto ding in, kelchal khat gakaiyun lang chule pumgo maicham thilto ding in, nolnabei bongnou khat leh kelngoi nou khat nahin kaidiu ahi.
9.4: Pathen angsunga chamna maicham ki lhaina thiltoa din, bong chal khat le kelngoi chal khat naga kaidiu; lhosohga maicham thiltoa din changbong thaotwi kichapsa jong jaonan, ajeh chu tuni khoa hi nangho henga Pakai, Pathen hung kilah thei ahi, tin hil’un tin aseiye.
9.5: Hitobang chun amaho jousen Mose akonna athu jah bang un, thil jouse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh mailam achun ahin poluh sohtauvin; chuin khopi sung akon japin ahin nailut un, abonchauvin Pathen ansung achun ading soh keiyun ahi.
9.6: Chuin Mose’n ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh in, hitobang thil ho jouse hi Pathenin nang ho natoh dinga napeh doh-u ahitan, hichea chu Pakai, Pathen loupina nangho jal'a naheng uva hung kilah ding ahi.
