23.8: Ni sagi sungsea chu Pakai dia govam thil tang louva na todoh diu, ni sagi lhin nikho vangleh khompi theng nikho ahitan, hiche nikho tengchu leh na bonchauva na kichol diu lelna thei na natoh lou diu ahi.
23.9: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
23.10: Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin seiyin, keiman kapeh nau gamsung nahin phah uva gamga soh nahin lo teng uleh, nachangphal gao masapen chu thempupa lama nachoi diu ahi.
23.11: Hichea konna chu thempu pan nangho santhei dol nahi thei nadiuva nathenso diu, ajing nikho cholngah ni teng leh thempu pan thensona anei ding ahi.
23.12: Hiche thensona kibol nikhoa changpal natodoh teng uleh, kelngoinou achal khat jong Pakaiya dia nolnabei hel chu nakat doh tha diu ahi.
23.13: Hiche nikhoa lhosohga todoh ding chu, suhlou changbong neldisel Ephah khat dim, hopsoma hopni kiso ding; hichu thaotwi toh kihal, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui sela govam ding, don ding lengpithei jong chu khon dimkhat hoplia konna hopkhat chu hichea ding chu ahi.
23.14: Chule hiche nikho masang chun, na Pathen pa diuva thilto ding nahin pohlut kahseo vin, changlhah jong nehdao vinlang, chang kikang poh ahin changlhah kigou tho jong nehdauvin, hoilai chana cheng jong leuchun hicheng hi nakhang nakhang uva chonna dan in jui jing un.
23.15: Cholngah nikho aki chai apat, changpal nahin choi uva, thensona thilto nabol nikho uva pat nikho nasim cheh cheh diu, hapta sagi chan nasim diu ahi.
23.16: Cholngah nikho vel sagi chan geiya nasim uva chule ajing nikho nisomnga lhin changeiya nasim tha diu, chujou tengleh Pakai heng lama lhosohga thilto natodoh diu ahi.
23.17: Na inson cheh uva pat Ephah dim khat cheh hopsom lah a, hopnia kikhen thenso thilto dinga changlhah lhonsao ni jaona nahin choi diu ahi, hiche teni chu cholsosa ahin, Pakaiya dia lhohsoga masapen thiltoa pang ding ahi.
23.18: Chule hiche changlhah jaona chu kumkhat lhing tasa nolna beihel kelngoi sagi, bongchal golpai khat, kelngoi chal ni jaona nakat doh uva, hiche gancha ho chu Pakaiya dia pumgo thiltoa kimang ding gimnamtui sela meiya govam ding ahi.
23.19: Chonset thilto ding in kelchal khat mang unlang, chamna thilto le gantha ki lhaina dinga kum khat a tah kelchal ni nahin kat diu ahi.
23.20: Chule hicheng ho chu thempu pan Pakai angsunga thensona anei ding, lhosohga masa thilto changlhah jaonaa, kelngoi chalteni jong chu athenso tha ding ahi, hiche hose hi thempu dia Pakai angsunga thil thengsel'a um ahi.
23.21: Hiche nikhoa hi khompi khat nanei diu, hichu khompi thengsel'a naman uva, lel nathei natoh nabol lou diu, na khang lhum keiyuva hoichana chejong leuchun, hiche hi chonna dan dungjuiya najui jing diu ahi.
23.22: Na bonchauva na gamsung uva konna chang na-at teng uleh, na lou jao uchu apam chin jousea na-at chai lou diu, nachang at na nung uva chang khai ho jong nachom thengsel lou diu ahi; vaichate leh kholjin hodia na koipeh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima nangho Pakai, Pathen kaum jing e, ati.
23.23: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in hiti hin bol in, ati.
23.24: Israel chate jouse jah a hiti hin sei peh tan, lha sagi lhin teng, hiche lhasung nimasa nileh na bonchauva naki chol uva khompi theng nanei diu, sumkon mutgin tothoa naphon jal jidiu ahi.
23.25: Thabeina thei natong hih un, Pakai henga pumgo thilto nahaimil lou diu ahi.
23.26: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bolin, ati.
23.27: Lha sagi lhin nikho nisom alhin nikho hi ki thoidamna ahin, hiche nikhoa hi thonlouva khompi theng khat nabol diu, an ngol tothoa Pakai dia pumgo thilto nato doh diu ahi.
23.28: Hiche nikhoa hi koima chan thabeina thei natoh nabol lou diu, ajeh chu kithoidamna nikho loupi khat ahin, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu henga thoidamna nanei diu ahi.
23.29: Koi hijong leh hiche nikhoa an ngol lou aum leh, amite lah akonna pampeiya um ding ahi.
23.30: Hitia chu koi hijong leu chun, hiche nikhoa hi thabeina thei natong aum khah leh, ama chu amite lah a konna kasuh mang ding ahi.
23.31: Na bonchauva natoh thilbol akon na nakikangse cheh diu, hoilai muna hijong leh na chenna jouseuva chonna dan ahitia, najui cheh diu ahi.
23.32: Hiche nikho hi na boncha diuva kicholdo nikhoa naman jing diu, hitia chu an ngol tothoa, hiche lhasung nikho ahung lhin niapat, ajing nilhah lam chana choldonaa naman cheh diu ahi, ati.
23.33: Pakiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
23.34: Israel chate jouse henga seipeh tan, lhasagi lhinna chule nisom le ninga lhin nikhoa pat, ni sagi sungse hi Pakaiya dia ponbuh kut a kimang ding ahi.
23.35: Kut akipat nikho chu khompi theng nikho ahin, hijeh chun thabei nathei natoh ima bolhih un, ati.
23.36: Tanglou hela ni sagi sunga Pakaiya dia thilto nabol jom jing diu, niget alhin nikho tengleh khompi theng khat nabol diu, Pakai ansunga pumgo thilto nakat doh diuchu ahin, hichu khompi theng laitah ahijeh'in thabei nathei natoh akon nakikangse cheh diu ahi.
23.37: Achunga kimin phah chengse hi, Pakaiya dia phat tepsa kut hochu ahin, hiche nading chun Israel chate koukhom soh keiyun lang, khompi theng tothoa, thilto ding ho ahin, pumgo thiltonaa naman diu, anikho mama a abol ding dan jouse govam ding hihen, donthei lengpitwi hi jongleh, nabol diu ahi.
23.38: Hiche ho jouse hi na bonchauva Pakaiya dia na thiltou hichu deilhen choma na thilto uva ahitan, chule athenso ho jouse jaonan, nathil pehdoh jouseu leh Pakaiya dia cholngah nikho le adang dang nanit kimsel hou kisim tha lou ahi.
23.39: Lhasagi chan nisom leh ninga lhin nikho leh, na bonchauva gamsung lho sohga nachop kimsoh niuva pat nasim uva Pakaiya dia ni sagi sungsea kut tang louva nabol jom jing diu, hiti chun kut akipat nichu choldo nikho theng hiding, niget lhin nichan chu choldo nikhoa naman diu ahi.
23.40: Kut kipat nikho teng thingga ahoilai nalo lhah diu, lusuna tampi jaona, thingboh phatah tah na helhah diu, vadung pang lah a tomdo he tohthoa, hicheng chu na kichoi uva, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu angsunga tang louva nakipa jing diu ahi.
23.41: Kumkhat seh le Pakai heng lama ni sagi tang louva kut khat nabol jing diu, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dan ngaiya naman chah jing diu, lhasagi lhinna lhasung achu naman diu ahi, ati.
23.42: Ni sagi sunga na bonchauva lhambuh a nachen diu, Israel sungkon agammi cheng aboncha lhambuh sunga cheng ding ahiuve.
23.43: Hichea kon chun nachilhah teuvin keima tah in Egypt gam'a konna, Isarel chate jouse kahin puidoh chun lhambuh sung a bou kachen sah ji'e ti, ahin hetdoh thei diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahi, ati.
23.44: Mose’n Pakai dinga phat tepsa kut ho jouse chu, Israel chate jouse lah a aphondoh peh ahi.

24.1: Pakaiyin Mose hengah thu asepeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
24.2: Isarel chate ho henga seipeh tan, mit theilou helding vah jing din, olive thaomei chu nahin choipeh nading un seipeh tauvin.
24.3: Ki khop khomna ponbuh hettohsahna pon kilang doh, hiche muna chu Aaron in thaomei kivah chu tang louva avet kol jing ding ahi. Hiche thaomei hi Pakai angsunga nilhah muthima pat jingkah khovah geiya kivah khovah hel ding ahi. Hiche hi nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dana nanei jing diu ahi.
24.4: Aaron in jong Pakai sana thaomei khom phunga chu, hiche thaomei kivah jouse chu avah jingnai ti, photchetna avetkol jing ding ahi.
24.5: Chule nangman chang bonga kigoidi chu nalah ding, hichu changlhah lhonsom le ni nasoa naken ding, lhonkhat cheh chu Ephah dimkhat hopsoma hopni lhingsela kisem hiding ahi.
24.6: Chang lhah nasemsa chu golni nia nagol ding, golkhat achu changlhah lhongup pang ding, sana thengsel'a kisem touna chunga chu nagola nakoi ding ahi.
24.7: Gimnamtui nalah a changlhah golkhat chu nasun den ding, hichu nangman nato doh changlhah toh chun Pakaiya dia govam thiltoa kitoh doh tha ding ahi.
24.8: Cholngah nikho seh le hichu Pakai angsunga kigol doh ding, hitia chu beitih umlouva Israel chaten machah thei hochu atodoh jing diu ahi.
24.9: Hiche thilto hose hi Aaron le achapate ho ding ahin, hitia chu hiche thilto hochu muntheng laiya anehji diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche thilto chu Aaron ding Pakaiya dia pumgo thilto kitoh dohsa, ama chanvou dia thiltheng tah ahin, hichu tang louva chonna dan dinga juijing ding ahi.
24.10: Pasal khat chu anu Israel numei chule apa Egypt mi, hichepa chu ahungvah doh le tan ngahmun khat a avah lut in ahileh, hichun Israel chaten aum kemvel tauvin, chuin Israel numei nu chapa jong Israel chapa khat toh chun akiboi lhontan ahi.
24.11: Israel numeinu chapan jong Pathen pa min panin taitomna toh thon agao sapjeng tai, chuin mipi hon ama chu Mose heng lama ahin pui tauve. Hichepa anu min chu Shelomith ahin, Dan phung akonna Dibri chanu ahi.
24.12: Amahon jong hichepa hi iti ding hi tam atiuvin, Pakai lunglam aheng uva ahung kilah kahsea din, mihenna kul sunga chun akhumlut tauve.
24.13: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
24.14: Pathen gaosap mipa chu polam ngahmuna hin kaidoh inlang, aman agaosapna awchang japha chan in, aluchunga akhut angap lhah cheh diu, hiche jouteng leh khompi thenga mipi jousen song in seplih jeng tauhen, ati.
24.15: Chule Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh tan, koi hileh Pathen gaosap mihem aum khah leh, hiche mihem chun amatah themmona akipoh ding ahi.
24.16: Pathen taitom mihem chu thajeng ding ahi, khompia pang mihem jousen amachu songa aselih diu, kholgammi hihen agamsung chengden hi jongleh, Pathen min taitom mihem kiti phot chu thana chang ding ahi.
24.17: Chule mihem khat that chu, ama jong thina chansah ding ahi.
24.18: Koi hileh gancha that achu ama chun akhel apeh doh pai ding, hiche gancha khel thei dia chu gancha hing khat alepeh ding ahi.
24.19: Koi hileh ain-heng khattou amavo khah leh, aman hichepa abolna banga chu ama chunga jong bolgimna lhung ding ahi.
24.20: Agu ham achang ham asuh chep a ahileh, ama jeng jong agu achang suhchep del ding, amit asuh chot tah jong leh ama mit jong hitia chu suhchot peh ding, aha ham khat asuh lhoi khah jong leh ama ha jong suh lhoi pai ding; aman mi abol gimset banga chu ama chunga jong abepbep a lhunsah ding ahi.
24.21: Gancha that aum leh hiche athat pen pen chun akhel ahola apeh le ding, mihem chunga hem lama thatpa chu ama jeng jong tha ding ahi.
24.22: Na bonchauvin kholgam akonna mihem hihen, agamsung akon hijong leuchun abonchauva danthu khat a chondel del diu, ajeh chu keima Pakai leh nangho jouse Pathen pachu kahi, ati.
24.23: Mose jong hiti chun Israel chate jouse jah aseipeh soh tan, chuin amahon Pathen taitomna neipa chu polam ngah munkhat a ahin kaiyun, amapa chu song in aseplih tauvin ahi. Pathen thupeh bang in Israel chate jousen abolun ahi.

25.1: Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chunga konin, Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in,
25.2: Israel chate jouse jah a seiyin, na bonchauva keiman kapehna gam nahung lhun teng uleh agam pumpia jong Pakaiya dia choldam kum anei tei ding ahi.
25.3: Kumgup sunga na loujaova muchi nathe ding, hitia chu kumgup sunga na lengpi thei nalho ngimsela, chuteng aga nakilo ding ahi.
25.4: Kum sagi lhinkum levang agamsung pumpin choldam kum anit ding, hitia chu lou jaova muche jeng jong natu thei lou ding, na lengpithei lei jong nalho ngimtah lou ding ahi.
25.5: Chule changval hung kehdoh ho jong na-at lou ding, lengpi lei lholou laiya hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon da jeng ding, ajeh chu na boncha diuva choldamna kum ahi.
25.6: Gamsung pumpia dia choldamna kum ahitan, ami chan cheh ading in chule nangma nahin nasoh pasal ham nasoh numei hijon gleh; natha lah mihem hihen lang gamchom ahung kholjin hijong leh, na bonchauva dia anneh ding nahin ngaito peh diu ahi, ati.
25.7: Nangma gancha ho ahin, na gam'a um gamsa ho jaona hiche gamga soh hochu aneh diu ahi.
25.8: Kum khat sunga hapta sagi nasim dohji ding, hatpa sagi veijen na simdoh ding hitia chu agoma kumsom li leh kumko aphah ding ahi.
25.9: Hiche jou tengleh nangman lha sagi lhinna hiche lhasung mama achu, nisom lhin nikho chule sumkon namut ging ding, hichea chu kithoidamna nikho nagam pumpiuva thong jejua sum kon na lhangsap uva nathejal soh diu ahi.
25.10: Kum nga don ahung lhin teng hiche kum chu kum theng tah ahi, hichu na phonjal diu, gamsung pumpia khosa jouse henga chamlhat kum ahitia naphon jalsoh diu ahi; hiche kum hi naboncha diuva jubilee kum ahitan, mihem koi hileh athilkeo jouse akile lah kit ding, mihem jeng jong ama cheh in muna kile cheh ding nahiuve.
25.11: Hiche kum somnga lhinkum hi nangho jouse dia jubilee kum ahitan, hiche kuma hi muchi jeng jong natu louhel diu, achama hung keh muche chang jeng jong na-at da jeng diu, lengpilei nalho louna beh a hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon lou ding ahi, ati.
25.12: Ajeh chu Jubilee kum hi kum theng tah ahi, na boncha diuva atheng ahi; hijeh chun agamsunga anagasa hobou naneh diu ahi.
25.13: Hitia chu Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng, na boncha uva koi hileh agoulo cheh chu na kile pehto diu ahi.
25.14: Na kinaipi henga na thil joh ham, ahilouleh nathil chohsa ham jeng jong chu, hitia thil joh chung chang leh akijoh doh thil chung changa na sopi khat toh adih louva na kibol to thei lou ding ahi.
25.15: Chule Jubilee aki chaiya pat naheng nakoma na thilchoh chule akum ijat sunga hi jongleh, agamga soh toh kitoh a nangma koma thil ale joh ding ahi, ati.
25.16: Kum vang chu ahung tamkhah tah leh hiche thilman chun nasan sah ding, ahinlah akumjat chu alhom khah vangleh athilman jeng jong nalhom sah ding ahi, ajeh chu akum kisim jat dungjuiya aman jong gamga toh ajoh ahi, ati.
25.17: Na bonchauva khat leh khat nakisuh gimlou heldiu, hiche sangchun na Pathen chu ging jing in, ajeh chu keima na Pakai leh na Pathenu chu kahi, ati.
25.18: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan jouse najuikim soh kei diu, hiche ho jouse chutoh natoh doh diu ahi, chuteng gamsung pumpia na bonchauva lungmong sela nakhosah diu ahi.
25.19: Agamsunga jong gamga pha hung um doh ding, hitia chu oiva sela naneh thei diu, agam sunga lungmong sela nachen thei diu ahi.
25.20: Na bonchauva na ngaito uva, kum sagi ahung lhin kum le ipi ham ineh diu, muchi la itu ta pouvin, chang jeng jong i-at lou diu hitam, tia na lung don khah uva ahi leh,
25.21: Keima tah in kumgup alhin kumle na boncha chung cheh uva phattheina kahin bung lhah peh diu, hichun kum thum sungsea naneh khop diuva anga ahin sodoh ding ahi.
25.22: Na bonchauvin kum get lhin kum apat muchi tujong leu chun lhosoh ga aumsa alui hobou naneh diu, kumko ahung lhina lhosohga athah kahsea lhosohga alui hobou naneh na ai diu ahi, ati.
25.23: Gam leiset kiti jong najoh doh thei lou diu, aneipa kei kahin, na bonchauva gamchom mi kholjina kanei nahiuve, ati.
25.24: Hijeh chun hoilai chan hi jongleh nachen na jouse uva, gam leiset lhatdohna man na bonchauva napeh cheh diu ahi.
25.25: Na sopipa hamkhat hahsatna ato jeh a, agam leiset ajoh doh khah a ahileh, ama bana asopipa chu hunga athiljoh doh chu ahung lhat ding ahi.
25.26: Ahinlah ajoh dohpa ham khat chun, asopi alhat doh thei mi anei tah louva, amavang khonunga ahung haodoh thei dinga auma ahileh, aman ahin kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
25.27: Hitia chu agamjoh doh pan jong ajohdoh kuma pat phatah a sim ding, ajohna pa henga chu aman jat apeh dia lom cheng chutoh apeh dohtha ding, chujou tengleh ana chodoh pa chun agam leiset chu aboncha anung peh kit ding ahi.
25.28: Ahinlah amapa chun alhat dohna ding aneilouva ahileh, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea ajoh dohnapa koma chu athil joh doh chu chuti um ding ahitan, Jubilee kum ahung lhun phat levang chun achopa chun ale lhatdoh ding, athil neipa chu lechan kit ding ahi.
25.29: Kula kigensa gam leiset behkah khat tou johdoh a umleh, hiche ajohdoh pa chun ajoh kum sunga chu akile lhat dohthei ding ahi. Ajeh chu kum khat sunga chu akile lhatdohna dia thu anei ahi.
25.30: Ahinlah a-in chu kum sunga chu alhatdoh jou louva ahileh, khopi sunga kul ki gensa ki johdoh a akichohpa chun akhang lhum keiya anei ding ahitan, Jubilee kum hung lhung jongleh akile lhatna ding thu anei lou ahitai.
25.31: Kul kigen lou khopi neocha sunga in ki johdoh ho vang chu, amin mai maiya ki sim peh ding, hiche ho chu lhatdohna tha um ding, hichu Jubilee kum ahung lhunteng lhatdoh ding ahi.
25.32: Ahinlah Levite chenna khopi ho chu, ama ho ana chennasa akhopi sung uva in ho vang chu, Leviten itih phatlai hi jongleh akile lhatdoh thei diu ahi.
25.33: Koi hileh Levi mite akonna athuneina aman chah louva ahileh, amaho chenna khopi sunga ana kijoh dohsa in vangchu, Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng kile peh cheh cheh ding ahi, ajeh chu Israel chate chenna tin cheng chu Levi mite dia amaho goulo jeng ahibouve.
25.34: Levi mite dia kikoi gam beh jouse chu, khat a khat cha kijoh doh thei lou ding, hichu amaho dia tonsot goulo ding ahi.
25.35: Na sopipa chu aneilel valtah a, nakom tah a akivah lelna aum doh a ahileh, nangman jong ima dang gel louva ama chu navah jeng ding, kholgam akonna jin banga nakom a khosa jeng ding ahi.
25.36: Natoh le tham akon in apung akal jong tep peh dan lang, na Pathen maiven na sopipa chu nakoma khosa teijo hen, ati.
25.37: Ama chu veikan dia sum bat napeh thei lou ding, nehle chah jeng jong apung dia nei peh lou ding ahi.
25.38: Ajeh chu kei matah hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahin, nang ho Pathen kahiye tia Cannan gam kapeh diu ahitia, Egypt gam'a konna nahin puigal kaipau chu kahi, ati.
25.39: Hijeh chun nangma nai lama cheng na sopipa chu anei lelval tah a nangma koma ama le ama ahung ki peh lut tah leh, ama chu soh tobanga nagoi thei lou ding ahi.
25.40: Amapa chu na koma thalah mi banga khosa jeng ding, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea na koma khosa ding ahi.
25.41: Jubilee akichai teng nangma dalhaa pot tading achate jouse jaona che diu, a insung lama leche diu, apu apa khanga gou ho chu lechan ding ahiuve.
25.42: Ajeh chu abonchauva keima lhachaa pang ahiuvin; abonchauva Egypt gam'a konna kahin puigal kai ahiuve, hiche jeh chun amaho hi abonchauva sohjoh a najoh doh lou diu ahi.
25.43: Nangman ama ho jouse munemna neitah a thu nasei lou ding, na Pathen ging khencha hinkho naman ding ahi.
25.44: Soh pasal ho in numei jong nanei jeng thei ahin, hiche soh ding achu nakom lah a namtin vaipi hochu na chohdoh a navul thei ahi.
25.45: Na bonchauva nalah uva chenglut kholgam mih hochu nachoh doh uva, soh a nalap thei diu ahi, nagam sung pumpiuva chengsa ho jong nachoh thei diu, hitobang mi nachoh doh hou chu na in cheh uva uma nalap le thei diu ahi.
25.46: Chule soh ho chu na chateu banga na goulo diuva na umsah uva, khonunga goulo ding jong nakoi peh diu, nangho Israelte lah a vang khat in khat chunga thuneina tah a vaihoma chatloh thei lou ding ah.
25.47: Na koma cheng kholjin mi chu ahung haodoh jeng tah a, na koma cheng na sopi pakhat machu achen dan ahah satval tah a ahileh; amajeng jong na koma cheng kholjin mipa koma ahung kipeh doh jeng tah a ahileh, chule asopi ho kom ham khat a akijoh doh jeng tah a ahileh,
25.48: Hitia akijoh nunga chu lelhat kit thei ahi, asopi ho lah akonna khat penpen in amapa chu ale lhat kit ding,
25.49: Ahilouleh apaneo ham apaneo chapa ham khat in jong ale lhat thei ahi, amatoh kinai asopi aheng akom aphung chan khompi ainsung toh kinai pen khat injong alhat doh thei ding, hiche kala chu ama le ama ahung neijou tah levang ama chama kilhat ding ahi.
25.50: Ana ki chohdoh patoh akinopto banga, ama le ama akijoh doh niapat Jubilee kum chana asim ding, aman jat chu akum tam leh lhom dungjuiya alepeh ding ahi, anakichoh pan amapa alap sungsea chu thalah man toh kibang ding ahi.
25.51: Jubilee kum lhunna ding kum phabep avat nah laileh, aki lhatdohna dia ana ki chohdohna man chu alang khat alepeh ding ahi.
25.52: Ahinlah Jubilee lhinna ding chu kum lhomcha akivat tah a ahileh, aki choh apat akum jat chu avet toh lhon ding, hiche kuma pat chu atohman jat dungjuiya avaldoh chengse chu akile lhat dohna dia ale dip ding ahi.
25.53: Tohman akisim teng hichepa chu thagoi man bep bep a kisim peh ding, koi hileh hichepa tobang chunga engset nanei thei hoa konna navet tup ding ahi.
25.54: Hiche ho jouse nunga hi, amapa hi aki lhatdoh joulou tah vangleh, chuti uma Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng lhat ding, ama ahin achate jouse jaona lhat tha ding ahitai.
25.55: Ajeh chu Israel chate hi abonchauva keima lhacha ngen ahiuvin, amaho hi ka lhacha ahin, Egypt gam'a konna keima tah in kahin puigal kai ahiuvin, keima hi na Pakaiyu le na Pathenu chu kahi jinge, ati.

26.1: Na bonchauva milimdoi nasem thu louhel diu, milim akisem hihen songa tun ding hi jongleh, khat a khat cha natundoh theilou diu ahi, gamsung pumpi naumnau kitia hi song milim natundoh theilou diu, hiche ho chu nabol uva amasanga naboh khup loubeh diu ahi; ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen pau kaum jing e, ati.
26.2: Na bonchauva ka cholngah nikho chu nanit kimsoh kei diu chule ka muntheng jeng jong jabolna napeh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi.
26.3: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan ho najui kimsoh keidiu, ka thupeh chengse jong aboncha nanit kimsoh keidiu aboncha nabol kimsel teng uleh,
26.4: Hichea chu keima tah in nangho jouse dia gotwi kahin lhah sah ding, chuting leh agam leiset pumpia konin gamsa hung kisep doh becheh ding, thingga jeng jong hagaa hung ga ding ahi.
26.5: Chuteng na loujao dung uva thingga lou ding le lengpi theiga lou ding, alhang alhanga mihem kikaiya, chuteng na oivasel uva changlhah naneh cheh diu nagam sung jeng uva jong lungmong le lhamonga na khosah diu ahi.
26.6: Chuteng keiman nangho gamsung pumpia chamna ka umsah ding, nomtah a na choldo diu koiman nasuh kichat tahlou diu ahi, gamsung pumpia gamsa phalou jouse katol manghel ding, na chennau gam jenga jong hem mangchaa kitona um talou ding ahi.
26.7: Namel mateu nadel jam diu, na masang lai tah uva chem jam tothoa nasat lih jeng diu ahi.
26.8: Nang hoa konna mi nga jeng in jong mi jakhat nadel jam thei diu, chule nangho mi jakhat seh in melma sangsom nadel jam thei kit diu ahi, namel mateu chu chemjam lama nasat chop joukei diu ahi.
26.9: Na bonchauva kagel khoh cheh diu, na boncha chung uva ka kitepna jong guilhun sah ding kahi.
26.10: Na bonchauva nahou thei diu lho sohga abeisa naneh uva, lhosohga thah ahung lhun kit teng aumsa ho chu na otdoh diu ahi.
26.11: Keima tah jong nalah uva khosa ding kahin, ka lungsung jenga jong kidah tah a na kibol kit lou diu ahi.
26.12: Chule nalah uva kalhat le ding, na Pathen pau chu kahi jing ding, na bonchauva ka mite nahi jing diu ahi.
26.13: Egypt gam mite soh nahi lou na diuva, agam sung uva konna hinpui galkai Pakai na Pathen uchu keima hi kahin, keiman na bonchauva namkol chu kasuh chip a nangho jouse dingdet puma ka che sah nahiuve.
26.14: Na bonchauvin kathu nit ding nanom pouve, thupeh jouse jong najui tapouvin ahi.
26.15: Ka chonna dan aboncha nahsah louva na koi uleh, na hinkho sung uva ka chondan ho kidah le thet a nakoi khah uleh, ka thupeh khat cha beh jong bol ding go louhela naum uva, ka kitepna napel keh khah tah uleh,
26.16: Keima tah in naboncha chung uva hitobang chu ka lhunsah ding. Na chung cheh uva lunggim hesoh lhung jeng ding chule na gam nadiu ka lhunsah a, nahai hu jengu jong bing leuva ka lhunsah ding ahi, namel mateu neh chai ding bep sohdoh ahi.
26.17: Na bonchauva kaki doupi soh keiyuva, namel mateu masanga jong na kisuhgam set diu ahi, nadei lou uleh nathet bol teu aboncha nangho chung vum'a vaihom thuneiya umdiu, koima dellou beh a ha jama najam cheh diu ahi.
26.18: Akisei chengse nahsah a koi louva kathu jeng jong na kijah mosah ngei ngei uleh, na chonset nauva konna vel sagi jen bolgimna ka lechuh sah ding nahiuve.
26.19: Na kiletsah nau le natha nei sunu aboncha kasuh manghel ding, na chung cheh uva thih ka chuh sah a, na gam sung jengu jong sum eng ka hisah ding ahi.
26.20: Hitia chu na thanei na jouseu pannabei jeng hi tading, nagam leiset pum piuva jong lhosohga um talou ding, gamsung pumpia thing phung jouse gasoh thei louhel ding ahi.
26.21: Keima dounaa na kisah uva na chon khah uleh, keima tah in nat phalou jouse na gamsung ule na boncha chung uva, kalan sah ding ahi.
26.22: Keima tah in na boncha chung uva gamsa hang jouse kahin hoilut peh diu, na chateu aboncha abah gamset diu, gancha jeng jong natha chai peh kei uva; na bonchauva na manthai cheh cheh diu, naki jotna jouseu jong thip del ding ahi.
26.23: Hiche ho jouse nunga jong na khah doh thei lou uva, nei ki doupi nah lai uva ahileh,
26.24: Keiman na bonchauva kahin kile doupi diu, na chonset jaluva na bonchauva talent namat cheh diu, na pumpiuva kasuh gamset ding nahiuve.
26.25: Kitepna phulahna chemjam hem chu na chunguva kahin jah jeng ding, Na khopi lai lung uva kikhom khom unlang aning aum jong leu chun, na boncha chung cheh uva natna huise hung lang in tin, chuteng na kidou piteu ma sanga nakun cheh diu ahi.
26.26: Nang ho hinna changlhah mol chu kalah peh diu, nalah uva numei som seh seh in jong chang lhah pha bep cha bou anei diu, hichu kitup tah a atena toh kitoh chet a tepeh cheh cheh ding, naneh jeng vang uva oivanaa neh diu ahitapoi.
26.27: Kathu naki jah mosah uva, nei ki doupi nah laiyu ahileh,
26.28: Na chunguva lungsatna tothoa ka doudal diu, hiche chonsetna nanei jaluva ajat sagi vei nachung cheh uva lethuhna chu ding ahi.
26.29: Na chateu tahsa geiya, numei kithei lou pasal kitheilouva nahin neh nah laidiu ahi.
26.30: Na chunguva munsang lai jouse kahin suh chim jeng ding, gim namtui na halvam nau maicham phung jeng jong kasuh jaldeh ding, hinkho lhum keiya ka kidah uva kathet ding nahiuve.
26.31: Na chennau khopi aboncha aching ding koima um louva kalha ding, muntheng lai nanei chengseo jong thipdel ding, nagim namtui lhut nam jengu jong kanah sahpeh lou ding nahiuve.
26.32: Gamsung pumpi akeuseh a um ding, nagam sunguva um nakidou piteuvin nalung don jeng diu ahi.
26.33: Namtin chitin lah a kathejal sohhel diu, chemjam kalap a hajam a kajam sah diu, nagam sungu aboncha akeova umding, nakhopi jengu jong thip dela um ding ahi.
26.34: Na bonchauva na kidoupi teu gam'a na vaitham sung seuva na gamsung uchu thip dela koima um louva umding, chuteng agam sung pumpi chu kitha kimat ima louva choldam sel ding ahi.
26.35: Gamsung chu akeuva aum channa chol damsel ahin, ajeh chu nachen laiyuva cholngah nikho nanit tapouvin hijeh achu cholngah nikho banga chol damsel ding ahitai.
26.36: Nalah uva konna athi moh cheng ahing nalai na kidou piteu gamsunga cheng ho jeng jong alungthimu kasuh nemdeh peh diu, nathu khat a kheh lhah a agin khu chemjam kilam banga tijat tothoa jam lele uva, mikhat seh del maimaia jong jamcheh ji diu ahi.
26.37: Koima del louva ama ho le ama ho kigela chemjam in adel banga jamcheh diu, khat le khat kinolhua jamcheh cheh jeng ding ahiuvin, na bonchauva naki doupiteu masang kitia nalhuh lhuh jeng diu ahi.
26.38: Namtin lah a navaitham gam kei diu, na kidou piteu gam leiset chun nasuh gamset jeng diu ahi.
26.39: Na kidou piteu gamsunga chengho ahing doh chengse jong chu achonset jaluva meidoi gamkei diu, apu apateu chonset a alhah nauva konna amaho jouse jong apu apateu akilo diu meidoi joukei diu ahi.
26.40: Abonchauva keima douna jeh’a chon khelna abol uva, keima eiki doupi uva joule nal thua achon uva apu apateu chonset phondohna neiya,
26.41: Hitia achon khah tah jeh uva chu keiman jong akale lama lethuhna achung'uva ka lhunsah ding, akidoupi teu angsunga kapui lut nau ajehmpentah aphondoh thei ule; alung tahna jengu, jong aki suhnem thei uva, achonset nauva konna kisem thahna anei thei uleh,
26.42: Jacob henga ka kitepna kageldoh kit ding chule Isaac toh ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, hitia chu Abraham henga ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, agam leiset pumpi jong kahin geldoh thaa ka huhdoh kit ding ahi.
26.43: Adalhahna agam sung pumpiu chu cholngah nikho tobanga anisih a choldamnaa aman chah diu, hitia chu chondan jouse nahsah moa akoi uva ahinkho sung uva keima doumah le kidahna achonset jouseova konna kisemphatna achunguva lhung ding ahi.
26.44: Hiche ho jouse jal'a hi abonchauva akidou piteo gamsunga achen teng uleh, keiman jong abonchauva sumil louhela ka hebol cheh diu, ka kitepna jong umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen uchu kahi jing jenge, ati.
26.45: Amaho jouse Pathen kahi jing na dinga keima tah in Egypt gamsunga konna mi jouse mitmu changtah a kahin puigal kaiyu ahin, apu apateu chunga kana kitepna keiman achunguva gelkhohna kanei ding ahi, keima Pakai chu kahi jing jeng e, ati.
26.46: Hiche chondan jouse ahin chonna dan jouse jaonan, danthu chengse toh Pakaiyin ama tah le Israel chate dinga akoichu ahitia, Mose henga ana thupeh chengse chu ahi.

27.1: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
27.2: Israel chate henga chondan chengse hi asei peh in, kinop toh jeh a mihem khat chu Pakaiya dia kipeh dohna anei ding ahi, sum aki seijat hi apeh a kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
27.3: Kitepna dungjui cheh le aki chepi bang banga pasal kum somni apat kumsom gup chan chu dangka somnga jaonan shekel jaonan sanaa kisem shekel somnga hichu muntheng laiya ding ahi.
27.4: Chule numei ahileh amanu chun dangka somngaa kitepna anei ding ahi.
27.5: Hitia chu Pasal kum nga apat somni chan, dangka somni hiding, numei vang chu dangka somkhat hiding ahi.
27.6: Chule naosen kum nga apat noilam dangka cheng nga hi ding, numei ahileh dangka cheng thum hi ding ahi.
27.7: Amavang pasal kum somgup chunglam dangka somle nga hi ding, numei kum somgup chung lamse ahileh dangka somkhat a lhatdoh thei ahi.
27.8: Ahinlah hitobanga kitepna nei dingpa chun, hiche chepi ding chu angaplal banga ahileh, ana kikat dohsa mihempa chu thempu lama apui ding, chuteng thempu pan aman ato khambep ateppeh ding, hiche mipan ajokham ding chu atep peh ding ahi.
27.9: Amavang hiche kitepna hi gancha peh ding toh kisaiya kitepna nei ding ahileh, Pakai lama santhei ding, hitia chu Pakaiya dia kipe dohsa chu atheng ahi.
27.10: Kitepna neipa chun gancha chu aphajo ding gelna jal'a adang khat a akhel thei lou ding, apeh khel dia aum jong leh, atodoh masat le akhel dia atodoh chu ania atheng ahi.
27.11: Pakai lama todoh theilou hichu gancha theng lou kitepna ahi vangleh, kitepna nei dingpa chun agancha chu thempupa heng lama akai ding ahi.
27.12: Thempu pan aman lutdan le aman lut lou dan atetoh ding, thempu pan aphatsah dungjuiya hichu achaina hi ding ahi.
27.13: Ahinlah atodoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, aman jat jaonaa jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding ahi.
27.14: Chule mi koi hileh a in atheng dinga Pakai henga apehdoh noma ahileh, in ahoi dan le ahoi loudan dungjuiya thempu pan jong atetoh chet ding, thempu pan atetoh bang banga chu achaina hi jeng ding ahi.
27.15: In pedoh pa chun akile lhatdoh noma ahileh, aman sum leh jakhat lah a somni chu toh ale peh tha jeng ding ahi. Hichea bouchu akitepna banga lechan thei ding ahi.
27.16: Chule koi ham khat chun Pakaiya dia agam beh khat tou apeh doh noma ahileh, hiche gambeh khat chu muchi kitu lutjat ding toh atetoh a, chuteng suhlou chang shekel somni ki tulutna thei gambeh chu sum somkhat man jat atepeh ding ahi.
27.17: Thil kile pehna kum kut kon chaa apeh doh khah ahile vang, aki tepehna banga aman jat jong lhingset a apeh ding ahi.
27.18: Ahinlah agambeh chu apat a alhat doh jou louva ahileh, thil kile pehna kum kut ahung lhun kahsea dinga thempu pan aman jat atetoh peh ding, aman hichea chu lhat dohna anei thei ding ahi.
27.19: Agam beh pedoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, sum aman jat bang banga jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding, hichea bouchu lechan thei ding ahi.
27.20: Pakai henga chodoh louva midang kom khat touva agam beh chu ajoh doh khah bang leh, hichu itih chan hijong leh akile lhatdoh thei talou ding ahi.
27.21: Amavang thil kile peh to kum ahung lhung ding, chuting leh imatih chana Pakai gambeh mong monga um ding, hitia chu thempu pan ama neiya akisim ding ahi.
27.22: Chule koi hileh aki chodohsa gambeh khattou Pakaiya dia apehdoh noma ahileh, hichu ama gambeh hilou ding ahi.
27.23: Hitia chu thempu pan thil man lepeh kum ahung lhun ding to kitoh a aman jat atepeh
27.24: Thil kilepeh na kum ahung lhun teng leh, hiche gambeh chu aneisa pa ahilouleh aki naipi henga lepeh kit ding ahi.
27.25: Thilman ho aboncha chondan dungjuiya akiman dan bang banga ale teppeh cheh ding, hichu Gerah somni jaona shekel toh kitoh ding ahi.
27.26: Gancha masa jouse aboncha Pakaiya ding bou ahin, hicheng chu aboncha koima chan atum beh a apehdoh thei lou ding, bong nou hihen kelngoi nou hihen, kelnou hi jeng jong leh hichu aboncha Pakaiya bou ahi.
27.27: Amavang gancha thenglou masa vang chu akile lhatdoh thei ding, amanjat chule jakhat lah a somni chutoh apehtha ding, ahinlah ale lhat dohtah louva ahile, chonna dan dungjuiya midang khat henga ajoh thei ding ahi.
27.28: Hitia chun mihem ahin, gancha hihen, gambeh jeng jong, ajeh um louva Pakaiya dia kipeh dohsa chu koiman ale lhat thei lou ding ahi.
27.29: Ajeh beihela Pakaiya kitoh doh chu mihem jeng jong kiledoh thei louva, thina chan sah jeng ding ahi.
27.30: Lhosohga chang ahin, thingga hihen, ipi chu hi jongleh gamga jouse chu hopsom lah a hop khat vang Pakaiya ding ahi.
27.31: Koi hileh thil somakhat kipeh dohsa le choh nom aum leh, chonna ngai banga aman jat jaonan jakhat lah a somni alepeh cheh cheh ding ahi.
27.32: Hitobang chun gancha jouse som lah a khat chu Pakaiya ding ahin, hitia chu gancha kiti phot, som lhinna jouse aboncha khat chu Pakaiya ding ahi.
27.33: Gancha neipan jong agancha hochu ahoi leh apha alhen chil lou ding, alhen kah le lou ding ahi. Gancha khat khela chu achom khat apeh khah bang leh ani tah a Pakai chang jeng ding. ale lhat thei lou ding ahitai.
27.34: Hiche thupeh chengse hi Israelte henga Pakayin Sinai molchunga Mose athupeh ahi.

1.1: Israelten Egypt gamsung ahin dalhah kal u kum khat ahung lhin chun Pathenin Sinai gamthip a houbuh a chun Mose ahoulimpi tan ahi. Hichu alhani channa nikho masapen ni ahin, Pakaiyin hitin asei peh e,
1.2: “Israel namsung pumpi a kon in aphung cheh uva kon a gal hangsanho leh ainsung mihou min jouseu aumden ding in jihlut cheh in. Pasalho jouse chu jihlut soh hel in.
1.3: Kum somni apat chunglam gal boltheiho jouse chu Nang le Aaronnin amin u najihlut teitei lhon ding,
1.4: chuleh hiche phungho jouse lah a kon a chu lamkai khat cheh in nangma nakithopi ding ahi.
1.5: “Hiche phungho a kon a Lamkai hohi nakithopi dingho chu ahiuve. Reuben Shedeur chapa Elizur
1.6: Simeon Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel
1.7: Judah Anminadab chapa Nahshon
1.8: Issachar Zuar chapa Nethanael
1.9: Zebulun Helon chapa Eliab
1.10: Joseph chapa Ephraim Ammihud chapa Elishama Joseph chapa Manasseh Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel
1.11: Benjamin Gideoni chapa Abidan
1.12: Dan Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer
1.13: Asher Ocran chapa Pagiel
1.14: Gad Deuel chapa Eliasaph
1.15: Naphtali Enan chapa Ahira
1.16: Amahohi japilah akon a kilhengdoh lamkai cheh, apu apa phung kailhah a pat lamkaiho chuleh Israelte phung hoa kon a mi upa cheh ahiuve.”
1.17: Hichun lamkai kilhen doh chengse chu Mose le Aaron in akou khom lhonin,
1.18: hiche nikho ma ma chun Israelte jalhang pumpin jong akhom tup lhonin ahi. Mipiho jouse chu ama ama phung leh insung cheh kailhah a konin amin akijihlut cheh in ahi. Pathenin Mose athupeh bangin, Israel pasal kum somnia pat chunglamse chu khat khatnin akijihlut in ahi.
1.19: Hitichun Mose in amaho min jouse Sinai gamthip lai mun a chun anasutup soh keiyin ahi.
1.20: Ama ama phung dungjui cheh a amin u kijihlut bang a pasal kum somnia pat achunglam galsat a konthei amijatho chu hicheng hi ahi. Phung Mijat Reuben (Jacob chapa tahpen) 46,500
1.22: Simeon 59,300
1.26: Judah 74,600
1.44: Israel phung somleni lamkaiho toh Mose le Aaron in akhumlut u pasalho cheng hi abonchauva ama ama phung chilhah dungjui cheh a kikhumlut cheh ahi uve.
1.45: Amaho chu ama ama insung duijui cheh a kikhumlut ahiuve - Israelte pasal kiti pou kum somni apat chunglam gal bolthei jouse hi abonchauva a insung dung jui'a kijihlut cheh ahiuve.
1.47: Ahinlah hiche kisim khomna a hin Levite vang apang pon ahi,
1.48: Ajehchu, Pathenin Mose kom hitihin ana seiyin ahi,
1.49: Min najihlut teng Levite hi najihlut loubeh ding, Israel mite lah a nasim tha loubeh ding ahi.
1.50: Kikhop khomna ponbuh le aki mangcha thilho aboncha a Levite mopohna napehding, nachena chan uva Ponbuh le aman chah chengse aboncha amahon apoh uva, akimvella ngahmun semtoh thoa alhacha a pang ding ahiuve.
1.51: Kikhop khomna ngahmun chon phat alhin teng, Levi chapate cheng in aphet lhah diu, hitia chu ngahmun nalhun teng uleh amahon thah sondoh kit diu, ama vang koi hileh phalna beiya kikhop khomna ponbuh ganailut behseh chan chu thiding ahi.
1.52: Phung jousen ama ama insung ponlap cheh utoh ngahmun akisem diu ahi.
1.53: Israel pumpi chung a Pakai lunghan louna dinga Levi chapaten vang kitepna ponbuh kimvella ngahmun akisem cheh uva avetsui diu ahi. Hitia chu hiche ponbuh ventupna chu Levite mopohna hiding ahi.
1.54: Hitichun Pathenin Mose henga athupeh bangtah chun Israel chaten emajouse aboltauvin ahi.

2.1: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron chu thu hicheng a hin hilchahna aneitan ahi:
2.2: “Israelten ngahmun asem teng uleh, ama ama phung kai cheh a umding ahiuve. Aphung phung leh ama ama insung micheng chu ama ama ponbuh noija khosa cheh ding ahiuve. Aphung aphung a kihomtohho chun angahmun cheh uchu kikhop khomna houbuh pangli kiemvel a akisem ding u ahi, hinlah hichu kikahjep hiding ahi.
2.3: Kikhop khomna ponbuh niso lama ngahmun semding phungho chu Judah, Issachar leh Zebulun hidiu ahi. Anoia hohi amin kikhum galsat ding jat, aphungmin uleh alamkai hou chu ahiuve. Judah Amminadab chapa Nahshon 74,600
2.5: Issachar Zuar chapa Nethanel 54,400
2.7: Zebulun Helon chapa Eliab 57,400
2.9: Judah phung lamkaina noiya galsat mi ahung kikhom jat chu mihem 186,400 ahi. Israelten ngahmun thah ajot a asemji teng uleh hiche phung thumho leh alamkai hou hi mapui a pang ding u ahi.
2.10: Reuben, Simeon leh Gad chu kikhop khomna ponbuh lhanglam a ngahmun sem a pangding phungho chu ahiuvin, aphungjem u noi cheh a um cheh ding ahiuve. Anoia hohi galsat ding a amin kikhum jat, aphungmin uleh alamkai hou chu ahiuve. Reuben Shedeur chapa Elizur 46,500
2.11: Simeon Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel 59,300
2.14: Gad Deuel chapa Eliasaph 45,650
2.16: Reuben phung lamkaina noija galsat thei aloi loiya kikhomdoh jat chu agom a mihem 151,450 ahi. Israelte ahon a achenna jouseuva hiche phung thum hohi anina a pang ding u ahi.
2.17: Chuleh houponbuh Leviten aput uchu ngahmun lailung a pat a hung kipudoh ding ahi. Phung jouse ngahmun ana kison bang cheh u sukeh louhel a ama ama phung jem noicheh a kitol diu ahi.
2.18: Kikhop khomna ponbuh lhum lama ngahmun semding phungho chu Ephraim, Manasseh leh Benjamin hidiu ahin, aphungjem u noi cheh a um cheh ding ahiuve. Anoia hohi amin kikhum galsat ding jat, aphungmin uleh alamkai hou chu ahiuve. Ephraim Ammihud chapa Elishama 40,500
2.20: Manasseh Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel 32, 200
2.22: Benjamin Gideoni chapa Abidan 35,400
2.24: Ephriam phung lamkaina noija galsat thei aloi loiya kikhomdoh jat chu agom a mihem 108,100 ahi. Israelte ahon a achenna jouseuva hiche phung thum hohi athumna a pang ding u ahi.
2.25: Kikhop khomna ponbuh sahlama ngahmun semding phungho chu Dan, Asher leh Naphtali hidiu ahin, aphungjem u noi cheh a um cheh ding ahiuve. Anoia hohi amin kikhum galsat ding jat, aphungmin uleh alamkai hou chu ahiuve. Dan Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer 62,700
2.31: Dan phung lamkaina noija galsat thei aloi loiya kikhomdoh jat chu agom a mihem 157,600 ahi. Israelte ahon a achenna jouseuva aphungjem noi cheh uva hiche phung thum hohi anukhahpen a pang ding u ahi.
2.32: Agomlam tah in, aloi loiya um Israelte, ainsung cheh uva kon kijihlutho chu abonchauva gomsoh in mihem 603,550 alhing uve.
2.33: Pakai thu peh bang chun Levite vang chu amin u akisim tha tapon ahi.
2.34: Hitichun Pakaiyin Mose ana thupeh bang bang chun Israelten imajouse abolsohkei tauvin ahi. Pakai thupeh jui in ama ama insung leh phung jem noi cheh a chun akijotji un chuleh ngahmun jong asemji tauve.

3.1: Hiche hi Sinai molchunga Pakaiyin Mose ahoupi lai a ana kijihlut Aaron le Mose insung khanggui thu chu ahi.
3.2: Aaron chapateho min chu Nadab (atah pen), Abihu, Elezear chule Ithamar ahiuve.
3.3: Hiche Aaron chapateho chengse hin thempu kintheng atoh thei nading uva thao anu uva chule atumbeh a kilhandoh ahiuve.
3.4: Ahinlah Nadab le Abihu chu Pathen umpet a Sinai gamthip a maicham asemlai uva Pathen thupeh toh kikal a meikong dihlou ahal lhon jeh chun, ani lhonin hiche muna chun athilhon tan ahi. Chapa dang aneitahlou jeh in kintheng natong ding chu adalhahlhon Eleazer le Ithamar chutoh apalhon Aaraon chubou ahitauve.
3.5: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin,
3.6: Levi phung le changho chu koukhom min lang, Aaron kintheng natoh ga kithopi ding in gapuiyin.
3.7: Amaho chu Aaron leh mipijenlea pang ding u, houbuh leh akimvel a kintheng natong a pang ding ahiuve.
3.8: Levite jousen hiche ponbuh theng chu avettup dingu Israel mipite thalheng a ponbuh maicham a chu kin thengna atoh diu ahi.
3.9: Levi chilhahho jouse chun Aaron leh achapate vaihomna noi a umsah in. Amaho chu Israel mipiho jouse lah a kon a Aaron le achapate jenle ding leh kithopi ding a kipehdoh ah ahitauvin ahi.
3.10: Aaron le achapateho jouse chun thempu kintheng na atoh ding uvin seipeh in. Koi hijongleh nganse changlou a muntheng ganailut hochu thitei teidiu ahi.
3.11: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose kom a asei in,
3.12: “Ven, Levite hi Israel japi lah kon a Israel chapate apengmasa jouse thalheng a natong ding a kalhendoh ahitai. Leviteho jouse keiya ahi.
3.13: Ajehchu chapa tahpen jouse keima a ahi. Egypt chapate lah a apeng masa jouse kanasuhgam nikho apatna keima Israel chapa tahpen jouse hi keidia atumbeh a ka lhendohsa ahin, mihem a hihen gancha a hi jongleh amaho jouse chu keia ahiuve; Keima Pakai chu kahi.”
3.14: Pakaiyin Sinai molchung a chun Mose hengah thu aseikit in, hiti hin ati,
3.15: “Levite chu ama ama insung leh phung kailhah in amin u jihlut cheh in. Pasal jouse lhakhat a pat chunglam se jihlut in.”
3.16: Hichun Mose chun Pakai thupeh bang chun minho chu ajihlut tan ahi.
3.17: Levi in chapa thum aneiyin, amaho chu Gershon, Kohath chule Merari ahiuve.
3.18: Gershon a kon a phungguiho chu ama chilhahte lah a kon a mini min, Libni leh Shimei a kiminsah ahiuve.
3.19: Kohath akon a phungguiho chu ama chilhah a kon miliho- Amran, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzzeil a kiminsah ahiuve.
3.20: Merari a kon a phungguiho chu ama chilhahte lah a kon a mini min, Mahli le Mushi a kiminsah ahiuve.
3.21: Gershon chilhahte chu Libni le Shimei phunggui akon ahiuvin ahi.
3.22: Gershonte phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 7,500 aum uve.
3.23: Amaho chu houbuh akon a lhumlam lang chu angahmun kisahna ding uva kipedoh ahiuve.
3.24: Gershonte phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Lael chapa Eliasaph ahi.
3.25: Hiche phung teni chung a mopohna a um chu ahileh houbuh avetsui diu, ponbuhtheng leh achung a kidal akhuna chengse ahin, maicham ponbuh lutna phung a kikhai pondal ahin,
3.26: Maicham ponbuh leh maicham phung kimvel a ki-dah pondal chengse ahin, a khaoho ahin, chuleh manchah akimangcha ding jouse jaona a ahiye.
3.27: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel phung a kon ahiuve.
3.28: Gershonte phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 8,600 aum uvin, amaho chu muntheng ventup leh vettupna mopohna kipe ahiuvin,
3.29: chuleh angahmun sahna ding uva Houbuh a kon a lhanglam kipe ahiuve.
3.30: Kohath phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Uzzeil chapa Elizaphan ahi.
3.31: Hiche phung li ho hin Pathen thingkhong, dokhang, thaomei khom, maicham phungho, houbuh sung a kimang thil le lo chom chomho, asung dan pondal, chuleh amaho manchah ding a angaicha jouse chung a mopohna anei ding u ahi.
3.32: Thempupa Aaron chapa Eleazer chu, Levite ho jouse chung a vaihom pipu anahin, houbuh sung a nakitong jouse vetup ding a deichom a mopohna kipe ahi
3.33: Merari chilhahte chu Mushi le Mahli phung a kon ahiuve.
3.34: Merari phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 6,200 aum uve.
3.35: Amaho chu houbuh akon a Sahlam lang chu angahmun kisahna ding uva kipedoh ahiuve. Merari phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Abihal chapa Zuriel ahi.
3.36: Hiche phung teni hin houbuh thingkolho, ingolvaiho, akhumho, akhumdouho leh amaho manding manchah ho jouse avetup diu ahi.
3.37: Chuleh houbuh kimvel a palkhumho leh athehho ahin, akikhainaho le khaoho jouse jong avettup ding u ahi.
3.38: Maicham ponbuh mai lhang, solam niso lamkot lang sese chu, Israel mipi ho thalheng a Houbuh muntheng a natohna ding a mopohna nunungpen kipe, Mose le Aaron chapate ponbuh kisahna dinga ana kikoitup a ahi. Koi hijeng jong leh Thempu le Levite tilou Houbuh muntheng maicham lang hin nailailut tapou chu tha jeng ding ahi.
3.39: Mose le Aaron chun Pakai thupeh banga Levite phunghoa a kon in pasal lhakhatna pat chunglam se chu asim lhon in ahileh mi 22,000 alhing uvin ahi.
3.40: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Tun nangman Israelte chapate apeng masa lhakhat lhingtasa apat chunglam jouse amin u jih lut in.
3.41: Keima Pakai kahin, keima ding a Levite chu, Israel chapa tahpenho thalhelng ding a kikoitup teitei ding ahi. Chuleh Israelte pumpi a gancha apengdoh masa ho khel ding a Levite gancha ho chu kikoitup teitei ding ahi.
3.42: Hitichun Mosen Pathen thupeh bangtah in Israel chapate lah a atahpen ho chu asimtan ahi.
3.43: Lhakhat a lhingsa leh achunglam chapa tahpenho chu 22,273 anahiuve.
3.44: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin,
3.45: “Levite chu Israel chapate lah a atahpen ho thalheng chun la in. Chuleh Israelte gancha apeng masa ho khel ding a Levite gancha ho chu nalah ding ahi. Keima Pakai kahi, Levite chu keiya ahibouve.
3.46: Levite sang in Israel chapate apeng masa mi 273 in atamjo uvin ahi. Amaho lhatdoh a aum thei na ding un,
3.47: mikhat cheh a ding a Sumgoi a Shekel nga nalahkhom ding, hiche shekel chu muntheng laiya shekel ho toh agihdan nakibahsah ding, gerah somnia shekel khat dungjuiya nate ding ahi.
3.48: Chapa pengmasa avahdoh ho lhatdoh na ding in hiche sum chu Aaron le achapate petan.”
3.49: Hiti chun Levite jat sang a hung tamjo Israel chapa tahpen ho lhatdoh a aum nading uvin Mosen in sum ho chu achom khom in ahi.
3.50: Aman Israel chapate lah a apengmasa ho thalheng chun sum pum 1,365 achomdoh in ahi. Hiche ho khat cheh hi muntheng a Shekel khat cheh toh agihdan kibang cheh ahiuve.
3.51: Chuin Pathenin thu apeh bang bang chun, akilhatdoh thei nadiuvin Mose in hiche sumho chu Aaron le achapate apetan ahi.

4.1: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga thu aseijin,
4.2: Levi phung sung a kon a Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou najih lut ding ahi.
4.3: Amaho lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.
4.4: “Kohath hon Houbuh sunga anatoh ding u chu manchah thil athenga umho jouse vettupna chungchang chu ahi.
4.5: Amahon ngahmun u achon ding teng ule Houbuh maicham sunnung pondal chu Aaron le achaten alahlhah diu kitepna thingkong khuna a anei ding u ahi.
4.6: Chuteng hiche pondal chu kelcha vun kisuhtah a atom dingu, hiche ho jouse chu pondum khatseh a apha chansoh ding u ahi. Chiho jouse kichai teng thingkhong chu aputna thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
4.7: “Abankit a Changlhah a umpi jing ahiu melchihna, hiche Changlhah kikoina dokhang chunga pondum khat aphajal ding u ahi. chuleh hiche pon kipha chung a chu lheng kongho, gimnamtui halna lhengho, khonho, twi lhitthengna, chuleh deisahtah a aumjing jeng changlhah ho kikoi ding ahi.
4.8: Amahon hicheho jouse chu ponsan a akhu diu, chutengle kelchavun thengsel'a hiche ponsan chu kikhuson kit diu ahi. Chujouteng dokhang chu aputna ding thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
4.9: Hicheban jom a chu amahon pondum-eng achu thaomei khum chu ahin khu a, thaomei semtohna, achoina kong, chuleh Olive thao kikoina khon jong chu akhu khum dingu ahi.
4.10: Chule amahon pondum a chu thaomei khom leh athil manchah ho jouse chu kelchavun thengsel'a atom khum uva chuleh hiche alom chu akiputna kolchahna chung a chu akoi ding u ahi.
4.11: “Chuban leh pondum khat a sana gimnamtui maicham kilhaina chung a aphajal ding u, kelchavun thengsel'a hiche pon chu akhu diu ahi. Chuteng aputna ding thinglhon toh maicham chu asuhto ding u ahi.
4.12: Maicham kin a dia manchah akigongtuplou laise chu pondum khat a tomding, kelchavun thengsel khat a hiche pon chu kitomson ding, chuteng aputna kolchah a chu kikoi ding ahi.
4.13: “Amahon kilhaina ding a maicham phung a kon a vutvam hochu alodoh diu, chule ponsandup a maicham phung chu atom diu ahi.
4.14: Maicham thilkeuho jouse - meihalna kong, thihkhe, leilodohna longkhol, kisilna kongho, chuleh thilkoina ho jouse - pon chung a chu kikoi a, chuleh kelchavun thengsel chu hiche ho chung a chu kiphajal a kikhu ding ahi. Chuteng aputna thingjol chutoh asuhto ding u ahi.
4.15: Aaron le achapaten munthengho ahin, atheng a um thil le lo ho ahin, ahintom jousoh teng ule ngahmun a kon a kitol theidiu ahitai. Kohath chapaten hiche hi lhun nading mun chan ahin putdiu ahi. Ahivang a thil theng hochu asuhkhah louhel ding u ahi, achuti louleh thilo ding ahiuve. Hichengse hi Kohath chapaten houbuh a konna aput diu ho chu ahi.
4.16: Aaron chapa Eleazer thempupa mopohna chu thaomei khom a thaotwiho, gim namtui ho, niseh a kitoh lhosoh thiltoho, kinuding thaotwi ho avettup jing ding ahi. Houbuh pumpi leh asung thil ijakai, muntheng le muntheng a akimangcha jouse chu Eleazar vettup na noi a um ding ahi.
4.17: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga thu aseiyin,
4.18: “Levite phung a konin Kohath chilhah ho mahthah sahhih in.
4.19: Muntheng pen thil ho ahin nailut teng a thilou nadiuva nang in hiche hi nabolpeh ding ahi. Aaron le achapaten aki lhonlutpi jing diu chule amichang cheh a atoding abol ding u chu napeh cheh ding ahi.
4.20: Kohath chilhah techu phat chomcha hijongleh muntheng laiya thil umho veding a lutlou hel ding u ahiuve, achuti louleh thitei teidiu ahi.”
4.21: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga ahin asei in,
4.22: Levi phung sung a kon a Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou najih lut ding ahi.
4.23: Amaho lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.
4.24: Gershon chilhahte chu japi natohna a leh thilgih domding ho chung a mopoding ahiuve.
4.25: Amahon Houbuh pondal ho jouse apoh diu, Houbuh jong aki tomna pon puma, kelcha vuntheng sel a akitomna pum a, chuleh houbuh lutna kotphung a pondal toh ahinpoh tha diu ahi.
4.26: Houbuh polama ahin amalam ahin houbuh leh maicham phung vel'a pondal ho jouse jong, khaoho ahin, chuleh amaho natoh toh kisai a amanchah hou jouse ahi. Hicheho jouse chung a hi Gershon chilhahten avettup diuva mopohna chang ahiuve
4.27: Aaron le achapate mopohna Gershonten amopohna hou jouse, thil dople ding hihen, natohna dang dang tohna ding hijongle Aaron leh achapaten akomu peh jing diu ahi. Gershon chilhahten thilgih putna ding a jong ngansena apeh ding u ahi.
4.28: Hichengse hi Gershon chilhahten Houbuh sunga atohdiu kipe chu ahin, Ama hohi Aaron thempupa chapa Ithanar vetsuina noi a umdiu ahi.
4.29: Levi phung sung a kon a Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou najih lut ding ahi.
4.30: Amaho chapate lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.
4.31: Merarite hon Houbuh a muna atoh diu chu Houbuh thilho dop le ding ho ahi. Houbuh kolchah thingho, a agol kamho, khom ho, chuleh atotheh ho adop diu ahi.
4.32: chukit jongle houbu kimvel a pal khomho leh atotheh ho, akikhainaho le khaoho chuleh amaho natoh toh kisaiya amanchah ho jouseu jong avettup ding u ahi.
4.33: Hichengse hi Merari chilhahten Houbuh sunga atohdiu kipe chu ahin, Ama hohi Aaron thempupa chapa Ithanar vetsuina noi a umdiu ahi.
4.34: Hichun Mose, Aaron chule phung lamkai hon Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou anasim un anajih lut tauvin ahi.
4.35: Hiche min kijihna chun houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga chan hochu abonchan jihlut cheh ahiuvin,
4.36: Chule amaho chu agom a mi 2,750 ahiuve.
4.37: Hicheng hi Kohath chilhah ho lah a Houbuh a natong thei cheh ding a lhin na nei ho ahiuve. Pathenin Mose athupeh bang in Mose le Aaron in jong ajihdoh lhon in ahi.
4.38: Gershon chilhahte jong chu hitobang ma chun aphung achang dungjui in aki sundoh cheh uvin ahi.
4.39: Hiche min kijihna chun houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga chan hochu abonchan jihlut cheh ahiuvin,
4.40: chule amaho agom a mi 2,630 ahiuve.
4.41: Hicheng hi Gershon chilhah ho lah a Houbuh a natong thei cheh ding a lhin na nei ho ahiuve. Pathenin Mose athupeh bang in Mose le Aaron in jong ajihdoh lhon in ahi.
4.42: Merari chilhahte jong chu hitobang ma chun aphung achang dungjui in aki sundoh cheh uvin ahi.
4.43: Hiche min kijihna chun houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga chan hochu abonchan jihlut cheh ahiuvin,
4.44: chule amaho agom a mi 3,200 ahiuve.
4.45: Hicheng hi Merari chilhah ho lah a Houbuh a natong thei cheh ding a lhin na nei ho ahiuve. Pathenin Mose athupeh bang in Mose le Aaron in jong ajihdoh lhon in ahi.
4.46: Hichun Mose le Aaron chule Israel phung lamkai hon Levite chu a insung le ama phung dungjui cheh in ana jihlut tauvin ahi.
4.47: Kum somthum apat somnga chan Houbuh a natong thei leh thilho po le theija pang thei ding ho chu
4.49: Pathenin Mose thu apeh dungjuiya, aminhou jouseu jihlut a aumphat chun, pasal khat cheh chu atoh ding dol cheh uleh apoh ding dol cheh u akipecheh tauvin ahi. Hitichun Pathenin Mose thu apeh bangtah in min kijihlutna natoh chu akichai tai.

5.1: Pakaiyin thu hichengse hi Mose hilchahna anei e:
5.2: “Israel mipite lah a koi hijong leh tiphah nei, boina nei, ahilouleh mithilong suhkhah jeh a chonna dan dungjui a athenglou a uma ahileh, ngahmun chu adalhah sah nading uvin thu pen.
5.3: Hiche thupeh hi numei leh pasal chung a umgel ding ahi. Ngahmun a amaho lah a cheng kahin, asuhboh lou nading un amaho chu koidoh un.”
5.4: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose thu apeh bang chun Israel mipiten hitobang hochu ngahmun a kon in akoimang, hiti chun aboltauve.
5.5: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin,
5.6: Anoija hilchahna chengse hi Israel mipite pen: Pasal hihen, numei hihen, koi hijeng jongleh, midang chung a thilphalou bol a Pathen joulhep a chu themmo chang a ahitai.
5.7: Amahon achonsetnau aphondoh teitei diu chuleh athilbol khel cheng chu aboncha a aledit ding ahi. Hiche chungvum a asuhkhel na pachu asuhkhelna jakhat lah a 20 abelap peh nalai ding ahi.
5.8: Ahinlah aki suhkhel napa chu athi tah a, asuhkhel ho dit nading asopi a-u, a-nao aumtah louva ahile, pehdinga umjouse chu Pathen ding ahitan chuleh thempuho kipe ding ahiuve. Themmona neiho vang chun Pakai henga kilheina dia kelngoinou ahin kai ding, chuteng suhtheng a umdiu, Pathen toh kicham diu ahi.
5.9: Israelten pumgo thilto ahin poh jouseu aboncha a ama chanding ahi.
5.10: Atheng a kipehna a hung kitohho jouse aman asan chan chu, ama ama thempu cheh chun akikoi ding ahiye.
5.11: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose kom a aseiyin ahi.
5.12: “Israel mite chu hiche hilchahna ho hohi pen. “Vetsahnan pasal khat ji chu achon chavei tan, chuleh ajipa a ding in kitahlouvin aum tan
5.13: chule Pasal dang toh ajong tan, ahin ajipa ahin midang ahin koimacha in ahedoh tapon ahi. Koimacha ahetoh umlouva, ajon bolpettah a akimat lou jeng vang a, amanu chu ama le ama kisuboh a ahitai.
5.14: Itiham khat a ajipa chun ajinu chu aginmo a athangthip a, amanu akisuhboh akisuhbohlou hettei ding agot leh,
5.15: ajipa chun ajinu chu thempu ang a ahin puilut ding ahi. Chuleh chang suhbongsa pucha ni chu amanu khel a ahinto ding ahi. Hiche chu Olive thao le gimnamtui toh nahel lou ding ahi, ajehchu hiche kilhaina hin a in-neipi chu kisuboh aham, kisubohlou ham ti photchetna dinga thangtomna a kibol ahi.
5.16: “Chuteng Thempupan Numeinu chu Pakai thutanna ang a adinsah ding ahiye.
5.17: Thempu chun leikhonlen a twitheng themkhat asodoh a Houbuh mai leitol a konna leivui alahdoh chu asunkhum ding ahi.
5.18: Thempu pan hiche numeinu chu Pathen henga ahin kilahsah teng, amanu sam chu alheplhah peh ding chule akhutteni chu hettohsah kilhaina a chu akoipeh ding ahi - hichu inneipu ginmona chu atah alhem ahi hetthei na dinga kibol ahi. Hiche teng Thempu chu numeinu nunglam a ding, athemmo pen pen gaosap chan na ding twikha umna leikhonlen, chu ahin dop ding ahi.
5.19: Hiche teng chule Thempupan numeinu kitepna noi a aumsah a, “Najipa thunoiya naum sung a Pasal dangtoh nana chonset khah louva, nana chonchatvei louva nana kisuhboh lou leh, hiche gaosapna twikhatah hi nathoh jou ding himei tahen” tia asei ding ahi.
5.20: Ahinlah na in-neipu adia kitahjou lou jeh a nana chekhel khah tah a, pasal dang toh nana chonset a nana kisuhboh khah tah a ahileh,'
5.21: “Thempu pan numeinu chu kitepna noi a aum sah ding, hitia hi asei ding ahi, ‘Pakaiyin chaneithei louva nakoi a, nanaobun panna aneilouva, nathong apomsah teng mipi jousen Pakai sapsetna nachunga lhung ahitai ti hehen.
5.22: Tuhin hiche sapsetna twihi nasung a lut henlang, nathong pomsah hen lang, naobu jong pannabei himai tahen.’ Chuleh numeinu chu, ‘Henge, hung lhung tahen’ atisah ding ahi.
5.23: Chule Thempupa chun hiche sapsetna thucheng ho chu savun chunga ajihdoh a hiche twikha a chu a sop lhah ding ahi.
5.24: Hiche sapsetna polut twikha chu numeinu adonsah ding ahi. Itiham khat a hiche numei chu themmo chang ahikhah leh twi chun amanu oisung aphah teng, hiche chun khajenjun a athohlelsah ding ahi.
5.25: Thempu pan hiche thangtom kilhaina chu numeinu khutna kon a alahdoh a, Pakai masang a dopsang ding, chuleh maicham phung a achoi ding ahitai.
5.26: Thempupa chun hiche changbong khutsip dim khat chu mangmo thilto ding a ahamdoh a maicham phunga ahalvam ding, twi chu numei adonsah teitei ding ahi.
5.27: Hiche numeinu chu a jipa angsung a kitah joulouva ana kisuboh khah tahleh, hiche sapsetna po twi chun numeinu chu khajenjun a atholelsah ding ahi. athong hung poh ding chule anaobu jong panna bei hiding, chuteng chuleh amanu min chu amite lah a sapsetna hiding ahitai.
5.28: Ahinlah amanu chu anathen jinga kisuhbuh khah lou ahileh, imacha tilou ding, naosen jong aneithei ding ahi.
5.29: “Hiche hi ginmona thu suhlhepna dinga chonna dan ahi. Numei chu ajipa thuneina noiya aum sung a akisuhboh khah a ana chon chatvei khah tah a,
5.30: ahilouleh Pasal khat chun ajinu chu kitahjoulou ding a ahin ginmo khah tahleh, ajipa chun ajinu chu Pakai angsung a apui ding, chuteng Thempu chun hiche chonna dan jouse hi abol ding ahi.
5.31: Hiche thua vang ajipa themmona itobang hijong leh ongthol ding, ajinu vang achonsetna dungjuiya themmo chang ding ahi.”

6.1: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseyin,
6.2: “Israel mite chu hiche hilchahna hohi pen. Mipiho lah a koi hijong leh, numei hihen pasal hijong leh atumbeh a Nazirte kitepna a kitem aum a, Pakaiya dia atumbeh a ama leh ama kipedoh aum leh,
6.3: Amaho chun khamnathei juho leh lengpithei twiho don angah ding u ahi. Hitobang miho chun lengpi theitwi ahilouleh adangdang khamnathei a kisem juthuh kilhahna ho chu aman lou ding u ahi. Lengpiga apat a twikilhithah jeng jong adonlou ding, Lengpi theiga ahin Lengpi theiga gopsaho jeng jong aneh uva adonlou ding u ahi.
6.4: Amaho chu Nazirte kitepna kol sung a aum laise uva, lengpigui a kon a kisemdoh ho chu aneh diu le adondiu phal ahipoi - Lengpi thei ahoh le amu jeng jong aneh lou ding u ahi.
6.5: “Nazirte tia kitepna kol sunga aum sung sese uva chu asam u jong ache louhel diu ahi. Akitepnau suhbulhit a aum phatsungse a chu asam u akihoisao ding u ahi.
6.6: Chule hiche kitepna kol sung a aum sung sese uva hi thilong umna'a vel lah a che lou ding ahiuve.
6.7: Hiche mithi long chu apen na mong mong pa hihen, anu hihen, sopipa ahilouleh asopinu hijongle amaho chu kisuboh lou ding ahiuve, ajehchu alu uva asam uchu Pathen a dinga kitum lhandoh ahinau lim a um ahi.
6.8: Pakai kintheng natong dinga lhenchom a aum chan uva hiche kigahna ho hi ajui jing diu ahi.
6.9: Itiham khat a ama angsung a mikhat chu alhuh a athi jeng tah a ahileh asam kithenso chu kisuhboh ahi tai. Nikho sagi kho ngai dingu, asam u akivotol ding u ahi. Chuteng amaho chu akisuhbohna uva kon a atheng a umkit a ahitauve.
6.10: Ni get lhinni teng vakho kopkhat ahi louleh in vapal nou ni houbuh maicham lutna dontah a thempu kom a ahin choi ding u ahi.
6.11: Thempu chun vachateni lah a khat chu chonset kilhaina a atodoh ding, khatpen chu pumgo maichamma a dia atodoh ding ahi. Hitia dol a chu thempupan mithi tahsa suhkhah jeh a themmo channa chu asuhtheng ding ahitai. Amahon akitep nau chu aphudet kit uva, asam u chu aki hoisao kitdiu ahitai.
6.12: Amaho aboh a aum masang uva kitepna nikho ajo cheng uchu kisimlou a ahitai. Amaho chu athahbeh a Pakai angsung a Nazir ahinau chu alhumkei a ding a kilhandohkitna ding u chuleh amacheh in themmo kilhaina thilto ding a kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi achal khat ahin kai ding ahi.
6.13: “Hiche hi Nazirte chonna dan chu ahi. Nazir a dia akilhekhen nau phat nunung lam teng, houbuh kotphung a chu che diu
6.14: chule Pakai ang a thilto hou alhantheng diu ahi. Hichu kumkhat lhingsa nolnabeihel kelngoichal khat pumgo thilto ading, kumkhat lhingsa nolnabeihel kelngoi anu khat chonset kilhaina ding chuleh nolnabei kelngoi achal lhingset khat hichu chamna maicham ding,
6.15: Cholsolou changlhah Pocha khat - hichu akilhengdoh changbong Olive thao toh kimehhel chule changlhah neocha cha a paset a kisem a olive thao kichapkhum- chuleh pehding a umsa lhosoh thilto leh atwi a kilhaina thiltoho ahiuve.
6.16: Hiche thilto hohi Thempu in Pakai angsung a pehdohna anei ding ahi. Amasa penna chonset kilhaina thilto leh pumgo maicham thilto ahin,
6.17: aban'a chamna maicham ding a kelngoichal lhinsel chu ahin, chuleh Cholsolou changlhah pocha khat ahi. Pehding a umsa lhosoh thilto leh atwi a kilhaina thiltoho ho hjong chu Thempu in Pakai kom a pehdohna anei ding ahi.
6.18: “Chuteng Nazirte hochun Houbuh lutna kotphung achu asam u akivolhah diu ahi. Chamna maicham kilhaina noi a meilah a chu anakikat dohsa asam u chu akoilut diu ahi.
6.19: Nazir hon asam u akivotol jouteng uleh, thempun amaho cheh ding a akihulmin sa kelngoi chal dah chu alah ding, Pocha sung a um cholsolou changlhah leh changlhah neocha cha a paset a kisem chu alah ding ahi. Hicheng se chu aman Nazirpa khut teni a akoi ding ahi.
6.20: Thempun hicheho chu adopsang a kilhanna thilpeh tumbeh Pakai anga a abol ding ahi. Thempupa dinga atheng hung kitoh dohho chu ahileh, atumbeh a hung kitoh a-omlhang leh thengtah a Pakai anga a kitohdoh leh kidomsang a-mal jaona cheng chu hiding ahi. Hiche kintheng hi ahung kichai teng Nazirpa chun lengpi twi adonthei ding ahitai.
6.21: Hiche hi, kilhaina hicheng Pathen kom hinlhut ding a kitepna nei Nazirte chonna dan chu ahi. Hiche chungchon a kilhaina apehjou chan uva jong apeh thei u ahi. Chuleh amaho chu Nazir tia lhendoh chom a aumteng uleh khopho tah a hitia akitepna jouseu chu abol ding u ahi.
6.22: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin,
6.23: “Aaron le achaten Israelte mipi jouse chu atumbeh a phatthei abohdiung uvin seipeh in:
6.24: Pathenin phatthei naboh uhenlang naveng jing uhen.
6.25: Pathenin lhaisel in nave jing uhenlang nachung nga lung lhaisel jing tahen.
6.26: Pathen mitvet in lung lhaina chang in chule chamna nape hen.
6.27: Aaron le achapaten keimin a Israelte phatthei aboh teng uleh keima in jong amaho chu phatthei kaboh ding ahi.

7.1: Mose chun houbuh atundoh nichun thao anun, atheng in atum koi tai. Aman thilkeo jouse jong thao anun, houbuh sung manchahho, maicham phung leh athilkeo ho jong atheng in atum akoi tai.
7.2: Chuin Israelte lamkai ho - akilom a um miho min jihlut a pang phung lamkaiho- ahung un, ama ama thilto ahin pohlut cheh uvin ahi.
7.3: Amahon abonchauvin Sakol kangtalai lentahtah gup toh Bongchal Somle ni ahin kaiyun ahi. Sakol kangtalai khat chu lamkai ni a ahin, Bongchal khat cheh chu Lamkai khat cheh a ahi. Hicheho cheng hi Pakai a ding Houbuh mai a chun apeuvin ahi.
7.4: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose kom a seiyin,
7.5: “Thilpeh hochu sang in, Sakol kangtalai leh bongchalho chu houbuh pohle na a nanei ding ahi. Levite chu atoh dungjui cheh un homkhen in.”
7.6: Hitichun Mosen kangtalaiho leh bongchal ho chu Levite apetan ahi.
7.7: Mosen Kangtalai ni le Bongchal li chu Gershonten anatohnauva amanchah ding uvin apetan ahi,
7.8: Chuleh Kangtalai li le Bongchal get chu Merariten anatoh nauva amanchah ding uvin apetai. Na kitong jouse aboncha a thempu Aaron chapa Ithamar vaihom nanoiya umsoh kei ahi.
7.9: Ahinlah Houbuh a kimang cha thil theng hochu alengkou uva apoh ding u ahijeh chun Kohatte vangchu kangtalaiho le Bongchalho imacha apepon ahi.
7.10: Lamkaiho jousen jong kilhanthengna thilpeh ahin kichoi cheh uvin, kisuhtheng nikho chun maicham phung nga akoi cheh tauve.
7.11: Pakaiyin Mose kom a aseiyin, “Maicham kithensona ding in lamkai khat in thilpeh khat cheh hintoh hen.”
7.12: Nikho masapen tah chu Nahson kiti Aminadab chapa Judah phung lamkai chun maicham a ahin pelut in ahi.
7.13: Nahson in ahinto doh thilho chu sum-eng lheng, agihdan shekel jakhat le somthum a gih chule sum-eng lheng khat Hou-In sung nga dangka kholna ahin, hiche ho jouse hi changbong kitahna chule chanbong neljet Olive thao toh ania kisung dim cheh ahiye.
7.14: Nahson chun sana a kisem thilkoina li gimnamtui dimset chu ahin choiyin ahiye.
7.15: Nahson in Bongnou khat toh, kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal chu pumgo maicham ding in,
7.16: Chule kelchal khat chu chonset kithoina maichama pang ding in ahin kai in ahi.
7.17: Chamna maicham adin Bongchal ni, kelngoi achal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, kelngoi kumkhat lhingsa hochu ahinkai in ahi. Hichengse hi Amminadab chapa Nahson in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.18: Nikhoni lhinni in Zuar chapa Nethanel, Issachar phung lamkai pan, amaicham ahintoh doh in ahi.
7.19: Ama hinto ho chu, sum-eng hopthum ahin tohdoh in chule sum-eng kong khat sopna agih diu khat hichu Hou-In nathilgih tetoh na kila ahi. Hiche sum-eng kong twihi chang bong kitang Olive thao kisun khum ahiye.
7.20: chuleh sana a kisem thilkoina gimnamtui dimset ahi.
7.21: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.22: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.23: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Zuar chapa Nethenel in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.24: Anithum lhinnin Helon chapa Eliab, Zebulunte phung lamkai pan jong amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.25: Ama hinto ho chu, sum-eng hopthum ahin tohdoh in chule sum-eng kong khat sopna agih diu khat hichu Hou-In nathilgih tetoh na kila ahi. Hiche sum-eng kong twihi chang bong kitang Olive thao kisun khum ahiye.
7.26: chuleh sana a kisem thilkoina gimnamtui dimset ahi.
7.27: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,

7.29: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Helon chapa Eliab in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.30: Nili lhinnin Sheduer chapa Elizur, Reuben phung lamkai pan jong amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.31: Aman sum-eng kong khat chule houbuh sunga thiltena kitetoh chat ahin, hihcu changbong jaona Olive thao toh kihel khomma ahiye.
7.32: Eliazur in jong sana dangka kong ahin choijin hichu gimnamtui jaona ahi.
7.33: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.34: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.35: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Sheduer chapa Elizur in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.36: Ni-nga lhinna in Zurisaddi chapa Shelumiel, Simeon phung Lamkai pan jong amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.37: Shelumeul chun maicham hohi sum-eng kong tong gihtah ahin, amaho shelul kitena dungjuiyin Houin sunga kimanchahna bang chun changbong neldijet Olive thaotoh kihel chu ahiye.
7.38: Sana dangka kong jing ahin kitetoh in agih Gram li tobang ahin hiche chu gimnamtui a dimset e.
7.39: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.40: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.41: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Zurisaddi chapa Shelumiel in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.42: Ni-gup lhinnin Deuel chapa Eliasaph, Gad phung Lamkaipan jong amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.43: Phung lamkai dang hon atobang chun Eliasaph in jong lhingsel in a maicham ho ahin kipeh lut e. Sum-eng changbong neldi jet jaona hichu Olive thaotoh kihelsoh keija ahiye.
7.44: Eliasaph in Sana dangka jaonan gimnam tui dimsetna kikoi chu ahintoh doh in ahi.
7.45: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.46: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.47: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Eliasaph chapa Deuel in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.48: Nisagi lhinna in Amihud chapa Elishaph, Ephraimte phung Lamkaipan jong amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.49: Amachu phung sagi hou lamkai cheh in atodoh u akibang chet in sum-eng chang bong ho chu Olive thaova kihel soh keija ahiye.
7.50: Elishamma in sana dangka chule gim namtui tui dimsetna kikoi ahi.
7.51: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.52: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.

7.54: Niget lhina in Pedazur Chapa Gamaliel, Manassehte phung lamkaipan jong amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.56: Todoh maicham phung sung hotoh aki bang chat nalaiyin ahi.
7.57: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.58: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.59: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Amihud chapa Elisaph in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.60: Niko lhinnah in Gideon chapa Abidan, Benjamin phunga Lamkai pan amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.62: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.63: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.64: Chuleh kelchal khat chonset maicham kilhainan apang in ahi.
7.65: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Gideon chapa Abidan in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.66: Nisom lhinna in, Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer, Dan phung lamkaipan amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.67: Ahiezer lin maichamma ahin todoh hiche hohi ahiye. Sum-eng khon sopna Israelte houdan thua thiltena toh kitohchetna kite, changbong deitah ki subong chule kisuh neldijet Olive thao toh kinu khom ding ahi.
7.68: Ahiezer kite Amishaddai chapa in Sana dangka chule gim namtui thao jaonan ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.69: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.70: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.71: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.72: Nisomlehkhat lhin in Ocran chapa Pagiel, Asher phung lamkai pan anoija hohi maicham a din ahin tohdoh e.
7.73: Sumeng khon sopna theija gih hiche sum-eng lhengkong tunna chu leh changbong neldisel jaona hichu Olive thao toh kihal ding ahi.
7.74: Sana dangka le lhengkong chule gimnamtui dimset jao nan ahin toh e.
7.75: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.76: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.77: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Ocran chapa Pagiel in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.78: Nisom le ni lhinna in Enan chapa Ahira, Napthali phung lamkaipan amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
7.79: Ahira maicham ho sum eng jaonan chang bong hichu Olive thao jaonan ahin todoh ahi.
7.80: Ahira in sana dangka jaonan gimnamtui toh ahin toh doh in ahi.
7.81: Bongchal anou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
7.82: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.
7.83: Chamna maicham a din Bongchal ni, kelngoichal lhingset nga, kelchal nga, chule kelngoi kumkhat lhingsel-nga ahin kai in ahi. Hichengse hi Enan chapa Ahira in kilhaina thilto a ahinto ho chu ahiye.
7.84: Israel a phung lamkai hon maichamphung thao ana kinu a kilhandohna maicham dia ahintodoh hou chu: Sumeng lheng kong len som le ni, Sumeng kisilna kong som le ni, Gimnamtui kikholna Sana lhengkongho ahiuve.
7.85: Houintheng a shekel kitena a ilep leh Sumeng lhengkong len khat gihdan chu 3-1/4 pounds ahin chuleh Sumeng kisilna kong khat gihdan chu 1-3/4 pounds ahi. Sumeng mong mong agihdan chu 60 pounds ahi.
7.86: Houintheng a shekel kitena a ilep leh Sana lhengkong somleni khat cheh gimnamtui jaona a agihdan chu 4 ounces ahin. Sana mong mong agom a agihdan chu 3 pounds ahi.
7.87: Bongchal anou somleni, kelngoi achal lhingset somleni, kum khat lhing cheh kelngoi achal som le ni pumgo thilto a ding in ahung kitoh in, todoh ding a umsa lhosoh maicham jong ahi. Chonset kilheina maicham ding in kelcha achal som le ni ahung kikailut in ahi.
7.88: Chamna maicham ding in Bongchal somni le li, kelngoi achal lhingset somgup, kelchal somgup, kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal somgup ahung kitohdoh in ahi. Hicheng hi maicham phung thao akinu jouva maicham phung a dia kitodohna maicham dia hung kitohho ahi.
7.89: Mose chu Pakai toh kihou ding a Houbuh sunga alutji teng, aman houpina awgin thingkhong akhu (Themmona akon a themchanna mun - Kitepna thingkhong chung a kinga) chung a Cherubim teni lailung a kon chun aja jin ahi. Hiche lai mun a kon a chu Pakaiyin amachu ahin houpi ji ahiye.

8.1: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
8.2: “Aaron in hiche hilchahna ho hi pe in: Thaomei khom sagi chu atunna a natundoh teng le, amalam ma thaomei khom mailah chu a salvah jou nading nading in tundoh in.”
8.3: Aron in chutichun aboltan ahi. Thaomei khom Sagiho chun amailam salvahna din Pakaiyin Mose henga asei bang bang chun atungdohtan ahi.
8.4: Hiche thaomei khom aboncha a, akhombul apat ajem kisemna changei chu sana kikhen a kisemdoh ahi. Hiche hi Pathenin Mose alim umding dol avetsah bangtah a kisem a ahi.
8.5: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga ahisei in,
8.6: “Tun Israel mipi adangho jouse a kon in Levite tumkhen inlang, chonna dan ngai bang in sutheng sohkei in.
8.7: Kisuhtheng na twi chu nathinkhum ding, amaho apumpiuva atahsa uva amul jouseu kivoumui diu chule amanchah jing apon hou akisoptheng diu ahi. Hitia chu abolteng uleh chonna dol a atheng a ahitauve.
8.8: Bongchal gol khat leh lhosohga maicham a kon a changbong Olive thao a kisunum chip chep, chule Bongchal golkhat mama toh chonset kilheina maicham a ding a ahin to dingu ahi.
8.9: Chuteng Israel nam mite jouse chu nakhopkhom a Houbuh kotphung a umdia Levite chu na peh doh ding ahi.
8.10: Pathen na dinga Levite chu napeh doh teng le, Israel miten amaho chunga chu akhut u angap diu ahi.
8.11: Aaron in akhut teni adopsanga Israel mipite lah a kon a Levite chu Pathen a dinga atumbeh a katohna aneiding, hitiachu Pathen lhacha natong ding a lhandohna anei ding ahi.
8.12: Hiche jouteng chule Levite jousen Bongnou achalni chung nga khut ngapna anei diu, Bongchalnou khat chu chule chonset maicham kisem chu pumgo maicham kisem na ding ahin, Pathen henga Levite chun ki suhtheng na anei diu cham dela umdiu ahiye.
8.13: Aaron le achaten Levite chu Amaho ma sanga adin sah uva, akhot u adop sang jou teng uleh Pathen masanga loupi tah’a maicham a sempeh diu ahi.
8.14: Levite chu Israel mipi telah akonna natum khandoh diu, ajeh chu amaho keija umjing diu ahi.
8.15: Hi chengse kichai teng, Houbuh sunga chu lut diu ana toh diu ijakai ajom thei diu ahi tai. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amaho chu asuh thenga na pehdoh ahi tan nangma heng nga loupi tah ana peh doh ahi tai.
8.16: Israel mipite ding in Levite hi keima dinga kikoisa ahin Israelte chi lhah’a pang masa pen ho chu keima konna phondoh le lhen doh tum ahi tai. Levite chu numei chilhah apat kilah doh ahiye.
8.17: Israel mipite lah’a peng masapen mihem pasal ahin gancha hi jong leh keima ahi soh keiyin, Egypt mite pasal chapa masapen jouse kana suhmang nia pat chun keima dinga kana gontup sa ahi tai.
8.18: Levite phung hi keiman Israelte lah’a chapa peng masa penna ka koi ahi tai.
8.19: Aaron le achate ho hi Levite vetup ding nga ki sem ahi tai. Israelte tha khel lah maicham Houbuh a kin theng na tong ding ahiuvin, pumgo maichamma kisuh thengna kin thenga a na tong le ding mong mong ahiuve.
8.20: Mose Aaron chule Israel mipi jousen Levite chu alheng doh un Pathenin amaho thu apeh dung juiyin abol tauvin ahi.
8.21: Leviten achonset na’u chu aki soptheng uvin chule aponsil ho jong aki noilhah un. Pathen masang nga loupi tah in maicham asem peh tai. Aaron in amaho chu maicham athengsel na ding uvin abolpeh in ajeh chu Pathen toh chamdela aum na diu ahiye.
8.22: Chu teng Levite chu Houbuh maicham’a sunglha diu kintheng na toh apat diu, Aaron le achaten aki thopi diu ahiye. Amaho thu nit ding aki pat jouse Pathenin Levite jui dinga Mose ahin hetsah ho chun anit soh keiyun ahi.
8.23: Chu in PakaiyinMose hengah hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
8.24: Hiche dan hi Leviten anit’u ngaijin, Houbuh sunga chu kintheng na toh apat na diuva chu kum-somni le nga beh alhin’u ngaiding ahiye.
8.25: Chule Levite chu kum-somnga alhin teng ule kichol thei ding ahitauve.
8.26: Levite chu akichol joulam teng ule asopiu aloi agol hon Houbuh kimvella ajenle a jong pangthei nalaiju ahi. Ahin lah akintheng na tong vang pang thai ta lou ding ahi. Hi chengse hi Levite kin theng natoh na muna aman chah diu dan ahiye.

9.1: Israelte chu Egypt a patna ahung kichon doh jou kum khat ahung lhing chun Sinai lhang a gamthip lah a chun Pakaiyin Mose kom a ahin seiyin,
9.2: Kalchuh kut kiman na ding phat kitepna a hi aman ding uvin Israel mite chu seipeh tan,
9.3: hichu lha masa pen nisom le nili lhina a khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hiche kipathanop kibol ding dan thupeh ho leh dan umho phate a najui sah ding ahi.
9.4: Mosen jong mipi henga kalchuh kut kipa golnop abol ding uvin aseipeh tan ahi,
9.5: ajeh chu Sinai lhang gamthip lah a nisomle nili ahung lhin a khovah chip chep in ahinphah den un ahitai. Pathenin Mose thu apeh bang bang chun amahon jong kipagolnop chu aboltauvin ahi.
9.6: Ahinlah ama ho lah a mi phabep chun mithi long ana thamkhah jeh un, chonna ngai bang in akisuboh a ahitauvin, hiche nikho a Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a chun alha thei tapouve. Hiche nikho chun Mose leh Aaron kom a ahung un
9.7: “keihon mithi long ka tham khah tah jeh un, chonna ngai banga atheng louva ka hi tauve. Hijong leh Israel mipin asem leng a keihon jong Pathen ang a maicham kasem mo diu ham?” ahungtiuvin ahi.
9.8: Mose chun a donbut, “Nangho ding a Pathen a kon a hilchahna kamu kah khongai un” ati.
9.9: Pakaiyin Mose ahin donbutna chu hiche hi ahi.
9.10: “Hiche hilchahna ho hi Israel mipite seipeh in: Tukhang hihen lang khang hunglhung ding ho hijongleh chonna ngai bang a akisuhboh kha hihen, kholgam a chedoh ho hijongleh Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a pangthei ding u ahi.
