3.25: Nalung ahileh, Jordan hi nei galkai sah in lang, gamhoi tah Lebanon molsang ho nei musah tan, ati.
3.26: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan, ka taona angaisah tapoi. Chuin aman aseiyin, aphatai! Imadang seibe datan, ati.
3.27: Pisgah molchunga kaltouvin lang, gam jouse gavetan, amavang Jordan vadung na galkai lou ding ahi.
3.28: Nangma khel in, Joshua thaneina pen lang hilchah jotan, ajeh chu Joshua in mipi aboncha Jordan chan agalkai pia, alam kai ding ahi. Masanga namu gam jouse aboncha aman mipi apeh ding ahi.
3.29: Chuin Beth-peor kiti muna chun kaum tauvin ahi.

4.1: Tun, Israel miten danthu kahil jouseu phatah in ngaiyun, Pakai, Pathenin napu, napateu khanga pat napehnau gam nalhun thei nadiu le agama nachen thei nadiu ahi.
4.2: Kathupeh a kon in ngaisah louna ima neihih hel uvin. Pakai, Pathen akonna ka thupeh chengse hi phatah a najui diu ahi.
4.3: Baapeor muna Pakaiyin nangho dinga ichangeiya na atoh namusoh keiyun ahi. Hiche muna chun Pakai, Pathenin Baal doi hou jouse abonchan asugam sohkeiye.
4.4: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen tahsan a thua nung jouse, tuni chan in nabon chauvin nadam nalaiyun ahi.
4.5: Vetan, Pakai, Pathen akonna juiding dan hichengse hi nangho dinga thupeh ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi gamsung nalut teng uleh phatah a najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
4.6: Hichengse hi najui uva ahileh, na kimvel uva cheng nam dangte sanga athem leh achinga naum diu ahi. Hitobang nunle khan ahin jahdoh teng uleh, hiche nam mite hi datmah umtah in aching lheh uve tia asei diu ahi!
4.7: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen ikom cha uva aum jing banga, eiho Pathen tobang nam dang ten anei khah ngai em?
4.8: Hitobanga chu keiman jong na masang uva ka koipeh danthu hijatpi hi, kicheh tah’a ka koipeh banguva koi dang nam in hitobang anei khah ngai em?
4.9: Ijeh inem itileh vetan! Nanghon namit tah uva namu chan uchu nahaimil lou diu ahi. Hiche hi na damsung uva nalung thim uva konna na jamdoh sah lou diu ahi! Natu na chate changeiya achin jing diu ahi.
4.10: Chule Pakai, Pathenin Sinai mol chunga adin nikhoa ka henga thu asei chu na haimil lou diu ahi. Mipi ho abonchan ka henga hinpuiyin, keiman ijakai kahil diu ahi. Chutileh amahon keima gin ding dan ahet uva, atu acha khang gei uva jong keima eigin jing diu ahi.
4.11: Nangma mol chunga na keng in nahung ding in, Molchung vum jouse meibol in atom in chuin mu athim lhatan ahi.
4.12: Chuin Pakaiyin nangma henga thu aseiyin, meikong in akilah in, Ama awgin chu najan ahinlah tahmel in namupoi; ajeh chu awgin bou najah ahi.
4.13: Pakaiyin kitepna asem in, Thupeh som nanit jing diuvin thupeh aneiyin, songpheng ni chunga ajihdoh in ahi.
4.14: Hiche muna chun Pakaiyin thupeh aneiyin, nangho gamsung nalut kon teng uleh danthu najui diuvin abonchan eihil in ahi.
4.15: Hijeh chun nangho ching theiyun! Sinai mol chunga Pakaiyin najah uva thu asei nikho chun, nanghon tahmel in namu pouve.
4.16: Hijeh chun nanghon milim doi numei leh pasal lima semthu a-angsunga na bokhup uva na kisuhboh louhel diu,
4.17: gancha hihen chung leng vacha hijongleh,
4.18: tol-lhang lah a ganhing hihen, twipi noiya um ganhing limsem thu kitiphot angsunga na bohkhup lou diu ahi.
4.19: Chunglang vea lha, ahsite chule vanthamjola thil ho jong bohkhup a akin bol ding na ngaito louhel diu ahi. Hichengse khu aboncha Pakai, Pathenin leiset a cheng mihemte apeh ahi.
4.20: Ajeh chu nangho hi Pakai, Pathenin Egypt gamsung meilhum lah’a kiloidoh a Pathen dei tum mong mong dinga tunia hi nasemu ahin, hichu nasuhmil lou diu ahi.
4.21: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan. Pakaiyin kitepna asem in keima Jordan vadung galkaiya, keima hiche gamsunga khu kalut thei lou ding ahitai.
4.22: Keima khela hiche gamsung lodinga Jordan vadung nagal kai diu ahi. Keima vang hiche solam vadung pama hi thiden ding kahi tai.
4.23: Hijeh chun chingthei un Pakai, Pathenin kitepna napeh hou aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi. Pathen doumah milim doi sem ding gohih un, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga doumah umtah ahi.
4.24: Pakai, Pathen hi meikong a kilahji ahin; thangtomna aneiji ahi.
4.25: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, tu le cha nahin neiyuva gam sunga na hung chen teng uleh, milim doi kiti sema a-angsunga na bohkhup louhel diu ahi. Hitobang thil hi Pakai dinga thet umtah leh Pakai lunghan na ahi.
4.26: Tuna van leh leiset kasan hi nangho hettohsahna ding ahi. Ka kitepna na suhkeh uva ahileh, Jordan vadung galkaiya gamsunga na hetman lou uva na manthah jeng diu ahi. Hinkho chomcha bou nanei diu; hetman louva thinan na lhunden diu ahi.
4.27: Ajeh chu nam dangte lah a Pakaiyin nathe cheh diu, lhom cha bouvin gamsung nalo diu ahi.
4.28: Hiche muna chu, gamdang mite lah a milim doi song le thinga kisem thu, ima jathei lou, muthei lou ho kin nabol diu ahi.
4.29: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen nahin hol kit diu, nalung thim pumpiuva nahin hol teng uleh namu bep diu ahi.
4.30: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, hitobang din muna naum uva gim genthei nan nalhun den teng uleh, Pakai, Pathen angsung nahin bel diu, Pakai thusei jouse nangai diu ahi.
4.31: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, Pathen uhi ngailutna a dim jeng ahin; na lung na heija Pakai lam nahin bel teng aman na damsah ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh, napu napateu khang apat akitepna ageldoh jing in ahi.
4.32: Tun leiset ahung kisem apat tuchana Pathenin ichangeiya mihemte akhohsah ham, ti thusimle vanthamjola ijakai jouse kholdoh uvin. Hitobang thil ki dang hohi najah a namu khah uvem?
4.33: Nanghon meikonga Pathen akilah a, awgin najah bang uva nam dang ten hitobang thil kidang atokhah tah uvem?
4.34: Pathen dang in nampi khat gim hesoh na a kon apui doh a, thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah gal asat peh, ban thahat pana kithopina, ki dang tah a na-atohna um kha tam? Ahinlah nangho Pakai, Pathenin Egypt gam naum lai uva anatoh ijakai na musoh kei tauvin ahi.
4.35: Pakaiyin ijakai na muchen sah tauve, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen tobang dang umlou ahi.
4.36: Pakaiyin vana kon in awgin na jahsah uvin, thupeh ijakai aneiyin ahi. Pakai meikonga akilah in nang ho nahou piu vin ahi.
4.37: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin napu napateu angailun chule a chilhahte changei phatthei aboh ahi. Pakaiyin abanthahat apan in, Egypt gam'a konna nahin pui galkaiyu ahitai.
4.38: Nangho ding in namdangte gamlha tah in achon doh in, Pakaiyin nangho chenna ding gamnom tah na peuvin, tunin na cheng tauvin ahi.
4.39: Hijeh achu hiche hi na geldoh jing diu leh na lungthim uva na chin jing diu ahi: Pakai, Pathen hi vana jong leiset a jong Pathen ahin, Pathen dang ama tobang aumpoi.
4.40: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha na juikim soh keiyuva ahileh, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding nachateu changeiya phatthei chang diu ahi. Imatih chana gam sunga kipah leh lungmonga nachen diu, na hinkhou asotna dinga Keiman thupeh hichengse aboncha kapeh nahiuve.
4.41: Chuin Mose’n khopi thum solam Jordan vadunga kichol nading in atung doh in ahi.
4.42: Koi tobang'in mihem khat alam louva atha a, suhna ding beiya auma ahileh, ama chu hiche muna hi jamlut ding ahinkho aki huhdoh ding ahi.
4.43: Khopi thum hochu: Bezer kiti gamthip lah a hichu Reuben in sunga ding; Ramoth kiti Gilead muna hichu Gad in sunga ding; Golan kiti Bashan muna hichu Manasseh insunga ding ahi.
4.44: Thupeh hichengse hi Mose’n Israel mite henga aseipeh ahi.
4.45: Hichengse hi danthu jui ding’a Mose’n Israel miten Egypt gam adalhah uva apeh,
4.46: Beth-peor toh kinai solam Jordan vadung phaicham ngahmun aum laiyuva apeh ahi. Phat masa chun hiche gam hi Amor mite lengpa Sihon in Hesbon muna konna ana vaipoh ahi. Hinlah Egypt gam'a konna Mose leh Israel mite ahung doh uchun ana sugam hel tauvin ahi.
4.47: Chuin Israel miten Bashan lengpa Og lalna gam leh anei agou jouse achom chai keiyuvin, solama Amor mite leng teni jaona ahi.
4.48: Israel miten Aroer apat Arnon Gorge chule Sirion mol Hermon tiajong kihe changeiyin ajousoh hel tauve.
4.49: Chuin amahon solam gamkai Jordan vadung pang leh, lhanglam San dung changeiyin ajousoh uvin, Pisgah noilam changei ahi.

5.1: Mose’n Israel mite akoukhom in aheng uva aseipeh tan ahi, Israel miten phatah in ngaiyun. Tunin Dan thupeh chengse hi jasoh keiyun, kihilnan neiyun lang najui kimsoh kei diu ahi!
5.2: Pakai, Pathenin Sinai mola kitepna eisem peh tauvin ahi.
5.3: Pakaiyin hiche kitepna hi ipu-ipateu toh asem ahipon, amavang tunikhoa eiho jouse dinga asem ahi.
5.4: Pakai mol chunga meikong in akilah in nangho kimaiton nakihou limpiuvin ahi.
5.5: Nangho leh Pakai kimlaiya keima ka ding in ahi, ajeh chu nanghon meikong nakicha uvin molchung na nailut ngam tapouve. Pakaiyin ka henga thu aseiyin, athusei doh aboncha nangho kapeh son ahi. Pakai thuseidoh chu hiche hi ahi:
5.6: Keima na Pakai leh na Pathen kahi, Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva na huhdoh pau chu kahi.
5.7: Kei tailou Pathen dang nanei loudiu ahi.
5.8: Milim semthu kiti nanei thei lou diu, van le leiset chule twikhanglen sunga hijongleh pathen lim semthu nanei thei lou diu ahi.
5.9: Hitobang lim semthu ho ang sunga chu naboh khup uva, akin nabol louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima na Pakaiyu leh na Pathen u-kahin, pathen dang semthua konna thang-tomji ka hin, hiche chonset nachu nacha teu khang geiya pap kalhunsah ding; keima ei pam pai insung pumpi chunga, khangthum leh li chan geiya lethuhna ka lhunsah ding ahi.
5.10: Hinlah ka thupeh nit a keima eingailu jing ho chunga, akhang akhanga ngailutna kalhunsah ding ahi.
5.11: Pakai, Pathen min nasuhboh louhel diu ahi. Koihileh Pakai min suboh chan chu ngaidam chang lou ding ahi.
5.12: Pakai, Pathen thupeh banga, Sabbath nikho theng chu nanit jing diu ahi.
5.13: Natohna ding nigup naneiyun ahi,
5.14: hinlah nisagi lhinni Sabbath nikho hi Pakai, Pathen dinga nikho theng ki todoh ahi. Hiche nikhoa hi koi machan insung natoh abol theilou ding, hiche hi nangho nahiuvin, nachapateu le nachanuteu, nasoh pasal ho le nasoh numei hou, bongchal holeh, sa-ngan ho chule nagancha jouse jaona, chule gamdangmi nalah uva hung cheng ho jaona hi ding ahi.
5.15: Hiche hi nasuhmil lou diu ahi, khatvei chu Egypt gam sunga soh a um nahiuvin, hinlah Pakai, Pathenin abanthahat pana nahin puidoh'u ahi. Hiche jeh achu Pakai, Pathenin Sabbath nikhoa ki chol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
5.16: Pakai, Pathen thupeh bang in nanu, napa jabol un. Chutileh nahinkhou sot ding Pakai, Pathenin napehnau gam sunga lung monga nachen diu ahi.
5.17: Toltha nabol lou diu ahi.
5.18: Jon thanhoi nabol lou diu ahi.
5.19: Gu chat nabol lou diu ahi.
5.20: Na sopi nalhep chatvai lou diu ahi.
5.21: Na sopi jitoh nalupkhom lou diu ahi. Chule nasopi gam jong nachu lou diu, asoh numei hihen pasal hijongleh, abongchal hihen, asangante hijongleh nasopi nei le gou, ijakai lepthola nalah thei lou diu ahi.
5.22: Hichengse hi molchunga nakal laiyuva Pakaiyin aseidohsa ahitai. Pakai chu meikong in akilah in aw-sang tah in asam in, chuin meibol le muthim in atomlha jeng in ahi. Hiche laimuna chu aboncha aseiya chule hichengse chu aboncha song pheng nia ajihlut a keima eipeh ahi.
5.23: Nanghon awgin le mu-athime ti najauvin chule molchung pumpi athimlha jeng tan ahileh, na insung cheh uva koin lamkaiho le upa ho ka henga ahung uvin ahi.
5.24: Amahon hiti hin aseiyuve, vetan! IPakaiyu le i-Pathen uvin aloupina ki dangtah in eimusah uvin aw-sangtah meikonga kilah chu kaja uvin, tunin kamu tauve. Ajeh chu Pathenin mihemte henga thu aseiyin, hinlah ima kati deh pouvin ahi.
5.25: Tunvang ipi dinga thi ikichat kit diu ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin iheng uva thu asei kit a ahileh, thinan ilhun den uva meikonga iki govam jeng theiyu ahi.
5.26: Haina hu neiya hing itobang hijongleh, eiho banga hing jing Pathen awgin ja'a thi louva hing thei aum dem?
5.27: Tun nangho cheuvin lang Pakai, Pathenin ipi asei em gangai tauvin. Chule hung kile kit unlang Pakaiyin ipi asei em ti kaheng uva hung seiyun, chuteng keihon kangai uva kajui diu ahi.
5.28: Keima henga nangeh chan’u Pakaiyin ajasoh tan ahi. Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiye, mipihon nangma henga ipi asei uvem ti keiman ka hesoh keiyin, chule amahon thudih aseiyu ahi.
5.29: Oh, hitia hi amahon lung ngaichatna anei jing diu chule hiche bang achu amahon keima eigin jing diu, ka thupeh jong anit jing diu ahi! Hitia chu achon jing uva ahileh, amaho leh achilhah teu chan geiya phatthei chang diu ahi.
5.30: Nangma chen lang aheng uva gasei tan, “Na ponbuh cheh uva kile tauvin.”
5.31: Hinlah nangma hiche muna hin ding den nalaiyin chonna dan thupeh aboncha kasei peh ding nahi. Chule hichengse hi aboncha mipiho henga naseipeh ding chutileh amahon achen nau gamsunga chu ajui jing diu ahi.
5.32: Chuin Mose’n mipiho henga aseiyin, nang hon chingthei tah in Pakai, Pathen thupeh aboncha jui ding go uvin.
5.33: Pakai, Pathenin nathupeh nau lampi chu jui jing uvin. Chutileh nalhun nadiu gamsunga hinkho sot tah nachen thei diu ahi.

6.1: Pakai, Pathenin nangho seipeh dinga danthu eipeh hichengse hi ahi. Hiche gamsung nalut teng uleh, najui kimsoh kei diu ahi,
6.2: chutileh nadam sunguva natu nachateu khang geiya keima eigin jing diu ahi. Pakai thupeh aboncha nanit soh keiyuva ahileh, lungmonga naum diu chule nahinkhou jong sot ding ahi.
6.3: Phatah in ngaiyun, Israel, ajeh chu hichengse hi najui kimsel diu ahi. Chutileh ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding, napu napateu khanga pat Pakai, Pathen kitepna banga khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam'a chu nachen diu ahi.
6.4: O Israel ngaiyun! Pakai hi i-Pathen’u ahi, chule Pakai ama bou ahi.
6.5: Hijeh chun Pakai le na Pathen'u nalung thim pumpiu le natha neisun in ngailu uvin.
6.6: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha chunga kipehna naneiyuva najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
6.7: Hichengse hi nachateu henga avel vel'a naseipeh diu ahi. In muna naumpet'u hihen, lam najot pet'u hihen, nalup konu hihen, nakithodoh pet'u hijongleh, aheng uva naseipeh jing diu ahi.
6.8: Hichengse chu na khut’uva kikhi jing unlang chule nachalpang uva jong nakhi chah jing diu, hitia chu na suhmil lou diu ahi.
6.9: Na in kot phung uva jong jih unlang chule kelkot mai ajong najih sohkei diu ahi.
6.10: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, na Pathen uvin napu na pateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga akitepna gam sunga napuilut vah diu ahitai. Hiche khopi hoa hi ijakai bukimsel, hichu nang hon man beiya namu diu ahi.
6.11: Insung hoa chu neileh gou ijakai aki lamsa hi ding ahi. Twikul ho jong aki laisa ahin, Olive thing phung le adanghoa konna jong aga naneh diu, hicheho jouse hi nanghon tu lou hela aga nalo diu ahi. Hiche hohi naneh teng uleh gamsung pumpi nalodim diu ahitai.
6.12: Chuleh chingthei un Pakai, na Pathen'u nasuh mil lou diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin na huhdoh’u ahi.
6.13: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u nagin diu chule Pakai kin jenga na kisah lel diu ahi. Ki hahselna nanei ujongleh Pakai min pana naki hahsel diu ahi.
6.14: Na kimvel uva nam dangte pathen semthu angsunga naboh khup lou diu ahi.
6.15: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen hi thangtom thei ahi. Pakai lunghanna chun leiset chunga konna natol mang jeng theiyu ahi.
6.16: Nanghon Massah muna Pakai, Pathen napatep banguva avela napatep kitlou diu ahi.
6.17: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh phatah a nanit jing diu, Dan jouse najui kim sohkei diu ahi.
6.18: Pathen mitmua apha jeng bol ding go uvin, chutileh ijakai pha chamkim soh kei ding ahi. Chuteng Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga pat’a kitepna gam sunga nachen diu ahi.
6.19: Pakaiyin asei bang in, hiche gam sunga nagal miteu aboncha Pakaiyin asuhmang hel ding ahi.
6.20: Khonung le nachateu vin hitia hi ahin sei diu, hiche dan le thupeh jui ding hohi ipi jeh a Pakai, Pathenin napeh ham? tia nahin doh diu ahi.
6.21: Chuteng nanghon hitia hi na donbut diu, keiho Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh angsunga soh a kana um laiyuva Pakai, Pathenin abanthahat a eihin huh doh'u ahi.
6.22: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh le amite henga thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah in, ipu ipateu khanga pat akitepna gamsunga cheng dia eihin puiyu ahi.
6.23: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga konna eihin puigal kaiyu ahin, ajeh chu eihon hiche gam ilo thei nadiu ahi.
6.24: Hijeh achu Pakai, Pathenin hiche dan thupeh jui ding jouse hi eipeh uva, hichengse ijui kimsoh kei uva ahileh ihinkhou sot ding chule imatih chana phatthei ichan diu ahi. Hichu tuni chan geiya idamnau ahi.
6.25: Pakai, Pathen akonna dan le thupeh aboncha ijui uva ahileh Pakaiyin eiho jouse them changa eisim diu ahi.

7.1: Pakai, na Pathen uvin gam sunga nahin puilut teng uleh, nam dang tampi umho khu asuhmang ding ahi: Hit mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite ahi. Hiche nam sagi hohi nang ho sanga hatjo le pungjo ahiuve.
7.2: Pakaiyin akhut akonna nang ho nahin pehdoh tenguleh, nang hon abonchauva nasuh gamsoh keidiu ahi. Amaho toh ki chamna ima semlouva abonchauva natha gam diu ahi.
7.3: Chule amaho toh chun na kichen thei lou diu ahi. Na chanuteu le nachapate hou chu amaho chanute le chapate toh nakichen sah louhel diu ahi.
7.4: Ajeh chu ama hon na chateu apui mang diu, semthu pathen angsunga abohkhup sah diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai lunghanna nachung uva hung chu jeng ding, chomlou kah a na manthah lo diu ahi.
7.5: Hitia hi nabol teidiu ahi, amaicham phung hou le akhom ho aboncha naphuh lhuh peh diu ahi. Chule Asherah ho jong naphuh lhuh diu aboncha meiya nahal vam diu ahi.
7.6: Ajeh chu nangho Pakai, Pathenin vannoi mite lah atumbeh a na lhen’u ahin, chule nangho amagou nahi tauvin, Pakai dinga mithengte nahi tauve.
7.7: Pakaiyin namdang te banga thalhing le hatjo nahijeh uva nalhen tumu hilouvin, amavang nam neopen nahijeh uva nalhen joh’u ahi!
7.8: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akitepna ageldoh jing in, nachung uva ngailutna anei jing in ahi. Hijeh achu Pakaiyin athahat pana Egypt gam Pharaoh akon suhgimna nachan nauva konna nahuh doh’u ahi.
7.9: Hijeh chun hethem un Pakai, Pathen hi nang ho Pathen dihtah mong ahi. Pakai ngailua athupeh nit jing mite chunga, akhang akhanga akitepna akoi jing in ngailutna jong anei jing in ahi.
7.10: Hinlah Pakai nasah louva umho chunga gim genthei alhunsah in asumang jin ahi.
7.11: Hijeh chun tunia thupeh kapeh chengse hi aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
7.12: Dan le thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathenin na chung uva alungsetna longlou chu akoi jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu napu napateu khanga pet akitepna ahi.
7.13: Pakaiyin phatthei naleh Ami ngailutna chun naumpi jing diu chule cha jong tampi nahin diu ahi. Pakaiyin gampha tah gaphaso nading leh naganchateu kivahna ding napeh diu, napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam nalhun tenguleh louga phatah nachom khom diu, lengpi thah leh Olive thao chule bonghon tampi leh kelngoi hon tampi jaona nanei diu ahi.
7.14: Chutengleh Vannoiya nam dangte jouse sanga phatthei nachan diu ahi. Numei, pasal hihen nagancha teu hijongleh cha nei louva khatcha naum lou diu ahi.
7.15: Chule dammo veisetna akonna Pakaiyin navenbit jing diu ahi. Egypt gam'a gim genthei nathoh bang uva nathoh sah lou diu, na doumah jouseu aboncha asuh mang ding ahi.
7.16: Pakai, Pathenin nam dangte nakhut a apehdoh chengse aboncha nasuh gam diu ahi. Ngailutna beiya nabol diu chule amaho pathen angsunga nabohkhup lou heldiu ahi.
7.17: Amavang nanghon hitia hi nasei diu, hiche nam mite hi eiho sang in ahat jouvin, iti iki doupi thei diu ham?
7.18: Hinlah nakichat thei lou diu ahi! Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin Egypt gam Pharaoh henga ichan geiya na atoh ham ti nageldoh diu ahi.
7.19: Pakai, na Pathen uvin amaho chunga tijat umtah’a na atoh geldoh jing un, hichu nangho mitmu tah a thilsoh ahi! Chule thil ki dang ijakai akilahsah ho geldoh jing uvin, abanthahat pana anatoh thil kidang hoa konna Egypt gam'a pet nahin puiyu chu na suhmil lou diu ahi. Hiche banga chu Pakai, Pathenin tua nagal miteu chunga na atoh ding ahi.
7.20: Pakai, na Pathen uvin tijatna phabep namasang lam uva ahin koi ding, chuteng ijakai atol mang soh ding ahi.
7.21: Hiche nam mite chunga chu kichatna nanei louhel diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na umpi jing uve, Pathen thilbol thei kidang ahi.
7.22: Pakai, na Pathen uvin hiche nam mite hohi aloi loiya asuh mang ding ahi. Khatvei pansa nasuhmang jeng thei lou diu ahi. Achuti louva ahile gamsate hung dimlha jeng ding ahi.
7.23: Hinlah Pakai, na Pathen uvin abonchauva nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi. Amaho abei kahseuva Pakaiyin asuhnoh phah diu ahi.
7.24: Pakaiyin alengte hou nangho khut a apehdoh ding, chuteng nanghon leiset a amin hou nasuh mang diu ahi.
7.25: Chule amilim doi semthu hou aboncha nahalvam peh diu, milim doi tomna ki mang sum-eng hijongleh khat jeng cha na kilah thei lou diu ahi.
7.26: Na insung'u suboh thei ima nanei thei lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho kibolna banga nangho jong thina nachan diu ahi. Hitobang thil hoa konna gamna kipan ding chule na kidalse jing diu ahi.

8.1: Tunia ka thupeh chengse hi chingthei tah in jui bukim soh keiyuvin. Chutileh nahinkhou sot intin, Pakaiyin napu napate khanga pat peh dinga akitepna gam nalo thei diu ahi.
8.2: Pakai, na Pathen uvin kum somli gamthip lah akonna nahin puidohna geldoh jing un, ajeh chu Pakai thupeh ijakai nanit kimsoh nadiuva nangho patepna ahi.
8.3: Henge, Pakaiyin gilkiela naum laipet tah uvin mana napiuvin ahi. Hiche tobang an-hi napu, napateu khanga jong um khalou ahi. Ajeh chu mihemte hi changlhah jengseh a hing jou ahipoi ti, Pakaiyin nahetsah nau ahin; amavang Pakai kam sunga konna hung potdoh thu changa bou hinga nahiuve.
8.4: Kum somli sung in von-ah ding jong nangaicha pouvin chule nakeng ujong imacha atipon ahi.
8.5: Hichu geltem uvin: Minu mipan acha ahilna banga, Pakaiyin nang ho phatchomna dinga bou nakhoukhah nau ahi.
8.6: Hijeh chun Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh chengse abonchan nit kimsoh keiyun lang, Pakai ging jinga hinkho naman diu ahi.
8.7: Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na gamu phatah twi nenna muna nahin puiyuva, hichu phaicham leh thing lhang gam aboncha ahi.
8.8: Hiche gam pumpi hi mimchang le kolbu lei jeng ahin; theiba phung, kolbu thei phung, Olive phung leh khoiju lonna gam ahi.
8.9: Hiche gamsung hi Pakaiyin ijakai kimsela twi achap nou ahin, chule agam sunga thih jong song banga kimang ahin, thinglhang gam song mantam jeng uma ahi.
8.10: Agamsungga naneh teng uleh Pakai, na Pathen'u thangvahna napeh jing diu ahi.
8.11: Hinlah chingthei tah in um uvin! Ajeh chu hiche gampha laitah jeh a chu tunikhoa Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh nasuh millou diu ahi.
8.12: Nanghon innom nahin kisah doh diu chule haosatah a nain chen diu,
8.13: chule nagan chateu jong hung pung cheh cheh ding, sana leh dangka ijakai kimsela nahin neidiu chuteng chingthei tah naum diu ahi.
8.14: Chutengleh kiletsah hoithona imacha naneilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga gim genthei nathoh lai uva Pakai, Pathenin nahuh doh’u ahi.
8.15: Pakaiyin gamthip noiya aipi hang leh gulse holah a nahin puidoh nau nagel doh jing diu, hiche mun chu tolgo lah le gamsa mun ahin, hinlah Pakaiyin twi nape uvin ahi.
8.16: Pakaiyin gamthip noiya manna in navah vaset uvin, hichu napu napateu khanga um khalou anneh ahi. Hiche hi Pakaiyin nangho patepna dinga abol ahin athua nanun cheh diu ahi.
8.17: Hiche ho jouse Pakaiyin nang ho dinga na atoh ahin, keima hatna a ka kilamdoh ahitia ima nasei louhel diu ahi.
8.18: Pakai, na Pathen'u na geldoh jing diu ahi. Pakai bouvin nangho lolhin theina dinga tha napeh’u ahi, ajeh chu napu, napa teu khanga pat kitepna gui lhunsah nading ahi.
8.19: Hiche hi nahet jing diuva ka thupeh ahi: Pakai, na Pathen'u sumila pathen dang angsunga na bohkhup uva ahileh, na chung uva thina lhung jeng ding ahi.
8.20: Pakai, Pathen nah sah louva naum uva ahileh, nam dang ki sumang ho banga nangho jong na ki sumang diu ahi.

9.1: Ngaiyun, O Israel! Tunia hi nangman Jordan vadung galkaiya namdangte chenna nalut ding ahitan, amaho khu nangho jouse sanga hatthei ahiuve. Khopi sunga acheng uvin chule akhopi kimvel uva pal kigen jouse jong vanthamjol chana sang ahi!
9.2: Amaho khu nangho sang in asang jouvin chule athahat jouvin abonchauva Anak chilhah ahiuve. Hijeh chun amahoa konin awchang naja tauvin, Anak mite kalvala chung nungjo koi ham? tin asei uve.
9.3: Ahinlah nahe sohkei uve tunikhoa hi Pakai, Pathenin ki dangtah’a aluchung vumuva meikong akilah sah ding asuh gam hel diu ahi. Pakaiyin ahin suhnem diu chuteng nanghon baithet’a natha gam diu ahi. Hichu Pakai, Pathen kitepna ahi.
9.4: Pakai, Pathenin nangho dinga hitobang natoh ahin chaisoh tengleh, ka chonphat jeh uva Pakaiyin hiche gam hi eipeh’u ahi, tia nasei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche nam mite phatlou jeh’a Pakaiyin agam uva konna asoldoh joh ahi.
9.5: Nangho chonphat vanga hiche gam hi nalo diu ahipoi. Hinlah hiche nam mite phatlou jeh’a adelmang ahin chule Pakai, Pathenin napu napateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga aki tepna asuh bukim ahi.
9.6: Nangho chonphat vanga Pakaiyin hiche gam hi napeh’u ahipoi ti nahet diu ahi, ajeh chu nangho milungtahte nahiuve.
9.7: Gamthip noiya Pakai nalunghan sahnau geldoh jing uvin. Egypt gam nahin dalhah nikho uva pat tuni chana vel ijat Pakai, Pathen doumah nabol doh tah uvem.
9.8: Sinai mol jenga jong Pakai doumah nabol uvin hi chun Pakaiyin thagam ding nago uvin ahi.
9.9: Hiche hi Sinai molchung ka umlaiya thilsoh ahin, Pakayin songpheng-ni ah imatih chana ding in kitepna chu asem tan ahi. Nisomli le jansomli jen an nelou twidon louvin kaum in ahi.
9.10: Chuin Pakaiyin songpheng-ni eipen hichu Pathen amatah molchunga naum laiyuva athu seidoh chengse akhut’a ajih doh ahi.
9.11: Ni somli le jansomli lhin nikhon Pakaiyin kitepna songpheng teni chu eipe tan ahi.
9.12: Chuin Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, Kipat in che tan! Egypt gam'a konna nahin puidoh miten doumah jeng aboltauve. Chomlou kah in ka thupeh nahsah louvin aki hei mang tauve! Sana limdoi sem in hinkho amang tauvin ahi!
9.13: Pakaiyin ka henga asei kit in, ‘Hiche mite lungtah le thungai louna ka muchen tai.
9.14: Tun keima che ingting hiche mite hi vannoiya kasuh mang jeng diu ahi. Amaho sanga hatjo le chung nung joa keiman na chillhahte ka tundoh ding ahi.
9.15: Chuin molchung vum'a meikong akilui jeng tan ahile, keima ka hung kumsuh in mon mang theilou kitepna songpheng teni chu kahin choiyin ahi.
9.16: Keiman kahin vesuh in ahileh, Pakai ding in chonset gitlouna nabol tauve ti ka muchen tai. Sana mangchan bonglim doi nakisem thu tauvin ahi. Pakai, Pathenin nathupeh nauva kon in chom loukah in nakihei mang tauve!
9.17: Chuin keiman songpheng teni chu tol lhama kasep lhan namit mutah uvin kasep in ahi.
9.18: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen angsunga nisomli le jan somli masang chun keiman an jong ka nepon chule twi jong ka don poi. Ajeh chu nang hon Pakai doumah bol in hinkho namang tauvin ahi.
9.19: Pakai lunghanna nachung uva ahung chuh a na thagam diu chu keima ka kicha lheh jenge, hinlah Pakaiyin ka taona eisanpeh kit in ahi.
9.20: Pakai chu Joshua chunga alung phamo lheh jeng tan, tha ding agon ahi. Aaron dingin ka taovin ahileh Pakaiyin ahing hoi tan ahi.
9.21: Na chonset nau bonglim chu kalan nen lah a meiyin ka halvam tan ahi. Mei kihalna vutvai abonchan kalan molchung akonna vadung twi a kasep lhatan ahi.
9.22: Massah, Taberah le Kibroth-hattavah muna jong Pakai doumah nabol uvin ahi.
9.23: Chuin Kadesh-barnea muna Pakaiyin hiche thupeh mangchan nasol tauvin ahi: Chetou un keiman kapehna gamkhu galo tauvin. Hinlah Pakai, Pathen thupeh nah sah louvin hinkho namang uvin ahi.
9.24: Henge, Pakai doumah jeng nabol uve tihi keiman kahin he jing in ahi.
9.25: Hijeh achu nisomli le jan somli Pakai henga ka bohkhup in ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nabonchauva thagam ding na got’u ahi.
9.26: Pakai henga hiti hin kataove, O thaneipen Pakai, hiche mite hi sugam louvin, hinghoi tauvin. Amaho hi namite ahiuve. Chule amaho hi nagoulupen Egypt gam'a nahuh doh’a naban thahat pana nahin puidoh ahiuve.
9.27: Hiche mite chonsetna leh lungtahna akon in ngaidam tan, chule ka puluiyu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob geldoh in, ati.
9.28: Hiche mite hi nasuh manga ahileh, Egypt miten hitia hi asei diu, ‘Israel mite athi gam tauve, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aki tepna gam'a chu apui lhung lou ahitai.’ Ahilouleh hiche mite hi Pakaiyin avetda jeh’a asuh gam ahitauve; thagam dinga apuile ahi, tia asei diu ahi.
9.29: Ajeh chu hiche mite hi nang man naban thahat pana Egypt gamsunga konna nahin puidoh ahiuve.

10.1: Chuin Pakaiyin kaheng ah hiti hin aseiyin, Songpheng ni masanga toh kibang chat hin choiyin chule thingkong khat phatah in sem inlang asunga khum ding ahi. Hiche na ding chun molchunga kahenga hung kaltouvin.
10.2: Hiche songpheng chunga chu masanga na sekeh chunga thucheng kijih bang banga kajih lut ding, hichu thingkong sunga nakoi ding ahi.
10.3: Keiman thinggi thingkong in kasem in chule amasanga bang bang in songpheng ni ka suitoh in ahi.
10.4: Chuin Pakaiyin avelin thupeh som hochu ajih lut in, keima eipetan ahi. Songpheng teni chu kakhut in kachoiyin, molchung lama kakal tou tan ahi.
10.5: Molchunga kon ka hung ki heisuh in, kitepna songpheng teni chu thingkong sunga kakoi tan, hichu Pakai thupeh banga kei man kabol ahi. Songpheng teni chu thingkong sunga aumtai.
10.6: Israel mite chu Jaakan twikul muna kon in Moserah kiti Aaron kivuina muna chun akitol tauvin ahi. Achapa Eleazar chun thempu na atoh ahi.
10.7: Hiche muna pat chun, Gudgodah mun ajon tauvin, aban'in Jotbathah hiche muna chu twisam tampi putna mun ahi.
10.8: Hichun Pakaiyin Levi insung mite chu thingkong pu dingin adei lhen tan, chuleh Pakai angsunga ding diu Pakai mina thempu na atoh diu ahi. Hiche hi amaho natoh ding ahi.
10.9: Hiche jeh achu Israel mite lah’a Levi insung chu chenna ding gamtum neilouva um ahiuvin, Pakai hi amaho dinga agoulupenu leh Pakai, Pathen thempu kinbol dinga um ahitauve.
10.10: Keiman amasa pena ding in, ‘Nisomli le jan somli molchunga Pakai henga kaum in, Pakaiyin avelin ka taona asang in nangho nahing hoi tauvin ahi.’
10.11: Chuin Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, keiman napuluiteu khang apat peh dinga ka kitepna, gamlo din mipiho lamkai tan, ati.
10.12: Chule tun, Israel mite, Pakai, Pathenin nanghoa konna adei chu ipi ham? Pakaiyin nang hoa konna adeichu Pakai ging jing unlang chule Pakai lunglam jeng nabol diu, na lungthim pumpiuva Pakai lam jeng nakat diu ahi.
10.13: Chule tunia najah uva kasei, Pakai, Pathen akonna thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
10.14: Veuvin! Chung sangpen leh leiset chunga thil ijakai jouse hi Pakai, Pathen a bou ahi.
10.15: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin napuluiteu ana ngailun hijeh achu, achilhahteu nangho jouse jong nam dang jouse sanga Pakaiyin na khohsah joh’u ahi.
10.16: Hijeh chun na lungtah nauva kon in, na lung heiyun.
10.17: Ajeh chu Pakai le na Pathen uhi pathen jouse lah’a Pathen chung nung, pakai jouse lah’a Pakai chungpen ahi. Ki dangtah Pathen ahin, sihnei langneina beihel Pathen ahi.
10.18: Pakaiyin meithaiho leh chagaho angailun chule gamdangmi nalah uva chengho angailun, von ki-ah ding apeuvin ahi.
10.19: Hijeh chun nanghon jong kholjinmi na ngailut diu ahi, ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam'a kholjina hinkho na-namanu ahi.
10.20: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u kin jeng nabol diu ahi. Kitepna ijakai Pakai min jenga nanei diu ahi.
10.21: Pakai ama bou Pathen ahin, chule Pakai bou choi-at dinga lom ahi. Ajeh chu ama bouvin thil kidang ijakai abol in, hichu namit tah uvin namu soh kei uve.
10.22: Napu napate hou Egypt gam'a ache uchun amaho mi somsagi bou ahiuve. Hinlah tun nangho Pakai, Pathenin vana ahsi jat in na semdoh tauvin ahi.

11.1: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen na ngailut diu chule Pakai dan leh thupeh aboncha najui teidiu ahi.
11.2: Chule nalungthim in haimil hih uvin, ajeh chu keiman nachateu henga thu hichengse Pakaiya konna dan leh thupeh khat jengcha jong ajah uvin kasei pon, amahon Pakai, Pathen loupi le thahatna mu jong amudoh hih laiyuve.
11.3: Pakaiyin Egypt gam Pharaoh henga thil kidang tampi akilahsah in, hinlah amahon hichu amu hih laiyuve.
11.4: Pakaiyin Egypt galsat miho le asakol kangtalai hou chunga itobanga na-atoh ham ti amu pouvin, chule Egypt miten nahindal laitah uva Twipi San dunga Pakai natoh jong amunai pouvin ahi. Amaho chu Pakaiyin asumang hel tauve.
11.5: Gamthip akon tuni chanin Pakaiyin, ichangeiya nakhohsah uham ti nachateu vin amu nai pouve.
11.6: Reuben chilhah, Eliab chapa teni Dathan leh Abiram chunga Pathen natoh jong nachaten amu pouvin ahi. Gamleiset Israel mite chenna aki hoh in, chuin amaho abonchauvin agam hel tauvin; aponbuh hou ahin chule anei leh agou ganchahou, jaonan abonchan amang heltan ahi.
11.7: Hinlah nanghon Pakai natoh ki dang abonchan namu soh kei tauvin ahi.
11.8: Hijeh chun chingtheiyun, tunia thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keidiu ahi. Chutileh na thahat diu nalhunna diu gamsung nalo thei diu ahi.
11.9: Thupeh hi chengse najui uva ahileh Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam napeh diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho chilhahten hiche khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam khu aluodiu ahi.
11.10: Hiche gam naluodiu khu nahin dalhah’u Egypt gam tobang ahipon, hiche gam leiset achun hon sunga ipi muchi hijongleh aga aphapon ahi.
11.11: Amavang naluo diu gam hi go jong aneng in, gamphatah ahi.
11.12: Hiche gam sung pumpi hi Pakaiyin nangho jouse dinga, aphatcha avet kol jing ahi.
11.13: Tunia naheng uva ka thupeh chengse najui uva chule Pakai, Pathen kin jing nabol uva ahileh,
11.14: Pakaiyin go-nangai chat tenguleh gamsunga go ahin juhsah ding, chule chang khoptup phat ahiteng jongleh go juh atansah ding ahi. Chuteng nanghon louga, lengpithei leh Olive thao nakhop tup diu ahi.
11.15: Nagan chate diuva anpha tah tah napeh diu chule nanghon nadu chan’u naneh thei diu ahi.
11.16: Hinlah chingtheiyun. Na lungthim'u phat mosah hih uvin, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen akonna Pathen dang nabel lo diu ahi.
11.17: Achuti louva ahileh Pakai lunghanna chun na halvam jeng diu, Pakaiyin vankot akha ding gotwi aum lou teng nanghon ahina banga chang na khop tup thei lou diu ahi. Chuteng hiche gampha muna chu hetman louva na thigam jeng diu ahi.
11.18: Hijeh chun ka thupeh chengse hi nalungthim cheh uva koiyun. Na khut uva kibu’uvin chule naluchang uva kop un chutileh imatih chana na haimil lou diu ahi.
11.19: Na chateu henga na seipeh soh kei diu ahi. Insunga naumpet’u hihen, lam najot pet, imut kon chule nathodoh kon teng ujongleh naseipeh diu ahi.
11.20: Thupeh chengse chu kot phung leh kelkot jousea najih diu ahi.
11.21: Chutileh vanthamjol um laisea, Pakaiyin napehnau gamsunga nangho leh na chateu chule na chilhahteu changeiya lung monga na chen diu ahi.
11.22: Ka thupeh jouse hi chingthei tah a najui diu ahi. Pakai, Pathen lama nache jing diu, chule hichu natuh chah jing diu,
11.23: Chuteng Pakaiyin namasang uva nam dang jouse ajamsah ding ahi. Amaho athao hat jo jongleh, Pakaiyin agamu nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi.
11.24: Anneh nakiholna jouseu chu nangho gam hi ding ahi. Chule solam gamkaiya pat lhumlam chan, hichu Euphrate vadung changeiya nalo diu, hiche gamsunga chu koima chan nasuh loh thei lou diu ahi.
11.25: Pakaiyin kitepna anei banga koimachan ima nalo theilou diu chule na chennau gam jousea lungmonga na chen diu ahi.
11.26: Vetan, tunin keiman thilni kapeh diu, hichu nanghon khat joh sang nakilhen diu, hichu phat theina leh gao sapna ahi.
11.27: Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh chengse hi na nitsoh keiyuva ahileh, nangho phatthei na chan diu ahi.
11.28: Hinlah thupeh hichengse hi jui louva, nahsahmoa na koiyuva Pathen akonna na kihei manguva, imatih chana nahet khah lou pathen dang kin naboluva ahileh gaosapna nachan teitei diu ahi.
11.29: Gamsung nalhun tenguleh Pakai, Pathen phattheina Gerizim molsanga naphon doh diu chule gaosapna vang chu Ebal molsang hiding ahi.
11.30: Hiche molsang teni hi, lhumlam Jordan phaicham a Canaan mite chenna, Gilgal khopi toh kinai cha, Moreh apat ki gamlha talou ahi.
11.31: Ajeh chu nanghon Jordan vadung galkaiya Pakai, Pathenin peh dinga atepsa gam lhung ding nahi tauve. Gamsung nalhun uva, nachen tenguleh,
11.32: tunia keiman kapeh dan jui ding jouse, aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.

12.1: Hichengse hi napu, napateu khanga Pakai, Pathenin dan leh thupeh jui dinga na peh’u ahi. Hoilai mun hijongleh nadam sunguva najui jing diu ahi.
12.2: Hiche gam khu nalhun uva, nam dangte abonchauva nano mang tenguleh, a pathen milim semthu jouseu molchunga hihen, gammang lah chule thingphung tinchenga hijongleh nasuh manghel diu ahi.
12.3: Amaicham hou nasuh set diu chule maicham phung jouse jong nasuh chim diu ahi. Asherah ho jong meiya nahal vam diu chule apathen min jouseu aboncha nasuh manghel diu ahi.
12.4: Hiche Pagan miten pathen ahou banga nanghon nahou lou diu ahi.
12.5: Amavang nang hon Pakai, Pathen houna ding muna Israel insung aboncha kikhop khomna muna chu, gin leh jabol tah’a nahou diu ahi.
12.6: Hiche muna chu pumgo thilto nahin choi diu, nathilto diu soma khat, kitepna suhbuh lhitna ding thilto chule na gancha penglha masa jouseu jong na todoh cheh cheh diu ahi.
12.7: Hiche muna chu nang leh na insung miten Pakai ansunga an neh khom nanei diu, Pakai phatthei naho nachan diu ahi, ajeh chu nangman Pakai thupeh nanit jal ahi.
12.8: Pakai kin nabol danu jong kikhel ding ahi. Tunin nabon chauvin natao uve.
12.9: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin atumbeh a napeh naugam nangho jouse dinga choldona gam chu na lhun nailou’u ahi.
12.10: Hinlah nanghon chomlou kah’a Jordan vadung nagal kai diu chule gamsung nalhun diu ahi. Pakaiyin nagal mite hou jouse akonna choldamna napeh tenguleh,
12.11: na bonchauva keiman ka thupeh chengse nahin choi diu pumgo thilto, na thilto diu ho, kitepna suh bulhit nading thilto hichengse hi, Pakai amintheng loupina ding muna chu nahin choisoh kei diu ahi.
12.12: Hiche muna chu nachanuteu ahin, nachapateu chule nasohte jouseu jaona Pakai henga thangvahna nanei khom diu ahi. Chule khopi sunga nachen khompiu Levi mite nagel doh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon gam chanvou anei lou’u ahi.
12.13: Nangho chingtheiyun, ajeh chu mun jousea pumgo thilto na todoh thei lou diu ahi.
12.14: Na insung miteu chenna mun, hichu Pakaiyin adeilhenna muna vang chu natodoh thei diu ahi. Hiche muna chu pumgo thilto natodoh diu chule ka thupeh aboncha nabol kimsoh kei diu ahi.
12.15: Nagan chate vang chu na kitha a khopi tinchanga naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Pakai, Pathenin phatthei aboh ganchaho chu nadei chan naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Sakhisa leh Sapeng jong naneh bang bang uva hi nanop chan’u naneh thei diu ahi.
12.16: Gan thisanho vang chu meiya nago lou diu, chule gan thisan jouse chu tollham a twi kisung banga nasun lhah diu ahi.
12.17: Hinlah nanghon na thilto hou chu na khopi sung uva naneh thei lou diu, hichu soma khat ahin, gathah, Olive thao, nagancha asoh masaho ahin chule kitepna thilto, chule mimal kipehna thilto ho hijongleh khopi dunga naneh thang lou diu ahi.
12.18: Hichengse chu Pakaiyin adeilhen na muna chu naneh diu ahi. Na chateu ahin, nasohteu ahin chule khopi sunga Levi mite jaona hichu Pakai, Pathen ansunga golvah nabol khom diu ahi.
12.19: Chule nadam sung uva Levi mite nageldoh jing diu ahi.
12.20: Pakaiyin akitepna banga nagam-u ahin keh let ding, nang hon sa nadu chanu hoilai muna hijongleh naneh thei diu ahi.
12.21: Hichu Pakai deilhenna mun, Pakaiyin akinbol nadia adeilhen namun’a jong naneh thei diu nain muna pat kenglama saotah kijot ahi. Chutengleh gancha lah’a nakel hon, na kelngoi hon chule nabong hon lah’a nadei na kitha uva naneh jeng theiyu ahi.
12.22: Nalah uva koi hijongleh atheng hihen, aboh hileh hichu aneh jeng thei ding, Sapeng le Sakhisa banga naneh diu ahi.
12.23: Gan thisan vang chu meiya nago vam thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu thisan hi hinkho tobang ahin, hinna thisan chule gancha meiya na gotha lou diu ahi.
12.24: Hiche khel chun ganthisan chu, twi banga tol lhama nasun lhah diu ahi.
12.25: Gan thisan chu meiya nago vam louhel diu ahi. Chutileh nangho leh nachateu nabon chau chunga, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai lunglam nabol jeh’u ahi.
12.26: Atumbeh a nathilpeh diu leh kitepna thilto chu choiyun lang, Pakaiyin adei lhenna muna chu naga koi diu ahi.
12.27: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen maicham phunga chu pumgo thilto gan thisan naga todoh teitei diu ahi. Gan thisan jouse chu Pakai maicham kimvela nathe khum soh kei diu, asa vang naneh thei diu ahi.
12.28: Chingtheiyun ka thupeh aboncha najui kim soh kei diu ahi. Chutileh nangho leh nachateu chunga ijakai phacham kimsoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai lunglama nachon jalu ahi.
12.29: Pakai, Pathen na-masang lamuva che jing ding, chuteng nam dangte jam gam diu agamsunga konna asuh manghel diu ahi.
12.30: Hiche muna chu achon chan’u jui ding nagot louhel diu chule apathen hou kin jong nabol lou heldiu ahi. A pathen hou chungchang hetnomna jong nei louva, hiche nam mite hin pathen iti ahou uham tiajong nadoh lou diu ahi.
12.31: Nanghon nam dangten apathen’u ahou bang uva Pakai, Pathen nahou louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai lama dinga doumah jeng abol uvin, achapateu leh achanute hou jeng jong apathen diuva akat doh jiu ahi.
12.32: Hijeh chun ka thupeh jouse hi chingthei tah’a najui diu ahi. Nanghoa konna ima ki lahdoh sah hih unlang chule amahoa konna jong imacha lah ding nagot lou diu ahi.

13.1: Chule nalah uva gaothusei ho khonunga hung lhung ding aseiyun, amahon thil kidang melchihna ho aki lahsah uve.
13.2: Hiche bang chun gaothua asei doh jouseu agui lhung in ahi. Amaho chun hiti hin hinseiyu henlang, ‘Hung un, pathen dang hou tauhite, ajeh chu hiche pathen ho hi imatih chana nahet khah louvu ahi.
13.3: Hitia chu ahinsei diu amavang, na nahsah louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu nPakai, na Pathen'u thua nanun jing diu chule nalungthim pumpiuva Pakai lam jeng nakat diu, chuteng Pakaiyin nangho nangailut jing diu ahi.
13.4: Pakai, na Pathen'u kin jeng nabol diu ahi. Pakai thupeh nanit jing diu, Pakai thusei a bou nanun diu chule Ama lam jeng nakat diu ahi.
13.5: Alam louva gaothusei doh’a khonung ding thilmu ho abonchauva thina chang diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon nahuhhing pau Pakai, na Pathen'u Egypt gam'a konna nahin puidoh pau doumah jeng abol tauvin ahi. Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh a konin puimang ding nagouvin, hijeh achu thina nachansah teitei diu ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva konna phatlou naho natol mang diu ahi.
13.6: Mikhat touvin guhthima nahin lhep diu nasopipa, nachanu ham nachapa, nangailuttah najinu, ahilouleh naloi ngaipen najah uva hitia hi asei diu, ‘pathen dang hou din cheu hite ati diu, hinlah hiche pathen hohi napu, na pateu jeng in jong ana het khah lou ahi.
13.7: Nahin lhep patep diu, napu, napateu khanga pat le leiset a nahet khah lou pathen hou tauvin, atidiu ahi.
13.8: Hinlah athu uva nanun louhel diu ahi. Chule hepina jong nanei lou diu, ven jong naven bit thei lou hel diu ahi.
13.9: Amaho chu thina nachansah teitei diu ahi! Amasa tah in kho lhangsam leu chun mipin nahin kithopi diu ahi.
13.10: Phat louna keng mihem chu thina nachansah diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai, na Pathen a konin puimang ding nagouve. Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin nahuhdoh'u ahi.
13.11: Chuteng Israel pumpin ajahsoh kei diu kichatna anei diu, adih louva chonkit talou ding ahiuve.
13.12: Pakai, na Pathen uvin napehnau khopi sunga nachen tenguleh, nanghon hitia thu kisei najah diu,
13.13: nalah uva gaothusei hon nasopi hou henga hiti hin aseiyun alam kaiyuve, pathen dang houvin cheu hite atiuvin, hinlah hiche pathen ho khu imatih chana nahet khah louvu ahi.’
13.14: Hitobang dimun hoa konna nakikhol cheh diu ahi. Nalah uva hitobang thil aum mong taiti aki cheh tengleh,
13.15: hiche khopi sung leh achilhahte jouseu le agancha jouseu jaona nasuh manghel diu ahi.
13.16: Mun kihong laiya chu aboncha nahalvam heldiu chule khopi chu Pakai, Pathen dinga pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi. Hiche khopi chu kiledoh kit talou ding chule sajong kisadoh kit lou ding ahitai.
13.17: Khopi sahdoh nathei thil khat cha jong naum den sahlou diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai milungsetna chu nachan diu chule hepina dimset a napu, napateu khanga akitepna banga nam lentah naso diu ahi.
13.18: Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, Pathen mihepina chu nachan jing diu ahi.

14.1: Nangho Pakai, na Pathen a mong nahinau photchetna ding in, nachalsam kalval uva navotol louhel diu ahi. Hichu athiho lunghempina ahi.
14.2: Pakai, na Pathen diuva nangho atheng nahi tauve, leiset chunga nam jouse lah a goulu pena nalhen doh’u ahitai.
14.3: Chule gancha boh kiti phot naneh thei lou diu ahi.
14.4: Hichengse vang hi naneh thei diu ahi: bongchal, kelngoi, kelcha,
14.5: sajuh, pelkai, sakhi, gam kel, chule molchunga kelngoi jaona neneh thei diu ahi.
14.6: Nanghon a-an lhai umho naneh thei diu ahi.
14.7: Hinlah a-an lhai umlou sa vang chu naneh lou diu ahi. Hichu sangong sang, talep, bui amaho cheng hin an-lhai aneiyun ahinlah a-ihdoh pouvin ahi. Hijeh achu hiche gancha hohi nangho dinga atheng lou ahi.
14.8: Chule vohcha jong naneh lou diu ahi. Anlhai aneiyin hinlah a-ihdoh poi, hijeh achu nangho dia atheng lou ahiye. Hiche gancha hose hi neh jong naneh thei lou diu chule tohjong natoh khah lou diu ahi.
14.9: Twikhanglen'a cheng ganhing lah a, aling nei naneh thei diu ahi.
14.10: Hijeh chun twikhanglen'a um alingnei naneh diu, hinlah aling nei lou kitiphot vang naneh lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi nangho dia atheng lou ahi.
14.11: Chule nanghon chungleng vacha namkim naneh thei diu ahi.
14.12: Hinlah vacha hichengse hi naneh thei lou diu ahi: muthang chule mubong naneh lou diu,
14.13: chule Muvom, muthi, sumbupi,
14.14: va-ah leh ama tobang va dang jouse,
14.15: muthi, muthi-muhchom, chule adang phabep jaona,
14.16: sumbupi nou, sumbupi len, sumbu changlit,
14.17: muthibong, sumbu changlit, sumbupi, Egypt mite muthi,
14.18: bah chule adang phabep jaona naneh lou diu ahi.
14.19: Tollham a ganhing vahle jouse hi naneh lou diu ahi, ajeh chu atheng lou ahi.
14.20: Hinlah vacha lhanei atheng kitiphot chu naneh diu ahi.
14.21: Ganthikam kiti naneh louhel diu ahi. Nakhopi sunguva kholjin miho naneh sah thei diu ahilouleh na hetkhah lou mikoma najoh thei diu ahi. Amavang nanghon naneh thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen diuva atheng nahiuve. Chule nanghon kelchanou chu kelchapi noitwiya nahon lou diu ahi.
14.22: Gasoh lah a somakhat ding nakoi doh diu gasoh jouse lah a, somakhat kumseh le na todoh diu ahi.
14.23: Hiche somakhat chu Pathen houna muna nahin choi diu Pakai, Pathenin amin dopsang nadinga alhenna muna chu nahin choi diu, hichu Pakai angsunga naneh diu ahi.
14.24: Pakai, na Pathen uvin phatthei nahin boh tenguleh mun gam lha tah hijongleh lousohga tamtah nalo diu, chuteng hoilai muna kon hijongleh somakhat nahin choi diu ahi.
14.25: Amun chu agamlhat behseh a ahileh, hiche gasoh chu najoh diu najohna manu vang chu Pakai, na Pathen'u houna muna chu nalhut diu ahi.
14.26: Nahung lhun tenguleh, nanghon nadeichan nasumuva nakichoh diu bongchal, kelngoi, kelcha, lengpitwi chule adang donthei nachoh jeng theiyu ahi. Chuteng nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin Pakai ansunga an-najon khom diu ahi.
14.27: Chule nalah uva Levi mite nahebol jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chenna ding nei louva um ahiuve.
14.28: Kumthum lhinsih leh somakhat achombeh a nahin choi diu, hichu khopi toh kinaichaa nakhol khom diu,
14.29: hichu Levi mite napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho gam nei louva khosa ahiuvin, hichu amahon aneh uva lungkim sela umdiu ahit. Chutile Pakai, na Pathen uvin phatthei naboh diu ahi.

15.1: Kum sagi alhinseh leh khat koma sumpa bat a nalah jouseu chu nale sah diu ahi.
15.2: Hichu nabol teitei diu ahi. Israel mite lah a hitobanga thil bat a kila jouse chu nakile sahto naphat-u ahi. Koiman asopi aheng akoma thil bat a alah thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga kilha ongna lhung ahi.
15.3: Hiche bat kilesahto nahi Israel mite insunga ding bou ahin, kholjin miho jao lou ahi.
15.4: Koima vaichatah a umlou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na pehnau gamsunga phat theina hung lhung ding ahi.
15.5: Tunia keiman kapeh thupeh aboncha nanit kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathenin phattheina chamkim naboh diu ahi.
15.6: Chuteng Pakai, na Pathen uvin akitepna banga phatthei naboh teidiu ahi. Nam dangten naheng uva sumpa ahin lah diu chule nanghon vang bat a ima nalah lou diu ahitai. Namdangte chunga vaihoma napan diu, nangho chunga koiman thaneina a vai ahop lou ding ahi.
15.7: Hinlah Pakai, na Pathen uvin napehnau gam nalhun tenguleh, Israel insunga konna avaicha aum khah leh amachu nadal bol lou hel diu ahi.
15.8: Hongphal tah a amaho chu achandiu gambeh napeh diu ahi.
15.9: Bat a thilpeh ding hijongleh itlou hela napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu khat leh khat bat a konna kilepeh naphat chu nakhut uva umjing ahi. Bat a peh ding nada uva mikhat nachung uva lhisona aneiya ahileh, phat louna chonset achu lhalut nahitauve.
15.10: Vaichaten angaichat banga hongphal tah a napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin natoh nalam lamuva phatthei naboh diu ahi.
15.11: Na chennau gamusunga chu vaicha umjing ding ahi. Hiche thupeh hi najui jing diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel mite lah hihen midang lah hileh vaicha a hinkho mang umjing ding ahi.
15.12: Hebrew mite lah akonna numei hileh pasal hileh soh dinga kiphal aum leh kum gup sunga nangho najen diu, kumsagi ahung lhun tengleh nanghon hiche sohnu ham sohpa ham chu, chamlhatna napeh diu ahi.
15.13: Soh pasal chu nasol doh tenguleh, khut goh keuva nasol lou diu ahi.
15.14: Alhahna dinga gancha honkhat napeh diu, najubel tun nauleh lhongdapna toh napeh tha diu ahi. Nanei nagou lah uva kijepna phabep jong napeh tha diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin ijakai napeh'u ahi.
15.15: Hiche hi nageldoh jing diu ahi. Nangho Egypt gam'a soh in nana um un Pakai, Pathenin na lhatdoh’u ahi! Hijeh a chu keiman hiche thupeh hi nangho kapeh nahiuve.
15.16: Hinlah soh chun ‘Keiman ka dalhah lou ding nahi’ tia aseiya ahileh, ajeh chu aman nangma leh na insung mite angailut jal ahi.
15.17: Hitobang dinmuna konna hi nanghon jong nakotbul uva konna nasoh uchu, nahin lepui diu chuteng hinkho lhumkeiya nahenguva um thei ding ahi.
15.18: Nasoh uchu nasoldoh tenguleh hahsatna a nagel lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu kum gup sunga ajo chana nahin jenu ahitan, Pakai na Pathen uvin phatthei naboh diu ahi.
15.19: Na ganchate lah uva konna apeng masa jouse Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choi diu ahi. Na ganchateu lah a apeng masa kitiphot chu louna natohsah lou diu chule gancha hon lah a nalhatsah lou diu ahi.
15.20: Ajeh chu gancha peng masa jouse hi Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin Pakaiyin alhena muna chu kumseh leh naneh khom diu ahi.
15.21: Hinlah hiche gancha pengmasa chu a elbai ham ahilouleh mitcho ahikhah leh nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u henga na todoh lou diu ahi.
15.22: Hichu nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin nain mun uva naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Hichu koi hileh aboh hihen aboh lou hijongleh sa juhsa naneh bang uva naneh thei diu ahi.
15.23: Chule sa thisan chu meiya na halvam thei lou diu ahi. Hichu tol lham chunga nasun lhah diu ahi.

16.1: Pakai, na Pathen uva dinga kumseh le kut nabol diu ahi. Hichu Abib lhamasa hiding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche lhasunga hi Pakaiyin Egypt gam'a konna jan muthim noiya nahin puidoh-u ahi.
16.2: Hiche kut ading chun nagan chateu lah a kon todoh ding chengse chu Pakai, Pathenin adeilhenna houmun a chu nahin choi diu, hiche mun chu Pathen loupina ding ahi.
16.3: Hichu cholsolou changlhah toh aneh tha diu ahi. Nisagi sunga cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a konna kinotah a nahungnau avetsah ahi. Hiche changlhah hi neuvin suhgim vetsahna changlhah ahin, chutileh nadam lai sung seuva Egypt gam'a konna nahung potdoh nau na geldoh jing diu ahi.
16.4: Hiche nisagi sunga hin koiman cholsosa a-in muna koihih hen. Kut adia kelngoi natha tenguleh, hiche sa chu koiman jingkah khovah geiyin koihih hen.
16.5: Hiche kut hi khopi tinchenga nabol thei lou diu ahi.
16.6: Pakai, Pathenin adeilhenna mun a bou chu nabol diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin amin choiatna dinga alhen ahi. Nisa alep lhah tengleh hichu Egypt gam'a nahung potdoh nau vetsahna nabol diu ahi.
16.7: Sachu nakisem diu Pakaiyin alhenna muna chu naneh diu ahi. Chule jingkah lam leh na ponbuh mun cheh uva nakile thei diu ahitai.
16.8: Hinlah aban nigup sunga chu cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi. Anisagi lhin ni chu Pakai, Pathen adia nikho thenga nanit sohkei diu, koiman na atoh thei lou ding ahi.
16.9: Lousohga nakhop tup nikho uva pat hapta sagi nasim diu ahi.
16.10: Chujou tengleh Pakai, na Pathen uva dinga kal chuh kut golvah nabol diu ahi. Pakaiya konna phatthei nachanna hou ijakai nahin choisoh kei diu ahi.
16.11: Chuteng Pakai, na Pathen uvin houmun adei lhenna muna chu na hinchoi diu golvah nabol diu, hiche muna chu Pathen min choiat a um ding ahi. Na khopi sung uva nachanuteu leh na chapateu chule Levi mite ahin, chagate, kholjin miho chule meithai ho jaona a golvah nabol khom diu ahi.
16.12: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam'a soh-changa hinkho mang na hiuve ti nageldoh jing diu, thupeh hi chengse hi najui diu ahi.
16.13: Lhosohga, lengpiga ijakai nakhop tup tenguleh nisagi sunga lholhun kut naman teidiu ahi.
16.14: Hiche golvah loupi hi nachanuteu leh nachapateu, nasoh tehou, Levi mite, chaga ho, kholjin mi chule meithai ho jaona nabol diu ahi.
16.15: Hiche golvah hi nisagi sunga Pakaiyin alhenna muna chu nabol diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya konna phatthei nachannau gasoh chu ahin, hiche kut hi mijouse adia kipana hi ding ahi.
16.16: Kumseh leh Israel miten hiche kut thum hohi aman jing diu ahi: Mon mang theilou chang lhah kut, lholhun kut chule khoptup kut ahi. Hiche ahung lhun tengleh pasal a kailha kitiphot Pakai, Pathen angsunga kilah ding, koimachan khut goh keuva Pakai angsung anai lut thei lou ding ahi.
16.17: Mijousen ajokham khama phattheina chu Pakai henga ahin lhut cheh diu ahi.
16.18: Pakaiyin napeh nau khopi jousea thutan vaihoma pang ding nakoisoh kei diu ahi. Amaho chun miho chunga chamdela thu atan diu ahi.
16.19: Koima chunga langnei sihneiya thil ima nabol lou diu ahi. Aching athem hihen, khomu louva hijongleh Pakai mit mua chamdela thu natan diu ahi.
16.20: Adih a kivaihopna chu umjing hen, chutileh Pakai, na Pathen uvin napeh nau gamsunga lungmonga nachen diu ahi.
16.21: Asherah thing mangcha a pathen lim nasemthu louhel diu ahi.
16.22: Chule aguh a hou dinga khom ima naphu thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen adia hitobang chu thet umtah ahi.

17.1: Ana damlou gancha kiti phot Pakai, Pathen henga natodoh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dia hitobang thilpeh hohi thet um ahi.
17.2: Pakai, Pathenin napehnau gam'a nachen tenguleh, nalah uva konna numei hileh pasal hileh Pakai, na Pathen'u mitmua aphalou nabol thei lou diu chule kitepna nasuhboh thei lou diu ahi.
17.3: Semthu pathen dang angsung, nisa chule ahsiho vamthamjol kitiho jouse angsunga naboh khup theilou diu ahi.
17.4: Hitobang hohi nakhol chilsoh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu Israel mite lah a hitobang hi umkha get inte.
17.5: Numei hileh pasal hileh hitobanga chon chu, khopi pam lama nodoh ding songa se lih ding ahi.
17.6: Hinlah mikhat jeng seh thutannan mithat hih un, mithum beh thutanna'a chu thina nachan sah thei diu ahi.
17.7: Thutanpa chun songa ase masat ding, chuteng mipin ase ding ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva konna aphalouva chon chu nano doh diu ahi.
17.8: Nalah uva thilsoh chung thu tanna ahahsat behseh a, hichu phat louna, tol-that, mithat chule dan chung kalvala chon achung thua boina chom chom neiya auma ahileh, hitobang chu Pakai, na Pathen henga nalhut diu ahi.
17.9: Chule hitobang ho chu danthempuho henga aphatcha napui diu ahi. Amahon achungchang thu angai diu chuteng thu lhuhna asem diu ahi.
17.10: Amahon thu lhuhna asem uchu Pakai muntheng lama nahin lhut diu, amahon asei bang uva nabol diu ahi.
17.11: Dan dung juiya thulhuhna chu ahin phondoh tenguleh, thulhuhna jouse chu ahina banga chelha ding, imacha na hapbe thei tah lou diu ahi.
17.12: Koihileh Pakai, Pathen angsunga thutan vaihom ho natohna deilou vetsahna jal'a kisa auma ahileh, thina chang ding ahi. Hitia chu phat louna kiti phot Israel mite lah akonna nano mang diu ahi.
17.13: Hitobang chu mi jousen ahin jahsoh kei diu, chuteng koima aphalouva chon ngam talou ding ahi.
17.14: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin napehnau gamsung nalhun diu ahitai. Hiche gamsung nalhun tenguleh, i-lamkai diuvin leng khat, nam dangte kivaipoh nabang in tungdoh tauhite tia nasei diu ahi.
17.15: Chutengleh Israel mite lah a Pakai, Pathenin atundoh ding ahi. Hichu nalah uva mikhat pen pang ding, amavang kholjin mi nalhen thei lou diu ahi.
17.16: Leng a pang pen ding pen chun, sakol kangtalai ngaichat jeh’a mikhat tou Egypt gam'a sakol kangtalai cho dinga asol thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho Egypt gam nakile kit thei lou diu ahitai.
17.17: Lengpa chun jitampi anei thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai akonna apui mang thei diu ahi. Chule ama ding jeng ajong sana leh dangka akikhol thei lou ding ahi.
17.18: Leng touna mun alo tengleh, amapa chun danbu akilah ding, alal-touna muna chu akikoi ding ahi.
17.19: Hiche danbu lekhajol chu akoma akoi ding adamlai sunga asim jing ding ahi. Hichea konna chu dan leh thupeh ijakai Pakaiya kon in aume ti amu chet ding, dengchang tah’a ajui jing ding ahi.
17.20: Hiche lekhajol asima konna chu kiletsahna puma, achenkhompi mi jouse sanga chungnung kahi tia umlou ding ahi. Chule hichea konna hi lamchoma kihei mang louva umjing ding kahi tijong ahet doh thei ding ahi. Keima leh ka chilhah ten Israel sung hi akhang akhanga ka vaihop diu ahi, tijong het dohna anei thei diu ahi.

18.1: Thempu hon hiche hi nageldoh jing diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel insung mijouse lah a Levi insung kailhah hi chenna ding gam chang lou ahiuve. Hijeh achu Thempua pang Levi mite hon Pakai, Pathen adia ki todoh chengse hi chang diu ahi.
18.2: Israel nam sunga konna gamtum neilou ahiuvin, Pakai hi amaho dinga agoulu penu ahitan, hichu aheng uva Pakai kitepna ahi.
18.3: Hichengse hi mihon gancha dinga ahin choi lah a thempu ho chan ding chu ahi: bongchal ahin kelngoi hijongleh amahon adah akeng, agilpi chengse chu thempupa henga apeh lut diu ahi.
18.4: Nanghon jong na lou sohgao lhung masaho, lengpitwi, chang, thaotwi chule nakelngoi mul kivou masapen chu neh diu ahi.
18.5: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin phung jouse lah a Levi insungmite hi imatih chana ama lhacha a pang dia alhen doh ahi.
18.6: Chule Israel mite chenna khopi holah achu Levi miten adeisah laiyu Pathen houna muna ahin lhen doh diu ahi.
18.7: Levi dangho banga kigela Pakai, Pathen min pana akin bola pang jeng thei diu, chuteng Pakai angsunga natong jing Levi mite banga akin bola pang diu ahi.
18.8: Ama insungmite akon thilpeh ijat um jongleh, thil ki todoh jouse aneh khopset aneh thei diu ahi.
18.9: Nangho Pakai, Pathenin napehnau gamsung nahin jot tenguleh, chingtheiyun hiche gamsunga namtin vaipi chonna dan thet umtah tah hokhu najui louhel diu ahi.
18.10: Nangho lah akonna koiman achanu ham achapa ham khat chu meiya agoa kilhaina a aman chah thei louhel ding ahi. Doithu hihen, phunsanna hihen, ipidoi mangcha hijongleh,
18.11: buma bolna hihen, thilha akonna gaobol theina hihen, mitphel doithepna chule thilha akonna gaothem kiti jong khat jeng cha nalah uva konna um thei lou ding ahi.
18.12: Hitobanga chon mihem chu Pakaiya dinga thet umtah ahi. Hijeh achu Pakai, Pathenin nangho masanga hiche lai muna cheng ho jouse anadel mang ahi.
18.13: Chule nangho Pakai, Pathen adia mi kitah nahi teidiu ahi.
18.14: Ajeh chu hiche muna cheng mite hon doithem ho thusei angaiyun, amavang Pakai, Pathenin hitobang hoa na chon diu aphal pon ahi.
18.15: Mose'n avelin aseikit in, Israelte lah akonna Pakai, Pathenin kei bang banga thempu khat nahin tundoh peh diu ahi. Chuteng nang hon ama thu chu nangaiyuva nakhohsah cheh diu ahi.
18.16: Nanghon Sinai molchunga mipiho kikhop nikhon Pakai, Pathen henga nadei, nangai chan hiti hin naseiyun ahi. Pakai, Pathen awgin leh ama akonna meikong kilah chu neijah sah kit hih hel un, ajeh chu hitobang kajah uva kamu uva konna chu keiho ka thilo jeng theiyu ahi, natiuve.
18.17: Chuin Pakaiyin keima henga aseiyin, amahon asei chanu hi adih lheh jeng e, ati.
18.18: Chule Pakaiyin aseiyin keiman nasopite lah akonna hi nang tobang khat ka tundoh ding, hiche themgaopa kam sunga chu ijakai ka thumop soh kei ding, hichea konna chu keiman ama ka thumop bang banga aman jong mite jouse athupeh son ding ahi.
18.19: Koi hijongleh hiche themgaopa thusei nah sah lou auma ahileh, amapa chunga chu lhen chilna lhung ding ahi.
18.20: Keima thupeh kal vala chon auma chule pathen limsem thu min pana thusei apang themgao khat tou aum ngei ngeiya ahileh, amapa chunga chu thina lhung teitei ding ahi, tin aseiye.
18.21: Hichea chu nanghon Pakai thusei ahipoi, tia lungopkaina nalung thimsung uva nanei khah uva ahileh,
18.22: themgao khat in thu aseiya athu seidoh aguilhunva ahilouleh adihlou tengleh, hitobang chu Pathen akon mong ahipoi ti photchetna ahi. Themgaopa chun ama macham chama asei ahin, hitobang themgao chu gin jong nagin louhel diu ahi.

19.1: Pakai, Pathenin nangho napehnau gamsunga cheng mite ahin suhgam teng, nanghon agamsung pumpiu chuleh a in jouseu nalodiu akhopi uva nachen diu ahi.
19.2: Pakai, Pathenin napehnau gamsunga na chenlut tenguleh, nanghon hiche gamsung chu chenna dinga thum naso diu ahi.
19.3: Hitia chu Pakaiyin napehnau gamsung chu khopi thum naso diu, hiche khopi jousea chu lampi nasem lut cheh diu, nalah uva konna koi tobang mithat auma ahileh, amachu hiche sunga chu jamlut a kihuhdoh thei ding ahi.
19.4: Mikhat touvin kidoupi beiya, khat chu amoh tha khah tah a ahileh, khopi khat pen pen achu jamlut a kihihuh hing thei ahi.
19.5: Tekah nan, mikhat chu asopipa toh gamlah lama thing phuh dinga akon doh’a thing aphuh laitah a aheicha lap chu aki khodoh a, asopipa chu akhokhah jeng tah’a ahileh, aheicha chun asopi chu akhokhah a thina atokhah’a ahileh, mithat khapa chu khopi thum holah a khat pen pena jamlut a ahinkho aki huhdoh ding ahi.
19.6: Chule kihuhdohna dinga khopi chu agamlhat behseh a ahileh, akahlah a phula thei khattouvin ahin delkhuma atha jeng thei ahi. Hinlah mithat khapa chun akidoupi hilouvin, khutsoi jeh a atha khah ahi.
19.7: Hitobang akon kiven doh theina ding chun, keiman naheng uva khopi thum sem uvin kati ahi.
19.8: Pakai, Pathenin napului, napalui khang uva pat napehsau gamsung hi akehlet ding, agam sung hi aboncha napeh doh diu
19.9: chuteng nanghon khopi thum nalhendoh bediu ahi. (Chingthei tah a kathupeh nangaiyuva Pakai, Pathen nangailut uva alampi nacheuva ahileh Aman hiche gam pumpi hi napeh diu ahi).
19.10: Hitia chu naboluva ahileh, Pakai, Pathenin napehnau hiche gam sunga hi mona beihela thina umlou ding ahi. Chuteng monabei ho thina jal'a mo nachan lou diu ahitai.
19.11: Hinlah koitobang khat chun asopi ahot bola, chang lhih jinga aum a, adel khum jenga ahileh, hiche tolthatpa chu khopi ho lah a khat pena chu jamlut a kisel jeng thei ahi.
19.12: Chuteng upa chensge chu kon uva mithat pachu khopi sunga aga hol doh diu, amahon aga mudoh diu amapa chu phulahna a ahin lhut diu, athina ding chan gotna apeh uva, thina achansah diu ahi.
19.13: Tolthatpa chunga chu lainatna ima nanei lou diu ahi! Hichu Israel mite lah a konna thisan sona chu nasuh bei diu; hichu nangho dinga aphalama pang ding joh ahi.
19.14: Pakai, Pathenin napehnau gam sung nalhu tenguleh nanei nagou hou, napu napateuva pat gamgi song kitung hochu khat jeng cha jong nabodoh lou diu ahi.
19.15: Themmona jouse lah a konna mikhat sehseh in themmo thu aseiya konna, adang khat chu themmo namoh chansah lou diu ahi. Hitobang chu hettohsah mini ham mithum ham ahiteng lebou themmo kichan sah bep ding ahi.
19.16: Midang khat chu muda man meimeiya konna adih louva bol jeng lou ding, hettohsah tothoa doumah a abolthei lou ding,
19.17: chule mini chu akidouva ahileh anigela Pakai angsung leh thempu ho masang leh thutan vaihom ho henga hung cheh ding ahi.
19.18: Chutengleh thutan vaihom hon achan chin thu chu giltah a akhol diu ahi. Hinlah jou leh nal thua Israel khattou ahehset a ahileh,
19.19: Hitobanga ahehsepa chu gotna peh chang ding ahi. Hitobang thil phalou chu nalah uva konna nasuh mangdiu ahi.
19.20: Chuteng midang jousen ahin jah soh keiyuva, kichat nan alhun den diu, nangho jouse lah a thilse kiti him him abol kit tah lou diu ahi.
19.21: Hiche hotobang gitlouna ahin koima khoto hih un! Gotna chang dia dan chu, hinkho khela hinkho, mit khela mit, ha khela ha, khut khela khut chule kengphang khela kengphang lah ding ahi.

20.1: Nagal miteu toh kisat dinga nakon doh tenguleh, sakol ahin kangtalai, nanghoa sanga tamjo namu diu, hinlah nakichat lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangho Egypt gamsunga konna nahinpui doh'pau Pakai, Pathenin naumpi jing uve!
20.2: Galmun nalhun masang kahseuva, nalah uva thempupa chu mipi jouse masang lama namakai sah diu ahi.
20.3: Chule mipi henga thu asei ding, Vo Israelte ngaiyun! Kichatna jong neihih un, ajeh chu tunia nangho nacheuva amaho khu naga kisatpi diu ahi! Nagal miteu kichat nan kihot hih unlang, gin jong nagin loudiu ahi.
20.4: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin nangho dinga gal asat ding! Na masang lam uva lamkai jing ding, galjona nachan diu ahi!
20.5: Chuphat leh gal vaipoa pang hon mipi henga hitia hi asei diu ahi. Koiham inthah tungdoh a thenso louva koi? Nalah uva hitobang mihem chu auma ahileh, ama chu galmuna thiden jeng thei ahi. Athiden khah tah’a ahileh, a in chu mi dang dinga thensona um ding ahi.
20.6: Lengpi lei laiya natonga lengpi thei tepkha lou koiham? Amapa jong chu inlama kile jeng thei ahi. Achuti louva ahileh galmuna thina ato jeng thei, alengpi lei jeng jong mi dang chan lo ding ahi.
20.7: Hiche bang chun pasal koi tobang khat chu jinei dinga kigosa dem a umta, ahinlah jinei loulai koi ham? Ama jong chu in kilea jinei thei ahi. Ajeh chu galmuna thina nachan'a naji ding nu chu mi dang chang jeng thei ahi.
20.8: Chule sepai vaihom natonga pang hon mipi henga hitia hi asei nah lai diu ahi. Meidoi, kichase um em? Aumleh in a kile hen, ajeh chu midang asuh meidoilo ding ahi, tia aseidiu ahi.
20.9: Sepai vaihom natonga pangho chun sepai ho henga hitia chu asei chaisoh kei tenguleh, aloi loiya lamkai alhendoh diu ahi.
20.10: Chule khopi khat nabulhu konu leh, amasan hiche khopi chu ki champi din tem un.
20.11: Hiche khopi chun natepnau ahin ngaiyuva, kelkotpi chu nahonpeh uva ahileh, na vaihomna noiyuva umdiu, nakinu bollea pang diu ahi.
20.12: Ahinlah kicham ding gel louva kidoupi ding joh ageluva ahileh, khopi chu nabulu tei ding ahi.
20.13: Chuteng Pakai, Pathenin hiche khopi chu nangho khut a ahin pehlut ding, na chemjam'uva pasal jouse natha diu ahi.
20.14: Hinlah numei le chapang, thilkeo ho nakikoi khom diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin khopi sunga konna chu nopsa tah a naman chah diuva napeh'u ahitai.
20.15: Nachen nauva konna gamlha tah a um khopi ho, hitia chu nabol sohkei diu ahi.
20.16: Pakai, Pathenin napeh nau hiche khopi chengsea chu naum tenguleh, ahing thei jouse nasuh gam diu ahi.
20.17: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin naseipeh bang uva, Hit mite, Amor mite, Canan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite hijongleh abonchauva nasuh gam hel diu ahi.
20.18: Chutileh hiche mite akonna chu milim doi kisem thuhoa konna nakihei mang thei diu, amaho pathen semthua konna nakiven tup uva, nalhah lutlou diu ahi.
20.19: Khopi khat bulu dinga phatsotpi naumkim tenguleh thingphung naphuh lou diu ahi. Aga neuvin, hinlah aphung phuh hih un, thingphung hochu nagalmiteu ahipoi.
20.20: Hinlah thingphung aphachompoi tia nagel houvang chu naphuh uva, khopi sunga galmite toh kidouna galmanchah a naman theiyu ahi.

21.1: Pakai, Pathenin napeh'u nachennau gamsunga chu thise khat tou auma, ahivanga hiche thise chu koitha pen ham ti, aki hedoh thei lou aum a,
21.2: hitobang dinmun chu aum khah tah a ahileh, na upateu leh vaihom natong chengse chu hung diu, nakhopiu leh akim vel'a khopi chengse chu phatah atetoh soh kei diu ahi.
21.3: Hitia chu abol diu thise tohpa umna akonna chu, khopi akinaipi pen chu mo kichan ding ahi. Bong ala khat lou natong kha loulai hichu agakai diu ahi.
21.4: Hiche mochanga khopi sung mite chun, bongla chu phaicham lah khat a ahin kai diu, hiche phaicham chu lou natohnaa kimang khalou hi ding, phaicham muna chu bongla gol chu angong chang aheboh diu ahi.
21.5: Chuteng Levi thempuho abonchauva ama sang lama hung masa diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin amaho chu akin natong dinga alhen dohsa ahin, Levi thempu ho thusah bang banga kinopmona leh kinah boutam jouse aboncha thu chaina um ding ahi.
21.6: Thisepa umna toh kinaina muna bongla kithana muna chu, khopi sunga upa ho jousen twiya akhut akisop cheh diu ahi.
21.7: Hichu amaho dinga hettohsahnaa pang ding, “Keiho khut a konna hiche thise hi thisan kiso ahipoi, thisan kiso pet jeng jong kamu hih hel uve,” tia seina diu ahi.
21.8: O Pakai, nangman nahuh dohsa nami Israel mite hi ngaidam tan, hiche themmona thisan kisona ho jal'in nami Israelte chunga lethuhna neihih helin, thisan kiso jal'a amaho chunga lethuhna achan nalou dinga, taona anei peh teitei diu ahi.
21.9: Hitia chu nangman jong mona beihela thisen kiso na chung changa konna Pakai, mitmua adih a natohna chu nabol tenguleh suhtheng najong nanei diu ahi.
21.10: Namel mateu toh gal kisat dinga nakon doh tenguleh Pakai, Pathenin na melmateu chu nangho henga ahinpeh doh khah tah’a ahileh, nangman jong amaho chu gal hinga nahin kai ding ahi.
21.11: Chule hiche gal hing lah’a konna chu numei melhoitah nakimu doh’uva ahileh, nangmhon jong hiche numei chu naji diuva na kipui jeng theiyu ahi.
21.12: Chuteng hiche numei chu nangho inlama nahin puidiu, asam jouse natan peh diu chule atin jouse jong natan mui peh diu ahi.
21.13: Hiche numei nu jong chun soh kivonna chu akoiya, nangho insunga chu cheng jing ding lhani jen anu leh apa pul adou ding ahi. Hitia chu nangho jong numeinu henga na galut diu, nangho jong ama dia ajipa nahi thei diu, nupa naum thei diu ahi.
21.14: Amanu chunga hi lungkim louna naneiyuva ahileh, nang hon jong amanu chu achena nom chana nasol jeng theiyu ahi. sum leh paiya jong najoh doh thei lou diu chule soh ki bolna bang banga jong nabol louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon amanu hi na luppi sau ahitai.
21.15: Koitobang pasal khat chun numei ji ni akop a, khatnu adeiya khatnu vang chu adeimo joh’a, ahivanga anigel lhona cha ahin lhon tah a, adeimo nu chun cha pasal ahin khat tah a ahileh,
21.16: ajipa chun kho nunga achapate thil leh lo ahin hoppeh nikho tengleh, adeimo johnu chapa sanga chu adeinu chapa chu gel khohna aneiya langnei na jong anei thei lou ding, apeng masa chu apeng masa bang bang abol thou thou ding ahi.
21.17: Adeimo johnu chapa chu achapa lah a atah pen ahi tia aphon doh ding, anei agou jouse lah’a chan nia tam joa apeh ding ahi. Ajeh chu ama dia chapa masapen ahin, mi-upa chan ding chu achansah thou thou ding ahi.
21.18: Chapa khat touvin Pakai thungai lou chule anu, apa thujong ngai louva doumah jenga achona ahileh,
21.19: Hiche chapa chu anu leh apan jong khopi kelkot lama, thutan vaihom ho henga ahin puilut jeng lhon ding ahi.
21.20: Chuteng anu leh apan jong hiche ka chapa hi doumah jeng aboldoh tan chule kathu lhon jong angai hih hel in, milop tah le phatseh a jukhamnaa hinkho mang jeng ahitai, ati lhon ding ahi.
21.21: Chutengleh hitobang miphalou chu khopi sunga cheng mipi ho chun songa aselih jeng diu ahi. Hiche hi Israel pum pin amu soh kei uva, kichaa umdiu ahi.
21.22: Mihem khat touvin thina chan gotna pehna thei chonset a alhah khah tah a, amapa chu tha teitei ding ahi tah leh, ama chu thing chunga konna na khai lih jeng theiyu ahi.
21.23: Amavang hiche na khai lihpau chu khovah chana na khai den thei lou diu, nakho vahsah ngei ngeiyuva ahileh nang hon Pakai, Pathenin nagoulo dinga napeh nau gamsung nasuh boh'u ahitan, hijeh achu nakho vahsah louhel diu ahi.

22.1: Na sopi bongchal ham khat tou avah mang na mua ahileh, hichu nakimu mosah lou diu, don-nahsah mo’a na koi lou diu, ama vang namu chan uchu nasopi henga nahin kailut joh diu ahi.
22.2: Hiche gancha neipa chu nangma inlam toh kigam lha a um ahia, achenna nahet lou'uva ahileh agancha chu nanghon na inlam uva nahin kai diu, aneipa na sopipan ahung hol kahsea na ventup peh diu ahung hol tengleh phate chaa na lepeh diu ahi.
22.3: Asangan ham khat namu tah ujongleh hitia chu nabol diu, asangkhol ham namu ujongleh hiti ma achu nabol peh diu ahi. Ipi thil le lo hijongleh nanghon nasopi thil namu khah tah’uva ahileh nale peh cheh cheh diu, hitia chu nakithopi diu ahi.
22.4: Na sopi khat sangan ham, bongchal ham khat chu lampia alhusa namu khah’uva ahileh, hichu napanpi tei diu ahi. Na sopi gancha alhua chu na phoh doh peh diu, nahuh doh diu ahi.
22.5: Chule nalah’uva numeiyin pasal chunga kaisa akivonna ponsil chu kivonnaa aman thei louhel ding, hitobanga chon chan chu Pakai, Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
22.6: Vabu hamkhat chu na tokhah’uva hichu tollham ham thing chung ham khat a um, vabu sunga chu atwiham anou ham khat chu vapin aop khum lai ahileh, hichu anousen puma namat thauva nasuh gam loudiu ahi.
22.7: Ahinlah vapi chu nadel mang'uva ahileh, anou chengse chu nakilo thei diu ahi, achutileh phat theina jong nachan diu chule nangho dinga hinkho sotnaa pang ding ahi.
22.8: Chule nanghon in thah nasah teng ujongleh, bilha nunga konna mi akhih lhahna lou ding, thisan jal'a themmona achuhna lou dinga, bilha gol jousea aki-tanden nading nasem peh diu ahi.
22.9: Chule na lengpi lei laiyuva muchi ni natu kop thei lou diu, muchi ni natu kop’uva ahileh hichu munthenga todoh dinga ki sang thei lou ding ahi.
22.10: Bongchal ham sangan ham khat chu, lou kainaa naman kop thei lou diu ahi.
22.11: Tupat kihel leh pat chom kihel khom jong mangchaa, kisilna a naman thei lou diu ahi.
22.12: Na kivonnau ding na sangkhol chol'u mong ning lam lia chu, pat hol khat cheh naba diu ahi.
22.13: Pasal khat chun numei aji dinga akipuija, alup khompia chujou le numeinu chu athet bol jeng lou ding ahi.
22.14: Hiche numei nu chu jachat naleh jumna dimset’a alha jenga, hiche numei nu chu kaji ding in kapuiyin kaluppin ahileh, atheng lou mitoh lum khomsa ahitai, ti asei khah ngei ngeiya ahileh,
22.15: Hiche numei nu chu anu leh apan jong khopi sung lam kelkot’a thutan vaihom ho henga chu apui lut lhon ding, amanu hi atheng mong mong ahi nai ti, photchetna aga bol lhon ding ahi.
22.16: Chuteng numeinu pan jong hitia hi aphondoh ding, hiche pasalpa toh'hin kicheng ding mong monga kana pehdohsa chu ahitai. Ahinlah pasalpan vang muda in solmang ding agoe, tia asei ding ahi.
22.17: Chugoh keu hilouvin, amanu chunga hin jachatna tampi alhunsah in, “Hiche nachanu chunga hin nungah thengsel ahina ima kamu doh tapoi,” tia asei ding ahi. Chuteng apan jong ka chanu hi nungah theng mong mong ahi, tiphot chetna hicheng hi ahiye tia asei ding, ajehchu hitobang phot chetna dinga chu numeinu anu leh apan jong khopi kelkot thutan vaihom ho, henga aphondoh lhonna pon asil lhon ding ahi.
22.18: Chujou tengleh khopi sunga upa hon jong, hiche pasalpa chu amat uva ajep diu ahi.
22.19: Chule pasalpa chu dangka shekel jakhat a aleu sah diu, hiche dangka shekel jakhat chu nu ngahnu pa chang ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche pasalpa chun Israel nungah khat aminset sah jeh ahi. Chule numeinu jong jia anei ding, ahinkho lhum keiya dinga ajia pang ding ahi.
22.20: Amavang nungahnu chunga chu, athenge tiphot chetna aum tah louva ahileh,
22.21: Amaho chun hiche nungahnu chu apa in kot phunga konna ahin kai doh diu, chuteng khopi sunga cheng josuen amanu chu songa aselih jeng diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche numeinu chu chondih louna mangchan aki ngolsah tan, Israel insunga, apa insunga hiti chun ana chon tan ahi. Hitobanga chon chan phalou jouse chu nasuh dih jing diu ahi.
22.22: Chule pasal khat chun pasal dang jikhat chu aluppi khah tah'a ahileh, numeinu ahin pasal pa ahin anigel lhonna thina chang lhon ding ahi. Hitobang achu Israel sunga thil dihlou chonna jouse nasuh bei diu ahi.
22.23: Chule khopi sunga nungah thengsel khat chu pasal khat touvin, kholai dung ham khat a chu aki timatpi jeng tah'a ahileh,
22.24: Hitobanga chon teni chu ani lhonna khopi sung lam kelkot phunga nahin kaidoh diu, ani lhona songa na selih jeng diu ahi. Ajeh chu numeinu jong chu apanpi thei mi tampi kho sunga aum in, ahinlah ama peng doh louhel in aum in, pasal pan jong aheng akom chu asuh set jeng ahin, hitobang chondan dih lou jouse hi nalah uva konna nasuh thengsel diu ahi.
22.25: Hinlah nungah khat chu mitoh lumkhomsa ama chu gamlah a pasal khat touvin ana lupkhom pia, pasalpa chun numeinu chu tha guma amat chah a aki timat pia ahileh, hiche dinmuna vang hi pasal pa bouseh thina chang ding ahi.
22.26: Hitobang dinmun thilsoh chung chang hi, numeinu ima kilo theilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu numeinu chunga hin thina chan gotna pehna ding aum pon, pasal khat in asopipa lam ajot lutna thina achansah tobang ahi.
22.27: Ajeh chu hiche numeinu chu pasal pan gamlah a adel khum a aki timatpi ahin, numei khangdong nun jong kithopi ding ngaicha in apeng in, hinlah koiman ajah peh lou ahi.
22.28: Chule pasal khat touvin nungah theng tah khat chu alup pi khah tah a, thahat husana amanu chu aki timat pia alup pettah lhon akimat doh a ahileh,
22.29: Hiche pasalpa, nungahnu ki timatpi pa chun numeinu pachu dangka shekel somnga apeh ding ahi, ajeh chu amapa chun numeinu chu aki timatpisa ahitan, a hinkho lhum keiya ji dinga aki puiya hinkho aman ding ahi.
22.30: Koitobang pasal khat chun, apa jinu chu jia agel thei louhel ding chule apa ji khat chu anih aho peh thei lou ding ahi.

23.1: Pasal khat chu til lahsa leh hinpi kitansa ahileh pampeiya um ahi. Amapa chu Pakai hou’in sung kikhopna muna hunglut thei talou ding ahi.
23.2: Chule nalah uva konna noti cha jeng jong Pakai houbung sunga jao thei lou ding, khang som changeiya noti chanu—chapa teho chu khat jeng cha jong, Pakai houbung sunga lha thei lou diu ahi.
23.3: Hitia chu Ammon mite ahin, Moab mite ani lhona Pakai houbung sunga lha theilou diu ahi. Khangsom chan geiya Pakai houbung sunga lutthei lou diu, hichu imatih chana ding ahi.
23.4: Ajeh chu nangho Egypt gamsunga konna nahung potdoh uchun, lampi dunga changlhah leh twisih neo chan jong nana lamto pouvin ahi. Amavang Mesopotomia gamsunga Pethor muna Beor chapa Balaam chu ana lamhil uvin, achena mun chana dingin aga thah kit un ahi.
23.5: Ahinlah Pakai, Pathenin Balaam thusei chu anahsah pon, Pakai, Pathenin Balaam henga gaosapna aneiyin, chuin nangma ding’in phatthei nan aheidoh tai, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathenin nangma nangai lun ahi.
23.6: Imatih chana nanghon amaho chamlen nading leh ahaosatna diuva lampi ima nasem doh peh thei lou diu ahi.
23.7: Amavang Edom mite kiti nolna nanei thei lou diu, nangho dinga na sopiu ahi. Egypt mite jong thetbolna nanei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsunga ana khopemsa nahiuve.
23.8: Edom le Egypt mite chengse vang khang thum alhin tengleh, Pakai houbung sunga lhathei diu ahi.
23.9: Chule namelmateu toh gal kisat dinga nakon doh tenguleh, nangho jong thilse jousea konna na kikangse diu ahi.
23.10: Ajeh chu jankah chun namite lah’a khat touvin botwi hinche doh taleh, amapa chu ngahmuna konna pam lama paidoh a um jeng ding, ngahmun sung kitia chu hungvah lut kit lou ding ahitai.
23.11: Nilhah lam tengleh vang ama chu twiya ki sutheng ding, nilhum lam teng ngahmun sunga hung lut thei ding ahi.
23.12: Ngahmun polama chu ehkul khat nasem diu, hiche muna chu eh-thaa na cheji diu ahi.
23.13: Nagal manchah'u poh lah a chu lei-tuhna thei khat naki poh jing diu, ehtha dinga naum tenguleh hiche lei laina achu na leiyuva naeh nathah diu, na thah chai tenguleh hichu leiya nale vuh diu ahi.
23.14: Pakai, Pathenin nangho nahuhdoh diu leh ngahmuna chu nangho huhdoh dinga umjing ahin, hiche naum nau ngahmun chu kisutheng jing ding ahi. Chutileh Pakai, Pathenin naum nau ngamuna chu thil thenglou ima amudoh lou ding, nang hoa konna kihei mang louva na umpi jing diu ahi.
23.15: Aneipa akonna hung jamdoh soh chu, nanghon aneipa chu namoh peh jeng thei lou'u ahi.
23.16: Amatoh chun nachen khom jing diu, hoilai muna hijongleh na khopi sung'uva chu aman adeilhenna mun pena chu nachen sah jeng diu ahi. Chule hiche soh chu nanghon jong achunga gimna ima nalhun sah thei lou diu ahi.
23.17: Chule Israel insunga konna numei khat jeng cha jong noti a kichem chavei um thei lou ding ahi. Hitobanga chu Israel insung’a pasal hon jong milim semthu doia neiya notia kisa chavei um theilou ding ahi.
23.18: Ucha kithana man le notia konna man chu Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nato doh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche teni hi Pakaiya dinga thet umtah ahi.
