Ahin kum thum changphat vangleh muchi natua konna chu naki-at ding ahin chuleh lengpilei jong nabol’a aga nanehding ahitai.
19.30: Chuleh nangle, Judah gamsunga amoh chengse, athimoh ahingdoh chasun chun ajung’u akhothuh chehdiu, chule hung khangtou cheh uva hung kisepdoh ding ahiuve.
19.31: Ajeh chu Jerusalem ma konna kamite amoh changes leh Zion molla konna ahingdoh ho chengse chutoh hung kithe jalding ahi. Hatchungnung Pakaiyin amikhotona ‘a pan alahna chu ahin tahdoh ding ahi,” ati.
19.32: Assyria lengpa chungchanga Pakai thusei chu hichehi ahi, “Asepaiteu chu Jerusalem’a lutlou diu ahi, amahon thal changkhat jong ahin kaplut jouloudiu ahi. Amahon a-ompho’u puma kelkot pam’a hi kijot loudiu chujongleh khopi umna dinga leipel aset lou dingu ahi.
19.33: Lengpa chun ahungna lampi’a hunglut louding ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseje.
19.34: “Kamin loupina dingleh kasohpa David khohsahna jal’in keiman hiche khopi hi kavenbit’a kahuhdoh ding ahi,” ati.
19.35: Hiche jan chun Pakai vantil khat Assyriate ngahmun ah achen Assyriate sepai sangsom le sang get le ja nga hochu aga that tan ahi. Ahing doh Assyriate chu jingkah’a agah thodoh uleh mithilong chu muntin’ah amu tauvin ahi.
19.36: Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chun ngahmun ahin dalhan, ama gamsunga ahung kiletan ahi. Ama Nineveh khopia ainlam ajonnin hichea chun aumtan ahi.
19.37: Nikhat hi semthu pathen Nisroch chu aHou-In’a aga hou pettah’in, achateni Adrammelech leh Sharezer chun chemjam’in athat lhontan ahi. Amani chu Ararat gamlang’ah ajam lhonin acha dangkhat Esarhaddon kitipa chun Assyria lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.

20.1: Hiche phat laitah’in Hezekiah chu aha natlheh jingin ahileh, Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao chu aven achen ahi. Aman lengpa chu hiche thuhi aseipehtan ahi, “Hichehi Pakai thusei ahi, Nainsung kisemtoh tan, ajeh chu nang nathi ding ahitai. Hiche nanatna a konna hi nakiledoh joulou ding,” ati.
20.2: Hezekiah in hiche thu ajahdoh phat’in, “Akiheiyin banglang anga’in Pakai kom’ah ataovin ahi.
20.3: “O Pakai na ang’a kitah tah le gunchu tah a nakin kabol jing geldoh in, chuleh ichangeiya nalunglhaina a kana umjing ti neihin geldoh peh in,” atin, hijouchun lhasetah in hakan akap’in ahi.
20.4: Hichun Isaiah in lengpa adalhan, ahinla leng inpi thutanna lailung aphah masangin Pakaiya konin hiche thuhi ahung lhungpai jeng in,
20.5: “Kamite lamkaipu Hezekiah kom’ah gache in lang hiti hin gaseijin, Napu David Pathen Pakai chun hitin aseije, keiman nataona kajan kasanpeh tai chuleh namitlhi jong kamun, keiman nangma hi kadamsah ding nahitai, tuapat ni thum nileh nalupna a konna nathodoh ding Pakai Hou-In kaija nache ding ahitai.
20.6: Keiman nahinkho hi kum som le kum nga kapehbe ding nahi, chuleh hiche khopi hi Assyria lengpa a konna kahuhdoh ding ahi. Keiman hiche khopi hi kamin loupina dingleh kasohpa David khohsahna jal'a hiche khopi hi kavenbit ding ahi,” ati.
20.7: Hichu Isaiah in, “Theichanga konin lou teinang sem’un,” ati. Hiti chun Hezekiah lhachaten jong hiche lou chu anatna apomlai hochun anu uvin ahileh Hezekiah ahung damdoh tan ahi.
20.8: Hichun Hezekiah in Isaiah kom’ah, “Tunia patna ni thum nileh kadamdoh’a Pakai Hou-In kaija kache thei dingchu Pakaiyin ipi melchihna eipeh thei ding ham?” ati.
20.9: Isaiah in jong adonbut’in, “Pakaiyin nateppehna bang banga nadamdoh sahding melchihna chu hiche hiding ahi, hiche kalbi leiya nilim khu kalsom amachonding, nadeijem? Ahiloule anung chonding nadeijem?” ati.
20.10: Hezekiah in jong, “Nilim khu kalsom amchon ding chu abainan hijehchun kal som nungchon sah tan,” ati.
20.11: Hijeh chun Isaiah themgao chun Pakai kom’a ataovin ahile, Aman Ahaz kalbi leidoa nilim chu kalsom anungchon sah tan ahi.
20.12: Hiche jou chun, Babylon lengpa Baladan chapa Merodach –baladan chun Hezekiah lengpa kipathu leh thilpeh ahin thotin ahi, ajeh chu aman Hezekiah chu aha nat lheh’e ti ana jahdoh ahi.
20.13: Hezekiah Babylon’a konna hung palai hochu anei agoukholna insunga thiljouse chu sana, dangka, gim-namtui ahin thaonamtui ahin avetsah soh keijin ahi. Aman amaho chu apuijin leng inpi sunga thilkholna a kikhol jouse chu gal manchah ho pum’in avetsah sohkeijin ahi. Aleng inpi sunga ahin aleng gam sunga ahin Hezekiah in avetsahlou aumtapon ahi.
20.14: Hichun Isaiah themgao chu Hezekiah lengpa kom’ah achen hitin aga dongtan ahi, “Hiche hochun ipiham adei’u ham? Amaho hoiya hungkon hiuvem?” tin ana dongin ahile, Hezekiah in adonbut in, “Amaho chu Babylon khopi gamlatah a hung kon ahiuve,” tin adonbut in ahi.
20.15: “Amahon naleng inpia hi ipi pi amu uvem?” tin Isaiah in adongin ahileh, Hezekiah in adonbut in, “Keiman amaho chu kanei jouse kavetsah in, kaleng inpia kanei kagou jouse jong kavetsah soh keijin ahi,” ati.
20.16: Hichun Isaiah in Hezekiah kom’achun, “Pakaiya konin hiche thupeh hi ngaijin.”
20.17: “Naleng inpia thiljouse, napu napate hon ana khollu leh tuchangeija um nanei nagou jouse hi Babylon khopi a akipohlut diu nikho chu hung lhung ding ahi. Thilkep ho chu khat a kahtcha kidalha louding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije,” ati.
20.18: “Nangma chate tah hojeng jong phabep jong kikai mangding amaho chu Babylon leng inpi sunga nukiso ahisah uva soh a pangdiu ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
20.19: Hezekiah in Isaiah kom’ah, “Hiche thupeh Pakaiya konna eikipe hi aphalheh jenge,” ati. “Ajeh chu lengpan ageldan’a chu, Keima hinkho sung beh’in chamnale lungmonna umnante atin ahi.”
20.20: Hezekiah vaihomlai sunga thilsoh jouse chuleh athanei na sunga ahin, chuleh aman twikul alaija, twilam anasem’a khopi sunga ana lonlutsah ho jouse chu Judah le lengho thusimbu kijih lutna lekhabuah aumsoh keijin ahi.
20.21: Hezekiah athin, hichun achapa Manasseh in lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.

21.1: Manasseh chu leng ahungchan chun ama kum somle kumni alhingbep in ahi. Amahin kum som nga le nga geijin vai ahom’in ahi. Anu min chu Hephzibah ahi.
21.2: Amahin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing anabollin ahi. Amahin Pathenin Israelte masanga ana nodoh pathen neilou nam mite thet umtah chonna ho chu anajuijin ahi.
21.3: Apa Hezekiah in ana suhmang pathen neilouho doiphung chu atungdoh kit’in ahi. Aman Baal maicham jong asemdoh kit’in, chule Asherah doikhomjong atungdoh kit’in Israel lengpa Ahab bol tobang bangin in abollin ahi. Vanthamjolla thaneiho jouse anga ana bohkhup’in chuleh hiche hochu ahouvin ahi.
21.4: Pakaiyin “Jerusalem’ah kamin umden jing ding ahi,” ana tina Pakai Hou-In mun’ah, pathen neilouho maicham ana semdoh in ahi.
21.5: Aman hiche van thanei ho pathen doiphung hole maicham phungho jouse Pakai Hou-In mun jousea ana thah tundoh kit in ahi.
21.6: Manasseh in ama cha tahbeh jeng jong doi pathen ho hounan anatodoh in, meiya ana gouvin, themka pou ana dongin, ai-lhimpou anabollin, gaochang miho jong atahsan in, mitphel doithem hopou anamang chan ahi. Hitihin aman Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin Pakai chu ana sulung hangin ahi.
21.7: Manasseh hin Asherah semthu pathen lim jeng jong ana sem’in, Pakaiyin David leh achapa Solomon anaseipeh na mun laitah Hou-In sunga chun ana tungdoh in ahi. “Israel phungho jouse lah a konna kana lhendoh Jerusalem khopi leh a Hou-In nahi kamin hi atonsot na kijajing ding ahi,” anati ahi.
21.8: Israelte hin chingthei tah a kathupeh holeh kasohpa Mose kana pehsa kadan sem hohi anit sohkei uva ahileh keiman apu apateu kanapeh gamsunga konna gamdanga sohchanga kasoldoh louhel diu ahi.
21.9: Ahinlah hiche mipite hin sei angai pouvin, chuleh Manasseh chun Israelte gamtepgam agalut’un, Pathenin ana suhmang Pathen neilou namdangte sanga thilsejo Manasseh in ana bolsah in ahi.
21.10: Hiche jouchun Pakaiyin alhachate themgao ho mangchan thu ana seijin ahi.
21.11: “Judahte lengpa Manasseh in thet um tahtah thil tamtah ana boldoh in ahi. Israelte hiche gam’a achenlut masang uva anacheng Amor mite sangin thilsejo ana boldoh in ahi. Aman Judah mitehi milim semthu doilim houna a ana chonset sah in ahi,” ati.
21.12: Hijeh chun hichehi Israel Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije, “Keiman Israelte Judah mipite chunga kahinpoh lutding hamsetna hi ajachan jouse tijatna kihot ling gamdiu ahi,” ati.
21.13: “Keiman Jerusalem chunga thu katanding hi Samaria chungle Ahab insung mite chunga kanatanbang banga katantoh chet ding ahi. Keiman Jerusalem mipite chu min annehna kong akhup athalla asop banga kasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.
21.14: “Hijouteng chule kamite amoh chengse jeng jong kapaidoh ding chuleh agalmi teuvin achom gam diuva kapehdoh ding ahi,” ati.
21.15: “Ajeh chu amahon kamitmu’n thilse jeng abolluvin, Egypt akonna apu apateu kahin puidoh apat tunigei hin eilunghansah jing jeng un ahi,” ati.
21.16: Manasseh in themmo nabei mitamtah athat’in, Jerusalem ning langkhatna konin ning langkhat geijin themmona bei thisan adimset tokah in athat that jing in ahi. Hiche hi aman Judahte achonsetsah chungchonna chonset abolbesah nahlai chu ahin, hitia hi Pakai mitmua thilse bolna a anapuilut jing ahi.
21.17: Manasseh in avaihom sunga thilsoh adangho jouse chuleh anatoh athibolho jouse, athilse bol ho jouse pum’in, Judah lengte thusimbu kijihna lekhabua aum’in ahi.
21.18: Manasseh athiphat’in, Uzza hon leng inpi hon sunga chun anavui tauvin ahi. Hijouchun achapa Amon nin lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.
21.19: Amon chu leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni le ni alhin in chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah kum ni sung lengvai ana po in ahi. Anu chu Meshullemeth, Jotbah khopi akon Haruz chanu ahi.
21.20: Amahin apa bol bol ana bollin, apan milimdoi ho ana hou ho mama chu ana houvin ahi.
21.21: Amahin apa Manasseh in anabolbang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bollin ahi.
21.22: Aman apu apte Pathen Pakai ana paidoh in, Pakai lampi chu anajui nompon ahi.
21.23: Hiti chun Amon noija natong pipui ho chun ama dounan tohgon ana neijun aleng inpi sunga ana that tauvin ahi.
21.24: Ahinlah agamsung mipiten Amon lengpa douna tohgon ananei ho jouse chu ana that gam’un chuleh amahon achapa Josiah chu leng mun analosah tauvin ahi.
21.25: Amon vaihom sunga anasoh thildang ho jouse chuleh anatoh thilbol hojouse Judah lengte thusimbu kijihna lekhabua aum’in ahi.
21.26: Amachu Uzza honsung lhan nachun. Anavui taovin ahi. Hijouchun achapa Josiah chu leng ahung chang tai.

22.1: Josiah hi leng ahungchan kum chun ama kum get bou anahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah kum somthum le khat sung lengvai anahom’in ahi. Anuchu Jedidah ahin Bozkath kho a konna Adaiah chanu ahi.
22.2: Amahin Pathen mitmu’n thilpha jing anabollin, apu David khonung chu anajuijin ahi. Amahin thildih bolna dinga hin ana nungchon pon ahi.
22.3: Ama vaihom kum somle get alhinin, Josiah lengpan Meshullam tupa Azaliah chapa Shaphan chu thutanna munna lekhasunpa chu Pakai Hou-In’ah ana sollin, hitihin thu anapen ahi,
22.4: “Nangma thempulen Hilkiah koma gache inlang, kot ngah pan Pakai Hou-In'a mipi akonna adondoh’u sum hochu simtoh henlang,
22.5: Houin semphatna dinga vaihom ho khutna pelut hen, chutileh amahon Pakai Hou-In sahphatna a natong ho chu athaman u peh nan mangcha theiyun te,” ati.
22.6: Amahon thingthembol ho, insa ho chule songkhengthem ho goina’a amanchah theidiu ahi. Chujongleh Houin semphatna man dingin thing chuleh song kikhengsa ho chule adang Hou-In semphatna dinga ngaichat umho chu chohnan mang’u hen,” ati.
22.7: “Ahinla insahna dinga vaihom hochun akhut uva sum hunglut hochu ajat simtoh suhtoh le kholtoh angaipoi, ajeh chu amaho lungtheng cheh leh tahsan theidolcheh ahinauve,” ati.
22.8: Hilkiah thempu lenpa chun thutanna lekhasunpa kom’a chun, “Keiman Pakai Hou-In sunga chun Dan buchu kamu dohtai,” ati. Hichun Hilkiah chun hiche lekhajol chu Shaphan kom’a apen aman jong asim’in ahi.
22.9: Shaphan chu lengpa kom’a achen thilsoh ho chu alhut un, “Nanoija mopohna neiho chun Pakai Hou-In na sum hunglut hochu Hou-In’a natong hole toh lamkai ho khutna apelut tauve,” atiuvin.
22.10: Shaphan chun lengpa chu aseipeh kit’in, “Hilkiah thempu pachun lekhajol khat eipe in ahi,” ati, hichun Shaphan in jong lengpa chu asim pehtan ahi.
22.11: Lengpa chun hiche Dan lekhabua kijih chu ajah phat chun, lungkham tah’in apon abot eh jengin ahi.
22.12: Hiche jouchun aman, Hilkiah thempupa, Shaphan chapa Ahikam, Micaiah chapa Acbor, Shaphan thutanna'a lekhasunpa chuleh Asaiah lengpa thumop a pang, amaho koma chun hiche thupeh apetan ahi.
22.13: “Nangho cheuvin lang keima leh Judah mipi ho jouse thalhengin Pakai kom’ah tao unlang, akimudoh lekahjol akijih thucheng ho chung chang hi gakhol toh tauvin. Ajeh chu ipu ipateu vin hiche lekhajol kijih thucheng ho dungjuiyahi ana chonloujeh uvin, achung'uva Pakai lunghan na hi adeojah jing in ahi. Eihon itohtei diuva kisei i-toh diu thilho chu khatcha jong ihin tong pouvin ahi,” ati.
22.14: Hijeh chun Hilkiah thempupa, Ahikam, Achor, Shapahn leh Asaiah chu Jerusalem a chenna ding munthah lang achun Huldah themgaonu ga dongtoh dingin acheuvin ahi. Amanu hi Harhas chapa Tikvah chapa Shallum jinu, Hou-In a vonchol vesuija pang ahi.
22.15: Amanu chun amaho kom’ah chun, “Israel Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije, kileuvin lang nahin solpa kom’a chun hitin aseijun,” ati.
22.16: “Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi, Keiman hiche khopile amite chunga hi thohgimna kahin chuhsah ding ahi. Judah lengpan asimdoh hiche lekhajolla kijih ho chengsehi hung guilhung teiding ahi.
22.17: Ajeh chu kamiten eipaidoh tauvin, Pathen neilou namdangte semthu pathen ho kom’ah kilhaina gantha atodoh tauvin, athilbol hojouse jeh in keima eilunghan sahlheh tauvin ahi. Hiche mun douna kalunghan hi deojah jeng ding ahin hiche chu chen-mitjou hilou ding ahi,” ati.
22.18: “Ahinlah Pakai holding’a nahin sol uvah Judah lengpa kom’achun cheuvinlang hitin seipehun, Hichehi Israel Pathen Pakaiyin nathujah thupeh chungchanga chun hitin aseije,
22.19: Nangma nalungkham’in, nang le nang nakisunem lhehjingin, nangin hiche khopi le amite douna kasei hiche gamhi sapsetna aching ding chule ahomkeo hung hiding ahi, kitichu najah phat’in lungkham tah in napon nabottel jengin chuleh kisih tah in nakap jah jengin ahi. Hijehchun keiman tahbeh in nataona chu kajatai tin Pakaiyin aseije,” ati.
22.20: “Hijeh chun keiman kateppeh hamsetna chu nangma nathi’a lungmong’a nakivui kahsen hinchuhsah taponge. Keiman hiche khopi chunga kachuhsah ding suhgimna chu nangin namutah louding ahi,” ati. Hiti chun amanu konna thupeh chu lengpa kom’ah ale pohlut peh tauvin ahi.

23.1: Hijou chun lengpan Judah leh Jerusalem a lamkaiho jouse akoukhom’in,
23.2: Chuin lengpa chun Judah le Jerusalem a mipiho jouse toh thempu holeh themgao hotoh mipi aneopen leh alenpen geijin Pakai Hou-In’ah akilhon khompi in, hichea chun Pakai Hou-In na kimu Pakai toh kitepna lekhabu chu lengpan mipi holah’a abonchan asimphong in ahi.
23.3: Lengpa chu thuneina mun khompi panga chun adingin Pakai ang’ah chun kitepna chu panthah lah na aneipi in ahi. Aman mipi ho jouse koma chun, Pakai dan thupeh jouse, chondan ho jouse chu chu alungthim pumpiuva anitsohkei dingin ngehna aneiyin ahi. Hitihin aman lekha jolla kijih Pakai toh kitepna chu asudet’in ahi, chuleh mipi hojong chu ama cheh Pakai ang’a kitepna aneiyun ahi.
23.4: Chuin lengpan Hilkiah thempulen chule amasanga neojo thempuho chutoh chuleh Houin kotngah hochu Baal houna leh Asherah leh vanlaijol thuneiho houna thilho jouse chu Pakai Hou-In akonna alahdoh dingun thu apen ahi. Lengpan hicheho jouse chu Jerusalem polanga Kidron phaicham munnah meiyin ana go-lhah sah tan ahi, avam hochu Bethel lang’a apo mangun ahi.
23.5: Tumasang’a Judah lenghon ana pansah’u doi houna kimangcha thempu hochu aman ana sumang gamtan ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Judah gamsung jouse ah, pathen neilouho doiphung ang’a kilhaina ana bolji jiu ahi. Amahon Baal, nisa le lha, ahsi hole van thuneina hojouse ang’a kilhaina anabol ji jiu ahi.
23.6: Hichun lengpan, Asherah kihouna doikhum jong Pathen Houin’a konin aladoh in Jerusalem pamlam Kidron phaicham’ah ahallha gam in ahi. Aman doikhom hochu agoibong in vut ason mipi kivuina lhan chunga athe thang tan ahi.
23.7: Aman pasal kijoh hole numei kijoh ho achennao mun jouse chu aphelhan, Pakai Hou-In sunga akijohnao doiphung jong asuhset pehin. Hichea numei hon Asherah ahounao ponlukhuh ding akhon nao ahi.
23.8: Josiah in, Judah khopi dang danga cheng thempu hojouse chu Jerusalem’ah ahin polut’in ahi. Aman Geba le Beershaba kikah a um Pathen neilouho doiphung kilhaina gantha abolnao munchu asuhbohpeh in ahi. Aman Jerusalem a gamvaipo Joshua kelkot’a hunglutna munna kithoina doiphung jong ana sumangin ahi. Hiche kelkot hi khopi igahlutna a kelkot veilanga um’ah ahi.
23.9: Hiche Pathen neilouho doiphunga thempu ana pang hochu Jerusalem a Pakai maicham a na atohdiu ana phal pon ahi, amavang thempu dang hotoh cholsolou changlhah anehdiu vang aphal in ahi.
23.10: Chujou chun lengpan Ben-hinnom phaicham a um Topheth maicham jong chu ana suboh peh in ahi. Hijehchun hilai munna hin koiman Molech anga katding’a achapa hileh achanu hileh meiya govam dia kilhaina abolsah tapouvin ahi.
23.11: Aman sakol lim kisemthu Judah leng masa hon nisa houna a ana tundoh’u jong chu Pakai Hou-In na konin ana ladoh in ahi. Hicheho chu Nathan-melech kiti nukiso thu kitanna a pipui khat in hotoh kinaija uma ahi. Lengpan sakol kangtalai nisa houna a anatodoh jiu jong chu ana hal-lha tan ahi.
23.12: Leng inpia Ahaz indan chungnung chungvuma inchung’a Judahte leng danghon ana sem’u maicham phungho chu, Josiah in ana suchip in ana subeiyin ahi. Chuleh Pakai Hou-In hongcha teni a Manasseh in anasem maicham jong chu lengpan ana sumang in ahi. Aman ahel hellin ana vochip in, ahel hochu Kidron phaicham’a ana the jallin ahi.
23.13: Solomon lengpan kidah umtah semthu doiho houna dinga Jerusalem solang chuleh Olive mol lhang langa maicham ana tundoh hochu Josiah in asuhboh peh in ahi. Solomon in ana semdoh doi hochu, Ashtoreth kiti kidah umtah Sidon mite numei pathen, Chemosh kiti kidah umtah Moab te pathen chuleh Molech kiti Ammon mite pathen ahiuve.
23.14: Josiah in doikhom jouse ana volhun, chuleh Asherah ahounau doiphung jong ana phuhlhun, hijouchun hiche munho a chun mihem gule chang ho chu ana thekhum’in, asuhboh peh sohkei jin ahi.
23.15: Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sahna Bethel’a semthu pathen houna chu ana jep lhun ahi. Aman adoiphung’u chu ana halvam in chuleh Asherah doikhum jong ana hal-lhai.
23.16: Hijou chun Josiah ahung kiheiyin ahileh mol lhang lang panga lhanmol tamtah hochu ahin mudoh in ahileh aman aguhou chu ahin chomdoh uva Bethel doiphung ho chu suhbohna dingin achung'uva guho chu ahal lhahsah in ahi. (Hiche thil sohhi Jeroboam chu kut nikhoa maicham panga ana din phat’a hiche thilsoh ding hi Pakai jin Pathen mipa ana phondohsah ahi). Chuin Josiah agah dadohleh Pathen mipa lhan chu agah mun, amachu hiche thilsoh ding ana phongdoh pachu ahi.
23.17: “Hiche lhankhu koija ham?” tia Josiah in adohleh, mipihochun, “Hiche lhan hi Judah a konna hung Pathen mipa tunia Bethel’a nahintoh dingho ana seidohpa lhan chu ahi,” atiuve.
23.18: Hichun Josiah in adonbut in, “Hichu limsah hih un, agu jong suboi hih un,” ati. Hijehchun amahon ama guchu ahal tapouve, hitobang machun Samaria kon themgaopa a jong asuloh pouvin ahi.
23.19: Hiche jouchun Joshia in Bethel’a abol bang bangin Samaria’a jong ana bollin, khopiho sunga pathen neilouho doiphung hole ainhou aban vohset peh in ahi. Hiche hochu Israel leng tamtah'in ana tundoh uva Pakai ana lunghan sah’u anahi.
23.20: Hichun Josiah lengpa, pathen neilouho doi houna a thempu a pangho jouse chu amaicham chung tah uva athat’in mihem guhochu amaicham chunguva ahallin hiti chun ana suhboh peh in jouvin Jerusalemma ahung kile tai.
23.21: Chuin Josiah lengpan mijouse het dingin thupeh khat aphongdoh in, “Pakai toh kitepna lekhabu dung juiyin nanghon Pakai na Pathen’u kom’a kalchuh kut namantei teidiu ahi,” ati.
23.22: Israelten thutan vaihom ho khanglai apat’a Israel lengte khanglai le Judah lengte khanglai geija jong hitobang kalchuh kut hi ana kimang kha talou ahitai.
23.23: Josiah leng chan kal kum somle kumget alhin kum a bou hiche kalchuh kut hi Jerusalem khopia hung kimang pan kit bep ahi.
23.24: Josiah in gaochang miho jong asumang in, mitpheldoi them ho jong asubeijin, indoile milim doi kisem tapou chu Judah gamsung le Jerusalem’a amudoh thet umtah thil tapou chu asubei jingin, Pakai Hou-In sunga Hilkiah thempupan ahin mudoh lekhajol sunga kisun Pakai thusei jouse chu atohdoh thei tei nadin aboltan ahi.
23.25: Josiah masang in ama tobang leng alungthim pumpi le ahinkholhum keija chule athanei na jousea Pakai jinga kingaija Mose danthua kisei ho aboncha jui sohkei koima ana umpon, ama nungin jong koima dang ahung umkit tapon ahi.
23.26: Ahijingvangin Pakai chu Judah chungah ana lunghang lheh jengin ahi. Ajeh chu Manasseh in thilphalou tamtah ana tohdoh a Pathen ana choudoh ahi.
23.27: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin hitin anaseije, “Keiman Israel katolmang banga Judah jong katolmang soh ding ahitai. Chule Keiman kalhendoh Jerusalem khopi leh aHou-In a kamin kija dinga kana lhendoh jonghi kapaidoh ding ahitai.,” ati.
23.28: Josiah vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho jouse le anatoh jouse hi Judah lengte thusimbu kijihlutna lekhabua aumsoh keijin ahi.
23.29: Josiah leng chanlaijin Egypt lengpa Neco chun Assyria lengpa kithopi dingin Euphrates vadung lang ana jontan ahi. Josiah in asepai ho akipuijin aga kisatpin ahi. Ahinla Neco in Megiddo muna akimaitopin ahileh Josiah lengpa chu amahon athattan ahi.
23.30: Josiah noija sepai lamkai hon atahsa chu sakol kangtalai’ah Megiddo a konin Jerusalem’ah ahin polut’un ama lhankhuh achun anavui tauvin ahi. Hijouchun agamsung mipiten Josiah chapa Jehoahaz chu amakhel in leng achansah tauvin ahi.
23.31: Jehoahaz chu leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni thum ana lhingtan ahi. Chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah lha thum leng ana changing ahi. Anuchu Libnah khopi akonna Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
23.32: Amahin apu apateu chonna bang bangin Pathen deilou jeng ana bollin ahi.
23.33: Pharaoh Neco in Johoahaz chu Jerusalem’a avaihoplou nading in Hamath gam’ah Riblah mun’ah songkulla aheng in ahi. Chule aman Judah ten dangka pound sang sagi le ja nga chuleh sana pound som sagi le nga kai apeh dingin ana ngeh in ahi.
23.34: Hichun Pharaoh Neco in Josiah chate lah’a khat Eliakim kitipa chu apa khellin leng chang ding in atung in a, amin jong akhel peh in, Jehoiakim asah tan ahi. Ahin Jehoahaz vang chu Egypt gam'a soh chang dingin apuijin hikom’a chun ahung thiden tan ahi.
23.35: Pharaoh Neco kom’a kai apeh jouna dingun Jehoiakm in Judah mipite lah’a konin sana le dangka ama ama neile neilou dungjuijin adongin ahi.
23.36: Jehoiakim chu leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le nga ana lhingtan ahi. Jerusalema chun kum som le khat sung vai anahom in ahi. Anu chu Rumah khopi akon Pedaiah chanu Zebidah ahi.
23.37: Ama jong hin apu apate bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin ahi.

24.1: Jehoiakim vaihom laijin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in Judah gam’ah gal ahin sattan ahileh, Jehoiakim in kisatpi louvin amale agamsung jouse chu Nebuchadnezzer khut’ah ana kipelut tan ahi. Aman kum thum sungin kai anapen, chuche jouvin akiphintan ahi.
24.2: Hichun Pakaiyin Babylon mite, Syria mite, Moab mite, Ammon mite ahin tildoh in Pakaiyin themgao ho kam’a ana phondoh sahbang bangin aguilhung tan ahi.
24.3: Hitobang hamsetna Judah gam’ah ahunglhun hi Pakai thupeh akon ahi. Aman amitmu’a konna Judahte atolmang kigutna ajeh hi Manasseh in thilse tamtah ana boldoh jeh ahi.
24.4: Chule Jerusalem a themmona neilou thisan anaso’a ana hesosah jeh ahi, Pakaiyin hichu a ngaidam lou ahi.
24.5: Jehoiakim vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho jouse jong Judahte lengho thusim kijihna lekhabua aumin ahi.
24.6: Jehoiakim chu athi phat’in, achapa Jehoiachin lengin ahung pangtan ahi.
24.7: Egypt lengpan hichejou apat hin ahung galkondoh jou tapon ahi, ajeh chu Babylon lengpan Egypt in kagam ahi tia ahopsah chengse chu Babylon lengpan abonna alahpeh soh ahitai. Aman ana kilah lut gam hochu Egypt vadunga apat Euphrates vadung chan-gei ahi.
24.8: Jehoiachin chu alengchan kum chun ama kum somle kum get alhingtan ahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem chu lha thum bou lengvai anapon ahi. Anu chu Jerusalem makon Elnathan chanu Nehushta ahi.
24.9: Jehoiachin in apa bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol in ahi.
24.10: Jehoiachin vaihom sungin, Nebuchadnezzer in Babylon akonin anoija sepai pipui ho ahinsollin Jerusalem ahung umkhum tauvin ahi.
24.11: Hichun Nebuchadnezzer amatah jong hiche khopi aum sungu hin ahung lhungtan ahi.
24.12: Hichun Jehoiachin lengpan lengnu toh ama thumop hotoh, asepai lamkaiho le pipuho Babylonte khut’ah akipelut tauvin ahi. Nebuchadnezzer lengvai ahom kum som le kum get alhin in, Jehoiachin chu aman’in soh chang dingin ana kai tauvin ahi.
24.13: Pakaiyin ana phondohsa bangin Nebuchadnezzer in Pakai Hou-In akonin chuleh leng inpia konin sumle pai, sana dangka, neile gou ho jouse le, sana akisem thil-ho jouse, Solomon’in Hou-In a ana koiho abonchan achom theng hel tan ahi.
24.14: Hiti chun Nebuchadnezzer in Jerusalem khopi sung’a cheng jouse, asepai lamkai ho jouse le sepai galsat themho jouse, khut thepna neiho le thilsem themho abonchan mihem sangsom tobang Babylon gamlang’a akaijin ahi.
24.15: Nebuchadnezzer in Jehoiachin lengpa, lengnu anu, ajite ho chule apipui ho jaonan Babylon gam'a akaimang tan ahi
24.16: Chuleh aman sepai ahangsan cheh sang sagi leh khut thepna neiho abon’un mihat galsat thei cheh sangkhat ho chu gam chom’ah asoldoh tan ahi.
24.17: Hichun Babylon lengpan Jehoiachin pa’ngah pa Mattaniah chu leng in atung in, chule amin jong akhellin, Zedakiah asahtai.
24.18: Zedekiah leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le khat ana lhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle khat sungin lengvai ana pon ahi. Anu chu Libnah akon Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
24.19: Ahinlah Zedekiah in Jehoiakim bol bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol’in ahi.
24.20: Jerusalem leh Judah chung’ah thilsoh ho achuhna jeh hi, Pakai lunghan jeh ahi. Hijeh chun Pakaiyin, ama angsunga konna apaidoh a, hitia hi gamchom’a sohchang gam’ah ahi tauve. Zedekiah hin Babylon lengpa a konin kiphinna anei tan ahi.

25.1: Hiti chun Zedekiah lengvai ahom kal kum ko alhin kum, lha som na, chuche lha, nisom lhin nin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in asepai jouse ahin puijin Jerusalem khopi chu ahin bulutan ahi. Amahon khopi chu aum’uvin pal akai khum tauvin ahi.
25.2: Zekediah lengpa lengvai ahom kal kum somle khat alhin in, Jerusalem chu galmi ten aumkhum tan ahi.
25.3: Lha li lhinna, niko lhin nin khopi sunga neh ding akilhasam tan, kel ahahsa behseh tan, anneh twidon ding akinehchai gam tauvin kel athohpan tauvin ahi.
25.4: Hijou chun khopi pal chu themkhat avutbang’un, chule sepai ho jouse chu ajam gam tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu khopi chu Babylon ten aumkhum chahkheh chule jankhovah hella achanlhih jeng vangun, pal le pal kikah a lengpa honleiya chun ajamdoh tauve. Amaho chu Arabah lang jonin ache tauvin ahi.
25.5: Ahinlah Babylon sepaihon lengpa chu adellun Jericho phaicham’a chun aman tauve, ajeh chu asepaiten adalhah uva kithecheh gam'a ahitauve.
25.6: Amahon Riblah kho muna Babylon lengpa kom alhut tauvin, hilai munah chun Zedekiah lengpa chu achungthu atan tauvin ahi.
25.7: Amahon achateu atha peh uchu avetsah’un ahi. Hijou chun amit akaldoh peh’un sum-eng khaoguija akan un Babylon lang’ah akai tauvin ahi.
25.8: Nebuchadnezzer lengpa lengchan kal kum somle ko lhin kum, lha nga lhin na, chuche lha, ni sagi lhin nin, Babylon lengpa sepai pipui chuleh leng vesui lah’a lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem ahung lhung atan ahi.
25.9: Hichun aman Pakai Hou-In, leng inpi chuleh Jerusalem a in jouse ahal lhan chuleh khopi sunga insang aphadom jouse jong asuse gam tan ahi.
25.10: Chujongle aman Babylon sepai hojouse chu Jerusalem pal ho avohlhuh sah in, ajet avaija umjouse jong asuhset sah sohkeijin ahi.
25.11: Babylon lengpa tahsa vesuija pang ho lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, Jerusalem khopi sunga ana kidalha mipi amoh chengse, Babylon lengpa lang’a ana pang chengse chutoh mipi ahon jamah amoh chengse chu sohchang dingin ahin toldoh tauvin ahi.
25.12: Hichea hin Sepai lamkaipa hin mipi holah’a avaichapen hochu lengpilei leh lou lhou dingin adalhan ahi.
25.13: Pakai Hou-In maiya sum-eng khom kiphut holeh Pakai Hou-In sunga sumeng twikonglen atunna sum-enga kisem chengse jong chu Babylon sepaiten avo chipdellun, sum-eng chengse chu Babylon lamah akipoh atove.
25.14: Chujongle Babylon mite chun bel jouseu le tupheng jouse jong, chaiche ho ahin gim namtui hal namna lhengho ahin, Hou-In kin bolna dinga kisem sum-enga kibol umle bel lhengle kong abonchan akipoh mang tauve.
25.15: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun gim namtui kihalna le kong ho chule sana le dangka thengsel'a kisem thildang dang ho jouse jong akilah gam’in ahi.
25.16: Sum-eng’a kisem khompi teni, twikonglen, akhom atunna tenia kimang umle bel, lheng le konga kimang sumeng chengse chu agihdan anasa behseh jengin tejou hilou ahi. Hiche thilkeo hose se hi Solomon lengpan Pakai Hou-In na pang dinga anasem ho chu ahi.
25.17: Khomkhat chu asandan tong som le tong get alhingin, aluvumma chu alutomding sum-enga kisem asandan tong thum cheh a lhingin, chule khut them lah a kijempah a kolbuthei pahcha jem banga aluvum kimvella kisem sohkei ahi.
25.18: Nebuzaradan sepai lamkaipa chun thempulen Seraiah le thempu ni lhinna Zephaniah kitipa chutoh kelkot ngah apangji mithum chutoh sohchang dingin akai mangin ahi.
25.19: Chujongleh khopi sunga akisel nalai mipi holah a konin, Judah te dia gal lamkaipa leh lengpa thumop a pang mi nga, sepaite gamsungmi simtohle apang alamkai pauvin lekhasun’a amanpa leh khopi sunga kimandoh mi somgup chutoh anakai mangthan ahi.
25.20: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, amaho jouse chu Riblah khomun ah Babylon lengpa henga ahinkai luttan ahi.
25.21: Riblah kho Hamath gamsunga chun Babylon lengpan abonchauvin adengin athat sohtai. Chuin Judah mite chu agamsung uva konin sohchang din aki kaimang sohtauvin ahi.
25.22: Hijou chun Nebuchadnezzer lengpan Shaphan tupa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu Judah gam’ah hung kidalha mipiho chunga gamvaipo dingin ana pansah in ahi.
25.23: Babylon lengpa Nebucahdnezzar in Gedaliah kitipa hi gamvaipon apansah taiti Judah mi sepai holeh apipui houvin ajah phat’un, amahon Gedaliah chu Mizpah a akimupi din ana cheuvin ahi. Amahochu Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Kereah chapa Johanan, Netophath khomi Tanhumeth chapa Seraiah, Maacath khomi chapa Jezaniah chule akho midang jouse ahiuve.
25.24: Hichun Gedaliah chu amaho kom’achun akihahsel’in hitin aseije, “Ima kichatna le tijatna nei hih hellun, gamsunga chun lungmong in cheng un, chule Babylon lengpa thuhi ngaiyun, chutile nangho dinga imajouse phajeng ding ahi,” tin alungmon sah’un ahi.
25.25: Ahivangin hiche kumma lhasagi lhin phat’in leng insunga peng mi, Elishama tupa Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu sepai somkhat toh ahung konin Mizpah khoa hin Gedaliah leh Judah mite toh Babylon mite umkhom apanpi chengse chu ahung delkhum mun athat tauve.
25.26: Hiche jou chun Judah ho aneovapat alenpen geijin chujongleh asepai lamkaiho geijin kichatah’in Egypt lang’ah ajam gam tauvin ahi, ajeh chu Babylon miten i-ahinlo diu ham tichu kicha a ahiuve.
25.27: Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchanna kum somthum le sagi alhin’in, Hiche kum chuche lha, nisom ni le ni sagi lhin nin Evil-merodach chun Babylon lengmun ahinlo tan ahile, Jehoiachin chu akhoto in songkulla konin alhadoh tan ahi.
25.28: Amahin Jehoiachin chu ngailutna neitah’in akihoupi in, Babylon’a leng dang kihen ho sangin mun sang apen jana ana pen ahi.
25.29: Aman Jehoiachin chu songkul von khel chun vonthah anapen chuleh ahinkho lhung keija lengpatoh anneh khom dingin phalna anapen ahi.
25.30: Hiti chun Babylon lengpan ahinkho lhumkeiya niseh’a aneh ding an agontoh peh in, ama neh ding chan khat akisem jing jeng tan ahi.

1.1: Adam son le achilhahho Seth, Enosh;
1.2: Kenan, Mahalaleh, Jareh,
1.3: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
1.4: Chule Noah, Noah chate ho Shem, Ham chule Japheth.
1.5: Japheth chilhahho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, chule Tira ahiuve.
1.6: Gomer son achilhahho chu Ashkenaz, riphath chule Togarmah ahiuve.
1.7: Javan son achihlhahho chu Elishah, Tarshish, kikttim chule Rodanim ahiuve.
1.8: Ham chapate chu Cush, Mizraim, Put chule Canaan ahiuve.
1.9: Cush son achilhahho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
1.10: Cush jong hin Nimros ahingin, Nimros hi leiset chunga galhang masapen in ahung pang tai.
1.11: Mizraim hin Ludim toh, Anamim toh, Lehabim toh, Naphtuhim toh,
1.12: Pathrusim toh, Casluhim toh, Caphtorim toh ahingin, amaho’a konna hi Philistine ho hung kondoh ahiuve.
1.13: Canaan chapa masapen/tahpen chu Sidan ahin, Sidon chu Sidon mite ahung pen nau bulpi ahung hitai. Chujouvin Canaan in Heth kitipa chu ahinge.
1.14: Jebus mite, Amor mite, girgash mite,
1.15: Hivi mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,
1.16: Arvad mite, Zemar mite, chule Hamath mite jong ahiuve.
1.17: Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Aphaxad, Lud, chule Ram ahiuve.
1.18: Arphaxad kitipa hin Shelah ahingin, Shelah kitipa hin Eber ahinge.
1.19: Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, chapa masapa chu amin Peleg akiti ( hichu kikhentel tina ahi ); ijeh-enem itileh ama khang laiya leiset mite chu pao le ham chom chom’a kikhentel anahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
1.20: Joktan hin Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
1.21: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
1.22: Obal, Abhimael, Sheba,
1.23: Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahingin ahi. Mi hichengse hi abonchauva Joktan son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
1.24: Shem son achilhah: Arphaxad, Shelah,
1.25: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
1.26: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
1.27: Chule Abram, ama hi khonunga Abraham kitipa chu ahi.
1.28: Abraham chapa teni chu Isaac le Ishmael ahilhone.
1.29: Akhanggui kisim dan’u chu hiti hi ahiye: Ishmael chapate chu Nebaioth ( apeng masapen ), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
1.31: Jetur, Naphish, chule Kedemah ahiuve. Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate ahiuve.
1.32: Abraham thaikemnu Keturah chapate chu Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, midian, Ishbak, chule Shuah ahiuvin ahi. Jokshan chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
1.33: Midian chapate chu Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, chule Eldaah ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Abraham thaikemnu Keturah son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
1.34: Abraham hin Isaac anahingin ahi. Isaac chapate ni chu Esau le Israel ahilhone.
1.35: Esau chapate chu Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
1.36: Eliphaz chapate chu Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz chule Amalek ahiuve. Amalek hi Timna sung peng ahi.
1.37: Reuel son achilhaho chu Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, chule Mizzah ahiuvin ahi.
1.38: Seir son achilhahho chu Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Nah, Dishon, Ezer, chule Dishan ahiuve
1.39: Lotan chapate ni chu Hori le Heman ahilhonin, chule Lotan sopinu min chu Timna akiti.
1.40: Shobal son achilhahho chu Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, chule Onam ahiuve. Zibeon chapate ni chu Ariah le Anah ahilhone.
1.41: Anah chapa chu Dishon ahin; Dishon chapate chu Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, chule Keran ahiuve.
1.42: Ezer chapate chu Bilhan, Zaavan, chule Akan ahiuve. Dishan chapate ni chu Uz le Aran ahilhone.
1.43: Israelte chunga mi koima lengvaipoa pang anaum masanga Edom gamsunga lengvaipoa anapang miho chu leng hichengse hi ahiuve. Boer chapa Bela ahin, a lengvaipohna khopi min chu Dinhabah akiti.
1.44: Bela athi phat in ama khel’in Bozrah kho’a mi Zerah chapa Jobab chun lengvai anapon ahi.
1.45: Jobab athi kit phat chun ama khel’in Teman mite gamsunga mi Husham kitipa chun lengvai anapon ahi
1.46: Husham athi phat’in ama khel’in Moab gamsunga midan sepaite kisatpia jou lengpa Bedad chapa Hadad chun akhopi min Avith kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi.
1.47: Hadad athi kit phat chun Masrekah khoa mi Samlah chun ama khel’in lengvai apotai.
1.48: Samlah athi phat’in ama khel’in luipi dunga cheng Rehoboth khoa mi Shaul kitipa chun lengvai apotan ahi.
1.49: Shaul thi nungin ama khel’in Acbor chapa Baal-hanan kitipa chun lengvai apon ahi.
1.50: Baal-hanan athi kit phat’in ama khel’in Hadad chun akhopi min Pau kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi. Ajinu min chu Mehetabel ahin, Matred chanu chule Me-zahab tunu anahi.
1.51: Hadad jong athi kit tai. Edom gam'a ahung lamkai/haosa ho chu Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
1.54: Magdiel, chule Iram ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Edom gam'a phung lamkai ( Haosa ) jeng ahiuvin ahi.

2.1: Israel chapate chu Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
2.2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, chule Asher ahiuve.
2.3: Judah chun Canaan numei nu Bathshua kitinu akon in chapa thum ahingin ahi. Amaho min chu Er, Onan, chule Shelah ahiuve. Achapa apeng masapa Er kitipa hi Pakai mitmun agilou behseh jengin ahileh Pakaiyin jong amapa chu athat tai.
2.4: Judah hin amounu meithainu Tamar chu tohjong chapa pengkop ni Perez le Zerah chu ahing kit’in, hijeh chun Judah hin chapa nga jen aneiyin ahi.
2.5: Perez chapate ni chu Hezron le Hamul ahilhone.
2.6: Zerah chapate chu Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, chule Darda ahiuvin mi nga jeng alhing uve.
2.7: Carmi ( Zimri son achilhah ) chapa chu Achar ahin, amahin suhmang dinga kikoisa thet ho chunga Israelte anabol gim lheh jengin ahi.
2.8: Ethan chapa chu Azariah ahi.
2.9: Hezron chapate chu Jerahmeel, Ram, chule Caleb ahiuve.
2.10: Ram hin Amminadab ahingin, chule Amminadab hin Judahte leng chapa Nahshon ahingin ahi.
2.11: Nahshon hin Salmon ahingin, Salmon hin Boaz ahingin,
2.12: Boaz chun Obed ahingin, Obed in Jesse ahinge.
2.13: Jesse chapa apeng masapaen chu Eliab ahin, anina pa Abinadab ahin, athum lhinna pa Shimea ahin,
2.14: Ali lhin na pachu Nethanel ahin, Raddai chu nga lhinna ahi.
2.15: Ozem chu achapa gup lhinna ahin, chule asagi lhinna chu David ahitai.
2.16: Amaho hin sopi numei ni aneiyun amin lhon jong Zeruiah leh Abigail ahilhone. Zeruiah hin chapa thum ahingin, Abishai, Joab, chule Asahel ahiuve.
2.17: Abigail hin Ishmael mi Jether kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
2.18: Hezron chapa Caleb jong hin ajinu Azubah kitinu Jerioth khoa minu chu toh chapa phabep ahing lhonin ahi. Amanu chapate chu Jesher, Shobab, chule Ardon ahiuvin ahi.
2.19: Azubah hi athi nungin Caleb in Ephrathah akichenpi’in, chule chapa khat Hur kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
2.20: Hur hin Uri ahingin, Uri in Bezalel ahinge.
2.21: Hezron hin akum kum som gup jen alhin nungin, Gilead sopinu Makir chanu chu akichenpin ahileh, chapa khat amin Segub kitipa chu ahing lhonnin ahi.
2.22: Segub hin Gilead gamsunga khopi somni le thum jen semdoh’a chule lengvaipoa pang Jair kitipa chu ahingin ahi.
2.23: Ahin Geshur le Ram chun Jair ngahmun khopi toh Kenath khopi toh chule akhobah chengse kholen cheh somgup jen alah tha lhon tai. Mi hichengse hi Gilead hingpa Makir son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
2.24: Hezron chu Caleb-Ephrathah ngahmun khopia athi nungin ajinu Abijah chun chapa khat Tekoa hingpa Ashhur kitipa chu ahinpeh-in ahi.
2.25: Hezron chapa apeng masapen Jerahmeel chapate chu apeng masapen Ram ahin, Bunah ahin, Oren ahin, Ozem ahin, chule Ahijah ahiuve
2.26: Jerahmeel kitipa hin ji chom khat jong aneiyin, amin chu Atarah akiti. Amanu hin Onam chu anahinge.
2.27: Jerahmeel chapa masapen Ram chapate chu Maaz, Jamin, chule Eker ahiuve.
2.28: Onam chapate ni chu Shammai le Jada ahilhonnin, chule Shammai chapate ni chu Nadab le Abishur ahilhone.
2.29: Abishur le ajinu Abihail chapate ni chu Abhan leh Molid ahilhone.
2.30: Nadab chapate ni chu Seled le Appaim ahilhone. Seled chu cha nei louvin athitan,
2.31: Ahin Appaim hin chapa khat amin Ishi kitipa chu aneiyin ahi. Ishi chapa chu Sheshan ahin, chule Sheshan chapa chu Ahlai ahi.
2.32: Shammai sopipa Jada chapate ni chu Jether le Jonathan ahilhone. Jether hi cha nei louvin athitan,
2.33: Hinlah Jonathan hin vang chapa ni Peleth le Zaza ahinge. Mihem hijat hi Jerahmeel son achilhah ahiuve.
2.34: Sheshan in chapate aneipon, ahin chanu tampi ahinge Sheshan hin Egypt mi pasal khat soh aneiyin, amin jong Jarha akiti.
2.35: Sheshan in hiche asohpa Jarha kitipa hi achanu khat toh akichensah in ahileh achanun amapa chu toh chapa khat amin Attai kitipa chu ahing lhone.
2.36: Attai hin Nathan ahingin, Nathan in Zabad ahinge.
2.37: Zabad hin Ephlal ahingin, Ephlal chun Obed ahingin ahi.
2.38: Obed hin Jehu ahingin, chule Jehu hin Azariah ahinge.
2.39: Helez hingpa chu Azariah ahin, chule Eleasah hingpa chu Helez ahi.
2.40: Sismai hingpa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Shallum hingpa chu Sismai ahi.
2.41: Jekamiah hingpa chu Shallum ahin, chule Elishama hingpa chu Jekamiah ahi.
2.42: Jerahmeel sopipa Caleb chapate lah’a apeng masapen Mesha chun Ziph ahingin, chule Mareshah hin Hebron ahinge.
2.43: Hebron chapate chu Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, chule Shema ahiuve.
2.44: Shema hin Raham ahingin, Raham hin Jorkeam ahinge. Chule Rekem hin Shammai anahingin ahi.
2.45: Shammai chapa chu Maon ahin, chule Maon chun Beth Zur ahingin ahi.
2.46: Caleb thaikemnu chun Haran, Moza, chule Gazez ahinge; chule hichea hin Haran hin Gazez chu ahingin ahi.
2.47: Jahdai chapate chu Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, chule Shaaph ahiuvin ahi.
2.48: Caleb thaikemnu achom khat Maachah kitinu jong chun Sheber le Tirhanah ahingin ahi.
2.49: Amanu ma ma hin jong Madmannah pa Shaaph chule Macbenah le Gibea pa Sheva anahingin ahi. Caleb hin jong chanu khat aneiyin amin Achsah akiti.
2.50: Mihem hijat hi abonchauva Caleb son achilhah jeng ahiuve. Caleb jinu Ephrathah chapa masapen Hur chapate chu Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal,
2.51: Bethlehem pa Salma, chule Beth-Gader pa Hareph ahiuve.
2.52: Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal son achilhahho chu Haroeh sung kon Manahath mi akeh khat jen toh,
2.53: Chule Kiriath-Jearim insung mite Ithir miho ahiuvin, Puth miho ahiuvin, Sumath miho ahiuvin, chule Mishrai miho toh ahiuve; amahoa konna hi Zorah miho le Eshtaol miho hung kondoh ahiuvin ahi.
2.54: Salma chapate chu Bethlehem miho ahiuvin, Netophath miho ahiuvin, Atroth-Beth-Joab miho ahiuvin, adang miho chu Manahath miho leh Zor miho akeh khat jen jong ahiuvin ahi.
2.55: Chule Jabez khoa cheng danthu lekha sunna pang miho insung mite jong Tirath miho ahiuvin, Shimeath miho hi Recab insung penna Hammath kitipa sung peng ngen ahiuvin, Ken mi jeng ahiuve.

3.1: Hebron khopia achen laiya David in ahin achapate chu hicheng hi ahiuve: achapa apeng masapen chu Ammon ahin, apenna nu chu Ahinoam akitin Jezreel kho mi ahi. Achapa ni lhinna pachu Daniel ahin, Carmel kho numeinu Anogail toh ahinlhon ahi.
3.2: Athum lhinna pachu Absalom ahin, anu chu Maacah akitin, Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu ahi. Li lhinna pachu Adonijah ahin, anu chu Haggith ahi.
3.3: Nga lhinna pachu Shephatiah akitin, anu chu Abital ahi. Gup lhinna pachu Ithream ahin, David in ajinu Eglah toh ahinlhon ahiye.
3.4: Hebron khopia kum sagi le akeh khat sunga lengvaipoa anapan sungin David chun chapa gu hi anahingin ahi. Chujouvin kum som thumle kum thum sungin Jerusalem khopia lengvaipon anapangin ahi.
3.5: Jerusalem khopia achen laiya David in anahin achapate chu Shammua, Shobad, Nathan, chule Solomon ahiuve. Amaho penna nu chu Ammiel chanu Bathsheba ahi.
3.6: Chujouvin David in chapa ko ahinbe’in amaho chu Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
3.7: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
3.8: Elishama, Eliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
3.9: Athaikemho toh ahindoh ho tailouvin hichengse hi David chapate jeng ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei Tamar kitinu bouseh aneiyin ahi.
3.10: Solomon son achilhah ho chu Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,
3.11: Jeroram, Ahaziah, Joash,
3.12: Amaziah, Uzziah, Jotham,
3.13: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh,
3.14: Amon, chule Josiah ahiuvin ahi.
3.15: Josiah chapate chu apeng nasapen pa Johanan ahin, ni lhinna pa Jehoiakim ahin, athum channa pa Zedekiah ahin, li lhinna pachu Shallum ahi.
3.16: Jehoiakim son achilhah ho chu achapa Jehoiachin leh asopipa Zedekiah ahilhone.
3.17: Babylon miten soh-chaga anakaimangu Jehoiachin chapate chu Shealtiel,
3.18: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, hoshama, chule Nedabiah ahiuvin ahi.
3.19: Pedaiah chapate ni chu Zerubbabel le Shimei ahilhone. Zerubbabel chapate ni chu Meshullam le Hananiah ahilhonin, Amani sopinu chu Shelomith akiti.
3.20: Aman chapa adang nga jong ahingin, amaho chu Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, chule Jushab-Hesed ahiuve.
3.21: Hananiah chapate ni chu Pelatiah le Jeshaiah ahilhone. Jeshaiah chapa Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa Arnan ahin, Arnan chapa Obadiah ahin, Obadiah chapa Shecaniah ahi.
3.22: Shecaniah chapa le atute chu achapa Shemaiah ahin; chule Shemaiah chapate chu Hattush ahin, Igal ahin, Bariah ahin, Neariah ahin, chule Shaphat pumin mi gup alhing uve.
3.23: Neariah chapate chu Elioenai ahin, Hizkiah ahin, chule Azrikam pumin mi thum ahiuve.
3.24: Elioenai chapate chu Hodaviah ahin, Eliashib ahin, Pelaiah ahin, Akkub ahin, Johanan ahin, Delaiah ahin, chule Anani ahin, abonchauvin mi sagi alhing uve.

4.1: Judah chapate chu Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, chule Shobal ahiuve.
4.2: Shobal chapa Reaiah kitipa hin Jahath ahingin, jahath hin Ahumai le Lahad ahingin ahi. Hichengse hi Zorath insung mite jeng ahiuvin ahi.
4.3: Atam chapate chu Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash, chule asopinu Hazzelelponi, Gedor hingpa,
4.4: Penuel, chule Hushah hingpa Ezer ahiuve. Mi hicheng hi Bethlehem hingpa Ephrathah chapa apeng masapen Hur son achilhah ho ahiuvin ahi.
4.5: Tekoa pa Ashur chun ji ni anei in Amani chu Helah le Naarah ahilhone.
4.6: Naarah hin Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, chule Haahashtari ahingin ahi.
4.7: Helah chun Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,
4.8: Chule Anub pa Koz, Zobedah le Harum chapa Aharshel insung mite chengse chu ahingin ahi.
4.9: Jebez kitipa ji asopite dang dang sanga agunchu jeh’in anun jong, amahi nat chung nunga kahin ahi tin amin Jabez asah’in ahi.
4.10: Jabez hi Israel Pathen henga ataovin hiti aseiye, “O Pathen, nangin keima phathei neiboh tei teiyin lang, neikaile jing jengin lang, chule hahsatna le gentheina jousea kon’in neichom khen jing jengin,” atin ahi. Hichun hiche ataona hi Pathen’in anop peh tai.
4.11: Shuhah sopipa Kelub chun Mehir anahingin, Mehir chun Eshton ahingin,
4.12: Eshton chun Bethrapha, Paseah, chule Tehinnah ahingin ahi. Tehinnah chun Irnahash ahingin ahi. mihem hichengse hi Recah son achilhah ahiuve.
4.13: Kenaz chapate ni chu Othniel le Seraiah ahilhonin ahi. Othniel chapate ni chu Hathath le Meonothai ahilhone.
4.14: Meonothai chun Ophrah ahingin, chule Seraiah chun Geharashim pa Joab ahingin ahi; amaho hi khut them thing thembol mi ahiuve.
4.15: Jephunneh chapa Caleb chapate chu Iru le Elah toh Naam ahiuve; chutengle Elah chapa chu Kenaz ahi.
4.16: Jehallelel chapate chu Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, chule Asarel ahiuvin ahi.
4.17: Ezreah chapate chu Jether, Mered, Epher, chule Jalon ahiuvin. Mereh jinu ho lah’a mi khat’in Meriam le Shammai toh Eshtemoa pa Ishba ahinpeh-in ahi.
4.18: Chujongle Mered hin Judah numei khat jong akichenpi’in, amanun Gedor pa Jered ahingin, Soco pa Heber ahingin, chule Zanoah pa Jekuthiel jong anahingin ahi. Mered chun Pharaoh channu Bithia kitinu jong ana kichenpi’in, chule amanun jong chapa phabep ahinpeh-in ahi.
4.19: Hodiah jinu chu Naham sopinu anahi. Amanu chapa lah’a khat chu keilah kho’a Garm mite pa ahin, chule khat pachu Eshtomoa mi Maacath miho pa ahi.
4.20: Shimon chapate chu Amnon le Rinnah toh, Ben-hanan le Tilon ahiuve. Ishi chapte ni chu Zoheth le Ben-Zoheth ahilhone.
4.21: Shelah kitipa hi Judah chapate ho lah’a mi khat anahi. Shelah son achilhah ho chu Lecah pa Er; Mareshah pa Laasah; chule Beth-Ashbea kho’a tupat pon khonga pang insung mite toh;
4.22: Jokim; Cozeba mite le Joash chule Jashubi-Lehem le Moab gamsunga vaipoa anapang Sraph ahiuvin ahi. mi hijat le abonchauva amin nu chu khanglui laipeh’a athusim mu kisutna lekhahoa ana kisunlut peh ahitai.
4.23: Amaho chengse hi bel denga pang ho, Netaim le Gederah kho’a cheng ahiuve. Hichea hi amaho hi cheng khom’uva lengpa natonga pang ji ahiuve.
4.24: Simeon chapate chu Jemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zohar, chule Shaul ahiuve.
4.25: Shaul son achilhah ho chu Shallum le Mibsam, chule Mishma toh ahiuve.
4.26: Mishma son achilhah ho chu achapa Hammuel ahin; Hammuel chapa Zaccur ahin; chule Zaccur chapa Shimei ahi.
4.27: Shimei hin chapa som le gup jen ahingin, chule chanu gup ahinge; ahinlah asopi pasal dang vang cha tamnei aum pouvin ahi. Hijehchun, Simeon insung mite hi Judah insung mite bangin apung thei mong mong pouve.
4.28: Amaho hi Beersheba le moladah, Hazar-Shaul,
4.29: Bilhah le Ezem Tolad dunga achenguvin,
4.31: Beth-Marcoboth, Hazarsusim, Beth-biri, chule Shaaraim dunga jong acheng uve.
4.32: David lengvaipoa ahung pan masanga kho hijat hi amaho thuneina noiya um ngen ahiuve. Amaho son achilhah hochu Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, chule Ashan pumin khopi nga,
4.33: Chule kimvel dunga akhobah chengse chutoh Baalath mun chan geiyin jong achenguvin ahi. Hicheng hi amaho chenna mun ahin, chuleh, hiche min chengse ho hi amaho khanggui kisimna lekhabua ana kisun lut’ah ahi.
4.34: Simeon son achilhah dang hochu Meshobab, Jamlech, chule Amaziah chapa Joshah,
4.35: Joel le Joshibiah chapa Jehu toh, Seraiah chapa ahin, Asiel chapa ahin,
4.36: Elioenai ahin, Jaakobah ahin, Jeshohaiah ahin, Asaiah ahin, Adiel ahin, Jesimiel ahin, Benaiah ahin,
4.37: Chule Shiphi chapa Ziza ahin, Allon chapa ahin, Jedaiah chapa ahin, Shimri chapa ahin, chule Shemaiah chapa ahi.
4.38: Tua amin cheh’a kisimdoh hohi Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate cheh ahiuvin; apu apau insung dungjui cheh in jong nasatah in aphatheiyuvin akhangtou theilheh jenguve.
4.39: Chule amaho hi Gerar gamkai langa akitol’uvin, phaicham gam'a niso lam geiyin jong acheuvin, akelngoi hon teu din hamhing um umna ahol’uvin ahi.
4.40: Hikoma chun amahon gam phatah, hamhing thalhinna gam len tah, chule chamlenna le lung mong tah’a chenna thei akimuve. Hiche gam a ana cheng masa mite chu Ham son achilhah mi phabep anahi uvin ahi.
4.41: Hinlah, Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate chu hikoma hin Judah lengpa Hezekiah lengvaipoh layin ahung lut’uvin, hikoma anachengte Ham son achilhah phabep ho chule Meun mite ponbuh ho ahin, achennau in ho ahin, amuphah phah asumanguvin ahi. Hiti hin amaho chu asuhmang phat’uvin amaho khel’in anachenguvin, tuni gei hin amahon mun chu alo nalaiyuve. Ijeh-inem itileh hiche gam'a hi akelngoiteu neh ding hamhing pha amu’u ahi.
4.42: Chuin, Simeon mite lah’a mihem ja nga tobang chu Seir molsang geiyin akitol’uvin, a lamkai diuvin Pelatiah le Neariah toh, Rephaiah, le Uzziel, abonchauva Ishi chapate chu anapansah uvin ahi.
4.43: Amaho hin Amalek mi athimoh’a jamdoh chengse jong asumanguvin, chule amaho khel’in tuni geiyin acheng den tauve.

5.1: Israel cha amasapen chu Reuben ahi. Ahinlah, aman apa jalou tah’a apa thaikemho lah’a khat alupkhom-pi jeh chun a upat hi asopipa Joseph chapate joh achanguvin. Hiche jeh’a chu Reuben hi khanggui kisimna lekhabua chun apen masah dung juiyin akijih lut tapoi.
5.2: Judah son achilhahte chu athahat pen’a ahung pan uva chule amaho phunga konna leng khat ahung kisep doh jing vang'in, upatna kiti hi Joseph bou achangin ahi.
5.3: Israel chapa apeng masapen Reuben chapate chu Hanoch ahin, Pallu ahin, Hezron ahin, chule Carmi ahi.
5.4: Joel son achilhah ho chu Shemaiah ahin, Gog ahin, Shimei ahin,
5.5: Micah ahin, Reaiah ahin, Baal ahin,
5.6: Chule Beerah ahi. Assyria lengpa Tiglath-Pileser pachu Beerah anahi.
5.7: Beerah inkote chu ama phung sunga akhangguiya akisimtoh’a akijih toh tengleh ahaosa chu Jeriel ahin, Zechariah jong ahi;
5.8: Chule Azaz chapa Bela ahin, Shema chapa ahin, chule Joel chapa jong ahi. Reuben mite ho hi Aroer apat Nebon changei, chule Baal-Meon chan geiya cheng ahiuve.
5.9: Chule amaho hin Gilead gam'a chun gancha tamtah anei jeh’a niso lama jong achenguvin, nel gam jot nalampi lang apat Euphrates luipi gal lam geiyin acheng uvin ahi.
5.10: Shual lengvaipoh laiyin jong Reuben mite hin Hagar mite chunga gal abol uvin ahi, hiche Hagar mite chu ajophat uvin Gilead niso lama amaho ponbuh jouse a chun alhung keiyin achen den lo tauvin ahi.
5.11: Gad son achilhah ho chu Reuben mite ho toh kigalsaiyin achenguvin Salecah chan geiyin alouve.
5.12: Joel chu Bashan khoa haosan apangin, Shapham ama ban in apangin, ama ni ban’a Janai le Saphat apang ahilhone.
5.13: Amaho insunga phunggui sagi haosa ho chu Michael ahin, Meshullam ahin, Shiba ahin, Jorai ahin, Jacan Zia ahin, chule Eber ahi.
5.14: Hiche ho chengse hi abonchauva Huri chapa Abihail son achilhah jeng ahiuve; Huri chu joroah chapa ahin, Joroah chu Gilead chapa ahin, Michael chu Jeshishai chapa ahin, Jeshishai chu Jahdo chapa, chule Jahdo chu Buz chapa ahi.
5.15: Ahi chu Abdiel chapa ahin, Abdiel chu Guni chapa ahin chule Guni hi amaho insung lhah’a haosa ahi.
5.16: Hiche Gad mite hi Gilead gamsung, Bashan gamsung, chule akhobah jouse le Sharon gam hamhing phatna lai jousea achenguvin ahi.
5.17: Mihem hijat khanggui thusim hi Judah lengpa Jotham lal lai le Israel lengpa Jeroboam lal laiya kisimtoh a kijih doh ahiye.
5.18: Reuben chapate leh Gad chapate chule Manaseh phung keh khat jong hin galhang mihat, pho le chemjam thoa gal bolthei, thalpi kap them, galsat themtah tah sepai sangsom li le sang ni le ja sagi le somgup jen gal bol dia gonsa anei jinguvin ahi.
5.19: Amaho hin Hagar mite chung le Jetur mite chung, chule Naphish mite le Nodab mite chunga gal abol’uve.
5.20: Gal lai hin amahon Pathen hengah panpina athum un, amahon Pathen tahsanna anei jeh’uvin, aman ataona chu asanpeh tai. Hijeh chun amahon Gar mite le amaho panpi chengse chu ajou soh hel tauve.
5.21: Amahon akisatpi Har mite thil achompeh ho chu sangongsao sangsom nga jen ahin, kelngoi le kelcha sang jani le sangsom nga jen toh ahin, chule mihem sang jakhat jen galhingin akaiyun ahi.
5.22: Gal kisat chu Pathenin apanpi jeh’in Har mite simsen lou akijam chap jengin ahi. Soh-changa akitol mang kah seuvin amaho gamsunga chun Reuben mite, Gad mite, chu Manaseh mite acheng tauve.
5.23: Manaseh phung kehkhat jong mihem atam lheh jenguvin, Bashan gam'a pat Baal-Hermon gei, Senir gei, chule Hermon molsang geiyin achengdoh peh jenguvin ahi.
5.24: Ama ama pajang lhah ainsung cheh-uva a upa chengse chu: Epher ahin, Ishi ahin, Eliel ahin, Azriel ahin, Jeremiah ahin, Hodaviah ahin, chule Jahdiel toh ahiuve. Amaho mihat galhang ho hina lama minthanna anei uvin, chule ama ama insung pajang lhah a a upa chengse chu ahitauvin ahi.
5.25: Ahivangin amaho hin apu apateu Pathen ahou khel’uvin, Pathenin asuhmangsa mite gam'a vaipo ho Pathen lim semthu doi ho akou tauvin ahi.
5.26: Hichejeh hin Pathenin Assyria lengpa Pul (Tiglath-Piteser jong akiti ) lungthim ahintildoh peh in, hiche Reuben mite le Gad mite toh, chule Manaseh phung akeh khat hi akaimangin ahi. Assyria ten amaho hi Halah kho le Habor kho, Hara kho, chule Gozan vadunga ahinkai lut’uvin, tuni geiyin aumden tauve.

6.1: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari toh ahiuve.
6.2: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel toh ahiuve.
6.3: Amram chapate chu Aaron ahin, Moses ahin, chule Miriam toh ahi. Aaron chapate chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, chule Ithamar toh hichengse hi ahiuve.
6.4: Eleazer hin Phinehas anahingin, Phinehas hin Abishua anahinge.
6.5: Abishua hin Bukki anahingin, Bukki hin Uzzi ahinge.
6.6: Uzzi hin Zerahiah ahingin, Zerahiah in Meraioth ahinge.
6.7: Meraioth hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah hin Ahitub ahinge.
6.8: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok hin Ahimaaz ahinge.
6.9: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, Azariah chun Johanan ahinge.
6.10: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, amahi Jerusalem khopia Solomon hou-in sahdoh sunga thempu chungnunga hung pang ahi.
6.11: Azariah hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah chun Ahitub ahinge.
6.12: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok chun Shallum ahinge.
6.13: Shallum hin Hilkiah ahingin, Hilkiah chun Azariah ahinge.
6.14: Azariah hin Seraiah ahingin, Seraiah chun Jehozadak ahingin ahi.
6.15: Pakaiyin Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite soh-changa asol manga Nebuchadnezzar khut’a atolmang sah phat’in Jehozadak jong hi soh-changin achemang tan ahi.
6.16: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari ahi.
6.17: Gershom chapate ni chu Libni leh Shimei ahilhone.
6.18: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel ahi.
6.19: Merari son achilhah teni chu Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Anoiya mi hichengse hi apu apau kailhah cheh ama ama insung dol cheh’a Levi miho insung jeng ahiuve:
6.20: Gershon insung ahileh, Libni ahin, Jahath ahin, Zimmah ahin,
6.21: Joah ahin, Iddo ahin, Zerah ahin, chule Jeatherai ahi.
6.22: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amminadab ahin, Korah ahin, Assir ahin,
6.23: Elkanah ahin, Abiasaph ahin, ahimoth ahin,
6.24: Tahath ahin, Uriel ahin, Uzziah ahin, chule Shaul ahi.
6.25: Elkanah son chilhah ho ahileh, Amasai ahin, Ahimoth ahin,
6.26: Elkanah ahin, Zophai ahin, Nahath ahin,
6.27: Eliah ahin, Jehoram ahin, Elkanah ahin, chule Samuel ahi.
6.28: Samuel chapate ni chu apeng masa Joel ahin, chule anni lhinna pachu Abijah ahi.
6.29: Merari son achilhah ho chu Mahli ahin, Libni ahin, Shimei ahin, Uzzah ahin,
6.30: Shimei ahin, Haggiah ahin, chule Asaiah ahi.
6.31: Pakai hou-in sunga Pathen thingkong ahung kitol lut nunga David’in hou-in sunga la lamkaiya pang dia anganse miho chu hicheng hi ahiuve.
6.32: Jerusalem khopia Solomonin Pakai hou-in asah doh masangsen la lamkaiya pang ho hi mipi kikhopna ponbuh’a la lamkaiyin anapanguvin lhacha na atong jinguve. Hitobang hin amahon atoh dingdol kinse chu hoikeichan atong jing jenguve.
6.33: Hichea la lamkaiya pang ho leh achapateu chu aban'a kisei ho hi ahi-uve: Heman tumging thempa chu Kohath chilhah miho lah’a Joel chapa ahin, Joel chu Samuel chapa ahin,
6.34: Samuel chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Jeroham chapa ahin, Jeroham chu Eliel chapa ahin, Eliel chu Toah chapa ahin,
6.35: Toah chu Zuph chapa ahin, Zuph chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Mahath chapa ahin, Mahath chu Amasai chapa ahi.
6.36: Amasai chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Joel chapa ahi, Joel chu Azariah chapa ahin, Azariah chu Zephaniah chapa ahi.
6.37: Zephaniah chu Tahath chapa ahin, Tahath chu Assir chapa ahin, Assir chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin, Ebiasaph chu Korah chapa ahi.
6.38: Korah chu Izhar chapa ahin, Izhar chu Kohath chapa ahi; Kohath chu Levi chapa ahin, Levi chu Israel chapa ahi.
6.39: Heman’in manchah phapenna anei masapa Gershon chilhah miho lah’a Asaph kitipa chu Berekiah chapa ahin, Berekiah chu Shimea chapa ahi;
6.40: Shimea hi Michael chapa ahin, Michael chu Baaseiah chapa ahi. Baaseiah chu Malkijah chapa ahin,
6.41: Malkijah chu Ethnic chapa ahi; Ethnic chu Zerah chapa ahin, Zerah chu Adaiah chapa ahi,
6.42: Adaiah chu Ethan chapa ahin, Ethan chu Zimmah chapa ahi; Zimmah chu Shimei chapa ahin,
6.43: Shimei chu Jathah chapa ahi; Jathah chu Gershom chapa ahin, Gershom chu Levi chapa ahi.
6.44: Hemanin manchah phapenna anei ani channa pa Merari chilhah miho lah’a Ethan chu Kishi chapa ahin, Kishi chu Abdi chapa ahin, Abdi chu Malluch chapa ahin,
6.45: Malluch chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Amaziah chapa ahin, Amaziah chu Hilkiah chapa ahin,
6.46: Hilkiah chu Amzi chapa ahin, Amzi chu Bani chapa ahin, Bani chu Shemer chapa ahin,
6.47: Shemer chu Mahli chapa ahin, Mahli chu Mushi chapa ahin, Mushi chu Merari chapa ahin chule Merari chu Levi chapa ahiye.
6.48: Amaho sopite Levi phung sung mite jouse chu abonchauvin Pathen hou-in houbuh sunga natong kinbol din akipansah soh keiyuvin ahi.
6.49: Aaron le achapate jeng bouseh chu Thempu kin tongin apanguvin ahi. Amahon pumgo thilto kigona maicham chung le gimnaitwi kihalvamna maicham chunga thilto ding jouse toh-soh in apanguvin, Muntheng Phunga natohna ding thil toh din apanguve, chujongleh Pathen lhachapa Mose thupeh dungyuiyin Israelte kithoina kinbol’in apang jiuve.
6.50: Aaron son chilhah hochu hicheng hi ahiuve: Aaron chapa chu Eleazar ahin, Eleazar chapa chu Phinehas ahin, Phinehas chapa chu Abishua ahi.
6.51: Abishua chapa chu Bukki ahin, Bukki chapa chu Uzzi ahin, Uzzi chapa chu Zerahiah ahi.
6.52: Zerahiah chapa chu Meraioth ahin, Meraioth chapa chu Amariah ahin; Amariah chapa chu Ahitub ahi.
6.53: Ahitub chapa chu Zadok ahin, chule Zadok chapa chu Ahimaaz ahiye.
6.54: Hichengse hi amaho gamgi hop sunga achenna mun chengseu chu ahiye: Aaron chapate Kohath phung sung mite dinga phun kisan chu aphat jeh’in,
6.55: Mihon amaho chu Judah gamsunga Hebron khopi le akimvel gamse se toh chule avel’a hamhing gam gancha vahna ding jouse chutoh apeh tha taove;
6.56: Amavang akhopi loujao lah chengse leh akhoneo dung jouse chu Caleb kitipa Jephunneh chapa chu apetauve.
6.57: Aaron chapa dinga khopi anapeh’u chule ahamhing gamsunga cheh toh anakipeh tha ho chu: Hebron khopi ( kiselna khopi ), Libnah khopi, Jattir khopi, Eshtemoa khopi,
6.59: Ain khoppi, Juttah khopi, chule Beth-Shemesh khopi toh hichengse hi ahi.
6.60: Chuleh Benjamin phunga konna alahdoh-u khopi ho chu Gibeon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Geba khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Alemeth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, chule Anatholh khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahi. Aaron chapate ainsung pumpiuva achan jat’u khopi chu abonchan khopi som le khopi thum alhingin ahi.
6.61: Kohath chapate amoh chengse din Bamau insung dinga phum aphatna dungjuiyin, Manasseh phung keh khat, hichea phunga kon chun khopi som khat jen akipen ahi.
6.62: Gershom chapate chu phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Issachar gam'a kon, Asher gam'a kon, Naphtali gam'a kon, chule Jordan solam’a um Bashan gam'a Manasseh phunga konna kidong khom khopi agomin khopi som le khopi thum achanguvin ahi.
6.63: Merari chapate jong phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Reuben gam'a kon, Gad gam'a kon, chule Zebulun gam'a kon kidong khom khopi som le khopi ni acheng uvin ahiye.
6.64: Hitobang hin Israel chaten Levite chu khopi chujat chutoh ahamhing gamsese toh anapeuvin ahiye.
6.65: Hitobang hin phun phatna dungjuiyin, Judah phunga kon, Simeon phunga kon, chule Benjamin phunga konin achunga kisei khopi ho hi anapeuvin ahi.
6.66: Kohath chapate insung mi phabep jong Ephraim phunga konin agamsunguva khopi phabep le ahamhing gamsungse cheh achanguvin,
6.67: hiche khopi ho chu: Shechem ( kiselna hoidohna khopi Ephraim thinglhang gam'a um ) ahin, Gezer khopi ahin,
6.68: Jokmeam khopi ahin, Beth-horon khopi ahin,
6.69: Aijalon khopi ahin, chule Gath-Rimmon khopi chengse hi ahi.
6.70: Kohath chapate amoh chengse kipe khopi ho chu Manasseh phung keh khat’a kon in jong Aner le bileam khopi cheh leh Ahamhing gamsungse cheh toh ahin ahi.
6.71: Gershon insung mite kipe khopi ho chu Bashan gamsunga Golan khopi le ahamhing gamsungsese, chule Manasseh phung keh khat’a konna Ashtaroth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahiye.
6.72: Isssachar phunga konna kipedoh khopi ho chu Kedesh khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, Deberath khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se,
6.73: Ramoth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se le Anem khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahi.
6.74: Asher phunga konna kipedoh khopi ho chu Mashal khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se, Abdon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se,
6.75: Hakok khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se, chule Rehob khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahi.
6.76: Naphtali phung sunga konna kipedoh khopi ho chu, Galilee gamsunga Kedesh khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, Hammon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se, chule Kiriathaim khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahi.
6.77: Merari chate amoh chengse chu Zebulun phunga konin Jokneam khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, Kartah khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, Rimmon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, chule Tabor khopi ahamhing gamsungse se akipen ahi.
6.78: Reuben phung sunga konna kipe khopi ho chu Jordan vadung gal lang Jericho khopi dunga, Jordan kal niso lam’a Bezer khopi ( Nel khopi ) le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, Jahaz khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin,
6.79: Kedermoth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, chule Mephaath khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se toh akipen ahi.
6.80: Chutengleh Gad phunga konna kipedoh khopi ho chu Gilead gamsunga Ramoth khopi le ahamhing gamsungsese ahin,
6.81: Heshbon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se ahin, chule Jazer khopi le ahamhing gamsungsese ahi.

7.1: Issachar chapa li ho chu Tol'a, Puah, Jashub, chule Shimron ahiuve.
7.2: Tol'a chapate chu Uzzi le Rephaiah toh, Jeriel le Jahmai toh, Ibsam le Shemuel ahiuve. Amaho hi apau Tol'a insungkon mite lah’a upa cheh ahiuve. Daniel lal laiyin amaho hi gal-hang mihat jeng ahiuvin, sepai 22,600 alhinguvin ahi.
7.3: Uzzi chapa chu Izrahiah ahi. Izrahiah chapate chu Michael, Obadiah, Joel, chule Isshiah ahiuve. Amaho mi nga hi aphung sunguva lamkai cheh in apanguve.
7.4: Amaho hi numei ji tampi le chapa tamtah aneiyuvin, hijehchun amaho chapate sunga galsat thei sepai hi agomin mi 36,000 alhinguve.
7.5: Issachar insung mite mong mong jong gal-hang mihat jeng jeng jong abonchauvin 87,000 alhinguvin ahi. Amaho cheng chu akhanggui lekhabu’va kijih lut’ah ahitai.
7.6: Benjamin chapa thum hochu Bela, Beker chule Jediael ahiuve.
7.7: Bela chapa nga ho chu Ezbon le Uzzi toh, Uzziel le Jerimoth toh, chule Iri ahiuvin ahi. Amaho hi amau insung apu apau lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuve. Chujongle akhangguiyu kisimna akisut dol chun gal-hang sepai agomin 22,034 alhinguve.
7.8: Beker chapate chu Zemirah ahin, Joash ahin, Eliezer ahin, Elioenai ahin, Omri ahin, Jeremoth ahin, Abijah ahin, Anathoth ahin, chule Alemeth toh ahiuve.
7.9: Amaho hi apu apateu lhah’a insung upa cheh ahiuve. Amaho hi akhangguiya lekhabu’a kisut lut dungjuiyin mihat gal-hang sese le lamkai sese chu agomin mihem 20,200 alhinguvin ahi.
7.10: Jediael chapa chu Bilhan ahi. Bilhan chapate chu Jeush le Benjamin toh, Ehud le Kenaanah toh, Zethan le Tarshish toh chule Ahishahar ahiuve.
7.11: Amaho cheng hi apu apateu insunga phung upa cheh ahiuve. Hichengse phung sunga hin gal-hang mihat galbol thei cheh agomin 17,200 alhinguve.
7.12: Ir chapate ni chu Shuppim le Huppim ahilhone. Hushim chu apa Aker ahi.
7.13: Naphtali chapate chu Jahzeel ahin, Guni ahin, Jezer ahin, chule Shillem ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Jacob thaikemnu son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
7.14: Manasseh son achilhah ho lah’a Aramean numeinu toh ahin chu Asriel ahi. Amanu hin Gilead hingpa Makir jong ahinge.
7.15: Makir hin Huppim le Shuppim jong ji apuipeh cheh’e. Makir hin sopi numei khat aneiyin amin Macaah akiti. Ason chilhah ho lah’a numei khat chu Zelophehad ahin, amanu hin chanu jeng bou ahingin ahi.
7.16: Makir jinu Macaah chun chapa khat ahingin amin jong Peresh asah’e; chule asopipa min chu Sheresh ahi. Peresh chapate ni chu Ulam le Rakem ahilhone.
7.17: Ulam chapa chu Bedan ahi. Hichengse hi Manasseh chapa Makir son chilhah ho lah’a Gilead insung mite jeng ahiuve.
7.18: Makir sopinu Hammoleketh kitinu chun Ishod, Abiezer, chule Mahlah ahingin ahi.
7.19: Shemida chapate chu Ahian, Shechen, Likhi, chu Aniam ahiuvin ahi.
7.20: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Shuthelah ahin, Bered ahin, Tahath ahin, Eleadah ahin, Tahath ahikit’in,
7.21: Zabad ahin, Shuthelah akiti kit’in, Ezer ahin, Elead ahiye. Ezer le Elead, ama ni hi Gath kimvella cheng loulhou mi hon anathat tauvin ahi: ijeh-inem itileh ama ni hi aganchau guhpeh dinga hung konsuh jing ahilhone.
7.22: Apau Ephraim chun nikho phabep sungin amaho pul adou jengin, alhem lung mong din asopite jong ahunguvin ahi.
7.23: Chujouvin Ephraim hin ajinu aluppi kit’in ahileh amanu ahung gaiyin chapa khat ahing kit’e: ainsunga chutobang vangsetna alhun jeh’in Ephraim in achapa pengthahpa chu Beriah akisah’in ahi.
7.24: Aman chanu khat ahingin amin jong Sheerah akitin ahi. Amanu hin Beth-horon chung nung le anoinung chu anasadoh’in chule Uzzer-Sheerah jong anasadoh’e.
7.25: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Rephah ahi, Resheph ahin, Telah ahin, Tahan ahin,
7.26: Ladan ahin, Ammihud ahin, Elishama ahin,
7.28: Ephraim son chilhah hon gam alouva achenphana mun’u chu Bethel khopi le agamsunga kholen dom jouse toh, niso lama Naaran ahin, nilhum lama Gezer le akholen dung jouse jong ahithan, chule Shechem khopi le akholen len ho jong ahin, Ayyah khopi le akholen dung jouse changei jong ahithai.
7.29: Chutengle Manasseh mite gamgi dunga hung kilhah ahipeh’in, Beth-Shan le akholen dung jouse ahin, Taanaeh le akholen ho toh, Megiddo khole akholen dung jouse le Dork hole le akholen dom jouse toh ahiye. Khopi hijat sunga hi Israel chapa Joseph son chilhah chengse anacheng ahiuve.
7.30: Asher chapate chu Imnah ahin, Ishvah ahin, Ishvi ahin, chule Beriah ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei khat aneiyuvin amin Serah ahi.
7.31: Beriah chapate ni chu Heber le Malkiel ahilhonin, Malkiel hi Birzaith pa ahiye.
7.32: Heber chapate chu Japhlet le Shomer toh, chule Hotham ahiuve. Amaho hin sopi numei khat bou aneiyuvin amin Shua akiti.
7.33: Japhlet chapate hin Pasach, Bimhal, chule Ashvath ahiuve.
7.34: Shomer chapate chu Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, chule Ram ahiuve.
7.35: Shomer sopipa Helem chapate chu Zophah, Imma, Shelesh, chule Amal ahiuve.
7.36: Zophah chapate chu Suah, Harnephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
7.37: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, chule Beera ahiuve.
7.38: Jether chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuvin ahi.
7.39: Ulla chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuve.
7.40: Asher son achilhah mi hichengse hi, apajang khai cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve. Mihat gal-hang mi jeng leh milen milal jeng ahiuve, ti phatea phot chetsa cheh ahitauve. Akhanggui lekhabua galsat’a manthei cheh mihing kisimdoh chengse chu 26,000 alhinguvin ahi.

8.1: Benjamin chapa apeng masapen chu Bela ahin, ni lhinna pachu Ashbel ahin, athum channa pachu Aharah ahin,
8.2: Li lhinna pachu Nohah ahin, chule a nga channapa chu Rapha ahi.
8.3: Bela chapate chu Addar ahin, Gera ahin, Abihud ahin,
8.4: Abishua ahin, Naaman ahin, Ahoah ahin,
8.5: Gera ahin, Shephuphan ahin, chule Huram ahiuve.
8.6: Ehud chapate, Gam'a cheng mite dinga ainsung cheh uva mi upa jeng ho chu, abonchauvin Manahath gamsunga min soh-chang din akaimang tauve.
8.7: Ehud chapate chu Naaman ahin, Ahijah ahin, chule Gera toh ahiuve. Gera hin soh-changa apuimang’u ahin, amahin Uzza le Abihud ahingin ahi.
8.8: Shaharaim hin ajite ni Hushim le Baara ada nungin jong Moab gamsunga cha tampi anei nalaiyin ahi.
8.9: Ajinu Hodesh kiti nu chuto jong chapa Jobab le Zibia toh Mesha le Malcam ahing lhonin,
8.10: Jeuz le Sakia toh, chule Mirmah ahing lhonin ahi. Hichengse hi amapa chapate ahiuvin, ainsung cheh uva mi upa cheh ahiuve.
8.11: Aman ajinu Hashim tohjong chapa ni Abitub leh Elpaal ahing lhonin ahi.
8.12: Elpaal chapate chu Eber ahin, Misham ahin, chule Shemed ahi: ( Shemed hin Ono khopi le Lod khopi toh chule akholen dung jouse anasan ahin),
8.13: Beriah ahin, chule Shema jong ahilhone. Amaho hi Aijalon khopi’a cheng insung phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule Gath’a cheng ho toh kisat’a nomanga pang ho chu ahiuve.
8.14: Chujongle Ahio le Shashak toh chule Jeremoth jong ahiuve.
8.15: Zebadiah ahin, Arad ahin, chule Eder jong ahiuve.
8.16: Michael le Ishpah toh Joha, amaho hi Beriah chapate jeng ahiuve.
8.17: Zebadiah ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
8.18: Ishmerai ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
8.19: Jakim ahin, Zicri ahin, Zabdi ahi,
8.20: Elienai ahin, Zillethai ahin, Eliel ahin,
8.21: Adaiah ahin, Beriah ahin, chule Shimrath ahin, amaho hi Shimei chapate ahiuve.
8.22: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
8.25: Iphdeiah, chule Penuel hichengse hi Shashak chapate jeng ahiuve.
8.27: Jaareshiah, Elijah, chule Zicri hichengse hi Jeroham chapate ahiuvin ahi.
8.28: Mihem hijat hi akhangguiyu lekhabua kisut dungjuiyin ama ama insunga phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule amaho hi Jerusalem khopia anachenguvin ahiye.
8.29: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopia anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
8.30: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon akitin ahi. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
8.32: Chule Shimeam hingpa Mikloth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi ainkoteu toh kigalsai cheh’in Jerusalem khopia chun anachenguvin ahi.
8.33: Ner chun Kish ahingin, Kish chun Saul ahingin, Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
8.34: Jonathan’in Meribaal ahingin, Meribaal in Micah ahinge.
8.35: Micah chapate chu Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, chule Ahaz ahiuve.
8.36: Ahaz chun Jadah ahingin, Jadah chun Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri ahinge. Zimri hin Moza ahinge.
8.37: Moza chu Binea pa ahin, Binea chu Rephaiah pa ahin, Raphaiah chu Eleasah pa ahin, chule Eleasah chu Azel pa ahi.
8.38: Azel hin chapa gup aneiyin, amaho chu: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
8.39: Ezel sopipa Eshek chun chapa thum ahingin ahi: Apeng masapen chu Ulam ahin, ani lhinna pachu Jeush ahin, chule athum channa pachu Eliphelet ahi.
8.40: Ulam chapate chu mihat gal-hang jeng, thalpi kap them jeng ahiuvin ahi. Amahon chapa tampi pi aneiyuvin chule tute jong tamtah aneiyun, abonchauvin mi 150 jen alhinguve. Mi hichengse hi Benjamin son chilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.

9.1: Hijehchun Israelte chun abonchauvin akhangguiyu akisim soh keiyin, akisim doh jouse chu Israel Lengte thusim lekhabua akijih lut soh keiye. Judah miten Pakaiya kitah louna anei jeh-uvin Babylon gamsunga soh-changin min akaimang taove
9.2: Agamsunguva hung lut kit’a akhopi dunguva hung cheng lut masaho chu thempu ho, Levi mite, Hou-In lhacha ho, chule Israel mite adang dang ahiuve.
9.3: Judah mite lah’a abang bang, Benjamin phunga ahin, Ephraim phunga ahin, chule Manasseh phunga ahiuvin, Jerusalem khopia ahung kitol lut’uvin chule achenguve.
9.4: Judah chapa Perez chapate lah’a inko khat hung kinungle chu achapa Bani, Bani chapa Imri, Imri chapa Omri, Omri chapa Ammihud, Ammihud chapa Uthai chu ahi.
9.5: Adang inko ahung kinungle ho chu Shilon mite lah’a achapa apeng masapen Asaiah le achapate ahiuve.
9.6: Zerah phung sunga ahung kinungle chu Jevel le ainkote chengse ahiuve. Judah phung sunga ahung kinungle inko chu abonchauvin 690 alhinguvin ahi.
9.7: Benjamin phung kon’in Meshullam chapa Sallu ahin, Sallu chapa Hodaviah ahin, Hodaviah chapa Hassenuah ahin,
9.8: Jeroham chapa Ibneiah ahin, chule Elah chu Uzzi chapa Micri chapa ahin, chule Meshullam jong chu Shephatiah chapa ahin, Shephatiah chu Reuel chapa ahin, Reuel chu Ibnijah chapa ahi.
9.9: Amaho chengse hi ama ama insung lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule akhanguiyu thusim lekhabua kijih lut soh kei ahiuve. Benjamin phunga konna hung kinungle agomin inko 956 alhinguve.
9.10: Thempuho lah’a hung kinungle ho chu Jedaiah le Jehoiarib toh Jakin ahiuve.
9.11: Azariah kitipa Hilkiah chapa jong chu ahin, Hilkiah chu Meshullam chapa ahi; Meshullam chu Zadok chapa ahin, Zadok chu Meraioth chapa ahi; Meraioth chu Ahitub chapa ahi. Azariah chu Pathen hou-in’a vaibol lamkai pipua pang ahiye.
9.12: Thempu adang hung kinungle ho chu Jehoram chapa Adaiah ahin, Jehoram hi Pashhur chapa ahin, Pashhur chu Malkijah chapa ahin, chule Aiel chapa Maasai ahin, Meshullam chu Meshillemith chapa ahin, chule Meshillemith chu Immer chapa ahi.
9.13: Hicheng tilouvin jong thempu adang ahung kinungle agomin mi 1,760 ahiuve. Amaho hi apu apauva ainsung kailhah’a phung upa chengse ahiuvin, chule mi hangsan ngen jong ahiuve. Chule amaho hi Pathen Hou-In sunga natonga mopohna nei cheh ahiuve.
9.14: Levi phunga mite chu Hasshub chapa Shemaiah ahin, Hasshub chu Azrikam chapa ahi; Hazrikam chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Merari chapate lah’a khat ahi.
9.15: Bakbakkar, Herish leh Galal jong ahiuvin, chutengle Mica chapa Mattaniah ahin, Mica chu Zicri c hapa ahin, Zicri chu Asaph chapa ahi.
9.16: Chule Shemaiah chapa Obadiah ahin, Shemaiah chu Galal chapa ahi; Galal chu Jeduthun chapa ahin, chule Asa chapa Berekiah ahi; Berekiah chu Elkaneh chapa ahin, ama hi Netophah gamsunga cheng anahi.
9.17: Kulpi kelkot ngah’a pang miho chu Shallum ahin, Akkub ahin, Talmon ahin, Ahiman ahin, chule a inkoteu toh ahiuve.
9.18: Chule masang chun amaho hi niso lama lengpa kelkot ngah’in apanguve. Hiche miho hin Levi mite ngahmun kelkot jong angah’uvin ahi.
9.19: Kore chapa Shallum ahin, Kore chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin; Korah phunggui akon ahi. Ama le ainkote, Korah mite chengse chu Hou-In kinbol’in apu apateu Pakai ngahmun ngah’a apan banguvin apanguve.
9.20: Masanglaiya chu Eleazar chapa Phinehas kitipa hi amaho kulpi kelkot mopoa anapang ji ahi; hijeh chun Pakaiyin jong amapa chu ana umpi jing jenge.
9.21: Chule hiche jou chun Zechariah kitipa Meshelemiah chapa chu kikhopna ponbuh kotphunga kot ngah’in anapang jin ahi.
9.22: Chuche laichun hongcha kelkot dung ngah dinga kilhengdoh miho mong mong chu mihem 212 alhinguvin ahi; chule amaho hi akhangguiyu kisimna’a akho kho uva kisim soh kei ahiuve. David le mitva neipa Samuel chun amaho hi akitah jeh’uva apu apateu ho chu hitobang apan mun’uva hi apansah lhon ahiuve.
9.23: Hijeh’a chu amaho le son chilhahho chu Pakai hou-in, ponbuh’a hou-in kelkot phung dung ngah’a in-ngah’a apansah’u ahiye.
9.24: Hiche kelkot dunga kot ngah’a pang ho chu niso lam, nilhum lam, Sahlam le lhang lam’a pang soh keiyuva, mun lia pang ahiuvin ahi.
9.25: Amaho kithopi din ainkoteu, akho mun cheh’a hunguva ni sagi gia amaho hi ahung panhu jing jenguvah ahi.
9.26: Kelkot ngah’a pang lamkai cheh Levi mi li ho chu indan jouse leh Pathen hou-in sunga thil kibol jouse ngah’a jong pang ahiuve.
9.27: Amaho hi Pathen hou-in kimvel a geh jiuva, hitia hi amaho chunga in-nga kiti mong mong chu kikoiya, jingkah seh leh kot ahon jiu ahi.
9.28: Kelkot ngah’a pang mi phabep khat chu hou-in kinbolna kimangji manchah thil le lo simtoh’in apang jiuvin ahi; ijeh-inem itileh hitobang thilkeo ho chu akilah doh le akikoi lut chan’a amanlouna dinga simtoh ji ji ngai monga ahi.
9.29: Midang ho jong chu thilkeo dang le manchah thil thengho, changbong ding le lengpitwi, thaotwi, gimnamtuui le adang dang lhutnam ding anamtuui ho vetup din apansah’uvin ahi.
9.30: Hinlah thempuho chu lhutnam ding gimnamtui chohhal din apansah’uve.
9.31: Levi mi Mattithiah kitipa leh Korah insung kon Shallum chapa apeng masapen pachu changlhah pheng semna din avaibol’in apangin ahi.
9.32: Chujongle Kohath phunga kon mi phabep jong chu cholngah nikho seh leh todoh ding changlhah semin apanguvin ahi.
9.33: Levi miho lah’a tumging/lathem tah tah ho chu hou-in sung dan’a acheng den jenguvin ahi. Amaho hi hou-in kinbolna ho’a ongthol’in aum theiyuve; ijeh-inem itileh amaho hi asun ajan a lasa pang pang jengji ahiuvin ahi.
9.34: Mi hichengse hi Jerusalem Levi miho apu apauva ainsung lhah cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve.
9.35: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopi anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
9.36: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon ahiye. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
9.37: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, chule Mikloth ahiuve.
9.38: Mikloth hi Shimeam pa ahiye. Inko hijat hi Jerusalem khopia ki-inmai ngatto cheh’in anachenguve.
9.39: Ner hin Kish ahingin, Kish in Saul ahinge. Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
9.40: Jonathan chu Merib-Baal pa ahin, chule Merib-Baal chu Micah pa ahiye.
9.41: Micah chapate chu Pithon ahin, Melech ahin, Tahrea ahin, chule Ahaz ahiye.
9.42: Ahaz hi Jadah pa ahi. Jadah chu Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri pa ahi. Zimri chu Moza pa ahi.
9.43: Moza chu Binea pa ahi. Binea chapa chu Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahiye.
9.44: Azel hin chapa gup ahingin, aminu chu Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheriah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuve.

10.1: Philistineten Israel chunga gal ahin bol tauve; chule Philistinete masanga Israelte ajam gam tauvin ahi. Gilboa molsang chunga gal alel’uvin akijam chap jeng tauvin ahi.
10.2: Philishtineten Saul le achapate ajamnauva apha uvin, hichun achapa thum-Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Malkishua ho chu athat tauve.
10.3: Saul din gal kisat chu adou hah cheh cheh jeng tan, chuin Philistine thalpi kapthem mihon ma Saul chu amudoh’uvin chule melse tah’in amavouvin ahi.
10.4: Hichun Saul’in jong agalvonpopa jah’a aseiyin, “Nachemjam satdoh jengin lang neithat pai jengin, achuti louva ahileh hiche cheptanlou Philistine mite khu hung uvin tin kichepna einei diu ahitai,” ati. Ahivanginla agalvonpopan chutia bol jeng ding chu atijat behseh jeh’in anompon aboldeh tapoi. Hiche jehchun Saul’in jong achemjam akisadoh jengin, achunga alhun akibah lut jenge.
10.5: Hichea hi agalvon popanjong Saul thi amudoh phat’in ama jong achemjam chunga akibah lut pai jengin athi pai pai tai.
