18.12: Akelthoh u chun athao asulhom in chuleh vangset nachun amaho kipal lhuh ding chu anga ahi.
18.13: Natna in ativun u anen, thinan atibah u aval lhum tai.
18.14: Ahoidoh nau ainuva konna kibotkhen uva, chule kichat umtah lengpa henga chun akipui lha tauve.
18.15: Migiloute in chu kihal lha a ain chung uva kath meikong akijuh lhah sah e.
18.16: Ajungu golha a abah u jong goplha ding ahi.
18.17: Aum ingo kihetna ho jouse leisetna konna mangthah ding ahin koima chan amaho min chu ageldoh kit lou ding ahi.
18.18: Khovah a konna muthim lah a kisep lut ding ahiuvin vannoi leiset a konna kidel manga ahi tauve.
18.19: Amahon chate hihen tute hijongle anei tahlou ding u ahi, achennau gamsung a hung cheng ding son leh pah hung beihel ding ahi.
18.20: Nilhum lam miten avangset diu akichat peh un, solam amite akichauve.
18.21: Hichehi migilou Pathen neiloute chenna mun ahi tin hin seiju vinte.

19.1: Hiti hin Job in asei kit e:
19.2: Itih chan nei suhgenthei nahlai dingu ham? Itih chan nathu sei uva chu suhchip ding neigot nahlai diu ham?
19.3: Nanghon somvei jen neijumsou ahitai, aphalouva neibol u hi najachat pi louvu ham?
19.4: Keiman chonsetna nei jeng jong leng hichu keija bou ahin nangho a ahipoi.
19.5: Kei sanga phajo a nakigel u ham? Nei suh jachat nau hi kachonset hettohsahna a man ding natiu ham?
19.6: Themmo eichanna chu Pathen ahin, alenna eimat ahi.
19.7: Nei kithopiuvin tia kapen jah vang'in koima chan ei donbut poi, kanel kal in ahinlah thudih'a thu kitanna aum deh poi.
19.8: Pathenin kalampi akhotan jeh in kachat thei poi, kalampi muthim lah a eilhun lut peh e.
19.9: Aman kaloupina eilah mang peh in chule kalu chunga konin kalal lukhuuh eilahdoh peh tai.
19.10: Aman kasih lang jousea eikai lhun chuleh abeipai kahitai. Thingphung lhusa bangin kahinna jung jouse eibodoh peh tai.
19.11: Alunghanna chu kachunga ahung deujah jengin amelma khat bangin eisem e.
19.12: Asepai honpi amasan amahon kei bulu nading lampi asem uvin kaponbuh kimvella ngahmun asauve.
19.13: Kasopi jouse kakomma konin gamla tah a aum uvin chule kaloi kagol te jong kei doudin akihei gam tauve.
19.14: Ka inkote akichai soh tai, chule kakinai pi kagol ten jong eisumil tauve.
19.15: Kasohte le kasoh numei ten hetkhah lou mi danin eigel tauvin, keihi amaho dinga gamchom mi toh kabang tai.
19.16: Kasohpa kakou chun ama ahung tapoi, amapa koma katao ding angaije.
19.17: Kahai jong kajinu dinga theida um ahin, keihi kain koten eile mang u ahitai.
19.18: Chapang neucha cha ho jengin jong ija se louvin eibol uvin, thusei dinga kadin doh chun amahon anunglam eingat uve.
19.19: Kakinaipi kagolten eikidah uvin kangai tah tah hon jong eidou tauve.
19.20: Kavun leh kagu kachang bouseh a eikikoi ahitan, chule kanevun teni khu apang kaven maimai jeh a thina a konna jamdoh kahi.
19.21: Nei khotouvin, kagol kapai ho, nei khotuvin, ijeh inem itile Pathen khut in eitham khah ahi.
19.22: Pathenin eibolna banga nangin jong nei bolgim ding ham? Nei lhaingem lou jeh a hi chimlou nahim?
19.23: O kathusei hohi sahlut thei hihen, O hiche hohi hetjing nathei khat a kimin chon sah hile,
19.24: Thih paicha in kikhen doh hen lang chuleh ngen twi kisunkhum hen lang a itih a umjing ding songpi chunga kikhen doh hen.
19.25: Ahinlah keija dingin vang eilhandampu ahinge ti keiman kahei. Akhon naleh leiset chunga hung ding ding ahi.
19.26: Chule katahsa akemsuh jou nung hihen, hijeng jongle katahsa tah a Pathen kamu ding ahi.
19.27: Keima mong mongin ama chu kamu ding ahi.
19.28: Keima gimbolna dinga ichan geija hangsan nahim? Hiche hi ama thepmo ahi natijiu ham?
19.29: Nang chunga chu ding gimbolna chu naki chat ding ahi. Na chonna toh kitoh bep a gimbolna nachan kihet in.

20.1: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun adonbut in:
20.2: Kadonbut tei ding ahi, ijeh inem itile keima nasatah in eiki sunoh phah e.
20.3: Nami phosal nahi kahin thoh joulou ahitan, ahinlah ka lhagaovin donbut nomna eihin neisah ahitai.
20.4: Phat kipat tillai leiset chunga mihem te ana um masat pen laiju chu geldoh in,
20.5: Migilou te kichoisang nahi phat chomcha bou ahin, chule Pathen neiloute kipana jong chomkhat a ding bou ahi.
20.6: Pathen neiloute kiletsah nan van pha hen lang, chuleh alu uvin meibol ga tong kha jongleh,
20.7: Amaho chu tonsot'a mangthah ding ahiuvin, a eh u kipaimang banga amaho jong kipai mang ding ahiuve. Koi hijongle ahepha jousen dong uvin te.
20.8: Amahohi janmang bangin mangun tin chule kinung mukit lou diu ahin, amahohi jan a thil kimu aman bangin mangthah tauvinte.
20.9: Amaho chu amukha sa hon anungmu kit lou diu ahitan, ainkoten anungmu kit louhel diu ahi.
20.10: Achate houvin mivaichate komma akhut do uvinte, ijeh inem itile amahon aguh u haosat naho chu anung peh kit diu ahi.
20.11: Khangdong hijong leu agubuh u leivui lah a kijam ding ahi.
20.12: Amahon agitlou nau chu kipana ana neiju ahin, alei noi uva hung junlha ding ahi.
20.13: Amahon twi asauvin akamsung uva sottah akoi uve.
20.14: Ahinlah hetman louhel in a oisung uva a anneh u chu athuh jitai, a oisung uva thina thei gu aum jeh chun,
20.15: Amahon aval lhum sau anei agou hou chu alodoh un ahin Pathenin akoi lhahsah lou diu ahi.
20.16: Amahon gulsoh gu hin chop untin gulsen amaho ahintha dingu ahi.
20.17: Amahon olive thao twidung banga long ahiloule khoiju leh bongnoi vadung banga long amukhah kit louhel diu ahi.
20.18: Amahon atohman uva amu thil jouse anungpeh uva anei agou jouseuvin nopsahna hin lhut peh pouvin te.
20.19: Ijeh inem itile amahon vaichaho asu genthei un chule genthei lengvai jin adalhau vin amahon asah u hilou hel inho akilah uve.
20.20: Amaho akilose uvin chuleh lung nachimna anei pouve, aval beihella thil jouse nei cham kim ding bou agel gel uve.
20.21: Imacha khen neilou hellin amaho changseh in anei jou hel uvin hijeh a chu ahaosat nau jong umsot lou hel ding ahi.
20.22: Neng tah a aumlai tah ule hahsatnan ahin lhunkhum in hahsat gentheina achung'uva hunglhung ding ahi.
20.23: Pathenin amaho chu hahsat gentheina a a oisung dimset uvin peuhen Pathenin alunghanna achung'uva hin juhlhah sah hen.
20.24: Thih hemma konna jamdoh ding go jongle sum-eng a kisem thalchang in adot pai ding ahi.
20.25: Thalchang chun atungtun langa konna ki botdoh ding chule athalchang muh chu thisan nat dehduh a thina kichat umtah chu achung'uva chu ding ahi.
20.26: Agou jouse muthim lhangkal kiheh lah a kisep lut ding, athil keu jouseu akidalha beihel a gamlah meiyin akahvam gam hel ding ahi.
20.27: Vanho jousen athemmo nau ahin phon jal ding chule leiset in jong ama douna ahin phot chet ding ahi.
20.28: Ain jouseu twisoh in alhoh manga Pathen lung hanna chu twi hattah long banga hung longlha ding ahi.
20.29: Pathenin migilou apeh ding tohman hiche hi ahin, Pathenin achan diuva ateppeh sau chu ahi.

21.1: Chuphat in Job in asei kit in:
21.2: Kathusei hohi ipi ham ti naichan hin ngai uvin, hichu kilhamonna neipeh thei sun u chu ahi.
21.3: Neithoh piuvin chule ken thu sei inge, keiman thu kasei jou teng leh nanghon nei nuisat pan kit nauvin nate.
21.4: Pathen koma kiphin kahin, mihem ho koma ahipoi, kanga sot joulou nau ajeh hoitah kaneije.
21.5: Nei veuvin chule thipchet in um un, nakhut uvin nakam kisip cheh uvin,
21.6: Ken ipi kasei ding ham tia kagel teng, kaki thing tuntun in katahsa akihot hot e.
21.7: Ipi dinga migiloute hi khang tou touva ateh gei uva khang uva chule thahat hiuvem?
21.8: Chule amahohi achateu khantou leh a inchen uve dinga hing ahiuvin chule atuteu chunga akipah uve.
21.9: A in hou jong kichat tijat na a konin a ongdoh un chule Pathenin agimbol poi.
21.10: Abongchal hou jong nou neilou vin aum pouvin, abongpi houvin nou aneiyun athollha jong aumpoi.
21.11: Kelngoite bangin achateu akichop le sah uvin, achapang hou chu akichom un chule alam lam uve.
21.12: Amahon semjang saigin leh selang dah toh lhonin la a asauvin, theile kimut gin in kipa golnop abol'uve.
21.13: Amahon ahin nikho hou nopsah nan amangun, chuti chun lungmong tah in lhankhuh ajon ji tauve.
21.14: Amahon chemangin nathil imacha kadei pouvin, nalam lhah jong kadei pouve tin PAthen koma aseijuve.
21.15: Hatchungnung kitipa chu koi hija chule ipi dinga athu kangai diu ham?
21.16: Amahon ahausat najouseu hi amaho thahat a kilam doh danin agel un, ahinlah hitobang lunggel na a chu keiman imacha bol ding kanei lou ding ahi.
21.17: Ahijeng vang'in migilou thaomei jong akimumit peh khapoi. Amaho hin hahsatna anei khah uvem? Pathenin lunghang tah a lung genthei nahi amaho ana hoppeh khah em?
21.18: Changpol banga amaho huijin amasang amutmang khah hitam? Huipi hat in changvai alhohmang banga alhoh mang khah hitam?
21.19: Aphai Pathenin achateu beh agimbol ding ahi tin nasei juvin ahinlah chonset bol pen pen vang chu agim bol ding ahi tin kaseije. Chutile ama thutanna chu ahet thei diu ahi.
21.20: Amanthah nau amahon amit tah uvin veu hen hatchungnung pa lunghanna thuhtah chu twidon in don uhen.
21.21: Ijeh inem itile ama athi nung teng le ainkoteu iti dingu ham ti angaito pouve.
21.22: Ahinlah koipen in Pathen chu ahil thei ding ham? Mithahat chung thu jeng jong atan ji ahi.
21.23: Mikhat chu hausa tah le lungmong tah hin boina beihel in athi jin ahi.
21.24: Mithahat misalhing hole tahsa damthei ho lim chu ahi.
21.25: Mikhat kit chu nopsahna hepha louhel in vaichatna khonteh in athi jin ahi.
21.26: Ahinlah ani honna chu leivui lah a kivui cheh ahi lhonin, ani lhonna than hon aneh cheh lhon ding ahi.
21.27: Ven nangin ipi nagel kahen nangin kei douna a nathilgon kahen ahi.
21.28: Achonset jeh uva ain u mang hella migilou leh mihausatah thu neihin seipeh ding ahi.
21.29: Ahinlah akimvella um hohi dong le chun amahon adihtah chu naseipeh dingu ahi.
21.30: Vangset phat laileh amaho chu aki hing hoijin chule manthah na a konna ajamdoh diu jong akiphal peh e.
21.31: Koima chan amaho hi lhangphong tah in aseise ngam pouvin ahiloule anatoh athilbol hou jeh in jong lethuhna akipe pouve.
21.32: Lhankhuh jonna amaho akiput tengu le alhan u chu mihon nidan kah khat bep bou anga peh jiuve.
21.33: Lhanmol a chun mithi kivuina kin akimang in atahsa choldo dinga akilupsah namun a chun mihon ajanau apeuve, chule leiset in kicholdo na nomtah in apei.
21.34: Nanghon keihi iti dan a thu hom keuva nei lhamon diu ham? Nahil chet najouseu jong jou ahi.

22.1: Hichun Teman mi Eliphaz in adonbut in:
22.2: Pathen kithopina dinga mikhat in abol thei ding um'em? Miching khat jeng jong chu Pathen ding a kithopi pha hithei ding ham?
22.3: Michonpha ana hile chun Hatchungnung pa a dinga phachom nana hikha dem? Mipha chamkim hile chun Hatchungnungpa a dinga phachom nahidem?
22.4: Pathen thengtah a nahou jeh a ama chun themmona chansah ham? Chule nang douna a thutan ahin pohlut ding ham?
22.5: Ahipoi nagitlou na jeh ahibouve. Nachonsetna angahna umlou ahi.
22.6: Vetsahnan nagolpa chu sumbat din pen lang nabat man dingin aponsil ho chu neipen tin lang henge agu achang geijin lahpeh jengin.
22.7: Nangin adangchah ho twi peh ding nom hih in lang chule agilkel an peh ding nom hih le chun,
22.8: Nangin gam chu athahatpa a ahi timai theijin natin ahinlah hiche a chu mikhat bouvin thaneina anei ding ahi.
22.9: Meithai khat tou chu khutgoh keuva nasol mang hikhat inte chule chagate kinepna jong nasuhkeh thei ahi.
22.10: Hiche ho jeh a chu thang’a naki umkimvel ahi, chule hetman louva kichat najeh a kitihot hot nahi.
22.11: Hiche ho jeh a chu muthim lah a namu theiji lou ahi. Chule twi kinong in achup ji ahi.
22.12: Pathen chu alen behseh in vanho sangin jong alen joi. Ahsite lah a agamla pen sangin jong agamla joi.
22.13: Hiche jeh a chu Pathenin kanatoh hohi amuthei jilou ahin, muthim jing lah a hi iti thu atan ding ham tin nadonbut e.
22.14: Ajeh chu meibol satah chun ana velkol lele a hiche jeh a chu aman eimu theilouvu ahi. Ama chung sangpeh a khun aumin vanna thilkholna mun ho a chu vahle ahi.
22.15: Migiloute lamlhahna lampi lui chu najot nahlai ding ham?
22.16: Ahinkho kibul patna twijin alhoh manga ahinkhou it um laitah le asalhah peh ji ahi.
22.17: Hatchungnungpachun kachung uva ipi abolthei ding ham? Kachangin nei dalhauvin tia Pathen koma asei jeh u chun,
22.18: Henge ama chu a insung uva thilpha tamtah dipset a chu ama ahi, hijeh a chu keiman hiche tobang lunggel a bolthei ding imacha kaneipoi.
22.19: Michonpha ho chun migiloute manthah na chu amuteng uleh kipah unte, chule nolna bei miho chun isah loutah a anuisat dingu ahi.
22.20: Veuvin melmate iti kisuhmang hija anukhah pen chu meiyin akavam tai tin sei uvinte.
22.21: Pathen a kipelut in chutile lungmong a naum ding ahi, chuteng leh nanga dinga ijakai phasoh kei ding ahi.
22.22: Ngaijuvin athuhil hi chuleh nalung chang ah khollin.
22.23: Hatchungnung pa komma nakile kitna ahile nakilepeh kit ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nahinkho chu sutheng in.
22.24: Sum ngailutna napeh doh a ahile, chule nasana mantam tah chu vadunga naselut a ahile,
22.25: Hatchungnungpa amatah chu nagou hijeng ding ahin, ama tah chu nanga dinga dangka manlu tah hiding ahi.
22.26: Chutile Hatchungnungpa koma konin nomsahna kilah in natin, hiteng chule Pathen chu ven.
22.27: Amakoma taovin natin chule aman na taona najah peh ding ahi. Chule nangin ama koma nakitepna chu namolso ding ahi.
22.28: Ipi hijongle bol dinga nagot chan namolso ding ahi. Chuleh namasanga lamlen chu vah'in hinsal vah peh tan nate.
22.29: Mihemte chun hahsatna ahin nei teng ule kithopiu vin tin seijin natin, chule Pathenin ahuhdoh diu ahi.
22.30: Michonse ho jeng jong, huhdoh in um unte, nakhut thenna jeh a chu huhdoh a umdiu ahi.

23.1: Hichun Job in aseikit in:
23.2: Kakiphinna tuni chan geijin akhoh cheh cheh in chule pendoh lou ding hatah in kagoi.
23.3: Keiman Pathen ama umna bouseh kahol doh thei hileh keima athutanna munna kache ding ahi.
23.4: Kachung chang thuhi kaluidoh a chuleh kaki phin a thu kasei ding ahi.
23.5: Chuteng leh keiman eidonbutna kangaija chuleh kakoma ipi asei ham ti kahetdoh ding ahi.
23.6: Athahatna jousea chu keima einel ding ham? Ahipoi aman ngainom umtah'a eidonbut ding ahi.
23.7: Milungtheng ho chun amatoh ngaito khom theijun tin hijeh a chu keima thutanna'a konna a itih a dinga lhadoh a kaum ding ahitai.
23.8: Solama kachen ahin hiche mun a chun ama anaumpon, lhumlam a kachen ahinlah ama kaga mu poi.
23.9: Sahlang gam kahol in kaga mu joupoi, ijeh inem itile ama kisel ah ahi. Keiman lhanglang gam kaven ahinlah ama akisel mangah ahitai.
23.10: Ahin aman hoiya kache ahen ahi, chuleh aman ei patep tengle sana thengsel banga kahung doh ding ahi.
23.11: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lampi a um kahin kihei mang louhel a alampi chu kajui ahi.
23.12: Athupeh a kon in kapotdoh khapon ahinlah niseh anneh twidon sangin athusei ho gou khol in kaki khol e.
23.13: Ahinlah aman khatvei kigel lhahna anei tengleh koipen in alungthim akhelsah thei ding ham? Aman abol nomchan chu ipi hijongle abol jing ding ahi.
23.14: Hijeh a chu ipi hijongle kachunga kathilgon jouse chu eibol doh peh a kavanga ana umsa chu aman athuneina noija akoi ding ahi.
23.15: Datmo louhel in ama aum tengle kaki cha behseh jin hiche ho kagel tengle kaki cha behseh ji e.
23.16: Pathenin kalung anat sah in lungchang nan eisem in Hatchungnung pa chun ei tijat sah e.
23.17: Muthim in ei umkim vellin athimdan seijou lou chu muntin a aume.

24.1: Ipi dinga Hatchungung pan migiloute khu thutanna munna dinga ahin pui lou ham? Ipi dinga Pathen ging ten panna beija ama anga nga diu ham?
24.2: Miphalou ten gamgi melchihna achonun gam leiset agu jiuve. Amahon gancha akiguh uvin chuleh amaho gamsunga hamhing lah a alhalut uve.
24.3: Amahon chagate sangan akilah un meithai ho bangchal bat man na apeh diuvin angeh jiuve.
24.4: Mivaichate chu lampam ah asondoh un migiloute chu ahoidoh nadiuvin akisel khom jiuve.
24.5: Gamlah sangan ho gammang lah a aum bangin mivaichaten aphat jouseu neh ding holnan amangun achateu neh ding nelgam sanna aga hol uve.
24.6: Amaho a hilou loujau lah a chang a-at jiuvin chule migiloute lengpilei lah a akhai achomkhom uve.
24.7: Jan khovah vah'in daplah ah akeuvun ponbeijin ahiloule kikhukhum ding neilouvin alum jiuve.
24.8: Amaho chun molla konna hung phinlha gotwijin akot soh jiuvin chule chenna in ngaichan songpi bel din alhai khom jiuve.
24.9: Migilou ten meithai ho chasen chu anu oplhanga konin aloilhah peh un nausen ho chu thil manna tun din alahpeh jiuve.
24.10: Mivaichate chu ponsil beijin akeuvun acheleuvin amaho tah anngol pumin midang ding chang a atkhom peh uve.
24.11: Amahon Olive thau achil lhauvin ahinlah atep diu jong akiphal peh pouve, chule dangchah thohpum pumin lengpi thei hehna khol ah na atohsah uve.
24.12: Khopi a konin mithi ding kon ho ahung pengdoh uvin chule maha pu hon kithopi ngaichan akap uve. Ahivangin Pathenin ataonau imachan agelpeh poi.
24.13: Migiloute chun khovah adouvun, amahon alampi hetpeh ding anom pouvin ahiloule alampi a jong aum pouve.
24.14: Mivaicha ho leh mi genthei ho that dingin tolthat ho chu jingpi phal vah'in athou jiuvin jan teng amapa chu guchan apang jin ahi.
24.15: Numei jon pipan khomut chip chep angah jin hiche phat chuleh koiman eimu taponte atin koiman ahetdoh louna dingin amai asel jin ahi.
24.16: Migucha ho chun jan tengle mi in asuse jiuvin chuleh sun leh a ihmu jiuve. Amaho chu khovah toh kihekha lou ahiuve.
24.17: Jan muthim chu amaho din jingkah ahin amaho tah hi khojin kichatna toh kijopmat ahiuve.
24.18: Ahinlah amaho hi twinoi langa twihu bangin amang ji tauve, athilnei jouseu hi gaosapna ahi chule amaho alengpi lei uva alut diu jong akichauve.
24.19: Nichangsat leh sat in buhbang twi amanchah banga lhankhuh in jong michonse ho amanchah ahi.
24.20: Ahingnu tah'un jong hin sumil untin than hon amaho chu twitah in hin neuvin tin, koima chan amaho chu geldoh tapouvin te. Migiloute chu huipi gopin thingphung amutlhuh tobang hiuvinte.
24.21: Kithopi ding chapa neilou meithai ho alhemlha jiuvin meithai gentheiho kithopi ding amaho anom pouve.
24.22: Pathen thanei nan miho chu akaimang jin amaho chu kichoisang maithei unte, ahinlah ahinkhou iti ding ham ti hetchetna anei pouve.
24.23: Amahohi lungmong tah a ahin diu kiphal peh jeng jongleh Pathenin amaho chu avelhi jing jenge.
24.24: Chuleh tuhin amaho hi oupe lheh jong leu mitphet kah louvin adangho bangin che mang tauvin tin, changvui bangin satlhah in um uvinte.
24.25: Ahilou jongleh khat touvin achu thei ham? Koipen in kadih louna aphotchet thei ding ham?

25.1: Hiti chun Shuh mi Bildad in adonbut in:
25.2: Pathen hi thahattah le kichat umtah ahin, vanho a lungmon athaneina aumsah ahi.
25.3: Koipen in avan sepai ho asim thei dingham? Akhovah chun leiset chung pumpi asalvah hilou ham?
25.4: Thithei mihem hi Pathen masanga nolna bei a um thei ding ham? Numeija konna pengdoh mihem hi thengsel thei ding ham?
25.5: Pathen hi lhathah sanga loupijo ahin ahshi ho sangin jong aha vah joi.
25.6: Tekah pi dingin mihem tehi than tobangbep ahi. Eihohi than ho sanga lhasam jo ihiuve.

26.1: Hichun Job in thu aseikit in:
26.2: Thabei chu nangin iti nana kithopi ham? Atha lhasam chu iti naki thopi ham?
26.3: Kangolna hi iti nahetdoh sah thei ding ham? Ipi chihna chu neihil khah em?
26.4: Hitobang chihna thusei hohi hoiya nakilah ham? Koi lhagauvin nanga konna thu asei ham?
26.6: Pathen masanga chun noimigam jong akeu ahi, manthahna mun chu akihol doh tai.
26.7: Pathenin van sahlang kai chu onghom laiya ahin khang doh in chule leiset chu imacha umlouna ah akhaije.
26.8: Aman go chu meilhang satah in atom in chule agih a chun apohkeh dehpoi.
26.9: Aman lha chu amai atompeh in ameilhang ho a chun akhumin ahi.
26.10: Aman leisetna konna twi achom khenna chu kolmong ana semdoh ahi. Sunle jan gamgi asempeh ahi.
26.11: Van khombul ho akiling in aman asapset teng akithing tuntun jin ahi.
26.12: Ama thahat in twikhang len thipchet in aumin athilbol theina in twikhanglen'a ganhing len chu asuhchip ahi.
26.13: Alhagauva vanho hoitah a asem ahi. Athaneina a gulpi kilap lele chu asutpai ahi.
26.14: Athilbol ho lah a hicheho hi akipatna mai mai bou ahi nalaije. Athilboltheina husa mai mai bou ahin kon hitia chu van kithin thahatna chu ahet thei ding ham?

27.1: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
27.2: Kathaneina eilah mang peh pa Pathen a kihahselna kaneijin kalhagao eisuhnatpeh Hatchungnung pachu,
27.3: Pathen a konna haina hu kaneija kahai laisung sea,
27.4: Kakama thuse kasei lou ding chuleh kalei jin jong thujou sei ponge.
27.5: Keiman nadihna kapom peh louhel ding ahi, kathi chan geija lung thengsel'a kaum na hi kahuh jing ding ahi.
27.6: Keiman nolnabei kahina hi lhaso louhela katuhchah jing ding kahin lai sung sea ka selepha hetna hi thengsel ah ahi.
27.7: Kamelma pachu migiloupa bangin kigim bolhen, kamelma te jong miphalou ho tobang hiuhen.
27.8: Pathenin asatlhah tengule Pathen neilou ten ipi kinepna anei nahlai diu ham? Chuleh ahinkhou akilah mang teng leh,
27.9: Hahsatna achung'uva ahunglhun tengle Pathenin akanau angai peh dem?
27.10: Hatchungnung pa komma kipana akimu diu hinam? Itih phat hijongle Pathen ahou thei diu ham?
27.11: Pathen thahatna chu keiman kahil ding nahi. Keiman Hatchungnung pa chungchang thu imacha im kanei lou ding ahi.
27.12: Hicheng ho jouse hi namusoh ahitan ahivangin pannabei thu jeng kakomah nasei nalaije.
27.13: Migilouvin Pathen komma konna amu ding chu hiche hi ahi, Hatchungnung pa a konna agou chan diu chu hiche hi ahi.
27.14: Chate tamtah nei maithei unte, ahinlah achateu chu gal kidouna ahiloule an ngolla thidiu ahi.
27.15: Ahingdoh nalai ho chu gamna hise a thidiu, chule ameithai hou jeng in jong apul u adou lou diu ahi.
27.16: Miphalou ten sum alom lomin nei maithei untin chule ponsil lhemlhung bangin sevum maithei unte.
27.17: Ahinlah hiche ponsil ho chu michonpha hon akivon diu chule nolna bei miho hiche sum chu kihom diu ahi.
27.18: Migilou hon mompan banga se baijin in kisah untin, thingbah kanga kisa bangin paset in kisah unte.
27.19: Migiloupa chu alupna ah hausa tah in chen tin ahin ahung khah doh teng anei jouse ana beisoh amu ding ahi.
27.20: Kichat nan twisoh bangin vuh khum untin chuleh amaho chu janna khopi hui nung chun amut mang tauve.
27.21: Solam hui chun amaho apomang un chule amaho chu achemang a kitheh anga hi tauve.
27.22: Dipdapna neilouvin apei lhu uvin, hiche thaneina a konna jamdohna ding akiha bol uve.
27.23: Ahinlah mijousen anuisat u chu iman agel pouve.

28.1: Mihem ten dangka kilaidohna aheuvin, chule iti kilhit theng ding ham ti aheuve.
28.2: Leisetna konna thih kilaidohna ding mun aheuvin, songpi a konna sum eng sontwi je aheuve.
28.3: Chule leiset a gambeh gamla pen pen jong akhol doh uvin, thih ahol nau muthim lah a khovah sah je aheuve.
28.4: Mihem ho chenna a kon gamla tah a leiset a kokhuh avut un, khaovin akumsuh uvin anung leh ama ah akivol leuve.
28.5: Neh le chah hi leiset chunga kitu ahin, ahinlah anoi langa leiset hi meiya kihal jun ji ahi.
28.6: Hiche a songho lah a chu songval mantam tah um ahin, chuleh leivui lah a chu sana umah ahi.
28.7: Hiche gou hohi chunga leng hingne hon jong amu theilou, chule vacha neo mit in jong amutheilou ahi.
28.8: Hiche gou ho chunga hi gamsa ho jengin jong ajot khah louhel ahin, keipi bahkai jengin jong atin a akhoi khah louhel ahi.
28.9: Mihem in songgel song keh soje aheuvin chuleh mol lekhup je jong aheuve.
28.10: Amahon songpi lah a kohom avut un chuleh song mantam manlu tah tah ho chu aladoh uve.
28.11: Valha chet chut a long luidung ating tan jiuvin chuleh akiselguh gou jouse khovah a ahin polut jiuve.
28.12: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya kimudoh ding ham ti ahet uvem? Thilhet khen theina hi hoiya amu thei diuvem?
28.13: Hoiya kimu ham ti koima chan ahepoi, ijeh inem itile hichehi mihing gamsunga kimulou ahi.
28.14: Hiche ah aumpoi tin twikhanglen in aseijin Twipi thuhtah in jong keikomma aumpoi ati.
28.15: Chihna chu sana a choh thei ahipon, dangka a choh thei jong ahipoi.
28.16: Ophir am asana jouse sanga jong manlu jo ahin, manlu tah onyx leh songval sanga jong thupi jo nalai ahi.
28.17: Chihna hi sana leh songval sanga mantam jo ahin, song mantam kijepna chung sana hoitah chonga jong choh thei hilou ahi.
28.18: Chihna chohna dingin coral leh jesper songmantam teni jong hi phachom lou ahin, chihna man ding chu hiche song mantam sang sanga jong sangjo nalai ahi.
28.19: Ethopia gam'a song mantam Peridot tojong lhet thei hilou ahin, sana theng pen pen sanga jong manlu jo ahi.
28.20: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya konna kimuthei ding ham ti ahe thei diuvem? Thil hettheina hi hoiya amu diu ham?
28.21: Mihem te mitmu a konin akisel tan chung leng vacha mit hat pen in jong amu doh joulou ahi.
28.22: Manthah nale thinan asei lhonin keinin jong chihna hi hoiya kimu ding ham tithu kithang bou kaja lhone.
28.23: Pathen ama changseh in bou chihna lampi hoiya kimu ding ham ti ahet ahi.
28.24: Ijeh inem itile aman leiset chung hi apumpia avet ji ahin, vannoija thil umjouse hi amusoh kei ahi.
28.25: Aman hui ichan hat a nunsah ding chule go ichan a juhsah ding ti agel lhuh sa ahi.
28.26: Aman gojuh ding dan asempeh in chule kolphe vahna ding lampi asempeh e.
28.27: Hiti chun aman chihna chu ana mun chule manlu tah ahi, ahin munkhat ah akoiyin hoitah in akhol chiljin ahi.
28.28: Chule aman mihem te jah a asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakai gin kiti hi chihna chu ahin, thilse a konna kiheidoh kiti hi thil hetkhen theina chu ahi.

29.1: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
29.2: Pathenin eina chin hoi jing lai kum chemangsa ho kagel doh kit e.
29.3: Kamasang lampi eivah peh a muthim lah a bitsel a kana vale lai.
29.4: Pathen toh golcha a ka in a apansah lai, aluboh pen a kapan lai chu hileh.
29.5: Hatchungnung pachu kakoma aum jing lai, chuleh kachate kakimvel a anaum laijin,
29.6: Kabongpi ten bongnoi ninglhing set a asosah thei laiju chuleh kahon na keh hon olive thao alondoh sah laiju chu hileh.
29.7: Khopi kelkot phung kajot a ja um tahtah le lamkai len leh lalte ho toh katou khomle lai nikho ho chu hileh,
29.8: Khangdong hon eimu teng ule eipel doh jiuva upa tehseho jengin jong akoma kahung tengle jana neitah a adindoh ji laiju.
29.9: Leng chapate jong thipbeh a aum uva chule akam uva akhut u akoi uva.
29.10: Khopi sung vaipo lenpen pen ho thipchet a adin uva jabolna a adin uva aleiju atuh chahkheh uva.
29.11: Kathu japha ho jousen eipahcha uvin, eimu kha jousen phatechan eihoupi jiuve.
29.12: Ijeh inem itile mivaicha ten angaichat nau leh chagate kithopina ngaicha ho chu kakithopi jin ahi.
29.13: Keiman kinepna beimi ho chu kaki thopin ahile amahon phatthei eiboh jiuve, chule meithai ho lungthim kakipa doh sah jin, chuteng amahon la asajiuve.
29.14: Kabol jouse chu lungtheng sellin kabol in chonphat nan sangkhol chol bangin eikhu khume, chule thutan dihna chu lukop bangin kakikop e.
29.15: Mitcho ho din mitchang tenin kapang in, chule elbai ho din akeng tenin kapange.
29.16: Chaga pabeite din mipan kapang in chuleh het khahlou hel miho jong kithopi angaichat nau vah kapanpi ji e.
29.17: Keiman Pathen neilou mi engse ho ha kasuhbal peh jin, chuleh gimbol a um chu aha a konin kasalhah peh ji'e.
29.18: Hinkho pha sautah kahin man nung hin tahbeh mongin kathi tengle kainko ten eikimvel unte tin kana gel’e.
29.19: Ijeh inem itile, thingphung ajung hon twi lah aphah a abah ho daitwi in achap nou jing tobang kahi.
29.20: Jabolna thah thah kachunga kilong louhel in eikipe jing jin, chuleh kathahatna jong tang louhel in akibelap jinge.
29.21: Amichang cheh in kathumopna angaijun kathusei ding hi amahon thipchet in angah uve.
29.22: Chuleh kasei chai tengle amahon belap ding anei ji pouve, Kathumop chun amaho alung lhai sah jeh u chun.
29.23: Mihem ten gojuh ding kinem tah a anga jing bangun amahon kathusei ding kinem tah in angah jiuvin, kathusei ho chu chavang gotwi bangin adon uve.
29.24: Amaho alunglhah teng uleh ken amaho chu nuiseuvin kave jin ahileh mailhai sel a kavet chu amaho a din manlu tah ahiji.
29.25: Haosapu bangin amahon atoh diu kaseipeh in sepai hon lah a chun lengpa bangin kacheng in chuleh lengvai ho kalhamon jin ahi.

30.1: Ahinlah tun vang apateu kelngoi chinga pang kauicha ho toh lhaikhom dinga jong lhing joulou mihem, kasanga dong jo golhang khangdong ho nuisat bep in kaum doh tai.
30.2: Amaho khu keija dinga tamtah'a pha ahiuvin, hiche ho chu von sesa lungset um ahiuve.
30.3: Amaho chu akel thoh jeh uva gong ahiuvin, chuleh nel phai gam mihem chen louna leh gaso talou leiset muthim gam'a chu jam ah ahiuve.
30.4: Hiti chun amahon hamboh lah a konin gamlah a na eng ho chu akilo uvin chuleh muntheh phung jung ho chu akilah un anejiuve.
30.5: Amaho chu mihem kiloikhom na a konna kidel mangah ahiuvin, chuleh gucha ahijeh uvin mihem ten amaho chu asamse jiuvin ahi.
30.6: Hiti chun gom kokhuh thuhtah tah lah a timul thou pumin leiko lah leh songpi ho lah a chun ching uve.
30.7: Amaho chu hamboh lah a sa loupitah a aum bangun a ao chehchuh jiuvin thahpi ho noija chun alhaikhom jiuve.
30.8: Amaho chu kiloikhomna a kon kipaidoh mingol minbeiho ahiuve.
30.9: Chuleh tun amahon pao ngeilou louvin isah loutah in einuisat jiuvin eiphin phin jiuve.
30.10: Amahon iman eisep pouvin chuleh kamaija chil set khumpeh ding tailouvin kakomah ahung pouve.
30.11: Ijeh inem itile Pathenin kathal khao eisattan peh in aman eisuhnem ahin, hijeh a chu thuneina umnaho jouse chu apaimang u ahi.
30.12: Hiche akideldoh ho chun kamaichang tah a eidoudal un, kilhon changnam pet dingin eisol un chuleh kalampi ah thang eikampeh uve.
30.13: Amahon kalamlhah jouse eikha peh un chule keiman eikithopi ding koimacha kaneilou ahet jeh uvin eisuhmang nathei diuvin abolthei jouseu abol'un ahi.
30.14: Amaho muntinna konin kakomah ahungun keima kalhah suh pet in amaho kachungah akichom uve.
30.15: Tun vang kicha tah in kahingin eikijabol najouse huilah a akithe mangin kanei leh kagou jouse meilhang kitol mang bangin amangthah soh tai.
30.16: Chuleh tua hi kahinkho along mang ahitan, kanikho ho jong genthei hesoh nan eihen den tai.
30.17: Jan teng kagu kachang ho natnan alodim jin hichun tang louhel in eichip eichip ji'e.
30.18: Khuthat tah in Pathenin ka sangkhol eilah peh in ka sangkhol ngong ah eimanchah kheh in ahi.
30.19: Aman bonlhoh lah a eisep lut in keima hi leivui leh vutvam sanga jong panna beijo kahi.
30.20: Nahenga hung tao kahi O Pathen, ahinlah nangin nei donbut pon, namasang a ding kahin, ahin nangin vet ding'in jong neigo poi.
30.21: Keija dinga lungsetna beihel nahung hitai. Nathahat na chu kei engbol nan namange.
30.22: Nangin chimpei lah a neisep lut in chuleh huipi kinong in nei sumange.
30.23: Chuleh nangin mihing jouse lhunna kathina ding munna chu neisol ahi ti kahei.
30.24: Tahbeh mongin genthei hahsatna a kithopi ngaicha ahung tao tengule koima cha hiche genthei thoh ho lang ngan kihei pouvinte.
30.25: Hahsatna toh ho dinga kapji kahi lou ham? Vaicha genthei tedinga nasatah a ka genthei pi ji hilou ham?
30.26: Hijeh chun thilpha kave jin ahinlah hiche sang chun thilphalou joh chu ahung jin ahi.
30.27: Kalungthim agentheijin chuleh cholngahna kanei theipoi. Kagentheina nikho te hin eisu genthei lheh e.
30.28: Nisavah umlouna muthim lah a kavah len mipi kigol toh chet lah a kadingin kithopi ngaichan kakap e.
30.29: Hiche ho khellin keima gam-ui sopipa simbupi toh kikoppan eiki ngaiton ahi.
30.30: Kavun ho aduplha soh tan chule kagu kachang ho jouse khosih in kati apeh henhun e.
30.31: Ka selangdah gin in jong lungkham la ahin sa in katheile gin jong kana ogin in aginge.

31.1: Keiman kamit teni toh kigahna kasem in khangdong numei chu jon lunga vet lou dingin,
31.2: Ijeh inem itile chunga Pathen chun eiho ipi dinga eilhen u ham? Chungsang a um hatchungnung pa a konna goulo ding chu ipi ham?
31.3: Migiloute dinga vangsetna hilou hija chule thilphalou bolte dinga vangset umtah dinmun chu hilou ham?
31.4: Pathenin kabol katoh jouse amulou hija chuleh kakalse jat jong ahet hilou ham?
31.5: Mikhat tou koma jou kasei khah a chuleh mikhat tou kalhep khah em?
31.6: Thudih kitena chun Pathenin eitetoh hen, ijeh inem itile aman kalung thenna hi ahet ahi.
31.7: Alamlhah a konna ahilouva ijem tia kamu ji ho a kalungthim jon lung ngaichatna kanei khah a ahiloule chonsetna dang khat a themmona kanei khah a ahile,
31.8: Hiti chun mikhat touvin hange mim kaphu na ana nejeng hen, kaphu doh chengse abonchan kibotdoh soh jeng hen.
31.9: Ijem tia kalungthim in numei khat tou alheplhah a ahiloule ka inheng pa jinu jon lunga kavet khah a ahile,
31.10: Chuti chun kajinu jong pasal dang ji hijeng hen, pasal dang khat in luppi jeng hen.
31.11: Ijeh inem itile jon lung put hi jachat umtah chonset ahi, hiche dandih louva chon ho chu gimbol dinga lha ahi.
31.12: Hichu damun lampi lhung keija meiyin akah tobang ahin, kanei jouse kamang hel ding ahi.
31.13: Ijemtia kasohpa ham kasoh numei adih louva kabolla ahileh amahon akiphin nau kakoma ahinlhut teng uleh,
31.14: Pathen chu iti kakimaito pi ding hitam? Aman thu eihin doh teng ipi kasei tadem?
31.15: Ajeh chu Pathenin kei leh kasoh te kaniuva eisem kop u ahi.
31.16: Vaichate panpi ding kada khah a ahiloule meithai ho kinepna kasuh keh peh khah em?
31.17: Ka anneh chunga kachip khah a chaga pabeite toh nehkhom ding kada khah em?
31.18: Ahipoi, mipa khat bangin, kaneo laiya pat in chagate kahin hoitup in chule kahinkho lhumin meithaite hoitup nan kahin mange.
31.19: Itih lai hijongle chenna ding neilou ponbeija umho chule von ding neilou gentheiho kamu tengle
31.20: Akisillum diuva samul pon kapeh ji jeh a eipachat jiu hilou ham?
31.21: Thutanpa kalanga apan nadinga chaga khat douna a kakhut kadop khah a ahile,
31.22: Hiti chun kalengkou aumna a konin kisatlha jeng hen, kaban jang jong akisuhto na a konin kisatlha jeng hen.
31.23: Hichu Pathen thutanna kimaitopi sangin phajonte, ijemtia oupe Pathen chun einan chahkheh a ahile kinepna ipi kanei ding ham?
31.24: Keiman katahsanna summa kakoi khah a ahile, ahiloule kasana a hi kakison khah a ahile,
31.25: Kanei kagou jouse leh kakhol khom jouse jeh a kipah a kahile,
31.26: Vantham jol ho a vahpel a vah nisa leh lha alampia chesuh khu kavet a,
31.27: Chuleh aguh a kalungthim kalheplhah a amaho houna kaga galchop khah a ahile,
31.28: Achuti tah a ahile thutan vaihom hon eigim bol uhen, chuti chu ahi tah leh van Pathen thusei kangaipeh lou hiding tina ahi.
31.29: Kamelma techu manthah nan ahin phah tenga ahiloule alampiuva hahsatna ahung tengle, hetnom ten tena aum jeh uva kipah kahile,
31.30: Ahipoi, keiman mikhat tou kaspset a, ahiloule phulah ding kasei kha pon, hitobang chonsetna hi kabol khapoi.
31.31: Kasoh pan jong adangho chu gilkel in kachesah tai tin asei khapoi.
31.32: Hetkhah lou mi jong kakihei mangsan kha pon, ahinlah mijouse din kot kahonpeh ji bouve.
31.33: Midangho banga ken kachonsetna selmang ding kagot a, kasuhkhel kalung thima ka imden khah ham?
31.34: Mipiho kakichatna ahiloule kikhop khom naho kadeimo a hiche ho jeh a chu thipbeh a insunga kaum den khah ham?
31.35: Mikhat tou beh in kathusei eingai peh hen lang hileh ven kakihonna dinga kamin soi kakai ding ahi. Hatchungnungpa chun eidonbut hen lang eiheh pan kei douna thu sundoh hen.
31.36: Keiman themmo eichan sah nau chu kiloupi sah tah a kaki maitopi ding lallukhuh banga kakikhuh ding ahi.
31.37: Ijeh inem itile keiman kathilbol adihtah chu kaseipeh ding ahin, ama masanga chu leng chapate banga kahung ding ahi.
31.38: Kagam in themmo eichansah khah tah a tucha maha jouse kitoh tah a ahung ka soh keijuva,
31.39: Ahilouva achang leh mim kana guh khah a ahiloule anei ho kana tha khah tah a ahile,
31.40: Chuti chun gehu khellin ling leh khau agama chun keh henlang, chang khellin hampa keh hen. Job thusei ho akichaitai.

32.1: Job in nolna bei kahi tia apanchah kheh phat in aloi agolte thumho chun donbut be ding anom tapouve.
32.2: Hichun Ram phunga Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihu chu ahung lunghang tai. Job in chonset kana bol nai chuleh Pathenin eigim bolna hi adih e ti ding anop lou jeh a lunghangah ahi.
32.3: Job in anel nau adonbut thei uva Pathen joh chu dihmo dinga akilah jeh uva Job loile golte thum chunga jong kinga ahi.
32.4: Elihun adangho Job koma thu asei diu chu anga nga jeng ahi. Ijeh inem itile amaho chu ama sanga upajo ahiuve.
32.5: Ahinlah amahon adonbut be tahlou u amu phat in lunghang tah in ahung paodoh e.
32.6: Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihun aseitai. Keima khangdong kahin nangho upa nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nangho komma kalunggel kasei ding chu kakhongai ahi.
32.7: Keigel in ateh jep hon thu seiju hen, ijeh inem itile upa ho a hi chihna hung ahi.
32.8: Ahin mihem te sunga chu lhagao um ahi. Hatchungnungpa hu haikhuma amaho sunga um hiche chun achihsah u ahi.
32.9: Phatkhat tengle upa ho jong aching ji pouve. Khatvei vei teng thutan dihje ahe pouve.
32.10: Hijeh chun kasei ngaijun chuleh kalunggel seipeh uvinge.
32.11: Keiman nang thusei phat hitih chan sung hin kahin ngah in nakinel nahou lunglut tah in kahin ngaijin, khomulouva nathusei doh hou kangaije.
32.12: Nathusei hou kangaije, ahin khat chan jong nanel thei pouve. Ahiloule aminelna nadonbut thei pouve.
32.13: Amapa hi eiho dingin aching beh seh e, Pathen bouvin ama ajo ding ahi tin kakoma sei hih un.
32.14: Job chun keima einel hihen hileh nanghon namanchah u hettheina bangin donbut ponge.
32.15: Seibe ding helouva lunggimma tou nahiuve.
32.16: Tua nangho thipbeh a naum bang uva hi ken kanga nga nahlai dingu ham? Keijong thipbeh a kaum jing ding ham?
32.17: Ahipoi halkhat beh kaseija kalunggel kasei ding ahi.
32.18: Ijeh inem itile, kalung in adol joulou thu cheng tampi ho seidoh hi kasunga ka lhagaovin seidoh dingin eino tuntun e.
32.19: Keima ahom umlou jubom tobang kahin, jupohna thah pohkeh ding sa tobang kahi.
32.20: Kalung ol theina dinga kasei ding ahi. Hijeh chun ka donbutna penge.
32.21: Kadei tah in jong kichem ponge, ahiloule koimacha pachat lhem bol ponge.
32.22: Keiman joulhep ding kagot a ahile eisempan gangtah in eisumang jeng hen.

33.1: Job kathusei hohi ngaijin, kathusei dingho hi lunglut in ngaijin.
33.2: Tun kathusei hitihin pan kit ing ting banjom tange.
33.3: Kasei jouse hi lung thengsel'a kasei ahin, thutah kasei ahi.
33.4: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lhagauvin eina sem ahi. Chuleh Hatchungnung pa hu haikhumin kahinna hi eipeh ahi.
33.5: Naki ngachat leh nei donbut in, nachung chang thu kisem toh'in, chuleh nadin namun ah dingin.
33.6: Ven nang leh kei inia Pathen a ihicheh e. Keijong leingan a ana kisem ah kahi.
33.7: Hijeh a chu kei neikichat nading aumpoi, huham tah a kahung kumsuh lou ding ahi.
33.8: Nangin kajah ding thu naseisa ahitan, chule nathusei ho achang cheh a kajah ahi.
33.9: Nangin keima kathengin, kei chonsetna bei kahi, kei nolna bei themmona kaneipoi tin naseije.
33.10: Pathenin eikinah pin chuleh amelma in eingaito e.
33.11: Kakeng teni khaokol sung ei chotlut sah in chuleh kakholhahna jouse amelchih e.
33.12: Ahinlah nang nadih poi, chuleh ipi jeh ham ti navet sah inge. Ijeh inem itile miching ho sanga oupe jo ahi.
33.13: Ijeh inem itile ipi dinga nadouna a nanokhum ham? Ipi dinga aman mihem te kiphinna adonbut poi nati ham?
33.14: Ijeh inem itile mihem ten ahet theilou vanga Pathenin avel vel'a asei ahitai.
33.15: Janmanga ahim, muneina ahim a mihemte ha imut a aimut pet u, ajalkhun chunga alup pet uva aman aseipeh u ahi.
33.16: Aman anabeng tenia ol chakhat in aseije, chule kichat tijatna a agih ji ahi.
33.17: Athilse bolnau va konna akinungle sah ji a, akiletsah nau alahmang ji ahi.
33.18: Lhankhuh a konna ahuhdoh a thina lui agal kai diuva jong ahuhdoh jiu ahi.
33.19: Ahiloule Pathenin mihem tehi dammona jalkhun chunga natle sat toh tang louhel a agu achangin achi a hitia hi asuhdih ji ahi.
33.20: Chuteng leh amahon anneh twipen pen jong aduchatna mang ji ahitai.
33.21: Amaho tahsa agongsuh tan chule agu achang aki langdoh soh tai.
33.22: Amaho chu thina kotkhah gei ahitauvin, thina vantil chun amaho ana nga jiu ahitai.
33.23: Ahinlah vantil khat vanna kon in hung kilang hen, thupole chombeh khat chun mikhat dingin tao peh hen, chuleh amapa hi lungthengsel ahina phongdoh henlang,
33.24: Amapa chu milungset them hihen lang, lhankhuh a konin huhdoh tauvin, ijeh inem itile keiman ahinkhou kilhatdoh na man ding chu kamutai tin seihen hileh,
33.25: Chutileh atahsa chu chapang tahsa dehchet leh khangdong lai phat bangin hung damthei kit inte.
33.26: Pathen komma atau tengleh amachu kisan peh ding ahi. Chule Pathenin kipah in sang intin, chule adinmun hoitah in koi kit inte.
33.27: Amapan aloi agolte komma phongdoh intin keima kachonse tai chule thutah adihlou lamin kaheijin ahinlah hichu phatchomna bei ahi.
33.28: Pathenin lhankhuh a konin eihuhdoh in chule tun kahinkho hi avahdoh tai.
33.29: Henge, Pathenin hitobang thil hohi avel vella mihem tedinga abolji ahi.
33.30: Aman amaho chu lhankhuh a konin ahuhdoh in hijeh chun amaho chu hinna khovah a chun kipah tauvinte.
33.31: Job hiche hi phatechan melchih in, kathusei hi ngaijin. Ijeh inem itile keiman seiding kahaove.
33.32: Ahinlah seibe ding nanei nahlaija ahile seiben, seijin, ijeh inem itile keiman nathem channa chu mukal ngahlel a um kahi.
33.33: Chuti chu ahilouva ahile kathusei ngaijin, thipbeh chan um jingin, keiman chihna thu nahil inge.

34.2: Miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, chihna themna neihon phatechan hin ngai uvin.
34.3: Ngaijuvin kam’in antwi leh twilou ahet khen bangin bilkol in jong thucheng ajah jouse hi apatep jin ahi, tin Job in aseije.
34.4: Ipihi adih ham ti eima cheh a din hekhen u hitin, ipi hi thilpha ham ti kihilkhom sohkei uhite.
34.5: Hijeh chun Job in jong aseijin keima hi nolna bei kahin ahinlah Pathenin kathusei eilah mang peh tai.
34.6: Keima nolnabei kahin ahinlah amahon mijou eitiuve. Kachonset lou vang'in kathoh gimna hi jendam thei ahipoi.
34.7: Dang goleuva daichat vaina leh nuisatna thoh jing Job tobang mi aum kha dem? Neiseipeh tem uvin.
34.8: Amapan kalhat khompi dingin thilse bolte alhengin aphat ho jouse migiloute toh amang khom e.
34.9: Ipi dinga Pathen lunghol na a phat jouse namoh manchai ding ham ti chanin amapan aseije.
34.10: Thilhet khen themna neihon ngaijuvin kathusei hi, Pathenin chonset abolpoi ti mi jousen ahet ahin, hatchungnungpa chun thil dihlou aboltheipoi.
34.11: Aman mihem hi atoh dungjui cheh a lethuhna apeh ji ahin, aman mihemte hi achonna dungjui a alethuh ji ahi.
34.12: Tahbeh mongin Pathenin thil dihlou abol louhel ding ahi. Hatchungnung pa chun thudoh chu aheimang lou ding ahi.
34.13: Mihem khat touvin leiset pumpi hi athu noija akoi khah em? Leiset pumpi hi kitup chetna koipen in akoi ham?
34.14: Pathen chun alhagao ana kinunglah khat tou hihen chuleh ahaina hu chu akinung lah hitaleh,
34.15: Hinkho jouse kichai ding ahitan, chule mihingte jouse hi leivui soh kit ding ahitai.
34.16: Tun miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, ipi kasei lunglut tah in ngai uvin.
34.17: Thudih deilouva Pathenin vai ahom ding ham? Hatchungnungpa thutan hum o nachan ding ham?
34.18: Ijeh inem itile aman leng ho jah a nang hi migilou nahin chuleh milen milal pa komah nanghi langnei nahi tin aseije.
34.19: Aman mihem chu itobangin oupe jongle iman agelpon chuleh mivaichapa sangin mihausa pachu akhohsah chompoi, aboncha ama khutsem ahi cheh e.
34.20: Mitphet kah louvin athi theijin, jankim lai teng jongle amangthah jiuvin, mithat hatpa jong chu mihem khat pang louvin akisumang jitai.
34.21: Ijeh inem itile Pathenin mihem tehi iti hin ham ti ave jingin, athilbolu amusoh keije.
34.22: Migiloupa kiselna ding chun muthim jong ama mitmun kiselna din alhing joupoi.
34.23: Pathen thutanna'a itih le idin diu ham ti eihon, gonsan ikoi pouve.
34.24: Aman mihat pachu koimacha dong louhel in asumang jin, chule ama munna chu adang khat atung doh ji'e.
34.25: Aman ipi abol'u ahet ahin, chuleh jan tengle alehkhup in chuleh asumang jitai.
34.26: Aman agitlou jeh uvin ajeplhu jin mijouse mu thei dingle ima jousen amu theidin abol ji'e.
34.27: Ijeh inem itile, ama nung ajui nauva konin akihei mangun alampi jeng jong donlouvin akoi tauve.
34.28: Amahon mivaichate chu aka sah un, akanau chu Pathen koma alhunge. Pathenin mi gentheite kana ho ajahpeh jin ahi.
34.29: Ahinlah ama chun thipbeh a um ding chu lheng jo tahen lang hileh kon amachu themmo achan thei ding ham? Aman amai aselmang teng mikhat ham ahiloule namkhat hijeng jongle koiman aholdoh joupoi.
34.30: Mihemte thanga a o louna diuvin aman Pathen neiloute vaihomin apansah jipoi.
34.31: Kachonse tai, ahin chonset bolkit taponge tia mihem ten ipi dinga Pathen koma aseikit jilou u ham?
34.32: Ahiloule ipi thilse kabol kahekha poi neisei peh in thilse kabol aum khah leh tutah hin ngai jeng inge.
34.33: Nathum najeh a chu Pathenin athudih nachu asemphat ding ham? Ijeh inem itile nangin ama chu napaidoh sa ahin, akilhen ding chu nang nahin, kei kahipoi, sei jomin lang nachihna chu keiho komma phong doh in.
34.34: Hicheng jou nungin milungval hon eiseipeh untin chuleh miching hon kathusei ngai uvinte.
34.35: Job in hetoh louva asei ahin, athucheng ho chu agilpoi.
34.36: Job migilou thuseija nathusei jeh a akhonna leh nachung thu kitan ding nakikhol khom ahi.
34.37: Ijeh inem itile nangin nachonset na chunga doumah nabol ben, nangin Pathen dounan lunghanna thu nasei lelen, jabolna nanei tapoi.

35.2: Pathen masanga keima hi chonpha kahi tia sei ding hi dih nakisah ham?
35.3: Ijeh inem itile, chonphatna a hinkho aman hi ipi phatchomna kaneijem? Keija dinga phachom ipi um'em? tinjong nasei ji'e.
35.4: Ken nadonbut ing ting chuleh naloi nagolho jousen jong na donbut uhen.
35.5: Van thamjol khu ven lang, chule nachung langa meilhang ho khu ven.
35.6: Chonset bol ta le chun Pathen ichan geijin asuna dem? Avel vel in chonse ta le chun ama lungthim ichan gei asukha dem?
35.7: Chonphat bol hile chun ama a dinga thilpeh loupi khat ahidem? Ama chu ipi nape tadem?
35.8: Ahipoi nang chonset chun nangma tobang mihem ho chun adoulel ahin, chule nathilpha bol jong chun mihem mama aphatchom pi sah ahi.
35.9: Mihem techu bol gentheija aum teng ule apeng jah jeng jiuvin, mithahat thaneina noija chun apeng peng jiuve.
35.10: Jan laileh la a hin saji pa eisempau Pathen chun hoiya umham ti jeng jong nadong kha pouve.
35.11: Ganchate sanga hoijo a eisem pau leh chunga leng vachate sanga chingjo a eisem pau chu hoiya umham?
35.12: Chule mihemte chu akiletsah jeh uvin aka teng uleh Pathenin adonbut jipoi.
35.13: Ahinlah Pathenin ajah peh pouvin hatchungnung pa chun ngaisah in aneipoi tia seiding chu dihlou ahi.
35.14: Nangin kamu theipoi tin naseije, ahinlah nanga hat le bou thudih chu hungdoh ding ahi.
35.15: Nangin michonse ho chu lunghang in alethuhpoi natin chule migiloute ngaisah in aneipoi tin naseije.
35.16: Ahinlah Job nangin thu homkeu jeng naseiyin, mingol khat bangin thu naseije.

36.2: Thutah muchet sah ding kanei nahlai jeh in seibe kit nalai inge, ijeh inem itile Pathen thalhenga seiding kanei nalaije.
36.3: Keiman eisempa chonphatna thu giltah a nelna kapeh ding ahi.
36.4: Keima hetna bukim nei kahi jeh in thutah tailou thudang imacha keiman kaseipoi.
36.5: Pathen chu hatchungnung pa ahin, ahinlah aman koima isah louvin abolpoi. Ama chu thanei naleh thil hetkhen themna akopto a hatchungnung pa ahi.
36.6: Aman migilou ahinghoi jipon, ahinlah suhgentheija umho chu them achan ji'e.
36.7: Aman nolna bei miho a konin amit ahei mang ngaipoi, ahinlah laltouna a leng ho toh atoukhom sah jin chuleh aimatih channa din achoisang ji'e.
36.8: Thihkol a ana kihen hihen lang chuleh gentheina a chu kha ana hijong leu,
36.9: Aman akiletsah nau amuchet sah jin, chuleh achonset nau avetsah ji'e.
36.10: Alungthim u alahmang peh in, chule thilse a konna akilehei nadiu thupeh apejin ahi.
36.11: Amahon thu ngaiju hen, chuleh athusei ngaipeh ule ahinkho lhum kei uva khantouna jousea phatthei kiboh diu ahi.
36.12: Ahinlah athusei ngai ding anoplou uleh amaho chemjam a kithat ding ahin, chuleh hetna lhahsam jeh a thidiu ahi.
36.13: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu lunghan nan adimset un, aman a engbol teng u jongle nei kithopiuvin tia kou ding chu anom ji pouve.
36.14: Ahinkhou chonchatvai na a aman jou nung uleh khangdong cha chan athijiuvin ahi.
36.15: Ahinlah agenthei thoh jeh u chun aman ahuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ijeh inem itile agenthei nauva kon thungaije ahiljin ahi.
36.16: Job Pathenin vangsetna ho a konin napui doh in lungnat naho a konin ongthol tah in nahoijin, nadokhang chungah anpha pha nalui doh peh e.
36.17: Ahinlah nangin Pathen neiloute thu kitan ding kichat nan nadim in, lungkham hih in thutanna leh thudih'a thutanna chu machal jing ding ahi.
36.18: Ahin kivephan, achuti louleh nei le gou vin nalhem lha khantin nehguh kilah jeh in nang leh nang chonse hih in.
36.19: Nanei leh nagou ahiloule thahattah'a nakihabol naho chun lung gentheina jouse a konna nahoidoh jou ding hinam?
36.20: Jan hunglhun kal ngahlel hih in, ijeh inem itile hichu mihem te kisuhmang nading jan ahibouve.
36.21: Kiging phan thilse a konin kileheijin, chonsetna hinkho a konna nahoidoh nadinga Pathenin hiche gentheina hohi ahin lhunsah ahi.
36.22: Ven Pathen hi thahat chungnung ahin ama tobang mihil thei ding koi um'em?
36.23: Koima chan hichehi nabol ding ahi atitheipon, ahilouleh nabolkhel tai tia seithei ding chu,
36.24: Hiche ho khel chun athil bolthei thahatna chu achoian un, vahchoina la ho asauve.
36.25: Gamla tah ahijeng vang'in hiche ho chu mijousen amucheh uve.
36.26: Ven Pathen hi eihon ihet sang uvin aloupi jon amakum ho chu sim jou hilou ahi.
36.27: Aman twi chu ahu in achop touvin chuleh chuti chun alhitheng in go asosah kit e.
36.28: Meilah a konin go ahin sung lhan, chuleh mi jousen aphatchom pi ji'e.
36.29: Meilom hung kijel ji khu kon ahet theija chule vanna vanging kithong jeju a akitol lele khu kon ahetdoh jou ding ham?
36.30: Ven ama kimvel a kolphe khu iti avahsah ji a, chule twikhanglen to geija avahsah khu iti ham?
36.31: Hiche athahat athil boltheina ho a hi mihem te avah khang ji a nehle chah neng jeng junga apeh ji ahi.
36.32: Aman akhut in keh chang aki choijin chuleh adoina laitah a chudin aseplha jin ahi.
36.33: Hiche van gin chun ahina aphondoh a huipi gopi chun alunghan alungsatna chu aphondoh ahi.

37.1: Hicheng hohi kagel ji teng ka lungchang aphudot dot jeng jin, kasung a hin akithing thing jin ahi.
37.2: Pathen kamsung'a konna hung doh a ogin thong khu phaten ngai uvin.
37.3: Van dung lhungin agin akitol in chuleh kolphe vah'in ningtin asalvah phan ahi.
37.4: Chuti chun huipi gopi kitum gin in alal loupina ogin nasatah in ahung in thu asei teng jongle akituh tang deh poi.
37.5: Pathen Ogin chu van gin in aloupisah in athahat aloupina chu eigel phah hoi ahipoi.
37.6: Aman buhbang leisetna longlha din thu apejin, go jong leiset chunga longlha din thu apeji e.
37.7: Chuteng leh mijousen anatoh u angan hiti chun athaneina chu ave jiuve.
37.8: Gam'a gamsa ho akikhu khum un chuleh akosung uvah aum den ji tauve.
37.9: A indan sunga kon in huipi gopi ahungin chuleh hiche a kon chun huidap ahung nunge.
37.10: Pathen hu haikhum chun buhbang lhang asosah in chuin twi chu atebep bep chun akan den sah jin ahi.
37.11: Meiho chu twi akhumdim jin chule kolphen avahsah ji'e.
37.12: Ama thusah a meilhang hohi kitol leleuva, leiset chunga hi aman thu apeh jouse aboljiu ahi.
37.13: Hicheng ho jouse hi mihem engbolna ham ahiloule tang theilou ngailutna vetsahna a abolji ahi.
37.14: Job hiche hi phaten ngaijin, Pathen natoh thilbol kidang tah tah ho ngaito din khongaijin.
37.15: Itobang tah a Pathenin huipi gopi athua anunsah a chule meilah a konna kolphe ahung vahdoh sah ji hi nahet em?
37.16: Akhut themna leh akidanna chamkim keija meilhang ho atolle le ji hi iti dan ham ti nahet doh jou ding ham?
37.17: Nangin na-ul naponna nakitheh tengle lhanglam hui hung nung intin chule thil ijakai thipchet in aum jitai.
37.18: Sum-eng phatvet bangin van thamjolla konin asa chu akikhodoh sah jin ahi, hichu nangin nabol the idem?
37.19: Hijeh chun Pathen komma ipi kasei diu ham? Keihon imacha hetna kanei pouve.
37.20: Pathenin akomma thu kasei nom hi eihet peh dem? Mihem te jengin jong thil ahetkhen theilou teng ule thu akisei thei diu ham?
37.21: Huijin meibolho amut theng soh tengleh vantham jol'a nisa khu avah behseh jeh in eihon ive thei ji pouve.
37.22: Pathen hi molsang a konna sana lal loupina a kijemma hung'ah ahin ama chu alal loupina leh ahoina jousea kijemma ahi.
37.23: Hatchungnungpa thahat naho chu ei ngaito phah hoi hilou ahi. Ahijeng vang'in athudih in chuleh achonpha jinge. Aman eiho eisumang pouve.
37.24: Datmo umtah in muntinna mihem ten ama aging uvin, miching ho jouse ajanau avetsah uve.

38.1: Chuti chun chimpei kipei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job chu ahin donbut tai:
38.2: Koi hiya hitobang hetna neilou chu chenga kachihna thu hin donga chu?
38.3: Pasal pha bangin nakong kigah in, ijeh inem itile keiman nangma thu kadoh ding nangin hiche ho chu nei donbut ding ahi.
38.4: Leiset bul kaphu a chu hoiya nana um'em? Nahet leh nei seipeh in.
38.5: Kon alet aneu dan aga te a chuleh ageigol hohi akaitoh ham?
38.6: Abul hi ipin atheh ham? Aninga songpi chu koi koiham?
38.7: Jingvalpa ten la asahkhom uva chuleh vantil jouse kipah a hung pengdoh diu ham?
38.8: Naobu sunga hung pengdoh banga twipihi gamgi chin kah khat sunga kon akoija?
38.9: Chuleh meibol ponsilla kakisil a chuleh muthim lhangkhal a kakitoma,
38.10: Ajeh chu vapam kasem peh a, anunga kotpi akhel louna dinga kakam khum ahi.
38.11: Hichan a gamla chule hisanga gamlajo a nahung louna dinga hiche mun a hi kiloupi sah tah a nakinon nangah ding ahi tin kaseije.
38.12: Jingkah khovah nadinga thu napeh khah a khovah jong solama konna hung kipan dinga nahil khah em?
38.13: Khovah hin leiset kolmang geija asalvah nadinga nasema, gitlouna jan muthim changei bou vah dinga nasem khah em?
38.14: Khovah ahung nai tengle leingan chunga mahor kinam bangin leiset jong agong ahung kilang doh jitai.
38.15: Khovah hin migiloute asunoh phah in chuleh kihat sah tah a kidom sang ban lhang jong asuhai tai.
38.16: Twipi hung lon doh patna twinah phung nagahol doh khah a hem? athuh dan nakhol doh khah hitam?
38.17: Thina kelkot hoiya um'em ti nahet khah ta hem? Muthim lhangkhal kihehna kelkot namu khah ta hem?
38.18: Leiset letdan nagel doh khah a hicheng chu nahet leh nei seipeh in.
38.19: Khovah hoiya konna hung kipan doh ham? Chuleh muthim hoilanga cheji hitam?
38.20: Khat cheng chenga a in na napuilut theija chuleh amun lhunje chu nahet em?
38.21: Ahinlah hicheng chu nahet maithei ahi, ijeh inem itile thil ijakai kisem masanga penga nahi tan, hijeh a chu ijakai nahet themsoh ahitai.
38.22: Buhbang kikhol khomna mun naga chelut khah ta hem? ahiloule gelchang kikhol khomna mun naga mu khah ta hem?
38.23: Genthei hesoh nikho a gal manchah dinga kakhol ahin, kidou nikho leh kisat nikho a dinga kakhol khom ahi.
38.24: Khovah hung kondohna lampi chu hoilai hija, solam hui chenna chu hoilai ham?
38.25: Go hattah a hung long jung jung twilam chu kon asemma kolphevahna lampi kon adopeh ham?
38.26: Hampa ke louna gamgo lah leh nelgam mihem chenlouna gam'a chu kon go ajuhsah ham?
38.27: Tolgo lah sunouva dangchim sah dinga go juh sah chu koi hija chule hampa louhing kedohsah a koiham?
38.28: Go in pa aneijem? Daitwi kon ahin pen doh sah ham?
38.29: Buhbang lhang hingnu chu koiham? Vanna hung kon buhbang twihi kon ahin ham?
38.30: Ijeh inem itile twi chu song banga tah in akisoh jin chuleh twi chung chu akan den jin ahi.
38.31: Ahshi ho kitol ding dan khu nahil theija bombiel akoi ho khu alomma nakan theija, ahiloule juhei suhtum khu akhau nalhap kang thei ngaijem?
38.32: Kum kiheichin hohi aban ban cha che dinga nahil theija ahiloule ahsi somleng chu anoute toh van jotpai dinga napuile theijem?
38.33: Thilsem jouse chondan hi nahet soh keija, leiset hi dan dungjuiya naman chah thei ding ham?
38.34: Meibang lom chu nakouva chule go nasosah theijem?
38.35: Kolphe chu nakilah sah theija chule naseina mun chu navah sah thei ding ham?
38.36: Lungchang thil het jeng theina pea chu koi hija chule lungthim angaina a khohetna pe a chu koiham?
38.37: Meilhang ho sim jouna dinga chihna lhingsetna neikoi hija, vanna twi kikholna mun loukhoija khoilet jou ding koiham?
38.38: Tolla leiset hi akikoi got setna chule leiset chu leilhanga atahsah thei ding ham?
38.39: Keipi dinga neh ding namat khom peh a chule keipi bahkai noute gilkel chu alung nachim a navahva jouva,
38.40: Akosung uva alupnauva ahiloule nang noija abohmat pet tengule,
38.41: Vavomte khu kon an apeh a anoute khu Pathen jah dinga apenna chule gilkella amoh toilele tenguleh kon an apeh jiu ham?

39.1: Gamkel ho khun itih phat le nou anei jiuvem ti nahet em? sajuh ho gam lah a aso u khu namu khah tah em?
39.2: Lha ijat gai uvem ti nahet khah em? itih phat le soh diu ham ti nahet em?
39.3: Anou neina dingin tolla aboh mat jiuvin chule ason chu ahing doh jiuve.
39.4: Anou ho chu tollhanga akivah khang jiuvin chuti chun achennau adalhah teng ahung kinungle ji tapouve.
39.5: Gamlah sangan khu kon chamlhatna apeh a chule akihenna khao kon alhap peh ham?
39.6: Gamthip lah hi amaho umna dinga kapeh ahin achenna diuvin hamhing ke louna gam kepei.
39.7: Khopi sung husa atheinom pon chuleh ahohsal diu kangtalai tol jong aumpoi.
39.8: Molsang lah chu akivahnau mun ahin, hamhing don thah jouse ahol lelei.
39.9: Gamlah bongchal chu vahngoi din anop peh dem? Nagancha an koina huong sunga chun jan khat beh aum nadem?
39.10: Gam bong chu naloukhoi nalang konna chu nakhum theija nalou nakhoipeh ding hinam?
39.11: Athahat na chu eipente ti natahsan em? nadalhah a chule nana natoh peh ding chu natahsan em?
39.12: Nachang in langa po dinga nanganse ding ham? Chuleh na changphol a konna chang nahin pohpeh ding hinam?
39.13: Vangongchai jin alha ahin jap jin ahinlah nachakang toh tekah thei ahipoi.
39.14: Vangongchaijin atwi leiset chunga atha jin leivui khun akahlum dinga akoiji ahi.
39.15: Thilkhat touvin akengin chonkeh inte ahiloule gamsa khattouvin sumathah inte tijong agelpoi.
39.16: Anoute chunga jong a engse lheh jengin ama a hilou bang bangin athi diu jong khoh asapoi.
39.17: Ajeh chu Pathenin ama a konna chihna alahdoh peh a, thil hetkhen theina apehlou ahi.
39.18: Ahinlah itih phat hijongle lhai dinga ahung chopdoh phat phat uleh sakol lhaihat pen pen jong achunga toupa toh adalha tha jitai.
39.19: Sakol thahat khu nangin napeh hija ahiloule angonga amul bahkai khu nangin nakesah ham?
39.20: Khaokhopi kichop thei banga akichop theina khu nangin napeh ham? Anah khon gin khu tijat jat aum jenge.
39.21: Galsat dinga ahung kipatdoh tengle atin in leiset akhot in athahat in akipah jin ahi.
39.22: Chemjam masanga ajam pon, kichat kiti chu anuisat in chuleh kichatna aneipoi.
39.23: Thalchang amalam ngan aleng jeng jung in, chuleh tengcha leh tenglung aval lah lah jenge.
39.24: Lunghang tah in akengtin in tol akhot jal lah lah in chule kelngoi ki ahung kimut ging phat in galmun manon alhaikit jitai.
39.25: Saki kimut gin chun anah akhongin gamla tah a konin gal gimnam ajan, gal kisat gin thong leh captian pa thupeh ngah in akinuh nuh jenge.
39.26: Mu khu nangin nachihna a nahilla vanlama sangtah'a lengle le a chule alhaving teni khu lhanglam nga ajah ji ham?
39.27: Muvanlai sangtah'a alentouva chunglang peh a buh asah khu nangin nepeh ham?
39.28: Kolsong chunga achengin gamlatah songkuo hoa chenna in akiseme.
39.29: Hiche a konhin aneh ding sahing akihol in mitchim keuvin avelhi jingin ahi.
39.30: Anouten thisan achop chop un gancha thikam umna hiche munna chu ama namu ding ahi.

40.2: Hatchungnungpa chu nakinelpi nom nah laijam? Pathen thutan dihlouna podohpa nahin, ahileh donbutna ding nanei nahlai em?
40.3: Hichun Job in Pakai chu adonbut in,
40.4: Keima ima hilou kahi, adonbutna ding chu iti kaholdoh jou ding ham? Kakhut in kamuh kisip ing katin,
40.5: Thu tamtah kaseidoh ahitan, seibe ding kanei tapoi.
40.6: Hiti chun Pakaiyin chimpei lah a kon in Job ahin donbut in,
40.7: Pasal phatah bangin nakong kigah in, keiman nangma doh ding thudoh themkhat kaneijin, chuleh nangin hiche ho chu nadonbut ding ahi.
40.8: Kathutan dihna hi tahsan louva nakoija, chule nangma dihna photchetna dinga kei themmo neichan joh ding ham?
40.9: Pathen banga thahat nahin, Pathen ogin banga nangin van nagin sah thei ding ham?
40.10: Aphai naloupina leh nagun chenan kivon in lang, ja naumna leh aming than nan kivon temin.
40.11: Nalung hanna ngoh ding hol in lang, mikiletsah teho jouse chunga chuhen.
40.12: Mikiletsah techu namit hei chun jachat sah in lang, migiloute chu adin nauva chun chot phan.
40.13: Leivui lah a chun vui in lang, amaho chu mithigam songkul'a hunk hum den tan.
40.14: Chutia chu kei jengin jong kapachat ding nahi, ijeh inem itile nabangol thahat chun nahuhuhdoh ahitai.
40.15: Behemoth khu vetemin, nang kasem banga kasem ahin, bongchal bangin hampa ane e.
40.16: Akengphang athahat nale, a oipoh a aphe ho khu ven.
40.17: Amei jong khu Cedar thing bangin atah in, akhel teni a aphe ho khu detchet a kipheh khomahi.
40.18: Agu ho jong sum-eng long abangin atibah ho jong thihjol tobang ahi.
40.19: Pathen khutsem ho lah a vetkah theipen ahin, chuleh asempa bouvin agihsal thei ahi.
40.20: Gam'a gamsa jouse lhatle namun hiche molsang hohin amaho dinga anneh phapen pen chu apeh nom u ahi.
40.21: Thambal pahcha phung noija chun akol jin, pengphung boh lah a akisel jin ahi.
40.22: Vadung pang thingnem ho lah a pahcha phungho chu amadin lim in apange.
40.23: Vadung twisoh in ama asunoh phah pon, Jordan vadung soh hen lang chup jongle alungkham deh poi.
40.24: Koima chan amandoh joupoi, ahiloule anah avu a, thihkol abu peh a chuleh akaimang theilou ahi.

41.1: Ngakoija Leviathan namat thei ding ham? Ahiloule aha a khaokol nabu peh thei ding ham?
41.2: Anahhom sunga khao nathil lut theija, ahiloule akhalhang thihhem a nasut vang thei ding ham?
41.3: Nakhoto ding ngeh na a, hung taova ahiloule nalainat pi dinga hung tao tuntun nam?
41.4: Ahinkho a nasoh a panga nanatong dinga nanop peh ding hinam?
41.5: Nangin hiche khu vacha banga nangailut bol thei hiya, ahiloule nachapang neunu kichepna dinga napeh thei ding ham?
41.6: Kivei mihon athiljoh nau mun ho a joh dinga ahung kichoh diu hinam?
41.7: Avun khu tengcha a nasut khah theija, ahiloule aluchang ngathal a nakap khah thei ding ham?
41.8: Achunga nakhut ngam in lang hile chun kidounan ahin jui ding khu geldoh in natin, avel a nabol patep kit lou hel ding ahitai.
41.9: Ahipoi hiche mat ding got chu phatchomna bei ahin, sadel hatpa thiltup jong chu kisuhnem peh ding ahi.
41.10: Chuleh a itih a koima chan asuhnoh phah ngamlou ahin, koiham kamasanga ding ngam ding chu.
41.11: Kangaichat pet tah a kalepeh kit ding thil eipe chu koi ham? Vannoija thil umjouse hi keija ahi.
41.12: Leviathan tibah ho hoidan chuleh athahat oupe dan chule agongso hoidan ho kasei nomme.
41.13: Avun khu kon alahdoh peh theija chule athoa um agalvon khu kon amulet pai thei ding ham?
41.14: Akhalhang khu kon akal keh a ahondoh ding ham? Ajeh chu aha khu tijat jat um behseh jeng ahi.
41.15: Alip ho chu pho banga agol gol a detchet a mahor kinam banga thakhat'a kinam detchet ahi.
41.16: Kimatchet a umkhom ahijeh chun akah a hui jangkhat cha jong alut theipoi.
41.17: Alip khat chu aban'a alip chunga hub eh detchet a, khat leh khat kikam toa kimulet pai theilou ahi.
41.18: Anah akhon tengle avahlap lap jengin, amitchang teni jong jingkah nichangsat pet toh abange.
41.19: Akamsunga konin meisi apahlah lah jin, meikou ahung vahdoh ji'e.
41.20: Meichunga twibel kisonga, twihu pot bangin anahhomma konin meikhu ahung kitung doh ji'e.
41.21: Akamsunga konna meikou alendoh ji jeh chun, ahai husa chun meihol ahal kou jeng jin ahi.
41.22: Leviathan ngongchang thahatna chun chene jouse a kichat tijatna asosah e.
41.23: Aphe ho chu atah in chuleh adetchet in, akimulet thei poi.
41.24: Alungchang chu song bangin atah in sumhei song bangin atah e.
41.25: Ahung kithodoh tengle thahat chungnung ho akicha jiuvin, kichat tijatnan amanchah kheh jin ahi.
41.26: Chemjam, tengcha, thalchang ahiloule tengcha neoho khat chan asutang joupoi.
41.27: Thih jong imacha ahisah poi. Hiche thilsem ding hin changpol tobangbep bou ahin, chuleh sum-eng jong thing motsa tobangbep ahi.
41.28: Thalchang in adeljam joupon, song aboma kisep jong chu hampan ajepkhah abang bep e.
41.29: Akivoh ho jong chu ham donthah toh abahsah in chule tengcha neu euvel vul hung leng jong chu anuisat bep e.
41.30: A oipoh chu haihal hemtah tobang alip in atom in ama chena nung chu loukai nang pan lou akainangna nung abahsah ji'e.
41.31: Leviathan chun twi lah'a aum tengle twi chu belphul abahsah ji'e. Twikhanglen tojong thao kiloijol abahsah jin ahi.
41.32: Twi lah'a ache tengle twi kinong ho chu aval lah lah jin, gah vet ding'in twikhanglen chu akang in akilang ji'e.
41.33: Leiset chunga ama kibahpi aumpon, ama tobanga kichat neilou thilsem ganhing dang aumpoi.
41.34: Thilsem ganhing jouse lah a akiletsah pen ahin, amahi ganhing jouse leng ahi.

42.1: Chutah chun Job in Pakai chu adonbut tai.
42.2: Thil ijakai bolthei nahi naleh, nanatoh koiman nasuh tang theilou chu keiman kahei.
42.3: Thil hetkhen theina beija kathil hetkhen theina dongpa chu koiham? Tin nei donge. Hichepa chu kei kahi. Chule keiman kahet khah louhel thu kana sei kha tai.
42.4: Ngaijin keiman nasei peh inge. Keiman nangma thu kadoh a chuleh nangin nei donbut ding ahi.
42.5: Masanga chu nangma hi athu a bou kana jah tho ahin, ahinlah tun vang kamit tah in kamutai.
42.6: Kana thusei jouse kageldoh sohkei tai. Chuleh keima kakisih taiti vetsahnan, leivui leh vutvam lah a hin katouve.
42.7: Pakaiyin thu hijatpi hi Job koma asei nungin Teman mipa Eliphaz komah aseitai. Nangma leh nagol teni chunga kalung ahange. Kasohpa Job sei bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nanghon nasei pouve.
42.8: Hijeh chun bongchal sagi leh kelngoichal sagi ma kikai unlang kasohpa Job koma cheuvin, chuleh nangma ho a dingin kilhaina govam thilto gabol un. Kasohpan nangho dingin nataopeh untin chuleh keiman taona chu nangho minna kasan peh a, natoh dungjui uva kalethuh tahlou ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nanghon kasohpa Job bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nasei pouve ati.
42.9: Hiti chun Teman mipa Eliphaz, Shuh mipa Bildad chule Naamat mi Zophar chun Pakai thupeh bangin agabol un chuleh Pakaiyin Job taona asanpeh tai.
42.10: Job chun aloi agolte dinga ataopeh phat in Pakaiyin vangphat nan akile sah in, tahbeh in Pakaiyin masanga aneijat sanga ajatni a tamjon apetai.
42.11: Chutah chun asopi pasal holeh numeiho chuleh masanga akihetpi aloi agolte ahungun a in'ah an anehkhompi uvin ahi. Pakaiyin ama douna a achung hange thilse analhunsah ho jouse jal chun amapa chu alhem un chuleh alhamon un ahi. Chuleh amaho khat cheh chun amapa din thilpeh sum le sana khutjem ahin choipeh uve.
42.12: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Job hinkho anukhat lang chu akipat tillai sangin phatthei aha boh jon, hijeh chun tun kelngoi sangsom le sangli aneiyin, sangong sao sang gup aneiyin, bongchal kop sangkhat aneiyin, chule sanganpi sangkhat aneitai.
42.13: Aman jong Job chu chapa sagi apeh ben, chule numei jong thum jen apeh bei.
42.14: Amapan achanu masapen chu Jemiah asah in, anina Keziah asah in, chule athumna Keremhappuch asah e.
42.15: Gamsung jouse a numei lah a Job Chanute banga melhoi dang aumpoi. Chuleh apaovin amaho chu asopi pasal ho toh alunglhaina bang tah in asem khomin ahi.
42.16: Hicheng nung hin Job chu kum jakhat le somli ahingin, achate leh atute khangli chan geijin amun ahi.
42.17: Chutah chun Job chu hinkho bulhingset in ahingin, tehse mong monga hingin atehthi tai.

1.1: Migiloute thuhil jom louva, michonse ho lamlhah dunga jong dingle lou; chule Elohim Pathen ginglou ho kikhop na dunga jong tou khompi lou mi chu anun nom ahi.
1.2: Hitobang mihochun Yahweh Pakai Dan thu a bou lunglhai na aneiyun, Yahweh Pakai Dan thu chu sun le jan in angaito jing jeng ui.
1.3: Hitobang mi hochu twi lonna luipanga kiphut, aphat cha hung gaji adojong gopjilou thingphung tobang ahi; hitobang miho jong chu atohna lam lam'uva alolhing jiuve.
1.4: Yahweh Pakai ginglouho vang chutobang ahipoi: huilhoh mangle changvai tobangbep ahiuve.
1.5: Hijeh a chu Yahweh Pakai gingloute chu thutan nikho tengleh themmo changdiu, michonse hon jong mikitah ho lah'a mun aneiloudiu ahi.
1.6: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin michonpha ho lamlhah ahetpeh jing in, Yahweh Pakai ginglou ho lampi vang manthahna'a lut diu ahi.

2.1: Ipi dinga chitin namtin kitohmoa, thilphachomlou ngaito na a aphat'u amoh man chatvei u hitam?
2.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin lengdinga athaonupa dounan leiset lengte akikhom un, chule vaihom thunei hon jong thulhuh asem un, hitin asei ui.
2.3: “Ei-kihennauva kon ahin kilhamlhao hitin, Elohim Pathen thaneina'a kon'in kilha ong-u hite” atiuve.
2.4: Hinlah Yahweh Pakaiyin avan laltouna'a kon'in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, Yahweh Pakai a din nuijat umtah ahitauve.
2.5: Chuin Yahweh Pakaiyin amaho chu lunghang tah'in aphoh in, alunghan jah jeng chun amaho atijatsah tai.
2.6: Chutah in “Keiman kalhendoh lengchu kalhang theng Zion molvum a katousah'e,” ati.
2.7: Keiman thugahna chu phongdoh inge; Yahweh Pakaiyin kahengah hitin asei e, “Nangma hi kachapa nahi, Keiman tunia nangma hi kahin nahi tai.”
2.8: Kahenga nathum pouleh chitin namtin hi nagoulo dinga kapeh ding, vannoi leiset pumpi geija nagou kahisahding ahi.
2.9: Nangman amahohi thihjolla najep boh'a; belkhengpa bel kivoh chip banga ahal hal a nakoi ding ahi.
2.10: Hijeh chun Vo leiset lengte kichih theiyun; Chule leiset thutan ho nanghon thuhil ngaiphaovin.
2.11: Yahweh Pakai chu ging tah in akin bol un, chule kithing pum in Ama chu houvun.
2.12: Yahweh Pakai lungsatna nachung uva achuh a namanthah masangun akengphang kolchah in chop un, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai lungsat na neocha jong eihodia deojah ahi. Atahsan nau Yahweh Pakai a koi jing ho chu anun nom ahiuve.

3.1: O Yahweh Pakai, idia eisulam vaiding mi pung jing hitam! eidou din mitamtah akipandoh taove.
3.2: Ama kihuh doh na hi Elohim Pathen a aumpoi tin kalungthim in mitamtah'in aseijui. (Selah)
3.3: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai, nanghi eiveng tup, kalum'a kisoung nahi; Ka loupina le khodah ngam-a, gal jona eipeh jing nahi.
3.4: Keima O sangtah in Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Aman alhang thenga kon'in eihin donbut tai. (Selah)
3.5: Keima kalum'in ka-imu jin; Yahweh Pakaiyin eichin tup'a eihoidam jeh'in, kajing-thou kit tai.
3.6: Keima doudin mihem sangsom sangjan ei umkimvel jongle kichakit taponge.
3.7: Hung thoudoh in O Yahweh Pakai; neihuhdoh'in, Elohim ka Pathen: Eidou hojouse khagu eivohchipeh in; nangma migilou ho hahemtah jong vopul soh ji nahi.
3.8: Huh hingna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon bou ahi: Na phattheina jong namite chunga aume.

4.1: Kakou teng neidon but'in, them eichan sah a O Yahweh Pakai; ka lhahsam nikho teng jong le nangman lunglet neipe ji; neikhoton lang kataona neingai peh tei in.
4.2: Vo mihem chapate, nanghohin itihchanpi neisuh jum diu hitam? Itihchan ajehbei a nei thepmosah uva, itihchan pihi jouthu nachepi diu hitam?
4.3: Ahin nanghon heuvin, Yahweh Pakaiyin ama gingho Ama ding'in atum'in alhengdoh'e. Yahweh Pakai kakou tengleh Aman ei-donbut teijin ahi.
4.4: Ki sonlelnan kithing pumin umun, ahin chonset boldaovin; hichu nalupnao muna jong nalungthimu toh gelkhom jinguvin lang umdet jingun.
4.5: Lungthengsel a kilhai naho boljingun chule natahsan nao Yahweh Pakai a koi jingun.
4.6: Hiho sanga phajo eimusah thei diu koi ham? tin mitamtah'in seiunte, Yahweh Pakai namaivah achun keiho neihinsu emsel un.
4.7: Nangman lengpitwi leh changle mim nengchat'a kilamdoh ho kipani sangin, kalungthim nakipasah tai.
4.8: Keima Nanga dia lungmonga kalup a ka-ihmut ding ahi, Yahweh Pakai nei hoidoh inlang neivengtup in.

5.1: O Yahweh Pakai, ka ocheng ho neingaipeh'in, Kalungthim a kataona jong neigelkhoh peh'in.
5.2: Panpi ngaija kakana neigelkhohpeh'in, ka lengpa le Elohim ka Pathen; ajeh chu nangma kom'a bou taovakahi.
5.3: O Yahweh Pakai, jingkah teng kataona nei ngaipeh'in, jingkah seh leh nangma lam sang ingting kangai chat jouse nakom kahinlhut a kinemtah a ngah jingding kahi.
5.4: Nangma thil phalouho chunga kipah ji pathen nahipon, migilou ho jong na angsuna aumthei ji pouve.
5.5: Nangma angsunga mikiletsah ho a dingjou jipon; Yahweh Pakai nang man gitlou nale chonset bol jouse nathet soh hel e.
5.6: Nangin jouthu sei ho nasuh mang ding ahi; Yahweh Pakaiyin mijoulhep holeh tolthat ho athet ahi.
5.7: Keima din vang, Nangailut na bulhingsetjal chun na hongsung hunglut nange; Chule nangma ginle jana a naHou-In theng mai a bohkhup a chibai kabohding nahi.
5.8: O Yahweh Pakai, kamelma ten eijo lounadin nalamdih a neipui in. Kamasanga um lampi hi kajuidih nadin neihin lhun jang peh in.
5.9: Ajeh chu kamelmate kamsunga thutah apotthei tapon, asunglam'u jong setnajeng ahitai; Alol sung ujong lhankhuh abangin, alei ujong chuchi a kilhunglut kalbi abang e.
5.10: O Yahweh Pakai ama ho khu gotna petan. Aduhabol nauhi amaho lhuh na hihen! Achonsetnao ho jeh'in delmang jeng'in, ajeh chu amahohin nangma dounan na atong'un ahi.
5.11: Ahin koihileh nangma lhalim noi'a umho chu thanom'u hen! Nangma thangvahna lachu kipah tah'in sajingu hen! Amaho chunga nalhajah in hoidoh jing in lang, Nangma min ngailu jing ho jong kipa na lodim jing'u hen.
5.12: O Yahweh Pakai, nang'in michonpha ho phatthei naboh tei in. Nalungtoh te ngailut na ompho phatah achun nahoibit jing e.

6.1: O Yahweh Pakai, nei lung han san loujen in! Lungsat namoljol a chun neikhoukhah hih helin.
6.2: Neikhoto teijin lhasam le hatlou kahi Yahweh Pakai, neidam sah in kagu kachang jousen eichip ui.
6.3: Kalhagao alengvai lheh jeng tai, O Yahweh Pakai itihchan pi hitia hi kaum ding hitam?
6.4: Hungkilen O Yahweh Pakai, kalhagao huh doh in. Namingailutna longlou jeh chun neihin huhdoh tei in.
6.5: Ajeh chu thina ahin nangma geldoh na aumpoi: lhankhuh a konna jong koiham nahin thangvah ding?
6.6: Ka ka kamao nan kachao lhatai; janseh a kakanan kajalkhun achin in, kaka na mitlhi hon kalupna jalkhun akotsah sohtai.
6.7: Genthei a kaka nan kamit athimtan; kagalmiten eisuh genthei jeh'uvin apomhel jengtai.
6.8: Gitlouna bolho jouse kakoma kon'in potdoh tauvin; Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin kakana eijahpeh tai.
6.9: Yahweh Pakaiyin kangaichat a kathum na ho eihetpeh tan; kataona hi eidonbut ding ahitai.
6.10: Kagalmite jouse kijumsou henlang kithing pumin um uhen: Jum le ja pumin gangtah in kinungle taohen.

7.1: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen eihoidam din nangma kahin belle. Eipedoh a pang hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in, neihuhdoh'in.
7.2: Achuti loule panpi ding bei a kaum a, keipi bahkai-jin mi abolset banga eiboset uva, ahal halla eibotel diu ahi.
7.3: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pathen keiman thil suhkhel kaneija, thildihlou kana tohdoh khah'a,
7.4: Lungmonga kachenkhom pi khat chonphatlouna kalethuh a, ajehbeija kagalmi kanchom khah'a ahileh,
7.5: Kagal mite khut-ah neipedoh jeng in lang kahin na lajengu hen, amahon tolla eichotpha jeng uhen chule kaloupi najouse bon lah'a kaithang jeng-u hen. (Selah)
7.6: O Yahweh Pakai, lunghan in hungthoudoh'in, Doumit melpu kagalmite jeh in nang hung kichoisang in; Chule hung kipatdoh'in Elohim ka Pathen nathutan dihtah chu hinpolut in.
7.7: Namasangah chitin namtin kikhom soh hen: Ama ho chunga namun dih tah chu hin kimusah kit in.
7.8: Yahweh Pakai chu chitin namtin ho thu atan ahi: Kachondih naho nei phondoh peh tan, O Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu keiman them mo na kanei poi O hatchung nung.
7.9: Mi phalouho thil dihlou bolna kichai sah tan, chule michonpha ho chu domsangin. Ajeh chu nangman mihem lungthim gilsung ve Pathen dihtah chu nahi.
7.10: Elohim ka Pathen hi kalum'a pang ahin, alungthim dih le akitah ho chu ahuhhing jin ahi.
7.11: Elohim ka Pathen hi thutan dihtah ahin, niseh'in miphalou chunga alung hangjingin ahi.
7.12: Mihemkhat chu akisih louva ahileh, Elohim ka Pathenin achemjam kinol hem intin, athalpi kaosa akoijing ahi.
7.13: Aman thina manchah gimneitah chu kigot intin athalpi meikou chu akapding ahi.
7.14: Miphalou hon setna avop un, umhelna le thilphalou va agaiun, jouthu ho ahinpen doh sah jiu ve.
7.15: Amahon mi lhahlutna dingin kotong thuhtah alaijiuvin, ahinlah amaho joh alhalut jiuvin ahi.
7.16: Midia set na abol hou chu amaho angsung joh in achuhjin ahi. Michunga chudinga thilse agon houchu amaho luchunga joh achujin ahi.
7.17: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu akitahna jeh'in thangvah ing-ting, keiman Yahweh Pakai hat chung nung min chu ka thangvah ding ahi.

8.1: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam! naloupi nahi vanho sangin asangjon ahi.
8.2: Nangin chapang hole naosen ho kamsunga nathahat naho nahil in, hiti chun nagalmi hole nangma douho nasuthipjin ahi.
8.3: Keiman janteng vanthamjol kavet akangaito jiteng, nakhut jung ho natoh in lhathah le ahsi ho agongtoh sel ui.
8.4: Mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagelkhoh'a, Mihem Chapa hi ipi dinga hibanga hi nakhohsah ham?
8.5: Nang'in amaho hi Vantil sanga themchabou nemjep in nakoi jin, loupina le jana dimset in lallukhuh nakhuhpeh e.
8.6: Nangin nathilsemsaho jouse chunga vaihop na napen, thiljouse akhutnoija nakoitan ahi:
8.7: Kelngoiho le bong ho chule gamsahang ho jouse,
8.8: Vantham jol'a vachate, twikhang len'a nga-ho chule twikhang len'a kijap jouse ahiuve.
8.9: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam!

9.1: Yahweh Pakai kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ing-kate. Thil loupi nabol ho hi seiphongle-inge.
9.2: Nangma jal a kipana a kadimset ding ahi. Namin in vahchoi la sang e, O Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung.
9.3: Nang nahung dindoh teng kagal mite anungjam jiuvin, akiseplhu vin na angsunga athiden jitaove.
9.4: Ajeh chu nangin kadih nalam a thu neitan pehin, navan laltouna'a kon'in thu adih'in nahin tan e.
9.5: Nangman namtin vaipi nalethuh in migiloute nasu-mang'in, amin'u tonsot'a din nathai mangtai.
9.6: Melmate chu nangin a-itih'a dingin nasumang in, khopi nasuh mang ho jong tun suhmil'in aumgam-tauve.
9.7: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai hi tonsot leng ahin, thutanna dingin alaltouna atungdoh'in ahi.
9.8: Aman leiset hi thudih'a achungthu atan a, namtin vaipi chunga hi dihtah'a vai ahop ding ahi.
9.9: Yahweh Pakaihi bolgentheija umho dinga hoidohna ahin, hahsatna nikho hoa dinga kicholdona kulpi ahi.
9.10: Namin heho jousen nahin tahsan ui, ajeh chu, O Yahweh Pakai nangin nangma holte chu nadalha ngaipoi.
9.11: Jerusalem'a vaihom Yahweh Pakai vahchoinan lasauvin. Suhmil theilou atohdoh ho namtin jah a seiphongun.
9.12: Ajeh chu aman tolthat ho aphu alahjin, panpi beiho apanpin ji. Aman migentheiho kana jong nahsah mon akoijipoi.
9.13: Neikho to teijin O Yahweh Pakai; eibose teuvin ichan a eisuh genthei u hitam, thina kokhuh a kon'in neiloidoh'in.
9.14: Zion chanu kelkot phunghoa lhangphong tah'a kathangvah theina dingin neihuhdoh'in, chutengleh neihuh doh jal a kakipa thanom ding ahi.
9.15: Midangho lhahlut nadia asem u kokhuh a chun Namtin vaipi alhalut un, athang kam uva chun amaho keng joh a ohtai.
9.16: Yahweh Pakai hi athutan dihna'a kon'in akilangdoh jin: Migilouho vang amaho thang-kamna'a a-ohden jiuvin ahi. (Selah)
9.17: Migilouho vang lhankhuh a lhalut untin, hichu Elohim Pathen nahsah lou namtin vaipiho chunga got na jong ahi.
9.18: Ahinlah panpi ngaichaho chu nahsahmoa umjom jing loudiu: chule migenthei te kinepna jong tonsot a suhmil-a um louding ahi.
9.19: Hungthou vin, O Yahweh Pakai! Mihemho kinoise sah-hih beh'in! Nangma ginglou namtin vaipi ho chungthu hi tanin!
9.20: amahohi tijatnan lungkhamsah'in, O Yahweh Pakai. Namtin vaipi hi mihem maimai ahiu kihetdoh sah'in.

10.1: O Yahweh Pakai, idia gam lhatah'a ding nahim? Genthei kathoh jiteng ibol'a kisel jia nahim?
10.2: Migilouten noise tah'in migentheite adel mangjiu vin, mi-o nadinga asem'u thang a chun amahojoh hin-o sah'in.
10.3: Ajeh chu amhon thilselam a alung ngaichat hou akiletsah piuvin, mikilose ho apah chauvin, Yahweh Pakai chu ataitom-un ahi.
10.4: Migilou te vang Elohim Pathen holdin akiletsah val un, alungthim pumpiu vin jong Elohim Pathen aum poi atiuve.
10.5: Ahinlah amaho hi abol-lam lam uvah alolhing'un ahi. Achung uva hunglhung ding eng-bolna ho jonghi amupha jipouve. Amahon agal-mihou jouse chu ataitom-un ahi.
10.6: Amahon, kachung'uva thilse kiti chulouding ahi tin atahsan un; boina hoa konna aitih a ongthol ding kahitaove atiuve.
10.7: Akam-uvah sapsetna, joule nal, chule gihsalna adimset ui. Alei muh uva jong thilse le thilphalou jeng aum e.
10.8: Amahon khopam lam gamthip lah hoa mi achanglhi jiuvin, them-mona neilouho thading agojiuve. Amit un alhasam te umna aching lhi jingun ahi.
