10.9: Keipi bahkaiho bang'in akisel'un lhasam le hatloute mat jeng dingin angahun ahi. Sachangho bang'in tah-lelte chu len akhu khum un amandoh jitaove.
10.10: Lhasam a bolsetna toh te chu asugep jiuvin; miphalouho thahatna noi a chun alhalut jitaove.
10.11: Migilou ten Elohim Pathenin eimupha pouve atiuve! Aman amit sing intin, “Eihon ibol uhi mu hih beh inte” atiuve!
10.12: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai, migiloute hi gotna petan, O Elohim Pathen! Hatlou lhasam te hin sumil hih beh in.
10.13: Migiloute Elohim Pathen sam se pum puma iti ongthol diu ham? Amahon Elohim Pathenin eithemmosah pouvinte tin angai touve.
10.14: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai nangin athilse bol-houhi namusoh keije. Nangin hicheho hi melchih inlang amahohi gotna pen. Hatlou lhasam ten atahsan nao nanga akoi un, nulou palou te jong nangin vengbit in.
10.15: Hiche migilou mi-engseho hi abanjang-u heh bongin! abon-uva nasuhmang kahsen anung u deljingin.
10.16: Yahweh Pakaihi atonsot tonsot leng ahi! Elohim Pathen neilou nam mitechu gamsung akon a mangthah ding ahiuve.
10.17: Yahweh Pakai nangin tah-lelte kinepna hi nahetsa ahi, nangin thon louva akana-u najahpeh'a nahin lhamon ding ahi.
10.18: Nangin nulou palou te leh bolgentheija umho chungthu adih'a natanpeh ding, chuteng athi thei mihem in amaho hi asuh lengvai theilou diu ahitai.

11.1: Keiman eiveng tup din Yahweh Pakai katahsan e. Hijeh achu, nangin ipi dia, “vacha bang'in nahoibitna dingin hiche molchunga khun galeng tan” natiham!
11.2: Migilouhon athalchangu akhaoto suhtoh san akoi un aloisal tauvin ahi. Amahon munthip a kon-in milungdih ho ahinkap'un ahi.
11.3: Dan leh thupehho akisuhset teng, michonphapa chun ipi abolthei nahlai dingham?
11.4: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai chu a-Hou-In munthenga chun aum e; Yahweh Pakai chun vanna kon'in vai ahinhom nalaije. Aman mijouse ahin vechilsoh keijin, leiset chunga mitin ahinkholtoh e.
11.5: Yahweh Pakaiyin michonpha le migilou anigelin ahinkhol toh e. Aman thunoh baotam bol ho athen ahi.
11.6: Aman migiloute chunga mei-am lenglung leh katsong meikong gojuh'a ajuhsah ding hui savetvut pumma gotna apeh ding ahi.
11.7: Yahweh Pakai dihnahin thu adih'a kitan achepin, hijeh'a chu thudih chepi hochun Yahweh Pakai mai amudiu ahi.

12.1: Huhhing in, O Yahweh Pakai, michonpha mangthah ding ahitai! Leiset mihem te lah a mikitah jong abeitai!
12.2: Heng le kom jengjong jouthu jengin akilhemtouvin, muhnal a lungthima kilhep lhahding jeng thu asei ui.
12.3: Yahweh Pakaiyin dangnal tah a thukisei ho hi asuh bei ding, kiletsahna thuchengho jonghi asuthip ding ahitai.
12.4: Amahon aseijun, eihon lungna chim set'in jouthu seiju hite, ajeh chu i-lei ikam'u eihoa hilouham, kon eisuh tang jou diuham? atiuve.
12.5: Yahweh Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Keiman hatlou lhasamte chunga bolgenthei naho kamudohtai chule migenthei ho ka lemao jong kajatai. Tun keima kipan inting huhdoh dia eingaichat bangu va kahuh doh diu ahitai.”
12.6: Yahweh Pakai kitepna hi thengsel'a ahin, dangka mei chunga sagivei kilhit theng tobang ahi.
12.7: Hijeh chun, Yahweh Pakai nangin bol-hesoh'a umho nahuhdoh ding ahi, ti kaheuve, chule hiche kitahlou khang mitea kon'a tonsot geija dinga nahoidoh ding ahi,
12.8: migilou te muntina vahle henlang migilou pen ho jong gamsung a kidomsang u jong le.

13.1: O Yahweh Pakai, phat itihchan geihi neisuhmil ding hitam? Itih chan keija kon'a nakiselmang ding nahim?
13.2: Itihchan gei hiche hahsatna hi kathoh ding ham? Itih chan asun ajan'a lungkhamna dimset'a kaum ding ham? Itih chan kagalmiten hanla eisap khum diu hitam?
13.3: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hung kiheiyin, neihin donbut tan! Katha kile dohsah'in, neithisah hih'in.
13.4: “Ama hi kajou tai!” tin kamelma te hi ka lhuh nin kipasah hih beh in.
13.5: Amavang namingailutna longlouvachu kingai jing kahi. Neihuhdoh jeh a keima kipa jing ding kahi.
13.6: Keiman Yahweh Pakai vahchoi lan sang e ajeh chu Ama keidin thilpha tah eibol peh ati.

14.1: Mingol'in bou alungthim in “Pathen aumpoi” ati. Amaho hi lepche ngen ahiuvin, chule athilbol ujong adihlou jeng ahin, khatcha jong thilphabol aumpouve.
14.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin vanna kon'in lei mihemte jouse ahinven, mikhattou aching tahbeh um-em, chule Elohim Pathen ngaicha'a hol-a um-em atin ahi.
14.3: Hinlah aumpoi, abon'un aki-heimang gamtauve, abonchauva lepche ngen ahiuvin, koimacha apha aumpoi khatcha jong aumpoi.
14.4: Setna bolten hetna anei lou u hintem? Amahohin kamite changlhah bang'in aneuvin, Yahweh Pakai komin la taoding agelpouve.
14.5: Amahohi tijatnan alodim diuahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin athua nung ho aumpin ahi.
14.6: Migilou ten bolgentheija umho tohgon asuhsetpeh jiuvin, ahin Yahweh Pakaiyin amite ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
14.7: Zion molsang a kon a Israel huhdoh dinga koi hungding ham? Yahweh Pakaiyin amite aki-ledohsah kit teng, Jacob in kipana asap phon a, Israel in Elohim Pathen athangvah ding ahi.

15.1: Yahweh Pakai na intheng sunga, kon nangma nahou ding hitam? Koiham nalhang thenga na angsunga hunglut ding?
15.2: Hitobang mi themmona bei, thil dihjeng bol, lungthim theng pumma thudih jeng seiho.
15.3: Akam a miseiset ding nomlou chule aheng akom chunga thilse bollou, ahiloule aloi agol chunga thilse seinomlou.
15.4: Chonset kithang-atpiho theinomlou va, Yahweh Pakai dihtah a juiho ngaisanga, chuleh itobangin hahsa jongleh akitepna nitjingho.
15.5: Athoi lalouva sumpa homho chuleh setna neilouho, ahethemlou ho lhemlha a phatchomna sum hol lou. Hitobang miho chu ahinkhouva dingdet jingding ahiuve.

16.1: Neihoibitnin O Elohim Pathen: ajeh chu nangahi kinem jing kahi.
16.2: O Kalhagao, nangman Yahweh Pakai koma Nanghi ka Pakai nahi nati, thilpha kaneijouse hi nanga kon bou ahi;
16.3: Leiset a Elohim Pathen lhentumte hi pachat umtah ahiuvin, amahohi keidinga kagal lamkai le kakipa thanop napen ahiuve.
16.4: Pathen dangho nung jui a delle ho chu alung khamnao kibejing ding ahi. Amaho thisan a kilhaina ganthat a pang ka hilou ding, a pathen nu jong kahoupeh loudiu ahi.
16.5: Yahweh Pakai hi ka chanding gou le ka phatthei channa khon chu ahi. Yahweh Pakaiyin ka ijakai eichintup peh e.
16.6: Nangin neipeh gam jonghi gamphapen ahi, itobanga goupha kidang neipeh hitam!
16.7: Ijakai eihilla ka Yahweh Pakai chu keiman thangvah inge; janteng jong le avel in eigeldoh sah jin eihil jie.
16.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin eiumpi danhi keiman hetna kanei jinge. Amahi kakomma naichakhatna um ahi ti kahen hijeh chun keima lungthomhao ponge.
16.9: Hijeh hin keima kalung amongsellin chuleh kipanan kadimmin Elohim Pathen kathangvah e.
16.10: Ajeh chu nangin thina mun a neidalha pon natin namitheng te jong lhankhuh a lhahlutsah pon nate.
16.11: Nangin hinnalampi chu neimusah'in natin, neiumpi jal a kipana le nei umpina tonsot nopna chu nei pen nate.

17.1: O Yahweh Pakai adih thumna a kaka ogin hi nei jahpeh in, katao nahi nei ngaipeh in, lungthengsel le dih tah katao ahi.
17.2: Kathem chan na neiphondoh peh'in, ajeh chu nangin thudih a natong namuchet ahi.
17.3: Nangin kalunggel ho napatep jin, janteng jongle kalungsung navelhaji. Nangin kapum changin neivechillin kathepmo na namupoi; kakamsung jenga jong set na potlou ding ahitai.
17.4: Keiman nathupeh Dan dungjuiin, migilou ho le mi-engseho ho khonung kajui ji poi.
17.5: Kakalson dan hin nalampi kajui jingin nangma lampia konnin kapotdoh pon ahi.
17.6: Keima nangma komma taova kahi ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangin neisanpeh teiding kahei. Kataona hi lunglut tah'in neingaipeh in.
17.7: Nami ngailutna longlou chu kidangtah in neimusah'in, agalmitea konna hoidohna ngaichaho chu nathahatna gimneitah chun nahuh doh ji e.
17.8: Nangman namit teni na chintup jing bangin keima jong nei vesuijin. Nalhaving limnoija chun neisellin.
17.9: Kavel a eidoujing migilouho a kon in eivengtup in, eithatgo kamelma hoa konnin nei huhdoh in.
17.10: Amahohi mi khotona bei ahiuvin akiletsah nao thucheng chu ngaitan!
17.11: Amahon eihin juilutnun eiumkimvel uvin tola selhuh dingin agomkom ahol un ahi.
17.12: Anehding changlhih le keipi bahkai hangtah bang le keipinou vin gamthip lai matding avetlhih le tobang ahiuve.
17.13: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai kidintepin lang seplhu jengin! Nachemjammin migilouhoa konnin neihuhdoh in.
17.14: O Yahweh Pakai naban thathatnin vannoia ama phatchomna ngaito hohi sumangin. Amavang nangma goulu hohi nangman vah va jing in. Achateu neijong suhnengpeh inlang ason apahteu goulo ding geija adalhah peh theina diuvin gontoh peh'in.
17.15: Monabeija hinkho Kaman jeh a namel kamu teiding ahi. Kathodoh tengleh nangma toh kimaitoa ikimuto ding chule kalungnachim tante.

18.1: Keiman nangma kangailui Yahweh Pakai; Nangma hi kathahatna nahi.
18.2: Yahweh Pakai hi kasongpi, kakulpi, chuleh eihuhhingpu ahin, Elohim ka Pathen hi kasongpi ahin eiveng tup jing ahi. Amahi kalumdal, eihuhhinga thahat chu ahin, chuleh kahoidohna munpi chu ahi.
18.3: Keiman thangvah dinga lomtah Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, aman kamelmatea konnin eihuhdoh'in ahi.
18.4: Thina khoisatna chun eiumkimvel tan, manthahna twipi chun eichup tan ahi.
18.5: Damun lungkhamna chun eiumkimvelin, kalampi a thinan thang akam e.
18.6: Ka lungkham val phatnin Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, Elohim ka Pathen komma chun panpi ngaichan kataovin Aman aHou-In thenga konnin kataona asangin ahi.
18.7: Hi jouchun leiset akilingin akihot e. Molbul ho jeng jong kihot e ajeh chu Elohim Pathen lunghang a ahi.
18.8: Yahweh Pakai nah hom a meikhu ahung potdoh in, meikou gimneitah akam a konnin ahungkou doh'in chuleh Mei-am al lenglung Ama-a konnin ahung koudoh'in ahi.
18.9: Aman vanho chu ahongdoh'in meilom thimletlut chu ahin chotphan ahung kumsuh in,
18.10: Yahweh Pakai chu vantil pipui khat chunga atouvin, huipi chu alhavingin amangin alengin ahi.
18.11: Yahweh Pakai chu muthim in ahung kitom in, meilom twi jingletlut pumin ahung lhungin ahi.
18.12: Yahweh Pakai vah'in ahintom chu meilom satah'in ahinkhu khum in gelchang le mei-am chu gojuh'in ahung julhan ahi.
18.13: Yahweh Pakai chu vanna konnin ahung kisen in hatchungnung ogin chu gelchang leh mei-am koulah achun akithongin ahi.
18.14: Aman athalpi ahin kapmin agalmiho chu athe cheh'in, avah em lahlah chun amaho chu asuboi gamtan ahi.
18.15: O Yahweh Pakai nangin nagalmi ho napho a lunghangtah a nakisen chun twikhanglen ato geijin akikangin, leiset bulpi jouse jong akeuvin aumjie.
18.16: Aman vanna konnin akhut ahin lhangin eihin kaidoh'in, twipi thuh lah'a kon in jong eikaidoh'in ahi.
18.17: Aman kagalmi hattah tah ho a konin eihuh doh in, kasang a hatjo ka dougal hoa kon in eihuhdoh'in ahi.
18.18: Hahsatna kato pettah'in amahon eihin delkhum un ahinlah Yahweh Pakaiyin eipanpin ahi.
18.19: Aman kahoidohna mun nah eipuilut in eihuhdoh tai ajeh chu ama kipana kahi.
18.20: Yahweh Pakaiyin thildih kaboljeh in kipaman eipen mona kaneilou jeh'in eikiledohsah tai.
18.21: Keiman Yahweh Pakai lampi kajui in, thilse lam jon'in Elohim Pathen'a kon'in kakiheimang poi.
18.22: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chonphatna lampi kajui jingin, a Dan thupeh ho kapaidoh khapoi.
18.23: Elohim Pathen masangah nolnabei kahin, chonsetna kon'in kaki kangse jing e.
18.24: Yahweh Pakaiyin thildih kaboljeh in Aman kipaman eipejin ahi. Aman themmonabei kahi amui.
18.25: Mikitah kom'ah nangmatah jong nakitah'in, monabei ho kom'ah monabei nahi.
18.26: Milungtheng ho kom'ah nalungtheng in ahinlah miphalouho kom'ah nakhohjin ahi.
18.27: Nangin mikineosah ho nahuhdohjin ahinla mikiletsah ho nasujumjin ahi.
18.28: Nangin thaomei neidetpeh'in, Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen'in kamuthim jong neisalvah peh e.
18.29: Nangma hatna chun kagalmi hi neisuhchip peh'in Elohim ka Pathen toh kapankhom poupou leh itobang bang sang hijongleh kakal ngapchan ahi.
18.30: Elohim Pathen lampi chu nolnabei ahi! Yahweh Pakai kitepna jouse alolhing jinge. Amahi ahuhdoh ding ngaicha jouse dinga lum le pho ahi.
18.31: Yahweh Pakai tailou pathen dang um'am? Elohim Pathen tailou songpi det dang um'am?
18.32: Hiche Elohim Pathen hin eihatdoh sah'in kalampi jong hoibitnapen ahisah ahi.
18.33: Aman molsang hahsa chung dunga kadindet theina din kakeng jong sakhi keng bang'in atah sah e.
18.34: Aman kakhut teni jong galsatna a manthei dingin agongin, kabanjang jong sum-eng thalpi loithei dingin ahatsah'in ahi.
18.35: Nangman nagaljona lum chu neipetan nabanjetnin neipanhun ahi. Neikithopina hin eithupi sah'in ahi.
18.36: Nang man kakeng phang tenin alhonal louna dingin kalampi neikehlet peh'in ahi.
18.37: Keiman kagalmite kadel'in kaman'in ahi; amahohi kajo kahsen katangpon ahi.
18.38: Amahohi ahung ki thodoh jou louna diuvin kasat lhun kakeng noijah akijammun ahi.
18.39: Nangin kagalsatna dingin thahatnan neivon in; Nangman kagalmite chu kakengphang noi a neikoipeh e.
18.40: Nangin angongchang'u neichotpha sah'in eivetda ho jouse chu kasumang sohtan ahi.
18.41: Amahon panpi athummun koiman ahung huhdoh pouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai akouvun ahinla Aman adonbut pon ahi.
18.42: Keiman amaho chu huilah a vutvai kithethang bangin tol ah kagoibong sel'in, bonlhoh lah'a kasunat gamatai.
18.43: Nangin eihouse jing ho chungah galjona neipetan ahi. Nangin namtin vaipi chungah vaihom'in neipansah tan ahi. Kanahet phahlou miho jeng jong kalhachan ahungpang tauvin ahi.
18.44: Kamin ajah jah'un kanoijah alut un gamchommi hojeng jong ka-anga akisunem gamtauvin ahi.
18.45: Hansanna aneijou tapouvin kithing pumpum'in ka-ang ahinbel tauvin ahi.
18.46: Yahweh Pakai ahing jinge, kasongpia apanjeh'in kathangvah e! Ka sochatna Elohim ka Pathen chu loupi jing tahen!
18.47: Amahi eibolse ho lethuh jinga Elohim ka Pathen chu ahin, aman namtin vaipi hi eisuhnem peh'in kanoijah eikoipeh tai.
18.48: Chuleh kagalmitea konnin eihuhdoh'in nangman kagalmiten aphah joulouna munnah neikoijin, eidouva mi-engse hoa konnin neihoidohsah tan ahi.
18.49: Hichejeh hin O Yahweh Pakai namtin vaipi lah'a nathangvah ingkate, na min vahchoinan la sang nge.
18.50: Nangin leng a natun pa din goljona loupitah chu napetai; Chuleh nathaonupa David leh achilhahte chunga nalungset longlou namusah e.

19.1: Vanho'n Elohim Pathen loupina aphongdoh un ahi. Vanthamjol hon jong akhut thepna atahlangui.
19.2: Anitin in aphongdoh jing jeng un; jansim janseh le amachu aseiphong jingui.
19.3: Ocheng soh lou vin thu asei un; a ocheng'u hi akijakha ngaipoi.
19.4: Ahinlah athu chun vainoi alodim in, thucheng jong chun vannoi leiset athechansoh in ahi. Vanthamjol hoa Elohim Pathenin nisa chenna ding asem peh e.
19.5: Hihchu kichen jouva moulang emsel a ahung potdoh bangin avahchan jengin ahi. Kisongtah a lhaitet golseh a pango bang in haltah le kipah tah in aum e.
19.6: Vanmong langkhatna konnin nisa ahung sohdoh jin ajotna ding vanmong lang khat gei in ajui peh jie. Hiche asat a kon chun imacha ahoidoh ji poi.
19.7: Yahweh Pakai thuhil hohi achamkim in, lhagaova asuhhal jing in ahi. Yahweh Pakai Dan thu hohi tahsanthei tah ahin milham jong chihsah jengthei ahi.
19.8: Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi adih'in, lungthim kipasah ji e. Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi akicheh'in lungsunga hetthem theina eipeuvin ahi.
19.9: Yahweh Pakai ginle jana neihi athengin ahi, hichehi tonsotna ding ahitai. Yahweh Pakai thutan hi adih'e; a etih a dih jing jeng ahi.
19.10: Hicheho chu sana sanga deiumjo ahin, sana thengpen sanga jong deiumjo ahi. Khoiju sangin jong alhumjon, akhoiphang dunga kilhoh lhatil sangin jong alhumjoi.
19.11: Hicheho hi nasohpa dinga gihsal na ahin, nathu nung hoa dia kipana chanvou lentah ahi.
19.12: Kalungsunga chonset kisel guh jouse hi itikahetdoh jouding ham? Hitobanga kiselgua setna hoa konhin neisilthengin.
19.13: Nasoh hi henasasa chonset bolna a konnin neihuhdoh'in! Hicheho hi kachunga vaihomsah hihbeh'in, chuteng keima chonsetna a konna kahoidoh ding ahi.
19.14: Kakam a kon'a hung potdoh thucheng holeh kalungsunga kalunggel ho nalunglhaina hihen, O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi leh eihuhhingpu.

20.1: Na hahsat nikhon Yahweh Pakaiyin nakana taona nadonbut hen. Jacob Pathen Elohim min chun thilse jousea kon in nahoidoh hen.
20.2: Aman aHou-Intheng a kon'in kithopina nahin pejing henlang Jerusalem a kon in nahin hatsah jinghen.
20.3: Elohim Pathen'in namaicham thilto ho hingeldoh jinghen lang chuleh napumgo thiltoho jong khotona in nahin vetpeh jinghen.
20.4: Elohim Pathen'in nalunga nangaichat nape henlang nathilgon jouse nalolhinsah soh keihen.
20.5: Nagaljona thu kajah tenguleh kipah'a kasapdiu ahi, chuleh Elohim ka Pathen u minna galjona ponlop kadopsangdiu ahi. Yahweh Pakaiyin natao na jouse donbut jing hen.
20.6: Tun keiman athaonu lengpa chu Yahweh Pakaiyin ahuhdohji ti ka hetai. Aman avan mun thenga kon a ahin donbut ding, chuleh athahatna nasatah a chu ahuhdoh ding ahi.
20.7: Namtin vaipi abankhat chun a sakol u leh sakol kangtalai hou akiletsah piuvin, ahin eihonvang Yahweh Pakai, eihon Elohim Pathen u minbou ikiletsahpi diu ahi.
20.8: Namtin vaipi hohi hunglhu'u vintin chip lhadiu ahi, ahinla eihovang idindoh diu chule dehtah a idin diu ahi.
20.9: Kalengpau chu galjona pe'n, O Yahweh Pakai! Panpi ngai a kakana neidonbut tei in.

21.1: Nathahatna ahi lengpa iti kipah hitam O Yahweh Pakai! Galjona napehjeh'in aman kipah'in kho asam e.
21.2: Ajeh chu nangin alungthim'a angaichan napen aman athumho khatcha jong nadapeh poi.
21.3: Nangin lolhin naleh houtheinan nalamto jin, aluchungah sana hoipen lallukhuh nakhuhsah'in ahi.
21.4: Aman ahinkho nahoitup peh din athumjin, chule nangin ataona nasanpeh jie. Ahin nikho jong tonsot a din nasuh saopeh ji e.
21.5: Nagaljona chun jabolna lentah achansah in, thupina le loupinan najemhoijin ahi.
21.6: Nangin tonsot malsomnan naphungvuh in chuleh nangtoh umkhom a nopna kipana achun naphung vuh e.
21.7: Ajeh chu lengpa'n Yahweh Pakai atahsan e. Hat chungnung ngailutna longlou chun alhuhna dinga konnin na hoidoh sah jingin ahi.
21.8: Nangin nagalmiho chu namattup sohkei ding, nangma nadouho jouse chu thahattah na banjetna chu na mattup ding ahi.
21.9: Nangma nahung teng amaho chu meikong lah'a naselut ding ahi. Yahweh Pakaiyin alunghanna a asuhgam ding meikonga ahalgam ding ahi.
21.10: Achateu leiset chunga kon a nathaimang ding; amahon sonlepah aneikitlou diu ahi.
21.11: Amahon nangdounan thil gong jongleu, athilse gonhou chu lolhing louding ahi.
21.12: Ajeh chu amahon nathalchang amaho kapna dinga nadoi chu amutenguleh kiheimang untin jammang diu ahitai.
21.13: O Yahweh Pakai na thahat na nasatah a chun hungthou doh tan. Tumgin le lasah to thoa nahat na natoh chu kakipa pi diu ahi.

22.1: Ka Pathen Elohim, ka Pathen idia neidalhah hitam? Panpi ngai a kamao teng idia gamlha tah a um ji nahim?
22.2: Niseh in nangma kakoujie, Elohim ka Pathen, hinlah nangin nei donbut poi. Janseh jongleh kakou ogin naja jin, hinlah lungmon na kanei jipoi.
22.3: Israel'in athangvah jing laltouna-a tou nangmahi Atheng nahi.
22.4: Kapu kapa teovin nangma natahsan un, nangman amaho nahuh hing tai.
22.5: Naheng a akap un huhhing in a umtaove. Amahon nangma natahsan un nang man amaho nasujum poi.
22.6: Hinlah keima hi mihem a dia lhing joulou lungtol bang bep kahi. Mijouse dia thet umle musit umchu kahitai!
22.7: Eimu jousen eihouseovin, aleiju adosah un, alu apeijun asei uve,
22.8: “Ama pa hi Elohim Pathena ki ngai pa chu hilou ham? Achuti le a Pathen Elohim chu kihuhdoh sah hen! Yahweh Pakaiyin amahi angailut a ahileh aYahweh Pakaiyin huh doh hen!”
22.9: Nangin kanu naobusunga konin neina hoidamin nei pui galkai in, kanu a-anglum laija patna nangma tahsanje neina hil ahitai.
22.10: Kahung pen a patna nangma ban thahatna a eikipelut a ahitai. Kahung penlhah a patna ka Pathen chu nangma nahi jing e.
22.11: Keija kon in gamla loujen in ajeh chu boina ahungnai in, koima dang eikithopi thei aumpoi.
22.12: Bongchal ho'n aum kimvel bangin kagal miten eihin um kimvel taovin, Bashan bongchal khohlai hon eium kimvel taove!
22.13: Hang tah le kisong tah Keipi bahkai in aneh ding aboltel bangin keima val lhum dingin akamkau ve.
22.14: Kahinkho hi twi banga kisunglha ahitai, kagu kachang hojong akilhep gamtan, kalungchang jong khoilu bangin ajunlha gamtai.
22.15: Nisan asah gep leilhang bangin katha akanghel jengtai. Kaleijong kadang chungah akikamat tai. Nangin vutvai lah a neijam in athidin neida lhatan ahi.
22.16: Kagalmiten uichahon bangin eium kimvel taovin. Migilou honkhat in eium kimvel taovin ahi.
22.17: Kagu kachang hojong simthei ahisoh tan. Kagal miten eiveovin eivesalteh jengun ahi.
22.18: Kavon hojong vang asan un akihom gamtaovin ahi.
22.19: O Yahweh Pakai keija konin umgamla hih behin! Nangma kathahatna nahi neihung kithopi loijin.
22.20: Nachemjam chun neihuhdoh in, kahinkho manlutah hi hiche uicha hoa kon in neihuhdoh peh in.
22.21: Keipi bahkai kam a kon in neiloidoh peh in lang hiche gambongchal hang kiteni ki a kon in neihuhdoh in.
22.22: Kasopi pasal holeh numeiho kom a naminhi phongjal leng katin, Houbung kikhom holah a nangma kathangvah ding ahi.
22.23: Ama gingho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah hen! Jacob chilhahte jousen amachu ging uvin! Israel chate jousen amachu jana peohen!
22.24: Ajeh chu aman migentheite thohgimna jouse chu anungsun pon, panpi ngaichatna a taona neiho angaipeh in ahi.
22.25: Keiman Houbung kikhopna lah a nangma kathang vahding ahi. Nangma chibai boh ho angsunga kakitepna kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
22.26: Mivaichaten neovintin vaset diu ahi. Yahweh Pakai holte jousen amachu athangvah diu ahi. Alung thim u tonsotna kipah jingding ahiuve.
22.27: Vannoi leiset miten Yahweh Pakai chu ahin hetdoh diu chuleh akom a hung kilediu ahi. Chutengleh namtin vaipi insung jousen a anga hungkun cheh diu ahi.
22.28: Ajeh chu leng thaneina chu Yahweh Pakai ama a bou ahi. Aman namtin vaipi chunga vai ahom ahi.
22.29: Leiset chunga mihaohon ankong sem untin chibai aboh diu ahi. Ahinkho kichai a leivui sohding athithei mihem jouse a anga kun cheh hen.
22.30: Ichate jouseuvin jong Ama kin ahinbol diu ahi. Ahung lhungding khang miten jong Yahweh Pakai kidanje chu ahin jahpeh diu ahi.
22.31: Tua penglou laiho komma jong thudih a anatoh naho jouse hung kiseipeh ding ahi. Amahon athilbol natoh naho jouse ahin jahdiu ahi.

23.1: Yahweh Pakai chu akelngoi keima eiching pa ahi, keiman lhah samna neiponge.
23.2: Aman hamhing dumlah lah a kelngoi bangin eikicholdo sahjin, kilinglou hel twiveina pang dungah eipuilei.
23.3: Yahweh Pakaiyin katha akiledoh ji. Amintheng khohsahna jalin lamdih lang jenga eipuilen ahi.
23.4: Thim jin napen phaicham palgalkai jongleng keima kichaponge, ajeh chu nangman naum jing in nateng gol le namoljol chun neihongin neilhamon jinge.
23.5: Ka melmate masangtah jenga jong nangin kaneh ding ankong neiluipeh in, naphat theina thao ka lujangah neinupeh in kadon ding khonjong phatthei na aletset in ahi.
23.6: Tahbeh in phatnale hepinan kahinkho lhung keiya eijui jingding ahi, chuleh keijong tonsot na Yahweh Pakaiyinn sunga kachenjing ding ahi.

24.1: vannoi leiset le asunga umjouse hi Yahweh Pakai a ahi. Vannoi pumpi le asunga cheng mihemte jousehi Ama a jeng ahi.
24.2: Ajeh chu Aman leiset khombul hi twikhanglen chunga atun ahin, twipi thuhlah a aphudet ahi.
24.3: Koiham Yahweh Pakai moul chunga kaldoh jouding? Koiham amunthenga dingthei ding?
24.4: Akhut le Alungthim thengho bou, chuleh milim semthu houlou le jou seilouho bou hidiu ahi.
24.5: Amahon bou Yahweh Pakai malsomna amudiu ahin, chuleh ahuh hingpao Elohim Pathen toh ki guijop na dihtah aneitheidiu ahi.
24.6: Hitobang miho hinbou nangma naholthei diu chuleh Jacob Elohim Pathen nangma nachibai theidiu ahi.
24.7: Khanglui kelkot ho kihonglen un! Khanglui kotpiho kihong len un lang leng loupi chu lutsah un.
24.8: Koiham lengloupi chu? Yahweh Pakai hattah leh thupi tah, Yahweh Pakai koiman ajojou lou galhattah chu ahi.
24.9: Khanglui kelkot ho kihong lennun, khanglui kotpiho kihong lennun, loupina leng chu lutsah un
24.10: Koiham lengloupi chu? Van Elohim Pathen sepai, Ama hi leng loupi chu ahi.

25.1: O Yahweh Pakai, kahinkho hi nang kapetai.
25.2: Nang katahsan e Elohim ka Pathen! Nei jumso hihbeh in, chule kalel na a hin ka melmate kichoisang sah hihbeh in.
25.3: Nangma tahsan koimachan jumna ato loudiu ahi, amavang mijoulhep gojing honvang jumna ato diu ahi.
25.4: O Yahweh Pakai lamdih chu neihil in; kajuiding lampi chu neiko peh in.
25.5: Nathutah chu neihil in hichea chun neipui in ajeh chu nangmahi eihuh hinga Elohim ka Pathen chu nahi. Nilhum kei keijin nanga hin kinepna kanei jinge.
25.6: O Yahweh Pakai gol lui a patna neihin puinao nami khoto nale na mingailutna longlou hingeldoh in.
25.7: Ka khangdon lai a kachonset gitlou naho neigeldoh peh hih inlang nami ngailutna longlouva neipuina johchu galdoh in, ajeh chu nangma milungset them nahi, O Yahweh Pakai.
25.8: Yahweh Pakaihi apha ahin adih jengbou abol'e, aman lamdihlou vache ho jeng jong lamdih akopeh jinge.
25.9: Aman mi kineosah hochu lamdih a apuijin, ama dei lampi chu ahil jinge.
25.10: Yahweh Pakai kitepna nitjing holeh ama deipeh dungjuiya chonho chu ami ngailutna longlou leh akitahna in apuihoi jinge.
25.11: Namin loupina dingin O Yahweh Pakai, ka chonsetna simjoulou neingai dam in.
25.12: Yahweh Pakai ging ho chu koi ho hiuvam? Amaho che nading lampi chu Yahweh Pakaiyin avetsah ding ahi.
25.13: Amaho chu khangtou untin achateovin jong gamsung alodingu ahi.
25.14: Yahweh Pakai hi ama gingjing tedinga golphapen ahin, Aman hitobang miho chu akitepna ahiljing e.
25.15: Kamit tenin Yahweh Pakaichu avejingin, aman kagalmite thangkol a kon in eihuhdoh jinging e.
25.16: Neihin ang-ngatnin lang neikho ton, ajeh chu keima kachangseh a lungthom haotah a um a kahi.
25.17: Kaboi na ho akhoh se cheh un. Oh hichehoa konhin neihuhdoh in.
25.18: Kalung gimnahi neihet pehin chuleh kahah satna hohi neivet peh inlang kachonset naho ngaidam in.
25.19: Ven galmi ijat mong kanei hitam chule ama hohin ichan geija eihotnu hitam!
25.20: Neivengbit in! amaho akonna hin kahinkho huhdoh in! nangma a kisel kahi neijumso hihbeh in.
25.21: Kitah nale thenna in eivengbit hen ajeh chu nanga hin kakinepna aum jinge.
25.22: Vo Elohim Pathen Israelte hi aboi najouseu va kon in lhatdoh tan.

26.1: O Yahweh Pakai themmo na bei kahihi phongdoh tan, ajeh chu keiman kitah na neitah in hinkho kamang in nungchonlou hel in Yahweh Pakai a tahsan na dettah kaneije.
26.2: Yahweh Pakai neipatep inlang neikhol chil in, kachondan leh kalungthim hi vechen mongin!
26.3: Ajeh chu neingailutna longlouhi keiman kahejing e, chuleh keiman nathudih dung jui in hinkho kamange.
26.4: Keima mijouho tojong kakivop khompon, miphalhem ho deilam jong kachepipon ahi.
26.5: Keiman migiloute kikhop na kathet in thilphalou hojong kanuse ji e.
26.6: Themmona kaneilou vetsahna in kakhut kasil in namaicham kahin jon e O Yahweh Pakai,
26.7: Thangvah la sapum in nakidan na ho kaphong doh e.
26.8: Na Hou-In theng kangailui, Yahweh Pakai, naum pi na loipi tah kilan doh na mun chu.
26.9: Michonse ho thoh ding neithoh sah hih in, tolthat hoto kibang in neithep mo sah hih in.
26.10: Set bolnom nan akhutnu asuboh un, chuleh amahon phatseh in nehguh akilah un ahi.
26.11: Keiman hitobang hinkho chu kamangpon, kitahna hinkhoa kading jinge. Hijeh chun neilhat doh inlang nami hepina chun neipuijin.
26.12: Tun keima tolgo lai a dettah in kadinge chuleh keiman lhangphong tah a Yahweh Pakai kathang vahding ahi.

27.1: Yahweh Pakaihi keidin vah leh huhhingna ahi. Chuti ahileh idia kakichat ding ham? Yahweh Pakaihi kakulpi, hahsatna a eihuhdoh pa ahi. Chuti ahileh ken idia kakithin ding ham?
27.2: Migilou ten suhgamdia eihindel khum uva, kagalmite leh eidou teovin eihin nokhumteng uleh kipal lhuvintin chuleh lhugam diu ahi.
27.3: Galmi tamtah in eium kimvel jeng jongleh kalung linglao ponte, ijemtin thagam dingin eihin delkhum jongleo Elohim ka Pathen a lung mongtah a kaum ding ahi.
27.4: Hiche thilkhat Yahweh Pakai henga kathum kadei pipen chu kahinkho lhumkeija Yahweh Pakaiyin na umding, Yahweh Pakai lolhinna a chu lunglhaisel a um a aHou-In na aphatnaho geljinga hinkho manding hi ahi.
27.5: Ajeh chu aman hahsatna a konna eihoidoh sahding a Houin thenga chu eihoibit ding Aman mi maiphah louva songpi chunga eiselding ahi.
27.6: Ajeh chu boina hon eihin lonkhum jong le Aman eihoi dam ding ahi. Ama Hou-Intheng sunga kipah le thanom tah a pumgo thilto kabolding semjang saipum a Yahweh Pakai thangvah la kasah ding ahi.
27.7: Kahung taove neingai peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Namikhoto na pum in neidonbut in.
27.8: “Hungin lang neihoulim pin” nati chu kalungthim in ajan hitin adonbutne, “Yahweh Pakai kahunge”
27.9: Yahweh Pakai neinung ngat hihbeh in. Na lunghan nan nasoh hi paidoh hihbeh in. Nangmahi eikithopi phapen chu nahijenge. Tun neipaidoh hih in; neidalha hih in, O Elohim Pathen ka huhing pu.
27.10: Kanu le kapan eipaidoh jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakaiyin eikolchah jing ding ahi.
27.11: O Yahweh Pakai kahinkho manding Dan neihil in lamdih jenga neipuiin, ajeh chu kagal miten eichang lhijingun ahi.
27.12: Amaho khut a neilhah lutsah hih in, ajeh chu amahon kabol louhel thil a themo eichan un, phatin in kachungah thilse abolgo jingun ahi.
27.13: Ahijeng vangin, hiche mihing gam a kaum laisen Yahweh Pakai phatna kamu jing jeng ding kakinem e.
27.14: Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tahin ngah jingin, Hanginlang hatnin, Henge, Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in ngah jingin.

28.1: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi nakom a kataove, Ngaipeh lou in neikoi hih beh in. Ajeh chu nangin neithip sanleh keijong lhadah ing kating kathi ding ahitai.
28.2: Hepina ngeh a neipanpi dia katao teng nei ngaipeh tei in, kakhut kahin domsang in namun theng lam kahinsan e.
28.3: Thilse bolnom jing a, akam uva thungei ngei seija alung sunguva thilse jeng gonle ho to nei sumang tha hih beh in.
28.4: Amahon achanding dol u athilse bolu toh kitoh in got na pejengin! Athilse bolu dungjui chetnin lethuh jengin! Michunga athilse bol gu'utoh kitoh in amaho chungah chuhsah in.
28.5: Yahweh Pakaiyin ipi abolham ti amahon anahsah pouve, Elohim Pathen khut sem ipi jeh a umham agel pouve, hijeh a chu aman abotel a tonsot gei a kitung doh lou diu ahitai.
28.6: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen! Ajeh chu khotona kangaicha a kataona chu eijah pehtai.
28.7: Yahweh Pakai hi kahat nale kalum ahi. Kalungthim pumpin amachu katah san e. Aman eikithopin kalungthim kipanan adim e. Thangvahna la'n keiman kasam phonge.
28.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin amite thahat apei, amahi athaonu lengpa dinga ahoidohna kulpi ahi
28.9: Namite huhhing in! Kelngoi chingpha bangin nagoulu Israel chu phatthei bohtan, chule tonsot in amahohi nabanjetnin puitan.

29.1: Nangho vanmi hon Yahweh Pakaichu jana peuvin; Aloupi nale athahatna jeh in Yahweh Pakaichu jana pecheh un.
29.2: Amin loupinajeh in Yahweh Pakai chu jabolcheh un. Athenna thupitah jehchun Yahweh Pakaichu chibai bohun.
29.3: Twipi chungah Yahweh Pakai ogin athong doh e. Vanthamjol ginbang in Elohim Pathen loupina akithonge. Yahweh Pakaihi twikhanglen chungah akithonge.
29.4: Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thaneitah ahi, Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thupitah ahi.
29.5: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin Cedar thing thupitah hojong aban tumboh gam e; Yahweh Pakai thupinan Lebanon Cedar thingho jong asubong soh gamtai.
29.6: Aman Lebanon moljeng jong bongnou bangin akichop sah e, Aman Hermon moljeng jong gambong bangin akichop sah e.
29.7: Yahweh Pakai oginhi kolphe meivah gimneitah banga ginga ahi.
29.8: Yahweh Pakai Ogin chun gamthip gamgolai jeng jong akilinsah e; Kadesh gamgolai jong Elohim Pathenin akilin sah e.
29.9: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin gangpi phung phatah hojong ahot ling in, gammang jong asuchai hel e. AHou-In theng sungah mijousen “Aloupi” tin asam uve.
29.10: Yahweh Pakai chu twipi chunga chun atouvin vai ahom e.
29.11: Yahweh Pakaiyin amite thahat apen, Yahweh Pakaiyin amite chamna apen phatthei aboh'e.

30.1: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh tahjeh in kahin thangvah e. Nangin kagalmite kachunga nakithang at sahpon ahi.
30.2: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen panpi ngaichan kahin kouvin nangman ka tahsa nakiledoh sah tai.
30.3: O Yahweh Pakai nangin lhankhuh a kon in neihin puidoh in, thina kokhuh a ka lhahlut na dinga kon in jong neihoidoh sah e.
30.4: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna lasaovin! Amintheng chu choi an'un.
30.5: Ajeh chu alunghan hi phat chomcha bou ahijin, ami hepina vang hinkhoa ding ahi. Ka na nikho ho jong kipanin ajui pai jitai.
30.6: Keiman ka phatthei nikhon, “Imachan eisutang jouponte!” kanati.
30.7: O Yahweh Pakai nami hepinahin muol bangin eisudettai. Keija kon a nakiheimang jiteng leh keima kading jou jipoi.
30.8: O Yahweh Pakai nahenga kahung tao ahi. Nami hepina chu kathum in hitin kaseije,
30.9: “Keima kathi alhankhuh a ka lhalut teng nangdinga ipi phachom dingham? Katahsa leivui in nang navah choi thei dingham? Nakitah na thu chu hiche hin aphondoh thei ding ham?
30.10: Neihin ngaipeh in Yahweh Pakai neihin khoto in. O Yahweh Pakai neihin kithopin”
30.11: Nangin kalung khamnahi kipah tah a lam nan neiheidoh pehtai. Nangin kalung khamna silpon neilahdoh pehin kipana silpon joh neisilpehtan ahi.
30.12: Hitiachu thipsan louva thangvahna la kasah jing theina dingin. O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen, keiman nangma tonsot in thangvah jing tange.

31.1: O Yahweh Pakai neihuhdoh ding ngaichan nakom kahin bel e; Jumna neimusah hih behin. Neihuh dohin ajeh chu nangma chondihtah Elohim Pathen nahi.
31.2: Kataona najah nadin neingai peh tei in; neihung huhdoh loi in. Kakiselna songpin pang jing inlang, kahoidohna kulpi hijing in.
31.3: Nangmahi kasongpile kakulpi nahi namin loupina dingin kahahsatna a konnin neihuh doh in.
31.4: Kadougal hon kalhuhna dinga thang eikampeh naova kon in neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu kahoidoh nahi nangma a bou aum e.
31.5: Kalhagao nangma khut a ka pedoh tai. Neihuhdoh in Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu nangmahi kitah jing Elohim Pathen nahi.
31.6: Phatchom nabei semthu pathen hou hokhu keiman kathet ahi. Kenvang Yahweh Pakai katahsan jing e.
31.7: Nami ngailutna longlou jeh in keima kipah thanom jing inge, ajeh chu nangin kaboina ho neihet peh jingin chuleh kalung gimna jouse nangin neihet thempeh jingin ahi.
31.8: Nangin kadougal ho khutnah neipelutpon, lungmon na munjoh a neikoi jin ahi.
31.9: Neikhoton Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu keima hahsatna a um kahin kamitlhin kamit akhutan ahi. Kahinnale katahsa abeipaiding ahitai.
31.10: Lungkham a thipaiding kahitai, gentheinan kahinkho asuhchom tai. Chonset in kajaitha anem sah in asung langa beipai ding kahitai.
31.11: Kamelma ten eisamseovin, kaheng kakom ten eitheuvin ahi. Kagol kapaite jeng jongin eihin naingam tapouvin ahi. Lampi dunga eimu jongleh ajam mang gamji taove.
31.12: Keima mithisa bang leh bel kehsa bangin notthap in kaumtai.
31.13: Keima chung changhi thujoungen eikisei khum in tijatnan eium kimvel tan, kadougal ten keidounan thilse agong un kahinkho hi suhmang ding agouve.
31.14: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai keima nanga kingai jing kahin, “Nangma Elohim ka Pathen nahi!” kati.
31.15: Khonung kakhankho hi nangkhut a um ahin hitia tanglouva eidelle jinghoa konin neihuhdoh in.
31.16: Nami khotona chun nasohpa hi hinsalvah in, namingailutna longlou chun neihin huhdoh tan.
31.17: O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh in, ajeh chu panpi ngaichan nangma kakou jinge, miphalou hochu jumsah jon, amaho chu alhankhuh uvah thipsan sahtan.
31.18: Jouthu pot na alei u suthip in, ami noise nao le Elohim Pathen mite a houset nao leichu suthip jengin.
31.19: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma gingte dingin nangin ijakai nasuh nengpeh hi iti phat apha hitam. Panpi ngaicha a nakom a hungte nangman naphat thei in, vannoi mite mitmu changtah in nangman phatthei nabohjin ahi.
31.20: Nangin amahochu suhsetding gohoa kon in na angsunga nahoi bitjin, chuleh ahousetnao leile danga kon in jong na angsungah nahoibit jinge.
31.21: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahin umhen, ajeh chu Aman angailutna longlou kidangtah chu eimusah jingin, kachen na khopi gal akinokhum a kon in jong eihoidoh sahtan ahi.
31.22: Lunglinglao pum in keima kapengjah in, “Yahweh Pakai toh eiki sukhentai!” kati. Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangin nei kho to dia ka ka na neijahpeh in panpi ngaicha a kakouna neidonbut tai.
31.23: Nangho Elohim Pathen miteho Yahweh Pakai chu ngailu vin! Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin ama a kingai jingho chu ahuhdoh jingin ahi. Ahinlah mi noiseho chu engbolna nasatah apejin ahi.
31.24: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakaiya kinepna neiho jouse hatnunlang hangun!

32.1: Oh, asei ngailou nahou ki angaidam a achon set nahou kisuhmang peh ho iti thanop um hitam.
32.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin ajihlutsa achonset nao athaimang peh a ahinkhou jongkitah tah a mangho chu iti kipa um a hitam!
32.3: Keiman kachonset kaphon nomlou chun katahsa chu amangthah anahin, niseh in kapeng in kamao jinge.
32.4: Sun le jan in kipui dih na nakhujol chun eidou ve. Nipilai a nichangsat in asuhkang twihu bangin katha asukang hel jengin ahi.
32.5: Akhon nan kachon setna nahenga kaphong in, kamo najouse selguh ding golou vin kasei tai “Kalouchal kasetna jouse Yahweh Pakai kom a phongdoh tang e” kati. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai nangin neingaidam e! Kachonsetna jouse abeisoh tai.
32.6: Hijeh chun, phatpha umlai hin Elohim Pathen mite jouse naheng a taocheh uhen, hiche thutanna twilen lah a alhahlut lou nadiuvin.
32.7: Ajeh chu nangma hi kakiselna kulpi nahin; nangin boinana a kon in neihuh doh e. Galjona lan neiumkimvel tai.
32.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin aseije, “Nahinkho a lampi phapen achu kapui le ding ahi. Keiman kathu mop a kavetsui jing ding nahi.
32.9: Sakol le Sangan bangin hetna beiyin um hih in, ajo leh kamdal le thihkol bupeh a thunoiya ki koi nabah loding ahi.”
32.10: Miphalou hohi lungkhamna tamtah in abomjin, ahinla Yahweh Pakai tahsan hovang angailutna longlouvin aum kimvel jingin ahi.
32.11: Hijeh chun ama lungdei a chon ho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom jingun! Milung thengho jouse thanom tah in khosam un!

33.1: Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la kipah tahin saohen; milung thenghon Ama athangvah diuhi lomtah ahi.
33.2: Semjang gin ngaitah in Yahweh Pakai thangvah un, tumgin jangsom ngaitah saijin nguiheo vin saovin.
33.3: Yahweh Pakai thangvahnan lathah saovin; thepna neitah in selangdah saijun lang kipah tah in la saovin.
33.4: Yahweh Pakai thusei jouse chu atah ahin chuleh anatoh athilbol jouse chu tahsan thei cheh ahi.
33.5: Adihleh apha kiti jouse chu Yahweh Pakai deilam ahin, Amingailutna longlou chun vannoi leiset hi adimin ahi.
33.6: Yahweh Pakai thucheng hin bou vanmun hi asem doh in, Ama thucheng haikhum chun ahsi jouse apendoh sah tai.
33.7: Aman twikhanglen jong agamgi asempeh in chule twikhanglen jouse hi munkhat a aveikhom sah in akoidet in ahi.
33.8: Vannoi leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakaihi jana peohen, chuleh mijouse a-angsung a kichatah in dingu hen.
33.9: Ajeh chu ama thucheng khat in leiset khang akipatsah ahi! Ama thupeh a kitungdoh jeng ahi.
33.10: Yahweh Pakaiyin namtin vaipi thil gon houchu asuhboi peh in, chuleh atohgon hou jouse chu asuhmo peh in ahi.
33.11: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai thilgon vang tonsot in adet jing e, ama tohgot hochu itih a jong killing lou ahi.
33.12: A pakaiju Elohim Pathen hikha nammite chu anunnom ahiuve, Yahweh Pakaiyin agoulo dinga alhen nammite chu anun nom ahiuve.
33.13: Yahweh Pakaiyin vanna konnin mihemte jouse ahin ven musoh kei e.
33.14: Alaltouna a konin ahin ven leiset chunga cheng jouse hindan ahesoh keijin ahi.
33.15: Alung thim u sempa ama ahijeh'in alung gellu le athilbol jouseo ahesoh kei e.
33.16: Gal manchah phapen in lengpa huhdoh jou pontin, hangta le hansan nan jong gal hat pa ahuh doh jou poi.
33.17: Gal satna sakol khatnin jong gal na josah jouding ahipon, thahatna jousen jong nang nahuhdoh jouponte.
33.18: Ahinla Yahweh Pakaiyin ama gingte, angailut na longlou va ki ngaijing ho avelhi jing e.
33.19: Yahweh Pakaiyin amaho chu athina diuva kon in ahuhdoh jin athigam nadiuva kon in ahuh dohjin ahi.
33.20: Keihon Yahweh Pakaiyah kinepna kakoi ui. Ajeh chu amahi eiki thopiu leh eilum uva pang ahi.
33.21: Ama a hin ilungthimu akipah in, ajeh chu eihon amin thenga tahsan na dettah inei un ahi.
33.22: Vo Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou achun eium kimvel u hen, ajeh chu nang jenga bou ka kinepnao aum e.

34.1: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu phat tin in thang vah in kate. Yahweh Pakai thagvah nahi kakam sunga gingdoh jingding ahi.
34.2: Keima Yahweh Pakaiya bou kithang at jing ding kahin; Panpi beite jouse lunglut cheh uhen.
34.3: Hungun Yahweh Pakai loupi nahi seiphong khom u hitin amin hi choi-an khom u hite.
34.4: Keima Yahweh Pakai kom a kataovin aman kataona eisanpeh tai. Aman kakichatna jousea jong eilhat doh tai.
34.5: Ama panpi ding ngaicha jouse vah bangin hungvah doh untin, amai uva jachatna muthim jinglou helding ahi.
34.6: Kahahsat behseh phat in kataovin Yahweh Pakaiyin eingai peh e; aman kaboina jouse eisuh lhap peh tai.
34.7: Yahweh Pakai vantil chu hoidamna ahin; ama ging te aman aumkimvel in ahuhdoh jinge.
34.8: Yahweh Pakai phatje chu patepmun lang veovin, Yahweh Pakaiya kisel jing mite chu iti kipa hitaovem!
34.9: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite ho Yahweh Pakai chu ging jingun ajeh chu ama ging jingten angai chat jouse amudiu ahi.
34.10: Keipi bahkai gol hat laitah jong agilkel jin, ahin Yahweh Pakai tahsandet jing hovang thilpha alhasam ngaipouve.
34.11: Kachate ho hunguvin kaseihi kingai phaovin, chuleh keiman Elohim Pathen ginje kahilding nahiu ve.
34.12: Hinkho sottah leh phatthei na lhingset a hingnom umkha em?
34.13: Thuse seinan nalei tuhtangin lang chuleh nakam jong jouseinan mang hih in!
34.14: Thilse a kon in kihai mangin lang thilpha bol in, chamna hol in lang hichu chepin.
34.15: Yahweh Pakai mitin thilpha boljingho avesui jingin; panpi ngai a koute din akol tenin jong akihong jing e.
34.16: Hinla thilse bolte chu dou mit nin aven, aman amin u leiset akon athaimang ding ahi.
34.17: Yahweh Pakaiyin panpi ngaichaho kouna angaipeh in. Aboi naova kon in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
34.18: Lungthim kisuchipte kom a Yahweh Pakai chu anai in; Alhagao kisu gimte ahuhdoh jin ahi.
34.19: Michonpha hon boina tampi atohjiuvin, hinla Yahweh Pakaiyin phat tinin ahung huhdoh jin ahi.
34.20: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin michonpha ho gule chang ahoibit pehjin; khatchajong abohsah pon ahi!
34.21: Hamset nan migiloute hinkho alah teiding, michonpha ho hotbol tejong got na chang tei diu ahi.
34.22: Hinla Yahweh Pakaiyin ama kin bolho vang alhatdoh ding, ama a kisel jing honjong themmo changlou diu ahi.

35.1: Yahweh Pakai, eidou ho hi nangin kidoupin, ei kisatpi ho jong nangin kisatpin.
35.2: Nalum leh naumpho hin kipat in. Galmun a din kigon lang neihung kithopin.
35.3: Eihin delkhum ho dounan natengcha leh nateng muh chu hin lam tan. “Keiman gal kajopeh ding nahi!” ti neijah sah tan.
35.4: Eithat goho chunga hin jumnale jachatna lhun sah in, eigimbol a eisumang go hohi jumson lang nungno jeng tan.
35.5: Huilah a changvai alenmang bangin lenmang sah in, Yahweh Pakaiya kon a vantil banga hung chu semmang sah in.
35.6: A lam lhah nao thimsah inlang lhonalsah in, Yahweh Pakai vantil chun nungdel peh u hen.
35.7: Keiman amaho kabol sepoi, ahin amahon kei matna dingin kotong eilai khum un ahi! Ken amaho kabol sepoi ahin amahon keimat nadin kotong alai uve.
35.8: Hijeh chun amaho chunga hetman louvin mathahna hunglhung hen! Kei ona dia asem u kotong chu amaho manthahna hijo tahen.
35.9: Chuteng keima Yahweh Pakai akakipa ding ahi. Eilhatdoh jeh a keima kipa thanom ding kahi.
35.10: Katahsa chunga kagu kachang jouse pum a Yahweh Pakai kathangvah ding ahi: “Yahweh Pakai koiham nangtoh kitekah theiding? Koidang ba ham mihatpa thaneina a konna panpi beipa huhdoh a chu?”
35.11: Engbolna dih louvin eithemmo sah un. Kahetphahlou jouthu a monna eikichan e.
35.12: Amahon kathil phabol jengjong thilsen eile thuh un lung lhahnan kangui heltai.
35.13: Ahijeng vangin amahon anat tenguleh keiman amaho kalainatpi jin khaodip pon kakisil in anngol in amaho kataopeh jin ahi. Hinla kataona donbut louvin ahung kinung le jitai.
35.14: Ka golpha le insung mi monga kagel jeh in kalungkham pin, eihinga kanu kalainatpi bang bangin kalainat pi jin ahi.
35.15: Hinlah ken tunia boina katophat in amaho akipah un keidounan thanom tah in akiloi khomun, hiti chun kahetkhahlou miho kisan in tujeng in jong eino khum un; phat tin in eihouse jing jengun ahi.
35.16: Amahon einuisat un eitam seovin noise tah in eihagel khum un ahi.
35.17: O Yahweh Pakai itih changei pi neivet a donlouva neikoi ding hitam?
35.18: Chutengleh mipi tamtah ki khom te lah a kipathu kahin seiding ahi. Mipi ho jouse masanga nangma kahin thangvah ding ahi.
35.19: Kajolel nachung a hin eidou te kipa thanop sah hih beh in. Kamuiset nachung in jong ajeh bei a eivetda ho kitai sah hih beh in.
35.20: Amahon chamna thu aseipouvin, amahon thepmona neilou atoh dingdol bep tongho dounan thilse agong jingun ahi.
35.21: “Aha! Aha! ipi bol kigo nahi kamit tah un kamudoh taove!” tin asam uve.
35.22: O Yahweh Pakai nangin hicheghi namusoh kei in nahesoh e, donlouvin koihih beh in O Yahweh Pakai. neidalha hihbeh in O Yahweh Pakai.
35.23: Hungthoudoh in! eihuhdoh dingin hung dingdoh jengtan! Yahweh ka Pakai le Elohim ka Pathen kachung thuhi neitan peh in.
35.24: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim, kamo louna neiphon doh peh tan, ajeh chu nangma thudih a thutan nahi. Kaboina chung chon a kadougal te nuisat in neium sah hih beh in.
35.25: “Veovin itup uchu imutaove! Tua hi ahingsan a inehchai diu ahitai!” tisah hihbeb in.
35.26: Kahahsatna nikhoa kipah ho sujum inlang jachat sah in. Kachunga hanla samhohi jumnaleh minsetnan lhuh khumin.
35.27: Ahin koi hileh keima ei huhdia hung ho jouse chu kipanalentah pen. “Yahweh Pakai aloupi e aman asoh hi lunglhai tah in phatthei aboh in lungmon na apei!” tin tanglouvin samjingu hen.
35.28: Chuteng keiman nathutan adihji samphong ingting niseh a nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.

36.1: Chonsetnin miphalou ho lungthim gilsungah thu aseijin ahi. Amahon Elohim Pathen ginna him him aneipouve.
36.2: Akihisah naovin amaho le amaho akijou lhepmun ichan geija gilouleh phamo hiuvam ti akihet pouve.
36.3: Athusei anatohna hou jousehi adihlou leh kijou lhepna ngen ahi. Chingthei tah a natoh leh thilpha bol dinghi adatthei pouve.
36.4: Jankhosot in ahah un thildihlou tohgon tamtah agong jiuvin ahi. Atohdoh uhi apha khatcha aum poi. Thilsea konna kiheidoh ding angaito mong mong pouve.
36.5: O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlouhi van bangin aki hohjale, nakitahna hin meilom kaina mun hohi akho khel e.
36.6: Nadih na jong muolsang vum tobang ahi. Nathutan dihdan jong twikhanglen thuhtah abang e. Nangin mihemleh ganhing hojong kibanga nangailut ahi.
36.7: O Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou hi eti mamtam hitam! Mihem jousen nami ngailutna lhaving limnoija chun choldo na anei ui.
36.8: Nainsunga nehkemlou ann a chun navah van, kanglou nalui a twi chun nadon sah e.
36.9: Ajeh chu nangma mihem hung kondohna twinah nahin, keihon kamu u vahjonghi nanga kon ahi.
36.10: Yahweh Pakai nangma ngailuho chung a nami ngailutna longlou chu londoh sah in, milung thengho chunga thu adih in tanpeh in.
36.11: Mi kiletsah ho neichotpha sah hih in, ahilouleh miphalouho sot tol le neihisah hih in.
36.12: Ven! Thildihlou bolteho alhugam taove! Amahochu kithoudoh kit loudinga sot lhuh ahitaove.

37.1: Mikitahlou te chung a lungkham dan, thildihlou bolte jong thangse hih in.
37.2: Ajeh chu amaho khu hamhing banga molloi diu, nipilai pahchaho banga goplha loidiu ahi.
37.3: Yahweh Pakai chu tahsa inlang thilpha bollin. Chutileh gamsunga lungmongin chengin natin nakhan touding ahi.
37.4: Yahweh Pakai a kipah jingin, chutileh aman nalung sunga nangai chatchan napehding ahi.
37.5: Nabol natoh jouse Yahweh Pakai a pelut jengin, ama chu tahsanin chutileh aman nakithopi ding ahi.
37.6: Aman nathem na chu khovah banga muthimlah a avahdoh sahding ahi. Chuleh nachanchin jong sunlai nisa banga avahdoh sahding ahi.
37.7: Yahweh Pakai masangah lungneng chan ngahhat in Aman ahintoh ding chu ngah hat in. Mi giloute ahaotheiukhu lungkhampi hih un, athilse gon ujong lunghimo peh hih in.
37.8: Lungchom lunghan bolhih in! Lung sat a kon in jong kihei mangin. Nalung lhaso hih in hichun thilse lamma bou napui lut ding ahi.
37.9: Ajeh chu migiloute kisumang ding ahin, amavang Yahweh Pakai tahsan a dingdet ho chun gamsung alodiu ahi.
37.10: Migilou hohi gangtah a mangthah diu ahin, amaho chu hol le jonglechun mangthai ding ahitaove.
37.11: Kisunem tah a umhon gamsung alodiu ahin, lungmong tah leh ninglhing tah a inchengdiu ahi.
37.12: Mi gilouten Elohim Pathen ngaisah miho douna ahinbol diu; Amahon engset sanna ahin nelpehdiu ahi.
37.13: Hinlah Yahweh Pakaiyin amaho chu ahin nuisat in, ajeh chu aman achung thu kitanna ding nikhou ahunglhun chu amui.
37.14: Mi-engsen hon mivaicha ho leh suhgam theija umte that dingin achemjam u hin asatdoh un, athalpiu hin loisal uvintin, thilpha bolte chu ahin suhmang gotdiu ahi.
37.15: Hinlah achemjam un amaho lungchang asutpai johding chuleh athalpiu chu bong ding ahi.
37.16: Ase bola thil tampi neisangin Elohim Pathen mite hia lhomcha nei aphachomjoi.
37.17: Ajeh chu migiloute hatna chu kisumang ding, Pahen mite vang Yahweh Pakaiyin avenbit jing ding ahi.
37.18: Ani ania Yahweh Pakaiyin themmona neilou hochu avetsui ding, chule amahon tonsotna mang louding gou chu alodiu ahi.
37.19: Amahochu hahsat nikho jongleh kijumso loudiu kel lhah nikho jong leh angaichat ho anei teidiu ahi.
37.20: Migiloute mangthai diu ahi, Yahweh Pakai dougal miho jong loulaija pahcha tobang ahiuve-mei banga hung mang loi diu ahi.
37.21: Migilouten asumpa lah u anungsah ngaipouvin, Elohim Pathen mite vang hongphal tah a peh jeng ahiuve.
37.22: Yahweh Pakai phatthei changhon gamsung alodiu ahin, aman asapset ho vang mangthah diu ahi.
37.23: Elohim Pathen mite, Yahweh Pakaiyin akalsondan avetpeh in, ahinkho mandan jouse aman akipapin ahi.
37.24: Amaho chu kipal jongleu lhupai loudiu, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin akhut in atuh jing ui.
37.25: Phat khat lai chun khangdong kahin tun kateh tai, ahin Elohim Pathen mite paidoh a aumlam kahepon, achateo jong khutdon apangkhapouve.
37.26: Elohim Pathen miten khotona neitah in sumpa ahomjiuvin, chuleh achateojong phatthei achang jiuve.
37.27: Thilse akonin kiheidoh in thilpha bol in, chutileh tonsot a gamsunga nachen ding ahi.
37.28: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin thudih bou adei in, Elohim Pathenin acha teu jong donlou a akoi louhel ding ahi. Aman ahoibit jing ding, Gitlou bol chate vang mangthah diu ahi.
37.29: Elohim Pathen chaten gamsung alodiu ahin, tonsotna cheng jingdiu ahi.
37.30: Elohim Pathen mite kamsunga thudih apotjin adihle adihlou ahilthem jiuve.
37.31: Elohim Pathen Dan chu amaho changval din akisan un, hijeh a chu Ama lampi a konna vah lonle loudiu ahi.
37.32: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen mite achanglhi leuvin, suhmang nading lampi ahol jiuve.
37.33: Hinlah Yahweh Pakaiyin migiloute alolhin sah louhel ding Elohim Pathenin mikitah te patepna a aum tengu le themmo achan louhel ding ahi.
37.34: Yahweh Pakai ah kinem jingin. Alamlhong achun ching thei tah in lamjot in. Aman nadopsang a agam leiset nalosah ding ahi. Migilou te manthahvang namu ding ahi.
37.35: Keiman migilou le khotonabei te Lebanon gama Ceder thingphung phatah banga akhantouvu kamui.
37.36: Ahin kanungvet kitle, ana beisoh taove! Ken kahol le vang in kamudoh joutapoi!
37.37: Milungtheng holeh miphaho khu veovin, chamna adei hochu amakhouva thilphatah in angah jing ui.
37.38: Hinla thilse bolte suhmanga umdiu ahi; amahon khonung hinkho aneipouve.
37.39: Yahweh Pakaiyin mikitah te chu ahuhdoh jin; boina nikho hoa jong Amahi akulpiu ahi.
37.40: Aman amaho chu akithopin, migiloutea kon in ahuhdohjin ahi. Aman amahochu ahuhdoh in, amahon ama a lungmon na anei un ahi.

38.1: O Yahweh Pakai lung phatmo nan neilethuh hih in, nalunghan jeh in jong neijep hih in!
38.2: Nathal changho kasunga akikam dentan, nakhuttum in neivo lhutan ahi.
38.3: Neilunghan khum jeh in katahsa pumpi hi anan, kachonset naho jeh in katahsa achip soh tai.
38.4: Kathepmo nan eilon khum in, agihdan poh jouhoi ahitapoi.
38.5: Ngolhoi tah a kana chonset jehin, kamaha anasetan auidoh leotai.
38.6: Kathoh gimna hin ei kong konsah tai, lung gim tah in nilhum kei in kavah len ahi.
38.7: Khosih pi kasunga meikong bangin a allin, eidammo sahtai.
38.8: Keima kalhasam in kapum in kagoi lhatai. Kalungthim natna a kon in kapeng pengin ahi.
38.9: Yahweh Pakai nangin ipi kangai chat ham nahei, nangin ka khoisatna jouse najai.
38.10: Kahaina hu alhasam tan katha beitai, chule kamit in jong kho amu tapoi.
38.11: Kangailut chengle kagol kapaiten kahivei hi akichaovin eidalha taove. Ka insung mite jengjong achomin aumtaovin ahi.
38.12: Hiche jeng a jong chun kagalmi ten kathi nading thang akam nalai uve. Kaman thahna ding toh gon anei un, nilhum keijin kathi nading agong taovin ahi.
38.13: Hinlah ken eikigih naho jouse chu kakijah mosah in, chuleh amasang uvah apaomo bangin thipbeh in kaumtai.
38.14: Imacha jahlouding kanom in chuleh donbutna jong donbutlou ding kanom e.
38.15: Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma ngah jinga um a kahi. Nangin kataona neidonbut tei ding ahi O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen.
38.16: Keima katao in, “kadougalte noise tah in eivetsah dan, kalhuhna a jong kitaisah dan.”
38.17: Keima tanglouva kathohgim na-ah akichaipai ding kahitai.
38.18: Hinlah kachonset naho kaphong-doh in, ka nachonna ho chu kakisih behseh jenge.
38.19: Keiman dougal khohtah tah ho kanei e; amahon ajeh beihel in eidou ui.
38.20: Amahon thilpha kabol chu thilsen eilethuh un, chuleh thilpha kachepi jing jeh in eidouvun ahi.
38.21: O Yahweh Pakai neidalhahih in Elohim ka Pathen kei a kon in um gamla hih behin,
38.22: O Yahweh Pakai eihuh hingpa hungloi in lang nei kithopin.

39.1: “Katohna chunga chingthei tah in thil bol ing kating, kathusei doh chenga chonseponge. Kavel a Elohim Pathen ginglou ho aumteng kalei kakituh tang ding ahi” tin kei le kei kakihou ve.
39.2: Hinla hitia thipbeh a kaum a thupha jeng jong changkhat cha seilouva kaum chun kalung sunga lung gimna akhoh secheh in ahi.
39.3: Kalunga kagelbe chan in kalung gimna akhoh cheh in, hiti chun seilou in kaum theipon ahi:
39.4: “Yahweh Pakai leiset a kahinkhohi ichan a chom hitam neihin hetsah jing in, kahin nikhohi akisim jinghi neigeldoh sah in, kahin kho iti chom hitam?
39.5: Nangin kahinkhov hi ichangeija chom a nasem hitam kakhut phang sangin jong asaojo poi. Nang dingin kahinkho lhum kei jong hi haikhat bou ahi soh tan, Mihem hinkho khat cheh jong hi haikhat cheh bou ahi.”
39.6: Mihem hinkho hi milom kitol bang bep bou ahin, kisah lunggim naho jong hetman lou kah in akichai loi ji tai. Gou ikhol khom un, kon ahin manding ham jong ihe doh ji pouve.
39.7: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai hoi a kinep na kakoi ding ham? Nanga bou kakinep na aum e.
39.8: Kaset bolnom na a kon in neihuh doh in, mingol ho neinoise sah hih in.
39.9: Keima na ansung a thipchet in kaum e; imacha jong kasei louding ahi.
39.10: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nei engbol hih in! Nakhut gu dounan kachao lhagam tai.
39.11: Kachonset u suhdih na dia neijep tengu le, kasah lut u chonsetna chu nget in aneh bang in ajun lhaji tan ahi. Tahbeh in mihem khat cheh hi haikhat bou ahi.
39.12: O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang panpi ngaija kataona neingai pih in! kamit lhi lon nah sah mon koi hih in, ajeh chu keima hi namaljin bou kahin, kema masang a kapu kapa teu bang a kholjin vahle kahi bouve.
39.13: Hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah a kahin kho abei masang kakipa a kanui kit na din nalung han na, nagim bol na ho toh neichom khen in.

40.1: Panpi ding ngai in Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in kangah jing e, aman kahenglam ahin ngan kataona eisanpih tai.
40.2: Aman lunglhah nathei kotong a kon in eikai doh in, buol sung a buon ngan lah a kon in eikai doh in tolgo chung a eidin sah in kakal sonna jong eisuh dih pih e.
40.3: Kasah ding lathah khat eipen, I Pathen u Elohim vahchoi na ding la khat eipen ahi. Mitamtah in ana toh hin mu un tin adatmo ding u ahi. Hitia chu amahon Yahweh Pakai chu atah san diu ahi.
40.4: O Yahweh Pakai tahsan na a ding det ho iti akipah tadiuvem, amahon mikiletsah ho chung a tahsan na anei pouvin ahilouleh semthu pathen limhou ho jong atahsan pouve.
40.5: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, nangin keiho ding in thil kidang tah tah neibolpeh taove. Neigon peh u thilho hi simjou sutjou hoi ahipoi. Nangto kibang ding koima cha aum poi. Na kidang natoh doh ho hi sim ding kagon, achaina gei kalhun lou ding kahei.
40.6: Nangman pumgo thilto ho a hin kipana nanei poi. Nei ngaisah thu ho chu tun kahechen tai, nangin chonset thoidam na thilto leh pumgo thilto jong nangeh poi.
40.7: Hichun keiman kaseijin, “Ven keima kahung e. Elohim Pathen lekhabu a kisun bang in:
40.8: Nangma lungdei lam bolding hi katha anop na ahi, O Elohim Pathen, ajeh chu kalung sung a nangma Danthu hohi akisun lut tai.”
40.9: Namite jouse lah a nathutan dih je hi kaphongdoh tai. O het themna nei Yahweh Pakai, nangma bang in kichaloubeh in kasei doh tai.
40.10: Nadih jedan kipana thupha hi keiman kachang a din kalungthim a selguh in kakoi poi; Nakitah na le nami huhhing na thu kasei e. Nahoubung mithengte lah a namingai lut na long lou le nakitah na chu tanglou in kasei phong jinge.
40.11: Yahweh Pakai nangin tanglou vin neingailu jing jeng in. Nangailut nale nakitahna chu neihoi bit jing sah in.
40.12: Boinan eibom in sim a simjou hoi ahipoi! Kachonsetna akikhol sang in kalampi jong kamu thei tapoi. Kalujang a kasam sangin atamjo tan hansan na him him kanei jou tapoi.
40.13: Yahweh Pakai lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! hung vah in Yahweh Pakai neipanpin.
40.14: Eisumang gohohi jumson lang kisuhboi sah in, kahahsat nikho a kipah ho lungdong in nungjam sah in.
40.15: “Aha tun akimaikhah tai” ti a asei jeh un, jum nan kichao hen.
40.16: Nangkom hinbel jouse kipa nale thanop nan dimset uhen. Nami huhhing na kipapi hochun “Yahweh Pakai chu aloupi e” tin sam jing u hen.
40.17: Keidin vang gentheile vaicha kahi jeh in, Yahweh Pakaiyin alung sung a eihoi jing hen. Yahweh Pakai nang chu eikithopi le eihuhhingpu nahi. O ka Pathen Elohim khongai sot hih in.

41.1: Mivaichate khoto ho chu anunnom ahi! Amaho chu Yahweh Pakaiyin boina ato nao a kon a ahuhdoh diu ahi.
41.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin amaho chu ahoibit in ahinghoi jiu ve. Aman amaho chu gamsung ah phatthei aboh in galmiho akon na ahuhdoh ji e.
41.3: Yahweh Pakaiyin adam mo naova panpin tin adamdoh sahding ahi.
41.4: “O Yahweh Pakai”, katao ahi “eilungset in, neidamdoh sah in ajeh chu nangma dounan kachonsetai.”
41.5: Ahinla kadougal ten keima dounan thilse jeng asei un ahi. “Itih tah le athin suhmil in aum tadem?” atiu ve.
41.6: Kagol kapai bang in eihung vil jiuvin, hinla chomloukah in kachungchang guhthim thu asei khom leuvin, eidalhah tengu le muntin in aphonjal ji taove.
41.7: Eihot bolten keichung chang a thilphalou ngan aseijun, kachung a thilse ahung lhun dingbou adei un ahi.
41.8: “Amahi thina thei hiveija na ahi” atiuve. “Amahi damdoh joulou ding ahitai!” atiuve.
41.9: Katahsan pen kagol phapen, an kaneh khom pipa jeng jong keima eidouvin apang tai.
41.10: Yahweh Pakai neilungset in. Neidamdoh sah kitin amahohi kalethuh jou nadin!
41.11: Yahweh Pakai nangma kachunga nalung lhaije ti kahei ajeh chu nangin kamelmate kachungah gal nalel sahtai.
41.12: Nangin kahinkho neihing hoipeh tai, ajeh chu keiman lhamonna kaneipoi, chuleh nangin atonsot a din na-angsung a neipui luttai.
41.13: Israel Elohim Pathen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen, Tonsot tonsot a hingjing pa chu. Amen chule Amen!

42.1: Sakhi sitwi chimset ngaichat dangchah bangin, kahin ngaicha e O Pathen Elohim.
42.2: Hingjing Elohim Pathen chu dangchah in kalha ngai e. Itih tahle kache a a-anga kachibai theiding ham?
42.3: Sunle jan in lonlhi bou ann in kanei tai, kagal miten phat tin in ei enghouvun “Na Elohim Pathen hoija umham atiuve?”
42.4: Kalung thim analheh ji e thil umdan hochu kageldoh ji teng: Elohim Pathen Hou-In a mihonpi chutoh kilhon a, tanggol a Elohim Patheninlam jon a kitol a thangvah la kisa a mihonpin golvah kibolji hochu!
42.5: Ibol a kei lunglha dah kahim? Ibol a kalung hibanga hesoh a ham? Keiman Elohim Pathen a kinepna giltah kanei in! Ken ama kathang vah kit ding ahi ka huhhing pu Elohim ka Pathen.
42.6: Tun keima kalung alhadah lheh jengtai, hinlah Jordan hung kondoh na, Hermon molsang lang hijong le kahin gel doh jing ding nahi.
42.7: Nang man twipibang nakinon a naki ho twikhanglen gin chu kajai, nangma twipi kidilleh twipi kitol chun eihin lonvuh in ahi.
42.8: Ahinlah niseh in Yahweh Pakaiyin angailutna longlou chun eiphung vuh jingin, chuleh janseh leh ama vahchoila kasajin hinkho eipe a Yahweh Pakai komma chun kataojin ahi.
42.9: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi keima kakapme, ipi dinga neisuhmil hitam? Ipidinga kadougal te bol hesoh jeh a lunggima kavale jingding ham?
42.10: Eihou setnao hin kagep lhatan ahi, “Na Pathen hoija umham,” tin eidong jingun ahi.
42.11: Ipi dinga keima hiti lungkham kahin, epidinga hiti lungboi kahim? Keiman Elohim Pathen nah kakinepna koijing ting chuleh eihuhhing paleh ka Pathen chu avellin thangvah kit inge.

43.1: O Elohim Pathen themmona bei kahi neiphongdoh in! Elohim Pathen ginglou hoa kon in nei vengdoh in, chutengleh mikitah lou holeh joupan hoa kon in neihuhdoh in.
43.2: Ajeh chu nanghi kakiselna Pathen Elohim nahi, ibol a neipaidoh hitam? Ibol a keima kadougal ten eibolset jeh a lunggim a kava lele dingham?
43.3: Nadih na le navah na chu neihinsol peh in, hichun eilamhil hen. Hihochun nangma chenna muol theng chu eilhut hen.
43.4: Hikomma chun keima Elohim Pathen maicham achu kasemjang puma kathang vahding ahi, O Pathen Elohim.
43.5: Idia lungkham kahim? Ipidinga kalung lhadah ham? Keiman kakinepna Elohim Pathen a koi inge! Eihuhhingpa le Elohim ka Pathen keiman nangma thangvah kit inge!

44.1: O Elohim Pathen, phat sottah masanga kapu kapateo khanglai a nanatoh nathil bolho eina seipeh u chu keiho tah in kanakol un kanajaove:
44.2: Nangin nangma helou namtin vaipi ho naban thahat in nana deljam in agam leiset uchu kapu kapateo nanapen ahi. Nangin agalmiteo nana suhlhuh peh in kapu kapateo chu nana chamlhat sah in ahi.
44.3: Amahon achemjam uva gal anajouva gam analah u ahipoi; aban thahat uva jong gal anajou ahipoi. Amavang nangma ban thahat leh namaivah chun gal nana jopeh ahibouve ajeh chu nangin amaho chu nana ngailun ahi.
44.4: Nangma kalengpa le Elohim ka Pathen nahin nangin Israel te dingin gal nana jo peh tai.
44.5: Nangma thahatna jal a bou kagal miteo kanungno jouvu ahin naming a bou keihon eidouhou kachotphao ahibouve.
44.6: Keiman kathalpi kasongpoi, kachemjamin eihuhdoh dingjong kakinempoi.
44.7: Nangma bouvin kagalmi teo chunga galjona neipeh u ahibouve, hitihin nangin eihotbol teo chu jumna napejin ahi.
44.8: O Elohim Pathen naloupina ho hi tantih neilou va ka samphon jing diu, chule a kumkho a ka thangvah jing diu ahi.
44.9: Ahinla tunvang nangin jumthetna neipaidoh u ahitai. Nangin ka sepia hou jengjong neilamkai peh tapouve.
44.10: Nangin kagalmi teu va kon in neinung jamsah un chuleh eidou houchu kagamsung u nalosah tai.
44.11: Nangin kelngoiho bangin eikisat chen chen sah gamtaovin chitin vaipi lah a neithe thang gamtaove.
44.12: Nangin nasahlut namitehi manbai tah in najohdoh in man neilouhel toh nabah sahtai.
44.13: Nangin kaheng kakomhou noise neichansah taovin kavelluva mite taitom le houset dingbep in neikoitaove.
44.14: Nangin amaho totthang hoina bepseo neihisah taovin isahlou tah in alu eihih khum taovin ahi.
44.15: Ki taitom jingna a konhin kakile doh jouta pouvin kamai uva jumleh jachat mel kapu den taove.
44.16: Kajah uhi eitaitomteo housetna thucheng ngen ahin, kamit uva kamu houhi ahileh kachunguva phula nom dougal mite ngen ahiuve.
44.17: Hichenghi kathoh jeng vangun keihon nangma kasumil deh pouvin ahi. Kitepna thuchengho jong kasukeh deh pouve.
44.18: Kalung thim un nangma kanuse deh pouvin nalampia konin jong kajam mangdeh pouve.
44.19: Hinlah nangin sial chenna neldi gam anei suchipden taove, nangin thina le muthim neikhu khum taove.
44.20: I jemtia keihon Elohim ka Pathen u min kasuh mil uva ahilouleh gamdang semthu pathen houna a kakhut u kalhandoh khah uva ahileh,
44.21: Elohim Pathenin ahet teiding ahi ajeh chu Aman mihem lungthim a thuguh jouse ahet ahi.
44.22: Ahin, nangma jal in niseh in eiki thatnun; kelngoi bangin eiki that taove.
44.23: O Yahweh Pakai hung thoudoh in ibol a na imut ham? Hung thoudoh in! neipaidoh pai pai hihbeh un.
44.24: Ipidinga namai naheimang ham? Kathohgim naoleh eibolset naohi nanahsah lou hitam?
44.25: Keiho leivui lah a kalhumat gam taove, bonlhoh lah a akhupbon kakijam taove.
44.26: Hung kipatdoh inlang! Neikithopiuvin! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihung lhatdoh taovin.

45.1: Kalungthim in thu hoi tah ahung kilang e. Keiman lengpa chungchang hiche jaila ngeitah hi lungchin in sei inge, ajeh chu kalei hi jaila themtah pa mol jap tobang ahi.
45.2: Nanghi mihem jouselah a ahoipen nahi, nalei a thungei tamtah ahung potdoh e. Elohim Pathen amatah in tonsotna din phatthei naboh tan ahi.
45.3: O galhatpa! nachemjam chu hin kipoh in! nangmahi naloupi in nathupi e!
45.4: Nathupina a chun hung kivon in lang galjou dingin hung kondoh tem in, thutah leh thudih chuleh kisuhnemna hohi chejom sahdingin kondoh inlang datmo umtah tah thilho chu hung tongdoh tan!
45.5: Nathal muh hochu ahem in nagal mite lungsung asunvang jeng tai. Namtin vaipi nakengto noija aumtaive.
45.6: Vo Elohim Pathen nalal touna hi tonsot tonsot a chejom jing ding ahi. Naleng tengol a chu thudih tah a vai nahomding ahi.
45.7: Nangin thudih tah a thutan nadeijin thilse nathet ahi. Hijeh chun Elohim Pathen, nangma Pathen Elohim chun thao nanu ahitai, lengdang sanga nang chungahi kipale thanopna thaotwi chu nasunlhah khum ahitai.
45.8: Myrrh, aloes, chuleh cassia hon navon anamtui sel e. Saiha a kisem khopia chu tumging ngaitah a nakilamto ding ahi.
45.9: Leng Chanute chu na numei nunnem te lah a aum un. Najet langa ophir sana hoipen ho a kijem lengnu ading e.
45.10: O leng chanu te kathusei ngai un; amapa hi jabol un ajeh chu ama hi na Yahweh Pakai pau ahi.
45.11: Ajeh chu sahlut tah naji hi namel hoinan alunglhai sel e; jabol in, ajeh chu amapa hi na Pakai pa ahi.
45.12: Tyre lengpa chanuten jong kipa thilpeh tampi nahung pehdiu ahi. Mihaoten nalung lhaina ding ahin holdiu ahi.
45.13: Mounu, leng chanu, chu kivon na sana a kisem sangkholchol a chu iti vet loupia hitam.
45.14: Hiche avon loupi tah kivon in lengpa kom lam a ahin pui un, anunjui nungah hochutoh apuilut un ahi.
45.15: Kipah tahle thanom tah a leng inpi sunga ahung akijot lut uchu iti lou a loupi hitam!
45.16: Nachate jong apa tobang a leng hung hicheh ding ahiuve. Nangin amaho chu gam tamtah a lenga napan sah ding ahi.
45.17: Khang jousea na min thanna kahin pohlut pehding ahi. Hijeh achu namtin vaipin tonsot a nahin thangvah ding ahi.

46.1: Elohim Pathenhi ikiselnao leh isongpiu ahi, boina nikho hoa eipanhu diuva kigosa ahi.
46.2: Hijeh achu ling kihot henlang molle lhang chim henlang twikhanglen a kilehlut jongleh kicha tapouvinge.
46.3: Twikhanglen hi kinong henlang kitum jeng hen. Twikhanglen kinong a ahung letdoh jeng bang in muolle lhang jong kihot chimlha jeng hen.
46.4: Vadung khat in iPathen u khopia chun kipa thanopna ahin polut e.
46.5: Hiche khopi achun Elohim Pathen achengin kisumang thei lou ding ahi. Nikho kipat a pat Elohim Pathenin avenbit jingding ahi.
46.6: Leiset chung namtin vaipihi aboitan lenggam hojong akiling sohtan ahi! Elohim Pathen ahung kisen in ahileh leiset ajunlha gamtan ahi!
46.7: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung hi ilah uva aum in, Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
46.8: Hungin Yahweh Pakai thil loupi bolhi hungvetan, Hunginlang aman vannoi leiset asuhmang hi hungve tan.
46.9: Aman vannoi leiset pumpia galho hi atuhtang in athalpiu leh ateng chau heboh peh gamtan ahi.
46.10: “Thipchet un, chule Elohim Pathen kahi hi heovin! Vannoi leiset pumin eijabol cheh diu ahi. Leiset pumpia a hi dopsanga kaum ding ahi.”
46.11: Hatchungnung Elohim Pathenhi ilah uva aumme; Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.

47.1: Mijouse hungun! Nakhut benguvin! Elohim Pathen kom a kipah tah in thangvahna sam un!
47.2: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung chu gimneitah ahi. Amahi leiset chunga leng thupitah ahi.
47.3: Aman imasang uvah namtin vaipi hi asonkun in eidougalteo jong ikengto noi uvah eikoipeh taove.
47.4: Gamtep gam chu, angailut Jacob chilhahate, kithang at tah a kijot eiho lodinga alhen ahi.
47.5: Elohim Pathen chu gimnei tah in akal tou in, Yahweh Pakai chu sumkon gin kithong pum'in akal tou in ahi.
47.6: Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin; ilengpau thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin!
47.7: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen hi leiset chung pumpi chunga leng ahi lasah pum'in thangvah un.
47.8: Elohim Pathen alaltouna theng chunga atou in namtin vaipi lah'a vai ahom'e.
47.9: Vannoi leiset vaihomte Abraham Pathen Elohim mitetoh atoukhom'un ahi, ajeh chu leiset chunga leng jouse hi Elohim Pathen'a ahi. Amahi vannoi leiset chung muntin a jana achang'in ahi.

48.1: Yahweh Pakai hi iti loupia hitam, ichangei a pachat dinga lom hitam, i Pathen'u Elohim chu akhopia acheng'in alhangtheng'a atou in ahi!
48.2: Hichehi asang'in ahoilamdang'e. Leiset pumpi'n mu ding atup un athanom cheh ui. Lhangtheng Zion molhoi hi leng thupipa chenna khopi ahi!
48.3: Elohim Pathen amatah chu Jerusalem indan sung'a chun acheng'in ahi Amatah hi avengbit'a pang ahi akilang doh e.
48.4: Vannoi mite lengho akigom'un hiche khopi dounan ahin nokhum'un ahi.
48.5: Ahinla amahon amuchet phat'un atangchot jeng'un atijauvin ajammang gamtauve.
48.6: Amaho chu tijatnan numei naonei hon hahsatna atobang'in akithingleu jeng'un ahi.
48.7: Ahin nang'in Tarshishte kong thupitah ho solam huijin asuhset bang'in nasuse tan ahi.
48.8: Keihon hiche khopi loupina chu kanajaovin tunvang Elohim Pathen hatchungnung khopi chu keiho tah'in kamuchen tauvin ahi. Hiche hi iPathen'u Elohim khopi ahi; Aman tonsot a ahoi doh ding ahi.
48.9: O Elohim Pathen, na Hou-In theng sunga nangma kavahchoi lai un nami ngailut na longlou chu kagel jing ui.
48.10: O Elohim Pathen namin ja dia kilom tah ahibang in leiset kolmong geija vahchoiya naum ding ahi. Najet lam ban thahat chu galjona a dimset ahi.
48.11: Zion mol'a mipiho kipah uhen. Judah khopiho nathutan dihjeh hin kipah uhen.
48.12: Vo Elohim Pathen mite cheuvin Zion khopi gakholchen'un akimvel'a kijot uvin ainsangho jong gasim'un.
48.13: Akhopi jouse jong gachon uvin lang akulpi bang nasa tah ho jong melchih'un, chule nang hon nason nachilhah teu naseipeh thei diu ahi.
48.14: Ajeh chu Amahi hitobang mong Pathen ahi. Amahi tonsot tonsot geija dinga iPathen'u Elohim ahin Aman ithi tokah uva eipui hoi diu ahi.

49.1: Nangho mipite'n hichehi ngaijuvin! Nangho vannoi mite jouse'n ngaicheh uvin!
49.2: Milen le mineo, ahao avai in ngaisoh keijun!
49.3: Ajeh chu kathuseiho hi chihna thu ahin, chuleh kalung'a kagel jong hi hetgilna dimset ahi.
49.4: Keiman thuchih kaseiho chu giltah'in kagel'in hiti chun semjang sai a kitilkhou in thulem kaseiho suhlhap na kanei jie.
49.5: Kagalmite'n eihin umkimvel'uva boinan eihin lhunkhum teng idia kakichat ding ham?
49.6: Amahon anei agouhou atahsan un ahaotheinau a akiletsah ui.
49.7: Ahijeng vang'in athina diuva kon'in amaho le amaho akihuhdoh joupouvin Elohim Pathen henga sum in ahinkhou akichoh thei pouve.
49.8: Lhatdamna kitihi bailam tah a um ahipoi, ajeh chu koiman alhingset'in apejou poi;
49.9: tonsot'a hingjing a lhanmun'a chelou hel nading chu.
49.10: Michingho chu nikhat thitei diu ahi, hiche mingol le lungel neilou ho banga anei agouhou chu adalhah cheh di'u ahi.
49.11: Lhanmol chu atonsot inn'u ahitan achen jingna di'u mun chu ahitai. Anei agouho'u chu amaho min putsah jong leu.
49.12: Aminthan nao chu sotlou ding ganhing ho bang'a thithou thou diu ahi.
49.13: Amaho hi min miching dan'in geljong leu mingol bang'a thina ato thou thou di'u ahi.
49.14: Kelngoiho bang'a lhanmun lhung thou thou di'u thina chu akelngoi chingpa'u hiding, anei agouhou a kon'a gamlatah'a lhanmun khat'a monlha thou thou diu ahi.
49.15: Ahin keivang Elohim Pathen'in kahinkho eilhatdoh peh'in tin, Aman lhanmun'a kon'in eihuhdoh nante.
49.16: Hijeh chun migilou ho ahung hao uva, a in chen ujong ahung hoibe cheh tengu le lunglhadah hih in.
49.17: Ajeh chu amaho athiteng uleh imacha akipoh di'u aumpoi anei agou'un lhan sung'ah juilut thei pouvinte.
49.18: Hiche lei hinkho'a hin alolhin jeh'un vangpha le ochat um'in kigel jong leu,
49.19: Chemasa ho bang bang'a thidiu khovah amukit louhel di'u ahitai.
49.20: Anei agou'u kiletsahpi ho chun amaho jong ganhing bang'a phat khatleh thithou thou diu ahilam akihetdoh lou'u ahi.

50.1: Yahweh Pakai loupipen ama chu Elohim Pathen ahin, chuleh Aman thu asei e; Niso namun apat nilhumna munho gei in mihem te akou jing e.
50.2: Zion mol'a kon'in Amelhoina bulhingset'in Elohim Pathen loupina chun ahinsalvah'in ahi.
50.3: Pathen Elohim ahung lhung tai Ama thipbeh'in aumpoi, alamlhahna a thiljouse mei in akavam gamtai, chuleh avel'ah huipi nasatah anung'in ahi.
50.4: Aman a mite chung'a athutanna ve ding'in chunglang'a van ho le leiset akou in ahi.
50.5: “Kahenga kilhaina bol'a kitepna kasemkhom pi tahsan umtah kamite chu kaheng a hin pui lut uvin.”
50.6: Chuleh vanho jouse'n athudihna phongdoh uhen, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen amatah thutan'a pang ding ahi.
50.7: “Vo kamite kathuseihi ngai uvin, Vo Israel nangma douna kathilgon aum'e, keima hi na Elohim Pathen chu kahi!
50.8: Kilhaina nabolna ho leh pumgo thilto nabol ho chuleh tang lou a nathilpeh jingho chung'a hin keiman lungphatmo na kaneipoi.
50.9: Ahin keiman nabong hon lah'a kon'a hiche bongchal ahin, nakel hon lah'a kon kelcha jongchu kangaicha dehpoi.
50.10: Ajeh chu gammang lah'a ganhing jouse kei a ahin, chuleh mol le lhang jouse'a bong ho jouse jong kei a ahi.
50.11: Keiman mol jouse chung'a vacha jouse kahen, chuleh gamlah'a ganhing ho jouse jong keija ahi.
50.12: Keima hi gilkel thei anahi jeng tajong leng nangma kom'a kasei angaipoi, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chung'a thil ijakai aumho jouse hi kei a ahi.
50.13: Keiman bongchal ho sa kaneh a, kelcha ho thisan kadon khah em?
50.14: Nang'in thangvahna hi kilhaina in mang'in, chuleh Hatchungnung kom'a nakitepna chu nit in.
50.15: Chule genthei nikho'n keima neihin kouvin, keiman nahuhdoh ingting nang'in neichoi-at ding ahi.”
50.16: Ahinlah miphaloute kom'a Elohim Pathen'in hitihin asei e: “nang'in ka Dan thu kakitepna chu naboi pi khoh ham?
50.17: Ajeh chu kahilna na la najuipon kathumop jong lahlou in nakoi e.
50.18: Nang'in guchaho namu teng napahcha in chuleh jonthanghoi bol te nakivop pi jie.
50.19: Nakam sunga thujou adimset'in, nalei chu thujou jengseh seinan namang'in ahi.
50.20: Muntin in natou len nanu a konna napenpi nasopipa jengjong jouthun naheh se lei.
50.21: Nangma hitobang'a nakimanchah sung'in thipbeh in kaum'in ahileh keiman kanahsah lou dan'in nagel'in, tuvanghin nachung'a themmo kahinchan'a hichengse pum'a hi kahingih nahitai, nangma douna kahin lhunsah diho hi kagollha tai.
50.22: Ei sumilho jouse kisih un, achuti loule Keiman kabotel ding nahiuve, chule koiman nakithopi loudiu ahi.
50.23: Ahinlah kilhaina thilto khel'a thangvahna eipe'a chun eichoisang tahbeh ahi. Kalamlhahna a naumjingleh Elohim Pathen mihuhhingna chu kamusah ding nahi”

51.1: O Pathen Elohim, na mingailutna longlou jeh'in na mi khotona chu neimusah in. Na mi hepina kidangtah jeh chun ka chonset nenbeh jouse neisuhbei peh in.
51.2: Kathemmona ho jouse'a kon'in neisutheng in lang neisoptheng in, ka chonsetna a kon'in neisuthengsel in.
51.3: Ajeh chu ka phatlouna ka kihet'in sun le jan'in eijui jing'in ahi.
51.4: Nangma douna mong'a chonse ka hi, Nangma mitmun thilse chu ka na bol tai. Na thusei in nadihna aphondoh ding ahi, chuleh ka chung'a nathutan jong adih'in ahi.
51.5: Ajeh chu ka nu oisung'a ka ki jil'a pat'a chonset pum'a kijil ka hin chonsesa hung peng a ka hi.
51.6: Hinla nang'in ka nu oisung'a pat'in jong atheng a ka um ding nana ngaichat ahin hiche mun jeng'a jong chu chihna lungthim neina hilpat ahitai.
51.7: Ka chonsetna a kon'in neisutheng lechun ka then ding ahitai, neisoptheng lechun buhbang sang'in theng tang'e.
51.8: Oh! Ka kipana neipekit in, nang'in nei hesoh sah ahin tun neikipasah kit tan.
51.9: Ka chonsetna ho neivet peh jing hih in, ka setna nenbeh ho sumang in.
51.10: Lungthimthah neisem peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Kasunga um lhagao hi nei thah sempeh in.
51.11: Na angsung'a kon'in neipaidoh hih'in, chuleh keija kon'in na Lhagao Theng chu lamang hih'in.
51.12: Nei huhhing nikho'a ka kipana chu avel'in neipe kit in lang chuleh nathu'a nung jing mi neihisah in,
51.13: Chuteng na thua nunglou ho jong nangma deilam'a ahung chonna di'uva ka hil ding chutengleh amaho nangma kom lang'a hung kile kit ding ahi'uve.
51.14: O Pathen Elohim mi huhhingpu, keiman thisan kaso tahjeh in neingaidam'in chutileh neingaidamna chu kipah tah'a vahchoila a ka sah ding ahi.
51.15: O Yahweh Pakai lungnachim'a nangma ka vahchoi theina ding'in ka lei neilhap peh'in.
51.16: Nangman kilhaina thilpeh na ngaicha pon, pumgo thilto ding khat jong na ngaicha pon ahi.
51.17: Nang in na ngaichat kilhaina chu-Lhagaova kisuh gep ahin, nang'in lung kisuchip pum'a kisihna neiho napaidoh poi o Yahweh Pakai.
51.18: Zion hi lungsetna mitvet in venlang hin kithopin, Jerusalem pal hinsem phan.
51.19: Chutengleh kilhaina lungtheng sel a kipe pumgo thilto hon lunglhai in natin chule pumgo thil to pum bongchal ho avel'in hung kitodoh tante.

52.1: Galhang nangman idia na thilse bol ho kiletsahpi nahim? Elohim Pathen thutan dihje hi tonsotna aum jing helou nahim?
52.2: Nilhum kei keijin nangman manthahna ding jeng na gong e. Na leigui in jong chem hemtah in mi a-at abang'in; jouthu sei in nangma nathem lheh e.
52.3: Nang'in thilpha sang'in thilse na deijon, thutah sangin jong jou nadeijoi.
52.4: Nathu jou hoa chun nangman mi suhmang ding nadei e!
52.5: Hinlah Elohim Pathen'in nangma na hin suhmanghel ding ahi. Aman na in'a kon a nahin kaidoh ding chuleh mihing chenna gam'a kon'a na hin bodoh ding ahi.
52.6: Mi chonpha hon hichu hin muvintin ahin datmo di'u ahi. Amahon hin nuisat intin aseidi'u ahi,
52.7: “Veuvin Elohim Pathen tahsanlou galhat ho chung'a hi ipi thil soh'a hitam? Amaho ahao nao a akisong'un, athilse bol nao a akhangtou cheh cheh un ahi.”
52.8: Hinlah, keima vang Elohim Pathen Hou-In sung'a keh Olive thing hing hoitah tobang kahin, keiman phat tin'a Elohim Pathen mi ngailutna long lou chu katahsan jing ding ahi.
52.9: O Elohim Pathen na thilpha bol jeh hin nangma thangvah jing ingting na mithengte masang'a na min ngeitah chu tahsan jing tang'e.

53.1: Mingol honbou alungsung uva kon'in “Elohim Pathen aumpoi” ati'uve. Amaho chu mi kitahlou ahi'uvin, thilphalou jeng bol ahi'uvin khatchan jong thilpha abol pouvin ahi.
53.2: Elohim Pathen'in van'a kon'in mihemte jouse hi ahinven, Aman mikhattou aching tahbeh um am, khat touvin Elohim Pathen ahol am tin ahinven ahi.
53.3: Ahinlah khatcha amupon, abonchaovin akihei mangsoh hel ta'uvin, aboncha'uvin akitahlou ngen ahi'uvin, koimacha thilpha bol aumpouvin khatcha jong aumpoi.
53.4: Hitobang'a thilphalou bol ho hin ahetdohlou hel di'u ham? Amaho hin kamite hi changlhah bang'a anehchai di'u ahitan Elohim Pathen kom'a tao ding jong agelpha pouve.
53.5: Amaho hi, tu masang'a anahetphah louhel u tijatnan ahin lokhum ding ahi'uve. Elohim Pathen'in na galmite'u gu le chang ahin thejal ding, nang'in amaho hi na ahin suhjum ding ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen'in amaho hi apaidoh ahi'uve.
53.6: Zion mol'a kon'a Israelte huhdoh dia koi hung ding ham? Elohim Pathenin amite akiledohsah tengleh, Jacob in kipah a kho asap ding Israelte kipah ding ahi'uve.

54.1: O Elohim Pathen thaneitah in hung'in lang neihuhdoh in! Na thahatnan nei veng'in.
54.2: O Elohim Pathen ka taona ngaijin, ka thumna hi neihin gelkhoh peh'in,
54.3: Ajeh chu gamdang mite'n eihin delkhum uvin, mi engse ten tha ding'in eihol'un ahi, amahon Elohim Pathen imachan agel pouve.
54.4: Ahinlah kei ding'in Elohim Pathen hi eipanpi ahin, Yahweh Pakai hin eihinghoi ahi.
54.5: Ka galmi ten thilse agon jouse'u hi amaho chunga le chuh hen! Na dei dan tah in achung uva na tong'in lang amaho khu subei in.
54.6: Keiman naheng a kiphal tah in thilpeh hinchoi ing e; Keiman namin hinthang vah ing kate Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu hichu apha ahi.
54.7: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai nang'in ka hesohna a kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ka galmite chung'a jong galjona neimusah tan ahi.

55.1: Vo Elohim Pathen ka taona neingaipeh in, panpi ngehna ka taona neigelkhoh peh'in!
