55.2: Lungset tah in ka taona neingaipeh in lang neihin donbut teijin, ajeh chu kagimnan eihin lonvuh tan ahi.
55.3: Ka galmite'n eisamseu vin, eigihna'u hi akithong le'u jeng'in ahi. Aman boi na eilhunkhum sah un lunghang tah'in eihin delkhum taove.
55.4: Ka lung aphul lap jeng'in thina gimneitah hin eihin nokhum tan ahi.
55.5: Tijatna le lunggimna'n eilonvuh tan kithing louvin ka umthei poi.
55.6: Oh, vakhu bang'a lhaving nei hitave leng o keima lengdoh ingting ga kicholdo tang'e!
55.7: Keima gamlatah in lengdoh ingting gamthip noi olnamun gabel tang'e.
55.8: Hitobang kivetdatona huipi kinunglah a konhin gangtah in gamlatah a jammang tang'e.
55.9: Yahweh Pakai amaho hi kisuhmosah in lang athilse gon'u jong hi suhmopeh jeng tan, ajeh chu athilgon'u hin khopi sung'a thilse tamtah asodoh sah ding ahi.
55.10: Akulpi bang'u jong galmi'a kon'a hoidohna ding'a asun ajan a anga'u ahi, ahinla akhohpentah chu khopi sung'a chonsetna ho hi ahi.
55.11: Thil jouse hi asegam'a ahitai, kailhang jeng'a jong kigihna le ki joubol na adimlha tan ahi.
55.12: Ka dougal'in eitai tomna jong ahipoi hichu ka doujou thouve, kiletsah tah'a eijumso jing'a ka kidoupipa jong ahipoi, amaho a kon chun ka ki seldoh theinan ahi.
55.13: Amavang hiche ho chu hilouvin, ka kibahpi, ka kivoppi, ka golngai nangma chu na hi.
55.14: Phat khatna chu ichan geija ina kingailut hitam Elohim Pathen Hou-In jeng'a jong ina kijotlutji ahie!
55.15: Ka dougalte hi thina'n lhunkhum hen, lhankhuh in ahing'in vallhum jeng'u hen, ajeh chu setna'n alungsung'u chen nan aneitan ahi.
55.16: Ahinlah keiman Elohim ka Pathen ka kou ding chuleh Yahweh ka Pakaiyin eihuhdoh ding ahi.
55.17: Jingkah, sun, nilhah in ka lung hesoh jeh'in ka kap'in ahileh Yahweh Pakaiyin ka-o eijahpeh tai.
55.18: Mi tamtah in eidou jing hen lang, kei douna'n gal kisat chohjeju jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakaiyin eilhatdoh'in ol-heuvin eiumsah tai.
55.19: Tonsot a vaihom jing Elohim Pathen chun ka taona sang intin ka dougalte asuhnem ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon achondan'u akhelnom pouvin Elohim Pathen jong aging pouve;
55.20: Keima kiloipipan vang, aloihi alhem lhan akitepna asukeh'in ahi.
55.21: Athu cheng chu thaotwi bang'in analjet in hinlah asung uvin gal lungthim apu'uve. Athu cheng'u thaotwi nang abang'in hinlah asunglang uvah chemjam ngen aum'e.
55.22: Na pohgih chu Yahweh Pakai chung'a seplha tan Aman na ngai jangpeh nante. Aman mi chonpha ho chu akipalsah lou ding lhuh jong alhuhsah lou ding ahi.
55.23: Nangvang O Elohim Pathen mi gilou ho chu lhuh na kokhuh a nasotlhah ding ahi. Tolthat ho le jonpan ho jong khangdong cha na thisah ding ahi, hinla keimanvang eihuhing din nang jeng katahsan e.

56.1: O Elohim Pathen, na mi khotonan neipui jing'in, ajeh chu mipite'n eidel jing'uvin eidouhon nilhumkei kei'in eidelkhum jing'un ahi.
56.2: Eihousehon jong phattin in eidel jing'un chuleh mitamtah'in eidelkhum jing'un ahi.
56.3: Ahinlah ka kichat teng nangma tahsanna a chun ka lut ji tan ahi.
56.4: Aman kahenga kitepna anei jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu ka thangvah e. Elohim Pathen tahsana a ka dindet jingle kei ipi ding'a ka kichat ding ham? Hi chi mihem chun i eilo thei ding ham?
56.5: Amahon ka thusei jouse ahilou lam in alao vin; kei suhsetna ding'in anikho ho'u jong amang jing ui.
56.6: Amaho ahung'un eihung velhi'uvin, keima eithatheina diuvin ka chaloh ka sinsah avelhi jing'un ahi.
56.7: Achonset pum'un jammang sah hihbeh in; na lungsah na achun O Yahweh Pakai amaho chu sumang jeng'in.
56.8: Nang'in ka thoh gimna neihetpeh jingnan ahi, nang'in ka lengvaina mitlhi hi khon a nakhol khom in, chuleh abonchan na lekhabu'a najihlut e.
56.9: Keiman nangma eikithopi ding'a ka kou tengleh ka galmite jammang taovin te. Hijeh'a chu keiman Elohim Pathen hi keima lang'a pang ahi ti ka het jingna ahi!
56.10: Elohim Pathen'in kakoma kitep na anei jeh in keiman Elohim Pathen ka thangvah e; henge, Elohim Pathenin kahenga kitepna anei jeh in Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah ahi.
56.11: Keiman Elohim Pathen ka tahsan na ahi ka din jingle ipi ding'a ka kichat ding ham? Mihem mai hon i eilo di'u ham?
56.12: O Elohim Pathen nang kom'a ka kitepna keiman subulhit ingting chutengleh kilhaina in thangvah na peng ka te.
56.13: Ajeh chu nang'in ka thina ding'a kon'in neihuhdoh tan kakiselhuh louna din nang in ka keng neituh peh tai. Hijeh chun O Elohim Pathen tun na angsunga hinna vah napeh na mun a chun hung lut thei tange.

57.1: Neilungset in O Elohim Pathen, nei khoton! Neivenbit jingna ding'in nang malam ka hin sang'e. Hahsatna ho abeito kahsen na lhaving lim noi a ka kisel jing ding ahi.
57.2: Ka chung'a athilgon eisuhbulhing pehna ding'in Elohim Pathen hat chungnung chu ka kouve.
57.3: Aman eihuhdoh ding chuleh eidel lele ho jumsahna ding'a van'a kon'a panpina eihinpeh ding ahi. Elohim ka Pathen'in angailutna longlou leh akitahna a chu eihung vil ding ahi.
57.4: Keipi bahkai hangtah hon mihem te a anchah dia achanlhih le banin galmite'n eiumkimvel'uvin, aha uhin tengcha leh thalchang bangin asunvangthei in, alei'u jong chemjam hemset tobang in asat tan thei uve.
57.5: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi vanmun jouse chungvum sang'in hung kichoisang'in! Na loupina hin leiset chung mun jouse hi salvah hen!
57.6: Ka galmite'n thang eikampeh uvin, keima lung gim leh lunglengvai in kaum'e. Amahon ka lampi'a kotong thuhtah alai un ahinlah amaho ma alhalut jiuvin ahi.
57.7: O Elohim Pathen nang a lungmon na kanei e; nang a kalung among e. Nangma thangvah la ka sahthei hi thil kidang ahipoi.
57.8: Thou in kalung! Thou in, o Semjang le tumging! Ka vahchoila'n jingninou hi thoudoh ing e.
57.9: O Yahweh Pakai mipi ho jouse lah'a na thangvah ing'e. Namtin vaipi jouse lah'a nangma na thangvah ing kate.
57.10: Ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi vanho bang'in asang e. Na kitahna in meilomlah apha'n ahi.
57.11: Hung kichoi sang in O Elohim Pathen, van mun sangpen ho sang'in na min hi dopsang'in umjo hen. Na loupina in leiset chung pumpi hi salvah hen.

58.1: Vaihom ho nanghon thutah kiti hi ipi kisei na ahi nahet u hinam? Nang hon thu adih'a natan'u hinam?
58.2: Ahipoi! Nang ho'n na lungsung un thudihlou na gong'un gamsung a hunam a natohna ngen na chelheh sah un ahi.
58.3: Miphalou ho hi chonsesa peng'a ahiuvin, ahung pen'uva pat'in jou apan'un ama deidan cheh'in achon'un ahi.
58.4: Ama hon gul bangin gu hat tah alhao vin; gulsoh bang in thuhil angainom pouve.
58.5: Gul lam sahhon atheile'u ichan geija amut ngeisel vang un akihetmosah un ahi.
58.6: O Elohim Pathen a-ha uhi suhbong jeng'in, O Yahweh Pakai hiche keipi bahkai ho hi a-ha'u suhgoi peh jeng'in.
58.7: Tolgo'a twi isunlhah a agotloiji bang'in mangthah loi jeng'u hen. Akhut uva achoi u agal manchah'u chu manmo sosah jeng'in.
58.8: Dahdeng amacham'a ajunlhah ji bang'in junlhahsah'in, naosen athisa hung peng nisa mumanlou bah sah in.
58.9: Hampa kisatlha bang in ateh akhang Elohim Pathenin lhamlha jeng uhen, leibel meikou lah a ling le khao kigouvam sang a gang jo jeng u hen.
58.10: Thildih lou ho akilethuh teng mi chonpha ho kipah di'u ahi.
58.11: Chuteng achaina le mijousen asei diu ahi, “Elohim Pathen a dia hing ho dihtheina chu kipa thilpeh ahin; leiset a jong thudih a thutan Elohim Pathen aum mong e.”

59.1: O Elohim Pathen, ka galmite a kon'in neihuhdoh in, keima eisumang ding'a hungho a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
59.2: Mi sugentheiho a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang tolthat ho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
59.3: Amahon eichanglhiuvin, Yahweh Pakai melma engsetahte hon eingah un ahi, keiman amaho dounan imacha thilse ka bol poi.
59.4: Keiman imacha thilse kabol pon hinla keima eidelkhum ding'in akigo jing'un ahi. Hung thoudoh in thilsohho hi hung ven lang neikithopi'n!
59.5: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hatchungnung Israelte Pathen Elohim, ei hung thoudoh in lang mi phalou namtin vaipiho hi gimbolna hung petan kitahna neilou mi phaloute chung'a hin khotona neihihbeh in.
59.6: Amaho janteng leh ahungdoh jiuvin, uingol hon mi angih bang'in lamlen'a akijot'un apeng le jiuvin ahi.
59.7: Akamsunguva thu thanghoi hung potdoh khu ngai in chemjam a kisat bang'a ngaithada umtah ahi. Hitobang'a ngai thaset umtah hi kon angai ngam ding ham?
59.8: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nang'in amaho chu na nuisat'in, mi phalou namtin vaipiho chu na hohdal'in ahi.
59.9: Nang hi kahatna nahi; eihuhdoh din nang kangah jing e, ajeh chu nang hi ka ki venbitna kulpi nahi.
59.10: Ka Pathen Elohim in, ami ngailut na longlou achu eidinpi ding ahi. Aman ka melmate jouse chung'a agaljona a eimusah ding ahi.
59.11: O Elohim Pathen amaho chu thatgam jeng hih'in ajole ka mite'n kihil na aman u hi sumil loi get'unte; eipanpi o Yahweh Pakai amaho khu thethang'in lang akhuboh uva dilsuh sah jeng tan.
59.12: Akam'uva chonset thu ngen aseidoh jeh uleh, alei uva thilse ngen aseidoh jeh'un, akiletsahna'u, ahansetna'u chuleh ajouseina'u vin manchah jeng uhen.
59.13: Na lunghan nan amaho chu sumang'in lang abonchauvin sumang jeng'in! chutengleh vannoi leiset pumpin Israel chung'a vaihom Elohim Pathen na hi chu ahetdi'u ahi.
59.14: Ka melmate jan leh hungdoh'un tin uichangol hon mi angih bang'in akisen le leuvin ahi.
59.15: Amaho neh ding an holna'n avahle leuvin oivana kham amulou jeh'un gilkel pum'in alum jiuvin ahi.
59.16: Hinla keiman vang na thaneina chu vahchoila'n sangnge. Na mi ngailutna longlou chu jingkha she leh kipah tah'in vahchoila'n sangnge. Ajeh chu nangma ka kulpi, ka hahsat teng leh ka kiselna na hi.
59.17: O ka hatna Yahweh Pakai, nangma thangvahna'n la'n sangnge, O Elohim Pathen nangma ka kiselna na hin, na mi ngailutna longlou chu neimusah jing'e.

60.1: O Elohim Pathen nang'in keiho hi neipaidoh tauvin ka kiselna'u jouse jong neisuh chimpeh tauve, nangma keiho chung'a analunghang jong leh chun na lungsetna neimusah tauvin.
60.2: Ka gamsung'u na hotling in chuleh na pokehsah ji'n ahi, tun vang akehlai mehbit tan, ajeh chu gamleiset akithing'in ahi.
60.3: Keiho hasatnatah nahin pen, jukham a lon lele ho nei sodoh jeng u ve.
60.4: Ahinla nang'in nangma ginna neiho ding'in ponlap khat neina dopsang peh'un, hichu min eihin nokhum teng'uleh eikipunkhom sah'in anapang'in ahi.
60.5: Tun na ngailut na mite hi huhdoh tan, ka taona ngai in lang na ban thahat'in neihuhdoh tauvin.
60.6: Aloupi na in Elohim Pathenin, “keima kichoisangna a hiche kitep nahi ahin sem tai. Shechem hi kipa na a kakehso ding ahi. Sukkoth phaicham hi ka mite ka hoppeh ding ahi.
60.7: Gilead hi keija ahin, chuleh Manasseh jong ahi. Ephraim ka thih lukhuh hin galhat miho ahinsep doh ding, chue Juda ka leng tenggol hin leng tamtah hinsepdoh ding ahi.
60.8: Ahin Moab vang hi ka kisilna kong ahin ka sohna ahin toh ding ahi chuleh Edom a hi ka kengto kathehngim ding chutengleh Philistia chung a ka galjona ka hin sapdoh ding ahi.”
60.9: Koi pen'in kul kigetkhum khoipi'a hi eipuilut ding ham? Koi pen in Edom chung'a hi galjona eihin pohlut peh ding ham?
60.10: O Elohim Pathen nang'in neipaidoh'u hitam? Nang'in ka sepaite toh galsatna a neihung lhonpi lou ding hitam?
60.11: O lungset tah in ka galmiteuva konin neipanpin, ajeh chu mihem panpina hi aphachom aumpoi.
60.12: Elohim Pathen panpina jal'a hi thil loupi tah tah tohdoh'a um ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman imelmate'u achotpha ding ahi.

61.1: O Elohim Pathen ka kana neingaipeh in! Ka taona hi ngai in!
61.2: Lungsung lunghemnan eilonkhum teng leiset kol kimvel a kon'in panpi ngaichan ka hin kou e. Hoidoh na songpi sang chung'ah neipuitou in,
61.3: ajeh chu nangma hi ka kiselna mun olna pen chu na hi, ka melmate'n ahin phahjoulouna kulpi chu nangma na hi.
61.4: Na mun theng'a tonsot'in neichensah in hilai chu na lha limnoi kiselna chu ahi.
61.5: O Elohim Pathen ka kitepna chu nei jahpehtai, nangma gingte chan dia na gonpeh na goulona mun chu neipeh ahitai.
61.6: Lengpa hinkho hi kum tamtah pehben! Khangkit geiin jong hinghoi in!
61.7: Elohim Pathen hoidam na achun vai hom jing hen. Na mi ngailutna longlou le na kitahna chun kaihoi jing hen.
61.8: Hiteng chuleh nitina ka kitepna suh bulhit ingkating tonsot'in na min thangvah jing tang e.

62.1: Elohim Pathen ang a thipbeh chan ka ngah e, ajeh chu Ama a kon a ka galjona hung kipan ji ahi.
62.2: Ama bou hi kasongpi le kakihuhhing na ahin, longlou hel a kaum thei kakingai na kulpi ahi.
62.3: Mi khatseh douding melma tamtah ahiuvin-abon'un keima eithat gouve. Amaho ding hin keima hi bang chimsa le tho kigen achimsa tobang ka hi bouve.
62.4: Amahon munsang a kon a sotlhah di eigouve. Ka chung chang a jouthu sei athanom un ahi. Amahon kamasanga eipahchao vin alungsung uvah eigaosap un ahi.
62.5: Keiman ka hina jouse pum in Elohim Pathen angsung a thipbehchan ka ngah e, ajeh chu ama a hin ka kinepna aumjing e.
62.6: Ama bou hi ka sochatna leh ka kulpi chuleh ka songpi ahin keima sotlinghoi ka hi tahlou ding ahitai.
62.7: Ka galjona leh ka minphatna Elohim Pathen a kon jeng bou ahi. Ama hi ka kiselna le ka songpi ahin, ka melma hon eihin maiphah lou diu ahi.
62.8: O ka mite phat tinin Ama bou tahsan jingin na lungthim a na pohgih ama chuga sung lhan, ajeh chu Ama hi ikiselna u ahi.
62.9: Milham ho hi hainahu khat hui bap a phachom lou ahibou uve, chule mithahat ho jong alim u va amelsou toh akibang deh pouve. Amahokhu lepton lang vele chun hainahu khat sanga jong jangjo ahibou uve.
62.10: Nang in na inchen na hinkho hi hunam a lah le guhchat in kivah hih in. Na nei na gou ahung punbe a ahijongleh hiche a chun kisong hih in.
62.11: Elohim Pathenin ol heuvin thu asei in hichu keiman phat tin in ka na jajin ahi. O Elohim Pathen thaneina jouse hi nang a ahi.
62.12: O Yahweh Pakai ngailutna longlou hi nang a ahi, tahbeh in nang in mijouse hi atoh dungjui cheh a na lethuh ahi.

63.1: O Elohim Pathen nang bou ka Pathen na hi; ken lungil tah in nang kahol e. Kalhagao in nadangchah in; twi veilouna mun gotna gamgo ahin ka tahsa pumpin nang ka hin lhangai e.
63.2: Na mun theng'a kon'in ka hin mun na loupina leh na thaneina chu ka hin mun ahi.
63.3: Na mi ngailutna longlou chu mihem hinkhoma ma sang a phajo ahi; nang ka hin thangvah chim theipoi.
63.4: Hinkho ka nei laisen nangma thangvah ing kating, nahenga taonan ka khut teni hin domsang ing kate.
63.5: An twipen ka neh sang'in nang'in neihin lunglhaisah jon. Kipah tah in nangma thangvahnan la sangnge.
63.6: Kalupna mun a limgeh chan nang kagel gel jin, janteng jongle nangma lungel ho kangaito ji e.
63.7: Nangma eikithopi nahijeh in, na lhaving lim noi ah kipah tah in vahchoila ka san ahi.
63.8: Na ban thahat tah jet lang in det tah in neituh in ahileh keiman nang ka tuhchah in ahi.
63.9: Keima eisumang goho chu hung mangthah diu ahi. Amaho chu leikotong athuhlai pena chu lhalut ding ahiuve.
63.10: Amaho chu chemjam a thidiu sial ho anchah a pang diu ahi.
63.11: Ahinla lengpa chu Elohim Pathen a kipah ding ahi. Koi hileh Ama tahsan chan chun athangvah ding, mijouho vang suhthip a umdiu ahi.

64.1: O Elohim Pathen, ka kiphinna hi neingaipeh tei in. Ka melmaten eigihnauva kon hin neihuh doh in.
64.2: Hiche engset lungput a tohgon nei mipiho a kon'in neiselmang in, hiche thilse bol hon hoa kon in.
64.3: Amahon chemjam kinolhem bang'in alei'u anolhem'un thalchang kikap doh bang'in thucheng ngaimo tah tah in mi adoi leleu ve.
64.4: Themmona neilou miho chu akiselnauva kon in ahin kap un kichatna neilouvin gangtah in anokhum jiuvin ahi.
64.5: Thilse bol ding in amaho le amaho akitilkhou un chujongle aguh a iti thang kam ding ham, tichu agong'un ahi. “Hiche hi kon amudoh ding ham?” atiuve.
64.6: Athilse gonpat'u chun hitin aseijun, “Hiche hi thilgon hoipen ahitai!” atiuve. Henge mihem lunggel le lungthim vang hi aphalou mong ahi.
64.7: Ahinla Elohim Pathen amatah'in athalchang ahin kap ding gangtah a akaplhuh diu ahi.
64.8: Amaho tah kampao in ahin thagam diu ahi, koi hileh amaho muchan chun alunghan khum uva alu ahihdiu ahi.
64.9: Chujouteng mijouse kicha diu, Elohim Pathen thil boltheina kidangtah chu aphondoh diu, chuleh athilbol datmo umtahho chu ahin hetchen diu ahi.
64.10: Mi chonphaho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom diu chuleh Ama chu kiselna ahin neidiu ahi. Koi hileh thilpha bolho jousen Elohim Pathen ahin vahchoidiu ahi.

65.1: O Elohim Pathen, vahchoina thupitah chu Zion'a um nang'a dinga ahi. Keihon nang kom a ka kitepnau chu ka molso diu ahi.
65.2: Ajeh chu nang'in ka taona'u na sang'in, ka bonchauva nang kom'a ka hung di'u ahi.
65.3: Ka chonsetnauvin eilonvuh jong le'u nang'in abonchan na ngaidam sohkei tan ahi.
65.4: Yahweh Pakai, na muntheng a um nangkom naiding go ho iti akipa tadiuvem. Na Hou-Intheng sung a chu itobang kipana golnop in eingau hitam!
65.5: Kataona hou natoh hoitah in neidonbut peh uve, O Elohim Pathen eihuhingpau. Nangma hi leiset mite jouse kinepna nahin, gamlatah twikhanglen chung'a kongtolho geiyin nang chung a kinepna anei u ahi.
65.6: Thahatna thupitah a na kivon a, na thahatna a mol le lhang jong hi na sem ahi.
65.7: Twikhanglen kinong le kitum jong hi nasuthip in chuleh namtin vaipi kithong lellul jong na suthip tan ahi.
65.8: Leiset chung kolmong gei a chenghon jong na kidanna hi adatmovin ahi. Nisa sona langa pat nilhum na mun geiya umho jong kipah a asaple diuva na tildoh ahitai.
65.9: Leiset hi na gelkhoh in gon nachapnou in, leithao leh leipha na sodoh sah in ahi. Elohim Pathen vadung a chun twi nengchet in aum in; hichun louga chang le mim aput sah e, ajeh chu hiti dinga nangman natep sah ahitai.
65.10: Lou kikhoiho gotwi in na chap kot jin, leilhangho na su nang in, changkongho jong na kibah sah in, gotwi in leiset na noudoh sah in hiti chun chang le mim nengchet a aumnadin phatthei na boh in ahi.
65.11: Kumlhung keiya neh le chah ding nengchet in na gongtoh in leitah lah jeng jong leiphatah na so sah tai.
65.12: Gam golai gammang jeng jong hamhing dongset lah a sohdoh in, molpang jeng jong kipah tah in apahlha jengin ahi.
65.13: Hamhing lah a kelngoihon adimset un chule phaichamho jong chang le mim adimlha jeng tai. Hi hojousen thong jejun asam un kipa la asaove.

66.1: Leiset mite jousen Elohim Pathen vahchoi cheh uhen!
66.2: Amin loupi chu vahchoilan saohen! Aloupina ji vannoi a sei leu vin.
66.3: Elohim Pathen henga sei in, “Na thilbol ho hi iti hoia lamdang hitam! Na melmate jeng jong na thaneina thupitah masang a akun jeng uve.
66.4: Leiset chung thil jouse jong na angsung a dilsu cheh untin, nathangvahna la asahdiu, naming hi thongjenju a asahdiu ahi.”
66.5: Hung in lang ven Elohim Pathenin ipi atohdoh hitam, mipite dia itobang thil kidang atohdoh hitam!
66.6: Aman twipisan a jong lamgolai asem in, chule amite chu akeng'uva ache galkai ui. Hea chun eiho Ama ah ikipah un ahi.
66.7: Ajeh chu Aman athahatna thupitah a chun tonsot in vai ahom e. Aman namtin vaipi chaloh sinsah aboncha ave lhisohkei in; koimacha Ama dounan hung kon da jeng hen.
66.8: Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen iPathen u Elohim thangvah cheh u henlang avahchoina la choh jejun sauhen.
66.9: I hinkhou hi Ama khut a um ahin, Aman ikipallouna diuva ikeng u eituhpeh u ahi.
66.10: O Elohim Pathen neipatep tauve; dangka bang in neisuhtheng taovin ahi.
66.11: Na thangkol a neimat u ahitan chuleh ka tungtun uva sohchanna pohgih chu neipoh sah u ahitai.
66.12: Ka chunguvah midangho lam na jotsah in hiti chun keiho meilhum leh twisohlah neipal galkaisah uvin, hinla nehding nenna mun a neipuilut tauvin ahi.
66.13: Tun nahenga kakitepna subulhit din pumgo thilto pum in na Hou-In ka hinjon e.
66.14: Henge, lunggim le kakhoisat nikho hoa nakoma kitepna ka na nei chu ahi.
66.15: Hijeh a chu keiman kanei ho lah ka kelngoichalho hi namtui pen ding le, ka bongchalho le ka keltahchalho hi pumgo thilto a ka hin todoh ahitai.
66.16: Elohim Pathen gin le jana neijouse hung un lang ngai un, Yahweh Pakaiyin ipi eibolpeh am na seipeh ung ka te.
66.17: Ajeh chu keiman Ama thangvah pum in panpi thumnan ka tao in ahi.
66.18: Keiman ka lunsunga um ka chonset phongdoh lou hile Yahweh Pakaiyin ka taona eingaipeh louding ahi.
66.19: Hinla Elohim Pathenin eingaipeh e! Aman khohsah tah in ka taona eingaipeh in ahi.
66.20: Ka taona eigelkhohpehjeh le amingailutna longlou kei a kon a eilahdohpeh lou jeh in Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in um hen!

67.1: Elohim Pathen lungsetthem hihen lang phatthei eiboh u hen. Amaivah chun eisalvah u hen.
67.2: Leiset pumpi a nadeilam kilang hen, muntin a mihemten na mihuhhingna thahat chu heuhen!
67.3: O Elohim Pathen namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen. Henge, namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen.
67.4: Vannoi leiset pumpin nangma thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu namtin vaipi chung a hi thudih a vai hom nahin vannoi leiset pumpi hi na puihoi hoi le jinge.
67.5: Namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen O Elohim Pathen. Henge, namtin vaipin thangvah u hen!
67.6: Hiteng chuleh leiset in chang le mim gasosah intin chuleh Elohim Pathen, iPathen'un nengchet a phatthei eibohdiu ahi.
67.7: Henge, Elohim Pathenin phatthei eiboh un tin, chule vannoi leiset mihemte jousen Ama chu agindiu ahi.

68.1: O Elohim Pathen hung kipat inlang namelmate hi thethang jeng in, Elohim Pathen doumah bolte jouse akihuhdohna diuvin jam uhen.
68.2: Amaho khu meikhu bang in mut mang in, meisalah a khoilu ajollhah bang in jollhahsah in, Elohim Pathen ansung a kon in migiloute mangthah jeng uhen.
68.3: Hinla miphaho chu kipah u hen. Amaho chu Elohim Pathen angsung'ah kipah u hen. Kipa thanopnan dimset u hen.
68.4: Elohim Pathen le amin thang vah la saovin! Meibanglom puile pa thangvahla chohthet in sauvin. Amin chu Yahweh Pakai kiti ahi–a angsung a kipah un.
68.5: Pa neilou te dia Pa nahin, meithaiho hoidam jing nahi-hiche hi Elohim Pathen ahin aumna chu muntheng ahi.
68.6: Elohim Pathenin changkhatpu hinkho chu insungmi lhingtah in akoi in; Songkul a tangho chamlhat na apen akipa sah tai. Ahinlah thuanunglou ho chu nisan akahgepna neldigama achensah e.
68.7: O Yahweh Pakai na mite Egypt gama kon a na hin puidoh a chun, gamgo lah'a na hin puigalkai chun,
68.8: Israel Pathen Elohim, Sinai Pathen Elohim nangma masang'ah leiset akithing in vanhon go ahin juhlhahsah in ahi.
68.9: O Elohim Pathen nang man leigo chapnousah din go nengchet in neihin peuvin ahi.
68.10: Akhon nan hichea chun na mite na chensah in, neh le chah nengchetnin na pen, na mite ngaichat jouse jong na pe tai.
68.11: Yahweh Pakaiyin thu chengkhat agahseileh mitamtah in hiche kipana thu chu apoleuvin ahi.
68.12: Melmate lengho le asepaite ajamgam tauvin Israel numeiten athilkeo u achomgam peh taove.
68.13: Kelngoi hong a chengho jeng in jong nei le gou tamtah-alhaving teni dangka le amul sana a kisem vapal akimu uvin.
68.14: Hatchungnung chun Zalmon molchung'a buhbang kithejal bang'in melma lengho chu athejal gamtan ahi.
68.15: Bashan a molho hi athupi thei lheh jeng uve, mol monghem tamtah'in vanthamjol a kilhungdoh jenge.
68.16: O molsang gumtahho ibolba thangthip tah a navet uham, Zion molsang Elohim Pathenin alhen na mun, tonsot a achen nading chu?
68.17: Sakol-kangtalai simjoulou hon akolkhum Sinai mol a kon a hung'a amuntheng a lut ding ahi.
68.18: Nangma achung sang a na kaltou tengleh galhing a kiman tamtah na puitou ding, mipiho'a kon'a kipaman tamtah na san ding, nangma na douho a kon'a jong na san ding ahi. Hiche'a chu Yahweh Pakai eiho lah a cheng ding ahi.
68.19: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen; eihuh hingpau Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Niseh a aman abanjang a eikai u ahi.
68.20: Eiho Pathen hi mihuhhing Elohim Pathen ahi. Yahweh Pakai lengchungnung hin thina a kon a eihuhdoh u ahi.
68.21: Elohim Pathenin amelmate luchangho asuhchip ding ahi, thilse jeng bolna a kipeho chu alugu u asuhchip ding ahi.
68.22: Yahweh Pakaiyin asei e, “Bashan a kon'a ka melmate ka hinpui lhah ding ahi; twikhanglen lailung a kon'a ka hin puidoh ding ahi.
68.23: Ka mite, nanghon athisan uva chu na keng u na kisoptheng diu, chuleh na uichahou jengin jong chan aneidiu ahi.”
68.24: O Elohim Pathen gal nahin jaova na hung kijot u chu muthei in ahung kilangdoh tai, Elohim ka Pathen le ka lengpa muntheng a na kijotlut u chu.
68.25: La saho amasang a aum un, tumging saiho a nung a aum ui; alai lunga chun nungah hon vohging theiho avouve.
68.26: Israel mipite Elohim Pathen thangvah un; Israel hinkho hungkondoh naho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un.
68.27: Ven phung neocha Benjamin in ahin lamkai e. aban'ah Judah a kon a vaihomho, chule Zebulun le Naphtali a kon in vaihom tamtah ahung uve.
68.28: O Elohim Pathen, na ban thahat chu jedoh in. Achesa nikho ho bang chun na ban thahat chu nahat na hung kilangdoh hen.
68.29: Jerusalem a na Hou-Intheng ah leiset lenghon na hunglutna u thilho ahinchoijuve.
68.30: Na melma namtin vaipiho, pang lah'a kisel gamsaho, ahatmo bongnouho lah a bongchalho hi phohsal in. Kisunem tah a ahunglutnau thil in sumlhonho hinchoisah in. Galbol'a thanom namtin vaipiho thethang in.
68.31: Egypt a kon'in kipa thilpeh ding'in thil mantamho hinchoi u hen, Ethiopia mite Elohim Pathen a akipehlutna uvin bohkhup uhen!
68.32: Leiset gam lengho'n Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen kom'ah vahchoila sauhen.
68.33: Vanlaijol'a kon'a ogin hat tah hung kithongdoh a, masanglai vanho lah a ki tollepa vahchoila'n la sauvin.
68.34: Elohim Pathen thuneina hi mijouse hetsah un, aloupina chun Israelte ahinsalvah in athahatna hi vanho chung'ah akilang jing'e.
68.35: Elohim Pathen hi amuntheng'ah gimneitah in aumjing'e. Israel Pathen Elohim'in amite chu thuneina le thahatna ape'n ahi. Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen!

69.1: Eihuhdoh in, O Elohim Pathen, twisoh hin ka ngong gei achuptai.
69.2: Bonlhoh lah a hin ka lhalut cheh cheh tai; pansatna ding ka mujou tapoi. Keima twithuh lah a ka lhalut tan twisoh hin eichup tai.
69.3: Panpi ngai a kaka na katha achollha tai; ka lolhomsung jong agolha tai. Ka ka kanan ka mit jong apomtan, Elohim Pathenin eipan pi ding kangah e.
69.4: Ajehbei hel a eivetdaho hi ka lujang a ka samjang sang'in atamjouve. Ka melmate hin jou thu jeng a suhmang ding eigouvin, hitihin ka guh louhel thil chu kanung peh din athum uve.
69.5: O Elohim Pathen ichangei a ngol kahi nahenai; Ka chonsetnaho hi nang'a kon'in akiselmang theipoi.
69.6: Keijeh in, nangma tahsan ho chu jumsah hih beh in, O van a lengchungnung Yahweh Pakai, kei jeh in nang ma houmi tehi kisuh jum na nei hisah hihbeh in, O Israel Pathen Elohim.
69.7: Ajeh chu nangma jal a housetna ka thoh ahi; jumna le jachatna kamai a adimset tai.
69.8: Ka sopiho tah jeng'in jong eikihetmosah tauvin gamchommi bangin eibol tauvin ahi.
69.9: Na Hou-In a ding a ka tompan jeh in eichaideh tan ahi, nangman na housetnau jouse chu ka chunga achu tan ahi.
69.10: Kappum a an kangol a chun, noisetah in eihou un ahi.
69.11: Ka genthei phondohna a khaodippon ka kisil'a ahileh einuisat un ahi.
69.12: Keima hi khopi sung a jalhang a kihoulim nopna bep ka hitan jukhamhon kei chungchang thu totnopnan anei tauve.
69.13: Hinla Yahweh Pakai naheng a katao jingin, tuchung beh neihin khoto ding kakinem e. O Yahweh Pakai na mingailut longlou chun katao nahi huhing na tahbeh a chun nei donbut in.
69.14: Bonlhoh lah a kon hin neihuhdoh in; athuh jep a neilhahlutsah hihbeh in, eivetdaho lah a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang hiche twithuh lah'a kon hin neikaidoh in.
69.15: Twisohhat lai neichupsah hih in, ahilouleh twithuh gillai jong nei vallhum sah hih in, ahilouleh thina lhan kotong jong nei nehmang sah hih in.
69.16: O Yahweh Pakai ka taona neingaipeh in, ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi kidangtah ahin, neikaihoi jing in, ajeh chu na mikhotona hi lolhingtah ahi.
69.17: Na sohpa a kon hin kisel mang hih in; gangtah in neidonbut in ajeh chu keiman boina nasatah ka toh tai.
69.18: Hung'in lang neihung lhatdoh tan; ka melmat a kon'in neilha-ong tan.
69.19: Nang'in eiki houset na eikijum bolna le ei kijachat sah naho jouse na hesohkei in ahi. Ka melmaten abol jouseu na hesohkei e.
69.20: Ami taitomnauvin ka lungthim asukeh in, kadailheh jeng tai. Mikhat seh hijong le lungset na eimusah um hen lang; Khattou hung kiheihen lang eihin lungmonsah le kanom e.
69.21: Ahinla chutimalah in amahon ka nehdin gu eipeuvin amahon ka don ding'in juthuh eipeuve.
69.22: Amasang uva neh-le-chah dimset dokhang chu akipal nao soh henlang, ahaonau chu amaho ding'in thangkol hisah jeng tan.
69.23: Kho amutheilouna diuvin amit u chojeng henlang atahsao kithing thing in umsah jeng in.
69.24: Na lunghanna chu achung uvah sunglha jeng'in; na lunghanna meikong achun amaho chu kavam jeng in.
69.25: A-in'u chu ahomkeo soh doh jeng henlang aponbuh u jong kihoh doh jeng hen.
69.26: Gotna napeh mi chun, akisuhkhah na chung uva jumbol na akoibe uve; akisukha ho chu natna abelap peh uve.
69.27: Achonsetnau setvum peh unlang, khatcha ongthol'in lha hihbeh in.
69.28: Amin u chu hinna lekhabu a konin thaimangpeh in; michonpha ho lah a kisimtha sah hihbeh un.
69.29: Keima natna thohgim in ka um e, O Elohim Pathen, na mihuhhingna thahat chun neihuhdoh in.
69.30: Hiteng chuleh keiman na min pachatna la'n sangting chule thangvahna pum'a jana ka peh ding ahi.
69.31: Ajeh chu hichun kilhaina bongchal ki todoh sang'a Yahweh Pakai chu alunglhaisah ding ahin, bongchal thaotah le akeng tin hoitah thilpeh kipe sang in jong aphajoi.
69.32: Mi kineosah ten a Elohim Pathen'u natoh muo vintin kipahdiu ahi. Apanpi dia Elohim Pathen holte jousen kitilkhouna neicheh uhen.
69.33: Ajeh chu Paka in ngaichageova umte taona angai in; Aman sohchang'a umho donlouvin akoi jipoi.
69.34: O van-le-lei in Elohim Pathen vahchoi u henlang twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong vahchoi u hen.
69.35: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathenin Jerusalem ahuhdoh ding Judah khopiho asemphat ding ahi. Hiche'a chun amite cheng untin gamsung chu alodiu ahi.
69.36: Ama thu nitjing chaten gamsung chu louvin tin, chule ama ngailuho jouse hiche mun a chu lungmong a cheng diu ahi.

70.1: Elohim Pathen lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! Yahweh Pakai, gangtah in hung in lang neihung kithopin.
70.2: Tha dia eiholten jumna toh uhenlang jachatsah in. Ka gentheipet a kipahho jachat thohpum in kinunglesah tan.
70.3: Amaho chu tijat le jachat thohsah in, ajeh chu amahon “aphai tun ama ikhut uvah aumtai” atiuve.
70.4: Hinlah koi hileh nangma holte jousen nang a kipa-le-thanopna dimset muo hen. Koi hileh na mihuhhingna ngaichaho jouse chun “Elohim Pathen hi aloupi e!” tin samging'u hen.
70.5: Hinla keidin vang vaicha le lhasam ka hi; O Elohim Pathen lungset tah in eipanpi din hung loi in. Nanghi eipanpi le eihuhhingpa na hi; O Yahweh Pakai geisang hih in.

71.1: O Yahweh Pakai eihuhdoh ding ngaichan na kom kahinbel e.
71.2: Neihuhhing in lang neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu nangma adih na hi, na kol hinsung'in lang ka sei neingaipeh in, chule neichamlhatsah in.
71.3: Ka kisel jing theina din kahoidam na songpi hijing in. Keima huhhing ka chan theina ding'in thu peh chu pen, nangma ka songpi le ka kiselna na hi.
71.4: Ka Pathen Elohim, miphalouho thaneina a kon'in neihuhdoh in, eibolse a mi engbolseho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
71.5: O Yahweh Pakai nangbou ka kinepna na hi, O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi ka chapan laiya pat'a ka hin tahsan na hi tai.
71.6: Henge, ka pen'a pat nang'in neina umpi jing in, ka nu naobu sung'a ka kijil'a pat'a neina chintuppat ahitai, hijeh a nangma ka thangvah jing hi datmo ding ahipoi.
71.7: Ka hinkho hi mitamtah din kihilna thei ahi, ajeh chu nangma hi ka thahatna le ka kiselna na hi.
71.8: Hijeh a chu nangma ka thangvah chim theilou na hi; Nilhum kei kei a hi na loupina ka phondoh jing ahi.
71.9: Tua, ka tehphat hin neipaidpoh hih in. Ka tha'n ajolou teng neinungsun hih in.
71.10: Ka melmate hi keima douna di'n akihoutoh tauve. Amaho hin thadoh ding eigo tauvin ahi.
71.11: Amahon, “Elohim Pathenin anungsun tai che'u hitin gaman'u hite ajeh chu tuahi koiman apanpi lou ding ahi” atiuve.
71.12: O Elohim Pathen, munchom a potdoh hih in, Pathen ka Elohim neihung panpi loi in.
71.13: Keima eihehseho hi sunem'in lang sumang jeng in, keima eibolsenomho hi sujum'in lang jachatsah in.
71.14: Keima vang neikithopi ding'a kinem jing ding ka hi; Keiman nangma ka thangvahbe jing ding na hi.
71.15: Keiman nangma chonphatnaho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi. Keima thusei them hihih jong leng na mihuhhingna thahatna hi nilhumkei kei a ka phondoh jing ding ahi.
71.16: O Yahweh Pakai thaneichungnung, keiman na thilbol nasatah tahho jeh a ka thangvah ding na hi. Thudih choija nangma bou na hi hi keiman mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
71.17: O Elohim Pathen nang'in ka chapanlai a pat'a neinahil ahitai. Ken jong na thilbol kidangho hi midangho ka seipeh jing ding ahi.
71.18: Tunvang keima ka tehtan ka sam akang tai neinungsun hih in. Tu khangthahte lah a hin na thaneina hi samphong lengnge. Kei nung'a hung ding miho lah a jong na thilbol datmo umtahho jong phongdoh ing kate.
71.19: O Elohim Pathen na chonphatna hi van sangpenho lah jong aphapeh e. O Elohim Pathen na thilbol kidangtahho hi koitoh na kitekahpi thei ding ham?
71.20: Hahsatna nasatah tah neithohsah in ahinlah nang'in ka hinkho na kiledohsah ding ahi'n chule lhan lah a kon'in jong neikaidoh in.
71.21: Nang'in lolhinna sangjo cheh a jong neikiledohsah ding avel'a neihin lhamon ding ahi.
71.22: Hiteng chuleh keiman semjangsaito tho'a nangma ka thangvah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangma na kitepna a na thon ngaipoi.
71.23: Keiman nangma thangvahna la hi kipah tah'a thongleuva ka sah ding ahi, ajeh chu nang in neihunglhatdoh tan ahi.
71.24: Keiman nangma thilphabolho hi sun nilhum a ka seiphongle ding ahi, ajeh chu keima eibolsego chun jachatna le jumna atoh tauvin ahi.

72.1: O Elohim Pathen nang'in na ngaisang thutan dihna chu lengpa hinpe jing'in, chule na chonphatna chu lengpa chapa hinpe tan.
72.2: Na mite chung'a thu adih in tansah in; genthei lengvaite jong aphalam achan dingdol chang jing u hen.
72.3: Molsang dung hon jong mijouse ding'in haodohna sodohsah hen chule thinglhang in jong gapha sodohsah hen.
72.4: Genthei lengvaite panhusah in lang alhasamho chate huhdoh hen chule misugentheite chu sumang jeng hen.
72.5: Vanlai jol'a nisa le lha avahjing laise'n tonsot in amahon nangma naging jing'u hen.
72.6: Lengpa chu amite lah a go'n leiset chung achapnou bang'in hamdongho tobang amite chapnou hen.
72.7: Ahinkho lhumkeijin chonphatna hinkho chepi jing hen. Chule lha'n vah aneilaisen khangtou jing hen.
72.8: Alenggam in twikhanglen khat a kon'in twikhanglen langkhat hoppha hen lang chule Euphrate vadung'a kon'in leiset mong langkhat gei hop hen.
72.9: Neldigam a ganchaching mite'n chibai aboh diu ahi; amelmate jong amasang a um nen le boh lah a chun lhu cheh unte.
72.10: Tarshish le gamlatah a cheng lhumlam lengte'n kai hin peuhen. Sheba le Seba a kon solam lengte'n kipa thilpeh hinchoiju hen.
72.11: Leng jouse a ang'a kun'untin namtin vaipi alhacha hung pang di'u ahi.
72.12: Aman genthei lengvaite chu akom'a atao teng'uleh hin huhdoh intin, min abol genthei panpibeiho chu ahinpanhu ding ahi.
72.13: Aman milhasamte neiloute akhoto'a ahin huhdoh ding ahi.
72.14: Pumhat a kibol thohgimna noija umho chu alhatdoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman amaho chu alainatpi ding ahi.
72.15: Lengpa chu hingsot hen! Sheba sana chu ama kipe hen, amite'n taopeh jing'u hen chule nilhumkei in phatthei boh uhen.
72.16: Agamsung'uva chang-le-mim nengchet hen, thinglhangvum geiyin chang-le-mim kehdoh hen. Thei gana thingphungho jong Lebanon thingphungho bang'in keh dimset'u hen. Chule mipite jong hamphung phat bang'in hinhoi u hen.
72.17: Tonsot in lengpa minthang hen, nisa asat laisen chejom jing hen. Namtin vaipi amajeh in phatthei chang'u hen.
72.18: Yahweh Pakai, Israel Pathen Elohim chu thangvah in um hen, Amabouvin thil kidang aboldoh thei ahi.
72.19: Amin loupi chu tonsot in thangvah in umhen! Vannoi leiset hi Ama loupina dimset hen, Amen, Amen!
72.20: (Hiche hi Jesse chapa David taona achaina ahi).

73.1: Yahweh Pakai chu Isreal te din aphai, hitobanga lungthimtheng ho dinga chun.
73.2: Keima din vang, kalamjotna beikoncha bou ahitai. Kalamlhong anal in lhulham pai ding kahitai.
73.3: Ajeh chu keiman mikiletsahho gitlou bol pum hijong leu akhangtou u kamuteng ka otchalheh jin ahi.
73.4: Amaho hi atahsa'u aphatheiyin, adamthei un, ahattheiyun lungkhamna imacha neilou dan'in aum jiuve.
73.5: Amaho hin midang bang'in boina imacha aneipouvin midangho'n aneiyu lunggimna amahon imacha aneipouve.
73.6: Amahon kiletsahna songmantam a kisem khivui bang'in aki ouvin, gitlouna chu pon bang'in akisil'un ahi.
73.7: Hiche miboltheiho hin alungsung uva angaichat chan'u anei un ahi.
73.8: Amahon mi jahda dingngen aseijun kiletsah tah in midang chu suhmang ding ago uvin ahi.
73.9: Amahon van douna'n thu asei uvin a-o cheng'un leiset pumpi asamsesoh jeng'un ahi.
73.10: Hiti chun mipiho'n athusei u hi ajah uleh akicha uvin akisulungdong gam tauvin ahi.
73.11: Elohim Pathen'in ipi ahet am? “Hatchungnung in thilsohho hi ahena dem?” atiuve.
73.12: Hiche migilouho hi veuvin hinkhonom amang un ahao tultul jeng'un ahi.
73.13: Imacha phachomlou ding'a lungthim theng ka put ham? Themmona beihel'a hinkho ka man hi mohseh ham?
73.14: Nilhumkei in imacha phatchomna ka mupon hahsatna ngen ka mu jo'n ahi, jingkah seh in lunggimna ngen in eilonvuh in ahi.
73.15: Keiman hitiahi ka seikhah a ahileh na mi ka hilou hijeng inte.
73.16: Hijeh chun keiman miphalouho hi i-atileh khangtou cheh cheh u ham ti hetchet ding'in ka khol'in ahi. Ahinla iti hahsat hitam?
73.17: Hichun O Pathen Elohim, nangma muntheng'a ka lut'in ahileh ajona in migiloute akhankho diu chu kahin hedoh tan ahi.
73.18: Tahbeh in nang'in amaho hi lhuh nathei munjeng a nakoi ahin alhuh gam nadiu a kiling gih geh songpi chung a nakoi joh ahi.
73.19: Chomkah lou in amaho amahthahgam tauvin ahi, tijatna'n alhohmang gam tauve.
73.20: O Yahweh Pakai nangma na hung kipatdoh tengleh nang'in amaho ngolna chu na nuisat ding ahi, mikhat in jingkah lang'a amang anuisat tobang bou ahi.
73.21: Hijouchun ka lungsung analheh jeng'in, hiti chun ka sunggil lang achiplha jeng'in ahi.
73.22: Keima vang mingol le thilhethemlou kana hi-Nang a ding chun khohephalou gamsa tobang bep ka na hi bouve.
73.23: Henge keima nang'a ka hi jing'e, nang man ka jetlang na tuh jingnai.
73.24: Na chihna'n eikaihoi jing in, munloupi tah chu neilhut ding ahi.
73.25: Van a nang tailou koidangba ka nei ding ham? Leiset chung'a thildang jouse sang'in jong kalung in na ngaicha joi.
73.26: Ka tahsa bei henlang ka lhagao lhadai jongleh, Elohim Pathen chu ka lungthim'a ka hatna ahijing'in Amahi tonsot a kei a ahijing'e.
73.27: Ama dalhaho jouse chu mahthah ding ahiuve, ajeh chu nangma dalhaho jouse chu nangman na sumang jin ahi.
73.28: Ahinla keima ding'in Elohim Pathen kom nai hi iti phat a hitam! Keiman vang Yahweh Pakai Lengchungnung chu ka kiselna ahijing e, chule keiman na thilbol kidangho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.

74.1: O Elohim Pathen, idia hitihchan pi neipaidoh u hitam? Ipi ding'a na kelngoite douna a hichangeihi na lunghan ham?
74.2: Khang masalai peh a nalhentum chate kahiu neisumil hih beh un, hiche nam nagoulu tum dia na ngeh jing chu kahiuve! chule hiche lei a na inn Jerusalem jong sumil hih beh in.
74.3: Hiche khopi kisumangsa a hin hungvahlen lang, na melmate'n na Hou-In hi ichanggei a asuhset'u hitam hinven.
74.4: Hiche mun a hi na melmate'n haan la anasap u hitam, hiche mun a hi aponlap u ana khaisang'u ahi.
74.5: Amahon gammang lah a thingtuhna a heicha analap u bang'in,
74.6: Heicha le chempong toh tho'n anakhenchip'un ahi.
74.7: Amahon namuntheng a na mintheng kitahdohho chu asuboh un,
74.8: Chuban in jong “abonchan suseu hite” akitikit uvin, Elohim Pathen houna mun jouse jong anahallhah u ahitai.
74.9: Keihon melchihna thil kidangtahho chu ka mudohjou tapouvin ahi. Themgaoho jouse la aumgam tapouvin, chule hiche hi itihleh kichai ding ti chu koimacha ahe aumpon ahi.
74.10: O Pathen Elohim ka melmate'u hi itihchanggei na kihousetsah ding ham? Namin theng hi tonsot a nasuh molphou sah ding hitam?
74.11: Ipi dia na banjet thahatna hi na chalohsah lou ham? Na khut thahattah chu mangcha'n lang amaho khu sugam tan.
74.12: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi khangluilai a pat a leiset chung'a huhhingna hinpolut a ka lengpa na hi.
74.13: Nang man na ban thahat'in twikhanglen jong na lhehkhen in, twikhanglen a cheng sahemho luchang jong navohchip soh hel e.
74.14: Nangman Leviathan luchang jong nasuchip in atahsa neldigam a um ganhingho vahnan na mangtai.
74.15: Nang man leiset a kum nakihei sah in leiset a kon'in twi tamtah na putdohsah in chule a-itih a kang khalou vadungho jong na sukang jin ahi.
74.16: Sun le jan jong nang'a ahin: nangman vanlai jol'a avahho jouse le nisa jong na sem in ahi.
74.17: Nangman leiset gamgiho jouse jong na lhehkhen in chule nipilai le phalbilai jong na gongtoh in ahi.
74.18: Ven Yahweh Pakai hiche melmaho hin ichangei a nangma hi na houset'u hitam, ima hetkhenna neilou nam miten na min hi asuminseuvin ahi.
74.19: Hiche gamsa tobang miphalouho hi vapal tobang miphaho hi suhmangsah hihbeh in, na mite gentheina hi itihchan'in jong sumil hihbeh in.
74.20: Na kitepna kinep umtahho chu sumil hihbeh in, ajeh chu gamsung hi muthim le pumhat a natohna adimset e!
74.21: Noise le chotpha a umte hi jumna tosah kit hihbeh in, amavang mivaicha le tahlelte na min choi-at sah in.
74.22: Na melmate'n na housetnaho le na doumah mah asap a saptho jenghou hi nahsahmon koihihbeh in.
74.23: Namel ten aseidoh uchu nungvet kit hih in ahiloule amaho phunchel jing na chu.

75.1: O Elohim Pathen nangma kahin thangvah e! Yahweh Pakai nangma nailama naumjeh in kahin thangvah uve. Muntin a um mipiten nathilbol kidangtah ho aphongdoh un ahi.
75.2: Elohim Pathennin asei e, keiman thutanna phatkhat kagong e, keiman dihtah a thu katanding ahi.
75.3: Leiset hi kihot linghenlang mihemte tija jongleu leiset bulpi tuhchah jingding chu kahi.
75.4: “Keiman mikiletsah ho kagih-in ‘kiletsah datan!’ Migiloulou ho komachun, ‘nakhut tumjel hihin!’
75.5: Vanho dounan nakhut tum jel hihin, ahilouleh nahsah loutah in thu seihih in” kati.
75.6: Ajeh chu, leiset chunga koimacha solam a kon hihen lhumlam-a kon hijongleh chuleh gamthip noi a kon hijongleh kihisah tah a akhuttum ajel louding aphai.
75.7: Ajeh chu thutan vaihom-a hi Elohim Pathen Amabou ahin, Amahin koipen ding doh ding ham ahi louleh koipen lhuding ham gonga Amabou ahi.
75.8: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin juphon gimnamtuitoh kihal chu akhutna khonkhat in achoiye. Aman hiche ju chu thutan na mun a sunglut in, hichu migilou cheng in adon teitei diu adontheng heldiu ahi.
75.9: Hinla keima vangin, Elohim Pathen thil bol ho hi kaphondoh jengding; Jacob Elohim Pathen henga vahchoila kasha jingding ahi.
75.10: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathenin asei e “Keiman miphalouho thahatna laichu kasuhchip ding ahinla michonphaho thahatna kahatsah beding ahi” ati.

76.1: Judah a Pathen Elohim hi akijabol in, Israel a Amin hi aloupin ahi.
76.2: Jerusalem hi achenna ahin; Zion molchu a inn ahi.
76.3: Hicheachun agalmite meikong tobang thalchang chu asubong in, a umphou le achemjamhou chuleh agalmachah houjouse jong asuhchip pehin ahi.
76.4: Nangma hi tonsot a umjing mol ho sang in jong naloupi in nalamdang deh e.
76.5: Eidou u galmi hangpenho jouse jong akisugep gam tauve. A imumil bang in kamasang uvah akijamdel tauve. Galmi koiman kamasang uvah akhutnu alamp ngapchat lou diu ahitai.
76.6: O Jacob Elohim Pathen nakam sunga nahaina hu chu ahung gindoh chun asakol jouse leh akangtalai jouseu akolchah sah soh jengin ahi.
76.7: Nangma hitobang tah-a ginle ja naumhi datmo ding ahipoi. Ajeh chu nalunghan ahung deujah leh koiham na-anga ding ngam dingah?
76.8: Vanna konin nagalmite chunga thu nahin tan in, leiset hi akithingin na-ang sungah adingin ahi.
76.9: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nadingdoh-in mi engsete thu natan in leiset abol genthei a umte nahuhdohjin ahi.
76.10: Mihemte hi nangma doumah a achonteng hichu naloupina kilandohna ahijon ahi, ajeh chu hiche chu nangma manchah-a pangbep ji ahi.
76.11: Na Pakai Yahweh, na Pathen Elohim heng a kitepna neiyin lang hichu nit'in, mijousen kichat umtah Elohim Pathen kom a pehdingdol hinpecheh hen.
76.12: Ajeh chu Aman leng chate kiletsahna avochip in, lengten jong Ama ginle jana aneiyun ahi.

77.1: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kakouvin; henge, kasaptho jengin ahi. Oh, Elohim Pathenin eingaipeh tei inte!
77.2: Keiman hahsatna kato teng Yahweh Pakai chu kaholjin ahi. Jankhovah in vanlang sangin kakhut katungin kataojin ahi. Ahinla kalhagao in olna amujoupoi.
77.3: Keiman Elohim Pathen kagelin apanpina ngaichatnan eilonvuh-in kamaojin ahi.
77.4: Nangman jankhovah in nei imutsahpon ahi, ajeh chu keima kalung ahesoh behsehin kataotheipoi!
77.5: Keiman phat sottah chetasa hinkholui nopsahna chengchu kageldohjin,
77.6: kipana dimsetna vahchoina la ana kisahna janhochu kalhagao lungthim a kakholchil tengleh tuhin masangtoh akibah louna kageldohjin ahi.
77.7: Yahweh Pakai hin aitih a dia eipaidoh mong hitantem? Amahin khotona eimulou mong mong ding hitam?
77.8: Angailutna longlouchu chemang monga hitam? Akitepna hochu lolhing lou mong ding hitam?
77.9: Elohim Pathenin eihepina chu asuhmil mong hitam? Eihepina kotchu akha mong hitam?
77.10: Hitihin keiman kaseijin, “hichehi kachanding mongchu ahi, chungnungpen'in ei engbol ahi,” kati.
77.11: Ahinla O Yahweh Pakai nanatoh hohi kahin geldohin, tuma sang peh-a nanatoh kidangtah hochu kageldohin ahi.
77.12: Hicheho chu kalung sunga amil theipon ahi. Nanatoh loupitah hochu gellouvin kaumthei jipon ahi.
77.13: O Elohim Pathen nalampi hi atheng e. Nangma tobang patheng dang um mong nantem?
77.14: Nanghi datmo kidangtah Elohim Pathen chu nahi ahi! Nangin chidang namdangte lah-a nabol theina gimneitah chu nakilandohsah ahitai.
77.15: Naban thahatna a nami Jacob leh Joseph chilhahte chu nahuhdoh ahitai.
77.16: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglensan chun namuphat in twichun nahinven akithingtan ahi! Twikhanglen chu asunglang ho ngeiyin akithingin ahi.
77.17: Meilhang in go ahin juhlhahsah in, van gin kithong chun vanthamjol chu agin akithonsah in ahi. Nakolphe thalchang chun ahin salvah in ahi.
77.18: Chimpei lah-a kon chun van gin ahung kithongin kolphe chun vannoi leiset ahin salvah in ahi! Leiset chu akithingin akihot-e.
77.19: Nalampi chu twikhanglen'ah akilhunglutnin ahi, Nakeng nung twilah ajong akigollut e, ahinlah nakhonung koimachan amudoh joupoi!
77.20: Nangin kelngoi chingpa hina in Mose le Aaron mangcha in namite hi kelngoi honbangin napuilen ahi.

78.1: O kamite ho, kathuhil hi ngaiyun. Kathusei a hin nakol'u hinsungun,
78.2: ajeh chu keiman thulem a nahenga thu kaseiding ahi, keiman achesa thilsoh ho-a kon a kahin hilding nahi,
78.3: eihon thusim ijahsa houleh ihetsahou, thusim ipu ipateuva kon a hung kiseilhapeh ho ahi.
78.4: Eihon hiche thutah hohi icha inaoteu i-impeh loudiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh loupi tahtah hohi, athaneinale akidanna hohi ikhangthah houhi iseipehdiu ahi.
78.5: Ajeh chu Aman Jocob kom a Dan anapeh-a, Israel kom a thuhil ho anapeh ahi. Aman ipu ipateu atu achateu ahil diuva thupeh anapeh ahin,
78.6: hitiachu ahunglhung ding khangthah ten ahet nadiuleh ahung pengloulai chapang ho dinga, chuleh aman amaho chapangte ahilsonna diuva ahi.
78.7: Hitiachu khangthah ahunglhun channa Elohim Pathen a kinepna thah aneisah nadiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh kidang thil loupi hochu asuhmillou nadiu chuleh athupehho anitjing nadiuva ahiljing diu ahi.
78.8: Hiteng chuleh ipi iputeu tobang talou a lungtahna, kiphinna, kitah louna Elohim Pathen a alungthim'u pehnom louna anei lou diu ahitai.
78.9: Ephraim galsat hon thalchang akipoh vangun akinung hei un galmun a konin ajam tauve.
78.10: Amahon Elohim Pathen toh akitepnau ajuitapouvin ama thuhil dinpi ding anom tapouvin ahi.
78.11: Elohim Pathenin ipi abolpeh uham thil kidangtah tah anabol hochu,
78.12: napu napateu dinga thil kidang anatohdoh ho, Egypt gamsungle Zoan phaicham chunga, atohdohho asumil tauvin ahi.
78.13: Ajeh chu Aman twikhanglen ana homkhen in twichu bang bangin aki khen in amaho anapui galkaiyun ahi.
78.14: Sunleh meilhang in anapuijin, janleh meikong in anapuijin ahi.
78.15: Aman gamthip gamm a songpia kon in adondiu twi anaputdoh sah-in ahi.
78.16: Aman songpia konna twichu vadung bangin analondohsah in ahi.
78.17: Ahijeng vangin neldi gam achun amahon chonset anabol'un hatchungnung dounan ana kiphin'un ahi.
78.18: Amahon alungsung uchu lungtahna neipumin Elohim Pathen ana patep un nehding anathumun ahi.
78.19: Amahon Elohim Pathen Amatah dounan thu anaseiyun “Elohim Pathenin gamthip gammah an eipejou pouve” atiuve.
78.20: “Henge, songchu ajep'un twichu aputdoh nai, ahinla amite changlhah le sa me eipejou pouve” atiuve.
78.21: Elohim Pathenin hichehi ajahdoh phatnin alunghang lheh jengin, Jacob dounan alunghan na mei akoudoh jengin ahi! Hitihin Israel douna alung hanna ahung koudoh jengin ahi,
78.22: ajeh chu amahon Elohim Pathen atahsan pouvin chuleh amaho akhoukhah diuvin jong ana tahsan pouvin ahi.
78.23: Elohim Pathenin chungleng vanthamjol thu apen vankot jouse jong ahongdoh in,
78.24: Aman aneh dingun van a konin Mana gojuh in ahin juhlhah sah in van changlhah chu ahinpen ahi.
78.25: Amahon vantil buchu aneuvin, Elohim Pathenin alungna chimsetnun apen ahi.
78.26: Aman solam huichu ahin nunsah in, Athahatnan lhanglang huijong anunsah in ahi.
78.27: Aman aneh dingun sachu vutdi jat ahin juhlhah sahin, vachaho chu twikhanglen panga neldi jat ahin,
78.28: Aman vachaho chu aponbuh sungu leh avel uvah ahin lenlhah sah in ahi.
78.29: Amahon oivasetin aneuvin ahi. Angaichat dungjuitah in apen ahi.
78.30: Hinla amahon angaichat dungjuiya anehva masangu, akam sung uva sa aumpet jeng jong chun,
78.31: Elohim Pathen lunghana achung uvah ahung lhungtan ahileh Aman alah uva ahatpen pen hochu athat tan ahi. Israel khangthah anasapen hochu athat gamtan ahi.
78.32: Ahijeng vangin mipiho chun chonset aboljom jingun ahi, thilkidang ijat abol vangin atahsan dehpouvin ahi.
78.33: Hiti chun ahinkhou chu lhuhgam na ahitan akum khouchu kichatnan adimtai.
78.34: Elohim Pathenin amaho ahin thapat phatnun amahon ajona langin Amachu ahin holtauvin ahi. Kisihna ahin neitauvin Elohim Pathen ahin holtauvin ahi.
78.35: Hiti chun Elohim Pathen chu asongpiu ahi chuleh Elohim Pathen chu hat chungnung le ahuhhing pao ahi ahin geldoh tauvin ahi.
78.36: Ahijeng vangin hichu kamnal a anaseijiu ahibouvin alei u mangchan jou anaseiyun ahi.
78.37: Alung sungu chu Elohim Pathen a ana petheng pouvin Elohim Pathen toh anakitep nauva jong ana dingdet pouvin ahi.
78.38: Hinla lungsetna dim Elohim Pathen chun achonsetnau anangai damun amahochu ana sumang deh pouvin ahi. Phat atamjon alunghan na anatuh tangin hiche bangchun ima ana tongdoh pon ahi.
78.39: Tahsa mihembep ahiuve ti ahejingin, hui anun leh heikhat kahbou ahin ahung kiletapoi ti ageldoh in ahi.
78.40: Gamthip sunga ijatvei Ama douna ana kiphin jengu chuleh alungsung anatsah vangin,
78.41: Avel vel in Elohim Pathen thohhat nachu apatep jiuvin Israel Pathen Elohim chu asulunghang jiuvin ahi.
78.42: Amahon athahatna in agalmi houva kon a anahuhdoh u hi ageldoh joutapouve.
78.43: Egypt gamsunga thil kidang ijat abolu hitam chuleh Zoan phaicham a athil kidang bol hochu ageldoh tapouvin ahi.
78.44: Vadungho thisan asosah a don mohella alha, vadung twi donmo hella alha jengchu.
78.45: Elohim Pathenin amaho lah a thousi vaibong alansah a, uphohte alansah a agam ujong a suh set peh chu ahepha tapouve.
78.46: Aman achang jouseu khongbai aneh gamsah in alousoh jouseu jong khaokhopi anehgam sah e.
78.47: Alengpithei jouseu gel avohlhah sah sohkei in, atheipiu phung jouseu jong daibang athagamsah in ahi.
78.48: Agancha jouseu gel lah a dalhah in aumsah in, akelngoi houjong keh alhah lihsah sohtai.
78.49: Achung uva nasatah in alunghangin, alung dammona alung hanna, mi sumang vantil hon tamtah alhahkhum tan ahi.
78.50: Aman alunghanna achung uvah achuh sahtan, Egypt mite hinkho anahing hoipon, amangthah gamtan ahi,
78.51: Egypt insunga achapa tahpen cheh athat in Egypt gamsung pumpia khangdongte pahcha amolsahtai.
78.52: Hinla Aman amite chu kelngoi honbangin apuiyin gamthip noija bitkei in apui galkai tan ahi.
78.53: Aman mongtahin apuilen hijeh chun amahon kichatna aneipouve, chujongleh twikhanglen in agalteu alhoh mangpeh gamtai.
78.54: Amaho chu Elohim Pathenin agamtheng abanjetna atundoh, molsang vum achun ahin puilut in,
78.55: Amaho masangah namtin vaipi adelmang peh sohkeiyin, abonchauvin achan dingu gam ahoppeh chehin, Israel phung namtin abonchauvin ama ama ponbuh cheh a achensah tai.
78.56: Ahijeng vangin amahon hatchungnung Elohim Pathen dounan thil abol jingun athupeh ho khatcha anitpeh pouvin ahi.
78.57: Apu apateu bangin avah mang-uvin jou jengin na atonguvin ahi. Amaho chu thalpi janglou bangin akitah pouvin ahi.
78.58: Amahon pathen dangho doiphung aphutdoh un Elohim Pathen alunghan sah uvin, chuleh semthu pathen ahoujeh-un Elohim Pathen athangthip sahtauvin ahi.
78.59: Elohim Pathenin ajahdoh phat in hatah'in alunghangin Israel chu pumpai in apaimangtan ahi.
78.60: Elohim Pathenin Shiloh achenna mun adalhan mihemte lah a aumna ponbuh chu adalhatai.
78.61: Aman aloupina le athaneina hetna kitepna thingkong chu galmiho khutna apehdohtan ahi.
78.62: Ama amite chunga alunghan jeh-in agalmiteu athasah gamtan ahi.
78.63: Gollhangho galah athigam tauvin, nungah ho akichenpidiu aumtapon ahi.
78.64: Thempute athat gamtauvin ameithai houvin alhasetpi thei tapouvin ahi.
78.65: Ajonan Yahweh Pakai chu a-ihmua ahung khangdoh bangin ahung thoudoh in mihatpa hung kiltildoh bangin ahung kitildohin,
78.66: Galmi hochu anungno in a-itih a ding jumna atosah tan ahi.
78.67: Ahinla Joseph chilhah hochu apaidohin, chuleh Ephraim phungchu alheng tapon ahi.
78.68: Aman akhellin Judah leh angailut Zion molchu alhengin,
78.69: hichea chun vanho san banga sang, leiset banga chah a-itih a umjing dingin Hou-In khat atungdoh tan ahi.
78.70: Aman asohpa David chu akelngoi chinna a konnin anakoudoh'in analheng tan ahi.
78.71: Aman kelngoipi le anou achin laijin akoudoh'in amite Israel Jacob chilhah hochu kelngoi chinna ching dingin anapansah tan ahi.
78.72: David in amaho chu lungtheng tah leh chingtheitah in analamkaiyin ahi.

79.1: O Elohim Pathen chiding namdangten nanga dinga nanakilhendoh nagamchu ahinlo tauvin, na Houin theng asuboh'un chuleh Jerusalem chu khogemsa abahsah tauvin ahi.
79.2: Amahon nasohte tahsa chu vantham jolla lengle vachate adalhahpeh tauvin, pathen mi thengte tahsaphe chu gamlah a ganhingho an le chahin apangtan ahi.
79.3: Jerusalem kimvellah thisan hi twilon in along jengin mithi vuiding koimacha aumpoi.
79.4: Kaheng kakomho noise dingleh kajet kavei a umho dingin noise le taitomin kaumtauve.
79.5: O Yahweh Pakai phat ichangeija kachung uva nalunghan ding hitam? Tonsot geijin em? Phat ichan geija nathangthipna chu meikong banga aljeng dingham?
79.6: Yahweh Pakai nalunghanna chu nang na donnom loute chidang namdang holeh naminpan nomloute lenggam hochungah bunglhatan.
79.7: Ajeh chu amahon namite Israelte hi avallhum gamtauvin chuleh gamsung hi gamgem asodohsah tauvin ahi.
79.8: Kapu kapateu chonset jehin keiho neithep mosah hihbeh un! Nami khotonan gangtah'in kangaichatnu neisuh bulhitpeh un, achutilouleh kakinepnau beiding ahitai.
79.9: O Pathen Elohim kasochatnau, neipanhu loiyun! namin loupina dingin neipanhuvin, kachonsetnau ngaidam inlang neihuh doh'un namin loupina dingin.
79.10: Ipi dinga chiding namdangte hin eihouset uva “A Pathen u Elohim hoilai a umham?” natisah nahlai dingham? Hiche chiding namdangho chunga naphulahna chu neimusahih in, ajeh chu amahohin nasohte thisan aso u ahi.
79.11: Sohchangho lhasetna hi ngaipehin, thidinga athu kitansa hohi huhdoh inlang nathaneina chu neivet sah'un.
79.12: O Yahweh Pakai kaheng kakom hon noise tah a nahousetnao hi ajat sagin lethuh tei in.
79.13: Hiteng chuleh keiho namite nangailutna ankonga kivah nakelngoiten akhang khangin nang vahchoi ungting, vahchoijing taovinge.

80.1: O Israel neingaipehun, nangma Joseph chilhahte gancha hon ho banga puihoija kelngoi chin a chingpa. O Elohim Pathen Cherubim chunga laltouna a toupan naloupinavah hoi chu hin kimudoh sah in.
80.2: Ephraim, Benjamin leh Mannaseh chungah hintah langin, nathahatna gimneitah chu neimusah unlang neihung huhdoh tauvin.
80.3: O Elohim Pathen nangma komah neihoilutnun, namaivah chun neihin salvah un, chuteng boule huhhing kachandiu ahi.
80.4: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, phat itihchan gei a kataona sanlou a nakoi dingham?
80.5: Nangin lungkhamna a ichan gei a neivah uva chuleh khondimset a mitlhi neilonsah diuham?
80.6: Nangin hengle kom chiding namdangte taitomna neichansah tauvin kagalmi teuvin totnan einei tauve.
80.7: O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung nangma kom neingatsah un, namaivah chun neisalvah'un chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
80.8: Nangin lengpiga twi bangin Egyptma kon in neihin puidohun, nangin chiding namdangho nadel mangna nagamsunga neipuilutnu ahi.
80.9: Nangman keiho ding amun neisuhtheng pehun chuleh hichea chun keiho kajung khouvin gamsung chu kadimset tauve.
80.10: keiho len molsangho atomjouvin, kabah houvin Cedar thingphung lentah tahho atomjouvin,
80.11: keihon kabah hou lhumlam Mediterranean twikhanglen gei in kathejalun chuleh kajungun Euphrate vadung gei ka thejallun ahi.
80.12: Hinla tunvang, kabangu ipi dinga neivoh lhahpeh uva, hilang lampia hinhopa jousen kagao akiguh u hitam?
80.13: Gammanga kon in ngalchang hangin avallhum in, gamlah ganchahon kivahnan anei un ahi.
80.14: Hungkile kit in O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung, kahung tao un ahi. Van a konnin neihin veuvin kahahsatnau neihin vetpeh un, hiche lengpigui hi hin khoukhah'in.
80.15: Nangma tahin nanatu ahi. Hiche chapa hi nangma tahin nangma dinga nahin khoukhah ahi.
80.16: Ajeh chu keihohi thing banga eikitan bong bonga kagal miteuvin eihal lhah'u ahitai. Nangman navetsah chu amuteng uleh manthahnan juiju hen.
80.17: Mihem nangailut nacha nadeilhen chu hatsah-in,
80.18: Chutengleh keihon itihchan injong nanungsun pouvinge. Nei suhal kit un chutileh namin avella kahin koukit theidiu ahi.
80.19: Nangma komlang nei ngatsah kitnun, O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hatchungnung namaivah chun neihin salvah'un, chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.

81.1: Ei thahatsah u Elohim Pathen thangvahnan la sauvin, Jacob Pathen Elohim vahchoinan la sauvin.
81.2: Sauvin! tumging tothon avahchoila sauvin voh gingthei vouvin, semjang kisai ginleh selangdah gin to thouvin,
81.3: Lhathah janle sumkon mut-uvin lang, lhalih janle lhalih nikhoa golvah bolteng sumkon mut uvin.
81.4: Ajeh chu hichehi Israel dinga chondan thupeh ahin Jacob Elohim Pathen thugahsa ahi.
81.5: Egypt gam a kon a ahungdoh uchun Aman Joseph komma hettohsah khat anaphutdoh tai. Keiman kahetchetlou thukhat kajan,
81.6: Keiman apohgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih hahsa kathamsah tapoi.
81.7: Nagimna a kon in neihin kouvin keiman kahuhdohtai. Meivom lhangkhat kiheh chetchut laha kahin houjin, Meribah a twi umloupet in natahsah kapatepjin ahi.
81.8: Ngai uvin O kamite, nangho gihna nasatah kapeh pet-hin, Vo Israel kaseihi nangai poupou uleh,
81.9: Nanghon imatihchan ajong gamchom mit pathen koipouvin nate, pathen lhem masanga kun pouvin nate.
81.10: Ajeh chu Egypt-a kon a nahin puidoh uva Yahweh Pakai na Pathen'u Elohim keima kahi. Nakam hakatnin ka-in keiman thilpha tamtah adimsetna kahin sunlut pehding ahi.
81.11: Ahinla kamiten angainom pouvin, Israel'in Keima eingaicha pouve.
81.12: Hijeh chun Keiman alouchallu dungjuijin amaho deilam lam a chondin kalha kangtai.
81.13: O kamiten kaseihi ngaipou pouleu, O Kamite Israelte hin eijuiju henlang kalampia hin chenom poupouleu!
81.14: Ichan geija gang in agalmiteu kajopeh tadiuvem! Ichan geija gangtah'in akidoupiteu chunga kakhut kalha tadem!
81.15: Koi hile Yahweh Pakai nahsah loute chu a-ang sunga kisuchipdiu atonsotna mahthahdiu ahi.
81.16: Ahinla keiman nehthei aphapen a kavahding nahin, keiman songpia kon a kimu khoijua kavahdiu nahi.

82.1: Van a thutan na chunga Elohim Pathenin vai ahomin Van mite chunga athutan na aphondoh e.
82.2: Nangman itihchan hi miphalouho napanpia thudihlou ho nachelhah sah dingham?
82.3: “Chaga leh vaichate chungah thudih chepin lang; tahlel tele engbolla umte chungah thudih phongdoh in.
82.4: Panpi bei tele engbolla umte huhdoh in, miphalouho khut a konin huhdoh-in.
82.5: Hinla mibolse ten imacha ahepouve; ama hokhu hetna lhasam ahiuve. Muthim noi a avah leuvin, leiset sungil lamgei in ahotling tai.
82.6: Keiman kasei in, ‘Nang ho Pathen nahiuve; nangho hatchungnung chilhah te nahiu ve.
82.7: Hinlah nangho mihem tabang bep a nathi diu, thunei vaihom dang ho banga nalhuh tei diu ahi.’”
82.8: Hung kipatin, O Elohim Pathen vannoi leiset hi athu tannin, ajeh chu chiding namdangho jouse jonghi aboncha nanga ahi.

83.1: O Elohim Pathen, thipbeh in umhih'in! Na-ngong in umhih'in. O Pathen Elohim thipsan jeng hih in.
83.2: Nagalmite cho leng lung khu najahlou ham? Kiletsah tah nagalmiho ahung kipatdoh khu nahet louham?
83.3: Amahon namite douna dingin aguh in thil agong uvin, nangin napanhu mite dounan thilphalou agong uvin ahi.
83.4: Amahon aseijun “Hungun hiche nam mite hi sumang uhite akitiuve, chutileh Israel hi isuhmit heldiu ahi” atiuve.
83.5: Hiche tohgon ahi amaho akinop to uvin nang dounan kiloikhomna khat anei taove.
83.6: Ama hohi Edom mite, Ishmael mite, Moab mite, Hagrit mite,
83.7: Gebal mite, Ammon mite, Amelek mite chuleh Philistine leh Tyre akon mipiho ahiuve.
83.8: Assyria miten jong ajopmun ahin, Lot chilhah hoto jong kiloikhom ahiuve.
83.9: Amahohi Midian, Sisera, Jabin mite Kishion vadunga nabol bang bangin boljengin.
83.10: Amaho chu Endor lah nasumang in chuleh atahsa'u monlha chu leiset leipha sosahnan akimang in ahi.
83.11: Nang in alamkai hochu Oreb le Zoab nabolna bang in sumang in lang chuleh avaipo ho chu Zebah le Zalmunna nabolna bang in thatdoh tan,
83.12: ajeh chu amahon hitin aseijuve, “eihon hiche Elohim Pathen gam hohi eiho phatchom na dingin lahpeh-u hite” akitiuve.
83.13: O Elohim Pathen amahohi huilah a changvai akithejal bangin thejaltan!
83.14: Meijin gammang ahal bang in chuleh meikong in molle lhang ahal lhah bang in hallha jengin,
83.15: Huile gon melse tah a adelmang bang in delmang'in, nakhopi huijin kichat sah in,
83.16: Nasatah in sujumm in O Yahweh Pakai, namin a ahung kipehlut tokah un.
83.17: Amaho hi tonsotna jum ding leh kicha jing dingin melsetah'in thisah tan.
83.18: Hiteng chuleh amahon nangbou hi Hatchungnung leiset chunga thunei chungnung nahi hi hin hetau vinte.

84.1: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung naHou-In hi iti kangailut hitam?
84.2: Hiche a chu iti kaum nom hitam! Yahweh Pakai Hou inn chu kangaicha lheh jenge, kahina apumpin hingjing Elohim Pathen ah kakipana lan sange.
84.3: Inva jengin jong abuh akisah in, chuleh pengpalep injong intum akison e. Vo Yahweh Pakai hat chungnung, kalengpa le ka Pathen Elohim! Vachan jong namaicham kom a anou kicholdo nading abuh akisem ahi.
84.4: NaHou-Inn'a chenghon ichangei a hinkho nopna anei'u hitam phat tin in nangma vahchoila asauve.
84.5: Athahatna Yahweh Pakai a kon a kimuho hinkho iti nop a hitam, alungsungun Jerusalem'ah akholjing jengun ahi.
84.6: Beca phaicham ajot tengu jongle, twisam putna twinah tampi umna bangin abol'un, gotwi hunglha masapen in jong twikul tampi ahinsemdoh pehjiuve.
84.7: Amaho akalson chan uva ahetbe cheh chehjingdiu ahin, amahon Jerusalem a Yahweh Pakai chu amudiu ahi.
84.8: O Yahweh Pakai, Ka Pathen Elohim hatchungnung kataona neingaipeh'in, O Jacob Elohim Pathen.
84.9: O Elohim Pathen kalengpauhi phatthei boh'in, amahi kaluum u ahi, nathaonusa nalhen pahi khotona musah jingin.
84.10: Munchom a ni sangkhat umsangin na Houin a nikhat um aphajoi. Miphalou inna chen sangin ka Pathen Elohim inn'a kotngah a pan aphajoi.
84.11: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hi eiho dia nisa le umpho ahi. Aman khoto nale loupina eipeuvin ahi. Yahweh Pakaiyin thildih jeng bol mihoa kon in thilpha alamang pon ahi.
84.12: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nangma tahsan mihohi iti kipa um a hitam?

85.1: Yahweh Pakai nangin nagamsung'ah phatthei bohna nasunglhan ahi! Hiti chun nangin Israel phatthei naboh'in ahi.
85.2: Nangman namite chonsetna nangaidam in hichun achonsetnau jouse nalekhu peh e.
85.3: Nangin na lunghan na natuh tang'in, nalung hanna deujah jengchu naki kham jie.
85.4: Ei suhal kit uvin, eihuhhingpau O Pathen Elohim! kachung uva nalunghan na tolmang kittan.
85.5: Kachung uva nalunghan jing jeng dingham? Nalung hanna khang jouse chung naumsah jing jengding hitam?
85.6: Nei suhhal kit loudiu hitam? Namite kipa le thanom a aumjing thei nading a.
85.7: Vo Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou chu neimu sah'in nami huhhing najong neipe uvin.
85.8: Elohim na Pathen chun ipi asei am, chingthei tah'in ngai in ajeh chu Aman mi kitah ho kom ah chamna thu asei e. Ahinla amaho angolna lampi uvah kilekit dahen.
85.9: Tahbeh'in Ama gingte dingin huhing na naicha um a ahi. Chuti leh igamsung u jong aloupina dimding ahi.
85.10: Ngailutna longlou leh thutah akimuto'in chonphat nale chamna akichopto lhon e.
85.11: Kitah nahi leiset a kon a hungdoh ahi. Chuleh chonphatna chu van'a kon a mai lhaisel'a hung kumlha ahi.
85.12: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakaiyin phatthei boh hi ahin lonlhahsah ahin gam leiset a hi ninglhing tah'a ahin gadoh sah'a ikisan ji u ahi.
85.13: Chonphat nahin Yahweh Pakai hung nading semtoh nading nikho asap masat ji ahi.

86.1: O Yahweh Pakai hung kisunem'in lang kataona neingai peh'in, neidonbut in ajeh chu napanpi ngaicha jing kahi.
86.2: Yahweh Pakai nanga dinga kiphaldoh jing kahi neihuhdoh'in ajeh chu nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahin, keima hi nakinbol kahin chuleh nangma hi katansan jingin ahi.
86.3: O Yahweh Pakai nami khotona neimusah jingin ajeh chu keiman Nangmahi ka koujing nahi.
86.4: O Yahweh Pakai kipana neimusah jingin ajeh chu keimahi Nangkoma kiphaldoh jing kahi.
86.5: O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi naphatna jalla eingaidam jing nahi, nakomma panpi ngaichaho dinga longlou ngailutna dimsah nahi.
86.6: O Yahweh Pakai kataonahi khotonan neingaipeh'in gangtah a kap kahi neingaipehin.
86.7: Kahahsat channa nangma kakouding ahin nangin neidonbut jingding ahi.
86.8: O Elohim Pathen! Semthu pathen ho nang tobang khatcha aumpoi, nabolthei ho bolthei jong aumpoi.
86.9: Naemsa chitin namtin ho jong na ang a hungdiu chibai naboh cheh diu ahi Yahweh Pakai; amahon na mintheng avahchoi diu ahi.
86.10: Ajeh chu nangma bou Elohim Pathen nahin naloupin, nangin bou thil loupiho naboldoh jin ahi.
86.11: O Yahweh Pakai, na lampiho neihil in, nathudih dung jui a hinkho kaman theina dingin, nangma loupina kadopsang jingna dingin lungtheng neipen.
86.12: O Yahweh ka Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen! kalungthim pumpin nangma nathangvah ingkate, phattin'in naloupina domsang jing tange.
86.13: Ajeh chu nei ngailut na hi akidange. Nangman thina kulkhuh a kon in nei huhdoh tai
86.14: O Yahweh Pakai mijumso hatho keima dounan ahung ding doh un; misunoh phah a pang hon thading eigouve. Amahon nangma hi imachan nagel pouve.
86.15: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai Nangma hi khoto naleh ngailutna nei Elohim Pathen nahin lunghang vahlou chuleh kitahna leh tang theilou lungsetna dim a nahi.
86.16: Nami lungsetna chun noilang hinven lang nasoh hi tha neipen, nasohpa chapa kahi neihuhdoh'in.
86.17: Nei hepina melchih na chu hin tahlang'in chutileh eivetda hohin jumna amudiu ahi. O Yahweh Pakai neipanpin nei lungmonsah jingin.

87.1: Moltheng chunga chun Yahweh Pakai tundohsa khopi chu aum e.
87.2: Aman Jerusalem khopi hi Israel khopi dangho sangin angailu joi.
87.3: O Elohim Pathen khopi, nangma chungchang ahi itibang thuloupi tahtah kisei a hitam!
87.4: Keima eiheho lah'a hin, Egypt le Babylon chule Philistine leh Tyre chuleh gamlha tah Ethiopia jong kasimtha e. Amaho hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove.
87.5: Jerusalem chungchang a hitiahi kisei ding ahi, “amijousen nammi hina a thaneina chu akipapi cheh uve”, chule hatchungnung ama tah in khopi chu phatthei aboh ding ahi.
87.6: Yahweh Pakaiyin chitin namtin hi ajihlut teng, aseiding, “amaho jouse hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove” atiding ahi.
87.7: Mipi hochun theile amut'uva la asahdiu, “Kahinkho hung kipat nahi Jerusalem ahi” atidiu ahi.

88.1: O Yahweh Pakai, eihuhhing'a ka Pathen Elohim, sunleh nangma kakou in, jan leh nakom kahin nailut ji e.
88.2: Tun kakouna neijah peh'in lang katona neisan peh'in.
88.3: Ajeh chu kahin khohi boina adim in, thinan eikainai chehcheh e.
88.4: Athisa bang bep kahitai, mithahat tah khat athahat na bei nungsang bep kahitai.
88.5: Amahon mithi lah'a eidalha uvin lhan ah mithi lup'in kalum e. Keima hi suhmil in kaum tai, nami kaihoina a kon in eiki lamang tai.
88.6: Nang in kotong noinung pen athim pen ah neison lha e.
88.7: Nalung han na gihtah chun eidelphan, hichu twi kinong bangin akinong'in eichup tai.
88.8: Keima hi doumah in neisem in kagol kapai ho neidelmang peh gamtai. Keima hi thang'ah ka-oh in kitoldoh theilouvin kaum e.
88.9: Kamit lhin kamit achupmin kho muthei louvin kaum e. O Yahweh Pakai niseh'in na panpina kathum in nami lungsetna ngaichan kakhut teni kahin sange.
88.10: Nathil kidang bol hohi mithi dinga phachom ding hinam? Mithi hungthodoh a nathangvah theiding hinam?
88.11: Lhankhuh a kon in amahon nami ngailutna longlou hi ahin phongdoh theina diuvem? Suhmangna mun'a umhon nakitah nahi aphongdoh theina diuvem?
88.12: Muthim'in nathilbol kidang hohi aseiphong nadiuvem? Thil suhmil delna gama umhon na chonphat na hochu aseiphong theina diuvem?
88.13: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kakouve, niseh-a nakom a katao jingding ahi.
88.14: O Yahweh Pakai, ibolla kei nei paidoh hitam? Ibol a kei a kon a naki heimang hitam?
88.15: Kakhang don lai a pat a, kanatna hin thina komcha eina lhutsa ahitan, nagim neina masanga hin thabei leh lungkham tah'in kading e.
88.16: Nalunghan na tijat umtah chun eilonvuh'in, tijat naumna chun eithabei sah e.
88.17: Hiche hochun sun nilhum in twisoh bangin kavel a eilon khum un ahi. Muthimhi kakinai pipen kagol in apang un ahi.
88.18: Nang man ka mite le ka ngailut cheng neilahpeh tai, Thimjing hi kaki naipi pen ka loi chu ahi tai.

89.1: Keiman Yahweh Pakai mingailutna longlou thuhi vahchoilan sajing tange, khangdong hole tehse hon nakitahna hi ajauvin ahi.
89.2: Nami ngailutna longlou hi itih hijongleh umjing ding ahi. Nakitah nahi vanho bangin aumjinge.
89.3: Yahweh Pakaiyin hitin asei e “kalhendoh kasohpa David toh kitepna kanabol ahi. Hiche kitepna a hi kana kihahsel ahi.
89.4: Keiman nachilhahte chu lenga katun jingding ahi. Amaho nalaltouna a chu tuapat tonsot gei a toujingdiu ahi.”
89.5: Yahweh Pakai van mite jousen nakidan nahohi navahchoi diu ahi. Nakitahna ho jeh'a hi simjoulou vantilten navahchoi diu ahi.
89.6: Ajeh chu van gam a umho jouse koipen tah hi Yahweh Pakai toh tekah thei umbeh am? Vantil thupipen ho jengjong Yahweh Pakai toh tekah pithei um'am?
89.7: Vantil thaneipen hojong Elohim Pathen ang'a kithing thinga ahibouve. Amahi alaltouna vel a dingho jousen jong agimnei na aphapouve.
89.8: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung sepai ho! Hoilai mun a nang tobanga thanei a umbeh am Yahweh Pakai? Nanghi kitahna lhingset nahi.
89.9: Twikhanglen jong nathanei na noia umma ahi. Nangin huipi le twipi kithoa twi kinong jong nasutang'in,
89.10: twikhanglen'a um sa lenpen hojong na sugep in, Naban thahat in nagal mite jong nahocheh jitai.
89.11: Vanho jouse jong nanga ahin, leiset jong nanga ahi, vannoi a um thiljouse jong aboncha nanga ahin nangin nasem ahi.
89.12: Nangin sahlang lhanglang jong nasem ahin, Tabor Mol leh Hermon mol'in jong naming athangvah ahi.
89.13: Nabantha hi iti hat hitam! Nakhut hi iti hat hitam! Najetlang jonghi nathahat loupitah'in adomsange.
89.14: Chonphat nale thudih chu nalaltouna khombul ahi. Longlou ngailutna le kitahna chu nalhachate bangin na ang sungah avahlen ahi.
89.15: Elohim Pathen houna dinga kipa umtah kouna jaho chu anunnom ahiuve, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai amahohi na umpina vah a chu lhalediu ahi.
89.16: Naminthan na kidangtah hohi amahon nilhum kei keija akipapi diu ahi. Amahon nachon phatna hi akithang atpiu vin ahi.
89.17: Nangma hi amaho dinga thahatna loupitah chu nahi. Keiho thahat sah dinghi nangma kipana ahi.
89.18: Ahi, keiho hoidohna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon ahi. Chuleh Israel Elohim Pathen hin lengjong eipeh u ahi.
89.19: Masang lai in kitah tah a nangma jui namipite lah-a gaothu nana seijin ahi. Nangin nasei in, Keiman galsat ding kanalhengdoh'in keiman milhamho lah a konna lengding jong kanalhendoh ahi.
89.20: Keiman kasoh David kana mudoh'in chuleh kathaotheng kana nun ahi.
89.21: Keiman kakhut a kana dindoh sah a, kaban thahatna kahatdoh sahding ahi.
89.22: Agal miten ajoloudiu ahilouleh miphalou honjong athajou loudiu ahi.
89.23: Keiman akidoupi hohi amasang tah a kasuhlhuh ding ahin chuleh ama douho jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
89.24: Kakitahna leh kangailutna longlou hin aumpi jingding kathuneina jalla amahi atha kahatsah jingding ahi.
89.25: Keiman twikhanglen chunga jong athaneina kalhunlut ding vadungho chung jenga jong vai ahomding ahi.
89.26: Chutengleh aman eihin kou intin, “Nangma kapa nahin ka Pathen Elohim, kasongpi le kasochatna nahi” atiding ahi.
89.27: Keiman Amahi kachapa masapen, leiset chunga leng thaneipen kahisah ding,
89.28: Kangailut ding chuleh tonsot gei a kakhoto ding, amatoh kaki tepna hi angahtih umlouding ahi.
89.29: Keiman ama dinga ason apah ho kahoibit pehding, vangam'a nikhon beitih aneilou banga alaltounan jong beitih aneilouding ahi.
89.30: Ahinlah achilhahten kathuhil hohi apaidoh uva, kachedan hi ajuilou uva,
89.31: ka Dan semhohi anit lou uva chuleh kathupeh hi angailou uleh,
89.32: keiman achonsetnao chunga gambol na mol kalap ding, chuleh athungailou naojeh-a kavoh diu ahi.
89.33: Hijeng jongle kangailutna chu beideh louding kakitepna jong achunga kasuhmil deh louding ahi.
89.34: Ahipoi, kakitepna chu kasuhkeh louding ahi; keiman kana seidoh saho chu changkhat jong kanung lahdoh louding ahi.
89.35: Keiman David kommah kihahselna khat kana nei in chule atheng kahi jeh in jou seiponge.
89.36: Ama chilhahte itihchan hijongleh chelha jingding alenggam jong nisa banga chelhumding ahi.
89.37: Vantham jolla kahettohsah nachu lhavah banga kikheltih aneitah louding ahi.
89.38: Ahinlah nangin tuhin amachu nakahdoh tan chuleh napaidoh tai. Tuhin Nangma nathaonu lengpa chungah nalunghang tan,
89.39: nangin Ama toh nakitepna napaidohtan, nangin alal lukhuh jong vutvai lah-a nasep lhatai.
89.40: Nangin akhopiu bangho navohlhah pehtan chuleh akulpiu jong khogem nasodohsah ahitai.
89.41: Koi hileh ahin hopa jousen athilkeu u akichomgam hellun aheng akomho jousen anuisat'un ahi.
89.42: Nangin agal miteu galjona namusahin, abonchauvin nakipasah'in ahi.
89.43: Nangin agal manchah u manmo naso'in chuleh galmunnah gal nalelsah'in ahi.
89.44: Nangin aleng tenggol nalahpehin chuleh alaltouna tolsenan naneipeh in ahi.
89.45: Nangin aphat achang louvin natehset sah'in chuleh jumthet in nalhan ahi.
89.46: Yahweh Pakai nangma hi hitiahi kisel jing jingding nahi hitam? Ichangei nalunghanna meikong jing jeng dingham?
89.47: Kahinkho hi itihchom a hitam geldoh'in, keihohi thitei dinga neisem'u ahi ti geldoh'in!
89.48: Mihing koihi athi theilou ding um'am? Mihem koipen ham lhan a kon a ahoidohthei dingah?
89.49: Yahweh Pakai tumasanga neingailutnau chu ahet theina mudohthei ipi umam? David komma nakitepna hohi hoilang geija hitam?
89.50: Nasohpa keimahi ichan gei a jumna kato hitam? Hiche nangma hedohlou mitehin eisapsetnau ichan gei a kathoh hitam?
89.51: O Yahweh Pakai nadeilhen nalengpa hi nangma dou miten nahsah loutah'in abollun ahi! Achena chan a asujum un ahi.
89.52: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umjing jenghen! Amen, Amen!

90.1: Yahweh Pakai, akhang khanga nangmahi kachennao inn nahijenge!
90.2: Moul le lhang ho pen masang, vannoi le leiset hi natundoh masangin, thiljoue kipat a pat ajo na chen in jong, nang ma Elohim Pathen nahijing e.
90.3: Nangin mihemhi anahina masa-a kile kitding'in nasollin leivui nalesosah kitjin ahi.
90.4: Nangdin Kum sangkhat jeng jonghi achejing tunikho bangbep ahin, jan phat chomcha tobang bou ahi.
90.5: Nangin twisoh bangin neilhohmang jiuvin mang sangin asot jodeh poi. Keihohi hampa jingkah langa hung pahdoh tobang bou kahiuve.
90.6: Hichu akhangdoh loijin ahinla nilhah langle agop lhajin athijitai.
90.7: Keihohi nangma lunghan nan eisumang jitauvin chuleh nalung satnan eikichatsah'un ahi.
90.8: Nangin kachonsetnao namasangah natahlang jin ahi, aguh a kachonset nauhi nakilandoh sahjin ahi.
90.9: Nalungsat na noi a higjing kahinkhou ahin, kakumkhou jong lungsat nan abeiloi jitai.
90.10: Kei hohi kum 70 hingding bep kahiuvin, kahat tah'uleh kum 80 bep hingding kahiuve, ahinla hiche sunga chun natna le boina bou ahin; amang loiji taovin, chule keiho kaleng mang taove.
90.11: Nalunghanna thahat koiham ahe thei dingah? Naging a nalungsat khohje gelkhoh a koi ham?
90.12: Kachih theina diuvin kahinkhou chomdan hi neihetsah taovin.
90.13: O Yahweh Pakai, kaheng lam uva hung kile kit tan! Itihchan neikho ngai diu hitam?
90.14: Jingkah seh le nalungset longlou chun kalungthim kipasah in, chutile kahinkhou lhumkei a navah choi la kasha jing diu ahi.
90.15: Hesoh genthei kana thoh hou chuga kon in lunglhai na themkhat beh nei peu vin! Kakhoisat nao kumho jong kipana neisoh doh peh un.
90.16: Nasohte hi nathilbol kidangtah hochu neimusah'un; kachilhah teuvin nathaneina loupitah chu mu uhen.
90.17: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim un namalsom nauchu eimu sah uhen lang katohna jouseuvah lolhinna eipetao hen. Henge, katoh gao neiso peh un.

91.1: Chungnungpen cholngah na noi a um chan chun hatchungnung lhalim noi a choldo na amu ding ahi.
91.2: Yahweh Pakai chungchang a hiche hi kaphong e: Ama bou eivengbit ahin, kahoidam na mun ahi; Amachu ka Pathen Elohim ahin, keiman ama katah san e.
91.3: Ajeh chu aman thangkol jouse a kon in nahuh doh intin thinathei hivei hoa kon a nahuhdohding ahi.
91.4: Aman alhavinga nale khu ding ahi. A lhalim noi a nahoidoh ding ahi. Kitah tah a akihahsel naho chu nading a galvon le ompho ahi.
91.5: Jan a misu lung linglao ho kichat dan, sun lai a thalchang leng le ho jong kichat dan.
91.6: Jan noi a donthah nantna hivei gimnei tah ho kichat dan, sun lai a nadelkhum hesoh na jong kicha hih in.
91.7: Nasih langa sangkhat lhu henlang, navel a sangsom thijongle, hiche boina hon nangma natoh khah lou ding ahi.
91.8: Namit hah in lang vejeng in, itilom a migilou te chung a got na lhung hitam?
91.9: Nangin Yahweh Pakai chu napanpi ding a nakisem le, Yahweh Pakai chu nahuhdoh ding a nakigon ahi le,
91.10: Setna imachan najo lou ding ahi; natna hivei khatchan jong na inn ahinphah louding ahi.
91.11: Chuteng le Elohim Pathenin navale nachan a navengbit din avantilte thu pen tai.
91.12: Nakeng chu songa nakisuhkhah louna dinga vantilten akhut uva nadopdiu ahi.
91.13: Nangin keipi bahkai ho nasuh goi a; gul hang ho chuleh gunei gul ho nalhonat gamding ahi.
91.14: Yahweh Pakaiyin hitin ati, “keima eingailu ho kahuh hing ding ahi. Kamin a tahsan na nei ho chu kahoi dam ding ahi.
91.15: Amahon eihin kouteng uleh keiman kadonbut ding chuleh hahsatna ato tengu leh keiman kaumpi ding ahi, keiman amaho chu kahuhdoh a jabolna kachan sah ding ahi.
91.16: Keiman hinkho sotna kapehding chuleh kavenbit jingdiu ahi” ati.

92.1: Thangvah na Yahweh Pakai peh a, chung nungpen vah choi ding hi thil pha ahi.
92.2: Jingkah le nami ngailut na longlou sap phong a, nilhah le nakitah na sap phong hi thil pha ahi.
92.3: Tumging jangsom to tho a lyre gin ngai tah to tho dia pha tah ahi.
92.4: O Yahweh Pakai nei bol peh thil loupitah hochun kalung lai atong kha in, natohdoh ho jehchun keiman kipa la kasan ahi.
92.5: O Yahweh Pakai nanatohdoh hohi iti loupi hitam! nalunggel ngeito ho jong iti gil a gil jeng hitam.
92.6: Mihem mai mai het jou hoi ahipon, chih na a lhasam hon jong hedoh jou pouvin te.
92.7: Migilou hochu hamhing bangin khangtou'un tin, thilse bolho chu pungthei jong leu, tonsot a suhmanga umdiu ahi.
92.8: Hinla Yahweh Pakai, nangma vang, tonsot a dopsang a naum jing ding ahi.
92.9: Namel ma te jouse mangthah tei diu ahi; chule gitlou na bol jouse suh chat vai a um diu ahi.
92.10: Nangin keimahi bongchal bangin neihatdoh sahtan, chuleh nangin kipanan neimalsom tan ahi.
92.11: Kamit hin kagal mite lhuh amun; kana kol in jong eidou a migiloute gallel na thu ajai.
92.12: Michonphate chu chahthing bangin khangtou untin, Lebanon a Cedar thing banga hat tah khangtoudiu ahi.
92.13: Amahohi Yahweh Pakaiyinn a kehdoh thingphung likeh ahiuvin, iPathen'u Elohim angsung a khangtouva ahiuve,
