92.14: Teh nung jeng a jong ga aso nalai diu; chuleh phattin'a noujingleh hatjing diu ahi.
92.15: Amahon aphon doh uva hitia hi asei diu ahi, “Yahweh Pakai chu adih jingin! Amachu kasong pi ahi! Ama a chun set na aumpoi!”

93.1: Yahweh Pakai hi lengpa ahi! Ama loupi na in a kivon e. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai chu loupi na le hat nan akivon e. Leiset hi ading det in suh ling hoi ahipoi.
93.2: O Yahweh Pakai nalaltouna chu phat kisim masang a pat a umsa ahitai. Nangma jeng jong phat kipat masanga aumjingsa nahitai.
93.3: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglen akikhan tou e. Twisoh hi van gin abang tai; twisoh in gih tah in akinon sah e.
93.4: Hinlah twikhanglen kinong ging dem dum sang a nasa jo le, twipi pang a twinong kivoging sang in jong Yahweh Pakai thilbol thei na anasa joi.
93.5: Yahweh Pakai na Dan thu sem hohin kikhel tih anei poi. Navai hop na jong Yahweh Pakai, tonsot a theng jing jeng ding ahi.

94.1: O Yahweh Pakai, phulaji Elohim Pathen, O phula ji Elohim Pathen nathutanna dihtah chu loupitah chu hung kilang doh hen.
94.2: Hungthou doh in, vainoi thutan pa. Mi kiletsah hochu achanding dol u chansah in!
94.3: Miphalou hohi itih chanpi kipah diuham, ichan gei in em Yahweh Pakai?
94.4: Itih chan kiletsah tah a thu asei diu ham? Hiche migilou hohi itih chanpi kihatsah diu ham?
94.5: Yahweh Pakai amahon namite asuchip gamtauve. Nangma mite hohi amahon asugenthei'un ahi.
94.6: Amahon meithai hole gamdang mi chule chaga ho athat gam un ahi.
94.7: Amahon asei un, “Yahweh Pakaiyin eive pouve chule, Israel Elohim Pathenin anasah poi.”
94.8: Kigel pha kit un, mingol ho! Itihleh tahle nahin hethei diuvem?
94.9: Na nakol sempa chu a nangong ham? Namit sempau chu amitcho a ham?
94.10: Aman chitin namtinte ana engbol in ahi, nangjong na engbol louding ham? Aman imajouse ahesoh kei in ahi, nangin ipi naboljong ahetsohkei louding ham?
94.11: Yahweh Pakaiyin mitin lunggel ahesoh kei e, imacha phatchomna neilou ahi ahesoh kei e.
94.12: Yahweh Pakai, nadanthu a nahil hole nasuhdih ho chu iti kipah u hitam?
94.13: Migilou te kimat nading leiko tong akilai kah sen nangman amaho chu boina akon in lung ol na nape e.
94.14: Yahweh Pakaiyin amite nungsun ponte; Aman ami deitumte donlou in koi ponte.
94.15: Thutan na mun a thudih kimu ding chuleh michonpha ho jousen apanhu diu ahi.
94.16: Gitlou na akon a koiham eidal ding? Miphalou ho masang a ei din peh ding koi ham?
94.17: Yahweh Pakaiyin eina kithopi lou hile, keima thina lhankhuh mun a thipchet a ana kicholdo tading kahi.
94.18: “Keima kalhutai” tin kakap jah in, O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou chun eiphong dingin ahi.
94.19: Keima lungdon na a kadim teng, nami lungmon nachun kinep nale kipa na eipe ji e.
94.20: Dandih lou a natong lamkai ho chun Yahweh Pakai kalang a pangding hi ati ngam nadiu vem?
94.21: Themmo nabei ho dou din amaho akipun khom un mona neilou chungah thina chan in athepmo sah uve.
94.22: Ahin Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim hi kakisel na songpi kakulpi chu ahi.
94.23: Elohim Pathenin migiloute achonset nau chu ale thuh ding ahi. Achonset nau jeh a asuh gam ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai, iPathen uvin asuh gam ding u ahi.

95.1: Hungun, Yahweh Pakai vahchoiyu te! Eihuhdoh uva Elohim Pathen ah kipah tah'in vahchoila sau te!
95.2: Thangvah pum in a angsung jon u hite. Avahchoina la sau te.
95.3: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu loupitah Pathen Elohim ahin, pathen dang chung a leng loupi ahi.
95.4: Mollen penle leiset laigil athuhlai abon'a Aman akhut a atuhchah ahi.
95.5: Twikhanglen hi Ama a ahi, ajeh chu Ama sem ahi. Ama khut in leigo jonghi asem ahi.
95.6: Hungun, eisempau Yahweh Pakai angsungah dilsu-u hitin ama hou u te,
95.7: ajeh chu Ama iPathen'u ahin, eihohi aman achinjing amite ihiuvin akaihoijing akelngoihon ihiuve.
95.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin asei e, “Israelten gamthipnoi masah a abol bangu leh Meribah a alungtah bang bangun nalung tahsah hih'un.
95.9: Ajeh chu hilai munna chun napu napateuvin kathilbol ho chengse hi amu uvin chule eipatep'un ahi.
95.10: Kum somli sunga hin keima achung uva kana lunghang'in chuleh Keiman kasei in ahi, ‘amahohi keija kon a kinung heidoh mipi chu ahiuvin, keiman kasei dungjui a chon nomlou ahiuve.’
95.11: Hijeh chun kalunghan jehin kana kihahsel'in: ‘amahohi kachol ngahna munna hunglut theilou heldiu ahi!’”

96.1: Yahweh Pakai kom ah lathah sauvin! Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin!
96.2: Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin amin thangvah un. Ami huhhingna kipa umtah chu niseh'in samphongin.
96.3: Chitin namtin holah a athilbol kidangtah hohi samphong'in, Aman thil loupi tahtah abol hohi mijouse seipeh'un.
96.4: Yahweh Pakai hi aloupi e! Amahi vahchoi dinga lompen ahi! Amahi pathen jouse sanga kichat umpentah ahi.
96.5: Chidang namdang ho pathen hohi semthu pathen ngen ahiuve hinla Yahweh Pakai hin vanho asem ahi!
96.6: Gin na le jana-in aumkimvel ahi, thahatna le melhoina hin muntheng alosoh ahi.
96.7: O chitin namtin vannoi mite ho, Yahweh Pakai hethem un Yahweh Pakai ahat nale aloupina hohi hethem un.
96.8: Yahweh Pakai chu achan dinga lomtah loupi nale jana chan sah'un! Nathilpeh ding kichoiyin lang a-angsunga lut in.
96.9: Yahweh Pakai chu athenna loupina vah chutoh kitohin chibai boh'un. Vannoi leiset pumpi hi a-angsungah kithing jenghen.
96.10: Chitin namtin hi seipeh un, “Yahweh Pakaiyin vai ahom e!” Vannoi hi adingdetna ahitan holingbut ahitapon ahi.
96.11: Vanho kipah hen chuleh vannoi leiset kipah-u hen! Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen thangvah'un.
96.12: Loujao holeh asunga kehho jouse jong kipahtah in hung gadoh sohkei uhen, gammang sunga thingphungho jousen jong
96.13: Yahweh Pakai angsungah thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu Ama ahungtai! Leiset chungthu tan dingin ahunge. Aman vannoi mite le chitin namtinhi kitahna-a achungthu atanding ahi.

97.1: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Vannoi mite kipah hen! Twikhanglen akimvelle agamla penna um miho jong kipah uhen.
97.2: Amahi meilhang thim in atomin, chonphatna le thudih chu alaltouna khombul ahi.
97.3: Amasang ah meikong aleng'in akidoupi ho ahallih gamin ahi.
97.4: Akolphe vah in vannoi leiset asalvah'in ahi. Leiset in amun akithing thingin ahi.
97.5: Molle lhangjong Yahweh Pakai masanga khoilu bangin ajunlha jengin ahi. Leiset pumpi Yahweh Pakai masanga hitiahi thil soh-a ahi.
97.6: Vanhon adih nale akitahna aphongdoh'in namtin'in aloupina amu'uvin ahi.
97.7: Milim semthu doihou ho jouse, pannabei semthu pathen kiletsahpi hojouse jumle jachat athoh'un ahi, ajeh chu semthu pathen hojouse a-anga kun teidiu ahi.
97.8: Jerusalem in ajauvin akipah un chuleh Judah khopiho jouse jong athanom'un ahi. Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudih nahi.
97.9: Nangma hi O Yahweh Pakai vannoi leisetna athupipen nahin, semthu pathen ho jouse chunga dopsang'in naumin ahi.
97.10: Nangho Yahweh Pakai ngailuhon thilse nahot bollun ahi. Aman ami chonphate ahinkho-u ahuhdohjin ahi, chuleh miphalouho thaneina a konnin ahuhdohjin ahi.
97.11: Michonpha ho vah-in asalvah'in, chuleh milungdih ho akipah jiuvin ahi.
97.12: Koi hileh michonpha ho jouse kipah henlang amintheng chu thangvah'u hen!

98.1: Yahweh Pakai ah lathah sauvin, ajeh chu Aman thil kidangtah tah aboldoh tai. Aban jet in gal nasatah ajou tai; Aban thengin huhhingna thahat amusah e.
98.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin galjona aphongdoh tai, chuleh adihna leh akitahna chitin namtin lah a aphongjal tai.
98.3: Aman Israelte dinga ngailutna le kitahna nei a akitep nachu ageldoh'in ahi. Leiset kolmang gei in jong iPathen'u Elohim galjona hi amudoh tauve.
98.4: Leiset mihemten Yahweh Pakai ah kho sam'un; thangvahna bunglhauvin kipah tah'in thangvah la sauvin!
98.5: Tumging toh thon Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sauvin, tumging tothon langai chu sauvin.
98.6: Sumkon toh kelngoi ki gin kithong tohthon iPakai u Yahweh le ilengpau masanga chohjejun la sauvin.
98.7: Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen athangvahna samphongun! Leiset chunga hinna nei jousen jom un.
98.8: Vadung jousen kipah'in akhut beng uhen! Thinglhang gam jousen kipah'in la sauhen,
98.9: Yahweh Pakai masangah. Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu leiset chung thu tandinga hungding ahi. Vannoi hi thudih a athu atanding chitin namtin thuhi dihtah a atanding ahi.

99.1: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Chitin namtin kithing thingjeng hen! Ama Cherubim teni kikah a laltouna a atouvin ahi. Vannoi leiset pumpi kithing hen.
99.2: Yahweh Pakai chu Jerusalem ah loupitah'in atouvin ahi. Chitin namtin ho jouse chung vum a dopsang'in aum e.
99.3: Amahon namin gimneitah chu thangvah uhen, naminhi athenge!
99.4: Lengloupi thudih ngailua, nangin thildih hi nadomsang'in, thudih in kal nasong'in Israel lah-a thudih nachelhah sah'in ahi.
99.5: Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim hi dopsangin umhen! A-ang sungah bohkhup un, ajeh chu Amahi atheng ahi.
99.6: Mose le Aaron jongchu thempu ahilhon e, Samuel injong Amin anakouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai kom ah panpi ngaichan anakouvun ahi, chuleh Aman anahouvin ahi.
99.7: Aman meilom lah a kon in Israel ho lah-a thu anasei in, amahon Yahweh Pakaiyin apeh-u Dan le thupeh hochu anajui un ahi.
99.8: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen'u Elohim! nangin amaho nana donbut in ahi. Nangma hi amaho ding a mi ngaidam jing Elohim Pathen nahi, ahinla amaho achekhel teng uleh nagim boljin ahi.
99.9: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi domsang'un chuleh Jerusalem a moltheng achun chibai boh'un ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi atheng ahi.

100.1: Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai a kipana samphong'un,
100.2: kipah tah'in Yahweh Pakai chu chibai boh'un vahchoila sapum pumin a-angah hungun
100.3: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen ahi tin hettohna phongdohun, Aman eisem uva eiho Ama a ihiu ahi. Eiho Ama mite ihiu vin a-an a kivah akelngoite ihiuve.
100.4: Thangvah pum in akulpi sungah lut un, vahchoi pum in ainsungah lut in, Akom a kipa thu sei un, amin thangvah'un.
100.5: Yahweh Pakai phatna jehchun, ami ngailutna longlou hi tonsot in aumjinge, chuleh akitah nahi akhang khangin aumjinge

101.1: Yahweh Pakai keiman nami ngailutnale nathudihna lan sange. Keiman nangma thangvah nahi lan sange.
101.2: Keiman monabei hinkho kaman theina dingin chingthei tah in um inge, itihleh eipanpi dinga nahungding hitam? Keiman ka insungah kitahna hinkho kaman jingding ahi.
101.3: Keiman ipi hijongleh athenglou chuleh vet hoilou ho veponge. Thil adihlouva kitongho jouse kathet ahi, hichengse hitoh kaki timat louhel ding ahi.
101.4: Keiman dei umlou thil ho jouse hi kapaidoh sohkei ding thilgilou hojousea kon a kakidalse ding ahi.
101.5: Aheng akom aseiseho jouse kadeplou helding ahi. Keiman akiphatsei leh akiletsah ho kadeplou ding ahi.
101.6: Keiman tahsan um miho kaholdoh ding amaho chu kakivoppi ding ahi. Koi hileh oimothei hilou miho bouchu kakivoppi ding ahi.
101.7: Keiman milepche ho ka insunga kamanchah louding ahi.
101.8: Aniseh'a katohding chu mi jonchih ho deldohding chuleh khopi hi hitiho tobanga konna hoidoh sahding hi kakin ahi.

102.1: Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in! Ka ngeh nahi neisanpeh in.
102.2: Kei a kon in kiheimang hih'in, kahahsat phatleh khohsah tah'in neingaipeh in, kangaichat phatleh neihin gelkhoh in,
102.3: Ajeh chu kahinkho hi meikhu bangin abeipai jitai, kagu kachang hi asadohji tai.
102.4: Kalungsung hi anadohjin hamhing bangin agolha jitai, chutengle chun kagilkel jong abeipaiji tai.
102.5: Ajeh chu lunggim a kakhoisat sat jeh'in kavun le kagu hobou kahitai.
102.6: Keima neldi gam a sumbupi toh kabangtai, gamlatah gamthip gam a sumbupi noutoh kabangtai.
102.7: Keima kahah khovahjin, inting vumma vacha changkhat seh lunghel tah-a um kabange.
102.8: Kagal miten sun nilhum in eitaitom jingun, amahon eisamseuvin eitaitom jingun ahi.
102.9: Keima buneh jong vutvai jeng ahitai. Kadon na sunga jong kamitlhi alonglut tai.
102.10: Nalunghan na le nagimbol nachun eidom sang in eipaidoh tai.
102.11: Kahinkho hi nilhah lang nilep bangin achemang loijitai. Keima hampa bangin kagop lhaloi jitai.
102.12: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang nalaltouna a natoujing ding ahi. Naminthan na akhang khanga chelhajing ding ahi.
102.13: Nangma hung kipat in natin Jerusalem hi nahin khoto ding ahi. Tuahi nangnam na khohsah phat ahin, tuhi na kitepna dungjui a mi kithopi phat ahi.
102.14: Ajeh chu namiten bang'a song jouse angailu uvin chuleh lamlenna vutvai hojeng jong angaisang'un ahi.
102.15: Chujouteng leh chitin namtin ten Yahweh Pakai ang-a kithing thingding ahi,
102.16: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin Jerusalem ahin thahsem kitding chutengle Ama aloupina-a hung kilang ding,
102.17: Aman tahlelte taona ahin sanding Aman angaichat hou asanpehding ahi.
102.18: Khonunga khangthahho dinga kijihlut pehding hitiachu tua pengloulai hon Yahweh Pakai chu ahin thangvah dingu ahi.
102.19: Yahweh Pakaiyin van muntheng a kon a ahin vetsuh ding, Aman van a kon a leiset hi ahin vetsuh ding
102.20: songkul tangte khoisatna ajahding thidinga themmo kichanho alha doh dinga,
102.21: hiteng chuleh Yahweh Pakai minthanna chu Zion a lopna umding, chule Jerusalem a kithangvah ding ahi.
102.22: Mihonpi tamtah chu ahung ki khopkhom teng leh leng gam hojouse chu Yahweh Pakai chibai boh a hungdiu ahi.
102.23: Aman kaban thahat akim laitah avolhun kahinkho asuchomtai.
102.24: Hinla keiman Ama kakouvin, Oh Yahweh Pakai tonsot a hingjing kakhandon laitah ahin kahinkho lahih'in.
102.25: Kum tamtah achetai, nangin hiche leiset leibul nana lhungdoh'in, vanhohi nakhut tah'in nanasemdoh in,
102.26: hihojouse hung mangthah ding ahinlah nang tonsotna nahinjing ding ahi, amaho ponlui bangin hungvui lhantin, Nangin amaho chu von banga nakhelding chujouteng napai mangdiu ahi.
102.27: Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang abang chu nahijingin ahi.
102.28: Nangma mite chate jouse lungmong a umdiu ahi. Achate chateho chu na-anga hung khanglen diu ahi.

103.1: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thagvah ingkate. Kalungthim pumpin amintheng choian inge.
103.2: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate. Keidinga thilpha eibolpeh ho itihchan hijongleh sumil ponge.
103.3: Aman kachonsetna jouse angaidam tai, chuleh kadam mona hojouse le kahivei hojouse eiboldam pehtai.
103.4: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdohtai chuleh ngailutna leh khotona dimset in eiphungvuh tai.
103.5: Aman kahinkho hi thilpha dimset in eiphungvuh tai, Muvanlai bangin kakhandon hinkho akiledohsah tai!
103.6: Yahweh Pakaiyin chonphatna leh dihna chu suhgenthei a umte chu amusah ding ahi.
103.7: Aman ahina tahbeh chu Mose kom ah anatahlang'in chuleh anatoh hochu Israel mipite lah-a anaphongdoh'in ahi.
103.8: Yahweh Pakai hi mikhoto them tahleh mihepi themtah lunghang vahlou chuleh longlou ngailutna a dimset ahi.
103.9: Amahin phat tinnin eithepmosah pouvintin ahilouleh lunghang jingjeng ponte.
103.10: Aman ichonset nauva jong ei engbol pouvintin chuleh Aman eiho chanding dol hotbolna jong einei pouvinte.
103.11: Ama gingte chunga angailutna tanglou hi leiset chunga van asan banga hi sanga ahi.
103.12: Aman eiho chonset nahi, solam le lhumlam akigam lhat bangin gamlatah in atolmang tai.
103.13: Yahweh Pakai hi chapangte dinga apauva panga ahin, ama gingte dinga khoto them tahle ngailutna dimset ahijing e.
103.14: Ajeh chu Aman ihatmonau eihet thempeh'un chuleh eihohi vutvai tobang bou ihiu ageldoh jingin ahi.
103.15: Leiset chunga ihinkho hou jong hampa bangbep ahin, gam pahcha tobangin ipahdoh'un athi loikitji tai.
103.16: Hui ahung nung jin aitih a aumkhlou bang in bep in eimut mang ji taove.
103.17: Hinla Yahweh Pakai gingte din vang amingailutna nitin in aumjinge. Ami huhhing nanjong achate chateho gei in,
103.18: hitobanga aDan thua kitahna nei ho le, athupeh jui jing ho din aumpeh jing e.
103.19: Yahweh Pakaiyin vanmun hohi alaltouna in asemin; hichea kon in muntin chunga vai ahom e.
103.20: Nangho vantilte ho, nangho mithupitahte ho, ana tongdoh a pangho Yahweh Pakai hi thangvah un.
103.21: Ahi, nangho vantil sepaite ho alungdeilam boljinga Ama janlea pangjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
103.22: Asemsa ho jousen, chuleh alengam a umjousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un. Keima kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah jing ing kate.

104.1: Kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai thangvah inge. O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim, iti lom a nathupi hitam! Nangma, naloupina le nathupina toh nakivon e.
104.2: Nangman khovah chu ponsil bangin nakisil in, Nangin vanho ahin ahsi hohi pondal bangin nadahdoh in;
104.3: twimei chunga na iin natungdoh in, meilom chu sakol kangtalai in namangin, huihi nalhavingin namangin nalenglen ahi.
104.4: Huihi sottol len namangin, meile meikong jong nasoh'in namangin ahi.
104.5: Nangin, itihchan hijongleh kil ling louhel dingin nangman vannoi leiset bul naphutdoh tai.
104.6: Nangin twipi veihi leiset dingin ponsil in nasilpeh'in molsangho jong nachupsah soh hel in ahi.
104.7: Nangin thu napehleh twipi chu alengmang jingin, na ogin ajahleh ajammang hel jenge.
104.8: Mol ho adingdoh in phaicham atonglha jengin nangin nathupeh bang bangin akijam jengin ahi.
104.9: Chujouvin nangin twikhanglen hochu aphah nadiu chanbep naphahsah'in, hitiachu leiset hi avella achupkit louna diuvin nasemtoh tan ahi.
104.10: Nangin twisamho naphuldoh sah'in kotong dunga nalonlutsah'in, vachaho chu molle lhanga konnin ahung lengsuh'in,
104.11: ganhingho jouse dingin twi nasuhmang peh'in ahi, chuleh sangan honjong dangnou nan anei un ahi.
104.12: Vacha hon va pang dunga buh akisem un thingbah lah'a la asajiuvin ahi.
104.13: Nangin navan inmun a kon in molle lhang chunga go nahinjuhsah in chuteng nakhutsoh gachun leiset nasudimjin ahi.
104.14: Nangin hampa ho nakhandohsah in ganchaho, thingphungho le mihemho manchah pha nasodoh sah'in ahi. Chujongleh nangman leiset chunga amaho dingin nehpha nasodohsah'in ahi.
104.15: Akipana diuvin adondiu lengpitwi nagonpeh in atahsauva akinu diuvin Olive thao nasosah'in, chule athaneina diuva nehding changlhah napen ahi.
104.16: Yahweh Pakaiyin athingphung hohi phatah'in akhoukhah in, Lebanon ah Cedar thingphung ho akedohsah'in,
104.17: hichea chun vachaten abu-u akison un chuleh vakang ten Cypress thing chunga inn akise un ahi.
104.18: Molsang chungvum langa gamlah kelho achengun chuleh songpi hochu kollah saho dingin na phatah'in apangin ahi.
104.19: Nangin lha nasemmin kum kiheichin aphongdoh e, chule nisan alhumding phatjong akihetne.
104.20: Nangin janjong nasem in, jan ahunglhung jin ahi, gammang ganchaho anunkho jiuvin ahi.
104.21: Keipi nouhon amatdiu hochu angihjiuvin, Elohim Pathenin apeh'u amaho anchah hochu matdingin agemjiuvin ahi.
104.22: Jingpitah leh abusung uva kicholdo dingin anungche jiuvin ahi.
104.23: Hichejou tengle chun mipiho chu ama ama natohna dingcheh ajon un hicheachun nilhah gei in na atong ji tao ve.
104.24: O Yahweh Pakai nangin thilho hi jatchom chom in nasem jinge! Nachihna a hiche hohi nasemdoh ahije. Leiset hi nathilsemsa ho adimset e.
104.25: Hiti chun twikhanglen lentah leh kiphahjal tah nasem in, asunga ganhing achatthei alen aneo nasem in ahi.
104.26: Ven, kong inneiho akitol un, Leviathan jong twikhanglen'a kichem din nasem e.
104.27: Amaho jousen angaichat'u an amunadiu hi ngang chunga kingaicheh ahiuve.
104.28: Anehdiu nangin napehteng uleh amahon achomkhom jiuvin nangin nakhut a nalhangdoh in namop jin hiti chun amaho lungna chimset'in navah jin ahi.
104.29: Ahinla Nang, amahoa konna nakinunghei tengleh amaho kichadiu ahi. Nangin ahinna hu'u nalahdoh tengleh amaho thiding vutvai sohding ahitauve.
104.30: Nangin nahu napeh tengleh hinna nasemdohji a, hiteng chuleh leiset maihi akithahsem kitjin ahi.
104.31: Yahweh Pakai loupina hi tonsotnin umjing jenghen. Yahweh Pakaiyin athilsem jousea hin kipana aneiyin ahi.
104.32: Leiset hi avetleh akithing jengin molho jonghi akhoi khahleh meikhu alengdoh jengjin ahi.
104.33: Hinkho kanei laisen Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sange, kahai hu bei chan geijin jong ka Pathen Elohim thangvah ingkate.
104.34: Kalunggel ngaito jouse jonghi Ama lunglhaina hihen, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi kakipana ahi.
104.35: Hiche leisetna konhin michonsete jouse mangthah gam jengu hen, miphalou ho jouse mangthah jengu hen. Kahina ho jouse pummin Yahweh Pakai thangvah ingkate, Yahweh Pakai loupina ding hitahen!

105.1: Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu sei in aloupina samphong'un. Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen ipi abol ham heuhen,
105.2: Aheng a la sauvin; henge avahchoila saovin. Athilbol kidangho hi mijouse seipeh'un,
105.3: Amintheng hi domsang'un, nangho Yahweh Pakai chibai bohte jouse kipah'un,
105.4: Yahweh Pakai athahatna chu kholchil in phattin'in amachu hol'un,
105.5: datmo umtah tah atohdoh ho chuleh thilkidang abolho, athupeh eipeh hou,
105.6: nangho asoh Abraham chate ho, Jacob chilhah ho alhendoh sate ho, geldoh'un.
105.7: Amahi Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim ahin, Ama thudih nahi gamsung jousea akimudoh sohkeijin
105.8: Amahi akitepna itihchan hijongleh dingjing ahin, khang sangkhat dinga ana kipehdoh na,
105.9: Abraham toh anasem kitepna chuleh Issac kom a ana kihahselna,
105.10: Aman Jacob kom ah Dan khat apen anasuhdet in, chuleh Israel mipite dinga beithei lou kitepna ana sem in:
105.11: “Keiman Canaan gam kapehding nahi, nang dinga jatchombeh'a kapeh natouphadiu gamchu ahi” anati.
105.12: Aman hichehi hon lhomcha ahipet'uva, Canaan gama kholjin hon lhomcha ahipet uva anasei ahi.
105.13: Amaho namkhat a kon a namkhat, leng gam khatna konna leng gam khat a akholjin pet'uva asei ahi.
105.14: Aman koimacha anasuh genthei sahpon ahi. Aman amaho huhnan namdang lengho chu anagih'in ahi.
105.15: “Kami lhentum hochu tongkha hih'un, chuleh kathemgao hojong tongkhahih'un,” anati.
105.16: Aman nehle chah hochu akhahtan'in Canaan gamah kel analhahsah'in ahi,
105.17: hiti chun amaho masanga Egypt gammachun mikhat anasol masan ahi, amaho soh a anajoh Joseph chu ahi.
105.18: Amachu akengphang tenia thihkhao avouvin, angongchang'a thihkol a-opeh uve.
105.19: Amang lolhinna dinga thil ahung sodoh tokah'in Yahweh Pakaiyin Joseph chu ahina tahbeh hetdohna dingin ana patepmin ahi.
105.20: Hichejou chun Pharoah'in amachu agakousah'in alhadohtai; Gamsung vaipopan songkul kotchu ahonpeh tai.
105.21: Joseph chu lengpa insunga thil jouse chunga vaihom dingin apansahtan ahi. Hiti chun lengpa thil ho jouse chungah vaipon ahung pangtai.
105.22: Hiti chun aman adei bang tah in lengpa noi a vaihom pipuiho chu avaihop in chule lengpa thumop lea pang ho chu ahil ji tai.
105.23: Hi jouchun Israel chu Egypt gam alhungtan, Jacob chu Ham gamsunga chun gamchom mi hinan ana chengtan ahi.
105.24: Yahweh Pakaiyin Israel mipite chu hapun'in apunsah tan hiti chun agalmite diuvin kichat aumleu tauvin ahi.
105.25: Hichun Egypt te chu Israelte vetda dingin atildoh tan hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai mite dounan tohgon aneitauvin ahi.
105.26: Ahin Elohim Pathen nin asoh Mose chu ahinsol'in aman ana lhendoh Aaron chutoh asolthan ahi.
105.27: Amanin Egypt mite dounan melchihna kidangtah chuleh datmo umtah tah Ham gamsunga anatongdoh lhonnin ahi.
105.28: Yahweh Pakaiyin Egypt chu mu anathimsah tan ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Yahweh Pakai thupeh Israelte soldoh dingchu ananom pouvin ahi.
105.29: Aman twi thisan anasosah'in, ngaho dingin thina thei gu ahitan ahi.
105.30: Uphoh honjong agamsung'u alonvuh jengin lengpa lupna dansang jenga jong alhailut jengun ahi.
105.31: Yahweh Pakaiyin thu aseileh thousiho Egypt mite chunga ahung chu'uvin, Egypt gam pumpi thousi vaibong'in alo jengin ahi.
105.32: Aman go khel in gel anajuhsah'in, keh in agamsung'u anasepchap jengin ahi.
105.33: Aman alengpithei uleh atheichang ujong asuhmangpeh'in athingphung houjong asatchap jengin ahi.
105.34: Aman thu aseileh khaokhote ahung kitollutnun khaokho noute jong simsenlou ahung kitollut tauvin ahi.
105.35: Amahon gamsunga ado eng jouse anechai jengun, loulai a anche louhing jouse jong achaidoh jengun ahi.
105.36: Hiche jouchun Aman Egypt te insung jousea chapa tahpen ho aban thapeh'in ahi. Hiti chun aki letsah pipen ule aki panapen hou asuhbei peh'in ahi.
105.37: Yahweh Pakaiyin amite chu sana le dangka dimset pum in Egypt'a kon in ahin puidoh'in, Israel phungho lah'a khat chajong akipallhua aumpouvin ahi.
105.38: Egypt miten nana kichat behseh jeh'un apotdoh uchu ana kipapi lheh jengun ahi.
105.39: Yahweh Pakaiyin sunleh meilom akhu khum sah'in janleh meikong in asalvah peh'in ahi.
105.40: Amahon sa athum uleh vamim alhalutpeh'in a-oivana diuvin van changlhah mama chu anapen ahi.
105.41: Aman songpi chu ahomsah'in twi ahung kiphidoh sah'in gamchai lah'a vadung bangin alondonsah'un ahi.
105.42: Ajeh chu Aman asohpa Abraham kom a akitepna atheng chu ageldoh'in,
105.43: hijeh chun amite Egypt'a kon in amilhendoh chu kipah tah'in ahin puidoh'in ahi.
105.44: Aman gamsung mite Elohim Pathen helou chitin namtinte chenna chu alahpeh'in Ama mite hochu apen, hiti chun amahon mi tusa chang ga hochu aki-at'un ahi.
105.45: Hitiho jouse anachelhah sahchu amahon a Dan thupeh leh athuhil ho dungjui a achon nadiu adeijeh ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

106.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Elohim Pathen chu aphatna jeh'in thangvahna peuvin.
106.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin thil loupi kidangtah atohdoh hohi kon asim jou ding ham? Kon Amahi ahina bangtah'in athangvah joudem?
106.3: Mi ahina bangtah a pachatna pethei holeh phat tin a adih jeng bol hon kipana aneithei jengun ahi.
106.4: Yahweh Pakai nangin namite khotona namusah tengleh neihin geldoh'in lang neihin nai in neihuhdoh'in.
106.5: Nalhendoh namite phatthei naboh nahoa keijong chan neineisah'in. Namite kipana a keijong neikipa sah'in. Nagou chang toh nangma thangvah khom kanom e.
106.6: Kapu kapateu bangin keiho jong kachonse tauve, keihon kabolkhel tauve, keiho phaloutah'in kanachon tauve,
106.7: Egypt gam a ana um kapu kapateu chu Yahweh Pakaiyin thil kidang aboldoh ho chun atilkhou pouve. Amahon adinguva Yahweh Pakai phatna hochu ana sumil loiji tauve. Amahon twikhanglen san mun nachun Yahweh Pakai dounan ahung phunchel tauvin ahi.
106.8: Achuti jeng vangun, Amin loupe dopsangna dingleh athaneina thupitah chu akilandohna dingin amaho chu ana huhdoh thouthou jin ahi.
106.9: Aman twikhanglen sanchu akan-na dingin thu apen, Aman twikhanglen chu neldigam abahsah'in Israelte chu ahinpui galkai in ahi.
106.10: Hiti chun agalmiteuva kon in anahuhdoh jin, chuleh akidoupihoa kon in ana hoidohsah'in ahi.
106.11: Twichu akinung ledoh sah'in agalmiteu akhukhum jin khatcha jong anahingdoh pouvin ahi.
106.12: Hitengle chun amiten akitepna chu atahsan jiuvin Ama vahchoina la chu asajiuvin ahi.
106.13: Ahinla Yahweh Pakaiyin abolpeh houchu gangtah'in asumilji tauvin, Ama thuhil angahji pouvin ahi.
106.14: Gamthip noi achun amaho tahsa ngaichat thilngen anathum'un hiche gamchai lah'a chun Elohim Pathen chu anapatep'un,
106.15: hijeh chun Aman angaichat'u chu anapen ahinlah nat na toh apehthan ahi.
106.16: Camp sunga umhochu Mose chungah athangthipmun chuleh Yahweh Pakai thempu theng Aaron a-ot'un ahi.
106.17: Hichejeh chun leiset chu ahung kamkan, Dathan, Abiram leh akiphinho jouse chu anavallhum'in avuimangtan ahi.
106.18: Anungjui ho chungah meikong achun miphalou ho jouse chu meikong'in ahalgam tan ahi.
106.19: Sinai mol'a sana a kisem bongnou chu chibai aboh'un,
106.20: Loupitah Elohim Pathen chu hampane bonglim toh analheh tauve.
106.21: Amahon ahuhingpau, Egypt gamma konna ahinpuidoh pau,
106.22: Ham gam sunga thil kidang tamtah ahin boldohpeh pau, twikhanglen san na gimneitah thil ana tongdohpa a Pathen'u Elohim chu anasumil tauvin ahi.
106.23: Hijeh chun Aman kasuhmang ding ahi tin anaphongdoh tan ahi. Ahinlah Mose, lhendoh mipa chu Yahweh Pakai leh amipite kikah'a anadingtan, aman Yahweh Pakai kommachun alunghanna'a konna kile heija amipite chu asuhmang louna dingin ataotai.
106.24: Mipite chu gam nom lutding chu ana nom tapouvin ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathenin ana kitepna banga apuihoi dingchu ana nom tapouvin ahi.
106.25: Ajeh chu akaleh langin achon un, aponbuh sung uvah ana phunchel gam un, Yahweh Pakai thu anangainom pouvin,
106.26: hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai chu lunghemtah'in ana kihahsel'in amahohi hiche gamthip noi a kathagam ding ahiuve anatitai.
106.27: Chutengleh ason apahteu chu chitin namtin lah'a kathejal sohding, chuleh gamla tah tah'a kaimang'a umdiu ahi ati.
106.28: Hiti chun, ipu apateu chu Baal leh Peor chibai bohna a anapang'un, mithi dinga kitodoh sa jengjong ananeuvin ahi.
106.29: Hitiho jehhin amahon Yahweh Pakai chu ana sulang hangun hijeh chun alah uva natset analangtan ahi.
106.30: Ahinla Phenehas kitipa chun hangsantah'in nat se chu ana tingtan'in ahileh natset chu atangtai.
106.31: Hijeh chun hichea patchun michonpha tin jana anapetauvin ahi.
106.32: Meribah-a jong Yahweh Pakai chu ana lunghansah'un hichun Mose chu anasuboi lheh'in ahi.
106.33: Amahon Mose chu analunghan sah'un ahileh aman ngolkaitah'in thu anaseilo tan ahi
106.34: Israelten chidang namdang hochu Yahweh Pakaiyin thu anapeh dungjui in anasohjou pouvin,
106.35: hichu hilouvin agamsung mite lah'a chun ana chenghal un achonnao phaloutah hochu ana joptauvin,
106.36: amilim doi houvu chu anahou un hichun alhuhnao asodohsahtan ahi.
106.37: Amahon achateu kisan chu anatodoh'un chuleh achanuteu jengjong thillha hounan anapedoh'un,
106.38: amahon themmona neilou thisan anasouvin, achapateu leh achanuteu thisan chu Canaan mite doi hounan anamang'un tolthanan gamsung chu anasuboh'un,
106.39: amahole amaho jong thilgilou bolnan anakisuboh'un adoihou thanopnau chu Yahweh Pakai mitmun jonthanhoi ana hidohtan ahi.
106.40: Hichejeh chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna chu amite chungah anakoudoh jengin ahileh Yahweh Pakaiyin ama-a tum hochu ana kidah lotan ahi.
106.41: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakaiyin amaho chu agamsung nammite lah'a chun ana pedoh'in chuleh athet nammiteu chun amaho chungah vai anahomji tauvin ahi.
106.42: Agalmi houchun asugep jiuvin chuleh abolgimnao khut thahatna noi a anakoiji tauvin ahi.
106.43: Avel vellin Aman ahuhdohjin, ahinlah amahon Ama dounan akipedohji tauvin ahi, chutengleh amaho chu achonset jeh'un suhmangin aumji tauvin ahi.
106.44: Ahijeng vangin ahahsat tenguleh Aman akhotokit jiuvin akanao angaipeh kitjitan ahi.
106.45: Aman amaho toh akitepnao ahin geldoh kitji in angailutna chultheilou jeh in alung ahinhei kitji in,
106.46: Aman ganhing a amanteu khutnah khotona amusah kitji nalaijin ahi.
106.47: O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen'u Elohim neihuhdoh'un! Chitin namtin lah'a konhin neichomkhom kitnun hitiachu namintheng kathangvah theina diuvin chuleh kipah a nangma kathangvah theina diuvin.
106.48: Israel Pathen Elohim, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un, Amahi tonsot'a pat tonsot geija hingjing Elohim Pathen ahi! Mi jousen “Amen” tiuhen. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

107.1: Yahweh Pakai hi aphatjeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah hi tonsot'a dettou jing ahi.
107.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin nalhatdoh hitam? Achutileh phongdoh'in! Aman namelma holah'a kon a nahoidohsahhi miho seipeh'in.
107.3: Ajeh chu Aman gam tamtah a kon in solamle lhumlam'a kon in, sahlam le lhanglam a kon in sohchangho ahin puikhom'in ahi.
107.4: Miloi khat hi gamthip gam mah avah mang'un, in le lou beijin avah mang'un,
107.5: Gilkil leh dangchah geovin a thiding konchan aum mun,
107.6: “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” tin ahahsat nauva Pakai Yahweh akouvun, chuteng Aman agenthei nauva konnin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
107.7: Aman amaho chu bitkei chan apuijin achenna theiju khopi khatna akoiyin ahi.
107.8: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupi tah jehleh thil kidang tahtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
107.9: Ajeh chu Aman adangchah ho adangnou sah'in, agilkil'ho thilpha tamtah tothon a-oiva sahjin ahi.
107.10: Miloikhat muthim lah athimlah pen a atouvin, lung gimna thihkhao vin ahen oh'in ahi.
107.11: Amaho Elohim Pathen thu dounan akiphin un, Elohim Pathen thumop chu anelpeh'un ahi.
107.12: Hijeh chun Aman amaho chu akhut hamtah in avo lhun, amaho alhuh phatnun koima akithopidiu aumpon ahi.
107.13: Ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” atiuve. Hitengle chun Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
107.14: Aman amaho chu muthimleh ahahsatnau thimjin banga thimlah a kon in apui galkaijin akihennao asutlhappeh'in ahi.
107.15: Yahweh Pakai chu ami ngailutna thupitah jehleh thil kidangtah tah abolpeh jeh'in thangvah uhen,
107.16: ajeh chu Aman sum-eng songkul kotpi avohlhahpeh'in chuleh akihennao thihkhao avohtan pehtan ahi.
107.17: Mingol themkhat chun boina asemuvin achonset jeh'un thohgimna atoh'un ahi.
107.18: An le twi ngaichatnan athohlel lheh'un hiti chun amaho chu athiding kon ahiuve.
107.19: “Yahweh Pakai neikithopin” tin ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
107.20: Aman thu changkhat agahseijin aboldamjin, thina kotbul a kon in aloidohtan ahi.
107.21: Ami lungsetna thupi tah jehleh amaho dinga thil kidang tamtah anabolpeh jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen.
107.22: Kilhaina gantha pummin thangvahna peuhen, chuleh athilbol kidangtah ho jeh'in thangvahna peuhen.
107.23: Mi phabep chu kong innei mangchan twikhanglen'ah vannoi leiset kiveina lampi ajot un akitollun ahi.
107.24: Amaho jonghin twikhanglen athuhlang tah'a Yahweh Pakai thuneitah'a anatoh naleh thil thupi tahtah abolna ho amu'vin ahi.
107.25: Aman thu aseijin hui ahungnung doh'in twikhanglen ahin kinongsah'in ahi.
107.26: Kong innei hochu vanlanga anuh touvin chule twi thuhlah'a ahung kilehlut kitjin kongtol hochu kichatnan akileh leuvin ahi.
107.27: Amaho jukham ho bangin a-onle leuvin kichat tijat nan adim'un ahi.
107.28: “Yahweh Pakai neihuh'un” tin ahahsat phatnun Yahweh Pakai akouvun, Amanjong agimnauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
107.29: A-o neochakhat'in hui le guo kithochu athipsah'in chuleh twi kinong jong asutang'in ahi.
107.30: Hiche athip theina chu ichan gei a pha a phatthei bohna hitam? Kongchu kong mun'ah bitkeichan apuilut in ahi.
107.31: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupitah jehleh thilkidang tamtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
107.32: Nam lamkaiho masangleh, mipi kikhomho masangah japi hetthei doltah'in thangvahna peuhen.
107.33: Aman vadung jong neldigam aso sahjin, twisam putna munho jong gamgo leh adang chahna aso sahjin ahi.
107.34: Aman ga phatah sona gam phatah jong ima sodoh louna chitwi-al gamgo asosah thei in ahi, agam sunga cheng mipite phatmo jeh'a hitiachu abolji ahi.
107.35: Ahinlah Aman neldigam chu twikul asosah'in, chuleh gamgo jong twi putna mun aso sahjin ahi.
107.36: Aman gilkel dangchah techu khopi semdoh dinga hiche mun a chu achensah ding ahi.
107.37: Amahon aloulai uva muchi kitheuvin tin lengpigui tu uvintin ga lhingsetna akilodiu ahi.
107.38: Aman ichan gei a phatthei aboh hitam? Amahon insungmi tamtah atungdoh'un chuleh aganchahou ninglhingset ding ahi.
107.39: Ijemtia bolgentheina jalle, boina le hahsatna jalla umho mihem a akemsuh uva avaichat phatnuleh,
107.40: Yahweh Pakaiyin alengteu hinpaidoh intin amaho gamgo laija pannabei in umsah leleu vintin,
107.41: hinla Yahweh Pakaiyin mivaichaho ahahsat nauva kon in kelngoihon phatah bangin ainsunga hinpunsah intin,
107.42: Miphahon hiche thilsoh hohi hinveu vintin kipahdiu ahinla miphalou hochu suhthipma umdiu ahi.
107.43: Michingho jousen hitia thilsoh hohi lunggiltah'in hinheu vintin, amahon hitobang ikhankhouva kon a hi Yahweh Pakai mingailutna dihtah chu ahin mudohdiu ahi.

108.1: O Pathen Elohim kalungthim hi nang ah akinem jinge, ahijeh chun kalungthim pumpia nangma thangvah la kasha theihi datmo ding ahipoi.
108.2: Hungthouvin, katheile leh kasemjang, jingpi ihmuhi kavahchoilan sukhang'ing kate.
108.3: O Yahweh Pakai mitinlah'a hin nangma hin thangvah ingkate. Keiman chitin namtin lah a hin nangma vahchoila sange.
108.4: Nami ngailutna longlouhi vanho sangin asangjon ahi. Nakitahna hin meilomlah ho aphan ahi.
108.5: O Elohim Pathen vanho lah'a asangpen sangin namin hi dopsangin umjo hen. Naloupina leiset pumpi chung vumma hin vahdoh hen.
108.6: Tuhin name ngailut tehi huhdoh tan. Naban thahatnan neidonbutnun lang neihuhdoh tauvin,
108.7: Elohim Pathen'in athenna a chu hichehi akitepna ahi. “Keiman kipahtah a Sechemhi kabokhen ding, Keiman Succoth phaicham hi katetoh ding ahi.
108.8: Gilead hi kei a ahin, Manasseh jong kei a ahi, Ephraim kathih lukhuh ahin, ama a kon a hi kagalsat dingho hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Judah hi kaleng tenggol ahin ama a kon a hi kalengte hung kondoh diu ahi.
108.9: Hinla Moab hi kakeng silna kong ahin ama a kon a hi kasohte hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Keiman Edom chunga hi kakeng kasilding ahi. Philistia chunga galjona kasapkhum ding ahi.”
108.10: Koipenham kulpi kikaikhum khopi sunga eipuilut ding ah? Koiham Edom chunga galjona a eipuilut ding ah?
108.11: O Elohim Pathen nangin neipaidoh hitam? Nangin kasepaite toh galsat'a nakonkhom louding hitam?
108.12: O Yahweh Pakai kagalmite toh kidouna a hi neipanhu louding hitam, ajeh chu mihem kithopina hi aphachom aumpoi.
108.13: Elohim Pathen toh pankhom hi thil loupi tahtah tohdoh theina ahi, ajeh chu Aman eikidoupi ho chu akengtoa alhopha ding ahi.

109.1: O Elohim Pathen koiham kathangvah ding, kei a kon in thipbeh leh gamla tah in umdan lang,
109.2: miphalouten eihousetna thujou eiseikhum teng u jong le thipbeh in umdan.
109.3: Thet umtah thucheng ho pum in eiumkim vel un, ajeh beihel'in eikisat piuvin ahi.
109.4: Keiman amaho hi kangailui amaho dinga kataolai hin amahon thepmosah teiding leh suhmang dingin eigong jingun ahi.
109.5: Amahon thilpha kabol ho thilse jengin eilethuh'un, kangailutna hi vetda nan eithuh'un ahi.
109.6: Amahon asei un, “Ama doudin miphalou khat hintungdoh un, achungthu kitan theina dinga athepmo sahding hinsol'un” atiuve.
109.7: Achungthu akitan teng amahi thepmosah uhitin, ataona chu chonsetnin simmu hite,
109.8: Akum lhomsah uhite, michomkhat ama munna dinsah'u hite,
109.9: achate paneilou hisah uhitin aji meithai hisah'u hite,
109.10: achate khutdo a moh vahlele hiu henlang, inn gem in vah mang jeng uhen.
109.11: Bat le tham houvin a in alou chuleh anei agou kichom u hen, kholgam mihon asum lodoh jouse lahpeh uhen,
109.12: koimachan lungset dauhen; koimachan paneilouva um achate chu khoto dauhen.
109.13: Ason apah jouse thisoh hen. A inn sung pumpiu min jong akhang cheh a din lah doh in um mai hen.
109.14: Yahweh Pakaiyin apateu chonsetna ngaidam hihbeh hen, anu-u chonsetna jong lekhabua kon in kikahdoh hihbeh hen,
109.15: Yahweh Pakaiyin achonsetnau geldoh jinghen, chuleh aminjong mihemten geldoh hihbeh hen.
109.16: Ajeh chu mi koima ngailut aneipoi, aman mivaichaho leh tahlelte abol genthei e, chuleh lung gentheite thina a adellut e.
109.17: Ama mi samset athanom in; tun nang ama sugoi tan. Aman midang phatthei aboh khapoi; tun nangman ama jong phatthei boh hih in.
109.18: Mi sapset hi amadinga aponsil, atwidon, abuneh tobang a angaito ahitai.
109.19: Tun amisapsetna chu hung kile henlang ama chunga pon bangin behdoh henlang angonga kong gah bangin kikhit chah hen,
109.20: Tun hiche sapsetna hochu eiseise hole eidem demho chungah Yahweh Pakai engbolna chujohen.
109.21: Hinla O thaneipen Yahweh Pakai neidin pi in, nangma min khoto najal chun! Neihuh doh in ajeh chu nangma hi chutobangtah a pha le kitah nahi.
109.22: Ajeh chu keimahi mivaicha le tahlel tah kahin kalungthim hi ana behseh jenge.
109.23: Nilhah langa nisa lim achemang bang a mangthah ding kahi, min khaokhopi apaidoh banga eikipaidoh ahitai,
109.24: Ka ann ngol na-a kon in kakengpah ho kisan atha aumtapon kavunleh kagu keubou kahitai.
109.25: Keima hi muntin a mi totnopna bep kahitan amahon eimu tenguleh noisena'in alu-u eiheikhum jiuvin ahi.
109.26: Nei kithopin O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihuhdoh'in.
109.27: Yahweh Pakai nangin ka chung ahi nangma natoh mong ahiti ahetchet nadiuvin musah'in.
109.28: Hiteng chuleh amahon eisapset nom u jongleh eisamseuhen ajeh chu nangman phatthei neiboh ding ahinai. Amahon eihin delkhum tenguleh jumna akimudiu ahi. Ahinla nasoh keimavang kipah a kagalkai ding ahi.
109.29: Eitaitom jingho vang jumna ponbanga akikhu khumdiu ahin, suhnem a aum nao chun ponbanga atomkhudiu ahi.
109.30: Ahinla kenvang Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu kasei jingding mijouse kom a kasei choile ding ahi.
109.31: Ajeh chu Aman tahlelte adinpi jingin suhmang ding gohoa kon in ahuhdoh jingin ahi.

110.1: Yahweh Pakaiyin ka leng pakai kom ah, “nagal mite kasuhnem a, nakengtoa kachotpha sah tokahsen kakhut jetlam naloupina mun tou jengin” ati.
110.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin naleng gam thaneitah chu Jerusalem a kon a ahin lhundoh ding, nangin nagalmite chunga vai na homding ahi.
110.3: Galsat'a nacheteng namiten thanomtah'a najuidiu ahi, nangma vonthenga nakivon ding chutengleh jingkah daitwi banga nisehleh natha kidodoh jingding ahi.
110.4: Yahweh Pakaiyin kihahselna anei ahin akitepna chu asuhkeh louding ahi. “Nangma Melchizedek hina banga tonsot thempu nahiding ahi” ati.
110.5: Yahweh Pakai chu najet langa dinga napuihoi jing ahi. Ama alunghanna ahung koudoh leh lengle lalho tamtah asuhlhuh ding ahi.
110.6: Aman chitin namtin ajepding agamsunga thilong dimset ding, aman leiset pumpia lengle lalte aban vohlhuh ding ahi.
110.7: Ahinlah amavang lampi pang dunga long twi adon a hatdoh jingding ahi. Hitiachu amahi galjoupa hijengding ahi.

111.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Michonpha hotoh kikhop khomna chan ah keiman kalungthim apumpin Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate.
111.2: Yahweh Pakai natoh hi iti kidan a hitam! Koi hileh ama a lunglhaina neijousen giltah a agel angaije.
111.3: Athilbol ho jouse hin aloupina leh aja ngaina aphongdoh'in ahi. Athu adih nahi athon ngaipon ahi.
111.4: IYahweh Pakaiju mi ngailutna le amikhotona hi iti kidan hitam tihi aman eigeldoh sahjiuvin ahi.
111.5: Aman akitepna hi ageldoh jingin ama gingte chu nehle chah apejingin ahi.
111.6: Aman amite chu chidang namdangho gam alahpeh a amaho apeh achun athaneina thupitah chu akilandoh sah'in ahi.
111.7: Athilbol ho jouse hi adih'in aphan ahi, chuleh athupeh ho jouse hi tahsan theicheh ahi.
111.8: Hicheho hi tonsotna dihjing jeng ahin tahsan tahleh kitahna neitah a juiding ahi.
111.9: Aman amite Manchu lhingsetna anapeh ahitai. Aman a mite toh akitepna chu tonsotna dinga asuhdet ahi. O ichan geija gimnei leh minthang hitam!
111.10: Yahweh Pakai ginhi chihna dihtah kiphudohna khombul ahi. Athupeh hoitah a nit ho dingin chihna a khangtou cheh chehding ahi. Atonsotnin thangvah'in umjing tahen.

112.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai ginna neija athupeh ho lunglhai tah'a juiho dinga iti kipa um a hitam.
112.2: Achaten muntin a lolhinna aneiding ahi. Khangkhat lhingset a mipha ngen hina phatthei changdiu ahi.
112.3: Amaho hung haodoh ding ahiuve chuleh athilpha bol u umjing jingding ahi.
112.4: Michonpha ho dingin jan jengjong avah'in ahi. Amahohi ahongphal un, khotona aneiyun chuleh thudih achepiuvin ahi.
112.5: Hongphal tah a sumpa hom hole thengtah'a akiveina chepiho phatthei changdiu ahi.
112.6: Hitobang miho chu thilsen asuhmo joulou ding ahi. Mikitah hohi min asumil theipon ahi.
112.7: Amahohin thuse hung kithangho jengjong akichapon amahon Yahweh Pakaiyin ahoibit diuvin tahsan na dettah aneiyun ahi.
112.8: Amahohin tahsanna dettah aneiyun kichatna aneipouvin ahi, chuleh akidoupi hojeng jong joteiding tahsan nan akimai topiuvin ahi.
112.9: Hitobang hohin panpi ngaichaho hongphal tah'in apeuvin kiphaltah'in mitoh chan aching khomji nom un ahi. Atohphat nahou geldoh'in aumjingin ahi. Amahohin mi thujona leh jana achang'un ahi.
112.10: Milungdihlou hon hichehi mu uvintin alung hanpi diu ahi. Amahon lunghang tah'in aha gel unte, chuleh akinepnau thonjeh'in jumthet in kilapdoh tauvin te.

113.1: Yahweh Pakai thangvah'in umhen! Yahweh Pakai sohte ho thangvahna peuvin, Yahweh Pakai minchu choian un!
113.2: Yahweh Pakai minchu nunnom hen, tuleh tonsot gei a dingin.
113.3: Muntin a solam le lhanglam a kon in Yahweh Pakai minchu choiat in umhen.
113.4: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi chitin namtin jouse sangin asangjon aloupina hi vanho jouse sangin jong asangjon ahi.
113.5: Koi hintem Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim toh tekahpi thei chu, Amahi choisanga alaltouna a touva ahi.
113.6: Aman kisunemtah'in van leh leiset ahinven ahi.
113.7: Aman mivaichate vutvai lah'a kon in aphongdingin chuleh tahlelte munnom pen a kon in akaidingin,
113.8: leng chate toh atoukhomsah'in Ama mite leng chapate jengto jong atoukhomsah'in ahi.
113.9: Aman chaneilou numeiho cha le nao apen minu nomsatah in asemdohjin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

114.1: Israelte Egyptma kon a ajamdoh jouvun, Jacob insung miten hiche midangho gamchu adalhah phatnun
114.2: Judah gamchu Elohim Pathen muntheng a sohdoh tan Israel chu aleng gam asoh doh tan ahi.
114.3: Twikhanglen san chun ahungu amun ajam mangtan Jordan vadunga twi hojong ana kiheimang'in,
114.4: Mol ho jong kelngoichal ho bangin akichom un thinglhang hochu kelngoinou bangin akichom leuvin ahi.
114.5: Twikhanglen san ipibol a na lhaimang loijeng ham? Jordan vadung ipibol a na lhaimang jengham?
114.6: Mol ho nangho ipidinga kelngoichal banga nakichop uham? Thinglhang ho ipi dinga kelngoinou banga nakichop uham?
114.7: O leiset, Yahweh Pakai angsung'leh Jacob Elohim Pathen masangah kithing thingin um in.
114.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin songpi chu twi veina twikul asosah'in, songpi tahbetna kon in twisam alondoh sahjin ahi.

115.1: Keiho a ahipoi, O Yahweh Pakai keiho a ahipoi, amavang loupina jouse hi namingailut na longlou jeh a chun nang ding jingbou ahi.
115.2: Chitin namtin hohin a Pathen'u Elohim hoi a umham tia aseidingu ham?
115.3: Ka Pathen'u Elohim hi vanho chunga aum in thil adeidan dana abolji ahi.
115.4: Amaho semthu doihon vang sana le dangka a kisem ngenchang bou ahiuvin mihem khut in asemthu jeng ahiuve.
115.5: Amahon kam anei un ahinla apaotheipon, chuleh mit anei un kho amuthei pouvin,
115.6: kol aneiyun ajathei pouvin, nahkui anei un anahthei pouvin,
115.7: khut anei un ima tohnan amangthei pouvin chuleh keng anei un achele theipouvin, lolhom anei un ahin thucheng ahungdoh theipon ahi.
115.8: Hitiachu doilim semthu hohi hiche tobang ahiuve, hicheho tahsan hojong hitobang machu ahiuve.
115.9: O Israel Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanhu na lum a pang ahi.
115.10: O thempuho Aaron ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amahi napanpia leh na lumdel a pang'a ahi.
115.11: Nangho Yahweh Pakai gingjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanpi le nalumdal ahi.
115.12: Yahweh Pakaiyin nahin geldoh jingin phatthei nabohjing ding ahi. Aman Israel mipite hi phatthei aboh ding ahi, chuleh thempuho le Aaron chilhah ho jong phatthei aboh ding ahi.
115.13: Mithupi hihenlang milham hijongleh Yahweh Pakai ging hochu Aman phatthei aboh ding ahi.
115.14: Yahweh Pakaiyin nangma nahin nachate ahin phattheina lhingset in napehen,
115.15: Van le lei sem a Yahweh Pakai chun phatthei naboh hen,
115.16: Vanhohi Yahweh Pakai a ahin, leiset vanghi mihemte apeh ahi.
115.17: Mithin Yahweh Pakai thangvah la asatheipoi, ajeh chu amaho chu lhan munthip gam a che ahiuve.
115.18: Ahinlah eihon tu le tonsot geija Yahweh Pakai ithangvah theiju ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

116.1: Yahweh Pakaiyin ka o eingai peh eikhoto dia katao na eisan peh jeh in keiman Yahweh Pakai kangailui.
116.2: Aman eihin ang ngat a kataona eingaipeh'in kahaithei laisea keima katao jing jingding ahi.
116.3: Thinan apon in eihin tomkhum e; lhankhuh gimneitah chun eihin lonvuh e. Keiman lungkhamna leh lunggimna ngen kamu e.
116.4: hiteng chuleh keiman Yahweh Pakai min kakoujin, “Yahweh Pakai lungset'in neihuhdoh'in!” katijin ahi.
116.5: Yahweh Pakai hi itobang tah'a milungsetthem hitam! Chuleh itobang tah'a pha a hitam! iPathen'u Elohim hi ichangei a mikhoto them hitam!
116.6: Yahweh Pakaiyin chapang lungthengtah atahsanna neijachu ahahsatna'a ahoidoh jin ahi. Keima thina toh kimaitoa kaum laitah'in aman eihuhdoh'in ahi.
116.7: Kalhagao, nacholdo namun hinjon kittan ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi keidingin aphalheh jenge.
116.8: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdoh'in kamitna mitlhi lonlouna dingle kakeng hi kakiselhuh louna dingin eiveng jenge.
116.9: Hiche leisetna kahin laisen Yahweh Pakai masanga kavahle jengin ahi.
116.10: Yahweh Pakai keima kagenthei behseh jengtai katiteng jongleh nangma katahsan jing nalai e.
116.11: Kahahsat teng jongleh nangma kahin koujin ahi, ajeh chu hiche mitehi tahsan thei ahipouve.
116.12: Thilpha simjoulou eibolpeh jeh'a hi Yahweh Pakai chu ipi kapehding ham?
116.13: Keiman huhhingna khon hi domsang'ing ting eihuhhing jeh'a amin kathangvah ding ahi.
116.14: Keiman amite ho jouse masangah Yahweh Pakai ah kakitepna nitjing ing kate.
116.15: Yahweh Pakaiyin angailut mite athiteng leh alainatpi lheh jengjin ahi.
116.16: O Yahweh Pakai keima nasoh kahi, nangin kasoh channa'a kon in neihuhdoh tai.
116.17: Keiman thangvahna hi kilhaina gantha napengting Yahweh Pakai min'in taovinge.
116.18: Keiman Yahweh Pakai a kakitepna chu amite jouse masangah pengtin,
116.19: Yahweh Pakai Hou-In ah Jerusalem lailungah subulhit'ing kate. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

117.1: Chitin namtin in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen, leiset chungcheng jousen thangvah cheh hen,
117.2: Amahi tonsot a kitahjing Yahweh Pakai ahin eingailutnao hi longlou ahijeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen.

118.1: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un! Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
118.2: Israel pumpin avel in seikit hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
118.3: Aaron chilhah holeh thempuhon avel in seikitnu hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
118.4: Yahweh Pakai ging jousen seikit uhen agailut thutah chun tonsot in athoh jing e.
118.5: Kagenthei pet in Yahweh Pakai kom ah kataovin ahileh Yahweh Pakaiyin kataona asangin eilhadoh tai.
118.6: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh ipi kakichat ding ham? kon I-eilothei dingham?
118.7: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh Aman eipapin tin, eidou hochu kajosa tobanga kavetding ahi.
118.8: Mihem a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai kiselna a nei aphajoi.
118.9: Leng chapate a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai a kisel aphajoi.
118.10: Eidouva chidang namdangten eiumkimvel jongleh keiman amaho chu Yahweh Pakai thahatna jalla kasuhmang ding ahi.
118.11: Amahon eiumkimvellun eidelkhummun ahi, ahinla ken amaho chu Yahweh Pakai hanta jallin kasumang gamtan ahi.
118.12: Amahon khoi bangin eiumkimvellun eitommun, meikong a-al leng lungngin eileo tobangin eibolseuvin ahinla keiman Yahweh Pakai thahatna jallin amaho chu kasumangtan ahi.
118.13: Kagal miten tha tei ding eigouvin ahin Yahweh Pakaiyin eihuhdoh tai.
118.14: Yahweh Pakai hi kathahatna leh kala ahin Aman galjona eipetan ahi.
118.15: Kipana le galjona lahi michonphate ponbuh sungah akisan, Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjet in thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi!
118.16: Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjetchun thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi.
118.17: Keima thilouding kahin, Yahweh Pakaiyin eibolpeh thilho phongdoh dinga kahinjoh ding ahi.
118.18: Yahweh Pakaiyin nasatah'in eijepmin, ahinlah eithisah pon ahi.
118.19: Mikitah ho lutna kot chu neihondoh peh'in keima lut ing ting Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna kapehding ahi.
118.20: Hiche kelkot hohi Yahweh Pakai kom lhuntheina ahin michonpha hojong hicheahi lutji ahiuve.
118.21: Kataona neisanpeh jehleh galjona neipeh jeh'in nangma kathangvah e!
118.22: Insahon adeimova apaimangu inning'a songpi khomdet pennin apangtai.
118.23: Hichehi Yahweh Pakai natoh ahin mitvet dinga thilkidang tah ahi.
118.24: Hiche nikho hi Yahweh Pakaiyin asem ahin, eihon kipahtah leh thanomtah'a imandiu ahi.
118.25: O Yahweh Pakai lungsettah'in neihuhdoh'un, O Yahweh Pakai lungset tah'in neilolhin sahtei teijun.
118.26: Yahweh Pakai minna hungpa chu anunnomme. Yahweh Pakai Hou-Inna kon in nangho phatthei kahinboh'un ahi.
118.27: Yahweh Pakai chu Elohim Pathen, ichunguva hi vahjinga um a ahi. Kilhaina sa chu khaovin khitninlang maicham ki ho chutoh khitbeh'in
118.28: Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kavahchoi ding nahi! Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kachoisang ding ahi.
118.29: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna ho jeh'in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a umjing ahi.

119.1: Yahweh Pakai thupeh dungjui a chonho leh kitahna neiho chu kipah uhen.
119.2: Koi hileh a Dan thu nit a alungthim pumpia Ama holjing hochu kipah'u hen.
119.3: Amahochun thilphalou achepi pouvin Yahweh Pakai deilampi joh ajui un ahi.
119.4: Yahweh Pakai nangin nathupeh hochu phatah'a kanit diuvin neiseipeh'un ahi.
119.5: O Yahweh Pakai kanitin hinkho Mandan ahin nangman neideipeh hinkho hi kilangdoh jengle kati e.
119.6: Chuleh nathupeh leh ka chondan kavetkah teng kajum louding ahi.
119.7: Keiman nei thuhilna dihtah hochu kahet dungjui a kakimanding dol a kakimanchah theijeh'a nangma chu kathangvah ding ahi.
119.8: Neidalha hihbeh'in, keiman na Dan chu kanitjing ding ahi.
119.9: Khangthah khatchu itileh ahinkho atheng theidem? Nangma thu angaileh hitheiding ahi.
119.10: Keiman nangma mudoh teiding kagelkhoh'in ahi, nangma thupeh'a kon in neilam vai sahhih'in.
119.11: Nangma douna kachonset louna dingin kalungsung ah nathu chu kachensah jingin ahi.
119.12: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kathangvah'e nathupeh nitji dan neihil in.
119.13: Ka chonding dan nangin neipeh hochu keiman kasimphongjin ahi.
119.14: Nei le gouva housangin na Dan thu chu juiding katha anomjoi.
119.15: Neithupeh na Dan hochu keiman simjing ingting nei deipeh lampia chejing dingin kingaito jing nange.
119.16: Na Dan thu hohi kakipapin, juidinga neithupeh hojong sumil ponge.
119.17: Nasohpa keima hi thilpha neibolpen kahinkhoa hi nathupeh kanit jingna dingin.
119.18: Nathupeh hoa thudih kidangtah hohi kamuchet theina dingin kamit hi hadohsah'in.
119.19: Keima hiche leisetna hi kholjin bep kahibouve nathupeh hochu keima nei impeh hihbeh'in.
119.20: Phatin in keiman nachondan juiding ngaichatna hin eilonvuhtan ahi.
119.21: Nangin mikiletsah hochu nahousejin, nathupeh a kon a pampet hochu nasamsejin ahi.
119.22: Na Dan sem hohi kajui jingnai amahohi neinoise sahhih beh'in.
119.23: Leng chapate ho toukhom u henlang keima dounan thu seijongleu keivangin na Dan semhohi juiding geljing nange.
119.24: Na Dan semho hi kakipapi lheh jenge ajeh chu hiche hohin chihna thu eihil jingin ahi.
119.25: Keima leivui lah'a kijama kahitai nathu chun neisuhal kittan.
119.26: Ka chondan, kaumchan nakom ah kaphongdoh tai, tun nadan semchu neisei pehtan.
119.27: Na Dan thupeh chu neithem sah'in, chutengleh keiman natohdoh datmo umtah hochu kalungin geljing nange.
119.28: Lungkhamnan eibom in kakaptai, nakam changing neihaldoh sahkit tan.
119.29: Mijou milepche hotoh neichom khen in, nathuhil kahetthem theinading thuguh chu neipen.
119.30: Kitah tah'a hinkho manding hi kakilhen ahitai, nathuhil dungjui a hinkho mandinghi kadinpi ahitai.
119.31: Na Dan semhi katuhchah ahitai, O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh'in!
119.32: Nathupeh hohi kajui jingding ahi, ajeh chu nangin hetthem theina neipeh jingding jehin.
119.33: O Yahweh Pakai nathupeh chu neihillin, keiman achaina gei in juijing ing kate.
119.34: Nathuhil kajuijing theina dingin hetthem theina neipen. Kalungthim pumpin hichu natohman podoh ingkate.
119.35: Nathupeh dungjui in neikalson sah'in hichu kakipanapen ahi.
119.36: Sum ngaichatna sangin na Dan thu hetthemding ngaichat theina neipejon.
119.37: Thil phachomlou hoa kon in kamit heimangin lang nathuchengin neihindoh sah'in.
119.38: Nangma ginle jana neiho napeh kitepna chu keima kom ah neisuhdetpeh'in.
119.39: Kajumna hinkho hi neipailhah sah'in ajeh chu na Dan semho hi aphalheh jengin ahi.
119.40: Nathupeh hohi kajuinomlheh jenge naphatna'in kahinkho hi neithah sempeh kittan.
119.41: Yahweh Pakai namingailutna longlou tonsot hinna neiteppeh chu neipetan,
119.42: Chutileh eitaitom ho donbutje kahetding ahi ajeh chu keiman nathutep chu katahsan in ahi.
119.43: Phat tin in thutah jeng neisei sah'in ajeh chu nangma chondan thupeh a bouhin kinepna kanei in ahi.
119.44: Keiman nathupeh hochu itihchan hijongleh kanit jingding ahi.
119.45: Keiman chamlhatna tahbeh chu kaneitai, ajeh chu nangma thuhil juidinga kigo kahitai.
119.46: Keiman nathupehho hi jahchalou hella lengte masanga jong kaphondoh ding ahi.
119.47: Keiman nang thupeh juidinghi kakipanapen ahitai ajeh chu hicheho hi keiman kadeilheh jengin ahi.
119.48: Keiman na thupeh ho hi kadeilheh jengin chuleh jana jong kaneijin ahi, na Dan thu hohi giltah'in kagellin ahi.
119.49: Kakom a na kitepna chu geldoh'in hiche bouchu ahi kakinepna.
119.50: Hiche nakitepna hin kahinkho akiledohsah kit'in kalungthim boina hoa kon in jong lungmon na eipen ahi.
119.51: Mikiletsah hon noise tah'in eibol jongleu keivang nangma thuhilhoa kon in kapotdoh pon ahi.
119.52: Masanglai peh'a na Dan sem nachepi hochu kangaito leh O Yahweh Pakai hichechun eilhamon sahlheh jenge.
119.53: Keima miphalou ho chunga kalung ahang'in ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathuhil apompouve.
119.54: Hiche kakholjinna munhi hoilai hijongleh na Dan thu semho hi kala ngeipen ahijinge.
119.55: O Yahweh Pakai jantengleh nangma nahina hi kalungsung ah akilangjin, hijeh chun nathuhil hohi kajui jingin ahi.
119.56: Nathupeh juijinghi kahinkho mandan hitoh kilhon khoma ahitai.
119.57: O Yahweh Pakai, kachanding gouchu nangma nahi! Nathupeh juidingin kakiphaldoh jinge!
119.58: Kalungthim pumpi hi namalsomna ngaichajing kahi, Nakitepna bangin neihepi jingtan.
119.59: Kahinkho ka lam lhahdan hi kanung gel jin chutengleh na Dan thu juina dingahin ka lutkit ji tai.
119.60: Nathupeh juina dingahin gangtah'in kipelut jing nange.
119.61: Miphalou hon chonsetna a lhohlut teiding eigo jiuvin ahinla keima vang na Dan thuhilna a hin dettah'in kading jingin ahi.
119.62: Na Dan thupeh hohi adih jeh'in jankhang jongleh kathoudoh'in nangma ka thangvah jin ahi.
119.63: Nangma thupeh juijing holeh nangma ging jingho dingin agolphao kahijinge.
119.64: O Yahweh Pakai namingailutna tanglou hin leiset chunghi adipmin, na Dan thuhi neihil jingin.
119.65: Yahweh Pakai nangin nakitepna dungjuijin thilpha tamtah neibolpeh tai.
119.66: Nathupeh hoachun kading jinge, hetna thepna leh thu adih'a tantheina thuguh chu neihil in,
119.67: Nangin neihilchah masang chun kana lamvaijin, tunvang nathu thun kanungtai.
119.68: Nangman naphatna'in thilpha bou na bol jie, na Dan thuchu neihil in.
119.69: Miphalou ho jouthu eisei khum jiuvin, ahinla kenvang kalungthim pumpin nathupeh ho dihtah'in kajuijing nai.
119.70: Alungthim u ngol hoitah ahin; keivang nangma thupehho juijing hi kakipana ahijinge.
119.71: Ka thohgimna chu keidinga thilphajo anahi, ajeh chu hichehin nathupeh juina ding langa lunglutna eipethei jin ahi.
119.72: Nathuhil ho juiding hi sana le dangka simsenlou sangin aman atamjon ahi.
119.73: Nangin neina gon a neinasemdoh ahin, tunvang nathupeh juina dinga hin hetthem theina neipen.
119.74: Nangma ging ho jousen kei a konna hin kipa na mu u heuhen, ajeh chu keiman nathupeh ahin kinepna dihtah kanei in ahi.
119.75: O Yahweh Pakai keiman na Dan semho adihdan hi kahethem tai, neisuhgim ji ding hi keidia thil phachom ahi.
119.76: Tuhin nasohpa neiteppeh bangin namingailutna longlou chun eilungmonsah jin ahi.
119.77: Kahintheina dingin namihepina chun neiumkimvel jingin ajeh chu neithuhilna hohi keidinga kipana leh lunglhaina ahi.
119.78: Keichung changa thujou seiho miphalou hochu jumle jachatna penlang, keivangin nangma thupehho chu kangai jingding ahinai.
119.79: Nangma Dan he themho leh nangma ging jingho chutoh nei ki vopkhom sah jingin.
119.80: Na Dan thu kajuina ahin bolkhel kaneilouna dingin neivengin, chutileh jumna leh jachatna kaneilou ding ahi.
119.81: Nangma huhdohna ding kangana lamma hin abeipaiding kahitai, ahinlah nathupeh ahin kakinepna adetjinge.
119.82: Nakitepna ahung gulhunna ding vetnan kamit achahleutai, itih tahleh neilhamon dingham?
119.83: Lengpi twipai savun ahun ahulgot bangin kagolhatai ahinlah na Dan thu juiding kasumil dehpon ahi.
119.84: Itihchanpi hi kanga jingding hitam? Keima eibolse hohi itihleh aphu nalah dingham?
119.85: Nangma thuhil nahsahlou mi kiletsah hohin keima kipalna ding ko thuhtah alaijun ahi.
119.86: Nathupeh jouse hi tahsan dinga lomtah cheh ahi. Ajeh bei a eidel lele hoa konhin neihuhdoh'in.
119.87: Amaho hin eichaidohpai got u ahitai, ahinla keiman nathupeh hohi kajuida dehpoi.
119.88: Na mi ngailutna longlou chun kahinkho hi huhdoh'in, chutileh na Dan thu kajui theiding ahi.
119.89: O Yahweh Pakai tonsot a dinga nakitepna chu van a dettah'in aumjinge.
119.90: Nangin nanatundoh hiche leiset hi aumjing bangin nakitahna jong akhang khanga umjing ahi.
119.91: Nathilgon jouse hi nathupeh dungjui in tuni chan geihin aumsohkei un ahi, ajeh chu amahohi aboncha nalhacha ahisoh kei un ahi.
119.92: Na Dan thupeh hin kipana hinkho'ah eihin khoukhah hihleh kagenthei lengvaina a kana mol lem ding ahitai.
119.93: Na thupeh Dan hohi itihchan hijongleh ka suhmillou helding ahi, ajeh chu hicheho hin eihinghoi ahi.
119.94: Yahweh Pakai nanga kahi; neihuhdoh'in! Ajeh chu nadan thu nitna a hin ka kihabol lheh jenge.
119.95: Mi phalouhon suhmang dingin lampi dungah eichanglhi le jonguleh kei man vang na Dan thuhi kalung sungah thipbeh chan geljing nange.
119.96: Thiljouse hin akhonna aneisoh keije ahinlah na Dan thupeh hin akhonna aneipoi.
119.97: Oh, na Dan thupeh hi iti kahin dei hitam! Ni lhumkei kei in hicheho hi kageljin in ahi.
119.98: Na Dan thupeh hohin kagal mite sangin eichihsah'e, ajeh chu hicheho hin phattin in eiveng jinge.
119.99: Na Dan thuhi phattin a ka geljing jeh'in eihilho sangin jong hetgilna ka neijotai.
119.100: Na thupeh Dan ho kanitjing jeh'in kachunga upa tehse ho sangin jong kachingjo tai.
119.101: Nathupeh dettah a kajuijing theina dingin thilse bolna a cheding kanompon ahi.
119.102: Nangin phate keicha neihil ahitah jeh'in na Dan thu juina a konnin ka ki heimang nompon ahi.
119.103: Na thupeh hi kapatep leh alhum lheh jenge, khoiju sangin alhumjon ahi.
119.104: Na Dan thupeh hohin hetthemna eipen; hiti chun hinkho adihlou lam a cheding hi kathet lheh ji e.
119.105: Nathupeh hi kakalsonna a eipuiding thaomei jin apangin, kalampi salvah ding vah'in apangin ahi.
119.106: Na Dan thupeh dihtah hohi kajuijing ding ahin, hiche dinga hi kitepna kananei ahitan avel a kakitep kitding ahi.
119.107: Yahweh Pakai nathutep dungjui in ka hinkho hoidoh sah'in ajeh chu kathohlel behseh jenge.
119.108: O Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah nahi kilhaina thilto bangin neisanpeh'in lang chuleh na Dan thupeh ho neihil in.
119.109: Keima ka hinkho hi kilep ditdet in aum e, ahinlah na thuhil hi ka juidadeh pong e.
119.110: Mi phalou hon ka kipalna dingin thang akam jingun ahi, ahi vangin nathupeh'a kon a ka ki heimang doh louding ahi.
119.111: Na Dan thu hi keidinga gou ahi, hicheho hin ka lungthim akipasah'in ahi.
119.112: Ka thini changei a na Dan thu nitding hi ka dinpi ahitai.
119.113: Kitahna neiloute hi kathet ahin keivang na thuhil ho jui dinghi katha nopna ahi.
119.114: Nangma hi kakiselna leh kalumdal nahi, nathupeh hi kakinepna bulpi ahijinge.
119.115: Milung gilouho keija kon in potdoh'un, ajeh chu keiman ka Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi kajuinom e.
119.116: Yahweh Pakai, nakitepna bangin kahinjouna dingin tha neipen kakinepna hi neijumso hihbeh'in,
119.117: Nathahatnan neituh'in chutileh kahoidohding ahi, chutengleh nathupeh hi kachepi jingding ahi.
119.118: Nathupeh a kon a potdoh hohi nangin napaidoh gamheltan ahi. Amahohi amahole amaho kijoulhep ahibouve.
119.119: Nangin mi-engse hochu leiset chunga konnin bohse bangin napaidoh jitan ahi, hijeh chun kei vangin na Dan thuho hi kajui nom e.
119.120: Nangma ginnan ka kithinge, na thutan dihtah ho jeh'in ki chatnan kadim e.
119.121: Keiman thudih tahleh kitahna neitah'in na katonge, kagal mite khut a neidalhahih'in.
119.122: Phatthei neibohding kinepna neipen, mi kiletsahho neibolsetsah hihbeh'in.
119.123: Nathutep dihtah chu asuh bulhit nadinga neihuhdohna dingchu kavet vetnan kamit achah leutan ahi.
119.124: Nami ngailutna longlou chun nasoh hi neibolpha jingin, chuleh na Dan thuho chu neihil in.
119.125: Na Dan thuhohi kahettheina dingin nasohhi hetthem theina neipen.
119.126: Yahweh Pakai tu hi nakipatna na tohphat ahitai, ajeh chu miphalouhon na Dan thu apal kehgam tauve.
119.127: Tahbeh'in nathupeh hohi sana mantampen sangin kadeijon ahi.
119.128: Na thupeh hohi adihsoh kei in, hijeh'a chu lamdihlou hohi kathet ahi.
119.129: Na Dan semhohi akidang theilheh jengin hijeh'a chu kalungthim pumpia kajui ahi!
119.130: Na Dan thuhil'a hin vah akilangin hijeh chun milham minjong ahetheijin ahi.
119.131: Nathupeh ho kangaichat behseh jeh'in kaki gon chule kakam kah in kangah jinge.
119.132: Nangma ngailuho nabolna bangin hung kihei in lang nami khotona neimusah'in.
119.133: Nakitepna dungjuijin kalhuh louna dingin neituh'in, thilse eijosah hihbeh'in.
119.134: Eisugenthei hoa kon in neihuhdoh'in, hitiachu nathupehho hoitah'a kajuijing theina dingin.
119.135: Nasohpa kei ahin namaivah chu hin kilan dohsah'in chutengleh na Dan thuchu neihil in.
119.136: Mi hemten na thuhil ajuitah lou jeh'un kamit na hin mitlhi twi vadung bangin along'e.
119.137: O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudihtah nahi, na Dan semho jong adih'e.
119.138: Na Dan semhohi nolnabei ahin chuleh tahsanthei mong mong ahi.
119.139: Ka galmiten na thupeh hi anahsah loujeh'un ka lunghan hi aki khonhel jengin ahi.
119.140: Na thutep hohi kapatep sohkei ahitan adih lheh jeng in keiman ka deilheh jenge.
119.141: Keima hi hetkhamlou leh notthap ka hivang in nathupeh hohi ka sumil dehpoi.
119.142: Yahweh Pakai nanga hin tonsotna thudih na aum e, chuleh na thuhil dihtah ho jonghi nolnabei ahi.
119.143: Hahsat na le lung khamna in eilonvuh jeng jongleh nathupeh hohi keidinga kipana tahbeh ahijinge.
119.144: Na Dan semho jouse jonghi adihjing jenge, hinna ka neitheina dingin neihet them sah'in.
119.145: Kalungthim pumpin kataove O Yahweh Pakai neihouvin, keiman na Dan thuho chu kanit jingding ahi.
119.146: Nangma kahin kouve Yahweh Pakai neihuh doh'in, na Dan thuho chu ka juijing thei nadin.
119.147: Khovah masangin matah'in kathouvin, nathutep na chun kakinem in panpi kathum e.
119.148: Jan khovah'in kahah'in nathutep chu kagel jinge.
119.149: Nami ngailutna dihtah'a konchun O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang na Dan thu juina ahin neichoh hing kittan.
119.150: Dan neilou miten eihung delkhum un ahi, amahohi nangma thuhilla kon in agamlha lheh'un ahi.
119.151: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai nangma naichan naum in ahi, chuleh nangma thupehho jouse adih'in ahi.
119.152: Na Dan semhohi tonsot a ding ahije tihi kaneolai a patna kanahetsa ahitai.
119.153: Kathoh gimna hi venlang neihuhdoh'in, ajeh chu keiman na thuhil hochu ka sumil khapoi.
119.154: Keima langa pangin lang ka chung chang thu neiseipeh'in nakitepna bangin neihuh doh'in.
119.155: Mi phalou hovang ki huhdoh louding ahiuve. Ajeh chu amahon na Dan thu hi anahsah pouve.
119.156: O Yahweh Pakai namihe pina hi anasalheh jenge, na Dan semhohi jui ing kating ka hinkho hi neikile dohsah tan.
119.157: Mitamtah'in asugenthei jin eisuboijin ahi, ahinlah na Dan thu juina a kon in kakiheimang dehpoi.
119.158: Hitobanga mikitahlou hohi ka muting leh ka lungnatpi lhehjin ahi, ajeh chu amaho hin na Dan thu hi anahsah pouvin ahi.
119.159: Yahweh Pakai ven na thupeh hi ichangei a ka gelkhoh hitam, na mingailut na longlou jal in ka hinkho hi neilepeh kit in.
119.160: Na Dan hung kipatna thuguh chu thutah ahi, na Dan thu dihtah hohi tonsot a dingjing ding ahi.
119.161: Mi thanei hon dihloutah'in eibol seuve, ahinlah keiman nathupeh hi ka lungthim in ginna kanei jinge.
119.162: Khat touvin gou nasatah akimudoh bangin nathupeh ahin kakipah'in ahi.
119.163: Keiman jou le nal kitihi kathetnin ahinlah nathupeh hohi kagelkhoh'e.
119.164: Na Dan thu hohi adihjeh'in nikhat in sagivei thangvah na penge.
119.165: Nang ma Dan thu ho gelkhoh na neiho jousen thahatna anei un ahi chuleh kipalna aneipou vin ahi.
119.166: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaicha lheh jengin ahi, hijeh'a chu nathupeh ho hi ka juijing ahi.
119.167: Na Dan semhohi kahinjui jinge ajeh chu hicheho hi deium ka salheh jenge.
119.168: Ahi, keiman nathupeh hole na Dan semhohi kajui jinge ajeh chu nangin ka kiman chahna jouse nahen ahi.
119.169: O Yahweh Pakai kahin kou nahi ngai in nangin neitep pehna bangin het them theina lungthim neipen.
119.170: Ka taona hi ngai in, nathutep na bangin nei huhdoh tei in.
119.171: Kakam a kon in thangvahna hi hung lengdoh jenghen ajeh chu nangman na Dan thu hohi neihil themtan ahi.
119.172: Kalei in nathupeh hohi thangvah lan sa hen, ajeh chu nathupeh jouse hi adih'in ahi.
119.173: Nei kithopina khutchu hin lhangdoh'in ajeh chu na thupeh ho juidinga kigotna kanei ahitai.
119.174: O Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaichat jing ahi, ajeh chu nangma thuhil hohi kakipana ahijinge.
119.175: Nangma ka thangvah jing theina dingin nei hing hoi in, chuleh nathupeh hohi eikithopin pangjing hen.
119.176: Kelngoi banga vahmanga kahitai hungin lang neihung holdoh tan ajeh chu nathupeh hohi keiman kasumil theipoi.

120.1: Lungkham na leh lung gim na kato tengleh Yahweh Pakai kom kalhutjin ahileh Aman kataona asangjin ahi.
120.2: O Yahweh Pakaiyin mijoubol ho a konleh milepche ho a kon in neihuhdoh'in.
120.3: Oh lepchena leigui mangcha ho, Elohim Pathenin nangho ipi na louvin tem? Aman nachunga engbolna ichan gei in apunsahbe dem?
120.4: Nangma thalchang hemtah a naki sunding chuleh meihol sapehpoh naki desah ding ahi.
120.5: Gamlatah Meshach lah'a ka chenchu kadanave, gamlatah Kedar ponbuh a ka chenchu ka thohlel ngeije,
120.6: Keima chamna deilah'a kachenhi kakhoplheh jengtai,
120.7: Keiman chamna kahol in, ahinlah keiman chamna thu kaseipou pouleh amahon gal bou adeijiu ve.

121.1: Keima kadah'in thinglhanglam kavei, hichea kon a khu eipanpi hung hintem?
121.2: Vanle lei sem pa Paka a kon a eipanpi hung ahi.
121.3: Aman nangma nakipalsah louding; nachingpa chu ihmu louding ahi.
121.4: Tahbeh'in Israel chingpa chu itihchan hijongleh ihmu lhulou ding ahilouleh ihmu louding ahi.
121.5: Yahweh Pakai amatah chu nachingpa ahi! Ama nakom a ading jingin nahoidohna lim in apang jinge.
121.6: Sun leh nisan nasangpeh pontin, janleh lhavah injong nasubeipon te.
121.7: Yahweh Pakaiyin thilse jousea nahoidohsah in tin nahinkho chingjing nante.
121.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin tuapat tonsot gei in navai kondoh leh nahung vailhun in nachingjing tahen.

122.1: Yahweh Pakai Hou-Inn ah cheuhite tia kakom a asei u chun keima kakipahlheh jengin ahi.
122.2: Vo Jerusalem tuhin keiho nakelkot sung langah kadingtao ve.
122.3: Jerusalem hi dettah'a kisa khopi ahin apal jonghi detchetna kigenbitna ahi.
122.4: Yahweh Pakai mite Israel phungho jousen hicheahi kintheng bolla ahungnao ahi. Israelte chonna dan dungjui a Yahweh Pakai kom a thangvahna pedinga ahungnao ahi.
122.5: Hichea hin lengte thutanna laltouna hochu aum in David chilhah ho laltouna ahi.
122.6: Jerusalem a cham lenna din taovun, hiche khopi ngailu jouse khangtouhen.
122.7: Vo Jerusalem, nakulpi sunga chamleng hen chuleh nakhopi sung khangtou hen.
122.8: Kainsung mite leh kagol kapaite khohsahna in keiman Jerusalem ah “Nanga chamna umhen” kati.
122.9: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u insung khohsah na'in, O Jerusalem nang dinga aphapen chu kahol ahi.

123.1: Van a alaltouna a tou O ka Pathen Elohim nangma munomna in kadah'in kahinvei.
123.2: Sohten amit uva apupao avetjing bangun Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim khotona ngaichan keihon kahin vejing ui. Hiti hin soh nungah honjong api'u chaloh akivetgeu jingun ahi.
123.3: Yahweh Pakai ka chung u vah khotona neipeuvin ajeh chu keiho hi vetda changsa ka hiuve.
123.4: Ajeh chu keihohi mi kiletsahho housetna leh mikhoh ho tai tomnan eichupmu ahitai.

124.1: Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh? Israelte jousen velseikit hen.
124.2: Min eina delkhum pettah'un Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh,
124.3: amahon alunghan u deojah pum in ahingin eina vallhum tauvinte.
124.4: Twi chun einachup uvintin, twikhanglen chun einalhohmang diu ahitai.
124.5: Hitiachu ichunguva twipi kitoltol ding ahiuve.
124.6: Igalmiteu einasuhmang sah louva Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhite.
124.7: Eiho thang kampa a kon a vacha ahoidoh banga hoidoh ihiuve. Thangpou chu akivobong tan eiho ihoidoh tauve.
124.8: Hitobanga kithopina chu vanle lei sem ah Yahweh Pakai a kon a imu'u ahi.

125.1: Yahweh Pakai a tahsanna dettah neiho chu Zion mol tobag ahiuve. Amaho chu suhlinghoi hiloudiu a-itih'a detjing ding ahiuve.
125.2: Jerusalem mol'in aumkimvel bangin, tuleh tua dingin Yahweh Pakai chu amite kimvel a akisung jinge.
125.3: Michonphate gam a chu miphalou te vaihomna leng teng gol in chan aneilou ding ahi. Achuti louleh michonpha ho jengin jong thilse ahinbol maithei ahi.
125.4: O Yahweh Pakai miphaho lungthim nangma toh chekhom theiho chu nangin thilpha bolpeh jingin.
125.5: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai lamdihlouva chete chu thildihlou bolte toh paidohtha jengin. Israelte lah'a cham lenghen!

126.1: Yahweh Pakaiyin sohchang hochu Jerusalem a ahinlepuilut kitphatchun, hichu mangtoh abang jengin ahi!
126.2: Keiho lungna chim tah'a nuinan ka dimset jingun, ki pahtah'in la kasauve. Hichun chidang namdang hon asei un, “Yahweh Pakaiyin thil loupi kidangtah chu aboldoh peh tauve” atiuve.
126.3: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakaiyin thil loupi kidangtah chu eiboldoh pehtauve! Iti kipa um a hitam!
126.4: Neldi gam a twilonglut hon athah semkit bangin O Yahweh Pakai kanei kagouhou hin kiledoh sah kittan.
126.5: Mitlhi long pum pum a muchi tuten, kipah thanom tah'a aga akilodiu ahi.
126.6: Kapjing pum a atuding muchi kipoh'a vaikonten, aga hinkipoh puma inmun kipahle thanomtah'in hung kileuhen.

127.1: Insa-a hi Yahweh Pakai apan louleh, asahon mohseh'a asah'u ahi. Khopi ngah'a hi Yahweh Pakai ajao louleh, khongah ho pannabei a hahkhovah ahiuve.
127.2: Jingkah matah'a nakipat uva jankhang gei a nehding an holna a na natoh'u pan nabei ahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin angailut achate hi a-ihmut sunguva hi ijakai agontohpeh ahibouve.
127.3: Veuvin, chatehi Yahweh Pakaiya kon a gou ahin, naobu sunga konna aga kimu jonghi kipa thilpeh ahi.
127.4: Khang don laija cha kineiho hi galsatpan akhutna thal changho akichoi tobang ahi.
127.5: Thal chang abom dimsetna kipohpa anun nom ahi. Amachu agalmite toh thutan na munna akimuto teng gal lel hilouhel ding ahi.

128.1: Koi hileh Yahweh Pakai ging geh'a um a Ama lunglhaina lampia kalsongho chu anunnom ahiuve.
128.2: Nangin nakhutsoh natohga naneh ding ahin, iti nakipading hitam na hinkho kiledoh ding ahitai.
128.3: Nainsunga najinu jong lengpigui ga phatah banga phatthei punna hiding, ankong phunga an naneh khompi nachate melhoitah tah Olive thingbah lhoutah bangdiu ahi.
128.4: Veuvin, Yahweh Pakai gingte phatthei achandingu chu hitobang hi hiding ahi.
128.5: Yahweh Pakaiyin Zion a kon in phatthei nabohjing jinghen, nahinkho lhumkei in Jerusalem machalna mujing jingin.
128.6: Natuson gei in jong hin munlang, Israel chungah chamleng hen!

129.1: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi. Israel pumpin hichehi velsei uhen.
129.2: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi, ahinla amahon khatveicha eijoukha pouvin ahi.
129.3: Katungtun hi maha adiptauvin, loukhoipan lou akhoi chehlah lahtoh abahsah jengun ahi.
129.4: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai chu aphatjeh'in miphalouhon khaova eikan nao eisutlhap peh tan ahi.
129.5: Koi hileh Jerusalem hot leh deimoa bolho jouse chu jumthet in ki nunglekit'u henlang lhuhpiu hen.
129.6: Amahohi pannabei inchung vum a hampa kehtobang, akhan kilhit masanga goplha tobang hiuhen.
129.7: Chang-at hon anotthap'u, chuleh chang kanhon adeimou hihen, chuleh hichelang hopa jousen, “Nachunguva Yahweh Pakai phattheiboh umhen keihon Yahweh Pakai mi in phatthei kahinboh uve” tin seihihbeh'u hen.
129.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin phatthei na boh hen, Yahweh Pakai min in nang ma phatthei ka boh uve, chule nang man na lam jot na chun hichi mi ho chun phatthei na chu sutang jou pou vin te.

130.1: O Yahweh Pakai lunglhahna kotong sunga kon in nangma panpina kahinthum e.
130.2: O Yahweh Pakai kakanahi ngai in, kataona hi neingaipeh'in.
130.3: O Yahweh Pakai kachonset nauhi hoitah'a namelchih ding hileh, koiham O Yahweh Pakai ahingdoh ding?
130.4: Ahinla Nangin nangma ginje kahetthem theina diuvin ngaidamna neipejiuvin ahi.
130.5: Keiman Yahweh ka Pakai nangma panpina kinem tah'in kangah'e. Henge, keima nangma a ki ngaijing kahi. Keiman athusei katahsan'in hichea kinem a ngahjing kahi.
130.6: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu ka ngahlel ngei e, kho ngahpan khovah ding angalel sangin kangahlel joi.
130.7: Vo Israel, Yahweh Pakaiya kinem in, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai ahin longlou ngailutna umma ahin chuleh ama a hin lhatdamna lhingset in aum in ahi.
130.8: Amatah'in Israel chu achonsetna jouse a konna ahuhdoh ding ahi.

131.1: Yahweh Pakai, kalungthim akiletsah poi; kamit ha dan jong kihi sahna aumpoi. Keima hi thil thupitah in jong kakigel pon keimat phah din jong aloupi behseh e.
131.2: Hiche sang chun keima kahina kalung lhaipen lung ol heuvin kaum in ahi. Naosen anu noitwi ngaicha talou bang in lung ollin kaum in, naosen lungmonga aum bangin keijong kalhagao lungmong in aum e.
131.3: O Israel tule tonsotnin Yahweh Pakaiyah lungmong'in ummin.

132.1: Yahweh Pakai David hi athohgim na jouse pum in hin geldoh'in.
132.2: Aman Yahweh Pakai ah kitepna gimneitah'in anase in ahi. Aman Israel Pathen Elohim ah kitepna ananei in ahi.
132.3: “Keima kain ah cheponge, keima kicholdo ponge,
132.4: keiman kamit kicholdo sah ponge ahilou leh kamit imutsah ponge,
132.5: Keiman ka Yahweh Pakai dinga inkhat sahna ding mun kamu kahsen, Israel Pathen Elohim a dingin muntheng kamu kahsen!”
132.6: Vetan hiche thing kong dinghi Ephrathah a aume ti kajaovin Jaar loujao dunga hiche mun hi kana mudoh tauve.
132.7: Yahweh Pakai chenna mun a cheu hitin akengphang bul ah chibai boh'u hite.
132.8: O Yahweh Pakai thouvin nacholdona mun a chun luttan nathahat melchihna thingkong chutoh lutthatan.
132.9: Nathempuhon chonphatna ponsil chu kisil uhen; nalhacha dihtah hon kipa la sauhen.
132.10: Nalhacha David khohsahna jal in, nathao nusa lengpa chu paidoh hih'in.
132.11: Yahweh Pakai chu David kom ah akihahsel in, kitepna nunglah doh kit louhel dingin: “Keiman nachilhah khat nalaltouna a katousah ding ahi.
132.12: Nachilhah ten nangtoh kakitepna leh ka Dan sem holeh kathuhil hohi anit uva ahileh nalal touna hi chejom peh ding ahi,” ati.
132.13: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin Jerusalem hi a inn chenna mun dinga adeilhen ahi.
132.14: “Hichehi tonsot a kacholngah na munding ahi” anati. Keima hiche mun a hi kachending ahi, ajeh chu hiche hi kadeilhen inn chu ahi,
132.15: Keiman hiche khopi hi phatthei kaboh ding chuleh ijakai kasuhmang pehding ahi, keiman asunga um vaichate an kapehding,
132.16: athemputeu chonphatna pon kasilpeh ding, asoh dihtah hon kipa la asahdiu ahi,
132.17: Hiche mun a hi David thaneina khantousah ding, hiche kathaonupa hi kamite dinga thaomeivah hiding,
132.18: chuleh agalmite chu jumna le jachatna pon kasilpeh ding amavang leng loupitah kasosah ding ahi.

133.1: Veuvin, insungkhat hi kilungkhat tah'a achenkhom teng iti phat'a pha lunglhai um a hitam?
133.2: Hichehi Aaron chunga thao mantam kisungah aluchanga kon a akhamul lah'a longlha a avon mong chan a longlha suhpeh tobang ahi.
133.3: Kitohdel a Hermon mol chunga kon a longlha daitwi theng tobang a Zion mol a hung longlha chu ahi. Hichea kon a chu Yahweh Pakaiyin malsomna chu ahin phondoh'a hichu tonsot hinkhoa ding ahitai.

134.1: Oh Yahweh Pakai sohte jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un, nangho Yahweh Pakaiyinn a jankhovah'a asohkin na tongten.
134.2: Nakhut theng'u chu taona in domsang uvin lang Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
134.3: Van le leiset sempa Elohim Pathen chun, Jerusalem a kon in phatthei naboh tao hen.

135.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai min chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai lhacha ten Ama chu thang vah un,
135.2: Nangho Yahweh Pakai lhacha na tong, Elohim Pathen, Hou-In sung a natong ten.
135.3: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un; amin ngaitah chu vahchoilan domsangun.
135.4: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin Jacob chu Ama a dingmong monga alhen ahin, Israel chu atumbeh'a amagou dinga agon ahi.
135.5: Keiman Yahweh Pakai aletna leh aloupina chu kahen, iPakai u Yahweh hi pathen dang sanga lenjo le loupijo ahi.
135.6: Yahweh Pakaiyin van le leiset chunga hin, twikanglen thuh sunga hin Aman along lhaina a adeidei abol ahi.
135.7: Aman meiho jonghi leiset chunga kon a alentousah ahin, Aman gojuh pet in koljong aphetsah'in, huijong hi athilkholna a kon in ahin lhadohjin ahi.
