135.8: Aman Egypt te insunga chun ainson in mihemle ganhing jong apeng masa jouse ana sugam in ahi.
135.9: Aman Egypt a chun Pharoah le amipi jouse douna in datmo umtah thil kidangho ana tongdoh'in ahi.
135.10: Aman namlentah tah ho anavolhun leng thupi tahtah hojong ana satchap e.
135.11: Amor lengpa Sihon, Bashan lengpa Og chuleh Caanan lengho jouse anathat gam in ahi.
135.12: Aman agam u chu Ama goulo Israelte gamtum dingin anapen ahi.
135.13: O Yahweh Pakai namin hi tonsot a umjing ding ahi.
135.14: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin amite chunga thutah'a vaihom ding asohte chunga khotona aneiding ahi.
135.15: Chitin namtinte doilim hohi sana le dangka maimai mihem in asemthubou ahi.
135.16: Amahon kam anei un ima aseithei pouvin, mit anei un ima amuthei pouvin,
135.17: kol anei un ima ajathei pouvin nahkui anei un ima anahthei pouvin ahi.
135.18: Doilim semthu ho jouse le hiche tahsanho jouse chu hitobang ngen ahiuve.
135.19: Vo Israel Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! O thempu Aaron chilhahho, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un,
135.20: O Levite Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Nangho Yahweh Pakai ginna neijouse Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
135.21: Zion'a kon in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un ajeh chu Ama Jerusalema hin achengin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!

136.1: Yahweh Pakai chu aphat na ho jouse jeh in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu ami ngailut na dihtah hi tonsot gei a longlou ahi
136.2: Semthu pathen ho, Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
136.3: Pakai ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin. Ajeh chu Ami ngailut na dihtah chu tonsot geija longlou ahi.
136.4: Ama bou hin thil loupi ki dangtah chu abolji ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
136.5: Thepna giltah'a vanho hinsemdoh'a Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot geija longlou ahi.
136.6: Twilah'a leiset umsah pa chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailut na dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
136.7: Van a kon a vah semdohpa chu thangvah'un. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
136.8: Nisan sun a vai ahom in ahi, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.9: Chuleh lha leh ahsi hon jan ah vai ahom un ahi.
136.10: Egypt gam a apeng masapen ho anathagam jeh'in Amachu thangvahna peuvin. Ama mi ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot na longlou ahi.
136.11: Aman Egypt ma kon in Israel ana puidoh'e, Ami ngailutna chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.12: Aman akhut thahatna leh aban thaneina pum in na atongin ahi. Amingailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
136.13: Twikhanglen san sukhen a chu Ama ahi, thangvah na peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
136.14: Aman Israel chu anapui galkai e, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
136.15: Aman Pharaoh leh asepaite twikhanglen sanlah'a analehlut in ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.16: Gamthip noi a amite apuigalkai jeh'in thangvah na peuvin, Am ingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.17: Leng thupitah tahho anajeplhuh jeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.18: Aman leng thahat tah tah ho anathat gam in ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.19: Sihon Amor lengpa; Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.20: Og Bashaan lengpa, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.21: Elohim Pathenin hiche lengho gamchu agoulo din amite anapen ahi. Ami ngailut na chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.22: Asohte Israelten gam tumbeh'a alodiuva anapeh ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.23: Aman ihatmo nauvah eihin geldohjiu vin ahi. Amibngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.24: Aman igalmihou va kon in eihuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.25: Aman hinkho neiho jouse dingin aneh achahdiu apejingin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
136.26: Van Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.

137.1: Jerusalem kageldoh phatnun Babylon vadungpang a chun katou un kakapgam tauve.
137.2: Keihon kasemjang houchu mong thingbah chung dunga chun kakhai un ahi.
137.3: Hikom a chun soh a eihente houchun la sah sahding eigouvin, chuleh eisugenthei houchun kipahtah'a la sahsahtei ding eigouvin, “Jerusalem la ho chu khatpen beh neisahpeh'un” atiuve.
137.4: Ahinlah keihon hetkhahlou mi gam sunga hi Yahweh Pakai la hochu iti kasahdiuham?
137.5: Vo Jerusalem nangma kasuhmil uleh kakhut jetlam hin semjang pehdan sumil jenghen.
137.6: Nangma kageldoh louva, Jerusalem chu kakipana sangpen sang a thupi a kagel lou le, ka leihi kadang chungah behden jenghen.
137.7: O Yahweh Pakai Babylon sepaiten Jerusalem alonkhum niuva Edom mite thilbol chu geldoh tei in, “Sumang jengin,” “Toltoh sumat jengun” tin asam un ahi.
137.8: O Babylon, nangma nakisu mang ding ahi. Nangin neibol nao bang banga nalethuh penpen chu anunnom ahi.
137.9: Nachapangteu puimang a songpi chunga sepgoiho chu nunnom hen!

138.1: Ka Pathen Elohim kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ingkate, pathen dangho masanga nang vahchoinan la sange.
138.2: NaHou-Inn theng lang nga'ing ting nami ngailutna tanglou jehleh nakitahna jeh'in namin vahchoi ing kate, ajeh chu nakitepna hi namin loupinan asuhdet ahi.
138.3: Kataopet petleh nangin neidonbut in nangin thahatna neipen neitilkhou vin ahi.
138.4: Leiset chunga leng jousen nangma nathangvah diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathupeh ajauvin ahi.
138.5: Amahon nathilbolho jehleh naloupi behseh jeh'a nangma thangvah la asahdiu ahi.
138.6: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma nalet lheh jeng vangin milham jong nakhohsah thouvin, ahinlah mikiletsah hoa kon in vang nakikhin gamlhan ahi.
138.7: Keima lungkhamnan eiumkimvel jeng jongleh nangin kagalmite khutna konna neihoidoh ding ahinai. Nangin nakhut hinlhangdoh'in natin nabanjetlang thahatna a neihuhdoh ding ahi.
138.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin keima hinkhoa athilgon achelhahsah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai na mi ngailutna dihtah chu atonsotna longlou ahi. Kachunga na natoh nahinpat hi subulhit tan.

139.1: O Yahweh Pakai nangin kalungthim nakholchil in neihechen sohkeitan ahi.
139.2: Nangin katouthimpet hihen, kadindoh pet hijongle nahei. Gamlhatah a kaum jeng vangin nangin kalung gel ngaito jouse nahei.
139.3: Kakholjinpet hihen, inna katouthimpet hijongleh nangin neimun ahi, chuleh kabol jouse nahesoh kei e.
139.4: Yahweh Pakai kathusei got jonghi kasei masangin nahejitai.
139.5: Kamasanga nachen, kanunga jong neijuijin ahi, naphatthei bohna khutchu kaluchungah nangam'in ahi.
139.6: Hitobang hetna hi keidingin aki dang val in, chuleh hitobang hetchet dinghi keidingin ahahsaval e.
139.7: Nalhagaova kon a iti kajam mang thei dingham? Nanga kon a keima iti kajam mang theiding ham?
139.8: Keima van a kaltou jongleng nangma naum in, mithigam ah lutjong leng nangma naum e.
139.9: Keima jingkah lhaving in lengdoh ingting twikhanglen gallang peh'a gacheng jong leng,
139.10: hichemun jenga jong chun nakhut in neikai hoi in natin, nathahat na in nei vengbit in nate.
139.11: Keiman muthim jah'a neisel in tijongleng chuleh kavel a vahjeng jong muthim sosah jongleng,
139.12: muthimlah'a kisel jing jongleng nanga kon a kakisel mangthei louding ahi. Ajeh chu nang dingin ajing jongchu sun banga vahding ahi. Muthimleh vah jong nangdingin thakhat ahibouve.
139.13: Nangin ka oisung a thil umjuse jong najopmat mat a kanu naobu sunga neigontoh ahi.
139.14: Hitobanga thil kidangtah'a neina gontoh jeh'in kathangvah'e! Na natoh nathil bol danhi datmo umtah ahi ti kalung thim apumpin kahe them e.
139.15: Keima jatchombeh'a kanu naobu muthimlah'a eina kigontoh jeng jongchun nangman neinavesui jingin ahi.
139.16: Kapen lhah masang a nang man nei namusa ahitai, nitin ka hinkhoa ka ki manchah na ding dan, phatche dungjui a ana kigongtoh chu nikhatcha jengjong achelhah masanga nalekhabua ana kigoltohsa ahitai.
139.17: O Yahweh Pakai kachung changa nalung gel nathilgon tohsaho chu iti mantama hitam simjou jai ahipoi!
139.18: Asim jengjong keijo chi ahipoi, neldi halsiho sang in jong atamjoi. Kahung khahdoh gei injong nangin neina umpi jing nalai e!
139.19: O ka Pathen Elohim miphalouho hi nasuhmang hitavele ong! Tolthat ho kahinkhoa kon in potdoh'un.
139.20: Amahohin na suminseu ve, nagalmi hohin namin hi asamseu ve.
139.21: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nahotbolte hohi keiman jong kahot louding ham? Nangma nadouho hi kenjong kathet louding ham?
139.22: Ahinai, nangman nathetho hi keiman pumthetna kathet ding ahi, ajeh chu nangma galmi ho chu keima galmi ho ahiuve.
139.23: O Yahweh Pakai neikhol chil in kalung neihet peh in; neipatep inlang kahina hi kilang doh sah in.
139.24: Kasunga hi nangma douva thilse umnalai am nei nodoh peh inlang tonsot lampi a neipui tan.

140.1: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in, pumhat-a natong hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in,
140.2: ajeh chu alung sung'uva thilse jeng agong un, beitih um louvin gal abol jiuvin ahi.
140.3: Alei gui-u gul in mi achuh bang in amang chauvin, athuseidoh jouseu jong gul-gu tobang ahi.
140.4: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou ho khutna kon hin neihoidoh in, pumhatna natong hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in; ajeh chu kakipal lhuhna din thisle jeng agong un ahi.
140.5: Mi kiletsah hon kei matna din thang akam un, khao ajan-doh'un lampi dunga thang ei-kampeh'un ahi.
140.6: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kom'a, “Nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahi!” O Yahweh Pakai, khotona dinga kataona nei sanpeh tan.
140.7: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, athahat pan-a eihuhdoh pa; nangman gal kisat nikhoa nei huhdoh ahi.
140.8: Yahweh Pakai, migilouho adei bang'in chesah hih'in, athilse gonhou chu lolhin sahhih'in; achuti louva ahileh kiletsahna dim diu ahi.
140.9: Kagal miten kachunga thil phalou tohgon anei jal un, manthah nan lhung u-hen.
140.10: Meiam kong chu alu chunguvah chuhsah'in, meilah'a seplut in; ahilouleh ajamdoh louna diu twiveina kotong'ah lhalut jeng u-hen.
140.11: Ka gamsung uva hin ajou jouva mihehse ho khantousah hihbeh'in, pumhat'a natong ho achunguva thilse chuhsah'in lang sumang in.
140.12: Hinlah suhgentheija umte Yahweh Pakaiyin asumil poi, ti kahen; Aman vaichate thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi, ti kahei.
140.13: Tahbeh'in mi kitah hon namin athangvah diu, chule michonpha ho na kom'a cheng diu ahi.

141.1: O Yahweh Pakai, nangma kakouve, Panpi ngehna katao hi nei ngaipeh loijin!
141.2: Kataona hi nahenga gimnamtui kilhut bang'in chule kakhut teni kadopsang hi nilhah lang kilhaina gantha bang'in neisanpeh tan.
141.3: O Yahweh Pakai, kakam'a hin kamdal neikoipeh'in. Kakam sung nei vetpeh jing in.
141.4: Thilse bolna din kalungthim aselam-a kon'in neihoidah sah in, thil dihlou bolna'a neipansah hih'in. Thildihlou bol hon aphat chompiu thangset umtah thil hoa chan nei neisah hih'in.
141.5: Miphan eiphoh hen hichu ngailutna joh ahi! Amahon eisuhdihna chu damna ahipoi, Miphalou hon thilse abol dounan katao jinge.
141.6: Alamkaiteu kol'a akisot lhah tengleh, miphalou hon kathusei angaidiu chuteng dih ahinsah diu ahi.
141.7: Songpi akikhet keh teng tol'a akitakeh bang in, miphalou ho gule chang ho jong vui louva kithe jal ding ahi.
141.8: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, panpi ngaijin na henga kataove. Nangma kakiselna kulpi nahi; amaho khut-a thina neitosah hih in.
141.9: Kei ona dinga thang akam-uva kon in neihuhdoh in, thilpha lou jenga chon ho thangkol'a nei o-sah hih in.
141.10: Miphalou ho chu amaho thang kam-a chun oh uhen, kijam chap tauhen; keivang nei hoidoh sah'in.

142.1: Keima Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Yahweh Pakai henga khotona kathum in ahi.
142.2: Keima Yahweh Pakai ang-sunga kakiphin in, kahahsatna jouse jong kaphongdoh'in.
142.3: Kalhagao alam vai jitan, hinlah Yahweh Pakai nangbou nahi kachena ding lampi ei-hil ji. Kajotna lam'a chun ei-douten thang eikam peh jiuvin ahi.
142.4: Keiman mikhat tou hunga eipanpi ding kangaichat lai jin, koiman amitsih jenga jong eive poi! Koimacha eikithopi ding aumpoi, kachunga thilsoh koiman imachan eigelpeh poi.
142.5: O Yahweh Pakai, keima na henga kataovin, “Nangma hi kakiselna nahi, kahinkhoa kangaichat pen nang bou nahi,” kati.
142.6: Kataona hi nei ngaipeh teijin, ei-kisunem behseh jeng tai! Ei-bolgenthei hoa kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ajeh chu amaho keisang in ahatval jeng tauve.
142.7: Songkul'a kon'in neihuhdoh loijin, chutileh nangma kathangvah thei ding ahi. Lolhing tah'a neibol jeh'a kajet le kaveija mikitah dim lha diu ahi.

143.1: Vo Yahweh Pakai, kataona ngaijin. Kangeh hi nei ngaipeh teijin! Nangma kitahna le dihna bang in, neidonbut in.
143.2: Nalhacha hi nei patep hih in chule kachung thu jong tan hihbeh in, ajeh chu koima na ang-sunga adih aumpoi.
143.3: Ajeh chu kagal miten eihin del peh in, kahing chang in tolgoi nan ineijin, lhan khuh-a athisa umho bangin, kada kacham louvin muthim lah'a eiumsah tai.
143.4: Hijeh chun keiman kinepna ding kanei tapon, kalung sung kichatnan adim e.
143.5: Keiman khanglui nikho chesa ho kageldoh'in, nakhut tenia natohdohsa thil thupi ho kagel jing in ahi.
143.6: Kakhut tenin nahenglam kasang'in kataovin, Gamgo-in sadoh leuva twi angaichat bang in; keiman nangma kangaichan ahi.
143.7: O Yahweh Pakai, nei donbut loijin, ajeh chu kahin kho bei pai ding ahitai. Keija kon'in kihei mang hih in, ijeh-inem itileh lhan khuh-a lhalut ho kabah ding ahi.
143.8: Jingkah sehleh nalungsetna longlou neijahsah in, ajeh chu keima kingaina nangbou nahi. Kalam lhahna jouse neihil them in, kahin kho hi nangma dia kaphal theng ahi.
143.9: O Yahweh Pakai, kagal mitea kon'in neihuhdoh in, nahenga kisel dinga hung jamlut kahi bouve.
143.10: Ka Pathen Elohim nahi, nadeilam bolje neihil in, name khotona lhagao chun dettah'a pan kalah jingna din neipui jing in.
143.11: O Yahweh Pakai, namin loupina ding in kahinkho hinghoi teijin. Ajeh chu nakitahna jal'in kahahsatna'a kon in nei puidoh tan.
143.12: Nami ngailutna longlou chun, kagal mite manthahsan in! Chule nalhacha kahi, eidou ho jouse sumang hel in.

144.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un Amachu kasongpi ahi. Aman kakhut teni hi galsatje dan eihil in, chule kakhut jung hohi galsatna'a manchahje dan eihil ahi.
144.2: Amahi eipanpi phapen leh kakulpi ahin, kahoidohna pal leh eihuhdohpa ahi. Chitin namtin anoijah akunsahji ahi.
144.3: O Yahweh Pakai, mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagel-lut'a, mihem chapa jeng jong ipi hija hibanga nakhohsah hitam?
144.4: Ajeh chu mihem hi hai khatseh'a hing ahibouvin, ahin-nikho jong nisa-lep tobanga mangpai thei ahibouve.
144.5: Yahweh Pakai vanho hinhong in hung kum lhan, molsang hohi tham'in lang meikhun len mangsah in.
144.6: Kehchang len-dohsah inlang galmite thejalsah in! Nathalchang kap inlang jamsah soh hel in.
144.7: Vanna kon'in nakhut hin lhang in, twithuh lah'a konleh kagalmite thaneina'a kon in nei huhdoh in.
144.8: Akam'un jou jeng aseijun, thudih kaseije atiuvin akihahsel un, hinlah jou jeng aseijun ahi.
144.9: O ka Pathen Elohim, na henga lathah khat sange; selangdah jangsom kibut chu mangchan na vahchoila sange.
144.10: Ajeh chu nangman lengho galjona napen! Nalhacha David jong athi nading chemjam'a kon in nahuhdoh jin ahi.
144.11: Neihuhdoh'in! Kagalmite thaneina'a kon'in neihuhdoh'in, akam un jou jeng aseijun; thutah kaseiding ahi tin akihahsel-un, hinlah jou jengseh aseijun ahi.
144.12: Kachapateu akhandon laijun thingphung phatah bang in khanlhit sah in, ka chanuteu jong leng inpi jemhoi dinga kisem khompi hoitah ho bang u-hen.
144.13: Ka chang pang jouseu jong lousoh jouse pum'in dimsoh hen, kalou jaova kagan chateu asang sang in, sangsom som chan geijin pung hen.
144.14: Kagancha teu gai pha hen, veiset le apengsol um hih hel hen! Ka khopi sung jenguva jong lung gim khoisat beihel hen.
144.15: Hitobang thilpha achunga lhung ho kipah uhen! chule a Pathen'u Elohim, Yahweh Pakai hikha nam mite chu kipah cheh'u hen!

145.1: Ka Pathen leh kalengpa Elohim nangma choi at inge, chule itih chan hijong leh nangma thangvah jing ing kate.
145.2: Niseh'a nangma ka thangvah jing ding, itihchan hijongleh nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
145.3: Yahweh Pakai hi athupin, Amabou thangvah dinga lom ahi; koiman athupina tejou ponte.
145.4: Akhang khanga mihem ten Yahweh Pakai natoh apachat jing diu, thil kidangtah tah nabol ho aphonjal diu ahi.
145.5: Yahweh Pakai nalal loupina kidang leh nathilbol datmo umtah ho giltah'a kagel jing ding ahi.
145.6: Nathilbol gimnei hohi mijouse kam'a kijadoh ding, keiman nathupi na ho kaphondoh ding ahi.
145.7: Kidangtah'a naphatna thusim hi mijousen aseiphong diu, keiman jong nadihna thu hi kipahtah'a vahchoila kasah ding ahi.
145.8: Yahweh Pakai hi milungset them leh hepina'a dim, lunghang vahlou; lungsetna long lou ahi.
145.9: Yahweh Pakai hi mijouse din aphai, Aman athilsem saho jouse chungah khotona lhingset apen ahi.
145.10: O Yahweh Pakai, nasemsa jousen na henga kipathu asei diu, chule nanungjui dihtah jousen nathangvah diu ahi.
145.11: Amahon nalenggam loupina asap phong diu, nathahatna atah-lang diu ahi.
145.12: Amahon natohdoh thil loupi ho mihem chate aseipeh diu, navaihomna lenggam loupi leh anatsat dan aphondoh peh diu ahi.
145.13: Ajeh chu nalenggam hi tonsot lenggam ahin, nangin akhang khanga vai nahop ding ahi.
145.14: Yahweh Pakaiyin alhuho athoudoh'in apohgih'in adelpha ho aphong dingin ahi. Aseidoh chan a kitah Yahweh Pakai ahin, atohna jousea lungset them ahi.
145.15: Mit jousen kinem tah'in nangma lam ahin ven, nangman amaho ngaichat dung juijin aneh diu napejin ahi.
145.16: Nangman nakhut namang chan, hinkho neijouse hi agilkel adangchah nau nasuh bulhinpeh jin ahi.
145.17: Yahweh Pakai hi atohna jousea kitahnan ajuijin, atohna chan'a ngailutna dim ahi.
145.18: Yahweh Pakai henga taote Aman anailut jing in, tahbeh'a taote aumpi jing in ahi.
145.19: Aman gimna le jana neipumma ngaichatna neiho alolhinsah in, panpi ngaicha'a akanao angaipeh'in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
145.20: Yahweh Pakaiyin Ama ngailuho ahuhdoh jin, hinlah miphalou ho vang asumang jin ahi.
145.21: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu kathangvah jing ding, vannoi leisetna cheng jousen tonsot tonsot in Amin thangvah jing tauhen.

146.1: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun! O kalhagao Yahweh Pakai vahchoi jin!
146.2: Kahin laisea Yahweh Pakai kavahchoi ding, hinna hu kanei laisen ka Pathen Elohim vahchoi la sange.
146.3: Leng chapate chunga natahsan koi hih'in, hichu panpi bei ahibouve.
146.4: Mihem chate hu abei teng leisetna akilekit-un leivui akisoh jin, hiche nikho lechun athilgon chengseu toh thi thading ahitauve.
146.5: Hinlah apanpi dinga Israel Pathen Elohim neiho, chule Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen a kinepna neiho anunnom ahi.
146.6: Aman van le leiset twikhanglen leh asunga um jouse anasem in, Aman imatih chan'a akitepna achepi jing ahi.
146.7: Aman suhgentheija umho thudih'in achungthu atanpeh in, chule agilkel te an apen ahi. Yahweh Pakaiyin songkul tangho alhadoh'in, achamlhat sah jin ahi.
146.8: Yahweh Pakaiyin mitchoho kho amusah'in, alhu ho aphong ding in, michonpha Yahweh Pakaiyin angailun ahi.
146.9: Yahweh Pakaiyin gamdang miho ahuhdoh in, Aman meithaiho leh chaga ho akhoton, amavang miphalou ho thilgon asuhbei peh'in ahi.
146.10: Yahweh Pakaiyin tonsotna vai ahomding ahi. O Jerusalem, Amahi akhang akhanga na Pathen hiding ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun!

147.1: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen! iPathen'u Elohim vahchoi lasah ding hi iti phat-a pha hitam! Ijeh-inem itileh Ama lungset nan adimn in, vahchoi dia lomtah ahi.
147.2: Yahweh Pakaiyin Jerusalem aki ledohsah in, amangtasa Israelte ahin lepui kit in ahi.
147.3: Aman lungthimna jong aboldam in, amaha jeng-u jong adamsah'in ahi.
147.4: Aman ahsi ho asim toh in, amin cheh'in akouvin ahi.
147.5: I-Yahweh Pakaiju hi iti loupi hitam! Athaneina hi akhonna gei ahi! Athil hetthem theina jong mihem hetphah hoi ahipoi.
147.6: Yahweh Pakaiyin mikineosah ho adomsang'in, ahin miphalouho vang toltoh alhobeh'in ahi.
147.7: Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la sauvin, semjangto thon Elohim Pathen vahchoila sauvin.
147.8: Aman vanho meilom'in akhun, leiset'a go ajuh lhahsah in, chule molchunga hampa louhing akedohsah'in ahi.
147.9: Aman gamsa ho neh ding apen chule va-ah nou ho apenteng aneh diu apejin ahi.
147.10: Aman sakol thahatna leh mihem thahatna'a akison-jiu akipapi poi.
147.11: Yahweh Pakai chu Ama ging jing hole ami ngailutna longlou chunga kinepna neiho akipa pin ahi.
147.12: Vo Jerusalem, Yahweh Pakai loupina vahchoijun! O Zion, na Pathen Elohim vahchoijun.
147.13: Ajeh chu Aman nakelkot jol ho alhousah in, chule nakul sunga nachate phatthei aboh in ahi.
147.14: Aman nagamgi tin-uva chamna alensah in, chule nagilkel nauvah an twitah'in navah uvin ahi.
147.15: Vannoi leiset chunga thu-apeh teng jongleh aman gang in ahi.
147.16: Aman buhbang jeng jong samul abahsah jin, chule dai-kai jong vutvam kithejal abahsah jin ahi.
147.17: Gel-chang jong song kisunglha abahsah jin, adapsah teng jong ama-anga ding jou ding koiham?
147.18: Chujouteng Aman thu apen ahileh ajunlha gamji tan, Aman hui chu asol'in ahileh buhbangho chu twijin alongji tai.
147.19: Aman Jacob henga thu aseipeh in, Israel kom'a a Dan thupeh hole athuhil hochu ahilchen in ahi.
147.20: Hitobang hi namdang ho jah'a aseipeh pon, amahon athuhil jong ahepouvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen!

148.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanhoa kon'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanthamjol-a kon'in Amachu thangvah'un!
148.2: Avantilte jousen thangvah'un! Van sepaite jousen thangvah'un!
148.3: Nisa le lha-in amachu thangvah'un! Aphelhet lhet ahsi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
148.4: Achungsang lam'a um vantham jol'in thangvah'un! Meilom chung sangpeh'a um meitwi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
148.5: Thilsemho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuvin, ajeh chu Aman thu apen ahileh amaho chu ahung kisemdoh jengun ahi.
148.6: Aman tonsot geija dinga anagontohsoh ahitai. Ama Dan semchu itih hijongleh ki khokhel louding ahi.
148.7: Leisetna konnin thangvah'un, twikhanglen lailunga thilsemhon thangvah'un,
148.8: meileh gel hon, buhbang leh meilom hon thangvah'un, huileh adap asatnin Ama thu chu ngaijun.
148.9: Mol leh lhangho, aga nei thingphung ho le Cedar thinghon,
148.10: gamsa ho le ganhingho jousen, ganhing neochacha ho le vachahon,
148.11: leiset chunga lengho le mipite jousen, leiset chunga vaihom hole thutanho jousen,
148.12: pasal khangthah ho le numei khangthah hon, tehse hole chapanghon,
148.13: abonchauvin Yahweh Pakai min thangvah'u hen! Ajeh chu Aminhi aloupi lheh jenge, hiche Amin loupina hi leiset le vanho jouse sanga sangjo ahi.
148.14: Aman amite chu ki khat atundohpeh tan ahi, amadinga kitahna neijouse Aman angailut Israel mipite chu jana apetan ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

149.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Yahweh Pakai vahchoina lathah sauvin. Tahsan chate kikhopna ah avahchoila sauvin.
149.2: O Israel nasempa chunga kipah'in, O Jerusalem mipite, na lengpau chungah kipah'un.
149.3: Khongpi gintoh semjang saito thon lampum pum'in Aminchu vahchoijun,
149.4: Ajeh chu amite chungah akipah'in, mi nun nem te chu jana lallukhuh akhupeh tai.
149.5: Elohim Pathen chate chu hitobang jana achanjeh'un, jankhovah'in avahchoila sauhen,
149.6: Akhut'in chemjam hemtah kichoiyu henlang, akamsunguuvah kipah tah'in Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauhen.
149.7: Chitin namtin ho chunga aphulah theina diuleh, namtin chunga engbolna apehtheina diuvin,
149.8: alengteu thihkhao kola akihen'uva, chuleh alamkaiteu thihkhaova akikan theina diuvin,
149.9: achunguva thu kitanna dungjuiya akitohdohna dingin. Hichehi Elohim Pathen chate chan loupitah achannao chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

150.1: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin! Elohim Pathen chu Houin'ah thangvah'un, Avan chung thahatna mun nah thangvah'un!
150.2: Athilbol thahatna kidangtah jeh'in amachu thangvah'un, aletna seijoulou jeh'in thangvah'un!
150.3: Sumkon gin kithong pum'in vahchoijun, theile mut selangdah saito thon thangvah'un!
150.4: Khopi ginleh lam pummin vahchoijun, kuli leh tumging theito thon thangvah'un!
150.5: Khong gintoh thon thangvah'un, Khong gin kithong gimneitah chuto thon vahchoi jun,
150.6: Haina hu neijousen Yahweh Pakai thangvah na la sauvin! Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!

1.1: Hiche hi Israel leng David chapa Solomon thuchih ho ahi.
1.2: Hiche hi mihemten chihna le kigah chahna, thuchih kiseiho hi ipi kiseina ham, ti ahetdoh theina diu ahi.
1.3: Chule ahoi-apha adihlam'a kihilna kisan them'a adih le thudih agom'a kisanlut ding,
1.4: Chuteng milham ho dinga lunglim-geh'a hinna, chule khangdong hon hetna le thil detkhen themna anei diu ahi.
1.5: Miching jeng jong khodah'a thepna alambe ding, hetkhenna nei mihem in jong kihilchahna alambe ding ahi.
1.6: Hiche thuchih kiseiho le thil umdan hetthemna anei ding, miching hon thu asei teng, thulem aseidoh jouseu hettheina tha anei ding ahi.
1.7: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi hetna dinga abulpi ahin, mingol hon vang chihna le hilchah nan asang thei poi.
1.8: Kachapa, napan nahilna ngaijin lang, nanun nahilna jong sang teijin,
1.9: Ijeh inem itileh, amanin nahilna jouse khotona lallukhuh'a nakikhuh ding, chule jana na ngong changa khivui oa naki'o ding ahi.
1.10: Kachapa michonseten jol lhah ding nago jong leu, athu'u nangai lou hel ding ahi.
1.11: Amahon na henga ahin seidiu, “Hung'in cheu hitin mihem thadin ngah-ute; suhkhel neilou ho jong chu inop chabep uva ibol diuvin nga lhih tau hite.
1.12: Ahing changa lhankhuh in aval lhum'a abah gam bang in, eihon jong ahing in bahgam-u hitin, thina kokhuh'a lhalutsa bang in, apum chang in val lhum gam tau hite.
1.13: Chuteng thil thupi tahtah imu diu, mi thil lelo ichomdoh hou chu in dimset'a isit diu ahi.
1.14: Keiho kom'a chan hung neijin lang, sumdip kikhong in sum khol khom u-hite, tia ahinsei diu ahi.”
1.15: Hinlah kachapa, amaho toh kilhon khom hih hel'in, amaho lam lhahna akon chun kidalse jon,
1.16: Ajeh chu amaho thilpha lou bolnan akeng-u ajangkhai in, gangtah in thisan aso jiuve.
1.17: Hijeh chun vachan ao nading thang kikam amu teng, pannabei asoh jitai.
1.18: Hitobang miho hin ama hole amaho thisan sodohna dinga midang achan lhih jiu ahin, amaho thina ding jenga bou mi achan jiu ahi.
1.19: Koi hileh hitobang pumtho changa ama phatchomna ding ngaito bang bep ahiuvin, thil lelo neipa ahivang in thina atoh jitan ahi.
1.20: Chihna hin lamlen lah'a kho asamjin, japi lah jenga jong ogin kithong tah'in apeng jin ahi.
1.21: Chihna hi lamlen dunga jong apeng jah jeng in, khopi kelkot mai'a jong thu aphong doh jin ahi.
1.22: “Vo mihemte, itih chanpi mihem mei meija hin ding nagot u-ham, anop nop'a paohon itih chanpi michunga nanop pao diu ham? Angol hon itih chanpi hetna nathet diu hitam?
1.23: Kathumop nahi ngai phau vin, ajeh chu keiman nangho dinga kalunggel ngaito kasei ding, chuteng kathuseija kon chihna nalam doh diu ahi.
1.24: Ijeh inem itileh keiman nang ho kakou un, nang hon nei donbut deh pouve. Kakhut ban in kahin sang uvin, iman jong nagel deh pouvin ahi.
1.25: Kahilna abonchan nadonse pouvin, kagihsal na jouse jong khatcha nadonse pouvin ahi.
1.26: Hijeh chun hahsatna dinmun nalhun teng uleh kanuisat diu, manthah nan nalhun den tengu jong leh kanuisat ding nahiuve.
1.27: Huipi hattah banga manthahnan nahin lhun khum diu, chimpei banga hahsatna nahin to diu, chule gim le hesoh hoise tah in nalhun dendiu hijongleh ka khohsah louhel ding nahi tauve.
1.28: Hinlah amahon panpi ngaija eihin kou-diu, keiman kadonbut dehlou diu, gil tah'a eihol jing diu, ahin eihol doh jou deh lou diu ahi.
1.29: Ajeh chu amahon hetna athet uvin, Yahweh Pakai gin ding jong alheng deh pouvin ahi.
1.30: Amahon kahilna asang pouvin, kagih salna jouse jong pannabei aso tauvin ahi.
1.31: Chule amahon anop chabep uva atoh-gau aneh diu, thilpha lou angaito jouseu thao twi banga jol lha diu ahi.
1.32: Ajeh chu amahon lamdih jot louvin, milham ho chunga thina alhung lo jitan, lungthim beiho kiletsahna chu amaho manthahna asoh jin ahi.
1.33: Koi hileh kasei phatah'a ngaija chun lungmonna anei ding, gin ding neiloua lungmong sel'a cheng jing ding ahi.”

2.1: Kachapa, kathusei ho na-ngaija, chule kathupeh ho gou banga na chintup jing ding,
2.2: Chihna thu nakhoh sah jing ding, chule lunggil tah'a thil hetkhen themna nanei ding ahi.
2.3: Hetgilna dingin peng jah-in, thil hetkhenna nanei thei nadin othong in peng jah in,
2.4: Dangka banga na hol ding; thil lutah kisel banga nahol ding ahi.
2.5: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai gin kiti nahetdoh ding, Elohim Pathen hetna jong nanei ding ahi.
2.6: Ajeh chu chihna hi Elohim Pathen thilpeh ahin, Amakam sunga kon hetkhenna hung konji ahi.
2.7: Milungtheng hodin hetkhen themna apejin, lung limgeh cha lamlha te chunga lum-in apang jitai.
2.8: Mikitah ho lampi avetsuipeh in, amakoma kitah ho avengbit jing e.
2.9: Chuteng nang in chonphat na le thudih chu nahin hetdoh ding, chule lamdih'a cheje dan nahin kimu dohding ahi.
2.10: Ajeh chu nalung sunga chihna hunglut intin, chule hetna lhingset nahin nei ding, hichun nakipa sah ding ahi.
2.11: Hetkhan them chihna chun nahin venbit ding, hetthemna chun nahoibit ding ahi.
2.12: Hichun aphalou lampia kon navenbit jing ding, miphalou le milhem chavei hoa kon nahuhdoh ding ahi.
2.13: Hitobang miho chu lamdih'a kon lamvaija, lamdih lou ajot diu ahi.
2.14: Amaho thil dihlou jeng bol ding athanom un, chule thil phalou jenga kiman chah athanop piuvin ahi.
2.15: Amahon atohdoh jouseu aphalou ngan ahin, chule achonnau lamlhah jouse damun jeng ahi.
2.16: Chihna hin numei phalou akon nahoidoh sah ding, joulhep toh tho a tuhchah ding nagot uva kon nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
2.17: Hitobang numei hin ajipa adalhah'a chule Elohim Pathen henga akitepna jong aheimil ahitai.
2.18: Hiche numeinu hin a-insunga thina chan alhut ahin, alam lhahna jouse jong damun lam jeng ahi.
2.19: Ama henga lut pasal tapou mahthah ding, hinna lampi langa lutlou hel ding ahi tauve.
2.20: Hijeh chun nangman mipha ho lampi najui jing ding, michonpha ho lampi jeng bou najot ding ahi.
2.21: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen ging hon bou gam sung alo diu, chule mikitah hobou gam sunga cheng diu ahi.
2.22: Amavang mi lungdih lou ho gam sunga kon kikai doh diu, chule lungthim dihlou ho chu gam sunga kon kipei doh jeng diu ahi.

3.1: Kachapa kahilna ho sumil hih beh in, Kathupeh ho na lung sunga chen sah jing in,
3.2: Hichengsea kon hin, nakum ajop sau thei ding, chule phatheina bukim nachan theina ding ahi.
3.3: Itih chan hi jong leh kitah nale khotona nalha-kang lou ding, hiche teni hi na ngonga khivui oa naki o-ding, hichengse hi na lungthim sunga lekhajem banga naki-jih lut ding ahi.
3.4: Chuteng Elohim Pathen le mipi lungdei lam nahung hi thei ding, minphatna naki-lam doh thei ding ahi.
3.5: Nalungthim pumpin Yahweh Pakai bou tahsan in, nangma hetna jenga kisong hih in.
3.6: Nalam lhah natin chenga Yahweh Pakai jeng naphondoh ding, chuteng Aman na lampi nakomu peh ding ahi.
3.7: Nangma mitvet jenga kichang chihsah boldan, Yahweh Pakai ging pum-in thilse dalhan.
3.8: Chutileh natahsa dinga damna hiding, chule nagu na chang dinga hatdohna hiding ahi.
3.9: Nanei nagou chule ga masa jouse Yahweh Pakai jabol pum'in tohdoh in,
3.10: Chutileh Aman nachang pang nasuh dimpeh a, nalengpi twi kholna jong aletset'a nasun dim peh ding ahi.
3.11: Kachapa, Yahweh Pakaiyin nasuhgim nachu nahsah mon koi dan, chule Aman nasuh dihna chu lungnop mo peh hih in.
3.12: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaiyin asuhdih hohi angailut jeh ahin, mipan acha dihtah asuhdihji banga aphosalji ahi.
3.13: Chihna le hetthem theina kimu chu lungmonga kipah ding ahi.
3.14: Ajeh chu chihna kitihi dangka sanga phachomjo ahin, chule aga chu sana sanga jong phachomjo ahi.
3.15: Chihna hi songmantam sanga mantamjo ahin, nangaichat thil ho jeng to jong tekah thei ahipoi.
3.16: Hinkho sausah thei jong chihna hin akhut jet lam'a atuh chah ahin, haosatna le jabolna jeng jong akhutvei lam'a akituh chah ahi.
3.17: Chihna hin kipa thanop na lampia napui ding, alampi jouse chu lung chamna jeng ahibouve.
3.18: Chihna kisanlut chan dinga hinna thingphung ahin, chihna tuh chah jing ho chu anunnom ahiuve.
3.19: Chihna mangchan Yahweh Pakaiyin vannoi leiset ana tungdoh in, thil hetthemna jal'a vanmun ho asem doh ahitai.
3.20: Ama thil hetkhenna jal'a komtong ho kisemdoh a, meilhang pumpi jong gotwi a julhaji ahi.
3.21: Kachapa, chihna tothon, thil datkhenji dan them in, namit vet in hiche ho jouse hi pannabei sosah hih in.
3.22: Ajeh chu hiche hohin nalhagao asuhnou jing a, nangong chang jenga jong khivui banga kijep thei ahi.
3.23: Chuteng lungmonga nalam lhah le ding, nakeng jong kipal talou ding ahi.
3.24: Kichatna beihel'a jalkhun najot ding, na imut teng jong leh lungmong tah'a na-imut ding ahi.
3.25: Kiging man louva thiding kicha hihbeh in, migilou hoa kon manthahna hung lhung ding jong nagin louhel ding ahi.
3.26: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai bou na kulpi ahin, Aman nakeng jeng jong thanga ao-sah louhel ding ahi.
3.27: Nathahat laisen na kithopi thei chan ding in, thilpha nabol peh ding ahi.
3.28: Naheng nakom jenga jong chen lang hung kilen, jing le nale peh nanga tin, hinlah neinasan bol hihbeh in.
3.29: Naheng nakom dounan thil gong hih beh in, ajeh chu amahon nakison piuva nakom'a cheng ahiuve.
3.30: Nachunga thilse bol-lou chu ajehbei in kinahpi dan,
3.31: Chule pumthoa natong mihem chu thangsetpi hih in, alam lhahna tinchenga kon chu nakiven joh ding ahi.
3.32: Hitobang milung dihlou chu Yahweh Pakaiyin athet ahin, milungtheng vang chu Yahweh Pakaiya kingai jing ahi.
3.33: Yahweh Pakaiyin asapsetna chu miphalou ho inchunga alhung jin, mikitah ho chenna in chu Yahweh Pakaiyin phatthei aboh ding ahi.
3.34: Yahweh Pakaiyin minoise ho chunga noisena alhunsah jin, akineosahte chunga lunglhaina aneiyin ahi.
3.35: Miching chun mite a kon jana akimu ding, mingol ho vang muda chang diu ahitai.

4.1: Chapate, napauvin nahil chah nau ngai phauvin, giltah'a nahet them uva aphachom nasohdoh theina diuvin lunglut tah'in ngaijun.
4.2: Ajeh chu Keiman Dan phatah kapeh nahiuve. Hiche kathuhil chengse hi pelkeh hihbeh un.
4.3: Keima kapa dinga chapa khatseh kahin, kanu mitvet jenga jong ngailut umtah chapa changkhat kahi.
4.4: Kapan hitin eina hil in, “Kathusei ho nalung in chensah jing in, ka thupeh jouse jong tuhdet jing in, hinna'a nanei ding ahi.
4.5: Kakam sunga kon potdoh thuchang ho sumil hih in, dalha hih hel in, chule chihna kisan in giltah in hetna neijin.
4.6: Chihna hi nungsun hih beh in, chihna hi ngaisang in, chutileh chihna hin nangma na umpi jing ding ahi.
4.7: Hitobanga hi chihna bulpi hung kipan ahi. Chihna mutei ding gon, namu chan chu giltah'a hetdoh ding ngaiton.
4.8: Chihna hi mutheijin domsang in, chuteng chihna chu nangma domsanga pang ding ahi. Chihna hi natuh chah jing poule, chihna chun jabolna namusah ding ahi.
4.9: Chihna hi nalu-changa delkop phatah'a pang ding, Lal-lukhuh hoitah khuh tobang nahi ding ahi.”
4.10: Kachapa kasei ngaijin lang, kathua nung in, chutileh na hinkho kijop sau thei ding ahi.
4.11: Keiman chihna lampi kahilsoh tan, chule chondihna lampi chengsea jong kapui tan ahi.
4.12: Nakal son-le teng jongleh nakipal lou ding, nalhai-le teng jongleh nakipal lhuh lou ding ahitai.
4.13: Ka thuhilna kisan in tuhchah jing in, hichu chingtup in, nang dinga hinna ahi.
4.14: Milungthim phalou lam lhahna'a che dan, mipapse te lam lhahna'a jong vah-le hih in.
4.15: Hitobang lampia kon chun kihei mang in, vah-lut louvin jotpai jeng in.
4.16: Ajeh chu thilse bol masa louvin ajan choldo jipouvin, mikhat tou akipalsah kahseu-vin, mu jong a-imu theiji pouvin ahi.
4.17: Amahon phatlouna ga-a bou akivah un, pumtho chang'a anatoh uchu judon banga adon jiu ahi.
4.18: Mi chonpha ho lam lhahna vang chu jing ninou bang in asoh jin, sunlai nisa asat bang in, avah cheh cheh jin ahi.
4.19: Amavang miphalou ho lam lhah chu muthim lah bang bep ahin, hoilaija kipal diu ham jong ahephaji pouvin ahi.
4.20: Kachapa, kathuhil ho ngaiphan, kasei jouse lunglut tah'in ngaijin
4.21: Hichengse hi namit mun mansah hih hel in, nalungthim sunga chensah jing tan.
4.22: Ajeh chu hiche kimu chan chun hinna'a anei ding, atahsa jeng jong adamsah ding ahi.
4.23: Khodah in limgeh chan um in, ajeh chu hinna gui hung konna asohjin ahi.
4.24: Thudihlou nasei pai lhan, thuchavei kihoulimna nanei jong dalha tan.
4.25: Na mitte-nin ching geh in mive phan, namai changa nathilmu jeng jong adih hiding ahi.
4.26: Nakeng phang tenia nachotna ding vephan, ajeh chu nalam lhahna jouse kicheh ding ahi.
4.27: Jetle vei-a jong kiheile dan, thil dihlou lampia kon chun nakeng phang sepdoh in, kihei mang jeng tan.

5.1: Kachapa, kachihna hi khohsah inlang ka thumop hi phaten ngaijin. Kathil hetkhen theina hi phatea nakol sunga nangai ding ahi.
5.2: Ajeh chu thil hetkhen theina neijin natin, nakam sung jenga jong hetthemna um jing ding ahi.
5.3: Numei jong ho lei-chu khoiju lhumma lhum ding, athusei chan-u thao kinu sanga jolji ahi.
5.4: Hinlah achaina chu guu-banga kha jia, chule hemto chemjam banga hemji ahi.
5.5: Akeng tenin thina'a apui lutjia, noimi gam chan'a chelut ding ahi.
5.6: Hitobang numei hin hinna lampi anahsah jipon, achena tincheng anoh phah jin, amanun-la akihet doh jipon ahi.
5.7: Hijeh chun tun kachapa teho kasei ngaijun, kahilna thuchang hoakon hin jammang ding go hih beh un.
5.8: Hiche numeinua kon khun kidalseu vin, akotpi phung lam'a jong chenai ding go hih beh un.
5.9: Hitia chu nabol lou ule, mihoa kon jabolna nachan lou ding, nahin kho sunga min nakhoto thei lou ding ahi.
5.10: Hetkhah lou mihon nahatna le nahaona aboncha a-luo diu, natohga jouse jong michom beh in a-luo ding ahi.
5.11: Na hinkho ajona lam teng gim hesoh nato ding, natahsa pumpi manthahna aso diu ahi.
5.12: Chuteng nangin seijin natin, “Kigah chahna hi ichan-a kana thet a, phosalna hi iti kana thet hitam?
5.13: Keiman eihil ho thu kana donse pon, ka dinga thusei ho jeng jong kana donse tapoi.
5.14: Tuhin mipi kikhopna'a kon keima mah thahna mun kalhun kon ahitai, tia nasei ding ahi.”
5.15: Nangma twikhuh'a kon hung potdoh twi chu kidon jeng tan.
5.16: Na twikhuh dunga twi put chu muntin'a hetdoh-a um'a chule kholai tinchanga um mong ding hinam?
5.17: Hichu nanga ding bouvin koiyin, nakom'a hung maljin vang nachan sah lou ding ahi.
5.18: Na twikhuh chu phatthei chang tahen, nangma tah jong nasenji chunga kipah tan.
5.19: Na deitah na jinu sajuh golpai hoitah le sajuh chal hoitah bang in, phat tin in aman nahebolna nachunga lhung jing hen, amanu anglum jal'a kipah jing nahin, aman natuh chah jing hi nalungset phot chetna ahi.
5.20: Kachapa, i-atileh numei chon chavei chu naki ngaipi jing a, hitobang numei kampao phalou chu a-anglum'a um ding nagot jing ham?
5.21: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi mihem lam lhah jouse ve-jing ahin, alam lhah na jouse avet-jing ahi.
5.22: Miphalou chu a chondih lounan akipalsah teijin, a chonsetna chun atuh chahji ahitai.
5.23: Ama chu kigah chana beija thina chang ding, a ngol-ga chun manthahna asoji ahi.

6.1: Kachapa, naheng nakom dinga batsahna dinga kitung nahim, hetkhah lou mikhat tou batsahna dinga naum khah a,
6.2: Nangma thuseija kon kipalna naneija, nakama kon'a phondohsa thu chun nakipalsah khah leh,
6.3: Kachapa, ka thuhil hi ngaijin lang bol ding gon, ajeh chu naheng nakom'in na chunga thu anei tah jeh in, chen lang naheng nakompa ang-sunga taovin.
6.4: Jan choldo louvin, namit teni jeng jong sing-hih in, namit geija keh mitmul ho jong kichol da hen.
6.5: Sadelpa masanga sakhigol ajammang bang in, nangma tah kihuh hing ding gotan, vacha thangkol-a kitoldoh bang in nangma tah kihuh hing loijin.
6.6: Vo mi thase ho, cheuvin sihmi khu gave tim un, aum chan u-khun kihil un lang chingdoh tauvin.
6.7: Amahon natonga agoi diu lengle gamvaipo, vaihom aneilou vang un,
6.8: Amahon nipi laija neh ding aki-khol khom un, khokhal teng nehding aki-khol khom theijun ahi.
6.9: Hinlah vo mithase hiche mun'a hi itih chan na-imut ding hitam? Nalup mun'a kon itih phat'a thoding nagot hitam?
6.10: Na i-mut a, namoh kijam jeng a, nakhut chalo-sah louva namoh um jenga ahileh,
6.11: Chule vaichat na chun gucha banga na hin lhunkhum ding, lhinlel na chun gal manchah choipa banga nahin lhunkhum ding ahi.
6.12: Mi pannabei le mikitah lou chu thudihlou sei phong in ache leuvin ahi.
6.13: Ajon chihnau amit lhap uva akilang jin, akhut jung uvin hichu akoh jiuvin ahi.
6.14: Alungthim phatlou nauvin thilse agong un, tantih neilouvin kitomana ding jeng abol jiuvin ahi.
6.15: Hiche ho jeh chun, amaho chunga gangtah in manthahna achujin, damdoh vah thei loua um diu ahi.
6.16: Yahweh Pakaiyin athet tah thil gup aum in, Ama ding in thil sagima adei lou aum in ahi.
6.17: Kiletsah mitvet, jou seina leigui, mona beija thisansoa panla khut teni,
6.18: Thilse gonna lungthim, thilse bol dinga lhai keng teni,
6.19: Thujouseina-a jou sakhia pang, chule asopi lah-a kitomona muchi thea pangpa ahi.
6.20: Kachapa, napa thupeh hohi jui jing in, chule nanun nahilna jong don louvin koi hih in.
6.21: Hichu nalung sunga chingtup jing in, na ngonga khivui on ki-o jing in.
6.22: Hiche hochun nakal sonna jousea napui hoi ding, na-imut teng jongleh nachin tup diu, nahung khahdoh teng jongleh nahil'a pang kit ding ahi.
6.23: Ajeh chu thupeh chengse hi thaomeia pang ahin, kihilna jeng jong thaomei vah tobang, chule kiphosalna le kigah chahna jouse jong hinna lampia pang ahibouve.
6.24: Hichun numei phalouva kon navenbit ding, akam them jehju numeia kon chu nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
6.25: Melhoinu khu nalung in deicha hih beh in, amit vetdan akon in jong kilhep lhahsah hih hel in.
6.26: Ajeh chu numei kijohnu chu changlhah khat jengseh a jong muthei ahin, hitobang numei pasaltoh jongji chun pasal hinkho chu manthahna asoji ahitai.
6.27: Mihem khat chun adip-a mei-al apoh theijem? Chule aponsil jeng jong kavam louva akoi thei lou ahi.
6.28: Mihem khat chu mei-al chunga vahle theijem? Akengto phang teni jong kalouva akoi thei lou ahi.
6.29: Aheng akompa jinu jonpi jong hiche tobang bep chu hiding, aheng akompa jinu lup khompi tapou chu Dan in amat tei ding ahi.
6.30: Gilkel khat chun neh ding deija thil aguh tah-a ahileh, hichepa chu mihemte muda chang cheh ahi.
6.31: Hinlah gucha chu akimat khah tahleh, aguhdoh jat chu jat sagi jen'a ale ding, anei le agou jouse aguchat jeh'a asahna'a anei ding ahitai
6.32: Chule mitoh jon thanhoi bolpa chu lungthim neilou ahin, thildihlou abolna chun manthahna alhun den ding ahi.
6.33: Amapa chun jumna maha aput ding, min amuda na jong beitih um lou ding ahi.
6.34: Ajeh chu thangset kiti hin mihem alung sousah jin, datkhen um louva phulahna aneiji ahi.
6.35: Amapa chun leona man akilah nom lou ding, thil ijat pebe jong lechun asan thei lou ding ahi.

7.1: Kachapa, kathumop hi juijin, kathupeh chengse jong gou chin in ching jing-in.
7.2: Kathupeh chengse hinna nanei thei nadin nit jing in, kathuhil chengse namit chang naki chintup bang in chingtup in.
7.3: Hichengse chu nasuhmil lou nadin khutjem bun kibun lang, nalungthim gil sunga lekhajem bang in kijih lut in.
7.4: Chihna hi naso pinu bang in ngailun, chule nagol ngaitah banga nakisem ding ahi.
7.5: Hichun numei jong hoa kon navendoh ding, pasal toh jonthanhoi bol numeia kon chu nahoidoh ding ahi.
7.6: Kain bang-kot akon kagal vet'a, polam kavet a hileh,
7.7: Japi lah'a jong kamun, gollhang ho kititna mun'a jong kamun, lungthim bei gollhang khat aum in ahi.
7.8: Amapa chu, numei jong-nu inlam achun avah lejin, hiche numeinu in-jotna lam chu ajon jitai.
7.9: Jingkah khovah then then in jong, nilhah lam in jong, jan muthim lah'a jong, hiche lam'a chun ache jitan ahi.
7.10: Chuin numei khat in amudoh tan, amanu chu noti-von a kivon, a-lua pon akikhuh in ahi.
7.11: Hiche nuchu thunung lou khop in, jum le ja jong helouvin, in-a um thim thei louva keng javelvul a um ahi.
7.12: Kholaija um'a igel laijin, kailhanga akimun, munthip ningkoi lah jenga mi achang lhih jin ahi.
7.13: Gollhangpa chu amu teng angong koi pai ji-in, achop jitan, jum lou tah'in gollhangpa henga chun aseijin
7.14: “Keiman chamna maicham sem ding tampi kaneijin, tuni hin kakitepna jouse pe tange,
7.15: Ajeh chu nangma velhih-a hung potdoh kahin, lunglhai sel'a nangma hol'a kahung chu, hikom-a kamutai.
7.16: Kajalkhun jong Egypt gam'a ponnem jemhoi tah'a kapha jolsel ahi.
7.17: Kajalkhun chunga myrrh namtui kathe in, aloes namtui le thingthal namtui tah kahin the ahi.
7.18: Hungin, jankhovah geijin lungna chimtah in kinou ta hitin, kilungset hitin, jankhovah in kideito hite.
7.19: Ajeh chu kajipa inn-a aumpon, kholjin in mun gamla tah'a achen ahi.
7.20: Asum bom a sum dimset'in akipoh in, lha kichai lam teng hung kile din achetai.”
7.21: Hitichun numeinun thungai tah tah aseijin ajol tan, ajonan athunun in, kamnal hiu hiu cha akihoupi tahjeh in gollhangpa jong anom tan ahi.
7.22: Alungthou jah'in hichenu chu ajui tan, Bongchal in aki tha nading mun ajot bang le thang a-ohsa sakhi bang in numeinu nung chu ajuitai.
7.23: Sakhi golpai thalpin alungchang athil pai bang leh, vacha banga ahinkho beina ding akihet phah tapon ahi.
7.24: Hijeh chun ka chapate ho kathusei hohi lunglut tah in ngaijun, chule kakam sunga kon thu kisei hohi ngai phauvin.
7.25: Hiche numeinu lam akhun nalungthim lamvai sah hih in, amanu lam lhahna tinchanga jong nache lou hel ding ahi.
7.26: Ajeh chu amanu hin pasal tampi manthahna aso-ahitan, sepai thahat lai jong asuhgam ahitai.
7.27: Amanu in jotna lampi hi noimi gam lampi ahin, thina lhankhuh sunga kilhung lut lampi ahi.

8.1: Chihnan kho ahin sap teng jatei ding gon, chule thil hetkhen nan lhang asap teng ngaijin.
8.2: Lampi pam le lhangvum dung a, chihna chu ading le'in ahi.
8.3: Khopi lutna kelkot phung dung a, kholen tinchang maija, chule kotjum lutna thei jousea lhang asam in ahi.
8.4: “Mijouse jah-a kakou ahin, mihem chapa jouse kakou ahi.
8.5: Milham ho nahiu vin, lunggel them hina din kihil un, mingol ho jeng in jong lunglut in ngaijun.
8.6: Ngaitem un, keiman thil phachom tah nahil uvinge, kakam sunga kon thudih jengbou pot ding ahi.
8.7: Ajeh chu kakam in thudih bou aseiji ding, adihlou sei kiti hi kakam in ajahda ahi.
8.8: Kakam akon thu kisei jouse adih ahin, akikal le ache khel ding ima um lou ahi.
8.9: Kathu hil hekhen theipa chun adih akisan ding, hetthemna neipa dinga chu adih bou ahi.
8.10: Sumlepai sang in kathu hil kilhen un, Sana thengsel sanga jong hetna naki lhen joh diu ahi.
8.11: Ajeh chu sana kijem pah sanga chihna hi thupi ahin, na lungdei chan toh kitekah thei ahipoi.
8.12: Chihna hi keima kahin chingthei tah'a um kahi, hetna le thil hetkhen themna nei kahi.
8.13: Yahweh Pakai ginna chun thilse ahotbol in, hijeh chun keiman kiletsahna le hoithona, thil aphalou, ahilou louva thu kisei chan chu kathet ahi.
8.14: Keima'a kon hin, chihna giltah le phachom tah'a kihilna aum in, asung thua hetna le thahat chu keija bou um ahi.
8.15: Keijal'a lenghon vai-apoh ahin, keijal'a bou vaihom ten adih'a thu tanna anei ahi.
8.16: Keijal'a alen alal ten vai ahop jiu, chule keijal'a bou alal ten vai apoh theiyu ahi.
8.17: Keima eingailu ho kangailun, giltah'a eihol ten eimu tei jiuvin ahi.
8.18: Keima haona le jabolna jousen eijui in, phattheina le haona chun eidalha jipoi.
8.19: Ka thilpeh hohi sana sanga phachom ahin, sana thengsel sanga jong hoijoa, chule kanatoh jong sum le pai sanga phajo ahi.
8.20: Keima thudih tah'a lamlha jing kahin, thutanna adih lam jeng chu kaho-ji ahi.
8.21: Keima eingailu hon gou alo diu kasem peh in, agou kholnau jouse kasuh dimpeh-jin ahi.
8.22: Yahweh Pakaiyin atil abulla athilsem apat ei-umsah ahin, khanglui apat athilsem masapen kahitai.
8.23: Atil-a leiset kisem masang, kum asang sang masanga pat keima tundohsa chu kahi tai.
8.24: Kapen chun anem, atong lai jong ana um pon, twi putna jouse jong khatcha ana um poi.
8.25: Mol le lhang kigol toh masang, chule thinglhang jouse kisemtoh masanga pat ana um kahitai.
8.26: Elohim Pathenin leiset le tollhang asem masang, vannoija leigum kisemdoh masanga pat um kahi.
8.27: Elohim Pathenin vanho atundoh masanga um kahin, twikhanglen kuol khum vanthamjol alhundoh masanga jong um kahitai.
8.28: Elohim Pathenin chunglam'a vanthamjol ho atundoh ahin, leinoija pat twi aput dohsah masanga jong um kahin,
8.29: Twikhanglen geilah jong alet lhahna lou dinga asem toh, twipi jeng in jong athu angaina dinga asem toh, leiset khompi jouse jong atundoh masanga pat um kahi.
8.30: Keima tah jong akom-cha'a khut them bang um kahin, nitin le phat tin in akom-a kapansan kipatah in kaum jing in ahi.
8.31: Elohim Pathenin mihemte chenna dia leiset atundoh ahin, keima jong kipah tah-in kaum in, mihemte lah'a thanopnan kadim e.
8.32: Hijeh chun kachate ho kasei ngaijun, kathu ngaija ka lampia che jing ho kipah ding'u ahi.
8.33: Kathuhil ho ngaijun lang ching theijun, kahilchah-nau hi tuh chah jing un.
8.34: Ka thusei ngaija mihem chu anunnom hi ding, amachun nitin'a kakot phunga anga jing ding, ka kotpi phunga tatlouvin ading in ahi
8.35: Ajeh chu keima eimudoh chan chun hinna akimu tan, chule Yahweh Pakaiya kon in hepina achang'un ahi.
8.36: Amavang keima eidonlou chan chun, ama le aman gimna akimu jin, keima ei hot chan chun, thina jeng angai chat ahibouve.”

9.1: Chihna kiti hin a-in akisahdoh in, khompi sagi jen atungdoh tan ahi.
9.2: Chihna kiti hin, neh le chah ding gancha phabep akitha jin, lengpi twi jong lhumkeijin ahel-in, chule chihna kiti hin an-nehna ding dokhang jeng jong atungdoh tan ahi.
9.3: Munsang laija kon'in khopi sung mihoa kon chun, mikou din asohte asol in ahi.
9.4: Koi hileh milham a um jouse, “Kakom'a hung hen,” tin akousah in ahi. Chule koi hileh alungthim bei tapou chu, kou-un, ati.
9.5: “Hung un, kaneh ding khel in neuvin, kadon ding khel in lengpitwi don un.
9.6: Milham in um hih un, giltah in hetkhenna neijin hinkho mang un,” ati.
9.7: Mi munem'a noisea, adih bolsah teiding gopan jong kisuh khahna aneilo-bep ahi.
9.8: Hijeh chun mi munem pum-a adih bolsah teiding go-hih in, ajeh chu nahin mudalo thei ahi. Hinlah miching chu hil lechun nangailua pang jo-ding ahi.
9.9: Miching chu nahil chan'a ching cheh cheh ding, hibang chun mikitah jong nahil chan'a ching cheh ding ahi.
9.10: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi chihna bulpi ahin, mithengpa hetna nei chan chun giltah'a thu ahetdoh ahi.
9.11: Ajeh chu keima jal'a na hinkho sao chom ding, na hinkho sunga nakum jong kibe tei ding ahi.
9.12: Na chihna chu nangma goh-keuseh ding ahin, midang noisena nanei le mona chu na changseh a nakipoh ding ahi.
9.13: Numei ngol kiti chu akam tam in, amanu chu pannabei le jum helou ahi.
9.14: Amanu chu a-in kot phunga atoujin, kholai jenga jong mundoh lai a bou atoujin ahi.
9.15: Amanun mi ama kincheh a kisalel akom'a hung kijot hochu “akou jin,”
9.16: Chule milham ho koma chun kakom'a hung un tin, akouvin, lungthim beija um jouse tin akoujin ahi.
9.17: “Aguh'a kidon twi hi alhum in, aguh a kineji changlhah jong lungkim umtah ahi,” ati.
9.18: Hinlah golhangpa chun hiche mun hi thina ahi ti, aheji pon, numeinu insunga lhung jinhon jong noimi-gam mithi kholna'a lhalut ahilam-u, akihet phahji tapouve.

10.1: Solomon thuchih ho: Chapa chingin apa aki pasah jin; Chapa ngol vang anu ding in lungkham na bep ahi.
10.2: Gitlouna le engset jeh'a kilamdoh gouchu phat chompi thei ahipon, hinlah chondih nahin hinkho jeng jong ahuhdoh jin ahi.
10.3: Yahweh Pakaiyin michonpha chu kelthoh in akoi jipon, chule milungthim phalou ho ngaichat akhohsah jipoi.
10.4: Khut chaloh sah nomlou thase chun vaichatna alhut ding, khut umthim thei lou chun haosatna amu ding ahi.
10.5: Chapa ching in nipi laileh neh akikhol khomin, neh kikhol khom laija kinomsah chapa vang chun jumna amu tei ding ahi.
10.6: Michonpha luchanga phattheina gobang in ajun, mikitah ho kamsunga vang pumtho changa thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
10.7: Mikitah chu akisumil thei jipon, mikitah lou ho min vang chomlou kah'a kisumil ding ahi.
10.8: Miching in thu kisei chan asanje ahen, amoh a thusei vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
10.9: Lungthim kitah a kalsonna chu monna ahin, achena tinchang kisuh boi-achu matdoh a um tei ding ahi.
10.10: Aphalou lam galdot chun gimna asodoh jin, hangsan tah'a mi phohsal a sudih chun chamna asemdoh jin ahi.
10.11: Michonpha kamsung chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, miphalou ho kamsunga vang ki nah na ding thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
10.12: Kivetda nahin kinahna asodoh sah jin, ngailut na vang chun thilse jouse asel mang jitai.
10.13: Thil hetthemna neipa vang chun akamsunga kon thu aseidoh chan le chihna amu jin, lungthim beipa vang chun aphahsam a moltum adou jing ding ahi.
10.14: Miching hon hetna akhol chen un, mingol kamtam hon hamset na akiloilut jiuvin ahi.
10.15: Mihaoho nei leh gou hi akulpia apang jin, vaichate neilal na vang chun manthahna asojin ahi.
10.16: Michonpha chun atohga dungjui'a hinna alhut jin, migilou ho phatchomna vang chun chonsetna alhut jitan ahi.
10.17: Min ahilna ngaipha chun hinna lam ajot jin, min aphona ngaimahpa vang chu avah mang jitai.
10.18: Alungthim'a mudana neipa chun jouthu jeng asei jin, mi enghotna thuseipa vang angol ahi.
10.19: Thu tamseina hin seikhel aumsah teijin, hinlah akam kihup them mi chu mi ching ahi.
10.20: Mikitah pa kamcheng hi dangka manlu tobang ahin, mikitah lou ho lungthim vang pannabei jeng ahi.
10.21: Mikitah pa kamsunga kon in mitampi vah va na ding thu apot jin, mingol ho vang lungthim beijin amang thah jitauve.
10.22: Yahweh Pakai phattheina chan hi haodohna ahin, hichun lungkhamna asodoh sah jipon ahi.
10.23: Thilse bol hi mingol ding in kichep golnop abang jin, thil hetthemna neipa ding in limgeh a chon hi lungkimna ahi.
10.24: Miphalou in mi akichat sahna chu ama chunga ale-lhun jin, mikitah ding in angaichat chan Elohim Pathenin apeh tei ding ahi.
10.25: Khopi hui alan a gopi ajuh teng, miphalou chu atol tha jitan, hinlah mikitah vang tonsot geija tundoh ahitai.
10.26: Juthuh hin ha ajatsah bang le, meikhun mit athipsah bang in, mithase jong agolpa ding in doujou ahipoi.
10.27: Elohim Pathen ginna hi hinkho sotna ahin, miphalou ho hinkho vang kisuchom ding ahi.
10.28: Mikitah ho kinepna chu kipana ahin, miphalou ho kinepna vang pannabei ahi.
10.29: Mikitah ding in Yahweh Pakai hi bitna ahin, thil phalou bolte dinga vang manthahna ahi.
10.30: Mikitah chu kisuloh lou hel ding, miphalou ho vang gamsunga kon'a kichon mang ding'u ahi.
10.31: Mikitah kamsunga kon in chihna apot jin, aphalouva thu motsei vang chu aleigui kitan ding ahi.
10.32: Mikitah chun akam sunga kon in lahthei aseidoh jin, miphalou ho kamsunga kon in vang thu chavei jeng apot jin ahi.

11.1: Thil adihlouva kite hi Yahweh Pakaiyin athet ahin, dihta a akilep-toa akite teng Yahweh Pakai ding in kipa aum-jie.
11.2: Kiletsahnan ahin phah teng, muda nan ahin lhut paijin, milung neng ho ding in vang chihna aum jing e.
11.3: Mikitah ho kamkeh loubeh a aum jiu hi, amasang-diuva lamhil a pang ahin, jou le nal'a thuseija lungthim dihlou hin, ajona leh manthahna aso-sah jitauvin ahi.
11.4: Elohim Pathen lunghan niteng, nei le gou iman apang pon, dihna kiti hi thina dinmun a jong hoidohna a pang ahi.
11.5: Chamdel a um mikitah chu alampi a-jang in, mikitahlou vang chu aphatlouna in alhup denji ahi.
11.6: Mikitah te chu adihna in ahuhdoh jin, jou le nal a thuseina vang chun soh-a apanlo sah ahibouve.
11.7: Miphalou chu athiteng akinepna jong pannabei ahin, Elohim Pathen sumilte dinga kinepna jong pannabei ahi.
11.8: Mikitah chu gim le hesohna kon in akihuhdoh jin, miphalou vang chu gim le hesohna'a alhalut jitai.
11.9: Elohim Pathen sumil mi chun aheng akom manthana ding jeng asei jin, hinlah hetkhen na thahat nei jeh in mikitah te huhdoh in aum-jin ahi.
11.10: Mikitah hon aphalam amano teng, khopi sunga mihemte akipah un, mikitah lou ho chunga manthahna alhun teng, mi akipah jin ahi.
11.11: Mikitah ho chunga phattheina jal in, khopi sung mite dopsang in aum un, hinlah mikitah lou ho thumot sei jeh'in khopi amangthah bep jin ahi.
11.12: Aheng akom hebol lou-pa chu milungthim bei ahin, thil hetkhenna neipa vang chu thipbeh chan aum jin ahi.
11.13: Muntinna thu seilepa chun thuguh jeng jong aseidoh jin, hinlah tahsan theitah mi vang chun thuguh kiti a-im jon ahi.
11.14: Kilamhilna aum louteng mipi kipal tei ding, guhthim cha kithuhilna achun bitna aum teijin ahi.
11.15: Hetlou miho batsah na dia athil tung chun atohga amu tei ding, thil tun ding deiloupa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
11.16: Mi ngailuthem numei chu jana chang tei ding, gitlouna vang chun noisena dimset akimu ding ahi.
11.17: Mi ngailuthem chun phatchomna atoh doh ahin, mi kilose vang chun maha akilam doh-ji ahi.
11.18: Miphalou in jou le nal in tohman amujin, mikitah vang chun muchi pha atun aga alou jitan ahi.
11.19: Thildih tuhchah a ngailu chun hinna anei tei ding, aphalou lam jenga chepa chu thi tei ding ahi.
11.20: Alungthim a thildih lou puho Yahweh Pakaiyin athet in, achena lam lam'a chamdel'a umte chunga Yahweh Pakai akipah jing in ahi.
11.21: Hechen soh keijun, mi koihile engsetna nei chun talen amat ding, mikitah te vang huhdoh-a um tei diu ahi.
11.22: Limgeh a um lou numei kitihi vohpi nahko sunga sana chao kiba bep kheh ahi.
11.23: Mikitah ho dei le ngai chu, apha cha cha jeng ahin, mikitah lou ho kinepna vang chu lungsatna jeng ahibouve.
11.24: Itcha louhel'a hongphal mi chu ahao cheh cheh jin, mihem koi hileh apeh ding kisan nunglah achu lhasam cheh cheh ding ahi.
11.25: Mi hongphal chun anei be cheh cheh ding, mi dang dinga twi chap chan chu ama chunga jong kichap ding ahi.
11.26: Chang hom-lou a koitup chah khehpa chu mipi sapset chang ding, hinlah kiphal tah'a chang homdohpa chunga vang phattheina lhung ding ahi.
11.27: Giltah'a thilpha ngaito pan, lungkimna aneiyin, thilpha lou jong chu aphaloupa chunga aga chu-jitan ahi.
11.28: Nei le gou'a kisongpa chu ahomkeuva um tei ding, mikitah te vang thingna banga nou jing diu ahi.
11.29: Mi koi hileh a-insung vai hom tup lou chu huija leng le tobang bep ahin, chule mingol chun miching ho jenlea pang tei ding ahi.
11.30: Mikitah natoh chu hinna thingphung ga tobang asoh jin, pannabeija kichih sahna hin hinkho manthahna alhut jin ahi.
11.31: Leiset'a mikitah jeng bon akile thuh theileh, miphalou chunga ichan geija lhung ding hitam chule achonsete chunga ichan gei lhung ding hitam!

12.1: Koi hileh kigahna thet lou chun, hetna jong adeijin, min akhou khah ding deiloupa vang chu miching ahipoi.
12.2: Mipha chun Yahweh Pakai lunglam atong jin, setna jeng tohgon neipa vang Yahweh Pakaiyin athetbol jin ahi.
12.3: Phatlouna a kon in inchen amangthah jin, mi chondih ho vang chu koiman asuh-ling jou lou ding ahi.
12.4: Numei pha chu ajipa dinga lallukhuh ahin, jumna le jachatna'a um numei vang ajipa dinga agu achang chip tobang ahi.
12.5: Mikitah te tohgon chu adih a tanpeh ding, hinlah, lungthim dihloute thumop vang chu kijoulhepna jeng ahi.
12.6: Mikitah loute kamcheng chu thisan sona ding jeng ahin, mikitah ho kamcheng vang kihinsona jeng ahi.
12.7: Mikitah loute chu manthahnan alhut loiji tan, mikitah ho vang chu ding det cheh cheh diu ahi.
12.8: Mihem hi alungdih jal'a pachat changji ahin, mihem lungphalou chu thetbolna achang-jin ahi.
12.9: Mi thupi tah banga chon a, neh le chah lhahsam sang in, lung lhaisel'a ana-kitohpa aphajon ahi.
12.10: Mikitah hon agancha jengu jong khohsahna aneiyun, mikitah loutea kon ngailutna vang chu thangsetna ahi.
12.11: Mipontho chun agam leiset akhot-a neh ding aki khol ahin, pannabeija thil ngaitoa lhailepan vang ima aneiji pon ahi.
12.12: Mikitah lou in chu mangthah loi ding, mikitah ho vang chu thingphung phatah in ajung akhodet tobang ahi.
12.13: Mikitah lou chu akamsung sohsa aseikhel thucheng achun akipal jin, mikitah ding in vang gim hesoh akon in ajamdoh jitai.
12.14: Mihem khat chun akam thep-ga anen alungkim jitan, hijeh achu mihem khat in na atoh teng achunga lelhun-ji ahi.
12.15: Mingol hon achena chan-u adih jeng in amu-jiuvin, mikitah vang chun min ahilna angaijin, lam dihlou apeldoh jin ahi.
12.16: Mingol in alunga adeilou chu aphongdoh paijin, mikitah vang chun min ahilouva athet bolna jong iman agel jipoi.
12.17: Mikitah chun thudih aseiteng kicheh sel'in vetsahna aumjin, jou le nal-a thuseipa vang chun amacham cham in thu aseidoh-jin ahi.
12.18: Thu kiti hi, nasatah chemjam banga akidoulel jong aum jin, miching thusei vang chun mihem adamsah-jin ahi.
12.19: Thutah beh seite kamsunga kon in, thudih jeng apot in, thujou seite kamsunga kon vang chu hetman louva manthahna sohji ahi.
12.20: Thilphalou gong ho lung sunga thilse jeng dimset in achengin, thilpha jeng ngaito teding in kipana jeng ahi.
12.21: Mikitah chunga thilse alhung jipon, miphalou te chunga vang gim le hesohna jeng alhung jin ahi.
12.22: Jou le nal jeng seiji leigui chu Yahweh Pakaiyin athet in, thudih a natong te chunga vang Yahweh Pakai akipah-jin ahi.
12.23: Miching hon achih-nau kiletsahpi louvin aum jiuvin, mingol hon vang angolnau chu aphongjal le-jitauve.
12.24: Lungdih pu-hon akhut'un vai ahom jiuvin, khut chalosah nom lou mihem chu soh-a pang tei ding ahi.
12.25: Lunggim a umpa chu atahsa agep liu jin, ngailutna thu ajah teng ama chu kipanan adim jitai.
12.26: Sihnei lang-neina nei lou mihem chun aloi agol ding in thupha jeng aseijin, mikitah loute vang chu abonchauvin amangthah jitauve.
12.27: Natong nom lou chu nehding beija um ding, miching in vang nei le gou nengsel-a aset ding ahi.
12.28: Mikitah lamlhahna chu hinna lampi ahin, lamdih lou chun thina alhut ding ahi.

13.1: Chapa ching chun anu le apan ahilna angaijin, miduhdah lou vang chu min aphona jong iman-agel jipoi.
13.2: Chihna kamcheng in an-pha akimu thei jin, jou le nal jenga thuseipan vang pumthoa mu ding bou agel in ahi.
13.3: Alei kituh tang joupa chu kihinso tei ding, koi hileh alei tuhtang thei lou chu mangthah tei ding ahi.
13.4: Mithase hon nehding tampi angaicha jiuvin, hinlah miching in nehding lungkim sel-in amujin ahi.
13.5: Mikitah in jousei abol ngaipon, mikitah lou vang chun jumna le ngailutna beijin na-atongdoh jin ahi.
13.6: Mikitah chu adihna jal in ahoidoh jin, miphalou vang chu chonsetnan apui mangthah jitai.
13.7: Mi kimkhat chu hao akisah lheh jin, hinlah ima aneideh poi. Mi kimkhatma chu akivai chatsah lheh jin, hinlah nei le gou kimsel-in aneiyin ahi.
13.8: Mihem khat chun anei le agou jal'a ahinkho akilhatdoh ahin, hinlah mivaicha ding in kilhatdoh jouna aum jipoi.
13.9: Mikitah chu thaomei bang in avah jing in, miphaloute thaomei vang hetman louva mit ding ahi.
13.10: Kiletsahna jeh'in thungai loute akitoh thei jipon, kineosah a min ahilna kisante ding in vang chihna ahi.
13.11: Gangtah'a kimu nei le gou chu hetman louva bei ding, nei le gou kholkhom lelepa-a vang chu tam cheh cheh ding ahi.
13.12: Kinepna bang aso-lou teng, mihem lungthim atongkha jin, hinlah lungtup molsona chu hin-thingphung banga hing jing ding ahi.
13.13: Min ahilna ngainom loupa chunga manthahna lhung ding, koi hileh thupeh ngaisanga chu kipaman chang tei ding ahi.
13.14: Miching mihilna chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, hitobang kihilna sang chan chun thina apeldoh teidiu ahi.
13.15: Lungdih kiti hin thilpha atongdoh jin, kitahna beihel mi vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
13.16: Miching ho chun akalson masang in ageltoh masa jin, mingol hon vang geltoh masa louvin, angolnau atah lang jiuvin ahi.
13.17: Thupole miphalou chun miho lunggim hesoh alhut peh jin, ngansena chang tahsan um mi vang chun lungdamna jeng alhut jin ahi.
13.18: Seingai loupa chunga chun gentheina le vetsetna alhung jin, min ahilna chan ngaipa vang chu jabolna chang tei ding ahi.
13.19: Ngaichat khat toh molso nahi hinkhoa dinga lungkimna ahin, hinlah thilse jamsan ding hi mingol hon athet jiuvin ahi.
13.20: Miching toh kivop chu aching in, mingol toh kivoppan vang setna ato tei ding ahi.
13.21: Chonseho chu setna ajui jiuvin, mikitah te vang chu phatthei nan ajui jing un ahi.
13.22: Mipha chun atute khang geija din gou adalhah peh jin, chonseten akhol nei le gou vang chu michonpha ho ding ahibouve.
13.23: Vaichaten lou alho teng, neh ding nengchat in akhol khom un, hinlah adihlouva thutan ten achom peh jitauve.
13.24: Achate mol'a jep loupa chun, mol aboh ding nom lou ahin, hinlah achate ngailutna neipa chun lungthim phatah mangchan ahil-jin ahi.
13.25: Mikitah chun lung nachim tah'a neh ding anei jing in, hinlah miphalou ho chu gelkel'a oi-thep ding ahiuve.

14.1: Numeiching in ain-chen akisemtup in, numei ngol in vang amatah ain-chen sukeh in apangin ahi.
14.2: Lungdih'a lam jot chun Yahweh Pakai a ging in, hinlah achena jousea thilphalou gelpan Yahweh Pakai anahsah jipon ahi.
14.3: Mingol in akijepna ding akiseidoh bep jin, miching hon vang ahoidoh nadiu akiseidoh jiuvin ahi.
14.4: Bongchal loukai ding umlou na-a chang akilamdoh ngai pon, ajeh chu bongchal thahat akon chang tampi kilam-ji ahi.
14.5: Mi kitah hettoh sah-a apan teng jouthu asei ngai pon, mikitah lou hettoh sah-a apan teng jou le nal in thu aseijin ahi.
14.6: Michavai hon chihna ahol-un amu jou deh pouvin, hinlah thil hetthemna neipa ding in chihna hi nailam cha ahibouve.
14.7: Mingol hoa kon'in kikhin mang in, ajeh chu amaho kamsunga kon'in chihna thu kisei japon nate.
14.8: Milungthim ching hon ajot nadiu lampi akihet-un, mingol ho vang joulhepna jeng ahi.
14.9: Elohim Pathenin miphalou aphohsal jin, michonpha hon vang Elohim Pathen lunglhaina akimu jiuve.
14.10: Mihem lungthim hin gim le hesoh ahen, midang in akipanau chu ahetthem peh-un ahi.
14.11: Migilou ho inchu kiphet lhah peh ding, mikitah ho ponbuh vang dettah a kisong jing ding ahi.
14.12: Mihem khat'in achena lampi chu dih-in agel jin, hinlah alampi chu ajonaleh thina ahi.
14.13: Nuijat pat jeng in jong mihem alung kham jin, kipana jeng jong gimnan akichai-ji tai.
14.14: Mikitah lou chu achena chan'a atohga aneh ding, hitobanga chu miphan jong atohga aneh ding ahi.
14.15: Mihem meimeija um chun akisei jouse atahsan jin, miching in vang achena ding akivet phet in ahi.
14.16: Miching hon chingthei tah'in thilse apeldoh jiuvin, mingol hon vang ngol han pum'in na atong jiuve.
14.17: Milungchom hon ngol hoitah in thil abol jiuvin, hinlah thil hethem mivang chu atomngai ahi.
14.18: Mihem meimeija um chu ngolna ahin, miching hon hetna kiti hi lallukhuh a aneiyu ahi.
14.19: Thilse kiti phot chu thilpha masanga dilsu ding, miphalou ho jong mikitah ho kelkot phunga dilsu diu ahi.
14.20: Mivaicha hohi ain-heng ho kisan in athet bol jiuvin, mihao ding in vang golpha atam jin ahi.
14.21: Aheng akom ngailu lou mihem chu achonse ahin, mivaicha ho ngailua chu anunnom ahi.
14.22: Thilse jeng gel hon suhkhel anei tei jiuvin, thilpha jeng ngaito hon vang tahsanna le kitahna akimu jiuvin ahi.
14.23: Natoh hahsa kiti chun aphachom asoh tei ding, natoh beija thumot seina hin vaichat asoji ahi.
14.24: Miching ho ding in chihna hi lallukhuh in apang jin, mingol ho ding in vang ngolna hi pahvui banga aki-o jiu ahi.
14.25: Mikitah hettohsah a apan teng mi tampi huhdoh jin, hinlah thujou seina hin mihem amanthah sahji ahi.
14.26: Elohim Pathen ging kiti hi mihem dinga kisonna ahin, achate jeng jong ama'a kisel diu ahi.
14.27: Yahweh Pakai gin kitihi hinna twinah tobang ahin, ajeh chu mihem in thina jeng jong apeldoh-ji ahi.
14.28: Gamsunga cheng mipite apunbe teng lengpa loupina ahin, hinlah mihem lhomcha ahiteng milen milal dinga pannabei ahibouve.
14.29: Koi hileh lunghang vahlou chun thil hetthemna anei ahin, kino thethua lungchomna vang chun ngol-hoitah atoh doh ding ahi.
14.30: Lungneng tah'a um hi tahsa damna ahin, hinlah thangthipna kiti hi gu le chang in adoulel ahi.
14.31: Mivaicha sugenthei hon asempau Elohim Pathen ataitom nau ahin, amavang nei lou genthei khoto them chun asempa Elohim Pathen agin ahi.
14.32: Miphalou chu toset atosah in alehkhup jin, mikitah ding in vang bitna aum jing in ahi.
14.33: Thil detkhen them mi chun chihna anei jing in, mingolte lungthim sunga vang chihna in mun aneipoi.
14.34: Thudih hin mihem namkhat adom sang in, hinlah chonsetna hin mihem nam pumpi muda achansah ahi.
14.35: Lhacha chingtah'a natong hin, lengpa lunglam aboldoh jin, jachatna natongpa chunga lengpa alungkim jipoi.

15.1: O nem heova mi akidonbut teng alunghang jong alungdam theijin, ahinlah O ngailou tah'a thu kisei vang hin mi aphin lunghang jin ahi.
15.2: Miching ho leigui hin hetna le thepna thu jeng aphongdoh in, mingol ho kamsung invang ngolna thu jeng aphongdoh jin ahi.
15.3: Yahweh Pakaiyin muntin hi amit tenin avelhih jing in, thilse le thilpha kibol jouse jong ahesoh keijin ahi.
15.4: O nem heova thu kiseihi hinna thingphung tobang ahin, thu gilou seina leigui hinvang, mihem lungthim asusen ahi.
15.5: Apan ahilna jahda mihem chu a ngol ahin, asuhkhel na chunga apan ahilna sang nga chu miching ahi.
15.6: Mikitahte insunga nei le gou tampi aum jin, miphalou din akilamdoh jeng jong chu gimna bep ahi.
15.7: Miching kamcheng akon'in thupha jeng apot in, mingol lungsunga kon in vang hiche hi thil-hahsa ahi
15.8: Miphaloute kilhaina gantha hi Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, mikitah ho taona vang Yahweh Pakai ding in lunglhai umtah ahi.
15.9: Miphalou chena lampi chu Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, thildih lam jenga chepa vang Yahweh Pakai hepina achangin ahi.
15.10: Koi hileh lamdih jot nomlou chu engbolna achansah jin, min aphona sangnom lou hon athipi teidiu ahi.
15.11: Yahweh Pakai thilhet thei na hin mithi gam a um ahet dia lom ho jong ahet thei in, achutile mihem lungthim chu ichan geijin ahechen tadem!
15.12: Adihlou a chonpan, min aphondoh ding anom pon, hichepa chu miching ho henga jong ache poi.
15.13: Lungthim kipanan mai alhaisah in, lungthim ahesoh teng lhagao jong angui jitai.
15.14: Hetthemna neipan alunggil in hetna ahol jing in, mingol kamsunga kon in vang ngolna thu jeng apot e.
15.15: Gim le hesoh'a um ho hinkho hi nitin'a thilsen abop ahin, lungthim kipah tah'a um hoding in golvah abang jing in ahi.
15.16: Nei le gou tampi neija, gentheipi sang in, themcha bou neija Yahweh Pakai gin ding athupi joi.
15.17: Bongchal thaotah kitha'a kitomona aso-bep sang in, kingailutah-a ancheme neh khom aphajoi.
15.18: Milungkhoh in kinahna apunsah in, mi lungneng lunghang vahlou in kitomona jong akichamsah in ahi.
15.19: Mithase ho lamlhahna jouse lingle khao'in abap in, mikitah ho lampi vang lamlen kilhong peh-ji ahi.
15.20: Chapa ching in apa akipa sah jin, chapa ngol in vang anu jeng jong iman agel-ji poi.
15.21: Lungthim beipa din ngolna chu lunglhaina ahin, thil hethempa vang ama chal peh jitai.
15.22: Kithumopna alhahsam teng, tohgon ache khel jin, mi akithumop to teng lolhinna ahi.
15.23: Phatah a kidonbut hi mijouse lunglhaina ahin, hijeh chun aphat toh kitoh a thu kisei hi aphat a pha ahi.
15.24: Michingpa lamlhahna chu hinna lampia akilhung tou in, aman gotmun apeldoh jin ahi.
15.25: Yahweh Pakaiyin mi kiletsahho inn aphet lha jin, meithai ho gamgi vang aphet peh jipoi.
15.26: Miphalou lunggel jouse Yahweh Pakaiyin athet in, Mi lungdih ho kamcheng soh vang Yahweh Pakai dinga lunglhai um ahi.
15.27: Koi hileh lamdih louva mutei ding gochan chun, a-insung dinga gimna alhut ahin, ajeh chu neh guh thetbol chan chun hinna amu ding ahi.
15.28: Mikitah hon min thu asei teng, lunggil in adonbut ding dan angaito jin, hinlah mingol te kamcheng soh jouse thilphalou jeng twi kisung lha abang jin ahi.
15.29: Miphalou hoa kon in Yahweh Pakai akidalsen, mikitah ho taona vang angai peh jin ahi.
15.30: Mit-ha hoisel'a mi akivet teng midinga lungthim kipana ahin, thupha kiseidoh jousen mihem gu le chang adamsah ahi.
15.31: Min ahilna ngainom mi chu, miching ho lah'a lha thei ding ahi.
15.32: Koi hileh min ahilna sang thei loupa chun ahinkho agimsah ahin, ajehhcu min ahilna ngainom mi chun hetthemna anei tei ding ahi.
15.33: Yahweh Pakai gin hi chihna dinga kihilna ahin, chule kisuhnemna hi jabolna'a pang ahi.

16.1: Mihem in alung sunga tohgon anei jin, kam kilhang sel'a thu kisei jong Yahweh Pakaiyin adonbut teijin ahi.
16.2: Mihem in angatna lampi chu amit-tenin aven adih jeng in agel in, hinlah Yahweh Pakaiyin alunggel ngaito jouse akhol chil jin ahi.
16.3: Nabol natoh abonchan Yahweh Pakaiya pedoh jeng in, chutileh nathilgon aboncha lolhing ding ahi.
16.4: Yahweh Pakaiyin thil jouse akiman chahna ding dol cheh'a aumsah ahin, migilou jeng jong hahsat nikhoa dinga aumsah ahi.
16.5: Yahweh Pakaiyin mikiletsah kiti athet in, hijeh chun hethem un, amaho chu gotna chang tei diu ahi.
16.6: Tahsan theija chonna le kitahna hin, themmona jeng jong adihsah in, Yahweh Pakai ginna jeh'in mihem in thilphalou apeldoh thei jin ahi.
16.7: Mihem chu achena lam jouse Yahweh Pakai lungdei ahitengleh, Yahweh Pakaiyin ama chu amelmate toh jong akichamsah jitai.
16.8: Thildihlou pum'a kai-tampi kidon khom sang in, thildih'a lhomcha nei ding aphajoi.
16.9: Mihem in alung in chena ding lampi akisem in, Yahweh Pakaiyin achena ding lam ako-peh jin ahi.
16.10: Lengpa kamsunga kon'in Elohim Pathen thusei ahung gingdoh jin, hijeh chun lengpan thu a tankhel jipon ahi.
16.11: Yahweh Pakaiyin thil adih in atetoh jin, hijeh chun thil ijakai Yahweh Pakaiyin atetohsa jeng ahi.
16.12: Leng ho din thil adihlouva bol hi thet umtah ahin, ajeh chu Ama vaihomna hi thudih a kingam ahi.
16.13: Leiguia kon thudih kiseidoh hi lengpa din lunglhai aum in, ajeh chu lengpan thu adih'a sei chu angailun ahi.
16.14: Lengpa lunghan nahi gihsalna ahin, hinlah miching chun lengpa lunghanna adamsah jin ahi.
16.15: Lengpa mailhai sel'a aum teng, damna akibe jin, lengpa lunglhaina jong hi, go hung phin lhaji meilhang tobang ahi.
16.16: Sana sang in chihna kimu dei aum jon, dangka sang'a jong thil hetthemna kisan ding ahi.
16.17: Michondih chu thilse lam'a kon'in akiheidoh jin, achena tinchenga limgehpa chu kihinso teiding ahi.
16.18: Manthah ding kon le kiletsahna ahung lhung loi jin, kipal lhuh ding konleh, lhagaova hoithana ahung um loi jitai.
16.19: Mikiletsah hotoh thil kichomdoh kihop sang in, kineosah a vaichate toh lhat khom anom e.
16.20: Min ahilna ngaija chu khangtou jing ding, chule Yahweh Pakaiya kisong chan chu anunnom ahi.
16.21: Mi-lungchingpa chu thil hethemmi kiti ding, chule lunglhaina'a thuseipan mi athujo tei ding ahi.
16.22: Chihna nei mi chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, mingol ho ngolna hi talen matna bep ahi.
16.23: Miching lung sunga kon chihna thucheng hungpot chan chu, Dan toh akikal jipon, akamcheng soh jouse chu mi thununna ahibouve.
16.24: Ngailutna'a thu kisei hi khoiju tobang ahin, lhagao le tahsa ding in antwitah damna ahi.
16.25: Mikhat ding in lampi khat chu lamdih jeng in akimun, hinlah alampi chu ajona thina ahi.
16.26: Natong gimpa hin, aneh ding gelna'a atoh ahin, ajeh chu aneh nomna alol chun achama atohsah ahitai.
16.27: Mihem pannabei chun thilphalou jeng agel in, akamcheng soh jong melkah gin tobang ahi.
16.28: Thilphalou bolpan, baotamna aso-sah jin, aguh a thuphong lepan golcha kingaitah jong asukhen in ahi.
16.29: Pumthoa natong hon aheng akom jeng jong atilseu-vin, chuting aheng akompa jong lamdih-lou alhung jitai.
16.30: Koi hileh mit teni-singa phetsah jichun, thilpha lou jeng angaiton, muh phunsah sah pan jong thilphalou abolsoh ahita bouve.
16.31: Sam-kang liuva hinna hi, loupina lallukhuh ahin, adih jenga hinkho akiman teng, hitobanga hi hinkhosot thei ahibouve.
16.32: Ki hatsah sang in thohhat tah'a lungneng apha jon, alungput athua nunsah joupa chu, khopi khat nokhum'a kilah sang in aphachom joi.
16.33: Khutphang sunga vang akive jin, hinlah vang phatna leh phatlouna chu Yahweh Pakaiya hung kon bou ahi.

17.1: Insunga kiboina pum'a golvah bolsang in, an-keoseh kineh a lungmonga um aphajoi.
17.2: Soh chingtah chu apupa chapa ahin, chule adihlouva chonpa chunga jong vaihom in apang jin, hiche sohpa chu apupa nei le gou aboncha achapate toh sopi khat banga kihom ding ahi.
17.3: Thil solna bel chu dangka solna kimang ahin, mei-khuh sung hi sana solna ahi. Hinlah Yahweh Pakai hi lungput aboncha patepna ahi.
17.4: Miphalou in akamsunga thilphalou seipa thusei bou angai nom in, chule mijou in jong jou le nal thoa leigui kilehpel chu angai nom in ahi.
17.5: Vaicha noisea tot chaveipa chun asempa Elohim Pathen ataitom ahin, mi vangset pat'a kipah chun gimbolna ato tei ding ahi.
17.6: Tehse ho ding in atute hi alallukhuh-u ahin, chapate loupina hi apateu ahi.
17.7: Mingol ho din thu ngaitah'a kisei hi pannabei ahin, milen milal te ang sunga jou le nal'a thu kisei jong pannabei ahibouve.
17.8: Aguh'a thilpeh kiti hi apepa din vangbohna tobang ahin, hijeh chun achena jousea khang ding ahi.
17.9: Koi hileh suhkhelna ngaidam thei chun, ngailutna angaichat jing ahin, hinlah miphul phul pan vang gol le pai akikhenpi jin ahi.
17.10: Mingol jakhat vei akichup sang in, thil hetthemna neipa ding in akihilna jeng jong asanji ahei.
17.11: Engsetna nei mi chun doumah jeng ahol le jin, amatoh kitoh ding in sottol engse ahung lo jitai.
17.12: Mikhat in mingol khat angol pet'a akimaitopi sang in, vompi nou akilo-doh nungsanga api kimaitopi aphajoi.
17.13: Mihem in thilpha khat thilsea alethuh teng, a-insunga thilse cheng jing ding ahi.
17.14: Kitoma ahung um teng twiput tobang in ahung pot jin, ajeh chu kitomona aso masanga kikhen tel aphajoi.
17.15: Athemmo lha kanga athem-jo mo chansahna hileh, Yahweh Pakai dinga anitah lhonna dei um lou ahi.
17.16: Lungthimbei mingol in chihna kichohna ding sum akhol ngei poi.
17.17: Golngai chun phat tin in mi alungset in, sopi kiti hi hahsat petna kithokhom dinga hung peng ahibouve.
17.18: Lungthim neilou mihem chu bat-san apang jin, hitichun aheng akom hoa batsah nan apang bep e.
17.19: Suhkhel ding ging lou mihem chun kinah baotam adei ahin, ain kotpi paopia kiletsah pan manthahna jeng agon ahibouve.
17.20: Mihem lungput dihlou kiti chu akhang thei pon, jou le nal seija pang kamsung jong vangsetna'a lhalut teiji ahi.
17.21: Chapa ngol hi ahingpa dinga gimna bep ahin, hiche mingolpa hing chu akipah thei poi.
17.22: Lung kipana hi damna pipen ahin, lamvaija um chu gu le chang dinga doulal um ahi.
17.23: Thu adih a tan sang in, miphalou hon sum-guh ane jiuvin, thudih chu achekhel sah jitauve.
17.24: Thil jouse hetthemna nei mi chun chihna lam jeng aven, ajon in, hinlah mingol chun leiset kol mang avelen ahi.
17.25: Chapa in apa lunggimna asodoh peh in, anu dinga gimna tah ahi.
17.26: Mikitah ahilou lam'a leosah kiti apha pon, vaihom milen milal jep ding jong thildih ahipoi.
17.27: Thu kisei ngaija chu hetna anei jin, chule lungneng tah'a thusei mi chun hetkhenna anei ahi.
17.28: Mingol jeng jong thipbeh cha aum teng, miching bang in akigel jin, hitobang michun akam akeh lou teng, miching tah bang in akigel-ji bouve.

18.1: Mihem ama changseh kikhoh sahpa chu ama dei lam jeng-ah akisalal jin, thildih lam ki manchahna jouse adoudal jin ahi.
18.2: Mingol in thil hetthem'a lunglhai ding kiti anahsah pon, ama lung ngaichat jeng bou akhoh sah-jin ahi.
18.3: Phatlouna ahung um teng, thangset nan ahin jui in, kijatona abei teng kimudana aum paijin ahi.
18.4: Miching kamsunga kon hung potdoh thuchang hohi twithuh tobang ahin, chihna jong hi vadung tehliu'a twilong tobang ahi.
18.5: Miphalou maija langnei hi angaina ahipon, mikitah chungthu adih'a tan ding jong suh-noh phah lou ding ahi.
18.6: Mingol thucheng hin mitoh kinahna ason, akamchenga kon in mol akisei doh bep jitai.
18.7: Mingol kamcheng hi ama dinga amanthahna bep ahin, aleigui in ama le ama thangkol'a o-na ding akisemdoh bep ahi.
18.8: Aguh a thu poa pangpa thusei jihi, anneh twitah tobang ahin, akamcheng sohdoh jouse jong mihem lungsunga alhalut paijin ahi.
18.9: Atohna chunga mithase hi, mi manthah sahpa toh sopi ahi.
18.10: Yahweh Pakai minhi kulpi nasatah tobang ahin, hijeh chun mikitah in abel-jin hoidohnan aneiye.
18.11: Mihaopa nei le gou chu ama din kulpi dettah tobang ahin, akihuh hingna dinga pal kikai bep bep ahi.
18.12: Mihem amanthah kon leh, kiletsah nan adim jin, koi hileh akineosa masa chan chu jabolna chang ding ahi.
18.13: Thil hetchet masanga donbut jeng chun, ngol-houi tah jumna ato tei ding ahi.
18.14: Mihem lhagao in dam-mona athoh jou in, hinlah lhagao adamlou teng thoh hahsa ding ahi.
18.15: Chihna lungthim neihon phat tin'in hetbe ding adei-jun, hijeh chun miching hon hetna mube ding ago jing un ahi.
18.16: Mihem kiti hi athilpeh chun lampi agonpeh-ji ahin, hijeh chun milen milal henga jong apuilut jin ahi.
18.17: Mihem khat'in achung thu akikhol masah teng, adih in akimu nan, akihehpi dingpa ahung lhun'a akikhol chaisoh teng, achung thu kiseipan bep ahi.
18.18: Vang vetna kiti hin baotamna abeisah jin, akidou teni kah'a jong thutan in apang e.
18.19: Sopi khat in asopi khat apanpi hi, kulpi dettah tobang ahin, hinlah kinahna aso teng khopi kelkot kikam chah kheh tobang ahi.
