12.5: Chujong leh Judah phung mite amahole amaho kihou lim untin Jerusalem mipiten a Pathen-u hatchungnung Pakai thahatna change ahitauve ati dingu ahi.
12.6: Hicheni chuleh keiman Judah phung hochu thingkho koudohsah mei, ahilou leh chang phellhah a kolphe thaomei kivah kabahsah ding, amahon ajet avei uva cheng nammite ahallhah ding Jerusalem cheng mipi vang chu lungmonga cheng diu ahi.
12.7: Pakaiyin Judah phung amoh chengse chu galjona apeh masatding ajeh chu Jerusalem mipite leh David sonlepahte hin Judah phung amoh ho sanga hi loupina amudeh lou ding ahi.
12.8: Hicheni lechun Pakaiyin Jerusalem mipite ahuhdoh ding, alah uva alhasam pen jeng jong leng David banga hatdiu chuleh David sonhochu Pathen toh bangding, amasang sang uva che Pakai vantil to bangdiu ahi.
12.9: Ajehchu hiche nile hin Jerusalem doudinga hung chitin namtin jouse chu ka suh mang ding ahi.
12.10: Hiche jouteng chuleh taona le ngailuitna lhagao chu David insungah Jerusalem mipite chunga kabuhlhah ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh asutpau keima chu eimu diu, min achapa khatseh chunga alunghom bang uva alunghom pidiu. Min achapa masapen athia alungnatpi banga alungnatpi diu ahi,
12.11: Hichenia Jerusalema lungkham nale lung hemna chu Maggido phaichama Haddad-rimmon lungkhamna nasatah chu toh bang ding ahi.
12.12: Israel pumpi lungkhamna chu ama phung changcheh lungkhamna hiding chuleh jipa chengin ajinu chengutoh akikhenniu tobang hidiu ahi. David phungin achangin lungkhampin tin, Nathan phungin jong alungkham piding,
12.13: Hitia chu Levi phung jong chule Shimi phungjong chute ding ahi,
12.14: Judah phung sunga ahing doh hoa konna hi achu atumma lungkham diu, chuleh ajipateu ajinu cheh-u toh akikhen niu lungkhamna hi ding ahi.

13.1: Hiche nikhoteng chuleh David insung mite dingleh Jerusalem mipite ding in twinah khat kihongdoh intin, hiche twinah chun achonset nau leh athem lounaova konna asoptheng diu ahi
13.2: Hiche nikho chuleh nahouvu semthu Pathen hohi amin-u kisan ana suhmil sohhel theina diuva gamsung pumpia semthu Pathen hojouse hi kasuh mang sohkei ding ahi. Chuleh lhangao boh vop themgao lhemho jong hiche gamma konna kadel doh ding ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseije.
13.3: Koitabang hamkhatnin gaothusei chu ajomma ahileh ahinga anu apa tahin nangin Pakai minna jouthu naseidoh jeh'in nathi teitei ding ahi tia aseipeh ding chuleh hitia chu asei teitei leh ahinga anule apa tah in chemma asutlih ding ahi.
13.4: Hiteng chuleh themgao ho jousen gao thudihlou asei uchu jachat piuvin tin, themgao vonjong vonngam tapouvintin, themgao tiajong kisei ngamta pouvinte.
13.5: Chujongleh keima themgao kahipoi, loubolmi kahibouve kaneo a patna lou hinlhou kahi bouve atidiu ahi.
13.6: Khat touvin ahileh naop achu ipi maha baham atiuleh aman kagol kapaiho in na eimavonau ahi atiding ahi.
13.7: “Thoudoh in Vo Chemjam kakelngoi chingpa leh katohkhom pipa douna ding in tin hatchungnungpen Pakaiyin aseije. Kelngoi chingpa chu sat lhun, akelngoi hochu jam cheh nauvinte chuteng keiman kelngoiho chunga kakhutlam nange ati.
13.8: Hitichun gamsunga mipate chu hopthuma hopni kithat gam ding hopkhat chu gamsung a hi kidalhadiu ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije.
13.9: Keiman hicheng chu meilah a kon in puidoh ingting kasuhtheng ding ahi. keiman dangka bangin sutheng in ting sana banga kalhit theng ding ahi. Amahon kaminna eihin koudiu chujong leh ka hou ding ahi. Keiman amahohi kamite ahi kati ding ahin amahon Amahi Pakai le ka Pathen ahi atidiu ahi” ati.

14.1: Chingthei jun, ajehchu Pakaigam hunglhung ding ahi, hiche nikho lechun na-angsung tah uva min nathil nalo’u achom ding ahi.
14.2: Keiman Jerusalem satdinga chitin namtin kakhop ding, khopi hi alah diu, ima jouse hi achom diu, numeiho asuhset diu, mipi akehkhat galhinga kiman ding, chuleh amoh chengse chu khopi sunga kidalha ding ahiuve.
14.3: Hiteng chuleh hiche chitin namtin hochu tumasanga banga chu kisatpi dinga hung kon doh ding ahiuve.
14.4: Hiche nikho chuleh akeng in Jerusalem solang Olive molchunga chu hung ding ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh Olivet molchu kehni hung kisontin solamle lhumlam hung kikhenna phaicham lentah khat hung kijedohding ahi. Mol akehkhat chun sahlang hin jon intin chuleh akehkhat chun lhang lang ajotding ahi.
14.5: Nangho phaicham lam jonna nachediu Azal changei naphahdiu ahi. Judah lengpa Uzzah nikhoa lingkiho jeh a najammu tobang chu hiding ahi. Chujou teng Pakai ka Pathen chu hung intin amitheng te jousen ahin kilhonpi diu ahi.
14.6: Hicheni lechun nisavah umlou ding,
14.7: Ahinla sunchu hijengding ahi! Hichehi iti hithei ding ham tichu Pakaiyin bou ahet ahi. Angaija anaum sunle jan chu um talou ding ajeh chu nilhah lang jong leh vahvah jeng ding ahi.
14.8: Hicheni lechun Jerusalema konna hintwi hung longdoh ding, akehkhat Dead Sea langa chentin akehkhat Mediterranean langa chen tin chuhleh khalla longlong jing ding ahi.
14.9: Chuteng leiset pumpia Pakai hung leng chang intin, Pakai chu khatbou hiding ama minbou chu min ahin houding ahi.
14.10: Gamsung pumpi Judah sahlang Geba-apat Jerusalem lhanglam Rimmon geihi phaicham lentah hung hiding, amavang Jerusalem vang hi ama mun mama-a kikhang sang ding chuleh in ningkoi kelkot gei, chujouteng hannanol inting Vamampat lengpa lengpitwi chillhana nungei mi hungcheng dimsoh ding ahi.
14.11: Jerusalem hi mi hung dimding sapset chang talou helding, hung kisuse talou ding achaina keija hoibitna khopi hung hiding ahi.
14.12: Chuleh Pakaiyin Jerusalem khopi satna nabol chitin namtin ho chunga suhgamna hoise ahin lhadingchu hitiding ahi. Akeng uva adinpet jeng uva jong chu atahsau monlha jeng ding, amit kosung uva jong amitchang’u monlha jeng ding chuleh akamsung uva jong aleiju monlha jeng ding ahi.
14.13: Pakai jepna achung'uva che ding amaho tijatna dim ding, amitakip atophah phah chunga akhutna alap jeng diu ahi.
14.14: Judaten jong Jerusalem huhna-a gal asat diu avel uva um nam dang ho gou, sana dangka chuleh nihchen ponsil tamtah akichom dohdiu ahi.
14.15: Hiche gamna hisehi sakolte le sakolpolte, sangong sauté leh sangante chunga jong chuleh galmite ngahmuna um ganchadang ho jouse chunga jong chusoh kei ding ahi.
14.16: Achaina teng, Jerusalem hinsatna galmiho hiche gamma hisea konna hoi doh hochu kumseh leh Jerusalemma chetou diu hatchungnungpen Pakai kiti leng chu aga hou diu chuleh lhambuh kut mang dinga che jeng diu ahi.
14.17: Vannoi leiset a koinam hamkhat hatchungnung pen Pakai, kiti lengpa chu hou dinga che lou aum khah leh agam sung uva go ju lou ding ahi.
14.18: Egypt mite hiche kut a hi apan nomlou uleh Pakaiyin amaho chu namdang ho tobanga che nomlou ho chunga achuhsah gamna hise tobang bangchu achung'uva achuh sah ding ahi.
14.19: Egypt leh namdang jouse hiche lhambuh kut mang dinga che nom lou jouse chunga chu hiche engbolna chu chu ding ahi.
14.20: Hiche nikho hileh sakolte kikanna savunkhao chung dunga jong, “Pakai ja atheng,” tia kijih soh kei ding ahi. Pakai Hou-in sunga bel jouse jong, maicham maija khon ho tobanga athenga um ding ahi.
14.21: Atahbeh in, Jerusalem leh Judah gam sunga kho ho jouse jong hatchungnung pen Pakaiya dinga atheng hi ding ahi. Pakai hou dinga hung jouse chun hiche bel hohi pumgo thilto ho honnadinga adeidei amantheidiu ahi. Chuleh hiche nikho lechun hatchungnung Pakai Hou-in ahi kivei mi ho um thei lou ding ahi.

1.1: Pakaiyin Malachi mangchan Israelte koma thu athot in ahi.
1.2: Pakaiyin hitin a sei’e, “Keiman nangho ka hingailu jing uve” ati. Ahinlah nanghon nei donbutnuvin “Iti nei ngailutnu ham” natiuve. Pakaiyin Esau chu Jacob sopi hilou ham? Ahinlah keiman Jacob kangailun ahi.
1.3: Esau chu ka thet in chuleh keiman a thinglhang gam chu ka suhchai peh helin, agoulona ding gam chu Sialte lhatna neldi gam kaso sahin ahi.
1.4: Esau chilhah Edom in hiti hin hinsei jintin, keiho nei suchip deluvin ahi. Ahinlah keihon kaga phah nauva konna kahung kile kituva ka kisem phat kitdiu ahi, atiuve. Hat chungnung Pakai chun hiti hin aseije. “Amahon sapha jong leu keiman ka phetlhah peh diu ahi. Amaho chenna chu mipha lou gam kiti ding chuleh amite’u chu Pakai lunghan jing na mite” kiti ding ahiuve.
1.5: Nanghon a kisuhmang na chu na mit tah uva namu tengule nangin, “Tahbeh in, Pakai loupina hi Israelte gamgi kalpeh a mihon jong amu uve” tin seijin nate.
1.6: Hatchungnung Pakai chun thempu ho komah hitin aseije. “Chan apa ajabol le, soh in a pakai pa agin ding ahi. Keihi napau le na Pakai pau kahile hoi chi ham nei jabolnau, hoiche ham nei jen nau? Nanghon ka min hi nahsah louvin nabolun ahi! Ahinlah nanghon na seijun kei hon namin nahsah louva kakoi khah um natiu’ve.
1.7: Nang hon ka maichama an thenglou na toh’un ahinlah nanghon iti danna nangma ka suhboh diu ham? natiuve. Nanghon Pakai maicham jana peh angaipoi natiu chu na suhbohu ahi.
1.8: Nanghon ganhing mitcho pumgo thilto a nahin to uchu dih mong’a hinam? Chuteng leh nanghon a elbai le a damlou ganhing nato uchu dih mong hinam? Nanghon hitobang ho chu nagam vaipo ho kipa thilpehin gape leu chun a kipah nadiuvem? tin hatchungnung Pakai chun a seijin ahi.
1.9: Tun kipat un Pakaiyin nakhotona diuvin tao’un, ahinla hitobang thilpeh chu maichama napeh jingle Pakai chun iti khotona na musah ding ham? tin hatchungnung pen Pakai chun aseije.
1.10: Hiche Hou-In kot hi nangho laha khat pen penin khah chahleu chun kati lheh jeng’e, chuti leh hiche thil thonlou hung kitodoh ho hi umlou ding ahi. Ajeh chu keima na chunguvah kalung lhaipoi chuleh na thiltou jong ka sanpeh lou diu ahi, tin van sepaite Pakaiyin aseije.
1.11: Ahinlah namdanga kon mipiten jingkah nilhahin vanoi leiset pumpia hin gimnamtui leh atheng hohi kamin loupina dingin a todoh jingun kamin hi aloupi sahun chitin namtin laha hin kamin hi choisang in aum in ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
1.12: Ahinlah nangho natohdan hin ka min na sumin seuvin ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai dokhang hi kisuhboh jongle akhoh poi natiuvin thilthenglou pou na hintoh’un ahi.
1.13: Nanghon, kon Pakai alunglhaisah jou ding ham natiuvin ka thupeh na taitomun ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije “Gel uvin adamlou a elbai chuleh a ki gu doh gancha pou na hin todoh jiuve, hichu ken iti ka sanpeh ding nahiuvem? tin Pakaiyin aseije”
1.14: Koi hijongleh Pakai kom’a toh dinga kitepna neija aki lomlou joh hintoh chan chu sapsetna chang ding ahi. Chutengleh chitin namtin laha kamin hi mi gin le ja kahithei ding ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakai chun a seije.

2.1: Tun thempu hon ngaiuvin hiche thupeh hi nangho dinga ahi.
2.2: Kasei hi ngai’unlang ka min jabolna ding in lunggel thah na nei tan, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije. Achuti louleh na chunguva sapsetna nasatah kalhunsah ding ahi. Tahbeh in keiman ka sapsetsa nahitauve, ajeh chu nanghon kagihnau chu na gelkhoh pouve.
2.3: Keiman na chilhahteu ka engbol a thilboh ho chu na maichanguva ka thekhum ding ahi. Chu tengleh na thilbol ho lah’a ka selut ding nahiuve.
2.4: Chutengleh nanghon Levite toh nakitepnau achejom theina dinga gihsalna vopsah chu keima kahi chu nahin hetdoh ding’u ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije.
2.5: Levite toh kitepna ka nanei nalopen chu na hinkhouva chamna nanei theina diuva kana peh’u ahi. Hiche hin amaho’a konna jana leh ginna kachantheina ding a hin amahon jana lentah eina peuvin kamin loupina dingin ana ding chahkheh’un ahi.
2.6: Amahon keija konna amu’u thupeh ho chu amiteu anape sonnun ahi. Amahon jou le tah chonna ana neipouve, amahon keidei lampi ana chepiuvin phatna leh chonphatnaa konin mi tamtah ahin le puidoh kit’un ahi.
2.7: Pathena konna chihna leh hetthem theina hi thempu ho kom’a konna hung potdoh ding hitia chu mipi ho chu amaho kom’a thuhil ngaicha a cheji diu ahi. Ajehchu amaho hi hatchungnung Pakai thuhil pole ho ahiuve.
2.8: Ahin nangho thempuhon Pathen lampi na peltauve nang ho thuhila konin mi tachonsea alhalut tauvin ahi. Nanghon Levite toh ka kitepna chu na suboh tauvin ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
2.9: Hijeh achu keiman nang ho hi vannoi mite ho mitmu a kidah umtah leh noise umtah ka hisah nahitauve. Ajeh chu nanghon ka thu nangai pouvin, ka thuhil dungjuijin na chon pouvin mipi lah a sihnei langneina in na natongun ahi.
2.10: Eiho hi mipa khat cheh ihiu hilou ham? Eiho hi Pathen khatseh sem ihi louvu ham? Chuti ahileh iti danna eiho leh eiho ikilhep lhahuva ipu ipateu Pathen toh iki tepnau chu i-suhkehu hitam?
2.11: Judah akitah poi, Jerusalem leh Israelte lah a thil dihlou tah ahung lhung tai. Juda miten semthu milim hou numeiho a kichenpiuvin Pakai muntheng a suboh tauve.
2.12: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitobang bol ho jouse chuleh hatchungnungpen Pakai henga thilto dihlou hin choi ho jouse hi Israel namlaha konin amaho hi hatchungnung Pakaiyin ka chomkhen tan ahi.
2.13: Chuleh nanghon thildang nabol’u jong aum’e. Pakaiyin na thiltou anah sahlou jeh leh alunglhai lou jeh, asan thei lou jeh'in Pakai maicham chung chu na mitlhi na chupsahin kap leh lunghem tahin na khoisa in ahi.
2.14: Nangman na seijin, “Pakaiyin ipi dinga ka taona hi asan lou ham nati.” Keiman seipeh ing kate! Ajeh chu na khandonlaija na jinei a chu ahetoh a Pakai pang ahi. Ahinlah amanu naji hina a na kichen lhonna na kitepna lhon dungjuiya kitah taha aum vang'in nang vang kitahlou tahin na hung chon tan ahi.
2.15: Pakaiyin naji toh pumkhat hidinga na goplhon hilou ham? Tahsa leh lhagaova ama a nahi lou ham? Chuleh aman adei chu ipi ham? Na kigop lhonna pat Pathenna nahi lhon hilou ham? Hijeh chun phatah in kingaiton lang na khandonlaija na jinu a chun kitah tahin um'in, ati.
2.16: Ajeh chu keiman kida hi ka mah ahi! tin Israel Pathenin aseijin ahi. Na jinu chu na da leh ama chunga chu engsetna nalhut khum ahitai, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei’e. Hijeh chun ki tomla in na jinu chunga na kitepna lhon sukeh hihin.
2.17: Na kampaovin na Pakai chu suboi hihun; nang hon iti kasuhboi uvem? tiuvin nate: thilse bol hi Pakai mitmua thilpha ahin, ama lunglhaina ahi natiu hin Pakai chu nalung phatmosahu ahi, thu adihtaha tan Pathen chu um hinam natiu hin, nalung phatmosahu ahije.

3.1: Veuvin keiman ka masanga lampi sujang dingin ka thu polepa ka sol’e, chutengleh na hol jing na Pathen chu pohphunga Hou-In a hung kilah jing ding ahi. Nanghon mukal na ngalel’u kitepna thu hungtei ding ahi, tin van janel Pakai chun asei’e.
3.2: “Ahinlah ahung tengleh koi ham adoujou ding ah? Koiham ama ahung kilah tengleh amaija ding ngam dingah? Amachu thih kilhajol meikong al’lenglung tobang ding, ahilouleh pon sop bangna sabon tobang ding ahi.
3.3: Sana lhajolpan, sana alhahjol banga, manthei louho a suhtheng ding, dangka leh sana asuhjol tobanga asuhjol ding chutengleh Pakai komma santheidol thilto ahin neithei ding ahi.
3.4: Hiteng le chun Pakaiyin akomma hung kichoilut Jerusalem leh Juda mipite thilto ho chu tumasanga banga ahin santhei kit ding ahi tai.
3.5: Chuteng chuleh keima thutan dinga na kom’u kahin nai ding phunsan themho, mijong ho, mijou ho, sum lo a na tong ho, thaman penom lou ho, meithai holeh, nulepa beiho chuleh gamchom mi na lahuva cheng ho chunga thu adiha tan nomlou ho chuleh keima seijui lou ho chu ka engbol ding ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei’e.
3.6: Keima Pakai kahin kikhelna neilou kahi. Hijeh a chu nangho Jacob chate na kisumang soh louvu ahi.
3.7: Napu napateo khanglaija pat’in nanghon ka danthu ho na nahsah pouvin jui jong na jui pouve. Tun hung kile kit ding ka hi tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei’e. Ahinlah nanghon na sei jun keiho chebon ki che mang kha louva iti ka kile kit diu ham? na tiuve.
3.8: Mihemin Pathen achom angai ham? Ahinlah nanghon nei chomun ahi! ahijeng vang'in nanghon na sei jun “Pathen chu iti ka chom diu ham?” na tiuve. Na hopsom to lou jeh ule thilto to ding na tolou jeh uva nei chom’uvah ahi.
3.9: Hitia keima nei chom jeh uva na nam pumpiuva na ki gaosap sohkeiju ahitai.
3.10: Hopsom jouse akholna munna hinlhut soh keijun chutileh ka Hou-In sunga nehleh chah lhingset ding ahi. Hiti a chu na bol uleh keiman van gam lang kot jouse ka hon lhah a phathei bohna lhingset a, akholna let lha gei ja ka hin sunlhah ding ahi. Hiti chun keima jeng jong hi nei patep mun tin hat chungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije.
3.11: “Na chang le na min jong pha ding ahi, ajeh chu a susethei ho jousea konna ka ventup peh ding, na lengpi thei ho jong amin masanga lhulhop lou ding ahi” tin hatchungnung Pakai jin aseije.
3.12: “Chuteng chuleh chitin namtin in mi nunnom ahiuve ati diu ajeh chu na gamsung chu kipana dimset ding ahi” tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseije.
3.13: Pakaiyin asei’e, “Nanghon kei dounan thupha loutah tah na sei’uve, ahinla nanghon nangma douna a ipi ka sei uvem?” na tiuve.
3.14: Nanghon, Pathen kin bolhi ipi phachom nam? na tiuve. A thupeh dungjui ja ichon’uva ipi phachom am, ahilouleh ka chonset jeh uvin ka kisih uve tia hatchungnung Pakai komma isei uva ipi phachom am? natiuve.
3.15: Tua pat'in mi kiletsah ho phathei achangin, thilse bolho a haodohun Pathen engbolna thoh ngap ho jong ahao doh theije, na tiuve.
3.16: Chujou chun Pakai ging khencha umho chu khat le khat akihouvun ahileh Pakaiyin amaho kihouna chu angai pehin ahi. Pakai angsunga chun, Pathen ging jing holeh amin domsang nom jing ho geldoh jingna dingin lekhajol khat a amin’u aki pehlutin ahi.
3.17: “Amaho chu ka mite hi diu ahi” tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin ahi. Keiman thu katanna nikho teng leh amaho chu atum be a kasahlut tah, ka gou hi diu, mipan athu ngai, acha thilsea konna ahoi doh banga, kenjong ama ho chu kahoidoh sah ding ahi.
3.18: Chuteng leh nanghon michonpha le michonpha lou nahet khenuva Pathen kin bol hole abollou ho na hetkhen thei diu ahi.

4.1: Hatchungnung Pakai chun asei’e, “Thutan nikho ahung lhuna, meilhum sunga meikong alonlut jeng tobang'in ahung’e.” Hiche nikhole hin mi kiletsah ho leh miphalou jouse changpol banga a kahlhah diu amaho chu thingjung leh thingbah hobanga akahvam sohkei ding ahi.
4.2: Ahinlah kamin ging khenna umho ding vang chun, chonphatna nisa hungsohin tin, alha ning te nia chun midam sahtheina ahinpoh ding nang ho jong na tha’u nomma bongkul sunga konna bongnoute hamdong ne dinga hung kilha doh banga kipah leh thanom taha na lhaile diu ahi.
4.3: “Hiche nia kei kahung kipat teng nangin miphalou hochu vutvai na chotpha banga na chotpha ding ahitai,” tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije.
4.4: Keiman Israelte jouse dinga Sinai molla ka peh danpi le chonna ding danho jouse chu geldoh in lang nit jing in, ati.
4.5: Ven keiman Pakai nikho loupe tah leh kichat umtah chu ahung lhun masang in Themgao Elijah chu ka hinsol masan ahi.
4.6: Elijah hin mipate lungthim jouse achateu lungthim banga ahei doh peh a acha teu lungthim jouse jong apateu lungthim banga aheidoh pehding ahi. Achuti louleh keima kahunga gamsung chu kasuhmang ding ahi.

1.1: Hiche hi Abraham le David a kona hung kikhai lha, Messiah Yeshua khanggui thu kisun doh chu ahi.
1.2: Abraham chapa chu Isaac, chule Isaac chapa chu Jacob, Jacob chapa chu Judah le asopite ahiuve.
1.3: Judah chapa chu Perez le Zerah ahilhon in (Anu lhon chu Tamar ahi), chule Perez chapa chu Hezron, chule Hezron chapa chu Ram ahi.
1.4: Ram chapa chu Amminadab, chule Amminadab chapa chu Nahshon chule Nahshon chapa chu Salmon ahi.
1.5: Salmon chapa chu Boaz (Anu min Rahab) ahin, Boaz chapa chu Obed (Anu chu Ruth) chule Obed chapa chu Jesse ahi.
1.6: Jesse chapa chu Leng David, chule David chapa chu Solomon (Anu chu Uriah jinu Bathsheba) ahi.
1.7: Solomon chapa chu Rehoboam ahin Rehoboam chapa chu Abijah chule Abijah chapa chu Asaph ahi.
1.8: Asaph chapa chu Jehoshaphat ahin, Jehoshaphat chapa chu Jehoram ahin chule Jehoram chapa chu Uzziah ahi.
1.9: Uzziah chapa chu Jotham ahin, Jotham chapa chu Ahaz chule Ahaz chapa chu Hezekiah ahi.
1.10: Hezekiah chapa chu Manasseh ahin, Manasseh chapa chu Amon ahin, chule Amon chapa chu Josiah ahi.
1.11: Josiah chapa chu Jehoiachin le asopi pasal ho ahiuve (Babylon a apuimang laiyuva peng ahiuve).
1.12: Babylon a puimang ahi jouvin: Jehoiachin chapa chu Shealtiel ahin, chule Shealtiel chapa chu Zerubbabel ahi.
1.13: Zerubbabel chapa chu Abiud ahin, Abiud chapa chu Eliakim ahin, chule Eliakim chapa chu Azor ahi.
1.14: Azor chapa chu Zadok ahin, Zadok chapa chu Akim ahin, chule Achim chapa chu Eliud ahi.
1.15: Eliud chapa chu Eleazar ahin, Eleazar chapa chu Matthan ahin, chule Matthan chapa chu Jacob ahi.
1.16: Jacob chapa chu Mary jipa Joseph ahi. Hiche Mary a kona hi Yeshua kiti Messiah chu ana peng ahi.
1.17: Achunga ki jihdoh ho hi—Abraham apat David chan gei khang som le li sung ahin, David apat Babylon a puimanga aum gei chu khang som le li sung ahin, chule Babylon a puimanga aum uva pat Messiah hung chan gei chu khang som le li ahi.
1.18: Hiche hi Yeshua Messiah hungpen thudol ahi. Anu Mary hi, Joseph to kicheng dinga kitepna neisa ahi. Ahinlah aum khom masang lhon in, Lhagao Theng thilbol theina a nungah theng ahipet in, amanu hi naovop ahi akihedoh tai.
1.19: Chutah in, aji dingpa Joseph chu mipha ahijeh'in, japi het in jumna ape nom pon, hijeh chun guhthim'a kikhenpi din lunggel aneitai.
1.20: Hitia lung angaito lai hin Pakai vantil khat ahenga ahung kilah in ajah a “Joseph, David chapa, Mary chu ji dia nakipui ding kicha hih in, ajeh chu naocha asunga umkhu Lhagao Thenga kona kijil ahi.
1.21: Chule amanu hin chapa khat ahin nei ding, nangman amin Yeshua tia nasah ding ahi, ajeh chu Ama hin Amite achonset nauva kon'a ahuhhing ding ahi,” ati.
1.22: Hiche ho jouse hi Pakai thupo, athemgao thusei gui lhunna dinga sohdoh ahitai:
1.23: “Vetem un! Nungah theng khat in nao ahinvop ding ahi! Amanu hin chapa khat ahin ding chule amin Emmanuel asah dingu hichu ‘Pathen in eium piuve,’” tina ahi.
1.24: Chujouvin Joseph ahung khahdoh phat in, Pakai vantil thupeh bang in abol in, chule Mary chu ajidin akipui tai.
1.25: Ahinlah achapa pen masang sen amanu hi kitoh khah pilou hel in aum in, chuin Joseph chun amin Yeshua asahtai.

2.1: Leng Herod vaipoh laiyin, Judea gam Bethlehem a Yeshua ana peng in ahi. Hiche pet chun solam gamkai hoa kon in miching phabep Jerusalem khopia ahung un, amaho chun adong un,
2.2: “Juda nam mite lengthah hungpeng chu hoilaiya umham? Kei hon Ama ahsi hung sohdoh chu solam a kamu uvin chule Ama chu, hou dinga hunga kahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
2.3: Leng Herod chun hiche thu ajah phat in ama le Jerusalem a cheng jouse alung kham lheh jeng un ahi.
2.4: Aman thempu pipui ho leh hou dan thuhil ho akhom in “Messiah hoilai muna peng ding ham?” tin amaho chu adong tai.
2.5: Amahon adonbut un, “Judea gam Bethlehem a atiuve, ajeh chu themgao vin hiti hin ajih e:
2.6: ‘Chule nangma, vo Bethlehem Judah gam'a um, Judah khopia vaipo holah a aneopen nahi poi, ijeh inem itileh nangma a kona vaipo khat, kami Israelte ching dingpa chu hung ding ahi,’” atiuve.
2.7: Chutah in Herod chun miching ho chu guhthim in aki houpin, amahoa kon in ahsi akimu masat phat chu ahedoh tai.
2.8: Chutah in aman amaho chu aseipeh in, “Bethlehem a che uvin chule naosen chu ching thei tah in gahol un, ama chu namu teng uleh, hungkit un chule keima neiseipeh un, chutia keima jong kaga chea Ama chu kaga hou theina ding in,” ati.
2.9: Lengpa thu ajah jou uchun miching ho chu ache uvin ahileh, solam a ahsi amu uchu amasang uva ache peh in, Bethlehem lama apuiyun chule naosen umna mun chunga chun akingan ahi.
2.10: Amahon ahsi chu amu phat uvin, amaho chu kipanan alungu alodim tai!
2.11: Amaho insunga alut uva ahileh naosen chu anu Mary toh ana umkhom amu uvin, chuin amaho aboh khup uvin, Ama chu ahou tauve. Chuin amahon agou bom'u chu ahong doh uvin, ama chu Sana, Bego chule Myrrh kipa thilpeh in ape tauvin ahi.
2.12: Chujouvin amahon adalhah tauvin ahileh, Pathen in amang uva Herod heng lama kile lou dinga agihsal jeh'u chun, lam chom aho uvin agam lam uva akile tauve.
2.13: Miching ho ache doh jou uvin, Pakai vantil khat Joseph mang'in akilah in, “Kipatdoh in! Egypt gama naosen le anu chutoh jam uvin. Hiche mun achun hung kile kit dinga kaseipeh kahsen umden un, ajeh chu Herod in naosen chu tha dinga ahol ding ahi” tin aseipeh tai.
2.14: Chuche jan chun naosen chutoh anu Mary chu Joseph in apuiyin Egypt'a din, hiche mun chu adalha tauvin ahi.
2.15: Chule Herod thi kahsen chua chun aum den tauve. Hiche hi Pakaiyin themgao kam'a ana phondohsa: “Keiman ka Chapa chu Egypt a kakou doh e” ti gui lhunna ahi.
2.16: Miching hon angol bol'u Herod chun ahet doh phat in alung hang lheh jengtai. Aman chapang pasal jouse, miching hon ahsi so masat phat aseiyu totoh in, kum nia lhah noi-lamse Bethlehem sung le akimvel sea sepai ho asol in agatha sahtai.
2.17: Herod khansetna hi Pathen in themgao Jeremiah henga ana seisa:
2.18: “Ramah ah ka awgin akijai-Kana le lunghemna nasatah chu! Rachel in achate akapin, amaho athitah jeh uvin, lhepbi ding anom tapoi,” kiti chu gui lhunna ahi.
2.19: Herod athi phat in, Pakai vantil khat chu Joseph henga amang in, Egypt a aumpet in ahung kilah in,
2.20: “Kipatdoh in naosen chule anu chu Israel gam'a puikit in, ijeh inem itileh naosen tha ding ana goho chu athi tauve” tin vantil in aseipeh in ahi.
2.21: Chuin Joseph akipat doh in chule Israel gam lama Yeshua le anutoh ahung kile tauve.
2.22: Ahinlah aman Judea vaipo thahpa chu Herod chapa Archelaus ahi ti ahetphat in, chuche mun a gache ding akicha tai. Ajan manga gihsalna amutah jeh in Galilee gam lam a ding in akipat doh tai.
2.23: Hiti chun hiche insung chu Nazareth kiti khopi khat a chun aga cheuvin chule hichea chun acheng tauve. Hiti chun themgao thusei “Ama Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi” kiti chu agui lhung tan ahi.

3.1: Hiche nikho lai chun Twilutsah John chu Judea gamthip'a ahung in chule thu aseiphong in athupoh chu,
3.2: “Nachonset nau dalha uvin chule Pathen lam a hung ki heiyun, ijeh inem itileh Van gam anaitai” ati.
3.3: Themgao Isaiah chun John chung chang hitin ana seiye, “Ama hi gamthip'a khosam aw chu ahi, Pakai hung nading lampi sem un, Ama ding in lampi theh ngim un” ati.
3.4: John kivon na chu sangongsang mul kikhui ahin, chule akong kimvel achun savun konggah akigah in, chule khaokho le gamkhoiju chu an in anen ahi.
3.5: Mihonpi chu Jerusalem kimvel le Judea gam chule Jordan phaicham kimvela kon in, John ve ding le athusei ngaiya hung ahiuve.
3.6: Chuin amahon achonset nau aphongdoh un, Jordan vadunga chun aman amaho chu baptize achansah in ahi.
3.7: Ahinlah aman Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chu baptize chansah vea ahungu amun, amaho chu asosal in, “Nangho gul chilhah ho, Pathen lung hanna hung lhung dinga kon jam dohna dinga koiham nagih uva?
3.8: Nachonset nauva kon'a nalung heiyu chule Pathen lam nangat'u chu, aphot chenna na hinkho uva tahlang un.
3.9: Nangho khat in khat komah, ‘eiho Abraham chilhah ihiuvin, huhbit in um nau hite’ tin kisei pehto hih un. Hichu imacha ahipoi, ajeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen in hiche songchang ho lah a kon a hi Abraham chate asemdoh thei ahi.
3.10: Tu jenga jong Pathen thu tanna heicha koisa a uma, thingphung ajung geiya kaldoh dia gonsa ahitai. Thingphung gapha hin sodoh lou jouse chu kiphuh lhu ding chule meilhum sunga kilehlut ding ahi.
3.11: Achonsetna a kon'a lungheiya chule Pathen lam'a hung kihei ho chu, keiman twiya baptize kachansah ahi. Hinlah keima sanga gamchenga lenjo chu ahunge; keima hi ama soh, akeng chot choi dinga jong chu kilom kahi poi.
3.12: Aman changtah'a kona changsi khendoh dinga agodal akichoiya asep dia kigosa um ahi. Chule aman achangphol kimvel chu asuh theng'a changtah chu achang pang'a akhumlut ding, hinlah changsi chengse vang chu mei mit theilou meikong'a kilehlut ding ahi,” ati.
3.13: Chutah in Yeshua chu Galilee a kon in, Jordan luiya John in baptize achansah ding in agachen ahi.
3.14: Hinlah John chun ana janom hihbeh in, “Keima hi nangman baptize nei chansah dia kiloma kahi, i-atileh kei koma hunga nahim,” ati.
3.15: Hinlah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hiche hi bol dinga lom ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in angeh jouse iboldoh tei ding ahi,” ati. Hiti chun John in Ama chu baptize achansah tai.
3.16: Baptize achan jouva Yeshua twi lah'a kona ahung potdoh pet in, vanho chu Ama ding in ahung kihong doh in, chule Pathen Lhagao chu vakhu tobanga ahung kumsuh a chule achung'a aumden chu amun ahi.
3.17: Chuin van'a kon aw khat in, “Hiche hi Ka Chapa dei umtah le ngailut umtah, kipana sangpen eipea chu ahi,” tin aseiye.

4.1: Chutah in Yeshua chu lhagao puiyin gamthip'a diabol lhep patep dingin aum tai.
4.2: Ni somli le jan somli jen, an ngol ahijeh chun agil akel behseh jeng in ahi.
4.3: Hiche phat sung chun Diabol chu ahung in ajah a, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahileh, hiche songchang hohi changlhah akiso theina ding in thu pen,” ati.
4.4: Hinlah Yeshuan ajah a, “Ahipoi! Pathen Thubun aseiye, Mihem changlhah bouva hingthei ahipoi, Pathen kam sunga kon hung potdoh Thua bou chu hing ding ahi,” ati.
4.5: Chuin Diabol chun khopi theng, Jerusalem hou in ting vuma chun adinsah kit in,
4.6: ajah a, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahileh, ki chomlhan!” Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun aseiye, “Aman avantil te nangma hongbit dinga thu apeh ding, chule amahon nangma akhut uva nadop doh dingu chutia chu nangman nakeng phang jeng jong songa nakita khah lou ding ahi,” ati.
4.7: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thubun hitin jong aseiye, nangman Pakai na Pathen chu lhem patep hih in,” ati.
4.8: Chujouvin Diabol in molsang chungvum a chun apuiyin chule vannoi lenggam jouse le aloupina ho avetsah in ahi.
4.9: Aman ajah a, “Nangma naboh khup'a chule keima nei houva ahileh, keiman nangma aboncha hi kapeh ding nahi,” atikit in ahileh,
4.10: Yeshuan ajah a, “Satan, hichea kon hin potdoh'in. Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun aseiye, nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nahouva chule Amabou najen ding ahi,” ati.
4.11: Chutah in Diabol chu ache mang in, chuin Vantil te ahung un, Yeshua chu ahung jen le tauve.
4.12: Yeshua chun John aman tauve tithu ajah phat in, Judea gam adalhan Galilee gama ahung kile kittai.
4.13: Ama amasatah in Nazareth chen, chuin chu mun chu adalhan, Zebulun le Naphtali gamkai sung Galilee twipi panga, Capernaum khoa aga cheng in ahi.
4.14: Hichu Isaiah Themgao kam a Pathen thusei:
4.15: “Zebulun le Naphtali gam, twipi pam, Jordan vadung gal'a Galilee gam, chidang nam dang tampi umna mun,
4.16: muthim lah a touho chun vah loupi tah amu tauve, chule thina gam le alim a touho chu achung'uva kho avah tai,” ati chu agui lhunna ahi.
4.17: Hichea pat chun Yeshuan thu asei phong in, “Na chonset nauva kon in lung heiyun chule Pathen lama hung ki heiyun, ijeh inem itileh Van gam anai tai,” ati.
4.18: Nikhat hi Yeshua Galilee twipi pam'a achea avale pet in, aman uchani—Simon, Peter jong kitipa le Andrew in twi lah a len asepet lhon agatoh e, ajeh chu amani ngaman a kivah lhon ahi.
4.19: Yeshuan amani chu akouvin, “Hung lhon in, kanung hinjui lhon in chule keiman miho iti mat ding ahi navetsah lhon inge,” ati.
4.20: Chuin amanin apet tah chun alen lhon adalha lhon in chule Ama nung ajui lhon tai.
4.21: Chule Ama chukom'a kon chun ache pai in ahileh, ucha dang mini Jacob le anaopa John kong sunga apau Zebedee toh atou khom uva len akhui phat pet'u aga mun, chuin Aman amani jong chu akouvin ahi.
4.22: Amanin chupet tah chun kong le apa adalha lhon in, anung ajui pai jeng lhon tai.
4.23: Chule Yeshua chu Galilee gamkai sea akhol jin in, Judah te kikhopna intin ah thu ahil in, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len ahi. Chule Ama chun miho natna jouse le adamlou jouse chu aboldam in ahi.
4.24: Ama chung chang thu chu Syria geiyin aki thang doh in, hiti chun miho chun ana damlou jouse chu akom a ahin puiyuve. Chule itobang natna le hivei neiya nat thoh lel ho, thilha vop ho le alung chavai ho hihen, chule langthi ho hijong leh Ama koma ahin puiyun, aman amaho chu aboncha uvin aboldam sohkeiyin ahi.
4.25: Ama chena chan a chun Galilee, Decapolis (Khopi som kitina), Jerusalem chule Judea gama kon le Jordan gal lama kon in, mipi tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin ahi.

5.1: Nikhat hi mihonpi kikhom chu amu phat in, Yeshua chu moul chung a akaldoh in chule atou phat in aseijuite chu akimvel'a ahung kikhom un ahi.
5.2: Chuin Ama apaodoh in amaho chu hiche thuhi ahil pan in, ajah uva asei tai.
5.3: “Lhagaova vaichaho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amaho'a ahi.
5.4: Lhasetna neiho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lhamonga umdiu ahi.
5.5: Mi lungneng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon leiset chung pumpi alo diu ahi.
5.6: Thudih a din jeh a gilkel dangchah thoh ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon lung nachimna anei diu ahi.
5.7: Mi lungset them ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lungsetna chang diu ahi.
5.8: Mi lungtheng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amahon Pathen amu diu ahi.
5.9: Mi sucham ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho Pathen chate kiti diu ahi.
5.10: Adih boljeh a hesohna chang ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amahoa ahi.
5.11: Kanung jui nahi jeh uva mihon nahouset uva, nabol hesoh uva, jouva nabol'uva chule nang ho douna a thil phalou jouse aseiteng uleh Pathen phatthei boh chang ding nahi uve.
5.12: Nang ho kipah thanom'un chule hapan kipah uvin, ajeh chu van a nasan dingu kipaman alen e. Ajehchu amahon themgao masaho jong chu hitobanga hi anabol hesoh'u ahi.
5.13: “Nangho leiset chi nahiuve. Hinlah chi chu a alna beitaleh ipin ki alsah kit tantem? Chule ima chan phachom tapon tin, pai mang le miho chotpha bep hiding ahi.
5.14: ‘Nang ho vannoi vah nahiuve, lhang vuma khopi kisel theilou tobang chu nahi uve.’
5.15: Koiman thaomei avah in chujouleh lo akhu khum jipoi. Hisang chun akhom chunga aki tung in, in sunga um jouse avah chun asalvah jin ahi.
5.16: Hitobang chun navah uchu miho masang ah kilang hen, chuteng amahon na thilpha bol uchu mu uvin tin, van'a um na Pau chu avahchoi diu ahi.
5.17: “Ipi jeh a hunga kahi nei hekhel hih un. Keima hi Mose Danbu ahilouleh themgao ho lekhajih subei dinga hung kahipoi. Asumang dinga hunga hijo louva, asubulhit a hung kahijoi.
5.18: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, Van le leiset aman masanga Pathen Dan thu chu aguilhun sohkei masang sea, ajem neopen le ajem sipah geiya jong mang lou ding ahi.
5.19: Nang man thupeh aneopen na nahsah moa chule midang jong hitia chu nahil'a ahileh, Van gama chu aneopen nahi ding ahi. Hinlah koi hijongleh Pathen Dan thu juiya chule hiche ho chu ahil'a ahileh Van gama alen kiti ding ahi.
5.20: Hinlah kahil chah nahiuve. Nangho na chonphat nau chu Dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho sanga aphat joh louva ahileh Van gam'a chu nalut louhel diu ahi.
5.21: “Nanghon ipu ipateu jah a, ‘Tolthat hih in, koi hijong leh mithat chu thupi tanna dinga kicha jinga um ding ahi’ tia ana kiseipeh chu naja tauve.
5.22: Hinlah keiman nangho jah a kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hijongleh khat chunga lunghanga chu athu kitan ding ahi. Nangman koiham khat chu mingol pannabei natileh thutanna mun'a kipuilut ding kicha'a um ding nahi. Nangman mi na gaosap'a ahileh Damun meidil'a kicha a um ding nahi.
5.23: Hijeh chun nangman hou in a maicham thilto ding nachoiya, mi koiham khat in nangma kilung doupina nanei na geldoh a ahileh,
5.24: Maicham mun'a na thilto ding chu dalhan, gachen chuche mi chuto gakicham lhon in, chuteng leh hung in chule Pathen maicham'a kilhaina thilto chu napeh ding ahi.
5.25: Na kidoupi chutoh thutanna mun'a dinga na kilhon pina lampia chun, agan na theiyin kihou champi jeng in. Achuti louleh themmo na chanpa chun thutan vaihompa khut a napedoh intin, ama chun amopo khat khut a peson intin, chule songkul a na khumpai ding ahi.
5.26: Hiti chu hita henlang hileh, nangman achaina pen sum nasah chai masang sea chu itinama jongleh chua kona chu nalha ong thol kit lou ding ahitai.
5.27: “Thupeh a thu ana kiseisa, ‘Nangman jonbol hih in’ kiti hi nana ja tauve.
5.28: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hileh numei khat jon lunga ve achu amanu chutoh alunga jong ahitai.
5.29: Hijeh chun namit chu mitpha hikhat tou jongleh hichun na kipal lhuhsah a ahileh, kaldoh in lang paimang jeng in, nangma ding in natibah khat namansah chu na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in aphajoi.
5.30: Chule nakhut jetlam in na chonset sah a ahileh sat lhan lang paimang jeng in. Ajeh chu nangma dinga na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in, natibah khat aman chu apha joi.
5.31: “Danbua thu kisun, ‘Pasal in ajinu ada ding leh amanu chu dana lekha apeh a ahetsah leh ahithei jenge’ tia kisei chu naja tauve.
5.32: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, mikhat in aji chu pasal dang toh alup khom jeh tilouva thu dang jeh'a ada ahileh, amanu chu ajonsah ahitai: chule koi hi jongleh akidasa numei ki chenpia chu mi jong ahi.
5.33: “Chule malai mite ki seipehsa thu nana jahsau chu, ‘Nangman nakihahsel na chu sukeh hih in, nangman Pakaiya naki hahselna nabulhit tei ding ahi’ kiti ahi.
5.34: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, imachan ki hahsel hih beh un! Van pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu van chu Pathen laltouna ahi.
5.35: Chule leiset pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu leiset hi akengto ngapna ahi. Chule Jerusalem pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu Jerusalem hi Leng loupi khopi ahi.
5.36: Ka luchung pan beh a kaki hahsel ding hitante ti hih in. Ajeh chu nangman na samjang khat cha jong nakan sah thei lou chule na vom sah thei poi.
5.37: Hinlah naki houlim nau chu ‘Henge, ka nom e ahilouleh ka nompoi’ tia sei chu hi jeng hen. Hi cheng kalval chu agi loupa a kon ahi.
5.38: “Dan thun gim bolna chu atotoh hi ding: Mit khat khel'a mi khat, chule ha khat khel'a ha khat hi ding ahi kiti chu naja tauve.
5.39: Hinlah kaseipeh nahi uve, mi gilou lethuh hih un! Koiham khat in na ngeiphe jetlam abeh'a ahileh, na ngeiphe alang khat jong dopeh in.
5.40: Chule koi hileh nahehse aum a chule na sangkhol ah alah mang a ahileh na ponchol jong chu pehtha jeng tan.
5.41: Chule sepai khat in athilpo dia nacham louva, mile khat napui leh mile ni chan gathah peh in.
5.42: Na henga thum ho chu pen, chule nangma koma bat a thum chu kihei mangsan go hih in.
5.43: “Danbu in, ‘Naheng nakom ngailun’ chule namelma chu hot bol in, tia asei chu naja tauve.
5.44: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, na melma teu chu ngailu uvin, na gaosap teu chu phatthei boh un, na hotbol teu ding in thilpha bol un, chule nahsah mo tah a nabol teu le na gimbol teu ding in taovun.
5.45: Hitia na bol uchu nangho van'a um na Pau chate tahbeh nahiu kihetna ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga nisa vah apen, chule mi dih le mi dihlou chunga jong go ajuhsah in ahi.
5.46: Nang hon nangailu teu bou na ngailut uva ahileh, hichea chu ipi kipa man nasan diu um ding ham? Kaidong hon jong hitobang chu abolu ahi.
5.47: Nang ho nagol teu dinga bou na phat uva ahileh, midang to ipi naki kheh nau um em? Hitobang chu milim houhon jong abolu ahi.
5.48: Hijeh chun van a um na Pau chamkim ahi bang in, nangho jong chamkim un” ati.

6.1: Chingtheiyun! Midang pachat nachanna diuvin, mipi mu ding in thilpha bol hih un; chutia nabol leu vana na pauva kona kipa man mulou ding nahi uve.
6.2: Ngaichat nei michu thilpeh napeh teng uleh, mi phalhem ho bang in bol hih un; amahon kikhopna in hoa le lamlhong hoa sumkon amut'uvin mi apanpina hou chu miho ahetsah jiuvin ahi. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amaho hin kipaman amu diu abona akimu'u ahitai.
6.3: Hinlah nangman koiham khat ngaichat thil napeh tengleh, nakhut jetlam in abol chu nakhut veilam hetsah hih in.
6.4: Na thilpeh ding ho chu guhthim in pen, ijakai aguh-a mua napa chun nangma kipaman napeh ding ahi.
6.5: Nangma natao tengleh, mi phalhem ho banga lamlhong pam leh kikhopna inhoa mitin in amu diu deina a tao nom hoto bang hih in. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, hichu bou ama hon kipaman asan diu chu ahi jenge.
6.6: Hinlah nangma tao dinga nache tengleh nangma changseh chen lang, na nunglam kot khah in chule guhthima mu napa henga taovin. Chuteng napa, ijakai mupa chun, nangma kipa man napeh ding ahi.
6.7: Nangma natao teng leh, houdang ho bang in naseisa chu avel vel in seikit hih in. Amaho chun taona thucheng aman jiu chu avel vel'a sei jal a ataona chu sanpeh hi dinga aginchat'u ahi.
6.8: Nangho amaho toh bang hih uvin, ijeh inem itileh vana um na Pauvin na ngaichat'u chu nathum masang uva ahetsa ahitai.
6.9: Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: Van'a um ka-Pau, namin jatah in umhen.
6.10: Na lenggam hung lhung loihen, Van'a nalung lhaina aum tobang in lei chunga jong na lung lhaina umhen.
6.11: Tunia kangaichat'u anneh neipeu vin,
6.12: Keiho douna a chonse ho ka ngaidam bang un, keiho chonsetna jong ngaidam in.
6.13: Chule lhepna thua nei nunsah hih un, ahin agiloupa a kon in nei huhdoh uvin.
6.14: Nang ho douna chonseho na ngaidam uva ahileh, vana na Pauvin nangho na ngaidam diu ahi.
6.15: Hinlah midang na ngaidam nom lou uva ahileh, na Pauvin nangho chonsetna angaidam lou ding ahi.
6.16: “Chule nang hon an nangol tenguleh, mi pha lhem ho bang in ki nguisah hih un, ijeh inem itile amahon an angolu min ahetna din amaisou alam dansah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amahon kipaman hichea chu akimu-u ahitai.
6.17: Hinlah nang man an nangol tengleh, nasam kipon chule namai kiphet in.
6.18: Chutileh na anngol chu vana napa tailou koiman hepon tin, guhthim a na thilbol mua na Pa chun kipaman napeh ding ahi.
6.19: “Nget'in aneh heng thei le ap in asuhmang theina, chule gucha hon asuhset uva akiguh thei nau, hiche leiset chunga hin gou khol hih un.
6.20: Amavang nget le ap in asuh mang thei louna chule gucha hon jong asuhset uva aki guhdoh theilou nau van'a nagouvu kikhol un.
6.21: Ijeh inem itileh nagou umna a chu, nalung ngaichat'u jong um ding ahi.
6.22: “Namit hi natahsa dinga vahpea pang ahi. Namit aphat pet'a natahsa pumpi hi vahsoh keiya ahi.
6.23: Hinlah namit hi aphat lou tengleh natahsa pumpi hi thimsoh jia ahitai. Chule vah neiya na kigel chu, thima hi tahbeh le hiche athim chu iti natsat ding hitam?
6.24: “Mihem koiman pakai ni aneikop theipoi. Ajeh chu aman khat chu thet bol in tin chule khat joh chu ngailun te; nangma khat a naki pehlut ding chule khat joh chu nanah sahmo ding ahi. Nangma Pathen le sum ani gel a lhacha a na pankop thei ahipoi.
6.25: Hiti ahijeh chun nitin nehkhop ding an ahilouleh, twi ahilouleh ponsil thua nalung kham louna diu kaseipeh nahi uve. Hinkho hi an sanga thupi joa chule na tahsa chu ponsil sanga thupi joa hilou ham?
6.26: “Chunga leng vacha ho khu ven. Ajeh chu amaho khun tula atu pouvin, at la a at pouvin ahilouleh chang pang geiya aneilou vang un, vana um na Pauvin amaho khu avah nai. Chule nangho amaho sanga khu gamchenga na manlut joh'u hilou ham?
6.27: Na lungkham na hou chun, na hinkhou them khat beh ajop saobe theiyem?
6.28: Chule sil le chen dinga ibol a lung khama nahiu vem? Lou jaova molhoipah khu ngaito uvin, iti khan'a hiuvin tem? Amaho khun natoh la atong pouvin, aponsil diu jong akibol pouve.
6.29: Ahivang in Solomon chu aloupina jouse pum'in jong hicheho bang'in ahoi joupoi.
6.30: Chule Pathen in gamlah a pahcha jeng jong tunia uma chule jing le meisunga kilehlut ding bon hibanga hi ajep hoiya ahileh, nangma ding jong thon louva agel khoh ding ahi. Itia hiti loma hi tahsan na neilou nahiu hin tem?
6.31: “Hijeh chun ipi kaneh diu, ipi kadon diu? Ipi kachen diu hitam? Tin hiche ho thua hin lungkham hih un.
6.32: Hiche lunggel ho hin tahsan lou ho lunggel athu nun ahi, hinlah vana umna Pau chun hiti ho jouse na ngaichat uchu ahet ahi.
6.33: Hicheng jouse chung vuma chun Pathen Lenggam hol'un, chule chonpha tah in hing uvin, Aman na ngaichat chan'u chu napeh diu ahi.
6.34: Hiti ahijeh chun jinga ding in lungkham hih un, ajeh chu jinga ding hung um nante. Tuni gimna chu tuni khoa ding in apha settai.

7.1: “Mi koima oimodan, chutile koiman na oimo lou ding ahi.
7.2: Ajeh chu midang na oimona banga chu, Pathen in na oimo ding ahi. Nangman mi nabolna bang banga chu nachunga kibol ding ahi.
7.3: Chule nangma mit a bohse hal um chu boipi louva, ibol a nasopi mit a bohse hal um chu kisah boipia nahim?
7.4: Ahilouleh nangma mit a bohse hal um muthei louva, nasopi jah'a keiman na mit a bohse hal um chu na lahdoh peh inge, iti nati thei ham?
7.5: Vo mi phalhem! Nangma mit a bohse hal um chu amasan kilah doh le chun, nagol mit a bohse hal um chu ki chentah in muthei tan nate.
7.6: Uicha ho khu thil theng pe hih un, chule vohcha ho ang sunga khun twikoh chang jong lehlha hih un, chuti bol leu chun hichu akeng uvin chil'un tin chule hung kile heiyuva nangho jong nahin bah diu ahi.
7.7: “Na thum uchu thum jomun, chutileh na thum uchu nakipe diu ahi; na holu chu holjom un chutileh na holu chu namu diu ahi. Nakiu uchu kiu jom un chutileh nakiu uchu kot ki honpeh ding nahiuve.
7.8: Ajeh chu athum chan akipen, ahol chan achang uve. Chule akiu chan kot aki honpeh in ahi.
7.9: Nangho minu mipa ten, na chate uvin changlhah pheng athum leh, hiche khel achu song napeh uvem?
7.10: Ahilouleh amahon nga thum leu, amaho chu gul nape diuvem? Napeh lou diu ahi.
7.11: Chutia nangho chonset bol hon bon na chateu thilpha man beiya pehje nahet uva ahileh, hisanga chu gam chenga vana na Pau chun akoma thumte chu thilpha manbeiya apeh lou ding ham?
7.12: Hijeh chun imalam jousea mi dang in iti nabol leu na dei uvem, hitobang chun nang hon jong bol un. Hiche hi Dan bua kisun leh Themgao ho thuhil chu ahi.”
7.13: “Nangho Pathen Lenggama chu kot jima kona bou nalut thei diu ahi. Ajeh chu manthahna lam lhong chu lenpi tah ahin, chule akot jong jaotah ahin, chua lut ding kilhen'a chu mi tamtah ahiuve.
7.14: Hinlah Hinna kot chu akichi lheh in, chule alampi jong ahah in chule mi lhomcha bouvin akimu diu ahi.”
7.15: “Na heng uva hung jia themgao lhem ho, kelngoi vona kivona ahia asunglam ngei hangtah ho chu kichih theiyun.
7.16: Nanghon amaho chu agauva, tichu achon nauva kona na hetdoh thei diu ahi: Mihon lingnang lah a kona lengpi ga alo jiuva, ahilouleh ling phunga kona theichang ga alo ngai jiu vem?
7.17: Thingphung pha chun gapha asodoh in, chule thingphung phalou chun ga phalou asodoh ji ahi.
7.18: Thingphung pha chun ga phalou asodoh theipon, chule thingphung phalouvin jong gapha asodoh theipoi.
7.19: Hitia chu thingphung gapha sodoh louse chu kiphuh lhua chule mei sunga kileh lutji ahi.
7.20: Hijeh chun thingphung chu aga a kona hetdoh theina nanei bang un, miho chu achon nauva kona nang hon ahinau na hetdoh thei diu ahi.”
7.21: “Keima, Pakai! Pakai! tia eikou tapou chu Van gam lut ding ahipoi. Vana kapa lunglhaina bol ho bou chu lut ding ahi.
7.22: Thutan nikho leh mitampi chun kajah a, Pakai! Pakai! Nangma min in gaothu kaseiyun, chule nangma min in thilha ho kano doh uvin, chule nangma min in thilbol theina kidang kaboldoh uve atidiu ahi.
7.23: Hinlah keiman, ‘Nangho itih in jong kahekha pouve. Pathen dan thu palkeh a nangho, ka koma kon in potdoh'un,’ tia ka donbut diu ahi.”
7.24: “Kathuhil ngaiya chule jui chan chu koi hijongleh, miching songpi chunga in kisahpa tobang ahi.
7.25: Go hungju henlang, twi hungsoh hen chule hui hungnung henlang, hiche inchu hinsu jongleh, songpi chunga kisa ahijeh a chu lhulou ding ahi.
7.26: Hinlah ka thuhil ngaiya ahia la juilou chan chu mingol, nel lei chunga insa tobang ahi.
7.27: Go ahung juh a twi chu ahung soa chule hui chun hiche inchu asuh'a ahileh gimnei tah'in alhupai jeng tai,” ati.
7.28: Yeshuan hicheng thu aseijou vin, mipi chun athu hil kidang asalheh jeng uve.
7.29: Ajeh chu aman hou lamkai ho thuhil tobanga hillouvin, thunei tah in thu ahil in ahi.

8.1: Chujouvin Yeshua mol chunga kona ahung kuma ahileh, mipi atama tam'in anung ajuiyuvin ahi.
8.2: Photlot in, “Miphah khat'in Ama akimu pin chule a-anga abohkhup in, ajah a, Pakai nalung ahileh nei damsah a chule nei thensah thei ahi,” ahung titai.
8.3: Chuin Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule athamin, “Kalung ahi, dam jeng in, atin ahileh apattah in aphah chu atheng tan ahi.”
8.4: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Hiche thudol hi koima koma seihih in, chusang in nangma thempu koma gachen lang chule aman nave chil hen. Mose Danbua miphah ho athen teng thupehsa thilto ding chu gatoh tan. Hiche hi nathengtai ti ahetna, mipi lah'a na phondohna hiding ahi,” ati.
8.5: Chule Yeshua Capernaum ahung kile phat in, Rome Sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahung in chule ama chu atem in,
8.6: “Pakai, kasohpa alangthia ahin, jalkhun'a alume chule anatna chu athohlel lheh in ahi,” ati.
8.7: Yeshuan ajah a, “Keima hung ingting chule kahung damsah ding ahi,” ati.
8.8: Hinlah sepai jalamkaipa chun, “Pakai, nangman ka-in neihung chotlut peh dinga lhingjou chu kahi poi. Na umna mun'ah thu chu hinsei lechun, kasohpa hi dam tante.”
8.9: Hiche hi kahei, ajeh chu keima kachunga thunei lamkai lenho aum in chule keiman sepaite chunga thu kaneiye. Keiman, “Che uvin katileh ache uvin, ahilouleh hung un, katileh amaho ahung uve. Chule keiman kasohte jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol un katileh, amahon abol'uve,’” ati.
8.10: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in adatmo lheh jenge. Aman anung juiho jah'a aseiyin, “Thudih tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel ho jouse lah'ah hitobang tahsan hi kamu khapoi.
8.11: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, chidang namdang ho mi tamtah vannoi mun tina kona hung diu solama kon le lhum lama kona Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob toh Van gam'a golvah an nea tou ding ahiuve.
8.12: Hinlah Israel mi tamtah ho adiuva lenggam kigon peh ho chu polam muthim lah'a ale lut dingu, hichea chu ka le hagel um ding ahi,” ati.
8.13: Chutah in Yeshuan Rome sepai jalamkaipa jah a aseiyin, “In lama kile tan. Ijeh inem itileh nangman na tahsan chu aguilhung tai,” ati. Chule soh khang dongpa chu apattah chun adamtai.
8.14: Yeshua Peter In ahung lhun phat in, Peter jinu nu chu alupna a khosih natna neiya leltah a uma ahi.
8.15: Hinlah Yeshuan ama chu akhut athampeh in ahileh, akhosih chun adalhatai. Chuin ama athoudoh in Ama ding chun anneh ding agong in ahi.
8.16: Nilhah ahiphat in lhagaoboh vop mi tamtah Yeshua henga ahin pui tauvin. Aman lhagao gilou ho chu thu apen adamlou jouse chu aboldam tai.
8.17: Hiche hin Pakai thu Isaiah themgao in asei, “Aman inatnau aladoh in chule ihiveiyu ala mangtai,” atichu aguilhunsah e.
8.18: Yeshuan mihonpi akimvel'a aum amun, aman aseijuite chu dil langkhat a galkai ding in thu apen ahi.
8.19: Chuphat in Hou dan thuhil ho khat in ajah a, “Houhil, na chena chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
8.20: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Sial hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, chule vacha hon gena ding bu aneiyui, hinlah Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding mun jeng jong aneipoi,” ati.
8.21: Aseijui dang khat in ajah a, “Pakai, in a gakile masang ting kapa gavui inge” ati.
8.22: Hinlah Yeshuan aseipeh in ajah a, “Tun neijui in. Lhagaova thihon ami thiu kivui nau vinte,” ati.
8.23: Chuin Yeshua kong sunga alut in, chule aseijuite chutoh dil langkhat panga chun agalkai pan tauve.
8.24: Phutlot chang in, twipi kinong in dil chu ahin nuh in, chule twi kinong ho chun kong chu ahin nuh a ahileh kong sunga aluttai; hinlah Ama a'imun ahi.
8.25: Seijui ho chu aga che uvin, chule asukhang un, akou un, “Pakai nei huhdoh un, twiyin eichup diu ahitai,” atiuve.
8.26: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga kicha a nahiu vem? Tahsanna neocha jong nanei lou uham?” ati. Chuphat in Ama aki patdoh in chule huipi le twipi kinong chu aphoh in, chuin phulou helouvin athip paitai.
8.27: Seijui ho chun adatmo lheh'uvin, “Hiche mipa hi koi ham? Huipi le twipi kinong Ama thun anunge,” atiuve.
8.28: Yeshua chu dil langkhat pang agei tan, Gadarene gamkai alhung in ahileh lhagaoboh vop minin aki mupi lhon e. Amani chu lhan mun'a chengden lhona chule gilou huham behseh ahijeh lhon a, koiman hiche lam chu ahopa ngam lou ahi.
8.29: Amani chun ahinsam lhon in, ajah a, “Pathen Chapa, koi nahi hiya neihung suhboiyu ham? Nangma Pathen phat tep masanga hikom muna hi eisugim diuva hunga nahim?” ati lhon e.
8.30: Mun gamla tah a vohcha hon tampi loujaova lha a um uva ahi.
8.31: Hiti chun Lhagaoboh vop teni chu atao lhon in, “Nei nodoh diuva ahileh vohcha hon sunga khun neisol un,” atiuve.
8.32: Yeshuan amaho chu thu apen, “Aphai, che uvin,” ati. Hiti chun lhagaoboh ho chu mitenia konin ahung potdoh un, chuin vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, chule vohcha jouse chu abon'un mol pang dillen sunga chun alhai lha uvin, twi lah'a chun alhalut gam tauve.
8.33: Gancha chinga pang ho chu akoma khopia chun alhai lut un, lhagaoboh vop teni chunga thilsoh thudol chu amitakip aseipeh tauve.
8.34: Chuphat in khopia miho jouse chu ahung potdoh un, Yeshua ahung kimu piuvin, amahon Yeshua chu ache mang'a chule amaho adalhahna diuvin atem un ahi.

9.1: Chuin Yeshua kong khat'a akaldoh in chule dil chu agal kaiyin, ama khomun ahung kiletai.
9.2: Mi phabep chun langthi khat alupna pum in akoma ahinpui uve. Aman atahsan'u chu amu phat in langthipa jah a chun Yeshuan, “Lung nom in, ka chapa! Na chonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
9.3: Hinlah Hou danthu hil phabep chu amaho le amaho aki hou un, “Hiche hi Pathen taitomna ahi! Ama Pathen a kingaitoa ham?” atiuve.
9.4: Yeshuan alung'uva ipi angaitou chu ahen, hijeh chun amaho adong in, “Ipi dinga chutobang lunggel gitlouna ho nalung'uva naneiyu ham?
9.5: Nachonset ho kingaidam ahitai, tia sei, ahilouleh ‘Dingdoh in, chule lamjot in’ ti hoijoh baijo ham?”
9.6: Hijeh achu Mihem Chapan leiset chunga chonset ngaidam jouna thaneina aneiye ti photchenna kapeh ding nahiuve atin, chuin Yeshua langthipa lama akiheiyin aseiyin, “Dingdoh in, nalupna kichoiyin, chule in-a chen!” ati.
9.7: Chuin ama chu ahung kichop doh thon, chule in-a achetai!
9.8: Hiche thilsoh hin mihonpi chu alungu kichatnan alo dimtai. Chule amahon hitobang tah a thuneina nei, mihem ahinsol jeh hin Pathen avahchoi tauve.
9.9: Chuin Yeshua avalea ahileh, mikhat Matthew kitipa chu kai adonna muna atou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin chule kaseijui in pang in,” ati. Hi chun Matthew akipatdoh in anung ajuitai.
9.10: Chomkhat jouvin, Matthew in Yeshua le Aseijuite ho toh chun kaidong adang ho chule midang minphatna neilou chonse ho chu jin-gun in a-ina akouvin ahi.
9.11: Hinlah Pharisee hon hichu amu phat un aseijuite adong un, itia na jilkung pauvin amot mot'a thusei ho toh an aneh khom ham? atiuve.
9.12: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah phat in, “Mi damthei hon louthem angaicha pouve, ana damlou hon bou angai chauve,” ati.
9.13: Aman aseiben, “Tun cheuvin chule Pathen Thubun ipi asei ahi ga kihil un: Keiman khotona bou kangeh ahin, kilhaina nabol diu ahipoi. Ajeh chu keima midih a kigel ho kouva hunga kahipon, chonse ahi kihet ho bou kouva hunga kahi,” ati.
9.14: Nikhat hi John Baptist seijuiho chu Yeshua henga ahung un chule adong un, ipi iti dana keiho le Pharisee hon an ka ngol jiu tobanga na seijuiten an angol lou-u hintem? atiuve.
9.15: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Golvah kibolna a jin ho chun moulang toh akipa khom pet'uva alunghem'u ngaiyintem? Chuti ponte. Ahinlah moulang chu nikhat le amahoa kona kipui mang ding ahi, chutah le an angol diu ahi.”
9.16: “Ajeh chu koiman ponsop nem lou ahal chun ponlui abeh jipoi, achutibol le abehna chun hiche pon chu aloi-eh ding ahi.”
9.17: “Chukal valin koiman lengpitwi thah chu abom luiya akoiji poi. Ajeh chu abom lui chu pohkeh intin, chule lengpitwi chu jal ding, akoina bom chu seding ahitai. Lengpitwi thah chu abom thah a ikhum leh ania huhbit a um ding ahi,” ati.
9.18: Yeshuan hiche thuho asei laiyin kikhopna in vaipopa chu ahung in chule amasanga ahung dilsun, “Kachanu tupet tah chun athi” hinlah nangma na hunga chule achunga nakhut na ngap'a ahileh nahinsah kit thei ding ahi, ahungti.
9.19: Hiti chun Yeshua le Aseijuite chu akipatdoh un, chule amato chun akilhon un ahi.
9.20: Chupet tah chun numei khat athilon tang louva gimthoh nu chu anung lama ahunge. Amanu hin apon mongkai chu ahung tham e.
9.21: Ajeh chu ama nun agel chu, keiman apon mongkai khu thamkha jeng jong leng kadam ding ahi, ati.
9.22: Yeshua akihei kimvel in chule aman amanu chu amuphat in ajah a, “Chanu lungthoi hih in! Natasan in nadam thengsah ahitai,” ati. Chuche pettah chun amanu chu adam paitai.
9.23: Kikhopna vaipopa in a Yeshua alhun phat in mihonpi chu achoh thethu jeng un chule thi opna a kimut theile ging chu ajatai.
9.24: Amaho jah'a chun, “Potdoh tem un, chapang nu hi athia ahipoi, amahi a-ihmua ahibouve” ati. Hinlah mihonpi chun anuisat tauve.
9.25: Mihonpi chu polama asoldoh jouvin, Yeshua agalut in chule chapang nu chu akhut a atuh in ahileh amanu chu ahung ding dohtai.
9.26: Hiche thil kidang kibol thuthang chu agamkai pumpi'ah akithe chansoh tai.
9.27: Yeshuan numei chapang nu in chu adalhah jouvin, anunga mitcho minin ahinjui peh in, amanin, “David Chapa neikhoto lhon in,” tin asam lhon in ahi.
9.28: Amani chu aumna insunga ajuilut lhon in, Yeshuan adong in, “Keima hin khomu theina eineisah lhon ding ahi ti natahsan em?” ati. Ama nin adonbut in, henge, Pakai, katahsan lhone, tin asei lhontai.
9.29: Chuphat in Aman amit lhon atham in, chuin, “Natahsan lhon jeh a, hung hithei ding ahi” ati.
9.30: Chutah in amit lhon ahah in chule kho amulhon tai. Yeshuan amani agih in, “Hiiche thuhi koima seipeh lhon hih in,” ati.
9.31: Hinlah amani apotdoh lhon in chuin Amin chu agamkai kimvela aseiphong lhon tai.
9.32: Amani apotdoh lhon phat'in lhagaoboh vop mikhat pao theilou chu, Yeshua koma ahin puiyuve.
9.33: Hitia Yeshuan lhagaoboh chu anodoh jouvin amapa chu apao theitai. Hichu mi honpin adatmo lheh jeng uvin, “Hitobang hi Israel lah a anasoh khahih hel le,” atiuve.
9.34: Hinlah Pharisee hon, “Aman lhagaoboh chu Lhagaoboh ho Lengpa thahat vanga anodoh ahi,” atiuve.
9.35: Yeshua chuche gamkaiya khopi tinle khoneo tin a avahlen, akikhop nau inhoa thu ahil in, chule Lenggam Kipana Thupha chu aseiphong in ahi. Chuin Aman hivei ho le ana damlou ho aboldam in ahi.
9.36: Aman mihonpi amu phat'in, Aman amaho chu akhoto lheh e, ajeh chu amaho chu alungdong uvin chule panpi bei ahiuvin, kelngoi achingbei tobang ahiu amudoh in ahi.
9.37: Aman Aseijuite koma aseiyin, “Chang at ding atam lheh in, hinlah anatong ding alhom e.
9.38: Hijeh chun chang atna lou muna natong ding ahin soldoh theina ding in, lou neipa Pakai henga taovun,” ati.

10.1: Yeshuan aseijui som le ni ho chu akoukhom in chule amaho chu lhagao gilou ho nodoh theina le hivei namkim le natna ho damsah theina thuneina apen ahi.
10.2: Seijui som le ni ho min: Amasapen, Simon (Peter jong akitin), aban Andrew (Peter sopipa), James (Zebedee chapa), John (James sopipa),
10.3: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew (kaidongpa ahin), James (Alpheus chapa), Thaddaeus,
10.4: Simon (Zealot mi) chule Iscariot'a kon Judas (ama matsah a pang), hi chengse hi ahiuve.
10.5: Yeshuan seijui som le ni ho hiti hin ahil in: “Nangho chidang namdang ho kom ahilou leh Samaria mite koma che hih un.
10.6: Pathen kelngoi mangsa Israel te koma bou che uvin.
10.7: Chule nache nauva Van gam chu ahung naitai ti phongdoh un.
10.8: Ana sudam un, mithi kaithou un, phahvei ho ngimsah un, chule lhagaoboh ho nodoh un. Man beiya kilah a nahi bang un, phaldoh jeng un!
10.9: “Na sumdip uva sum, na konggah uvah sana dangka ahilouleh sum goi jeng jong kipoh hih-un.
10.10: Kholjin na a sakhau jeng jong akop in pohih un, kengchot ho le tenggol jeng jong kiken hih un chule min najen phat uleh ki phalam hih un, ijeh inem itileh natonga chun aneh ding dol ahi.
10.11: “Khopi sung hihen, khoneo sung hijongleh nalut nauva chun lhunna theija kilom michu holdoh un chule khosung ho nadalhah kahse uvin hichepa in a chun umun.
10.12: In nalut teng uleh phatthei na chu peuvin.
10.13: Achang dinga kilom in ahiuleh na phatthei nau chu umden hen, kilom lou in ahiuleh phattheina chu nunglah doh un.
10.14: Koi insung hihen, ahilouleh khopi sung hijongleh na lamdot lou uva, ahilouleh na thupoh-u angainom lou uleh, na dalhah ding teng uleh nakeng uva vutvai geiyin thing lhauvin.
10.15: Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, thutan nikho teng chuleh chutobang khopin athoh ding chu, gitlouna dim khopi teni: Sodom le Gomorrah thoh gamchenga oljo ding ahi.
10.16: “Veuvin, keiman ngeihon lah a kelngoi tobanga kasol nahiuve. Hiti chun gul ho tobang'in chingthei jun chule vapal ho tobang in suhset khoiset neihih un.
10.17: Hinlah ching theiyun! Ijeh inem itileh thutan ho khut a nahin pehdoh diu chule ki khopna in hoa sakol jepna a nahin jep diu ahi.
10.18: Nangho kanungjui nahi jeh uva gam vaipo holeh leng ho ang sunga na chung thu'u kitan ding ahi. Ahin hichu vaipoa pangho le atahsan lou ho henga, keima thu nasei theina diu phat kijentah hung hi ding ahi.
10.19: Amahon nahin mat teng uleh, iti ka donbut ding ham tin lungkham hih un; nasei diu apettah a Pathen in napeh diu ahi.
10.20: Ijeh nem itileh thuseija chu nangho hita louva na Pau Lhagao chun nang hoa kona thu ahin seidoh ding ahi.
10.21: “Sopi khat chun asopi chu thi dinga apeh doh ding, apa chun acha tahbeh jong chu apehdoh ding chule achaten anule pa adou uva chule athasah diu ahi.
10.22: Chule nanghon keima nung najuijeh uva nam jousen nahin hotbol diu ahi. Hijongleh achaina geiya thoh lhung jou chengse bou chu, huhhing a um ding ahiuve.
10.23: Nang hon khopi khat abol hesohna nato teng uleh, aban khoa jam lut un. Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel kho jouse naphah masang uva, Mihem Chapa hi hung ding ahi.
10.24: “Ahil uva pangpa sang in akihil ho alenjo ngaipoi chule soh ho jong apu sang in alenjo pouve!
10.25: Akihil ho chu ahilpau to abah uva chule soh ho jong apu uto abah diu chu phaset ahi. Chule keima insung pumpi neipa bon lhagao bohho lengpa eitiuva ahileh, ka insung mite chu hisanga phamo joa akou diu ahi.
10.26: “Hijongleh nagih uva pang ho chu kicha hihbeh un. Ajeh chu akisel guh jouse ki phondoh phat hung lhug ding ahi. Chule aguh a kisel jouse jong mi jouse het a um ding ahi.
10.27: Tua keiman muthim lah a kasei hi, kho ahungvah tengleh lhang phonga ki phongdoh ding ahi. Keiman na koluva thol a kasei hi mi jouse jah dinga, in chunga kisam doh ding ahi!
10.28: “Na tahsau that go ho kicha hih un, amahon na lhagao atongkha thei pouve. Pathen bou ging un, Ama chun na lhagao le na tahsau asuhmang thei chule damun a akoi thei ahi.
10.29: Inva nin ijat amat na het em? Paisa khat man bou ahi. Hinlah inva khat jeng jong na Pau het louva leiset a lhalou ahi.
10.30: Chule nalu uva nasam jang'u geiya kisim ahi.
10.31: Hijeh chun kicha hih un, inva ho aboncha uva sanga manlu joa nahiuve.
10.32: “Hiche leiset chunga Keima mipiho lah a eiphongdoh a chu, Keiman jong vana Kapa ang sunga Ka phondoh ding ahi.
10.33: Hinlah hiche leiset chunga hi koi hijongleh, ei seilep chan chu Vana um Kapa ang sunga kaseilep ding ahi.
10.34: “Keima leiset a hi chamna hinpo lut ding in nei gel hih un! Keima chamna poa hung hijo louvin, chemjam joh kahin poh ahi.
10.35: ‘Mikhat chun apa adou ding chule achanu chun anu adou ding, chule mounu tah chun atehpi adou dinga hunga kahi,
10.36: na melma teu chu na in sungmi ho lah a kona hiding ahi.’
10.37: “Nang man napa ahilouleh nanu chu keima sanga nangailut joh a ahileh, nangma keiya hi dinga kilom nahi poi; ahilou jongleh nachapa ahilouleh nachanu chu keima sanga nangailut joh'a ahileh, nangma keiya hi dinga kilom nahi poi.
10.38: Thingpel chu nakilah a chule kiput ding nanop louva ahileh, keiya hidinga kilom nahi poi.
10.39: Na hinna na kikol chah a ahileh na mansah ding, hinlah nangman keima dinga na hinna chu napeh doh jenga ahileh, na kimu ding ahi.
10.40: “Nangma nasanga chun keima eisan ahi chule keima eisanga chun, eisol Pa chu asan ahi.
10.41: Nangman themgao khat chu Pathen a dia thusei phong ahi chu nasan a ahileh, themgao khat hina a kipa man chu nasan ding ahi. Chule nangman mihong phal ho chu achonphat jeh uva nasan a ahileh, nangman jong amahoa tobang kipa man namu ding ahi.
10.42: Chule nangman twi dap khon khat kanungjui ho lah a aneopen jeng jong napeh a ahileh, nangman kipa man namu tei ding ahi.” ati.

11.1: Yeshuan hichenga seijui som le ni ho thu ahil jouvin, gamkai pumpia khopi hoa thuhil le lhangsam ding in aki patdoh tai.
11.2: Songkul a um John Baptist chun Messiah thil bol jouse thudol ajatan ahi. Hiti hin aseijuite ho chu asol in Yeshua aga dohsah in,
11.3: “Keihon kanga jingu Messiah chu nahi hitam, ahilouleh midang kanga be nahlai dingu ham?” atiuve.
11.4: Yeshuan amaho chu aseipeh in, “John henga kile kit un chule nathujah hou le namusa hou hi gaseipeh un,
11.5: mitchon kho amun, elbaiyin lam ajot in, miphah ho angim un, na ngong in kho ajan, athisa kai thouvin aum in chule mi vaicha Kipana Thupha seipeh ahi.
11.6: Chule ajah a ‘Keima jeh a kihei mang lou mi chu Pathen in phatthei na apei’ tiuvin,” ati.
11.7: John seijui hon adalhah phat un, Yeshuan achungchang thu mi honpi chu ahoulim pin, “Koi itobang mi gave dinga gamthip achu gachea nahiu ham? Ama pumpeng detlou hui anun chan a kilon lele tobang bep chu ham?
11.8: Ahilouleh pon man lutah a kivon a hintem? Ahipoi, pon man lutah a kivon ho khu leng inpia aum uve.
11.9: Themgao kimupi noma nahi uvem? Henge, chule ama themgao sanga chungnung joa ahi.
11.10: John chung chang thu hi Pathen Thubun asei, ‘Ven keiman na masanga palai khat ka solin chule ama chun na masanga na lampi ding nagon peh ding ahi.’
11.11: “Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, mi hing jouse lah a Twilutsah John sanga chung nung jo ding aumpoi.
11.12: Twilutsah John in thu asei phonga pat tu chan geiyin, Van gam chu gum hachang in amachal in, chule migilou hon hichu anokhum jing uve.
11.13: Ajeh chu John hung masanga kipat, themgao ho jouse le Mose Dan chun tulai phat hi agaldot uve.
11.14: Chule keiman kasei hi nakisan theiyuva ahileh, amahi Themgao hon aseiyu ahung ding Elijah chu ahi.
11.15: Koi hileh thu ngaina ding nakol neiho chun ngaiyu hen chule hekhen uhen!
11.16: “Tulai khang mi tehi ipitoh ka tekah ding ham? Kai lhang muna chapang ki chemho toh tekah thei ahiuve. Amahon agolte koma nopmo sahna aphongdoh uve.
11.17: ‘Keihon golvahna la kasah peh uvin, hinlah nangho nalam pouve chule thi opna la kasah peh uvin, hinlah nangho nalung hem pouve.’
11.18: Ajeh chu John in neh le don in phat anei pon, chuin nang hon ama chu lhagaoboh vop ahi natiuve.
11.19: Alang khat in, Mihem Chapan aneh a chule adona ahileh, amahi milop le julop ahi natiuve, chule kaidong ho le mi chonse ho jol le gol ahibouve, natiuve. Hinlah chihna hi aga hon adihna avetsah joh ahi,” ati.
11.20: Chuti chun Yeshuan melchih na kidang abolna khopi ho chu phongtah in themmo achan in ahi, ajeh chu amaho achonset nauva kon in alung hei pouvin chule Pathen lama amai ahei pouvin ahi.
11.21: “Chorazin le Bethsaida, itobang lungkham nan nahin pha diuvem? Ajeh chu thilbol kidang naheng uva kibol hohi Tyre le Sidon a kibol hita leh, masang peh chun achonset nauva kon in lung heiyun tin, akisih nau chun khaodip pon kivon uvin tin chule aluchung uvah vutvai kinu tau vinte.
11.22: Kaseipeh nahiuve, thupi kitan nikho tengleh Tyre le Sidon thoh ding chu athoh nomjo hi ding ahi.
11.23: Chule nangho Capernaum mite, nangho vangam a kijabol dinga kigel nahi uvem? Chuti ponte, nangho mithi lah a ki puisuh ding nahi uve. Ajeh chu melchih na nalah uva kibol hohi Sidon'a ana kibol hitaleh, tuni chan geiya hi um diu ahi.
11.24: Ka seipeh nahi uve, Sodom jeng jong chu thupi kitan nikhoa nangho sanga phajo ding ahiuve,” ati.
11.25: Hiche pet chun Yeshua hitin ataove, “Hepa, Van le Leiset Pakai, mi chingho le thil hetheiya kigel ho henga hicheng thil ho na selguh a chule chapang banga lunggel ho henga na hetsah jeh in ka thangvah e.
11.26: Henge, Pa, nang man hiti lama bol ding chu na lunglhai na ahi.
11.27: Ijakai ka-Pan einganse ahitai. Pa tailou koiman Chapa chu ahe tahbeh poi chule Chapan aki phondohna Chapa tailou koiman Pachu ahe tahbeh pouve.”
11.28: Chutah in Yeshuan, “Thachol ho le pohgih hahsa poho ka henga hung uvin, chutileh Keiman olsah uvinge.
11.29: Ka namkol jon kilah uvin kibu uvin. Keiman Kahil ding nahi uve, ajeh chu Keima nunnem tah le lungneng tah kahi chule nalung un lung olna amu ding ahi.
11.30: Ajeh chu ka namkol jon poh hi abaiyin chule ka pohsah got hi ajang e,” ati.

12.1: Yeshua chu suhlou chang umna lou jaova, cholngah nia aseijuite toh ahopa nauvah agilkel tauvin, hijeh chun amahon suhlou changvui chu amal lhauvin ane pan tauve.
12.2: Hinlah Pharisee ho phabep in amaho um chan amuvin chule nopmo sahna aphongdoh un, “Ven, na seijuiten cholngah nikhoa suhlou changvui amal'u hin dan apalkeh uve,” atiuve.
12.3: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Nangho Pathen Lekhabu simkhalou nahi uvem? David in agilkel pet'a chu aki lhonpi hotoh ipi abol uvem?
12.4: Ama Pathen in a alut in chule ama leh aloihon dan apalkeh uvin, thempu ho bouvin aneh ding uva kiphal changlhah theng chu ane uvin ahi.
12.5: Chule Mose danbua Thempu hou-in a lhacha hon cholngah nikhoa na atoh thei diu phal ahi chu simdoh khalou nahi uvem?
12.6: Kaseipeh nahi uve, Hou in sanga lenjo khat hichea aum e.
12.7: Hiche Pathen Thubun asei, ‘Keiman kilhai na thilto hi louvin, khotona nanei diu ka deijoh ahi,’ ti hi ipi kiseina ahi nahetdoh'u hileh them mona neilou Ka seijui ho themmo na chan lou diu ahi.
12.8: Ijeh inem itileh Mihem Chapa chu cholngah nikho chunga Pakai ahiye,” ati.
12.9: Chutah in Yeshuan akikhop nau in chu ajon paitai.
12.10: Chu muna chun khut ngoi khat amudoh in ahi. Pharisee ho chun Yeshua adong un, “Cholngah nikhoa ana damsah na chu dan in aphal em?” atiuve. (Amaho chun Aman aphal'e tin seihen lang Ama themmo chansah na kinei hen atiu ahi).
12.11: Chuin Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon kelngoi khat twikul a cholngah nin lhalut hen lang hileh, lahdoh tei ding nagon lou diu ham? Thon moa na gon diu ahi.
12.12: Chule kelngoi khat sanga mihem khat ichan geiya lujoa hitam? Tahbeh in cholngah nikhoa mikhat in thilpha abol ding chu dan in aphal ahi,” ati.
12.13: Chutah in Aman mipa jah'a chun, “Nakhut domin” ati. Hiti chun aman jong akhut adom in ahileh adamtai.
12.14: Chuphat in Pharisee ho aki khom uvin, Yeshua chu iti tha ding ham ti tohgon anei tauve.
12.15: Hinlah Yeshuan ipi agonu ahen, hiche mun chu adalhan chule mi atama tamin anung ajuitai. Amaho lah a ana damlou jouse aboldam in ahi.
12.16: Hinlah aman amaho chu koi ahi aphondoh louna ding un ahil chah in ahi.
12.17: Hiche hi Isaiah thusei Ama chunga agui lhunna ahi.
12.18: Ka lhacha Ka lhendoh hi ven, Amahi Ka cha deitah, Ka lung lhaina tah ahi. Keiman Ka Lhagao achunga kakoi ding, chule Aman chitin namtin lah'a dih tah'a thu atan ding ahi.
12.19: Aman doumah abollou ding, kisenlou ding, jalah a awsanga thu asei lou ding ahi.
12.20: Aman pumpeng chip jong aheboh pailou ding ahilouleh khoilu thaomei kihal khu atha mit pai lou ding ahi. Aman thudih'a thutan chu jona aumsah kahsea ding ahi.
12.21: Chule Amin chu vannoi pumpi kinepna hi ding ahi.
12.22: Chujouvin lhagaoboh vop khat, ama chu mitcho le pao theilou ahin, Yeshua koma ahin pui tauve. Ama chu adamsah'in ahileh thu asei theiyin chule kho jong amu tai.
12.23: Mi honpi chun adatmo uvin chule adong tauvin, “Hiche Yeshua hi David Chapa Messiah chu hi talou ding ham?” atiuve.
12.24: Hinlah Pharisee ho chun thil kidang kibol thu ajah phat un, asei un, “Aman lhagaoboh ho anodoh datmo hih un. Aman athanei na hi lhagaoboh ho lengpa Satan thahatna kon ahibouve,” atiuve.
12.25: Yeshuan alunggelu ahen, chuin adonbut in, “Lenggam ama le ama kidou amah thahjin, chule khopi hihen insung hijongleh akidou chan chu ding jou lou ding ahi.”
12.26: Chule Satan in Satan anodoh a ahileh, amale ama kikhen tela chule kidouva hiding, a lenggam chu ding doh joulou ding ahi.
12.27: Chule Keima Satan in thahatna eipeh ahileh nalah uva, lhagaoboh nodoh ho khula? Amahon jong lhagaoboh ho anodoh-u ahin, hijeh a chu na thusei uva chu themmo nahin chan diu ahi.
12.28: Hinlah Keiman Pathen Lhagao jal a lhagaoboh ho kanodoh a ahileh, Pathen Lenggam chu nalah uva hung lhunga ahitai.
12.29: Ajeh chu Satan tobang leuva hat mi khat in athanei tah galut a chule aneiho gachom ding koi ham? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akan tuma chule a in chu aphet lhahpeh ding ahi.
12.30: “Koi hijongleh Keima lama pang lou chun eidou ahi, chule koihileh Keima toh tong khom lou chun Keima douna a na atoh ahi.”
12.31: “Ka seipeh nahiuve, itobang chonset kibol hihen chule Pathen taitomna thusei doh hijongleh kingaidam thei ahi; Lhagao Theng taitomna athusei doh vang ki ngaidam lou ding ahi.
12.32: Mihem Chapa douna a thusei doh koi hijongleh ki ngaidam ding ahi, hinlah Lhagao Theng douna a thusei doh ho chu hiche vannoiya hihen, ahilouleh ahung lhung nalai ding vannoiya hijongleh ki ngaidam talou ding ahi.”
12.33: “Thingphung khat chu agan aphotchet ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat'a ahileh aga pha ding ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat louva ahileh, aga phalou ding ahi.
12.34: Nangho gul chilhah ho! Mi gilouvin thupha le thudih iti nasei thei diu ham? Ajeh chu na lunguva nagel lhah chan uchu ipi hijongleh na phondoh ahitai.
12.35: Mipha khat chun alung gela thilpha kikhol jeh'a apha chu ahin phondoh ahin chule mi phalou khat chun alung gela thil phalou akikhol jeh a aphalou aphondoh ahi.
12.36: Chule hiche hi ka seipeh nahiuve, mohthu nasei chengse chungchang thu chu thutanna nikhoa napeh ding ahi.
12.37: Nathusei ho chun nathem chan ahilouleh na themmo chansah ding ahi.” ati.
12.38: Nikhat hou dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho Yeshua henga ahung un chule aseiyun, “Pu, na thuneina photchet na nangma a kon'in melchihna kidang khat kamu nom uve,” ahung tiuve.
12.39: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Khang gilou le chon thanghoi khang miten melchihna ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khatbou kapeh ding chu Themgao Jonah melchihna hiding ahi.
12.40: Ajeh chu Jonah ngapi oisunga ni thumle jan thum aum banga, Mihem Chapa hi leilai gil a ni thumle jan thum um ding ahi.”
12.41: “Thutan nikho teng leh Nineveh mite hung dingdoh uva, tulai khang mite hi themmo ahin chan diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Jonah thusei phonga chun lung aheiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon lung nahei nom deh pouve.
12.42: Sheba Lengnu chu thutan nikho tengleh tulai khang mite douna a hung ding'a themmo ahin chan ding ahi, ajeh chu ama mun gam latah a kon in Solomon chihna thu ngaidin ahung e. Tuhin Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon asei nangai pouve.
12.43: “Lhagao phalou chun mikhat chu adalhah tengleh gamthip a aga chen, choldona ding ahol len, hinlah amu joupoi.
12.44: Chuteng aman aseiyin, ‘Keima ka hung potdohna pa koma gaki lekit tange ati. Hiti chun ahung kile kit in ahileh ahung dohna in chu koima ana umpon, ki theh ngim le kitup keicha aum chu amun ahi.
12.45: Chutah in lhagao chun ama sanga phaloujo lhagao sagi chu aga mun, chule mihempa sunga chun alut un acheng den tauve. Hiti chun ama chu masanga sang in akhohsejo chehtai.’ Hichu tukhang gilou mite hin, ahin hetchet diu ahi,” ati.
12.46: Yeshuan mihonpi henga thu aseipet in, anule asopi pasal ho ahung un, polama aumun, akihou limpi nom uvin ahi.
12.47: Chuphat in mi khat in ajah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopi pasal ho polama ading un, namu nom uve,” tin ahung seiyin ahi.
12.48: Hinlah Aman adonbut in chule ajah a aseiyin, “Koiham Kanu? Chule koiham Kasopi ho chu?” ati.
12.49: Chuin aman akhut chun aseijuite lam akoh in aseitai, “Veuvin, Kanu le Kasopite hohi!
12.50: Ajeh chu Koi hijongleh Vana um Ka Pa lunglam bol ho chu Kanu, Kasopipa chule Kasopinu te ahiuve,” ati.

13.1: Chujouvin hiche ni chun Yeshuan in chu adalhan chule dillen pama chun atouvin ahi.
13.2: Mihonpi akimvela aki khom un, hiti chun ama kong khat a alut e. Chuche muna chun atouvin chule mihonpi vapama umho chu thu ahil tai.
13.3: Aman thulem tampi mangchan amaho chu thusim tampi ahil in, hiche thusim hi aseiye: “Ngaiyun! Loubol mi khat muchi the ding in aga potdoh e.
13.4: Chule aman muchi chu loulaiya athea ahileh, muchi phabep chu lampia a-chu in ahileh vacha ho ahung un anejou tauve.
13.5: Muchi dang phabep chu songlheu chung lei patna a achutai. Lei apat jeh chun muchi chu ahung kehdoh loichel in ahi.
13.6: Hinlah nisa ahung satan ahileh, leiset achu ajung alut thuh lou jeh in asang gop pai jeng in ahi.
13.7: Muchi dang phabep ma chu ling lah a a-chu in ling chu akhang in chule chang phung dong nalai chu adep lihtai.
13.8: Hinlah muchi adang chengse vang leiphatna a a-chu in chule hiche ho chu ajat som thum, ajat somgup chule ajat jakhat chan geiyin apung uvin ahi.
13.9: Khojahna ding nakol nei ami chang cheh in angaiya chule ahetkhen angaiye,” ati.
13.10: Aseijuite ahung un chule adong uvin, “Iti dana nangman miho thu nahil tengleh thulem naseiji ham?” atiuve.
13.11: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho hi van Lenggam thuguh hettheina kipea nahi tauve, hinlah amaho kipe lou ahiuve.
13.12: Ka thuhil ngai ho chu hetkhen na kipeh be ding chule amahon hetna bulhingset anei diu ahi. Hinlah ka thuhil ngaisah lou ho chu hetna phabep aneiyu jong chu kilah mangpeh nalai diu ahi.
13.13: Hijeh chun hiche thulem ho hi Kaman chah ahi. Ajeh chu amahon avet vang uva amu tahbeh lou ding u, ajah uva ahivanga angaiyu chu hetdohna tahbeh neilou ding ahiuve.”
13.14: Hiche hi Isaiah themgao thusei, “Ipi kasei najah tenguleh hetkhenna nanei thei lou diu ahi. Ka thilbol namu tenguleh, geldohna nanei thei lou dingu ahi.
13.15: Ajeh chu hiche mite hi alung gelu atah cheh in, chule akol'uva khojahna aumpoi chule amahon amit asing uvin, amit un kho amu tapon, chule ana koluvin kho ajapon, chule alung un hetkhenna aneipon, chule keiman kasuhdam theina ding in ka heng lama ahung kihei pouve.”
13.16: “Hinlah namit teni uvin amu jeh un, namit-u mitvang pha ahi chule nana kolte niuvin ajah jeh un, nakol vangpha ahi.
13.17: Thu tahbeh ka seipeh nahiuve, themgao tamtah le mi chonpha tamtah'in namu uhi amu nomun, hinlah amu pouve. Chule thu najah chengseu hi ajah nomun, hinlah ajah lou-u ahitai.”
13.18: “Tuhin lou bolpa chun amuchi the ahil chetna ngaiyuvin.
13.19: Lampia chu-ah muchin avetsah chu Lenggam thu kihil ja'a, ahivanga hechen lou ho ahiuve. Chujouvin agi loupa chu ahung in chule alung sung uva kitulut muchi chu ahung lamang jitai.
13.20: Songlheu chunga chua muchi hin thu kisei chu ngaiya chule apet petna kipah tah a sanga mitoh tekah thei ahi.
13.21: Hinlah ajung athuh loujeh in ahingsot tapoi. Amaho chun hahsatna ato tenguleh ahilouleh Pathen Thu jeh a gim bolna ato tenguleh alhamang ji tauve.
13.22: Muchi ling lah a chu ho chu Pathen Thu ja a ahia tu hinlai vannoi lung gimna ho leh, haona ngaichatna ho jeh in gaso louvin aum jitai.
13.23: Muchi lei phatna a chuho vang thu chu atahbeh a ja a chule hetchetna nei ahiuvin, chule amaho chun ajat som thum, ajat som gup chule ajat jakhat ahin sodoh e!” ati.
13.24: Yeshuan thusim jatchom khat hichea hin aseiye: “Van gam chu loubol mi khat in alouva muchi pha athea toh tekah thei ahi.
13.25: Hinlah chuche jan chun natong ho aihmut pat un, melmapa chu ahung in chuin changtah lah a chun changlhem ahung then, ache mangtai.
13.26: Changphung ahung khanlhit phat in, aga jong ahung um'in chule changlhem jong chu ahung khang len in ahi.
13.27: Loubolpa natong ho akoma agache uvin, chuin ajah a, ‘Hepu louva muchipha nathe na'a khun changlhem akeh dimset in, hoiya kon iti hung um hintem?’ atiuve.
13.28: ‘Melma khat'in abol hichu’ tin loubolpa chun ahin phongdoh tai. ‘Changlhem ho kaga bodoh dingu ham?’ tin adong uve.
13.29: “Ahipoi, chutia nabol uleh changtah bodoh tha get nuvin nate.
13.30: A at phat lhin kah in khantha jengu hen. Chuteng keiman chang at ho jah'a changlhem chu lhengdoh unlang, kan khomun chule meiya halvam un, chule changtah chu changkul'a khum uvin tina nge” ati.
13.31: Hichea hin vetsahna chomkhat Yeshuan amange: “Van Lenggam chu ankam mu louva kithe tobang ahi.
13.32: Muchi jouse lah a aneopen ahi, hinlah hon a kitu lah a aphung lenpen ahung hitan, ahungkhang len in, thingphung ahung kisoh in, chule vacha ho ahungun chuin abah hoa abu akiset uvin ahi,” ati.
13.33: Yeshuan hiche thulem jong hi aseiyin: “Van gam hi numei khat'in changlhah semna dinga chol aman tobang ahi. Ama hin chol neocha chu chang bong tetohna thum'a akoi jeng vang'in, changbong chu apumpin apomsah soh hel in ahi.” ati.
13.34: Yeshuan mihonpi lah a thu aseina'a thusimle thulem hitobang ho hi amangcha jing in ahi. Ahimong in hitobang thulem mang cha louvin amaho koma thu asei jipoi.
13.35: Hiche hi Pathen in Themgao kam'a anaseisa: “Keiman nakom uva thulema kaseiding, Keiman vannoi kisem kipat apat thuguh kisel kahilchet peh ding ahi,” ti aguilhunna ahi.
13.36: Chuin mihonpi chu polama adalhan, Yeshua chu insung agalut in ahileh aseijuiten, “Changlhem loulaiya um thulem chu nei hilchet peh un,” atiuve.
13.37: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Loubolpa, muchipha the a-chu Mihem Chapa ahi.
13.38: Lou chu vannoi leiset ahi, chule muchipha chu Lenggam mite ahiuve. Changlhem chu agiloupa mite ho ahiuve.
