13.39: Melma changlhem changtah lah a thepa chu Diabol ahi. Chang at phat chu vannoi kichaina phat ahi, chule chang at ho chu Vantilte ho ahiuve.”
13.40: “Changlhem ho lhendoh a aum'uva chule meiya akigo banga chu, vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi.
13.41: Mihem Chapa chun a-Vantilte ahinsol ding, chule amaho chun Lenggama kon chonset hin umdohsah ho le thilse bol jouse asuhmang dingu ahi.
13.42: Chule Vantil ho chun amaho chu meikou jejua chu alelut dingu, hichea chu kana chule hagelna umding ahi.
13.43: Chuteng michonpha ho chengse a Pau Lenggam sunga nisa tobanga vahding ahiuve. Thungaina ding nakol neiya chun ngaiyu hen chule heuhen!”
13.44: “Van'a Lenggam chu mi khat in loulaiya gou kiselguh amudoh tobang ahi. Kipah thanom pum'in aselkit'in chule anei jouse chu ajoh doh in asumnei sun chun lou chu achotai.”
13.45: “Chujongleh Van'a Lenggam chu kivei mi khat in twikoh chang manlutah ahol tobang ahi.
13.46: Aman twikoh chang man lutah chu amudoh phat in anei jouse ajoh doh in, chule lou chu achotai.”
13.47: “Chule Van'a Lenggam chu nga matna len twi lah'a kiseplha a chule nga jouse man tobang ahi.
13.48: Len chu adimset phat in, hichu vapama aloidoh uvin, atou khomun chule nga aphaho chu aboma akoiyun, hinlah aphalou ho chu apai mang tauve.
13.49: Vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi. Vantil ho hunguvin tin michonpha hoa konna mi gilou ho ahin chom khendoh dingu ahi.
13.50: Miphalou ho chu mei deujeju sunga chun lehlut uvintin, hichea chu kana le hagelna umding ahi.”
13.51: Hiche hohi aboncha nahet nah uvem? atileh amahon “Henge,” atiuve.
13.52: Chujouvin aman aseiben, “Van'a Lenggama Hou thuhila pang seijui hung hi ho hi, in neipan aneikholna muna kona Thutah gou alui le athah ahin pohdoh tobang ahi,” ati.
13.53: Hiche thusimho le vetsahna ho ahil jouvin, aman chuche gam chu adalhan,
13.54: Achenna khopi Nazareth lama ahung kiletai. Aman amaho hou kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet'in amitakip in adatmo uvin chule aseiyun, “Hoiya kona hiche chihna le thil kidang boltheina hoiya thaneina akilah ahidem?” tin asei-uve.
13.55: Amahon anoisebol uvin, “Ama thing thembol chapa ahi, anu Mary le asopi pasal ho—James, Joseph, Simon le Judah abonun ihecheh uve.
13.56: Asopi numeiho jouse jong ilah uva aumcheh uvin. Hiche ho jouse hi hoiya kona akihetdoh hintem?” atiuvin ahi.
13.57: Chuin amaho chu hatah in alung-lhalheh uvin, chule Ama atahsan nomta pouve. Chuphat in Yeshuan amaho aseipeh in, “Themgao chu ama insung le akhopia mite lah tilouvin mun jousea jabolna achange,” ati.
13.58: Chuin amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin thil kidang themkhat bou aboltai.

14.1: Galilee vaipopa Herod Antipas hin Yeshua thu ajah phat in.
14.2: Aman asemang ho koma chun, “Hiche hi Twilutsah John athia thoudoh kit'a hitei inte! Hijeh achu hitobang thil kidang hohi aboldoh ahi,” ati.
14.3: Ajeh chu Herod in John chu ajinu Herodias (Herod naopa Philip ji ana hi) lung holna'a amat a songkul'a ahen ahi.
14.4: John chun Herod jah'a “Amanu na ki chenpi hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi,” atipeh jing anahi.
14.5: Herod chun John chu atha nom ahin, hinlah mipin adou diu chu kicha'a ahi, ajeh chu mi jousen John chu Themgao khat ahi tia atahsan'u ahi.
14.6: Hinlah Herod in apen nikhoa golnop abol nauva, Herodias chanu alam chun ama alunglhai lheh jeng in.
14.7: Hijeh chun amanu hin adei chan ipi hi jong leh pe dinga Herod in kitepna anei ahi.
14.8: Anu ngeh dungjuiyin, “Nungahnu chun, keiman Twilutsah John luchang chu lheng konga kadeiye,” atitai.
14.9: Chuphat in lengpan thu-asei chu akisih in, hinlah jin gunho masanga akitepna ahijeh chun, aman aki ngehna bang chun bol ding in asoltai.
14.10: Hiti chun Twilutsah John chu songkul'a alu atantai.
14.11: Chuin alu chu konga ahung kidom in chule nungahnu chu apen, ama chun anu apetai.
14.12: Khonung in, John seijui ho chu ahung un atahsa chu ahung lauvin chule avui tauve. Chutah in amaho aga che uvin, chuin Yeshua jah'a ipi soh a ham ahung hil tauve.
14.13: Yeshuan thusoh chu ajah jah in, Ama munchom beh a konga aga chen, achanga aga umtai. Hinlah mipi chun hoilama chea ahi ahe uvin, chuin khopi tin'a kon in Ama chu akeng in ajui tauve.
14.14: Yeshua chu konga kona ahung kumlhah a ahileh mi honpi chu amun, chule Aman amaho chu akhoton chule anat nau adamsah tai.
14.15: Hiche nilhah chun seijui ho ahung un chule aseiyun, “Hiche lai mun hi mun ningkoi ahin chule phat hi geisanga ahitai. Nangman mi honpi hi soldoh tan, amaho ache uva khotin'a aneh diu akichoh theina ding un,” atiuvin ahi.
14.16: Hinlah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hichu hithei ponte, nanghon neh ding peuvin,” ati.
14.17: Amahon adonbut uvin, “keihon changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni bou kaneiyuve,” atiuvin ahi.
14.18: Yeshuan aseiyin “Hichu hin choiyun,” ati.
14.19: Chutah in aman miho chu phoilah'a tou ding in asei pehtai. Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan vanlam aven, chule phatthei aboh in, chuin aman changlhah chu alan, ahehbal bal in, aseijui ho apen, amaho chun mi honpi chu apeuve.
14.20: Amahon angaichat chanun ane uvin, aval chu seijuihon paipeh som le ni alohdoh uve.
14.21: Chuche nikho chun pasal cheh mi sang nga chun ane vaset uvin, numei leh chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
14.22: Hiche jou chun Aman miho chu ain uva asol laiyin, aseijuite chu konga lut'a chule Dil gal langkhatna ana galkai ding in asol in ahi.
14.23: Amaho ain uva asoldoh jouvin, ama mol chunga tao ding in akaldoh in ahi. Jan ahung hitan, Ama achangseh'in mol a aum tai.
14.24: Hiche pet chun, seijuiho chun hahsatna atoh un, tolgo laiya kona gamlatah geiyuva ahi tauve, hui hattah ahung nung in, chule amaho chun twipi kinong hattah chu akimaito piuvin ahi.
14.25: Jingkah pung thum don in Yeshua amaho heng lama ahung in, twi chunga lam ajot in ahi.
14.26: Seijuihon Aman twi chunga lam ahinjot chu amuvin ahileh akicha lheh jeng uve. Akichat jeh'un amaho apeng uvin: “Lhadam ahi,” atiuve.
14.27: Hinlah Yeshuan ahin hou paiyin, “Kicha hih un. Lungmong tah in umun. Hia ka um nai,” ati.
14.28: Chuphat in Peter in Ama ahin houvin, “Pakai, Nangma nahi monga ahileh, nahenga twi chunga lam kahin jotna ding in neihin seipeh in,” ati.
14.29: Yeshuan, “Henge, hungin” ati. Hiti chun Peter chu kong panga akum lhan chule Yeshua lam jon in twi chunga lam ajot tai.
14.30: Hinlah Peter in hui hattah nung leh twipi kinong amu phat in, akichan chule lhalhum ding in aumtai. Chuin aman asam in, “Pakai, nei huhhing in,” ati.
14.31: Apettah chun Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule ama chu aman in, “Na tahsan aneo behseh'e, ipi dinga nei sonlel ham?” ati.
14.32: Amani kong sunga alut lhon phat in, huipi athip heltai.
14.33: Chuphat in seijuiho ahung un, Ama a-Hou tauve. Amahon, “Nangma Pathen Chapa tahbeh nahi monge,” atiuve.
14.34: Amaho Dillen chu agal kaiyun, Gennesaret alhung tauve.
14.35: Miho chun Yeshua ahi ahet phat un, agamkai pumpia chun ama hung lhun chu akisei thang sohtai, chule chomkah louvin miho chun ana damlou aneihou chu aboldam ding in abonchan ahin pui tauve.
14.36: Amaho chun apon mongkai beh atham ding uvin angeh uvin, chule Ama thamkha jouse adam tauve.

15.1: Pharisee ho le Houdan thuhil ho phabep chu Jerusalem a konin Yeshua kimupi din ahung lhungpai tauve.
15.2: Amahon Ama adong un, “Iti dana naseijui hon chondan luipeh ajuilou uham? Ajeh chu amahon neh khom masanga khutsop chonna isah louva akoiyu ham?” atiuve.
15.3: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutileh nanghon iti dan a Pathen in Thupeh apeh chu na chonnau jui man'a nahsah lou nahiu vem?
15.4: Avetsahnan, Pathen in, nanu le napa jabol in, chule koi hijongleh apa ahilouleh anu jalou tah'a houva chu kithat ding ahi.
15.5: Hinlah nanghon miho chun anu leh apa koma, ‘kapanhu joupoi’ tia aseidiu chu aphai natiuve. Ajeh iham itileh nangho kapeh diu pen chu Pathen a kapeh ding in kaki temtai natisah uve.
15.6: Hitia hi nanghon apa le anuteu ajabol diu angai khohpoi natiuve. Hiti hin nang hon Pathen Thu chu na chonnau dan'in na pailha tauve.
15.7: Vo mi phalhem ho! Isaiah chun nangho thu gaova anaseisa chu adih e, ajeh chu aman,
15.8: Hiche mite hin akam uvin keima eijabol'un, hinlah alung sungu keiya kon in gam latah ahi.
15.9: Eihou-u jong bolthu ahibouve, ajeh chu amahon mihem lung suhtoa agelu chu Pathen Thupeh in ahiluvin ahi,” ati.
15.10: Chuphat in Yeshuan mi honpi chu ahung'uva chule ajah diuvin akou khom in, Aman, “Ngaiyun chule hetkhen na neiyuvin.
15.11: Nasung uva lut chun nasuboh pouve ti heuvin; nakam uva kona hung potdoh thu joh chun nasuhboh'u ahi” ati.
15.12: Chujouvin seijui ho chu akoma ahung un chule adong uvin, “Tua nathusei chun Pharisee ho alung nopmo sah chu nagel doh em?” atiuve.
15.13: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kapan aphu lou thingphung kiphut chan chu abula kibot doh ding ahi.
15.14: Hijeh chu limsah hih un. Amaho mitcho le mitcho kilam hil ahiuve. Chule mitcho khat chun achom dang khat alam hila ahileh, ani lhona kokhuh'a lhalut talou ding ham?” ati.
15.15: Chutah in Peter in Yeshua jah a, “Mihon aneh uva akisu bohpoi nati thulem chu neihil chen un,” ati.
15.16: Yeshuan adong in, “Na hetlou laiyu hiya ham?” ati.
15.17: “Naneh'u chu gilpia alut in chule posona ah aki thadoh jitai.
15.18: Hinlah na thusei chu nakama kona hung potdoh'a ahi. Hichun nasuh boh'u ahi.
15.19: Ajeh chu lungsunga kona lunggel phalou ho, toltha, jonthan hoi, huh lungput, guchat, jousei chule miseiset.
15.20: Hichengse hin nasuhboh'u ahi. Khutsop louva anneh hin nasuhboh'u ahi poi,” ati.
15.21: Chujouvin Yeshuan Galilee chu adalhan chuin Tyre le Sidon gamkai sahlama agache toutai.
15.22: Chidang namdang numei khat chuche muna chun ahung in, angeh in, “O Pakai, David Chapa, nei lungset in! Ajeh chu kachanu hi lhagao phalouvin atomin asugim lheh jenge,” ahung ti.
15.23: Hinlah Yeshuan kamcheng khat in jong adonbut poi. Chuphat in aseijuite ahung uvin, “Amanu soldoh tan, amanu hi achena ding in seipeh in,” tin asei tauve.
15.24: Chuphat in Yeshuan numeinu jah a, “Keima amang thai kelngoi Israel mi (Pathen mite) henga bou eikisol ahi,” ati.
15.25: Hinlah amanu ahung in chule a-houvin, chuin angeh kit in, “Pakai nei panhu in,” ati.
15.26: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chate nehdi changlhah lahdoh peh a chule uicha peh angai ahipoi,” ati.
15.27: Amanun adonbut in, “Hichu adih ahi. Hinlah Pakai, uicha hon jong apute dokhanga kona anmal lhajah aneh diu phalpeh ahi,” ati.
15.28: Yeshuan, “Lungset umnu, natahsan alene. Thil nathum chu sanpeh na hitai,” tin aseipeh e. Chule achanu chu apettah in adamtai.
15.29: Yeshua Galilee twikhanglen a ahung kilen, chule mol chunga akaldoh in, chuin atoutai.
15.30: Mi honpi atama tam: a-elbai, mitcho, chatmo ho, a-pao theilou ho, chule midang tampi chu Ama henga ahin pui un. Amahon Yeshua ang'a alupsah uva ahileh, aman amaho chu aboncha uvin aboldam tai.
15.31: Mi honpi chun adatmo lheh uve. Apao thei louho jong apao theiyun, akhel a toi ho jong adamdoh un, chule nakong chatmo ho jong adamdoh un, chule mitcho hon jong kho amu tauve. Chuin amahon Israel Pathen chu avahchoi tauve.
15.32: Chujouvin Yeshuan aseijui ho akou khom in, ajah uvah, “Hiche mihonpi hi ka khoto'e. Amaho hi hiche muna hi keimato ni thum jen um ahitauve. Chule amahon aneh diu imacha khendoh anei pouve. Amaho hi gilkel'a soldoh ding kanompoi, achuti louva ahileh lampia lhasampa a alhuhkam diu ka nompoi,” ati.
15.33: Seijuihon adonbut uvin, “Mi honpi hibang loma tam hi aneh diu gamthip muna hi hoiya ilah diu ham?” atiuve.
15.34: Yeshuan adong in, “Changlhah ijat na neiyuvem,” ati. Amahon adonbut un, “Changlhah pheng sagi le nga them khat,” atiuve.
15.35: Hiti chun Yeshua chun mi jouse chu, tol a tou ding in aseipeh tai.
15.36: Chuin aman changlhah pheng sagi le nga chu alan, amaho ding in Pathen thangvahna aneiyin, chule ahal halin ahehbal bal in, Aman aseijuiho apen, amaho chun neh ding chu mi honpi lah a chun ahom tauve.
15.37: Amahon angaichat jat dungjuiyun aboncha uvin ane tauve. Hiche jou chun aseijuite chun anehval'u chu paipeh sagi alohdoh uvin ahi.
15.38: Amaho chu pasal sang li jen alhing uvin, numei ho le chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
15.39: Chujouvin Yeshuan mi honpi chu a-incheh ah asol in, chuin Ama chu kong khat'a alut'in Magadan gamkai lam a agalkai tai.

16.1: Nikhat hi Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho Yeshua koma apatep ding in ahung un, athuneina thudola melchihna kidang khat ahung ngeh uvin ahi.
16.2: Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon janteng van asan le jing leh kho phading ahi natiuvin,
16.3: Jingkah a van asan le nilhuma kho phalou ding ahi natiuva nahet'u ahi. Nanghon kho phat ding thua vana melchihna a kona nahet'u ahi, hinlah phat umdol amelchihna na hedoh thei pouve.
16.4: Khang gilou le jonthan hoina khang miten melchihna kidang ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khat bou amaho kapeh dingu chu Themgao Jonah melchihna bou hiding ahi,” ati.
16.5: Chuche jouvin, Dillen langkhat lama agalkai phat in, seijui hon changlhah apoh lou uchu ahin geldoh tauve.
16.6: Yeshuan amaho agih salin, “Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chol'a kon in kichih theiyun,” ati.
16.7: Amahon changlhah apoh tahlou jeh'u chun khat le khat akinel den tauve.
16.8: Yeshuan amahon ipi seija ahiu chu ahen, hiti chun, “Na tahsanu alhom tave! Changlhah neilou jeh'a ipi dia kinela nahi uvem?
16.9: Tugeiya hi nahetdoh lou uham? Mi sang nga changlhah pheng nga'a kavahva chu aval paipeh ijat nalodoh'u hitam?
16.10: Ahilou jongleh mi sang li changlhah pheng sagia, chule aval paipeh tamtah nalodoh uchu?
16.11: Ipi iti dana changlhah chung thua kasei ahipoi ti hedoh theilou nahi uvem? Hitia hi avela kasei ahi, Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho chol lah achun kichih theiyun kati ahi,” ati.
16.12: Chuphat in anunung pena, Aman changlhah'a chol thu asei hilouva, Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho doha lhep lhahna thuhil aneiyuva achihthei diuva ahil chu ahedoh tauve.
16.13: Yeshuan Caesarea Philippi ahunggei phat in, aseijui ho jah a “Mihon, Mihem Chapa hi koi ahi atiuvem?” tin adong tai.
16.14: Amahon adonbut un, “Mi phabep chun Twilutsah John ahi atiuvin, mi phabep chun Elijah ahi atiuvin, chule adang phabepma chun Jeremiah ahilouleh themgao ho lah'a khatpen hinte,” atiuve.
16.15: Chujouvin, amaho chu thu adong in, “Nanghon koi ahi neitiu vem?” ati.
16.16: Simon Peter in adonbut in, “Nangma Messiah, Pathen hing Chapa nahi,” ati.
16.17: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangma anunnom a nahi, John chapa Simon, ajeh chu nangman mihem koima'a kona nahet ahipon, vana ka-Pan na henga hiche hi ahin phondoh ahi.
16.18: Na henga kasei ahi, nangma Peter (Song) nahi, chule hiche Songpi (Christa) chunga hi Ka houbung Ka tundoh ding ahi, chule Damun thaneina in ajo joulou ding ahi.
16.19: Chule Keiman Van gam kot heh ho kapeh ding nahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou dinga na thupeh chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na noppeh chan chu vana jong kinop peh ding ahi,” ati.
16.20: Chujouvin Aman aseijui ho jah achun koima koma Messiah ahi chu, aphondoh louna ding uvin hatah in agihtai.
16.21: Chuchea pat chun Yeshuan aseijuite koma kichen tah in, Jerusalem a aga che ding angai khohna aseiyin, chule aman hou vaipo loi le thempu le houdan thuhil hoa kona thil tampi gimnei hahsa ho athoh ding chu ahiltai. Ama ahin tha diu, hinlah anithum lhin nileh thina a kona thoudoh ding ahi.
16.22: Hinlah Peter chun Ama apuidoh in chule chutia thu asei chu haphon aphoh in, “Pakai Vanin jong oiponte, hiche hi na chunga lhung hih beh jeng hen,” atitai.
16.23: Yeshua, Peter lama aki heiyin, ajah a, “Satan, kakoma konin chemang in! Nang hi keima dinga tijat um thangkol nahi! Nangman Pathen a kon hilouvin mihem lunggel a kona navet jeh ahi,” ati.
16.24: Chuphat in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Nalah uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chon nauva kona nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui diu ahi.
16.25: Na hinkhou naki kolchah jom uva ahileh, na mansah dingu ahi. Hinlah nanghon keima jal'a nahin nau naphal doh uva ahileh, naki huhhing diu ahi.
16.26: Chule vannoi apumpi nanga hihen lang, na hinna chan tale chun ipi phachom ding ham? Na hinna sanga man lujo ipi um nalaiyem?
16.27: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa hi avantil teho toh'a Pa loupina a hung ding chule mi jouse chu atoh dung juicheh a athu'u atan ding ahi.
16.28: Chule Keiman thutah kaseipeh nahi uve, hikoma tupetna ding ho lah'a Mihem Chapa a Lenggama ahung masanga thilou ding aum uve,” ati.

17.1: Ni gup jouvin Yeshuan Peter chule ucha teni Jacob le John chu molsang tah khat'a achanga umpi ding in apui touvin ahi.
17.2: Amaho chun avet pettah un Yeshua limso chu ahung kikhel in, hiti chun amaiso chu nisa bang in avah jeng in, chule aponsil chu vah bang in avah jeng in ahi.
17.3: Phot lot in Mose le Elijah ahung kilah in, chuin Yeshua chu akihou limpi pai lhon in ahi.
17.4: Peter chun Pakai, “Hikoma iumu hi aki dang lheh jenge! Nadeiya ahileh nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat melchihna ponbuh thum song inge,” ati.
17.5: Hinlah aman athusei pet chun meibang in amaho chu ahin tom khum un, chule vana konin aw khat in ahin-seiyin, “Hiche hi Ka Chapa ngailut tahbeh, ei kipa sah'a ahi, Athu ngaiyun,” ati.
17.6: Seijui ho chu akicha behseh'un, chuin tol a amaiyu asulut tauve.
17.7: Chuphat in Yeshua amaho lama ahung in chule amaho chu atham in, “Thoudoh un, kicha hih un,” ati.
17.8: Chuin amaho adadoh uva ahileh, Mose le Elijah chu ana chedoh tan, chule Yeshua bou chu amu tauve.
17.9: Amaho molchunga kona ahung kinung le suh phat'un Yeshuan Amaho chu thu apen, “Mihem Chapa thina a kona kaithouva aum kahsen koima koma na thilmu'u hi seidoh hih un,” ati.
17.10: Chujou chun aseijui-ten Ama adong un, “Ipi jeh a Dan thuhil hon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kile ding ahi tia asei sei jingu hintem?” atiuve.
17.11: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Elijah chu tahbeh a hunga ijakai agontup masat ding ahi.
17.12: Hinlah Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve. Elijah ana hunga ahitai, ama chu isah louvin abol tauve. Chule chutobang ma'a Mihem Chapan jong athoh gim ding ahi,” ati.
17.13: Chuin seijui ho chun Twilutsah John chung thu asei ahi ahedoh tauve.
17.14: Mi tampi chun Ama chu mol chunga ana ngah tauvin, mikhat chu ahung in chuin Yeshua ang-ah adilsun chule aseiyin,
17.15: “Pakai Ka chapa lungsetna neiyin, ama abuhthia ahin, chule athoh gim lheh e. Ama meisunga ahilouleh twi lah'a alhu matchet jin ahi.
17.16: Hitia hi naseijuite koma kahin puiyin, hinlah amahon adamsah jou pouve,” ati.
17.17: Yeshuan, “Vo tahsan neilou le miduh dahlou ho! Itih chan kaumpi nahlai ding nahiu vem? Chapangpa chu kakoma hin hinpuiyun,” ati.
17.18: Chutah in chapangpa sunga lhagaoboh chu Yeshuan aphoh in, hichun ama adalhatai. Hichea pat chun chapang chu adamtheng tai.
17.19: Chujou chun seijuiho chun guhthim in Yeshua chu adong un, “Keihon itia lhagaoboh chu nodoh joulou kahiu ham?” atiuve.
17.20: Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Tahsan bulhing naneilou jeh'u ahi. Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, tahsana aneova neo ankam mu tebep geiya naneiyuva ahileh, nanghon hiche mol jah'a hin, hichea kon khun kichon in tia nasei uleh, kichon thei ahi. Imacha ahimo ding aumpoi.
17.21: Hinlah hitobang lhagaoboh hi taona chule an ngol tilou potdoh lou ahi,” ati.
17.22: Galilee a amaho akikhop kit phat un, Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Mihem Chapa hi amelmate khut'a pehdoh a um ding ahi.
17.23: Ama atha diu, hinlah ani thum nileh athia kona kai thouva um ding ahi,” ati. Chuin seijuiho chu lunghem nan adim tauve.
17.24: Capernaum ahunglhun un, Hou'in a kaidong ho Peter koma ahung un chuin ajah a, “Na houhil pauvin Hou in kai apeh ngailou ham?” tin adong uve.
17.25: “Henge, apejie,” tin Peter in adonbut e. Chuphat in in sunga agaluttai. Hinlah aman thu asei masang in, Yeshuan anadong in, “Peter, ipi iti nagel em? Lengho khun ama mite kai adon jiu ha? Ahilouleh gal'a ajosa hou koma kai adonu ham?” ati.
17.26: Peter in adonbut in, “Gal'a ajohou koma kai adong uve,” ati. Yeshuan aseiyin, “Chuti ahileh aphai, agam mite chu ongthola ahiuve.
17.27: Hijongleh, amaho lung thoisah pohite, hiti hin Dil a gakum lhan chule ngakoi galeh lhan. Nga namat masatpen kam chu keh in, chuteng nangman sana dangka apeh len khat namu ding ahi. Hichu choiyin lang, ini lhon ding in ga petan,” ati.

18.1: Hichepet chun seijuiho Yeshua henga ahung un chule thudoh aneiyun, “Van Lenggama chu koipen alenpen hi ding ham?” atiuve.
18.2: Yeshuan chapang neocha khat akoma din akouvin, chuin chapang chu alah uva adinsah in.
18.3: Chuphat in aseitai, “Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho nachonset nauva kona nakile heiyuva chule chapang neocha ho tobang nahung hilou uva ahileh, Van Lenggam a nalut louhel diu ahi.
18.4: Hijeh chun koi hijongleh chapang neocha ho tobanga kineosah mi chu, Van Lenggam a alenpen hi ding ahi.
18.5: Chule koi hijongleh Keima khel a chapang neokhat sanga chun, Keima eisan ahi.”
18.6: Hinlah nanghon hiche aneocha ho lah'a khat Keima eitahsan achu chonsetna nalhahsah uva ahileh, sumhei lentah khat na ngong changa kihen henlang twikhanglen'a kileh lut lechun nangma ding in aphajoi.
18.7: “Vannoiya hi itobang gimnan ahinphah ding hitam! Ajeh chu miho chonse din alhem in ahi. Lhep patepna hohi pel theilou ahi, hinlah alhema pang mi chu iti hahsat ding hitan tem?
18.8: Hijeh chun nakhut ahilouleh nakeng in chonset nabolsah leh tanbong in chule paimang in khutkhat ahilouleh kengkhat neiya tonsot hinna'a nalut chu, khut ni ahilouleh keng ni neiya tonsot meidila nalut sang in gamcheng in aphajon ahi.
18.9: Chule namit in nachonset sah'a ahileh, kaldoh'in lang chule paimang jeng in. Mit khat neiya tonsot hinna'a lut chu mit ni neiya meidila lut ding sang in aphajoi.”
18.10: Ching theiyun, nanghon hiche ho lah a aneopen ho jong noise hih un. Ajeh chu van a avantil teu van a ka Pa ang sunga um jing ahiuve.
18.11: Chule Mihem Chapa hi amangthah ho chu huhhing dinga hung ahi.
18.12: “Mikhat in kelngoi jakhat neihen lang, chule hiche ho lah a khat chu vahmang taleh amapa chun ipi aboldem? Aman adangse somko le ko chu mol achun dalhan tin chule amang chu holding a chedoh lou ding ham?
18.13: Chule aman amu tengleh, tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, ama chunga akipana chu avah manglou somko le ko sanga lenjo ding ahi.
18.14: Hitobangma achu, hiche aneocha ho lah'a khatpen amah thah ding chu van a um Ka Pa lunglam ahipoi.”
18.15: “Tahsan nei mi dang khat nangma douna a achonset a ahileh, na chang in chen chule athemmona chu seipeh in. Aman nasei angaiya chule hichu aphondoh'a ahileh, nangman ama chu nathujo ahitai.
18.16: Hinlah nathujo joulou tah'a ahileh, nangman mikhat ahilouleh mini kipuiyin, gache kit in, hitia chu nangman nasei chu hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum in phochen hen.
18.17: Ama ada nahlaiya nasei angai louva ahileh, nachung thu chu houbunga lhut in. Chutengleh ama chun houbung thu angai louva ahileh, hichepa chu milim hou ahilouleh chidang nam dang in kisim jeng hen.”
18.18: “Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon leiset chunga najahda chan uchu vana jong kijada ding, chule leiset chunga naphal chanu chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou ding nati chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na phalpeh chan chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi.
18.19: Hiche jong hi ka seipeh nahiuve: Nalah uva mi ni na kinop touva ipi hijongleh leiset chunga nathum chan'u chu, vana Ka Pan nang ho dinga abol ding ahi.
18.20: Ijeh inem itileh Kamin a ni ahilouleh thum naki khop khom nau chana chun, Keima nalah uva kaum jing e,” ati.
18.21: Chujouvin, Peter Ama koma ahung in chuin ajah a, “Pakai, mi koiham khat chu keima douna a achonset a ahileh, ijatvei kijoma kangaidam thei ham? Sagi vei chan gei ham?” ati.
18.22: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keiman najah'a sagi vei katipoi, hinlah sagi mun som sagi vei kaseina ahijoi.”
18.23: “Hiche jeh'a hi van Lenggam chu Lengpa khat in asohte toh, ama koma sum baho chuto sum suto dinga akou khom toh kitekah thei ahi.
18.24: Aman sum asuhto khom nauva chun, ama koma sum sang som bapa chu ahinkai tauve.
18.25: Aman asah joulou phat in, apupa chun aji leh achate chule anei jouse ajoh'a abat chu asah dingin thu apetai.”
18.26: “Hinlah ama chu apupa ang sunga chun abohkhup in chuin athum in, ‘Lungsettah in, nei khongaiyin, keiman abonchan pena nge’” ati.
18.27: Chuphat in apupa chun akhoto lheh in, chuin alhadoh in chule abat angaidam tai.
18.28: Hinlah aman lengpa ada lhah chun, asoh chanpi sum asang mai mai bapa koma chun achen, angonga aman'in chule apetpet in neipen atitai.
18.29: Asoh chanpi a-anga adilsun chule phat chomkhat bep anga dingin angeh in: Nei khongaiyin, keiman penange tin angeh jeng e.
18.30: Hinlah abat napa chun angah jou tapoi. Aman mi amatsah in chule batchu asah chaisoh kahsea dingin songkul a akhum tai.
18.31: “Soh achom dang hon hichu amuvin, alung nommo lheh tauvin ahi. Amaho lengpa koma acheuvin chule thilsoh chu agasei sohkei tauve.”
18.32: Chuphat'in lengpa chun angaidamsa pachu akoulut'in chuin ajah a, Nangma soh-gilou! Keima henga nathum jeh'a bat chujat jenpi chu kangaidam nahitai.
18.33: Keiman nangma kakhoto tobanga chu nasoh chanpi nakhoto ding hilou ham? ati.
18.34: Chuphat'in alung hang'ah lengpa chun abat aboncha asahchai kahsea dingin hichepa chu songkul'a akhumtai.
18.35: “Vana um ka-Pa chun nanghon nasopiteu chu nalungil'uva na ngaidam louva ahileh nachung'uva hitia chu achutibol ding ahi,” ati.

19.1: Yeshuan hicheng thu asei jouvin, Galilee adalhan chuin Jordan vadung solama Judea gamkaiya achesuhtai.
19.2: Chuche muna chun mihon tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin, chuin Aman anaho adamsah tai.
19.3: Chuin Pharisee ho phabep ahung un hiche thudoh a hi kipalsah ding in apatep un: “Mikhat chun ajeh khat aum pouva ahileh aji ada thei hiya ham?” atiuve.
19.4: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thubua simdoh khalou nahi uvem? Hichea chun, atil abula pat Pathen in amaho chu pasal le numeiya asem ahi.”
19.5: Chuin aman aseiyin, “Hiche hin ipi jeh a pasal khat in apa le anu adalhah a chule ajinu akolchah ding, chule ani lhona khat hilhon ding ahitai ti ahil chen e.”
19.6: “Ama ni chu mini hita louva khat ahilhon tah jeh in, Pathen in agop khomsa chu koiman sukhen tahih hen,” ati.
19.7: “Chuti ahileh ipi jeh a Mose chun Danbua pasal khat in ajinu chu, dana lekha jih henlang chule solmang hen ati hintem,” atiuve.
19.8: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nalung thimu atah behseh jeh'a kida thua phatsahna napeh'u ahibouve, hinlah hichu Pathen in ana lunggon ahipoi.
19.9: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh aji da a chule achom ki chenpia chun jon abol ahitai, ajinu chun kitahna neilou hinkho mang ahingal louleh,” ati.
19.10: Yeshua seijuite chun ajah a aseiyun, “Hiti chu ahia ahileh jinei lou aphajoi!” atiuve.
19.11: Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hiche thu kisei hi mi jousen sang thei ponte. Pathen panpi na changhoa ding bou ahi.
19.12: Mi phabep chu apena cha hing theilou dia gonsa aum in, mi phabepma chu midang'in chutia asempeh loi jong aum in, chule abang phabep kit chu Pathen Lenggam jal'a jinei lou deilhen'a jong aumuve. Koi hileh hiche hi asang theiyin kisan hen,” ati.
19.13: Nikhat hi chapang ho chu anu leh apa teuvin, Yeshuan achung uva akhut angap a ataopeh din ahin puijui. Ahin seijuite chun anu leh apa teu chu mi nasugim uve tin ana houseuvin ahi.
19.14: Hinlah Yeshuan, “Chapang ho chu kakoma hungsah un. Hungda sah hih un. Ajeh chu Van Lenggam chu hitobang chapang hoa ding bou hiya ahi,” ati.
19.15: Chuin Aman alu chunguva akhut teni angam in, chuin phatthei aboh jouvin adalhatai.
19.16: Mikhatma Yeshua koma hiche thudoh hi dong ding in ahung in, “Houhil, Tonsot Hinna kanei theina dinga ipi natoh pha kabol ngai hintem?” ahung ti.
19.17: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga apha chu ipi ham tia neidoh ham? Apha khatseh bou ahi. Hinlah na thudoh donbutna ding in Tonsot Hinna chu nanei nomleh, thupeh ho juiyin,” ati.
19.18: Ama chun adong in, “Hoipen chu ham?” ati. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman tolthat hih in, nangman jon bolhih in, nangma gucha hih in, nangman thujou seiphong hih in.
19.19: Napa le nanu jabol in. Nangma na kingailut bang in naheng nakom ngailun,” ati.
19.20: Khangdongpa chun adonbut in, “Hiche thupeh ho jouse hi kajui sasoh kei ahitai. Ipi adang kabol ding um nalaiyem?” ati.
19.21: Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangma chamkim nahi nom leh, chenlang nanei jouse abon'in gajoh in chule asum chu mi vaicha ho gapen, chutileh vana gou khol ding nanei ding ahitai. Chujouleh hung in, neijuiyin,” ati.
19.22: Hinlah khangdong pan hichu ajahdoh phat in, gouthil tamtah nei ahijeh'in, lungnom motah in achemang tai.
19.23: Chuphat in Yeshuan aseijui ho jah a, “Thu tahbeh ka seipeh nahiuve, mihao khat ding in Van Lenggam lut ding chu ahahsa lheh jeng e.
19.24: Keiman seikit inge—Sangong sang dinga heobil hom sunga alut ding chu, mihao khat Pathen Lenggam a alut sanga baijo ding ahi,” ati.
19.25: Seijui hon adatmo lheh jeng un, chutobang ahileh vannoiya hi Huhhinga koi umjou ding ham? atiuve.
19.26: Yeshuan amaho chu ave chang mel'in chuin aseijin, “Mihem hina lamdol a seiding in, hithei chu ahipoi. Hinlah Pathen toh pankhom na a ijakai ahithei soh keiye,” ati.
19.27: Chuphat in Peter in ajah a, Keihon ijakai ka dalha uvin nanung kahin juiyuve. Ipi kahin mu diu ham? ati.
19.28: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keiman kasei chetpeh nahiuve. Vannoi aki thahsem tengleh, Mihem Chapa hi Loupina Laltouna a atou tengleh, kanung juiya nangho jong laltouna, Som le ni chunga natou uva, Israel phungsom le ni chunga thu natan diu ahi.”
19.29: “Chule koi koihileh a inho ahilouleh asopinu le asopipate ahilouleh apa ahilouleh achate ahilouleh aneile agou jouse dalha jenga chu, chan jakhat geiya amu ding chule tonsot Hinna chu alemu ding ahi.
19.30: Hinlah mi tamtah tua choisanga umho suhnem hidiu, chule tua ima hilouva kikoi ho chuphat tengleh choisangna chang diu ahi,” ati.

20.1: “Ajeh chu Van Lenggam chu louneipa jingkah matah a, lengpi leiya natong ding tha hola gapotdoh tobang ahi.
20.2: Aman niseh'a thaman jat apeh ding in akinop touvin, chuin natong ding in amaho chu asoldoh tai.”
20.3: “Jingkah nidan ko in kailhang ahopan ahileh, imacha bol louva moh'um mi phabep chu amun.
20.4: Hiti chun aman amaho chu agoiyin, nisa lhum teng keiman phante kati kham na penau vinge, ati.
20.5: Chuin amaho natong ding in lengpi leiya ache tauve.”
20.6: “Ni lhangkai pung nga a ama khopi sunga aga umkit pet in, aman midang phabep amoh'um amun ahi. Aman, ‘Ipi dinga tunia natong lou nahi uvem?’” tin adonge.
20.7: “Amahon, ‘koima eigoiyuva aum loujeh ahi’ atiuve. Lou neipa chun aseipeh un, chuti ahile che-un chule ka lengpi leiya natongho lah'a ga jaovun ati.”
20.8: “Chuche nilhah chun aman natong ho lamkaipa chu aseipeh in, natong jouse kou lut in chule natong nunung pena atoh manu pe pan in,” ati.
20.9: Pung nga a kigoi ho chu sum apeh phat in, achang cheh un nikho thaman akimu cheh tauve.
20.10: Akigoi masa ho chu asumu ladinga ahung phat'un, amaho chun tam mu cheh ding akinem uve. Hinlah amaho jong chu nikho thaman to kitoh aki peuvin ahi.
20.11: Amahon atohman akimu phat'un, amaho alou neipa chunga alungnom tapouve.
20.12: Khuchehon pung khat bou natong uva, keiho nilhum keiya nisa ahah laise thoh lhum keiho toh kibang'in amaho na peuve atiuvin ahi.
20.13: “Aman amaho khat chu adonbut in, ‘Gol, keiman adihlou kabolpoi! Nangma nilhum keiya nikhotha man lo dinga nanop hilou ham?’”
20.14: Nasum kilah in chule chen, hiche natong nunung pen hi nanga tobang in kape nom e, ati.
20.15: Kasum chu kadeina banga kaman ding chu dantoh akikalna ipi uma ham? Keiman midang kakhoto jeh'a nei mit thipna ding ipi umem?
20.16: “Hiti chu ahin, tua anunung peh ho chu chuphat teng amasapen hi dingu, chule amasa ho anunung hung hi ding ahiuve,” ati.
20.17: Yeshua chu Jerusalem lama achetou in ahileh, aman seijui som le ni ho chu guhthim in achoma akou doh in chule achunga ipi hung soh ding thu aseipeh tai.
20.18: Aman aseiyin, “Ngaiyun, eiho Jerusalem jon'in ichetou uve, chule thempu pipui hole houdan thuhil ho khut'a Mihem Chapa hi kipedoh ding ahi. Amahon thadinga apehdoh diu ahi.
20.19: Amahon Rome sepai ho khut'a apehdoh diu, sakol jepna a avoh diu chule thingpel a akhetbeh diu ahi. Hinlah ni thum nileh thinaa kona thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
20.20: Chua pat chun James le John Zebedee chapa teni Nu chu Yeshua koma achate nito ahung'un ahi. Aman jana neitah in adilsun lungsetna angeh e.
20.21: Aman adong in, “Ipi nathum nom ham?” ati. Amanun adonbut in, “Na Lenggama kachapa teni hi jabolna mun'a: khat najet lama chule khat navei lama koi gel in,” ahung tin ahi.
20.22: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in ajah uva, “Ipi nathumu nanghon na kihet pouve! Keiman gimhesoh kathohna ding khon kadon ding chu nadon ngam hinam?” ati. Aman in, Henge, kangam lhon'e tin adonbut lhontai.
20.23: Yeshuan ajah lhonna, “Nangnin tahbeh mongin kagimna khon hi nahin don lhon ding ahiye. Hinlah keiman koi kajet'a ahilouleh kaveiya toudi ham? Ti thuneina kaneipoi. Ka Pan alhendoh a agonpeh ho ding mun ahiye, tin aseipeh tai” ati.
20.24: James le John in ipi athum lhon ahi seijui adang som ho chun ajah doh phat'un alung gil uva nomo asalheh tauve.
20.25: Hinlah Yeshuan amaho chu akou khomin, chuin ajah uva, “Nanghon vannoi vaipipo hon midang chunga ki piput sahna aneijiu naheuve chule lamkai lenho chun anoiyuva ho chunga thuneina aneiyu naheuve.
20.26: Hinlah nangho lah'a chutilou ding ahi. Nangho lah'a alamkai pipu hinoma chu nasoh uva pang ding ahi.
20.27: Chule nalah uva amasa hinoma chu nasoh'u ahung hi angaiye.
20.28: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa jeng jong chu jenle dinga hilouva, ajen ding le mitamtah hinna dinga ahinna pedinga hunga ahi,” ati.
20.29: Chuin Yeshua le aseijuihon Jericho khopi chu adalhah nung uvin, mihon tamtah'in anung ahinjui uve.
20.30: Mitcho mini chu lampi pama atou lhon'e. Amanin Yeshua chun hilampi chu ahinho ding ahi ti ajahlhon phat in, amanin hasap in asam lhon in, Pakai David Chapa, neikhoto lhon in! atilhon tai.
20.31: Mihonpi chun aphoh uvin, “Thip lhon in atiuvin.” Hinlah amanin aha-sapcheh lhon in, “Pakai, David Chapa, neikhoto lhon in,” atilhone.
20.32: Yeshuan a-aw lhon ajah phat in, ading'in chule akouvin, “Ipi kabolpeh lhon ding nei deisah lhon'em?” atitai.
20.33: Amani chun, Pakai kho kamu nom lhon'e, ati lhon'e.
20.34: Yeshuan amani chu akhohsah jal'in, amit lhon athampeh tai. Hipettah chun kho amuthei lhontai! Chujouvin amanin ajuipai lhontai.

21.1: Yeshua le aseijuite Jerusalem ahung naiyun, Bethphage khopi Olive mola um chu ahin pha tauve. Chuin Yeshuan aseijui mini ama sanga asol'in,
21.2: aseiyin, “Khuche khoa khun galut lhon in, nagalut lut lhon le sangan anouto kihen na gamu lhon ding ahi. Anin lham lhon'in chule kakoma hinpui lhon in.
21.3: Koiham khat touvin ipi bola nahi lhon em tia donga aumleh, Pakaiyin aman nom e, tilhon in, chuteng aman aphal jeng ding ahi,” ati.
21.4: Hiche thilsoh hi Themgao thusei guilhunna dinga soh ahi,
21.5: “Jerusalem a cheng ho jah a seiyin, ‘Veuvin, na Lengpau chu na komuva ahung e. Ama nunnemtah ahin, sangan chunga atouvin—sangan nou chunga ahung touve,’” tia kisei chu,
21.6: Seijui teni chun Yeshuan athupeh bang'in abol lhon in ahi.
21.7: Amanin sangan chule anou chu Ama koma ahin pui lhon in chule amaho chun apon uchu sangan nou chunga aphauvin, Ama achunga atouvin ahi.
21.8: Mi honpi atamjo chun Ama masang sang-ah aponsil hou chu lam lhonga chun aphauvin, chule mi abang loi chun theoboh ho alham un chuin lampia apha tauve.
21.9: Akijot nauva Yeshua chu alai lunga aum in chule Ama kimvel sea ho chun asam un, “David Chapa jeh in Pathen vahchoiyun! Pakai mina hungpa chunga nunnom hen! Chung Van sang pen a Pathen vahchoiyun!” atiuve.
21.10: Jerusalem kho mite jouse chu khopi sung Ama alut lut chun aboisoh jeng tauvin, amahon adong un, “Ama hi koihiya ham?” atiuve.
21.11: Chuin mipi ho chun, “Ama hi themgao Yeshua, Galilee gamkai Nazareth khoa kon ahi,” atiuve.
21.12: Yeshua Hou'in sunga chun alut in, chuin maichama kilhaina thilto dinga ajoh'a le acho ho chu anodoh in, Aman vapal joh ho touna le sum lhenglea pang ho dokhang chu alekhutp pehtai.
21.13: Aman ajah uva, “Pathen lekhabua, Ka Hou'in chu taona in kiti ding ahi akiti, hinlah nanghon gucha ho thil kiselguhna mun naso tauve,” ati.
21.14: Mitcho le elbai ho Hou'in a chun ahung un, Aman amaho chu aboldam in ahi.
21.15: Thempu pipui ho le houdan thuhil hon athil kidang bol chu amu uvin, chule chapang hon Hou'in sunga “David Chapa jal'in Pathen vahchoiyin umhen,” tia kisam aja uvin. Hinlah lamkai ho chu alunghang thei lheh jeng uve.
21.16: Ama hon Yeshua adong uvin, “Hiche chapang ho hin ipi aseiyu najah em?” atiuvin, Aman “Henge kajanai, naosen chapang noi cheplai kam'in vahchoina achamkim sah e, ti nasim doh nailou'u ham?” ati.
21.17: Chujouvin Ama Bethany akile kit in hichea chun ajan geh dentai.
21.18: Jingkah in Yeshua chu Jerusalem a ahung kilen ahileh, agil akel tai.
21.19: Aman lam pama theichang phung um chu agatoh tan. Ama jong aga um ding ham tin aga ve in, hinlah ado jeng bou amun ahi. Chuphat in Aman theichang phung chu, “Nangma itih in jong gakit tahih in!” ati. Chuin apettah chun theichang phung chu agoppai jeng e.
21.20: Seijuiho chun hichu amu phat'un alung dong un chule adong un, “Iti dana theichang phung chu goppai jeng ahi dem?” tin adatmo tauve.
21.21: Chutah in Yeshuan Amaho aseipeh in, “Keiman Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon na tahsan uva chule lungthoina neiloubeh nahiuleh hitobang hi nabol thei diu ahi, chule asanga lenjong nabol theidiu ahi. Nanghon mouljah'a jong nangma kichon mang in lang chule twikhanglen'a kileh lut'in tileu chun chuti jeng ding ahi.
21.22: Ipia ding hijongleh natao theiyu, chule tahsanna naneiyuva ahileh namu diu ahi” ati.
21.23: Yeshua Hou'in a kona ahung kilekit in chule thu ahilpan in ahileh, thempu pipui holeh upa ho Ama koma ahung un ahi. Amahon adong un, Koi thuneina'a hiche ho jouse hi nabol ham? Kon bolin tia thu napeh ham? natiuve.
21.24: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nang hon thudoh khat hi nadonbut'uva ahileh koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse hi kabol ham seipeh nauvinge.
21.25: John chun miho baptize theina thuneina anei chu vana kon ham ahilouleh mihem a kon bep bou ham?” ati. Amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Eihon vana kon ahi itiuva ahileh Aman ipi jeh'a eihon John thusei chu itahsan lou uham, tia eidoh dingu,
21.26: Hinlah ama mihem bepbou ahi tin seileu hen, mipi oimo ichan diu ahi, ajeh chu miho chun John chu themgao ahi atiuve ti aseiyun ahi.”
21.27: Hiti chun achaina keiyin adonbut un, “Keihon kahe pouve,” atiuve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahitah le koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse kabol ham kaseipeh lou ding nahiuve” tin aseitai.
21.28: “Hinlah hiche thudol hi ipi nagel uvem? Mi khat chapa ni nei chun, alen jopa koma, ‘Chapa gache doh inlang, tunin lengpi leiya na gatong in’” ati.
21.29: Chapa chun adonbut in, “Ka-e, kachelou ding ahiye,” atin hinlah chujoupeh chun alunggel akhel in agache tai.
21.30: Chuphat in apa chun chapa khatpa jah a, “Nangchen” atileh ama chun “Henge,” Hepa tin aseiyin, ahin aga chedeh poi.
21.31: Chapa teni lah'a chu koijoh apa seingai hiya ham? Amahon adonbut un, Amasapa atiuve. Chuphat in Yeshuan ahil chen in, “Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, kaidong kitahlou ho le numei kijoh ho Pathen Lenggam a nangho masanga lut diu ahi.”
21.32: Ajeh chu Twilutsah John chu anahung in, chule adih'a hinna ding lampi chu nakopeh uvin, ahin nanghon ama chu natahsan pouve, hinlah kaidong ho le numei kijoh hon atahsan uve. Chule hiche aso nung in jong Ama natahsan nom pouvin chule nachonset nauva nakisih pouve.
21.33: “Tun thusim achom khat ngaiyun. Lounei khat hin lengpilei abol in, apal agen kimvel'in, lengpi theiga lhohna ding leiko alaiyin, chule gahvet suina ding in insang asan ahi. Chujouvin aman lengpilei chu alei-lhou ho khut'a apedoh in, chule gamchoma agache tai.”
21.34: Lengpiga alhun phat in, alei lhou'a pang ho koma asohte asolin ahi.
21.35: Hinlah alei lhou hon asoh ho chu aman un, khat avouvin, khat athat un chule achom khat chu songa asep tauve.
21.36: Hichun alou neipa chun asoh atamjo cheh chu lengpi theiga lohkhom dingin asolin ahileh abolngai ngai anabol un ahi.
21.37: “Achaina keiyin alouneipa chun achapa asolin, amaho chun achapa chu anajabol teiyunte tin agel'in ahi.”
21.38: “Hinlah loubol ho chun achapa hung amu phat un, amaho khatle khat akihou un, ‘Agou lo’ dingpa hikoma ahunge. Hungun, ama that'u hitin agam hi eiho chan ding'in kiheidoh'u hite,” atiuve.
21.39: Hitichun amahon aman'un, lengpi leiya kon in akaidoh un, chule ama chu athat tauve.
21.40: Yeshuan adong in, “Lengpi lei neipa chu ahung kile teng loubol ho chu i-lonte tia nagel uvem?” ati.
21.41: Hou lamkai ho chun adonbut uvin, Aman mi-engseho chu melse tah in that intin, chule alengpi lei chu alougasoh achanding pethei midang henga apehdoh ding ahitai, atiuve.
21.42: Chutah in Yeshuan amahotah adong in, “Hiche hi nanghon Pathen Thutheng bua nasimdoh khah lou u ham? In-sa hon adei-lou song chu aning'ah apipen in apang tai. Hichehi Pakai thilbol ahi chule gahvet ding in aki-dange.
21.43: Keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa kona kiladoh a, chule phatea ga sodoh thei nam dang kipe ding ahi.
21.44: Koi hijongleh hiche songa kipal chan chu ahal hal'a chip ding chule alhuhkhum chan chu atagoi ding ahi,” ati.
21.45: Thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho chun hiche thulem hi ajah phat un, amaho douna'a thusim kisei–loubol mi engse ahiu chu akihetdoh tauve.
21.46: Amahon Ama amatnom uvin, hinlah mipi chun Yeshua chu themgaova angaito jeh un akicha uvin ahi.

22.1: Yeshuan amaho chu thulem dang jong aseipeh in ahi. Aman ajah uva,
22.2: “Van Lengam chu lengkhat in achapa jineina golvah loupitah abol thusim toh tekah thei ahi.
22.3: Neh le don ding gontupsoh ahiphat in, asohte asolin akikou ho chu agahetsah tauve. Ahin, amaho abon'un ahungnom tapouve.”
22.4: “Hiti chun aman asoh dangho chu amaho gaseipeh dingin asolin, Golvah anneh ding gontupsa ahitai. Bongchal hole gancha thaotah ho chu kithat a, ijakai kigong tupma ahitai. Ankong um ding'in hung un agatisah-e.”
22.5: Hinlah akikou ho chun anahsah pouvin chule ama lampi cheh'a ache tauve, khat alouva, achom dang khat akiveinaa,
22.6: Adang-sen asottol leho chu aman'un chule jachat umtah in abol'un chule athat tauve.
22.7: “Lengpa chu alung hang in, chule asepaite asoldoh in tolthat ho chu asumang'in chule akhopiu jong ahal tauve.”
22.8: Chule aman asohte jah a, Golvah an gonsan aumtai, chule jin'a kikouho jong jaboltah a kilom ahipouve.
22.9: Tun lamlhong aningkoi tin'ah cheuvin chule namu mu hou chu gakou uvin, ati.
22.10: Hiti chun sohte chun amu chanu chu mipha le miphalou geiyin akou uvin ahileh, golvah in chu jin adim tai.
22.11: “Hinlah lengpa chu jinho kimu pia ahunga ahileh, aman mikhat chu kichenna Golvah vona kivonlou amudoh tai.”
22.12: Aman ajah a, kichenna Golvah vona kivon louva iti dana hikoma naum ham tia adoh le imachan adonbut tapoi.
22.13: Chutah in lengpa chun alhachate ho jah a akhut le akeng ho kan'un lang chule polam muthima lehdoh tauvin, hichea chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi.
22.14: “Ajeh chu mitampi kikouva ahi, hinlah mi themcha bou deilhen ahi,” ati.
22.15: Chutah in Pharisee ho akihou-un Yeshua chu athuseiya kipal sah'a mat ding angaito tauve.
22.16: Amahon aseijuiteu phabep asol'un, chule Herod lama pangho jong jaotha ahiuve. Amahon “Houhil,” mikitah nahi ti kaheuve. “Nangman Pathen lampi dihtah nahil'in koima dat-khen naneipoi chule maipha nave poi,” atiuvin ahi.
22.17: “Tun hiche thua hi ipi nagel em neiseipeh'un: Caesar henga kai peh hi dih'am ole dihlou ham?” atiuve.
22.18: Hinlah Yeshuan alunggel'u phalou chu ahen, aseiyin, “Nangho mi phalhem ho! Ipi dinga doha'a neimat got'u ham?”
22.19: Kai kipehna sum chu neivetsah un, ati. Ama hon Rome te sum avetsah tauve.
22.20: Aman adong in, “Koilim le koipen min ham?” tin adong tai.
22.21: Amahon adonbut'un, “Caesar a,” atiuve. Aman aseipeh in, “Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin, chule Pathen achu Pathen peuvin,” ati.
22.22: Aman adonbutna chu adatmo-uvin chuin achemang tauve.
22.23: Hiche nikho mama chun Sadducee hon mithi ho thokitna aumpoi ti hou lamkai ho Yeshua henga ahung un, hiche thudoh hi ahung bol tauve.
22.24: “Houhil, Mose chun mi koi ham khat cha neilouva athi khahtah'a ahileh anaopa chun meithainu chu akichenpia chule acha chun aupa min apohding ahi ati.
22.25: Aphai, vetsahnan sopi pasal sagi aume. Atahpen pa chun ji aneiyin cha neilou vin athitai, chuti chun asopipa chun meithainu chu akichen pitai.
22.26: Hinlah asopi ani napa jong chu athitan, chule asopi athum channa pan amanu chu akichenpi tai. Asagina chan in hiti chun abonchauvin aum tauve.
22.28: Hijeh chun neiseipeh un, thokitna'a chu koipen ji hiding hitam? Ajeh chu asagi-uva chu amanu akichenpiu ahi” tin adong tauve.
22.29: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thule Pathen Thahatna nahet lou jeh uva nasuhkhel jiu ahi.
22.30: Ajeh chu mithiho chu thokitna'a amaho kicheng talou, kichen jong kibolsah talou ahiuve. Amaho chu vana Vantilte tobang ahiuve.
22.31: Hinlah tun, mithiho thokitna umham tithua Pathen Thua nasimdoh khahlouvu ham? Masang peh'a anathisaho Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob ho chu athijoupeh uvin, Pathen in aseiyin,
22.32: Keima Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi. Hitia chu Ama ahing ho Pathen ahin, athiho Pathen ahipoi,” ati.
22.33: Mihonpi chun athusei ajah phat un, athuhil chu adatmo lheh tauve.
22.34: Ahin aman Sadducee ho paomo hel'a alha chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat un, amaho akikhom un, ama thudohna neikit ding'in akinopto tauve.
22.35: Amaho lah'a mikhat Hou Dan thuthem khat chun hiche thudoh'a hi kipalsah ding agon ahi.
22.36: “Houhil, Mose dan dung juiya hoipen hi thupeh lenpen ham?” ati.
22.37: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nalung pumpia, nahinna pumpia chule nalungthim pumpia na-ngailut ding ahi.
22.38: Hiche hi thupeh amasa le alenpen ahitai.
22.39: Anina jong athupina kibang ahi. Nangma na kingailut banga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding ahi.
22.40: Hiche thupeh tenia hi Dan thu apumpi le themgao hon angeh jouseu chu kikhaiya ahi,” ati.
22.41: Hipet chun Pharisee hon aum-kimvel un, Yeshuan amaho thudoh khat adongin:
22.42: “Messiah chung chang thua ipi nagel uvem? Ama koicha ham? ati. Amahon adonbut un, Ama David Chapa ahi,” atiuve.
22.43: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahileh iti dan'a David chun Lhagao Theng'in ahetsa'a kona Messiah chu ‘Ka-Pakai’ ati hintem?” Ajeh chu David chun,
22.44: Pakai chun kapakai koma, Keiman na melmate kasuh nem'a nakengto noiya ka koi masang sen, kijabolna kakhut jet'ah tou jingin, ati.
22.45: David in Messiah chu Ka-Pakai, tia akou thei leh, Messiah chu iti achapa hithei ding ham? ati.
22.46: Chuin koima chan ama chu adonbut thei tapouve. Chule hiche jouva pat chun, koiman thudoh abolngam tapouve.

23.1: Chutah in Yeshuan mi honpi le aseijuiho jah a chun,
23.2: “Hou Dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho Mose Danbu ho sutoh dinga houhil lamkaiya lhen doh ahiuve.”
23.3: Hijeh chun amahon nahil chan'u chu bol un chule nahil nauva aseiyu ngaiyun, hinlah aum chan'u vang jui hih un. Ajeh chu amahon ahilu chu abol pouve.
23.4: Amaho hin mihon apoh joudiu kalval chonna angeh un, hinlah pohgih ngai jangna ding in akhut jung khat'u jong chasah lou ahiuve.
23.5: “Athilbol jouseu chu mimu dinga bou bol ahiuve. Abanjang uva taona bom akoiyun, asungah Pathen Lekhabua thucheng kijih aneiyun, chule amahon sangkhol chol mong kailha agei kikhit ho akiah-uve.”
23.6: Chule amaho hi anneh khomna dokhang mun thupi laiya touva chule hou-kikhopna in'a jabolna'a tou anom'uvin ahi.
23.7: Amahon kailhang mun'a min jaboltah'a alem diu adeiyun, chule houhil ati diu adei-uve.
23.8: “Koiman houhil nati diu janom hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil khat naneiyun, chule nangho nabon chauva sopite hina a kibang cheh nahiu ahi.”
23.9: Chule hiche leiset chunga koima Pa sah hih un, ajeh chu vana um Pathen chu Lhagaova na-Pau ahi.
23.10: Chule koiman nangho houhil tin kikousah hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil naneiyun, Messiah chu ahi.
23.11: Nalah uva alen pen hinoma chu soh ahi angaiye.
23.12: Hinlah ama kichoisang ho chu kisu nem'intin, chule akingai nem ho chu kichoi sang ding ahiuve.
23.13: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Mipha lhem ho! Ajeh chu miho maikoh'ah nanghon Van Lenggam kot chu nakhah'un ahi. Nang hola nalut pouvin chule midang ho jong alut diu na janom deh pouve.”
23.14: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Nanghon meithai ho anei-agou thil chung'ah jachatna thei leuvin dohan nabol'un, chule hou ngaisah tah tobang'in mipi lah'a sotpi natao un ahi. Hiche jeh'a hi gimbolna nasatah kipe ding nahiuve.”
23.15: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon mi khat na loilutna ding un, gam tina twikhanglen gal geiyin navah leuvin, chule khat touvin lung ahin heiya ahileh nangho amachu nivei jen Damun cha in nasem un, nangho jong nahiu ahi!”
23.16: “Mitcho lamhil ho! Itobang lunghemna in nahin pha diuvem! Ajeh chu nang hon Pathen hou-in'a kihahsel ima akhohpoi natiuve; hinlah hou-in sunga Sana'a kihahsel chu khoh'ah ahi, natiuve.”
23.17: Mitcho mingol ho! Hou-in'a sana ahilouleh Hou-in sana suthenga chu hoijoh thupijo hintem?
23.18: Chule nanghon maicham muna kihahsel chu imacha akhohpoi, hinlah maicham chunga thil kipedoh'a kihahsel chu khoh ahi, natiuve.
23.19: Itobang loma mitcho nahiu ham! Maicham chunga thilto kichoi chuleh thilto suthenga maicham joh chu hoiche thupijo ham?
23.20: Nangho maicham pan'a nakihahsel tenguleh hiche maichama kihahsela chule maicham chunga umho geiya chu kihahsela nahi tai.
23.21: Chule nangho Hou-in pan'a na kihahsel tenguleh hiche maicham munle maichama cheng Pathen'a kihahsel nahiu ahitai.
23.22: Chule van min pan'a nakihahsel teng Pathen laltouna le Pathen laltouna'a toupa'a chu kihahsel nahi ahitai.
23.23: “Itobang lung hemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon nahonsoh uva kona muchi neopen geiyin som'a khat napeuve, hinlah danthupeh akhohjo, adih'a thutan khotona chule tahsan nahsah in nagel pouve!”
23.24: Mitcho lamhil ho! Thousi vaibong naval louna ding uvin twina lhiu vin, hilah nanghon sangongsang napum val uve!
23.25: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon khon le kong chu apolam siltheng nathem un, hinlah nasung lamu, chip setna le kichang khohsahnan nadim uve.”
23.26: Mitcho Pharisee ho! Amasan khon le kong chu asung soptheng un, chutengleh apolam jong chu hungtheng tante.
23.27: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu lhan kiloibang tobangbep nahiuve, apolam vet hoi, hinlah nasunglam'u mithi gu le nen dimset nahiuve.”
23.28: Polama vet ding'in midihho to nakilou uvin, hinlah nasung gil lamu phatlhemna le danbei nahibou uve.
23.29: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon napu napa teuvin anathau themgao hole Pathen ngaisah ho lhan chu nasemhoiyun ahi.”
23.30: Chujongleh nanghon kapu kapateu phatlai chun keiho anahing leuveng themgao ho athanauva kajaolou beh dingu ahi, natiuve.
23.31: “Hinlah hitia nasei jeng vangun, nanghon themgao that ho sonle chi lhah nahiuve tiphot chetna nakiphondoh u ahiye.”
23.32: Cheuvin lang napu napa teuvin ana-patsau chu nanghon gabulhit un.
23.33: Gulho, gulse chilhah ho! Damun thutanna chu iti napel thei mong ding'u ham?
23.34: “Hijeh'a chu keiman themgao ho le miching ho chule Houdan thuhil ho na henguva ka hinsol ahi. Hinlah nanghon abang chu thingpela na khetbeh dingu, chule adangse chu hou ki khopna in'a najep dingu, chule khopi khat'a kona khopi choma nadelle dingu ahi.”
23.35: Hitia chu michonpha Abel kitha'a pat Barachiah chapa Zechariah Hou'in maicham teni kikah'a kithat ho jouse chunga themmona nahin kipoh dingu ahi.
23.36: Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga hung lhung ding ahi.
23.37: “Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem themgao ho that le Pathen thupole ho that'a pangho! Ahpin anoute alhaving tenia a-opkhum tobanga nachateu itobang tah'a kakhoptup kigot hitam! Hinlah nanghon neiphal peh pouve.
23.38: Chule tun veuvin, na in'u chu dalhahsa le ahomkeo ahitai.
23.39: Ajeh chu hiche thutahbeh hi kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga chu ding ahi!”

24.1: Yeshuan Hou'in leitol mun adalhah ding chun, aseijuite ho chun Hou'in kisahna in tampi ho chu avetsah uve.
24.2: Hinlah aman adonbut in, “Hiche in kisadoh ho namu'vem? Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, abonchauva ki phelha sohkei ding, song hi khat chunga khat kise thom jong um lou ding ahi,” ati.
24.3: Chomkhat jouvin, Yeshua Olivet mola atouvin, aseijuiho chu guh thim in akoma ahung un, hiti hin aseiyuve, “Nahung kitna ding melchihna ipi hiya chule vannoi kichaini itih le hi ding ham?” ahung tiuvin.
24.4: Yeshuan aheng uva, “Koima cha kipui khelsah hih un.
24.5: Ajeh chu keima min'a mi tampi hung ding u, keima Messiah kahi ahungti ding u, amahon mi tampi alhep lhah diu ahi.
24.6: Chule nanghon galthu ho leh galbol khum dinga kigihna ho najah diu, hinlah kicha hih un. Tahbeh'a hiche hohi hunglhung ding, hinlah hichu achaina hipai jeng loulai ding ahi.”
24.7: Nam khat le nam khat gal'a kibolto ding, chule lenggam khat le lenggam khat kidou ding ahi. Vannoi muntin'a kel lhan tin chule ling hung kihot ding ahi.
24.8: Hinlah hiche ho jouse hi amasa pena naosonat thoh ahahsat bang bep hi ding, adang jong hung umbe nalai ding ahi.
24.9: “Chuteng nang ho, amahon namat uva, nabol engset diu chule nahin tha diu ahi nalaiye.
24.10: Chule mi tampi keiya kona kihei mang ding chule ki pedoh to'uva chujongleh ki hoto ding ahiuve.
24.11: Themgao lhem tamtah hung umdoh ding, mitampi alhep lhah diu ahi.
24.12: Chonsetna chu muntin'a pungcheh cheh ding chule mi tampi ngailutna'a hung dailha ding ahiuve.
24.13: Hinlah koi hileh akhonni geiya thoh lhum a chu huhhinga um ding ahi.
24.14: Chule Lenggam Kipana Thupha hi vannoi pumpia kihil lhang le ding ahi, hitia chu namtin in ajah diu; chujou tah le achaina hung hi ding ahi.”
24.15: “Daniel themgaovin asei nikho chu nahin mu diu chule thet umtah chu mitmu tah'a munthenga ahung din namu diu ahi (Asim sim in gelkhoh hen).”
24.16: Chuteng leh Judea gam'a umho mol lama jam uhen.
24.17: In chunga um chu ins unga thil gakilah din kumsuh dahen.
24.18: Louva uma jong chun asang khol chol kilah ding in kile dahen.
24.19: Numei naovop hole naonoi chepsah minu ho ding in hiche nikho ho sung chu iti ahoiset tadem?
24.20: Chule najam nau phat chu phalbi lai ahilouleh Sabbath nikho ahilouna ding in tao un.
24.21: Ajeh chu vannoi kipat til apat anasoh khalou, chule hung um bekit talou ding thoh hahsa chungnung hunglhung ding ahi.
24.22: Tahbeh in, chuche thoh hahsa nikho chu kisuchom lou hileh, mihem khat jeng jong hoidoh lou ding ahi. Hinlah Pathen lhen chomte jal'a nikho chu kisu chom ding ahi.
24.23: “Chuche phat tengleh koiham khat touvin ven, Messiah hikoma aume ahilouleh khukoma aume atia ahijongleh tahsan hih un.
24.24: Ajeh chu Messiah lhem ho leh themgao lhem ho hung kipatdoh uvin tin, melchihna kidang le datmo umho chu ahin boldoh diu, ahitheileh Pathen lhen chomte tah jong alheplhah diu ahi.”
24.25: Veuvin, keiman aphat lhun masanga kahil chah masah nahiuve.
24.26: “Hiti ahijeh chun, mi koiham khat touvin, ven, Messiah chu hikoma, ahilouleh gamthip a aume, atiu jongleh tahsan hih un.
24.27: Ajeh chu kolphe chun solam ahinsal a chule lhumlam ahinsalvah pai tobanga, Mihem Chapa ahung jong chuti ding ahi.
24.28: Ajeh chu muthong ho kikhop khom chun anaivela thilong uma ahi avetsah banga, hiche melchihna ho hin phat kichai ahung naitai ti ahil chet ahi.”
24.29: “Hiche hesohna nikho ho chu akichai tengleh, nisa thim in tin, lha jong avah sohdoh tapon tin, ahsi ho jeng jong van'a kona pullha ding, chule van thaneina ho chu kihot lingsoh ding ahi.
24.30: Chule achaina keiya Mihem Chapa ahung na ding melchihna van hoa hung kilang doh ding, chule leiset mite jouse chunga lunghemna um ding ahi. Amahon Mihem Chapa chu van meilhang lah'a thunei le loupi tah'a ahung amu diu ahi.
24.31: Chule Aman avantil ho chu sumkon ginthong jeju chutoh, asoldoh tha ding, chule amahon alhen chomte chu vannoi muntina kona van le leiset kikah kigamlat napen geiya kona chu akhop khom diu ahi.”
24.32: “Tun theichang phunga kon in kihilna khat neiyu hite. Thingbah ho ahung dot a chule ana ho anou tengleh khal ahung naitai ti nahe uve.
24.33: Hitobang ma chun hiche ho jouse namu soh tenguleh, Ama hung kitna ding anaitai, kotbul ahin phatai ti heuvin.
24.34: Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahi uve, hiche ho jouse hi akichai masangsea hiche nam mite hi suhmil'a um lou ding ahi.
24.35: Van le leiset hungmang ding, hinlah Ka Thu hi mang lou ding ahi.”
24.36: “Hinama jongleh, hiche ho hung lhunna ding chu vana Vantil ho hihen lang, ahilouleh Chapa Amatah in jong koima chan anikho le aphat tah ahepoi, Pa bouvin ahet ahi.”
24.37: “Mihem Chapa chu ahung kinungle teng, Noah nikholai tobang hi ding ahi.
24.38: Chuche nikho lai chun, twisanglet masang in, miho chun golvah abolun, chule golnop le kichenna ho Noah kong sunga alut nikho lhin kahsen abol'un ahi.”
24.39: Twisang ahunglet'a chule amaho alhoh mang masang seuvin miho chun, ipi hungsoh ding ahi ahepha pouve. Mihem Chapa ahung teng jong leh chutima hung hi ding ahi.
24.40: “Pasal nin louva na hintong khom lhon intin, khat kila'a khat johpa kida lhading,
24.41: Numei nin sumheiya chang goikhom lhon in tin, khat kila a, khat ki dalha ding ahi.”
24.42: “Hiti ahijeh chun nangho jong ki hongphan um un! Ajeh chu itih nikhoa na Pakai hung ding ahi nahe pouve.
24.43: Hiche hi heuvin: In neipa chun itih a gucha ahung ding kihetleh, ama ki hongphan um intin, chule a in chu phetvanga aumsah lou ding ahi.
24.44: Nang ho jong nakigin jing'u angaiye, ajeh chu Mihem Chapa chu nagel loupet tah uva hung ding ahi.”
24.45: “Soh tahsan um, phottohna neiya umpa chu apupa insung pumpia asoh dang ho, phatecha vepha'a aneh diu aphatcha gong tobang ahi.
24.46: A pupa chu ahung kile kit'a chule asohpa chun phate chan atoh ding dol atonge ti amua ahileh kipaman amuding ahi.
24.47: Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, a pupa chun hiche sohpa chu anei jouse chunga amopoh sah ding ahi.
24.48: Hinlah hiche soh chu phata hih leh chule hitin gel henlang: Kapu hi niphabep set hung kile lou ding ahi, tihen lang,
24.49: aman soh pasal dangho chu votahen lang, nopneh bol hen chule jukham tahen lang hileh,
24.50: a pupa chu hetsah masatna nei louvin hung henlang chule agel loupet hitaleh,
24.51: aman hiche sohpa chu asat tel tel'a chule mi phalhem ho lah'a akoi ding ahi. Hichea chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi,” ati.

25.1: “Chuti chun Van Lenggam chu mounu loiho nungah som thaomei kiken a, moulang lamto dinga kigo hotoh ki tekah ding ahi.”
25.2: Amaho lah'a nga chu angol uvin, chule adang nga chu aching-uve.
25.3: Nga angol ho chun athao meiyuva ding'in thao akiken bulhing pouvin ahi.
25.4: Hinlah adang nga ho vang chu aching theiyuvin thao bom'a thao akiken beuvin ahi.
25.5: Moulang chu ahung gei phat in, amaho aboncha uvin alulhu uvin chule a-ihmu tauve.
25.6: Jan khangkim in khosam aw chun asukhang un, “Veuvin, moulang chu ahung tai! Hungdoh un chule lamto uvin!” ati.
25.7: “Mounu loiho chu aboncha uvin athoudoh un, chule athaomeiyu akigot tauve.
25.8: Chuphat in adang nga angol ho chun aloi dang ho chu angah un, nathao twiyu chu phabep neipe uvin, ajeh chu kathao meiyu mitding ahitai” atiuve.
25.9: Hinlah adangse chun adonbut un, keihon ibon-uva dingin kanei lhing pouve. Ajohna mun khat'a gache uvin chule nang ho ding gacho uvin ati.
25.10: “Ahin amaho thaotwi choa ache kah un, moulang chu ahung tai. Chuphat in kigosa umho chu amatoh golvahna in'a chun ache khom'un chule kot chu akam tauve.”
25.11: Khonung in, mounu loi nga ho chu ahung phat un, polama ading un, akou-un, “Pakai! Pakai! Keidin kot hong in” atiuve.
25.12: Hinlah Aman alekou vin, “Kasei hi tahsan un, Keiman nangho kahe pouve,”
25.13: “Hijeh chun nangho jong kihong phauvin! Ajeh chu nanghon kahung kile na ding nikho le phat chu nahe pouve,” ati.
25.14: “Chujongleh Van Lenggam chu mikhat khol gam latah a gajin doh toh kitekah ding ahi. Aman asohte akou khom in chule asum chu aum lou kah'a ding in amaho chu ngansena apetai.”
25.15: Aman khat chu dangka sumdip nga jen apen, michom khat dangka sumdip ni apen, chule anunung penpa dangka sumdip khat apen ahi. Amahon atha uvin ajokham cheh'a achan diu ahoppeh sohkei in ahi. Chujouvin ama khol jindin achetai.
25.16: “Dangka sumdip nga kilah sohpa chun asum chu aveikan in ahileh nga ma alodoh tai.”
25.17: Dangka sumdip ni sangpa jong chu natong in achen ahileh ni-ma alodoh betai.
25.18: Hinlah dangka sumdip khat sangpa chun leiset ko alaiyin chuin apu sum chu avuitai.
25.19: Phat phabepset jouvin apupa chu akholchena'a kon in ahung kilen, chule asum chu iti amanchah uvem tin akou khom in, akholtoh in ahi.
25.20: Dangka sumdip nga angan sepa chu ahung in nga-ma ahin choiben chuin aseiyin, Pu, nangman Dangka sumdip nga neipeh ahin, keiman sumdip nga-ma kamube e, ati.
25.21: “Apu chun apahcha lheh jeng in, ‘Nabol aphalheh jenge Ka sohpha le tahsan umtah nahi. Hicheng sum hi tahsan um tah a nachin ahin, tua hi keiman ngen sena tamjo cheh kapeh ding nahitai. Kipah thanom khomu hite!’”
25.22: “Dangka sumdip ni sangpa chun ahin nailut in, aseitai, ‘Pu, nangman veipung dinga neipeh Dangka sumdip nia kon in kasupung in’, ni-ma kamube e,” ati.
25.23: “Chuin apupan, nabol aphai kasohpha le tahsan umtah, nangma sum lhomcha chunga tahsan umtah nahi, hiti chun tua mopohna tamjo cheh kapeh ding nahi. Kipah thanom khom'u hite!”
25.24: “Chujouvin, Dangka sumdip khat sangpa chu ahung in chuin aseiyin, ‘Pu, keiman nangma hi mi gumtah nahi ti kahen, naphuna louva na atjin, chule nalho louna'a nakhom khomji ti nahina kahei.
25.25: Nasum chu mansah ding kana tijan, hijeh'a chu leinoiya kasel ahi. Ven, nasum hi kilelah kit in,’” ati.
25.26: “Hinlah apu chun adonbut in, nangma sohgilou le thase, Keiman kaphu louna'a ka-at nahet a, chule kalho louna leiya kakhop khom nahet ahileh,
25.27: ipi dinga kasum chu sum veipungna'a koi louva nahim? Chuti hen hileh athoi themkhatbeh toh mutha tadinga! ati.”
25.28: “Chujouvin aman thu apen, sum chu hiche sohpa a kon in ladoh uvin chule dangka sumdip som mupa koma peuvin.
25.29: Akipe kham kham phatea amanje heho chu, atamjo cheh kipe ding, chule bu-lhingset'a anei diu ahi. Hinlah imacha bollou ho chu lhomcha anei chasun'u jong kilah mangpeh ding ahiuve.
25.30: Tun, hiche soh phachom loupa hi polam muthima paidoh un, hiche muna chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi,” ati.
25.31: “Hinlah Mihem Chapa chu aloupina'a ahung tengleh avantilte jouse chutoh, chuteng aloupina Laltouna'a tou ding ahi.
25.32: Namtin jouse Ama angsunga kikhom dingu, chule aman miho chu achingpan kelcha'a kona kelngoi achom khen tobanga akhen ding ahi.
25.33: Aman akelngoite chu ajetlama akoiya chule kelcha ho chu aveilama akoi ding ahi.”
25.34: “Chuteng Lengpa chun jetlam'a ho koma chu, ‘Hung un, Kapa phattheina changho, vannoi kisema pat nangho dinga kigongsa lenggam chu hunglo tauvin.’”
25.35: Ajeh chu keima kagil anakel in chupet in nanghon an nei peuve. Kadang ana chah in, chupet in nang hon don ding neina peuve. Keima maljin kanahin, chupet in nanghon na'inuva, neina puilut uve.
25.36: Sagohkeu kanahin, chupet in nanghon kavon ding neipeuve. Songkul'a kaum in chupet in nanghon neihung vil uve, ati ding ahi.
25.37: “Chutengleh michonpha ho chun, ‘Pakai, itih'a nagilkel kamu uva, chupet'a kavah vauham? Ahilouleh nadangchah'a chu donding ipi kapeh uvem?
25.38: Chule maljin nahi kamu uva, kajenphat nau um'em? Ahilouleh sagoh keova nauma, ponsil ding kapeh uvem?
25.39: Itih'a nanat kamu uva chule songkul'a naum itih'a kamu uva kahungvil uvem?’” atidiu ahi.
25.40: “Chuteng Lengpa chun, thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, kasopi ho lah'a aneopen nabol nau chu, nanghon keima neibolnau ahi.”
25.41: “Chutah le Lengpan aveilama umho lam angat'a asei ding, Chemang un, gaosap chang ho, Diabol le lhagao boh ho dinga gotsa kikoi tonsot meidil'a lut un.
25.42: Ajeh chu kagil akel'in chupet in nanghon an neinehsah pouve. Kadang achah in chupet in nanghon don ding jong neipe pouve.
25.43: Maljin kana hin chupet in nanghon na'in uva neipui lut pouve. Sagohkeo kanahin, nanghon ponsil neinapepouve. Kana dammo in chule songkul'a kaumin, chupet in nanghon neivil pouve.”
25.44: “Chutengleh amahon adonbut-uva, ‘Pakai keihon itih'a nagilkel kamu'uva ahilouleh nadangchah kamu'uva, maljin nahia ahilouleh nanat a, songkul'a nalut a chule kapanpi lounau um'em?’” tia aseidiu ahi.
25.45: “Chutengleh aman amaho chu adonbut a, Keiman thudihtah kasei ahi, nanghon kasopite lah'a aneopen napanhunom lounau chu keima neijen nom lou u kahetna ahi.
25.46: Chuteng amaho chu tonsot gimbolna a lutding'u, hinlah michonpha ho vang chu Tonsot Hinna'a lut diu ahi,” ati.

26.1: Hicheng ho jouse aseijouvin Yeshuan aseijuite jah a,
26.2: “Ni ni sunga kalchuh kut kipan ding ahi ti naheuve, chuteng Mihem Chapa hi thingpel a khetbeh dinga pehdoh'a um ding ahi,” ati.
26.3: Chuche pet chun Thempu pipui ho leh upa ho chu Thempu chungnung Caiaphas in'a aki khom un,
26.4: Yeshua chu guhthim'a iti matdoh a chuteng thathei hi ding ham ti agong tauvin ahi.
26.5: “Hinlah hichu Kalchuh Kut kiman sung hi dahen, achutilouleh mipi venjou hipou vinte,” tin ki noptona aneiyuve.
26.6: Hiche pet'a chu Yeshua Bethany khoa Simon, tu masang jep'a ana phahpa, in a um ahi.
26.7: Aman an aneh pettah in numei khat ahung in Alabaster haithei hoitah thaonamtui man tamtah chu ahinchoiyin, chuin Alujanga chun asunglhasoh jeng tai.
26.8: Seijuiho chun hichu amuphat'uvin alung hang un, “Iti kimoh suhmanga hitam?”
26.9: “Hichu man tamtah'a joh thei hiya, asum chu mivaicha ho peh thei ahi,” atiuve.
26.10: Hinlah Yeshuan hichu ahedoh paijin, “Ipi dinga numei nun kachunga athilpha bolna thua oimoa nahi uvem?
26.11: Mi vaicha ho chu nalah uva um jing ding, hinlah keima nalah uva kaum jing lou ding ahi.
26.12: Amahin katahsa hi vui dinga agon'a thaonamtui hi kachunga asunlhah ahitai.
26.13: Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahi uve, vannoi pumpia Kipana Thupha kihil lhang na chan a, hiche numeinu thilbol hi kigeldoh'a chule kihoulimna'a kimang ding ahi,” ati.
26.14: Chuphat'in seijui som le ni lah'a Judas Iscariot chu thempu pipui henga aga chen,
26.15: chuin adong in, Yeshua nang ho koma pehdohna dinga sum ijat neipeh diu ham? agatin ahi. Chuin amahon dangka nong som thum apeuvin ahi.
26.16: Hichea pat chun Judas chun Yeshua pehdohna ding in, phat kijenpet avetai.
26.17: Cholsolou changlhah kut kipat'in seijui ho Yeshua henga ahung un, chuin adong un, “Kalchuh Kut an neh hoilaiya kagon diu na deijem?” atiuve.
26.18: Aman aseipeh in, “Khosunga galut leu chun, mi khat namu diu, ama koma chun, Houhil chun aseiye, ‘Kaphat ahung naitai, na in'a ka seijuite toh kalchuh kut kaneh diu ahi’ tin seipeh un,” ati.
26.19: Hiti chun seijuiho chun Yeshuan asei bang in abol'un, chua chun kalchuh kut agong tauvin ahi.
26.20: Nilhah ahung hi phat in, Yeshua chu som le ni chutoh dokhanga atou khom un ahi.
26.21: Amahon an aneh laitah uvin, aman aseiyin, “Thu dihtah kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho lah'a khat in nei pehdoh diu ahi,” ati.
26.22: Alunglha lheh jeng uvin, ban neichan adong jeng uvin, Keima kahi ham, Pakai? atiuve.
26.23: Aman adonbut in, “Nalah uva tutah'a lhenga kaso khompi hin eipeh doh ding ahi.
26.24: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa chu Pathen Thun anasei masahpeh ahi dung juiya thitei ding ahi. Hijongleh Ama pedoh'a pang pa ding chun itobang tijat hoise ahung tadem. Amapa ding chun apen'a penglou ana hijoleh phajo tadinga,” ati.
26.25: Apedoh'a pang dingpa Judas jong chun adong in, Houhil, keima hichu kahim? ati. Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nakisei khah e” ati.
26.26: An aneh laitah un Yeshuan changlhah phabep alan chuin phatthei aboh in, chujouvin neocha chan aheh balin chuin aseijuite apen, “Kilah un chule neuvin, ajeh chu hiche hi katahsa ahi,” ati.
26.27: Chuin Aman khon a lengpi twi chu alan, chujouvin Pathen athangvah in, amaho chu apen chule aseiyin: “Don cheh uvin.
26.28: Ajeh chu hiche hi ka thisan Pathen le Amite kikah a kitepna photchetna mi tampi chonset thenna dinga ana longdoh chu ahi.
26.29: Kasei hi melchih un, Keiman ka Pa Lenggam a nang ho toh athah beh'a kadon kit kahsea lengpitwi hi kadonkit lou ding ahitai,” ati.
26.30: Chujouvin amahon la khat asauvin, chule Olive mol a ding in apotdoh tauve.
26.31: Lampia chun Yeshuan amaho aseipeh in, “Tujan a hi nabon chauva nei dalhah manghel diu ahi.” Ajeh chu Pathen Thun aseiye, “Pathen in kelngoi Chingpa chu avoh lhuh ding, chule kelngoi hon chu cheh chau diu ahi.
26.32: Hinlah keima thina a kon kahung thodoh jou teng, keima na masang uva kache ding chule chua chu keima neimu diu ahi,” ati.
26.33: Peter in aphongdoh jeng in, adang hon nahin dalhah cheh diu hijongleh, keiman vang na dalha ponge, ati.
26.34: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Peter thu dihtah kaseipeh nahi, tujan sunga hi, ahchal khon phat masanga thumveijen kahepoi tia neiseilep ding ahi,” ati.
26.35: Peter in asei teiyin, “Ahipoi, Keima Nangma toh thitha ding hi jong leng naseilep ponge,” ati. Chuin seijui adang hon jong, hiti chun aseiyun ahi.
26.36: Chujouvin Yeshua amaho toh chun Olive thingphung ho lah'a Gethsemane hon'a chun ache uvin chuin Aman aseiye, “Keima khukom muna khu kaga chea kagatao sung in, hilaiya hin touvun,” ati.
26.37: Aman Peter le Zebedee chapa teni James le John chu akipuiyin, chuin Ama alunghem in chule alung lha lheh jengtai.
26.38: Aman amaho aseipeh in, “Kalungthim hi thina chan geiya ding in ana behseh tai. Hikom muna hin um un chule keima neingah un,” ati.
26.39: Ama agache chon in, chule amai tol'a asulut in, ataovin, “Hepa! Hithei ding hileh, hiche gimthohna khon hi keiya kon in kichon mang hen. Hinlah keima thusah hijo louvin, nangma phatsah joh chu hijo tahen,” ati.
26.40: Chuphat in aseijuite henga ahung in ahileh a-ihmut'u ahung toh tai. Aman Peter jah a, “Nidan khat jeng jong nei kigin peh jou louvu ham?
26.41: Lhepna'a nalhah louna ding un kiging un chule taovun. Ajeh chu Lhagaovin ago-nan, hinlah tahsan ajoupoi,” ati.
26.42: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu anivei nan adalhan chule ataovin, “Hepa! Hiche khon hi kadon louva kichondoh lou ding ahileh, nalung got hita hen,” ati.
26.43: Chuin Ama amaho koma akile kit in, amaho chu a-ihmut'u ahung mukit tan ahi, ajeh chu amaho a-ihmut'u soh behseh jenga ahitai.
26.44: Hiti chun Ama athum veinan agatao kit in, asei ngaima chu agasei kit in ahi.
26.45: Chujouvin aseijuite koma ahung in, hiti hin aseiye, “I-mu jeng un. Ki choldo uvin, hinlah veuvin phat ahung lhung e. Mihem Chapa hi mi chonse ho khut a pehdoh'a uma ahitai.
26.46: Kipat un cheu hite. Veuvin, eipe dohpa hichea aum e,” ati.
26.47: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thu aseina laiyin, seijui som le ni ho lah'a khatpen Judas chu mihon tampi toh chemjam le moltum choi pum in ahunglhung un ahi. Amaho chu miho lah'a upa ho le thempu pipui ho hinsol ahiuve.
26.48: Amatsah'a pang Judas chun amaho melchihna gon tohsan akoiyin: “Nang hon koipen mat ding chu nahet theina ding uva, keiman kalem-a abeng kachop peh ding ahi,” ati.
26.49: Hiti chun Judas chun Yeshua ahinjon pai jel in, “Chibai houhil,” atin abeng achop tai.
26.50: Yeshuan ajah a, “Kajol, ipi boldia hung'ah nahim? Nabol ding chu boltan,” ati. Chujouvin amahon Yeshua chu aman tauve.
26.51: Hinlah Yeshua to um khom ho lah'a khat chun achemjam aladoh in, chuin Thempu chungnung sohpa chu asat le abilkol asat lha jeng e.
26.52: Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Na chemjam chu koidoh in. Chemjam mangcha ho chu chemjam a thi ding ahiuve.
26.53: Keiman Kapa jah'a Vantil asang sang ho chu eihuhdoh diuva kathum mo ham? Chule Aman apettah'a ahinsol paijeng thei ahi, nageldoh lou uham?
26.54: Hinlah keiman chuti bol leng, Pathen Thubun asei tua guilhung ding ati hi, iti hithei ding hitam?” ati.
26.55: Chujouvin Yeshuan mihonpi jah'a chun, “Keima hi gamsung vaipohna khelgoa nei ngai touva chemjam le moltum thoa eiman dinga hunga nahi uvem? Ipi dinga Hou-in a neimat lou uham? Chua chu niseh'a thu kanahil ji ahi.
26.56: Hinlah hicheng jouse hi Pathen Thubua thu kisei, aguilhun na dinga hitia ahi,” ati.
26.57: Chujouvin Yeshua man ho chun Caiaphas Thempu chungnung in'a apui tauvin, hiche muna chu hou danthu hil holeh upa ho kikhoma ahiuve.
26.58: Hiche phatkah sunga chu Peter in gal kanga Yeshua chu ajui ahi. Ama agalut in chule avesuiya pang ho chutoh atoukhom in, chujongleh iti kichai yuvem ti angah tai.
26.59: Asunga thempu pipui holeh upa ho akikhom jouse chun Yeshua chu jouthua hettohsahna neiya, hiti chun athemomna ding angai touvin ahi.
26.60: Hinlah amahon jouthua hettohsahna ding tamtah anei vang un, midang thua hettohsahje ahe tapouve. Ajonan mini masang lama ahungdoh lhon in,
26.61: amani chun, “Hichepa hin keiman Pathen Hou'in kasuh mang'a chule ni thum sunga katundoh kit thei ding ahi tin aseiye,” atilhon in ahi.
26.62: Chuphat in thempu chungnung chu ading doh in, chuin Yeshua jah'a chun, “Nathemmo channau hi nadonbut lou ding ham? Nachung thua ipi na kisei nom um'em?” ati.
26.63: Hinlah Yeshua chu thipbeh'in aum in ahi. Thempu chungnung chun ajah a, “Pathen hing mina katem nahi, Nangma Pathen Chapa Messiah chu nahim, neiseipeh un,” ati.
26.64: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei khai. Chule khonung teng nanghon Mihem Chapa hi Pathen jetlam thaneina'a atou namu diu ahi,” ati.
26.65: Chutah chun Thempu chungnung chun hoise val asah chu vetsahna'in aponsil abotkeh in chule aseiyin, Pathen ataitom e! Ipi hettohsah dang ingaichat beu ngaiyem? Nang ho jousen Pathen ataitomna thucheng naja tauve.
26.66: Ipi ham nang ho thulhuh chu? Tia adoh le amahon, “Athemmoa ahi, athi dinga pha ahi,” atiuve.
26.67: Hiphat chun amahon Yeshua maiya chil aset un chule akhut tumuva achum tauve. Chule abang phabep in angeiphe abeng un,
26.68: anuisat un, Messiah gaovin seiyin! Koipen in navoh ham? atiuve.
26.69: Hiche pet'a chu Peter chu thutanna mun pamlama touva ahi. Chuin soh numei khat ahung pheiyin “Nangma Galilee a Yeshua nungjui ho lah'a khat nahi,” ahung ti.
26.70: Hinlah Peter chun miho masanga chun aseilep in, “Ipi thu nasei ahi keiman kahepoi,” ati.
26.71: Chujouvin kelkot phung ageipet in, soh numei chom khat in ama chu ahen chule akimvel'a touho koma chun, “Hi chepa hi Nazareth Yeshua toh um khom jia ahi,” ati.
26.72: Peter in avelin aseilep in, kihahsel toh thon, “Hichepa chu ahet'a ka hetlou ahi,” atitai.
26.73: Chule chomkhat jouvin achom dang khat akimvela ding ho chu Peter koma ahung in, aseiyin, “Nangma amaho lah'a khat nahi, Galilee mi nahi, na pao aw chun ka hedoh jeng uve,” atiuve.
26.74: Peter ki hahsel tothon, “Jou kaseile gaosap chang ing'e keiman hichepa hi kahepoi,” ati. Chuin apettah chun ahchal akhongtai.
26.75: Apettah chun Yeshua thusei chu Peter lunggela ahung kilangdoh in, “Ahkhon masanga thumvei nei seilep ding, Keima hi koi ahi kahe khapoi,” tia nasei ding ahi, tichu ageldoh in polama apot'in lhasetah in akap tai.

27.1: Jingpi matah in thempu pipui holeh miho lah'a upa ho atoukhom kit un, Yeshua thana ding angaito tauve.
27.2: Chujouvin amaho chun Ama akan un, apui mang un, chuin Rome gamvaipo Pilate henga apui tauve.
27.3: Ama pedoh'a pangpa Judas chun Yeshua chu thi chan geiya dinga themo achan'u chu ahen, alunga akisih lheh jeng tai. Hiti chun aman dangka somthum chu alan, thempu pipui holeh upa ho koma achoiyin,
27.4: aman aphongdoh in, “Ka chonse tai, ajeh chu keiman themmona neilou chu kapedoh tai” ati. Ama hon adonbut'un, “Keihon ija kageldeh uvem, hichu nangma boina hibouva chu,” atiuve.
27.5: Chujouvin Judas chun dangka sum nong chu Hou'in sunga aleh lhan chule apotdoh in ama le ama akikhai lihtai.
27.6: Thempu pipui ho chun sum nong chu aloh khom un, aseiyun, “Hiche sum hi Hou'in a sumkoina a koikhom nom ponte, ajeh chu mithana dinga ki pedohsa ahi,” atiuve.
27.7: Aki houtoh jouvun, ajonan amahon bel dengpa honlei chohna ding in agellha tauve. Chule hichu gam pam mi kivuina ding in asem tauve.
27.8: Hijeh'a chu leimun min chu Thisan Man kitia ahi.
27.9: Hiche hi Jeremiah themgao thusei aguilhun nan “Amahon dangka som thum nong chu alauvin, Israel miten aman dinga agel-uva aphasah nau man chu ahi.
27.10: Chuin amahon bel dengpa honlei chu, Pakaiyin ahilna bangtah in acho tauve.”
27.11: Chupet'a chu Rome gamvaipo Pilate ang-a Yeshua ding ahin, Gamvaipo chun “Nangma Judah te Lengpa nahim?” tin adonge. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei khai” ati!
27.12: Hinlah Thempu pipui holeh upa hon ama douna thu aseiyun, Yeshua athipbeh in ahi.
27.13: “Amahon nangma douna thu hijatpi aseiyu hi na jahlou ham?” tin Pilate in adong in ahi.
27.14: Chuin Yeshuan athemmosah naho'uva imacha adonbutlou jeh chun Gamvaipo chun adatmo lheh e.
27.15: Kalchuh Kut kumseh le kiman jina'a chu mi honpin adeiyu khat gamvaipo chun sohchang khat alhadoh jiu ahi.
27.16: Hiche kum'a hi sohchang giloutah khat Barabbas atiu ana um'ah ahi.
27.17: Mihonpi chu Pilate in'a akikhop pet un, hiche jingkah chun, aman amaho chu adong in, “Nangho dinga koijoh ham kalha dohpeh diu? Barabbas ham ahilouleh Yeshua kiti Messiah hi kalha dohpeh diu ham?” ati.
27.18: (Amahin houlamkai hon Yeshua chu thangthip man'a amat'u ahi, ti ahe chen lheh in ahi).
27.19: Pilate thutanna'a atoupet tah in ajinu chun hiche thuhi athot in: “Hiche themmona beipa hi limsah hih in. Ama jeh hin tujan ka-ihmutna'a chun kathoh gimlheh jenge,” ati.
27.20: Hichepet chun thempu pipui holeh upa ho chun mi honpi chu atem un, Barabbas chu lhadoh'a auma chule Yeshua chu thisah ding in atil tauvin ahi.
27.21: Hiti chun Gamvaipopa chun adong kit in, “Koijoh hi lhadohpeh leuveng nalung uham?” ati. Mi honpi chun, Barabbas atiuve.
27.22: Pilate in adonbut in, “Messiah kiti Yeshua hila ikalo ding ham?” ati. Amahon, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.
27.23: Pilate in “Ipi jeh inem? Ipi suhkhel len anei ham?” ati. Hinlah mi honpi chun aha sap cheh uvin, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.
27.24: Plate chun imacha phatchomna aum-louva chusanga boina asocheh ding chu amu phat in, aman cha-konga twi athum in chule mi honpi masanga chun akhut akisop in aseitai, hichepa thisan kisona'a hin themmona kaneipoi: Nanghon kimopoh tauvin'ati.
27.25: Chuin miho jouse chun, Ama thina chunga keiho le ka chateu geiyin mo kipoh naveh tangu tin ale donbut un ahi.
27.26: Chuin aman Barabbas chu alhadoh peh in, Yeshua vang chu sakol jepna thih lingneiya jep ding in Rome sepai ho thu apen chule amahon thingpel'a akhetbeh diuvin apedoh tai.
27.27: Gamvaipopa sepai ho chun Yeshua chu atol-piu thutanna mun'a apuiyun chule sepai ho chu akou doh un ahi.
27.28: Amahon apon chu ahoh lhauvin, chule ponsandup asilpeh uvin ahi.
27.29: Amahon ling bah ho chu lukhuh in asem un chule alu chunga akoiyun, chuin akhut jetlam'a peng tengol akichoisah un leng-tengolin aneisah uve. Chujouvin totnan a-anga adilsu-uvin chuin dainopnan, Kajabol'ui, Judah te Lengpa atiuve.
27.30: Chujongleh chil aset khum un chuin atenggol chu alahpeh un chule hichea chun aluchang avohpeh un ahi.
27.31: Achaina keiya totnopna'a anei nung-uvin, amahon ponsan chu alahpeh uvin chuin amapon asilpeh kit tauve. Chujouvin amahon thingpel'a khetbeh ding in apui tauvin ahi.
27.32: Lampia chun mikhat Simon, Cyrene a kona hung ahin, chuin sepai ho chun ada adoiyin Yeshua thingpel chu aputsah tauve.
27.33: Chuin amaho Golgotha atiu (Hichu lugumun kitina) mun chu alhung tauve.
27.34: Sepai ho chun juthuh le gilkha kihal apeuvin, hinlah aman ate jouvin, adon nom-tapoi.
27.35: Amahon Thingpel chunga akhetbeh jouvun, sepaiho chun aponsil chu avangpha pha chang hen tin vang asang tauve.
27.36: Chujouvin amaho akimvela atouvun chule ama kikhai pet in angah un ahi.
27.37: Yeshua luchunga chun melchihna khat atah un, ama douna a aheh setnau phondohnan, “Hiche hi Yeshua Judah te lengpa,” tin akijih in ahi.
27.38: Gamsung kivaipoh kikhelsah goa mini chu khat ajet lama chule khat aveilama Amatoh akhetbeh thauvin ahi.
27.39: Chule ahin hopa ho chun isahlou tah in akhasuh khum uvin,
27.40: amahon asam un, “Kiven tun, nangman Hou'in chu nasuh chima chule ni thum sunga natundoh ding in naseiye. Chutia nangma Pathen Chapa nahileh nangma kihuhhing'in lang chule thingpel'a kon'in hungkum lhan,” atiuve.
27.41: Thempu pipui ho, houdan thuhil ho chule upa ho jong chun totnopnan Yeshua chu ahouvun,
27.42: ataitom un, “Aman midang ahuhhing theiyin, hinlah ama akihuhhing theipoi” atiuve. Hitia hi ama Israel te lengpa hiya ham? Tutah hin ama thingpel a kon'in hung kumlha hen, chutileh katahsan diu ahi.
