27.43: Aman Pathen atahsan in, hijeh chun Pathen in ama adeiya ahileh huhhing hen. Ajeh chu aman aseiyin, “Keima Pathen Chapa kahi, ati” atiuve.
27.44: Gamsung kivaipoh kikhelsah goteni jong chun hitima chun ahouse lhon in ahi.
27.45: Sunkim'a pat nilhangkai nidan thum geiyin gamsung pumpia mu athim in ahi.
27.46: Nilhangkai nidan thum don in, Yeshuan aw sangtah in asam in, “Eli, Eli, lema sabach thani?” hichu “Ka Pathen, ka Pathen, ipi dinga neidon lou hitam?” ti kiseina ahi.
27.47: Akimvela dingho phabep chun ahekhel-uvin, chuti chun themgao Elijah akouvin agel uve.
27.48: Amaho lah'a khat chu alhai jelin chuin twichop phonna juthuh chu agadelhop in, pumpeng leh'a chun adontheina ding in atah sang in ahi.
27.49: Hinlah midangho chun, “Khongaiyin, Elijah ahuhhing dinga hungnam, veuhite,” atiuve.
27.50: Chujouvin Yeshuan ahinsam kit in, chuin a-Lhagao alhadoh tai.
27.51: Hichepet chun Hou'in munthenga pondal chu anah a pat ato geiyin keh ni akiso tai. Leiset akithing in chule songpi ho jong akehlha jeng e.
27.52: Chuin lhankot ho akihong in, Pathen ngaisah athisa ho tahsa chu kaithouvin aumkit un ahi.
27.53: Yeshua thokit jouvin amahon lhankhuh chu adalha uvin, Jerusalem khopia alut un, chule mitamtah henga aga kimusah uvin ahi.
27.54: Rome sepai ja lamkai pa le sepai dang ho akikhetbehna mun'a umho chun ling akihoa hiti ho thusoh chun atijatsah lheh uvin ahi. Amahon aseiyun, “Hiche hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh ahiye,” atiuve.
27.55: Chule numei tampi Yeshua toh Galilee akon'a ahin lhonpi ama gelkhoh ho chun gamlatah a kon in aveu vin ahi.
27.56: Amaho lah'a Mary Magdalene, James le Joseph nu Mary, chule James le John (Zebedee chapateni) ahiuve:
27.57: Nilhah ahung hi phat in, Joseph Arimathea khoa mihaopa, amahin Yeshua nung anajui ahin,
27.58: Pilate henga aga chen chule Yeshua tahsa chu athum in ahi. Chule Pilate chun ama pehdoh ding in phalna apetai.
27.59: Joseph hin atahsa chu alan tupat ponnem thengsel'in atom in ahi.
27.60: Aman ama lhan thah, songpia kon'a kigeihom sunga chun akoiyin ahi. Chujouvin aman alutna mun'a chun songlentah khat atahlut jouvin achemangtai.
27.61: Mary le Magdalene chule Mary chomnu lhan'a atou un chule angah un ahi.
27.62: Ajingin, Sabbath nikhon thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho Pilate kimupidin aga-cheuvin ahi.
27.63: Amahon ajah a, “Pu, hiche milhem lhapa chun ahinlaiya khatvei anasei chu kageldoh uve. Aman ni thum joule thina'a kon'a kathodoh kit ding ahi.
27.64: Hijeh'a hi lhan chu ni thum lhinkah'a ding in mohor nam in. Hiche hin aseijuite ahung uva chule atahsa guhmangna chule mijouse koma ama athilah'a kon in athoudohtai atina diu umta ponte. Hiti chu hileh amasa suhkhel sang'a phajo hiding ahi,” ati.
27.65: Pilate in adonbut in, “Hou'in ngah ho chu puiyun lang chule nahonbit thei chan un hongbit un,” ati.
27.66: Hiti chun amahon lhan chu mohor anam'un chule avetup ding'in angah akoi tauve.

28.1: Cholngah nikho kichai hapta kipatni jingpi matah in, Mary Magdalene le Mary chomnu chu lhan gave ding in apotdoh lhon in ahi.
28.2: Phulou helouvin ling hattah in akihot in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai vantil chu van'a kon in ahung kumlhan, song chu atangdoh in, chule achunga chun atouvin ahi.
28.3: Amai chu kolphe bang in avah in, chule aponsil chu buhbang ban'in abangin ahi.
28.4: Angah ho chun ama chu amu phat-un kichatnan adim un, chuin athia to abang jeng uve.
28.5: Chujouvin vantil chun numei ho jah a, “Kicha hih uvin, keiman thingpel'a ana kikhenbeh Yeshua chu nahol'u ahi kahenai.
28.6: Ama hiche muna hin aum tapoi! Aman aseisa bang in, Ama thina a kon'in athou dohtai. Hung'un lang, Pakai tahsa lupna mun hi hung vetauvin.
28.7: Chule tuhin, chepai jeng un, chule aseijui ho koma Ama thina a kon'in athou dohtai, chule Ama nama sanguva Galilee a anache masa ding ahi. Chuche muna Ama namu diu ahi. Keiman kana seipeh'u geldoh uvin,” ati.
28.8: Numei ho chu lhan akon'in achepai jeng un ahi. Amaho chu aha kichat'u toh chule kipa thanop toh thon, vantil thupoh chu seiding in alhailoi jeng un ahi.
28.9: Chuin amaho acheuva ahileh, Yeshuan amaho akimupin chujongleh ana lamtouvin ahi. Chuin amaho akom lama chun alhaiyun, akeng atuh uvin, chule dilsun ahou tauve.
28.10: Chujouvin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Kicha hih uvin! Cheuvin, kasopite koma chun Galilee a che ding'in gaseipeh un, chule chua chu keima eimu diu ahi, ti gaseipeh un,” ati.
28.11: Numei ho chu lampi ageina laiyun, lhan ngah phabep chu khopi sunga alut'un chule thempu pipuho henga ipi thusoh ahi chu agasei tauve.
28.12: Upa ho chun kihou khomna aneiyun, chule amaho chun sepaiho chu sum tamtah pehguh ding'in aseilha tauve.
28.13: Amahon sepaiho jah'a chun, “Nanghon Yeshua seijuite chu jan'a ka-ihmut pet-un ahung un, chujongleh along chu ahung gudoh tauve, tin seiyun.
28.14: Gamvaipo chun hiche thu chu ajahdoh'a ahileh, keihon nadinpiu ving ting hahsatna nachunguva lhunsah pouvinge,” atiuvin ahi.
28.15: Hiti chun lhan ngah ho chun sum aguh'a kipe chu akilah un, hiti chun asei dinguva kinganse chu aseitauve. Amaho thusim hi Judahte lah'a thusim in akiseison peh in, chule tuni geiyin akisei jing nalaiye.
28.16: Chujouvin seijui som le khat ho chun Galilee adalhauvin, Yeshuan ateppeh nau mola chun agache tauve.
28.17: Ama amu phat'un, dilsun a-hou tauve, hinlah phabep in aging chalel-uvin ahi.
28.18: Chuin Yeshua ahung in, chujongleh aseijuite jah'a chun, “Van'a le leiset chunga thuneina jouse Keima eikipedoh'a ahitai.
28.19: Hijeh chun, nangho cheuvin chule namtin jouse seijuiyin gasemun, amaho chu Pa le Chapa chule Lhagao Theng min-in Twilutsah uvin.
28.20: Keiman Kathupeh ho jouse hi seijui thah hochun aboncha ajui sohkeina dingun hil-uvin. Chule hiche khang kichai kahsea dingin Keiman nangho Ka-umpi jing nauve,” ati.

1.1: Hiche hi Messiah Yeshua Christa, Pathen Chapa thudola kipana thupha chu ahi.
1.2: Isaiah Themgaovin anasei: “Veuvin, keiman na masang uva thupole kahin sol e. Aman lampi nagonpeh diu ahi.
1.3: Ama chu ahi gamthip a aw sam ging a, ‘Pakai hungna ding lampi semtoh-un! Amadin lampi sutheng un!’ tia chu,” anati bang in ahung kipan in ahi.
1.4: Hiche thupole chu Twilutsah John chu ahi. Ama chu gamthip ah aumin chule mihon achonset kisih nau chule ngaidam channa dia Pathen ang aki heilut nau vetsahna dinga baptize achan diuvin thu ahil in ahi.
1.5: Juda gam jouse, Jerusalem mite jouse chutoh, John mu ding le thusei ngai ding in ache uvin ahi. Chule amahon achonset nau aphondoh phat un, aman Jordan Luiyah baptize achansah in ahi.
1.6: Akivonna chu sangongsang mul pon ahin, savun konggah-in akong ageh in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.
1.7: John'in, “Koiham khat hungvah ding ahitai, Ama chu keima sanga lenjo kei sanga lenjo cheh hi ding, keima akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong lom kahipoi.
1.8: Keiman twiya baptize kachansah nahi uvin, ahivangin Ama chun nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi!” ati.
1.9: Nikhat Galilee gamsunga Nazareth khoa kon in Yeshua ahung in, Jordan vadung ah John khut'in baptize achangtan ahi.
1.10: Chuin Yeshua twi lah-a konin ahungdoh in, van akikehson Lhagao Theng vakhu bang in achungah ahungchu e.
1.11: Van'ah aw ahung ging in: “Nangma kachapa deitah nahi, nachungah kalung alhai tangeiye,” ati.
1.12: Chuin Lhagaochun gamthip'a apuimang paiyin,
1.13: Chua chun ni somli Satan lhep patep in aum in, gamsa ho laha aum in, vantil hon avengkol un ahi.
1.14: Phat chomkhat jouvin John songkul'a akhum jou un, Yeshua Galilee gamah achen, Pathen Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen,
1.15: “Pathen phattep ahung lhungtai,” tin asam peh in, “Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai. Chonset na kon kisih unlang, Kipana Thupha hi tahsan un!” atin ahi.
1.16: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee Dillen pang ajotpana ah ngaman'a kivah le nehhol, Simon le asopipa Andrew chun dillen a ngamatna len anase lhon aga tohkhan ahi.
1.17: Yeshuan akou doh in, “Kanung hinjui lhon in, keiman miho matje nahil lhon inge!” atin ahi.
1.18: Chuin amanin alen adalha lhon in anung ajuipai jeng lhontai.
1.19: Chuin twipanga kon themkhat ache chon jepleh Yeshuan Zebedee chapateni, James le anaopa John chun kong sunga len ana khuiphat pet lhon amun,
1.20: Amani chu akouvin ahileh, aman nin apau Zebedee toh kong sunga um thaloa agoihou chu adalha lhon in ajui lhontai.
1.21: Yeshua le akilhonpiho Capernaum khopiah achelut'un ahi. Cholngahni ahung lhunchun houin'ah ache uvin, hia chun thu ahil pantan ahi.
1.22: Aman danthu sunho banga hillouva, thuneitah banga ahil jeh'in miho chun athuhil chu kidang asalheh-un ahi.
1.23: Chuin hetloukah'in lhagao-boh vop mikhat houin'ah anaum in, ama chun ahin sampaiyin,
1.24: “Nazareth Yeshua, ipi dinga kalah'uva hung kikum nahim? Keiho suchimit dinga hung nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai—Pathen Theng chu nahi!” ati.
1.25: Yeshuan amachu aphoh in, “Thip in! Ama a kon chun hungdoh in,” tin thu apen ahi.
1.26: Chuin lhagaoboh chun mipa chu aheh-in, hapen in apeng in ahung potdoh tai.
1.27: Mijousen kidang asauvin, thilsoh chungchanga chun khat le khat akidong un ahi. “Hiche hi ipi kihilna thuthah hikit hitam? Itobang thuneina hitantem! Lhagaoboh jeng in jong athupeh angaiye!” atiuvin ahi.
1.28: Yeshua Christa thu chu Galilee gamsung pumpiah aki thangsoh pai jeng tan ahi.
1.29: Kikhopna in chu Yeshuan James le John toh adalhah jouvin Simon le Andrew in'ah alut un ahi.
1.30: Chua chun Simon nupanu chu khosih dammon analum e. Amahon adammo thu chu Yeshua ahetsah paiyun ahi.
1.31: Hichun amanu koma chun achepheiyin akhut in atuh-in, akai thouvin atousah tai. Hichun akhosih chun alhatan, chuin amanu chu amaho neh ding sem in apangtai.
1.32: Nilhum jou nilhah-in mihon ana damlou leh, thilhavop ho chu Yeshua koma ahin puiyun.
1.33: Kho mite jouse chu ave din kot khah phunga akitit dimsoh jeng e.
1.34: Chuin Aman hivei chom chom veiya damlou mi tamtah adamsah'in, chule thilha tamtahma adeldoh'in ahi. Hinla Ama Christa ahi chu thilhahon ahet'u ahijeh-in thilhaho chu apaodoh sahpoi.
1.35: Khovahlhah masang ajing jingkah-in Yeshua athouvin, apotdoh in gamthip munah achen, chua chun taona agamang in ahi.
1.36: Chomkhat jouvin Simon le aloiho apotdohun, chuin agamudoh tauvin ahi.
1.37: Amudoh phat un ajah-a, “Mijouse hinla Nang nahol cheh-un,” atiuvin ahi.
1.38: Yeshuan adonbut in “Khopi danga jong kahil lhangle theina din che ute, hiche dinga chu hung kahi,” ati.
1.39: Chuin Galilee gam sungsea achelen, akikhop nau intin'ah thu ahil lhanglen chule thilha adel dohpeh in ahi.
1.40: Chuin miphah khat Yeshua hengah kijen damsah dingin ahung in, adilsun, ajah a, “Nalung ahileh neidamsah'a neisuh theng thei ahi,” ahung titai.
1.41: Athusei chun alung atohkhah behseh jeh in, Yeshuan akhut alhang in atham in, “Kalung ahi,” atitai. Chuin, “Damthengtan!” ati leh,
1.42: Apetpet'in aphah chu aphapai jengin, adamtheng tai.
1.43: Chuin amapa chu khamgahna aneiyin asoldohtai.
1.44: “Hichehi koima komah seidoh hih in. Hisang chun thempu koma chen lang gakivetsah'in. Mose dan thupehsa dungjuiya phah kijen damhon maicham thilto apeh ding dol chu choiyin lang gape tan. Hichu nadam thengna mipi het'a phondohna hiding ahi,” tin thupeh aneiyin ahi.
1.45: Ahivang in amapa apotdoh in, thil umdol chu aseiphongle tan ahi. Hichea kon chun Yeshua chu mipin aum kimvelle jeng tan, hijeh chun lhangphong in khopi sunga alut thei tapoi. Hichun munthip thip lah-a aumjo tan, ahijeng vang'in muntina kon in mipin ahin jonlut jing nalaiyun ahi.

2.1: Nikho phabep jouva Yeshua Capernaum'a akile kit chun, in lama akile kittai ti muntin a ana thangsoh man kittan ahi.
2.2: Chomlou kah'in aumna in a chun mipi ahung kitit dim jeng in, umna ding kotphung polam jeng jong onglou khop'in mi adimlha jeng tai. Mipi chu Pathen thu ahil jing laiyin,
2.3: Pasal li-in langthi khat pheh chunga ahin pulut un ahi.
2.4: Mipi atam behseh jeh chun Yeshua kom alutthei tahih un, hijeh chun Ama luchung don tah'a inchung alhong chu aphevang un, langthipa chu alupna pumin a angsunga akhailha jeng tauvin ahi.
2.5: Atahsan uchu Yeshuan amun, langthipa jah achun, “Chapa, na chonset naho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
2.6: Ahinlah danthu sun phabep khat chua touho chun alungthim uva,
2.7: “Ibola hitia chu thu aseiham? Hiche hi kitaitomna ahi. Pathen bouvin chonset angaidam thei ahi!” tin agel un ahi.
2.8: Alunguva ipi agelu chu Yeshuan ahepai jeng in ajah uvah, “Ibola lung opkai le lungboi nahi uvem?
2.9: Langthipa koma, ‘Na chonset naho kingaidama ahitai’ ti toh ‘Thouvin, nalupna pheh chu kichoi inlang lam jottan,’ ti chu hoijoh baijo ham?”
2.10: Ahoi hita jongleh leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneiye ti, nahetna diuva photchenna kavetsah ding nahiuve, ati.
2.11: Chuin langthipa lamah Yeshua akiheiyin, “Thouvin, nalupna pheh kichoiyin lang in lama chetan!” ati.
2.12: Chutah chun langthipa chu akichom in, alupna pheh akilah-in japi lungdong ho mitmutah chun achedoh tai. Amaho chun kidang asalheh jeng un, “Hitobang himhim kamu kha pouve,” atiuvin Pathen avahchoi avahchoi tauve.
2.13: Chuin Yeshua apotdoh in dillen pangah achekit tan, chuah mipi ahenga hungho chu thu ahil e.
2.14: Chuin achephei leh, Alphaeus chapa Levi chu akaidonna mun'a atou amun ahi. Hichun ajah a, “Neijuiyin lang kaseijui hitan,” atileh ama chu akipatdoh'in anung ajuitai.
2.15: Chujouvin Levin Yeshua leh aseijuite ain'a an nedin akouvin, chuleh kaidong ho le mi chonse ho tamtah jong akou than ahi. (Yeshua nungjui ho lah-a hitobang mi chu tamtah um ahi).
2.16: Dan thuhil ho lah-a Pharisee hon Yeshuan mi chonse holeh kaidong ho toh an aneh khom chu amu phat un, aseijuite jah-a, “Itidan a kaidong ho le mi chonse ho toh an aneh khom ham?” ati tauvin ahi.
2.17: Hichu Yeshuan ajatan, hichun ajah uvah, “Atidam ten louthem angai pouve, adam louten bou angaiyui. Mi chonphate kouva hung kahipoi, lunghei dia mi chonsete kouva hungjoh kahi bouve,” atipeh un ahi.
2.18: Khatvei John seijui holeh Pharisee hon an angol laiyun, mi phabep ahungun Yeshua jah-ah, “I-atileh John seijuiho le pharisee hon an angol jiuva, nangma seijui hon an angolji louham?” tin adong un,
2.19: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mou loma chehon golnop anei laiyuva an angol jiuvem? Achutilou ding hetsa ahi. Moulang in aumpi laiseuva an angol lou diu ahi.
2.20: Amavang moulang chu akomuva kon'a aki puimang ni hung lhung ding ahi—chuche nileh an angol diu ahi.
2.21: Chujongleh, koiyin pon thah hal chu ponluiya abeh ngaiyem? Beh taleh abehna joh chun kai ehjo cheh intin, athah joh chun alui chu akaiset ding ahi.
2.22: Chule koiman Lengpitwi thah savun pengluiya akhum ngaipoi; achuti kibol leh alengpitwi chun asavun peng chu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi le savun peng akop a mang ding ahi. Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhumji bou uve,” ati.
2.23: Cholngah ni khat hin Yeshuan buleilai ajot in ahileh, aseijui ten ache pum un changvui chu asih pan tauvin ahi.
2.24: Chuin Pharisee hon Yeshua jah-a, “Vetang, ibola Cholngah nia bolngai lou abol uham?” atiuve.
2.25: Yeshuan adonbut in, “David le aloiho alhahsam uva agilkel pet'uva chu ipi-abolu nasim khah hih uvem?
2.26: Abiathar Thempu chungnung ahilaiyin Pathen in a alut in, Thempu tailou adang in aneh dia phal hilou changlhah ho chu anen, aloi ho jong apen ahi,” ati.
2.27: Yeshuan amaho jah-a aseipehben, Cholngah ni chu mihem dinga kisem ahi. Cholngahni dinga mihem kisemjoh ahipoi.
2.28: Hijeh chun, Mihem Chapa chu Pakai ahin, Cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati.

3.1: Yeshua Judah ho Pathen houna in'a achekit leh, hichea chun mi khutlang ngoi khat agamui.
3.2: Hichu cholngah ni ahijeh'in amel maten, ahehset theina diu achanglhi jing uvin ahi. Khutlang ngoipa chu cholngahnia adamsah-a ahileh, themmo chan ding tohgon aneiyu ahi.
3.3: Yeshuan khutlang ngoipa jah-a, “Hung in lang mipi masanga hung dingdoh-in,” atitai.
3.4: Chuin Ama doudal le nelkal-ho lang ngan akiheiyin ajah-uva, “Cholngahnia thilpha bol ding danthun aphal em, ole ase bolna ding nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinna huhdoh nikho ham, suhmang nikho joh ham?” tia adoh leh, amahon adonbut tapouve.
3.5: Hichun Aman lunghangtah in amaho chu avekim velin, alungtah jeh'u chun phamo asalheh in ahi. Hichun khutlang ngoipa jah a, nakhut lhang in, atin chuin alhang in ahileh, akhut chu adamtan ahi.
3.6: Chuin Pharisee ho chu apotdoh-un Ama suhmang theina ding angaito uvin, Herod solchah ho toh akihou toh tauvin ahi.
3.7: Yeshua aseijuite toh dil lama chun ache uvin, mihon tamtah'in ajuiyun ahi. Amaho chu Galilee le Judah gam'a kon,
3.8: Chule Jerusalem, Idumia, Solam Jordan luigala kon, Tyre le Sidon chunglam gam'a kon jong ahiuve. Athil bol kidang thuthanga kon in gamlatah tah'a kipan in ahung veuvin ahi.
3.9: Yeshuan aseijuite asolin, mihonpin Ama lam ahin phutlou nadin kong gotsa-a akoi diuvin athuhil in ahi.
3.10: Chuche nikho chun mi tamtah adamsah'in, hijeh chun adamlou ho chun Ama atohkhah theina ding un Ama lam chu ahin no tentun jeng un ahi.
3.11: Lhagaoboh vop ho vang chun Ama amu chan un, tolsenan akineiyun, a-ang sunga abohkhup un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa chu nahi!” tin asam jiuve.
3.12: Ahin Aman lhagao phalou ho chu Ama koi ahi aphondoh louna diuvin agih in ahi.
3.13: Chujouvin Yeshua molchunga akaltouvin, alhonpi dinga angaichat chengse chu akouvin, amahon jong ajuiyun ahi.
3.14: Chuin mi somleni alhengdoh'in, asolchah dingin apansahtan ahi. Amaho chu Ama kilhonpi ding le thuhillhang le asollea pang ding ahiuvin,
3.15: Chuleh thilha ho nodoh theina thuneina jong apen ahi.
3.16: Hiche somleni alhen ho chu: Simon (Aman Peter asahpa chu),
3.17: James le John (Zebedee chapateni, Yeshuan, Boanerges (Van-ging chapate tina) tia amin aphohpehteni),
3.18: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (Alphaeus chapa), Thaddaeus, Simon (mi kipum pehpa),
3.19: Judas Iscariot (Ama johdohpa); hicheng hi ahiuve.
3.20: Khatvei Yeshua in khat'a alut leh, mihonpi ahung kikhomkit tauve. Hijeh chun Ama le aseijuiten an nehphat tahbah jong aneithei tapouve.
3.21: Hichu ainkoten ajah phat uvin apuidoh dingin ahungui. “Ama hi angol a hita hi,” atitauve.
3.22: Jerusalem a kon'a hung danthu sunho ma jong chun, “Amahi thilhate lengpa, Satan in avop ahi. Ama a kon'a chu thilhate nodoh theina tha anei ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
3.23: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu akouvin, ahilchet na ding in, Satan in Satan iti anodoh thei ding ham?
3.24: “Lenggam khat amite kikhentel'a kidouto chu mahthah-a lhutei ding ahi.
3.25: Hibang chun insung kikhentel chu chehchaova dingdoh theilou ding ahi.
3.26: Satan jong kisepkhen henlang ama le ama kidou taleh iti dingdet thei ding ham? Dingdoh joulouhel ding ahi.
3.27: Seichenbe inge. Satan tobanga hat mi khat in'a chu koiham thanei tah'a galut'a chule aneiho gachom ding chu? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akantuma chutengle bou athil achomthei ding ahi.
3.28: Chule tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, itobang chonsetna le kitaitomna hijongle kingaidam thei ding ahi.
3.29: Amavang koihileh Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu imatih chan'a ngaidam changlou ding, hichu tonsot geiya ngaidam changlou ding chonsetna ahi,” ati.
3.30: Hicheho aseinajeh pentah chu amahon Ama chu, “Lhagao phalouvin avop ahi,” ati jeh-u ahi.
3.31: Chuin anu le asopite ahungun inpoah ading un, Ama ahungdoh-a ki houlimpi ding in thu athot'un ahi.
3.32: Hipet chun mihonpi Yeshua kimvelin atou chahkheh-in, thupopa chun ajah-a, “Nanu le nasopite polamah aumun, nahin hol uve,” ahung tin ahi.
3.33: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Koiham kanu? Koiham kasopiteho?” ati.
3.34: Chuin akimvela touho chu avegol in, “Ven, amaho hi kanu le kasopi ho ahiuve,”
3.35: Koihileh Pathen lunglama chon hochu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahi, ati.

4.1: Avelin dil panga thu ahilpan kit tai. Mipi tamtah akoma ahung kikhom pai jeng un, Ama kong sunga aluttan ahi. Kong sunga chun atouvin, mipite chu vaokama atouvun ahi.
4.2: Amaho chu thulem'in thu tamtah ahil in,
4.3: “Ngaiyun! Muchi thepa muchi then achen ahi.
4.4: Athe atheleh abang lamsih-ah achun, hiho chu vachaten ahungloh un anegam tauvin ahi.
4.5: Chule abang songlheo chunga leipatna lah a achun, alei asalou jeh'in akehdoh jeng in,
4.6: Ahivang in nisan ahin kah phat in asang gon, jung aneilou jeh'in agoplha paitan ahi.
4.7: Chule abang linglah-a achun, ling hochu ahung khang in chang phung dong nalaiho chu adep lihtan, ahinga aum tapoi.
4.8: Adang ho chu leiphalaiya achun, ahung khang in agatan, hiho chu ajat somthum, ajat somgup, ajat jakhat cheng in apungtan ahi!”
4.9: Chuin Aman aseiyin, “Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
4.10: Chomkhat jouvin aseijui somleni ho toh akimvela mi dangho toh aum khom pet in, amahon athulem seiho chu ipi kiseina ham tin adong un.
4.11: Aman adonbut in, “Pathen gam thuguh chu nangho kipea nahi tauve. Hinlah thulema kaseina jeh chu polam miho jah ding ahi,
4.12: Hichu Lekhabun aseisa agui lhunna ding: ‘Ka thilbol amu tengule, ima jildoh hetdoh aneilou diu. Ka thusei ajah tengule, ima hetdoh aneilou diu. Achutiloule keima lam'ah hung kiheiyuntin, ngaidam chang get unte,’ kiti chu ahi,” ati.
4.13: Abanin Yeshuan akomuva, “Nanghon hiche thulem hi nahetlou monguham? Achutile thulem dang jouse iti nahet tadiu vem?
4.14: Lou bolpan muchi athe chu Pathen thu midang koma kihil lhang tobang ahi.
4.15: Muchi kithe lamsih-a chuhon avetsah chu ahileh, Pathen thu ja-a ahivanga Satan in ahung kilhoh mang pai toh tekah ahi.
4.16: Songlheo chung leipatna lah-a chuhon avetsah chu, athu ajah jah-a thanomtah'a joppai jengho ahi.
4.17: Ahivang in amaho chu jung neilou ahi jeh-un, apangsot jouji pouve. Pathen thutahsan jeh'a boina le suhgimna ato tengule, jung aneilou jeh-uvin alhupaiji tauve.
4.18: Ling lah a muchi kithehon avetsah chu Pathen thu ja a,
4.19: Ahivanga leiset hinkho lungkhamna ten alodimsetna, haona lungthim chule thildang dang ngaichatnan thu chu adeplih jeh-a ga sodoh joulou tobang ahi.
4.20: Chule leipha laiya chuhon avetsah chu athu ja-a, hea jopte chu ahiuvin, abang ajat somthum, abang jat somgup chule abang ajat ja-a aga punsah beho ahiuve,” ati.
4.21: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Koiyin meivah khu lo sung le jalkhun noiya atun ngaiyem? Koiman bolponte! Meivah chu avah hoiselna ding muna aki tungjin ahi.
4.22: Ijeh-inem itileh thil kiselguh chengse chu achaina leh kiphongdoh ding, chuleh akiselguh jouse chu vahdoh ding ahi.
4.23: Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
4.24: Chuin ajah uva, “Najah chengseu chu lungluttah in ngaiyun. Phataha nangai chan uva, hetgilna nakipe diu ahi—chule kipehbe dingbon nahiuve.
4.25: Koihileh kathuhil ngaiho chu hetbena kipehbe ding, ahinlah koihileh kathuhil ngailou chu ahetsa themkhat jong amahoa kon'a kilahmang peh ding ahi,” ati.
4.26: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Pathen gam umdol chu loubolmi khat'in leiya muchi athe tobang ahi.
4.27: Asun ajan'a a-imut pet chuleh aha pet hijongleh, amuchi the chu ahung kehdoh-in, akhanglen in, hinlah aman hitia chu thil iti hung umdoh ham ahepoi.
4.28: Leiset'in acham in ahin gadohsah jin, amasapen in avui ahung dondoh in, chuteng achaina leh ahung gadoh in aminji tai.
4.29: Aga chu amin phatleh, a atphat ahitah jeh'in loubolpa achen, koiten a atpai jitai,” ati.
4.30: Yeshuan aseiben, “Pathen gam hi ipitoh kitekah ding hitam? Ipi thulema ka hilchet ding hitam?
4.31: Ankam mu chang leiya kithe tobang ahi, hichu muchi lah-a aneopen ahi.
4.32: Ahivang in ahung kedoh tengleh hampa dang jouse sangin alenjon, abah lentah jong ahin sodoh jin, chutichun chunga leng vachate abah lim noiya ahung geh jiuvin ahi,” ati.
4.33: Chuin chutobang thulem tamtah mangchan amahon ahetthei diu kham thu ahil e.
4.34: Mihonpi jah-a thulem tilouvin imacha aseikhapoi. Ahinla aseijuite chengse vang chu guhthimin ijakai ahilchen jinai.
4.35: Chuin nilhah in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Hung un, dil khu agal langa galkaiyu hite,” ati.
4.36: Chuti chun mihonpi chu adalha uvin, Yeshua chu konga akitolpi tauvin, kong dang phabep'in vang ahinjuiyun ahi.
4.37: Chuin khopi hui ahung nung in ahileh, twi kinong chu kong sunga ahung kinonglut matchet jeng tan, adimpai ding ahitan ahi.
4.38: Apet chun Yeshua chu kong mei lama lukhap kikhap'in ana ihmun, aseijuiten asukhang'un ajah-a, “Houhil, kalhummang gam dingu hi imalouva nagel ham?” atitauve.
4.39: Yeshua akhah phat'in huipi chu aphoh-in, twi-nong jah-a, “Thipmin! Thipchet in!” tia thu apeh leh, apettah'in huipi chu athipchet jeng tan, kho aphaseltan ahi.
4.40: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Ibola nakichat uham? Tahsanna nanei nailou uham?” atitai.
4.41: Seijui ho chu akithing jeng tauvin, “Hichepa hi koi mongmong hiya, huipi le twi-nongin jong athu angai ahitadem?” tin aki dongto tauvin ahi.

5.1: Chuti chun dil gal langkhat lama, Gerasene gam agalkai tauvin ahi.
5.2: Konga pat Yeshua ahung potleh, lhan'a konin lhagaoboh vop khat'in ahung kimupin ahi.
5.3: Ama chu lhanmol'a cheng ahin, koiman atuhtang joulou, thih khaova jong ahen joulou-u ahi.
5.4: Bul atuhsah uva thih khaova jong ahen ji vang un thih khao chu asattan jin, bul chu atumkeh jin, koima chan abolngoi jou louhel ahitai.
5.5: Sunle jan in lhan mola chun aumin chule molchunga a-aole a-aolejin, songhem in ama aki-at chen jin ahi.
5.6: Gal a pat'in Yeshua ahin mun, ahung lhaijel in a-angah abohkhup in ahi.
5.7: “Pathen chungnungpen Chapa Yeshua, ipi dinga neihung suhboi got ham? Pathen min'a nahenga katao ahi, neibolgim hih-in,” tin apeng jeng tai.
5.8: Hichun Yeshuan ajah-a, “Mipa-a kon chun hung potdoh in, nang lhagao boh,” tin ano tai.
5.9: Chuin, “Namin ipiham?” tia adohleh, aman adonbut in, “Tamtah kahi jeh'un kamin Janel ahi,” ati.
5.10: Chuin chuche gamkai sunga kon'a nodoh ahilouna ding un Yeshua henga hataovin ataotan ahi.
5.11: Hiche mun lhang pang khat'a chu voh hon tamtah kilha-a ahi.
5.12: Janelte chun, “Voh hon lah-a kaluttheina ding un neisol un,” tin athum tauve.
5.13: Yeshuan jong aphalpeh tan, lhagaoboh ho chu ahung potdoh-un vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, hichun vohcha sangni jen chu halhaiyin alhaiyun, kol ah alhai lhauvin dil ah alhalut'un, twi lah-a chun alhumgam tauvin ahi.
5.14: Chuin ganching ho chu ajam un, khopi sung le loujaovah athu chu aseile tauvin ahi. Mipi chun ipi tidan hitam tin ave dingin ahung lhaipheiyun ahi.
5.15: Chuin Yeshua kom ahung lhun un, thilha Janel voppa chun pon akisila chule lunglima anatou chu amuvin akicha lheh jeng uve.
5.16: Chuin thilha voppa leh vohcha ho umchan achen achaiya mua hetoh hon thil umje chu aseipeh tauve.
5.17: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu agamsung uva kon'a potdoh ding in ahenga atao uvin ahi.
5.18: Chuin konga alut konin masanga thilha voppa chun ama toh kilhon khom dingin angeh tai.
5.19: Ahivang in Yeshuan ajadan ajah a, “Na in a chen lang nain kote henga Pakaiyin itobang thil loupi nabolpeh a, iti nakhoto'em abonchan gaseitan,” atipeh tai.
5.20: Chuin amapa chu akipatdoh in Decapolis (Khopi som) jousea Yeshuan thil lentah abolpeh chu lhangphong tah'in aseile pantai. Mijousen kidang asa lheh jeng un ahi.
5.21: Chuin Yeshua konga akitol in agal langkhat alhung in, hiachun mi honpi tamtah ahenga ahung kikhom un ahi.
5.22: Hichun kikhopna in'a vaipo holah-a mi khat, amin Jairus chu ahung in, Yeshua amu phat in akengbulah abohkhup in,
5.23: “Kachanu khangdongcha thiding dinmun'in aumtan, lungset in hung in lang achunga nakhut hung ngam in lang, ahinna ding in neijen dampeh-in,” tin ahung taove.
5.24: Chuin Ama chutoh akilhon pheiyin, mi honpin jong ahin juiyun, atom lellul jeng un ahi.
5.25: Hikahlah chun numei khat jong kumsom le kumni athi longa damlou aum in ahi.
5.26: Louthem tamtah akivetsahna-a sum le pai anei jouse sumang jouva ahitan, imala phachom louvin khoh chehcheh a um ahi.
5.27: Amanu chun Yeshua thudol anajan, hijeh chun mi honpi lah achun ahung in Yeshua pon mong chu ahung tham tai.
5.28: Amanu chu aki ngaiton, “Apon jengjong hi thamleng dam nange,” ti atahsan ahi.
5.29: Chomloukah'in athiput chu akang in atang jeng tan, anat thoh lel a kon aol leh adamdoh dan chu atichunga akihettan ahi.
5.30: Chutah chun Yeshuan atichunga kon'a amidamsahna tha apotdoh chu akihet in, hichun mipi lah-a chun akihei kimvelin, “Kapon thama chu koiham?” tin adongtai.
5.31: Aseijuiten ajah-a, “Mipi hijat'in naneh le jeng uva, itidan'a, ‘Koiham eithama?’ tia dohna nabol ham?” atiuvin ahi.
5.32: Hinlah Aman chuche bol a chu mudohna dingin avelen ahi.
5.33: Amanu chun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, kicha sasan kihot pum in ahung in a-angah abohkhup in, ama ahi akiseidohtai.
5.34: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Boinu, natahsan in nadamsah ahitai. Lungmong in chetan. Na thohnatna chu kichai ahitai,” ati.
5.35: Amanu koma thu asei jinglaiyin, thupole khat Jairus in'a konin ahung in, “Nachanu athitai. Houhil hi kisahboisah ngaitaponte,” tin Jairus komah ahung seiye.
5.36: Aki hounau chu Yeshuan ajatan, Jairus koma chun, “Kicha hih-in, tahsan poupoutan,” ati.
5.37: Chuin Peter, James le John (James naopa), hicheng tailou midang koiman ajuiding ajadan akijuisah poi.
5.38: Kikhopna in vaihompa, Jairus in alhun'u chun, mihonpi chu anapoh cheichoi jeng un, kap le maova aum'u chu Yeshuan amun ahi.
5.39: Chuin ama alut'in ajah uva, “Ibola hitia hi napo cheichoiyuva nakau ham? Chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, aihmu ahibouve,” ati.
5.40: Thi op mi honpi chun anuisat uve. Hichun aboncha uvin asoldohsoh in, chapangnu nu le pa toh chule ahin kilhonpi seijui thum ho chengsetoh chapangnu umna'a chun alut un ahi.
5.41: Chuin chapangnu khut chu atuh in, “Talitha koum,” atin ahi. Hichu “Boinu, kithouvin!” tina ahi.
5.42: Chupettah chun chapangnu chu ahung thouvin, ading in lam ajotpai jeng tai. Amanu chu kum som le ni bou ahina laiye. Chutah chun amaho chun kidang asa lheh jeng un.
5.43: Hiche thuhi koima ahetsah louna diuvin Yeshuan akhamgah in, chule amanun aneh ding an apeh diuvin thu apen ahi.

6.1: Chuin chua kon chun Yeshua ache doh'in, achenna Nazareth lama aseijuite toh ache tan ahi.
6.2: Cholngahni ahung hi phat in Judah ho kikhopna in'ah thu ahil pan in, chuin athu hil chu mi tamtah ajaho chun kidang asa uvin, “Hichepa hin hoiya kon'a chihna le thibol theina hi chengpi hi akilah ahitadem?” atiuvin ahi.
6.3: Chuin nuisat toh atho uvin, “Ama hi thingthem bol maimai, Mary chapa, chule James, Joseph (Joses), Juda le Simon sopipa ahibouve. Chule asopi numei ho jong ilah uva acheng uve,” atiuvin ahi. Amaho chu alung-u adong in ahivang in atahsan nom pouvin ahi.
6.4: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in ajah uva, “Themgao chu ama achenna gamsung le ainkote lah chule ama insung tailouvin mun dang jousea jabolna achang jin ahi,” ati.
6.5: Chukoma miten atahsan lou jeh'un ana damlou phabep khat chunga, akhut angapma adamsah tailou chun thil kidang ima abol thei tapoi.
6.6: Atahsan lou dan'u chu adatmo lheh jeng e. Chuin kho anai dunga achelen thu ahil-le tai.
6.7: Chuin aseijui somleni ho chu akouvin, lhagaoboh chunga thaneina apen, chujouvin mi ni-nin asoldoh tai.
6.8: Chule ajin nauva tenggol tailou ima dang, changlhah jong, sakhao jong, dangka dip sunga sum them jong—aken louhel diuvin thu apei.
6.9: Kengchot vang akise uva, sangkhol thoni vang aki ahlou diuvin aseipeh in ahi.
6.10: “Hoikom hijongle nachena chan uva, nalhun lhunnau in'a chun, khosung na potdoh kahse uvin umun.
6.11: Ahinlah koi kho hileh nahin lhunsah lou uleh, nathu seiyu ngailou khomite nadalhah tenguleh, dalhah ahitauve ti ahettohsah nan nakeng phang uva agam leivui chu thinglha uvin,” tin thu apei.
6.12: Chuti chun akipatdoh un, mihemten lunghei ding ahi ti chu ahil lhangle uvin,
6.13: Thilha tamtah jong anodoh'un, ana damlou tamtah jong thao anu uvin aboldam un ahi.
6.14: Yeshua min gamtina akithan tah jeh chun, Leng Herod Antipas in hiti thu chu ajatan, mi phabep in, “Ama hi John Baptist athia kon'a thoudoh kit hinte. Hijeh'a chu thil kidang boltheina anei ahi,” tin aseiji uve.
6.15: Loikhat in, “Themgao Elijah ahi,” atiuvin, loikhat kit chun, “Malai themgao minthang ho banga themgao khat ahi,” atiuve.
6.16: Herod'in Yeshua chung thu ajah phat in, “Alu katansa John chu athia kon'a hung thoukit hinante,” ati.
6.17: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod in anaopa Philip jinu Herodias chu aki chenpi ahin, amanu jal'a chu ama tah'in mi asola John chu amatsah a, akan'a songkula akhum ahi.
6.18: John chun Herod jah a, “Nasopi ji jia naneiya naki chenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi,” anatin ahi.
6.19: Hiche jeh'a chu Herodias chun ama chu hahot in ahot in, tha ding in atup in, ahivanginla Herod phalna louvin abol theipon ahi.
6.20: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod chun John chu michon phatah le mithengtah ahi ti chu ahet jeh'in ajabolin, chuleh avesuiyin ahi. Herod'in John ahoulimpi teng ahimo ji lheh in, ahijeng vang'in, athusei angainom kit jin ahi.
6.21: Hinlah Herodias in phat gomkom anga jing chu Herod pen nikho chun ahung lhung tai. Chuche nikhoa chun gamvaipo natong alen alal ho, galsat-thalchoi lamkai ho chule Galilee gam'a milun ho chengse vahnan golvah abolin ahi.
6.22: Hiachun achanu chu ahung lut in, alam in ahileh leng Herod le atou khompi chengse chu alung lhaisah sohtan, chuphat'in lengpan nungahnu jah achun, “Nagot chan thum'in, keiman peng kate,”
6.23: “Nathum chan chu kapeh ding ahi, ka lenggam akeh khat geiya jong kapeh thei nahi,” atitai.
6.24: Chuin amanu apotdoh in, anu komah, “Ipi kathum ding ham?” tia agadoh leh, anun, “John Baptist luchang thum in,” ahin titai.
6.25: Chuphat'in amanu kintah'in lengpa hengah ahung loiyin, “John Baptist luchang tutah in konglheng khat'in neipe lechun kati penne,” tin athumtai.
6.26: Chuin lengpa alunggim lheh jeng tan, ahivanginla mi masanga athutep le akihahselna chule a-ankong umpiho jal chun, amanu thil thum chu nahsahmon akoithei tapoi.
6.27: Hijeh chun asolchah hemchoi ho khat chu John lu gala ding in asoltan, ama achen songkul sungah alu agatang dentai.
6.28: Chuin alu chu kong khat'in ahin domin nungahnu chu apen, aman anu aga petai.
6.29: Chuin aseijuiten ajah phat'un ahung un along chu ahung lauvin lhan'ah avui tauve.
6.30: Chuin solchah hochu anatoh nauva kon in Yeshua henga ahung kile uvin, akiman chah dan'u le athuhil danho uchu aseiyun ahi.
6.31: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Hung un, munthip'ah chomkhat gakichol ute,” ati. Ijeh-inem itileh ahungle achele mi atam behseh jeng in, an jeng jong ne manlou ahi tauve.
6.32: Hiti chun amaho munthip lam jonin kong in akitolphei tauvin ahi.
6.33: Hinlah mi tamtah'in hitia akitoldoh uchu anamu uvin, hichun khopi mun chomchoma kon in mi tamtah chu twipang achun anache pheiyun, agal langa chun analhung masakit tauvin ahi.
6.34: Kong sunga kon Yeshuan kal ahin sedoh leh hitia mi honpi anaum chu Yeshuan amun, achingbei kelngoi hontoh abah jeh uchun alung asen, hichun amaho chu thil tampi ahil in ahi.
6.35: Nilhah lam'in aseijuite ahung un ahenga, “Hikom hi gamthip ahin, phat hila agei lheh tan,
6.36: mi honpi hi ikimvel uva loujao le khosung hoa acheuva neh ding imathem aga kichoh diuvin soldoh tan,” atiuvin ahi.
6.37: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nanghon aneh diu peuvin,” ati leh, “Ipi-em kapeh diu? Mi hijatpi vahna ding vang chu sum tampi kakilona diuvin lha tampi lut inte!” tin ahin donbut uve.
6.38: Chuin Yeshuan, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum? Gave temun,” atin, hichun agave uvin, “Changlhah pheng nga toh ngani aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
6.39: Chuin mi honpi chu aboncha uvin hamhing eng lah-a chu ahon hon'a atousah diuvin aseijuite athu hil tan.
6.40: Chuin amaho agol golin—ja khat cheng, som nga cheng in atou tauvin ahi.
6.41: Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga toh nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei aboh-in changlhah chu ahehbal bal in, a anguvah luipeh ding in aseijuite apen, nga ni jong chu ahoppeh soh keiyin ahi.
6.42: Hichu amahon aneuvin, abonun aneva sohkei tauve.
6.43: Akivahva jouvun changlhah le nga aval chengse paipeh somleni aloh dimun ahi.
6.44: Mi honpi kivahva chu numei le chapang ho sim louvin pasal cheh mi sang nga alhing in ahi.
6.45: Chuin Yeshuan mi honpi chu alhadoh jinglai chun aseijuite chu, gal langkhat lama Bethsaida anagalkai masa ding in konga chun alutsah in asoltan ahi.
6.46: Abonuva alhahdoh soh phat in, tao ding in mol chunga akal toutai.
6.47: Jansot lamin aseijuite chu dil lailunga kong chunga aumun, Ama achangin tolgo chunga aum den e.
6.48: Chuin amaho dil chunga konga akitol uva, hui le twi nong in anuh uva alungdon uchu amun, khovah ding kon lamin akeng in dil chunga lam ahinjot in, amaho chu khel ding agon ahi.
6.49: Ahin amahon dil chunga kenga lam ahin jot amu phat'un thilha hinte atiuvin, a aosot jeng un ahi.
6.50: Aboncha uva Amachu amu sohkeiyu ahin, atija lheh jeng un, ahivang in Aman amaho chu ahin houpaiyin ajah uva, “Ki chahih'un, hangsan uvin, keima hichea kaum nai,” ati.
6.51: Chuin kong chunga chun akaldoh in, hui jong athip jengtai. Amaho chu alungdong lheh jengui.
6.52: Ajehchu changlhah kidang thudol jong chu hephatalou ahitauve. Alungtah behseh nalam uva chuti ahi.
6.53: Chuin agalkaiyun Gennesaret gamsung alhung un, kong chu twipam chin'ah anga tauve.
6.54: Chuin konga konin apotdoh doh un, miho chun anahepai tauvin ahi.
6.55: Agamsung uva alhai kimvel leuvin, chuah aume ti ahetna chanuvin ana damlou ho chu alupna pheh pumin ahinpu uvin ahi.
6.56: Achena chan khoneo, khopi chule loujao gamkochong alutna chan'ah adamlouho chu japi kititna kailhang mun'ah alupsah un, apon mongkaibeh atham dingun ahenga ataovun ahi. Hichun athamkha chan chu adam jeng un ahi.

7.1: Nikhat hi Pharisee holeh hou lamkai danthu sunho phabep Jerusalem a kipat'in Yeshua kimupi dingin ahung un ahi.
7.2: Aseijuite mi phabep khat in dan nitlou leh, khut soplouva an aneh uchu ahung mudoh tauve.
7.3: (Judah ho adehset'a, Pharisee hon akhang akhanga chonna dan dungjuiya khut phatea sopngim louva anehji lou u ahi.
7.4: Hitobangma chun, amahon kailhanga kicho hijongle twiya khut adelutlou leh ima anengai pouve. Hiche chu chonnangai tampi—khomho, belho, sum-eng chule jalkhun ho sopthengna kin-gun—hitobang chondan tampi anei lah-uva khat ahi.)
7.5: Hiti chun, Pharisee holeh hou dan thuhil hon adong un, “Ipijeh'a naseijuiten akhang akhanga ichonna ngaiyu banga khut soplouva an aneh-uham?” atiuvin ahi.
7.6: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Isaiah Themgaovin mi phalhem nangho chungchang thua: ‘Hiche nam mite hin akamsung uvin eichoian un, alung thimula keiya konin gamlatah ahi.
7.7: Amahon eihouvuhi moh ahi. Mihem semthu lungsuhto ho chu Pathen thupeh dan'a ahil u ahi,’ tin anaseiye.
7.8: Nanghon Pathen danthupeh ahibangtah chu nahsahmon nakoiyun nangho chonnamlhah joh natuhdetjo tauve.
7.9: Nachonna ngaiyu natuh dettheina diuvin Pathen danthupeh tahbeh chu nahei lamdang uve.
7.10: Atekahnan, Mose'n Pathen'a hungkon danthu napeuve: ‘Nanu le napa jabolun,’ chule ‘Koihileh anu le apa housea chu thi jeng hen,’ ati.
7.11: Hinlah mihon anu le apa koma, ‘Gelse hih'un, kahinpanhu joupoi, ajehchu kahinpeh ding chu Pathen'a dia kapeh dingin kakiteptai,’ tia aseitheiyu jongleh aphatmona aumpoi natiuve.
7.12: Hiti chun nule pate agel-thupitah diu angaikhohpoi natiuve.
7.13: Hitia hi nangho chon-namlhah joh najui jing theina diuva Pathen thupeh hochu juilouva nakahlhah jiu ahitai,” ati.
7.14: Chuin mipite chu athuhil ngaidin akouvin, “Nabonuvin ngaiyun, chule hetthem ding gouvin.
7.15: Polama kon'asunga lutchun ima asubohpon; lungsunga kon'a hung potdoh joh chun asuhbohji ahibouve.
7.16: Angaina ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
7.17: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi chu adalhan insung alut leh aseijuiten thulem asei chun ipilamdol akoa avetsah ham tin adongui.
7.18: “Nanghon jong nahet theilou laiyu ong? Natahsa sunga lut an nanehho chun nahin suhboh lou u ahi chu namu theilouvuham?
7.19: An nanehlut'u chu lungsunga lutlouvin oisungah alut in posona-ah ahungdoh jitai.” (Hitia kiseihi, Pathen mitmun an jouse hi santhei dol ahisoh keiye ti aphondohna ahi).
7.20: Chule Aman aseibe kit'in, “Lungsunga kon'a hungpot chun mi asuhboh ahi.
7.21: Ijeh inem iti leh mihem lungsunga konin apolamah—lunggitlou, jonthanhoi, guchat, toltha,
7.22: Midangtoh-jon, papset, gitlou, mi-dohabol, huhna, kimitthipna, kitaitom, hoitho, ngolna kitiho hi ahung sohdoh ji'e.
7.23: Hiche thilpha louho hi lungsunga potdoh ahin, mihem suboh ji chu ahiuve,” ati.
7.24: Chuin Yeshuan Galilee gam adalhan, sahlama Tyre gamsungah achetai. Hikoma chun in khat'a alhungin, aumna in chu koima hetsah anompoi, ahinlah akiselthei deh tapoi.
7.25: Hiachun Ama thudol anajakha numei khat ahungin, akengbula ahung bohkhup in ahi. Amanu achanu chu lhagaoboh vop ahin,
7.26: Achanu a kon'a lhagaoboh anodohpeh dingin ahung taovin ahi. Amanu chu Syrian Phoenicia tolkon, Gentile-ho ahijeh chun,
7.27: Yeshuan ajah-a, “Amasapenin keima insung, Judate chateho kavahva masat tahdi ding ahi. Chate changlhah lahpeh-a uichate masanga selhah angai ahipoi,” ati.
7.28: Amanun jong, “Hichu ahinai, Pakai, hijongle dokhang noiya um uichan jong chate lhengkonga kon tolkhe changlhah nehmoh anehkhah jiu khula-em,” tin adonbut in ahi.
7.29: Chuin Yeshuan, “Nadonbut hoilheh-e! Tuhin na-in'ah chetan, nachanu chu thilhan adalhatai,” atipehtai.
7.30: Hichun Amanu jong a-in'a acheleh achanu chu jalkhun'a analup amun, lhagaoboh anapotdohtan ahi.
7.31: Yeshuan Tyre gamkol sungse adalhan, Sidon ajotpan Decapolis gamkai ajotpeh in, Galilee Dillen alhungtai.
7.32: Chuin anangong, pao jong paochen theilou khat hi ahenga ahin puiyun, achunga akhut angap dingin ataovun ahi.
7.33: Hichun Aman mipi lah'a konin apuidohin, akhutchalin akol sung akhoiyin,
7.34: Achil aset in, alei athamin, chuin vanlam aven akhoisan, “Ephphatha,” ati. Hichu kihongin! tina ahi.
7.35: Chuphat tah chun ana avangin, aleigui jong akilham tan, kichehtah'in apaotheitai.
7.36: Chuin Aman amaho chu koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamtan ahi. Ahinla amahon ahaseiphong cheh'un ahi.
7.37: Kidang asabehseh jengun, avel avelin, “Aman ijakai abol jouse hi aloupi lheh jenge. Nangongla ana avansah-in, paomola apaosah-e,” atiuvin ahi.

8.1: Hiche laichun mipi ho chu atamlheh jengtan chule neh ding ima aneilou jeh un Yeshuan aseijuite chu akouvin ajah uva,
8.2: “Mi honpi hi kakoma aumnau nithum ahitan, amahon nehding ima aneipouve,
8.3: Chule annelouvin a-inlam chan uva solleng lampia lhasampa ding ahiuve. Akimkhat hi gamlatah a kon hung ahiuve,” ati.
8.4: Aseijuiten adonbut un, “Hikom gamthip laiya mi hichengpi lhingset'a vahna ding changlhah kon hoiya alahding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
8.5: Yeshuan adongin, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum?” ati leh, “Pheng sagi aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
8.6: Chuin Aman mihonpi chu tolla tou din asolin, changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, athangvah-in, chujouvin ahehbalbalin a-angsunguva luipeh dingin aseijuite chu apen, amahon mipi anga chun aluipeh-ui.
8.7: Chule aseijuiten nga neochacha phabep khat jong aneiyun, hijong chu phatthei aboh-in a-angsunguva luipeh dingin asoltan ahi.
8.8: Chuin amahon aneuvin, avasoh keiyun, anehmoh-u anong aval chu longkai sagi alohdoh-un ahi.
8.9: Amaho chu numei-chapang simlouvin mi sangli jen ahiuvin, anehva jouvun Yeshuan in lamah asoltauve.
8.10: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Ama aseijuite toh konga alutpaiyun, Dalmanutha gam alhung tauve.
8.11: Pharisee hon Yeshua ahunglhung taiti ajah phatnun, kinelkalpi dingin ahungun ahi. Athuneina photchenna dingin van'a kon melchihna avetsah diuvin angeh-un ahi.
8.12: Chuin alungsungah akhoisan, “Tukhang mite hin ibol a melchihna ahol uham? Tahbeha kasei ahi, hiche tukhang mite hi imacha melchihna kipelou ding ahi,” atitai.
8.13: Chuin amaho chu adalhan, konga alut kit'in, langkhat panga dingin akipat dohtai.
8.14: Hinlah aseijuiten changlhah kipoh ding ahin haimil tauve. Konga chunla changlhah phengkhat tailou adang aum hihhel in ahi.
8.15: Chuin Aman amaho chu ahilchah-in, “Chingtheiyun, Pharisee ho le Herod chol lah-a kihongpha uvin,” ati.
8.16: Hiche aseiya kon chun changlhah ahin poh haimil jeh-un amaho akihoulimun, akioimoto uvin ahi.
8.17: Akihounau chu Yeshuan ahen, ajah uva, “Changlhah naneilou jeh uva ibola kioimoto le nahiuvem? Tugeiya nalunguva hedoh loulai nahiuvem? Hetthemna dinga nalungu hibangloma tah lheh jeng ham?
8.18: Mit neiyuva—mutheilou nahiuvem? Nakhang neiyuva—jatheilou nahiuvem? Gel jong nagel dohlou monguham?
8.19: Mi sang-nga changlhah pheng nga kahoppeh-a chu amoh-ahal paipeh ijat nalodimum?” atileh amahon, “Somleni ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
8.20: Mi sangli lah-a changlhah pheng sagi kihoppeh-a chu nehmoh aval longkai ijat nalodimum? ati kit leh, “Sagi ahi,” atiuvin,
8.21: “Achutile tugeiya jong hedoh loulai nahiu ham?” atin ahi.
8.22: Amaho Bethsaida alhun phat'un, mi phabep in mitchopa chu Yeshua henglama ahin puiyun, chule amahon atohkhah-a adamsah din angeh-uvin ahi.
8.23: Yeshuan mitchopa chu akhut in atuh-in, khosunga konin apuidohtan ahi. Chuin amit a achil aset in achunga akhut angam in, “Tua hi kho namum?” tin adongin ahi.
8.24: Mipa chun akimvel dung aven, “Henge, miho kamun, ahinla kichentah'in ka muthei poi, thingphungte chat lele tobang'in kamui,” ati.
8.25: Chujouvin amit akhut'in atham kit'in, ave changmelin ahileh adamhel jengtan, ima jouse kichentah'in amu thei tan ahi.
8.26: Yeshuan ama asoldoh in, “Khosunga chun lutpa tahih-in,” tin akham'in ahi.
8.27: Yeshua le aseijuiten Galilee gam adalha uvin, Caesarea Philippi koma khohoa chun ache leuvin ahi. Lampia alamjot laiyun thu adongin, “Keima hi mihon koi ahi eitiuvem?” ati leh,
8.28: Aseijuiten, “Loikhat in John Baptist, loikhat in Elijah chule loikhat kit chun Nangma hi themgaoho lah a achom khat hinte atiuve,” tin adonbut uve.
8.29: Chuin Yeshuan, “Ahileh nanghonla keihi koi ahi neitiuvem?” tia adoh leh, Peter in, “Nangma Messiah chu nahi,” ati.
8.30: Ahinlah Yeshuan koimacha koma aseidohlou beh diuvin ahilchahtan ahi.
8.31: Chuin Aman amaho chu Mihem Chapan thohgimna tamtah athoh-a, vaipo upa hole thempu pipuho chule danthu sunhon adoudal diu thuho aseipeh-e. Chule thalih-a auma, nithum jouleh thoudoh kit teiding ahi chu ahil pantan ahi.
8.32: Aman hichu phongtaha aseijuite koma asei jinglaiyin, Peter in apuidohin hitobang thuho chu aseilou din angeh-in ahi.
8.33: Ahin Ama akiheiyin, aseijuiteho aven Peter chu aphoh-in, “Kanung lama chen, Satan! Nangman Pathen thulam gellouvin, mihem thulam jeng nagele,” atin ahi.
8.34: Chuin Aman aseijuiho le mihonpi chu ahenglama akouvin, “Nalah-uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chonnauva kon'a nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui dingu ahi.
8.35: Ijeh inem itileh koi hile ahinna huhhing nom'a chun alhaso ding ahi. Amavang koi hile keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a ahinna lhaso'a chun akihuhhing joh ding ahi.
8.36: Ijeh-inem itileh min vannoi pumpi neihenlang ahinna chan taleh, ipi phatchomna anei ding ham?
8.37: Min ahinna khel'a ipi apeh dingham?
8.38: Ijeh inem itileh koihileh tulai chonthanhoinale chonsetna khanga keima le kathuhil jachatpi chu Mihem Chapan jong apa loupina-a vantil thengtetoh ahung nileh, amapa chu ajachatpi ding ahi,” ati.

9.1: Yeshuan aseibe nalaiyin, “Keiman tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, tua hichea dingho kimkhat hi Pathen gam thaneitah'a ahung lhun amu kahseuva thina tepkhalou ding aumuve!” ati.
9.2: Nigup jouvin Yeshuan Peter, James chule John atumbeh in molsang chungah apui touvin ahi. Chuah amaho angsung laitah-a Yeshua avou akikheltan,
9.3: Aponsil chu vah bangin aemleng jengin, leiya koiman pon hitobanga chu asop bang theilou khop'in abangin ahi.
9.4: Chuin Elijah le Mose ahung kilah lhonin Yeshua chu ahoulimpi lhonin ahi.
9.5: Chuin Peter in, “Houhil, hikoma iumuhi eiho din anom ngeiye! Geldoh jingna din lhambuh thum song uhite—Nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat,” atin ahi.
9.6: Hiche asei hi akichat behseh jeh'a seiding hetmoa asei ahi.
9.7: Chuin meilhang khat'in amaho chu ahin lekhun, meilah-a konin aw ahung gingin, “Hichehi ka-Chapa deitah chu ahi, athu ngaiyun!” ati.
9.8: Chuin akimvelu avet uleh, koimacha amutahih un, Mose le Elijah chu anachemang tan, Yeshua changseh le amaho changbou aumtauvin ahi.
9.9: Molla kon'a ahung kumsuh jing laiyun, Yeshuan athilto-u chu Mihem Chapa athia kon'a athodoh kit kahsea koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamgah-in ahi.
9.10: Athusei chu alunguva aching jingun, athia kon'a athodoh kit chu ipi aseina ahidem, tin akidongto jiuvin ahi.
9.11: Chuin amahon adongun, “Ibola danthusunhon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kit masa ding ahi atiuham?” atiuleh Aman adonbut in,
9.12: “Elijah chu hungmasa'a ijakai ahung semphat ding mong ahi. Ahinla Pathen Thubun Mihem Chapan gimhesoh tamtah athoh ding chule mite nahsahmoa um ding ati ham?
9.13: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Elijah chu hunga ahitai, chule thil hungsoh ding anakisut bangtah'in isahlou tah'in anabol tauve,” atin ahi.
9.14: Chuin seijui dangho henglama ahung kileuva ahileh, amaho chu mipin anaumkimvelu chu amuvin, hou lamkai phabep khattoh jong anakinel un ahi.
9.15: Mihonpin Yeshua amu phatnun, akipah thanomun ahengah ahung lhaiyun, ahung lamtouvin ahi.
9.16: Hichun Yeshuan, “Amaho khutoh ipi thua kinel nahiuvem?” tin adongtai.
9.17: Mipi lah'a konin mi khat in ahin donbut in, “Pakai, kachapa nadamsah dingin nahenga kahin puiye. Amahi lhagaoboh-in avop in, apao dohsah thei tapoi.
9.18: Hoikom hijongle lhagaoboh hin amat matna'ah aheh lhujin, chule achilphon alhan, aha ageljin chule alhasamdel ji tai. Hijeh a chu naseijuite koma einodohpeh diuva kangeh leh abolthei pouve,” ati.
9.19: Hichun Yeshuan akomuvah, “Tahsanna neilou mite! Itihchan kaumpi ding nahiuvem? Kahenga chapangpa chu hin pui tangu,” atitai.
9.20: Hichun chapangpa chu ahin puiyui. Ahin lhagaoboh-in Yeshua amu phatnin, chapangpa chu nasatah'in aveingoiyin ahileh tolla alhun, achilphon akai letlut in akitel lelen ahi.
9.21: Chuin Yeshuan chapangpa apa jah-a, “Ahitinahi itih-a pat hitam?” tia adoh leh, apan, “Aneolaiya kipan ahitai.
9.22: Tha dingin abangleh meiya, abangleh twiyah alehlutjin ahi. Hijongle Nangman alonaje nahet leh kachunguva khotona neipumin neikithopin,” tin aseitai.
9.23: “Alonaje nahet leh, nati chu ipi naseina ham? Atahsanho dingin ijakai ahithei soh keiye,” tin Yeshuan adonbut e.
9.24: Hichun hetman louvin chapangpa apa chu ahung kapjah jengin, “Pakai, katahsan'e, katahsan lelna abeina din neikithopin,” tin ataotai.
9.25: Chuin Yeshuan mi ahung kikhop tam chehcheh amu phatnin lhagao-boh chu aphoh-in, ajah-a, “Ngaiyin, nang lhagao phalou, chapangpa paomosah le nangonsahpa, thu kapeh nahi, chapangpa sunga konin hung Potdoh inlang lutkit tahih-in!” ati.
9.26: Hichun lhagaoboh chu apengjah jengin, chapangpa chu hatah in aveingoiyin, chuin adalhatai. Chapangpa chu athi bangin aumtan, mihonpi chu akihou lahlah-un, “Athi hitakhu!” atiuvin ahi.
9.27: Ahin Yeshuan akhut in amanin, akaithouvin ahileh ahung thoudoh jengtan ahi.
9.28: Chujou chomkhat jouva Yeshua le aseijuite insunga aumlaiyun aseijuiten, “I-atileh keihon kanodoh lel'u ahidem?” tia adoh-ule,
9.29: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Hitobang hi taona thahatna'a bou kinodoh thei ahi,” ati.
9.30: Chumun chu adalha uvin, Galilee gam ajot un, min ahetdoh diu chu Yeshuan adeipoi.
9.31: Ijeh-inem iti leh Aman aseijuite toh phat mankhoma thuhil ding phat angaichan ahi. Hichun Aman ajah-uva, “Mihem Chapa chu melmate khut'a pehdoh-a umding ahi. Amahon atha dingu, ahivanga nithum nileh Ama thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
9.32: Athusei chu ipi asei ham ti ahethei pouvin Ama doh dingla akichauvin adong ngam pouve.
9.33: Amaho Capernaum ahung lhungun, chuin insung aumpet'un ajah uva, “Lamdunga chu ipi nangaitou ham?” tin adongin ahi.
9.34: Ahin, adonbut theipouve, ajehchu alah uva koichu alenpen hintem ti akinel ahiuve.
9.35: Hichun Yeshua atouvin somleni ho chu akouvin, “Koihileh amasapen hinom chu nukhah pending ahi, chule mijouse jenlea pang hiding ahi,” ati.
9.36: Chuin chapang neocha khat alaiyuva adinsah-in, chuin apomin ajah uva,
9.37: “Koihileh keima min'a hitobang chapang neokhat sanga chun keima eisan ahi, chule koihileh keima eisang chan chun, keima bou eisan hilouvin eihinsolpa jong sana hi,” ati.
9.38: Hichun John'in Yeshua komah, “Houhil, amin'a thilha nodoh mi khat kamu uvin, hinla ama chu eiho lah-a pang ahilou jeh-in kakham tauve,” ati.
9.39: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kham hih-un, kamin'a thil kidang bol a keima eiseiseloi thei koima aumpoi.”
9.40: Koi hijongle eidouloupou chu eilama pang ahi.
9.41: Koi hijongle Messiah nungjui-mi ahi tiatwi khon khat donding napechan'u chu, tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, itinama jongle ama chun kipaman asan ding ahi.
9.42: Chule koi hijongleh keima eitahsan khangdongchaho jeng jong setna-a kipallhuh sah chun angonga sumhei songlentah kikhai henlang twikhanglen'a kilehlut leh ama dingin aphajoi.
9.43: “Chule nakhut langkhat'in nachonsetsah'a ahileh tanbong jengin. Khut ni neiya meikong mittheilou damun'a che sangin tibukimlou khut langkhatseh toh hinkemlouna-a lut aphajoi.
9.44: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
9.45: Nakeng langkhat'in nachonsetsah'a ahileh tanbong jeng in, keng ni neiya damun jot sangin keng langbeiya hinkem louna mun'a lut aphajoi.
9.46: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
9.47: Namit langkhat'in nakipal lhuhsah'a ahileh kaldoh jengin, mit ni neiya damun'a nakilelut sangin mit lang choa Pathen gam'a lut nangma ding in aphajoi.
9.48: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
9.49: Ijeh-inem itileh mijouse meiya chisoa kiso ding, chule gankikat jouse chi kiso-al ding ahi.
9.50: Chihi apha ahivang in a-alna beita henlang tamtaleh ipia ki-alsah kit ding hitam? Chi bang in gun neiyun lang khat le khat chamdelin um uvin,” ati.

10.1: Chuin Yeshuan Capernaum adalhan chua kon in Judah gamkol sung leh, Jordan Lui solam gamkaiyah ache suhtan ahi. Mi honpi chu ahenga ahung kikhom kit tauvin, chuti chun Aman amaho chu thu ahilkittan ahi.
10.2: Chua chun Pharisee ho mi phabep ahenga ahung un mochan theina dinga kipalsahna ding in, “Pasal in aji ada hi danngai hinam?” tin thudoh ahung neiyui.
10.3: Yeshuan athudoh-u chu adonbut in, “Mose'n nang ho jida thua danthu itobang napeh uvem?” tia adoh leh,
10.4: Amahon, “Da ding aphalnai. Mi khat'in aji adana dia lekhasut apeh lut'a, chule amanu chu asoldoh thei ahi, tin aseiye,” atiuvin ahi.
10.5: Chuin Yeshuan adonbutnan: “Nang ho lungtah behseh jeh'a hitia chu dan nahin ngaijang peh-u ahibouve.
10.6: Ahivang in semtila pat'a Pathen in pasal le numei anasem ahitai.
10.7: Hichun ipijeh'a pasal in anulepa adalhah-a ajia beh ham ti avetsah-in,
10.8: Chule ama ni chu pumni hitalouva pumkhat, tahsa khat hilhon ding ahi tai.
10.9: Hijeh chun Pathen gopsa chu mihemin sukhen hih hen,” ati.
10.10: Phat chomkhat jouvin, aseijuite toh insunga amaho bou aumpet'un, hiche thuhi ahin podoh kit'un,
10.11: Aman aseipeh-in, “Koihileh aji da-a jidang neichun ajinu chu ajonsan ahi.
10.12: Numeiyin jong apasal ada-a midang toh akichen leh amanu jong chu ajong ahi,” ati.
10.13: Nikhat hi minu mipate phabep khat'in achateu chu Yeshuan atham'a phatthei aboh diuvin ahin puiyun ahileh, aseijuiten anajadauvin ahi.
10.14: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in aseijuite chunga alung phamon, ajah uva aseiyin, “Chapang neocha ho chu kahenga hung sah'un, jahda hih-un! Ijeh-inem iti leh Pathen Lenggam chu amaho tobang hoa bou ahi.
10.15: Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh chapang neoho banga Pathen Lenggam sanglou chu itinama jongleh hichea chu lutlou ding ahi,” ati.
10.16: Chuin chapangho chu apomin akhut achung uva angam'in phatthei abohtai.
10.17: Chuin Ama Jerusalem lang jon'a ache ding konin mi khat ahung lhaijelin a-angsungah adilsun, ajah-ah, “Houhil pha, tonsot hinkemlou kanei theina dinga ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
10.18: Yeshuan, “Ibola apha neitiham? Pathen khatseh tailou koima apha aumpoi,
10.19: Ahin, nathudoh donbutna dingin Thupeh chengse: Tolthat hih-in, Jonbol hih-in, gucha hih-in, dohan mi bol hih-in, nanu-napa jabolin, ti chu nahetai,” ati.
10.20: Hichun khangdongpan, “Houhil, hichengse chu kachapan laiya pat kahin nitpeh ahitai,” ati.
10.21: Chuin Yeshuan amachu aven, angailu lheh jenge. Adonbutnan, “Thil khat nabat nalaiye, chen lang nanei chengse gajoh-in langvaicha gentheiho gahoppehtan, chutileh vangou nanei ding ahi. Chuleh hungin lang kanung juiyin,” ati.
10.22: Chucheng asei ajah phat'in amai athim jengtan, gou haotah ahijehin lungnom motah in achemangtan ahi.
10.23: Chuin Yeshuan aseijuite avekimvelin, “Mihao theiho hi Pathen gam'a alut diu iti hahsat hitam!” ati.
10.24: Athusei chu aseijuiten adatmo lheh-uve, ahinlah Yeshuan asei kit'in, “Chateho, Pathen Lenggama luttheina ding hi thil hahsatah jong ahi,
10.25: Tahbehin, mihaoho Pathen Lenggam alut sangin sangongsang heo-bil hom'a alut ding abaijoi!” ati.
10.26: Amahon kidang asalheh jengun, “Achuti ahileh koi huhhing'a umjou ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
10.27: Yeshuan amaho aven, “Mihem dingin hitheihih jongleh Pathen dingin ahimo aumpoi,” ati.
10.28: Chuin Peter ahung paodohin, “Keihon ijakai kadalhauvin nanung kahin juitauve,” ati.
10.29: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge, ahinai. Chuleh tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a a-in, asopi pasalho, asopi numei ho, anu, apa, achate chule anei-agou dalha hon,
10.30: Ajatja-a in le lou, sopi pasal, sopi numei, nulepa, chate chuleh nei le gou—bolsetna thohpum puma akisan ding ahi. Chuleh khonung hinkhoa tonsot hinkemlou anei ding ahi.
10.31: Amavang tua athupipenho hung thupimo pen intin, tua thupimo penho hung thupipen tante,” ati.
10.32: Hichun Jerusalem jonin achetou tauvin, Yeshua chu amasanguva achen ahileh aseijuiten adatmo lheh jeng uvin, chuleh anung uva cheho chu kichatnan adimuvin ahi. Aseijui somleni ho apangin achesah-in, hichun khonunga Ama chunga hunglhung ding thuho aseipeh kittan ahi.
10.33: “Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin ichetauve, chukoma chu Mihem Chapa hi thempu pipui hole danthu sunho khut'a pehdoh-a umding, chule amaho chun athina dinga themmo achansah uva hiding nam dangte khut'a apehdoh dingu,
10.34: Chuleh amaho chun a-el ela aboluva chil asetkhum dingu, avoh-uva chuleh atha dingu, chuleh nithum jouleh ama thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
10.35: Chuin James le John, Zebedee chateni ahung lhonin akihoulimpi lhonin, “Houhil, kathum lhon neibolpeh tei lhon in,” atilhon e.
10.36: Yeshuan, “Nathum lhon chu ipiham?” ati leh,
10.37: Amanin, “Naloupina'a natou tengle khat najet lamah khat naveiyah neitousah lhonin,” atilhon tai.
10.38: Hichun Yeshuan, “Nathum lhon nakihet lhon poi! Keiman chomkhat joule kahin don ding thohgimna khon khachep'a chu nadon ngapchat lhon ding hinam? Thohgimna twilut'a kachan ding chu nachan ngam lhon ding hinam?” tin adongtai.
10.39: Amanin jong, “Henge, kangam lhonne!” tin aseilhon e. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kadon ding khon'a vang nadon lhon ding ahin chule thohgimna twilut kachanna jong changngam lhon nan nate,
10.40: Ahivangin kajet le veiya tousah ding vang chu keima boltheidol ahipoi. Pathen in hichu alhendohsaho dinga agotsa ahitabouve,” ati.
10.41: Seijui som ho chun James le John thilthum ajah-u chun athimah-un alungphamouvin ahi.
10.42: Yeshuan amaho chu akoukhomin, “Nanghon naheuve, leiset mite lah'a vaipo ho khu amite pakaiyin apangun chuleh gamvaipo milun milal-hon anoidouhou chunga athuneinau asouvin vai ahomuvin ahi.
10.43: Nangho lah'a vang chutilou ding ahi. Koihileh nangho lah'a alen hinoma chu nalhachauva pang ding ahi.
10.44: Chuleh nalahuva apipuipen hinoma chu mijouse soh ahi ding angaiye.
10.45: Ijeh inem iti leh Mihem Chapa tah jong chu jen dinga hung hilouvin mijenle ding le mitampi lhatdohna dinga ahinna tohdoh ding joh-a hung ahibouve,” ati.
10.46: Chuin amaho Jericho khopi alhungun, Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi sung adalhah ding kon'un mihonpi tamtah'in anung ahin juiyui. Chuti lai chun mitcho khat, Timaeus chapa Bartimaeus chu lampam'ah anatouve.
10.47: Nazareth Yeshua chu nailam chan aum taiti ahet phatnin, “Vo David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam pantan ahi.
10.48: Mi tamtah chun, “Thipmin!” tin ama chu aphoh-un, ahivangin aman ging cheh-in, “David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam kit'e.
10.49: Yeshuan ajah phatnin adingdenin, “Hilama hung din seipeh-un,” atin, amahon jong mitchopa chu aganai pheiyun, “Kipah thanomin! Hungtan, Aman nakouve,” atipeh-un ahin pui tauve.
10.50: Hichun Bartimaeus chun asangkhol-tho chu asut in akoilhan, chuin akichom touvin Yeshua heng ahin jon tai.
10.51: Yeshuan, “Ipi bolpehleng nadeiyem?” tia adoh leh, mitchopan, “Houhil, kho muleng kati,” ati.
10.52: Chuin Yeshuan ajah-a, “Chetan, natahsan in nadamsah tai,” ati leh, chupet tah chun kho amupai jengin, lamlhungin Yeshua ahin juitai.

11.1: Hiti chun Yeshua le aseijuiten Jerusalem ahinjon tauvin, Olive Lhanga Bethphage le Bethany kho alhung tauve. Yeshuan aseijui mi ni anache masadin asol masan,
11.2: “Che lhon inlang, namasang jon lhon'a khopi sunga khun lut lhonin. Nalut lut lhon leh sangannou kihen, achunga koima touna khahlou lai khat namu pai lhon ding ahi. Hichu sutlha lhon inlang hinkaiphei lhonin.”
11.3: Mi khat touvin, “Ibola nasut lhonham? tia ahin doh leh, ‘Pakaiyin manna nom aneiye, chomkhat jouteng hinthahvah kit lhon nange,’ tilhon'in,” atipeh-e.
11.4: Seijui teni achelhon in, khopi sung lamlen'a inkot poa kotphunga sangannou kihen agamu lhontan ahi.
11.5: Chuin asut lhon leh akoma anadingho loikhat in, “Ibola sangannou chu nasut lhon ham?” atiuvin,
11.6: Chuin amanin Yeshuan asei bang chun amaho komah aseilhonin ahile ahin phalpeh tauve.
11.7: Sangannou chu Yeshua henga ahinkai lhonin, achunga apon'u asep'un, Ama achunga atoutan ahi.
11.8: Mipi atama tamin lampiah apon'u aphauvin, mi abangkhat in loulaiya theoboh asat'un lampiah aphauvin ahi.
11.9: Yeshua chu alailunga achesah'un, amasang lam le anunglama, “Pathen thangvah-in umhen! Pakai min'a hungpa chu anunnome!
11.10: Lenggam hung lhung ding Pu David gam chu phattheiboh chang hihen! Chungnungpen'a Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen!” tin asam asam'un ahi.
11.11: Chuin Jerusalem khopia houin'a chun Yeshua agalut'in, ijakai avet kimvel sohkei jouvin, nilhah lam jong ahitan, apot in somleni ho cheng toh Bethany'a akilekit tauvin ahi.
11.12: Chuin ajingkah-in Bethany'a kon'a ahung potdoh leh agil akeltan ahi.
11.13: Hichun theichangphung amun, aga aum khattoule tia agavetle theiga phat lhingjep nailou ahitoh lhonin ado tailou aga ima amutapoi.
11.14: Yeshuan thingphung jah-a chun, “Tukallhah koiman natheiga nekit tahih hen!” atitan ahi. Chutia aseichu aseijuiten anajauvin ahi.
11.15: Chuin Jerusalem ahung lhun'un, Yeshua houin sunga alut in, asunga thiljoh holeh thilchoho anodoh pantan, chule sumlhengho dokhang le vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh tan ahi.
11.16: Houin sunga chun koima thilkeo apohle ding ajanom tapoi.
11.17: Ajah-uva aseiyin, “Thubua: ‘Ka-in chu namtin dinga taona in kitiding ahi,’ tia kisun hilouham? Ahin nanghon gucha michomho kokhuh in naso tauve,” atin ahousetai.
11.18: Hichu thempu pipui hole hou danthu themhon ajauvin ahile, athimah tauvin, Yeshua tha ding tohgon aneipan tauve. Hinlah mipin athuhil chu kidang asah-uva angainom jeh-u chun Ama chu akichauvin ahi.
11.19: Hiche nilhah chun Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi adalha tauve.
11.20: Ajing jingkah-a theichang phung chu ahin jotpau leh anagoplhasa-a aum chu amutauve.
11.21: Chuin Peter in ageldoh-in, “Vetan Houhil, theichangphung nagaosap chu agoptai!” ati.
11.22: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen tahsanun,
11.23: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh hiche mol jah-a, ‘Kichondoh'in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut tan,’ ati leh chutijeng ding ahi. Hinlah hichu tahsanna dihtah nei lelung-opkaina beihel ahi angaiye.
11.24: Hiche jeh a chu kasei ahi, nataova thil nathum chan chu namusan ngaito leuchun namu dingu ahi.
11.25: Chule atao dinga nadinpet leh van'a na-Pauvin jong nasuh khelnau angaidam theina din koi hijongle nadou uchu ngaidamun.
11.26: Nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidamlou vangule van'a na-Pauvin nangho suhkhel jong angaidam louding ahi,” ati.
11.27: Jerusalem ahung lhung kit tauvin, Yeshua Houin sungah agavahlen ahileh thempu pipui holeh danthusunho ahenga ahungun,
11.28: “Ipi thuneina'a hitihohi nabolham? Hitobang bolna dinga kon thaneina napeh ham?” atiuvin ahi.
11.29: “Keiman thukhat nadong uvingting neidonbut'un lang chuteng keiman jong ipi thuneina'a hichehi kabol ham naseipeh nauvinge,” tin Yeshuan adonbut in ahi.
11.30: Hichun, “John chun twilutsah abol thuneina chu vanna kon ha, mihem a kon ham? Nei donbut'un!” tin adongtai.
11.31: Amaho le amaho akidongto uvin, “Vanna kon ahi tileu hen achutileh ibola John natoh natahsanlou uham tintin,
11.32: Mihem a kon ahi iti ngam diu baham?” akitiuvin ahi. Amaho akichauvin ahi—mijousen John chu themgao tahbeh'a angaito cheh-u ahijeh chun.
11.33: Achainan adonbut un, “Kahepouve,” atitauve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutile ipi thuneina'a hicheng hi kabol ham ti keiman jong naseipeh povinge,” atitai.

12.1: Chuin Yeshuan thulem in thu ahil pantan: “Mikhatnin lengpilei abolin, akimvel ah pal agenin ahi. Chuin achilna ding khuh alaiyin, insang asan, chuin aleilhouho khut'ah lousan dingin apedoh in gamdangah achetan ahi.
12.2: Aga lo phat ahi phat'in ama chan ding chu lading in aleilhou ho henga asoh ho khat asoltai.
12.3: Hinlah leilhouho chun amapa chu amanun avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin soldoh tauve.
12.4: Chuin lou neipan asohho khat asol kit leh ama jongchu ajumso uvin, alu ahin vohpeh-uve.
12.5: Chujouvin achom khat asol kit'in ahile ama chu ahin that tauve. Chule adang asol ho jong abang ahin vouvin, abang ahin that un ahi.
12.6: Asolthei ding khat bou aumtan, ama chu achapa deitah chu ahi. Lou neipan achainakeiyin, ‘Kachapa ahijeh'in anajabol nauvinte,’ tin ama chu asoltan,
12.7: Ahinlah aleilhouho chu akihouvun, ‘Veuvin, agamngah ding, agou loding pa ahunge, khaiye! Thatdoh-utin agam hi eiho chang taute,’ aki tiuvin ahi.
12.8: Chuin aman'un, athat'un along chu lengpilei polam'ah alehdoh tauvin ahi.
12.9: Hichan gei chu ahitahleh lengpilei neipa chun leilhou ho chu i-lotante tia nagel uvem? Naseipeh-unge—ama hung intin aleilhouho chu sugamintin lengpilei chu midang pedoh tante.
12.10: Thubua kisun: ‘Insahon adeimouva apaiyu song chu inning songin apangtan,
12.11: hichehi Pakai thilbol ahin, vetdingin avetlom lheh-e,’ tia kisun chu nasim dohkhah-uvem?” tin adonge.
12.12: Chupet'a um hou lamkaiho chun—leilhou migilou ho chu amaho toh kitekahna'a kisei ahi tin agel tauvin, Yeshua chu matding ago tauvin ahi. Ahinlah mipiho akichat kit jeh-uvin, adalha uvin achemang tauve.
12.13: Chomkhat jouvin lamkaiho chun thua themmo chansah-a mattheina ding in Pharisee ho phabep khat le Herod miho phabep chu Yeshua thudoh bol ding in asol un ahi.
12.14: Hichun agacheuvin, “Houhil, Nangma midih nahin, koima gin naneipoi. Dihtah'a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahi chu kaheuve. Ahile neiseipehun—Caesar kai kapeh-uhi dihthei ding hinam ahiloule dihlou ding ham?”
12.15: Kapeh diu ham, kapehlou diu ham? agatiuve. Yeshuan aphatlhemnau chu amudoh'in, adonbutnan, “Ibola neilunglah patep uham? Romte dangka-pumkhat hinchoiyun langnei vetsah un, chule naseipeh-uvinge,” ati.
12.16: Ahin choi phat'un, Yeshuan aven, “Hichea kinam hi koi lim le koi min ham?” tia adohleh, amahon “Caesar a ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
12.17: Chuin Yeshuan, “Chuti ahile aphai, Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin lang, Pathen'a chu Pathen peuvin,” atipeh tai. Adonbutna chu adatmo lheh jeng un ahi.
12.18: Chujouvin Sadducee—mithi thokitna aumpoi tiho—chu ahengah ahung un, ajah-a thudoh aneiyun,
12.19: “Houhil, Mosen eithupeh dungjuiyun mi khattouvin cha neilouva ajinu adalhah'a, athi tah'a ahile, asopipa chun ajinu chu vehen lang asopipa phunggui amanlouna ding chun chi khaipeh hen tin akiseiye.
12.20: Achutile, tekahnan ucha pasal sagi aume. Amasapenpa chun ji aneiyin chikhai louvin athitai.
12.21: Aban'a pan amanu chu jin aneiyin chikhai louvin athin, athumnapa jong chutima chu ahin,
12.22: Hitichun akitol suhpeh tauvin, asagiuvin chikhailou ahitauve. Achainan numeinu jong chu athitai.
12.23: Ahileh tun neiseipeh-un, thokit nia amanu chu alah uva koipen ji hitantem? Ijeh-inem iti leh asagiuva amanu chu jia anei cheh-u ahitai,” atiuve.
12.24: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasuhkhel'u chu Pathen thubua thu kisei nahethem pouvin chule Pathen thaneina nahet lou uhi ahi.
12.25: Ijeh-inem iti leh mithiho athodoh tengu chule ji anei tahlou diu chujongleh kichensahna umtalou ding ahi. Hiche thudol'a hi vanna Vantilte tobang hiding ahitauve.
12.26: Ahileh, mithiho kaithouva aum diu thudol hi—Mose'n hamboh meikou thudol asutna-ah, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob thi jou khonungpeh-a Pathen in Mose koma, ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ tia asei thu chu sim khalou nahiuvem?
12.27: Chu dungjuiya chu ama ahingho Pathen ahin, athihoa ahipoi. Nanghon thuhettohlou suhkhelna lentah naneiyu ahitai,” ati.
12.28: Chua hou danthuhilho lah'a khat in akihounau chu anajan, Yeshuan kichentah'a ahil chu ahechen in, hijeh chun aman Yeshua jah-a, “Thupeh jouse lah'a hoichepen hi thupipen ham?” tin adongtai.
12.29: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Thupeh pipen chu hichehi ahi: ‘Ngaiyun, vo Israel! Pakai Pathen hi khatseh bou ahi.
12.30: Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu, nalung pumpi, nahinna pumpi, nangaitona pumpi chule nathaneina jousea nangailut mong mong ding ahi.’
12.31: Anina jong kibangchet'in athupin ahi, hichu: ‘Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.’ Hicheteni sanga thupijo thupeh dang aumpoi,” ati.
12.32: Hou dan thuhilpan adonbut in, “Naseihoi ngeiye, Houhil. Nangman thudihtah in thu naseiyin Pathen khatseh bou aume, Pathen dang aumpoi nati-e.
12.33: Chule Pathen chu lungthim pumpi, khohet theina pumpi le thanei jousea ngailut ding ahi chu kahen, chule eima ikingailut banga iheng ikom ngailut ding jong chu kahei. Hichu ganpum goa kilhainale longlhenna sangin gamchengin aphajoi,” ati.
12.34: Danthuhilpan kichentah'a adonbut ajah phat'in Yeshuan ajah-a aseiyin, “Nangma Pathen Lenggam toh nakigamlat poi,” atipeh tai. Chukal chun koiman thudang adongngam tapoi. David Chapa Thudol Asei
12.35: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yeshuan houin sungathu ahil pet'in miho adongin, “Danthusunhon Messiah chu iti David chapa ahi atiu hintem?
12.36: Ijeh-inem iti leh Lhagao Thengin ahil a konin David jengin jong, ‘Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah-ah, jabolna mun'ah kajet lamin touvin namelmate cheng nakeng chotphaa kaneisah masangsen,’ anatin ahi.
12.37: David amatah'in Pakai chu Pakai asah-in, achutileh achapa iti hithei dingham?” atin ahi. Mipi chun Yeshua thusei chu thanomtah'in angaiyui.
12.38: Yeshuan aseibe kit'in, “Danthusunhoa konin kihongphauvin! Ajehchu amahon sangkhol chol kiah-a kholailenna chule kailhanga min chibai aboh diu athanoppiuve.
12.39: Chule kikhopna in le golvahna'a touna pipen adeiyui.
12.40: Hinlah kiphatlamna beihelin meithaiho nei le gou lahpehna dingin alhemlha jiuvin, houguttah bangin japi mutheina ding munhoah sottahtah taona amang jiuve. Hichejeh'a hi amaho hi gotna sangtah chang diu ahi,” ati.
12.41: Chuin Yeshua Houin sunga sumdolna bom jon'ah atouvin, mipin sumdolna boma sum alelut chu aven ahile mihao tamtah'in tamtahtah alelut'u amui.
12.42: Chua chun vaichatah meithainu khat ahungin sumsan-nong pumni alehlut in ahi.
12.43: Chuin aseijuiteho akouvin ajah'uva, “Tahbeh'a kasei ahi, hiche meithai vaichanu hin adang jouse sangin sumdolna-ah atam lelut pene.
12.44: Ijeh-inem itileh adangho jouse khun aneival ato-u ahin, amanu vang hin aneichasun ahinpi chengse alelut jeng ahi,” ati.

13.1: Chuin Yeshua houin'a konin apotdohin, aseijuite khat'in aseiyin ajah-ah, “Houhil, vetemin hichea in len thupitahho hi! Abanga song lentahtah kimang ho khu athupi ngeiye,” ati leh,
13.2: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge, ven, hiche in lentahho hung kisuchim sohkei ding ahi. Songkhat jeng jong khat chunga kisethom umlou helding ahi!” ati.
13.3: Phat chomkhat jouvin Yeshua Olive Lhanga Houin jon'ah atouvin ahile, Peter, James le John chule Andrew ahenga ahungun, ajah'a adongun,
13.4: “Nei seipeh un, hitobang phat chu itih tengleh hiding ham? Hitobang ahung lhun ding hettheina ding amelchihna nei seipeh un,” atiuve.
13.5: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Koimacha kilheplhahsah hih-un,”
13.6: Ijeh-inem itileh mi tamtah keima minin hunguntin, “Keima Messiah kahi,” tiuvintin mi tamtah alheplhah dingu ahi.
13.7: Chule gal kisat thuthang najah diu ahi, ahivangin lunglinglau hih-un. Henge, hitiho chu hung lhung tei ding ahin, ahivangin achaina hilou laiding ahi.
13.8: Namkhat le namkhat chule gam khat le gamkhat kidouding, leiset chung mun chom choma lingkihot'a, kel lhading ahivanga hichu naosonat kipat tobang hinalai bep ding, aban'a jong umding ahinalaiye.
13.9: Hitiho chu ahung lhun tengle, kiging phauvin! Khosung vaipo ho khut'a pehdoh-a naum dingu, chuleh houin munhoa jep le suhgim'a naum dingu ahi. Keima nungjui nahi jeh-uva vaipo hole lengho masanga thutanna anga nadin dingu ahi. Hinla hiche phat chu keima thudol naseipehna diuva phat kijenpet hiding ahi.
13.10: Ijeh-inem iti leh Kipana Thuphahi namtin lah'a kihillhang ding ahi.
13.11: Ahivangin amahon namatuva a-angsunguva nadin tengule ipi kasei dingham tin lungdong masahih-un. Hitobang phatteng chuleh Pathen in seidinga napeh chan'u chu sei jengun, ajeh chu aseiya chu nangho hitalouva Lhagao Theng joh hiding ahitai.
13.12: Chule asopin asopipa, apan acha tha dinga ahin pehdoh ding, chaten anule apa ahin douva athadiu ahi.
13.13: Chule kaseijui nahi jeh uva mijousen nahin vetda dingu, ahinlah akhon nigeiya thohlhumpa bou chu huhhing'a um ding ahi.
13.14: Thet umtah thilsuboh chu adinlouna ding dol mun'a adin, namu nikho'u hung lhung ding ahi. (Asimhon chingtheitah'a simding!) Chuteng chuleh ud agama um chengse lhang gamah jamlut hen.
13.15: Inchunga umho jong athilkeo kilah dingin kumsuhda hen.
13.16: Koitobang loulaiya umjong apon-ah sangkhol kilah dingin hung kiledahen.
13.17: Ohe! Chuche phat laitah'a navop le naonoi chepsah ho ada nadiuve!
13.18: Chuche phat chu phalbi daplai ahilouna dingin taovun. Chutobang gentheina nasatah chu Pathen in leiset asema pat tuni geiyin aum khahih laiye; chuleh umjong umlou ding ahi.
13.19: Pakaiyin hiche phat chu asuhchomlou hileh ahingah koima umlou ding ahi.
13.20: Tahbeh'a, lhenchomte jal'a anikho chu asuhchom ahitai.
13.21: Chule koitobang hamkhat in najah uva, Veuvin, hikoma Messiah aume, atia ahiloule “Khukom'ah aume,” ati jongle tahsanhih'un.
13.22: Ajehchu Messiah lhemle themgao lhem hung sohdoh intin melchihna le mu kidang dang ahin vetsah dingu ahin, ahitheile lhenchomte jeng jong lheplhah ding ahin got diu ahi.
13.23: Nangho vang chingtheiyun, ijakai kahil masahdem nahiuve!
13.24: Hitobang nikhoho jouteng chule nisa thimintin lha vahta louding,
13.25: Vanlaijola konin ahsiho pullhantin, van'a hatnaho chengse kihotlingsoh ding ahi.
13.26: Chutahleh mitin in vanlaijola Mihem Chapa chu athuneina le aloupina toh meilom chunga ahung amu diu ahi.
13.27: Chutengtah chule Aman avantilho asola leiset monga pat van mong geiya kolkimvel lia kon'a alhenchomte alonkhom ding ahi.
13.28: Tuhin theichang phunga konin kihillun. Abah adon'a, ajih akilhap tengle nipi anaitai ti naheuve.
13.29: Chutobangma chun, nanghon jong hicheng chu aguilhun namu tengule, ahungkitna ding anaitai, kotbul ahung geitai ti heuvin.
13.30: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, hichengse aboncha a aguilhun masangsea tulai khang mite hi manglou ding ahi.
13.31: Van le lei mangding ahin, keima thu vang manglou ding ahi. Koiman Anikho le Anidan Ahepoi
13.32: Ahivangin hitobang ahungsona ding chu koi hihen, vanna Vantilte hihen, Chapa hijongle, Pa tailou koiman anikho le anidan tah chu ahepoi.
13.33: Aphat tah nahetlou jeh-un, chingtheiyin kiging jingin umun.
13.34: Mihem Chapa hungkit nikho hi tekahnan: mi khat'in asohten atohdingu thuneina apeh-a, kotngah jong kiging jinga um dinga thu apeh'a, a-in dalha a kholgama chemang tobang ahi.
13.35: Hijeh chun kiging jingin um'un! Ijeh-inem itileh inneipu chu itih-a ahung ding nahe pouve, nilhahlam ahim, jankhangkim ahim ahung ding phat nahe pouve.
13.36: Hung lhung taleh na-imut pet'u hung tohkhante.
13.37: Nangho jah-a kasei hi mijouse jah-a kasei ahi. Kiging jing in umun! ati.

14.1: Hichun Kalchuh Kut le Cholsolou Changlhah Kut kimanna ding nini aumtan ahi. Thempu pipui holeh dan thusun hon Yeshua chu, guhthima mat'a thatheina ding lampi anahol jing nalaiyun ahi.
14.2: Ahin, “Kalchuh Kut sung hidahen, achuti loulegh mipi lah-a thunoh umget inte,” tin akinopto uve.
14.3: Chuin Yeshua chu Bethany muna Simon phah anaveipa, in'ah alhunge. Chua an aneh laiyin numei khat'in songval bomin thaonamtui mantamtah ahin choiyin, abom chu asukeh-in aluchungah abunglhan ahi.
14.4: Ahin alah uva loikhat chu alungnommo'uvin, “Ibol'a hitia hi thaonamtui mantam kimoh suhmang hitam?
14.5: Ijeh-inem itileh hiche thaonamtui hi kijohleh kum lhunga thalo jat toh kikot intin, hichu vaicha gentheiho pehthei hiding!” atiuvin aphunkhum tauvin ahi.
14.6: Ahinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Amanu chu oimo hih-un, keima'a dinga thilphatah abol ahitai.
14.7: Ijeh inem iti leh vaicha le gentheiho nakomuva aum jing nauve, nagot chan uva nahu theiyu ahi. Kei vang nakom uva um jing ding kahipoi.
14.8: Amanun abolthei chan abol ahitai. Ka thilong chu vuiya ahung umtheina dinga thao einu masat ahitai.
14.9: Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, vannoi pumpia Kipana Thupha kilhangsapna chan'a hiche numeinu thilbol jong hi amanu hetjingna'a kisei toupeh ding ahi,” ati.
14.10: Chuin somleni ho lah'a mi khat Juda Iscariot chun Yeshua chu matsah theina dingin thempu ho henga aga chen ahi.
14.11: Amahon ahet phat'un akipatdoh un, ama chu sumpeh ding in atem tauvin ahi. Chuin aman Yeshua chu pehdoha matsah theina ding agomkom aholtan ahi.
14.12: Cholsolou Changlhah Kut nimasa nia Kalchuh Kut kelngoi atha pet uvin aseijuiten ajah-ah, “Kalchuh Kut Ankong hoikoma kagon diu nadeiyem?” atiuvin ahi.
14.13: Hichun aseijui mi ni khopi sunga gache lhon din asolin, “Khopi sung nalut lhon teng, twibel pua mi khat nato lhon ding ahi. Amachu jui lhonin.
14.14: Ama alutna inneipa jah-a chun, ‘Houhil'in: kaseijuite toh Kalchuh Kut ankong kasokhomna diu indan chu hoilai ham? ati,’ gati lhon in.
14.15: Chule ama tah-in insong chunga indan lentah gontupsa a kikoi khat navetsah lhon ding ahi. Hikom chu ahi inehkhomna diuva nagonna diu mun chu,” ati.
14.16: Chuin seijui teni chu apot lhon in, khopi sungah alut lhon in, akisei bang chun imajouse chu agatoh lhonin, Kalchuh Kut an ding chu agagong lhon tai.
14.17: Hichun nilhah-in Yeshua aseijuite toh chua chun agalhung tauve.
14.18: Atou uva an aneh laitah-un, Yeshuan aseiyin, “Tahbeha kasei ahi, tua kaneh khompi lah-a khat hin eipeh doh ding ahi,” ati.
14.19: Amaho alungkham pan tauvin, banneichan khat khat in ahin dongui, “Kei kahim?” tin.
14.20: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho somleni lah'a khat, tua lhengkong kasokhompi hi ahi.
14.21: Mihem Chapa chu athi ding dol masanglai peh'a pat Thubua anakiseisa ahitai. Hinama jongleh, Mihem Chapa melmate khut'a pedoh-a johdohpa chu—Ohe, ada nading e! Ama chu apen'a anapenglou hile ama dinga phajo dinga!” ati.
14.22: Chuin a-anneh laitah'un Yeshuan changlhah phabep alan, hichu phatthei aboh in, chuin ahehbalbal'in aseijuiteho apen, “Hichehi katahsa ahi, neuvin,” ati.
14.23: Chule khon'a lengpitwi alan, phatthei aboh-in amahochu apen, chutichun abonchauvin adonsohkei tauvin ahi.
14.24: Chuin Aman ajah'uva aseiyin, “Hiche hi ka thisan, Pathen le amite kah'a kitepna thah um photchetna ahi. Hiche hi mi tamtah chonset ngaidamna dinga longdoh ahi.
14.25: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman Pathen Lenggama athah-a kadon kit ni ding tailou lengpitwi hi kadonlou ding ahitai,” ati.
14.26: Hichun la asauvin, chujouvin apotdoh'un Olive Lhang lamah ache tauvin ahi.
14.27: Lampia achepet'un Yeshuan ajah'uva aseiye, “Nangho naboncha uva nalungthoi sohkeidiu ahi. Ijeh-inem iti leh, Pathen thubun: ‘Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavohlhuh ding ahi, chujou teng akelngoite chu chehchao diu ahi,’ ati.
14.28: Ahinlah keima thina-a kon kahung thodoh jouteng Galilee gam lama namasanguva kache ding chua chu neimu diu ahi,” ati.
14.29: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Aboncha uvin lungthoi jongleu, kei vang lungthoi ponge,” ati.
14.30: Hichun Yeshuan, “Keiman tahbeh'a kasei ahi, Peter—nangman tu jan'a ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” atipeh-e.
14.31: Peter in, “Kanompoi! Nang matoh thitha teiding hijongleng, naseilep hihhel ing kate,” atichang melin ahi. Chule abonchauvin achuti seicheh-un ahi.
14.32: Amaho olive thinglei lah-a Gethsemane atiu honsung achun ahungun, chuah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Keima katao sungsen nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun,” ati.
14.33: Aman Peter, James chule John akipuiyin, alunghem lheh jeng tai.
14.34: Chuin Yeshuan, “Thina khop helin kalung hesoh behseh jengtai. Hikoma hin um unlang eina kiginpeh-un,” ati.
14.35: Chule amasang lamah neokhat ache chon'in tollah akhupboh-in alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu Ama-a kon'a akitolmang theina dingin ataove.
