12.48: Koi hijongle keima eipampaiya kathuhil jong joplou chu, thupi kitan nile thutah kaseidoh hin achungthu atan ding ahi.
12.49: Ijeh inem itile keiman kacham'a kasei ahipoi, eisol'a Pa chun kasei dingle kapao ding dan hi thu eipeh ahibouve.
12.50: Ama thupeh chu tonsot hinna ahi, ti kahei; hiche jeh a chu kathusei hi Pan eihil bang banga kasei ahi,” ati.

13.1: Kalchuh kut masangin Yeshuan hiche vannoiya kona apa henga ache ding phat ahung lhungtai, ti ahen, vannoiya um ama a ho chu angailun akhon nigeiyin angailu lhumkeiye.
13.2: Chuin jan anneh lai sungin diabol chun Simon chapa Judas Iscariot lung sunga ama matsah na ding lungthim khumsa akoi ahitan;
13.3: Yeshuan, Pan thil jouse ama khut'a apeh chule ama Pathena kona hungdoh ahia, Pathen henga chea ahi chu ahen;
13.4: Ajan anneh ankonga konin akipat doh in chuin aponsil akong'ah akigah in ahi.
13.5: Chuin aman kisilna kong'ah twi alheiyin, aseijuiho keng asil'in, akong gahna pon chun atheh peh in ahi.
13.6: Chuin ama Simon Peter koma ahungin ahile aman ajah'a, “Pakai nangman kakeng neisilpeh ding ham?” atin ahile,
13.7: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kabol hi nangman tun nahepoi ajo le he nan nate,” ati.
13.8: Chuin Peter in ajah a, “Nangman itih hijongle kakeng nasil lou hel ding ahi,” ati. Yeshuan adonbut in ajah a, “Keiman nangma kasil loule keiya nangman chan nanei lou ahi,” ati.
13.9: Simon Peter in ajah a, “Pakai kakeng keojeng hilouvin kakhut le kalu jonge,” ati.
13.10: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Apumpia kisil khat chu akeng tailou adang silding angai khohpoi; apumpin angim sohnai. Chule nangho nangim nauve, ahivangin nabonchau nahi pouve,” ati.
13.11: Ijeh inem itile ama matsah a pang dingpa chu aman ahetsa ahin, hiche jeh a chu aman, “Nabonchauvin na ngim pouve,” ati ahi.
13.12: Aman akengu asil jouvin apon akilah in atou kit'in amaho jah a chun, “Ipi bol'a kahi, kabol chu nahet nah uvem?
13.13: Nanghon keima Houhil le Pakai neitiuve; hiche natiu chu aphai, ijeh inem itile keima hichu kahi.
13.14: Hijeh chun keima Pakai le Houhil jengin bon nangho keng kasil le nang hon jong khat'in khat keng nakisilpeh to dingu thu ahi.
13.15: Ajeh chu keiman nangho kabol banga chu nanghon jong nabolna dinguva vetsahna a kabol ahi.
13.16: Iti dih a dih hitam, Pakai sangin soh achungnungjo poi, asol'a sangin solchah jong achungnungjo poi.
13.17: Hiti ho hi nahetdoh uva nabol'u le nangho anun nom nahiuve.”
13.18: Nang ho nabonchauva thudol'a kasei ahipoi; keiman kalhendoh ho chengse chu kahenai; ahivangin, “kachanglhah nepan kachunga akengto alamtai,” ti Pathen Lekhabua thu guilhun theina dinga ahi.
13.19: “Tua kal'a ahung guilhun tengle keima hi ama chu kahi, nahetna dinguva ahung guilhun masanga kaseipeh nahiuve.
13.20: tahbeh a koi hijongle kasol na a nom chan chun keima eisan ahi; chule keima eisang chan chun eisolpa asan ahi,” ati.
13.21: Hichun Yeshua alung dong lheh jengin aseitai, “Atahbeh a nangho lah a mikhat in neijoh doh dingu ahi,” tin ahin seidoh e.
13.22: Hichun seijui ho chu khat le khat akiveto uvin, koi asei ahi agelmouve.
13.23: Hiche a chu aseijui ho lah a khat Yeshuan angailut chu a-ang a ki-ngai ahin;
13.24: Simon Peter in akhasuh in, “Koi nasei ham neisei peh'un,” ati.
13.25: Hichun aman aki ngai bang chun aki ngaiyin, “Pakai hiche chu koiham?” tin adongin ahile;
13.26: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Hiche changlhah hal hi kade a kapeh dingpen tah chu ama chu ahi,” ati. Chuin aman changlhah hal chu adekot jouvin alan Simon chapa Iscariot Judas chu apetai.
13.27: Chuche changlhah hal akisan joutah chun Satan asunga aluttan, chuphat chun Yeshuan ajah a, “Nabol ding chu bol loiyin,” ati.
13.28: Ahivangin aman ipi dol'a achuti sei ahidem, ankonga touho khatchan jong ahedoh pouve.
13.29: Ijeh inem itile kimkhat'in Judas khut'a sumbom aum jeh a chu kut'a dinga manchah ding choa, ahilou le vaichaho ikhat pe dinga Yeshuan aseiyin angaitouve.
13.30: Chuin aman changlhah hal chu akisanin hiche pettah chun apotdoh paijengtai. Hichu jan ahi.
13.31: Ama apotdoh chun Yeshuan, “Mihem Chapa choiat'in aumtai, ama ah Pathen jong choian'in aumtai;
13.32: Chule Pathen in jong Chapa jeh'a choi-atna amu jeh a, aman chapa chu achoiat pai jeng ding ahi.”
13.33: Chapang neocha ho nangho toh chomcha khat bou um ding kahi, nang hon neihol dingu, ahivanga Juda ho jah a kasei “Keima che na a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu,” kati ahi.
13.34: “Keiman nangho thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, nang ho khat le khat kingailuto cheh un; keiman nangho ka-ngailut bangu hin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu uvin.
13.35: Nangho khat le khat nakingailut tocheh uva ahile hichun keima seijui nahiu vannoiya natahlang'u ahi,” ati.
13.36: Simon Peter in adongin, “Pakai nangma hoilama nache ding ham?” atile Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tun nangma kache na a kanung nunga hung thei pon nate, phat chomkhat jou teng vangleh kanung nunga nahung ding ahi,” ati.
13.37: Peter in ajah a “Pakai ibol'a tua nanung nunga kahung thei lou ding ham? Nangma jal'in kahinna jong penge,” ati.
13.38: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keima jal'a nathi ding ham? Chutiponte, jing jingkah ahchal khon masanga kahekhapoi tia thumvei nei seilep ding ahi,” ati.

14.1: “Nalung'u khamsah hih'un, Pathen tahsan'un, chule keima jong neitahsan'un.
14.2: Kapa In'ah chenna ding indan ninglhingset in aume; umlou hi le najah uva kasei tah hih ding ham? Ajeh chu keima nangho dinga mun sema che ding kahi.
14.3: Thil jouse gontup ahiteng leh, keima hung ingting, kaumna a chu naum jingthei nadiuva kahung puiding nahiuve.
14.4: Chule nanghon kache na ding mun alampi nahe nauve,” ati.
14.5: Thomas in adonbut'in, “Pakai keihon nache na ding bon kihelou a alampi iti kahet dingu ham?” ati.
14.6: Yeshuan amapa chu adonbut'in, “Keima hi lampi le thutah chule hinna chu kahi; keima henga pat tailouvin koima Pa kom ahung theipoi.
14.7: Chule nanghon keima neiheleu chun Kapa jong chu nahet dingu ahitai; tua pat'a vang nanghon amapa chu naheuvin chule namu tauve.”
14.8: Hichun Philip in adonbut in, “Pakai Pachu neimu sah'un, hichu keiho dinga phaset ahi,” ati.
14.9: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip, keima hitih chan nangho toh kaum khom a jong chu neihet loulai ham? Chule keima eimua chun Ka-Pa amu ahitai; achutile Pachu neimu sah-un iti nati ham?
14.10: Chule keima Pa a kaum a chule Pa jong keiya um ahi, hiche hi natahsan lou ham? Chule keiman nangho jah'a thu kasei chengse hi keima cham'a kasei ahipoi; Pachu keiya uma na atoh ahibouve.
14.11: Keima Pa a kauma chule Pa jong keiya aume ti chu neitahsan jengun; ahilou jongle na kitong chengse jeh tah hin tahsanun.
14.12: Atahbeh a, keima eitahsan'a chun kathilbol chengse hi aman jong abol ding ahi; asanga lenjo jo abol ding ahi, chule keima Pa henga kinungle kit ding kahitai.
14.13: Chule Pachu Chapan achoiat'a, chule nanghon thil jouse ipi hijongle Keima mina nathum chanu chu kabol peh ding nahiuve.
14.14: Chule Keima mina nathum dingu chu ipi hijongle kabolpeh ding nahiuve.”
14.15: “Keima neingailut uleh kathupeh ho hi nanit dingu ahi.
14.16: Keima Pa henga taoving ting chuleh aman nangho naumpi jing dingu Lhamon sah Lhagao napeh dingu ahi.
14.17: Amachu Lhagao Theng, thudih lampia napuiyuvah ahi; vannoiyin ama chu asang theipoi; ijeh inem itile ama chu mu jong amu pouvin, he jong ahepouve; nang hon vang naheuve, ajeh chu ama nangho sunga chenga ahi, umjong hung um ding ahi.
14.18: Chule keiman nangho avetup ding beiyin nadalha pouvinge; keima nahenguva hung kit ding kahi.
14.19: Vannoi mihon phat chomkhat jou le eimu tahlou dingu ahi, ahinla nanghon vang neimu dingu ahinai; Ajeh chu keima kahing jinge, chule nangho jong nahin dingu ahi.
14.20: Keima hinna a kathodoh kit teng, nanghon nahet chen diu ahi; keima Pa a kaum a chule nangho keima a naum diu chule keima nangho a kaum ding ahi.
14.21: Koi hijongle kathupeh ho neiya chule nit chu eingailua ahi; chule keima eingailua chu Ka Pan angailut ding; chule keiman ama chu ka-ngailut a ahenga kakiphon ding ahi,” ati.
14.22: Judas (Iscariot hilou, seijui achom khatpa) chun ajah'a, “Pakai, ibol'a nangma keiho henga nakiphona vannoi mi henga naki phon lou ding ham?” ati.
14.23: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah a, “Ei ngailu jouse chun kathu anit ding, chule Ka Pan amaho chu angailut ding, chule ahenguva kahunga amaho chu kachenpi ding ahi,
14.24: Chule koi hijongle keima eingailu lou chun kathu jong anitpoi; chule nathu jah'u hi keiya ahipoi, eisola Pa a chu ahibouve.
14.25: Keiman nangho kaumpi pet'a thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
14.26: Ahinla Pan keima khel'a naki thopi dingu Lhagao Theng ahinsol teng, Ama chun thil jouse nahetsah dingu chule thil jouse kasei doh ho jouse avela nagel dohsah kit dingu ahi.
14.27: Lungmon kada lhah peh nahiuve; kalungmon kapeh nahiuve; kapeh hi vannoi mi peh bang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kicha jong kicha hih-un.
14.28: Nahenguva thu kana seiho gel doh jinguvin ajeh chu keima kache mang ding ahin, ahin naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi; chule keima nei ngailut mongule kei sanga laljo Pa koma kache dinghi nanghon nei kipa pi joh dingu ahi.
14.29: Hiche ho hi nahenguva kasei peh masat'u ahi, Ajeh chu thil hohi ahungso phattengleh nanghon natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
14.30: Nangho toh kihou limna ding phat kanei lhomtai, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga vaihompa ahung nai tai, aman kachung ah tha aneipoi.
14.31: Amavang Pan keiya kona a ngaichat chu kabol ding ahi, chutile vannoi in Pa ngailutna hi ahin hetthei dingu ahi, hunguvin eiho che jengu hite.”

15.1: Keima lengpi gui kahi, chule kapa hi alhoungim hon neipa ahi.
15.2: Chuleh keiya um abah aga lou ho chu aman apaidoh ji; chuleh aga chengse chu ahaga chehna dingin amal ngim jin ahi.
15.3: Kathusei vanga chu nangho angimsa nahi tauve.
15.4: Chuleh nangho keiya umjingun, keijong nanghoa um inge, abah lengpi guia aumlou le achanga agathei lou banga chu nang ho jong keiya naum lou u le naga theilou dingu ahi.
15.5: Henge, keima hi lengpigui chu kahi, nangho abah nahiuve. Keiya umho chule keiman jong kaumpi jouse chun ga tamtah ahin sosah dingu ahi. Ajeh chu keima louvin nanghon imacha nabol thei pouve.
15.6: Mi keiya umlou chu pannabei abah bangin paidoh-in aumjin, chuleh agop jin chuleh achom khomun meikong sungah asep lut jiuvin ahile akavam jitai.
15.7: Ahin nangho keima a naum jinguva, chuleh keima thucheng ho nangho a aumle, nanghon nangai chat chan'u nathum thei'u ahi; chuleh naki bolpeh dingu ahi.
15.8: Nanghon theiga tamtah napunsah teng'ule keima seijui dihtah nahiuve, hiche jeh'a chu Pa choiat na um ding ahi.
15.9: Pan keima eingailut bang banga keiman jong nang ho ka-ngailut nahiuve, hijeh chun kangailutna a hin umjingun.
15.10: Nanghon keima thupeh napom tengule keima ngailut na'a um nahi tauve; chule keiman jong hitobanga Pa thupeh kanit jing jeh'a, ama ngailut na a umjing kahi.
15.11: Kakipana nangho a aum jingna ding le naki panau acham kimna dinga thu hicheng hi najah uva kana sei ahi.
15.12: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, “Keiman nangho kangailut bangin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu tocheh in um'un.
15.13: Min ajol agol dinga ahinna apeh sanga ngailut chungnungjo koiman aneipoi.
15.14: Kathu peh ngai ho chu kaloi ahi.
15.15: Keiman nangho soh kati lou ding nahi tauve, ajeh chu soh in apupa thilbol ahepoi; tua nangho hi kaloi ngaitah nahiuve, ajeh chu Pan keima eihetsah jouse nangho kasei peh nahi tauve.
15.16: Nang hon keima neilhenu ahipoi, keima joh-in nangho kalhen doh a nacheuva haga nagauva chuleh nagau aumna dinga kapansah nahiuve. Ipi hijongle nagot chanu kamin a Pa henga nathumu chu aman napeh theina dingun,
15.17: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, nangho khat le khat kingailu tocheh'un,” ati.
15.18: Chule vannoiyin nahin vetda tengule geldoh un keima ei vetda masat'u ahi.
15.19: Nangho vannoiya hileu chun vannoiyin ama a chu angailut ding ahin; tunla nangho vannoiya nahi lou u, vannoiya kona keiman kalhen doh nahiuvin, hiche jeh a chu vannoiyin nahot'u ahi.
15.20: Chuleh najah uva kathusei hi, “Soh apakai sangin achungnungjo poi,” kati chu geldoh-un. Amahon kei eibolseuva chu nang ho nabolset dingu ahi; kathu nit leu nang ho thujong anit dingu ahi.
15.21: Amahon keima jeh'a hiche ho jouse hi abolsoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon eisolpa ahet lou jeh'u ahi.
15.22: Keiman kana seidoh lou hile amaho hi themmo chang pouvinte. Ahinla tun amahon achonset nau jeh chun thuphat bolthei pouvinte.
15.23: Koi hi jongleh keima eidoudal'a chun Kapa jong adoudal ding ahi.
15.24: Keiman alah uva mi koima dangin abol khah lou thil kabol lou hile chonset aneilou dingu ahin; tuvang'in amahon keima le Ka-Pa kakop lhonin eimu tauvin, ho jong eihotauve.
15.25: Hiche hin Pathen lekhabuho a kisei, “Amahon ajeh beiyin eidoudal ui” kiti chu aguilhunsah ahi.
15.26: Amavang keiman thumopthem–thutah Lhagao, chu kahin solding ahi. Pa Pathen a kona hung ding ama chun keima thudol aphondoh ding ahi.
15.27: Chule nanghon jong atil'a pat kaumpi jing nahi jeh-uva chu kathu hettohsah a napan dingu ahi.

16.1: Nakipal lhuh louna dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
16.2: Chuleh phat hung lhung ding ahi, kikhopna in'a kona nahin kaidoh dingu, chutengle koi hileh nathat uva pang hon athil bol'u chu Pathen'a dinga napha tonga kingaito dingu ahi.
16.3: Hiche ho jouse hi ipi jeh ham itileh amahon Pa Pathen ahet lou jeh ule keima eihetthei lou jeh'u ahije.
16.4: Ahinla hiti phat chu ahung lhun tengle keima tah'in kana seipehsa chengse hi nagel doh dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. Chuleh keiman nangho jah'a kanasei masah lou na ajeh chu phat chomkhat kaumpi ding nahi jeh'u ahi.
16.5: Ahinla tua keima eihin solpa henga kile kit ding kahitai, ahi nangho koima chan hoilam a che ding nahim tinjong neidong pouve.
16.6: Ahin thu hicheng chu kasei jeh'in nalungu lunghem nan adimjotai.
16.7: Ahinla tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, keima kapotdoh chu nangho dinga phatchomna joh ahi, ajehchu keima kaum laisea nangho kithopi ding chu hung theilou ding ahi. Ahin keima kapotdoh teng, Lhagao Theng chu nangho henga kahin sol ding ahi.
16.8: Ama chu ahung tengleh, aman vannoi mite hi chonset thudol, chonphat thudol, chuleh thutan thudol'a ahetphotsah ding ahi.
16.9: Chonset thudol chu, ijeh ham itile amahon keima eitahsan pouve.
16.10: Chonphat thenna ho hi chanthei ahi, ijeh inem itile keima Pa koma cheding kahi, chuleh nanghon nei mukhah lou diu ahitai.
16.11: Chule tun thutanna ahung lhung tai ajeh chu vannoiya vaihompa hi athu tansa a uma ahitai.
16.12: Chule keiman hiche ho tilouva thildang tamtah jong kaseipeh nom nahiuve, ahinla nanghon tua nathoh joulou diu ahi.
16.13: Lhagao dihtah chu ahung teng vangleh ama chun thutah lam jousea nangho napuihoi dingu ahi, ijeh inem itile aman achama aseilou ding, ajah chan asei dingbou ahi, chuleh khonung thusoh ding naseitoh peh dingu ahi.
16.14: Chule ama chun keima eichoiat ding ahi, ajeh chu kanei chengse chu aman alah a nangho nahetsah dingu ahi.
16.15: Pa a kona thil jouse chu keima a kona ahisoh keiye, hiche jeh a chu kaphon doh ahi; Lhagao Theng chun ana phondoh ho chu aboncha keiya kona alahson ahiye.
16.16: “Phat chomkhat joule nanghon neimu lou dingu ahitai; Ahinla phat chomkhat jouteng neimu kit dingu ahi,” ati.
16.17: Hichea chun aseijui ho khat le khat akihouvun, “Chom khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chuleh chom khat jou le neimu kit dingu, ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi, ati hi ipi aseina ahidem? akitiuve.
16.18: Chuleh phat chomkhat joule ati chu ipi aseina ham? Keihon kahe theipouve,” atiuvin ahi.
16.19: Adoh nom'u chu Yeshuan ahen ajah uva, “Chomcha khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chomcha khat jou le neimu kit dingu, kati chu itidol ahi khat le khat kidongtoa nahiuvem?
16.20: Tahbeh a nangho keima chunga nalhiso diu chule nalungu kham ding ahi; Ahinla vannoi mite dinga kipana ahiye, ajeh chu nangho nalungu sangtah'a boiding, ahinla nalung kham nau chu hetman louva kipana thupitah hiding ahi.
16.21: Numei aso dinga anat tengle athoh gimlheh jin, acha chu asolhah teng vangleh vannoiya mihem khat apen jeh chun akipah jin ahile alungdon hesoh chu ahejitapoi.
16.22: Tua nangho nalunglhah dah nau hi, keima in nangho kahin vil kit tengle thanopna a nadim dingu, chuleh koima chan naguh mangpeh thei lou dingu ahitai.
16.23: Hiche teng chule nanghon keima imacha neidoh'u jong ngaita ponte, thutah chu ahile, Pa henga nathum jengthei'u ahitai; ajeh chu keima mina nathum jeh uva na ngaichat hou chu suhbulhit a um ding ahi.
16.24: Chule hiche hohi masanga nana bolkhah lou'u ahiye, Keima min in thum'un chuteng namu diu ahi, chutengle kipana sangtah'a nanei diu ahi.”
16.25: “Keiman hiche ho jouse hi nangho jah'a alem a kasei ahi, ahin phat hung lhung ding chuteng chuleh keiman alema kasei tahlou ding ahi. Ahin Pathen ama hina tah'a kaphon doh ding ahi.
16.26: Hiche nikho teng chuleh keima mina nathum dingu keima kanop tahlou ding ahi ajeh chu keima Pa henga nangho dinga taova kahi.
16.27: Ijeh inem itile Pa amatah in nangho na-ngailuve, ijeh inem itile nanghon keima nei ngailuvin, chuleh keima Pa a kona hung kahi natahsan tauvin ahi.
16.28: Pa koma kona vannoiya hung kahin, vannoi kadalhah a Pa henga che kit ding kahi,” ati.
16.29: Hichun aseijuiten adonbut'un, “Ven, tun nangin thu alem'a seita louvin phongtah in naseiye.”
16.30: “Tuhin keihon ima jouse kahe chen tauve; Nangman thil jouse nahesoh hel'in, hiche ho jeh'in keihon katahsan tauve; nangma Pathen a kona hung kondon nahi ti katahsan tauve.”
16.32: “Veuvin, nangho nabonchauva nava cheh soh keiyuva keima kachanga neida lhah dingu phat ahung lhungtai, ahivangin keima kachang kahipoi; ijeh inem itile Pan keima ei umpinai.
16.33: Nanghon kachunga lungmon chamna nanei thei na dinguva thu hicheng hi kasei peh nahiuve, hiche leiset chunga hi nanghon thohgim hahsa tamtah nathoh diu ahiye, ahinla nalungu neosah hih'un, ajeh chu lungnom'un, keiman vannoi kajoutai,” ati.

17.1: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin, vanlam aven, “Pa naphat chu ahung lhunge; Chapan nangma na choiat thei na dingin na chapa choian in.
17.2: Ajeh chu nangman ama napeh ho jouse chu aboncha aman tonsot hinkemlou apeh dinga, nangman ama chu mi jouse chunga thuneina napeh ahi.
17.3: Pathen tahbeh khatseh nangman nasol Yeshua Christa tah chu ahet doh dingu, hiche hi tonsot hinna ahi.
17.4: Chuleh nangman keima bol dinga neipeh chu kajouvin, chule leiset chunga nangma min ka choian tai.
17.5: Chule tun, Pa vannoi leiset um masanga nangma toh ium laiya iloupina chun nangma tah toh kigomin nei choian in.
17.6: Vannoi leiset a neina peh ho chu keima in kahin tahlange. Amaho chu nangma a din aum jinguve, chule nangma in keima neipeh ahitan, amaho in nathu chu anit jing nauve.
17.7: Tun amahon nangman keima neipeh thil chengse hi nanga kon ahi ahetauve.
17.8: Hiti ahijeh chun nangman keima neipeh thuho chu keiman amaho kapen, chule keima hi nanga hung kon kahi jong atahsan tauvin, chuleh nangman nei hin sol ahiti jong atahsan tauve.
17.9: Chuleh keima amaho dinga katao ahi, vannoi dinga katao ahipoi; Ahin nangman keima neipeh ho dinga bou katao ahi, Ijeh inem itile amaho nanga ahiuve.
17.10: Keima'a umjouse nanga ahi, chuleh nangma in keima neina peh ahitai. Ajeh chu amahon loupina eihin chansah'u ahi.
17.11: Chuleh keima vannoiya hi kaumlou ding ahitai, amaho vang hi vannoiya aum nalaiyuve, chule keima nahenga hung ding kahitai. Ka Pa Theng, eini pumkhat ihi banga amaho jong pumkhat ahithei na dingun, nangman amaho hi vengtup'in.
17.12: Keima hikoma kaum sungin, amaho hi kana vengtup e. Amaho hi kaventup jal'in khat cha jong amangthah aumpouve, Pathen lekhabun anaseisa, manthahna lama chepa tailou chu.
17.13: Chuleh tua keima nangma koma hunga kahitai, chule keima leiya kaum laiya chu kipa thanopnaa adim jing thei na dinguva kana seipeh sohhel ahitai.
17.14: Chuleh keiman nathu amaho kapetai; chule keima vannoiya kahilou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahilou jeh'un, vannoi miten ahotauve.
17.15: Chule keiman kathum chu amaho hi vannoiya konin ladoh in tia katao ahipoi, agiloupa natoh na'a kon in huhdoh in katijoh ahibouve.
17.16: Keima vannoiya kona kahilou banga, amaho jong vannoiya kon ahipouve.
17.17: Chule nathutah chun amaho jouse hi sutheng in ajeh chu nangma thuhi thutah ahiye.
17.18: Nangman keima vannoiya neina sol banga chu keiman amaho hi vannoiya kasol ahi.
17.19: Chule amaho jouse hi thutah'a suhthenga aum thei na dinguva amaho jal'a keima kisuthenga kahi. Yeshuan tahsan chate jouse dia taona anei
17.20: Keima seijui ho ding seh'a tao kahipoi, amaho thusei'a kona keima eitahsan ho jouse dinga jong taova kahi.
17.21: Chule amaho chu pumkhat ahina dinguva, Pa, keima nangma sol kahi hi vannoi miten atahsan thei na dinguva nangma keiya nauma keima nanga kaum banga hi, amaho jong einia aum theina dinga katao ahi.
17.22: Keiman amaho chu loupina nangman neipeh ho chu kapetai, amaho eini banga pumkhat ahitheina dingu ahi.
17.23: Keima amahoa kauma chule nangma keiya naum, abon'a khat a chamkim soh ahi. Chuteng vannoiyin keima neisol ahi ahetdiu chule keima nei ngailut banga hi amaho jong nangailut ahidan ahetthem diu ahi.
17.24: Hepa nangman neipeh loupina chu nangin neipeh ho hin amuthei na dingun, keima umna'a chun kakoma amaho jong umleu kati ahi; chule vannoi bul kiphu masanga nangman neingailut ahijeh chun.
17.25: Vo Kapa Theng vannoi leiset miten nangma nahethem theipouve, ahinla keiman nangma kahen, chule keima neisol hi seijui ho hin ahetauve.
17.26: Keiman nangma hi amaho lah'a katah lang nahitai, chule keiman hiti a chu katah lang jing ding nahi; hiche teng chule keima nei ngailut naho chu amaho'a umding chuteng keima jong amaho a ka umjing ding ahi.”

18.1: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin apotdoh in Kidron vagal a hon umna'a chun aseijui hotoh agalkaiyun, chuin hon sunga chun amale aseijuiho aluttauve.
18.2: Yeshua pedoh a pang Judas jong chun hilai mun chu ahet chen mama ahi, Ijeh inem itile Pakai Yeshuan aseijuite chu phat seh a ana pui jing ahi.
18.3: Chutah in Judas chun sepaihon chule thempu pipui ho le Pharisee hoa kona sottolle ho aloiyin, meivah, meisel, chuleh hem manchah athouvin hiche kom mun chu ahung lhung tauve.
18.4: Yeshuan achunga thil hunglhung ho jouse chu ahesoh keiyin ahi, hichun amaho kom lang chu ajonphei in adongtai, “Koi nahol'u ham?” ati.
18.5: Amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hungkon Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuvin ahi. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Ama chu kahi,” ati. (Judas, apedoh a pangpa chu, amaho lah'a chu dinga ahi).
18.6: Yeshuan, “Keima hi kahi,” ati chun amaho jouse chu anung chon'un tol'a alhu jengun ahi.
18.7: Hichun avel'in adongkit in, “Nanghon koi nahol'u ham?” ati. Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hung Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuve.
18.8: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve, amapa chu keima hi kahi, keima neihol'u ahijeh chun midang hohi soldoh tauvin,” ati.
18.9: Nangman keima neipeh chengse chu khatcha jong kaman sahpoi, tia asei chu guilhunna dinga chutia ahi.
18.10: Hichun Simon Peter in achemjam asatdoh in thempu chungnung sohpa asatle ajetlam abilkol asatlha tai, sohpa min chu Malchus ahi.
18.11: Ahinla Yeshuan Peter jah'a, “Nachemjam chu apai sunga koilut kit'in, Pan eipeh gentheina khon chu donlouva ka um ding ham,” ati.
18.12: Hichun sepai ho le apipui pau toh chuleh Juda ho sottolle hon Yeshua chu aman un akan tauvin ahi.
18.13: Annas henga apui masauve; Ijeh inem itile ama chu chuche kuma chu Thempu chungnung pen'a pang Caiaphas nupa pa ahi.
18.14: Hiche Caiaphas hi ahi, “Miho jouse dinga mikhat athi aphajoi,” tia Juda ho ana thumop chu. Peter in Yeshua aseilep
18.15: Simon Peter chun, seijui dangho bangin, Yeshua chu anung ajui tan ahi. Seijui holah a khat chu Thempu pipui hotoh ana kihet jeh chun Thempu pipu pa umna gei chu Yeshua toh ana lutsah un ahi.
18.16: Ahin Peter vang chu polanga phat chomkhat aumin, hichun seijui holah a khat thempu pipuipa toh kihe pa chun kelkot ngah a pang numeinu koma phalna athumin hichun Peter insunga apuilut tai.
18.17: Hiche numeinu chun Peter chu thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma hi hiche pa seijui ho khat nahi lou ham? Nangma nahi,” ati. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Kahipoi,” ati.
18.18: Hiche koma chu soh hole sottol le hon adapjeh'a mei akitiuva dinmuna mei aoiyu ahin, Peter jong adingin meichu aoiyin ahi.
18.19: Hikom insung langa chun Thempupan Yeshua chu thudoh anei'in, anungjui ho ipi ana seipeh'a chuleh ipi ana hilchah em tichu adongtan ahi.
18.20: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Mipihon ahesoh keiye ipi kana hilchah, chule Houin a jong aphat jouse in mipi ho koma kana seipeh jinge, guhthima kana seipeh imacha aumpoi.
18.21: Ibol'a nangman hiche thudoh hohi neidoh ham? kathusei ngai ho le jaho chu nadoh thei lou ham? Ajeh chu amahon kathu hil jouse chu ahesohkei uve,” ati.
18.22: Hichun Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin ahile akoma Santri dingho lah'a khat in Yeshua ngeiphe abengin, “Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaiyem?” ati.
18.23: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kasei khel aumle neimu sah'un, ahinla thutah kasei doh jeh'a chu ibol'a neivoh uham?” ati.
18.24: Hichun Annas chun Yeshua chu ahentup'in Caiaphas Thempu chungnung heng lama asoltai.
18.25: Hiche phat dontah a chu Simon Peter chun dap asah jeh'a mei aki oi ahin, amahon adongkit'un, “Nangma hi amaho lah'a khat chu nahilou ham?” atiuve. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Keima kahipoi,” ati.
18.26: Ahinla Thempu chungnung sohpa Simon Peter in abilkol asatlhah pehpa inko khat'in ajah'a, “Keiman Hon a chu nangma amato kamu nahi lou ham?” atin ahi.
18.27: Hichun avel'in Peter in aseilep kit in, chule hetman louvin Ahchal akhong tai.
18.28: Chutah chun amahon Caiaphas in a konin gamvaipo pa inlama Yeshua akaitauve; hichu jingkah ahina laiye; ahivangin kal chuh kut an aneh thei na dingun, akisuhboh louna dingun gamvaipo inpia chun amaho alutpouve.
18.29: Hichun Pilate apotdoh in, amaho chu aga kimupin thudoh anei'in, “Hiche pa hin ipi abolkhel atoh khel um hitam?” ati.
18.30: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Amapa khang-gilou ahilouleh nangma koma kahin lhut lou dingu ahi,” atiuve.
18.31: Hichun Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hiche chu ahitah le, nanghon nungpui tauvin, chuleh nangho dan dungjui in kitan lhah tauvin,” ati. Hiche phat chun Judah hon adonbut'un, “Keima ho Danthu dungjui'in koima thana ding tha kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
18.32: (Hiche hin avetsah chu, Yeshuan athiding dan ana seidoh masah chu guilhunna ahi).
18.33: Hichun Pilate insung dan'ah alut'in, Yeshua chu akouvin, thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma Judate lengpa chu nahim?” ati.
18.34: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche thudoh ho hi nangma chama kon ham, ahiloule mi khat tou'in keima chung chang nasei peh ham?” ati.
18.35: Hichun Pilate in adonbut kit'in, “Keihi Juda mi kahi ham? Namite le thempu pipuihon kakhut'a eipeh nahi chu, ipi nabolsetba ham?” ati.
18.36: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi. Hiche vannoi a kon ana hitaleh keima dingin kaseijui hon gal eisat peh intin, Judate khut'a peh doh'a kaum lou ding ahi. Ahinla keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi,” ati.
18.37: Hichun Pilate in aseikit'in, “Ahileh nangma hi lengpa nahim?” atile Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Leng kahi chu nasei khai, Thutah thu hettohsah dinga hung penga, hiche dinga hi vannoiya hunga kahi. Thutah hechan chun thutah ahinphot chen diu ahi” ati.
18.38: Hichun Pilate in adonbut in, “Thutah chu ipi ham?” Hichun Pilate chu Juda mipi holah'a aga potdoh kit'in, ajah'uva aseitai, “Yeshua hi themmo na neilou ahi, ati. Yeshua tha dia alhuh sah'u
18.39: Ahivangin nanghon kalchuh kut le mikhat nakilha doh peh dingu chonna ngai khat naneiyui; hijeh chun Juda lengpa hi lhadoh peh leu veng nalungu ham?” ati.
18.40: Ahinla amahon asam'un, “Hiche pa hi hida hen, Barabbas joh,” atin asamtauve. (Barabbas chu doudal natong ahi).

19.1: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu mol'a jep dingin apedoh tai.
19.2: Chuin sepai hon ling lukhuh apheh'un, Pakai chu akhuh peh tauvin ahi. Chuleh amahon ponsandup asilpeh un ahi.
19.3: Chuin akoma ahungun, “Judate lengpa chibai,” atiuvin, totnopnan aneiyun chuleh abengphe abeh peh'un ahi.
19.4: Chuin Pilate agapot kit'in, ajah uva, “Veuvin akhan gitlouna ima kamu lou nahetna dinguva ama naheng uva kahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
19.5: Hichun Yeshua chu ling lukhuh khuh le ponsandup kisil pum chun ahung potdoh'in, chuin Pilate in ajah uva, “Veuvin hiche mipa hi!” ati.
19.6: Hichun thempu pipui hole Houin ngah'a pang sepai hon ama chu amuphat un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in,” tin asamtauve. Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Nanghon natahsa tah in kai unlang thingpel'a khenbeh tauvin, keiman vang Yeshua hi amona kamu dohpoi,” ati.
19.7: Judate lamkai hon adonbut uvin, “Keiho danpi dungjui'a ama hi athi dinga lomtah ahi, ijeh inem itile ama tah Pathen Chapa akihisah jeh chun,” atiuve.
19.8: Hichun Pilate in hiche thu ajah phat'in, atil'a sangin akicha cheh tan;
19.9: Hichun Pilate chu inpi sunga alut kit'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nangma hoiya hung kon nahim?” ati. Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut pon ahi.
19.10: Hijeh chun Pilate in ajah'a, “Nei houpi lou ding ham? Nangma lhadoh na ding jong chuleh thingpel a khetbeh na ding jong thu kanei hi nahet lou ham?” ati.
19.11: Hichun Yeshuan aseitai, “Nangman keima chunga imacha tha nanei nading aumpoi, amavang chunglam akon tilou'in, ati. Hiti ahijeh a chu keima eipeh doh'a pangpa chonset na achungnungpen e,” ati.
19.12: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu lha doh dingin agongtan, ahinla Judah hon asam uvin, “Nangman hichepa hi nalha doh leh Caesar jol nahilou ahi; ama lenga kisem chan chu Caesar douna'a thusei ahi,” atiuve.
19.13: Pilate in thu chucheng ajah phat chun Yeshua chu ahin puidoh in; chuin Pilate chu song lhongnal atiu (Hebrew paova Gabbatha) hichu thutanna'a touna, chunga chun atoutan ahi.
19.14: Hichu kalchuh kut dinga kigot ni, nidan gup dontah ahi; chuin Juda ho jah'a, “Veuvin na lengpau hi!” ati.
19.15: Hijeh chun amaho a-aosot jengun, “Sumangin, sumangin, thingpel'ah khenbeh-in!” atiuvin ahileh, Pilate in ajah'uva, “Nalengpau thingpel'a kakhet beh ding ham?” atileh; thempu pipuihon adonbut'un, “Keihon Caesar tailou leng dang kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
19.16: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua khetbeh na dingin amaho koma ape dohtai, Hichun Judaten Yeshua chu apuidoh tauvin ahi.
19.17: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu akai'un, chuin a thingpel akiput'in Lugu mun (Hebrew paova Golgotha) atiu mun chu jonin achetan ahi.
19.18: Chuleh hiche mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu thingpel chung'ah akhenbeh tauvin ahi, chuleh midang pasal ni jong asih langto gel'a amatoh akhetbeh thau vin, Yeshua chu amani lai tah a akikhenbeh in ahi.
19.19: Chuin Pilate in thingpel chunga simdoh ding atah in hichu, “Nazareth Yeshua, Judate lengpa,” tin atah doh in ahi.
19.20: Chuleh Yeshua akhetbeh na mun chu khopi nai ahijeh chun, hiche min chu Juda ho tamtah-in asimun; hichu Hebrew pao, Latin pao, chuleh Greek paova kisun ahi.
19.21: Hichun thempu pipuihon Pilate henga alungkim lounau aga lhut'un, Hiche kheldoh na dingin, “Judate lengpa” khel'a “Aman aseijin, ‘keima hi Judate lengpa kahi,’” tijoh a khel dingin aseitauve.
19.22: Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hithei ponte, ajeh chu keiman kana jihdoh sa chu kajih doh ahitai,” ati.
19.23: Chule Rome sepai hon Yeshua akhetbeh uchun, aponsil alauvin, hal li asouvin sepai khat hal khat cheh in achang'un; chule asangkhol jong chu alauvin; asangkhol chu khuilou ahin, alua pat ato geiya kikhong lhungkei ahi.
19.24: Hichun amahon aseiyun, “Atel tel'a bokeh sangin leh sangu hitin, vang vetaote, koi chang ding ham” atiuve; Hiche hi Pathen thua kijih guilhun na dinga kisei chu ahi. Hichun amahon von chu alehsang un vangvet nan aneiyun, hitichun anabol'un ahi.
19.25: Hiche jeh chun sepai hon hiti chun hicheng chu aboltauve, Ahin Yeshua thingpel koma chun anutoh, anu sopinu Mary (Clopas Inneipi) toh, Mary Magdalene ading jingun ahi.
19.26: Hichun Yeshuan anu le angailut aseijui chu akom'a adin amu phat'in anu jah'a, “Numei ven nachapa chu,” ati.
19.27: Chuin Yeshuan hiche aseijui pa jah'a aseijin, “Hiche hi nanu ahi,” atin hichun hiche aseijui pa chun Yeshua nu Mariam chu a-inlam'a apui tan ahi.
19.28: Hiche jou chun Yeshuan thil ijakai akichai soh chu ahen, Pathen Lekhabua thu chu guilhun sohthei nan, “Kadang achah-e!” ati.
19.29: Chuleh chukoma chu belkhat'a theitwi thuh kitung ahin, chule twichop phon a theitwi thuh dimset in hyssop mol leh'a atah-un akamtoh asutouvin ahi.
19.30: Chuin Yeshuan theitwi thuh chu adonin, “Akichaitai,” ati. Chuin akaikun alhagao alhadoh tan ahi.
19.31: Chuin kigin ni ahijeh chun cholngah ni a thilong ho chu thingpel'a aumden louna dingin (cholngah ni Chula ni loupi ni ahin), Judah hon Pilate henga akenggu heboh dingleh along galah mangna dingin athumun ahi.
19.32: Hichun Rome sepai ho ahungun mi ni kikhai Yeshua toh kikhenbeh te ni keng chu ahehbong tauvin ahi.
19.33: Amavang Pakai Yeshua kom ahin phah uchun, ama chu ana thitan ahi, hiphat chun Yeshua keng vang chu aheh bong tapouve.
19.34: Hitia aum vang chun sepai ho khat in Yeshua nah chu tengcha a asut le apet pet chun thisan le twisih ahung pot tan ahi.
19.35: Chule amupa tah chun ahettohsah ahi; chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi; chuleh aman atahbeh asei ahi chu ahei; nanghon jong natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
19.36: Hiche ho jouse hi Pathen thua ana kisei doh banga, “Agu khat cha jong kihehbong lou ding ahi,” ati chu guilhunna dinga thil hicheng chu soh a ahitai.
19.37: Chule “Amahon tengcha'a asutpau chu avet dingu ahi” kiti toh.
19.38: Chuin hicheng jou chun Arimathea Joseph, Yeshua seijui khat, amavang Juda ho gin jeh a guh thima hia ahin, ama chun Yeshua long chu pohdoh dingin Pilate henga aga thum'in ahileh, Pilate'in jong ana phal'e. Hijeh chun ama ahungin Yeshua long chu apo mangtai.
19.39: Chule Arimathea Joseph toh hung khom pachu Nicodemus ahin, ama hi Yeshua toh kimuto dinga jan muthim'a hungpa chu ahi. Nicodemus chun Myrrh leh Aloes thao namtui kihal, sel som sagi le nga a gih ahin choiyin ahi.
19.40: Hichun amahon Yeshua long chu alauvin Judate chon na ngai bang in lounam tui toh tupat pon nemin atom tauvin ahi.
19.41: Chuleh thingpel'a aki khetbeh nau mun'a chu hon khat uma ahin, hon a chu koima kivuina khahlou hel lhan thah khat uma ahi.
19.42: Hijeh chun Juda ho kiginni ahijeh chun lhan chu akomcha ahiman chun chukoma chun Yeshua chu avui tauvin ahi.

20.1: Chuin hapta kipatna nimasa ni jingkah matah ahung lhungtan, kho jong vah chen loulai ahin, Mary Magdalene chu lhan a chun agachen ahileh song chu lhan a kona tahdohsa aum chu agamui.
20.2: Hichun Mary Magdalene chu alhai in Simon Peter leh Pakaiyin a-ngailut seijui pa henga hitin thu aga lhuttai, “Pakai longdamsa chu amahon apo mangtauvin, chule lhan khuh akon'a hoilanga akoiyu ham akihetapoi” agatin ahi.
20.3: Hiche jehchun Peter le seijui khatpa chu lhan khuh lam jon in ache lhontai.
20.4: Hichun seijui teni chu hatah in lhan lam jon'in akilhaitet lhon in ahile seijui khatpa chun Peter akhokhel in lhan khuh apha masa tan ahi.
20.5: Ama akunin asung avet le tupat ponnem ho um chu amun, ahivangin asunga alutpoi.
20.6: Hichun Simon Peter chu ahung lhungtan, chuin lhan sunga chun alut tai; chuin tupat ponnem ho aum chuleh,
20.7: Aluchunga um ultheh pon chu tupat ponnem ho chutoh umtha louva akijel'a atuma ana um aga mun ahi.
20.8: Hichun seijui alhung masajo pa jong chu lhan khuh sunga aga sunglhan, hichun amun atahsan tai.
20.9: Hiche masangsea chu amahon Pathen thu akisei doh “Pakai Yeshua chu thi ding chuleh hungthou doh kit ding ahi” tichu ana tahsan thei lou'u ahi.
20.10: Hichun amahon Inlam ahin jon tauvin ahi.
20.11: Mary vang chu lhan khuh pam'a chun ading in akap'in aka pum chun lhan khuh sung chu aga ven ahi.
20.12: Hichun aban abang Vantil ni Yeshua long alupsah nauva chu khat alulhuna atouva khat akeng todop'a atou amui.
20.13: “Ngailut umtah numei nangma ibol'a kap nahim?” tin Vantil teni chun ahindongin ahi. Hichun amanun adonbut'in, “Ajeh chu amahon Ka Pakai apomang tauvin, chuleh along damsa chu hoiya akoiyu keiman kahe tapoi,” ati.
20.14: Chutia aseijou chun ama aki nungheiyin ahileh, Yeshua adin amun, ahin Yeshua ahi chu ahepoi.
20.15: Yeshuan ahin dong'in, “Ngailut umtah numei ibol'a kap nahim?” ati. Amanun honlei ngahpa ahisah in, “Pu, hoilaiya nakoi hitam Ka Pakai long chu, neisei peh in keiman gapo mang ing kate,” ati.
20.16: “Mary!” tin Yeshuan ahin koutai. Mary chu Pakai henglam a ahung kihei in akap'in, “Rabboni,” ati (hichu Hebrew paova, “houhil,” tina ahi).
20.17: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Neitong khahih in; ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga chun kakaltou hih laiye; ahin chen lang kasopi ho jah'a gaseiyin, Ka-Pa, nangho Pa, Ka Pathen nangho Pathen henga kakaltouve,” ati.
20.18: Mary Magdalene chun seijui ho akimupin, hitin aseiye, “Keiman Pakai chu kamutai,” ati. Chuin amanu chun athusei ho chu asei peh tai. Yeshua Aseijuite Henga Akilah
20.19: Nikho kipat ni nilhah chun aseijuite Judah ho gin na jeh'a kot kikha khuma um ahiuvin, hichun Yeshua ahungin amaho lah'a ahung dingin ajah'uva, “Nachung'uva lungmon umhen,” ati.
20.20: Aman hiche chu aseijou vin amaho chu akhut thihkil maha le anah tenga kisut na maha avetsah tan ahi. Hichun amahon Pakai amu'u chun seijuite chu akipah lheh jengun ahi.
20.21: Hichun Pakaiyin avel'in ahoulimpi kit in, “Nachunguva lungmon chamna umhen, chuleh Pan keima eisol banga nangho kasol nahiuve,” ati.
20.22: Hichun Pakai in aseijui ho chu ahu ahai khum in, “Lhagao theng kisan un.”
20.23: “Nanghon koitobang ham khat chu achonsetna nangaidam uva ahileh kingaidam ahitauve, ahin nanghon nangaidam louleh amaho chu kingaidam lou ahijenge,” ati.
20.24: Seijui som le ni holah'a khat Thomas (Didymus atiu) vang chu Yeshua hung kilah a chu amaho lah'a ana umlou ahi.
20.25: Amahon aseipeh un, “Keihon Pakai chu kamutauve,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin Thomas chun, “Keiman akhut phanga thingkil maha kamua kakhut junga kakhoiya, anah kakhut a katham kahsen keiman tahsan ponge,” ati.
20.26: Niget jouvin seijuite insunga aumkhom pettah'un, hia chu Thomas jong um'ah ahi. Aumnau in chu kot kikhah soh keiya ahi, hinlah hetmanlou kah'in, amasa'a bangin, Yeshua alah uva ana dingin ahi. “Chamnan nalon khum'u hen,” ati.
20.27: Hichun Thomas jah a, “Nakhutjung in hinkhoiyin, kakhut teni hi ven; chuleh nakhut hin lhangin lang kanah tham'in; chuleh gingcha lel tahih in, tahsanin,” ati.
20.28: “Ka Pakai le Ka Pathen!” tin Thomas chun ahin phongdoh tai.
20.29: Chuin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangman neimu jeh a neitahsan ahi. Mulouva tahsan ho anun nomui,” ati.
20.30: Hiti tah a chu Yeshuan aseijuite ang sunga melchihna kidang tamtah abol ahin, hiti ho chu hiche lekhabu sunga hin akisunlut poi.
20.31: Ahinla nanghon Yeshua chu Messiah, Pathen Chapa, ahi chu natahsan uva chule natahsan vanguva ama min a hinna nanei theina dinguva hichengse hi hiche lekhabua hi kisun'ah ahibouve.

21.1: Hichun phat chomkhat jouvin Yeshua chu seijui hotoh Galilee dillen panga akimuto kit'un, hiti hin ana um'in ahi.
21.2: Simon Peter le Thomas (Didymus atiu) chutoh, Galilee gam'a Cana khoa mi Nathanael toh, Zebedee chapa teni toh chuleh seijui dang nitoh umkhom'a ahiuvin;
21.3: Simon Peter in, “Keima nga manin chenge,” ati. Hichun amahon ajah'a, “Keiho jong kahung dingu ahi atiuvin ahi.” Chuin acheuvin kong sung khat ah aluttauve, ahin hiche jan chun imacha amanpouvin ahi.
21.4: Jingkah matah in Yeshua chu vapam'a adin seijui hon amuuvin, hinlah ama chu koi ahi ageldoh pouve.
21.5: Hichun Pakaiyin amaho chu akouvin, “Sopite ho, nga ijat namat tah uvem?” ati. Ahin amahon adonbut'un, “Imacha Kaman pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
21.6: Hichun aman, “Nalen'u chu kong jetlam'a gaseplha temun, hiteng chule namat dingu ahi,” ati. Hichun amahon aseu le nga atama atam jeh chun akaidoh joutapouve.
21.7: Hichun Yeshuan angailut seijui chun Peter jah a, “Pakai ahi,” ati. Hichu Peter in Pakai ahi ati chu ajah phat in asangkhol aki-ah loiyin, (asagoh keova um ahin) dillen a chun achom lhan chule vapam lam chu ajon'in ahi.
21.8: Adangse vang chu kong sunga atouvun, len chu vapam langa kaidoh ding agong'un, ajeh chu len a chu nga dimset ahin chule amaho vapam alhun nadingu chu tong jani tobang achebeu ngaiyah ahi.
21.9: Amaho vapam alhun uchun songmeihol meiya kitih le achunga nga kikoi chuleh changlhah, jing-an a nehding, amu'uvin ahi.
21.10: Yeshuan amaho jah'a, “Namatsau nga chu themkhat hinchoiyun,” ati.
21.11: Hichun Simon Peter kong sunga alut'in len chu vapam langa akai doh in ngalen ja khat le som nga le thum dimset len chu agakaiyin, nga achuti tam vang chun alen chu a-eh pon ahi.
21.12: Hiphat chun Yeshuan, “Tun nangho hungun lang jing an hung kineh tauvin,” ati. Ahinla aseijui holah a chun khat cha beh in jong, “Nang koi nahi ham?” tin adong ngam pouve. Amahon Pakai ahi chu ahesoh keiyun ahi.
21.13: Hichun Pakai in seijui ho chu changlhah le nga anehsah in avahva sohkei tai.
21.14: Hichu athia kona athodoh nunga aseijuite henga akilah athumvei na ahi.
21.15: Jing-an anehjou phat'un, Yeshuan Simon Peter adongin, “John chapa Simon nangman hiche ho jouse sanga hi nei ngailut joh em? ati. Peter in adonbut in, henge Pakai keiman kangailut nangman nahe nai,” ati.
21.16: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati. Anivei nan ajah'a, “John chapa Simon nangman neingailut'em?” ati kit tai. Aman ajah'a, “Henge Pakai ka-ngailut nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati.
21.17: Yeshuan athumvei nan adongkit in, “John chapa Simon, keima hi nei ngailut tahbeh mong hinam?” ati. Thumveijen, “Neingailut'em?” atijeh chun Peter chu alungthim anommo lhehtan, ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Pakai nangman ijakai nahe sohkeiye, keiman nangma kangailut na jouse nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in” ati.
21.18: “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, nakhandon lai chun nangma deibang tah'in navon nakivon thei in, chuleh nangma nop nop na lama nache theiye, ahinla nakum ahungtam tan chujongleh nahung pilhingtan, hijeh a chu nakhut ho nahinjal doh'a midang koitobang in navon nahin vonpeh ding chuleh nache nom louna lam lama napui dingu ahi,” ati.
21.19: Hichu ama iti thia athiding Pathen achoiat ding chu hetsah na a ati ahi. Chuin hiche chu asei jouvin ajah'a, “Kanung hin jui in,” ati.
21.20: Peter akinung hei jin avetle anunglam uva–Yeshua ngailut seijui, jan anneh pet'a Yeshua henglam a akingailhua chule “Pakai koiham nangma napedoh dinga chu,” tia dongpa chu amun ahi.
21.21: Peter in Yeshua chu thudoh aneiyin, “Pakai hichepa chula?” ati.
21.22: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima kahung kinungle kitkah a ana umdinga phalna kapeh chu, nangma a dinga ipi aboina uma ham? Nang man keima neihin juitan,” ati.
21.23: Hichun hiche asei chu, hiche seijui chu thi louding ahi, tin sopite lah'a athangtan ahi; ahinla Yeshuan ama jah'a chu, “Ama chu thilou ding ahi, ati ahipoi. Kahung kahsen umhen, tileng hichu nangman ipi ding natim?” ati ahibouve.
21.24: Hicheng thu hettohsah a chule hicheng thu suna hi hiche seijui chu ahin; ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi, ti kaheuve.
21.25: Chuleh hicheng tailouvin jong Yeshuan thil kidang tamtah anabol aume; hiti ho chu kageldan in, lekhabun ana kisun sohkei henlang hileh, lekhabua kisun chengse chu vannoi leiset hin dolponte kati.

1.1: Theophilus, ka lekhabu masa-a kahin sei chu, Yeshua thilbolle thuhil kipattil thudol jouse le
1.2: Lhagao thenga kona alhendoh solchah ho thu apeh jouva pat ama van'a lahtouva aum ni gei thu ahi.
1.3: Chuche thingpel chunga athia athodoh jou ni somli sung chun, ama solchah ho henga akilah jin, chule ama ahing monge ti chu photchetna tamtah avetsah jin, chuleh Pathen lenggam thudol aseiyin ahi.
1.4: Chuin solchah ho toh anehkhom laiyin, aman amaho chu thu apen, “Kana seipeh bangun Pan akitepna thilpeh ahinsol masangsen nanghon Jerusalem dalhah hih un.
1.5: John in twiya baptize nachansah'u ahin, ahin tuapat nikho phabep joule nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachan ding'u ahi.” ati.
1.6: Hichun solchah ho chu Yeshua toh aumkhom pet un, amahon adongun, “Pakai, Israelte chamlhat nading leh a lenggam nakiledohsah kit nading phat chu hitam?” atiuvin ahi.
1.7: Aman adonbut in, “Anikho leh aphat chu Pa changseh thaneina-a um ahin, nangho hetding dol ahipoi.
1.8: Ahinlah Lhagao Theng nachung uva ahung chuh teng leh nanghon thahatna nanei ding'u ahi. Chutengleh nangho Jerusalema, Judea gam'a, Samaria gam, leh leiset chung pumpia kathu hettoh sah'a napan ding'u ahi,” ati.
1.9: Thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, amahon avet jinglaiyun ama chu meiloma lahtouvin aumin ahileh amahon amupha tapouvin ahi.
1.10: Chutia amahon van lam'a lahtouva aumpet avet jinglaiyun pon-banga kivon mi ni alah'uvah ahung ding lhonin,
1.11: “Galilee mite, ibola nadinuva vanlam navet jingu ham? Yeshua nangho koma kona vana lahtouva aum banga hi nikhatle vanna kona hung kile kitding ahi!” atilhone.
1.12: Chuin solchah hochu Jerusalema kona mile keh'a gamla Olive mola kon chun Jerusalem'ah ahung kile tauvin ahi.
1.13: Jerusalem ahung lhunun aumnau inchung langah akaltouvun ahi. Amaho chu: Peter, John, Jacob, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, Jacob (Alphaeus chapa), Simon (Zealot), chule Judas (Jacob chapa), ahiuve.
1.14: Amaho chengse hi Yeshua nu Mary leh numei dang phabeptoh, Yeshua sopite phabeptoh akipunkhomun gunchu leh lungkhat tahin atao jom jing tauve.
1.15: Yeshua tahsan mipi jakhat le somni akikhop khom laitah uvin Peter adingdoh in,
1.16: “Sopite ho, Yeshua manho lamkaiya pang Judas thudol hi, kumsottah masanga Lhagao Thengin Leng David kam'a anaphondohsa Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhungah ahi.
1.17: Ijeh-inem itileh Judas chu eiho lah'a khat ahin, hiche lhacha hina jonghi changah ahi,” ati.
1.18: (Aman khan gitlou man sumin gambeh khat achon, akhupboh in achun atumpi apohkeh-in agil jouse ahung dohtan ahi.
1.19: Judas thi thuhi Jerusalem mite jouse koma ahung kithangsoh tan ahileh amahon hiche gambeh chu Aramaic paovin Akeldama asah tauvin, hichu Thisan gambeh tina ahi.)
1.20: Peter in asei jom kit in, “Psalm lekhabua kimu bang in ‘Ama In chu onghen, koima cheng hihhen, chuleh ama panmun chu midangkhat changhen,’ ati.
1.21: Hijeh a chu Judas panmun khel ding mikhat ilhen ding'u ahin amachu Pakai Yeshua toh iumkhomlai uva pat'a eiholah a umjing khat hiding.
1.22: John'in baptize achansah jouva pat eiholah'a kona Yeshua lahtouva aumni geiya eiholah a lhajing hiding, amachu Yeshua thodoh thudol hettohsah dinga eiholah'a pang ding ahi,” ati.
1.23: Chuin mi ni: Barsabbas kiti Joseph (Justus tiajong kihe) le Matthias chu alhengdoh-un,
1.24: Amaho ataovun, “Vo Pakai, nangma mijouse lungthim hesoh nahi,
1.25: Hiche teni hi koijoh in Judas khel'a solchah na atoh dingham neihetsah uvin, ajeh chu Judas chun hiche solchah natoh hi alhatan ahi.”
1.26: Chuin amahon vang asangun ahileh Matthias chu solchah somlekhat holah a akisimtha tan ahi.

2.1: Pentecost nikho chun tahsan chate jouse chu munkhat a ana umkhomun ahi.
2.2: Chuin phulou helouvin van'a konin hui hattah gin tobang ahung ging in, atoukhom nau inchu ahung dimset jengtan ahi.
2.3: Chuin meikong toh kilou ahiloule meikong banga kong lei ahung kilah in amaho jouse chunga chun achutan ahi.
2.4: chuin amaho jouse chu Lhagao Theng adimsoh tauvin ahileh Lhaogao Theng in apeh bangun amahon paochom paochom in thu asei pan tauvin ahi.
2.5: Hichepet a chu vannoi gamtin a kona hungkhom Judah hougut hojong Jerusalema um'u ahi.
2.6: Chuin chuche gin chu ajah phat'un mipi ajapha jouse chu ahung khomun ahileh tahsan chate thusei chu ama ama paocheh a ajah jeh uchun amaho alung kichih lahlah jengun ahi.
2.7: Chuin amaho chun kidang asauvin, “Hiche hi iti hithei ham?” tin adatmo lheh jengun ahi. “Hiche mite hi abonchauva Galilee mi ahiuvin,
2.8: ahinlah eihon eima eima penna gam cheh paovin ijauve!
2.9: Eiho hila Parthia mi, Mede mi, Elam mi ihiuvin, abang Mesopotamia gam'a cheng, Judah gam le Cappadocia gam'a cheng, Pontus gam'a le Asia gam'a cheng,
2.10: Phrygia le Pamphylia gam'a cheng, Egypt gam'a cheng chule Cyrene gam vel'a, Libya gam'a cheng ihiuvin; abang Rome a kona hung kholjin, Judah chona chonho,
2.11: chule Crete mi le Arab gam mi ihiuvin; ahivang in eima pao cheh-a Pathen thilbol loupi thu aseiyu thakhat jah-in ijauve,” atiuvin ahi.
2.12: Amaho chun kidang asauvin adatmo lheh jengun “Itidan ahidem,” tin khat le khat akidongto tauvin ahi.
2.13: Ahivang in mipi lah a konkhat chun ajontaiyun, “Hiteho hi lengpi twi kham ahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
2.14: Chuin Peter chu solchah dang somlekhat chutoh adingdoh in mipi ho koma chun aw sangtah in asamin ajah uva, “Phatechan ngaiyuvin, Judah mite le Jerusalema cheng mite! Hiche thuhi nanghon hekhel hih'un,
2.15: Nangho ngaito banga hiteho hi lengpitwi kham ahipouve, ajeh chu tuhi jingkah nidan ko ahinalai bouve.
2.16: Ahin hiche namu'uhi Joel themgaopan anaphon dohsa guilhunna ahibouve:
2.17: ‘Pathen in’ ni nunung lamle hiti ding ahi, mijouse chunga ka-Lhagao kabuhlhah ding ahi. Nachapateu le nachanu teuvin gaothu asei dingu, chule na khangdong-houvin mu aneiyuva, chule na Upa houvin mang anei dingu ahi.
2.18: Hiche niteng chule kasoh pasalte le kasoh numeite chunga ka-Lhagao kabuhlhah ding amahon gaothu asei dingu ahi.
2.19: chuleh vana thil kidang tampi kasosah ding, leiset chunga melchihna tampi-thisan, meikong le meikhu kamusah ding ahi.
2.20: Pakai hungkitna nikho loupitah ahung lhun masanga, Nisa hungthim ding, lha jong thisan soh ding ahi.”
2.21: Ahinlah koi hijongle Pakai min kou jouse sohcha ding ahi.
2.22: “Nangho Israel mite, ngaiyuvin! Pathen in Nazareth Yeshua chu nangho lah a amanchah-a bolmo kidang, datmo umho, chule melchihna ho abola kona chu aphotchetsah ahin, hichu nanghon nahet u ahi.
2.23: Ahin Pathen in ahet masat le agontoh masat bang in Yeshua chu pehdoh in aumtan ahileh nanghon dan neilou chidang namdangte toh kithon thingpel a nakhenbeh un nathat tauvin ahi.”
2.24: Ahin Pathen in Ama chu kichat umtah thina-a konin alha-ong in hinna ape kit tan ahi ajeh chu thina in atuhden hoi ahilou jeh chun.
2.25: Leng David in Ama thudol aseiyin, “Keiman Pakai chu kamaikoh-a kamu jinge; keima kalonle louding ahi ajeh chu kajetlama ama aum jinge.
2.26: Hijeh chun kalung akipah-in, chule kalei athanome; chuche kalval chun katahsa jong kinem'a cholnga ding ahi;
2.27: Ajeh chu nangman kalhagao mithiho lah a nadalhah louding, namitheng mon mangna namusah louding ahi.
2.28: Nangman keima hina lampi neihetsah ahitan, namaisoa kipana neidip ding ahi, ati.”
2.29: “Sopite ho, hiche thuhi ngaito temuvin, Ipu-u David in ama chungchang thu asei ahilou dan kicheh tah in iheuve, ajeh chu ama athi in, akivuina lhanmun jeng jong tugeiyin eiholah-a aumin ahi.
2.30: Ahin ama themgao ahijeh chun, Pathen in Ama taiguiya pengkhat alal touna a atousah ding, kihahsela athutep chu ahen,
2.31: Chutia chu khonung thu ahet masah jeh chun Messiah thokit thu aseiyin, ‘Thikhol khul'ah dalhah denin aumpoi, Alongin jong monmangna amupoi,’ ati.
2.32: Pathen in Yeshua chu thina a konin akaithouvin, keiho jouse hi ahettoh kahiuve.
2.33: Tun Ama vana Pathen khut jet lama choisangin aumin, athutepsa Lhagao Theng chu a-Pa a konin amun, hichu ahin bunglhan, tua namu'u najah-u hi ahi.
2.34: David chu amatah vana akaltou lou vang'in hitin aseiye, ‘Pakai chun ka Pakai jah a, jabolna mun kakhut jetlam'a tou jingin,
2.35: Namelmate kasuhnem a, nakeng chotpha a kaneisah masang sen,’ ati.
2.36: Chuti ahijeh chun Israel chate jousen heuvin, Pathen in hiche Yeshua, thingpel chunga nakhatbehpau chu Pakai le Messiah dinga atundoh ahitai!”
2.37: Peter thusei chun alungthim'u asuntan ahile amahon Peter le seijui dangho koma chun, “Sopite ho keihon ipi kabol dingu ham?” atiuvin ahi.
2.38: Peter in adonbut in, “Nachonset lungheiyun lang Pathen lama hung kiheiyun, chule nachonset nau ngaidama aum jeh in Yeshua Christa minin twiya baptize changun, chutengle Lhagao Theng thilpeh nachan dingu ahi.
2.39: Hiche thutep hi nangho le nachateu ding, chule chidang namdangte ding le, Pakai Pathen in akou mite jouse dinga jong ahi,” ati.
2.40: Chule Peter in thutampi asei jomjing nalaiyin, amaho chu atilkhouvin, “Hiche khang gilou mite-a kon hin kihuhdoh un,” atin ahi.
2.41: Hiche nikho a Peter thusei tahsanho jouse chu twija baptize achangun, hiche nikho chun Houbung mi sangthum ana kibe in ahi.
2.42: Tahsan chate jouse chun solchah ho thuhil jong, kiloikhomna jong, neh leh chah kihopkhomna le Pakai anjon a jong, taokhomna a jong gunchu tah in anapang det jingun ahi.
2.43: Chuin alungthim sunguva kichatna nasatah ahung lhungin, solchah hon jong melchihna le thil kidang tamtah aboltauve.
2.44: chuin tahsan chate jouse chu munkhat'ah aumkhom un athilnei jouseu chu neilhangin ana neikhom uvin ahi.
2.45: Anei agou-u ajoh uvin asum chu angaicha jouse toh ana kihom jiuvin ahi.
2.46: Niseh-in Hou-in a Pathen ahoukhom jiuvin, Pakai anjon jong dingin in'ah akikhom jiuvin, chule kipah tah le hongphal tahin an ana nekhom jiuvin ahi.
2.47: Abonchauva Pathen avahchoi jing laiyu-le mijouse lungdeiya thanomtah-a aum jing laiyun, aniseh in Pathen in huhhing'a umho chu amaho lah a chun abe jing tan ahi.

3.1: Nikhat Peter le John chu nilhah lang taokhom phat in, hichu nidan thum don ahin, Houin'ah achelhon in ahi.
3.2: Houin ahung nai lhontah chun apen a pat a elbai mikhat ahin polut un, ama pa chun houin'a cheho jouse koma akithum theina dinga niseh le houin kotkhahoi atiu muna chu akoi jiu ahi.
3.3: Hiche mipa chun Houin'a lut kigo Peter le John amu phat chun sum themkhat neipe lhonin tin athum tan ahi.
3.4: Peter le John in amapa chu ave changmel lhonin, hichun Peter in amapa koma chun, “Neive lhonin” ati.
3.5: Hichun elbaipa chun sum themkhat beh muding kinem in amani chu lunglut tah in avelhon tan ahi.
3.6: Ahin Peter in “Nang dingin Dangka le Sana kanei poi, ahinlah kaneisun penge, Nazareth Yeshua Christa minin ding in lang lam jot'in.” ati.
3.7: Chuin Peter in elbaipa chu akhut jet'in atuh in akithopi in akai ding tan ahileh, mipa kengphang le a-ahkhomit chu apettah chun adamtan chule athahatdoh tan ahi.
3.8: Chuin akichomin akengphang in adingdoh in lam ajot pantan, amani chutoh houin sunga alut'in avahlen, akichomin, chule Pathen avahchoi tan ahi.
3.9: Mi jousen elbaipa lamjot chu amu-vin, Pathen avahchoi chu ajau-vin ahi.
3.10: Chuin miho chun Houin kotkha hoiya touva khutdopa ahichu ahetdoh phat un kidang asauvin adatmo lheh jeng'un ahi.
3.11: Hichepa chun Peter le John atuhchah kheh laitah chun mipi jouse chun kidang asabehseh jeng-uvin, Solomon Kempum atiuva chun ahung lhaikhomun ahi.
3.12: Peter in chutobang phat gomkom amutah chun mipi ho chu adonbut in, “Vo Israel mite,” hiche chungchanga hi ipi kidang nasah uham? Ipi dinga keihon keiho thahat le houdih vanga hichepa hi lam kajotsah dan-uva nangaitou-va neivet vet jeng'u ham?
3.13: Ajeh chu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob Pathen, ipu ipateu Pathen chun alhacha Yeshua choiat nadinga hiche hi abol ahi. Hiche Yeshua chu nanghon napam paiyun, Pilate in lhadoh dinga agotlai in jong nanghon ama khut'ah napedoh un ahi.
3.14: Nanghon hiche thengtah le chondihtah pa sangin, tolthatpa joh nalhadohpeh nadingun nathumun ahi.
3.15: nanghon hinna bulpi chu nathat-un, ahin Pathen in thina-a konin akaithou kittan, chule keiho hi hiche thutah hetoh chu kahiuve!
3.16: Yeshua mina tahsan vanga hichepa hi damah ahin, chule tumasanga iti dammo ham jong nahet'u ahi. Yeshua mina tahsanna chun namitmu tah uva adamsah ahi.
3.17: Sopite ho, nangho le navaipo teuvin Yeshua nabol nauhi hetlouva nabol'u ahi kahenai.
3.18: Ajeh chu Messiah thoh gimding thudol, themgao hon ana sei masah sa chu Pathen in aguilhunsah ahi.
3.19: Tun nachonset lung heiyun lang Pathen lama hung kile hei kitun, chutileh nachonset nau thehngima um ding,
3.20: Pakai angsunga kona kiledohna phat hung lhung thei kit a, chuteng leh nangho dinga agotsa Yeshua Christa chu nahenguva ahinsol kit ding ahi.
3.21: Ajeh chu Pathen in phatsot a pat a Themgao thengho ana seidoh sah akitepna banga, ama chu thil jouse akiledoh sah kit phat hung kah-a vana umden ding ahi.
3.22: Mosen “Pakai Pathen in keima eitundoh banga hi nangho dinga nasopiteu lah-a khat themgaova atundoh ding ahi; ama chun najah-uva thu asei jouse chu nangai dingu ahi.
3.23: Chule koi hijong leh chuche themgao thusei ngailou chu Pathen mite lah'a kona kisumanghel ding ahi,” anati.
3.24: “Samuel khanga pat themgao jousen tukhanga thilsoh umchan jouse ana seiyun ahi.
3.25: Nangho chuche themgao holeh Pathen in naputeu napateu atepna thutep chate chu nahiu ahi; ajeh chu Pathen in Abraham koma chu nangma chilhah-a kona vannoi leiset phung jouse phatthei changding ahi, tia ana tepsa ahi.
3.26: Pathen in alhacha Yeshua akaithoukit jou chun, nachonset nau lampia kona nahung kilekitna dingule phatthei nachanthei na dinguva nangho Israel mite henga ahinsol masatpen ahi,” ati.

4.1: Peter le John in mipi ho henga thu asei jing lai lhonin, Thempu ho le Houin vengbit a pang vaipo, chuleh Sadducee ho themkhat chun lungphamo tah-in ahung kimaito piuvin,
4.2: Peter le John in Yeshua vanga thokitna aume tithu ahil lhon jeh chun hiche lamkai ho chu alung phamo lheh jengun ahi.
4.3: Chuin amani chu amanun, nilhah lam ahiphat in ajing khovah kah chun songkul'a akhum tauvin ahi.
4.4: Ahin athuhil lhon jaho lah a mi tamtah chun athuhil lhon chu atahsan tauvin ahileh numei chapang simlouvin tahsan mi sang-nga aval tauvin ahi.
4.5: Chuin ajing nikho chun, avaipoteu le a-upateu chule danthu sunho chu Jerusalema akikhomun ahi.
4.6: Ama ho lah-a chun Annas thempu chungnung jaonan Caiaphas, John, Alexander, chuleh thempu chungnung insung mite dang jong aumun ahi.
4.7: Chuin amaho angsunga chun solchah teni chu ahin puilut-un thudoh aneiyun, “Ipi thaneina, ahilouleh koi mina hitobang thilhi nabol lhonham?” tin adongun ahi.
4.8: Chuin Lhagao Theng dimset pumin Peter chun adonbut-un, “Vaipo hole Upate ho,
4.9: Elbaipa chunga thilpha kaboljeh lhona thudoh neibol'u ham? Elbaipa hi iti dam ham nahet chet nomu ham?
4.10: Nangho le Israel chate jouse dingin kichehtah in naseipeh uving kate, Nanghon thingpel chunga nakhetbeh uva ahivanga Pathen in thina a kona akaithoukit, thaneitah Nazareth Yeshua Christa mina dama ahi.
4.11: Ajeh chu Yeshua thudola Pathen lekhabun hiti hin aseiyin ahi, nangho insahon nadeimova napaiyu song aninga apipena panga chu ama hi ahi.
4.12: Chule koima danga huhhingna aumpoi, vannoiya huhhing'a ium nadiu mindanga mindang Pathen in eipe pouve,” ati
4.13: Chuin vaipo ho chun Peter le John hansanna chu amuvin adatmo lheh jengun ahi. Ajeh chu lekha themlou le jilna neimi ahi lhon lou chu aheuvin chule Yeshua to anaumkhom ahi lhon jong aheuvin ahi.
4.14: Ahin akiboldam mipa alailungtah-uva adin amujeh'u chun, vaipo ho chun seibe ding ahetapouvin ahi.
4.15: Chuin kikhop khomna in'a kona potdoh dingin Peter le John chu thu apeuvin, chuin amaho le amaho chu akihouvun,
4.16: “Hiche miteni hi i-ilo dingu ham? Thil bolmo kidang abol lhon la inelthei pouvin, chule Jerusalema mijousen jong ahen,
4.17: Ahin Yeshua mina thu ahiljomkit lhon louna dingin gihsalna neiyu hite,” akitiuvin ahi.
4.18: Chuin Solchah teni akoulut kitun, Yeshua mina thu ahilkit lhon louna dingin thu apeuvin ahi.
4.19: Ahin Peter le John in adonbut lhonin, “Pathen thu ngailouva nangho thujoh kangai diu chu Pathen in deijonte tia nagel uham?
4.20: Kamu jouseu le kajah jouseu sapphong ding hi kangah thei lhon louding ahi,” ati lhonin ahi.
4.21: Chuin amahon agihsal kit'un achainan alhadoh tauvin ahi, ajeh chu mipi tamtah jeh-a chu asuhgim thei lou u ahi. Mijousen Pathen avahchoiyun ahi.
4.22: Ajeh chu kum somli elbaipa kiboldamna chu bolmo thil kidangtah ahi.
4.23: Chuin alhadoh jou jouvun, Peter le John chu tahsan chate koma ahung kile lhonin thempu hole upate hon asei jouseu chu asei lhon tan ahileh.
4.24: akomuva Peter le John thusei ajah jah'u chun tahsan chate jouse chun o khat tah in Pathen koma hiti hin atao tauvin ahi. “Vo thaneipen Pakai, Van le leiset, twikhanglen le asunga thil umjouse hinsempa,
4.25: Nangin Lhagao Thenga kapuluiyu nalhacha David kam'a ‘Namtin vaipi ibola lunghanga hiuvem? Chule ibola mihon mohthil angaitou ham?
4.26: Leiset chunga a lengteu galsat din akigong chaiyun, a Pakai le a Christa dou dingin avaipoteu akikhomui’ tia nasei sah ahin,
4.27: Atah beh in hiche khopi sunga hin alhungtai! Ajeh chu Herod Antipas, gamvaipo Pontius Pilate, chidang namdangte le Israel chate jouse chu nangma thaonusa nalhacha theng Yeshua dou dingin akitho khom sohkei tauvin ahi.
4.28: Ahinlah abol jouseu hi nangma lungchamtah aboldinga umsa ahi.
4.29: Chuleh tun O Pakai, amigihsal nauhi ngaiyin lang nalhachate hin nathu kasapphong nadiuvin hansanna lentah chu neipeuvin.
4.30: Namidamsah theina thahat toh thon nakhut hinlhang inlang, nalhacha theng Yeshua minin melchihna le bolmo kidang dang bolu hen” atiuve.
4.31: Hitia atao jouvun, akikhopnau inchu ahung kilingin, abonchauvin Lhagao Theng adimset un, hangsan tah-in Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
4.32: Chuin Tahsan chate jouse chu lungkhat le thakhat ahiuvin, koiman jong anei chu keiya tum ahi tilouvin, anei jouseu abonchan aneikhomun ahi.
4.33: Solchah ho chun thaneitah in Pakai Yeshua thokit thudol chu ahettohsah jiuvin, chule Pathen phatthei bohna lentah chu amaho chunga aumtan ahi.
4.34: Amaho lah-a chun alhasam angaicha anaumpouvin ahi ajeh chu gam leiset le in neihon ahinjoh-un,
4.35: asum chu solchahho kengbul'a ahinchoiyun alhasam angaicha ho chu anahop peh jiuvin ahi.
4.36: Chuin Joseph, solchah hon Barnabas asah-u (hichu lungmonna chapa tina ahi) chu Levi phungmi Cyprus twikol gam mi ahi.
4.37: Amapa chun lou munkhat anei chu ahinjoh in asum chu solchahte kengbul'a ahin choiyin ahi.

5.1: Ahin Ananias kiti mipa khat ana um'in ama chun ajinu Sapphira to agou themkhat ajoh lhonin,
5.2: Asum kehkhat chu solchahho henga ahin choi lhonin, abona kahin choi lhon ahitai atilhon in adangse chu ajinu toh kinopto in akikoi den lhon tan ahi.
5.3: Chuin Peter chun aseiyin, “Ananias ipi dinga nalungthim chu Satan nalodimsah hitam? Lhagao Theng najoulhep in nasum akehkhat nanga dingin nakikoi tai.
5.4: Nagouthil chu nanga ahi, johding le johlou ding jong nangma thu ahi, najoh jouva jong asum chu nanga ahin, pehdoh ding le pehdohlou ding jong nangma thu ahi. Ipi dinga hitobanghi nabol hitam? Hiche hi keiho neijoubol nau ahipon Pathen najoubolna joh ahi” ati.
5.5: Hichethu chu Ananias in ajah jah chun lhonglaiya chun alhun athitai, chuin hiche thu ajapha jouse chu akichathei lheh tauvin ahi.
5.6: Chuin khangdong phabep ahungdoh un ponin atomun vuidingin apodoh tauvin ahi.
5.7: Nidan thum vel chejouvin, thilsoh imacha hephalouvin ajinu chu ahungin,
5.8: Chuin Peter in adongin, “Hiche sumhi najipa toh nagam mana namu lhon chu hitam?” atileh amanun jong “Henge hichu kagam man lhon ahi,” ati.
5.9: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga nanitah lhon'a Pakai Lhagao napatep lhona hitobang thilphalou hi nabol lhon hitam? Najipa vuiya che gollhanghon kotphung ahinpha tauvin ahi, chule nangjong naputdoh diu ahitai,” ati.
5.10: Apettah chun lhonglaiya chun alhun athipaitan ahi. Gollhangho ahunglut un ahileh amanu athisa anaum chu amu uvin chuin apodoh paiyun ajipa kivuina koma chun aga vui tauvin ahi.
5.11: Chuin Houbung pumpi le athu japha jouse chunga kichatna lentah achutan ahi.
5.12: Chuin solchahho chun miholah-a chun melchih nale thil kidang tampi abolun, tahsan chate jouse Houin a, Solomon kempum kiti muna chun niseh in akikhom jing tauvin ahi.
5.13: Ahin mipihon amaho chu amusang lheh vangun alah uva jaoding chu angam pouvin ahi.
5.14: Hijeng jongle tahsan chate chu Pakai henga hung akibe jing jengin, numei le pasal akibe jingin ahi.
5.15: Solchahho natoh jehchun miho chun Peter avale komle alebeh achunguva achuh khah nading tin damlou ho jouse chu lamlen dunga ahinpodoh uvin lupna le pheh chunga alupsah un ahi.
5.16: Jerusalem kimvela khopi hoa kon chun mipi ahung khomun damlouho le lhagaoboh vop ho ahinpuiyun ahileh abonchauvin adamsoh keiyuvin ahi.
5.17: Chuin thempu chungnung leh aloite Sadducee ho chu thangsetnan adimset un ahi.
5.18: Chuin solchahho chu amanun songkul'a chun ahentauvin ahi.
5.19: Ahin jan in Pakai Lhagao ahungin, akihennau songkul kot chu ahongdohin solchahho chu apuidoh in,
5.20: “Hou'in a cheuvin lang miho koma hiche hinna thuhi gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
5.21: Chuin ajing khovah-in solchahho chu Houin'a alut-un, Pakai Lhagaovin akomuva aseipeh bangun ahil tauvin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung chu atohkhompi chengtoh ahungin, Israelte lah-a aupa houle houvaipoloi ho chu akoukhomun, chuin solchahho chu achungthu-u kholchet dingin songkul'a konin aga puidohsah-un ahi.
5.22: Houin ngaha pang sottolle ho chu songkul'a ahungun ahileh, songkul'a chun koima anaum tapon ahi, chuin amaho akile uvin houvaipoho henga chun thil umchan chu aseiyun,
5.23: “Songkul kot chu kikhah detchet a angah ho chu apama ding ahiuvin, ahin songkul kot chu ahonuva ahile asunga chun koima anaumpon ahi!” atiuve.
5.24: Chuin Houin ngahho lah-a lamkaipa le thempu pipuho chu alungboi lheh jengun, ipi khat ahungsoh tadem tin adatmo lheh jengun ahi.
5.25: Chuin mikhat ahungin kidang satah in, “Songkul'a nakhum-u miho chu Houin'a adinguvin miho thu ahil uve,” ahung tin ahi.
5.26: Chuin Houin ngaha pang sepai lamkaipa leh a sepai techu acheuvin solchahho chu aga manun, ahin ajokhat le mipi ho chun songin eisep unte tin boina sem louvin oltah in agabolun ahi.
5.27: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga ahinpuilut un, amaho chu thempu chungnung in thu adongun,
5.28: “Hiche mipa min chun thu hilkit tahih-un tia hakhama kakham nahilou uham? Ahinlah nathuhil'u Jerusalem nadipsoh un hiche mipa thina chungchanga hin keiho neimoso got uve,” atin ahi.
5.29: Ahin Peter le solchahho chun adonbut'un, “Keihon mihem thuneiho sanga Pathen thu kangaijoh dingu ahi.
5.30: Ipu ipateu Pathen chun thingpel chunga nakhaisanguva nathau Yeshua chu thina-a kona akaithoukit ahi.
5.31: Ahin ama chu Pathen in Pakai leh Huhhingpu dinga achoisanga akhutjet lama atousah ahitai. Chule hiche hi Israel chate chonset lungheina dingle ngaidam channa dinga abol ahi.
5.32: Keiho hi hiche thudol hettohsah chu kahiuvin, chuleh athua nungho dinga Pathen in apeh Lhagao Theng jong chu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
5.33: Chuin hiche kisei ajah phat'un houvaipoloi ho chu alung hangdoh jah'un thading lung ageltauvin ahi.
5.34: Ahin houvaipoloi lah a mikhat, Pharisee mi amin Gamaliel, amapa chu hou danthu them le mijousen ajabol mikhat ahin, adingdoh in miho chu chomkhat pamlanga soldoh dingin thu apen ahi.
5.35: Chuin aman aloite henga chun aseiyin, “Nangho Israel mite, hiteho chunga bolding nagot uhi chingtheiyun!
5.36: Tu masang chun Theudas kiti mikhat anaumin, ama chu milen khat bangin ana um'in ahile mihem jali valin anung ana jui un ahi, ahin ama chu anathat'un ahileh anungjui ho chu lamchom cheh a anavahcheh gamun, abol atoh hou jouse imalou asohtan ahi.
5.37: Amapa jouchun hichu min kisut lai ahin, Galilee mi Judas kiti mikhat anaum kitin ama jong chun anungjui mitampi ana neiyin, ahin athat kitun ahile anungjui ho jouse chu ana kithecheh kit tauvin ahi.
5.38: Chuti ahijeh chun hiche mite hi ima lohih un, moh lhaong uvin, ajeh chu amahon angaitouva abolgot'u hi amaho lungchama ahile chomkhat joule hungmang paiding ahi.
5.39: Ahin Pathena kona ahileh nasuhmang jou lou dingu, nangho le nangho Pathen toh kidoubep nahilo dingu ahi!” ati.
5.40: Chuin ama thumop chun akilol tauvin, solchahho chu akouvun ajep uvin, chujouvin Yeshua mina thu aseikit tahlou nadingun agihsalun alha tauvin ahi.
5.41: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga kon chun apotdoh un, Yeshua mina suhgima aumjeh uchun akipah lheh jengun ahi.
5.42: chule aniseh in Houin le ainson tin'ah “Yeshua chu Messiah ahi,” tichu ahil'un asamphong jom jingun ahi.

6.1: Ahin aniseh a atahsan akibejing phat in alah uva phun noina le kilunglhaito louna aumdoh tan, hichun Greek pao tho atahsanho chun Hebrew pao tho atahsanhon niseh-a neh le chah kihopna-a meithaiho akhohsah pouve tin aphunnoi tauvin ahi.
6.2: Chuin solchah somleni hochun atahsanho chu abonchauvin akou khom uvin, “Keiho solchahho hin Pathen thuhilna-a phat kaman diu ahin neh le chah a hi kaboilou ding dol-u ahi.
6.3: Hijeh chun sopite ho, nanghon jaumtah, lhagao le chihna a dim mi sagi lhengdoh uvin lang ama ho chu neh leh chah a mo kapohsah dingu ahi.
6.4: Chutileh keiho solchah ho hin taona le Pathen thuhila phat kamanthei dingu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
6.5: Abonchauvin hiche lunggel chu pha asauvin chuin, Stephen (tahsan nale lhagaova dim mipa), Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Antioch mi Nicolas (Jews te tahsana sang masaloi) ho chu hiche panmun loding chun alhengdoh tauvin ahi.
6.6: Chuin hiche mi sagi kilhengdoh ho chu solchahho henga ahin puilut uvin ahileh solchah hon achunguva khut angamun ataopeh tauvin ahi.
6.7: Chutichun Pathen thu chu amachal jing in atahsan mi hatah in akibejing in, chule Judate thempuho jong tamtah ajau-uvin ahi.
6.8: Chuin Stephen chun, Pathen lungset nale thaneina dimset in thil kidang le melchihna tampi mipiho masanga abol in ahi.
6.9: Ahin nikhat chu chamlhat miho kikhop khomna a konin mi phabep, amaho chu Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, le Asia gam'a kona Judah mi ahiuvin amaho chu ahungun Stephen chu ahung kinelpi tauvin ahi.
6.10: Ahin Stephen in chihna le Lhagao dimset puma aseidoh thucheng ang a chun koima adingjou pouvin ahi.
6.11: Chuin amahon mipi themkhat atildoh-un amaho koma chun Stephen in “Mose le Pathen ataitom,” thu kajauve atiuvin ahi.
6.12: Hiche asei-uchun mipichu alung handoh sah-uvin, chuin upa hole houdanthu hilho chun Stephen chu aman uvin vaipoloi anga ahin puilut un ahi.
6.13: Chuin jouthu hettoh sahna asemun, “Hiche mipa hin Houin theng dounale Mose dan dounan thu aseiyin,
6.14: Chule Nazareth Yeshua chun Houin hi ahinsuh chimding chule Mose'n eipeh-u danjong akhelding ahi” tia asei kajauve, atiuvin ahi.
6.15: Hichepettah chun vaipo loiho jouse chun Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahi, ajeh chu Stephen maiso chu vantil ho maibanga vahset ahi.

7.1: Chuin thempu chungnung chun Stephen chu adongin, “Hiche hehna thu hohi dih em?” ati.
7.2: Chuin Stephen in adonbut in, “Sopite le Pateho ngaiyuvin, Ipuluiyu Abraham Haran a achen masang, Mesopotamia gam'a aumlaiyin Loupi Pathen chu ahenga ana kilah in,
7.3: Hitin anaseiyin ahi, ‘napena gam leiset le na insungmi hindalhan lang, keiman kavetsah ding gamleiset a hungin’” ati.
7.4: Chuin Abraham'in Chaldea gam ahin dalhan apa thikah in Haran a anachengin, chujouvin tua nachennau gamsunga hin ahin puilut in ahi.
7.5: Ahinlah Pathen in akengto ngapna dingkham gambeh neocha jong ana pepoi. Ahin Abraham'in chapa aneiloulai vang'in nikhatle ama le ason achilhah ten hichegam hi alodingu ahi tin Pathen in ana thutep-in ahi.
7.6: Chuleh Pathen in aseikit in nason nachilhate jong migama kum jali sohchang le bolgima um dingu ahi
7.7: Ahin soh-a kai nam mite chunga keiman thu katan ding, achaina le hiche gam'a hi hung kile kit uva keima eihoukit dingu ahi ati.
7.8: Chule Pathen in jong Abraham chu cheptana kitepna thu anapen, chuin Abraham'in achapa Isaac ahin phat in aniget nin chep anatan in, chule hiche kitepna chu Isaac in jong Jacob ahina, chuleh Jacob in apului-u somleni ahinchan geiyin jong ahin boljom jingun ahi.
7.9: Chuin hiche puluiho chu asopipau Joseph chunga ana thangthip uvin, hijeh chun Egypt gam'a sohding in anajohdoh uvin ahi. Ahin Pathen in anaumpi jingin,
7.10: Gentheina ho jouse a konin anahuhdoh in Egypt lengpa Pharaoh angsunga lungsetna anapen ahi. Chule Pathen in Joseph chu kidangtah chihna anapen hijeh chun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpia vaipon ana pansah in chuleh a leng inpia jong mopon ana pansah in ahi.
7.11: Ahin Egypt gam le Canaan gam sunga kel ahunglha tan ahileh gentheina sangtah ahunglhung tan hijeh chun ipuiluiteu jong nehding neilouvin anaum un ahi.
7.12: Chuin Jacob in Egypt gamsunga neh aum nalaiye ti ahet phatin achate-ipuiluiteu chu neh choding in asolin ahi.
7.13: Anivei channa a anache uchun Joseph chu a sopite henga ana kiphongin chuin asopite chu Pharaoh henga anapuilut in ahi.
7.14: Chuin Joseph in mi asolin apa Jacob le ainsungmite somsagi le nga hochu ahenga dingin agakousah tan ahi.
7.15: Chuin Jacob chu Egypt gam'a anache in athitan ahi chule ipuluiteu jong anathi tauvin ahi.
7.16: Chun alongdamsau chu Shechem a ahin pouvin Abraham'in Hamor chapate koma anachohna lhanmuna chun avui tauvin ahi.
7.17: Pathen in Abraham koma athutep guilhunna ding phat anaitah jehchun miho chu Egypt gam'a chun hatah in apungun.
7.18: Ahin Joseph hephalou lengthah khat Egypt lengvaipoa ahung pan phat in,
7.19: Hiche lengpa chun imiteu chu doha in abolin asugentheiyin chule achasen houchu athi nadingin anu le apa teu chu hunam'in ana paidoh sah in ahi.
7.20: Hichephat laitah chun Pathen mitvet a chapang hoitah Mose chu anapengin, anu le apan inmun'ah lhathum hoitah in anasin lhonin ahi.
7.21: Chuin anu le apan Mose chu apaidoh lhontan ahileh Pharaoh chanun ana kimudoh in ama cha bang bangin ahin vahkhang tan ahi.
7.22: Chuin Mose chu Egypt gamsung chihna ho jouse ahilun ahile ama chu thusei le natoh a thahattah'a hung hitan ahi.
7.23: Chuin Mose chu kum somli ahung hi phat hin nikhat chu asopite-Israel techu agavetan ahile,
7.24: Egypt mipa khat'in Israel mikhat alamlou tah'a abol chu amun chuin Mose chu ahungin Israel mipa chu ahuh in Egypt mipa chu athattan ahi.
7.25: Mose chun hiche Israel mite chun Pathen in keiho huhdoh dinga eihinsolpeh ahi ti geldoh nauvinte tia anagel vang chun Israel mite chun anageldoh pouvin ahi.
7.26: Chuin ajing nikhon amite agavet a ahileh, Israel mini ana kina lhonin hijeh chun aman jong chamna nasem kigon hiche miteni koma chun “Nangni sopi khat nahi lhon louham? Ipi dinga nakinah lhon ham?” atin ahile,
7.27: mikhatpa chun Mose chu ahin sondoh in, kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham? tin ahin dongin,
7.28: “Janhia Egypt mipa khat natha banga chu keima jong neitha got ham?” atin ahi.
7.29: Chuin Mosen hichu ajah phat chun, Egypt gam'a konin ajamin Midian gam apemin hiche muna chun chapa ni ahingin ahi.
7.30: Chuin kum somli jouvin Vantil hamboh meikongin Mose chu Sinai mol toh kinai gamthip a chun ana kimupi in,
7.31: Chuin Mosen hichu amun athilmu chu kidang asah in, achenaiya agavet kigot le Pakai awgin chun ahin kouvin,
7.32: “Keima napuluiteu Pathen kahi, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob Pathen kahi,” ahin tin ahile Mose jong akicha behseh jengin avengam tapon ahi.
7.33: Chuin Pathen in aseiyin, “Nakengchot sutlhan ajeh chu nadinna mun chu muntheng ahi.
7.34: Egypt gam'a kamite gentheina kamutan, akanau aw kajan ahuhdoh dinga hungkumlha kahitai, hijeh chun tun keiman nangma hi Egypt gam'a kanungsol kit nahi,” ati.
7.35: Chuin “Kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham?” tia asanlou pau chu, Pathen in hamboh lah'a kona akimusah vantil jalchun vaipo dingle thutan dingin Pathen in Mose chu alesol kit in ahile.
7.36: Mose'n thil kidang le melchihna tamtah pumin Israelte chu Egypt gam'a konin ahinpuidoh in twipisan le gamthip chu kum somli sungin ahung galkaiyun ahi.
7.37: “Chuin Mose amatah in Israelte koma anaseiyin, Pathen in keima tobang themgaokhat nangholah-a kona asodohsah ding ahi,” ati.
7.38: Mose chu gamthip a ipuluiteu toh Pathen mite kikhop khomna-a anaumkhomin, Sinai Molchunga valtil in thu aseipeh chun, khonunga eiho jouse pehson dingin hinna thu eina lahpeh-uvin ahi.
7.39: Ahinlah Ipuluiteu chun Mose thusei anangai pouvin Egypt gam'a kinungle ding ana deijo un ahi.
7.40: Ipuiluiteu chun Aaron koma aseiyun, “Eilamkai thei ding-u pathen lim themkhat neisempeh-un ajeh chu Egypt gam'a kona eihin puidoh pau Mose hi iti hitam kahetapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
7.41: Chuin bongnou toh kilou milim khat asem uvin, hiche milim henga chun kilhaina gantha asemuvin, athilsem uchu akipapi uvin ahi.
7.42: Chuin amahoa konin Pathen akihei mangin, Vana ahsiho chu apathenu hidingin adalhatan ahi! Chuin themgao lekhabun asei “Vo Israel kum somli gamthip'a nathamlaiyuva nahin choiyu kilhaina gantha le thilto ho chu keima henga ding ham?
7.43: Ahipoi, nanghon Molech ponbuh le pathen Rephan ahsi hou dinga alim nasemthu-u chu napole ji bouvui, hijeh a chu nangho Babylon gamsung chana soh-a kasol ding nahiuve,” ati.
7.44: Ipuluiteu chun gamthip noija chun Houbuh chu anapole un Pathen in Mose henga anamusah lim bang bang chun ana tungdoh ji-un ahi.
7.45: Kum phabep jouvin Joshua lamkaina a ipuluiteuvin hiche gam'a kona Pathen in ananodohho khopimun analo-uchun Pathen Houbuh chu anapolut un Leng David khang chanin ana um'in ahi.
7.46: David chu Pathen mitmun deium ana chang'in, aitih a Jacob Pathen chenna ding Houin sahna dingin anathumin ahi.
7.47: Ahin hiche houin chu Solomon in ana tungdoh in ahi.
7.48: Hijeng jongle hiche khut a kisa houin a chun Chungnungpen Pathen chu achengpoi tin, Themgaovin aseiye.
7.49: “Van kalaltouna ahin leiset kakengto ngapna ahi, chutobang chenna ding inpha chu neisahpeh thei ding ham?” tin Pakai chun adongin ahi.
7.50: Van le leiset ania kakhut a kasem hilou ham? tia asei banga chu.
7.51: “Nangho milouchalte, thutah'a dinga alungthim le ana ngong teho, aimatih chana Lhagao Theng nadoudalu hilou ham? Hichu na pului teuvin ana bola nanghon jong nabolu ahi.
7.52: Napului teuvin ana bolgim lou themgao khat umem? Chondihtah Messiah hungding thu ana sei masaho chu ana that un amatah jong namatsah un na that un ahi.
7.53: chule Vantil a kona nalah son u Pathen danthu jeng jong henasa san nanit pouvin ahi,” ati.
7.54: Stephen in athemmo nau thu asei chun Judate lamkai ho chu alunghansah lheh jengun chuin amachu akhuttum ajel khumun ahi.
7.55: Ahin Lhagao Theng dimset'in Stephen chun vanlam aven ahileh Pathen loupina le Yeshua Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna adin chu amun ahi.
7.56: Chuin aman amahojah a, “Ven vankot akihona chule Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna mihem chapa adin kamui,” ati.
7.57: Chuin amahon akhut'un anakol akisip-un apengjah un amachu anokhum jengun,
7.58: Khopi pamlanga akaidoh-un songin asep-un, chuin ama themmo chansah hochun avon chu asut-un Saul kiti khangdongpa kengbul'a chun akoiyun ahi.
7.59: Chuin songa asepettah-un Stephen chu ataovin, “Pakai Ka lhagao lan,” ati.
7.60: Chuin abohkhup in apengjah jengin, “Pakai abolho jouseu hi amaho chonsetin simpeh hih-in,” atin hiti chu athitan ahi.

8.1: Saul jong chu Stephen kitha amittah a muho lah'a khat ahin, amatah in jong aphatsah ahi. Chuin hiche nikhoa kipat chun Jerusalema Houbung suhmangna dingin suhgentheina lentah ana kipan tan ahile Solchahho tailou tahsan chate jouse chu Judea le Samaria gam'a ana kithe cheh tauvin ahi.
8.2: Chuin Pathen a dinga kipumpeh mi themkhat in Stephen chu lunghemtah in ana vuiyun ahi.
8.3: Ahin Saul chu achelen Houbungho chu ana sugentheiyin, a in tina alut in numei pasal akaidoh in songkul'a anaseplut jin ahi.
8.4: Ahinlah akithecheh tahsan chate chun achena lam lam uvah Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu alhangsamle tauvin ahi.
8.5: Vetsahnan, Philip chu Samaria khopi sunga analut in miho koma Messiah chu ana samphong in ahi.
8.6: Chuin mipi chun Philip thusei chu lungluttah in ana ngai uvin ahi.
8.7: Chuin lhagaoboh tampi anodohin ahileh amaho chu apenguvin apotdoh tauvin chule lhangthi le elbai tampi jong aboldam in ahi.
8.8: Chuin hiche khopi achun kipana lentah alhungtan ahi.
8.9: Chuin Simon kiti doithemmi khat hiche gam'a chu kumsotpi anauma ahin, ama chun milen khat kahi tia Samaria mite chu kidang satah-a anaumsah ahi.
8.10: Mijouse aneova pat alen changeiyin hichepa chu “Milen khat-Pathen thahat” tia aseiyu ahi.
8.11: Chule ama chun adoiya kona phatsottah kidang satah-a anaumsah jeh-u chun amahon aseijouse chu abonchan angai jiuvin ahi.
8.12: Ahivangin mipi ho chun Philip in Pathen lenggam thule Yeshua Christa mina thupha asei chu atahsan tauvin, hijeh chun numei-pasal tampi twiyin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
8.13: Hichun Simon jengin jong atahsan in twiyin baptize achangtan, chule Philip chena chana anung ajuitan, Philip in melchihna le thil kidang lentah tampi abol chu kidang asalheh jengin ahi.
8.14: Chuin Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria miten Pathen thu asang tauve ti ajah phat'un Peter le John chu asol tauvin ahi.
8.15: Chuin alhun lhun lhonin hiche tahsan thahho chu Lhagao Theng achanna dingun atao tauvin ahi.
8.16: Chule tahsan thahho chunga chu Lhagao Theng hungloulai ahi, ajeh chu amaho chu Yeshua mina bou baptize chang nalaiyu ahi.
8.17: Chuin Peter le John in hiche tahsan thahho chunga chu khut angap lhona ahileh amaho chu Lhagao Theng achang tauvin ahi.
8.18: Chuin Simon in Solchahho khutngap jeh a miho Lhagao Theng achanu chu amun ahileh aman jong sum peha hiche thahat chu kichoh ding agon,
