8.19: “Kenjong hiche thaneina hi neijing kate chutile kenjong miho chunga khut kangap teng amaho jong Lhagao Theng chang dingu ahi!” ati.
8.20: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Nasum le nangma suhmangin umtha tan ajeh chun Pathen thilpeh hi chohtho dingin nangaitoi,
8.21: Hichea hin nangman chan naneipoi, ajeh chu Pathen mitmun nalungthim adihpoi.
8.22: Hijeh chun nachonset lungheiyin lang, Pakai henga tao lechun aman nachonset lungput angaidam maithei ahi.
8.23: Ajeh chu nangma hi thangthipna a dimset leh chonset'a kihen-oh nahi kamuchen tai,” ati
8.24: Chuin Simon chun Peter koma, “Hitobang kichat umtah naseiho hi kachunga alhun lou nadingin Pakai koma nei taopeh in,” ati.
8.25: Chuin Samaria-a Photchet nale Pathen thu lhangsapna aneijou lhon chun, Peter le John chu Jerusalem jonin ahung kile lhon in Samaria kho muntampi ah ahung kibangpa lhonin Kipana thupha ahin lhangsam peh lhonin ahi.
8.26: Philip vang chu Pakai vantil, “Lhanglam a Jerusalem a pat Gaza jotna gamthip'a chesuh lampi a khun chetan,” atipeh in ahi.
8.27: Chuin akipatdoh in achesuh tan ahileh Ethiopia gouching mikhat akimupin, ama chu Ethiopia lengnu noiya natong lentah nukiso ahin, hiche nukiso chu Jerusalema Pathen houva che ahi.
8.28: Chule ahung kile lama kangtalaiya hungtouva Isaiah themgao lekhabu hi gingtah-a ahin sim ahi.
8.29: Chuin Lhagao Theng in Philip henga chun ahin seiyin, “Chenlang Kangtalaiya khun kilhon khom lhonin,” ati.
8.30: Chuin Philip chun aheng anaiyin ahileh mipan Isaiah themgao lekhabu asim chu ajan, hichun Philip in adongin “Nasim chu ipi kiseina ahi nahet nah em?” atile,
8.31: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Eihil ding mikhat aum loule iti kahet ding ham?” atin ahi. Chuin mipa chun Philip chu akouvin hungin lang kangtalaiya toukhom hite ati.
8.32: Chule Pathen lekhabu sunga asimmun chu hiche hi ahi, “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi nou bangin akaiyun, kelngoinou amul vouho angsunga thipbeh cha-a aum bangin, ama jong akam keh pon ahi.
8.33: Akineosahna lamin achunga adih a thutanna aumtapon, koipen'in akhang thusim asei ding hitam? Ijeh inem itile a hinkho chu leiset'a kona alahdoh'u ahitai.”
8.34: Chuin nukiso chun Philip chu adongin, “Themgaopa hin ama chung chang thudol asei ham ahiloule midang khat thudol asei ham nei seipeh in,” atin ahi.
8.35: Chuin in Philip jong chuche Pathen lekhabu muna kona pansa in Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu aseipeh pantan ahi.
8.36: Chuin ache che lhonin ahile twi umna khat ahin phah hon phatin Nukiso chun, “Ven! Hikoma khun twi aume! Baptize kachanmo nading ipi um'em?” ati.
8.37: Hijeh chun Philip in, “Nalung naheiya nalungthim pumpia natahsan pouleh hithei ding nahi,” ati. Chuin aman adonbut in, “Yeshua Christa, Pathen Chapa ahi ti katahsan e,” atitai.
8.38: Chuin akangtalai lhon chu akham lhonin, twi lah'a chun akumsuh lhonin Philip in ama chu baptize achansah tan ahi.
8.39: Chuin twi lah-a kona ahung potdoh lhon chun Pakai Lhagaovin Philip chu alamang tan ahile, nukiso chun Philip chu amupha tapon, ahin alampi a chun kipah thanom tah'in achetan ahi.
8.40: Chomkhat jouvin Philip chu sahlam a um Azotus muna chun akimudoh kit in, hichun aman Caesarea ahinphah chanin kipana thupha chu ahin sam phonglen ahi.

9.1: Ahin Saul vang chu Pakai nungjuiho gihsal le that dingin ahai hai nalaiyin, hijeh chun thempu chungnung henga achen,
9.2: Damascus khopia kikhopna in hoa dingin lekha agathumin, chule koi hijongle hiche lampi tahsanho jouse chu numei hihen, pasal hijongle akana Jerusalem ahinlhutna dingin kithopina agathumin ahi.
9.3: Hiche tupna neipuma achelaiyin Damascus khopi anaitah chun vana konin phulou helouvin vah-in akimvel ahin salin,
9.4: Chuin ama tol'a alhun chule “Saul! Saul! Ipi dinga neibolset ham?” tia kisam aw khat ajan,
9.5: Chuin Saul in jong “Pakai nang koi nahim?” tin adong tan ahi. Chuin aw chun ahin donbut-in “Keima Yeshua, nabolset jingpa chu kahi!
9.6: Tun kipatdoh in khopi sunga khun lut-in nabol ding ho nakiseipeh ding ahi,” ati.
9.7: Chuin Saul toh kilhon khom ho chu paopoh loubeh-in aum tauvin ahi, ajehchu Saul koma thusei aw chu ajauvin ahin koima la amu pouvin ahi.
9.8: Chuin Saul chu tol'a kona ahung dindoh-a amit ahasah-le kho amutapon hijeh chun alhonkhompi hon akhut-in akaiyun Damascus khopi sung alut tauvin ahi.
9.9: Chuin khopi sunga chun nithum sungin an nelou twidon louvin aumden tan ahi.
9.10: Chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan mikhat amin Ananias kitipa chu Pakaiyin akimusah in “Ananias!” tin akouvin ahileh amapan, “Hikoma kaumnai Pakai!” atin ahi.
9.11: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in “Namasanga lampi jangkeiya khun chenlang Judas in'a khun galut tan, chule insunga khu nalut tengle Tarsus gammi Saul kitipa chu gahol tan ajeh chu ama kahenga ataopettah ahi.
9.12: Chule hichepa khun Ananias kiti mikhat ahenga hunga aluchunga khut angap'a chutengle kho amukit ding khu kamusah ahi,” ati.
9.13: Ahivangin Ananias in adonbut in “Pakai hiche mipa hin Jerusalema tahsan chate kichat umtah-a abol genthei thu mitam tah-a kona kajah ahitai,
9.14: chule hoilai mun hijong le nangma min kouho jouse amat a songkul'a akhum thei nadinga thempu pipuihon thaneina apeh'u ahitai,” ati.
9.15: Ahin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Chen ajeh chu Saul khu chidang namdangte le lengho chuleh Israelte henga kathu lhangsam dinga kalhendoh ahitai,
9.16: Chule tua hi kamin jal'a itobang genthei athoh ding ham kavetsah ding ahi,” ati.
9.17: Chuin Ananias chu achen ahileh Saul chu amutan hichun aluchunga akhut angamin aseitai, “Sopi Saul, kho namukit nading le Lhagao Thenga nadimsetna dinga lampia nakimusah Pakai Yeshua chun nahenga eihin sol ahi,” ati.
9.18: Chuin apettah chun lip tobang thilkhat Saul mit a kon chun ahung kilehlhan ahileh Saul chun kho amutan ahi. Chutah chun Saul chu akipatdoh in baptize achangtan ahi.
9.19: Chujouvin Saul chun an themkhat anen ahileh athahatdoh kit tan, chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan chate koma chun nikho phabep aum den tan ahi.
9.20: Chule apettah chun Yeshua thudol chu asamphong pantan kikhopna in tin'ah, “Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahi,” tin asamle tan ahi.
9.21: Chuin athu lhangsap japha jousen kidang asauvin, “Hichepa hi Jerusalema Yeshua seijuiho suhmang ding gopa chu hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi. Chule “Hikoma hi seijuiho man dingle kanchoma thempu ho henga kaidinga hung hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi
9.22: Saul thulhangsap chu ahung thahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahileh Damascus khopia um Juda mite chun Yeshua chu Messiah ahi ti avetsahna apeh ho chu anel jou tapouvin ahi.
9.23: Chuche phat chomkhat jou chun Judah mite phabep khat ahung khomun ama chu thading agouvin,
9.24: Ama chu thatei nadingin khopi kelkot dunga sun le jan in achanglhi jingun, ahin mihon thading agonu thu chu aseipeh un,
9.25: Hijeh chun seijuiho mi phabep khat chun jankah in Saul chu boma akhumun khopi bang onglai khat'ah khaovin akhai lha tauvin ahi.
9.26: Chuin Saul chu Jerusalem ahung lhunin, seijuiho kimupi ding agon ahileh amaho abonun akichauvin ahi ajeh chu seijui dihtah ahiding chu atahsan lou-u ahi!
9.27: Chuin Barnabas chun Saul chu solchah ho henga apuilut in Damascus lampia Saul in Pakai akimupi thule Pakaiyin Saul henga asei thuho abonchan solchah ho henga aseipeh in chule Damascus khopia Saul in Yeshua mina hangsan tah-a thu asei jong chu aseipeh in ahi.
9.28: Chuin Saul chu solchah ho chutoh aumkhom tan, Jerusalem kimvela avahle un hangsan tah in Pakai minin thu alhangsam tan ahi.
9.29: Chuin Greek pao tho Juda te toh akinil un ahile Juda miho chun thading agouvin ahi.
9.30: Seijui hon chuche thu ajah phat'un Caesarea lama apuisuh un achenna Tarsus lama asol mang tauvin ahi.
9.31: Chuin Judea gam le Galilee gamsung chule Samaria gamsung pumpia Houbung chu mongtah-in aumtauvin chule seijui hon Pakai agin jeh'u chun athahat cheh cheh uvin ahi. Chule Lhagao Theng in aumpi jeh-u chun seijui jong akibe jingin ahi.
9.32: Chujongle Peter chu munkhat a konin munkhat ah avahle len chuin Lydda khopia seijui ho vilding in ahung kumsuh in ahile,
9.33: Hikoma chun Aeneas kiti mikhat langthi-a kumget jen jalkhun a lumpa chu agamudoh tan,
9.34: Chuin Peter in ajah a “Aeneas, Yeshua Christan nadamsah ahitai! Thouvin lang nalupna kijeldoh tan,” ati. Chupettah chun ama adamtan ahi.
9.35: Chuin Lydda le Sharon khopi sunga mijouse chun Aeneas in lam ajot-a avale chu amu-uvin, abonchauvin Pakai lamah ahung kihei tauvin ahi.
9.36: Chuin Joppa atiu mun a chun seijui mikhat Tabitha (Greek paova Dorcas) atiu chu aumin, amanu chun midang dingin thilpha abol jingin, genthei ho akithopi jingin ahi.
9.37: Amanu chu ahung dammo in athitan ahileh atahsa chu asiltheng-uvin vuidingin indan chungnunga chun alupsah tauvin ahi.
9.38: Ahivangin seijuiho chun Peter chu Lydda koma aume tithu ajauvin hijeh chun mini asol-uvin, Peter henga “Lungset tah-in aganna thei penin hungin,” tin aga kousah tauvin ahi.
9.39: Chuin Peter chu akouva cheteni chutoh ahung kile khomin ahileh ahung lhun lhun chun amahon Peter chu indan chungnunga chun apuitouvun ahileh insunga chun meithai ho adimset uvin kap pumin a sangkhol hou-le von dang Dorcas in adam laiya anabolpeh houchu avetsah'un ahi.
9.40: Ahivangin Peter chun abonchauvin insunga konchun asoldoh-in chuin ama adilsun atahsa alupsah-u chu aven “Thoudoh in Tabitha,” tin atao tan ahileh amit ahung hahdoh in, chuin amanun Peter amuphat in ahung toudoh tan ahi.
9.41: Chuin aman akhut in akaiding in chule meithaiho le seijuiho chu abonchan akoulut-in amanu chu ahing in apetan ahi.
9.42: Hiche thu chu khopi sunga akithang soh tan ahileh mitam tah-in Pakai atahsan tan ahi.
9.43: Chule Peter chu Joppa muna savun sem Simon in'ah nisottah aum dentan ahi.

10.1: Rome te sepai lamkai Cornelius atiu mikhat Caesarea ah ana chengin, ama chu Italia loi atiu sepai jalamkai ahi.
10.2: Amapa chu Pathen ngaisah tah le ainsung mi jouse toh Pathen gingmi ahin; migenthei ho hongphal tah-a pejing le Pathen henga taojing mi ahi.
10.3: Nikhat nilhah lam nidan thum donin mu aneiyin athilmu achun Pathen vantil khat ahenga ahungin “Cornelius!” ahung tin ahi.
10.4: Chuin Cornelius chun kichatah-in aven, “Ipi ham Pakai,” tin adong tan ahi. Chule Vantil chun ahin donbut in, “Nataona le migenthei ho dinga nathilpeh ho chu Pathen in thilto bangin nasanpeh tai!
10.5: Tun nangman mi themkhat solin lang Joppa-a um Simon Peter kitipa khu gakousah tan.
10.6: Ama twikhanglen panga Simon kiti savun sem mikhat in'ah aume,” ati.
10.7: Chuin vantil in adalhah lhah in Cornelius chun ainsunga lhacha ni le akinbola pang jing Pathen ngaisah tah sepai ho lah a khat akouvin,
10.8: Thilsoh jouse aseipeh jouvin amaho chu Joppa ah asol tan ahi.
10.9: Ajing nikho in Cornelius thupoho khopi sung alhun ding konun Peter chu indan chunga tao dingin ahung kaldoh in hichu sun nidan som don ahi.
10.10: Chule ama chu agilkel in, ahivangin aneh ding an asem laitah-un ama agaochangin,
10.11: Chuin vankot akihona lekha pheng lentah tobang khat aning lia ahung kikhai lhah amun,
10.12: Chuin hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sunga chun ganhing namkim le tol'a vah ganhing chule chunga leng vacha ho aumun,
10.13: Chuin aw khat in ahenga ahin seiyin, “Peter, kipatdoh inlang chule kithan lang nen,” ati.
10.14: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Ahipoi Pakai, ajeh chu imatih chanin keiman Judate dan thu dungjuiya satheng lou le saboh kanekhapoi,” ati.
10.15: Ahivangin aw chun ahinsei kit-in, “Pathen in asuhtheng sa chu athenglou tidan,” ati.
10.16: chuti chun thumveijen kibang chet'in mu aneiyin chujouvin hetmanlou kah'in lekha pheng lentah tobang chu vana khai touvin aumtan ahi.
10.17: Chuin Peter chun gaova athilmu chu ipi kiseina ahidem tia lunggim tah-a ana umlaitah in Cornelius in ahin sol miho chun Simon in chu ahin holdoh-un, amaho chu kelkot ah ana dinguvin,
10.18: Amaho chun hiche laiya hi Simon Peter kiti mikhat cheng em tin adong-un ahi.
10.19: Chuin Peter in gaova athilmu chu ipi ahidem tia ana gel jing laiyin Lhagao Thengin ahenga thu ahin seiyin, “Mithum tah in nangma nahol'e,
10.20: Kipatdoh in, kumsuh inlang amaho toh kilhon ding khu thase hih beh in, chule lungkham hih in ajeh chu keiman amaho khu kahin sol ahi,” ati.
10.21: Chuin Peter akum suh in amaho koma “Nahol-u mipa chu keima kahi, ipi dinga hung nahiu vem?” tin adong tan ahile,
10.22: Amahon adonbut-un, “Keiho hi Cornelius kiti Pathen gingtah mi chule Judaten ajabol-u Rome sepai jalamkai pa chun eihin sol-u ahin, chule nangma thusei hi ainsung mite toh angaithei nadinga vantil theng khat'in thu apeh bang banga nakouva hung kahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
10.23: Chuin Peter in amaho chu akoulut in a-in'ah jankhat agesah-in, ajing in Joppa a kona sopi themkhat toh akilhon tauvin ahi.
10.24: Ajing nikhon amaho Caesarea ahung lhung tauvin ahile Cornelius in a-insung mite le aloi agolho ana koukhomin ana ngah tauvin ahi.
10.25: Chuin Peter insunga alut in ahile Cornelius chu akengbula abohkhup in chibai abohtan ahi.
10.26: Ahinlah Peter chun akai dingin, “Dingdoh in keijong nang banga mihem khat kahi bouve!” ati.
10.27: Chuti chun amani akihoulim lim lhonin insunga mitampi kikhop khomna achun alut lhon in,
10.28: Chuin Peter in amaho henga chun, “Judah mikhat hitia chidang namdangte in'a alut hi Judah te chonna dan toh kitoh lou ahi naheuve, Ahin Pathen in koima aboh le athenglou tia kagel lou nadinga eimusah ahitai.
10.29: Hijeh a chu lungthoi louhela eihin kou banga kahung jeng ahi. Tun ipi dinga neihin kou ham seitan,” ati.
10.30: Chuin Cornelius in adonbut in, “Nili masang, tuphat chet nilhah lang nidan thum donin ka insunga kataovin ahileh, hetman lou kah-in ka masang laitah a ponbanga kivon mikhat ka-anga ahung dingin;
10.31: Hitin ahin seiyin ahi, ‘Cornelius Pathen in nataona ajatan genthei ho dinga nathil pha bol jong amutai!
10.32: Tun nangman Joppa a mi solin lang, Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan. Ama twikhanglen panga Simon kiti savun sempa in'ah aume’ ati.
10.33: Hijeh a chu nangma kouva mi kahin sol ahin, nahung hi apha lheh jenge, chule tun Pakaiyin thu napehho ngaiding in hikoma Pathen angsunga ahin ibon chauvin iki khom tauve,” ati.
10.34: Chuin Peter in adon but-in, “Pathen in mi lungset tum anei poi ti kichen tah in kamutai;
10.35: Ahin chitin namtin lah a koi hijongle Ama ginga thildih bolho chu ama dinga lahthei ahi.
10.36: Chule hiche hi Israel chatea dinga kipana thupha ahi–Yeshua Christa mijouse Pakai vanga Pathen toh kichamna aum hi.
10.37: John in twilut thudol ahin lhangsap pat a pat Galilee a kipan Judea gam pumpia ipi thilsoh em nanghon naheuve.
10.38: Chule Pathen in Nazareth Yeshua chu Lhagao Theng le thahatna-a thao anua chule Yeshua avalea thilpha abolho leh Pathen in aumpi jal'a satan suhgima umho aboldam chu nanghon naheuve.
10.39: Chule keiho solchahho hi Judah gam pumpi le Jerusalema athilbol ho jouse hettohsah kahiuve. Ama chu thingpel chunga akhaisang un athat tauve.
10.40: Ahin Pathen in ama chu anithum nin akaithou vin aki phondohsah tan ahi.
10.41: Hichu mijouse henga hilouvin, athu hettohsah dinga Pathen in ana lhendoh sa, athodoh jouva amatoh nekhom le donkhom keiho henga kiphong ahi.
10.42: Chule Yeshua chu mihing le mithi ho jouse thutan ahi ti thudol hi hille ding le hettoh sah dinga keiho hi thu eipeh-u ahi.
10.43: Ama tahsan ho jouse Amin jal a achonset nau kingaidam ding ahi tia themgao ho jousen ahettoh sah-u chu ama chu ahi,” ati.
10.44: Chuin Peter in thu hicheng asei jing laiyin athu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung chutan ahile,
10.45: Peter toh hung khom Judah mi atahsan ho chun chidang namdang te chunga jong Lhagao Theng akipeh chu kidang asalheh jengun ahi.
10.46: Ijeh-inem itile amahon paochom paochoma thu aseiyuva Pathen avahchoi uchu ajah-u ahi.
10.47: Chuin Peter in adong un, “Eiho banga Lhagao Theng changa hiteho baptize chanlouna dinga twi kham theiya koi umam?” ati.
10.48: Chuin aman Yeshua Christa mina baptize chang dingin amaho chu thu apetan, chujouvin Cornelius in amaho henga nikho phabep um ding'in alhotan ahi.

11.1: Chidang namdang ten Pathen thu akisan thu chu Judah gam'a um solchahho le seijui dangho henga gangtah in alhung tan;
11.2: Ahinlah Peter Jerusalem ahung lelhun phat in Judahmi atahsanho chun ana oimo un;
11.3: “Chidang namdang te insunga nalut in chule an jong naga neh khompie,” atiuvin ahi.
11.4: Chuin Peter in amaho heng-ah thilsoh jouse kicheh tah-in aseipeh in hitin aseiyin ahi.
11.5: “Keima Joppa khopia kauma katao jing laiyin gaochangin mu kaneiyin, lekha pheng lentah tobang aning lin vana konin ahung kikhai lhan, keima komtah ahung geiyin;
11.6: Chuin keiman hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sung chu kaven ahileh leiset chunga umsa akengli hole gamsa chule aop a kithol le chunga leng vacha kamun,
11.7: Chuin vana kona awgin khat kajan ‘Peter thoudoh inlang kitha inlang nen’” ati.
11.8: Ahipoi Pakai, keiho Judah te chona danin aboh le athenglou tia asei jouse imacha kane khapoi kati.
11.9: “Ahin vana kona awgin chun avelin ahin seikit in, ‘Pathen in asuhthengsa thilkhat chu athenglou tihih in,’” ati.
11.10: Hiche thilsoh chu thumveijen kijomin eimusah in chujouvin abonchan vana akikhai tou kit tan ahi.
11.11: Chutah chun Caesarea a kona mithum hung kisol ho chu kaum nau inmun ahung lhung paiyun ahi.
11.12: Chuin Lhagao Theng in kahenga ahin seiyin amaho chutoh kilhon'a chule amaho chidang namdang ahijeh'a ima lungthoina neilou dingin ahin seiyin ahi. Chuin sopi migup chun ei kilhonpiuvin gangtah in ahin solpau in chu kaga lhung tauvin ahi.
11.13: Chuin amapa chun thilsoh umchan jouse chu keiho henga chun aseiyin, ahenga vantil akilah-a Joppa a mi solin lang Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan,
11.14: Chutengle aman nang le na insungmi te jouse huhhing nathu naseipeh ding ahi! ati.
11.15: Chuin Peter chun aseikit in, “Thusei kahinpan in ahileh abul'a eiho chunga ahung kibuh lhah bangin ama ho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung kibunglhan,
11.16: Chun Pakaiyin ‘John in twiya baptize achansah ahin ahinlah nangman Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah dinga ahi’ tia Pakai thusei chu kalunga ahung kilang in ahi.
11.17: Chule eihon Pakai Yeshua Christa itahsan nikhouva Pathen in eipeh-u Lhagao Theng chu chidang namdang te jong apeh ahitah le kei chu koi kahi-a Pathen masanga kadin ding ham?” atin ahi.
11.18: Chuin midang hon chuche thu chu ajah phat-un athip tauvin Pathen avahchoi tauvin ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun, “Pathen in chidang namdang tedinga jong chonset lunghei nading le tonsot hina akisan thei nadinguva phatpha apeh hi imu tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
11.19: Alangkhat ah Stephen thijouva seijuiho kibol gentheina jeh a jamcheh ho chu Phoenicia, Cyprus le Syria gam'a Antioch changeiyin ajamun, chule Judah te henga bou Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
11.20: Hijeng jongle Cyprus le Cyrene gam'a kona Antioch khopia che seijui phabep ho chun chidang namdang te henga Pakai Yeshua thu alhangsam uvin ahi.
11.21: Pakai thahatna amaho chunga aumjeh chun chidang namdang te laha mitam tah in Pakai lama lung aheiyun atahsan tauvin ahi.
11.22: Chuin Jerusalema Houbung in hiche thu ajah phat-un Barnabas chu Antioch'a asol tauvin ahile,
11.23: Amun alhun phat in Pathen phatthei bohna chu amun akipah lheh jengin hichun aman seijui ho chu Pakaiya dihtah-a umjing dingin atilkhouvin ahi.
11.24: Ajeh chu Barnabas chu miphatah Lhagao Thenga dimjing le Tahsanna a dettah mi ahin, mitam tah Pakaiyah ahin puilutbe uvin ahi.
11.25: Chuin Barnabas chu Tarsus lama Saul hol dingin ana chepai tan ahi.
11.26: Chuin amu phat-in Antioch lama ahin nungpui kit in amani Antioch houbunga chun kumlhung keiyin aumden lhonin mipi tamtah ahiljing lhonin ahi. Hiche Antioch'a hi seijui ho Christian tia akou masat penu ahi.
11.27: Hiche phatlai hin themgao phabep Jerusalema kon Antioch'a acheuvin,
11.28: Amaho lah'a Agabus atiu themgaopa chu kikhop khomna khat'a ading doh in lhagaovin Rome gamsung pumpia kel nasatah hunglhung ding ahi tin aphondoh sah tan ahi (Hiche gaothu hi Claudius vaipoh laiyin aguilhung in ahi).
11.29: Chuin Antioch'a um seijui ho chun Judah gam'a um sopi hoa dinga kithopina thot dingin agel lha tauvin ahile abonchauvin atamthei penin atohkhom tauvin ahi.
11.30: Chuin hiche athil tokhomu chu Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema Houbung upa ho khut a apehlut lhon dingin nganse na anei tauvin ahi.

12.1: Chuin hiche phatlai chun Leng Herod Agrippa chun Houbung sunga seijui phabep ho chu ahin sugim pan tan ahi.
12.2: Chuti chun John sopipa solchah Jacob chu chemjamin ana thattan ahi.
12.3: Hiche thilsoh hin Judah te akipahsah chu Herod in amu phat in Peter jong chu aman in, (Hiche thilsoh hi Kalchuh Kut kimanlai ahi).
12.4: Chuin ama chu Songkul'a akhum tan angah dingin Sepai lili a kiloikhom loili akoiyin ahi. Herod in Kalchuh Kut kichai tengle mipi anga Peter chu dinsah dinga lung angaito ahi.
12.5: Ahin Peter songkul'a aum phat chun Houbung mite chu lunglut tah in ama dingin atao tauvin ahi.
12.6: Chuin mipi anga dinsah dinga agot jan chun Peter chu sepai ni kikah a thihkhao ni a kihena ihmu ahin; angah ho jong chu kotbula ding'ah ahiuvin ahi.
12.7: Chuin hetmanlou kah in vah hattah khat in aumna mun chu ahin salvah in chule Pakai vantil chu Peter angsunga ahung dingin, chuin Vantil chun Peter pangpeh abengin “Thoudoh loiyin,” tin asukhang tan ahile akihenna thih khao jong chu akilham tan ahi.
12.8: Chuin Vantil chun Peter jah-a “Kivondoh loiyin lang na kengchot kisen,” asei bangin Peter in aboltan ahile Vantil chun “Napon kisil in lang kanung hinjui jin,” tin thu apetan ahi.
12.9: Chuin Peter in aumna mun chu adalhan Vantil nung chu ajui tan ahi. Ahin Peter in thilsoh jouse chu gaochanga munei bangin akigelin atah tah ahilam ahedoh pon ahi.
12.10: Chuin amanin kot ngah masa le anina akhel phat lhonin khopi sung lam jotna a thih kot phung chu agei lhonin, kot chu amani dingin achamin akihong jengin, chuin amani achedoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajot lhung lhonin ahile, hichun Vantil chun ama adalha pai tan ahi.
12.11: Chuin Peter in kho ahin hedoh tan, “Thilsoh chu atah ahi! Pakaiyin a Vantil ahin solin Herod lengpa leh Judah lamkai hon kachunga abolgot'u thilsea konin eihuh doh-e,” ati.
12.12: Chuin aman thilsoh ho ahin hetdoh phat in John Mark nu Mary in'a achetan ahile mitam tah ana taokhomun,
12.13: Chuin aman kot chu akiuvin ahile soh numei Rhoda kiti nu chu kot hong dingin ahung in ahi.
12.14: Chuin numei nu chun Peter awso ahi ahetdoh phat chun kot jong hong louvin insunga anung lhailut in miho jah-a chun “Peter kotbula adinge!” agatin ahi.
12.15: Chuin miho chun amanu jah a “Angol thim nahim,” atiuve, ahin amanu chun ahi mong monge ati phat chun amaho chun akhutile “Alhagao hinah ta,” atiuvin ahi.
12.16: Alangkhat'ah Peter in kot chu akiu kiu jengin ahi. Achainakeiya amahon kot chu ahona avet'u le Peter chu amu phat un kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
12.17: Chuin Peter in amaho chu thipbeh a um ding'in akhut in avetsah in, amaho koma chun Pakaiyin kidangtah a songkul'a kona ahin puidoh dan thusim chu asei peh tan ahi. Chule “Hiche thu chu Jacob le asopiho seipeh un,” atin ama hikoma kon chun munchoma achetan ahi.
12.18: Chuin kho ahung vah phat in sepai ho chun i-atileh Peter chu songkul'a kona potdoh thei ham tin alung dong lheh jeng uvin ahi.
12.19: Chuin Herod lengpan sepai ho koma chun Peter chu phatecha ahol nadingun thu apen ahin lah amu deh lou phat un, songkul ngah a pang sepai ho chu thudoh aneiyin ajonan amaho chu athat tan ahi. Chujou chun Herod lengpa jong Judah gam dalhan phat chomkhat um ding'in Caesarea ajon tan ahi.
12.20: Tun Herod lengpa chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga alung hang lheh jeng tan ahileh amahon thalheng in mi asol uvin amaho chun Herod lengpa noiya natong Blastus chu athujo jouvun Herod lengpa toh chamna semding in aga thum tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu Tyre le Sidon gamsunga ding neh le chah hi Herod lengpa gamsunga kona hungji ahi.
12.21: Chuin Herod in athum nau chu asanpeh in akitep nikhou ahung lhunin Herod in aleng von ahin kivon in, aleng touna-a atouvin amaho koma chun thu asei tan ahi.
12.22: Chuin mipi ho chun “Hiche hi mihem awso ahipoi, Pathen aw ahi,” atiuvin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
12.23: Chuin mipi hon chutia asap pettah-u chun Herod in Pathen loupina peh sangin ama akiloupi sah tan ahile Pakai vantil in Herod chunga natna ahin lhunsah tan, chuti chun lungin anen athitan ahi.
12.24: Alangkhat'ah Pathen thu chu akithe jal jingin seijui apung jingin ahi.
12.25: Chuin Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema akin hon achai lhon phat in John Mark apui lhon in akile tauvin ahi.

13.1: Antioch Houbung sunga Themgao le mihil ho chu, Barnabas, Simeon (mivompa), Lucius (Cyrene mi), Manaen (Herod Antipas golpa), chule Saul ahiuve.
13.2: Chuin Nikhat amaho hin an ngola Pathen ahoukhom pet-un Lhagao Theng in amaho koma chun “Barnabas le Saul chu kakouna natong dingin lhandoh tauvin,” ahin tin ahi.
13.3: Chuin amahon an ngola taona hatah-a anei jouvun amani chunga chun khut angam un, ataopeh jouvun asoldoh tauvin ahi.
13.4: Chuin Barnabas le Saul chu Lhagao Theng in asoldoh lhon tan ahile, amani Seleucia kongkai muna achesuh lhon in chuin Cyprus twikol jon dingin konga atou lhon tan ahi.
13.5: Chuche muna Salamis khopi alhun hon phat in Judah te kikhop khomna hoa alut lhon in Pathen thu asamphong le hon tan ahi. Chule John Mark jong amani kithopi dingin akilhon uvin ahi.
13.6: Chuin amani twikol sung pumpi a chun khopi khat a kon in khopi khat ah avahle lhonin Paphos chan in achelhon in ahile hiche lai muna chun Bar-Yeshua kiti Judah mi doichoi le themgao lhemkhat akimupi lhon in ahi.
13.7: Chule amapa chu gamvaipo miching tah Sergius Paulus koma uma ahi. Chuin gamvaipo pa chun Pathen thu angai nom jeh chun Barnabas le Saul chu akou tan ahi.
13.8: Ahinlah Elymas kiti doichoi mikhat ahung kikum lut in gamvaipo chun Barnabas le Saul thusei chu atahsan louna tei dingin hiche teni thusei hi ngaipeh hih in tin aseiyin ahi.
13.9: Chuin Paul tiajong kihe Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset in, chule aman doichoi mipa chu aven,
13.10: “Nangma Diabol chapa, Jou le jona milhemlha, thilpha jouse dinga melma pa! Pathen lamdih a kona mihem puimang ding hi nangah louhel ding ham?
13.11: Ven tun Pakai mijep na khut chu nachunga hung chu ding chule namit choding phat chomkhat khovah namulou ding ahitai.”
13.12: Hiche thilsoh chu gamvaipo chun amu phat in ama jong seijui ho lah a ajao tan ahi ajeh chu Pakai thudol thuhil chu kidang asah val jeng ahi.
13.13: Chuin Paul le alhon khompi ho chun Paphos dalhan Pamphylia jon dingin konga akitolun Perga muna akinga tauvin, chule hiche muna kon chun John Mark chu Jerusalem lama akile tan ahi.
13.14: Ahin Paul le Barnabas vang chu keng lam in Pisidia gam'a Antioch chan achelhon in, chuin cholngah nikhon amani jong kikhom dingin kikhop khomna in ah alut lhon tan ahi.
13.15: Chuin angaiya Mose le Themgao lekhabu asim jouvun kikhopna-a lamkai hon amani koma chun “Sopi teni mipi ho tilkhouna dinga seinom nanei honle hung sei lhonin,” tin phat apeuvin ahi.
13.16: Chuin Paul ading doh in akhut alhang in mipi ho chu thipbeh cha-a um ding'in aseiyin, chuin aman aseitai, “Israel mite hole Pathen ging'ah chidang namdang teho, ngaiyuvin,
13.17: Hiche Israel nampi Pathen chun ipu ipateu ana lhengdoh in Egypt gam'a chun apunsah uvin chule thahattah nampi khat in ahin semdoh tan ahi. Chuin athahat nan Egypt mite khut ah asoh chan nauva konin ahin huh doh in,”
13.18: Gamthip noiya kum somli jen ahin puiyin,
13.19: Chuin Canaan gamsunga nam sagi jen asumang in, agam sungu chu Israel ten aloding in apetan ahi.
13.20: Hiche thilsoh hi kum 450 sunga soh ahi. Chujouvin Israel chate chunga vaihom ding in Pathen thutan vaihom ho ana pen ama ho chun Samuel themgao pa khang chanin vai anahom un ahi.
13.21: Chuin mipi chun leng ana thum'un, ahile Pathen in Benjamin phunga kon Kish chapa Saul chu ana pen ama chun kum somli lengvai anapon ahi.
13.22: Ahin Pathen in Saul chu leng muna konin ana ladoh in David chu ana tung tan ahi. Pathen in David thudola hitin ana seiye “Keiman kalung gottah mi Jesse Chapa David kamutai, aman kalunggot jouse abol ding ahi” ati.
13.23: Chule Pathen in Israelte huhdoh dinga athutep Yeshua chu leng David insunga kon ahi.
13.24: Ama ahung masang in twilutsah John in Israel mipi jousen chonset lung aheiya Pathen koma akilekit uva chule twiya Baptize achanna dingu thu ana lhangsam in ahi.
13.25: Chuin John in atoh ding kin achaiphat in aman adong in “keihi Messiah nei hisah uham? Kahipoi! Ahin Ama hungvah ding ahi, chule keima akengchot khao sutlha a pang asolchah khat dinga jong lhing jou kahipoi.”
13.26: Sopite, Abraham son ho le chidang namdang Pathen ging mite ho, Hiche huhhingna thuphahi eiho dinga hung kisol ahi.
13.27: Jerusalem mite le alamkai teuvin themgao hon Yeshua thudol aseiyu ahilam ahepouve. Chusang in themmo achanun hiche jeng jong hin cholngah niseh a themgao ho thucheng aguilhun sah ahi.
13.28: Chule dan dung juiya tha nading themmo najong amu pouvin, ahin Pilate henga chun atha teitei nading in angeh un ahi.
13.29: Chuin themgao vin achungchang thudol asei jouse aboljou soh phat un, thingpel chunga konin ala lhauvin lhanah alup sah tauvin ahi.
13.30: Ahivangin Pathen in thina-a konin akaithou kittai.
13.31: Chuin nikho phabep jouvin Galilee a kona Jerusalem lampia akilhon khompi ho henga ama akiphong in tun amaho Israel mite henga hettoh sah in apang uvin ahi.
13.32: Tunia keiho hiche laiya hi Pathen in ipu ipateu henga ana kitepna thupha choiya hung kahiuve.
13.33: Chule hiche hi ason achilhah eiho jouse henga Pathen in Yeshua akaithou vanga aguilhunsah ahi. Hiche thudol hi Psalm lekhabu nina in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Nangma kachapa, tunin keima napa kahitai.”
13.34: Ajeh chu Pathen in lhana monlha bep ding hilouva thina-a kona kaithou dinga ana thutepsa ahi. Pathen in aseiyin, “David henga kakitepna phattheina kiselguh chu nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
13.35: Psalm lekhabu dang khat'ah ahilchen be in, Nami theng chu lhan'a namon den sah lou ding ahi,” ati.
13.36: Chule hiche thuhi David aseina ahipoi, ajeh chu David chun ama khang sunga Pathen lunggot lam abol jouvin athi in apu apate toh akivui khomin chule atahsa jong amon mang tan ahi.
13.37: Ahipoi! Hiche thuhi Pathen in atahsa mon mang louva akaithou midang khat kiseina ahi.
13.38: Sopite ho, ngaiyun! Hiche Yeshua vanga chonset ngaidamna aum thudol lhangsama kahiuve.
13.39: Koi hijong le ama tahsan chan chu Pathen anga themchanga kisim ding ahi chule hiche hi Mose dan in aboltheipoi.
13.40: Chingtheiyun! Themgao thusei hohi nangho chunga chuh sah hih un, ajeh chu amahon hitin aseiyuve;
13.41: “Veuvin mi nuisat ho, kidang sauvin lang thidoh un, ajeh chu nangho phat laiyin thilkhat kabolin, hiche thil khat kabol chu mikhat in naheng uva ahung sei jong le natahsan pouve.” ati.
13.42: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chu kikhopna in'a konin apotdoh lhonin ahile mipi chun akham uvin hapta kit le asei lhon jouse avelsei kit lhon dingin angeh-un ahi.
13.43: Chuin Judah mi tamtah le hougut Judah houva lut mitampi chun Paul le Barnabas chu ajui tauvin ahile amanin amaho chu Pathen milungsetna a umdet jing ding in atil khou lhon tan ahi.
13.44: Chuin a-hapta kit in khopi sunga mipi atamjo Pathen thungai ding in ahung khomun ahi.
13.45: Ahin Judah mi abang chun mipi chu aveu vin ahile athangse uvin, hijeh chun Paul thusei jouse chu anelkal un ahi.
13.46: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun hangsan tah in alhangsam lhonin asei lhon tai, “Nangho Judah te henga Pathen thu kalhangsap masah lhon ding hi ngaikhoh ahi, ahin nanghon napampai uva, nangho le nanghon tonsot hinna changdia lomlouva thu nakitan tah jeh un, chidang namdang te henga kache lhon ding ahitai.
13.47: Ajeh chu Pathen in, ‘vannoi leiset pumpia huhhing na thupole dinga, chidang namdang te lah-a vah'a kasem lhon nahi,’ atia chu chidang namdang te lah a eisol lhon ahitai,” ati lhon e.
13.48: Chuin chidang namdang ten hiche thu ajah phat un hapan akipah in Pakai athangvah un chule tonsot hina chang dinga kilhengdoh ho jouse chu seijui in apang tauvin ahi.
13.49: Chuin hiche gamkai sung se achun Pathen thu chu akithe jal tan ahi.
13.50: Chuin Judah techun hougut numei ho le khopi sunga lamkai ho chu atil seuvin Paul le Barnabas chu khopi sunga konin adel mang sah tauvin ahi.
13.51: Chuin amanin apampai lhon vetsahnan akenglhona khobon athing lha lhonin Iconium ajon lhon tan ahi.
13.52: Chule Seijui ho chu kipana le Lhagao vin adimset tauvin ahi.

14.1: Chuin angai ngaiyin Iconium muna jong Paul le Barnabas chu Judah te kikhopna insunga alut lhonin thanei tah in thu alhangsam kit lhonin ahile Judah te le chidang namdang mitampin atahsan kit uvin ahi.
14.2: Ahinlah Judah te mi konkhat in Pathen thu sanglou vin chidang namdang te lungthim sunga Barnabas le Paul dounan thina thei gu akhum peh un ahi.
14.3: Ahin solchah teni chu hiche lai muna chun sottah aumden lhonin Pakai mi ngailutna thu chu hangsan tah in alhangsam jing lhonin chule athu lhangsap lhon chu atah ahi vetsahna dingin melchih na le bolmo kidang tampi abol lhonin ahi.
14.4: Ahinlah hiche khopi sunga miho chu lunggel ni in akihom khen un, konkhat chun Judah te ajop un konkhat ma chun solchah teni thu ajop un ahi.
14.5: Chuin chidang namdang mitam tah le Judah techun alamkai tehou toh kithon songa se-a delkhum ding lung angaito tauvin ahi.
14.6: Chuin Solchah hon chuche thu ahet lhih phat un Lycaonia gamsunga Lystra le Derbe khopi chule akimvel gamhoa dingin ana jamlut tauvin,
14.7: Chule hiche gamsunga chun kipana thupha chu asam phong le tauvin ahi.
14.8: Chuin Lystra-a aumpet un, Paul le Barnabas chun apena pat a akeng phang chatmoa lam pumjot theilou mikhat amu lhonin amapa chu atouvin,
14.9: Chule Paul thusei chu angaiyin ahi. Chuin Paul in amapa chu ave jangkei in ahile amapa chun damna dinga tahsanna anei chu amutan ahi.
14.10: Chuin Paul in aw sangtah in akouvin, “Dingdoh in!” ati. Chuin mipa chu akichomin lam ajot tan ahi.
14.11: Chuin mipi chun Paul thilbol chu amu tauvin ahile amaho pao vin asam un, “Hiche miteni hi mihem lima um pathen ahi!” atiuvin ahi.
14.12: Barnabas chu Greek mite pathen Zeus ahin Paul chun thuseiya pang ahijeh chun Hermes ahi ati tauvin ahi.
14.13: Chuin Zeus houbuh chu khopi pamlama umah ahin, houbuh a natong thempu ho le mipi ho chun bongchal le pahvui khopi kelkot phunga chun ahin pouvin solchah teni ding chun kilhaina agong tauvin ahi.
14.14: Ahin solchah Paul le Barnabas in thil umchan thu ajah lhon phat in atija behseh lhonin avon lhon asat-eh lhonin mipi lah a konin ajam lhon tan, aw sang tah in asam lhonin,
14.15: “Golteho, ipi dinga hitobang hi nabol uham? Keini hi nangho tobanga mihem mai mai kahi lhon bouve! Hiche panna bei thilhoa kona van le leiset, twikhanglen le asunga thil umjouse sempa Pathen hingjing henga nahung lut nathei diuva kipana thupha kahin poh lhon ahi bouve.
14.16: Phat masa lai chun namtin ama ama lung lam cheh a ache theina dingin ana phal in ahi.
14.17: Ahin amaho koma jong chun Ama hina le aphatna kiphong louvin ana umsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman go le dai aphat chan napeuvin anche louhing aphatsah in, nangho dingin neh le chah ning lhingset in napeuvin nalungu kipanan adim in ahi,” ati lhon e.
14.18: Thu hicheng asei jou lhon chun amani houna dinga kilhaina bol dinga kigong mipi chu anah nah in akham jou lhonin ahi.
14.19: Chuin Antioch le Iconium a konin Judah te mi phabep ahung lhungun mipi chu athujo uvin, Paul chu khopi pam lamah akaidoh un songa asep un athitai tin adalhauvin ahi.
14.20: Chuin seijui ho avela atoukhom pet un Paul chu athoudoh kit in khopi sunga anung lut kit in ahi. Chuin ajing in Barnabas toh Derbe lama ding in achekit lhon tan ahi.
14.21: Chuin Derbe a kipana thupha alhangsap jou lhon a mi tampi seijuiya asem jou lhon phat in, Paul le Barnabas chu Lystra, Iconium, le Pisidia gam'a Antioch geiyin akile kit lhon in,
14.22: Seijui ho asuhat kit lhon in, tahsan na a dingdet jing dingin atilkhou lhon in, chule Pathen lenggam lutna dinga gentheina le hahsat na tampi athoh ding danu jong ahetsah lhon in ahi.
14.23: Chule Paul le Barnabas chun houbung tina upa apansah lhonin, chuin upa a apansah lhon ho chu taona le an ngol pumin atahsan ngap nau Pakai khut'ah apelut tauvin ahi.
14.24: Chuin amani Pisidia jotpaiyin Pamphylia chan achekit lhon in ahi.
14.25: Chuin Perga muna thu asei jou lhon in Attalia a achesuh kit lhon in ahi.
14.26: Achainan, kong in akitol lhon in ahung kipat doh nalhon Syria gam'a Antioch muna akile kit lhon tan ahi. Hiche lai muna tahsan chaten Pathen mingailutna natoh tongdoh dinga anganse nau atong molso lhon tan ahi.
14.27: Chuin Antioch ahung lhun lhon toh kilhon in houbung mipi akou khom lhon in Pathen in amani a kona thil abol jouse le chidang namdang tedinga jong tahsanna kot ahon dan thudol ahettohsah lhon in ahi.
14.28: Chuin hiche laiya chun seijui ho toh sotpi aumkhom tauvin ahi.

15.1: Chuin Paul le Barnabas Syria gam'a Antioch muna aum jing lai lhon in, Judea gam'a kon in mi phabep ahung un “Mose dan dung juiya chep natan lou uleh huhhing'a naum thei lou dingu ahi,” tin seijui ho chu thu ahung hil'un ahi.
15.2: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun amaho thuhil chu dih asah lhon lou jeh chun nasatah in akinel tauvin ahi. Ahin achaina chan na akihoulhah thei tah loujeh un Houbung chun Paul le Barnabas chu amun houbung mi themkhat toh Jerusalema hiche thudoh chung changa solchah ho le upa ho toh kihou khom ding in ahin sol tauvin ahi.
15.3: Chuin Houbung in Jerusalem a dinga ahin sol houchu Phoenicia le Samaria gamsunga akinga pauvin, seijui ho ahin ho pauvin chidang namdang ho lunghei thu chu aseiyun ahile ama ho hapan akipah un ahi.
15.4: Chuin Jerusalem alhun un Barnabas le Paul chu solchah ho le upa ho jaonan houbung mipi chun ana lemun, chuin amanin Pathen natoh ho abonchan asei lhon tan ahi.
15.5: Ahin Pharisee ho lah a kona seijui ho themkhat ading doh un “Chidang namdang atahsan hon Mose dan dung juiya chep atanu ngai ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
15.6: Chuin solchah ho le upa ho chu hiche thua boina ho seilham ding in akikhomun ahi.
15.7: Akikhop khom nauva chun, phat sottah akihoulim jouvun Peter ading doh in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, phat masa a kona Pathen in nang ho lah a kona keima hi chidang namdang ten kipana thupha ajah thei nadingu le atahsan na dinguva eilhen ahi chu nahe sohkeiyuve,
15.8: Pathen in mihem lungthim ahen, eiho eipeh bang uva chidang namdang te jong Lhagao Theng apeh hin Pathen san ahi nau ahettoh sah ahi.
15.9: Eiho le amaho kikah a kikhenna asem pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman tahsan na-a alungthimu asuh theng ahitai.
15.10: Chuti ahi jeh chun, ipi dinga chidang namdang seijui ho chu eiho le ipu ipa teuvin jong anapoh joulou pohgih chu ipohsah uva Pathen ichou dingu ham?
15.11: Eiho ibonchauva ichan diuva lomlou Pakai Yeshua mingailut vanga huhhing'a um ihiu chu iheuve,” ati.
15.12: Chuin Barnabas le Paul in amani jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang te lah a melchih naleh thil kidang abol thu asei lhon chu mipi chun thipbeh in angaiyun,
15.13: Asei jou lhon in, Jacob ading doh in hiti hin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, kathusei hi ngaitemuvin,
15.14: Chidang namdang te lah a kona Pathen in ama dinga mi akilah tillai thu chu Peter in aseiya kon in ija tauve,
15.15: Chule hiche chidang namdang te lunghei thudol hi themgao hon ana phondoh masah sau ahitai, ajeh chu hiti hin akisun in ahi.”
15.16: “Chujou tengle kakile kit a, David in lhusa kasem phat a, asesa kasah phat kit'a chule kasem phat kit ding ahi.
15.17: Chutengle mijouse, chidang namdang te jaona a keima dinga kakou jousen Pakai ahin hol ding ahi tin,
15.18: Hitiho jouse phat sottah masanga kona hetsah ji Pakai chun aseiyin ahi.
15.19: Chuti ahijeh chun keima thutan chu hiche hi ahi, chidang namdang te Pathen lama lungheina neiho dinga pohgih igot peh lou dingu ahi.
15.20: Chusang chun, milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, hetphah lou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, tin jih thou hite.
15.21: Ajeh chu hiche Mose danthu ho hi khopi jouse le cholngah nikho seh a khang tamtah dinga Judah te kikhopna in'a kisei jing ahi.” ati.
15.22: Chuin solchahho le upa hon Jerusalem houbunga konin mi phabep alheng doh un, amaho chu Paul le Barnabas toh Syria gam'a Antioch houbunga akihoulhah nau thu hettoh sah dingin asoluvin ahi. Akilheng doh teni chu houbung lamkai Judas (Barsabbas tiajong kihe) le Silas ahi.
15.23: Chuin hiche lekha thot hitia kisun hi apohsah un ahi: “Hiche lekha thot hi solchahho le upa ho chule Jerusalema um sopihoa kon ahi. Hiche hi Syria gam'a Antioch le Cilicia a um chidang namdang te henga dinga kisun ahi.” Chibai!
15.24: “Hichea kona mi phabep in athuhil uva nahung suhboi uva, nahung suh lunghangu chu kaheuve, ahin amaho chu keihon kahin sol u ahipoi!
15.25: Hijeh chun kilungkhat tah a kakinopto nau toh lhonin keiho khel in ingailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul hi nangho henga kahin sol uvin ahi.
15.26: Amani hi Pakai Yeshua Christa mina ahinna chan ngam ahi lhonin ahi.
15.27: Chule nahin thudoh chung changuva kakihou lhah nau hettoh sah dinga Judas le Silas hi kahin sol u ahi.”
15.28: “Ajeh chu nangho chunga hicheng thil themkhat tailou pohgih poh sahlou ding hi Lhagao Theng leh keiho dinga phajo ahi;
15.29: Hicheng thil themkhat ho chu: milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, het phahlou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, hiche hi najuiuva ahileh alhingsel ahitai.”
15.30: Chuin thupoho chu Antioch alhunun seijui ho abonun akou khomun hiche lekha thot chu ape tauvin ahi.
15.31: Chuin hiche tilkhouna lekha thot chu asimun ahile houbung ho chunga kipana adimset tan ahi.
15.32: Chuin Judas le Silas chu ani lhonna themgao ahi toh lhonin seijui ho tilkhouna le atahsanu suhhat na thutampi asei lhon in ahi.
15.33: Chuin phat chomkhat aum jou lhonin seijui hon amani chu lungmong sel'in Jerusalem houbunga ale sol kit tauvin ahi.
15.34: Ahin Silas in chukoma umden ding ageljotai.
15.35: Paul le Barnabas vang chu Antioch a aum den lhonin, hilaiya chun midang ho toh Pathen thu ahil'un alhang samun ahi.
15.36: Phat chomkhat jouvin Paul in Barnabas jah-a aseiyin, “Kile kit hitin Pathen thu ilhangsapna khopi jouse chu gavil kit hitin seijui ho iti um hinauvem gave hite,” atin ahi.
15.37: Barnabas jong anomin chule John Mark jong puiding anomin ahi.
15.38: Ahin John Mark in Pamphylia muna ana haisan lhona, natoh na a anajao jom tah lou jeh chun ama puikit ding chu Paul akikam khonteh in ahi.
15.39: Chuphat chun akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas in John Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lama ding in konga akitol tan ahi.
15.40: Paul chun Silas akilhen in, chule tahsan chaten Pakai ngailutna kivoppi dingin asoldoh tauvin ahi.
15.41: Chuin Syria le Cilicia gamsungah avah len houbung ho atilkhou le tan ahi.

16.1: Chuin Paul chu Derbe ah ache masan chujouvin Lystra ah achen ahile hikoma chun seijui khang dong Timothy kiti mikhat anaum in ahi. Ama chu anu Judah mi ahin, apa vang chu Greek mi ahi.
16.2: Timothy chu Lystra le Iconium muna angaisang loi tahu seijui khat ahi.
16.3: Chuin Paul in ama chu alhonpi ding in adei sah in, hijeh chun akilhon khom masang lhonin Judah ten achom mu lou nadinguvin Timothy chu chep tan nading angaiton ahi. Ajeh chu mijousen apa Greek mi ahi chu ahet u ahi.
16.4: Chuin amani chu khopi khat a konin khopi khat'ah avahle lhonin seijui ho chun Jerusalema solchahho le upa ho thulhuhna chu phatecha ajui cheh nadingun thu ahille lhon tan ahi.
16.5: Chuti chun houbung ho chu atahsan nau suh hat in aumin chule nisih in akhanglen jep jep un ahi.
16.6: Chuin Paul le Silas chu Phrygia le Galatia gamsunga akholjin jom lhon tan ahi ajeh chu Lhagao Theng in Asia gamsunga Pathen thulhangsap ding chu ajahda ahi.
16.7: Chuin Mysia gamgi ahung lhun lhon phat in Bithynia jon ding in akihei toulhon in ahile hiche gam'a achelhon ding jong chu Pakai Lhagao in aphal pon ahi.
16.8: Hijeh chun kihei tou talouvin Mysia gamsunga achepeh lhon in Troas kongkaimun chan achelhon tan ahi.
16.9: Hiche ni jan chun Paul in mu aneiyin: Athilmu achun Greece sahlam gam'a um Mecedonia akonin mikhat ahung ding in “Mecedonia gam'a hung in lang neihung kithopiuvin,” tin ahung taovin ahi.
16.10: Hijeh chun keiho Mecedonia jonin kache tauvin, hiche gam'a kipana thupha lhangsam dinga Pathen in eikouvu ahi chu kahe tauvin ahi.
16.11: Chuin keiho Troas a konin konga katouvun jangjalin kacheuvin Samothrace twikol a kakinga pauvin, ajingin Neapolis kalhung tauvin ahi.
16.12: Hichea kon chun Mecedonia gamsunga khopi lenloi Rome te khosatna Philippi kalhung tauvin, hichea chun nikho tampi ka nichongun ahi.
16.13: Chuin cholngah nikhon khopi pamlama naicha a um vadung panga chun miho taokhom inte tia kagel jeh-u chun kacheuvin, hiche muna numei phabep anaum khom ho koma chun katouvun thu kaseiyun ahi.
16.14: Chuin Numei ho lah a chun Lydia kiti Thyatira gammi khat aumin ama chu ponsadup mantam tah a sumkolvei mi ahin chule ama chu Pathen hou jong ahi. Aman ka thuseiju chu phatechan angaiyin ahile Pakaiyin alungthim kot ahin hongin Paul thusei chu ajop tan ahi.
16.15: Chuin amanu chu a insung mi jouse to baptize achangun, chule ama nun adongun “Pakai seijui dihtah ahi neitiuva ahile keima in'ah hung lhung unlang kajin in hung pangun,” tin anop tokah uvin angeh tan ahi.
16.16: Nikhat taona ding muna kache suh uva ahile lhagaoboh vop soh numei khat kamu uvin, amanu chun khonunga hung lhung ding thu aseiya aPakai tedinga sum tampi pi alo ji ahi.
16.17: Amanu chun Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin aw sangtah in asamin, “Hiche miho hi Chung Nungpen Pathen sohte ahiuvin, chule huhhing'a naum theina dingu thu ahung seiyu ahi,” ati.
16.18: Hiti chun nikho tampi abolin ahile Paul jong alunghang tan, chuin akiheiyin asunga cheng lhagaoboh koma chun aseiyin, “Yeshua Christa mina thu kapeh nahi, amanu sunga konin pot in,” atile, apettah chun adalhatan ahi.
16.19: Chuin apakaiteu chun haosatna dinga akinepna jouseu akephat in Paul le Silas amanun kailhang muna thunei vaihom ho masanga akailut tauvin,
16.20: “Hiche Judah miho jeh hin khopi sung pumpi boina asou sang tai” tin khopi vaihom ho henga asam tauvin ahi.
16.21: Chule “Eiho Rome mite chonna toh kitoh lou chon dan thu ahilui,” atiuvin ahi.
16.22: Chuin mipi chu Paul le Silas dounan akikhom uvin, thing tenggol mangcha a ajep theina dingun khopi vaihom ho chun mipi chu thu ape tauvin ahi.
16.23: Chuin melsetah a avoh jouvun songkul'a akhumun, songkul ngah ho henga chun phatechan anga tup dingun thu apeuvin ahi.
16.24: Hijeh chun songkul ngah hon asung dan langpeh a akeng teni akan khomun akoi tauvin ahi.
16.25: Chuin jankhangkim laiyin Paul le Silas chu atao lhonin Pathen avahchoi lhonin ahile sonkula tangho chun angaiyuvin ahi.
16.26: Chuin phulou helouvin lingpi nasatah ahung kihot in, songkul khombul ho chu ahin hottan ahile, songkul kot jouse akihong tan, akihen na jouseu jong akilham tan ahi!
16.27: Chuin songkul ngahpa ahung khah doh le songkul kot jouse ana kihon amu phat chun asunga umho jouse jammang gam ahitai tin achem asatdoh in ama le ama akithat kigon ahi.
16.28: Ahivang in Paul chun asamin, “Khongaiyin nang le nang kithat hih in! keiho kabon chauvin kaum nauve!” atin ahi.
16.29: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun mei akidet in asungdan langa alhailut in Paul le Silas masanga kithing pum pumin akisep lhutan ahi.
16.30: Chuin polama ahin puidoh lhonin, “Pu huhhing'a kaumna dinga ipi kabol ngaiyem?” ati.
16.31: Amanin adonbut in “Nang le na insung miten Pakai Yeshua tahsanun chutile huhhing'a naum dingu ahi,” ati.
16.32: Hiti chun ama le a insung mite to Pathen thu aseikhom tauvin ahi.
16.33: Chuin hiche ni jan ma ma chun songkul ngahpa chun akijepna maha lhon chu asop theng peh lhon in, chuin a insung mite jouse toh baptize achang tauvin ahi.
16.34: Hiti chun amani ding chun a insunga ankong aluidoh peh un Pathen atahsan jeh-u chun ainkouvin akipah lheh jengun ahi.
16.35: Ajing jingkah in khopi vaihom ho chun songkul ngahpa henga, “Hiche mite chu soldoh in!” atiuvin ahi.
16.36: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun Paul hengah aseiyin, “Khopi vaihom hon nang le Silas soldoh tan atiuvin ahi, hijeh chun lungmong in che hon tan,” ati.
16.37: Ahivang in Paul in adonbut in, “Keini hi Rome mi kahi lhon in kholtoh louva mipi angsunga eivoh'u ahin, guhthima eisoldoh got'u chu hithei lou ding ahi. Hijeh chun amaho tah hungu henlang eisoldoh'u hen,” ati.
16.38: Chuin hiche thu chu khopi vaihom hon ajah doh uva Paul le Silas chu Rome mi ahi ahet doh phat un,
16.39: Songkul'a ahungun amani koma chun ngaidam athum tauvin ahi. Chujouvin amani chu apuidoh uvin khopi sung dalha hon tan tin ataovun ahi.
16.40: Chuin Paul le Silas chu songkul'a kona ahung potdoh lhon phat in Lydia in'ah akile kit lhon in hiche in a seijui ho chu atilkhou lhonin chuin amanin khopi chu adalha lhon tan ahi.

17.1: Chuin Paul le Silas chun Amphipolis le Apollonia khopi ajot peh lhon in Thessalonica ahung lhung lhon tan ahi. Hichea chun Judah te kikhop na in aum in ahi.
17.2: Chuin abolngai bang in Paul chu Judah te kikhopna in'ah cholngah nikho thum kijom in achen Pathen lekhabu a pansan miho chu akihoulim pijin,
17.3: Miho koma chun themgao hon asei banga Messiah chun genthei athoh'a chule thina a kona kaithouva aumding thudol ahil chen jin ahi. Chule “Hiche Yeshua athudol kaseipa hi Messiah chu ahi,” atin ahi.
17.4: Athusei ngaiho lah a Judah mi phabep le Pathen ging Greek mi chule numei mithupi phabep jaonan Paul le Silas thusei chu ajop uvin amani toh'a pang khom tauvin ahi.
17.5: Ahivang in Judah mi loikhat chu athangthip uvin hijeh chun kailhang dunga boina sem ho chu akoukhomun mipi atilseuvin, Jason in chu abulhu un, Paul le Silas chu mipi lah a kaidoh ing in ahol uvin ahi.
17.6: Chuin amani amu lou phat uvin, Jason le seijui dang phabep chu khopi vaihom ho mansanga akaidoh un, chule mipi chun asamun, “Paul le Silas hin vannoi pumpia boina asosah lhon ahin tun eiho khopi sunga jong boina aso hon tai,” atiuvin ahi.
17.7: “Hiche thilsoh hi Jason in a-in'a alhunsah jeh ahin, chule amahon Caesar dounan achonun Yeshua kiti leng dang khat aume,” atiuvin ahi.
17.8: Hiche thudol hin Khopi mite le vaihom ho nasatah in alungboi sah tan ahi.
17.9: Chuin vaihom ho chun Jason le seijui dangho chu hunam'in akilhadoh theina dingun man apeh sah un chuin alhadoh tauvin ahi.
17.10: Hiche ni jan ma ma chun seijui hon Paul le Silas chu Berea a dingin asoldoh tauvin, chuin amani Berea alhun lhon phat in Judah te kikhopna in'ah alutkit lhon in ahi.
17.11: Berea mite chu Thessalonica mite sangin alungthim kot-u akihong jon, Paul thusei chu lunglut tah in angaiyun ahi. Niseh in Pathen Lekhabu asim jingun Paul le Silas chun thudih asei lhon hinam tin akhol chil un ahi.
17.12: Hiche toh kilhon chun Judah mi tampi leh Greek mithupi numei le pasal tampin atahsan tauvin ahi.
17.13: Ahin Thessalonica a um Judah mi phabep in Paul le Silas in Berea a Pathen thu asei lhon'e ti ahetdoh phat un ahung un mipi atildoh un boina asosah un ahi.
17.14: Chuin seijui ho chun thakhat tah in Paul chu twipi gal langkhat ah asoldoh un, Silas le Timothy vang chu aumden lhon in ahi.
17.15: Paul thah doh a che ho chun Athens kho chanin alhon piuvin, chuin Silas le Timothy jong gangtah a Paul kom alhun lhon nading thu ahinpouvin Berea a ahung kile kit tauvin ahi.
17.16: Chuin Paul in Athens khopi a Silas le Timothy anga sung chun khopi muntina milim ho chu amun alungthim ana lheh jeng in ahi.
17.17: Chuin ama kikhopna in'a alut in, Judah miho le Pathen ging chidang namdang hotoh Pathen thun akihoulim khomuvin, chule niseh in jalhanga jong amuho jouse koma asei jin ahi.
17.18: Hitichun Epicurean le Stoic chihgilna nei miho toh akinel'un, chuin Yeshua le athodoh chung chang thudol aseiyin ahile, amahon, “Hiche kamtam pa hin ipi hetkhah lou thukhat asei ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah a konkhat chun, “Hetphah lou pathen thu asei hile akilome,” atiuvin ahi.
17.19: Chuin amahon Paul chu khopi vaihom ho anga apuilut un, “Hiche thuhil thah hi keiho koma hung sei kit in,” atiuvin ahi.
17.20: “Nang man thil chombeh thukhat naseiyin, hichu keihon kicheh tah in kahet nomuve,” atiuvin ahi.
17.21: (Hiche thuhil thah thudol a hin Athens mite le gamchoma kona hungkhom miho chun aphatseh in kihoulim nan anei tauvin ahi).
17.22: Chuin Paul chu mipi kikhopna a chun ading doh in, hitin aseiyin ahi. “Athens mite ho, nangho hi imalam jousea hougut tah nahiuhi kamudoh in ahi;
17.23: Ajeh chu kavah len ahile pathen kihouna muntheng tampi kamun, hiche maicham phung holah-a chun ‘hetphah lou pathen'a ding’ tia kisun khat kamudoh in ahi.” Keiman kasei hi hiche nahet phah lou u Pathen thu chu ahi.
17.24: Hiche Pathen chu vannoi leiset le asunga thil umjouse sempa ahin, hijeh chun Ama chu khut a kisa houin'a acheng pon,
17.25: Chule mihem khut in angaichat ho apethei pon ahi ajeh chu aman ngaichat anei poi. Ama chun ahingthei jouse hinna apeh ahin, angai cha jouse ngaichat asuh bulhit peh ji ahi.
17.26: Aman mihem khat a kona leiset pumpia namtin asemdoh ahin, namkhat hung kitundoh le lhahsuh ding jong aman ahet masah sa ahi, chule agamgi geiya aman adatkhen sa ahi.
17.27: Athilsem lona jeh chu namtin in ama ahol'uva amu theina dingu ahi ajeh chu ama eihoa kona gamla tah a umlou ahi.
17.28: Ajeh chu eiho ama a ihin uva ama'a ichale theiyuva chule ama'a ihiu ahi. Nangho zaila cheng khat'a jong, “Eiho ama chilhah ihiuve” tin akisun in ahi.
17.29: Hiti ahijeh chun eihon Pathen chu khutthem hon sana dangka ahiloule songa asemu milim hotoh ite loudiu ahi.
17.30: “Hetlouva nabol laiyuva chu Pathen kimumosah ahin, ahin tua hi hoilai hijong le mijousen chonset lungheiya ama lam ahin bel nadinga thu apeh ahitai.
17.31: Ajeh chu aman vannoi thu atan ding nikho atepsa ahin, thudih'a thutan ding mikhat apansah in, ama chu mijouse mudin thina a konin akai thouvin ahi,” ati.
17.32: Chuin Paul in thokit thudol asei chu ajauvin ahileh mi konkhat chun anuisat un, ahin adangho chun “Hiche thudol hi olleh kangai nom kit-ui,” atiuvin ahi.
17.33: Hiti chun Paul in akihoulim nau achaiyin ahi.
17.34: Ahivang in amaho lah a mi phabep chun atahsan un anung ajui tauvin ahi. Amaho chu, vaipo loiho lah a mi Dionysius, Damaris kiti numeinu chule adang mi phabep ahiuve.

18.1: Chuin Paul chu Athens a kon in Corinth achetan ahi.
18.2: Chuin hikoma chun Judah mi Aquila chu amun, amapa chu Pontus gam'a peng ahin, Italy gam'a kona Claudius Caesar in Rome a kona Judah te jouse ahin nodoh phat a ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhung til ahi lhone.
18.3: Paul chu amaho in'ah alhung in na atong khom jiuvin ahi ajeh chu ama banga pon-in sah them cheh ahiuvin ahi.
18.4: Hiti chun cholngah nikho seh le Paul chu kikhopna in'a achen Judah te le Greek mite chu thu ahil jin ahi.
18.5: Chuin Silas le Timothy jong Mecedonia a kona ahung suh lhon phat chun Paul in aphat nei jousen Pathen thu alhangsam in, Judah te koma Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin asam phong le tan ahi.
18.6: Ahin Paul chu adoudal uva alunghan sah jeh un, Paul in aponsil a leivui athing lhan, “Nangho thisan nangho chung ma ma ah chu hen, keima them mo nabei kahi, tunia pat'a chidang namdang te henga kasap phong ding ahitai,” atin ahi.
18.7: Chuin kikhopna inkoma cheng Pathen ngaisah mi Titius Justus in'ah chun alut tan ahi.
18.8: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai loi Crispus le a-insunga umjousen Pakai atahsan un, chule Corinth a um midang tamtah'in jong Paul thusei chu ajauvin, atahsan un baptize achang tauvin ahi.
18.9: Jankhat Paul henga Pakaiyin gaovin akimusah in hitin ahin seiyin, “Kicha hih in! Paodoh in! Umthim hih in!
18.10: Ajeh chu keiman nangma kaumpi nai, chule hiche khopi sunga hin koiman nabulhu lou ding nabol gim lou diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche khopi sunga mitamtah hi keiya ahi,” ati.
18.11: Chuin Paul chu Corinth a kum khat le akeh aumden in Pathen thu ahil len ahi.
18.12: Ahin Gallio chu Achaia gamvaipoa ahung pan phat in Judah miho chu Paul dounan ahung sousang kit uvin, gamvaipo anga athu tan dingin ahin puiyun,
18.13: “Paul in eiho dan toh kikal a Pathen hou dingin mi ajol e,” tin aheh seuvin ahi.
18.14: Ahin Paul in akihonna thu asei toh lhon in Gallio in ahehse ho koma chun, “Judah miho, Ngaiyuvin, naheh nau thua hi thildih lou ahiloule thilse ajaukhah a ahile naheh nau hi kasanpeh ding nahiuve,
18.15: Ahin tun naheh nau thuhi thudoh mai mai, min mai mai, ahiloule Judah te danthu mai mai ahijeh'in nang hon kivet sui tauvin, hitobang thuhi katan nompoi,” atin,
18.16: Thutanna in na kon in ahin soldoh tan ahi.
18.17: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai Sosthenes chu mipi chun amanun, thutanna inmai laitah a chun avotauvin ahi. Ahin Gallio chun iman jong agelpeh pouve.
18.18: Chujouvin Paul chu Corinth ah phat chomkhat aum in chuin sopite ho koma lhahna thu aseiyin, akinaipi Cenchrea ajon tan ahi. Hiche laiya chun Paul in Judah te chona dan dung juiyin akitepna phat alhin phat in asam avoulhan, chuin Priscilla le Aquila toh Syria lam jon in konga akitol tauvin ahi.
18.19: Chuin Ephesus kongkaimun ahung lhun un, hichelaiya chun Paul in amani adalhan ama chu kikhopna in na alut in Juda techu asuhtoh peh in ahi.
18.20: Hichea chun umsot jep ding in ana temun ahin anoppeh pon ahi.
18.21: Adalhah ding kon chun, “Pathen lunglam ahile kahung kile kit ding ahi,” tin Ephesus a kon in konga akitol kit tan ahi.
18.22: Chuin Caesarea kongkaimuna aki nga kit in, hichea kon chun Jerusalem houbung agavil in chuin Antioch a akile kit tan ahi.
18.23: Phat chomkhat Antioch a aum jouvin Paul chu Galatia le Phrygia lama akile kit in, seijui ho akimupi kit in asuhat kit in ahi.
18.24: Alang khat'ah Egypt gam Alexandria a konin thusei them tah le Pathen Lekhabu thu hetah Judah mi Apollos chu Ephesus ahung lhung in,
18.25: Ama chun Pakai lampi thu ahil in, chule midang ho chu dihtah le Lhagaova thaneitah in Yeshua thudol ahil in ahi. Ahinlah ama chun twilutsah John bou ahet ahi.
18.26: Chuin kikhopna in'a hangsan tah a thu asei chu Priscilla le Aquila in ajah lhon phat in ama chu akoudoh lhon in Pathen thu kicheh tah in ahil chenbe lhon in ahi.
18.27: Chuin Apollos in Achaia gam'a che ding lung agel jeh chun sopite hon ama chu atil khouvun, chule Achaia gam'a seijui ho ding chun lekha khat athot un kipah tah a analem ding un angeh un ahi. Chuin alhun phat in Pakai mingailut jal'a atahsan ho jouse dinga mi phachom tah asoh tan ahi.
18.28: Judate chu lhang phongin thaneitah in anelkhup jin, Pathen thu dung juiyin Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin ahil chen jin ahi.

19.1: Chuin Apollos Corinth a aum jing lai chun Paul jong chuche gamkai sunga chun avah len Ephesus ahung lhun chun seijui tampi amun amaho koma chun,
19.2: “Natahsan uva chu Lhagao Theng nachan nah uvem?” tin adong in ahile, amahon “Kachang pouve, Lhagao Theng aume akiti lam jong kajakha pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
19.3: Chuin aman adong kit in “Ahileh ipia baptize chang nahiuvem?” ati. Amahon jong “John baptize chanin,” atiuve.
19.4: Chuin Paul in, “John baptize chan chu chonset na a kon lunghei na ding bou ahi, ahin John jeng in jong miho jah a chun ama jouva hung ding pachu tahsanun,” ati, hichu Yeshua aseina ahi.
19.5: Chuche thu ajah jah un abonchauvin Pakai Yeshua minin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
19.6: Chuin Paul in achung'uva khut angamin ahile, Lhagao Theng achung'uva ahung chutan, chule abonchauvin paochom athouvin gaothu asei tauvin ahi.
19.7: Amaho chu abonun mi somleni ahiuve.
19.8: Chuin Paul chu kikhopna in'ah alut in hapta thum sungin hangsan tah in thu aseiyin, thununsah teina ding in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin ahi.
19.9: Ahin mi konkhat chu alouchal uvin thu kisei chu sanglouvin, lhang phongtah in asei seuvin ahi. Hijeh chun Paul in kikhopna in chu adalhan seijui ho chu akipui doh'in Tyrannus muna thuseina in khat'ah niseh in akihoulim pitan ahi.
19.10: Hiti chun kumni jen abol'un ahile Asia gamsung pumpia Judah te le Greek mi abonchauvin Pakai thu chu ajatauvin ahi.
19.11: Chuin Pathen in Paul chu bolmo kidang bolthei na tha ape tan ahi.
19.12: Chuti chun ultheh pon hihen lang achunga kai pon poupou hijong le achoiyun adamlouho chunga akoiyun ahile adamlou nau chu adamin asunga lhagao phalou ho jong ajamdoh jin ahi.
19.13: Chuin Judah miho phabep khopi khat'a konin khopi khat ah avah leuvin, lhagao boh ho anodoh un, amaho chun Pakai Yeshua min pat ding agouvin, “Paul in alhangsap Yeshua mina thu kapeh nahi, hungpot in!” tin asei jiuvin ahi.
19.14: Hitia thil bol chu thempu lenloi, Sceva chate pasal sagi ho ahiuve.
19.15: Ahin chutia nikhat abolgot kit laitah un lhagao boh chun, “Yeshua le Paul chu kahenai, nang koi nahiuvem?” atin ahi.
19.16: Chuin lhagao boh voppa chu amaho chunga achomlut in amaho chu athajo in asugim tauvin ahile amaho chu sagohkeo le maha pun ajamdoh tauvin ahi.
19.17: Hiche thilsoh chu Ephesus khopi sunga Judate le Greek mite hengah gangtah in akithe jal tan ahile, khopi sungah kichat tijatna adim tan, Pakai Yeshua min chu nasatah in ajabol tauvin ahi.
19.18: Chuin seijui tamtah ho chun achonset thilbol'u aphong tauvin ahi.
19.19: Chuin doichoi ho mitam tah'in jong a lekhabu-u ahin choi khom uvin, mipi ang sung laitah a agouvam tauvin ahi. Hiche alekhabu-u chu dangka tamtah man ahi.
19.20: Hiche Pakai natoh thudol chu muntina akithe jaltan thahat tah'in na atong tan ahi.
19.21: Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin lhagao vin asoljeh chun Paul chu Jerusalem ache masang in Mecedonia le Achaia gam'a ding in achen, “Chujou tengle Rome a kache ding ahi,” tin aseiyin ahi.
19.22: Chuin ama Asia gam'a phat chomkhat aum nalaiyin, Timothy le Erastus chu akithopi ding in Mecedonia a amasol in ahi.
19.23: Chuche phatlai chun Ephesus ah hiche kithuhilna lampi chung changa boina khohtah khat ahung umdohtan ahi.
19.24: Ajeh chu Demetrius kiti mikhat aumin, ama chu dangka a sumkolvei mi ahin, aman khutthem ho chu dangka in Greek te pathen Artemis lim akhen sah in hoitah in akoiyin ahi.
19.25: Chuin aman anatoh kibah piho chu akou khomin ajah uva: “Mipi ho hiche sumkolvei na hi ihaodoh nau ahi,” ati.
19.26: “Ahin najah uva namu bang un, hiche Paul hin miho jouse koma khut a kisem limho hi pathen tahbeh ahipoi tin aseiyin mijouse alhemlha tai, chule hiche thuhi Ephesus khopi bouseh a asei ahipon Asia gamsung pumpia asei le ahi!
19.27: Ahinai! Isumkolvei nau mijousen nahsah moa akoi ding thubou kasei ahipoi, ahin Artemis pathen houna in thupina jouse aman a, chule Asia gamsung pumpi le vannoi pumpia hiche pathen houna aman thah ding jong hi kagelkhoh tah khat ahi!” ati.
19.28: Hichun akikhom miho chu alung hangjah jeng uvin, “Ephesus mite pathen Artemis alen'e,” tin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
19.29: Hichun khopi sunga miho chu alung boilah lah jeng uvin, mipi chun Paul hin kilhonpi Macedonia gam'a kon Gaius le Aristarchus chu amanun golseh vetna muna chun akailut tauvin ahi.
19.30: Chuin Paul jong chu lut ding agon, ahin seijui hon analut sah pouvin ahi.
19.31: Chuin Asia gamsung a Paul loi le gol milen milal phabep in Paul henga thu ahin thot un, golseh vetna muna lut loubeh ding in ahung taovun ahi.
19.32: Golseh vetna mun sunga chun mipi chu apeng lah lah un mi abangin thilkhat asamun, abangin thildang khat asamun, hiti chun aeu lah lah jenguvin, abangloi chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu jong ahepouvin ahi.
19.33: Chuin mipi lah a um Juda miho chun Alexander chu mipi masanga ahin sondoh un thilsoh thudol ahil chet dingin asolun ahi. Chuin aman mipi ho chu aphoh thip in houlim ding agon ahi.
19.34: Ahinlah mipi ho chun amapa chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat un, hatah in asamkit un, “Ephesus Artemis alen e, Ephesus Artemis alen e!” tin nidan ni lang asamun ahi.
19.35: Ajo jo nan khopi vaipopa chun mipi ho chu aphoh thip in aman, “Vo Ephesus mite, Ephesus khopi hi vana kona hung khelha Artemis len lim houin ngah ahi hi mijousen ahet ahi,” ati.
19.36: “Hiche thutah hi koiman aseilep theilou ahijeh'in nangho thipkhen chan um unlang imacha kinothethun bol dauvin.
19.37: Hiche napuilut-u mite hin houin'a konin imacha agudoh pouvin, eiho pathen dounan jong ima asei pouve.
19.38: Amavang Demetrius le anatoh kibahpi khutthem hon amaho hehset nading thu aneiyuva ahile thutanna in honsan aum jinge, chule gamvaipoho henga jong athu agasei theiyu ahi. Amaho koma khun ga kihehsah tauvin.
19.39: Chule ahehnau thudang aumle vang angaiya kikhopna in'a athu tanding ahi.
19.40: Ajeh beiya boina soh ahijeh'in ajole Rome vaipoten ichunguva thu ahin tan khah diu ham tin kichat nan kadime. Ajeh chu Rome vaipoten tuni thilsoh thudol hilchen dingin eihin dongule ima isei thei lou diu ahi,” ati.
19.41: Hiti chun mipi ho chu anodoh tan ahile amaho akikhen tauvin ahi.

20.1: Chuin mipi sousang na chu athip phat in Paul in seijui ho chu agakousah in atilkhou jouvin, damselun tin akikhen pin ama Macedonia lamah achetan ahi.
20.2: Chuche gamsunga ajotpa na khopi jousea seijuiho atilkhou peh in chuin Greece khopi chanin achesuh tan ahi.
20.3: Chuin hiche khopia chun lhathum sung aumin, Syria gam lama konga kinung tolding angaiton ahile Juda mi phabep in thading agot-u ahetdoh phat in Macedonia lang joh jotpa ding in akile kit tan ahi
20.4: Ama chu mi phabep toh alhon in ahi. Amaho chu: Berea a kon Pyrrhus chapa Sopater, Thessalonica a kon Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe a kon Gaius, Timothy, chule Asia gam'a kona Tychicus le Trophimus ahiuve.
20.5: Amaho chu ana masauvin Troas muna eina ngah un ahi.
20.6: Chuin Kalchuh kut kichaiyin Macedonia gam'a Philippi khopia konin konga katouvun ninga jouvin Troas muna amaho heng kalhung uvin, chuin hiche muna chun hapta khat kaumun ahi.
20.7: Chuin nimasa nin seijuiho toh Pakai anjon jong dingin kakikhomun hichea chun Paul in amaho henga thu aseiyin, ajing a ama chekit ding ahitah jeh chun jankim chan ahoulimin ahi.
20.8: Hiche kakikhop nau indan chungnunga chu meivah tamtah kide ahi.
20.9: Chuin Paul in phat sottah thu asei jeh chun bangkot koma tou gollhang chapang khat amin Eutychus atiu chu aihmutso beh seh jeh chun aihmulhutan ahile bangkot a kon chun in danthum a sanga chun akileh lhan noilama athisain aga muvin ahi.
20.10: Chuin Paul akumsuh in abungin akhut in hiche gollhang chapang pachu apomin, “lungdong hih un ahing nalaiye” ati.
20.11: Chuin amaho indan chungnunga akaltou kit-un Pakai anjon changlhah aneuvin ahi. Hiti chun Paul in thusei abanjom kit in khovah lhah phat in aman adalha tauvin ahi.
20.12: Alangkhat ah gollhang chapang pa jong chu akisuhkhah na beihel in inlam'a akilen ahileh mijouse chu alungmong lheh jengun ahi.
20.13: Chuin Paul chu Assos chanin kenglamah ana chepeh in, keiho konga kacheuva chule ama kalahpa nadiuva agontoh ahi.
20.14: Chuin hiche muna kon chun ama jong keihotoh konga katoukhomun Mitylene chan kacheuvin ahi.
20.15: Ajing in Kios twikol kakhokhel un, akit-in Samos twikol kajot paikit un chule nikhat jouvin Miletus twikol kalhung uvin ahi.
20.16: Chuin Asia gamsunga aumsot nom lou phat in Paul in konga touva Ephesus khopi jotpai ding lung angaito tan ahi. Kinotah a cheloiya ahithei le Pentecost masanga Jerusalem lhun teiding ati ahi.
20.17: Ahin Miletus kalhun un Ephesus Houbung a um upa ho henga ahung kimupi diuvin thu athot tan ahi.
20.18: Chuin amaho ahung lhun phat un aman “Nanghon naheuve, Asia gamsung kahung chotlut nikhoa pat tuni chanin,
20.19: Kineosah tah le mitlhi pumin Pakai na katongin, Judate a kona gimbolna tamtah jong kathoh in ahi.
20.20: Chule nangho jahding imacha imlouvin, japi lah le intin'ah kahilleuvin ahi.
20.21: Juda te le Greek te henga thukhat seh hichu, chonsetna a kon lungheiya chule Pathen lama kiheiya, chule Pakai Yeshua tahsan ding thubou chu kasei jing ahi.
20.22: Tun keima Lhagaovin Jerusalema cheding in eisom tan, ipin einga ham jong kahepoi.
20.23: Khopi tina Lhagao Theng in eihetsah bangin thohgim nale songkul tanna tailou ima kahepoi.
20.24: Ahin Kahinkho hi Pakai Yeshuan einganse na banga midang te henga Pathen mingailut na kidangtah kipana thupha sapphong na natoh na a kamanchah lou le thildang aman nading kahepoi.
20.25: Chule tunia Pathen Lenggam thudol kaseipeh miho hin keima eimukit tah lou diu ahi.
20.26: Tu nikhoa hi kaphondoh ahi, keiman kitah tah a kaseipeh nahiuvin nalah uva koi tobang khat tonsot thina toh aumkhah a ahile keima thepmo ahi tapoi.
20.27: Ajeh chu Pathen in nangho hetsah dinga adeisah jouse imlou hel a kasei peh nahi tauve.
20.28: Chule tun, chingtheiyun, nanghon Pathen kelngoi hon, a thisan'a achohdoh houbung, chu vah unlang chingtup un, hiche dinga chu Lhagao Theng in upa a napansah-u ahi.
20.29: Ajeh chu kadalhah tengu le nangho lah a kona ngeihang tobang thuhillhem hunglut a kelngoi ho hi khatcha ahin hoilou ding kahei.
20.30: Chule nangho lah jenga jong hi mi phabep in amaho thu ahinjop a thutah chu akaleh a ahin hil dingu ahi.
20.31: Hijeh chun nangho kiging phauvin! Kumthum sunga asun ajana mitlhi tamtah puma kaumpiu chu geldoh jingun.
20.32: Chule tunia hi keiman nangho hi Pathen le amingailutna thu alhenchomte toh goulo khom dinga natungdoh theiyu thua chu kanganse nahiuve.
20.33: Keiman koima dangka le Sana chule nihchen ponsil hoi kaotcha poi.
20.34: Ajeh chu kakhut a kona keima ngaichat le kaum khompi ho ngaichat ding katoh a kakivah ahi.
20.35: Chule na hatoh a toh'a migenthei ho kithopi ding dan keima tah hinkhoa namu-u ahitai. Pakai Yeshuan ‘Akisan ho sanga apeho nunnom jo ahi’ ati chu geldoh jing un.”
20.36: Chuin thu asei jouvin adilsun amaho toh ataokhomun ahi.
20.37: Amaho abonchauvin akap'un akikoiyun damselin tin akikhen tauvin ahi.
20.38: Neimu kit tah lou diu ahi ati jeh chun amaho abonchauvin lungngui tah in ama chu kong muna agathah tauvin ahi.

21.1: Chuin Ephesus houbung upa ho henga lhahna thu asei jouvin, Cos twikol jonin konga kakitolun, ajing in Rhodes kalhung un chule chua kon chun Patara kajonun ahi.
21.2: Chua kon chun Phoenicia jonding kong khat ah katoudoh un,
21.3: Chule Cyprus twikol chu kagalmu phat un, veilama kakiheiyun Syria gam'a Tyre kongkaimun ah kakinga uvin hichea chun konga thilho chu asolhauvin ahi.
21.4: Chuin vapam achun kavah leuvin ahile seijui phabep kaga mudoh un, amaho koma chun hapta khat kaumun ahi. Hichea seijuiho chun Lhagao Thenga konin gaothu aseiyun, Paul chu Jerusalema chejom lou dingin aseiyun ahi.
21.5: Chuin hapta kichaiya konga kanung kaldoh ding phat un, mipi jouse, numei chapang jaonan, khopi sunga konin vapam chan'ah ahung kumsuh un, hichea chun, dilsun kataovun,
21.6: Chule lhahna thu kaseiyun chuin keiho konga toudoh ding in kacheuvin, amaho jong inlam cheh a akile tauvin ahi.
21.7: Tyre kadalhah jou uva kakingah nau masapen chu Ptolemais ahi. Hichea chun sopi numei le pasal ho chibai kaboh pauvin amaho henga chun nikhat kakibangpa uvin ahi.
21.8: Ajing in Caesarea lamah kache paiyun, an homle dinga mi sagi kilhengdoh ho lah a mikhat Evangelist Philip in'a chun kalhung tauvin ahi.
21.9: Amapa chun chanu jinei lou li aneiyin amaho chu abonun Lhagao thilpeh gaothu seina achangun ahi.
21.10: Chuin nikho tamtah jouvin Lhagao thilpeh gaothuseina chang Agabus kiti mikhat, Judea gam'a konin ahung in.
21.11: Paul konggah chu alan, ama khut le keng chu asomin, “Lhagao Theng in aphondoh ahi, hiche konggah neipa hi Jerusalema Judate lamkai hon amat uva chidang namdang te henga apeh doh dingu ahi,” ati.
21.12: Chuin hiche gaothusei kajah phatun keiho le amuna um seijui hon Paul henga Jerusalem ache lou na dingin kataovun ahi.
21.13: Ahinlah Paul in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga kap nahiuvem? Kalungthim nasujun uve! Keima chea songkul tanding mai mai hilouvin Pakai Yeshua min a thidinga jong gotsa kahitai,” ati.
21.14: Chuin keihon kahet chet phat un imacha kaseibe tapouvin, “Pakai lunglam himaihen,” katiuvin ahi.
21.15: Chujouvin kathilhou kagong tup un Jerusalema dingin kache tauvin ahi.
21.16: Chuin Caesarea a konin seijui phabep in eilhon piuvin, chuin Cyprus gammi seijui masaloi Mnason in'ah eipui lut un ahi.
21.17: Chuin Jerusalem kalhun un amuna um sopi numei le pasal hon phatechan eina vailhunun ahi.
21.18: Ajing in Paul jong Jacob toh kimuto ding in keiho toh kalhonun, hichea chun Jerusalem houbung upa ho jouse jong aumun ahi.
21.19: Chuin chibai aboh jouvun Paul in Pathen in chidang namdang te chunga kidang tah a na atoh ho abonchan aseitan ahi.
21.20: Chuin Paul thusei ajah phat un Pathen avahchoiyun ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun “Ngailut umtah sopipa Juda mi sang tamtah'in jong atahsan uva chule Mose danjong phatecha ajui uhi nahet em?
21.21: Ahinlah Jerusalema Judami atahsan ho hin, nangman chiding namdang te lah a cheng Juda mi seijui hon Mose dan anungsun dingun thu nahil e ti ajauvin, achateu chep atan lou diu chule chonna dan adang dang jong ajui lou diuvin thu nahil e ti aheuvin ahi.
21.22: Nangma nahung hila ahet teiding'u ahin, ipi ilo diu hitam? Atiuvin ahi.
21.23: Hijeh chun hiche nabol ding hi pha kasauve. Hichea hin kitepna neijou mili aumun, aluchang'u kivotol dinga kigong ahiuve.
21.24: Amaho toh hin lhon inlang Houin a gakisutheng unlang, chonna dan dungjuiya sam avo nadingun seipeh in, chutile mihon athujah jouseu hi alhem ahin, chule nangma tah jeng in jong Judate dan ajuinai ti hi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
21.25: Chidang namdang seijuite vang chu lekhathot a isei jouseu banga chon dingu ahi. Milim anga kikatdohsa an aneh lou dingu, thisan ahiloule hetlou sa aneh lou dingu, chule jonthanhoina a kona kikangse dingu ahi,” atiuve.
21.26: Chuin Paul chu ajing in hiche mili ho toh chun Houin a acheuvin, kisuhtheng na achelhah pi un, chule mipi angsunga chun phongtah in kisuhthengna nikho kichai niding le amichan cheh a kilhaina abol diu thu aseiyin ahi.
21.27: Chuin ni sagi kichai konin Asia gam'a kona Juda mi phabep in houin sunga Paul amudoh phat un, mipi chu atilseuvin aman tauvin ahi.
21.28: Chuin amahon aseiyun, “Israel mite nei kithopiuvin! Hiche mipa hin muntina eiho dounan thu asei jing in, chule mijouse koma Judate chonna dan ajui lou nadingun thu aseiye. Houin dounan thu aseiyin, chule Houin jenga jong chidang namdang te ahin puilut in asuboh in ahi” atiuve.
21.29: (Ajeh chu hiche masang jep'a chu Paul chu khopi sunga Ephesus mi Trophimus toh amu thau ahi. Paul chun hiche mipa chu Houin'ah puilut teiyinte tia agelu ahi.)
21.30: Chuin hiche ahehset nau hin khopi sung chu ahotling tan, chule boina asousang tan ahi. Chuin Paul chu houin'a konin gangtah in akaidoh un kelkot akhah chah tauvin ahi.
21.31: Chutia Paul tha ding agot laiyun, Jerusalem mite asousang thu chu Rome sepaite vaipi popa heng alhung tan ahi.
21.32: Gangtah in asepai hole alamkai hotoh mipi lah a chun achesuh tauvin ahi. Chuin mipi chun sepai vaipi popa le asepai ho hung kumsuh chu amu phat un Paul avoh'u chu anga tauvin ahi.
21.33: Chuin vaipipo chun Paul chu akan'in, thihkhao nia hen ding in thu apen, chuin mipi ho koma chun hiche mipa hi koiham chule ipi abolset ham tin adong tan ahi.
21.34: Chuin mi abangkhat in thilkhat asamin, chule abangkhat chun thildang khat ma asamun ahi. Chutia mipi eu jeh le kicheh loujeh chun ima thudih ahedoh thei tapon, hijeh chun Paul chu kulpi sunga apuilut ding'un thu apetan ahi.
21.35: Chuin Paul chu kulpi sung alut kigon ahile mipi ho jeh chun alut thei tapon hijeh chun ama ventup nading in sepai hon alengkouvun aput thouvin ahi.
21.36: Chuin mipi ho chun anung ajuiyun “Thatdoh un, thatdoh un,” tin asamun ahi.
21.37: Chuin Paul kulpi sung alhut ding konun, vaipipo koma atauvin, “Nakoma thukhat kasei thei ding ham? ati. Chuin vaipipo chun kidang satah in Greek pao nahet em, tin adong in ahi.
21.38: Nangma Egypt mi, masang laiya miho tilsea mi sangli gamthip'a loidoh pachu nahi louham?” ati.
21.39: Paul in adonbut in “Kahipoi, keima Tarsus gam'a khopi thupitah Cilicia a kon Judah mi kahibouve amaho toh hin nei kihousah in,” atin ahi.
21.40: Chuin vaipipo chun anoppeh jeh chun, Paul chu kalbi a chun ading in mipi ho chu thipbeh a umdingin atemin, chuin mipi thipchet'a aum phat in amaho pao Aramaic in ahoulimin ahi.

22.1: Chuin Paul in, “Sopite le jaumtah pateho, kakihonna thu kasei hi ngaiyuvin,”
22.2: Amaho paova thu asei chu ajah phat un mipi ho chu athipchet jengun,
22.3: Chuin Paul in, “Keima Tarsus gam'a Cilicia khopia peng Juda mi kahin, chule chihna thepna lama Jerusalema Gamaliel noiya hung seilen kahi. Ama noiya hung seilen khat kahi jeh chun Judate dan le chonna ho phatecha hung kijil kahi. Tunia nangho jouse banga hi Pathen a dinga tompan tah mi kana hin ahi.
22.4: Chule anung juiho ka sugentheiyin, abang kathat jin, chule numei pasal kamanin songkul'ah kakhum jin ahi.
22.5: Thempu chung nung le kivaihom na upa hon hiche hi eihetpeh-u ahi. Ajeh chu Damascus a um sopi Judate henga kahunga Christian ho kamat a suhgenthei dinga Jerusalema ka hin kai nadinga amaho koma phalna lekha kahin kichoi ahi.”
22.6: Ahin Damascus khopi lut ding kon lampi laitah ah, hichu sunkim ahin, hichun vana konin vah hattah khat in kakimvel ahin kho tan,
22.7: Keijong tol'a kalhu jeng in ahile aw khat kajan, “Saul, Saul, ipi dinga neibolset jing ham?” ahin tin ahi.
22.8: Chuin ken jong, “Nang koi nahim?” kati. Chuin aw chun eihin donbut in “Keima nabolset jing Nazareth Yeshua chu kahi” ahin tin ahi.
22.9: Chuin kakilhonpi miho chun vah chu amuvin, ahin kakoma thusei aw chun ipi asei ham ahe pouve.
22.10: Hichun “Ipi kabol ding ham Pakai” tin kadong in ahile, Pakaiyin eihin donbut in “Thoudoh inlang Damascus khosunga khun lut in chuteng ipi nabol ding nakisei peh ding ahi,” ati.
22.11: Vah hattah jeh a kamit in kho amutah lou jeh in kalhonpi ho chun kakhut in eikaiyun khopi sunga eikailut un ahi.
22.12: Hichea chun Ananias ana cheng in ama chu Pathen gingtah mi ahin Judate dan juithem tah le Damascus khopia um Judate jousen angaisang tah mi khat ahi.
22.13: Ama chu kakoma ahung ding in, “Sopipa Saul kho mukit tan atin ahile apettah chun ama chu kamu tan ahi.”
22.14: Chuin aman, “Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot lam heding le, dihtah pa mua, chule athu ngai dinga nalhen ahitai” ati.
22.15: Ajeh chu nangman namu hole najah ho jouse chu nasei phong le-a ama thu hettoh sah a napan ding ahitai.
22.16: Ipi nakhongai nahlai ham? Kipat doh in lang baptize chang tan, Pakai min kouvin lang nachonset soplhan eiti.
22.17: Chuin Jerusalem kahung kile chun Houin ah dilsun kataovin ahile,
22.18: Gaovin Yeshua kamun aman, “Kipat loiyin! Jerusalema kon in jamdoh in ajeh chu hiche laiya miho hin keima thudola nathusei asan lou dingu ahi” ati.
22.19: Ahin keiman kaseiyin, “Pakai kikhopna in tin aseijui ho kasuh gentheiya songkul'a kakhum jong ahesoh keiyuve”
22.20: Chule nasoh pa Stephen aselih pet uva asangkhol sutlhah hou akoinau koma ding jong chu kanahinai, kati.
22.21: Ahin Pakaiyin, “Chen gamlha tah a chidang namdang te lah a kasol ding nahi!” ati.
22.22: Hichun mipi hon chuche Paul thusei chu ajah phat un asamuvin, “Hitobang michu delmang un, ahing dinga jong lom ahipoi!” atiuvin ahi.
22.23: Chuin mipi chun a sangkholu asut un, vanlama vutvai atheuvin ahi.
22.24: Chuin Sepai vaipopa chun, Paul chu inpi sunga apuilut sah in, mipi achunga chubang tah a alunghannau ajeh seidoh sah ding ngaito nan jepsah ding in thu apetan ahi.
22.25: Chuin Paul chu jep dinga ahin kan phat un aman akoma ding sepai lamkai pa henga chun, “Rome mikhat athemmo na khol masa louva jep ding chu dan in aphal hinam?” tin adong in ahi.
22.26: Chuin sepai lamkai pan chuche ajah phat chun sepai vaipopa koma achen, “Ipi bol nahim? Amahi Rome mi hibouva hila!” atin ahi.
22.27: Chuin sepai vaipopa chu Paul henga ahung in, “Nangma Rome mi nahim? seiyin,” tin adong tan ahile Paul in jong “Kahinai,” ati.
22.28: Chuin sepai vaipopa chun aseiyin “Keijong sum tampi kapeh jouva Rome mihina chang kahi bouve,” atin ahile Paul in “Keivang kapena pat'a Rome mi a peng kahi,” ati.
22.29: Chuin Paul in Rome mi kahi ati ajahdoh phat in thudong dinga kigong sepai ho chu gang tah in apot doh tauvin ahi, chule sepai vaipopa jong chun chutobang thupeh anei jeh chun akicha lheh jeng in ahi.
22.30: Ajing nikhon Paul chung changa boina thu hetdoh nading in sepai vaipopa chun Judate kivaihom na a lamkai hole thempu ho chu hungkhom ding in thu apen, chule amaho masanga ding dingin Paul chu ana lhadoh tan ahi.

23.1: Chuin Paul in houvaipo ho chu ave changmel in, “Sopite ho, Pathen angsunga se le pha hetkhen na kicheh tah neiya hing jing kahi!”
23.2: Chuin thempu chungnung Ananias chun Paul toh kinaiya umho koma chun amuhsom abehpeh dingun thu apen ahi.
23.3: Ahin Paul in, “Phatlouna a dim miphalhem pa! Pathen in nangma nabeh ding ahi, itobang thutan mi nahiya nangman dan napal keh a chutobang a eibeng dinga mi thu napeh ham?” ati.
23.4: Chuin Paul kimvela ding ho chun, “Pathen thempu chungnung chu na housal ngam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
23.5: Paul in adonbut un, “Sopite ho, neingai damun, thempu chungnung ahilam kanahet lou ahi, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun ‘nalamkai te chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi’ tin akisune” ati.
